Moreover, it was said that during his visit there that year the emperor had received him no fewer than six times.
而且听说他今年进京，皇上召见六次之多，

He was enjoying exceptional imperial favour.
圣眷正隆，

Chunshou could not possibly prevail against him.
自己无论如何碰不过他。

These thoughts flashed through his mind like thunder and lightning, draining his courage.
这些念头雷轰电掣般闪过心头，顿感气馁，

Swallowing his anger, he could only apologise.
只得忍气吞声地陪个罪。


“Please do not be angry, Your Excellency.
“大人息怒。

How could I dare argue with you?
我岂敢跟大人抬杠？

I can only ask for your protection in this matter.”
一切还求大人维持。”


Only then did Huang's expression soften a little.
这一说，黄宗汉的脸色才和缓了一些，

“We are colleagues.
“既为同僚，

Naturally, I shall support you wherever I can.
能维持总要维持。

But...” He shook his head emphatically and pronounced each word with care. “Difficult. Very difficult.”
不过，“他使劲摇着头，一字一句地说：”难，难！“


Chunshou's heart sank further.
椿寿的心越发往下沉，

Forcing himself to remain calm, he asked, “What course would Your Excellency advise?
强自镇静着问道：“大人有何高见？

I beg you to instruct me.”
要请教诲。”


“Oh, I could hardly presume.
“岂敢，岂敢。

Let me think it over first.”
等我想一想再说吧！”


With that, Huang lifted his teacup.
说完，端一端茶碗，

An attendant waiting below called out loudly, “Show the guest out!”
堂下侍候的戈什哈便拉开嗓子：“送客！”


This dismissal amounted to an expulsion.
这送客等于逐客。

Chunshou left the governor's office and, once in his sedan chair, kept urging the bearers to go faster.
椿寿出了抚台衙门，坐在轿子里，只催轿扶加快，

Back at his own headquarters, he summoned his secretaries to his private office and shut the door.
急急赶回本衙门，让听差把文案请到“签押房”，关上房门，

After describing the interview in detail, he asked in alarm and uncertainty, “What do you think Governor Huang means by all this?”
细说了上院的经过，惊疑不定地问道：“各位看看，黄抚台这是什么意思？”


“His nickname is Huang the King of Hell.
“黄抚台外号‘黄阎罗’，

He is notorious for turning on people without warning.
翻脸不认人是出名的，

This business will need careful handling.”
这件事要好好铺排一下。”


“Ah!”
“唉！”

Chunshou shook his head, beginning to speak and then stopping.
椿寿摇摇头，欲言又止，

He regretted having ignored Huang's hint about a bribe when the new governor first arrived.
失悔在黄抚台刚到任，不理他索贿的暗示。


“‘A mountain of official business can be moved by a mountain of silver,’” one secretary said bluntly.
“ ‘天大的公事，地大的银子’，”有个文案说很很率直，

“We should first sound him out and learn what he really has in mind.”
“先去探探口气看，院上到底打的什么主意？”


They used their connections that very night to make inquiries and eventually obtained definite news.
于是连夜走路子去打听，总算有了确实的消息，

It was said that, to ensure next year's new grain could be accepted and loaded early and reach Tongzhou on time, Huang had decided to petition the throne to recall the boats of Huzhou's eight associations.
据说黄宗汉为了明年的新漕得以早日受兑装载，照限期抵达通州，决定上奏，把湖属八帮的瘤船追了回来，

Their grain would be unloaded and stored, then shipped together with next year's collection.
漕米卸岸入仓，连同明年的新漕，一起装运。


Such a measure would chiefly hurt the associations, which would have paid for the dredging to no purpose.
这样做法，只苦了漕帮，白白赔上一笔疏浚河道的费用。

The expectant magistrates appointed as escorts would suffer too: without official expense allowances to draw upon, the money they had hoped to take home for the New Year would vanish.
其次，那些奉委押运的候补州县，没有“公费”可派，一笔过年的盘缠便落空了。

Chunshou felt sorry for them, but their troubles were, after all, their own.
椿寿心中虽有不忍，但到底是别人的事，

If the provincial treasury could escape a loss, that was already the best he could hope for.
藩司能够不赔，已是上上大吉，

He would have to harden his heart and leave them to it.
只好狠一狠心不理他们了。


Sure enough, an official order arrived from the governor's office the next day.
果然，第二天抚台衙门来了正式公事，

To avoid disrupting the schedule for the following year's grain, “all boats belonging to this year's eight Huzhou associations are to be recalled without delay, in full compliance with this order, and held pending further instructions.”
惟恐影响来年新漕的期限，“所有本年湖属八帮漕船，仰该司即便遵照，全数追回，候命办理。”

Chunshou dared not hesitate.
椿寿不敢怠慢，

He immediately sent men to intercept the boats and bring them back, then went to the governor's office to ask what the “further instructions” would be.
立即派出人去，把湖属八帮的漕船截了回来，同时上院去见抚台，请示所谓“候命办理”是如何办法？


Huang repeatedly declined to see him, pleading illness.
黄宗汉一直托病不见。

Five or six days later, another official dispatch arrived.
过了有五、六天，一角公文送到，

Chunshou opened it and almost fainted.
拆开一看，椿寿几乎昏厥，

Stamping his foot, he cried, “Huang Shouchen! Huang Shouchen! How can you be so cruel?
顿足骂道，“黄寿臣，黄寿臣，你好狠的心！

What wrong have I done you that you must drive me to my death?”
我与你问冤何仇，你要置我于死地！“


Huang's methods were indeed ruthless.
黄宗汉的手段，的确太毒辣了，

Invoking his authority as the province's highest administrative official and his responsibility for the entire grain-transport system, he had issued a decision. To ensure that the following year's grain arrived on schedule and that regular arrangements could thereafter be restored, this year's grain from Huzhou's eight associations would remain in Zhejiang and be sold.
他以一省最高行政长官的地位，统筹漕运全局的理由，为了使来年新漕的输运，如期完成，以期此后各年均得恢复正常，作了一个决定，本年湖属八帮的漕米，留浙变价，

The total quantity was 276,000 shi.
全部漕米二十七万六千石，

At the Board of Revenue's prescribed rate of two taels per shi, the proceeds due were 552,000 taels, to be remitted within one month.
照户部所定价格，每石二两银子，共该五十五万二千两，限期一个月报缴。


Chunshou and the headman had already worked out what this meant: the gap between the market price and the official rate was some 330,000 taels.
这是椿寿与尖丁早已算过了的，市价与部价的差额，一共要三十三万两银子。

Had the governor made this decision before Chunshou's first meeting in Huzhou, the associations would have borne the larger share and the provincial treasury the smaller.
如果在他第一次到湖州开会之前，抚台就作了这个决定，那么漕帮赔大部分，藩司赔小部分，

The treasury's portion could still have been drawn from the excess collections.
这笔小部分的赔款，也还可以在浮收的款项中拨付，

In effect, everyone would merely have worked for nothing that year and forfeited their customary gains.
说起来只是今年白吃一场辛苦，没有“好处”而已。

Now the situation was entirely different.
但现在的情况完全不同了，

The associations had paid the full cost of dredging and had explicitly stipulated that, once the money was spent, the boats must sail.
漕帮负担了疏浚河道的全部经费，事先已经声明，出了这笔钱，漕船非走不可，

Recalling them already left Chunshou ashamed.
于今截回不定，已觉愧对漕帮，

He could hardly ask them to contribute towards the price shortfall as well, even if they were willing—which, from all appearances, they certainly were not.
再要他们分赔差额，就是漕帮肯赔，自己也难启齿，何况看情形是决无此可能的。


As for the profits from excess collection, those had already been divided into shares and distributed among the people concerned.
至于浮收的“好处”，早已按股照派，“分润”有夫人员，

How could they now be recovered?
哪里再去追索？

Even if recovery were possible, they amounted to only fifty or sixty thousand taels, far short of what was needed.
即使追索得到，也不过五、六万银子，还差着一大截呢！


Events had somehow left the entire burden resting on Chunshou alone.
事情的演变，竟会弄得全部责任，落在自己一个人头上。

Tormented by regret and anger, he nevertheless had to make one last desperate effort.
椿寿悔恨交并，而仍不能不拼命作最后的挣扎，

With a miserable expression, he called his trusted advisers together.
愁眉苦脸地召集了亲信来商议，

They all reached the same conclusion: only the man who had tied the knot could untie it.
大家一致的看法是：“解铃还须系铃人”，

He must beg the governor to withdraw the order to sell the grain and allow the more than two hundred thousand shi to be shipped with the next year's collection.
惟有去求抚台，收回“变价”的成命，应解的二十多万石漕米，随明年新漕一起启运。

Unloading it now, storing it on shore, and loading it again the following year would still cost tens of thousands of taels in handling charges, storage fees, and losses from repeated movement.
就这样起卸入仓，从船上搬到岸上，明年再从岸上搬到船上，来回周折的运费、仓费，以及两次搬动的损耗，算起来也要赔好几万两银子，

A disciplinary penalty would also be unavoidable.
而且一定还会受到处分，

Even so, it would be better than finding 330,000 taels.
但无论如何总比赔三十三万两银子来得好。


Choosing the lesser of two evils, Chunshou steeled himself and went to the governor's office.
两害相权取其轻，椿寿只得硬着头皮上院，

He sent in his visiting card, but the gatekeeper returned with a message.
把“手本”送了进去，门上出来答道：

“His Excellency is unwell and asks you to go home.
“上头人不舒服，请大人回去吧！

He says he will invite you to call when he has recovered.”
上头交代，等病好了，再请大人过来相叙。”


Chunshou's anger became uncontrollable.
棒寿愤不可遏，

“Go back and fetch my bedding,” he told his attendant.
吩咐跟班说：“回去取铺盖！

“If the governor will not see me, I shall not leave.
抚台不见我不走，

I can sleep on the couch in the reception hall.”
就借官厅的炕床睡。”


Seeing how unseemly the situation was becoming, the gatekeeper hastened to placate him.
门上一看，这不象话，赶紧陪笑道：

“There is no need, Your Excellency, no need at all!
“大人不必，不必！

You must have some urgent official matter to report.
想来是有急要公事要回，

I shall go to the inner quarters once more.”
我再到上房去跑一趟。”


Chunshou waited in the reception hall.
于是椿寿就在官厅中坐等，

After about an hour, Huang appeared, head raised and face stern.
等了半个时辰，黄宗汉出来了，仰着头，板着脸，

Before Chunshou could speak, he demanded loudly, “You insist on seeing me?”
一见面不等椿寿开口，就先大声问道：“你非见我不可？”


“Yes,” Chunshou replied humbly.
“是！”椿寿低声下气地回答：

“I ought not to disturb Your Excellency during your illness, but I am in the greatest difficulty and must explain my circumstances.”
“大人贵恙在身，本不该打搅，只是实在有万分困难的下情上禀。”


“If it concerns the Huzhou grain, there is no need to say anything.
“如果是湖属漕米的事，你不必谈。

I have already reported the decision to the throne.”
已经出奏了。”


The words struck him like a thunderbolt.
这句话就如焦雷轰顶，

The room seemed to spin, and he collapsed into a seat.
一时天旋地转，不得不颓然坐倒，

When he recovered enough to look around, Huang had vanished.
等定定神看时，黄宗汉已无踪影，

An attendant said softly, “Please go home, Your Excellency.
抚院的戈什哈低声向他说道：“大人请回吧！

Your chair has been waiting for some time.”
轿子已经伺侯半天了。”


Chunshou closed his eyes.
椿寿闭上眼，

Two tears escaped from their corners.
眼角流出两滴眼泪，

He wiped them away with the curved cuffs of his robe and, supported by an attendant, left the hall, each step more reluctant than the last.
拿马蹄袖拭一拭干净，由听差扶掖着，一步懒似一步地走官厅。


That night, Chunshou hanged himself in the private office behind the provincial treasury.
就在这天晚上，椿寿在藩司衙门后院的签押房里，上吊自杀。

His household discovered him early the next morning, and their cries of grief filled the compound.
第二天一早为家人发觉，哭声震动内外，

Someone inevitably seized the opportunity to curry favour by rushing the unhappy news to the governor.
少不得有人献殷勤，把这个不幸的消息，飞报抚台。


Huang knew at once that he was in trouble.
黄宗汉一听，知道闯了祸，

Driving an official of the second rank to his death was no minor offence.
逼死二品大贝，罪名不轻。

Then he remembered an earlier case.
但转念想起一重公案，

If he could follow the same procedure, perhaps he would be safe.
觉得可以如法炮制，

The thought eased half his fear.
心便放了一半。


The case he recalled was that of Wang Ding of Pucheng, Shaanxi, who had taken his own life as a final remonstrance ten years earlier.
他想起的是陕西蒲城王鼎尸谏的往事，这重公案发生在十年以前，

Wang and the corrupt minister Mujangga had both been grand secretaries serving on the Grand Council.
王鼎与奸臣穆彰阿，同为大学士值军机。

Wang, known as the grand secretary from Pucheng, was fierce in temperament and hated wrongdoing.
这位“蒲城相国”性情刚烈，嫉恶如仇，

Mujangga was subtle, yielding in manner, and treacherous.
而遇到穆彰阿是阴柔奸险的性格，

When they argued before the Daoguang emperor, one spoke with visible anger while the other remained composed.
每在御前争执，一个声色俱厉，一个从容自如，

The emperor, swayed by one side and failing to see clearly, invariably felt that Wang had gone too far.
宣宗偏听不明，总觉得王鼎不免过分。


In the twenty-second year of Daoguang, Wang Ding pressed for Lin Zexu's restoration to office and went so far as to hang himself in remonstrance, leaving a memorial that bitterly denounced Mujangga.
道光二十二年，为了保荐林则徐夏用，王鼎不惜自杀尸谏，遗疏痛劾穆彰阿。

A Grand Council secretary named Chen Fu'en, one of Mujangga's henchmen, noticed that Wang had neither attended duty nor asked for leave.
那时有个军机章京叫陈孚恩，是穆彰阿的走狗，一看王鼎不曾入值，亦未请假，

Growing suspicious, he found an excuse to leave the palace and hurried to Wang's residence.
心里一支，借故出宫，赶到王鼎家一看，

The sound of overwhelming grief confirmed his fears.
听得哭声震天，越发有数。

Wang's son, Wang Kang, a compiler in the Hanlin Academy, was dazed by the sudden calamity. Taking advantage of his confusion, Chen urged him to have the body lowered and at the same time secured the final memorial.
趁王鼎的儿子，翰林院编修王抗骤遭大故，五中昏瞀的当儿，劝他把王鼎的尸首解下来，同时把遗疏抓到手里，

Its contents were exactly what he had expected.
一看内容，不出所料，

He then advised Wang Kang to think of his own future and avoid offending Mujangga.
便又劝王抗以个人前程为重，不必得罪穆彰阿，

He added that the emperor already held a poor opinion of Wang Ding and that a senior minister's suicide damaged the dignity of the state.
又说“上头”对王鼎印象不佳，而大臣自杀，有伤国体，

If the emperor became angry, the family might lose not only the customary posthumous honours but also face unforeseen disaster.
说不定天颜震怒，不但王鼎身后的恤典落空，而且别有不测之祸。


Threats and promises together deceived Wang Kang.
这一番威胁利诱，教王抗上了当，

He accepted Mujangga's alteration of the final memorial, and his father's death was reported as the result of sudden illness.
听从穆彰阿更改遗疏，并以暴疾身故奏报。

The Daoguang emperor had some suspicions, but Mujangga had arranged matters so thoroughly that the truth could not reach the throne.
宣宗也有些疑心，但穆彰阿布置周密，“上头”无法获知真相，

The affair was allowed to rest.
也就算了。


Chen Fu'en profited handsomely from this service.
陈孚恩帮了穆彰阿这个大忙，收获也下小，

Before long, Mujangga recommended him for the governorship of Shandong.
不久，穆彰阿就保他当山东巡抚。

Wang Kang, on the other hand, was despised for failing to fulfil his father's purpose—by his father's protégés, by his own examination classmates, and by fellow natives of Shaanxi and Gansu.
而王抗则以不能成父之志，为他父亲的门生，他自己的同年，以及陕甘同乡所不齿，

He resigned, returned home, and died in sorrow.
辞官回里，郁郁以终。


Mujangga had been chief examiner at the metropolitan examination in the yiwei year, the fifteenth year of Daoguang.
穆彰阿是道光十五年乙未科会试的大主考，

Huang Zonghan was therefore one of his examination protégés and had diligently cultivated his patron.
黄宗汉是他的门生，颇为巴结这位老师。

Just as Qin Hui had once had his “Ten Guests,” Mujangga had his “Ten Sons.”
秦桧门下有“十客”，穆彰阿门下有“十子”，

Huang and Chen Fu'en both belonged to that circle, so Huang knew the Wang Ding affair very well.
黄宗汉与陈孚恩都在“穆门十子”之数，自然熟知其事。

As soon as Chunshou's death occurred, he sent trusted men to secure Chunshou's final statement, aiming to remove the danger at its source.
所以，一遇椿寿的变故，他立即遣派亲信，以釜底抽薪的宗旨，先设法把椿寿的遗嘱弄到手，

He then personally visited the commander of the local banner garrison and Zhejiang's education commissioner.
然后亲自拜访驻防的将军和浙江学政，

Both were entitled to submit independent memorials to the throne.
因为这两个人是可以专折奏事的，

He first had to secure their cooperation if the truth was to be kept from the emperor.
先要把他们稳住，才可以不使真相上闻。


Meanwhile, he used intermediaries to ask banner officials to placate Chunshou's family, then reported that the provincial treasurer's post had fallen vacant.
当然，另一方面他还要间接拜托旗籍的官员，安抚椿寿的家属，然后奏报藩司出缺。

The suicide itself could not be concealed.
上吊自杀是瞒不住的，

Huang therefore attached a supplementary note: “The administration of Zhejiang's revenues and grain entails many expenditures.
所以另外附了个“夹片”，说是“浙江钱漕诸务支出，

This year, prolonged drought and a poor harvest have made collection and remittance especially difficult.
本年久旱岁歉，征解尤难，

Fearing that official business would suffer, the treasurer grew anxious day and night until, overcome by desperation, he took his own life.”
该司恐误公事，日夜焦急，以至迫切轻生。”

He made no mention of the order to retain and sell the Huzhou grain.
把湖属八帮应运漕米，留浙变价的事，只字不提，

He also submitted an altered copy of Chunshou's final statement.
同时录呈了经过修改的椿寿的遗嘱。

The Xianfeng emperor, newly enthroned and still quite discerning, was struck by two phrases in it: “Driven by the circumstances, I can no longer live.”
咸丰帝此时初登大宝，相当精明，看遗嘱内有“因情节所逼，势不能生”两句话，大为疑惑，

Even if official business was difficult, why should it lead so abruptly to suicide?
认为即令公事难办，何至遽尔自尽？

Suspecting another cause, he ordered Huang to “make further detailed inquiries and report the facts, concealing nothing.”
是否另有别情，命令黄宗汉“再行详细访察，据实奏闻，毋稍隐饰。”


Zhejiang's education commissioner, Wan Qingli, then submitted his own memorial.
接着，浙江学政万青藜也有专折奏报，

He stated that Chunshou had left a final declaration and “had indeed taken his own life because official business had become intractable.”
说椿寿身后，留有遗嘱，“实因公事棘手，遽行自尽。”

This neatly echoed Huang's account.
与黄宗汉的奏折，桴鼓相应。

The emperor replied: “An order has already been issued directing Huang Zonghan to investigate thoroughly and report.
皇帝批示：“已有旨，令黄宗汉详查具报。

Since you are in the provincial capital, you too may submit a factual report if anything comes to your attention.”
汝近在省垣，若有所闻，亦可据实具奏。”


The affair seemed likely to grow serious, but only Huang knew where the real danger lay.
看来事情要闹得很大，但事态真正严重的关键所在，只有黄宗汉自己知道。

If Chunshou had truly killed himself merely because Huang's administrative measures were severe, Huang might feel guilty and bear moral responsibility, yet he could still defend his official conduct.
因为椿寿的自尽，如果真的是由于他的措施严峻、则虽良心有愧，亦不过课以道义上的责任，在公事上可以交代得过，

There would have been little to fear.
那就不必有所畏惧。

But that was not what had happened.
而事实上并非如此，

Chunshou had died because of a false statement Huang had used to intimidate him.
椿寿之死，是死在他虚言恫吓的一句话上。


The proposal to retain and sell the grain in Zhejiang had been devised to make Chunshou's life difficult.
所谓“留浙变价”，原是黄宗汉有意跟椿寿为难的一种说法，

In private, Huang did not insist upon it.
暗地里他并不坚持这样做，

Indeed, he had kept another course in reserve so that, if Chunshou could not comply, he himself would still have room to manoeuvre.
不但不坚持，他还留着后手，以防椿寿无法做到时，自己有转圜的余地。


With excellent connections in both the Grand Council and the Board of Revenue, Huang was entirely confident about securing sea transport for the following year's grain and about the arrangements for this year's Huzhou grain, which could not be sent north within the prescribed time.
由于在军机处和户部都有极好的关系，所以黄宗汉对来年新漕改用海运，以及本年湖属各帮漕米，不能如限北运的处置办法，都有十足的把握，

Private correspondence had already brought these matters close to agreement.
私底下书函往还，几乎已有成议。

Chunshou had no way of knowing this, and Huang deliberately kept him in the dark.
但这些情形，椿寿无从知道，他亦瞒着不说。

Claiming that sea transport remained uncertain and that the canal boats could not return on schedule, Huang ordered the fleet recalled and the grain sold in Zhejiang.
以改用海运并无把握，河运粮船难以依限回空的理由，下令截回漕船，留浙变价，

These measures were wholly at odds with the reforms he had actually proposed to the throne.
这一套措施与他所奏报的改革办法，完全不符。

When he told Chunshou that the decision to sell the grain had “already been reported,” he made it appear that matters had reached an immovable barrier and that no remedy remained.
他向椿寿所说的，留浙变价一事，“已经出奏”，事情到了推车撞壁的地步，再也无可挽回，

That was what persuaded Chunshou that he had reached a dead end and could only die.
这才使椿寿感到已入绝路，不能不一死了之。

In fact, the claim that the decision had already been reported was a complete fabrication.
其实，“已经出奏”这句话，根本是瞎说。


That lie alone made Huang fully responsible for Chunshou's death.
就凭这句谎言，黄宗汉便得对椿寿之死，负起全部责任。

He therefore had to do everything possible to conceal the truth from the throne.
因而他必须多方设法掩饰遮盖，不使真相上闻，

While persuading Wan Qingli and others to help sustain the deception, he sent trusted men to the capital with large sums of money to work on his behalf.
一面活动万青藜等人，帮着他瞒谎，一面遣派亲信，携带巨贤，到京师活动。

With someone like Grand Councillor Peng Yunzhang, of course, bribery was neither necessary nor possible.
当然，象军机大臣彭蕴章那里，是不必也不能行贿的，

Huang could only appeal to their bond as examination classmates and ask for his protection.
只有以同年的身份，拜托关顾照应。


Even so, a case like this could not easily be suppressed.
不过这样一件案子，也不是轻易压得下去的。

Chunshou belonged to the Upper Three Banners and had highly placed relatives.
椿寿是“上三旗”的旗人，亲戚之中，颇有贵官，

They suspected that his death had a hidden cause and naturally spoke up for him.
认为他的死因可疑，自然要出头为他讲话，

If the Grand Council was to help Huang, it would have to take some pains to conceal what it was doing.
这样军机处要帮黄宗汉的忙，就不能不费一番手脚，来遮人耳目。


In such circumstances, established practice called for a senior official to conduct a secret investigation.
照一向的惯例，类似这种情况，一定简派大员密查。

Naturally, the person under investigation was not supposed to know.
既称密查，自然不能让被查的人知道，

Yet the departure from the capital of a first- or second-rank official could hardly be hidden.
可是一二品的大员出京，无论如何是件瞒不住的事，

Various methods were therefore used to disguise his route and assignment.
于是便有许多掩护其行踪及任务的方法，

One was to announce one destination while aiming at another.
一种是声东击西，

A public edict might, for instance, order a named official to proceed urgently to Jiangsu to investigate a case.
譬如明发上谕：“着派某某人驰往江苏查案”，

Travelling as an imperial commissioner, he would receive elaborate honours along the way.
这人便是“钦差”的身分，所经之处，接待的礼节极其隆重。

On reaching Jinan, however, he would suddenly stop.
这样一路南下，到了济南，忽然不定了，

Using his commissioner's seal, he would send the governor of Shandong a list of people to be summoned immediately, launching the investigation before anyone had time to prepare.
用钦差大臣的关防，咨会山东巡抚，开出一张名单，请即传提到案，迅雷不及掩耳地展开了查案的工作。


Another method was to use an outwardly ordinary appointment as cover: a senior official leaving the capital to take up a provincial post would receive secret instructions to investigate a case elsewhere on the way.
再有一种是暗渡陈仓，乘某某大员外放到任的机会，密谕赴某处查案。


Such instructions were not published in the official court gazette, so the province concerned knew nothing of them.
这道密谕照例不发“邸抄”，被查的省分，毫无所知，

On reaching his destination, the investigator called on the governor-general or governor and produced the secret edict.
行到目的地，拜访总督或巡抚，出示密谕，

A major judicial inquiry could thus erupt overnight.
于是一夕之间，可以掀起大狱。

This was the method chosen to investigate Huang's role in driving Chunshou to his death.
查黄宗汉逼死椿寿一案，就是用的这一种办法，

Outwardly, there was therefore no sign that Huang was in trouble—another favour done him by the Grand Council.
所以在表面上看不出黄宗汉出了毛病的痕迹。这当然又是军机处帮他的忙。


The commissioner chosen was He Guiqing, Huang's examination classmate.
这位钦差名叫何桂清，是黄宗汉的同年。

Among the successful candidates of their yiwei year, He was relatively young.
在他们乙未一榜中，何桂清的年纪比较轻，

Handsome, refined in speech, and graceful in manner, he was exceptionally well liked.
仪表清俊，吐嘱渊雅，人缘极好。

That autumn he had been transferred from a vice-presidency at the Board of Revenue to the post of education commissioner in Jiangsu.
这年秋天，由户部侍郎外放江苏学政，

So many farewell engagements awaited him in the capital that his departure was repeatedly delayed.
在京里饯行送别的应酬甚多，所以一直迟迟不能启程。

Chunshou's case arose while he was making ready to leave.
就在这殷摒挡行囊，准备到任的期间内，出了椿寿这件案子，

After consulting other examination classmates in the capital, Peng Yunzhang proposed that He be secretly instructed to investigate it on his way to Jiangsu.
彭蕴章和他一些在京同年商量的结果，奏请密派问桂清于赴江苏学政途中，顺道查办。

The emperor suspected something about Chunshou's death, but had not imagined that Huang, whom he trusted, was responsible.
“上头”只对椿寿的死因怀疑，不曾想到是他所信任的黄宗汉干的好事，

He therefore saw no reason to object to He's relationship with Huang and approved the Grand Council's recommendation.
自然不会以何桂清与黄是同年为嫌，便准了军机处的建议。


The news reached Hangzhou swiftly and in strict secrecy.
这个消息，很快、很秘密地传到了杭州，

To Huang, it was profoundly reassuring.
黄宗汉等于服下一位定心丸。


With an imperial commission now entrusted to him, He Guiqing dared delay no longer.
何桂清以钦命在身，不敢耽搁，

As the year drew to its close, he left the capital and headed south.
也就在岁暮之际，出京南下。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第二章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Two, first part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER TWO｜第二章


On that very day, Wang Youling arrived at North Tongzhou.
就在同一天，王有龄到了北通州。

Leaving Hangzhou, he had taken a black-canopied boat to Suzhou and then boarded a grain boat heading north.
他从杭州动身，坐乌篷船到苏州，然后换搭漕船北上，

Unfortunately, his journey coincided with the breach north of Fengxian.
偏偏又逢丰北决口，

He had to leave the water and travel by cart, yet he was unwilling to spend more than necessary.
舍舟换车，却又舍不得多花盘缠，

Along the way, he asked innkeepers to find carts or boats on which he could share a ride.
一路托客店代找便车、便船，

This saved considerable expense but wasted so much time that nearly half a year passed before he reached North Tongzhou.
花费固然省得多，时间却虚掷了，以至于走了几乎半年，才到北通州。


The town was a major junction for travel by land and water.
这里是个水陆大码头，

The granary vice-minister was stationed there, and countless local people earned their living from the grain boats and warehouses.
仓场侍郎驻扎在此，当地靠漕船、廒仓为生的，不知其数。

It was now the busy season, when southern fleets converged and their rice was brought into storage.
这时正是南漕云集、漕米入仓的旺季。

The transport associations had all sorts of official and private dealings with the registered grain-handling operators, while the boatmen's private cargoes also had to be unloaded for sale.
漕帮与“花户”，有各种公务私事接头，漕丁所带的私货，也要运上岸来销售，

Teahouses, taverns, inns, and bathhouses were crowded everywhere.
因此茶坊酒肆、客店浴池，到处都是客满。

Wang hired a porter to carry his two bundles of luggage on a shoulder pole and tried several inns, but could find nowhere to stay.
王有龄雇了个脚伕，挑着一担行李，运投数处客店，找不到下榻之处。


At last he came to the Xingfa Inn outside the west gate.
最后到了西关一家“兴发店”，

There were relatively few people, carts, or horses loitering at its entrance.
看门口的闲人车马还不多，

This one ought to do, he thought.
王有龄心想：这一处差不多了。

Repeated refusals had taught him something: a polite request at the counter was all too easily turned down.
几次碰壁的经验，让他学了个乖，跟柜上好言商量，反而易于见拒。

Better to put on an official air and intimidate the tradesmen.
不如拿出官派来，反倒可以把买卖人唬倒。


He straightened his riding jacket, took a large pair of dark smoky-quartz spectacles from his breast, put them on, and strode inside.
于是，他把身上那件马褂扯一扯平，从怀中取出来一副茶晶大墨镜戴上，昂然直入，

An attendant hurried to meet him.
伙计赶紧迎出来，

Before the man could speak, Wang issued an imposing command: “Find me a quiet room.”
他不等他开口，先就大模大样地吩咐：“给找一间清静的屋子。”


Smiling respectfully, the attendant first asked, “May I have your honourable surname, sir?”
伙计陪着笑先请教：“你老贵姓？”


“Wang.”
“王。”


“Ah.
“喔，

You have come from the south, I presume?”
想是从南边来？”


“Mm,” Wang replied.
“嗯。”王有龄答道：

“I am going to the capital on business at the Board of Civil Appointments.”
“我上京到吏部公干。”


The attendant had seen plenty of officials awaiting appointment and had recognised the type at a glance.
那伙计对这些候补官儿见得多了，一望便知，

Now that Wang had confirmed it, he changed his form of address.
现在由他自己口中证实，便改了称呼：

“Your Honour Wang!”
“王老爷！”

Then, hesitating, he added, “We do still have two rooms, but I am afraid I cannot let you have either.”
然后踌躇着说：“屋子倒是还有两间，不敢让王老爷住！”


“Why not?”
“为什么？”


“The department magistrate's office has sent someone to reserve them.
“知州衙门派人来定下了。

An imperial commissioner is expected in a day or two, with a large entourage.
有位钦差大人一半天就到，带的人很多，

Every vacant room in the inns outside the west gate has been booked.
西关这几家客店的空房，全给包了。

I am very sorry, Your Honour, but perhaps you could try elsewhere.”
实在对不起，王老爷再找一家看看。”

He made another respectful salute, repeating, “Please forgive us, Your Honour.”
说着又请了个安，连声：“王老爷包涵。”


The man's manner left Wang no grounds for an unreasonable demand.
看他这副神情，王有龄不便再说不讲理的话，

He could only return to persuasion.
依然只好软商量：

“I've already tried several places.
“我已经走了好几家，

You really must help me find a room.
务必托你想办法，给腾一间屋子。

I'll stay just one night and leave first thing tomorrow.”
我住一宿，明天一早就走。”


A stay of one night was easier to accommodate.
只住一宿，便好说话，

The attendant agreed to consult the proprietor.
伙计答应跟柜上去商量。


The guests innkeepers dreaded most were the military officers from the grain boats.
柜上最头痛的客人，是漕船上的武官，

Their rank was low, but their airs were grand.
官儿不大，官架子大，

They shouted abuse at the slightest provocation, struck attendants who answered back, and made trouble whenever the service fell short.
动辄“混帐王八蛋”地骂，伙计回句嘴就得挨打，伺侯得稍欠周到便要闹事。

As mere captains and lieutenants, they were not even senior enough to serve as personal attendants to a governor-general or governor.
他们以“千总”、“把总”的职称，给总督、巡抚当“戈什哈”还不够格的官儿，

They dared behave so outrageously because their associations stood behind them.
敢于如此蛮横无理，就因为有他们的“帮”在撑腰。

The grain-transport men also had a secret organisation, so closely guarded that outsiders could learn nothing of its inner workings.
漕帮暗中还有组织，异常隐秘，局外的“空子”无从窥其堂奥，

All anyone knew was that they were fiercely united.
所知道的就是极其团结，

At a shout of “Fight!” every fist would rise, and they would smash the inn to pieces before anything else.
一声喊“打”，个个伸拳，先砸烂客店再说。

If a lawsuit followed, so be it: men and money could be produced at a word.
至于闹出事来，打官司就打官司，要人要钱，呼叱立办，

No inn could possibly stand against them.
客店里是无论如何斗不过他们的。

In such circumstances, invoking a government reservation was the simplest way to avoid endless trouble.
所以遇到这样的情形，干脆往官府一推，倒省了多少麻烦。


Wang was different.
但王有龄不同，

He too gave himself official airs, but he was courteous and cultivated, and did not look unreasonable.
虽然也有些官架子，文质彬彬，不象个不讲理的人，

Nor did he appear to be one of those hardened travellers who knew every trick and were difficult to manage.
再说，看他也不象习干行旅，相当难缠的“老油子”，

The proprietor therefore agreed to take him in, subject to one condition.
因而答应容留，但有一句话要声明在先。


“Your Honour Wang,” the attendant said, “there is something we must make clear beforehand.
“王老爷！”那伙计说：“有句话说在头里，

We hear that the commissioner has already left the capital.
听说钦差已经出京了，

We cannot be sure whether he will arrive tonight or tomorrow morning.
是今天晚上到，还是明天早晨列，可保不定，

If he comes tonight, we shall have to ask you to put up with some inconvenience.
倘或今天晚上到呢，那就只好委屈您老了。

Of course, we won't leave you with nowhere to sleep.
话说回来，也不能让您老没有有地方住，

But... well, in that case, you would have to squeeze onto the big heated sleeping platform with the rest of us.”
不过……嘿、嘿，那时候，只好跟我们一起在大炕上挤一挤了。“


“Certainly, certainly!”
“行，行！”

Exhausted by his journey, Wang was entirely satisfied and readily agreed.
疲累不堪的王有龄，心满意足，满口应承：

“As long as there is somewhere to sleep, that will do.”
“只需有地方睡就行了。”


The attendant found him a single room in the western side courtyard.
于是伙计在西跨院给他找了个单间。

Wang paid the porter and had his luggage brought in.
开发了脚夫，把行李拿到屋内。

The attendant, whose name was Liu Si, supplied tea and water, then chatted with him about his journey as he unwrapped his bedding.
那伙计叫刘四，伺候了茶水，一面替他解铺盖，一面就跟他搭话，问问来踪去迹。

Once Wang had washed and settled down with his tea, Liu brought an oil lamp and asked what he would like for supper.
等他洗完脸喝茶休息的时候，拿来一盏油灯，顺便问他晚饭怎么吃？


Reaching Tongzhou felt almost like reaching the capital itself, and Wang was in a relaxed mood.
到了通州就等于到了京城了，王有龄心情颇为悠闲，

He ordered two dishes and a pot of clear grain liquor, which he drank slowly.
要了两个碟子，一壶白干，慢慢喝着。

Pleasantly tipsy, he was recalling his days with Hu Xueyan when the door curtain lifted and someone asked, “Would Your Honour care to hear a song?”
正醺醺然在回忆与胡雪岩相处的那一段日子，只见门帘一掀，随即有人问道：“老爷！听个曲儿吧？”


The voice was clear and lively.
说话的声音倒还脆，

Looking up, Wang saw a woman of about thirty, her face heavily powdered and her hair arranged in a high “magpie's tail,” jingling with silver pins and little gold bells.
王有龄抬眼一看，是个三十岁左右的妇人，擦了一脸的粉，梳得高高的一个“喜鹊尾巴”，叮铃当啷插着些银钗小金铃的。

She wore a green jacket, black trousers, and embroidered red shoes scarcely larger than rice dumplings.
绿袄黑裤，下面穿一双粽子大的绣花红鞋。

On closer inspection, her complexion was rather dark, but every movement of her eyes seemed to overflow with charm.
重新再看到她脸上，皮肤黑一些，那眼睛却顾盼之间，娇韵欲流。

Half drunk and looking at her by lamplight, Wang thought her a perfect beauty.
王有龄有了五分酒意，醉眼又是灯下，看过去便是十足的美人了。


He had encountered this kind of business several times on his journey north.
这北道上的勾当他也领教过几次，

Beckoning, he said, “Come here.”
便招一招手说：“过来！”


The woman smiled, waved to the older woman behind her, and entered alone.
那妇人嫣然一笑，向她身后的老妇摆一摆手，然后一个人走了进来，

After a respectful greeting, she asked, “May I know your surname, sir?”
请个安问道：“老爷贵姓啊？”


“Wang.
“我姓王。”

And yours?”
王有龄问她：“你呢？”


“They call me Jincui.”
“小名儿叫金翠。”


“Jincui.
“金翠！

Mm, yes.”
嗯，嗯！”

He examined her once more from head to foot and nodded his approval.
他把她从头到脚，又细细端详了一番，点点头表示满意。


“Are you here alone, Your Honour?”
“王老爷，就是一个人？”


“Yes, alone.” Wang added, “Go out for now.
“对了，一个人。”王有龄又说，“你先出去，

I'll ask Liu Si to call you later.”
回头我找刘四来招呼你。”


Jincui gave him another inviting glance.
于是金翠又飞了个媚眼，

In a slightly cloying voice, she said, “Thank you, Your Honour.
用她那有些发腻的声音说道：“多谢王老爷，

Do remember me.
您老可别忘了，

Be sure to have Liu Si call me.”
千万叫刘四招呼我啊！”


“I won't forget.”
“不会，不会！”


She lifted the curtain and left.
金翠掀着帘子走了。

Wang continued drinking, now pouring less and sipping more slowly than ever.
王有龄依然喝他的酒，于是浅斟低酌，越发慢了。


He drank and waited, but Liu Si failed to appear.
就这样一面喝，一面等，刘四却老是不露面。

Instead, other wandering prostitutes came to solicit him.
反倒又来了些游娼兜搭。

Having already made his choice, Wang scarcely looked at them and soon grew irritated.
因为心有所属，他对那些野草闲花，懒得一顾，且有厌烦之感，

Finally, he stepped outside himself and called loudly, “Liu Si! Liu Si!”
便亲自走出屋去，大声喊道：“刘四，刘四！”


Liu was still in the front courtyard.
刘四还在前院，

At the sound of Wang's voice, he hurried over, assuming that his guest was impatient for food.
听得呼唤，赶紧奔了来伺候，他只当王有龄催促饭食，

He began by apologising: there were so many travellers that day that the kitchen could not keep up.
所以一进来先道歉，说今天旅客特别多，厨下忙不过来，

He suggested another four liang of liquor.
建议王有龄再来四两白干：

“Take your time and enjoy a drink, Your Honour,” he said with a conspiratorial smile.
“您老慢慢喝着。”他诡秘地笑道，

“I'll find you some entertainment later.”
“回头我替您老找个乐子。”


“What sort of entertainment?” Wang asked, though he knew perfectly well.
“什么乐子？”王有龄明知故问地。


“It's still early.
“这会儿还早，

There's no hurry.
您老别忙。

If nobody comes after the second watch, this room will be yours for the night.
等二更过后，没有人来，这间屋就归您老住了。

I'll bring someone you're certain to like.” Liu added, “The woman I have in mind is the very best in her trade.
我找个人来，包管您老称心如意。”刘四又说：“我找的这个人，是她们这一行的顶儿、尖儿，

Her name is Jincui.”
名叫金翠。”


Wang smiled.
王有龄笑了，

“Bring more liquor!” he ordered loudly.
“再拿酒来！”他大声吩咐。


He drank until the second watch and ate two flatbreads.
喝酒喝到二更天，吃了两张饼，

Liu cleared away the remains and brewed another pot of tea.
刘四收拾残肴，又沏上一壶茶来，

Then the curtain hook rattled, and Jincui appeared without further summons.
接着便听见帘钩一响，金翠不速而至了。


“Look after him well,” Liu told her before withdrawing and closing the door behind him.
“好好伺候！”刘四向她叮嘱了这一句，退身出去，顺手把房门带上。


Jincui poured a bowl of tea, untied the pink handkerchief fastened to her jacket, and wiped a tea stain from the rim before presenting it to Wang with both hands.
金翠便斟了一碗茶，还解下衣襟上的一块粉红手绢，擦一擦碗口的茶渍，才双手捧到王有龄面前。


For a northern woman of her calling, her manner was gentle and quiet.
虽是北地胭脂，举止倒还温柔文静，

Wang liked her all the more.
王有龄越有好感，

Taking her hand, he asked, “How old are you?”
拉着她的手问道：“你今年多大？”


She smiled with a hint of embarrassment.
“金翠略有些忸怩地笑着：”

“Why do you ask?”
问这个干吗？“


“Is it something I shouldn't ask?”
“怎么有忌讳？”


“Not exactly,” she replied.
“倒不是有忌讳。”金翠答道：

“If I tell you the truth, I'm afraid you won't want me.
“说了实话，怕您老嫌我，

But if I don't tell the truth, I'd be deceiving you, and I don't want to do that.”
不说实话，我又不肯骗你。”


“Why should I object?” Wang said earnestly.
“我嫌你什么？”王有龄很认真地说：

“I don't mind.”
“我不嫌！”


Her lively eyes travelled over his face; then she lowered her head and let her eyelids fall, her long lashes trembling.
金翠那双灵活的眼珠，在他脸上绕了一下，低下头去，把眼帘垂了下来，只见长长的睫毛不住跳运。

This seemingly tender gesture was ample consolation for the hardships of his journey.
这未免有情的神态，足慰一路星霜，

Wang decided to stay another day.
王有龄决定明天再在这里住一天。


After a night of intimacy, added to the fatigue of travelling, he slept deeply and comfortably.
一夜缱绻，加以旅途辛劳，他第二天睡得十分酣适，

He woke once, drew a silver-cased watch from beneath his pillow, and saw that it was nearly noon.
中间醒了一次，从枕头下掏出一个银壳表来看了看，将近午时，

It was late, but since he intended to spend another evening with Jincui, there was no reason to hurry.
虽已不早，但有心与金翠再续前缘，便无须亟亟，

He turned over, pulled the covers over his head, and went back to sleep.
翻个身依旧蒙头大睡。

Before long, an argument outside the window woke him.
这一睡睡不多时，为窗外的争吵声所谅醒，

He recognised Liu Si's voice, apologising humbly.
听出一个是刘四，正低声下声地在赔罪，

Liu admitted that he had known the room was reserved and should not have let it to another guest.
说原知屋子早已定下，不能更赁与别的旅客，

“But His Honour Wang had already tried several inns without success, and he looked unwell.
“不过，这位王老爷连找了几家鄙不行，看样子还带青病，

Surely travellers ought to help one another.
出门哪里不行方便？

Please don't be angry, sir.
总爷，你别生气，

Sit down for a moment and have some tea.
清稍坐一坐，喝碗茶，

I'll clear the room for you at once.”
我马上给你腾。”


So he had occupied someone else's room.
王有龄一听，原来是为了自己占了别人的屋子，

Wang could not let Liu Si get into trouble over that.
这不好让刘四为难，

He hurriedly sat up, put on his clothes, and got out of bed.
急忙一翻身坐了起来，披衣下床。


As he lifted the latch, he called out, “Liu Si, there's no need to argue with the guest.
他一面拔闩开门，一面向外大声招呼：“刘四，你不必跟客人争执，

I'll give up the room.”
我让就是了。”

等开出门来，只见院子里与刘四站在一起的那个人，约有五十上下年纪，

The newcomer wore a sheepskin robe with a brand-new grey cloth covering and a small cap, but on his feet were a pair of sturdy, close-fitting boots known as “ground-gripping tigers.”
穿着簇新灰布面的老羊皮的袍子，头上戴着小帽，脚下却穿一双“抓地虎”的快靴，

一下子倒认不准他的身分。

Your room was assigned to him.
您老这间屋子，就分派给杨二爷住。

I'll find you somewhere else.
我另外想办法替您找，

您老委屈，请收拾行李吧！”


“Ah!”
“喔！”

Wang nodded to the man in greeting.
王有龄向那姓杨的点点头，作为招呼。

“Then the room is rightfully yours.
又说：“你是正主儿，

Come in and sit down.”
请进来坐吧！”


“There's no hurry, no hurry,” Yang replied, now equally polite.
“不要紧，不要紧。”姓杨的也很客气了，

“Take your time, Your Honour.”
“王老爷你慢慢儿来！”


He spoke with a Yunnan accent.
开出口来是云南乡音。

Its strong guttural sounds gave an impression of straightforward sincerity.
喉音特重的云南话，本就能予人以纯挚的感觉，

Wang had lived in Yunnan as a boy, so the accent sounded especially familiar and warm to him.
王有龄又从小在云南住过，所以入耳更觉亲切，

Smiling, he asked, “Where's your home? Kunming?”
随即含笑问道：“你家哪里，昆明？”


He too spoke in the Yunnan dialect.
他这一句也是云南话，

His pronunciation was not entirely accurate, but he caught its rhythm.
字虽咬得不太准，韵味却足。

Yang was delighted, as though he had met an old acquaintance far from home.
姓杨的顿有他乡遇故知的惊喜：

“Your Honour, are you from Yunnan too?”
“王老爷，你家也是云南人？”


“I was born there.
“我生在云南。

I suppose that makes us fellow provincials of a sort.”
也攀得上是乡亲。”


“That's wonderful!” Yang exclaimed.
“那好得很。”姓杨的大声说道：

“Then don't trouble yourself, Your Honour.
“王老爷，你老不要麻烦了。

You can stay right here.”
你还住在这里好了。”

Come, do sit down.”
来，来，请进来坐。”

“是！”姓杨的很诚退恳答道：

顺便再找间屋子住。

事情办完了我再来，叙叙乡情。

It won't take long—less than a couple of hours.”
很快，要不了一个时辰。”

“好，好！

I'll wait for you.”
我等你。”


They exchanged repeated bows with clasped hands and promises to meet again.
两人连连拱手，互道“回见”。

Wang went back inside and sat down.
王有龄回到屋里坐下来，

Once he had collected his thoughts, he felt that the encounter was a piece of excellent fortune.
定定神回想，觉得这番遭遇，十分可喜，

Apart from the warmth of human kindness on his travels, he saw another possibility.
除了客中的人情温暖以外，他另有一番打算，

An imperial commissioner's attendant would naturally know his way around the capital.
钦差的跟班，京里情形自然很熟，

Wang had been worrying about how to manage his business at the Board of Civil Appointments, where he knew neither the procedures nor the people.
此番到吏部打点，正愁着两眼漆黑，不知门径，

Now someone had appeared who could guide him.
现在找到个人可以指点，

What could be better?
岂不甚妙？

一想到此，精神抖擞，

刚站起身要喊人，只见刘四领着小伙计，把脸水热茶都已捧了来了，

这一趟上京，一定万事如意。”

王有龄十分高兴，

“Liu Si, Second Master Yang is coming back to see me, and I'd like him to stay for a meal.

你给提调一下子，不必太讲究，可也别太寒酸！”


“I understand.
“我知道！

Leave it to me, sir.
您老放心。全文给我了，

I guarantee it will be good to eat and easy on your purse.”
包管您又便宜，又中吃。”


Before two hours had passed, Yang returned as promised, carrying a parcel.
过不到一个时辰，姓杨的果然应约而至，手里拎着一包东西。

Wang caught sight of him through the window and was reminded of what courtesy required.
王有龄从窗户里远远望见，顿被提醒，

He hurriedly opened his trunk, took out a few local specialities, and laid them on the table before lifting the curtain to welcome his visitor.
赶紧开箱子随便抓了些土产，放在桌上。然后掀帘子出去。


“Have you finished your official business?” he asked.
“公干完了？”他问。


“Yes,” Yang replied.
“嗳！”姓杨的答道：

“I've left them to carry out the arrangements.”
“交给他们办去了。”


Once seated inside, they formally exchanged names.
进屋坐定，彼此重新请教姓名，

The visitor was Yang Chengfu.
姓杨的叫杨承福。

Wang addressed him as “Brother Yang,” which pleased him greatly.
王有龄管他叫“杨二哥”，他十分高兴，

He then began opening the parcel he had brought.
接着便把带来的一个包裹解开。


Wang quickly forestalled him by bringing out his own gifts: a boxed pair of folding fans with polished bamboo ribs, made by Hangzhou's celebrated Shulianji, and a large packet of cut tobacco from Mi Dachang, a firm known even to the women in the inner quarters of northern official households.
王有龄机警，抢先把自己预备下的礼物取了来，是一盒两把水磨竹骨的折扇，杭州城内名闻遐迩的“舒莲记”所制，一大包“宓大昌”的皮丝烟，这个字号，也是北方官宦人家连深闺内部知道的。


“A modest token for our first meeting, Brother Yang,” Wang said with a smile.
“杨二哥，不腆之仪，也算是个见面礼儿！”王有龄笑道：

“Though I suppose fans are not quite the thing to give in winter.”
“不过，冬天送扇子，好象不大合时宜。”


“My dear fellow!”
“老弟台！”

Yang caught his hand before he could put the gifts down.
杨承福一把接着他的手，不让他把东西放下来，

“Listen to me for a moment.
“你听我说一句，

I want to speak frankly, as one brother to another, and you mustn't take offence.”
是一句自己弟兄的老实话，你可不能生我的气。”


“How could I?
“那叫什么话？

Say whatever you wish, Brother Yang.”
杨二哥你尽管说。”


“I know these local gifts of yours.
“你这些土仪，我也知道，

They belong to what people call the ‘Four Hangzhou Specialities.’
名为‘四杭’，

But they would be wasted on me.
不过，你送给我是糟蹋了！

I prepare water-pipe tobacco for my master, but I smoke an ordinary pipe myself.
水烟，我装给我们大人吃，自己吃旱烟，

And when have you ever seen a man like me waving a folding fan and pretending to be a grand gentleman?
扇子，你哪里看见过象我这种人，弄把折扇在手里摇啊摇的，冒充大人先生？

Keep them to give to someone in the capital.
你留着，到京里送别人，

They will earn you goodwill there.
也是一份人情。

There's something else...”
再说一句你听，

Yang seemed reluctant to say it, but after a pause he continued.
“杨承福似乎有些碍口，但停了一下，终于说了出来，”

“Once my master and I reach the south, there'll be no shortage of these things.
我跟我们大人到了南边，这些东西有的是。

My dear fellow, one has to think ahead.
老弟台，凡事总要有个打算，

You're coming north, where southern goods make useful presents, yet you would give them to me when I'm heading south.
你到北方来，没有南边的东西送人，我往南边走，你又拿那里的东西送我，

What sort of reckoning is that?”
你想，这是什么算盘？“


There was something of an elder brother's guidance in his words.
话中带些做兄长开导的意味，

Further ceremony would only make Wang seem distant.
王有龄再要客气，便似见外。

“Put that way,” he said, “you make my politeness sound rather empty!”
“这一说，变成我假客气了！”他说。


“There's no need for ceremony between us.”
“本来不用客气。”


As he spoke, Yang finished unwrapping his parcel.
杨承福一面说，一面已把他的包裹解了开来。

Although he would not accept Wang's presents, he had a persuasive case for offering his own.
他不收王有龄的礼，自己有所馈赠却有一番说词，

He had brought household medicines: Zijin tablets, Zhuge's Campaign Powder, and a golden preparation shaped like mouse droppings and named accordingly.
他送的是家备的良药，紫金锭、诸葛行军散，还有种金色而形状象耗子矢似的东西，即名为“老鼠矢”，

These were no ordinary remedies.
这些药与众不同，

They were specially prepared in the Imperial Dispensary from costly ingredients and could not be bought on the open market.
出自大内“御药房”待制，选料名贵，为市面上所买不到，

Eunuchs seeking gifts from his master had supplied them in considerable quantities.
而他家“大人”因为太监来打秋风，送得很多，

He had simply wrapped up a few to bring over: a kindness that cost him nothing, useful to have even if never needed.
特意包了些来相送，惠而不费，备而不用，

When Wang returned south, they would make excellent presents.
王有龄将来回南，拿这送人，最妙不过。


The thoughtfulness and sincerity of this explanation moved Wang.
这是体贴诚恳的老实话，王有龄相当感动。

When Liu brought four cold dishes and a hotpot, Yang readily accepted his hospitality.
等刘四送来四个凉碟，一个火锅，杨承福便老实叨扰了他的，

The new acquaintances drank together and exchanged accounts of their travels.
新知把酒，互道行踪。


Although Wang felt as if he had known his guest for years, they had only just met.
做主人的觉得初次见面，虽有一见如故之感，

To ask for help now would be to presume too much on a new acquaintance.
但请托帮忙的说，在此时来说，还是交浅言深，

He therefore said little about his family, confining himself to the fact that he had come north to purchase an upgraded qualification for a local magistracy.
所以除了直陈此次北上，想加捐个“州县班子”以外，对于家世不肯多谈。


On learning that Wang had purchased qualification as a salt-station superintendent—and was thus an official, however minor—Yang became conscious of his own inferior position.
那杨承福听说他是个捐班的盐大使，大小是个官儿，自己的身分，便觉不配，

Slightly embarrassed, he said, “Then I have been far too familiar.”
略有些忸怩地说：“这一说，我太放肆了！”


“How so?”
“怎样？”


“To tell you the truth, I'm only a servant.
“实不相瞒，我不过是个‘底下人’，

How can I address you as a brother?”
哪里能跟你兄弟相称！”


“Nonsense!” Wang replied.
“笑话！”王有龄说，

“I have no patience with such worldly distinctions.”
“我没有这些世俗之见。”


Yang held his cup and pondered.
杨承福把杯沉吟，

He seemed unsure how to behave, though perhaps he was also turning over some other idea.
似乎有些不知何以自处，也象是别有心事在盘算，

After a long pause, he abruptly put the cup down.
过了好半响，突然放下杯子说：

“In that case, let me suggest something.
“这样，我替你出个主意。

First, how much money have you brought?”
我先问你，你这趟带着多少钱？”


The question was unexpected.
这话问得突兀，

Wang remembered the traveller's maxim: “Tell a stranger only a little; never lay your whole heart bare.”
王有龄记起“逢人只说三分话，未可全抛一片心”的行旅格言，

He hesitated, then reproached himself.
有些踌躇，既而自责，

The other man had been so sincere.
别人如此诚恳，

Why should he respond with petty suspicion?
自己怎么反倒起了小人之心？


He answered honestly, “Less than five hundred taels.”
所以老实答道：“不到五百两银子。”


Yang nodded.
杨承福点点头：

“That should just about cover an upgraded qualification for a magistracy.
“加捐个‘州县班子’，勉强也够了。

But if you want a good appointment, you'll need another approach.”
不过要想缺分好，还得另想办法。”


“I was hoping I might rely on your help, Brother Yang.”
“原要求杨二哥照应。”


“You are too kind.”
“不敢当，不敢当。”

Yang returned to the subject.
杨承福接谈正文，

“There are endless intricacies in the purchase of official qualifications.
“捐班的名堂极多，

How could an outsider understand them all?
不是内行哪里弄得清楚？

The clerks in the Board's Appointments Department would eat you alive and leave no bones.
吏部‘文选司’的那些书办，吃人不吐骨头，

Have you made any arrangements?”
你可曾先打算过？”


“Before leaving Hangzhou, I consulted people who knew the system.
“上京之前，在杭州也请教过内行，

I thought I might also pay for the provision giving me priority within my category, so I could obtain a post sooner.”
我想另外捐个‘本班尽先，的’花样‘，得缺可以快些。”


“That provision is expensive.”
“这个‘花样’的价钱不轻。”

Indeed, many expectant magistrates waited on official summonses until they had eaten through their resources and pawned everything, growing white-haired without ever acting in a substantive post.
当然，多少候补州县，“辕门听鼓”，吃尽当光，等到须眉皆白还未署过一任买缺的也多得是，

Wang proposed to upgrade from a principal eighth-rank salt-station superintendent to a principal seventh-rank county magistrate and then claim first consideration for any vacancy upon reaching his assigned province.
王有龄以正八品的盐大使，加捐为正七品的知县，一到省遇有县缺，尽完补用，

Such a convenient arrangement naturally carried a high price.
这佯如意的算盘，代价自然不会低。

Yang offered another calculation.
杨承福便替他打算，

“There's no need to do that.
“不必这么办。

You must understand that the first thing in official life is to find a patron.
你要晓得，做官总以寻靠山最要紧，

Even if you pay every fee at the Board and secure priority within your category, once you reach the province, vacancies will still pass you by unless someone speaks for you.”
哪怕你在吏部花足了钱，是‘本班尽先’的花样，一到省里，如果没有人替你讲话，有缺出来，照洋轮不到你。”


“Really?”
“咦！”

Wang was surprised.
王有龄倒奇怪了，

“Can the provincial treasurer simply ignore the Board's regulations?”
“难道藩台可以不顾部定的章程？”


“Regulations are one thing; practice is another.
“章程是一回事，实际上又是一回事，

The treasurer can always find a reason to exclude you.
藩台可以寻个说怯，把你刷掉，

Suppose a county magistracy falls vacant.
譬如说，有个县的县官出缺了，

He can say that the county has a distinguished literary tradition and requires an examination graduate with exceptional learning.
他可以说，该县文风素盛，不是学问优长的科甲出身，不能胜任，

That rules out everyone who bought a qualification.
这样就把捐班打下来了。

He can just as easily argue the reverse: the county is strategically important and its affairs are complicated, so it needs an able administrator experienced in government business.
倒过来也是一样，说该县地要事繁，非谙于吏沽的干才不可，

The implication is that examination graduates tend to be bookworms.
这意思就是说，科甲出身的，总不免书呆子的味道。

Think about it.
你想想看，

Isn't that how it works?”
是这话不是？”


Wang considered the argument carefully and suddenly understood.
王有龄把他的话细细体味了一遍，恍然有悟，

Raising his cup in a cheerful toast, he said, “A conversation with you is worth ten years of reading.”
欣然敬一杯酒说：“听君一席话，胜读十年书。”


“So I advise you not to pay for priority within your category.
“所以我劝你不必加捐‘本班尽先’，

You can obtain a good post without it.”
一样也可以得好缺。”


Could there really be such an opportunity?
世上有这样的妙事！

Wang rose and bowed deeply.
王有龄离座而起，一揖到地：

“Brother Yang, my whole future rests with you.
“杨二哥，小弟的前程，都在你身上了。

If I make the slightest progress, I shall never forget it.”
若有寸进，不敢相忘。”


“You are too kind, too kind!”
“好说，好说！”

Yang jumped up and caught his hand.
杨承福急忙跳起身来，拉住了他的手，

“Please sit down and let me explain.”
“你请坐。听我告诉你。”


Yang's advice was that, instead of paying heavily for priority within his category, Wang should spend less and purchase the right to choose his province of assignment.
杨承福为王有龄谋，与其花大价钱捐“本班尽先”，不如省些捐个“指省分发”，

Ordinarily, expectant local magistrates drew lots, leaving their destination to chance.
州县分发省份，抽签决定，各凭运气，

A designated provincial assignment allowed them to seek favourable circumstances and avoid unfavourable ones.
“指省分发，便可有所趋避，

Yang wanted Wang to specify Jiangsu when making his application.
杨承福要他报捐时指明分发江苏。


“My master is Jiangsu's education commissioner.
“我们大人是江苏学政，

His standing is equal to that of the governor of Jiangsu and the garrison general at Jiangning; even the governor-general of Liangjiang must show him consideration.
身分与江苏巡抚、江宁将军并行，连两江总督也要买帐。

Once you're assigned to Jiangsu, I'll speak to him for you.
你分发到了江苏，我替你跟我们大人说一说，

A word from him to the governor or provincial treasurer, and I guarantee you'll have your appointment posted and be acting in a vacancy within three months.
巡抚或者藩台那里关照一声，不出三个月，包你‘挂牌’署缺，

How good the post is will depend on your luck.”
缺分好坏就要看你自己的运气了。“


It was an extraordinary opportunity, as though fallen from the sky.
这真是天外飞来奇遇！

Wang could hardly stop smiling, yet did not know what to say.
王有龄笑得合不优口，却不知说什么好！

What was the master's name?
心里在想，他家“大人”不知叫什么名字？

He wanted to ask but felt awkward.
想问出口来，又觉不妥，

After all this conversation, would it not be absurd to admit that he did not even know who Jiangsu's education commissioner was?
说了半天，连江苏学政是什么人都不知道，岂非笑话。


Afraid that Wang might still doubt him, Yang added, “My master is especially willing to help people from his home province.
杨承福还怕他不相信，特别又加了一句：“我们大人最肯照应同乡，

You count as half a Yunnan man, and with me speaking for you, success is certain.”
你算半个云南人，再有我从中说话，事情一定成功。”


As the wine took effect, Yang grew more expansive.
酒到微醺，谈兴愈豪，

Although a servant, he was no common labourer.
杨承福虽的“底下人”的身分，却不是那干粗活的杂役，

He was literate and capable of receiving his master's guests and handling contacts on official business.
一样知书识字，能替主人招待宾客，接头公事，

He therefore knew a great deal about developments in the capital's official circles.
所以对京里官场的动态，十分熟悉。

His friends, however, were rough men who could not converse with him on such subjects.
但是他的朋友，都是此粗人，不是他谈论的对手，

Wang was different.
此刻遇见王有龄，

Whether Yang discussed the examinations, official advancement, or the backgrounds and connections of high officials, Wang understood and listened with keen interest.
谈科甲、谈功名、谈那些大官的出身交游，他不但懂，而且听得津津有味，

This gave Yang immense satisfaction.
这使得杨承福非常痛快，

Drinking with someone who truly understood him seemed one of life's rare pleasures.
越觉得酒逢知己，人生难得。


“My master is liked by everyone.
“我们大人的人缘最好。

Among his examination classmates, he was young, talented, and handsome, so they were all willing to look after him.
在同年当中，年纪轻，有才气，人又漂亮，所以同年都肯照应他。

Within ten years of completing his Hanlin probation, he had become a vice-minister.
‘散馆’以后，不过十年的功夫，就当到侍郎。

If his father hadn't died four years ago, forcing him to spend more than two years out of office in mourning, he'd surely be a minister by now.”
如果不是四年前老太爷故世，丁忧闲了两年多，现在一定升尚书了。”


The reference to completing Hanlin probation told Wang that the man had belonged to the Hanlin Academy.
听到“散馆”两个字，便知是个翰林，

“Which examination year was your master's?” he asked.
王有龄问道：“你家大人是哪一科？”


“The yiwei year, the fifteenth year of Daoguang.
“道光十五年乙未。

That was a cohort of dragons and tigers.
这一榜是‘龙虎榜’，

They're the most influential men around now.”
现在顶顶红了。”


Yang spoke with delight.
杨承福兴高采烈地说：

“My master placed forty-ninth in the second class and was selected for the Hanlin Academy.
“我家大人是二甲四十九名，点了翰林。

Fiftieth was His Excellency Peng, now a grand councillor.
第五十名就是大军机彭大人，

He wasn't selected for the Hanlin, but his official luck has been the best of all.
他不曾点翰林，不过官运是他顶好，

He's very much in favour now and runs everything in the Grand Council.”
现在红得很，军机处里一把抓。“


That seemed difficult to believe.
这话似乎不能相信。

Wang knew that seniority mattered among the grand councillors.
王有龄也知道，军机大臣要讲资格，

However remarkably Peng Yunzhang had risen, he was still a relatively recent member.
彭蕴章就算飞黄腾达，异乎常人，在军机上也是后进，

How could he be running everything?
怎么会“一把抓”呢？


“Then there's something I'd like to understand,” Wang said.
“这我倒要请教了，”他说，

“Aren't there several grand councillors?”
“大军机不是有好几位吗？”


“There are, certainly.
“不错，有好几位。

But the ones above him aren't handling affairs now.
不过前面的几位现在都不管事。

The most senior was His Excellency Saishang'a.
资格最老的是赛尚阿赛大人，

He was sent to Guangxi to fight the Long-Haired rebels, lost his battles, and was dismissed.
派到广西打‘长毛’，吃了败仗，革职了。

Then there's His Excellency He Rulin, who's unwell and has taken sick leave.
还有位何汝霖何大人，身子不好，告了病假，

That leaves His Excellency Qi Junzao, a man of long standing, but his energy is failing too.
剩下就是祁隽藻祁大入，那是老资格，精神也不大好，

And that sixth son of Prince Zheng's household, the imperial minister Sushun, is always opposing him.
而且郑亲王家的那个老六，御前大臣肃顺，专门与他作对，

He's so discouraged that he's even less willing to take charge.
灰心得很，越发不愿管事。

That leaves His Excellency Peng.
这一来，就轮着彭大人，

There are another two or three below him who passed their examinations earlier, but they joined the Council later.
以下也还有两三位，科名上说是老前辈，不过进军机在后，

In its business, they have to defer to him and let him decide.”
凡事总要退让一步，听彭大人作主。“


“No wonder!
“怪不得！

With such a powerful patron, your master's promotion to minister can only be a matter of time.”
有这么硬的靠山。你家大人升尚书，那是看得见的事了。”


Wang asked another question.
王有龄又问：

“When he returned after mourning, did he resume his post as vice-minister of War?”
“丁忧服满起复，仍旧是兵部侍郎？”


“He was transferred—to Revenue, with additional responsibility for the Mint Office.
“调了。调户部，‘兼管钱法堂’，

A fine appointment!
好差使！

Without someone on the inside looking after him, how would it have come his way?”
不是自己人照应，哪里轮得到。”


Yet what was the man's name?
说来说去，到底叫什么名字呢？

Wang grew increasingly curious, but the longer they talked, the more awkward it became to ask.
王有龄心里痒痒地，但越说越不宜开口动问。

After the meal they arranged to meet again.
等饭罢订了后约，

No sooner had Yang left than Wang went out into the street himself.
杨承福刚刚告辞，王有龄跟着也上了街。


He wanted to buy a book.
他上街是要去买一部书。

It was available in every major city: the Complete Directory of Official Ranks, printed by Rongzhuzhai in the capital's Liulichang district.
这部书在通都大邑都有得卖，京城里琉璃厂荣主斋刻印的《爵秩全览》，

Wang bought two issues, the summer and autumn editions for the current renzi year of the Xianfeng reign.
王有龄买了两本，一本是今年，咸丰壬子年夏季的，一本是秋季的，

Turning to the section on the Board of Revenue, he could scarcely believe his eyes.
翻到户部这一栏一看，几几乎不相信自己的眼睛。


The names were unmistakable.
上面写得明明白白，

The Chinese-held posts of president and vice-presidents of the Board of Revenue were occupied by Sun Ruizhen, Wang Qingyun, and He Guiqing.
汉缺的户部尚书和侍郎是孙瑞珍、王庆云、何桂清。


He Guiqing, courtesy name Genyun, was a native of Kunming, Yunnan.
何桂清字根云，云南昆明人。


“How strange!
“奇怪啊？

Can it be the same He Guiqing?” Wang murmured.
是这个何桂清吗？”王有龄喃喃自问，

“His ancestral home wasn't in Yunnan, and I never heard of him using the name Genyun.
“他本籍不是云南，也没有听说过有‘根云’这个别号。

Is it really him?”
到底是不是他呢？”


Wang felt an excitement he could hardly describe, but his thoughts were in turmoil.
王有龄心里，有着说不出的兴奋，但也乱得厉害。

He urgently needed a quiet place to think.
他急需找个清静地方去好好想一想。


Back at the inn, he closed his door and lay on the heated platform, trying to recall the past.
回到客店，王有龄关门躺在炕上，细恩往事。

The wine, combined with this wholly unexpected discovery, left his mind in confusion.
有了几分酒意，兼以骤遇意想不到的情形，脑中乱得厉害，

Only after a long struggle did he find a thread to follow through the tangle.
好外，才从一团乱丝中抽出一个头绪。


That thread began with his first arrival in Yunnan with his father.
这个头绪从他随父初到云南时开始。

His father's personal name was Xie, his courtesy name Meilin.
王有龄的父亲单名燮，字梅林，

Poor but devoted to learning, Wang Xie was widely respected.
家贫力学，很受人尊敬，

In the twenty-third year of Jiaqing, he placed thirty-sixth in Fujian's provincial examination.
嘉庆二十三年中了福建乡试第三十六名举人，

He scraped together every available resource for travelling expenses and went to Beijing for the metropolitan examination.
悉索敝赋凑了一笔盘缠，到北京去会试，

The examiner assigned to his section recommended his paper, but the chief examiner rejected it.
房官已经荐了他的卷子，主司不取。

A poor scholar who failed the examination faced miserable circumstances.
贫土落第，境况凄凉，

Fortunately, Yan Jian, formerly governor of Fujian, had been promoted to governor-general of Zhili.
幸好原任福建巡抚颜检已调升直隶总督，

He had always thought highly of Wang Xie and invited him onto his private staff.
他本来就看重王燮，便把他招入幕府，

This was an excellent opportunity: the stipend would support Wang's family, while he could remain near the capital and await the next metropolitan examination.
这原是极好的一个机会，一面有束修收入可以养家，一面就近再等下一科的会试，

He would avoid another long journey and the despair of trying to raise its cost.
免了一番长途跨涉，不必再为筹措旅费，仰屋兴嗟。


Unexpectedly, in the third year of Daoguang, Wang Xie's great-grandmother died and he had to return home for the funeral.
下想到了道光三年，王燮的曾祖母故世，奔丧回籍。

The metropolitan examination was held only once every three years.
会试三年一科，

Repeated interruptions brought him into middle age.
连番耽误，已人中年，

Even if he passed and received an immediate appointment, he would become no more than a departmental official in one of the Six Boards or a local magistrate.
就算中了进士，榜下即用，也不过当六部的司官或者州县，

Why not take the route of the Grand Selection instead?
那问不就了“大挑”一途？


The Grand Selection had been devised for provincial degree-holders who were older, poor, and experienced in the world.
“大挑”是专为年长家贫，而阅历已深的举人所想出来的一条路子。

Princes and senior officials appointed by the emperor selected candidates, judging first their bearing and appearance and then their fluency in speech.
钦命工公大臣挑选，第一要仪表出众，第二要言语便给。

Wang Xie met both requirements.
王燮这两项都够条件，

He also wrote well, and his service on a governor-general's private staff made his familiarity with official business unquestionable.
加以笔下来得，而且当过督署的幕府，公事熟悉，更不待言，

He was therefore placed in the first class and assigned to Yunnan.
因此而中“一等”，分发云南。


He took his family to Yunnan and was promptly appointed acting deputy prefect of Qujing.
王燮携眷到了云南，随即奉委署理曲靖府同知，

After serving in various counties, he was eventually transferred to act as magistrate of Kunming, the county containing the provincial capital.
迁转各县，最后调署首县昆明。

One day, returning to his office from an outing, he heard someone reading aloud in the gatehouse as his chair passed through the entrance.
有一天从外面回衙，轿子抬人大门，听见门房里有人在读书，

The voice was exceptionally clear, its rise and fall bringing out the full meaning of the prose.
声音极其清朗，念得抑扬顿挫，把文章中的精义都念了出来，

He could not help admiring it.
不由得大为欣赏。


When he reached his private quarters, he asked an attendant, “Who was the boy reading in the gatehouse?”
回到上房，他便问听差，“门房里在念书的少年是谁啊？”


“The son of Old He, the clerk who drafts documents at the gate.”
“是‘门稿’老何的儿子。”


“Ah!
“噢，

He reads well.
念得好啊！

Bring him to me.”
找来我看看。”


Old He's son was summoned.
于是把老何的儿子去找了来，

Wang Xie saw a boy of fourteen or fifteen with fine features and a composed manner, looking for all the world like the son of a family distinguished in scholarship and office for generations.
王燮看他才十四五岁，生得眉清目秀，气度安详，竟是累世清贵的书香子弟，

Studying him more closely, he found something exceptional in his features, the signs of a man destined to rise early.
再细看一看，骨骼清奇，是一副早达的贵相，

His astonishment grew.
越发惊奇。


“What is your name?”
“你叫什么名字？”


“He Guiqing, Your Honour.
“回老爷的话，叫何桂清。

Gui as in the red osmanthus, and qing as in the phrase qingmi, ‘pure and secret.’”
丹桂的桂，清秘的清。”


The answer almost seemed an omen of selection for the Hanlin Academy, whose hall was known as the Qingmi Hall.
这一开口竟似点翰林入“清秘堂”的征兆，

Wang Xie asked, “Have you begun composing essays?”
王燮便问：“开笔做文章了没有？”


The boy looked a little embarrassed.
何桂清略有些忸怩了，

“I have no one to guide me,” he said.
“没有人指点。”他说，

“I haven't yet found my way into it.”
“还摸不着门径。”


“Bring me your written exercises.”
“拿你的窗课来我看。”


He had brought them already: two slim notebooks made of bamboo paper.
何桂清已把窗课带了来，薄薄竹纸订的两个本子，

He presented them with both hands.
双手捧了上去。

Opening them, Wang Xie found that the boy had not only begun writing essays but also attempted both classical poems and lyric verse.
王燮打开一看，不但已经开笔做文章，而且除了八股文以外，还有诗词，

He had considerable learning, and his handwriting was good as well.
肚子里颇有些货色，一笔字也写得不坏。


Having risen through hard study himself, Wang Xie knew the hardships of a poor scholar.
王燮是苦学出身，深知贫土的辛酸，

The sight of He Guiqing stirred his sympathy for neglected talent.
一看何桂清的情形，顿起怜才之念，

“This is what we'll do,” he said.
于是吩咐：“这样吧，

“From tomorrow, you shall study with my eldest son.”
从明天起，你跟大少爷一起念书好了。”


That eldest son was Wang Youling.
大少爷就是王有龄。

From then on, He Guiqing became both his study attendant and his fellow pupil.
何桂清从此便成了他的书僮兼同窗。


Was this the He Guiqing who employed Yang Chengfu?
这个何桂清可就是杨承福的主人？

That was the question Wang now had to answer.
王有龄要解答的，就是这个疑问。


He regretted not having asked where Yang was staying; he could not go and find him.
他懊悔没有问清杨承福的住处，此刻无从访晤。

Then it occurred to him that even if he knew the address, he could not rush over and ask outright.
转念一想，就是知道他的住处，也不能贸贸然跑了去，率直动间。

If it was the same He Guiqing, perhaps his family background was a secret.
如果是那个何桂清，可能他的家世是瞒着人的，

Why tear open an old wound and turn a former friend into an enemy?
一下揭了人家的痛疮疤，旧雨变作新仇，何苦？

If it was someone else, Yang might think Wang suffered from some disorder of the mind.
倘或不是，杨承福一定以为自己有痰疾，神智不清，

How could he then be expected to recommend him wholeheartedly to his master?
怎还肯在他主人面前竭力保荐援引？


There was nothing for it, then, but to search his memory.
这样一想，便仍旧只有从回忆中去研究了。

He remembered He Guiqing as a proud young man, but also one of deep feeling, who often secretly helped him with his lessons.
他记得何桂情是个很自负的人，也很重感情，在一起念书时，常常暗中帮自己做功课。

He liked to argue and held views unlike other people's—sometimes remarkably perceptive, sometimes absurd.
他喜欢发议论，看法与常人不同，有时很高超，有时也很荒谬，

Whatever the merits of his ideas, however, it had been a pleasure to lie in adjoining beds on rainy nights and listen to him range freely over past and present.
但不论如问，夜雨联床听他上下古今闲聊，是件很有趣味的事。


Those days had not lasted long.
可惜，这样的日子，并不太久，

Wang's mother died in Kunming, and he travelled the great distance home with her coffin.
王有龄的母亲在昆明病殁。他万里迢迢，扶柩归乡，

He never saw He Guiqing again.
从此再没万跟何桂清见过。

Nor did he remember his father speaking of him afterwards.
而且也下曾听他父亲谈过，

In fact, after father and son parted in Yunnan, they themselves had few opportunities to meet.
事实上他门父子从云南分手以手，见面的机会也不多。

Wang recalled that He was only a year or two older than he was.
王有龄记得何桂清比自己只大一两岁，

How could he have been selected for the Hanlin Academy more than a decade earlier?
如何能在十几年前就点了翰林？

Besides, he was not a Yunnan native and could not have taken the provincial examination there.
而且他也不尾云南人，不可能在云南应乡试。

It seemed likely that the vice-minister of Revenue appointed education commissioner in Jiangsu merely shared a name with Wang's old schoolmate.
看起来，这位户部侍郎放江苏学政的何桂清与自己的同窗旧交何桂清，不过姓名巧合而已。


But why should both men be connected with Yunnan?
可是，为何又都在云南？

One coincidence was possible; could there really be another?
一巧不能再巧！

Yang's description of a master who had risen young, who was talented and handsome, also fitted the He Guiqing Wang had known.
听杨承福悦他上人，少年早发，“有才气，人又漂亮”，这些又都象是自己所以的何桂情。


His uncertainty deepened, and his desire to resolve it grew stronger.
疑云越来越深，渴求澄清的心情也越来越重，

At last evening came, and Yang arrived as agreed.
好不容易盼到天黑，杨承福应约而至，

Once again, they sat opposite one another over four dishes and a hotpot, drinking together.
依然是四碟一火锅，对坐小的。


“I finally settled an important piece of business this afternoon,” Yang said.
“下午总算办了一件大事。”杨承福说，

“I've hired all the boats.”
“把船都雇好了。”


“Oh?”
“喔！”

This time Wang asked about He Guiqing by name rather than referring vaguely to “your master.”
王有龄问到何桂清，这次不再用“你家大人”的笼统称呼了，

“When will His Excellency He arrive?”
“何大人什么时候到？”


“Around noon tomorrow.”
“总在明天午间。”


“Will he board the boat as soon as he arrives?”
“一到就下船吗？”


“Hardly!
“哪里？

We'll be delayed at least three or four days.
起码有三四天耽搁。

Think how many officials in Tongzhou want to cultivate him.
你想，通州有多少官儿要巴结我家大人？

Quite apart from anything else, he cannot decline the farewell dinners given by the Tongzhou–Yongping circuit intendant and the granary vice-minister.
别的不说，通永道、仓场侍郎的两顿饯行酒，是不能不吃的，

That's two days gone already.”
这就是两天去掉了。“


“Then...” Wang asked cautiously, “might I have an opportunity to meet him?”
“那么……”王有龄很谨慎地问，“我能不能见一见何大人？”


Yang considered it.
杨承福想了想说：

“Let's do this.
“索性这样，

Come to the temporary residence early tomorrow morning.
明天上午你早些到行辕来，

When my master arrives, join those waiting to receive him at the gate.
等我家大人一到，你在门口‘站’个‘班’，

I'll submit your visiting card immediately and see what he says.”
我随即把你的‘手本’递了上去。看他怎么吩咐？”


“Excellent.
“好极了。

I'll do as you suggest.”
我遵办。”


“One more thing.
“还有句话，

My master is young and handsome himself, so he pays attention to other people's appearance.
我家大人自己年纪轻，人漂亮，所以看人也讲究仪表，

Have you brought your formal robes?”
他的袍褂带来了没有？”


That reminded Wang of a difficulty.
这倒提醒了王有龄，

He had left in the fifth month and had a set of summer robes made just before his departure.
他是五月里动身的，临进赶做了一套夏天的袍褂，

He had no winter set.
冬天却还没有。


When he admitted this, Yang said, “It's a good thing I asked.
听他老实相告，杨承福便说：“亏得问一声。

There's no time to have them made now, and we may not find any ready-made ones.
现做是来不及了，买现成的也未见得有。

Fortunately, you're of average build.
好在你身材中等，

I'll borrow a set for you.”
我替你借一套来。”


Yang was as helpful as could be.
杨承福非常热心，

He personally borrowed a nearly new blue padded gown, a black satin outer jacket edged with fox fur, and a winter hat.
亲自去替他借了一件簇新的蓝纳棉袍，一件狐皮出锋，玄色贡缎的褂子，一顶暖帽。

Wang opened his trunk and took out the gold hat button signifying the eighth rank, together with his insignia badge embroidered with a small quail, and fitted everything in place.
王有龄开箱子把八品顶戴的金顶子，以及绣着一只小小的鹌鹑的“补子”都拿了出来，配置停当。

Looking at his boots, he saw that they had two holes, so he sent Liu Si to buy a new pair.
看看脚下那双靴子，已经破了两个洞，便又叫刘四去买了双新靴子，

Meanwhile, he had his head shaved and face scraped at the barber's stall outside the inn.
一面在客店门口的“剃头挑子”上剃了头、刮了脸。

Back in his room, he hastily trimmed the lamp and wrote his visiting card.
回到屋里，了急急地又剔亮汕灯写手本，

Beneath his name, he carefully added in smaller characters: “Courtesy name Xuexuan; also known as Yingjiu.”
在自己的名字下面，特别用小字注明：字雪轩，一字英九“。

If Yang's master really was He Guiqing, his former schoolmate and study attendant, there could then be no doubt who this Wang Youling was.
这样，如果杨承福的主人，真的是当年同窗兼书僮的何桂清，便决不会想不起他这个”王有龄“是何许人。


Early the next morning, Wang dressed carefully and examined himself in the mirror.
第二天一早，收拾整齐，揽镜自照，

The proverb was right: “A Buddha needs gilding; a man needs fine clothes.”
果然“佛要金装、人要衣装”，

In the borrowed robes, he felt dignified and imposing.
穿上这身借来的新袍褂，自觉气宇轩昂，派头十足，

His pleasure lifted his spirits further.
心里一高兴，精神越觉爽健，

He asked Liu to hire a carriage and went straight to the temporary residence Yang had described: a secluded set of rooms in a Daoist temple near the west gate.
叫刘四雇了乘车，一直来到杨承福所说的“行辕”：西门一座道观的精舍。


“You're early,” Yang said.
“你来得早！”杨承福说：

“He won't be here until around noon.
“总要午间才能到。

Sit down and have some tea.”
且坐了吃茶。”


Something now occurred to Wang.
这时王有龄想起一件事，

Once his card was presented, an astonishing reunion might follow.
回头把手本递了上去，说不定就有石破天惊的奇遇出现，

Yang, unaware of the care behind Wang's silence, would surely think, “What a sly fellow!
到那时杨承福不知自己的苦心，一定会在心里骂：“这小子真会装蒜，

I've treated him so well, yet he never breathed a word beforehand.
枉为待他那么好，居然事先一点口风都不露，

That's no way to treat a friend.”
太不懂交情了！”

But Wang could not tell him the whole story, and even a hint of its origins would be unwise.
但是，要实说固然不可，就露一点根由，也是不妥，

After turning it over in his mind, he decided to give a vague warning now and explain afterwards.
恩来想去，只有含含糊糊先安一个伏笔，等事后再作解释。


He drew Yang aside and said quietly, “Brother Yang, if His Excellency He receives me, something may happen that you won't expect.”
于是他把杨承福拉到一边，悄悄说道：“杨二哥，等下如果何大小接见，说不定有些花样，让你意想不到。”


“What sort of thing?”
“什么花样？”

Yang grew uneasy.
杨承福有些紧张。

“You're not planning to present some memorandum, are you?”
“你不是要上什么‘条陈’吧？”


“No, no!” Wang answered, clasping his hands reassuringly.
“不是，不是！”他供拱手答道：

“Have no fear.
“你请放心，

Whatever happens, it certainly won't mean trouble.”
倘有花样，决不是闯什么祸。”


“Good.
“那好，

I didn't think you would get me into difficulties.”
我想你也不会害我。”


“How can you say that?”
“哪里的话？”

Wang was distressed.
王有龄异常不安，

“You have shown me more kindness than I can repay.
“杨二哥待我的这番盛情，报答下尽，

How could I cause you trouble?”
我怎能替你找麻烦惹祸？”


Yang nodded and was about to ask more when a man dressed as an official messenger galloped up to the gate.
杨承福点点头，还想问下去，只见一名差官装束的汉子，一骑快马，飞奔到门，

He appeared to be an advance rider from He's party, and Yang hurried out to meet him.
看样子是何大人的前站，杨承福便慌忙迎了出去。


It was indeed the news they awaited.
不错！消息来了，

He Guiqing had reached Tongzhou and was exchanging courtesies with the officials assembled at the reception hall.
何桂清已经到了通州，正在“接宫厅”与迎候的官员应酬，

He would be at his temporary residence very shortly.
马上就要到“行辕”了。


Wang began to feel nervous.
土有龄心里有些发慌，

If this really was the He Guiqing he had known, their present positions were as far apart as heaven and earth.
果真是当年的何桂清，相见之下，身分如云泥之判，

How should he address him?
见了面该怎么称呼，

What could he say without impropriety?
说些什么才得体？

He had no idea.
竟茫然不知所措。

The tangle of fear and excitement reminded him of only one other moment in his life: the day he became a bridegroom.
那乱糟糟夹杂着畏惧与兴奋的心情，他记得只有在做新郎官的那一刻有过。


Fortunately, the great chair, carried by eight bearers and preceded by gongs and shouted commands to clear the way, went straight through the residence gates.
幸好，鸣锣喝道的八抬大轿，一直抬进“行辕”大门。

Wang merely stood in attendance without announcing his name.
王有龄只“站班”，不报名，

The curtain of the chair remained closed, and its occupant had no idea that an expectant salt-station superintendent was there to receive him.
轿帘不曾打开，轿中人根本不知道有这么个候补盐大使在“伺候”，

Anyone else might have considered the effort wasted.
在别人是劳而无功，

Wang felt only relief.
在他却是如释重负，

He breathed out and returned to his seat in the gatehouse.
舒口气依旧到门房里去坐着。


He had scarcely sat down when calls were passed outward from within: “Invite His Honour Wang in!” “His Honour Wang!”
凳子都没坐热，忽听得里面递相传呼：“请王老爷！”“请王老爷！”


His heart began pounding again.
王有龄一听，心又跳了，

He stood, sat down, and stood once more, uncertain what to do.
站起来又坐下，坐下又站起，不知如何是好？


At that moment Yang came running faster than anyone.
就在这时候，杨承福比什么人都跑得快，

Reaching Wang, he pulled him aside to a quiet spot.
到了王有龄面前，把他一拉拉到僻处，

Blinking repeatedly in astonishment, he asked, “Your Honour Wang, what exactly is your connection with my master?”
不断眨着眼，显得惊异莫名地问道：“王老爷，你与我家大人到底是怎么回事？”


“Brother Yang...”
“杨二哥……”


“Your Honour!” Yang interrupted loudly.
“王老爷！”杨承福大声打断，

He made a respectful salute, then straightened.
跟着请了个安，站起身来说，

“You must never address me like that.
“你老千万不能如此称呼！

If my master hears of it, he'll be furious.
让我家大人知道了，一定生气，

He'll send me straight back to Yunnan.”
非把我打发回云南不可。”


“What should I call you, then? Old Yang?”
“那么叫你什么呢？老杨？”


“Yes.
“是。

If you would rather not use my name, Old Yang will do.”
王老爷如果不肯叫我名字，就叫老杨也可以。”


“Old Yang, first tell me: what did your master say when he saw my card?”
“老杨，我先问你，你家大人看了我的手本怎么说？”


“He was delighted.
“他很高兴，

He said, ‘This is an old friend.
说：”此是故人。

Show him in at once!’”
快请！快请！‘“


Now Wang was delighted too.
这一下，王有龄也很高兴了。

“Yes,” he answered readily.
“不错。”他顺口答道：

“Our families are old friends.
“我们是世交。

We haven't met for many years.
多年不见，

I feared it might be a different man with the same name, so I didn't dare tell you sooner.”
只怕名同人不同，所以一时不敢跟你说破。“


“No wonder!”
“怪不得！”

Yang's puzzle was solved.
杨承福的疑团算是打破了，

“Please come in at once.”
“快请进去吧！”


He bent slightly, extended a hand to invite Wang forward, and led him to a small courtyard.
说着，哈一哈腰，伸手肃客，然后在前引路，把王有龄带到一个小院子里。


The courtyard had formerly been the temple priest's retreat for quiet meditation.
这个小院子原是这里的老道习静之所，

Half hidden by trees and flowers stood a row of three single-storey rooms.
花木掩映中，一排三间平房，

Above the central doorway hung a small plaque bearing the name Crane Pavilion.
正中门媚上悬着块小小的匾，上快“鹤轩”二字。

Before they reached it, an attendant called out, “His Honour Wang has arrived!”
未进鹤轩，先有听差高唱通报：“王老爷到！”


The padded curtain lifted, and a man in his thirties stepped outside.
接着棉门帘一掀，踏出一个三十多岁的人来，

His face was as fair as jade.
面白如玉，

He wore a small black satin cap topped with a coral bead, a lightly padded robe covered in somewhat worn blue-grey satin, neatly pressed trousers gathered at the ankles, white cotton socks, and black satin shoes.
戴一顶珊瑚结子的黑缎小帽，穿一件半旧的青灰缎面的薄棉袍，极挺括的扎脚裤，白布袜，黑缎鞋，

Graceful and at ease, he looked from head to foot like a young gentleman from a family of distinguished refinement.
丰神潇洒，从头到脚都是家世清华的贵公子派头，

Nothing in his appearance suggested a serving official of the second rank.
怎么样也看不出是现任的二品大员。


At first Wang scarcely dared recognise him.
骤看之下，王有龄倒有些不敢相认，

It was He who spoke first.
反是何桂清先开口：

“Xuexuan! Twenty years apart, and who would have thought we'd meet again here?”
“雪轩，一别二十年，想不到在这里重逢！”


The voice was utterly familiar.
声音是再熟悉不过的，

The only difference was that the old address, “Young Master,” had become “Xuexuan.”
所不同的是，当初叫“少爷”，现在叫“雪轩”。


That brought home to Wang how completely their relative positions had changed.
这提醒了王有龄，身分真个判如云泥了！

He could no longer call him “Little Qing.”
他不能再叫他“小清”，

He could not even call him “Genyun,” a name he had discovered only in the official directory.
甚至也不能叫他“根云”，他还是从《爵秩全览》中发见他有了一个别号。

Rank demanded its proper courtesies.
“做此官行此礼”，

He would have to address him as “Your Excellency He.”
少不得要叫他一声“何大人”！


“Your Excellency He!” Wang said, making a formal salute.
“何大人！”王有龄一面叫，一面请了个安。


Now He grew a little embarrassed.
这时何桂清才有些局促，

“Please, there's no need!”
“不敢当，不敢当！”

He stepped forward to raise his old friend, then turned to Yang.
他亲手来扶“故人”，同时回头问杨承福：

“Has His Honour Wang brought an attendant?”
“王老爷可曾带跟班？”


The real question concerned a change of clothes.
问跟班实在是问衣包，

Had Wang brought a servant, the man would have known that the host would invite his guest to dispense with formal dress and would have brought a clothing bundle accordingly.
如果带了跟班，那么一定知道主人必会请客人便衣相见，预先带着衣包好更换，

Yang understood and answered quickly, “His Honour is travelling alone.
杨承福懂得他的意思、很快地答道：“王老爷在客边，

He has brought no one.”
不曾带人来。”


“Then help him change at once,” He said.
“那快伺候王老爷换衣服！”河桂清说：

“See whether that newly made fur robe of mine will fit.”
“看我那件新做的皮袍子，合不合身？”


“Yes, sir.”
“是。”

Yang turned to Wang.
杨承福转脸向王有龄说，

“Please come with me, Your Honour.”
“王老爷请随我来。”


He led Wang into a guest room on the east side, let the curtain fall, and withdrew.
他把他引入东面一问客室，放下帘子走了出去。

Looking around, Wang saw that the paintings and calligraphy on every wall bore the signature Genyun.
王有龄打量了一下，只见四壁字画都落着“根云”的款，

Although this was only a brief stop on a journey, the rooms had clearly been arranged for their occupant.
虽是过境稍作勾留，依然有过一番布置。


He Guiqing certainly lived in style.
何桂清的派头还真不小！

Twenty years had transformed him completely.
二十年的工夫，真正是脱胎换骨了。


As Wang reflected on these changes, Yang returned with a new fur robe belonging to his master and a sleeveless outer garment that was almost new, and helped him change.
正在感慨万端时，杨承福已取了他主人的一件新皮袍，一件八成新的“卧龙袋”，来伺候王有龄更换。

In the space of a single day, the two had gone from strangers to close friends, and from friends to men whose positions were wholly unequal—almost master and servant.
不过一天的工夫，由初交而成好友，由好友又变为身分绝不相类，相当于“老爷与听差”的关系，

Even this small turn in human relations was enough to reveal the endless, unpredictable changes of the world and give a man much to ponder.
仅是这一番小小的人事沧桑，己令人感到世事万端，奇妙莫恻，足够寻味了。


“Your Honour,” Yang said, “these clothes fit very well.
“王老爷！”杨承福说，“这一身衣服很合适，

You can wear them when you leave.
回头你老就穿了回去。

I can return the borrowed official robes straight away, which will save another errand.”
这套袍褂，我正好送去还人家，也省了一番手脚。“


“I am truly indebted to you!”
“真正承情之至！”

Wang grasped his hand.
王有龄握着他的手，

The warmth he felt in his heart exceeded even that supplied by the new sheepskin robe, whose fine curls of wool were known as “shredded radish.”
心头所感到的温暖，比那件号称为“萝卜丝”的新羊裘为他身上所带来的温暖更多，

“Old Yang, I really don't know how to thank you.”
“老杨，我实在不知道怎么样感激你？”


“You make too much of it.
“言重，言重！

Everything in life comes down to a fortunate connection.”
人生都是一个‘缘’。”

Yang brought him a mirror.
杨承福取过一面镜子来，

“Look at yourself, Your Honour.
“王老爷你照照看。

What a difference a day makes!”
昨日今朝大不同了。”


Wang found that he looked different again from the man in official robes.
王有龄从镜子里发现自己，比穿着官服，又换了副样子，

His face glowed with pleasure and good fortune.
春风满面，喜气洋洋，

With a little moustache turned down at the corners, he would have looked like a comfortably prosperous gentleman blessed with every advantage.
如果留上两撇八字胡子，就是面团团富家翁的福相了。


After studying himself for a while, he suddenly laughed.
照了一会镜子，他忽然笑了起来，

The laughter was cheerful but seemingly without cause, and Yang was puzzled.
笑得开心，却笑得无端，杨承福不免诧异。


“Old Yang, you say life is a matter of connections.
“老杨！你说人生是个‘缘’字，

I say it's a play.
我说人生如戏。

Look!”
你看，”

He pointed to what he was wearing and then to the neatly folded official robes.
他指指身上，又指指刚折叠好的那套官服：

“Aren't these all costumes?
“这些不都是‘行头’吗？

Then again, perhaps it's those connections that create the drama.
不过，话又说回来，就因为有‘缘’才生出许多‘戏’来。

Chance brings people together, and each of us depends on the opportunities it gives.
人生偶合，各凭机缘，

There's no explaining it.”
其中没有道理好说。”


“Quite right, Your Honour.
“王老爷的话不错，

Now, please come along.
请吧！

My master is waiting.
我们大人在等，

Make sure you play your part well!”
你老好好把这出‘戏’唱下来！”


“Very true.”
“说得是。”

Wang nodded deeply.
王有龄深深点头。


Once he began to think of it as playing a part, he no longer felt awkward or at a loss.
心中存着个“唱戏”的念头，便没有什么忸怩和为难的感觉了。

Walking with measured dignity, he followed Yang into He's room on the west side.
踱着方步，由杨承福领到西面何桂清的屋子里，

He bowed on entering and said composedly, “Thank you, Your Excellency, for your generous gift.
进门一揖，从容说道：“多谢何大人厚赐。

You have truly taken the robe from your own back to clothe me.
真是‘解衣衣我’，

I cannot express my gratitude.” He Guiqing had not expected such worldly assurance and self-possession from Wang.
感何可何桂清没有想到他是如此老练深沉，

He was surprised, but also relieved.
相当惊异，同时心里一块石头也落了地。

He had been afraid that Wang might expose his humble origins before the servants.
他一直在担心，怕王有龄在底下人面前泄了他的底细，

Judging by this performance, he need have no such fear.
照现在这样子看，看决不会有的事。


“Please, you are far too formal!
“嗳，你太客气了！

What is mine is yours.” He Guiqing responded generously, making it clear from the outset that he had not forgotten their old affection.
你我何分彼此？”何桂清也很厚道，一上来就表明了不忘旧情的本心，

“Come and sit on the heated platform.
“请炕上来坐，

You'll be more comfortable.”
比较舒服些。”


Eight raised dishes of fruit and refreshments stood on its small table.
炕几上已摆了八个高脚盆子，装着茶点水果，

In front, coals crackled softly in a gleaming copper brazier.
炕前一个雪白铜的火盆，发出哗哗剥剥煤炭的轻响。

Wang felt that the setting was ideal for a long conversation about the past and gladly took the less honoured seat.
王有龄觉得这样的气氛，正宜于细谈叙旧，便欣然在下首落座。

He Guiqing tried to give him the place of honour, but Wang firmly refused, and the matter was dropped.
何桂清还要让他上坐，他一定不肯，也就算了。


When Yang brought lidded bowls of tea, the host instructed him, “Turn away every visitor.
当杨承福端来了盖碗茶，做主人的吩咐：“有客一概挡驾。

His Honour Wang and I have been like brothers since childhood.
王老爷是我从小的‘弟兄’，

We haven't met for twenty years and have a great deal to discuss.
二十年不见，我们要好好谈谈，
