从这里开始，黄宗汉便问他的家世经历，

After a while, an attendant came to ask whether dinner should be served and reported that the other guests had arrived.
谈了一会，听差来请示开席，又说陪客已经到了。


“Then let us go.” The host rose and invited Wang forward.
“那就请吧！”主人起身肃容，

“We can continue at table.”
“在席上再谈。”


Two other men were waiting in the inner room.
走到里间，两位陪客己在等候，

Both were secretaries in the governor's office.
都是抚署的“文案”、

One, surnamed Zhu, drafted memorials to the throne; the other, surnamed Qin, handled social correspondence.
一个姓朱的管奏折，一个姓秦的管应酬文字。

Both held provincial degrees but had failed at the metropolitan examination, and Huang had invited them to join his staff.
两个人都是举人，会试不利，为黄宗汉邀来帮忙。


Wang had no choice but to accept the place of honour at dinner.
这一席自然是王有龄首座、怎么样也辞不了的。

Yet in both rank and scholarly distinction, a man who had purchased qualification as a county magistrate hardly deserved to sit above the others, and he felt extremely awkward.
但论地位，论功名，一个捐班知县高踞在上，总不免局促异常。

Fortunately, he had read several practical books and had travelled south just as Hong and Yang's army swept eastward.
幸好他读了几部实用的书在肚子里，兼以一路来正赶上洪杨军长驱东下，

His unusual experiences and observations kept the conversation lively and helped conceal his sense of inferiority.
见闻不同，所以席上谈得很热闹，把那臼惭形秽的感觉掩盖过去了。


When the wine had begun to take effect, an attendant came in and whispered in Huang's ear.
酒列半酣，听差进来向黄宗汉耳边低声说了一句，

The governor answered loudly, “Bring it at once!”
只听他大声答道：“快拿来！”


What arrived was an official dispatch bearing a large purple seal.
拿来的是一解盖青紫泥大印的公文，

Huang opened it, read it, and handed it to Secretary Zhu, whose brows drew together before he had read more than a few lines.
拆开来看完，他顺手递了给“朱师爷”。朱师爷却是看不到几行，便皱紧了双眉。


“Jiangning has fallen,” Huang told Wang calmly.
“江宁失守了。”黄宗汉平静地对王有龄说：

“This is a communication from the governor of Jiangsu.”
“这是江苏巡抚来的咨文。”


“So it could not be held after all!” Wang asked in distress, “What of Governor-General Lu?”
“果然保不住！”王有龄咽然问道：“两江总督陆大人呢？”


“He died in the disaster.
“殉难了。

An unjust death!” Huang said.
死得冤枉！”黄宗汉说，

“The rebels used mines to breach the walls in two places.
“长毛用地雷攻破两处城墙，

After they entered, Magistrate Liu of Shangyuan resisted so fiercely that they were already retreating.
进城以后，上元县刘令，奋勇抵抗，长毛不支，已经退出，

Unfortunately, Governor-General Lu was returning from the garrison general's office to his own headquarters and encountered some of the fleeing rebels.
不想陆制军从将军署回衙门，遇着溃散的长毛，

His guards and chair-bearers abandoned the chair and ran.
护勇、轿班，齐轿而逃。

He died there without even a proper fight.
陆制军就这么不明不白死在轿子里！

A grievous injustice!”
唉，大冤枉了！”


Outwardly, Huang remained composed, almost indifferent.
黄宗汉表面表现得十分镇静，甚至可说是近乎冷漠，

This was a practised manner, intended to steady others by concealing his own feelings.
其实是练就了的一套矫情镇物的功夫，

Inside, he too was alarmed.
他的内心也很紧张，

He thought of Chang Dachun, Jiang Wenqing, and Lu Jianying: governors and governors-general had died one after another along the rebels' route.
尤其是想到常大淳、蒋文庆、陆建瀛等人，洪杨军一路所经的督抚，纷纷阵亡，

Provincial grandees enjoyed splendour, authority, and power far beyond those of officials in the capital.
地方大吏起居八座，威风权势，非京官可比，

Yet in war they were responsible for their territories and had to stand or fall with their cities.
但一遇到战乱，守上有责，非与城同存亡不可，

Even had Lu escaped the rebels, he could not have escaped dismissal and investigation for losing troops and territory.
象陆建瀛，即使不为洪杨军所杀，能逃出一条命来，也逃不脱革职拿问，丧师失地的罪名，

Death would still have awaited him.
到头来还是难逃一死，

The thought frightened Huang.
恩到这里，黄宗汉不免惊心。


After further discussion of events and two more rounds of wine, he suddenly asked Wang, “Brother Xuexuan, your observations are more direct than ours.
又说了阵时局，行过两巡酒，他忽然问王有龄：“雪轩兄，你的见闻较为真切。

Now that Jiangning has fallen, what do you think will happen?”
照你看，江宁一失，以后如何？”


Wang considered before replying. “The rebels are advancing with extraordinary force, while the lower Yangtze region is weakly defended.
王有龄想了想答道：“贼势异常猖獗，而江南防务空虚，

Its people have known no war for over a century and are deeply unsettled.
加川江南百姓百余年不知兵革，人心浮动，

The area around Suzhou and Changzhou gives particular cause for concern.”
苏、常一带，甚为可虑。”


“Fortunately, Xiang Xinran is pursuing them.
“好在向欣然已经追下来了。

Since retaking Wuchang, he has won eight victories in eight engagements and has been appointed imperial commissioner.
自收复武昌以来，八战八克，已拜钦差大臣之命，

Perhaps he can recover Jiangning.”
或许可以收复江宁。”


This was Secretary Qin's opinion.
这是秦师爷的意见，

Wang disagreed, but Qin was a member of the governor's staff and a new acquaintance.
王有龄不以为然，但抚署的文案，又是初交，

It would be awkward to contradict him, so Wang merely smiled.
不便驳他，只好微笑不答。


“Let me ask this,” Huang continued.
“我倒要请教，

“If Suzhou and Changzhou fall, the enemy will soon enter our province.
倘或苏常不守，转眼便要侵入本省。

Brother Xuexuan”—he looked closely at Wang—“can you suggest a plan?”
雪轩兄，”黄宗汉很注意地看着他，“可能借箸代筹？”


There was an element of examination in the question, and Wang dared not answer carelessly.
这带点考问的意思在内，他不敢疏忽。

After considering it, he replied calmly, “Hong and Yang's advance has become a spreading fire, and the court is exerting all its strength against it.
细想一想，从容答道，“洪杨军己成燎原之势，朝廷亦以全力对付，

Yet even a celebrated commander such as General Xiang has had little opportunity to display his abilities.
无奈如向帅虽为名将，尚无用武之地，

Retaking Wuchang and winning eight successive engagements are great achievements, but they owe something to circumstances created by others...”
收夏武昌，八战八克，功勋虽高，亦不无因人成事……”


“What do you mean by that?” Huang interrupted.
“怎么叫‘因人成事’？”黄字汉打断他的话问。


Wang had intended a tactful hint.
原是句含蓄的话，

Pressed to explain, he had to speak plainly.
既然一定要追问，只好实说。

He smiled apologetically towards Qin. “To tell the truth, Hong and Yang took the civilians with them and moved their whole army east.
王有龄向秦师爷歉意地笑一笑：“说实在的，洪杨军带着百姓，全军东下，

General Xiang, following behind, has merely recovered places they abandoned.”
向帅在后面撵，不过收夏了别人的弃地而已。”


“Mm.” Huang nodded and turned to Qin. “That judgement is not unduly harsh.”
“嗯，嗯！”黄宗汉点点头，向秦师爷说：“此论亦不算过苛。”

He then looked back at Wang, inviting him to continue.
然后又转眼看着王有龄，示意他说下去。


“In my humble opinion, the immediate task is to hold out until reinforcements arrive.
“以愚见，如今当苦撑待援，

If Suzhou and Changzhou can resist for a time, the court will certainly send its best troops to converge from several directions.
苏常能抵挡得一阵，朝廷一定会调遣精兵，诸路台围，

A stalemate will follow.
那时候便是个相持的局面，

Victory may not come quickly, but at least the situation will have been stabilised.
胜负固非一时可决，但局面优势总是稳住了，

Our province should therefore not wait until the enemy reaches its border before sending troops.
因此，本省不可等喊临边境，再来出兵，

The best policy is to go beyond our borders and meet them there.”
上策莫如出境迎敌！“


Huang stared at him, then struck the table in approval. “‘Go beyond our borders and meet them there’—excellent!”
黄宗汉凝视着他，突地击案称赏：“好一个‘出境迎敌’！”


He was thinking that fighting outside Zhejiang might keep the war from entering the province.
他在想，出境迎敌，战火便可不致侵入本省，

His responsibility for defending its territory would then not arise.
就无所谓“守土之责”，

If his troops were defeated elsewhere, there would still be room to shift the blame.
万一吃了败仗，在他入境内，总还有个可以卸责的余地。

Better still, the court had repeatedly ordered provinces not to regard fighting in other regions as no concern of their own, but to cooperate in defence and suppression.
这还下说，最妙的是，朝廷一再颁示谕旨，不可视他省的战事与己无关，务宜和衷共济，协力防剿，

Sending forces across the border would accord perfectly with imperial wishes.
所以出省迎敌正符合上面的意思，

A memorial announcing it would surely receive a favourable response.
等一出奏，必蒙优诏褒答。


Secretary Zhu, who drafted the memorials, also thought Wang's phrase excellent.
专管奏折的朱师爷，也觉得王有龄想出来的这四个字很不坏，

There was much to be made of it in writing, and he nodded repeatedly.
大有一番文章可做，也是频频点头。


“The plan is good,” Huang said, “but carrying it out will not be easy.
办法是吁！“黄宗汉又说，”不过做起来也不容易。

Of the two tasks, training troops and raising military funds, the harder is finding the money.”
练兵筹饷两事，吃重还在一个饷字！“


“Indeed,” Wang replied.
“是！”王有龄说：

“With territory comes wealth; with wealth, military funds; with funds, troops.” “And with troops, territory!” Zhu completed the circle.
“有土斯有时，有财就有饷，有的就有兵”有兵就有上！“朱师爷接着就了这一句，

Everyone clapped and laughed.
阑座抚掌大笑。


They discussed ways of raising money.
于是又谈到筹响之道，

Wang thought it essential to preserve the source of military revenue—that is, to hold the prosperous districts.
王有龄认为保持响源，也就是说，守住宫庶之区最关紧要。

The conversation then turned to grain transport.
然后又谈漕运，

Having experienced the canal's shallow, silted channels himself, he remarked that changing times might bring this ancient system into decline.
他亲身经历过运河的淤浅，感慨着说，时世的推移，只怕己历数千数的河运，将从此没落。

With war spreading through the lower Yangtze region, keeping the canal open would be harder still.
而且江南战火已成燎原，运河更难保畅通，

A change to sea transport was therefore inevitable, and the sooner preparations began, the better.
所以漕运改为海运，为势所必然，惟有早着先鞭。


He thought these views reasonably practical, and Huang and the two secretaries listened with sustained interest.
这些议论，他自觉相当平实，黄宗汉和那两位师爷，居然也倾听不倦。


Then a warning suddenly occurred to him.
但他忽生警觉，

This was his first audience with the governor.
初次谒见抚台，

Whatever the merits of his opinions, speaking so freely and expansively might make him appear shallow and presumptuous.
这样子放言高论，不管话说得对不对，总会让入觉得他浮浅狂妄，

Regretting it, he said almost nothing for the rest of the meal.
所以有些失悔，直到终席再不肯多说一句话。


Over tea afterwards, Huang finally addressed Wang's own business.
饭扣茗聚，黄宗汉才谈到他的正事，

“Since you've only just returned to the province,” he said, “let us wait until you've seen the provincial treasurer.”
“好在你刚到省。”他说，“且等见了藩司再说。”


“Yes, Your Excellency.” Wang lowered his head.
“是！”王有龄低头答道，

“I must look to you for advancement.”
“总要求大人栽培。”


“You are too kind.” As he spoke, Huang lifted his teacup.
“好说，好说！”说着已端起了茶碗。


This was the signal to the attendant on duty: the interview was over.
这是对值堂的听差暗示，也就是下逐客令，

The moment he saw it, the man called out in a long, loud voice, “Show the guest out!”
听差只要一见这个动作，便会拉开嗓子高唱：“送—客—！”


Wang hurriedly rose and saluted.
唱到这一声，王有龄慌忙起身请安，

Huang accompanied him towards the door.
黄宗汉送了出来，

At the front of the hall, Wang asked him not to come farther, but the host continued.
到堂前请留步，主人不肯，

Only after repeated protests at the reception-room doorway did Huang bow slightly and turn back.
直到花厅门口，再三相拦，黄宗汉才哈一哈腰回身而去。


Liu again led Wang out.
依然是刘二领着出衙问。

Wang was uneasy, unable to judge the governor's attitude.
王有龄心里七上八下，看不出抚台的态度，

At moments Huang seemed to value him; at others, to be merely polite.
好象很赏识，又好象是敷衍，

He wanted to ask Liu, but maintaining his official dignity made such a conversation on the way out inappropriate.
极想距刘二打听一下，但要维持宫派，不便跟他在路上谈这事，

He decided to send Gao to sound things out the next day.
打算着明干叫高升来探探消息。


Beyond the main hall, two new lanterns bearing the character Wang stood beside his blue-cloth chair in the gateway.
绕出大堂，就看见簇新两盏“王”字大灯笼，一顶蓝呢轿子都停在门侗里。

Liu opened the curtain himself.
刘二亲手替他打开轿帘，

Only after Wang had backed into his seat did he speak softly. “Rest easy, Your Honour.
等他倒退着坐进轿子。才低声说道：“王大老爷请放心，

That's how my master is.
我们大人是这个样子的。

When he means to help someone, he doesn't announce it.
要照应人，从不放在嘴上。

He'll give instructions to the provincial treasurer.
他自会有话交代藩台。

The treasurer is a bannerman and particular about ceremony.
藩台是旗人，讲究礼数，

Be careful not to overlook anything.”
王大老爷不可疏忽！”


“Indeed, indeed!” Wang clasped his hands inside the chair.
“是，是！”王有龄在轿中拱手，

“I'm deeply grateful for your help.”
感激他说，“多亏你照应，承情之至。”


Those few words enabled him to go to bed at peace.
由于有了刘二的那几句话，工有龄这夜才能恬然上床。

He wondered at himself: after so many years of idleness without urgency, why was he now anxious on every side when an appointment was almost certain?
他自已奇怪，闲了这许多年，也不着急，一旦放缺已有九成把握，反倒左右不放心，这是为了什么？

He pondered it for a long time before understanding.
在枕上一个人琢瞎了半天，才悟出其中的道理，

This office was not for himself alone.
他这个官下尽是为自己做，

He also had to fulfil Hu Xueyan's hopes, which made the prospect of success or failure weigh more heavily upon him.
还要有以安慰胡雪岩的期望，所以患得患失之心特甚。


Thinking of Hu reminded him of something.
想起胡雪岩便连带想起一件事，

He nudged his wife beside him. “Did anyone call today?”
推推枕边人问道：“太太，今天可有人来过？”


“Do you mean Young Master Hu?”
“你是问那位胡少爷吗？”

His wife was a sincere and kindly woman.
王太太是个老实的贤德妇人，

“I've been hoping all day too.
“我也是盼望了一天，

Afraid we might miss him, I sent the older maid to the gate again and again.
深怕错过了，叫老妈子一遍一遍到门口去看。

But no, he hasn't come.”
没有！没有来过。”


“It's very strange...”
“这件事好奇怪……”


“It's your own fault,” she said.
“都要怪你！”王太太说，

“After receiving such an immense kindness, you never even asked about his family or where he lived.
“受人这样大的恩惠，竟不问一问人家是什么人家，住在哪里？

Of all the muddle-headed people in the world, you must come first.”
我看天下的糊涂人，数你为第一了。


“I don't know what I was thinking.” Wang recalled the occasion.
“那时也不知道怎么想来的？”王有龄回忆着当时的情形，

“It happened so suddenly that I could hardly believe it.
“事起突然，总有点儿不信其为真，

It was like a wonderful dream.
仿佛做了个好梦，

I wanted it to continue and didn't want to examine it too closely, for fear that even the dream would vanish.”
只愿这个梦做下去，不愿去追根落实，怕那一来连梦都做不成。”


“If it was a dream, it was a very strange and wonderful one,” she said with happy amazement.
“如果说是做梦，这个梦做得也太希奇，太好了。”王太太欢喜地感叹着，

“Who could have imagined that you would then meet His Excellency He in Tongzhou?”
“哪里想得到在通州又遇上那位何大人！”


“Exactly.
“是啊！

We had lost touch for years, and I never paid much attention to the court gazettes or the biographical registers of successful examination candidates.
多年音问不通，我从前又不大看那些‘邸报’和进士题名的‘齿录’，

I had no idea he had done so well.” Wang added, “Just think: such an excellent connection was there all along, and I never used it.
竟不知道何桂清如此得意。”王有龄又说，“想想也是，现成有这么好一条路子下去走，

Instead, I stayed here in misery.
守在这里，苦得要命！

Isn't it ridiculous?”
不好笑吗？”


“At least our hardships are almost over.
“现在总算快苦出头了！

It all comes back to the good your father did in his lifetime.
说来说去，都是老太爷当年种下的善因。

Even meeting Young Master Hu must have been a reward for his hidden virtue.”
就是遇到胡少爷，一定也是老大爷积了阴德。”


Wang agreed wholeheartedly.
王有龄深以为然，

“An official's office offers many opportunities to do good.
“公门里面好修行，

A local magistrate controls both justice and revenue.
做州县官，刑名钱谷一把抓，

It's easy to commit wrongs, but just as easy to accumulate merit.
容易造孽，可是也容易积德。

My father knew poverty and hard study, and understood people's difficulties.
老太爷是苦读出身，体恤人情，

He really did a great deal of good.”
当年真的做了许多好事。”


“You must follow his example and plant some blessings for your children and grandchildren.” Then she added anxiously, “And kindness must be repaid.
“你也要学学老太爷，为儿孙种些福田！”王太太又忧郁他说，“受恩不可忘报，

Not knowing where Young Master Hu is makes me very uneasy.”
现在胡少爷踪影毫无，这件事真急人！”


“Ah!” Wang was even more troubled.
“唉！”王有龄比她更烦恼，

“Don't speak of it again.
“你不要再说了！

If you do, I won't sleep at all.”
说起来我连觉都睡不着。”


Knowing that he had to rise early to visit the provincial treasury, she said no more.
王太太知道丈夫明日还要起早上藩台衙门，便不再响。

Before dawn, she quietly got up and woke the maids and older women.
到了五更天，悄悄起身，把丫头老妈子都唤醒了。

By the time Wang rose, everything was ready.
等王有龄起身。一切都已安排得妥妥帖帖，

After breakfast, he dressed carefully, entered his chair, and set off in high spirits.
于是吃过早饭，穿戴整齐，坐着轿子，欣然“上院”。


The visit was fruitless.
上院扑了个空，

Provincial Treasurer Lingui had gone to Shanghai on business concerning the sea transport of grain and would not return for at least ten days or a fortnight.
藩司麟桂为漕米海运的事，到上海去了，起码得有十天到半个月的工夫，才能回来，

Disappointed, Wang could only console himself with the thought that good things seldom came without delays.
王有龄大为扫兴，只好用“好事多磨”这句话来自宽自解。


With nothing to do, he spent his days either waiting at home for Hu or visiting Secretary Yu to learn the news.
闲着无事，除了每天在家等胡雪岩以外，便是到臬司衙门去访俞师爷，打听时局。

The court gazettes frequently carried edicts urging the provinces to organise local militias.
京里发来的邪报常有催促各省办理“团练”的上谕，

The model was the fortified defence and denial of supplies used against the White Lotus rebels during the Jiaqing reign.
这是仿照嘉庆年间，平“白莲教”时所用的坚壁清野之法，

Senior officials residing in their home provinces were to draw upon the old principle of mutual assistance, organise local forces, and defend their districts.
委派各省在籍的大员，本乎“守望相助”的古义，白办乡团练兵，保卫地方，

Besides directing these men to work with local officials and gentry, the edicts required senior officials in the capital and members of the academies and censorial offices to recommend people they knew: men who understood affairs, were fair-minded, and already enjoyed public esteem.
上谕中规定的办法是，除了在籍大员会同地方官，邀集绅士筹办以外，并“着在京各部院堂官及翰、詹、科、道，各举所知，总期通晓事体，居心公正，素系人望者，

Entrusted with initiating the work, such men should manage it properly and command public confidence.
责成倡办，自必经理得宜，舆情允阶”。

The gentry were also reminded that, having received imperial favour, they should secure their communities and unite against the enemy.
同时又训勉办理团练的绅士，说“该绅士等身受厚恩，应如何自固阎里，为敌汽同仇之计，

Persuading the population, raising contributions, clearing moats, and building stockades were all to be arranged according to local conditions.
所有劝谕、捐赀、浚濠、筑寨各事，总宜各就地方情形，妥为布置。

No official was to handle the funds.
一切经费，不得令官吏经手。

Governors and governors-general could recommend rewards whenever the work proved effective.
如果办有成效，即由该督抚随时妻请奖励。”


“Do you see?” Yu said, pointing to the provision that no official should handle the funds.
“ 你看见没有？”俞师爷指着“一切经费，不得令官吏经手”这句话说，

“The court's distress is plain. Local officials know only how to squeeze the people; they won't work conscientiously.”
“朝廷对各省地方官，只会刮地皮，不肯实心办事，痛心之情，溢于言表！”


“The plan is well framed,” Wang replied.
“办法是订得不错，

“With that provision, the gentry needn't fear official interference and can act freely.
有了这句话，绅士不怕掣时，可以放手办事。

But everything depends first on finding the right people.
但凡事以得人为第一，

There are plenty of disreputable gentry too.
各地的劣绅也不少，

If they choose to appropriate the money and monopolise control, any official who asks questions can be fended off with the imperial edict.
如果有意侵渔把持，地方官问一问，便拿上谕来作个挡箭牌，

The abuses could be endless.”
其流弊亦有不可胜言者！”


Yu nodded. “I wonder who will be appointed in Zhejiang.
俞师爷点点头说：“浙江不知会派谁？

Dai Chunshi will surely be among them.”
想来戴醇士总有份的。”


“Who is Dai Chunshi?” Wang asked.
“戴醇士是谁？”王有龄问，

“Is he the former vice-minister famous for his landscape paintings?”
“是不是那位画山水出名的戴侍郎？”


“Yes, exactly.”
“对了！正是他。”


A few days later, the gazette did indeed carry an edict appointing the retired vice-minister of War Dai Xi, grand secretariat academicians Zhu Pinfang and Zhu Lan, and Hunan governor Lufei Quan to supervise Zhejiang's militia arrangements.
过了几天，果然邸报载着上谕：“命在籍前任兵部侍郎戴熙，内阁学士朱品芳、朱兰，湖南巡抚陆费瑔等督办浙江团练事宜。”

Lufei Quan's surname was not Lu but the compound Lufei, belonging to a clan found only in Jiaxing, Zhejiang.
陆费瑔不姓陆，是姓陆费，只有浙江嘉兴才有这一族。


“The times are changing,” Yu remarked at their next meeting.
“气运在变了！”俞师爷下一次与王有龄见面时，这样感叹，

“At the beginning of our dynasty, great campaigns were entrusted to imperial relatives as commanders-in-chief.
“本朝有大征伐，最初是用亲贵为‘大将军’，

Later they went to senior banner officials, usually sons of hereditary military families.
以后是用旗籍大员，亦多是祖上的勋绩军功的世家子弟，

Now they are being given to Han Chinese—and to scholars at that.
现在索性用汉人，而且是文人。

This is a great change in the affairs of the state.
此是国事的一大变，

I wonder how effective warfare learned from books will prove.”
不知纸上谈兵的效用如何？”


Wang reflected that it was true.
王有龄想想这话果然不错，

Beyond Zhejiang, the militia organisers he knew of included Vice-Minister of Rites Zeng Guofan in Hunan and Grand Secretariat Academician Lü Xianji in Anhui.
办团练的大臣，除了浙江省以外，外省的，据他所知，湖南是礼部恃郎曾国藩，安徽是内阁学士吕贤基，

Elsewhere too, the work was led by senior civil officials of the first or second rank, living at home, who had risen through the examinations.
此外各省莫不是两榜进士出身，在籍的一二品文臣主持其事。

Grand Secretariat Academician Xu Naizhao had even been ordered to assist with military affairs in the lower Yangtze region.
内阁学士许乃刽甚至奉旨帮办江南军务，

Scholars were not merely commanding troops; they were going to the battlefield.
书生下但握兵权，而且要上战场了。


“Brother Xuexuan,” Yu continued, “living in a peaceful age is a blessing.
“雪轩兄！”俞师爷又说，“时逢盛世，固然是修来的福分，

But troubled times offer an opportunity to men who can accomplish things.
时逢乱世，也是有作为的人的良机，

I spend my life preparing the way for others, moving from one private staff to another.
象我依人作嫁，游幕终老，

My own course is already set.
可以说此生已矣，

You must not miss this chance.”
你却不可错过这个良机！”


Such encouragement made Wang's ambition burn more brightly and his desire to serve more urgent.
受到这番鼓励的王有龄，雄心壮志，越发跃然，因而用世之心，格外迫切，

Every day he awaited Lingui's return, hoping that after an audience and an appointment he could finally begin some real work.
朝朝盼望麟佳归来，谒见奉委之后，好切切实实来做一番事业。


One evening after supper, Wang had just spread out a map he had drawn himself, intending to consult it while reading Records of Imperial Military Achievements by lamplight.
这天晚上吃过饭，刚刚摊开一张自己所画的地图，预备在灯下对照着读《圣武记》，

Gao suddenly entered in a red-tasselled hat and saluted. “Congratulations, Your Honour!
忽然高升戴着一顶红缨帽，进门便请安：“恭喜老爷，

Your appointment from the provincial treasurer has arrived!”
藩台的委札下来了！”


“What?” Only then did Wang notice the official document in Gao's hand.
“什么？”这时王有龄才发觉高升手中有一封公文。


“The treasury sent it by special messenger.” Gao presented it.
“藩台衙门派专人送来的。”说着他把委札递了上去。


Wang opened it.
打开来一看，

He was appointed executive director of the Sea Transport Bureau.
是委王有龄做“海运局”的“坐办”。

This office had been established specifically to manage the change from canal to sea transport for the grain tax.
这个衙门，专为漕米改为海运而设，

The provincial treasurer concurrently held the title of director-general, but the executive director was the man actually in charge.
“总办”由藩司兼领，“坐办”才是实际的主持人。

Wang was disappointed not to receive a substantive local magistracy, yet it was still good news.
王有龄未得正印官，不免失望，但总是一桩喜事，

“Where is he?” he asked.
便问，“人呢？”


He meant the messenger.
那是指送委札的人，

Gao replied, “Still outside.
高升答道：“还在外头。

He's a clerk from the provincial treasury.”
是藩台衙门的书办。”


“Oh.” Wang consulted him. “Do you think I should receive him?”
“噢！”他跟高升商量，“你看要不要见他？”


“There is no need, but he should be given a reward.”
“见倒不必了。不过要发赏。”


“Of course, of course.”
“那自然，自然。”


Mrs Wang had thought of that long before.
王太太是早就想到了，

An appointment messenger would expect a reward, and she had kept a red packet ready for days.
有人来送委札必要发赏，一个红纸包已包好了多日，

She now brought it out herself.
这时便亲自拿了出来。


Gao hurriedly saluted and congratulated her too, and husband and wife exchanged congratulations.
高升急忙又替太太请安道喜，夫妇俩又互相道贺。

After the packet of four taels had been taken outside, the older maids, cook, and chair-bearers heard the news and came together to kneel and offer their good wishes.
等把四两银子的红包拿了出去，家里的老妈子、厨子、轿班，得到消息，约齐了来磕头贺喜，

Mrs Wang rewarded each with a tael.
王太太又要发赏，每人一两银子。

Everyone was happy that night.
这一夜真是皆大欢喜，

Only Wang felt that something was still missing.
只有王有龄微觉美中不足。


After the bustle subsided, he remembered an important question and called Gao back. “Has the provincial treasurer returned?”
乱过一阵，他才想起一件要紧事，把高升找了来问道：“藩台是不是回来了？”


“He arrived this afternoon and went straight to see the governor.
“今天下午到了，一到就‘上院’，

The instructions must have been emphatic, since your appointment was sent out this very evening.”
必是抚台交代得很结实，所以连夜把委札送了来。”


“Then I must go early tomorrow to thank him.”
“那明于一早要去谢委。”


“Yes.
“是！

I've already told the bearers.
我已经交代轿班了，

After that, you'll have calls to make.
谢了委还要拜客，

I'm going to the gatehouse now to prepare.
我此刻要在门房里预备。

Most important is the visiting list.
顶要紧一张拜客的名单，

Leave out one name, and you've offended someone.”
漏一个就得罪人。“


Wang nodded repeatedly, thoroughly satisfied.
王有龄非常满意，连连点头。

While Gao went to prepare the list and visiting cards, he took up his own brush in the private rooms.
等高升退了出去，在门房里开拟名单，预备手本，他也在上房里动笔墨，

He wrote a detailed letter to He Guiqing at Jiangyin, describing his return to Hangzhou, his audience with Governor Huang, and his appointment as executive director of the Sea Transport Bureau.
把回杭州谒见黄抚台和奉委海运局坐办的经过，详详细细写了一封信，告诉在江阴的何桂清。


By the time he finished, it was midnight.
信写完已经十二点，

His wife personally brought him a light meal and urged him to bed.
王太太亲自伺候丈夫吃了点心，催他归寝。

His head reached the pillow, but his mind would not rest.
人在枕上，心却不静，

First he thought of engaging someone to handle his writing; then of the questions Treasurer Lingui might ask the next day.
一会儿想到要请个人来办笔墨，一会儿又想到明天谢委，麟藩台会问些什么？

Would he choose his own date for taking office, or await instructions?
再又想到接任的日子，是自己挑，还是听上头吩咐？

By the time he had settled these matters in his mind, the clock was striking two.
等把这些事都想停当，已经钟打两下了。


He rose after only three hours' sleep.
也不过睡了三个钟点，便即起身。

Happiness had refreshed him so completely that he showed no sign of the short night.
人逢喜事精神爽，一点都看不出少睡的样子，

At the provincial treasury, he submitted his card and was admitted at once.
到了藩台衙门，递上手本，麟桂立即请见。


After Wang had knelt in thanks for the appointment and the customary greetings were over, Lingui spoke frankly. “You are the man the governor has sent me.
磕头谢委，寒暄了一阵。麟桂很坦率地说：“你老哥是抚台交下来的人，

I shall have much to rely on you for.
我将来仰仗的地方甚多，

There's no need to stand on ceremony.
凡事不必客气，

With the governor behind us, cooperation should be easy.
反正有抚台在那里，政通人和，

You may decide some matters yourself.”
有些事你就自己作主好了。”


Wang detected a strong note of resentment and quickly leaned forward. “I would not presume.
王有龄一听这话，醋意甚浓，赶紧欠身答道：“不敢！

Though the governor has favoured me, it is truly to Your Excellency that I owe my advancement.
我虽承抚台看得起，实在出于大人的栽培，

The distinction between superior and subordinate is part of the state's proper order.
尊卑有别，也是朝廷体制所关，

Naturally, I shall act on your instructions in everything.”
凡事自然秉命而行。”


“No, no!” Lingui waved his hands.
“不是，不是！”麟桂不断摇手，

“I'm not trying to keep you at a distance or shift responsibility.
“我不是跟你说什么生分的话，也不是推责任，

I mean what I say.
真正是老实话。

This governor is difficult to serve, and grain transport is more difficult still.
这位抚台不容易伺候，漕运的事更难办，

My predecessor lost his life over it, so I admit that I am wary.
我的前任为些把条老命都送掉，所以不瞒你老哥说，兄弟颇有戒心。

Nothing could be better than having you take this heavy burden of sea transport on your shoulders.
现在海运一事，千斤重担你一肩挑了过去，再好都没有。

As to how it is managed, you would do well to find out the governor's wishes.
将来如何办理，你不妨多探探抚台的口气。

I can sit back, pass your submissions on, and approve rather than reject them.
我是垂拱而治，过一过手转上去，公事只准不驳，

Wouldn't that suit everyone?”
岂不是大家都痛快？”


He was indeed speaking honestly.
倒真的是老实话！

Wang concluded that Huang intended to control sea transport himself and had appointed Wang to act on his behalf.
王有龄心想，照这样子看，是黄宗汉要来管海运，委自己出个面。

Lingui merely wished to avoid trouble.
麟桂只求不生麻烦，

If the work went well, his name would appear in the recommendations for rewards; if badly, the governor above him would bear the burden.
办得好，“保案”里少不了他的名字，办不好有抚台在上面顶着，也可无事，

It was a sensible calculation.
这个打算是不错的。


Wang therefore said little, replying only with respect, “I am young and inexperienced.
于是他不多说什么，只很恭敬地答道：“我年轻识浅，

I shall look to Your Excellency for guidance in everything.”
一切总要求大人教导。”


“I can hardly call it guidance.
“教导不敢当。

But since the sea-transport arrangements began under me, I can explain the situation to you.”
不过海运是从我手里办起来的，一切情形，可以先跟你说一说。”


“Yes, Your Excellency.” Wang straightened, leaned forward, and listened closely.
“是！”他把腰挺一挺，身子凑前些，聚精会神地听着。


“First, when do you intend to take up your duties?”
“我先请问，你老哥预备哪一天接事？”


“I await Your Excellency's instructions.”
“要请大人吩咐。”


“The sooner the better.” Lingui called, “Attend me!”
“总是越快越好！”麟桂喊道：“来啊！”


He sent an attendant for the imperial almanac and examined it.
唤来听差，叫取皇历来翻了翻，

The day after next was auspicious for assuming office, so that date was chosen.
第三天就是宜于上任的黄道吉日，决定就在这天接事。


“One other question.
“再有一件事要请问，

How many men have you ready to bring with you?”
你老哥‘夹袋’里有几个人？”


Wang had no staff of his own.
王有龄一个“班底”也没有，

Had he obtained a magistracy, he would have asked Yu to find suitable men.
如果是放了州县缺，还要找俞师爷去找人，

He knew nothing of the Sea Transport Bureau's requirements and could not answer immediately.
海运局的情形不知如何？一时无法作答。

While hesitating, he suddenly remembered someone for whom he must reserve a position.
就在这踌躇之间，忽然想到了一个人，必须替他留个位置。


“Only one man, surnamed Hu.
“只有一个人，姓胡，

He's extremely capable, though I don't know whether he'll agree to come.”
人极能干。就不知他肯不肯来？”


“In that case, please do your best to retain the bureau's existing staff.”
“既然如此，海运局里的旧人，请老哥尽力维持。”


So that was it.
原来如此！

Lingui feared that Wang would arrive with a group of his own followers to install and was making his wishes known in advance.
麟藩台是怕他一接事，自己有批人要安插，所以预先招呼。


Wang thought the treasurer an honest enough man.
王有龄觉得这位藩台倒是老实人，

“I shall follow Your Excellency's instructions.”
“我听大人的吩咐。”

He also left room for a possibility. “If the governor sends anyone to be placed, I shall report to you and discuss the arrangements.”
他又安了个伏笔，“倘或抚台有人交下来，那时再来回禀大人，商量安置的办法。”


“Very good.”
“好，好！”

Lingui turned to the business itself. “The change to sea transport for the grain of Jiangsu and Zhejiang is under the overall supervision of Ni Liangyao, recently appointed provincial treasurer of Jiangsu.
麟桂接着便谈到海运，“江浙漕米改为海运，由新近调补的江苏藩司倪良耀总办。

You must be careful with him.”
这位仁兄，你要当心他！”


“Oh?”
“噢！”

Wang paid particular attention. This was important.
这是要紧地方，王有龄特为加了几分注意。


“It's fortunate that our governor enjoys imperial favour and has powerful backing.
“亏得我们抚台圣眷隆，靠山硬，

Otherwise, Ni might really have landed us in trouble.”
不然真叫他给坑了！”


Ni had limited ability, and his management of the two provinces' sea shipments had not gone smoothly.
原来倪良耀才具有限，总办江浙海运，不甚顺利，

Faced with stern imperial orders to hasten the work, he shifted responsibility onto Zhejiang, claiming that only sixty thousand-odd shi of its new grain had arrived.
朝廷严旨催促，倪良耀便把责任推到浙江，说浙江的新漕才到了六万余石。

In fact, more than three hundred thousand shi had already reached Shanghai.
其实已有三十几万石运到上海，

Huang reported the facts, and an imperial edict sharply rebuked Ni.
黄宗汉据实奏复，因而有上谕切责倪良耀。


“With that grievance between us, the business will be difficult.
“有这个过节儿在那里，事情便难办了。

Ni will be looking for faults at every opportunity.
倪良耀随时会找毛病，

You must be careful.
你要当心。

That's the first point.”
此其一。”


“Yes.
“是。”

What is the second?”
王有龄问道：“请示其二。”


“Some places in Zhejiang are difficult too, especially Huzhou.
“二呢，我们浙江有些地方也很难弄。尤其是湖州府，

The local gentry dominate affairs, and many large landholders owe grain taxes.
地方士绅把持，大户欠粮的极多。

This year's new grain must be dispatched early by imperial order, so the deadline is tighter than ever.
今年新漕，奉旨提前启运，限期上越发紧迫。

The previous prefect was dismissed for delaying the shipments.
前任知府，误漕撤任，

I am now considering...”
我现在在想……”


Lingui suddenly stopped.
麟桂忽然不说下去了。

What did he mean? Wang wondered.
这是什么意思呢？王有龄心里思量：

Was he thinking of appointing him acting prefect of Huzhou?
莫非要委署湖州府？

That could not be right.
这也不对啊！

Wang belonged to the magistrates' category and had never even acted in a substantive post.
州县班子尚未署过实缺，

How could he be promoted out of nowhere?
何能平白开擢？

Perhaps he meant one of Huzhou's counties.
也许是委署湖州府属的哪一县。

That would be splendid.
果真如此，就太妙了！

Of the prefecture's seven counties, Wucheng, Gui'an, and Deqing produced the most grain tax.
湖州府属七县，漕米最多的乌程。归安、德清三县。

All three were famously prosperous.
此三县富庶有名，

To begin with a first-class county, serve for two or three years, and have someone above him offering support—then a prefecture might be within reach.
一补就先补上一等大县，干个两三年，上头有人照应，升知府就有望了。


“In short, there is Ni Liangyao outside the province and Huzhou within it.
“总而言之一句话，外面一个倪良耀，里面一个湖州府，

Handle those two well, and the rest will be easier.
把这两外对付得好，事情就容易了。

We can discuss other matters once you've taken over.”
其余的，等你接了事再说吧！”

Lingui lifted his teacup to end the audience.
麟桂说到这里端茶碗送客。


Leaving the treasury, Wang went straight to the governor's office.
出了藩台衙门，随即到抚署谒见。

Liu greeted him with warm congratulations, then said, “His Excellency is discussing business with the intendants of the Hangzhou–Jiaxing–Huzhou and Ningbo–Shaoxing–Taizhou circuits.
刘二非常亲热地道了喜，接着便说，“上头正邀了‘杭嘉湖’、‘宁绍台’两位道台在谈公事，

He may not have time to receive you.
只怕没有工夫见王大老爷。

I'll go and see.”
我先去跑一趟看。”


Huang was indeed consulting the two military circuit intendants about sending troops beyond the province to block the enemy.
果然，黄宗汉正邀了两个“兵备道”在谈出省堵敌的公事，

He had no time for Wang, but sent instructions through Liu: after taking over, Wang was to put the bureau in order without being constrained by other considerations.
无暇接见，但叫刘二传下话来：接事以后，好好整顿，不必有所瞻顾。

When a little time became available, Huang would summon him for a full discussion.
又说，等稍为空一空，会来邀他上院，详谈一切。


The instruction not to be constrained plainly referred to Lingui.
所谓“不必瞻顾”，自是指麟桂而言。

Taken together, the words of governor and treasurer showed Wang that, though nominally executive director, he had in fact assumed full responsibility for Zhejiang's grain shipments by sea.
把抚、藩两上司的话合在一起来看，王有龄才知道自己名为坐办，实在已挑起了总负浙江漕米海运的全责。


“Let me tell you something privately,” Liu said, drawing him aside.
“我跟王大老爷说句私说，”刘二把他拉到一边，悄悄说道，

“His Excellency has let it be known that, with military affairs so urgent, grain supplies concern the army's food, and the court is watching closely.
“上头有话风出来了：如今军务吃紧，漕米关系军食，朝廷极其关切。

If the sea shipments meet their deadlines, he can make a special recommendation for your exceptional promotion.
只要海运办得不误限期，这一案中可以特保王某，请朝廷破格擢用。

Whether it brings you fortune or disaster is in your own hands.”
是祸是福，都在王某自己。”


“The governor thinks so highly of me that I scarcely know what to say.
“真正是，抚台如此看得起我，我不知说什么好了。

When you have a chance, please tell him that I shall not disappoint the confidence he has shown in promoting me.”
得便请你回一声，就就我决不负抚台的提拔。”


Liu promised to convey the message.
刘二答应一定把话转到。

Then he discreetly handed Wang two biographical cards and smiled ingratiatingly. “One is my mother's brother; the other is my sworn brother.
接着悄悄递过来两张履历片陪笑道：“一个是我娘舅，一个是我拜把兄弟，

I hope Your Honour can find places for them.”
请王大老爷栽培。”


“Certainly, certainly.” Wang agreed at once and put the cards away without reading them.
“好，好！”王有龄一口答应，看也不看，就把条子收了起来。


He then began making his official calls, following the list Gao had prepared in an order that avoided unnecessary travel.
由此开始拜客，高升早已预备了一张名单，按照路途近远，顺路而去。


The garrison general, judicial commissioner, salt commissioner, Hangzhou–Jiaxing–Huzhou circuit intendant, and prefect of Hangzhou all counted as superiors and required formal visiting cards.
驻防将军、臬司、盐运使、杭嘉湖道、杭州府都算是上司，须用手本，

The magistrates of Renhe and Qiantang were his equals and received ordinary cards.
仁和、钱塘两县平行用拜帖，

Beyond them were the expectant intendants, prefects, and magistrates.
此外是候补的道府、州县，

Most calls amounted only to leaving a card at the gate, since the host customarily declined to receive visitors.
仅不过到门拜帖，主人照例挡驾，

Even so, a whole day was not enough to finish.
却跑了一天都跑不完。


Back home, Wang sent specially to invite Yu to dinner.
回到家，特为又派人到臬司衙门把俞师爷请来吃便饭，

Over a little wine, he described the attitudes of the governor and treasurer.
一在把杯小酌，一面说了这天抚、藩两宪的态度。

Yu was delighted for him.
俞师爷很替他高兴，

The executive directorship, he explained, would ordinarily go to an expectant circuit intendant, or at least an expectant prefect.
说这个“坐办”的差使，通常该委候补道，至少也得一名候补知府，

For someone of Wang's standing, it was exceptional advancement.
以王有龄的身分，派季这个差使，那是逾格的提拔，

He should not regret failing to obtain a magistracy.
不该为不得州县正堂而烦恼。


This removed Wang's remaining disappointment.
这一番话说得王有龄余憾尽释，

He asked about the procedures for taking office and requested a reliable man to handle his writing.
便向他讨教接事的规矩，又“要个办笔墨的朋友”，

Yu recommended a cousin surnamed Zhou, guaranteeing his diligence and trustworthiness.
俞师爷推荐了他的一个姓周的表弟，保证勤快可靠。

Wang gladly accepted and agreed to issue the formal letter of engagement the next day.
王有龄欣然接纳，约定第二天就下“关书”。


“There is something else on which I'd like your advice.”
“还有件事要向老兄请教。”

He showed Yu the two biographical cards. “These come through Liu Er at the governor's office.
他把刘二的两张履历，拿给俞师爷看：“是抚署刘二的来头，

One is his uncle; the other his sworn brother.”
一个是他娘舅，一个是他拜把兄弟。“


“Uncle and brother indeed!” Yu laughed.
“什么娘舅兄弟？”俞师爷笑道，

“They've paid Liu for his help.
“ 都是在刘二那里花了钱的，

The family relationships are merely a pretext.”
说至亲兄弟，托词而已！”


“So that's it!” Wang had learned another lesson.
“原来如此！”王有龄又长了一分见识，

“I suppose the older one is the uncle and the younger one the brother.
“想来年长的是‘娘舅’，年轻的是‘兄弟’。

How should I place them?”
你看看如问安插？”


“Liu is an old fox of the first order.
“刘二是头千年老狐狸，

You cannot ignore him, but you shouldn't oblige him too readily either.
不买帐固不可，太买帐也不好，

If he thinks you easy to deceive, he'll keep asking for more and cause endless trouble.”
当你老实好欺，得寸进尺，以后有碍麻烦。”


Yu decided the matter for him.
俞师爷代他作主，

Both men held official qualifications below the recognised ranks.
看两个人都有“未入流”的功名，

The younger, with more energy, could be made a transport escort officer; the older, better suited to sedentary work, could assist with incoming and outgoing correspondence.
年轻的精力较好，派了“押运要员”，年长的坐得住，派在收发上帮忙。

The arrangement was so appropriate that Wang accepted it with complete satisfaction.
处置妥帖，王有龄心悦诚服。


Taking office and receiving congratulations occupied two or three noisy days.
接享受贺，热闹了两三天，

Only then could he settle down to work.
才得静下心来办事，

His first task was to examine the correspondence and case files.
第一步先看来往文卷。


He now discovered that Huang's report that more than three hundred thousand shi had reached Shanghai and been delivered to Ni was not entirely accurate.
这时他才知道，黄宗汉奏报，已有三十余万石漕米运到上海交倪良耀之说，有些不尽实，

Most of the grain was still aboard canal boats and had not been handed over.
实际上大部分的漕注还在运河粮船上，未曾交出，

Any mishap would carry serious responsibility.
倘或出了意外，责任不轻，

The shipments had to be hurried forward.
得要赶紧催运。


While he was pondering the difficulty, Huang sent a civil affairs officer with a message: “There is urgent official business.
正在踌躇苦思之时，黄宗汉特为派了个“文巡捕”来，说：“有紧要公事，

His Honour Wang is to come at once.”
请王大老爷即刻上院。”

On arrival, Wang first knelt to thank the governor for his favour.
到了抚台衙门，先叩谢宪恩，

Huang received the gesture without protest.
黄宗汉坦然坐受，

As soon as Wang rose, he handed him a document. “Read this imperial edict first.”
等他起身，随即递了一封公事过来，说道：“你先看一看这道上谕。”


Wang knew that an imperial instruction transmitted through the Grand Council was called a court dispatch.
王有龄知道，这是军机处转达的谕旨，称为“延寄”，

He had often heard of such documents, but this was the first he had seen.
不过虽久闻其名，却还是第一次瞻仰，

The supposedly resplendent words of the sovereign were written on ordinary folded xuan paper, five lines to a page and twenty characters to a line.
只见所谓“煌煌天语”，不过普通的宣纸白单帖所写，每页五行，每行二十字，

There was neither a seal nor a signature.
既无钤印，亦无签押，

Without the envelope bearing the Grand Council's seal, he could scarcely have believed that such an unremarkable sheet was an imperial edict.
如果不是那个铃了军机处印的封套，根本就不能相信这张不起眼的纸，便是圣旨。


Thinking this, he read it through while holding it respectfully in both hands.
一面这样想，一面双手捧着看完，

His memory was good, and one reading fixed the whole content in his mind.
他的记性好，只看了一遍，就把内容都记住了。


Once again, the edict urged haste in the grain shipments.
这道上谕仍旧是在催运漕米，

The court had grown impatient with Ni Liangyao's repeated complaints that his appointed agents were ineffective and rebuked him sharply.
对于倪良耀一再申述所派委员，不甚得力，朝廷颇为不耐，严词切贡，

It concluded: “The provincial treasurer shall, in accordance with the repeated imperial commands, expedite the grain received from Zhejiang together with that of Jiangsu still awaiting dispatch, ensuring that the vessels put to sea by the prescribed date.
最后指令“该藩司即将浙省运到米石，井苏省起运未完米石，仍遵叠奉谕旨，赶紧催办，务令克期放洋。

Should there be the slightest further delay, I shall punish Ni Liangyao severely.”
倘再稍有延误，朕必将倪良耀从重冶罪。”


“I have also received a letter from the capital,” Huang said.
“我另外接得京里的信，”黄宗汉说，

“Since Yangzhou fell, the defending commanders have proposed opening the sluices to drain the Huai waters and prevent the rebels' boats from moving east.
“从扬州失守以后，守将为防长毛东窜，要放闸泄尽淮水，让贼舟动弹不得。

If they reach Gaoyou and Baoying, the embankments of Lake Hongze may be breached to drown them.
如果到了高邮、宝应，还要决洪泽湖淹长毛，

The whole region would become a sea, the people would drown with the enemy, and this year's grain would be lost as well.
那时汪洋一片，百姓一起淹在里面，本年新漕也就泡汤了。

That's why the demand for sea shipments is now so urgent.
为此之故，对海运的漕米，催得急如星火。

If Ni fails again, he'll certainly lose his rank.
倪良耀再办不好，一定摘顶戴，

We in Zhejiang must consider our position too.”
我们浙江也得盘算一下。“


Wang listened closely.
王有龄极细心地听着，

At the last sentence, he understood everything.
等听到最后一句，随即完全明白，

Zhejiang had not actually delivered its full quota.
浙江的漕米实在也没有运足，

If Ni were dismissed and investigated, he would have nothing left to lose and might reveal all the facts.
万一倪良耀革职查办，那时无所顾忌，将实情和盘托出，

Huang's inaccurate report would then expose him to serious trouble.
黄抚台奏报不实，这一下出的纰漏可就大了。


There was only one sound course: get the rice to Shanghai as quickly as possible and have the seagoing vessels accept the full quantity.
为今之计，除却尽快运米到上海，由海船承兑足额以外，别无善策。

Wang said so, but Huang showed no reaction.
他把这番意思说了出来，黄宗汉的脸上没有什么表示。


No reaction was itself a reaction: displeasure.
没有表示就是表示，表示不满！

Wang thought that nothing short of a guarantee to deliver everything within five or ten days would satisfy him.
王有龄心想，除非告诉他，五天或者十天，一定运齐，他是不会满意的。

Yet he could not honestly offer one.
但自己实在没有这个把握，

He could only reply, “I'll send agents out tonight to press the shipments forward.
只能这样答道：“我连夜派员去催，

I shall neglect nothing, however small.”
总之一丝一毫不敢疏忽。”


“That will have to do.” Huang spoke coolly, lifted his teacup, rose before his guest, gave a slight bow, and went inside.
“也只好这样了。”黄宗汉淡淡地说了这一句，一端茶碗，自己先站起身来，哈一哈腰，往里走去。


Wang was deeply discouraged.
王有龄大为沮丧。

Only a few days into the job, his first working audience had ended like this.
接事数天，第一次见抚台，落得这样一个局面，

He felt not merely hurt but chilled.
不但伤心，而且寒心，

A superior who treated his subordinates in such a manner would indeed be difficult to serve.
黄抚台是这样对部属，实在难伺候。


Sitting in his chair, he brooded.
坐在轿子里，闷闷不乐，

The proud pleasure with which he had looked about on his first rides a few days earlier had vanished.
前两天初坐大轿，左顾右盼的那份得意心情，已消失无余。

Lost in thought, he scarcely noticed where they were passing.
想着心事自然也不会注意到经过了哪些地方？

Then, through his distracted state, a figure suddenly caught his eye.
就在这迷惘恍惚之中，蓦地里兜起一个影子，

Stamping his foot, he shouted, “Stop the chair!
急忙顿足喊道：“停轿，

Stop!”
停轿！”


The bearers, moving at a brisk pace, had no idea what was wrong.
健步如飞的轿班不知怎么回事，

They tried desperately to halt but carried on for several steps before they could stop.
拼命煞住脚，还是冲了好几步才能停住。


Gao, walking beside the chair with the document folder under his arm, hurried to the front.
挟着“护书”跟在轿旁的高升，立即也赶到轿前，

His master had already lifted the curtain and thrust out his head, staring wide-eyed back along the street.
只见主人已掀开轿帘，探出头来，睁大了眼回头向来路上望。


The sudden commotion drew curious passers-by to a halt.
这个突如其来的动作，引起了路人的好奇，纷纷住足，

Seeing them watching from a distance, Gao felt that his master's dignity was at risk and called softly, “Your Honour!”
遥遥注视，高升看看有失体统，便轻喊一声：“老爷！”


At the sight of him, Wang said, “Quick!
一见高升，王有龄便说：“快，快，

The man in the black lined robe—stop him!”
有个穿墨布夹袍的，快拉住他。”


There were plenty of men in black lined robes.
穿黑布夹袍的也多得很，

What sort of man did he mean?
是怎等样一个人呢？

Tall or short, stout or thin, and how old?
高或矮，胖还是瘦，年纪多大，

Gao needed at least some description before he could search.
总要略略说明了，才好去找。


While he hesitated, Wang lost patience.
他还在踌躇，王有龄已忍不得了，

He beat on the carrying pole, demanding that the bearers lower the chair so he could leap out and pursue the man himself.
拼命拍轿杠，要轿班把它成倒，意思是要跨出轿来自己去追。

This was still less seemly.
这越发不象样了，

Gao cried repeatedly, “Your Honour, your dignity!
高升连声喊道：“老爷，老爷，体统要紧，

Who is it?
到底是谁？

Tell me, and I'll find him.”
说了我去找。”


“Who else?
还有谁？

Young Master Hu!”
胡少爷！“


“Ah!” Gao set off at a run.
“啊！”高升拔脚便奔，

He had heard his master describe Young Master Hu many times and already had a vivid picture of him in his mind.
“胡少爷”是怎么个人，他听主人说过不止一遍，脑中早有了极深的印象。


He ran along, examining the passers-by.
一路追，一路细察行人，

One man wore a black robe but had a grey beard.
倒有个穿黑布袍的，却是花白胡须的老者，

Another was approaching middle age and had an unprepossessing appearance.
再有一个已近中年，形容猥琐，

He did not seem right either, but Gao asked his surname just in case.
看去不象，姑且请问“尊姓”，

It was not Hu.
却非姓胡。

Gao grew anxious and puzzled.
这时高升有些着急，也不免困惑，

He trusted that, though his master had only caught a passing glimpse, he could not have mistaken Hu Xueyan.
他相信他主人与胡雪岩虽失之交臂，却决不会看错，

Where could the man have gone in these few moments?
然则就此片刻的工夫，会走到哪里去了呢？



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第三章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Three, first part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER THREE｜第三章


As Gao hesitated, looking this way and that and wondering what to do, he suddenly spotted the man.
正徘徊瞻顾，不知何以为计时，突然眼前一亮，

The fellow eating at the improvised counter must be him.
那个在吃“门板饭”的，一定是了。

Hangzhou's eating houses still preserved customs from the Song dynasties.
杭州的饭店，犹有两宋的遗风，

Upstairs were comfortable private seats; downstairs, cooked dishes were sold from large red-lacquered platters laid out on doors taken from their frames and used as counters.
楼上雅坐，楼下卖各样熟食，卸下排门当案板，摆满了朱漆大盘，盛着现成菜肴，

Long benches stood in front, where pedlars and labourers sat together for what was called a “door-plank meal.”
另有长条凳，横置案前，贩夫走卒，杂然并坐，称为吃“门板饭”。

A bowl of rice arrived heaped as high as a little pagoda.
一碗饭盛来，象座塔似地堆得老高，

Anyone unused to it hardly knew where to put his chopsticks: should he begin at the summit or halfway down?
不是吃惯了的，无法下箸，不知从顶上吃起，还是从中腰吃起？

The men in short working clothes therefore stared when this customer in a long gown sat down.
所以那些“穿短打”的一见这位“寄大衫儿的”落座，都不免注目，

A gentleman dining in such a place was unusual enough; more than that, they wanted to see how he would manage the rice.
一则是觉得衣冠中人来吃“门板饭”，事所罕见，二则是要看他如何吃法？

If he did not know the trick, the top would collapse.
不会吃，“塔尖”会倒下来，

They were waiting for the joke.
大家在等着看他的笑话。


Gao had reached him by then.
就在这时，高升已经赶到，

Studying his profile, he felt almost certain and ventured a call: “Young Master Hu!”
侧面端详，十有八九不错，便冒叫一声：“胡少爷！”


The men in working clothes laughed.
这一声叫，那班“穿短打的”都笑了，

What young master would come here for a door-plank meal?
哪有少爷来吃门板饭的？


Though new to Hangzhou, Gao had already learned something of local ways.
高升到杭州虽不久，对这些情形已大致明白，

He realised that his form of address was ill chosen.
自己也觉得“胡少爷”叫得不妥，

Even if this was Hu, he might be embarrassed to answer.
真的是他，他也不便答应，

Gao therefore approached and asked, “Excuse me, is your surname Hu?”
于是走到他身边问道，“请问，贵姓可是胡？”


“Yes.
“不错。

What of it?”
怎地？”


“And is your courtesy name Xueyan?”
“台甫可是上雪下岩？”


It was indeed Hu Xueyan.
正是胡雪岩，

Setting down the bamboo chopsticks he had just picked up, he said, “I am Hu Xueyan, but I don't believe we've met...”
他把刚拈起的竹箸放下，问道：“我是胡雪岩。从未见过尊驾……”


His faded clothes and unshaven face told Gao that Young Master Hu had fallen on hard times, which explained his choice of eating place.
高升看他衣服黯旧，于思满面，知道这位“胡少爷”落魄了，才去吃门板饭。

A public reunion in the street would make a story, and might not sound well for his master's official reputation.
如果当街相认传出去是件新闻，对自己老爷的官声，不大好听，

He therefore avoided naming Wang Youling.
所以此时不肯说破王有龄的姓名，只说：

“My master's surname is Wang.
“敝上姓王，

You'll know him as soon as you see him.
一见就知道。

There's no need to eat here, Young Master Hu.
胡少爷不必在这里吃饭了，

Let me take you to him.”
我陪了你去看敝上。”


Without waiting for an answer, he put a handful of copper coins on the counter with one hand and helped Hu step over the bench with the other.
说罢不问青红皂白，一手摸一把铜钱放在案板上，一手便去搀扶胡雪岩，跨出条凳，

Then he beckoned to a small hired sedan chair waiting nearby.
接着便招一招手，唤来一顶待雇的小轿。


Hu was bewildered and refused to get in.
胡雪岩有些摸不着头脑，不肯上轿，

Catching Gao's arm, he asked, “Which Mr Wang is your master?”
拉住高升问道：“贵上是哪一位？”


“He is...”
“是……”

Gao lowered his voice.
高升放低了声音说：

“His official name is Youling.”
“我家老爷的官印，上有下龄。”


“Ah!”
“啊！”

Hu's eyes lit up.
胡雪岩顿时眼睛发亮：

“It's him!
“是他。

Where is he now?”
现在在哪里？”


“His residence is in Qinghefang.
“公馆在清和坊。

Please get into the chair.”
胡少爷请上轿。”


Once Hu was seated, Gao gave the bearers the address.
等他上了轿，高升说明地址，

As soon as the little chair moved away, he hurried back to Wang and briefly explained what had happened.
等小轿一抬走，他又赶了去见王有龄，略略说明经过。

Wang was overjoyed.
王有龄欢喜无量，

He too climbed into his blue-cloth chair and urged the bearers to hurry.
也上了蓝呢大轿，催轿班快走。


The two chairs reached the Wang residence almost together.
一前一后，几乎同时抬到王家，

Gao had run ahead and ordered the central gates opened, so both were carried straight to the hall.
高升先一步赶到，叫人开了中门，两顶轿子，一起抬到厅前。

When the friends stepped out and faced each other, each felt as though he were dreaming.
彼此下轿相见，都有疑在梦中的感觉，

Wang in particular was overwhelmed by the sight of Hu's poverty and desperation.
尤其是王有龄，看到胡雪岩穷途末路的神情，

His nose stung and his eyes grew hot.
鼻子发酸，双眼发热。


“Xueyan!”
“雪岩！”


“Xuexuan!”
“雪轩！”


After those greetings, neither could speak.
两个人这样招呼过，却又没有话了，

Countless things crowded their throats and weighed upon their hearts, but with only one mouth apiece, neither knew what to say first.
彼此都有无数话梗塞在喉头，还有无数话积压在心头，但嘴只有一张，不知先说哪一句好？


Gao, standing beside them, had to intervene.
一旁的高升不能不开口了：

“Perhaps Your Honour would take Young Master Hu into the reception room.”
“请老爷陪着胡少爷到客厅坐！”


“Ah!”
“啊！”

Wang came to himself.
王有龄这才省悟，

“Come, Xueyan.
“来，来！

Sit down and rest before we talk.
雪岩且先坐下歇一歇再说。

We needn't stay out here.
也不必在外面了，

Let's go to the back, where it's more comfortable.”
请到后面去，舒服些。”


He led Hu into the rear hall.
一引引到后堂，

Mrs Wang, who had been watching from behind a screen, hurried away.
躲在屏风后面张望的王太太，慌忙回避。

Catching sight of her moving skirt, Hu hesitated.
胡雪岩瞥见裙幅飘动，也有些踌躇。

This reminded Wang of something else.
这下又提醒了王有龄。


“My dear!” he called loudly.
“太太！”他高声喊道，

“Come and meet this brother of mine.”
“见见我这位兄弟！”


Their bond went beyond ordinary family friendship; they were truly like brothers.
这样的交情，比通家之好更进一层，真个如手足一样，

Mrs Wang therefore came out without embarrassment.
王太太便很大方地走了出来，

Smiling, she pointed to Hu but spoke to her husband.
含着笑，指着胡雪岩，却望着她丈夫问：

“So this is the Young Master Hu you've been thinking of by day and dreaming of by night!”
“这位就是你日思夜梦的胡少爷了！”


“I hardly deserve that title.”
“不敢当这个称呼！”

Hu bowed deeply.
胡雪岩一躬到地。


She returned the bow and spoke with feeling.
王太太还了礼，很感动地说：

“Young Master Hu, we really don't know how to thank you.
“胡少爷！真正不知怎么感激你？

As soon as Xuexuan came back to Hangzhou, he went to look for you.
雪轩一回杭州，就去看你，

He returned without finding you and sighed and fretted, not knowing what to do.
扑个空回来，长吁短叹，不知如何是好？

I blamed him: how could anyone have so good a friend without asking where he lived?
我埋怨雪轩，这么好的朋友，哪有不请教人家府上在哪里的道理？

Now all is well.
如今好了，

Where did you meet?”
是在哪里遇见的？”


“In... in the street.”
“在，在路上。”

Hu looked embarrassed.
胡雪岩有些窘。


Wang's first rush of emotion had subsided a little.
王存龄的由意外凉喜所引起的激动，这时已稍稍平伏，

He hurried his wife along.
催着他妻子说：

“My dear, we couldn't finish all we have to say in three days and nights.
“太太！我们的话，三天三夜说不完，

Leave the questions for now.
你此刻先别问，

Neither of us has eaten.
我们都还没有吃饭，

See what is ready and bring a few dishes so we can have a drink.”
看看，有现成的，先端几个碟子来喝酒。”


“Certainly.”
“有，有。”

She smiled.
王太太笑着答道，

“Take Young Master Hu to the study.
“请胡少爷上书房去吧，

It's quiet there.”
那里清静。”


“Just so!”
“对了！”


Wang led Hu to the study.
王有龄又把胡雪岩引到书房，

His wife soon followed with the maid and older servant to look after them herself.
接着王太太便带着丫头、老妈子，亲来照料。

Surrounded by such warmth, Hu felt that even the hardship and insecurity of the past half-year had been worth enduring.
胡雪岩享受着这一份人情温暖，顿觉这大半年来的飘泊无依之苦，受得也还值得。


“Xuexuan,” he asked, “when did you return?”
“雪轩！”他问，“你几时回来的？”


“Less than a month ago.”
“回来还不到一个月。”

Wang was thoroughly content with his own circumstances, but the sight of Hu saddened him.
王有龄对自己心满意足，但看到胡雪岩却有些伤心，

“Xueyan, how did you come to this?”
“雪岩，你怎么弄成这样子？”


“It's a long story.”
“说来话长。”

Hu hesitated.
胡雪岩欲言又止地，

“What about you?
“你呢？

You seem to have done very well.”
我看很得意？”


“And whom have I to thank but you?
“那还不是靠你。

I've had one extraordinary encounter after another.
连番奇遇，

That tale in Strange Stories Old and New about the unlucky man whose fortune turns through Dongting oranges is nothing beside my experience.”
什么《今古奇观》上的‘倒运汉巧遇洞庭红’，比起我来，都算不了什么！”

He paused, then exclaimed, “Well, now that I've found you, everything can be put right.
王有龄略停一停，大声又说，“好了！反正只要找到了你就好办了。

Come!
来，来，

Today we drink until we're drunk.”
今天不醉不休。“


Four dishes and two sets of cups and chopsticks had been laid on a square table nearby.
另一面方桌上已摆下四个碟子，两副杯筷，

When they sat down, Mrs Wang wrapped a cloth around the wine pot and poured for them herself.
等他们坐下，王太太亲自用块手中，裹着一把酒壶来替他们斟酒。

Hu hurriedly protested at the honour.
胡雪岩便慌忙逊谢。


“My dear,” Wang said, “drink a toast to my brother, then go and attend to the kitchen.
“太太！”王有龄说，“你敬了兄弟的酒，就请到厨房里去吧，

Otherwise he'll feel obliged to keep standing on ceremony and won't be at ease.”
免得兄弟多礼，反而拘束。”


She toasted Hu and withdrew, leaving a maid to serve them.
于是王太太向胡雪岩敬过酒，退了出去，留下一个丫头侍候。


As they ate, Wang told his story, from meeting He Guiqing in Tongzhou to his appointment at the Sea Transport Bureau, filling in his own family background along the way.
于是一面吃，一面说，王有龄自通州遇见何桂清开始，一直谈到奉委海运局坐办，其间也补叙了他自己的家世。

By the time he finished, the wine had gone cold.
所以这一席话谈得酒都凉了。


“Congratulations!”
“恭喜，恭喜！”

Hu's face was flushed with drink, and every trace of his defeated appearance had vanished.
胡雪岩此时已喝得满面红光，那副倒霉相消失得无形无踪，

He smiled proudly.
很得意地笑道：

“My judgement was right after all.
“还是我的眼光不错，

I could see that your bad luck was ending and your good fortune about to begin.
看出你到了脱运交运的当儿，

And so it did.”
果不其然。”


“My good fortune began when I met you.”
“交运也者，是遇见了你。

Wang looked ashamed. “Xueyan, no wonder my wife calls me muddle-headed.
雪岩，”王有龄愧歉不安地说，“无怪乎内人说我湖涂，

You did me such an immense kindness, yet I never even learned where you lived.
受你的大恩，竟连府上在哪里都不知道。

Today you must tell me all about yourself.”
今天，你可得好好儿跟我说一说了。”


“Of course I shall.”
“自然要跟你说。”

Hu drank, planted both hands squarely on the corners of the table, and tilted his head slightly.
胡雪岩喝口酒，大马金刀地把双手撑在桌角，微偏着头问他：

“Xuexuan, what sort of man do you take me for?”
“雪轩，你看我是何等样人？”


Considering his manner and recalling his earlier impressions in the teahouse, Wang supposed that Hu must be the son of an official family, but one who had lowered his ambitions and preferred idling in teahouses to serious study.
王有龄看他的气度，再想一想以前茶店里所得的印象，认为他必是个官宦人家的了弟，但不免有些甘于下流，所以不好好读书，成天在茶店里厮混。


Naturally, he could not voice that judgement so bluntly.
当然，这“甘于下流”四字，他是不能出口的，

“Brother, don't be offended,” he said.
便这样答道：“兄弟，我说句话，你别生气。

“I took you for a well-born young idler.”
我看你象个纨袴.”


“An idler?” Hu laughed.
“纨袴？”胡雪岩笑了，

“You might have called me a liaogui'er instead!”
“你倒不说我是‘撩鬼儿’！”

That was the Hangzhou expression for a street loafer or local ruffian.
这是杭州话，地痞无赖叫“撩鬼儿”。


“Then I can't guess.
“那我就猜不到了。

Tell me the truth.
请你实说了吧，

I'm terribly anxious to know.”
我心里急得很！”


“Very well.
“那就告诉你，

I learned my trade in a private bank...”
我在钱庄里‘学生意’……”


Hu's father had died, leaving the family poor, and he had entered a private bank as an apprentice while still a boy.
胡雪岩父死家贫，从小就在钱庄里当学徒，

In Hangzhou, such apprentices were called “trade students.” He began with sweeping floors and emptying chamber pots.
杭州人称为“学生子”，从扫地倒溺壶开始，

But he was extraordinarily quick, a shrewd judge of people, persuasive in speech, and generous in his dealings.
由于他绝顶聪明，善于识人，而且能言善道，手面大方，

When his three-year apprenticeship ended, he immediately became one of the bank's most useful employees.
所以三年满师，立刻便成了那家钱庄一名得力的伙计，

At first he worked at the counter.
起先是“立柜台”，

Later, having won the confidence of both proprietor and manager, he was sent out to collect debts.
以后获得东家和“大伙”的信任，派出去收帐，

He had never made a mistake.
从来不曾出过纰漏。


The previous summer, when he learned from Wang that he held a salt-station superintendent's qualification and wanted to go north to register and purchase a higher one, Hu happened to have a debt to collect.
前一年夏天跟王有龄攀谈，知道他是一名候补盐大使，打算着想北上“投供”、加捐时，胡雪岩刚有笔款子可收。

It was exactly five hundred taels.
这笔款子正好五百两，

The account had gone bad, and the bank had already accepted the loss and written it off.
原是吃了“倒帐”的，在钱庄来说，已经认赔出帐，

Any recovery would be an unexpected gain.
如果能够收到，完全是意外收入。


No one else could collect it.
但是，这笔钱在别人收不到，

The debtor had the backing of a Green Standard officer, and if he refused to pay, the bank preferred to avoid trouble rather than challenge him.
欠债的人有个绿营的营官撑腰，他要不还，钱庄怕麻烦，也不敢惹他。

But he and Hu got on well.
不过此人跟胡雪岩很谈得来，

Hu heard that the man had somehow come into money and went to see him.
不知怎么发了笔财，让胡雪岩打听到了去找他，

The debtor said that anyone else would have been refused, but Hu was a different matter.
他表示别人来不行，胡雪岩来另当别论，

He readily fixed a date to settle the debt in full.
很慷慨地约期归清。


Moved by sympathy for Wang's wasted abilities, Hu decided to help him.
胡雪岩一念怜才，决定拉王有龄一把。

Since the bank had already treated the money as irrecoverable, he reasoned, he could lend it on to Wang.
他想，反正这笔款子在钱庄已经无法收回，如今转借了给王有龄，

If Wang repaid it later, all the better.
将来能还最好，

If not, the bank would be no worse off than before.
不能还，钱庄也没有损失。


There was a certain logic in the argument.
这个想法也不能说没有道理，

Had he acted quietly, nobody would have known, and nobody would have thought to inquire for some time.
悄悄儿做了，人不知，鬼不觉，一时也不会有人去查问这件事。

The trouble was that he disclosed everything.
坏就坏在他和盘托出，

He even drew up a promissory note in Wang's name and delivered it to the manager responsible for the bank's business.
而且自己写了一张王有龄出面的借据送到总管店务的“大伙”那里。


Entrusted with the proprietor's affairs, how could the manager accept such unilateral reasoning?
“大伙”受东家的委托，如何能容胡雪岩这种“一厢情愿”的想法，

In view of Hu's past service, he did not pursue Hu's guarantor, but he told him to pack his bedding and leave.
念在他平日有功，也不追保，请他卷了铺盖。

Word spread through the trade.
这一下在同行中传了出去，

Everyone said Hu was recklessly presumptuous.
都说他胆大妄为，

Luckily, this had been only five hundred taels.
现在幸亏是五百两，

What if it had been five thousand or fifty thousand?
如果是五千两、五万两，

If he took such liberties, might he not ruin an entire firm?
他也这样擅作主张，岂不把一爿店都弄“倒灶”了？


With that reputation, no bank would employ him, although everyone knew his abilities.
为了这个名声在外，同业间虽知他是一把好手，却谁也不敢用他。

Some also suspected that, given his fondness for gambling, he had lost money and invented the story to cover its misappropriation.
同时又有人怀疑他平日好赌，或许是在赌博上失利，无以为计，饰词挪用了这笔款子。

Once this further accusation spread, earning a living became harder still.
这个恶名一传，生路就越加困难了。


“Thank heaven you've finally returned,” Hu said, as though relieved of a heavy burden.
“谢天谢地，”胡雪岩讲到这里，如释重负似地说，“你总算回来了！

“Whatever happens about the money, your present position will at least enable me to clear my name.”
不管那笔款子怎么样，以你现在的身分，先可以把我的不白之冤，洗刷干净。“


With moist eyes, Wang sighed deeply.
润湿的双眼的王有龄，长长叹了口气：

“If we hadn't met again today, who would have imagined that I had unknowingly caused you so much suffering?
“唉，如果你我没有今天的相遇，谁会想得到我冥冥中已经害得你好惨。

Such kindness is beyond thanks.
如今，大恩不言谢，

Tell me what I should do.”
你看我该怎么办？”


“That's for you to decide.
“这要看你。

How can I say?”
我如何能说？”


“No, no!”
“不，不！”

Realising that he had expressed himself badly, Wang hurried to explain.
王有龄发觉自己措词不妥，赶紧抢着说道，

“That's not what I mean.
“我不是这意思，

Your affairs are mine.
我是说，你的事就是我的事。

I know how to restore your reputation fully.
怎么样把面子十足挣回来，这我有办法，

What I want to ask is what you intend to do next.
现在要问你的是，你今后作何打算？

Would you like to return to the bank?”
是不是想回原来的那家钱庄？”


Hu shook his head and quoted a Hangzhou saying: “Dried bean curd put back in the broth has lost its flavour.”
胡雪岩摇摇头，说了句杭州的俗语：“ ‘回汤豆腐干’，没有味道了。”


“Then do you want to set up on your own?”
“那么，是想自立门户？”


That was exactly what Hu wanted.
这句话说到了他心里，

But as he was about to admit it, another thought stopped him.
但就在要开口承认时，忽然转念，

Opening a bank was no simple matter.
开一家钱庄不是轻而易举的事，

It required capital and powerful support.
要本钱也要有人照应。

Wang had only just obtained an appointment; his resources were still limited.
王有龄现在刚刚得了个差使，力量还有限，

If Hu declared his ambition, Wang's loyalty and gratitude would compel him to do everything possible to help.
如果自己承认有此念头，看他做人极讲义气，为了感恩图报，一定想尽办法来帮自己，

He would take on a burden too heavy for him and be crushed beneath it.
千斤重担挑不动而非挑不可，那就先要把他自己压坏。


How could Hu allow that?
这怎么可以？


Alarmed by the possibility, he changed his answer.
有些警惕，胡雪岩便改口了，

“I don't want to earn my living in banking any more.
“我不想再吃钱庄饭。”他说，

Your bureau must employ quite a few people.
“你局里用的人大概不少，

Just find me some easy post where I can draw a salary without much work.”
随便替我寻个吃闲饭的差使好了。”


Wang smiled happily and imitated the Hangzhou accent.
王有龄欣悦地笑了，学着杭州话说：

“There'll be no money for sitting idle!”
“闲饭是没有得把你吃的。”


Hu understood.
胡雪岩心里明白，

Wang would give him an important position at the bureau.
他会在海运局里给他安排一个重要职司，

Then he could use his abilities to help his friend.
到那时候，好好拿些本事来帮一帮他。

Once Wang had prospered through that help, Hu could borrow a few thousand taels as capital with a clear conscience.
把他帮发达了，再跟他借几千两银子出来做本钱，那就受之无愧了。


When they had eaten and drunk their fill, two bowls of excellent Longjing tea were brought in, and the conversation continued.
吃得酒醉饭饱，沏上两碗上好的龙井茶，赓续未尽的谈兴，

Wang described Huang's character, recounted Chunshou's case as news, and spoke of the governor's difficult temper.
王有龄提到黄宗汉的为人，把椿寿一案，当作新闻来讲，又提到黄抚台难伺候，

From there, he turned to the audience he had attended that day.
然后话锋一转，接上今日上院谒见的情形。


“What do you intend to do now?” Hu asked.
“那么你现在预备怎么样呢？”胡雪岩问，

He meant how Wang would get the outstanding grain to Shanghai quickly enough to complete delivery.
意思是问他如何能够把应运的漕米，尽速运到上海，交兑足额？


“What can I do?
“我有什么办法？

Only press them as hard as possible.”
只有尽力去催。”


“That's difficult.”
“难！”

Hu shook his head.
胡雪岩摇着头说，

“You officials have no idea what other people suffer.
“你们做官的。哪晓得人家的苦楚？

Once transport shifts to the sea, the canal boatmen lose their livelihood.
一改海运，漕丁都没饭吃了，

To speak frankly, the associations would be delighted if the scheme failed.
所以老实说一句，漕帮巴不得此事不成！

You want them to carry the rice to Shanghai by canal.
你们想从运河运米到上海，

You're in a hurry; they aren't.
你急他不急，

They'll drag things out until you miss the deadline.
慢慢儿拖你过限期，

Then you'll discover how much power they have.”
你就知道他的厉害了。”


“Ah!”
“啊！”

Wang sat bolt upright.
工有龄矍然而起，

“Then we're certain to miss it.
“照你这一说，是非逾限不可了。

What can be done?”
那怎么办呢？”


“There's always a way.”
“总有办法好想。”

Hu tapped his temple.
胡雪岩敲敲自己的太阳穴说，

“Nothing in the world is beyond a solution; the difficulty is getting people to think.
“世上没有没有办法的事，只怕不用脑筋。

I have a plan that will save you a great deal of trouble.
我就有一个办法，这个办法包你省事，

It'll cost a little extra, but that's money well spent if it saves the governor's rank.”
不过要多花几两银子，保住了抚台的红顶子，这几两银子也值。”


Wang was doubtful, but might as well hear him out.
王有龄有些不大相信，但不妨听他讲了再说，

He nodded.
便点点头：

“Let's hear this excellent plan of yours.”
“看看你是什么好办法？”


“Rice is rice, wherever it comes from.
“米总是米，到哪里都一样。

Make up the shortage where it's needed.
缺多少就地补充，

Buy rice in Shanghai, deliver the full quota, and the problem is solved.”
我的意思是，在上海买了米，交兑足额，不就没事了吗？”


Before he had finished, Wang sprang up in delight.
他的话还没有完，王有龄已经高兴得跳了起来：

“Excellent! Excellent!
“妙极，妙极！

That's what we'll do.”
准定这么办。”


“But there's one condition: not a word must leak out.
“不过有一层，风声千万不可泄漏。

This is a large quantity of rice.
漕米不是少数，

If the merchants hear of it, they'll immediately raise their prices.
风声一漏出去，米商立刻扳价，

Too great a difference, and the business becomes difficult.”
差额太大，事情也难办。”


“Yes.”
“是的。”

Wang collected himself and considered the matter.
王有龄定定神盘算了一会，问道，

“Xueyan, do you hold any official or scholarly qualification?”
“雪岩，你有没有功名？”


“I'm a commoner of the first rank.”
“我是一品老百姓。”


“You ought to purchase a title.
“应该去报个捐，

Even one below the regular ranks would make you an official of sorts and simplify your work.
哪怕是‘未入流’，总算也是个官，办事就方便了。

For now, I can only issue a letter of engagement...”
现在我只好下个‘关书’……

Wang hesitated.
“王有龄又踌躇着说，”

“And I'm not even sure whether I can appoint you as a secretary.”
也还不知道能不能聘你当‘文案’？“


“One thing at a time,” Hu said quickly, anxious not to embarrass him.
“慢慢来，慢慢来！”胡雪岩怕他为难，赶紧安慰着他说。


“How can it wait?
“怎么能慢呢？

If you're to help me, you need some recognised position.”
我要请你帮我的忙，总得有个名义才好。”

Wang frowned.
王有龄皱着眉说，

“There are too many loose ends.
“头绪太多，

I suppose we must deal with them one by one.
也只好一样一样来。

Xueyan, who is there in your family?”
雪岩，你府上还有什么人？”


“My mother and my wife.”
“一个娘，一个老婆。”


“Then I must pay my respects to your mother...”
“那我要去拜见老伯母……”


“No, no!”
“不必，不必！”

Hu hastily stopped him.
胡雪岩急忙拦阻，

“Not just now.
“目前不必。

The lane where I live is too narrow for a sedan chair, and there's nowhere fit to sit inside.
我住的那条巷，轿子部抬不进去的，舍下也没有个坐处，

A visit now would expose my poverty rather than do me honour.
你现在来不是替我增光，倒是出我的丑。

Another time.”
将来再说。“


Knowing that Hu meant it, Wang let the matter drop.
王有龄知道他说的是老实话，便不再提此事，

He rose.
站起身来说：

“Sit here a moment.
“你先坐一坐，

I'll be back.”
我就来。”


When he returned, he held a bank draft for fifty taels and simply told Hu to use it for the present.
等他回出来时，手里拿着五十两一张银票，只说先拿着用。

Hu accepted without ceremony, rose to leave, and promised to return the next day.
胡雪岩也不客气，收了下来，起身告辞，说明天再来。


“I won't keep you today.
“今天就不留你了。

Come to the bureau first thing tomorrow; I'll be waiting especially for you.
明天一早，请你到我局里，我专诚等你？

And one more thing: leave me your address.”
还有一件，你把府上的地址留下来。”


Hu lived in Yuanbao Street and supplied the details.
胡雪岩住在元宝街，把详细地址留了下来。

Wang then ordered Gao to prepare four kinds of carefully chosen gifts and take them there to pay his respects to Madam Hu, with a card identifying himself humbly as her nephew by family friendship.
王有龄随后便吩咐高开，备办四色精致礼物，用“世愚侄”的名帖，到元宝街去替“胡老太太”请安。


Gao returned from delivering the presents in high spirits.
高升送了礼回来，十分高兴，

Poor as Hu was, he remained remarkably open-handed and had given Gao a gratuity of four taels.
因为胡雪岩虽然境况不佳，出手极其大方，封了四两银子的赏号。


“I tried to refuse; it was far too much,” Gao told his master.
“我不肯收，赏得太多了。”高升报告主人，

“But Young Master Hu insisted.
“胡少爷非叫我收不可，

He said he was only being generous with someone else's money.”
他说他亦是慷他人之慨。”


“Then you should accept it.”
“那你就收下好了。”

Wang thought that, with Hu's ability and temperament, any opportunity would lead him rapidly to success.
王有龄心里在想，照胡雪岩的才干和脾气，一旦有了机会，发达起来极快，

His own future might depend greatly on this man.
自己的前程，怕与此人的关系极大，

He must make good use of him.
倒要好好用一用他。


Early the next morning Hu arrived as promised, splendidly dressed.
第二天一早，胡雪岩应约而至，穿得极其华丽。

Gao, already instructed to wait for him, took him straight to Wang's private office.
高升早已奉命在等候，一见他来，直接领到“签押房”，

Wang asked, “Where is that bank?”
王有龄便问：“那家钱庄在哪里？”


“In the Lower City, at Salt Bridge.
“在‘下城’盐桥。

It's called Xinhe.”
字号叫做‘信和’。”


“Come with me.
“请你陪我去。

You handled the original transaction, so tell me how the note was worded.
你是原经手，那张笔据上是怎么写的？请你先告诉我，

I don't want my account to contradict it.”
免得话接不上头。”


Hu reflected, then recited slowly: “I, Wang Youling, expectant salt-station superintendent, acknowledge borrowing from Xinhe Bank, through the intermediary Hu Xueyan, five hundred taels of full-standard silver by the treasury weight, for necessary expenses in travelling to the capital to register.
胡雪岩想了一下，徐徐念道：“立笔据人候补盐大使王有龄，兹因进京投供正用，凭中胡雪岩向信和钱庄借到库平足纹五百两整。

Repayment is agreed within two years, with interest at the prevailing market rate.
言明两年内归清，照市行息。

Since a verbal statement is insufficient proof, this note is issued as a record.”
口说无凭，特立笔据存照。”


“How much interest would that make?”
“那么，该当多少利息呢？”


“It depends on the availability of money; there is no fixed rate,” Hu said.
“这要看银根松紧，并无一定。”胡雪岩说，

“At the high end, one point two per cent a month; at the low end, seven-tenths.
“多则一分二，少则七厘，

If we take one per cent throughout, ten months would make about fifty taels.”
统算打它一分，十个月的工夫，五十两银子的利息也就差不多了。”


Wang wrote an order authorising an advance of six hundred taels against official expenses and sent Gao to the accounts office.
于是王有龄写了一张“支公费六百两”的条谕，叫高升拿到帐房。

Soon the accounts clerk came himself with men carrying the silver: six official ingots, each weighing a hundred taels, newly received from the provincial treasury.
不一会管帐的司事，亲自带人捧了银子来，刚从藩库里领来的，一百一锭的官宝六锭，

Fresh from the mould and never used, they gleamed brilliantly.
出炉以后，还未用过，簇簇光新，令人耀眼。


“Shall we go to Xinhe together?”
“走吧？一起到信和去。”


“In that case, I'd better stay here,” Hu replied.
“这样，我不必去了。”胡雪岩说，

“If I go, the manager will be embarrassed in front of me.
“我一去了，那里的‘大伙’，当着我的面，不免难为情。

There's something else: say a few good words about Xinhe, and don't mention that we've already met.”
再有一句话，请你捧信和两句，也不必说穿，我们已见过面。”


This deepened Wang's understanding of his friend.
王有龄听他这一说，对胡雪岩又有了深一层的认识，

Hu was generous-hearted—or at the very least, remarkably graceful in his methods.
此人居心仁厚，至少手段漂亮，

Who else would willingly surrender such a chance to hold his head high before those who had dismissed him?
换了另一个人，象这样可以扬眉吐气的机会，岂肯轻易放弃？


Yet Hu was prepared to deny himself that satisfaction in order to preserve another man's dignity.
而他居然愿意委屈自己，保全别人的面子，

What breadth of mind!
好宽的度量！


For that reason, Wang abandoned his own plan to put on formal robes and arrive with gongs and shouted commands to frighten the bank.
因为如此，王有龄原来预备穿了公服，鸣锣喝道去唬信和一下的，这时也改了主意，

Instead, he changed into ordinary clothes, took a small chair, wrapped the six ingots in a cloth bundle, placed them inside, and went quietly to Xinhe with Gao.
换上便衣，坐一顶小轿，把六锭银子，用个布包袱一包，放在轿内，带着高升，悄悄来到了信和。


As soon as the chair stopped, Gao went ahead with the visiting card.
轿子一停，高升先去投帖。

Banks were exceptionally well informed about official affairs.
钱庄对官场的消息最灵通，

Xinhe's manager, known as Fat Zhang, recognised the name of a man favoured by the governor.
信和的大伙张胖子，一看名帖，知道是抚台面前的红人，

The name Wang Youling also sounded familiar in another connection.
王有龄三字也似乎听说，

A moment's thought brought the memory back—and broke him into a sweat.
细想一想，恍然记起，却急出一身汗！

There was nothing to do but receive the visitor and see what happened.
没奈何，且接了进来再说。


By the time Zhang reached the entrance, Wang had stepped out of his chair.
等他走到门口，王有龄已经下轿，

Zhang saluted, welcomed him into the reception room, and busied himself with tea, a water pipe, and the seat of honour.
张胖子当门先请了个安，迎到客堂，忙着招呼，泡茶拿水烟袋，肃客上坐，

Smiling deferentially, he asked, “To what do we owe the honour of your visit?
然后陪笑问道，“王大老爷光降小号，

What instructions may we carry out?”
不知有何吩咐？”


Wang removed his dark spectacles and answered calmly, “You have a man here surnamed Hu.
王有龄摘下墨晶大眼镜，从容答道：“宝号有位姓胡的朋友，

Please ask him to come and see me.”
请出来一见。”


“Oh, you mean Hu Xueyan?
“喔，喔，是说胡雪岩？

He is no longer with us.
他不在小号了。

Whatever Your Honour requires, you may tell me instead.”
王大老爷有事，吩咐我也一样。”


After a pause, Wang said, “May I ask your surname?”
王有龄停了停说：“还没有请教贵姓？”


“Zhang, sir.
“不敢！敝姓张，

Everyone calls me Fat Zhang.
都叫我张胖子，

My employer has entrusted me with the business, so I have some authority in all the firm's affairs.”
我受敝东的委托，信和大小事体都能做三分主。”


“Good.”
“好！”

Wang turned to Gao.
王有龄向高升说道：

“Bring in the silver.”
“把银子拿了出来！”

Then he addressed Zhang again.
接着转脸向张胖子：

“Your bank kindly lent me money last year.
“去年承宝号放给我的款子，

I've come to settle the matter.”
我今天来料理一下。”


“There's no hurry at all.
“不忙，不忙！

Please keep it for your use.”
王大老爷尽管放着用。”


“That would hardly do.
“那不好！

Repay one loan, and another can be obtained when needed.
有借有还，再借不难。

I know your firm has ample capital and an excellent reputation, and that this sum is of little concern to you.
我也知道宝号资本雄厚，信誉卓著，不在乎这笔放款。

But I would prefer to settle it sooner rather than later.
不过，在我总是早还早了。

Please calculate the principal and interest and bring out the original note.”
不必客气，请把本利算一算，顺便把原笔据取出来。


It was precisely the thought of that note that had made Zhang sweat. He could not produce it.
张胖子刚才急出一身汗，就因为取不来原笔据，

Having regarded it as worthless, he no longer knew where it had gone.
那张笔据，当时当它无用，不知弄到什么地方去了。


A banker dealt with officials, gentry, and wealthy merchants, and depended upon flexibility in social dealings.
做钱庄这行生意，交往的都是官员绅士、富商大贾，全靠应酬的手段灵活，

Zhang thought quickly.
张胖子的机变极快，他在想，

Without the note, he could hardly collect the debt.
反正拿不出笔据，便收不回欠款，

The man who had tied the knot must untie it: only by finding Hu could he hope for a satisfactory solution.
这件事解铃还须系铃人，要把小胡找到，才有圆满解决的希望，

For now, he might as well appear generous.
此时落得放漂亮些。


He bowed deeply and offered extravagant praise.
因此，他先深深一揖，奉上一顶高帽子：

“Your Honour is a gentleman of the highest benevolence.
“王大老爷真正是第一等的仁德君子！

A client as kind as you is a blessing our little firm could scarcely hope for.
象你老这样菩萨样的主客，小号请都请不到，

How could we turn the God of Wealth away?
哪里好把财神爷推出门？

Please keep the money until Xueyan returns.
尊款准定放着，几时等雪岩来了再说。

Meanwhile, if your bureau needs remittance services, we have dealings with the Big Three in Shanghai's southern city: Daheng, Dayu, and Dafeng.
倒是王大老爷局里有款子汇划，小号与上海南市‘三大’——大亨、大豫、大丰都有往来，

They know the sand-junk association extremely well.
这三家与‘沙船帮’极熟，

Freight payments for the sea grain shipments could be remitted through us to them with the greatest convenience, and our charges would be very modest.
漕米海运的运费，由小号划到‘三大，去付，极其方便，汇水亦决不敢多要。

Why not allow us to serve you?”
王大老爷何不让小号效劳？”


He did not understand the arrangements: Zhejiang did not pay the shipowners directly for sea freight.
这是他不明内情，海运运费不归浙江直接付给船商，

But Wang saw no need to explain that.
但也不必跟他说破。


He continued to insist on repaying the five hundred taels.
王有龄依然要还那五百两的欠款，

Zhang repeatedly refused, until the exchange finally drove him to tell half the truth.
张胖子便再三不肯，推来推去，他只好说了一半实话。


“To be frank, Your Honour, we considered the loan absolutely secure, so the note itself hardly mattered.
“老实禀告王大老爷，这笔款子放出，可以说是万无一失，所以笔据不笔据，无关紧要，

I don't know where it was put.
也不知放到哪里去了？

Once we find it, we can come to collect.
改天寻着了再来领。

As for interest, that needn't be mentioned.
至于利息，根本不在话下，

A bank considers who its customer is when calculating interest.
钱庄盘利钱，也要看看人，

Your Honour will have many opportunities to favour us in future.
王大老爷以后照顾小号的地方多的是，

If I charged you this little sum, my employer would certainly blame me.”
这点利息再要算，教敝东家晓得了，一定会怪我。”


The speech was handsome enough.
话说得够漂亮，

Remembering Hu's wishes, Wang decided to be more gracious still.
王有龄因为体谅胡雪岩的心意，决定做得比便更漂亮，

He had Gao unwrap the bundle and lay five hundred and fifty taels on the table.
便叫高升把包袱解开，取了五百五十两银子，堆在桌上，

Then he said calmly, “I am already much indebted to you.
然后从容说道，“承情已多，

How could I refuse to pay interest?
岂好不算利息？

Your Mr Hu told me that the rate varied with the money market, from seven-tenths to one point two per cent a month.
当时我也听那位姓胡的朋友说过，利息多则一分二，少则七厘，看银根松紧而定，

Let us take one per cent throughout.
现在我们通扯一分，

For ten months, that makes fifty taels.
十个月工夫，我送子金五十两，

Here are five hundred and fifty in all.
这里一共五百五十两，

Please accept them and give me a simple receipt stating that principal and interest are paid in full.
你请收了，随便写个本利还清的笔据给我，

When you find my original note, kindly destroy it.
原来我所出的那张借据，寻着了便烦你销毁了它。

I admire the consideration your firm shows its clients.
宝号做生意真是能为客户打算，佩服之至。

My bureau handles substantial public funds.
我局里公款甚多，

When Mr Hu returns, ask him to come and discuss a lasting business relationship between us.”
那位姓胡的朋友来了，你请他来谈一谈，我跟宝号做个长期往来。”


Overjoyed, Zhang immediately wrote a receipt and gave it to Gao.
张胖子喜出望外，当时写了还清的笔据，交与高升收执，

He still protested against taking interest, but Wang insisted, leaving him only to accept with repeated thanks.
一面决不肯收利息，但王有龄非要给不可，也就只好不断道谢着收了下来。


After Zhang had respectfully seen him into his chair, Wang felt that the whole affair had been both satisfying and amusing.
等他恭送上轿，王有龄觉得这件事做得十分痛快有趣，

He smiled inwardly.
暗中匿笑，

Eager for the bureau's business, Zhang would send someone to find Hu as soon as he left.
这张胖子想做海运局的生意，一走马上派人去找胡雪岩。

Little did he know that Hu had already decided never to return to the bank.
谁知胡雪岩已经打定主意，不会回他店里，

Letting him enjoy an empty promise for a while was a small punishment for having dismissed Hu.
现在让他吃个空心汤圆，白欢喜一场，也算是对他叫胡雪岩卷铺盖的小小惩罚。


Back at the bureau, Wang told Hu what had happened.
回到局里，会着胡雪岩说了经过。

Hu feared that Xinhe might send someone to his home and discover the truth, making refusal awkward.
胡雪岩怕信和派人到家去找，戳穿真相，那时却之不可，不免麻烦，

He hurried back to prepare for that possibility.
所以匆匆赶回家去，预作安排。

Wang changed into official robes and went to see the governor.
王有龄也换了公服，上院去谒见黄抚台，

Afraid of being denied an audience, he specifically told Liu Er that he had found an excellent solution to the grain-delivery problem and wished to explain it in person.
还怕他不见，特为告诉刘二，说是为漕米交兑一案，有了极好的办法，要见抚台面禀一切。


Liu was grateful that Wang had suitably placed both men whose cards he had submitted.
刘二因为他交了去的两张“条子”，王有龄都已有了适当的安插，自然见他的情，

He therefore spoke especially well of him inside.
所以到了里面，格外替他说好话。

At the words “an excellent solution,” Huang granted an immediate audience, and his expression was entirely changed.
黄宗汉一听“有了极好的办法”，立刻接见，而且脸色也大不相同了。


When Wang explained Hu's scheme of substitution, Huang became very excited.
等把胡雪岩想出来的移花接木之计一说，黄宗汉大为兴奋，

But the matter was too important for an immediate decision.
不过不能当时就作决定，因为兹事体大。


He sent attendants to summon the provincial treasurer and grain intendant for a secret consultation in the western reception room.
于是黄宗汉派“戈什哈”把藩司和督粮道都请了来，在抚署西花厅秘密商议。

Eager to complete the official business, all supported Wang's proposal, though not without reservations.
为了早日交代公事，大家都赞成王有龄所提出来的办法，但也不是没有顾虑。


“We have already reported to the throne that all the grain has reached Shanghai,” Lingui said. “If we now buy rice there to make up the shortage, and that censor gets wind of it and decides to have a little fun...” He hesitated.
“漕米悉数运到上海，早已出奏有案。如今忽然在上海买米垫补，倘或叫那位‘都老爷’知道了，开上一个玩笑……”麟桂迟疑了一下说，

“It would be no laughing matter.”
“那倒真不是开玩笑的事！”


“The treasurer is right,” the grain intendant agreed.
“藩台的话说得是。”督粮道接口附和，

Glancing at Wang, he added as though speaking to himself, “It would help if someone could stand in front of the affair.”
然后瞥了王有龄一眼，自语似他说，“能有个人挡一下就好了。”


He meant that someone should handle it openly while the senior officials professed ignorance.
所谓“挡一下”，就是有人出面去做，上头装作不知道，

If it came to light, they would have room to evade responsibility or negotiate a way out.
一旦出了来，有个躲闪斡旋的余地。

Both governor and treasurer understood.
抚、藩两宪都明白他的意思，

But who would put himself in that position?
但这个可以来“挡一下”的人在哪里呢？


Their eyes drifted towards Wang.
黄宗仪和麟桂都把眼光飘了过来，

Without hesitation, he said, “I owe my advancement to Your Excellencies.
王有龄便毫不考虑地说：“我蒙宪台大人栽培，

Having been entrusted with sea transport, I cannot evade the responsibility.
既然承乏海运，责无旁贷，

May the matter be left to me?”
可否交给我去料理？”


All three superiors immediately showed their approval.
在座三上司立刻都表示了嘉许之意，

Huang spoke slowly.
黄宗汉慢吞吞说道：

“The grain tax supplies the imperial storehouses.
“漕米是天庚正供，

In wartime, provisions are the army's lifeblood, and expedient measures cannot be avoided.
且当军兴之际，粮食为兵营之命脉，不能不从权办理。

Since Brother Youling is willing to assume responsibility, you may discuss the details here.”
既然有龄兄勇于任事，你们就在这里好好谈一谈吧！”

With that, he rose and withdrew to the inner rooms.
说完，他站起身来，向里走去。


The governor appeared to have removed himself from the business.
抚合似乎置身事外了，

Mindful of Chunshou's fate, Lingui too aimed above all to leave himself a way to disclaim responsibility.
麟桂因为有椿寿的前车之鉴，凡事以预留卸责的地步力宗旨。

The grain intendant, however, showed some willingness to act and worked carefully with Wang on the details.
倒是督粮道有担当，很用心地与王有龄商定了处置的细节。


The key was to find a large Shanghai grain merchant who would first supply a quantity of unpolished rice for delivery to Ni Liangyao, then receive Zhejiang's grain when it arrived.
这里面的关键是，要在上海找个大粮商，先垫出一批糙米，交给江苏藩司倪良耀，然后等浙江的漕米运到上海归垫。

In other words, the merchant would sell first and buy later.
换句说话，是要那粮商先卖出，后买进，

Naturally, the purchase and sale prices would differ, as would the quality of the rice.
当然，买进卖出价钱上有差额，米的成色也不同，

Grain-tax rice was of very poor quality, so compensation would be needed, together with an allowance for handling losses.
漕米的成色极坏，需要贴补差价，另外再加盘运的损耗，

The source of that money had to be agreed in advance.
这笔额子出在什么地方，也得预先商量好。
