“At this stage, there is no alternative,” the grain intendant said.
“事到如今，说不得，

“We shall have to add something to the collection of this year's new grain.
只好在今年新漕上打主意，加收若干。

For the moment, the provincial treasury must advance the money.”
目前只有请藩库垫一垫。”


“The treasury can advance it,” Lingui replied, “but you must consider my position too.
“藩库先垫可以。”麟桂答复督粮道说，“不过你老哥也要替兄弟想一想，

I truly cannot bear this responsibility.
这个责任我实在担不起，

I need an official instruction from the governor before releasing funds.”
总要抚台有公事，我才可以动支。


“A written instruction will probably be impossible.
“要公事恐怕办不到，

A definite verbal undertaking should be obtainable.
要抚台一句切实的话，应该有的。

We're all in the same boat now.
现在大家同船合命，

Rest assured: if anything goes wrong later, I shall bear witness.”
大人请放心，将来万一出了什么纰漏，我是证人。”


With matters put so plainly, Lingui could only nod.
话说到如此，麟桂只得点点头答应：

“Then that will have to do.”
“也只好这样了。”


“As for what follows,” the grain intendant said to Wang with clasped hands, “we must leave the work to you.”
“至于以后的事，”督粮道拱拱手对王有龄说：“一切都要偏劳！”


Wang found that harder to accept.
这句话王有龄却有些答应不下，

He knew little of Shanghai.
因为他对上海的情形不熟，

With Jiangning lost and everyone anxious, supplying so much grain in advance would entail great risk.
而且江宁一失，人心惶惶，粮商先垫出一批粮食，风险甚大，

He had no idea whether a merchant would undertake it.
有没有人肯承揽此事，一点把握都没有。


Seeing his hesitation, the intendant reassured him.
看他迟疑，督粮道便又说：

“There is no need to be afraid.
“王兄，你不必怕！

As I said, our interests are bound together.
我刚才说过，这件事大家休戚相关，

If difficulties arise, we shall all find a solution.
倘有为难之处，当然大家想办法，

We won't leave you alone in trouble.
不会让你一个人坐蜡。

You have only just begun, Brother Wang, yet your ability is already evident.
王兄，你新铏初发，已见长才，

I admire it.
佩服之至，

Go ahead with confidence.”
尽管放手去干。


Encouraged by these words, Wang thought of Hu.
受到这两句话的鼓励，工有龄想到了胡雪岩，

The man who deserved admiration was someone else.
该佩服的另有人。


The matter was now settled, and they agreed to pursue their separate tasks.
谈到这里，事情可以算定局了，约定分头办事，

Lingui and the grain intendant would see Huang about advancing the price difference and accounting for it later.
麟桂和督粮道另行谒见抚台去谈差额的垫拨和将来如何开支？

Wang would immediately find a merchant willing to supply the many tens of thousands of shi of rice required.
王有龄回去立刻便要设法去觅那肯垫出多少万石糙米的大粮商。


Upon returning to the bureau, his first question was for Hu.
等一回海运局，第一个就问胡雪岩，

He was told that Hu had not come back since going home.
说是从他回家以后，就没有来过，

It was nearly noon, so presumably he would come after lunch.
时己近午，想来他要在家吃了饭才来。

Yet three o'clock arrived with no sign of him.
但一直等到下午三点钟，还不见踪影，

Wang grew anxious.
王有龄有些急了，

There was much to discuss, and Hu should know it.
他有许多事要跟胡雪岩商量，胡雪岩自己也应该知道，

Why was he taking his time so calmly?
何以如此好整以暇？令人不解。


He had not imagined that Fat Zhang had detained him.
他没有想到，胡雪岩是叫张胖子缠住了。

Wang's unexpected visit had become the favourite topic of everyone at Xinhe.
王有龄的出人意表的举动，使得信和上上下下，没有一个不是津津有味地资为话题。

Hu had always been popular there.
胡雪岩在店里的人缘原就不坏，

When he was dismissed, however, his conduct had seemed too outrageous and the trouble too great for anyone to help.
当初被辞退时，实在因为他做事太荒唐，拆的烂污也太大，爱莫能助。

Later, ashamed of his poverty, Hu avoided old acquaintances, and the ties had weakened.
以后又因为胡雪岩好面子，自觉落魄，不愿与敌人相见，所以渐渐疏远。

Now memories revived.
现在重新唤起记忆，

Everyone said his judgement was exceptional, his methods and courage superior to other men's.
都说胡雪岩的眼光，确是厉害，手腕魄力也高人一等。

Quite apart from the bureau connection and the important client it might bring, his abilities alone made him someone Xinhe ought to invite back if it wished to prosper.
如今且不说有海运局这一层关系，可以拉到一个大主顾，就没有这层关系，照胡雪岩的才干来说，信和如果想要发达，就应该把他请回来。


This strengthened Zhang's resolve.
这一下，张胖子的主意越坚定了。

He had felt some guilt already.
他原来就有些内疚于心，

Hearing everyone's praise now added a personal concern.
现在听大家的“口碑”，更有个人的利害关系在内，

If their remarks reached the proprietor, Zhang would certainly be questioned.
因为他们这些话传到东家耳朵里，一定会找了自己去问，

Even leaving everything else aside, how could he explain losing a note for five hundred taels?
别的都不说，一张五百两银子的借据，竟会弄丢了，这还成什么话？

The proprietor had another bank in Shaoxing that needed a senior clerk.
东家在绍兴还有一家钱庄，档手缺人，

He might transfer Zhang there and make room for Hu.
保不定会把自己调了过去，腾出空位子来请胡雪岩做，

What would become of Zhang's dignity then?
那时自己的颜面何存？


He therefore found a young apprentice who knew Hu's address and set out in person.
为此他找了个知道胡雪岩住处的小徒弟带路，亲自出马。

His plan was ready.
事先也盘算过一遍，

Hu's salary of four taels a month would be paid from the date of his departure: forty taels for ten months.
胡雪岩四两银子一月的薪水，从离开信和之日起照补，十个月一共四十两银子，

Zhang had a bank note made out for that amount and put in a red envelope.
打了一张本票用红封袋封好，

With gifts of tea and ham, he went to call.
再备了茶叶、火腿两样礼物，登门拜访。


By chance, as he approached from one end of Yuanbao Street, Hu was returning from the bureau at the other.
说也凑巧，等他从元宝街这头走过去，胡雪岩正好从海运局回家，自元宝街那头走过来，

They met face to face.
撞个正着，

Hu saw him quickly and wanted to avoid him, but it was too late.
胡雪岩眼尖想避了开去，可是已经来不及了。


“Xueyan! Xueyan!”
“雪岩，雪岩！”

Zhang ran up, panting, his face red and heart pounding.
张胖子跑得气喘吁吁地，面红心跳，

That was useful: it concealed his embarrassment.
这倒好，正可以掩饰他的窘色。


“Mr Zhang!”
“张先生！”

Hu greeted him respectfully.
胡雪岩恭恭敬敬的叫一声，

“Have you been well?”
“你老人家一向好？”


“Well?”
“好什么？”

Zhang sounded almost reproachful.
张胖子埋怨似他说，

“Since you left, I've been like a man who has lost his right hand.
“从你一走，我好比砍掉一只右手，

Nothing goes smoothly.”
事事不顺。”


Hu knew his powers of flattery.
胡雪岩心里有数，张胖子替人戴高帽子的本事极大，

A few words from Zhang could make a man so pleased with himself that he became easy to manipulate.
三言两语，就可以叫人晕晕糊糊，听他摆布，

Hu therefore smiled without answering.
所以笑笑不答。


“Xueyan!”
“雪岩！”

Zhang examined him from head to foot.
张胖子从上到下把他打量了一遍，

“You're doing rather well.”
“你混得不错啊！”


“Thanks to your good wishes.”
“托福！托福！”


Hu did not invite him inside.
胡雪岩只不说请他到家里坐的话，

Zhang therefore scolded the apprentice.
张胖子便骂小徒弟：

“You fool!
“笨虫！

Take the tea and ham into the house.”
把茶叶、火腿拎进去啊！”

As the boy moved towards the gate, Zhang followed.
等小徒弟往胡家一走，张胖子也挪动了脚步，

“It's my first visit to your mother.
一面说道：“第一趟上门来看老伯母，

I must bring a little something.
总要意思意思，

Fresh tea and aged ham—a small token of my own respect.”
新茶陈火腿，是我自己的孝敬！”


Hu had no choice but to invite him in.
见些光景，胡雪岩只好请他到家里去坐。

Zhang insisted on paying his respects to both Hu's mother and wife.
张胖子一定要拜见“老伯母”、“嫂夫人“。

Ordinary families observed less strict separation between men and women than official households, so both women came out, exchanged greetings, and heard many pleasant words from him.
平民百姓的内外之防，没有官府人家那么严，胡雪岩的母亲和妻子都出来见了礼，听张胖子说了许多好听的话。


Once they were seated, Zhang came to the point.
等坐定了谈入正题。

He described Wang's unexpected visit and repayment in detail, omitting only the loss of the original note.
他把王有龄突然来到信和，还清那笔款子的经过，细说了一遍，只把遗失了那张借据这一节，瞒着不提。


Then he turned from events to his feelings.
讲了事实，再谈感想，

“Xueyan, can you guess what pleased me most about His Honour's visit?”
“雪岩！”他问，“你猜猜着，王老爷这一来，我顶顶高兴的是啥子？“


“The chance to secure an important customer, naturally.”
“自然是趁此可以拉住一个大主顾。”


That was precisely right, but Zhang would not admit it.
这句话说到了张胖子的心里，但是他不肯承认：

“No.
“不是。

I'm not saying this to flatter you or make you grateful.
雪岩，并非我此刻卖好，要你见情，

The truth is that our employer was furious about that affair.
说实在的，当初那件事，东家大发脾气，

As manager, I had no choice but to enforce the rules.
我身为大伙，实在叫没法子，只好照店规行事。

All the while, I hoped Mr Wang would soon repay the money—or that I might come into a little fortune and cover the five hundred taels for you myself.
心里是这样在巴望，最好王老爷早早来还了这笔款子，或者让我发笔什么财，替你赔了那五百两头。

Why?
这为什么？

Simply so that you could return to Xinhe.
为来为去为的是你好重回信和。

Well, no more talk.”
现在闲话少说喏，”

He produced the red envelope.
他把预先备好的红封套取了出来，

“Here are ten months' back wages: a note for forty taels.
“他十十月的薪水，照补，四十两本票，

Keep it safe.
收好了。

Come along!”
走！”


As he spoke, he pressed the envelope into Hu's hand with his left and seized him with his right to lead him out.
一面说，一面他用左手把红封套塞到胡雪岩手里，右手便来拉着他出门。


“Wait a moment, Mr Zhang.
“慢来，慢来！张先生。”胡雪岩问道：

I still don't understand what's happening.
“怎的一桩事体，我还糊里糊涂。

Where are we going?”
你说走，走到哪里去？”


“Where else?
“还有哪里？

Xinhe.”
信和。”


Hu had asked deliberately.
胡雪岩是明知故问，

Once Zhang stated it plainly, he shook his head firmly.
听他说明白了，便使劲摇头：

“A good horse doesn't turn back to graze the same patch.
“张先生，‘好马不吃回头草’，

I appreciate your kindness, but no, thank you.”
盛情心领，谢谢了。”

He handed the envelope back.
说着把红封套退了回去。


Zhang pushed it away with both hands.
张胖子双手推拒，

“Now, Xueyan, that isn't right of you...”
责备似他说：“雪岩，这就是你的不是了……


A long campaign of persuasion followed.
自此展开冗长的说服工作，

Zhang's eloquence met Hu's resolve.
他的口才虽好，胡雪岩的心肠也硬，

However he appealed to reason or feeling, Hu would not yield.
随便他如何导之以理，动之以情，一个只是不肯松口。


By midday, the household invited him to stay for lunch, partly hoping that the offer would prompt him to leave.
磨到日已过午，主人家留客便饭，实在也有逐客的意思。

But Zhang had resolved to stake everything on success and would not let go.
哪知张胖子是抱定了破釜沉舟的决心，嬲往胡雪岩，再也不肯走的，

“Excellent!
“好，

It's been so long since we talked properly.
多时不见，正要叙叙，

I'll add something to the meal.”
我来添茶！”

He took out a piece of silver and shouted to the apprentice, “You little scamp!
他摸出块碎银子，大声唤那小徒弟：“小瘌痢，

Go to the eating house at the end of the lane.
到巷口‘皇饭儿’，

Have them send four dishes: mulang tofu, sliced pork, crisp bean-curd rolls, and mixed meat and vegetables.
叫他们送四样菜来：木榔豆腐，件儿肉，响铃儿，荤素菜，

And fetch two jin of Zhuyeqing wine.”
另外打两斤‘竹叶青’！”


Hu and his wife could not stop him.
胡雪岩夫妇要拦拦不住，只好由他。

Once the wine was served, Hu could no longer remain silently on the defensive while Zhang did all the talking.
等一喝上酒，胡雪岩就不便“闷声大发财”，听他一个人去说，

He had to invent one reason after another for refusing.
少不得要找出许许多多理由来推托。

But Zhang's tongue was formidable.
无奈张胖子那张嘴十分厉害，

Like the magical duels in The Investiture of the Gods, every weapon Hu produced was met by a counterspell.
就象《封神榜》斗法似地，胡雪岩每祭一样法宝，他总有办法来破，

There was one argument Zhang could not answer, but Hu was unwilling to use it.
倒是有样法宝，足可使他无法招架，但胡雪岩不肯说，

If he revealed his relationship with Wang and his forthcoming work at the bureau, could Zhang possibly insist that he return to stand behind a bank counter?
如果肯说破跟王有龄的关系，现在要到海运局去“做官”了，难道张胖子还能一定叫他回信和去立柜台，当伙计？


More wine was brought, and the conversation grew longer.
酒添了又添，话越说越多，

Even Hu's wife began to lose patience.
连胡雪岩的妻子都有些不耐烦了，

Just as the situation seemed impossible to resolve, an unexpected visitor arrived.
正在这不得开交的当儿，来了个不速之客。


“Oh!”
“咦！”

Zhang stared.
张胖子把眼睛瞪得好大，

“Second Master Gao! How did you find your way here?”
“高二爷，你怎么寻到这里来了？”


Sent to fetch Hu, Gao was quick-witted but could not answer immediately.
奉命来请胡雪岩的高升，机变虽快，却也一时无从回答，

Something in Zhang's tone seemed strange.
但他听出张胖子的语气有异，

Unsure what lay behind it, he dared not announce his purpose and merely looked at Hu.
不知其中有何蹊跷？不敢贸然道破来意，愣在那里只拿双眼看着胡雪岩。


The truth could no longer be concealed—and perhaps need not be.
看看是瞒不住了，其实也不必瞒，

Hu decided to use his final argument.
于是胡雪岩决定把他最后一样法宝拿出来。

But it would take time to explain.
不过说来话长，

First he must settle Gao's business, then tell the story at leisure.
先得把高升这里料理清楚。才能从容细叙。


“Have you eaten?” he asked warmly.
“你吃了饭没有？”胡雪岩先很亲切地问，

“There's food and wine ready.
“现成的酒菜，

Sit down and have a cup.”
坐下来‘摆’一杯！”


“Thank you, but I wouldn't presume.
“不敢当，谢谢您老！”高升答道：

When will you be free, Young Master Hu?”
“胡少爷不知什么时候得空？”


“I understand.”
“我知道了。”

Hu glanced at the clock on the table.
他看一看桌上的自鸣钟说：

“I'll be there at four precisely.”
“我准四点钟到。”


“Then please come to the residence for dinner.”
“那么，请胡少爷到公馆个吃便饭好了。”


With his message delivered, Gao left.
把来意交代清楚，高升走了。

Hu smiled apologetically.
胡雪岩才歉意地笑道：

“To tell you the truth, Mr Zhang, I had already seen Mr Wang before he visited Xinhe.
“实不相瞒，张先生，我已经跟王老爷先见过面了。

I had reasons for not accompanying him, though there's no need to discuss them now.
我不陪他到信和去，其中自有道理，此刻也不必多说。

He has invited me to help at the Sea Transport Bureau, and I've agreed.
王老爷约我到海运局帮忙，我已经答应了他，

So I cannot return to my old home.
故而不好再回‘娘家‘。

You must understand my difficulty.”
张先生你要体谅我的苦衷。“


“Ah!”
“啊！”

Zhang drew out the sound, opening his mouth in a display of astonished delight.
张胖子咧丑嘴拉长了声调，做出那意想不到而又惊喜莫名的神态，

“Congratulations, Xueyan!
“雪岩，恭喜，恭喜！

You truly are a carp that has leapt the Dragon Gate.”
你真正是‘鲤鱼跳龙门’了。


“Even after leaping the gate, I remain a carp.
“跳了龙门，还是鲤鱼，

A man mustn't forget his beginnings.
为人不可忘本。

Banking is the trade I learned, and everyone in it is family to me.
我是学的钱庄生意，同行都是我一家。

I shall still rely on your help.”
张先生，以后还要请你多照应。”


“Not at all.
“哪里话，哪里话！

It's we who must rely on you now.”
现在自然要请你照应。”

Zhang suddenly lowered his voice.
张胖子忽然放低了声音说，

“In fact, there's something you can do at once.
“眼前就要靠你帮忙，

I told Mr Wang we'd like to do business with the bureau.
我跟王老爷提过，想跟海运局做往来。

Money is plentiful at present, and it's a pity to leave it idle.
现在银根松，摆在那里也可惜，

See if you can find a way to put ours to use.
你想个什么办法用它出去！

We'll be particularly generous about the commission.”
回扣特别克己。”


“Very well.”
“好！”

Hu nodded seriously.
胡雪岩很慎重地点头，

“I'll bear it in mind.”
“我有数了。”


Zhang left pleased that the visit had not been wasted.
张胖子总算不虚此行，欣然告辞。

Hu then hurried to Wang's residence.
胡雪岩也随即赶到王有龄公馆里。

His account of Zhang's expressions and speeches made both men clap their hands and laugh.
他把张胖子的神态语言形容了一番，两人拊掌大笑，

They found the affair thoroughly satisfying.
都觉得是件很痛快的事。


“Enough of that.
“闲话少说，

There's important business to discuss.”
我有件正事跟你商量。”


Wang related his audience with the governor and the consultation with the treasurer and grain intendant, then asked what should be done.
王有龄把上院谒见抚台，以及与藩司、粮道会议的结果都告诉了胡雪岩，问他该如何办法？


“It is a little complicated.
“事情是有点麻烦。

But merchants seek profit.
不过商人图利，

If the return is sufficient, they'll lick blood from a blade.
只要划得来，刀头上的血也要去舐，

Someone will accept the risk.
风险总有人肯背的，

What matters is having a guarantee.”
要紧的是一定要有担保。”


“What sort of guarantee?”
“怎么样担保呢？”


“An official undertaking from Zhejiang would be best, naturally.
“最好，当然是我们浙江有公事给他们，

I doubt we can obtain that, so we must find another way.
这一层怕办不到，那就只有另想别法，

There will be one.
法子总有的，

First, how much grain must be advanced?”
我先要请问，要垫的漕米有多少？”


“I checked the accounts.
“我查过帐了，

The shortage is 145,000 shi.”
一共还缺十四万五千石。”


“That isn't such a large amount,” Hu said.
“这数目也还不大。”胡雪岩说，

“I'll arrange for a bank to guarantee payment.
“我来托钱庄保付，

That should put the grain merchant at ease.”
粮商总可以放心了。”


“Excellent.
“好极了。

Through Xinhe?”
是托信和？”


“Xinhe can arrange it with a Shanghai bank.
“请信和转托上海的钱庄，

That can certainly be done.
这一节一定可以办得到。

But we must have a definite word from the governor.
不过抚台那里总要有句话，

I advise you to see him directly, rather than let the message pass through others.”
我劝你直接去看黄抚台，省得其中传话有周折。”


“Well...”
“这个，”

Wang was not convinced.
王有龄有些不以为然，

“Since the treasurer and grain intendant are asking for instructions, they'll surely give me a definite answer.
“既然藩台、粮道去请示，当然有确实回话给我。

Another visit seems unnecessary.”
似乎不必多此一举。”


“There's another reason.”
“其中另有道理。”

Hu lowered his voice.
胡雪岩放低了声音说，

“The governor may have further instructions—some expense he wants included, for example.
“作兴抚合另有交代，譬如说，什么开销要打在里头，

He can't conveniently raise it himself, still less discuss it with the treasurer.
他不便自己开口，更不便跟藩台说，

He needs you to understand and provide an opening.
全靠你识趣，提他一个头，

Then he can tell you what he wants.”
他才会有话交下来！”


“Ah!”
“啊！”

Wang understood and nodded repeatedly.
王有龄恍然大悟，不断点头。


“There's more.
“还有一层，

You must make arrangements at the treasury and the grain intendant's office too.
藩台跟粮道那里也要去安排好。

Even if the men themselves are honest, their subordinates will all be envious.
就算他们自己清廉，手底下的人，个个眼红，

Who won't suppose this assignment offers you a chance to fill your pockets?
谁不当你这一趟是可以‘吃饱’的好差使？

Without some benefit, they're certain to make difficulties.”
没有好处，一定要出花样。”


Wang was more astonished than ever.
王有龄越发惊奇了，

“I would never have thought of it.
“真正想不到！

Xueyan, you're an expert at official life!”
雪岩，”他说，“你做官这么内行！”


“The principles of being an official and doing business are the same.”
“做官跟做生意的道理是一样的。”


Wang almost laughed.
听得这话，王有龄有些想笑。

On reflection, however, blunt as the remark was, it went straight to the truth.
但仔细想一想，胡雪岩的话虽话得直率，却是鞭辟入里的实情。

This affair had begun by taking a side path.
反正这件事一开头就走的是小路，

Having chosen it, they might as well follow it through.
既然走了小路，就索性把它走通。

So long as Zhejiang's full grain quota was delivered and the state's needs were not delayed, everything else could be arranged.
只要浙江的漕粮交足，不误朝廷正用，其他都好商量。

If they faltered halfway and trouble arose, their superiors might stand above them, but Wang was the man acting openly.
如果小路走得半途而废，中间出了乱子，虽有上司在上面顶着，但出面的是自己，

He would bear the first and heaviest blow.
首当其冲，必受大害。


Seen in that light, Hu's advice was truly worth its weight in gold.
这样一想，他就觉得胡雪岩的话，真个是“金玉良言”。

He was a man Wang could not do without.
这个人也是自己万万少不得的。


“Xueyan, here's what I propose.
“雪岩，我想这样，

I'll apply to purchase a title for you at once.
我马上替你报捐，

Once you have the official receipt, no one can deny you're an official.
有了‘实收’，谁也不能说你不是一个官。

Your position in the bureau will then be more presentable—at least that of a commissioner—and you'll find it easier to act.”
那一来，你在我局里的名义就好看了，起码是个委员，办事也方便些。“


“There's no hurry.
“这慢慢来！

Let's finish this assignment of yours first.”
等你这一趟差使弄好了再说。”


Wang understood what he thought Hu meant.
王有龄懂他的意思。

The assignment should yield three to five thousand taels, he reckoned.
自己盘算着这一趟差使，总可以弄个三五千两银子，

Then he could purchase a more substantial title for his friend.
那时候替胡雪岩捐个官，可以捐大些。

Presumably that was what Hu hoped for, and naturally he should oblige him.
胡雪岩大概是这样在希望，自然要依他。


“Very well,” he said plainly.
“也许。”他把话说明了，

“Once I have the money, that will be the first thing I do for you.
“我有了钱，首先就替你办这件事。

But what about now?
不过，眼前怎么样呢？

You need some recognised position if you're to act for me.”
总要有个名义，你才好替我出面。”


“There's no need,” Hu replied.
“不必。”胡雪岩说，

“Once Zhang has told people about our friendship, everyone will know.
“我跟你的交情，有张胖子到外面去一说，大家都知道了，

Whatever I undertake on your behalf, they'll naturally trust me.”
替你出面办什么事，人家自然相信。”


“Very well.
“好，好，

As you wish.”
都随你！”

From that moment, Wang came to follow Hu's advice in everything.
就从这一刻起，王有龄对他便到了言听计从的地步。


That night, over more wine, they spoke at length of their ambitions.
当天夜里又把酒细谈，各抒抱负。

From his father's teaching, Wang knew that local magistrates, dismissed by some as ordinary officials immersed in worldly affairs, could in fact accomplish much.
王有龄幼聆庭训，深知州县官虽被视作“风尘俗吏”，其实颇可有所展布，

Since his studies had not brought success and he had purchased office, he had already abandoned dreams of the scholarly splendour of court.
而且读书不成，去而捐官，既然走上了这条路子，也就断了金马玉堂的想头，

He would seek achievement and advancement along the practical path he had chosen.
索性作个功名之士。

Hu's ideas were more practical still.
胡雪岩的想法比他还要实际，

One man remained attached to the ambition of official service; the other believed that excellence could be found in every trade and put making a fortune first.
一个还脱不了“做官”的念头，一个则以为“行行出状元”，而以发财为第一，

Wealth could bring office too.
发了财照样亦可以做官，

The only limitation was that purchased advancement reached no higher than a third-rank circuit intendancy, without the red hat button of a higher official.
不过捐班至多捐一个三品的道员，没有红顶子戴而已。


Their temperaments and outlooks were so alike that the longer they talked, the better they understood each other.
因为气质相类，思路相近，所以越谈越投机，

Both felt that the pleasure of friendship surpassed everything else.
都觉得友朋之乐，胜过一切。

It was after midnight when Gao finally escorted Hu home, carrying a lantern bearing the bureau's name.
当夜谈到三更过后，才由高升提着海运局的灯笼，送他回家。


Hu had exceptional energy.
胡雪岩精力过人，

Despite the late night, he rose early the next morning.
睡得虽迟，第二天依旧一早起身。

His main task was to visit Zhang at Xinhe.
这天要办的一件大事，就是到信和去看张胖子。

He felt that arriving empty-handed would look poor; some appropriate gesture was needed.
他心里在想，空手上门，面子上不好看，总得有所点缀才好。


Nor should Zhang alone receive a present.
胡雪岩又想，送礼也不能送张胖子一个人。

Hu had always been generous in his dealings, and now that he had a chance to show it, he intended to please everyone at the bank.
他为人素来“四海”，而现在正要展布手面，所以决定要博得个信和上下，皆大欢喜。


Money alone would not do.
这又不是仅仅有钱便可了事。

He carefully considered each former colleague's circumstances, relationships, and tastes, then chose a gift suited to each.
他很细心地考虑到他那些老同事的关系、境遇、爱好，替每人备一份礼，无不投其所好，

This occupied the whole morning.
这费了他一上午的工夫，

Finally, he hired a porter to carry the load and followed him to Xinhe at Salt Bridge.
然后雇一个挑伕，挑着这一担礼物，跟着他直到盐桥信和钱庄。


That won the entire bank over.
这一下，就把信和上上下下都收服了。

Everyone felt the same thing: when Hu was unfortunate, he did not trouble his friends; when he prospered, he would always remember them.
大家都有这佯一个感觉，胡雪岩倒霉时，不会找朋友的麻烦，他得意了，一定会照应朋友。


Zhang was naturally the most excited.
当然，最兴奋的是张胖子，

After leaving Hu's house the previous day, he had gone to the proprietor before returning to the bank.
昨天他从胡家出来，不回钱庄，先去拜访东家，

He boasted of his ability to recognise exceptional men.
自诩“慧眼识英雄”，

He had long known that Hu was destined for greater things, he said, and had always treated him especially well.
早已看出胡雪岩不是池中物，因而平时相待极厚。


It was because of their bond that Hu had left without resentment and still remembered Xinhe with affection.
胡雪岩所以当初去而无怨，以及现在仍旧不忘信和，都是为了他的情分。

The proprietor believed this shameless self-praise, commended Zhang warmly, and gave clear instructions: the bureau must be secured as a client.
东家听了他这番“丑表功”，信以为真，着实嘉奖了他几句，而且也作了指示，海运局这个大主顾，一定要拉往，

Profit was secondary.
因为赚钱不赚钱在其次，

Reputation and credit were involved, and those were a bank's real capital.
声誉信用有关，这就是钱庄票号的资本，

If Xinhe handled the bureau's remittances, its Shanghai counterparts would regard it with new respect.
信和能够代理海运局的汇划，在上海的同行中，就要刮目相看了。


Both Zhang and Hu were formidable men.
张胖子和胡雪岩都是很厉害的角色，

Behind closed doors, neither would reveal his true intentions.
关起门来谈生意，都不肯泄漏真意，

Hu began, “When I saw Mr Wang today, we discussed doing business with Xinhe.
胡雪岩说：“今天我遇见王老爷，谈起跟信和往来的事。

He said two or three banks were offering loans to the bureau—or rather, advances.
他告诉我，现在有两三家钱庄，都要放款给海运局，也不是放款，是垫拨，

Nothing has been settled because the interest rates differ.
因为利息有上落，还没有谈定局，

Naturally, when he heard that I was speaking for you, the situation changed.
听说是我的来头，情形当然不同。

Mr Zhang, what terms would you offer?”
张先生，你倒开个‘盘口’看！”


Zhang did not answer directly.
张胖子先不答这句话，

“Which banks?”
只问：“是哪两三家？”


Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑了：

“How would anyone be willing to tell me that?”
“这，人家怎么肯说？”


“Then tell me this: what is the rate on paper, and what is the private arrangement?”
“那么，你说，利息明的多少，暗的多少？”


“Let's leave private arrangements aside for now and discuss the stated rate.”
“现在不谈暗的，只谈明的好了。”


“Certainly,” Zhang said, lowering his voice.
“话是这么说，”张胖子放低了声音，

“But what about you?
“你自己呢？

How much do you want added for yourself?”
加多少帽子？”


Hu shook his head vigorously.
胡雪岩大摇其头：

“Mr Wang has entrusted this to me.
“王老爷托我的事，

How could I take a secret cut behind his back?
我怎么好落他的‘后手’？

There's nothing to discuss on that score.”
这也不必谈。”


“Even if you ask for nothing, we must show our appreciation.” Zhang continued, “How much is needed, and for how long?
“你不要，我们总要意思意思。”张胖子又问，“要垫多少？期限是长是短，

Tell me that first so I can make arrangements.”
你先说了好筹划。”


“At least two hundred thousand taels.”
“总要二十万。”


“Two hundred thousand?”
“二十万？”

Zhang was startled.
张胖子吃惊地说，

“You know Xinhe's resources.
“信和的底子你知道的，

We'd have to raise money elsewhere.”
这要到外面去调。”


Obtaining funds from other banks would mean a higher interest rate.
到同行中去调头寸，利息就要高了，

Hu understood the implication and smiled.
胡雪岩懂得他的用意，便笑笑说道：

“Then there's no point in discussing it further.”
“那就不必谈下去了。”


“That's not what I mean!”
“不是这话，不是这话！”

Zhang hastily corrected himself.
张胖子又急忙改口，

“Since you bring us the business, we must do you credit.
“你的来头，信和一定要替你做面子，

Even a larger sum could be managed.
再多些也要想办法。

Leave that to us.
这你不管了，

Tell me the term.”
你说，期限长短？”


“Would you prefer a long one or a short one?
“你们喜欢长，还是喜欢短？”胡雪岩说，

We can arrange either accordingly.”
“长是长的办法，短是短的办法。”

If the term could be extended, Hu intended to use a substitution of his own and open a bank with Xinhe's capital.
如果期限能够放长，胡雪岩预备移花接木，借信和的本钱，开自己的钱庄。


Zhang naturally avoided stating a preference.
张胖子自然不肯明白表示，只说：

“We follow the client's wishes.
“主随客便，

Once you tell us what is required, we can arrange our funds.”
要你这里吩咐下来，我们才好去调度。”


Hu could not answer that.
这一问胡雪岩无从回答，

The bureau did not yet need cash; it needed Xinhe's guarantee.
海运局现在还不需用现银，只要信和能够担保。

As for his own sudden idea of using Xinhe's capital to establish a bank, he would have to discuss it thoroughly with Wang before acting.
而他自己呢，虽然灵机一动，想借信和的资本来开钱庄，但这件事到底要跟王有龄从长计议过了，才有动手，

He had no definite plan to state.
眼前也还说不出个所以然来。


Zhang misunderstood his hesitation, assuming that Hu did want a personal margin added to the interest but was embarrassed to say so.
他这样踌躇着，张胖子却误会了，以为胡雪岩还是想在利息上“戴帽子”，自己不便开口，

He offered a hint.
所以他作了个暗示：

“Xueyan, let us speak privately as friends.
“雪岩，我们先谈一句自己弟兄的私话，

Now that you've entered official life, you must keep up appearances, and some expenses will have to be advanced from your own pocket.
你现在做了官，排场总要的，有些用度，自己要垫，

I'll open an account for you.
我开个折子给你，

Draw whatever you need up to two thousand taels and repay it whenever you have the money.
二千两的额子以内，随时支用，你有钱随时来归，

No interest.”
利息不计。”


Hu understood: Xinhe was offering two thousand taels in advance.
胡雪岩明白，这是信和先送二千两银子，

Accept a man's money, and you must solve his problems.
得人钱财，与人消灾，

If he took it, he would have to fulfil the bank's requests.
收了他这二千两，信和有什么要求，就非得替他办到不可。

But an outright refusal would be awkward.
不过胡雪岩也不便峻拒，

Instead, he deliberately boasted.
故意吹句牛：

“There's no need.
“这倒不必。

Xinhe is my old home.
信和是我‘娘家’，

Where else would I deposit my money?
我有钱不存信和存哪里？

In a few days, I expect five or six thousand taels.
过几天我有笔款子，大概五六千两，

I'll leave it here and begin an account.”
放在你们这里，先做个往来。”


“Excellent!
“那太好了。

Bring it in, and I'll lend it out for you.
你拿来我替你放，

I guarantee a good return.”
包你利息好。”


“We can discuss that later.
“这再谈吧！”

Do you have much business with Shanghai's Big Three at present?”
胡雪岩问道：“信和现在跟上海‘三大’往来多不多？”


“Fairly well.”
“还好。”


That meant not much.
这就是不多之意，

Hu was uneasy.
胡雪岩心里有些嘀咕，

After considering it, he decided they could no longer circle around each other.
考虑了一会，觉得不能再兜圈子了，

If both continued bluffing and concealing the truth, the matter would end in trouble.
尔虞我诈，大家不说实后，弄到头来，会出乱子。


His manner changed.
于是他换了副神态说：

“I understand what you want.
“我也知道你的意思，

A relationship with the bureau would make Xinhe's name more distinguished, and I'll do my best to bring it about.
海运局跟你做了往来，信和这块牌子就格外响了。我总竭力拉拢。

But first the bureau needs your help.
不过眼前海运局要信和帮忙。

If you can provide it, the benefits will be substantial.”
这个忙帮成功，好处不在少数。”


Zhang grew still more eager.
一听这话，张胖子越发兴奋，连连答应：

“Certainly.
“一定效劳，

We shall do everything we can.”
一定效劳。”


“Before I explain, there is one condition.”
“话未说之先，我有句话要交代。”

Hu's expression became stern.
胡雪岩神色凛然地，

“What we discuss today comes from the governor.
“今天我跟你谈的事，是抚台交下来的，

Not a word may leak out.
泄漏不得半点！

If it does and trouble follows, neither I nor Mr Wang will be able to save you.
倘或泄漏出去，闯出祸来，不要说我，王老爷也救不了你，

Officials aren't reasonable when things go wrong.
做官的人不讲道理，

If the governor sends soldiers to seal Xinhe's doors, don't blame me.”
那时抚台派兵来封信和的门，你不要怪我。”


The warning wiped the smile from Zhang's face and left him pale.
说得如此严重，把笑口常开的张胖子吓得脸色发青，

“Oh!
“唷！”他说，

This is no joking matter.
“这不是当玩儿的。

Let me close the door.”
等我把门来关起来。“


With the door shut, they sat together in a secluded corner.
关上房门，两个并坐在僻处，

Hu outlined the substitution scheme and asked two questions: did Zhang know a grain merchant he could recommend, and would Xinhe guarantee payment?
胡雪岩把那移花接木之计，约略说了一遍，问张胖子两点：第一，有没有熟识的粮商可以介绍。第二，肯不肯承诺保付。


The risk seemed enormous.
这风险太大了。

Zhang could not agree at once.
张胖子一时答应不下，

He rose and walked about the room, calculating silently.
站起来绕室徘徊，心里不住盘算。


Seeing this, Hu decided to appeal to his interest.
胡雪岩见此光景，觉得有动之以利的必要，

He drew him back into a seat and spoke quietly.
便把他拉住坐下，低声又说：

“Judge the risk for yourself.
“风险你自己去看，

Unless something happens on the waterway between Hangzhou and Shanghai—unless the grain boats sink and the rice cannot be supplied in repayment—there should be no loss.
除非杭州到上海这一段水路上，出了纰漏，漕船沉掉，漕米无法归垫，不然不会有风险的。

As for your return, here's my proposal.
至于你们的好处，这样，

The period won't be long.
好在日子不多，

From the day you undertake the guarantee, the bureau will treat the sum as though it had borrowed cash from Xinhe, paying interest by the day until the merchant's account is fully settled.
从承诺保付之日起，海运局就算借了信和的现银子，照日拆计息，一直到跟粮商交割清楚为止。

How does that sound?”
你看如何？”


Zhang's heart stirred.
这一说，张胖子怦怦心动了，

Without moving any funds, a written undertaking would earn interest as though he had made a cash loan.
不须调动头寸，只凭一纸契约，就可以当作放出现款，收取利息，

It was business requiring no immediate capital, with the bureau's reputation to enhance his own.
这是不用本钱的生意，加以还可借海运局来长自己的声势，

What could be better?
岂不大妙？


Weighing advantage against danger, he began to yield.
张胖子利害相权，心思已经活动、

Business depended on judgement and courage.
做生意原来就是靠眼光，有胆气，

Hadn't Hu shown unusual judgement in lending those five hundred taels to Wang?
想到胡雪岩当初放那五百两银子给王有龄，还不是眼光独到，

He had even sacrificed his livelihood over it.
甚至连张“饭票子”都赔在里面，

Personally, he had borne a great risk.
在他个人来说，是背了风险，

Yet now the transaction had proved sound.
但如今来看，这笔生意他是做对了。


With Hu's example before him, Zhang grew bolder and more inventive.
由于胡雪岩的现成的例子摆着，张胖子的胆便大了，心思也灵活了，

He had decided to accept, but could not commit immediately.
他已决定接受胡雪岩的建议，但不便当时就作决定，

There was one thing he must do first: inquire at the provincial treasury about the grain's progress towards Shanghai and the treasurer's attitude to Wang.
还有一件事是非做不可的，到藩台衙门去摸一摸底，看看漕米运到上海的情形，藩台对王有龄是怎样一种态度？

If both points were satisfactory, the business was settled.
只有这两层上没有什么疑问，这笔生意就算做定了。


“Xueyan, between friends like us, what cannot be discussed or trusted?” he said.
于是他说：“雪岩！我们自己弟兄，还有说不通、相信不过的地方？

“Consider it eight-tenths agreed.
这就算八成帐了！

But for a transaction this size, I must consult my employer.
不过象这样大的进出，我总要向东家说一声，

I'll give you a definite answer by noon tomorrow.
准定明天午刻听回话，

Will that do?”
你看好不好？”


“Of course.
“这有什么不好？

But I have something to say too.
不过我也有句话，

We're both acting for others and cannot decide everything ourselves.
大家都是替人家办事，身不由主。

To be frank, there's no need to insist on noon tomorrow.
我老实说，也不必明天午刻，

Take until the day after.
索性到后天好了，

If I hear nothing by then, I won't come back.
一过后灭，没有回话，我也就不必再来看你，

That will save us both wasted time.”
省得白耽误工夫。“


A final deadline had been set.
这就是说定了一个最后限期。

Zhang admired Hu's decisiveness and willingness to take responsibility, and nodded repeatedly.
张胖子觉得胡雪岩做事爽快而有担当，十分欣赏，连连点头答应。


Back at the bureau, Hu and Wang exchanged reports.
回到海运局跟王有龄见面，互道各人商谈的结果。

Wang was delighted: his morning had gone very well.
王有龄十分兴奋，说这天上午非常顺利，

He had first seen Lingui, who said the governor had agreed that the treasury should advance the price difference.
先去看了麟桂，说抚台已有表示，差额由藩库先垫，

How it would later be recovered through additional levies on the new grain would be decided separately and was no concern of Wang's.
今年新漕中如何加派来弥补这笔款子，到时候再定办法，不与王有龄相干。

He had then seen Huang, who told him that some extra expense did not matter provided the work was done quickly.
又去看了抚台，黄宗汉吩咐，只要事情办得快，多花点钱无所谓。

The governor showed him two edicts.
他还拿出两道上谕来给王有龄看，

One stated that the capital's Eight Banner forces numbered 150,000, required strict training, and must receive their overdue pay; the provinces were to expedite grain and silver to meet the state's needs.
一道是八旗京兵有十五万之多，须严加训练，欠饷要设法发清，通谕各省，从速解运漕米银两，以供正用。

The other ordered reductions in civil and military officials' integrity allowances to supply military funds.
一道是酌减文武大臣“养廉”银，以充军饷。

Clearly, the court was struggling to meet its requirements.
可见得朝廷在粮饷上调度困难，

Huang promised to recommend Wang for promotion if the grain arrived promptly.
如能早日运到，黄宗汉答应特保王有龄升官。


“Then the matter is almost settled.”
“照这一说，事情就差不多了。”

Hu knew Zhang would make inquiries.
胡雪岩心知张胖子要去打听情形，

With the treasury's undertaking so definite, Xinhe could feel secure.
既然藩司有此确实表示，信和这方面当然可以放心，

There was no need to await Zhang's formal reply to know the outcome.
不必等张胖子正式回话，便可知事已定局，

“We should discuss going to Shanghai to find the right merchant.”
“该商量商量，好动身到上海去寻‘户头’了。”


“My thought is that you should accompany me.
“我想这样，请你陪了我去，

The bureau will naturally send two officials, but that will be largely for appearances.
局里当然要派两个人，那不过摆摆样子，

The real work will depend on you.”
事情全靠你来办。”


Hu considered.
胡雪岩想了想答道：

“If you truly want me to handle it, you must let me do it my way.”
“真的要我来办，得要听我的办法。”


“Certainly,” Wang answered without hesitation.
“好！”王有龄毫不迟疑地答就，

“I'll follow your lead.”
“全听你的。”


To make the work easier, Wang finally issued a formal letter engaging Hu as an administrative clerk.
为了办事方便，王有龄到底下了一通“关书”，聘请胡雪岩当“司事”，

He occupied a small room beside the private office and planned matters behind the scenes.
在签押房旁边一个小房间办事，作幕后的策划。

First, a hundred thousand taels were drawn from the provincial treasury.
首先是从藩库提了十万两银子过来，

Once the guarantee terms with Xinhe had been settled, the sum was deposited there, and thirty thousand taels were remitted to Daheng Bank in Shanghai.
等跟信和谈好了保付的办法，把这笔款子存入信和，先划三万两到上海大亨钱庄。

Of that amount, ten thousand were for official expenses; twenty thousand were to be forwarded to Huang Zonghan's home district.
这三万两银子，一万两作公费使用，二万两要替黄宗汉汇到家乡，

The latter arrangement was, of course, strictly secret.
当然那是极秘密的。


Hu then selected two bureau commissioners: Zhou, a follower of Lingui, and Wu, who had connections with the grain intendant.
然后，胡雪岩在局里挑了两个委员，一个是麟桂的私人姓周，一个跟粮道有关系姓吴，

He asked Wang to issue orders assigning them to accompany him to Shanghai.
请王有龄下条子，“派随赴沪”，

Each also received an additional two hundred taels for travelling expenses.
同时每人额外先送二百两银子的旅费，

Both had initially regarded Hu with some hostility, but once they learned that this payment was his proposal, they immediately sought his friendship.
周、吴二人原来有些敌视胡雪岩，等打听列这于排出于他的主张，立刻便倾心结交。


Hu invited Zhang as well.
胡雪岩又把张胖子也邀在一起，

With the general affairs officer, cook, attendants, and others, the party numbered ten.
加上庶务、厨子、听差、上上下下一共十个人，

They hired two fast Wuxi boats and took a large supply of local products intended as gifts.
雇了两只“无锡快”，随带大批准备送人的土产，

Boarding at Wan'an Bridge, the first great bridge within Hangzhou, they cast off, passed the city barrier, and travelled east along the canal.
从杭州城内第一座大桥“万安桥”下船，解缆出关，沿运河东行。


It was the third month.
这时是三月天气，

Flat fields, rich green mulberry groves, golden rapeseed flowers, and peach and plum blossoms in shades of red and pink spread along both banks like a brocade.
两岸平畴，绿油油的桑林，黄澄澄的菜花，深红浅绛的桃李，织成一幅锦绣平原。

Inspired to poetry, Wang leaned against the side of his boat, gazing and murmuring lines.
工有龄诗兴大发，倚舷闲眺，吟哦不绝。

The others had no such literary inclination.
但别的人没有他那么雅兴，

Zhou and Wu, together with Hu and Zhang, made exactly four for mahjong.
周、吴两委员，加上胡雪岩、张胖子正好凑成一桌麻将。


Zhang proposed the game, and Hu readily agreed.
打牌是张胖子所提议的，胡雪岩欣然附议。

Zhang was about to send to the leading boat for the two commissioners when Hu stopped him.
张胖子便要派人到头一条船上去请周、吴二人，一个说，

“Wait.
“慢慢！

Let's have the table ready first.”
摆好桌子再说。”


Hu had come prepared.
胡雪岩早有准备的，

He opened a trunk and took out a new set of ivory mahjong tiles with bamboo backs and an exquisite set of counters.
打开箱子，取出簇新的一副竹背牙牌，极精致的一副筹码，雪白的牙牌，

He called the boatman's daughter, A'zhu, to lay the table and divide the counters.
叫船家的女儿阿珠来铺好桌子，分好筹码。

Fruit dishes stood on side tables, and fine tea was brewed.
两面茶几，摆上果碟，泡上好茶，

Only then did he ask the boatman to pause alongside the other vessel, put out a gangplank, and invite Zhou and Wu over.
然后叫船家停一停船，搭上跳板，把周、吴两委员请了过来。


The two were delighted by the preparations.
一看这场面，两人都是高兴得不得了，

“Splendid!” Zhou laughed.
“有趣，有趣！”周委员笑着说道：

“There's real pleasure in travelling with our friend Hu.”
“跟我们这位胡大哥在一起，实在有劲道。”


“Enough talk,” Wu said impatiently.
“闲话少说，”吴委员更性急，

“Let's sit down.
“快坐下来。

What rules are we playing?”
怎么打法？”


They took their seats and drew for positions.
于是四个人坐下来扳了位，

Zhang proposed a game with a hundred taels to a stake, using the yaoban scoring scale: a twenty-point base and a three-hundred-point limit.
张胖子提议，一百两银子一底的“幺半”，二十和底，三百和满贯。

A self-drawn limit hand would bring thirty taels from each of the other players, ninety in all.
自摸一副“辣子”，三十两一家，便有九十两进帐。


“That's too high,” Zhou said.
“太大了！”周委员说，

“We're friends playing for amusement.
“自己人小玩玩，

Let's halve it.”
打个对折吧！”


“Yes, halve it,” Wu agreed.
“对，对，打对折。”吴委员也说，

“I've brought only thirty taels.
“我只带了三十两银子，

I can't afford to lose at that rate.”
不够输的。”


“No need to worry.
“不要紧，不要紧！

With a banker here, what have you to fear?”
有钱庄的人在这里，两位怕什么？”

As he spoke, Hu gave Zhang a meaningful glance.
胡雪岩一面说，一面给张胖子递了个眼色。


Zhang understood.
张胖子会意了，

Taking out a stack of bank drafts, he laid a hundred-tael note before each commissioner.
从身上摸出一叠银票来，取了两张一百两的放在周，吴二人面前，

“I'll provide the capital,” he said with a smile.
笑着说道，“我先垫本，

“If you win, I take ten per cent.”
赢了我提一成。”


“And if we lose?” Wu asked.
“输了呢？”吴委员问。


“If you lose,” Hu said, “repay it when you win.”
“输了？”胡雪岩说，“等赢了再还。”


It was a game in which they could win without really losing.
这是有赢无输的牌，

Zhou and Wu were happier still.
周、吴二人越发高兴。

Good spirits brought good luck, and the bright, charming A'zhu repeatedly supplied hot towels and refreshments.
心里痛快，牌风也顺了，加以明慧可人的阿珠，一遍遍毛巾把子，一道道点心送了上来，

Nothing could have made the game more comfortable.
这场牌打得实在舒服。


After four rounds, Zhou, sitting immediately after Hu, had won heavily.
四圈打完，坐在胡雪岩下家的周委员，一家大赢，

Wu had done fairly well too.
吴委员也还不错，

The losers were Zhang and Hu, both cheerful and gracious, apparently unconcerned.
输的是张胖子和胡雪岩，两个人的牌品都好，依旧笑嘻嘻地毫不在乎。


After they changed places, Wu's luck improved.
等扳了位，吴委员的牌风又上去了，

For these next four rounds, it was he who sat after Hu.
因为这四圈恰好是他坐在胡雪岩的下家。

Zhou followed Wu, whose concentration on making high-scoring hands led him to discard freely.
再下一家是周委员，吴委员只顾自己做大牌，张子出得松，

Zhou therefore did reasonably well too and lost little of what he had won.
所以周委员也还好，氽出去有限。


By the end of eight rounds, the boats had moored and darkness was approaching, so they stopped.
八圈打完，船已泊岸，天也快黑了，自然歇手。

Counting the counters, Wu had won a stake and a half, Zhou one stake.
算一算筹码，吴委员赢了一底半，周委员赢了一底，

Zhang had neither won nor lost much, but the ten per cent due from their winnings made him a winner too.
张胖子没有什么输赢。但有他们两家一成的贴补，也变成了赢家，

Hu alone had lost heavily.
只有胡雪岩一个人大输，

Including the table fee, there were four claims upon a single loser's purse.
连头钱在内，成了“四吃一”。


“Leave it for now,” Zhou said generously.
“摆着，摆着！”周委员很大方地说，

“We can play again tomorrow and settle then.”
“明天再打再算！”


“Gambling debts are paid in cash,” Hu replied with a Hangzhou saying.
“赌钱赌个现！”胡雪岩说了句杭州的谚语，

“Besides, this is our first game together.
“而况是第一次，

Come, let's exchange the counters.”
来，来兑筹码，兑筹码！”


He opened his small bedside chest and took out bank drafts, paying each man and making up the odd amounts in silver.
胡雪岩开“枕头箱”取出银票，一一照付，零数用现银子补足，

He seemed scarcely to calculate, merely taking a few handfuls and dividing them.
只看他也不怎么细算，三把两把一抓，分配停当，

Yet when the recipients checked, every payment was exact.
各人自已再数一数，丝毫不差。


Wu was greatly impressed and raised a thumb.
吴委员大为倾服，翘起大拇指赞道：

“Brother Xueyan, you have the talent of a master of finance!”
“雪岩兄，‘度支才也’！”


Wu had some literary learning.
他肚子里有些墨水，

The phrase came from the New Book of Tang, in which Emperor Xuanzong praised Yang Guozhong for keeping his gambling accounts so clearly.
这句引自《新唐书》，唐明皇欣赏杨国忠替他管赌帐管得清楚的褒语，

Hu did not understand the allusion, but he knew how to conceal a gap in his knowledge.
胡雪岩却听不懂，但他懂得藏拙，

Assuming it was a compliment, he merely smiled his thanks.
料想是句好话，只报以感谢的一笑，不多说什么！


Last came the table fee, collected hand by hand.
最后算头钱，那是一副牌、一副牌打的，

With such high stakes, it amounted to sixteen or seventeen taels.
因为牌风甚大，打了十六七两银子，

Hu placed the counters before him and called, “A'zhu!”
胡雪岩把筹码往自己面前一放，喊道：“阿珠！”


She was helping her mother cook at the stern.
阿珠正帮着她娘在船梢上做菜，

At his call, she answered brightly, “Coming!”
听得招呼，娇滴滴答应一声：“来了！”


She appeared in the cabin doorway, wiping her hands on a blue cotton apron and smiling with simple good humour.
接着便出现在船门口，她系一条青竹布围裙，一面擦着手，一面憨憨地笑着，

Her long, glossy black plait had swung forward over one shoulder, setting off her oval face with its clear complexion and rosy colour.
一根乌油油的长辫子从肩上斜甩了过来，衬着她那张红白分明的鹅蛋脸，

She was strikingly attractive.
那番风韵，着实撩人。


Hu's quick eyes noticed Zhou and Wu staring at her, and another calculation formed in his mind.
胡雪岩眼尖，眼角已瞟见周、吴二人盯着阿珠不放的神情，心里立刻又有了盘算，

“Come here, A'zhu.
“来，阿珠，

Four taels in table fees,” he said.
四两银子的头钱。”他说：

“Give them to your mother.”
“交给你娘！”


“Thank you, Mr Hu.”
“谢谢胡老爷！”

She made a curtsy.
阿珠福了福。


“You're thanking the wrong man.
“你谢错人了！

Thank Mr Zhou and Mr Wu.
要谢周老爷、吴老爷。

Here!”
喏！”

He picked up a bank draft and beckoned.
他拈起一张银票，招一招手，

When she came close to the table, he spoke softly.
等阿珠走近桌子，他才低声又说：

“The fees came to more than four taels.
“头钱不止四两。

Mr Zhou and Mr Wu are adding a special reward to make twenty in all.
周老爷、吴老爷格外有赏，补足二十两银子，

It's money for you to keep yourself.”
是你的私房钱。”


Her eyes opened wider, and she was too delighted and surprised to know what to do.
这一说，阿珠的双眼张得更大了，惊喜地不知所措，

Zhang laughed.
张胖子便笑道：

“A'zhu, Mr Zhou and Mr Wu are helping with your dowry.
“阿珠！周老爷、吴老爷替你办嫁妆。

Aren't you going to thank them?”
还不快道谢！”


“Mr Zhang is always joking!”
“张老爷最喜欢说笑话！”

She blushed deeply, then lowered her eyes and paid her respects to Zhou and Wu.
阿珠红云满面，旋即垂着眼替周、吴二人请安。


“Now we must add something ourselves,” Wu said to Zhou.
“这倒不能不意思意思了！”吴委员向周委员说。

Each gave her another ten taels.
于是每人又赏了十两。


Never in her life had A'zhu possessed so much money.
在阿珠，自出娘胎，何曾有过这么多钱？

She thanked them again and again, then rose and hurried towards the stern, her long plait swinging.
只看她道谢又道谢，站起身来晃荡着长辫子，碎步走向船梢，

A moment later they heard breathless, laughing speech.
然后便是又喘又笑在说话的声音，

She was evidently telling her mother of her good fortune.
想来是把这桩得意的快事在告诉她娘。


They all found it entertaining and exchanged smiles.
大家都听得十分有趣，相视微笑。

Just then, a gangplank was laid outside, followed by the boatman's call: “Mind your step, Your Honour Wang!”
就这时听得外面在搭跳板，接着是船家招呼：“王大老爷走好！”


Wang had crossed over from his boat.
王有龄过船来了，

Everyone rose to greet him as he entered cheerfully with a sheet of writing paper in his hand.
大家一剂起身迎接，只见他手里拿着一个信笺，兴冲冲地走了进来，

Smiling, he asked Zhou and Wu, “How did the battle go?”
笑着问周、吴二人：“胜败如何？”


They were embarrassed to have their superior refer to the gambling.
属官听上司提起赌钱的事，未免不好意思，

Zhou blushed.
周委员红着脸答道：

“Fortune favoured us, thanks to Your Excellency.”
“托大人的福！”


“Good, good.”
“好，好！”

Wang pointed to Zhang.
王有龄指着张胖子说，

“Then our banker must have lost.
“想来是张老哥输了，

A few taels mean little to a man of his resources.”
饯庄大老板输几个不在乎。”


“A pleasure to contribute, a pleasure.”
“理当报效，理当报效。”


After some joking, A'zhu laid the table for dinner.
说笑了一会，阿珠来摆桌子开饭。

The cooking aboard the fast Wuxi boats was famous, and special efforts had been made that day, so the food was finer still.
“无锡快”上的“船菜”是有名的，这天又特别巴结，自然更精致了。


Everyone had also brought provisions for the journey.
除此以外，各人都还带得有“路菜”，

There was not enough room on the main table, and two side tables had to be added.
桌子上摆不下，另外端两张茶几来摆。

Hu had instructed the general affairs officer to bring plenty of aged Zhuyeqing wine.
胡雪岩早关照庶务多带陈年“竹叶青”，

A jar was opened and warmed to precisely the right temperature.
此时开了一坛，烫得恰到好处，

Its rich aroma filled the air as it was poured.
斟在杯子里，糟香四溢，

Even Zhou, ordinarily a poor drinker, could not resist a cup.
连一向不善饮的周委员，都忍不住想来一杯。


With such a meal and the lively, attractive A'zhu serving them, it should have been an occasion on which, as the ancient wit Chunyu Kun said, a man could drink an astonishing amount.
这样的场合，再有活色生香的阿珠侍席，应该是淳于髡所说的“饮可八斗”的境界，

Unfortunately, Wang's presence made everyone restrained.
无奈有王有龄在座，大家便都拘束了，

He conversed only with Wu.
他谈话的对象也只是一个吴委员，

That afternoon, gazing from his boat, he had composed four seven-character quatrains entitled “Spring Views” and was very proud of them.
这天下午倚舷平眺，做了四首七绝，题名《春望》，十分得意，

Now he enthusiastically discussed which word lacked resonance and which should carry a departing tone.
此时兴高采烈地跟吴委员谈论，什么“这个字不响”，“那个字该用去声”，

The others understood little and cared less, yet courtesy required them to look fascinated.
大家听不大懂，也没有兴致去听，但礼貌上又非装得很喜欢听不可的样子，

They drank in gloomy silence.
以致于变成喝闷酒，

Fine food and mellow wine lost their flavour; even the girl's charms were wasted.
嘉肴醇醒，淡而无味，可餐的秀色，亦平白地糟蹋了，

Their ears suffered, and their eyes were deprived as well.
真是耳朵受罪，还连带了眼睛受屈！


Hu saw that things were going wrong.
胡雪岩看看不是路数，

His careful arrangements were being spoiled by Wang's pedantry.
一番细心安排，都叫王有龄的酸气给冲掉了。

Fortunately, they had agreed that Hu should direct this journey.
好在有约在先，此行凡事得听他作主，

Seizing a pause, he gave Wang a glance, asking him to return early to his own boat and leave the others free to enjoy themselves.
所以他找了个空隙，丢过去一个眼色，意思请他早些回自己的船，好让大家自由些。


Warm with wine and delighted by his conversation, Wang at first missed the hint.
王有龄倒是酒酣耳热，谈得正痛快，所以对胡雪岩的暗示，起初还不能领会，

Then he examined the others' expressions, thought a little, understood, and felt apologetic.
看一看大家的神态，再细一想，方始明白，心头随即浮起歉意。


“I've had enough wine,” he said tactfully.
“我的酒差不多了！”他也很机警，

“You carry on.”
“你们慢慢喝。”


He asked A'zhu for a small half-bowl of rice, ate it, and left the table.
于是叫阿珠盛了小半碗饭，王有龄吃完离席。

Hu knew that he had not really finished drinking, so he specially asked the boatman to prepare four dishes and warm a jin of wine to send to the leading boat.
胡雪岩知道他的酒不曾够，特地关照船家，另外备四个碟子，烫一斤酒送到前面船上。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第三章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Three, concluding part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“There!” Zhou said, straightening his back.
“好了！”周委员挺一挺腰说，

“Now we can enjoy a proper drink.”
“这下可以好好喝两杯了。”

The table was tidied, the cups rinsed, and more wine poured.
略略清理了席面，洗盏更酌，

There were still five at dinner: Wang had been replaced by Zhao, the general affairs officer, a capable man whom Hu had already won over in these few days.
人依旧是五个，去了一个王有龄，补上一个庶务，他姓赵，人很能干，不过，这几天的工夫，已经让胡雪岩收服了。

“How about a drinking game?” Wu suggested.
“行个酒令，如何？”吴委贝提议。

“I only know finger-guessing,” Zhang said.
“我只会豁拳。”张胖子说。

“I can play that too,” Zhou put in.
“豁拳我倒会。”周委员接口，

“It's the drinking I can't manage.”
“就不会喝酒。”

“Never mind.
“不要紧，

I'll find someone to drink for you.” Hu called out, “A'zhu, drink Mr Zhou's forfeits for him.”
我找个人来代。”胡雪岩便喊：“阿珠，你替周老爷代酒。”

“Oh!”
“嗯。”

A'zhu immediately pushed out her lower lip and swayed her shoulders in a playful pout, like a little girl.
阿珠马上把个嘴撅得老高，上身摇两摇，就象小女孩似地撒娇。

“All right, all right!”
“好，好！”

Hu coaxed her as though soothing a child.
胡雪岩也是哄小孩似地哄她，

“You needn't, you needn't!”
“不代，不代！”

She smiled prettily, then felt a little embarrassed.
阿珠嫣然一笔，自己觉得不好意思了：

“How about this?
“这样，

For every cup Mr Zhou drinks, I'll drink one for him.”
周老爷吃一杯，我代一杯！”

“And if he drinks ten?” Zhao asked.
“如果周老爷吃十杯呢？”赵庶务问。

She considered, then declared firmly, “I'll drink ten too.”
阿珠想了想，毅然答道：“我也吃十杯。”


Everyone applauded.
大家都鼓掌称善，

Zhou laughed and waved his hands.
周委员便笑着摇手：

“No, no!
“不行，不行！

You're deliberately trying to get me drunk.”
你们这是存心灌我酒。”

He made to leave the table, but Zhao and A'zhu caught him, one on either side.
说着便要逃席。赵庶务和阿珠，一面一个拉住了他，

Wu declared sternly, “I'm master of the drinking game.
吴委员很威严地说：“我是令官，

Its rules are stricter than military orders.
酒令大似军令，

Mr Zhou has disobeyed me: one penalty cup to begin with!”
周公乱了我的令，先罚酒一杯！”！

“Let me plead for him,” Hu said.
“我替他计个饶。”胡雪岩说。

“No!
“不行！

Unless A'zhu does the pleading.”
除非阿珠来求情。”

“Oh, Mr Wu, you really are joking!” she said with a laugh.
“呀！吴老爷真正在说笑话了！”阿珠笑道：

“What has this to do with me?”
“这关我什么事啊？”

“Aren't you drinking for him?
“你不是替他代酒吗？

Since you're so fond of Mr Zhou, why shouldn't you plead for him too?”
既会你跟周老爷好，为什么不可以替他求情呢？”

What sort of reasoning was that?
这算是哪一方的道理？

He had talked her into a muddle.
阿珠让他缠糊除了，

She knew his argument was wrong, but could not refute it.
虽知他的话不对，却无法驳他。

Still, she would not admit to being particularly fond of Zhou.
不过，说她跟周老爷“好”，她却不肯承认。


“I serve all you gentlemen alike.
“我伺候各位老爷都是一样的，

If I'm fond of one, I'm fond of all...”
要好大家都好……”

She could not very well finish the thought, but the mischievous Zhang deliberately exposed it.
下面那半句话不能再出口，偏偏张胖子促狭，故意要拆穿：

“And if you dislike one, you dislike us all—is that it?”
“要不好大家都不好，是不是？”

“Oh, no, no!
“啊呀呀！

You mustn't say that.”
不作兴这样子说的。”

A'zhu looked flustered, her blush making her more charming still.
阿珠有些窘，面泛红晕，越发妩媚，

“All the gentlemen are good, except one.”
“各位老爷都好，只有一位不好。”

“Which one?”
“哪一个？”

“You, Mr Zhang!” She laughed at her own retort, then turned with a swing of her waist and went to the stern for hot wine.
“就是你张老板！”阿珠说了这一句，自己倒又笑了，接着把腰肢一扭，到船梢上去取热酒。

When she returned, Wu began challenging each man in turn.
取来热洒，吴委员开始打通关。

They were all in high spirits, and with A'zhu moving among them like a butterfly among flowers, Zhou and Wu were beside themselves with pleasure.
个个逸兴遗飞，加以有阿珠如蛱蝶穿花般，周旋在席间，周、吴二人乐不可支，

They drank until thoroughly drunk.
欢饮大醉。

So the days passed in cards, wine, and flirtation with A'zhu.
就这样天天打牌饮酒，跟阿珠调笑，

The boats moved very slowly, but their passengers thought them too fast.
船走得极慢，但船中的客人还嫌快！


They did not reach Jiaxing until the fourth day.
第四天才到嘉兴，

Wu hinted to Hu that several days aboard had become unbearably confining: he would like a walk ashore.
吴委员向胡雪岩暗示，连日在船上，气闷之至，想到岸上走走。

That was an excuse.
这是托词，

He really wanted another day's delay.
实在是想多停留一天。

Hu understood perfectly, spoke to Wang, and arranged to stay a day in Jiaxing.
胡雪岩自然明白，便跟王有龄说了，在嘉兴停一天。

A visit to Jiaxing necessarily meant an excursion to South Lake.
既到嘉兴，不能不逛南湖，

Wang joined them for tea upstairs in the Tower of Mist and Rain.
连王有龄一起，在烟雨楼头品茗。

The day happened to be overcast; spring haze hung over the water, and the willows blurred in the dim light.
那天恰好是个阴天，春阴漠漠，柳色迷离，

Wang felt another poem coming on.
王有龄的诗兴又发了。

Zhang, however, could not sit still.
张胖子却坐不住，

“Shall we hire a boat and row about?” he suggested.
“找只船去划划？”他提议。

“What for?”
“何必？”

Wu objected.
吴委员反对，

“We've been sitting in boats all the way and have had enough of it.
“一路来都是坐船，也坐腻了。

If we're going boating, we might as well use our own.”
坐这里的船，倒不如坐自家的船。”

Their own boat had A'zhu.
自家的船上有阿珠，

South Lake had plenty of boatwomen too, but none necessarily surpassed her; and even if one did, so brief an encounter offered little prospect of anything further.
南湖的船上也有不少船娘，但未见得胜过阿珠，就算胜得过，片时邂逅，也没有什么主意好打。


“I have an idea!”
“我倒有个主意了。”

Zhang blurted out.
张胖子失声说了这一句，

Then, noticing Wang's attention, he stopped, drew Hu aside, and spoke privately.
发觉王有龄在注意，不便再说，悄悄把胡雪岩一拉，到一旁去密语。

He wanted to seek out the amorous diversions concealed behind monastic doors.
张胖子是想去访“空门艳迹”，

Hu too knew of certain practices in Jiaxing that disgraced the Buddhist establishment, but Wang's official position made such a visit unsuitable.
嘉兴有些玷辱佛门的花样，胡雪岩也知道，但王有龄的身分不便去，

They agreed that Zhang should take Zhou and Wu to form these “blissful connections,” while Hu accompanied Wang on a stroll.
当时商定，张胖子带周、吴去结“欢喜缘”，胡雪岩陪着王有龄去闲逛。

They therefore separated.
于是分道扬镳，

With a little manoeuvring, Hu took Wang away first.
胡雪岩掉了个花枪，陪着王有龄先走，

Two small sedan chairs carried them to the busy streets, where they got out to browse and wandered into a bookshop.
两顶小轿到了闹市，下轿浏览，信步走进一家书坊。

Wang wanted a collection of poems.
王有龄想买部诗集子，

Hu idly leafed through a newly arrived Peking Gazette and, noticing Huang Zonghan's name in an imperial edict, read more closely.
胡雪岩随手翻着新到的京报，看见一道上谕，上有黄宗汉的名字，便定睛看了下去。

The entry included Huang's memorial in reply to the inquiry into Chunshou's suicide: “The treasurer, distressed by the shortage of treasury funds and the difficulties of grain transport, suffered a recurrence of liver illness and consequently took his own life.
上面除了黄宗汉奏复椿寿自尽原因的原折，说“该司因库款不敷，漕务棘手，致肝疾举发，因而自尽，

There were no other circumstances.”
并无别情。”

The emperor's response was, “Noted.”
皇帝批的是，“知道了。”

Hu knew that this particular trouble was now behind Huang.
胡雪岩知道，黄宗汉的那个麻烦已经没有了。

Was He Guiqing responsible for that?
这是否何桂清的功劳呢。

Wang bought his poems and Hu the gazette.
王有龄买了诗集子，胡雪岩也买了京报，

With nowhere else to go, and Zhou and Wu conveniently absent, they returned to the boats for a private talk.
无处可去，正好乘周、吴两人不在，回到船上去密谈。


After reading the edict, Wang felt both pleased and afraid.
看完京报上那道上谕，王有龄的心情，可说是一则以喜，一则以惧，

He was pleased that Huang had emerged unencumbered and stood high in imperial favour: Zhejiang's affairs should now be much easier to manage.
喜的是黄字汉脱然无累，圣眷正隆，今后浙江的公事，好办得多，

Yet he had long heard of the governor's harshness and cunning.
惧的是久闻他刻薄奸狡，

Huang might discard a bridge once he had crossed it and cease to heed He Guiqing.
说不定过河拆桥，不再买何桂清的帐，

That would cost Wang an important source of support.
那就失去了一座靠山。

“Mr Xuexuan,” Hu said, using a form of address he had recently adopted as suitable for both public and private occasions, “I think you're worrying too much.
“雪公！”胡雪岩对他，新近改了这样一个公私两宜的称呼，“我说你是过虑。

Governor Huang wants things done and wants credit for doing them.
黄抚台想做事，要表功，

If we follow his wishes and do better than he himself expects, what can he possibly complain of?
我们照他的意思来做，做得比他自己所想的还要好，那还有什么话说？

As the saying goes, the master shows you through the gate, but the practice is your own.
俗语说得好，‘师父领进门，修行在各人’，

Education Commissioner He has done enough by bringing you in.
何学台把你领进门就够了，

If you don't develop your own abilities, even the strongest patron is no use.
自己修行不到家，靠山再硬也不中用。

Look!”
你看！”


He pointed out another edict in the gazette: “Concerning the memorial jointly submitted by the Grand Secretaries, the Grand Council, and the Board of Punishments, as instructed, proposing a sentence for Xu Guangjin: Xu Guangjin, formerly acting Governor-General of Huguang and since dismissed, was specially appointed by Us as imperial commissioner to take charge of military affairs, yet was already dilatory in his progress along the route.
他指着京报中的一道上谕让王有龄看，写的是：“谕内阁大学士、军机大臣会同刑部定拟徐广缙罪名一折，己革署湖广总督徐广缙，经朕简派钦差大臣，接办军务，沿途行走，已属迟延；

When the rebels descended from Hunan and Hanyang and Wuchang fell in succession, he still clung to Yuezhou without devising a single plan.
迫贼由湖南下窜，汉阳、武昌相继失守，犹复株守岳州，一筹莫展，

He gravely mishandled the deployment of forces and lost his opportunity.
实属调度失机，

Let Xu Guangjin be sentenced, in accordance with the recommendation of Yucheng and his colleagues and the established law, to beheading after detention, the sentence to be carried out after autumn.”
徐广缙着即照裕诚等所拟，按定律为斩监候；秋后处决。”

“This Commander Xu was an imperial commissioner personally appointed by the emperor.
“这位徐大帅，皇帝特派的钦差大臣，

You could hardly have a stronger patron!
靠山算得硬了！

But when a man fails, even that support is unreliable.
自己不好还是靠不住，

He still faces execution.”
还是要杀头。”

Hu sounded deeply moved.
胡雪岩似乎很感慨他说，

“Everything else is uncertain.
“一切都是假的，

You can truly depend only on yourself.
靠自己是真的，

Even good connections depend on what you are.
人缘也是靠自己，

What friends can a good-for-nothing expect?”
自己是个半吊子，哪里来的朋友？”

Wang nodded repeatedly.
这番话听得王有龄连连点头，

“Xueyan, this is no flattery: it's a pity you haven't had more schooling.
“雪岩，”他说：“不是我恭维你，你可惜少读两句书，

Otherwise you'd certainly do better than He Genyun or Governor Huang.”
不然一定比何根云、黄抚台还要得意。”

“I don't see it that way.
“我不是这么想，

A merchant may seem at a disadvantage before an official, but business has pleasures of its own.
做生意的见了官，好象委屈些，其实做生意有做生意的乐趣。

An official faces all sorts of restrictions.
做官许多拘束，

A prosperous merchant can really enjoy himself!”
做生意发达了才快活！”


“Oh?”
“喔！”

Wang was interested.
王有龄很感兴趣地说：

“Then let us hear your ambitions!”
“ ‘盍言尔志’！”

This was one classical phrase Hu understood.
这句话胡雪岩是懂的，

“My ambition is rather different from other men's.
“说到我的志向，与众不同，

I like plenty of money—the more the better!”
我喜欢钱多，越多越好！”

He brought both hands round as though gathering a heap towards him.
他围拢两手，做了个搂钱的姿势，

“But once I have it, I don't mean to paper the walls with bank notes and be satisfied just looking at them.
“不过我有了钱，不是拿银票糊墙壁，看看过瘾就算数，

I mean to spend it!
我有了钱要用出去！

The finest pleasure in the world is to find someone at the end of his tether, some fine fellow whom the lack of a single coin is almost driving to his death, and happen to have money on me.”
世界上顶顶痛快的一件事，就是看到人家穷途末路，几几乎一钱逼死英雄汉，刚好遇到我身上有钱，”

He flung out a hand as though scattering silver and, almost acting out the scene, exclaimed, “Take it!
他做了个挥手斥金的姿态，仿佛真有其事似他说：“拿去用！

Is that enough?”
够不够？”

Wang burst out laughing.
王有龄大笑：

“It's a pleasure even to hear you say it!”
“听你说说都痛快！”

“There's something else.
“还有一样，

A merchant who makes a fortune can enjoy it freely.
做生意发了财，尽管享用，

He can build a great garden and put seventeen or eighteen concubines in it, and nobody has any right to complain.
盖一座大花园，计十七八个姨太太住在里面，没有人好说闲话。

But an official who grows rich—I'm sorry, he can't please himself so freely!
做官的发了财，对不起，不好这样子称心如意！

Leave everything else aside: having people point behind your back and call you a corrupt official would be unpleasant enough.”
不说别的，叫人背后指指点点，骂一声‘赃官’，这味道就不好过了。”

“Ah!”
“唉！”

Wang was tempted.
王有龄被他说动了心，

“The way you put it, I feel like giving up office and going into business myself.”
“照此看来，我都想弃官从商了。”


“That's not quite what I mean.
“这也不是这么说。

Office has its pleasures too.
做官也有做官的乐趣，

At the very least, it brings honour to your ancestors and makes your parents happy.
起码荣宗耀祖，父母心里就会高兴。

If I make a great fortune one day, my mother will naturally live in tremendous comfort.
象我，有朝一日发了大财，我老娘的日子自然会过得极舒服。

Yet there'll always be something missing.
不过一定美中不足，

In her eyes, ten or a dozen maidservants wouldn't be worth as much as an imperial patent granting her a title.”
在她老人家心里，十来个丫头伺候，不如朝廷一道‘诰封’来得值钱！”

“That isn't impossible either,” Wang assured him.
“这也不是办下到的事。”王有龄安慰他说，

“You simply couldn't obtain a patent making her a lady of the first rank.”
“不过一品夫人的诰封请不到而已。”

Purchased advancement could reach a third-rank circuit intendancy, which naturally carried eligibility for such a patent.
捐班可以捐到三品道员，自然也就有诰封。

Hu did not yet dare entertain that ambition.
胡雪岩此时还不敢存此奢望，

“Obtaining a patent wouldn't be too difficult, of course.
“请个诰封，自然不是太难的事，

But actually living up to an official title, with all the standing that ought to go with it—that isn't easy.”
只是做官要做得名符其实，官派十足，那就不容易了。”

He smiled and added, “I'm not disparaging officials, but some expectant gentlemen go years without a single assignment, until poverty has made them eat through their resources and pawn everything they own.
他笑笑又说：“不是我菲薄做官的，有些候补老爷，好多年派下上一个差使，穷得来吃尽当光。

That sort of office is hardly worth having.”
这样子的官，不做也罢。”


Wang felt the force of that remark from experience and valued his present opportunity all the more.
这话，王有龄颇有感触，便越觉眼前的机会可贵。

“Xueyan,” he asked, “what about Zhou and Wu?”
“雪岩，”他问，“周、吴二人，怎么说法？”

What about them in what respect?
什么事怎么说？

Hu could not answer so vague a question, but understood its intention.
胡雪岩无法回答，但他的意思是能够懂的：

“Rest easy, Mr Xuexuan.
“雪公，你放心！

Those two are completely in my hands.
这两位全在我手里，

They'll do exactly as I wish.
要他长就长，要他短就短，

There's no need to worry about them.
不必放在心上。

What concerns me now is whether we can find a large grain merchant willing to supply the rice in advance.”
我现在担心的是怕寻不着这么一位肯垫货的大粮商。”

“Yes.”
“是呀！”

Wang too grew anxious.
王有龄也上了心事，

“I'm also afraid that, even if we find one, he won't trust us.”
“我还怕找到了，他不肯相信。”

“That...”
“这……”

Hu shook his head.
胡雪岩摇摇头：

“That doesn't matter.
“不要紧！

Provided he has the resources, I can make him listen.”
只要他有实力，不怕他不听我们的话。”

His confidence, together with what Wang had seen of his skill in winning people over, reassured Wang at once.
看到他这样有信心，再想到他笼络人的手段，王有龄果然放心了。


They talked until evening, when Zhang returned with Zhou and Wu, all well satisfied with their outing.
等闲谈到晚，张胖子带着周、吴两人兴尽归来。

A closer look revealed secretive smiles on their faces.
仔细看去，脸上都浮着诡秘的笑容。

Hu could not ask questions in Wang's presence, but knew they must have experienced something quite new to them.
胡雪岩当着王有龄不便动问，心里明白，他们此行，必为平生所未历。

“Oh, I've just remembered something,” Zhang suddenly said with an air of complete seriousness.
“喔，喔，我想起件事。”张胖子忽然一本正经他说，

“I met a friend today, and it came up in conversation that a large grain firm in Songjiang has close ties to the grain-transport association.
“我今天遇到一个朋友，偶然谈起，松江有一家大粮行，跟漕帮的关系密切，

They have a hundred thousand shi or more of rice to sell.
他们有十几万石米想卖。

It might be worth making inquiries.”
倒不妨打听一下。”

Before Hu could speak, Wang exclaimed excitedly, “Now we're on the right track!”
胡雪岩还未开口，王有龄大为兴奋：“这下对了路了！”

“Why, Mr Xuexuan,” Hu asked in surprise, “we've only just heard of it.
“咦，雪公！”胡雪岩奇怪地，“事情不过刚刚一提，

We know nothing of the circumstances.
也不知内情如何？

How can you tell it's the right track?”
你何以晓得对了路了！

“So there are things even you don't understand!”
““你也有不懂的事！”

Wang smiled triumphantly and explained his reasoning.
王有龄得意地笑了，为他讲解其中的道理。


He had made a serious study of grain transport.
他对于漕运已经下过一番功夫，

Songjiang produced rice, lay at the boundary between Jiangsu and Zhejiang, and enjoyed excellent water communications.
知道松江出米，又当江浙交界，水路极便，

Its transport association was therefore large and ought also to have been rich.
所以松江的漕帮是个大帮，也应该是个富帮。

But its very size and wealth made it meat on the chopping board.
但唯其既大且富，便成了一个俎上之肉。

The prefecture of Songjiang ranked with Chengdu in Sichuan and Changsha in Hunan as one of the three famously lucrative prefectural appointments, each for its own particular reasons.
松江府知府所以与四川成都府、湖南长沙府，成为府缺中有名的三个肥缺，各有特殊的说法，

One important reason in Songjiang was the prefect's control of waterway labour and checkpoints.
松江府兼管水路夫隘，

When the association needed passage through sluices or men to haul its boats, it had to accommodate him.
漕帮过闸讨夫，不能不买他的帐是一大原因。

After years of exploitation, the Songjiang association had accumulated an enormous deficit in its common funds and become an impoverished organisation.
年深月久，饱受剥削，松江槽帮的公款亏空甚巨，成了“疲帮”。

Wang judged that the grain firm was actually its own business.
王有龄判断这家粮行，实际上就是漕帮所开，

The origin of the rice now offered for sale was highly questionable: it might well have been siphoned off from the grain-tax shipments.
现在有粮食要卖，来源大成疑问，可能就是从漕米中侵独偷漏而来的，

The quality would be poor, but the price should certainly be low, greatly reducing the amount needed to cover the difference.
米质不会好，但是米价一定便宜，差额便可减少许多。

“Excellent!”
“那好！”

Hu had not studied these matters in depth and accepted Wang's account.
胡雪岩对此还未有过深入的研究，只听王有龄的话。


Zhang therefore went ashore again to find his friend and arrange a meeting with the merchant in Songjiang.
于是，张胖子重又上岸，去寻他的朋友，约定在松江与那粮商会面的时间，

It was to take place aboard their boats.
会面的地方就在船上，

Wang, attentive to such details, feared that going ashore to negotiate with a grain dealer would arouse suspicion.
这是王有龄处事精细，怕上岸与粮商有所接洽，会引起猜疑。

On returning, Zhang reported that everything was arranged.
等张胖子回来，说是已经约好了，

They would reach Songjiang on the third day and moor beneath Xiuye Bridge inside the city.
第三天到松江，舟泊城内秀野桥下，

His friend would bring someone from the grain firm to find them there.
他那朋友自会约好粮行里的人来寻。

He also confirmed Wang's judgement.
而且他也证实了王有龄的判断，

The firm, Tongyu, was indeed the financial backing of the Songjiang association.
那家字号“通裕”的粮行，果然是松江漕帮的后台，

Besides trading grain, it operated a remittance bank.
不但经营米粮买卖，并且兼营票号，

But the south was the domain of private banks, and remittance houses with northern connections found it hard to compete.
只是南方为钱庄的天下，跟北方通声气的票号，难与钱庄抗衡，

Zhang had heard of Tongyu, but had never dealt with it and knew nothing of its credit.
张胖子也知道有这家通裕，素无往来，所以不知道信用如何？

“Enjoy yourselves for one more day tomorrow,” Wang said, half indulgently and half in warning.
“你们明天再玩一天，”王有龄以一半体恤、一半告诫的语气说：

“Once we reach Songjiang, there'll be serious work to do!”
“一到松江就要办正事了！”

In fact, serious work began that very night.
事实上这天夜里就已开始办正事，

They dined aboard Wang's boat and discussed grain transport.
大家在王有龄的船上吃饭，席间便谈起漕运。

Wang's knowledge came from books, so he knew the regulations, government orders, and precedents.
王育龄在这方面的学问，是从书本上得来的，所以只晓得规制、政令和故事。

Zhou, by contrast, was an experienced hand.
周委员却是老手，

As a convoy commissioner, he had made seven or eight journeys along the canal and knew a good deal about the abuses of the system.
久当押运委员，在运河上前后走过七八趟，漕运中的弊病，相当了解，

His scattered details were less orderly than Wang's account, but their basis in personal experience made them particularly vivid.
他所说的琐碎细节，虽有些杂乱无章，不如王有龄言之成理，但出于本身经验，弥觉亲切。

When Hu brought the two accounts together in his mind, something new emerged.
他们两个人的话，到胡雪岩脑子里一集中，便又不同了，

After a night's discussion, he understood both the regulations and their practical operation.
一夜深谈，他成了一个既明规制，又懂实务的内行。


“There is something I should like to ask,” Hu said, for he still had questions.
“我现在要请教，”他也还有些疑问，

“What does ‘cash payment by the taxpayer, procurement by the authorities’ mean?”
“怎么叫‘民折官办’？”

“The arrangement works as follows...” Wang explained that grain-tax collection took five forms.
“所谓‘民折官办’是如此……”王有龄为他解释，漕粮的征收，有五种花样，

One, called “regular delivery,” required the grain to be taken directly to the thirteen granaries in the capital.
一种叫“正兑”，直接运到京城十三仓交纳。

Another, “redirected delivery,” sent it to the two granaries in Tongzhou.
一种叫“改兑”，运到通州两仓交纳，

The two sets were known for short as the capital granaries and the Tongzhou granaries.
这两处米仓简称为“京仓”、“通仓”。

A third category, “white grain,” consisted of glutinous rice, also delivered to the capital, for sacrificial offerings and as part of the grain salaries of princes and officials.
再有一种“白粮”，就是糯米，亦运“京仓”，供给祭祀及搭发王公官员俸米之用，

This levy fell upon the five prefectures and one department of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Taicang in Jiangsu, and Jiaxing and Huzhou in Zhejiang.
规定由江苏的功州、松江、常州、太仓，以及浙江的嘉兴、湖州等五府一州缴纳。

All three required payment in kind.
这三种名目都是征实物，

Where special circumstances led to rice being replaced by other grains, or other grains by silver, the change required a specific imperial order and was called “altered collection.”
应证实物，由于特殊的原因，征米的改为征杂粮，征杂粮的改为征银，都出于特旨，就称“改征”。

The final form was “commuted collection”: a quota originally assessed in produce was collected in silver instead.
最后一种是“折征”，以实物的征额，改征为银子，

This had four variants, of which “cash payment by the taxpayer, procurement by the authorities” was one.
这又有四种花样，“民折官办”为其中之一，

In other words, the taxpayer paid the silver equivalent of his grain assessment, and the government bought the rice for regular or redirected delivery on his behalf.
换句话说，老百姓纳粮，照价折算银子，由宫府代办漕米充“正兑”或“改兑”，就叫“民折官办。”


“I understand.
“我懂了，

May I ask another question?
再要请教。

Under what circumstances is that arrangement permitted?”
是怎么一种情形之下，可以‘民折官办’？”

Zhou was the man to answer this practical detail.
这细节上就要同委员来解答了，

“There is no fixed rule.
“那也没有一定。

In general, it is for the convenience of both officials and taxpayers.
总之，为了官民两便。

Suppose an imperial order presses for grain to meet government needs.
譬如说，朝廷有旨意，为了正用，赶催漕米，

Treasury money can first be used to buy and ship the rice; silver is then collected to reimburse the advance.
那就先动库款，买米运出，再改征银子，归还垫款，

Some small households have no rice to deliver and willingly pay its market value instead.
也有小户实在无米可交，情愿照市价折银，

Naturally, the authorities are glad to procure it for them.
官府自然乐于代办。

There is another case: harvests vary from place to place.
再有一种就是各地丰歉不同，

In districts with a good harvest, people naturally deliver rice.
丰收的地方，大家自然交米，

Beyond the basic quota, the officially prescribed allowances for losses in transport and aboard ship are collected in rice too, as are the additional, unauthorised levies imposed on top of those allowances.
正项以外，另外额定的‘漕耗’、‘船耗’的耗米，以及浮收的耗外之耗，也都是米，

When this rice is taken to districts with poor harvests, its price is comparatively low.
这些米运到歉收的地方，价钱比较便宜，

The people there can buy it to discharge their grain tax.
老百姓可以买来交粮，

Only an entry in the accounts is required.
只要帐面上做一道手续好了，

That too counts as cash payment by the taxpayer and procurement by the authorities.”
也算‘民折官办’。“


“So that is how it works!
“原来如此，

Then we needn't go about this in secret,” Hu said.
那我们就用不着偷偷摸摸做了。”胡雪岩说，

“The military situation is urgent, and grain shipments by sea are being pressed forward.
“现在军情紧急，赶催海运，

Why shouldn't we use the regular funds to buy and ship rice?
我们动正项购运，有何不可？

As for Tongyu, if this is the association's legitimate allowance for transport losses, and official procurement against cash payments is permitted, selling it breaks no law.
至于通裕这方面，既然是漕帮应得的耗米，而且准许‘民折官办’，那他卖米也不犯法。

Even if the rice is stolen, we can treat it as their proper allowance.”
就算他们是偷盗来的赃货，我们只当他是应得的耗米好了！”

“Exactly!” the ever-ready Zhang said.
“不错啊！” 一向口快的张胖子说，

“The sacks don't have ‘Stolen’ written on them!”
“麻袋上又没有写着字：”偷来的‘！

Wang, Zhou, and Wu exchanged glances and nodded slightly.
“王有龄和周、吴二人都相视以目，微微点头，

They were plainly puzzled: why had so simple an argument never occurred to them?
显然的，他们都有些困惑，这么浅显的道理，何以自己就没有想到？

“That's true,” Wang said.
“话是不错。”王有龄说，

“Of course it would be best to proceed that way.
“照这样子做，当然最好，

But the Sea Transport Bureau is responsible only for shipping.
但海运局只管运，

This arrangement belongs to the collection stage.
‘民折官办’是征粮那时候的事，

Without an official communication from the provincial treasury and the grain intendant's office, how can I take over their duties?”
藩司、粮道两衙门，没有公事给我，我何能越俎代庖？


Now the effect of Hu's careful attentions to Zhou and Wu throughout the journey became clear.
到这里就看出胡雪岩一路来，把周、吴二人伺候得服服帖帖的效验了，

Both hurried to speak, then deferred to each other.
他俩争着开口，却又互相推让，

Plainly they had the same thing to say; one could answer for both.
不过看得出来，要说的话是相同的，有一个人说也就够了。

Zhou was older and a personal follower of Treasurer Lingui, so he replied.
周委员年纪长些，又是藩台麟桂的私人，所以还是由他答复：

“That needn't trouble you.
“这不要紧，

Whatever supplementary document is required from the treasurer's office, I'll arrange it.”
藩台衙门要补怎么样一个公事？归我去接头。”

“And I'll do the same at the grain intendant's office.”
“粮道衙门也一样，归我去办好。”

“Then I am most grateful,” Wang said, clasping his hands.
“那就承情不尽了。”王有龄拱拱手说，

“I must trouble you both.”
“偏劳两位。”

“It is our duty,” they answered together.
“分所当为。”周、吴二人异口同声地。


“Wait a moment!” Zhang suddenly interrupted.
“慢来，慢来！”张胖子忽然插嘴，

“This attractive calculation may not work out.”
“这把如意算盘不见得打得通！”

His reasoning was not without merit.
他说了其中的道理，确不为无见。

Tongyu wanted to sell rice, while they wanted someone to advance it on loan.
通裕是想卖米，而自己这方面是想找人垫借，

With different aims, the two sides might never reach an agreement.
两个目标不同，未见得能谈出结果。

“Not necessarily,” Hu replied.
“那也不见得，”胡雪岩说，

“A business cannot go on selling without buying.
“做生意不能光卖出，不买进。

Trade calls for negotiation.
生意要谈，

Everything depends on how you negotiate.”
就看你谈得如何？”

They all nodded, including Zhang.
大家都点头称是，连张胖子也这样，

“Only if you do the talking,” he said with a smile.
“除非你去谈。”他笑道，

“Nobody else could manage it.”
“别人没这个本事。”

The remark was partly a joke, but true enough.
虽是戏言，也是实话，

Zhou privately suggested to Wang that the officials should appear briefly to establish the authenticity of the matter, then leave the actual negotiation to Hu and Zhang.
周委员私下向王有龄献议，“当官的”出个面，证明确有其事，实际上都委托胡雪岩跟张胖子去谈，

Businessmen would find it easier to deal with one another.
生意人在一起，比较投机。

This was exactly what Wang wanted, and he readily agreed.
这番话恰中下怀，王有龄欣然接纳，

Hu accepted the responsibility without demur and revised their plans for Songjiang.
而胡雪岩也当仁不让，到松江以后的行止，由他重新作了安排。

They had originally intended a single meeting aboard the boats with Tongyu's representatives.
本来只预备跟通裕那面的人，在舟上一晤，

Now a conspicuous display of standing would make the negotiations easier.
现在却要大张旗鼓，摆出一番声势，才便于谈事。


With wind and current in their favour, they passed Jiashan and reached Fengjing, entering Huating County in Songjiang Prefecture.
一路顺风顺水，过嘉善到枫泾，就属于松江府华亭县的地界了。

The next day they entered the city and moored beneath Xiuye Bridge, famous for the four-gilled perch with its “great mouth and fine scales.”
第二天进城，船泊在以出“巨口细鳞”的四鳃鲈闻名的秀野桥下。

Wang sent the general affairs officer ashore to hire a sedan chair.
王有龄派庶务上岸，雇来一顶轿子，

Then, both dressed in fresh clothes, he and Gao set out to pay calls, accompanied by porters carrying generous gifts of local produce.
然后他和高升主仆二人，打扮得一身簇新，另外备了丰厚的土仪，叫人挑着，一起去拜客。

He first visited the prefect of Songjiang, presenting the formal card appropriate to an official call, then called on the magistrates of Huating and Lou counties.
先拜松江府，用手本谒见，再拜华亭县和娄县。

Huating, as the county containing the prefectural seat, was expected to act as host.
化亭是首县，照例要尽地主之谊，

Its magistrate promptly returned the visit, invited Wang to dinner, and sent men to attend to his needs.
随即便来回拜，面约赴宴，又派了人来照料。

The prefect then sent over a full seafood banquet.
接着，知府又送了一桌“海菜席”，

Hu took charge, tipped the bearers generously, and told them to carry it back to the restaurant, where further instructions would follow.
胡雪岩作主，厚犒来使，叫把菜仍旧挑回馆子里，如何处理，另有通知。

“Mr Xuexuan,” he said, “you, Zhou, and Wu should go to the Huating magistrate's dinner tonight.
“雪公！”胡雪岩说，“晚上你和周、吴二公去赴华亭县的席，

I have a use for the prefect's banquet.”
知府的这桌菜，我有用处！”

“Certainly.
“好，好，

Do as you think best.”
随你。”


They had scarcely finished speaking when Zhang's friend arrived with the manager of Tongyu.
话刚说完，张胖子的朋友，带着通裕的“老板”寻了来了，

On seeing Wang, both naturally paid their respects.
看见王有龄自然要请安。

Following Hu's advice, Wang deliberately assumed an imposing official manner.
他受了胡雪岩的教，故意把官架子摆得十足。

Zhang's friend was surnamed Liu; Tongyu's manager was Gu.
这两个人是张胖子的朋友姓刘、通裕的“老板”姓顾，

Wang asked their names, exchanged a few civilities, then rose.
王有龄请教了姓氏，略略敷衍几句，便站起身来说：

“I have an engagement.
“兄弟有个约会，

You must excuse me.”
失陪，失陪！”

Turning to Zhang, he added, “You gentlemen discuss matters.
接着又向张胖子，“你们谈谈。

Treat everything exactly as though I were here.
凡事就跟我在场一样，

Whatever you agree shall stand.”
说定规了就定规了。”

Once he had left, Zhou and Wu explained that they were accompanying him to the Huating magistrate's dinner and departed too.
等他一走，周、吴两人声明，要陪同王有龄赴华亭知具之约，也起身而去。

The four remaining hosts and guests then settled down to a serious conversation.
于是宾主四人，开始深谈。


They did not yet tackle the main issue, but sounded out the circumstances around it.
深谈的还不是正题，是旁敲侧击地打听背景。

Gu freely acknowledged that Tongyu was the collective property of the Songjiang grain-transport association.
顾老板坦率承认，通裕是松江漕帮的公产。

Hu then asked about the association itself.
接着，胡雪岩便打听漕帮的情形。

Though an outsider, he understood its customs, and his questions all touched the important points.
他是“空子”，但漕帮中的规矩是懂的。所以要打听的话，都在要紧关节上，

He soon learned that its most senior member was a boat-service soldier named Wei, nearly eighty, blind in one eye, and enjoying retirement at home.
很快地弄清楚，松江漕帮中，行辈最高的是一个姓魏的旗丁，今年已经八十将近，瞎了一只眼，在家纳福。

The man now managing its affairs was Wei's final admitted disciple, You Laowu.
现在全帮管事的是他的一个“关山门”徒弟，名叫尤老五。


“Proper respect comes first,” Hu said to Zhang.
“道理要紧！”胡雪岩对张胖子说，

“I should like our friends Liu and Gu to take us to pay our respects to Old Master Wei.”
“我想请刘、顾两位老大哥领路，去给魏老太爷请安。”

Both guests hastened to decline the honour implied by his courteous address.
刘、顾二人一听这话，赶紧谦谢：

“You are too kind.
“不敢当，不敢当！

We can simply convey your message to him.”
我把胡大哥的话带到就是。”

“That wouldn't do,” Hu said.
“这不好。”胡雪岩说：

“Please don't regard me as an official.
“两位老哥不要把我当官面上的人看待。

To tell you the truth, though I'm an outsider, I often pass myself off as a member.
实在说，我虽是‘空子’，也常常冒充在帮，

As the saying goes, a man may claim membership, but a member may not deny it.
有道是‘准充不准赖’，

Still, in the presence of the real thing today, I mustn't pretend.
不过今天当着真神面前，不好说假话。

A man away from home ought never to put on airs.
出门在外，不可自傲自大，

I ask you both to lead the way.
就请两位老哥带路。

And there's something else.
再还有一说，

After paying my respects, I should like to invite the old gentleman out for a drink.
等给魏老太爷请了安，我还想请他老人家出来吃一杯，

We have a banquet—I don't know how good it is, but the Songjiang prefect sent it to my employer.
有桌菜，不晓得好不好，不过是松江府送我们东家的，

I should like to offer it to him as a small mark of respect.”
用这桌莱来请他老人家，略表敬意。

Both guests were impressed.
“客人听得这一说，无不动容，

This Hu knew how to conduct himself in the wider world and was well worth befriending.
觉得这姓胡的是“外场朋友”，大可交得，

They ought to introduce him.
应该替他引见，

They readily agreed, and the party went ashore and walked to Wei's house.
欣然乐从，离舟登岸，安步当车，到了魏家。


Old Wei had withdrawn from social life and no longer received visitors.
魏老头子已经杜门谢客，

Gu therefore dared not announce them without preparation.
所以一到他家，顾老板不敢冒昧，

He explained to the household that a friend from Zhejiang had come and asked whether the old man wished to see him.
先跟他家的人说明，有浙江来的一个朋友，他愿不愿见？

Hu had anticipated this.
胡雪岩是早料到这样的处置，

He had brought a formal visiting card describing himself as a junior and handed it over to be taken in with the message.
预先备好了全帖，自称“晚生”，交魏家的人，一起递了进去。

They had not sat long in the reception room before a member of the household invited them into the inner quarters.
在客厅里坐不多久，魏家的人来说，魏老头请客人到里面夫坐。

Liu and Gu immediately brightened.
刘、顾二人脸上顿时大放光彩，

“Zhang,” Liu said, “our old gentleman rarely receives anyone inside.
“老张，”姓刘的对他说，“我们老人爷很少在里面见客，

To tell the truth, we scarcely ever get to go in ourselves.
说实话，我们也难得进去，

Today we owe the honour to you two distinguished guests!”
今天沾你们两位贵客的光了！”

Hearing that, Hu knew he had made the right move.
一听这话，胡雪岩便知自己这着棋走对了。


Inside, they found a thin, wizened little man.
跟着到了里面，只见魏老头子又干瘦、又矮小，

Yet when he opened his single eye to look at them, it flashed so fiercely that they could hardly meet his gaze.
只是那仅存一目，张眼看人时，精光四射，令人下敢逼视，

There was indeed something exceptional about him.
确有不凡之处。

Hu greeted him with the ceremony due from a junior to a senior.
胡雪岩以后辈之礼谒见。

Wei had difficulty moving and, rather as though trading on his age, repeatedly protested that he did not deserve the honour without stirring from his seat.
魏老头子行动不便，就有些倚老卖老似地，口中连称“不敢当”，身子却不动。

Once they were settled, he examined Hu closely.
等坐定了，他把胡雪岩好好打量了一下，问道：

“You must have something to tell me, my friend.
“胡老哥今天来，必有见教？

Among men of the world, plain speaking is valued.
江湖上讲爽气，

Say it directly.”
你直说好了。”

“My employer sent me.
“我是我们东家叫我来的，

He says the elders of the grain-transport association must be treated with respect.
他说漕帮的老前辈一定要尊敬。

He could not conveniently come himself in official dress, so he specially asked me to invite you.
他自己因为穿了一身公服不便来，特地要我来奉请老辈，

We are borrowing flowers to make an offering: the prefect sent him a banquet, and he wishes to devote it entirely to you.”
借花献佛，有桌知府送的席，专请老前辈。”

“Oh?” Wei asked attentively.
“喔！”魏老头很注意地问：

“He wants me to dine?”
“叫我吃酒？”

“Yes.
“是！

He is attending the Huating magistrate's dinner now.
敝东家现在到华亭县应酬去了。

When he returns, he would also like you to visit his boat.”
回来还要请老前辈到他船上去玩玩。”

“Thank you.
“谢谢，

Unfortunately, I don't move about easily.”
可惜我行动不便。”

“Then let us do this,” Hu said.
“那就这样。”胡雪岩说，

“I'll have the banquet brought here.”
“我叫他们把这一桌席送过来。”

“That would be too much.
“那更不敢当了。”魏老头说，

His Honour Wang's kind intention is enough.
“王大老爷有这番意思就够了。

Now tell me what you need.
胡老哥，你倒说说看，到底有何见教，

If there is anything I can do, I shall certainly help.”
只要我办得到，一定帮忙。”


“Naturally, if we run into difficulties here, whom else could we ask?
“自然，到了这里，有难处不请你老人家帮忙，请哪个，

But, truly, my employer sent me to seek your advice in all sincerity.
不过，说实在的，敝东家诚心诚意叫我来向老前辈讨教，

There is nothing beyond your powers.
你老人家没有办不到的事，

We, however, must know what it is proper to ask.
不过在我们这面总要自己识相，

That makes me a little reluctant to speak.”
所以我倒有点不大好开口。”

Hu was deliberately retreating in order to advance.
胡雪岩是故意这样以退为进。

At his first mention of sea transport, Wei's single eye opened wide and fixed him with a piercing stare.
等他刚提到“海运”，魏老头独眼大张，炯炯逼人地看着他，

That too was expected.
而这也在他意料之中，

Hu had already reasoned that moving the grain shipments to sea would seriously threaten the canal associations' existence.
