他早就想过了，凭人情来推断、漕运一走海道，运河上漕帮的生存便大受影响，

With countless livelihoods at stake, they were bound to fight the change desperately, openly and in secret.
万众生计所关，一定会在明里暗里，拼命力争。

Wei's hostility confirmed his judgement.
现在看到魏老头的敌视态度，证实了他的判断不错。

Since the judgement was sound, the matter would be easier to handle.
既然不错，事情就好办了。

He calmly finished explaining his purpose.
他依旧从从容容把来意说完。

Wei's manner changed again.
魏老头的态度又变了，

His gaze softened a little, but the welcome had gone from his face.
眼光虽柔和了些，脸上却已没有初见面时，那种表示欢迎的神情，

“My friend,” he said slowly, “do you realise that our association is about to lose its livelihood?”
“胡老哥，你晓不晓得，”他慢条斯理地说：“我们漕帮要没饭吃了？”

“I do.”
“我晓得。”

“Then you must understand my difficulty.”
“既然晓得，一定会体谅我的苦衷。”

Wei nodded.
魏老头点点头，

“I don't know much about Tongyu's affairs now, but business is business.
“通裕的事，我还不大情楚，不过做生意归生意，

If you have money to buy rice and Tongyu refuses to sell, nobody anywhere could defend that.
你胡老哥这方面有钱买米，如果通裕不肯卖，这道理讲到天下都讲不过去，

I would certainly speak for what is fair.
我一定出来说公道话。

But if you want an advance of goods, a merchant puts up his capital to earn a return and must make his calculations.
倘或是垫一垫货色，做生意的人，将本求利，要敲一敲算盘，

I can't give you an answer to that now.”
此刻我也说不出个所以然来。”


It was a refusal, and one Hu had anticipated.
这是拒绝之词，亦早在胡雪岩的估计之中，

“Sir,” he answered firmly, “would you hear a little more from me?”
“老前辈！”他抗声答道，“你肯不肯听我多说几句？”

“My dear friend, what are you saying?
“啊呀，胡老哥你这叫什么话？

You've done me the kindness of visiting.
承你的情来看我，

I ought at least to keep you three days, talk things over properly, and make a friend of you.
我起码要留你三天，好好叙一叙，交你这个朋友。

If you have advice, I could ask for nothing better.
你有指教，我求之不得，

Why ask whether I'm willing to listen?
怎问我肯不肯听你多说几句？

Do you find me arrogant?”
莫非嫌我骄狂？”

“Then I spoke badly.”
“那是我失言了。”

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑道，

“My employer's business is actually of great consequence to your association.
“敝东家这件事，说起来跟漕帮关系重大。

Let us speak plainly.
打开天窗说亮话，

If the sea shipment misses its deadline, the officials will naturally be punished.
漕米海运误期，当官的自然有处分，

But the consequences for the association will be worse.”
不过对漕帮更加不利。”

He went on to explain the balance of interests.
接下来他为魏老头剖析利害，

Any delay would not have occurred at sea, but on the canal journey to the port.
倘或误期，不是误在海运，而是误在沿运河到海口这段路上，

An inquiry into responsibility might leave Zhejiang's association liable for ruinous compensation.
追究责任，浙江的漕帮说不定会有赔累，

The associations' secret code was known as Tongcao—“all grain-transport men united.”
漕帮的“海底”称为“通漕”，

They formed one body, sharing prosperity and adversity.
通同一体，休戚相关，

How could the Songjiang association stand by and watch?
松江的漕帮何忍坐视？

This appeal to their obligation of brotherhood struck Wei at a vulnerable point.
先以帮里的义气相责，魏老头就象被击中了要害似地，

His resistance immediately weakened.
顿时气馁了。


“Besides, sea transport is only an experiment for now.
“再说海运，现在不过试办，

Nobody knows whether it will eventually replace the canal altogether, whether the old arrangements will be kept, or whether both routes will be used.
将来究竟全改海运，还是维持旧规，再不然海运、河运并行，都还不晓得。

Frankly, the association ought not to help the people who oppose canal transport and advocate shipment by sea.”
老实说一句，现在漕帮不好帮反对河运、主张海运的人的忙。”

“What do you mean?” Wei asked with close attention.
“这话怎么说？”魏老头极注意地问。

“You should know, sir, that plenty of people want to speak for the association.
“老前辈要晓得，现在想帮漕帮说话的人很多，

My employer is one.
敝东家就是一个。

But they must have grounds on which to help.
但是忙要帮得上，

If the association lets itself down, those who want sea transport will argue all the louder: ‘Look!
倘或漕帮自己不争气，那些要改海运的人，越发嘴说得响了，你们看是不是，

Even this short stretch is full of difficulties.
短短一截路都是困难重重！

The canal men are simply no use any more!’
河帮实在不行了！

Now consider the opposite.
现在反过来看，

Suppose the canal shipment arrives on time, without the slightest delay.
河运照样如期运到，毫不误限，

Once it has put to sea, a gale might overturn a couple of sand junks.
出海以后，说不定一阵狂风、吹翻了两条沙船，

Then the association's supporters would have something powerful to say!”
那时候帮漕帮的人，说话就神气了！”

Wei heard him out without answering.
魏老头听他说完，没有答复，

He merely told the attendants beside him, “Go and fetch Laowu.”
只向他左右侍奉的人说：“你们把老五替我去叫来！”


The affair had plainly taken a promising turn.
这就表示事情大有转机了，

Hu had an excellent sense of how far to go on such occasions.
胡雪岩在这些地方最能把握分寸，

No further argument was needed; he had only to keep Wei happy.
知道话不必再多说，只需哄得魏老头高兴就是，

Their serious business concluded, they turned belatedly to social conversation.
因此谈过正题，反入寒暄。

Wei said he had lost count of his visits to Hangzhou.
魏老头自言，一生到过杭州的次数，已经记不清楚，

That was hardly surprising: Hangzhou marked the beginning of the canal, and Gongchen Bridge outside the city had special associations with the boatmen.
杭州是运河的起点，城外拱宸桥，跟漕帮有特殊渊源，魏老头常去杭州是无足为奇的。

Wei recalled many old Hangzhou stories about which Hu knew so little that he could offer no answer.
谈起许多杭州掌故，胡雪岩竟螳然不知所答，

Instead, he eagerly asked for more, and they talked congenially.
反殷殷向他请教，两个人谈得投机。

They were deep in conversation when You Laowu arrived.
谈兴正浓时，尤老五来了，

He was about forty, small and composed.
约莫四十岁左右，生得矮小而沉静，

Anyone experienced in the world would have recognised at a glance a formidable man.
在懂世故的人眼里，一望而知是个极厉害的人物。

Wei himself introduced Hu and Zhang.
当时由魏老头亲自为他引见胡雪岩和张胖子。

Since they were friends of his master, You was exceedingly polite and addressed Hu as “Mr Hu.”
尤老五因为胡、张二人算是他“老头子”的朋友，所以非常客气，称胡雪岩为“胡先生”。

“This friend of ours comes from the home of the patriarchs,” Wei said.
“这位胡老哥是‘祖师爷’那里来的人。”

The three founders of the Qing Brotherhood, the secret society within the grain-transport association—Weng, Qian, and Pan—were all said to have attained enlightenment at Gongchen Bridge in Hangzhou.
漕帮中的秘密组织，“清帮”的翁、钱、潘三祖，据说都在杭州拱宸桥成道，

That was what he meant.
所以魏老头这样说。


“Then we're practically one family,” You said.
“这就象一家人一样了。”尤老五说：

“You mustn't stand on ceremony, Mr Hu.”
“胡先生千万不必客气。”

Before Hu could reply, Wei continued, “Our friend Hu is a man who knows the world.
胡雪岩未曾答口，魏者头又说：“胡老哥是外场人物，

We must make a friend of him.
这个朋友我们一定要交。

Laowu, call him Uncle.
老五，你要叫‘爷叔’，

He is like the Little Master Outside the Gate.”
胡老哥好比‘门外小爷’一样。”

You immediately changed his form of address, warmly calling him “Uncle.”
尤老五立即改口，很亲热地叫了声：“爷叔！”

Hu was genuinely overwhelmed by the honour.
这一下胡雪岩倒真是受宠若惊了！

He knew the story of the Little Master Outside the Gate.
他懂得“门外小爷”这个典故，

One of the three founders—he could not remember which—was said to have had a young personal attendant of exceptional loyalty and trustworthiness.
据说当初“三祖”之中的不知哪一们，有个贴身服侍的小童，极其忠诚可靠，

Even when the founders discussed secret matters, they did not exclude him.
三祖有所密议，都不避他。

Yet although he was treated as one of them, he had never joined the brotherhood and technically remained outside its threshold.
他虽跟自己人一样，但毕竟未曾入帮，在“门槛”外头，

They therefore honoured him as the Little Master Outside the Gate.
所以尊之为“门外小爷”。

Whenever an incense-hall ceremony was held, he too received a share of the incense offerings.
每逢“开香堂”，亦必有“门外小爷”的一份香火。

Wei's comparison meant that he was admitting Hu as a trusted intimate.
现在魏老头以此相拟，是引为密友知交之意，

Above all, to have him addressed as Uncle put him on Wei's own generational level.
特别是尊为“爷叔”，便与魏者头平辈，

In future, at least in the Songjiang district, the association would treat him as an honoured guest.
将来至少在松江地段，必为漕帮奉作上客。

That was no small achievement for someone just entering this world.
初涉江湖，有此一番成就，着实不易。

Naturally, he protested vigorously that he did not deserve it.
当然，他要极力谦辞。

But Wei's word was law among his people.
无奈魏老头在他们帮里，话出必行，

Whatever Hu said, they obeyed the old man's instruction and called him Uncle, including Zhang's friend Liu and Tongyu's manager Gu.
不管他怎么说，大家都只听魏老头的吩咐，口口声声喊他“爷叔”。连张胖子那个性刘的朋友，和通裕的顾老板也是如此。


“Laowu!
“老五！

His Honour Wang of the Zhejiang Sea Transport Bureau has also sent us a banquet.
浙江海运局的王大老爷，还送了一桌席，

It was a gift from our own prefect, and he has specially passed it on to me.
这桌席是我们松江府送的，王大老爷特为转送了我。

Such an unusual honour must be acknowledged.” Wei continued, “If a man gives me a foot of respect, I give him ten feet in return.
难得的荣耀，不可不领情。”魏老头又说：‘ 人敬我一尺，我敬人一丈’，

Go aboard his boat first and kowtow to thank him for me.”
你先到船上替我去磕个头道谢。

“There's no need!
““不必，不必！

I can convey your thanks,” Hu protested, delighted inwardly.
我说到就是。”胡雪岩口里这样客气，心中却十分高兴，

But he must explain matters to Wang beforehand.
不过这话要先跟王有龄说明白，

When You came, Wang must not put on an indiscriminate display of official superiority.
尤老五去了，便不好乱摆官架子，

He therefore added, “Besides, my employer has gone to dine with your county magistrate.”
因而又接上一句：“而且敝东家赴贵县大老爷的席去了。”

“Then I'll go first thing tomorrow.” Hu asked You to send men to the restaurant and bring the seafood banquet to Wei's house.
“那我就明天一早去。”于是胡雪岩请尤老五派人到馆子里，把那一桌海菜席送到魏家。

Wei had adopted a vegetarian diet and devoted himself to Buddhist prayers, so he declined to join them and was represented by You.
魏老头已经茹素念佛，不肯入席，由尤老五代表。

Both You and Hu now found themselves half host and half guest.
他跟胡雪岩两人变得都是半客半主的身分，

In the end, Zhang took the seat of honour.
结果由张胖子坐了首席。


After the opening courtesies and three rounds of wine, they turned to business.
一番酬劝，三巡酒过，话人正题，

Hu repeated what he had told Wei.
胡雪岩把向魏老头说过的话，重新又讲一遍，

You responded warmly, “Everything can be discussed, everything!”
尤老五很友好地表示？“ 一切都好谈，一切都好谈！”

Yet he gave no definite answer.
话是如此，却并无肯定的答复，

As the man responsible for running the association, he faced many difficulties.
这件事在他“当家人”有许多难处，

Filling the deficit in its accounts was the lesser problem.
帮里的亏空要填补，犹在其次，

The shift to sea transport had placed the Jiangsu associations in desperate straits.
眼看漕米一改海运，使得江苏漕帮的处境，异常艰苦，

Without grain to carry, their income had fallen sharply, and the brethren's livelihoods had to be maintained.
无漕可运，收入大减，帮里弟兄的生计，要设法维持，

They also needed to campaign for the abolition of sea transport and the restoration of the canal route.
还要设法活动，撤消海运，恢复河运，

Every approach, every favour sought, every person cultivated cost substantial sums.
各处打点托情，哪里不要大把银子花出去？

They were relying entirely on selling these hundred-odd thousand shi of rice.
全靠卖了这十几万石的粮米来应付。

If they advanced it to Zhejiang's bureau, they might earn something on the price difference, but would eventually receive rice again.
如今垫了给浙江海运局，虽有些差额可赚，但将来收回的仍旧是米，

That was wholly at odds with their aim of selling the stock to obtain cash.
与自己这方面脱价求现的宗旨，完全不符。

Watching You's expression, Hu noticed that, although he kept up his part in the conversation, his mind was elsewhere.
胡雪岩察言观色，看他表面上照常应付谈话，但神思不属，

He was calculating.
知道他在盘算。

This was no longer a question of credit, of fearing that the bureau would leave its obligations unmet.
这盘算已经不是信用方面，怕浙江海运局“拆烂污”，

Some other difficulty lay behind it.
而是别有难处。

In business, one must consider the other man's position.
做事总要为人设想，

Hu spoke sincerely.
他便很诚恳他说：

“Brother You, since we're one family, there is nothing we cannot discuss.
“五哥，既然是一家人，无话不可谈，

If you have a difficulty, why not say so plainly, and we can consider it together?
如果你那里为难，何妨实说，大家商量。

Your problems are ours.
你们的难处就是我们的难处，

We mustn't think only of ourselves.”
不好只顾自己，不顾人家。”

No wonder the old master valued him, You thought.
尤老五心里想，怪不得老头子看重他，

The man really knew how to speak properly.
说话真个“落门落槛”。

He answered gratefully, “Uncle, you are most considerate.
于是他用感激的声音答道：“爷叔！您老人家真是体谅！

But the old master has given his instructions, so you needn't worry.
不过老头子已经有话交代，爷叔您就不必操心了。

This is our first meeting, and Mr Zhang is here too.
今天头一次见面，还有张老板在这里，

Let us drink freely for now.
先请宽饮一杯，

Tomorrow we shall do as instructed.”
明天我们遵吩咐照办就是了。”


That was precisely what Wei had meant by returning ten feet of respect for one.
这就是魏老头所说的，“人敬我一尺，我敬人一丈”。

Hu reflected that You had given so handsome an answer because his own words had shown the proper understanding.
胡雪岩在思量，因为自己的话“上路”，他才有这样漂亮的答夏。

If he regarded the business as settled, it would be—for this one occasion.
如果以为事情成功了，那就只有这一次，这一次自然成功了，

You would certainly keep his word.
尤老五说过的话，一定算数。

But now that Hu knew of the difficulty and had spoken of it, to accept this gracious answer, pretend ignorance, and leave the matter there would make him a shabby sort of fellow.
但自己这方面，既然已知道他有难处，而且说出了口，却以有此漂亮答复，便假作痴呆，不谈下文，岂非成了“半吊子”？

Their friendship would end here.
交情当然到此为止，

There would be no second occasion.
没有第二回了。

“That won't do.
“话不是这么说！

Otherwise I shall feel uneasy.
不然于心不安。

Brother You,” Hu said earnestly, “let me say again that you must undertake this only if it is manageable on your side.
五哥！”胡雪岩很认真他说：“我再说一句，这件事一定要你们这方面能做才做，

If it would strain you, we'd rather find another way.
有些勉强，我们宁愿另想别法。

A man making his way in the world mustn't harm his friends.”
江湖上走走，不能做害好朋友的行当。

“Since you put it like that, Uncle, I would hardly be treating you as family if I failed to speak frankly.”
““爷叔这样子说，我再不讲买话，就不是自己人了。”

You paused, then continued, “There is a difficulty, though it isn't beyond discussion.
尤老五沉吟了一会说，“难处不是没有，不过也不是不好商量。

I hope you won't laugh at us, but our Songjiang association only looks prosperous.
说句不怕贵客见笑的话，我们松江一帮，完全是虚好看，

We've lived on borrowed money ever since the Qianlong reign.
从乾隆年间到现在，就是惜债度日。

Otherwise we wouldn't be so eager to sell this stock.
不然，不必亟亟乎想卖掉这批货色。

It's nearly the end of the third month.
现在快三月底了，

Before long, the lean fifth and sixth months will be upon us, when the old harvest is gone and the new one isn't ready.
转眼就是青黄不接的五荒六月，

Rice prices are bound to rise.
米价一定上涨，

Wouldn't it be better to hold the stock and wait?”
囤在那里看涨倒不好？“


“Ah, now I understand!”
“啊，啊，我懂了！”

Hu looked at Zhang.
胡雪岩看着张胖子说，

“This is where we need your help.”
“这要靠你们帮忙了。”

Even You understood the proposal: a bank would lend the association money, to be repaid when the rice was sold.
他这一句话，连尤老五也懂，是由钱庄放一笔款子给松江漕帮，将来卖掉了米还清，

He had considered that himself.
这算盘他也打过，

Unfortunately, bankers followed advantage wherever it led.
无奈钱庄最势利，

As soon as grain transport shifted to the sea, they all began courting the sand-junk association.
一看漕米改为海运，都去巴结沙船帮，

When it came to lending to the canal men, their tone suggested fear of the risk.
对漕帮放款，便有怕担风险的口风。

Unwilling to risk humiliation by asking, You had decided that relying on himself was better than seeking help and was prepared to sacrifice the stock for ready cash.
尤老五怕失面子，不肯开口，所以才抱定“求人不如求己的宗旨”，不惜牺牲，脱货求现。

Zhang, meanwhile, was now acting entirely as Hu's assistant, taking his lead from every hint.
至于张胖子，现在完全是替胡雪岩做“下手”，听他的口风行事，

He answered without hesitation, “We should be delighted to help.
所以这时毫不思索地答道：“理当效劳！

Just tell us what is needed!”
只请吩咐！”

At that, You and Gu exchanged a glance.
一听这话，尤老五跟顾老板交换了一个眼色，

They looked surprised and a little doubtful.
仿佛颇感意外，有些不大相信似的，

Hu understood: Zhang had agreed so readily and casually that he sounded insincere.
胡雪岩明白，这是因为张胖子话说得太容易，太随便，似乎缺乏诚意的缘故。


Hu therefore prompted him, speaking seriously in the Hangzhou dialect.
于是胡雪岩提醒张胖子，他用杭州乡谈，相当认真他说：

“Mr Zhang, a man's word is as good as silver.
“张老板，说话就是银子，

Don't treat serious business as a game!”
你不要‘玩儿不当正经’！”

Zhang took the hint and protested emphatically.
张胖子会意了，报以极力辩白的态度：

“How could a businessman dare do that?
“做生意的人，怎么敢‘玩儿不当正经’？

If Brother You needs a loan, a very large sum would be beyond my resources.
尤五哥这里如果想用笔款子，数目太大我力量不够，

But anything around a hundred thousand taels—leave that to me.
十万上下，包在我身上。

What do you say, Brother You?”
尤五哥你说！”

“That would be about right,” You answered, half seriously and half in jest.
“差不多了。”尤老五半认真，半开玩笑他说，

“Ours is an impoverished association.
“我们是疲帮，

Mind you don't end up with a bad debt.”
你将来当心吃倒帐。”

“Nonsense!” Zhang said.
“笑话！”张胖子说，

“I have every confidence.
“我放心得很。

First, there's the Songjiang association's credit and good name.
第一是松江潜帮的信用、面子，

Second, there's the standing of the Zhejiang Sea Transport Bureau.
第二是浙江海运局这块招牌，

Third, the rice is there as well.
第三，还有米在那里，

Surely those three guarantees are enough?”
有这三样担保难道还不够？”

You was reassured.
尤老五释然了，

The banker had made his own calculations and was not merely speaking to please them.
人家有人家的盘算，不是信口敷衍，

Deeply gratified, he said, “Excellent!
所以异常欣慰他说：“好极了，好极了！

That meets everyone's needs.
这样一做，面面俱到。

In truth, Uncle, you're the one helping us.
说实在的，倒是爷叔帮我们的忙了，

Otherwise, selling the stock for cash wouldn't have been easy at such short notice.”
不然，我们脱货求现，一时还不大容易。”

He repeatedly clasped his hands towards Hu in thanks.
说着，向胡雪岩连连拱手。

Hu too was delighted.
胡雪岩也很高兴，

The affair had gone remarkably smoothly.
这件事做得实在顺利。

Hosts and guests drank to their hearts' content and parted in the highest spirits.
当时宾主双方尽醉极欢。

They agreed to meet the next morning and immediately travel together to Shanghai.
约定第二天上午见了面，随即同船到上海。

There they would arrange how Tongyu was to deliver the rice, and how Zhang was to assemble the silver and lend it to the Songjiang association.
通裕如何交米，张胖子如何调度现银，放款给松江漕帮，都在上海商量办理。


You personally escorted them back to Xiuye Bridge, where they immediately noticed something unusual.
等尤老五亲自送他们回到秀野侨，一看便有些异样，

The landing was ordinarily neither bustling nor deserted, with a dozen or more boats of various sizes crowded together.
原来是个虽不热闹，也不太冷落的码头，大大小小的船，总有十儿艘挤在一起。

Now only their two boats remained, their bows facing the stone steps, giving them the best position and the easiest access.
这时只有他们两只船，船头正对码头石级，上落极其方便，占了最呼的位置。

“Why!” Zhang exclaimed.
“咦！”张胖子说，

“What's happened?
“怎的？

All the other boats have gone.
别的船都走了！

Does a water ghost haunt this place?”
莫非这地方有水鬼？”

“No, no!” You answered at once.
“没有，没有！”尤老五抢着答道，

“It's perfectly safe.
“这地方干净得很。

I was afraid that so many boats together would be noisy and keep you awake, so I arranged for them to move.” Only now did they see the extent of You's authority on the local canal, as well as the sincerity of his hospitality.
我是怕船都挤一起，吵得你们大家晚上睡不着，想办法叫他们移开这才看出尤老五在当地运河上的势力，也见得他们敬客的诚意。

Hu and Zhang thanked him repeatedly.
胡雪岩和张胖子连连道谢。

“It's late, and His Honour Wang must have retired.
“今天晚了，王大老爷想来已经安置，

I won't disturb him.
我不敢惊拢。

I'll come to pay my respects early tomorrow.”
明天一早来请安。”

You took warm leave of them and waited until they had boarded before departing.
说着，他殷殷作别，看客人上了船，方才离去。


A'zhu was still awake.
阿珠还没有睡，

As she wrung out towels and poured tea, she happily told them that the Songjiang association had sent all sorts of provisions: a shi of excellent white rice, four chickens, ten jin of pork, firewood, charcoal, oil, candles—even rough paper.
一面替他们绞手巾、倒茶，一面喜滋滋地告诉他们，说松江漕帮送了许多日用之物，一石上好的白米、四只鸡、十斤肉、柴炭油烛，连草纸都送到。

They had also sent someone to invite her father and the general affairs officer ashore for a bath and dinner.
而且还派了人邀他爹和那庶务上岸，洗澡吃饭，

The two had only just returned, thoroughly drunk, and fallen straight asleep.
刚刚才喝碍醉醺醺回来，倒头睡下。

“I've passed through this landing a dozen times and never seen anything like it.
“松江这个码头，我经过十几回，从来没有过这样的事。

Mr Hu,” she said innocently, “you must belong to the brotherhood, mustn't you?”
胡老爷，”阿珠很天真他说，“你一定是‘ 在帮’的，对不对？”

“Indeed he does!” Zhang laughed.
“对，对！”张胖子笑道，

“A'zhu, you've had a real stroke of luck on this trip.
“阿珠，你们这趟真交运了！

How will you thank Mr Hu?”
怎么样谢谢胡老爷？”

“I ought to, certainly.”
“应该，应该。”

She smiled.
阿珠笑道：

“I'll make him a pair of shoes.”
“我做双鞋给胡老爷。”

“Who wants those?”
“哪个稀罕？”

“Then I'll cook him a couple of dishes.”
“那么做两样菜请胡老爷。”

“Worse still.”
“越发不中用了。”

Zhang was deliberately teasing her.
张胖子是有意拿阿珠逗笑，

This would not do, nor would that.
这样不行，那样也不好，

At last she said helplessly, “Then I can only kowtow to thank him.”
最后她无可奈何地说：“那就只有替胡老爷磕头了。”


“Exactly!” Zhang laughed.
“不错！”张胖子笑道：

“But not just to Mr Hu.
“不过也不光是替胡老爷磕，

You'll have to kowtow to his mother and his wife as well.”
还要给胡老太太、胡太太磕头。”

“Why?”
“这又为什么？”

“Silly girl!”
“傻丫头！”

Hu could not help laughing.
胡雪岩忍俊不禁，

“Can't you see that Mr Zhang is making fun of you?”
“张老板拿你寻开心你都不懂。”

She still did not understand, so Zhang explained.
阿珠还是不懂，张胖子就说：

“Why, can't you work that out?
“咦！这点你都弄不明白，

Once you've entered his household as his concubine, won't you have to kowtow to his mother?”
你进了胡家的门，做胡老爷的姨太太，不要结老太太磕头？

That embarrassed her.
“这一下羞着了阿珠，

Rolling her eyes, she scolded, “The fatter you get, the worse you are!”
白眼嗔道：“越胖越坏！”

Then she turned and left.
说完掉身就走。

Zhang roared with laughter.
张胖子哈哈大笑，

“What an entertaining journey this is!”
“这一趟出门真有趣！”


“Enough of that,” Hu said.
“闲话少说。”胡雪岩问道：

“Are you sure you can provide the loan you've promised?
“你答应了人家放款，有把握没有？

Among these men, a handsome undertaking matters.
江湖上最讲究漂亮，

Once a word is spoken, the affair is settled.
一句话就算定局。

Don't make a stinking mess of it!”
你不要弄得‘鸭屎臭’！”

“Nonsense!” Zhang answered.
“笑话！”张胖子说，

“I have fifty thousand taels in Shanghai.
“我有五万银子在上海，

I'll borrow another fifty thousand from the Big Three and can pay out the cash at once.
再向‘三大’拆五万，马上就可以付现。

But we share the responsibility!”
不过，责任是大家的！”

“Naturally.
“那还用说？

The Sea Transport Bureau will guarantee it.”
海运局担保。”


With that settled, they each went to bed.
这样说停当了，各自安置。

Early the next morning, Hu was still asleep when someone shook him.
第二天一早，胡雪岩还在梦中，觉得有人来推身子，

Opening his eyes, he saw A'zhu beside the bed.
睁眼一看是阿珠站在床前。

“His Honour Wang sent Second Master Gao to ask you over.”
“王大老爷叫高二爷来请你去。”

“Oh!”
“噢！”

Hu sat up, took his watch from beneath the pillow, and saw that it was only seven.
胡雪岩坐起身子，从枕头下取出表来看，不过才七点钟。

She had already draped a lined silk jacket over his shoulders.
这时她已替他把一件绸夹袄披在身上，

As she leaned close, a faint fragrance reached him.
身子靠近了，香泽微闻，

Desire stirred, and he caught her hand and pulled her towards him.
胡雪岩一阵心荡，伸手一把握住了阿珠的手往怀里拖。

“Don't!” she protested softly, pointing towards the cabin wall.
“不要嘛！”阿珠低声反抗，一面用手指指舱壁。

Her objection was not, in truth, unwillingness, but concern that there were ears in the next cabin.
这不是真的“不要”，无非碍着“隔舱有耳”。

Hu did not want to press her too far.
胡雪岩不愿逼迫太甚，

He lifted her hand, smelled it, and laughed quietly.
拿起她的手闻了一下，轻声笑道：

“How sweet!”
“好香！”

She snatched it back, lowered her head, and smiled.
阿珠把手一夺，低下头去笑了。

Then she tossed his clothes onto the bed and went away.
接着把他的衣服都抛到床上，管口己走开。

At the cabin door, however, she turned, drew a slender finger twice across her cheek in a gesture of mock shame, made a face at him, and swayed out.
走到舱门口却义转过头来，举起纤纤一指，在自己脸上刮了两下，扮个鬼相，才扭腰而去。


Hu remembered that Li the Infallible, the fortune-teller on City God Hill, had told him the previous month that romantic luck lay ahead.
胡雪岩心想：上个月城隍山的李铁口，说自己要交桃花运。

There seemed to be something in it.
看来有些道理。

Then he reproached himself.
转念却又自责，

At the point when one's fortunes were changing, this sort of distraction was especially to be avoided.
交运脱运的当口，最忌这些花样。

What did “romantic luck” amount to?
什么叫桃花运？

With money, a man could enjoy it every day!
只要有了钱，天天交跳花运！

The thought drove the lively, charming A'zhu straight out of his mind.
这样一想，立刻便把娇憨的阿珠置诸脑后，

He dressed, hurried through his washing, and went to the leading boat to see Wang.
穿好衣服，匆匆漱洗，到前面船上去见王有龄。

Wang had waited to breakfast with him.
王有龄在等他吃早饭，

As they ate, Hu gave a detailed account of the previous day's events, and Wang listened spellbound.
边吃边谈，纲说昨日经过。王有龄听得出了神。

When he finished, Wang shook his head as though unable to believe it.
等他讲完，摇着头仿佛不相信似他说：

“What an extraordinary succession of encounters!”
“奇遇何其多也！”

“Things have gone smoothly, but we mustn't become careless,” Hu said.
“事情总算顺利，不过大意不得。”胡雪岩问道：

“You must have heard something yesterday.
“昨天总打听了些消息，

How does the general situation look?”
时局怎么样？”

“I did!
“有，有！”王有龄说，

I heard quite a lot.”
“得了好些消息。”


The news all concerned Hong and Yang.
消息都是关于洪杨的，

Hong Xiuquan had founded a state and proclaimed himself king.
洪秀全已经开国称王，

He called it the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, renamed Jiangning the Heavenly Capital, and took the title Heavenly King.
国号名为“太平天国”，改江宁为“天京”，洪秀全的尊号称力“天王”。

He had appointed officials, established court ceremonies, and issued ten prohibitions, also called Heavenly Commandments, reportedly modelled on the Christian Ten Commandments.
置百官，定朝仪，有十条禁令，也叫“天条”，据说仿自基督教的“十诫”。

Naturally, the new state's troops were called the Taiping Army.
太平天国的军队自然称作“太平军”，

One force, led by Lin Fengxiang, Chancellor of the Heavenly Office, and Li Kaifang, Chancellor of the Earthly Office, had taken Zhenjiang, crossed at Guazhou, and captured Yangzhou.
有一路由“天官丞相”林凤祥、“地官丞相”李开芳率领，夺镇江，渡瓜洲，陷维扬，

It was preparing to move north against the region around Beijing.
准备北取幽燕。

“Good heavens!” Hu exclaimed in alarm.
“唷！”胡雪岩吃惊他说，

“The Taiping Army is formidable!”
“太平军好厉害！”

“It certainly is, but the government forces have gained a foothold too,” Wang replied.
“太平军诚然厉害，不过官军也算站住脚了。”王有龄说，

“Imperial Commissioner Xiang has pursued them to Jiangning and encamped at Xiaolingwei, east of the city, preparing a siege.
“向钦差已经追到江宁，在城东孝陵卫扎营，预备围城。

Another commissioner, Qishan, formerly Governor-General of Zhili, has brought cavalry and infantry from Zhili, Shaanxi, and Heilongjiang down through Henan to meet them head-on.
另外一位钦差大臣，就是以前的直隶总督琦善，也率领了直隶、陕西、黑龙江的马步各军，从河南赶了下来，迎头痛击。

I think the situation may gradually improve.
我看以后的局势，慢慢可以变好，

It all depends on how the two great tasks of training troops and raising military funds are handled.”
只看练兵筹饷两件大事，办得如何？”


“Then grain prices should look promising?”
“照这一说，粮价一定会看好？”

“Of course.
“那当然。

In any reign or dynasty, once war begins, grain prices are bound to rise.
随便哪一朝、哪一代，只要一动刀兵，粮价一定上涨。

Grain merchants who store their supplies well and avoid losses invariably make fortunes.”
做粮食生意的，如果囤积得好，能够不受损失，无不大发其财。”

“Then that settles it,” Hu said with satisfaction.
这就是了。“胡雪岩欣慰地说，

“Our present arrangement really does help the Songjiang association.”
“我们现在这个办法，倒真的是帮了松江漕帮的忙。”

Wang nodded and gazed into space, apparently thinking.
王有龄点点头，两服望空，若有所思，

The expression on his face was so peculiar that Hu could not interpret it.
脸上的表情很奇怪，倒叫胡雪岩有些识不透。


“Mr Xuexuan,” he could not help asking, “what excellent idea have you thought of?”
“雪公！”他忍不住问，“你想到了什么好主意？”

“Yes, I do have an idea.
“对了，我有个主意，

Tell me whether it would work.”
你看行不行？”

Wang lowered his voice.
王有龄放低了声音说，

“Why let someone else make the profit when we could make it ourselves?
“与其叫别人赚，不如我们自己赚！

Could we discuss a loan with Zhang, buy Tongyu's rice outright to fulfil the delivery, then hold Zhejiang's shipment ourselves and sell when prices improve?”
好不好跟张胖子商量一下，借出一笔款子来，买了通裕的米先交兑，浙江的那批漕米，我们自己囤着，等价钱好了再卖？”

“It's a good idea in itself.
“主意倒是好主意。

But we can't do it.
不过我们做不得，

First, we have nowhere to store the rice...”
第一，没地方囤……”

“That doesn't matter!”
“那不要紧！”

Wang broke in.
王有龄抢着说，

“We can go into partnership with Tongyu and use their storage.”
“我们跟通裕合伙，借他的地方囤米。”

“That would be worse.
“这更不好了。

Mr Xuexuan,” Hu said gravely, “among these men, a spoken undertaking must stand.
雪公！”胡雪岩正色说道：“江湖上做事，说一句算一句，

We can't go back on what we've promised the Songjiang association.
答应了松江漕帮的事，不能翻悔，

Otherwise they'll despise us, and we won't get anywhere in future.”
不然叫人看不起，以后就吃不开了。”

Wang trusted Hu completely.
王有龄对胡雪岩十分信服，

At once he abandoned his “excellent idea,” saying repeatedly, “Yes, yes.
听他这一说，立刻舍弃了自己的“好主意”，不断说道：“对，对！

I'll follow your advice.”
我依你。”


“One thing more.
“还有一层，

When You Laowu comes over, please make a special point of showing him respect.”
回头尤老五来了，雪公，请你格外给他一个面子。”

“I understand.”
“我知道了。”

Before long, You boarded to pay his respects, kneeling and kowtowing.
不多久，尤老五上船谒见，磕头请安。

Wang treated him with great courtesy and devoted considerable attention to him.
王有龄十分客气，大大地敷衍了一番。

Then they cast off, left the city, and travelled east along the Wusong River.
接着就解缆开船，出城沿吴淞江东行，

The next morning they reached Shanghai.
第二天上午就到了上海。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第四章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Four, first part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER FOUR｜第四章


Shanghai's county town had been fortified in the thirty-second year of the Ming Jiajing reign, originally as a defence against Japanese raiders.
上海县城筑于明朝嘉靖三十二年，原是用以“备倭”的，

The walls extended nine li around the town and stood two zhang and four chi high.
城周九里，城墙高二丈四尽，

There were six gates, large and small.
大小六个城门，

The principal eastern, southern, western, and northern gates were named Chaozong, Kuahai, Yifeng, and Yanhai.
东南西北四门，名为朝宗、跨海、仪风、晏海，

Two others, Baodai and Chaoyang, were commonly called the Little East Gate and Little South Gate.
另外有宝带、朝阳两门，俗称小东门、小南门。

Their boats moored outside the Little East Gate.
他们的船就泊在小东门外。


As the boats arrived, someone on the landing waved.
船刚到就有人在码头上招手，

You Laowu, standing in the bow, answered with a gesture.
立在船头上的尤老五，也报以手势，

Before the gangplank was properly in place, the man came aboard in a few quick steps, as agile as though walking on level ground.
跳板还不曾搭妥，那人己三脚两步，走上船来，身手矫捷，如履平地，

One glance showed that he was accustomed to life on the water.
一望便知是过惯了水上生涯的。

“A'xiang,” You asked, “is everything ready?”
“阿祥！”尤老五问他，“都预备好了？”

“Everything.
“都好了。”阿祥答道，

I've had rooms kept at the Gaosheng Inn by the North Gate, and notified Sanduo Hall.
“叫北门高升栈留了屋子，三多堂也关照过了，

The chairs are waiting on the landing.”
轿子在码头上。”

“Good.
“好，

Go back and attend to things.
你到码头上去招呼，

Make sure nothing is overlooked.”
凡事要周到。”

Once A'xiang had left, You returned to the cabin.
等阿祥一走，尤老五随即回到舱中。

Hu and Zhang were discussing where to stay and in what order to conduct their business.
胡雪岩正在跟张胖子商量，住哪家客栈，先干什么，后干什么，

Neither knew Shanghai particularly well, and after considerable discussion they had settled nothing.
两个人对上海都不大熟，所以商量了半天，尚未停当。

You's arrival made further deliberation unnecessary.
等尤老五一出现，就不必再商量了。

He told Hu that he had sent a man ahead and prepared everything.
他告诉胡雪岩，已预先派了人来招呼，一切都有预备，

They need not trouble themselves.
不劳大家费心，

Shanghai County belonged to Songjiang Prefecture, he added, so he was their host.
同时声明，上海县属于松江府，他是地主，

All their needs in Shanghai would be supplied by him as his “official duty.”
所以在上海的一切供应，都由他“办差”。


“How could we accept that?” Hu protested.
“这怎么敢当？”胡雪岩说，

“And those words ‘official duty’—Brother You, you're positively insulting us!”
“尤其是‘办差’两个字，五哥，你是在骂人了！”

You only smiled, then asked, “Uncle, do you know Shanghai well?”
尤老五笑笑不响，然后问道：“爷叔，你上海熟不熟？”

“No.”
“不熟。”

“Then let's go ashore at once.
“那就快上岸吧，

There are plenty of places to enjoy ourselves.
好白相的地方多得很，

We mustn't waste time.”
不必耽误工夫了。”

They all went ashore, Wang included.
于是，连王有龄在一起，都上了岸，

Several blue-cloth sedan chairs were already waiting at the landing.
码头上已经有几顶蓝呢轿子停在那里。

Only ten years had passed since the opening of the five treaty ports, but Shanghai had become luxurious.
五口通商不过十年的工夫，上海已变得很奢华了，

Violations of the restrictions governing dress and display counted for little.
服饰僭越，更不当回事，

Apart from Wang, every man in the party rode in a large blue-cloth chair for the first time in his life.
所以除却王有龄，大家都生平第一遭坐了蓝呢大轿。


The chairs entered the city and turned north.
轿子进城，折而往北。

When they stopped, the travellers found themselves among inns of various sizes.
停下一看，附近都是客栈，大小不同，

The larger establishments proclaimed in gilded lettering that they offered “temporary residences for officials”; the smaller promised “comfortable lodgings for merchants.”
大的金字招牌上写的是“仕宦行台”，小的便写“安寓客商”。

The Gaosheng Inn naturally belonged to the former category.
高升栈自然是仕宦行台，

You had reserved a courtyard with five spacious, clean rooms.
尤老五派人包下一座院落，共有五间房，十分宽敞干净。

Their luggage had arrived too.
这时行李也送到了，

Once they were settled, he drew Hu aside and quietly asked, “Is His Honour Wang a very proper gentleman?”
等安顿妥帖，尤老五把胡雪岩拉到一边，悄悄问道：“王老爷为人是不是很方正？”

That was difficult to answer.
这话很难回答，

Hu replied, “Brother You, you must have a reason for asking.
胡雪岩便这样答道：“五哥，你问这句话，总有道理在内，

Tell me that first.”
先说来我听听。”

“Here's the arrangement.
“是这样，

I'll give everyone a welcoming meal, then we'll visit the City God Temple.
我先替大家接风，饭后逛逛邑庙。

The bankers' guildhall is in the garden behind it, so Mr Zhang can conveniently call on his fellow bankers.
钱业公所在邑庙后花园，张老板要看同行朋友，也很方便。

Tonight I'd like to entertain you all with courtesans.
到了晚上，我请大家吃花酒，

If His Honour Wang doesn't care to come, we'll make other arrangements.”
如果王老爷不肯去，另作商量。”

So that was it!
原来如此！

Wang seemed a man with a taste for romance, Hu thought, but visiting courtesans compromised official propriety.
胡雪岩心想，看样子王有龄也是个风流人物，不过涉足花丛，有玷官常，

He would have to ask him personally.
这非要问他本人不可。

“There's still plenty of time,” You continued.
“时候也还早。”尤老五又说，

“Perhaps we should eat first and discuss it over tea at the temple later.”
“或者我们先去吃了饭，等下在邑庙吃茶的时候再说。”

“Yes, exactly.
“对，对！

Let's do that.”
就这样。”


You's welcoming meal was at the leading restaurant for local Shanghai cooking, inside the Little East Gate, before the City God Temple, in Huacaobang's Guiyuan Lane—properly called Guanyi Lane.
尤老五替他们接风的地方，是上海城风第一家本帮馆子，在小东门内邑庙前花草滨桂圆弄，实在是馆驿弄。

Wang had already said that he wanted only a modest meal and would decline a formal banquet.
王有龄先就说过，只要小吃，若是整桌的席，他便辞谢，

You therefore ordered local dishes such as zaobotou, tufei, and juancai.
因此尤老五点了本帮菜，糟钵头、秃肺、卷菜之类，

Their flavours were strong and rich.
味极浓腴，

But this was a moment when hungry men were easily satisfied, and nobody found them too heavy.
而正当“饥者易为食”之时，所以也不嫌腻了。


Afterwards, they walked to the temple, which was only a few steps away.
饭后去逛邑庙，近在咫尺，便都走着去了。

The county temple was the City God Temple.
邑庙就是城隍庙。

Worship of this deity began under the Northern Qi, developing from the earth gods of the Qin and Han.
城隍这位尊神起于北齐，原是由秦汉的社神转化来的。

At first the cult existed only south of the Yangtze.
起初只有江南一带才有，

Somewhere in that cultured southeastern region, some clever person had devised the excellent notion of assigning the City God a definite identity: he was the local official of the underworld.
不知是东南人文荟萃之区，哪个聪明人。想出来的好法子，赋予城隍以一种明确的身分：它是阴间的地方官，

A metropolitan City God corresponded to a governor, a county City God to a county magistrate.
都城隍等于巡抚，县城隍便是县令，

Like an earthly yamen, his establishment had its runners and administrative offices.
一般也有三班六房。

In the unseen world, he could arrest people and hear cases.
在冥冥中可以抓人办案。

Thus ordinary people who suffered injustice had a final court of appeal.
因此，老百姓受了冤屈的，就有了一个最后申诉的地方。

The county magistrate acknowledged this local colleague of equal standing; moreover, the magistrate of the dead appeared to exercise authority over the magistrate of the living, so the latter could not help feeling some apprehension.
县官也承认本地有这么一位地位完全相等的同僚，而这位阴世的县官似乎也管着阳世的县官，是以不能不心存忌惮。

The Complete Book of Happiness and Benevolence, a manual on local administration, expressly instructed a magistrate arriving in his jurisdiction to spend a night of ritual fasting at the City God Temple one or three days before taking office.
有部教人如问做地方官的《福惠全书》，就曾写明，县官莅境，“于上任前一日，或前三日至城隍庙斋宿”，

This served, first, as a courtesy visit, an advance request for forbearance; and second, as an opportunity to seek advice in dreams about such matters as the local bullies and corrupt gentry who preyed on the people, or the hidden circumstances of unresolved injustices.
一则是礼貌上的拜访，先打个招呼：“请多多包涵”，再则是在梦中请教，本地有哪些鱼肉乡里的土豪劣绅，或含悬而未结的冤案，内幕如何之类。


The City God was not appointed by the court but chosen by the people, much as the worthy and capable were selected for office in the living world.
城隍不归朝廷指派，而是老百姓选出来的，就如阳世的选贤与能一般，

The guiding principle was that intelligence and uprightness made a spirit worthy of divine honour.
选城隍是“聪明正直之谓神”，

Without uprightness, he would not wish to redress the people's wrongs; without intelligence, he would be unable to do so.
不正直不愿为老百姓伸冤，不聪明则不能为老百姓伸冤。

Shanghai's City God was such a popular choice, one of the three most famous in the southeast.
上海县的城隍就是老百姓所选的，他是东南最有名的三位城隍之一。

Suzhou had Huang Xie, Lord Chunshen; Hangzhou had Wen Tianxiang.
苏州城隍春申君黄歇，杭州城隍文天祥，

Shanghai had originally belonged to Lord Chunshen's fief, but the people of Suzhou had already claimed him, so Shanghai had to choose another.
上海原是春申君的采邑，他被苏州人请了去，上海人只好另选一位城隍，

Their choice was Qin Yubo, a native of Daming Prefecture.
此公叫秦裕伯，大名府人氏，

Late in the Yuan dynasty he had risen to a departmental directorship in the Fujian provincial administration.
元朝末年当到“福建行省郎中”，

When the realm fell into disorder and rival leaders rose, he abandoned office and sought refuge in Shanghai.
因为天下大乱，群雄并起，弃官避难到了上海。

After Zhu Yuanzhang, founder of the Ming, won the empire, he summoned Qin to court, appointed him an academician serving as an imperial reader, then sent him out as prefect of Longzhou.
明太祖朱元璋得了天下，征辟至朝，授官侍读学士，外放陇州知州，

On retiring, Qin returned not to Daming but to Shanghai, his adopted home.
告老以后，不回大名府回到寄籍的上海，

After his death, he repeatedly manifested his powers to protect the people, who therefore chose him as their City God.
死后屡显灵迹，保障生民，所以上海人选他来做城隍。


Like the Great Xiangguo Monastery in Kaifeng, Shanghai's City God Temple was a lively market full of food and diversions.
上海的城隍庙跟开封的大相国寺一样，是个有吃有玩的闹市、

Inside the first entrance gate, miscellaneous shops lined both sides.
一进头山门，两旁郡是杂货铺，

A theatre stage stood in the centre of the second gate, with the passage running beneath it.
二山门正中是个戏台，台下就是通路，

Stalls on either side sold snacks such as sweet osmanthus rice porridge and rice balls in fermented rice wine.
过道两旁是卖桂花糖粥、酒酿圆子等等的小吃摊。

Beyond the stage lay an enormous open court.
戏台前面是个极大的广场，

Engravers occupied the western gallery; in the eastern stood a teahouse used as a meeting place by the county yamen's clerks and runners.
西廊是刻字铺，东廊有家茶店，是上海县衙门书办、皂隶的“茶会”，

People arranging lawsuits or seeking favours made contact there.
老而姓打官司、托人情都在这里接头。

Farther north stood the temple's main hall, flanked by four stone bailiffs.
再往北就是城隍庙的大殿了，两旁石壁拱立四个石皂隶，

Legend said they had drifted in from the sea, probably former subordinates of Qin Yubo in Fujian who had crossed the East Sea to rejoin their old master.
相传是海上飘来的，大概是秦裕伯在福建的旧属，特地浮东海而来，投奔故主。

Inside the hall, a great abacus hung over the doorway facing the god, with eight large characters beside it: “Man has a thousand calculations; Heaven has one.”
一进殿门，面对城隍的门楣上悬一把大算盘，两旁八个大字：“人有千算，天有一算”。

This was the parting admonition offered to worshippers as they left.
这是给烧香出殿的人的“临别赠言”。

Opposite the abacus, above a statue about a zhang high, hung a plaque bearing the City God's formal title, “Divine Lord of Jinshan.”
正对大算盘，丈许高的神像上面有块匾，题作“金山神主”，是为上海县城隍的正式尊号。

Beyond lay the rear hall, where both the god and his wife were worshipped.
再进去就是后殿，供奉城隍及城隍夫人，

Her sleeping chamber was on the western side, a secluded inner room that ordinary mortals were permitted to view on her birthday.
她的寝宫就在西面，寂寂深闺，在她生日那天亦许凡夫俗子一瞻仰。


The temple's chief attraction was Yuyuan, the finest garden within Shanghai's walls.
城隍庙的好玩，是在庙后有座豫园，为上海城内第一名园，

It had originally belonged to Pan Yunduan, who had served as provincial treasurer of Sichuan during the Ming Jiajing reign.
原是明朝嘉靖年间，当过四川布政使的潘允端的产业，

Naturally, the upheavals at the end of the Ming had left it neglected.
明末大乱自然废记，

By the middle of the Qianlong reign, prosperity was at its height and the country extraordinarily wealthy.
乾隆中叶，正值全盛，海内富丽无比，

To provide the City God, protector of this coastal district, with somewhere to relax after his official duties, local people raised money to buy the ruined garden from Pan's descendants and restore it.
本地人为了使“保障海隅”的城隍有个公余游憩之地，特地集资向潘氏后裔买了这个废园，重新修建，

The work took more than twenty years and enormous sums of silver.
历时二十余年，花了巨万的银子，方始完工。

Because it lay northwest of the temple, it was called the West Garden.
因为地处庙的西北，所以名力西园，

An East Garden already stood on the other side, commonly known as the City God Temple's Rear Garden.
而庙东原有个东园，俗称“城隍庙后花园”。

The bankers maintained and repaired the East Garden each year.
东园每年由钱庄同业保养修理，

It opened only for the birthdays of the City God and his wife, and for the elegant orchid gathering in early summer.
只有逢到城隍及城隍夫人生日，以及初夏的“蕙兰雅集”才开放。

Yuyuan, however, remained open all year, with several teahouses and a very large storytelling hall.
豫园却是终年洞开，里面有好几家茶店，还有极大的一座书厅。

You entertained the party with tea in Qingfen Hall, popularly called the Osmanthus Hall.
尤老五招待大家在俗称“桂花厅”的清芬堂喝茶。

A bird-fighting contest was taking place that day.
这天有人在斗鸟，

Several of the participants were his brethren, who greeted him warmly and urged him to join them.
其中颇多尤老五的“弟兄”，走来殷殷致意，请他“下场去玩”。

Like cricket fighting, the sport allowed heavy betting.
这就象斗蟋蟀一样，可以博采，输赢甚大。

You invited Zhou, Wu, and Zhang to take part, leaving Hu free to speak privately with Wang.
尤老五便把周、吴两委员和张胖子请了去一起玩，留下胡雪岩好跟王有龄说私话。


“Mr Xuexuan,” Hu asked casually, “would you care for a little diversion tonight?”
“雪公！”他意态闲豫地问道：“今天晚上，逢场作戏，可有兴致？”

Assuming he meant cards, Wang shook his head.
王有龄只当要他打牌，摇摇头说：

“You go ahead as usual.
“你们照常玩吧！

I'm no hand at gambling.”
我对赌钱不内行。”

“We'd be admiring flowers, not bamboo.”
“不是看竹是看花！”

Wang understood.
王有龄懂了，

Bamboo meant bamboo-backed playing tiles; flowers, needless to say, meant lingering among the alluring blossoms of the pleasure quarters like drifting catkins.
竹是竹牌，花则不用说，当然是“倡条冶时恣留连，飘荡轻子花上絮”，

He immediately smiled.
例即笑道：

“Flowers and bamboo—what a delightful turn of phrase!”
“看竹看花的话，隽妙得很！”

Close though they were, this was the first time they had discussed visiting courtesans together.
两人交情虽深，结伴作狎邪游的话，却还是第一次谈到。

Wang was older and could never quite put aside the thought that he was an official.
王有龄年纪长些，又去不了一个“官”字的念头，

Embarrassed inwardly, he could manage only this evasive answer.
所以内心不免有忸怩之感，只好作这样不着边际的答复。

Hu understood human nature thoroughly.
胡雪岩熟透人情，自然了解，

He knew Wang was tempted, but might not wish to dine with courtesans in Zhou and Wu's company.
知道他心里有些活动，但跟周、吴二人一起去吃花酒，怕他未见得愿意，

Even if he agreed, he might find little pleasure in it.
就是愿意也未见得有乐趣。

Hu therefore formed another plan.
这样一想，胡雪岩另有了计较，

For the moment he said nothing and turned to official business.
暂时不响，只谈公事，

They agreed to rest that day.
决定这天休息，

On the following day Wang would pay his calls, while Hu and Zhang joined You to arrange the loan.
第二天起，王有龄去拜客，胡雪岩、张胖子会同尤老五去借款。


“One important matter remains,” Wang said.
“还有件要紧事，”王有龄说，

“We must promptly arrange the twenty thousand taels Governor Huang wants remitted to Fujian.”
“黄抚台要汇到福建的那两万银子，得赶紧替他办妥。”

“I know.
“我知道。

Secrecy matters more than speed in that affair.
这件事不在快，要秘密，

I'll see to it.
我自会弄妥当，

You needn't worry.”
你不必操心。”

Hu rose as he spoke.
说着，便站起身来。

You was a man who heard and saw everything around him.
尤老五是耳听六路、眼观八方的角色，

Seeing Hu get up, he excused himself from the game.
见胡雪岩一站起身来，便借故离座，

They met, spoke quietly, and made their arrangements.
两人会合在一起，低声密语，作了安排。

That evening the visitors from Hangzhou separated into three unconnected parties.
这天夜里，杭州来的人，便分作各不相关的三起去玩，

One went to Sanduo Hall.
一起是到三多堂，

Another consisted of Gao alone, accompanied around town by a junior member of the association whom You had assigned to him.
一起是高升一个人，由尤老五派了个小弟兄陪他各处去逛。

When everyone else had gone, only Wang remained aboard, dressed in ordinary clothes, with a pair of dark crystal spectacles beside him, reading as he waited.
等人都走光了，只剩下一个王有龄，换了便服，把一副墨晶眼镜放在手边，在船上看书坐等。

Just after nightfall, Hu slipped away from Sanduo Hall.
天刚刚黑，胡雪岩从三多堂溜了出来，

One of You's men was already waiting.
尤老五已有人在等候，

They took a sedan chair to the landing outside the Little East Gate and collected Wang.
坐轿到了小东门外码头上，把王有龄接了出来。

Their guide told the bearers, “Meijia Lane.”
陪伴的人呛咐轿夫：“梅家弄。”


Meijia Lane was fairly secluded, but its winding approach led to a place of unexpected charm.
梅家弄地方相当偏僻，但曲径通幽，别有佳趣。

When the chairs arrived, the guide softly tapped the brass ring on a small stone-framed gate, which was promptly opened.
等轿子抬到，领路的人，在一座小小的石库门上，轻叩铜环，随即便有人来开门。

A woman of about forty received them, speaking in a particularly pleasing Suzhou accent.
应接的是一个四十左右的妇人，说得一口极好听的苏州话。

Only when they reached the lighted reception room did Wang, looking through his dark glasses, see that she retained considerable grace despite her faded youth.
到了客厅里灯光亮处，王有龄从黑晶眼镜里望出去，才发觉这个妇人，秋娘老去，风范犹存。

The room was arranged with neatness and taste, quite free of vulgarity, and he felt at ease.
再看客厅里的陈设，布置得楚楚有致，着实不俗，心里便很舒服。

“Third Aunt,” the guide told their hostess, “these are Mr Wang and Mr Hu, both distinguished guests.
“三阿姨！”领路的人为“本家”介绍：“王老爷，胡老爷，都是贵客，

Take special care of them.” She answered with repeated assent.
格外招呼！”三阿姨喏喏连声，

Her manner showed not merely compliance but a measure of fear.
神色间不仅驯顺，而且带着些畏惮的意味。

After the guide had left, she began the usual sequence of polite questions.
等领路的人告辞而去，三阿姨才向王有龄和胡雪岩寒暄，一句接一句，照例有个“客套”。

By the end of this conventional exchange, she had established her guests' identities—or rather, the false identities they supplied: Mr Wang and Mr Hu were country gentlemen from Hangzhou.
这个套子讲完，便了解了来客的身分。当然，她知道的是他们的假身分，王老爷和胡老爷都是杭州来的乡绅。

Fruit was set out and tea served.
摆上果盘献过茶，

Then Third Aunt called inside, “Young lady, come and meet Mr Wang and Mr Hu!”
三阿姨向里喊道，“大阿囡，来见见王老爷跟胡老爷！”


The lined gauze curtain, blue-green as lake water, lifted, and a beauty appeared.
湖色夹纱门帘一掀，闪出来一个而入。

Wang's eyes immediately brightened.
王有龄一见，双眼便是一亮，

He removed his dark spectacles and studied the young woman as she approached with the grace of a willow in the breeze.
随手把墨晶眼镜取了下来，盯着风摆柳似地走过来的阿囡，仔细打量，

Her lined silk jacket was the pale blue of a sky cleared by rain.
她穿一件雨过天青的绸夹袄，

Though its high, ingot-shaped collar rose stiffly, the waist was fitted closely enough to reveal her slender figure.
虽然也是高高耸起的元宝领，腰身却做得极紧，把袅娜身段都显了出来，

Instead of a skirt, she wore dark lined trousers edged with broad, coloured lace imported from the West.
下面没有穿裙，是一条玄色夹裤，镶着西洋来的极宽的彩色花边。

She wore little powder or rouge, but her hair was dressed to a glossy black sheen.
脸上薄施脂粉，头却梳得又黑又亮，

A gold ear-pick ornament set with jade adorned her coiffure; she wore no other jewellery.
髻上插一支翠镶金挖耳，此外别无首饰，

In such a household, this counted as exceptionally simple dress.
在这样的人家，这就算是极素净的打扮了。

As she came nearer, Wang could see her elongated oval face, poised between the shapes conventionally compared to an egg and a melon seed.
走近了越发看得清楚，是一张介乎“鹅蛋”与“瓜子”之间的长隆脸，

Her eyes were particularly beautiful, changing from dark to bright as she glanced about, like lustrous satin from the West.
生得极好的一双眼睛，就如西洋来的闪光缎一般，顾盼之间，一黑一亮，

Long lashes lent those glances a startling charm.
配上那副长长的睫毛，别有一种惊心动魄的媚态，

She was in the full bloom of young womanhood, like an autumn moon nearing fullness or spring flowers at their height, and seemed an opportunity not to be missed.
而且正当花信年华，就如秋月将满，春花方盛，令人一见便觉不可错过。

Smiling, she greeted the guests with easy assurance as Third Aunt directed, then said, “Please come and sit in my room, gentlemen.”
她一面含着笑，一面照着阿姨的指点，大大方方地招呼了贵客。然后说道：“两位老爷，请到房间里坐吧！”


Within, they found a different scene again.
到了里面，又别有一番风光，

Nothing suggested a house of courtesans.
看不出是风尘人家，

却象知书识字的大家小姐的闺房。

Besides the rosewood furniture, there was a bookcase.
红木的家具以外，还有一架书，

墙上挂着字画，有戴熙的山水和邓石如的隶书，都是近时的名家。

多宝架上陈设着许多小摆饰，

一具形制极其新奇的铜香炉正烧着香。青烟袅袅，似兰似麝，触鼻心荡。

王有龄真想连她的手指一起咬住，但到底不曾，

读过书会落到这种地方来？”

说着，略带凄楚地笑了。

Wang did not recognise the practised manner of the women in these private establishments.
王有龄却不知道是那些“住家”的“小姐”的做作，

顿时起了红粉飘零的怜惜，

握着她的手，仿佛有无穷感慨不知从何说起似地。

胡雪岩看看已经入港了，便站起身来喊道：

胡雪岩一意想躲开，好让他们温存，所以站起来就走，

听这一说，胡雪岩便站住了脚，

要走也还早。”

好亲热！”

胡雪岩打趣她说：

在这里‘借干铺’！”

畹香一面说，一面眼瞟着王有龄，却又立即把视线闪开。

那送秋波的韵味，在王有龄还是初次领略，

真有飘飘欲仙之感，

“今宵不可无酒！”

他用征询的眼光看着胡雪岩，意思问他这里可有“吃花酒”的规矩。

胡雪岩还不曾开口，畹香急忙答道：“已经在预备。

要不要先用些点心？”

说着，不等答话，便掀帘出门，大概是到厨房催问去了。

““ ‘要走也还早’。

不就是表示你可以不走吗？”

想一想果然！

王有龄倒有些踌躇了。

“我看这样，

还是我早些走。”胡雪岩为他策划，

回头我就对他们就，你的亲戚留你住下，要明天才回去。”

王有龄大为高兴，连连点头：

我是有个表兄在上海，姓梁。”

话刚说完，三阿姨已经带着“大小姐”端了托盘进来，

一面铺设席面，一面问贵客喝什么酒？又谦虚家厨简陋，没有好吃的东西款客，

Her hospitality was smoothly managed from every angle.
应酬得八面玲珑。

四样极精致的冷荤碟子搬上桌，酒也烫了来了，

却少了一个是主要的人，

胡雪岩便问：“畹香呢？”

“来了！”外面答应着，随即看见畹香提着一小锅红枣百合莲子汤进门，

说是好亲手煮的。

也不知是真是假，反正吃在王有龄嘴里，特别香甜。

吃罢点心再喝酒。

畹香不断替他们斟酒布菜，

不然就是侧过身子去，伸手让王有龄握着，静静地听胡雪岩说话。

He felt there was really no reason to remain.
看这样子，他觉得实在不必再坐下去，

找个适当的时机，说是还要回三多堂，又约定明天上午亲自来接王有龄，然后就走了。

一走出门，心念一动，

胡老爷一个人？”

今天大概不回来了。”

胡雪岩踏上船头，这样回答，又说：

我身子不爽，还是回来早早睡觉。”

我来碗粥，弄点情淡小菜来。”

船家答应着，回到后梢。

胡雪岩一个人走入舱中，

只见自己铺上，枕套被单都已换过，地板桌椅，擦得纤尘不染，

等坐定了，隐隐觉得香气袭人，

四下一看，在枕头旁边发现一串珠兰，

拿起来仔细玩赏，

穿珠兰的细铜丝上似有油渍，

细想一想明白了，必是阿珠头的桂花油。

阿珠头上戴的花，怎么会在自己枕头旁边发现？

An intriguing puzzle.
这是个很有趣的谜？

胡雪岩先不答，

一天都是倦得要命。”
