但他也是极坚忍的性格，

Neither Hu nor Wang ever told others the story of their remarkable connection.
胡雪岩与王有龄的一番遇台，当事人都从不跟别人谈，

Zhang, however, knew half or more of it and embellished it freely in conversation.
但张胖子了解十之五、六，闲谈之中，加油加酱地渲染着，

Everyone in the trade therefore knew Hu as an unfathomable man of consequence.
所以同行都知道胡雪岩是个神秘莫测的“大好佬”，

Liu thought, “He must have a reason for bringing me here.
刘庆生心里在想：“找我来，必有所为，

I mean to see what he has to say.”
倒偏要看看你说些什么？”

That decision enabled him to endure.
就由于这一转念，他能够忍耐了。

Hu was testing precisely that patience.
胡雪岩就是要考验他的耐性。

After an hour of empty talk, Liu showed no irritation.
空话说了一个钟头，刘庆生毫无愠色，

Satisfied, Hu considered the first test—and in truth the hardest—passed.
认为满意，第一关，实在也是最难的一关，算是过去了。

Only then did he turn to banking.
这才谈到刘庆生的本行。

An expert himself, he disguised his examination as casual conversation and set difficult questions.
胡雪岩是此中好手，借闲谈作考问，出的题目都很难。

Liu answered to the best of his knowledge, mostly correctly.
刘庆生照实回答，大都不错，

The second test was passed as well.
第二关又算过去了。


“Brother Qingsheng, I've been away from banking for some time.
“庆生兄，”他又问，“钱庄这一行，我离开得久了，

不晓得现在城里的同业，一共有多少家？”

“ ‘大同行，八家，’

小同行，就多了，一共有三十三家。”

“噢！哪三十三家？”

这下才显出刘庆生的本事，

从上城数到下城，以兑换银子、铜钱为主的三十三家“小同行”的牌号，

一口气报了出来，一个不缺。

这份记性，连胡雪岩都自叹不如。

到此地步，他差不多已决定要用此人了，但是还不肯明说出来，

“是的。”刘庆生说，

“伢儿都有两个了。”

家累也够重了！”

你说说看！”

刘庆生疑惑自己听错了，

这一次听清楚了，却又有些不大相信，

细看胡雪岩的脸色，不象是在开玩笑，才知道自己的运气来了。

倘或有这样的好机会，同事听了也高兴的。”

你先关了去。”

第二桩？”

这又是考一考他的文墨。

刘庆生倒也应付裕如，把条子写好，

胡雪岩看过不错，便画了花押，连同那二百两现银，一起让刘庆生带了回去。

刘庆生是就在这一夕谈中，完全为胡雪岩降服了。

附带有个条件，要在“钱庄”附近，替他租一所小小的住屋，

刘庆生的打算是要把家眷接了来，住得离钱庄近了，随时可以到店里去照应。

好得手里有二百两银子在，

刘庆生办了四样很精致的水礼。 登门拜访。

他完全弄错了！

但这番好意，反使得刘庆生难以启齿，

孙先生，我要走了。”

CHAPTER SIX｜第六章


The person he consulted was none other than Wang.
他请教的不是别人，是王有龄。

“This is my first attempt at naming a business,” Wang laughed.
“题招牌我还是破题儿第一遭。”王有龄笑道，

“I don't even know how to begin.
“还不知怎么题法，

What are the requirements?”
有些什么讲究？”

“First, it must sound impressive and be easy to say.
“第一要响亮，容易上口，

Second, the characters must be distinctive, so nobody confuses it with another firm.
第二字眼要与众不同，省得跟别家搅不清楚。

Naturally, it must suit a bank and be auspicious.”
至于要跟钱庄有关，要吉利，那当然用不着说了。

“Very well.
““好，

Let me think.”
我来想想看。”

He was rather at a loss.
他实在有些茫然，

Taking a book at random, he intended to select a few characters, write them down, and then try different combinations.
随便抽了本书，想先选几个字写下来，然后再来截搭选配。

The volume he pulled from the shelf was the Chronicles of Huayang.
书架上抽出来的那本书是《华阳国志》，

He opened it and read a few lines.
随手一翻，看了几行，

By a fortunate coincidence, two characters lay ready to hand.
巧极了，现成有两个字。

“What about these?”
“这两个字怎么样？”

He wrote out a passage: “The age is peaceful, the way well governed; the people and their possessions flourish in abundance and well-being.”
王有龄提笔写了《华阳国志》上的两句话：“世平道治，民物阜康。”

在“阜康”上面打了两个圈。

“Fukang, Fukang!” Hu repeated the name twice, then answered gladly, “Excellent!
“阜康，阜康！”胡雪岩念了两遍，欣然答道，“好极！

既阜且康，

That's the one.”
就是它。”

“Xueyan, I have news.
“雪岩，我有个消息告诉你，

我要补实缺了。”

“喔！

Which department or county?”
哪个州县？”

“现在还不晓得。

抚院的刘二来通知我，黄抚台约我今天晚上见面，

照我想，也该补我的缺了。”

就这时只见窗外人影闪过，脚步极其匆遽，

门帘掀处，伸进一张笑脸来，

真正大喜！”

这一说，连不十分熟悉官场情形的胡雪岩都觉得诧异，

候补州县，“本班”的实缺不曾当过一天，忽然一跃而被委署知府，

Surely that was extraordinary.
这不是太离谱了吗？

王有龄自然更难置信，

明天就‘挂牌’。”

王有龄沉吟了一会，总觉得事有蹊跷，

便央求吴委员再去打听究竟，一面又叫高升到刘二那里去问一问，或者倒有确实消息。

消息来得太突兀，却也太令人动心，

王有龄患得患失之心大起，在海运局签押房，坐立不宁，

王有龄大为欣慰。

这句话胡雪岩答应不下，

雪公，倒是有件事，不可不防！

What happens to your assignment here?”
这里的差使怎么样？”

“Here” meant the Sea Transport Bureau.
“这里”自是指海运局，

The question reminded Wang of all that handing over its executive directorship would involve: the deficit must be made good and every affair under his management explained.
一句话提醒了王有龄，“坐办”的差使要交卸了，亏空要弥补，经手的公事要交代清楚。

后任有后任的办法，

If the bureau's funds ceased to be deposited with Xinhe and the relationship ended, their guarantee for the Songjiang association's loan could create serious trouble.
倘或海运局的公款不再存信和，关系一断，替松江漕帮借款担保这一层，就会有很大的麻烦，

真个不可不防。

“Yes!”
“是啊！”

Wang drew a breath.
王有龄吸着气说，

“A great deal depends on that.
“这方面关系甚重，

We must act early.
得要早早想办法，

就怕他说，人在湖州，省城的公事鞭长莫及，那就煞费周章了。”

不能留下一个累来害你和张胖子、尤老五！”

经此一番交谈，王有龄彻底了解了自己的最后立场，心倒反而定了来了。

两个人接着便根据不同的情况，商量在见黄宗汉时，如何措同。

这样谈了有半个时辰，高升首先回来复命，

可见得吴委员的消息，不是无因而至。

事到如今，再无可疑。

海运局上上下下，也都得到了消息，约齐了来向坐办贺喜，

Wang thought this far too ostentatious and firmly refused.
这大招摇了！王有龄一定不肯，

托吴委员向大家道谢疏通，千万不可有此举动。

扰攘半日，莫衷一是，

“We must find a way to collect this year's full revenue.

你看，还有一道上谕。”

王有龄起身从黄宗汉手中上谕来看，

只见洋洋千言，尽是有关筹饷和劝谕捐输的指示，

朕思王公大臣，俸人素优，即暂停给发，事尚可行，

其文职四品以下，武职三品以下各员，仍着户部将本看春季暂停俸银，照数补行给领。

并着发内库帑银五十万两，交部库收存，以备支放俸饷要需。”

王公大臣的俸银，岂肯长此停发？

当然要严催各省解款。

王有龄心有警惕，今年的州县官，对于征粮一事，要看得比什么都重。

时逢二百年来未有之变局，朝廷一再申谕，但求实效，不借破格用人。

所以保你老兄署湖州府，我想不至于被驳。”

王有龄是早就预备好了的，

你要把全副本事拿出来。”

只要于公事有益，无不可通融。”

这次‘民折官办’一案，其中委曲，无不在大人洞鉴之中。

如今首尾未了倘或后任不明究竟，遇事挑剔，且不说赔累的话，只往来申复解释，就极费功夫。

这后顾之忧，我斗胆要请大人作主。”

这一个便也猜他的心思，

只因为自己不明其中的奥妙，说了句等他“随时交下来”，

为什么呢？

是要把人心稳住，

所以只要这样一说，人心定了，就不会有风言风语，是是非非。

雪公，你看可是？”

刘庆生的身价已非昔比了，

问知情形，也觉得事不可解，不过他信心未失，

There was no good news, but no bad news either.
认为虽无好信息，但也没有坏消息，

There was no need for alarm.
不必着急。


“Even so, Liu should have told me something.”
“就算如此，刘二也该先来告诉我一声。”

“He doesn't know why you're waiting.
“这是刘二不知道你的用意，

If he understood your anxiety, he'd certainly have come.”
倘或他知道你这么着急，当然会先来说一声。”

Hu thought a moment.
胡雪岩想了一下说，

“Go home first, and send Gao to invite him over.
“雪公，你不妨先回府。一面止高升把刘二请了来问一问看，

We can ask how the governor responded.”
看黄抚台是怎么个表示？”

“That makes sense.”
“这话有理。就这么办！”

Gao too was gone a long time without word.
高升这一去，又好半天没有信息。

Wang and Hu drank together at home while they waited.
王有龄在家跟胡雪岩两个人对饮坐等，

Not until the clock struck nine did Gao appear with a lantern, lighting Liu's way inside.
直等到钟打九下，才看见高升打着一盏灯笼把刘二照了进来。

Now that the man had arrived, Wang became composed and first asked whether he had eaten.
人已到了，王有龄便从容了，先问刘二吃过饭没有？

Liu had eaten long before.
刘二说是早已吃过，接着便说，

“When Second Master Gao came, I was still reporting upstairs.
“高二爷来的那一刻，我正在上头回公事，

There were many instructions, which delayed me.
交代的事很多，所以耽误了。

The governor read your letter early, but only now gave me a message.”
你老这封信，抚台早就看过，直到此刻才有话。”

“Oh?”
“噢！”

Liu's unhurried manner made Wang impatient, though he would not show it.
王有龄见他慢条斯理地，十分着急，但急也只能急在心里，表面上一点不肯摆出来。

“His Excellency says: after His Honour Wang has received the seal at Huzhou and put things in order, he is to return promptly to the provincial capital.
“ 上头交代：请王大老爷到湖州接了印，一等有了头绪，赶快回省。

The business here is important too.”
这里的公事也很要紧！”

“Here” naturally meant the Sea Transport Bureau.
“这里”当然是指海运局。

Wang was overwhelmed with joy.
王有龄喜心翻倒，

He and Hu exchanged a smile that needed no words.
与胡雪岩相视而笑，尽在不言。


Only then did Liu understand.
这下刘二才恍然大悟，

Wang's retention of the bureau had not been certain until this moment. He regretted his ignorance.
心里懊悔，原来他海运局的差使，直到此刻，才算定局。

Had he known, this news could have been made a valuable commodity, with a more elaborate account of his own services.
早知如此，这个消息真是奇货可居，应当另有一番丑表功的说法。

But it was not too late.
不过此刻也还不晚。

He immediately bent his knees in salute.
于是他立即蹲下身子来请了个安：

“Congratulations, Your Honour!
“恭喜王大老爷！

Knowing how anxiously you awaited news, I stayed beside our master without daring to move.
我晓得你老急着等信息，伺候在我们大人身边，一步不敢离开，

At last I obtained the good word.”
到底把好消息等到了。

“I am most grateful.”
““承请之至。”

Wang understood and sent him away with another envelope containing ten taels.
王有龄懂他的意思，封了十两银子一个赏封，把刘二打发了走。


“At last you've got what you wished, and everyone can be satisfied.”
“总算如愿以偿，各方面都可以交代了。”

Hu joked, “Your Honour Wang, I have an assignment to request.
胡雪岩开玩笑他说，“王大老爷！我要讨桩差使，

Let me hire the boat for your journey to take office.”
到湖州上任的船，由我替你去雇。”

Naturally, this meant giving A'zhu's family the business.
这自然是要照顾阿珠家的生意，

Wang laughed too.
王有龄使也笑道：

“Any other assignment is yours.
“别的差使，无有不可，

Only that one is out of the question.”
就是这桩不行。”

Their laughter drew Mrs Wang out to inquire.
两人哈哈大笑，把王太太惊动了，亲自出来探问，

That was her excuse; she really wanted to hear the news and share the joy of her husband's rising fortune.
这是一个因头，其实她是要来听听消息，分享这一份她丈夫大交官运的喜悦，

They had become intimate family friends, so she no longer avoided Hu.
好在彼此已成通家至好，她也不避胡雪岩，

Sitting with them, she thanked him repeatedly, then asked, “Young Master Hu, why don't you purchase an official title?”
坐在一起，向他谢了又谢，然后问道：“胡少爷，你怎么不捐个官？”

“Exactly!”
“对了！”

Wang seized on it.
王有龄立即接口，

“This is important.
“这实在是件要紧大事。

A qualification would make your work much easier.
雪岩，你有个功名在身上，办事要方便得多。

At the bureau, for instance, if you held a department or county magistrate's qualification, I could recommend you as a commissioner to oversee everything for me.
譬如说海动局，你如果也是个州县州子，我就可以保你当委员，替我主持一切。

Wouldn't that simplify matters?”
事情不就好办了吗？”

“True.
“话是不错。

But my first concern is getting Fukang established.”
不过老实说，我现在顶要紧的一件事，是先要把阜康办了起来。”

Hu glanced at Mrs Wang.
说着，向王太太看了一眼。

Understanding that some things could not be said before her, Wang found an excuse to send her away.
王有龄会意，有些话他当着王太太不肯说，便托故把他妻子调了开去。

“Fukang must open soon,” Hu continued.
“阜康要早早开张。

“We need those tens of thousands from the treasury as capital.
藩台衙门那几万银子，得要快领下来做本钱。

Press them again tomorrow.
雪公，你明天再去催一催，

I've already found someone to work on the matter below.”
我这里已经托了人了。”

“That can be done.
“这好办。”王有龄说，

My mind is in such confusion that I don't know what to do first.”
“我现在心里乱得很，不知道该先办何事，后办何事？”

“I don't fully understand official practice.
“官场的规矩我不十分在行。

Let's discuss it patiently.
大家慢慢商量，

We have the whole night to put things in order.”
尽这一夜工夫，理出个头绪来。

They talked through the night, writing down each task and its priority.
一宵细谈，该办的事，孰先孰后，一条一条都写了下来。

Hu busied himself preparing Fukang.
胡雪岩是忙着去筹备阜康，

Wang's first major duty was to find private secretaries.
王有龄的第一件大事，是要去物色幕友。


Private secretaries came in many varieties.
幕友的名堂甚多，

Besides the legal and revenue advisers, there were accountants handling receipts and payments, correspondence secretaries, tutors for the official's children, examination assistants who read papers, collection specialists, and others.
刑、钱两席以外，还有管出纳的“帐房”、写信的“书启”，以及为子弟授书的“教读”、帮忙考试的“阅卷”、征收地了的“征比”等等。

The legal and revenue posts were naturally the most important.
当然最重要的还是“刑名”和“钱谷”。

Secretary Yu at the judicial commissioner's yamen had long promised to find suitable men, so Wang made a special call.
臬司衙门的俞师爷，是早就答应过王有龄，为他好好物色的，所以第二夭他专诚去拜访俞师爷。

His purpose needed no explanation.
来意不道自明，

Yu had already chosen his own pupil for the legal post.
“刑名”一席，俞师爷已经替王有龄准备好了，就是他的学生。

This pupil, Qin Shoumen, was in fact nearly Yu's age and no novice.
俞师爷的这个学生，名叫秦寿门，名为学生，其实年龄与俞师爷相差无几，当然也不是初出茅庐。

The profession was sometimes dismissed as a last resort for men who failed in their studies, but a secretary's life could be that of “an immortal, a tiger, or a dog.”
大致走上幕宾这条路子，虽说“读书不成，去而学幕”，好象是末路，但却是“神仙、老虎、狗”的生涯。

Celebrated secretaries enjoyed great prestige.
名幕的声光，十分煊赫，

They needed not only command of statutes and precedents and a fluent pen, but sound professional lineage, broad knowledge, and experience.
此辈不但律例烂熟，文笔畅达，而尤贵乎师承有自，见多识广，

Their training was therefore crucial.
所以学幕的过程，十分重要。

Qin had followed Yu for years, beginning at county and department level, progressing through prefectural and circuit offices, and finally reaching the provincial judicial commission.
秦寿门跟随俞师爷多年，由州县开始，历经府、道，一直学到臬司衙门，

He understood the entire local judicial process and the powers and characteristics of every level.
了解地方上整套司法的程序，以及每一级的职权范围和特性，

This comprehensive experience made him superior to men trained only in a county office or only at the provincial commission.
是谓“能得其全”，比那仅仅于州县，或是臬司衙门的，自然高明得多。

He had begun independent practice ten years earlier and had never lacked employment.
他在十年前就已出道，馆地从来没有间断过，

Two years before, both parents died.
前年因为父母双亡，

He returned to Shaoxing for their funerals, then fell ill himself.
回到原籍绍兴奔丧，接着又生了一场病，

Recently recovered, he had come to his teacher for assistance.
最近身体复元来投靠老师，

Yu could now recommend him to Wang.
俞师爷正好把他荐给王有龄。

They met and conversed agreeably.
当时请了来彼此见面，一谈之下，相当投机，

Wang reflected that, besides ability, secretaries needed connections and channels of communication; otherwise even great talent achieved little for the effort.
王有龄心想，幕友除了自己来得以外，还要讲关系、通声气，否则本事虽大，事倍功半，

Since Yu had introduced Qin, he would naturally support cases submitted from the county to the province.
现在是俞师爷介绍的人，将来不管什么案子，由县里申详到省，俞师爷当然要尽力维持，

One salary would effectively secure two advisers.
这就等于出一份“修金”，聘了两位幕友，

An excellent bargain.
岂不划算？


They immediately agreed upon the engagement, to mutual satisfaction.
于是即时下了口头聘约，彼此都很满意。

Wang used the same method for the revenue post, asking the most celebrated Secretary Wang in the treasury to recommend someone.
王有龄对于另一位钱谷师爷，也是如法炮制，请藩署最出名的王师爷介绍，

He proposed a fellow pupil, Yang Yongzhi, stating plainly that the man was diligent and honest rather than exceptionally able.
他介绍的是他的一个名叫杨用之的师兄弟，言明在先，人是勤恳老实，本事并不怎么样了不起。

That suited Wang, who chiefly wanted the connection with Secretary Wang.
好在王有龄所重视的是借此拉上王师爷的关系，

He himself knew much of revenue administration, so a less capable adviser would not matter.
钱谷一道，他自己也懂得很多，幕友弱一些也不要紧。

Back at the bureau, he personally prepared the letters of engagement on large red cards.
回到海运局，王有龄亲自动笔准备聘书，用大红全帖，

The front bore the words “Letter of Engagement.”
面写“关书”二字，

Inside Qin's, he wrote: “I respectfully engage Master Qin Shoumen to manage legal affairs during my tenure as acting magistrate of Wucheng County and acting prefect of Huzhou, at a monthly remuneration of seventy taels of standard silver, commencing upon arrival.
里面写的是：“敦聘寿门秦老夫子，在署理乌程县知县兼署湖州府知府任内，办理刑名事件，月奉修金纹银七十两，到馆起修。

A further ceremonial gift of eight taels will be offered at each of the three major festivals.
三节另奉贽敬纹银八两。

This engagement is hereby confirmed.”
谨订。”

He signed himself humbly as Wang Youling, bowing his head.
下面署款“教弟王有龄顿首拜。”

Neither official nor private seal was used.
不用官印、也不用私章，

The card went into a red envelope labelled “For Master Qin's keeping.”
封入红封套内，加个签条，写的是“秦老夫子惠存”。

Yang's letter followed the same form, but offered fifty taels a month and expressly excluded additional festival gifts, since a revenue secretary received other benefits after each collection of land and grain taxes.
杨用之的那份关书，款式也是一样，不过修金每月只有五十两，并且写明“不另致送节敬”，这是因为钱谷师爷，在每地丁钱粮征收完毕，另有好处的缘故。


After sending the letters, Wang issued dinner invitations.
等把关书送了去，王有龄随即又下帖子请客。

Though they held no official rank, private secretaries enjoyed standing equal to that of their employer.
幕友虽无官职，但地位与他的“东翁”相同，

The legal and revenue advisers in particular had a prescribed form of address: since a local magistrate was called “His Honour,” they were accorded the corresponding honour as secretarial masters.
尤其是刑钱两席，有一定的称呼，州县称“大老爷”，所以秦寿门和杨用之，都该称为“师大老爷”。

They were invited separately.
两位“师大老爷”是分开来请的，

Secretaries insisted upon ceremony, maintaining a domain of their own within the yamen.
因为幕友最讲究札数，他们在衙里自成夭地，

An official seeking advice went to them.
长官有事，要移樽就教。

On the first and fifteenth of each month he dressed formally to pay his respects, much as at an official audience.
初一、十五就象衙参那样，要恭具衣冠去拜访问好。

Special banquets were offered on festivals.
岁时佳节，特为设宴奉请，

At ordinary dinners a secretary must occupy the seat of honour or not be invited at all.
平时请客一定要请幕友坐首座，否则就不必奉邀。

Although the two had not yet joined him, Wang must already follow the rules.
现在虽还未到馆，已要按规矩办事，

To avoid deciding which should sit first and which second, he entertained them separately, giving each the first seat.
怕秦、杨二人，哪个坐首座，哪个坐次席，难于安排，所以索性分开来请，两个都是首座。

Hu, Zhou, and Wu would accompany him.
陪客自然是胡雪岩和周、吴两委员。

Qin was invited first, but declined by letter because he observed a strict vegetarian diet and did not wish to cause trouble.
第一天请的是刑名师爷秦寿门，帖子发了出去，这位贵宾专函辞射，理由是他吃长素，不便叨拢。

This was easily remedied.
这也好办，

The vegetarian food of Hangzhou's four great monasteries was exquisite.
杭州四大丛林的素斋，无不精致万分，

At Jingci Monastery beneath Leifeng Pagoda, the abbot Xinwu was Wang's fellow townsman and an old acquaintance.
雷峰塔下的净慈寺，方丈心悟是王有龄的同乡，素有往还，更加方便，

Wang sent a new invitation promising a carefully prepared vegetarian meal, which Qin gladly accepted.
于是另外备了个“洁治素斋候光”的请柬送出去。秦寿门复信，欣然应诺。

On the appointed day, their chairs left through Qingbo Gate.
到了那天轿子出清彼门，

They boarded a boat at “Listening to Orioles among the Willows,” toured West Lake, and then ate.
中“柳浪闻莺”下船，先逛西湖，后吃素斋。

Abbot Xinwu joined them as half host, half guest.
净慈的方丈心悟以半主半客的身分作陪，

Asked why he had become a lifelong vegetarian, Qin answered frankly.
席间问起秦寿门吃长素的原因，他回答得很坦率。


“With the abbot present, I dare not speak falsely.
“ 有老和尚在，不敢打诳语，

I am repenting past wrongdoing.
我是忏悔宿业。”寿门说，

A few years ago, while employed at the Shuntian prefectural yamen, I mistakenly trusted someone's account and allowed a guilty man to escape his proper punishment.
“前两年我在顺天府衙门‘作客，办一件案子，误信人言，以致’失出‘，

Although I bore no formal responsibility, my conscience remained troubled.
虽无责任，此心耿耿不安，

Soon afterwards both my parents died.
不久，先父先母，双刃弃世，

I resigned, returned home, and arranged their funerals, then fell dangerously ill myself.
我辞馆回乡，料理完了丧事，自己又是一场大病，九死一生。

During the illness I repented and vowed that, if I survived, I would henceforth abstain from meat and recite Buddhist prayers.
病中忏悔，倘能不死，从此长焉念佛，

The bodhisattva evidently took pity on my sincerity.
一点诚心，固然蒙菩萨鉴怜，

I improved day by day.
一天好一天，

Now I am fulfilling that vow.”
如今是我还愿的时候。”

“Sincerity brings a response,” Xinwu said, nodding repeatedly.
“诚则灵！”心悟不断点头，

“Plant melons and you reap melons; plant beans and you reap beans.
“种爪得瓜，种豆得豆，

Cause and consequence cannot be disregarded.”
因果不可不信。”

“I intended to lay down my pen altogether, but my family obligations are heavy, and I have had to return to the profession.
“我本想从此封笔，无奈家累甚重，不得不重作冯妇。

It is easy to do wrong in public office.
公门之中，容易作孽，

I have nothing with which to repay my employer's kindness except to cultivate some merit on his behalf.”
多蒙东翁台爱，我别无所报，为东翁种些福田。”

“Indeed,” Wang answered earnestly.
“是，是！”王有龄很诚恳地答道，

“That is exactly what I hope for.”
“我所望于老夫子的，也就是如此。”

“One can also cultivate virtue in public service,” Hu reassured him.
“公门之中也好修行。”胡雪岩安慰他说，

“You must have done much good without realising it.”
“秦老夫子无心中积的德，一定不少。”

“Naturally, there has been some.
“这自然也有。

Our professional rule, passed from master to pupil for years, is ‘Save the living, not the dead,’ in accordance with Heaven's love of life.
我们这一行，多少年来师弟相传的心法：”救生不救死‘。就是体上天好生之德。

Though, frankly, there are rewards in that too.”
然而说句老实话，也是‘乐’在其中。

The words were discreet, but everyone understood.
“这名话很含蓄，但在座的人无不明白，

Saving the living brought monetary gifts.
救了‘生’才有红色收入，

If one merely sought justice for the dead, who but the bereaved would show gratitude?
一味替死者伸冤，除了苦主，谁来见情？

“Still, our profession does more good than harm.
“话又说回来。干我们这一行，到底积德的多，造孽的少，

It differs from prison officials and jailers, for whom wrongdoing is easy and merit difficult.”
不比刑官狱吏，造孽容易积德难。”


“Why is that?” Hu asked with interest.
“这又是为什么呢？”胡雪岩很感兴味地问。

“Simply because we can ultimately decide for ourselves.
“ 此无他，到底自己可以作主？

An employer like Mr Xuexuan would naturally forbid wrongdoing.
譬如象雪公这样的东家，自然不许我们造孽，

Even under the wrong man, if we hold firm, he cannot force us against our principles.
即使所遇非人，我们只要自己把握得定，东家也不能强人所难。

Prison is different.
狱里就不同了，

There truly is no daylight there.”
真正是晴无天日！”

“How so?”
“怎么呢？”

“In a word, nothing happens without money.
“一句话，非钱不行，

Without it, the place is worse than a pigsty.
没有钱，那地方比猪圈都不如，

With it, one lives as comfortably as at home.
有钱的，跟自己家里一样，

Food and lodging are excellent, and even wives or concubines can come in to spend the night.”
不但起居饮食舒服，甚至妻妾要以进去伴宿。”

“I've heard that too,” Wang said.
“我也听说过。”王有龄问道，

“Does it really happen?”
“真有这样的事？”

“Certainly.
“当然有！

Let me tell you a story to accompany your wine.
我说个故事为诸公下酒，

It happened here in Zhejiang, during the Daoguang reign.”
就出在我们浙江，那是道光年间的事……”


A young man from a rich family had committed a serious homicide.
据说，道光年培有个富家子弟，犯了命案，情节甚重。

County, prefectural, circuit, and provincial authorities all upheld immediate execution by beheading.
由县、府、道，一直到省里，都维持“斩立决”的罪名，

Only the Board of Punishments' authorisation remained before the sentence could be carried out.
只待刑部公文下来，便要处决。

He was the family's sole male heir for three generations.
这个富家子弟是三世单传，

They spent money on every possible approach in the hope of saving him.
所以他家上下打点，只想救出一条命来。

But the facts were clear and the officials honest.
无奈情真罪实，遇着的又都是清官，

Their considerable expenditure benefited only the intermediaries.
以致钱虽花得不少，毫无作用，只都便宜了中间经手的人。

His father could not bear to see the line end and his enormous fortune eventually divided among distant clansmen beyond the prescribed degrees of mourning.
那富家翁眼睁睁看着要绝后，百万家财，身后将为五服以外的族人所瓜分，无论如何于心不甘。

On someone's advice, he took a substantial gift to a legal secretary renowned for ingenious schemes, nicknamed “the Man Even Ghosts Fear.”
于是经人指点，备了一份重礼去请教一个以善于出奇计，外号“鬼见愁”的刑名师爷，

Unable to save his son, he asked for the next best thing: could the prisoner leave a child, even a girl?
不得已而求于次，只想他的在狱中的儿子，能够留下一点骨血，哪怕是个女孩子也好，问那刑名师爷，可有办法？

There was a method, though naturally nobody could guarantee a son.
办法是有，但不能包养儿子，因为这是任何人所无能为力的。但就照“鬼见愁”的办法，已能令人满意。

The secretary promised three more months of life.
他答应可以让那富家子，多活三个月，

During that time, several healthy women considered likely to bear sons would be paid generously to visit the prisoner.
在这三个月中，以重金觅得数名且男的健妇，送到狱中为富家子荐寝。

The jailers had already been bribed, so access was unrestricted.
当然，狱中是早已打点好的出入无阻，

Each dawn someone would meet the women at the back gate and take them to the wealthy household, where they were maintained.
每天黎明有人在监狱后门迎接，接着健妇送到家供养。

It was agreed beforehand that they would stay several months.
事先已讲明白，要在他家住几个月，

Those who did not conceive would receive money and leave; those who did would remain until the birth, with further arrangements made afterwards.
若无喜信，送一笔钱放回，有了喜信就一直住下去，直到分娩为止，那时或去或留，另有协议。


Yet after only a dozen days, the ministry's reply arrived in a cord-fastened sealed dispatch.
这样过了十几天，刑部的复文到了，是“钉封文书”，

One glance showed that it authorised immediate execution.
一望便知是核准了“斩立决”。

“Wait!” Hu interrupted.
“慢来，慢来！”胡雪岩打断秦寿门的话问道：

“Didn't you say he had three months?
“不是说可以活三个月？

It hasn't even been one.”
何以前后一个月不到？

“Be patient.”
““少安毋躁，”

Qin smiled.
秦寿门笑道，

“There is naturally another explanation.
“当然另有道理，

Otherwise, why would even ghosts fear the man?” He continued the story.
不然何以鬼见了都愁？”他接着又讲……


An immediate-execution order required the execution party to be assembled as soon as the sealed dispatch arrived.
既称“斩立决”，等“钉封文书”一到，就得“出红差”，

The magistrate took his seat, summoned the yamen personnel and executioner, and had the prisoner brought from jail.
知县升堂，传齐三班六房和刽子手，把犯人从监狱里提了出来，

He opened the dispatch in court—and froze.
当堂开拆文书。打开来一看，知县愣住了，

The name on the cover was correct, but everything inside was wrong: the name, the case, the place.
封套上的姓名不错，里面的文书，完全不对，姓名不对，案情不对，地方也不对，

A document meant for Guizhou had reached Zhejiang.
应该发到贵州的，发到浙江来了。

Without proper authorisation, how could he execute the man?
没有核准斩立决的文书，如何可以杀人？

The prisoner returned to jail and the document was sent back.
犯人依旧送回监狱，文书退了回去。

Even a slow journey from Hangzhou to the capital took no more than twenty days, but the ministry had to wait for Guizhou to return the other misdirected document.
杭州到京师，再慢也不过二十天，但是要等贵州把那弄错了的文书送回刑部，

Yunnan and Guizhou seemed half a world away.
“云贵半爿天”，

The round trip would take more than three months.
一来一往就三个月都不止，

The prisoner there benefited too, unexpectedly gaining several months of life.
便宜了贵州的那犯人，平白多活了几个月。

“Naturally, someone at the ministry had arranged it?” Wang asked.
“这不用说，当然是在部里做了手脚？”王有龄问。

“Yes.
“是的。”秦寿门答道，

A secretary at the Board of Punishments was persuaded.
“运动了一个刑部主事。

It counted as negligence, punishable by three months' salary—only a few dozen taels.
这算是疏忽，罚俸三个月，不过几十两银子，

But this effortless act of ‘negligence’ cost a thousand taels to arrange.”
但就这样一举手之劳的‘疏忽’，非一千银子不办。”

“A good deed!” Hu laughed. “To preserve a family line is great hidden merit, and brings a thousand taels besides.
“这是好事！为人延嗣，绝大阴功，还有一千两银子进帐。”胡雪岩笑道：

Why not do it?”
“何乐不为？”


“But what of the damage to the law?” Qin asked.
“其奈坏法何？”秦寿门说，

“If orders for sealing property or confiscating an estate suffered similar complications, who would compensate the treasury?”
“倘或查封、抄家的文书，也是这么横生枝节，国库的损失，谁来认赔？”

“Would that count as negligence too?”
“若有其事，也算疏忽？”

“Such important matters admit no negligence, nor would it occur by accident.
“此是何等大事，不容疏忽也不会疏忽。

Law cannot be separated from human motives.
国法不外乎人情，

When hearing cases and enforcing it, examine those motives and the doubts become apparent.
所以听讼执法，只从人情上去揣摩，疑窦立见。

Suppose a habitually meticulous man suddenly makes a mistake, and the mistake makes an enormous difference.
譬如说某人向来精细，而某事忽然疏忽，此一疏忽又有大出入，

That is suspicious.
其事便可疑了。

Or take a class of cases always decided one way.
又譬如‘例案’，向来如此办理，

Suddenly the responsible official declares that practice unjust, rejects it, or even overturns a final judgement.
而主管其事的忽然说，这么办是冤枉的，驳了下来，甚至已定谳的案子，把它翻案。

If this case was unjust, were the earlier identical cases not unjust too?
试问，这一案冤枉，以前同样的案子就不冤枉？

Why not reverse them?
何以不翻？

Consider that carefully, and the hidden interference becomes obvious.”
只从这上面去细想一想，其中出了什么鬼？不言可知。”

These remarks showed Qin's clear understanding of affairs.
听这番话，足见得秦寿门是个极明白事理的人。

Wang was naturally pleased.
王有龄当然觉得欣慰。


But legal affairs mattered enormously to a magistrate's career.
但刑名一道对县官的前程，关系太大，

They were also the first basis upon which the people judged their parent-official.
老百姓对父母官的信服与否，首先也就是从刑名上看。

With good harvests and a prosperous district, they might tolerate somewhat excessive additions to taxes and miscellaneous levies.
只要年成好，地方富庶，钱粮的浮收及各种摊派，稍微过分些，都还能容忍，

If the rightful party lost a lawsuit and the wrongdoer won, however, even an innocent mistake would provoke deep resentment and accusations of corruption and injustice.
若是审理官司，有理的一方受屈，无理的一方赢了，即或是无心之失，也会招致老百生极大的不满，说起来必是“贪赃枉法”。

Wang therefore valued Qin more highly than Yang.
所以王有龄对秦寿门看得比杨用之重，

He had agreed with Hu beforehand that, since he could not repeatedly question his new adviser himself, Hu should test him through conversation.
事先跟胡雪岩说好了的，自己不便频频质疑，要他借闲谈多发问，借以考一考秦寿门的本事，

He now gave another signal.
此时便又递了个眼色过去。

Hu adopted an expression of partial understanding and asked with curious admiration, “Everyone says a legal master's pen is formidable: one altered character can determine a family's fortune.
于是胡雪岩装得似懂非懂的样子，用好奇而仰慕的语气问道，“都说刑名老夫子一支笔厉害，一个字的出入，就是一家人的祸福，

They also say the finest writing comes from secretaries' offices.
又说‘天下文章在幕府’，

I've asked about it without receiving a clear explanation.
我问过人，也就不出个所以然。

Today you can surely enlighten me.”
今天遇见秦老夫子，一定可以教一教我了！”

This double compliment, to his profession and himself, pleased Qin.
又捧刑名师爷又捧他本人，这顶双料的高帽子，秦寿门戴得很舒服，

Half warmed by wine and enjoying the discussion, he smiled with restrained pride.
致且酒到半酣，谈兴正好，便矜持地笑道：

“‘Read ten thousand volumes but neglect the law—how will you guide your sovereign to the virtue of Yao and Shun?’
“读书万卷不读律，致君尧舜知何术？

The claim about writing refers to its practical use.
‘所谓’天下文章，出于幕府‘，言其实用而已，

As for a single character determining a family's fortune, that is true.
至于一个字的出入，关乎一家人祸福，这话倒也不假。

But manipulating words is our profession's great taboo.
不过，舞文弄墨，我辈大忌。

In short: where no trouble exists, don't create it; where trouble arises, don't fear it.”
总之，无事不可生事，有事不可怕事。”

Everyone nodded.
在座的人连连点头，

Wu, who had some literary education, particularly admired the warning against manipulating words and asked for an explanation.
吴委员肚千里有些墨水，尤其觉得“舞文弄墨，我辈大忌”八个字，近乎见道之言，因而说道。“我也要请教！”

“First, not creating trouble where none exists...” Qin began.
“先说无事不可生事……”


He gave an example.
秦寿门讲了个故事作例证：

A governor disliked his provincial treasurer and wanted him removed.
曾有一省的巡抚与藩司不和，巡抚必欲去之而后快，

Unfortunately, the treasurer was both honest and capable, leaving no fault to seize upon.
苦于那藩司既清廉又能干，找不着他的错处。

At last an opportunity came.
后来找到一个机会，

During a sacrifice at the Confucian temple, the treasurer had a severe cold and coughed continually through the ceremony.
文庙丁祭，那藩司正好重伤风，行札的时候，咳个不停，

The governor discussed this lapse with his secretary.
巡抚抓住他这个错，跟幕友商量，

Obeying his employer's wishes, the secretary used elaborate wording to make a great affair of it, impeaching the treasurer for ceremonial misconduct and disrespect.
那幕友顺从东家的意思，舞文弄墨，大张旗鼓，奏劾那藩司失仪不敬。

The court usually investigated before acting upon an accusation.
凡有弹劾，朝廷通常总要查了再说，

Grave cases brought a special commissioner from the capital by express relay.
情节重大则由京里特派钦差，驰驿查办。

Matters of this kind were often referred to the garrison general or provincial education commissioner.
类此事件，往往交“将军”或者“学政”查报。

That province had no resident garrison general, but every province had an education commissioner.
那一省没有驻防的将军，但学政是每一省都有的，

He too had attended the sacrifice and knew that the treasurer's conduct was involuntary.
这位学政文庙丁祭也在场，知道藩司的失仪，情非得已。

Even if it amounted to a breach of decorum, a reprimand afterwards should have sufficed.
就算真的失仪，至多事后教训一顿，

Why magnify a trifle into a special memorial of impeachment?
又何至于毛举细故，专折参劾？

Resenting this, he wanted not only to help the treasurer but to make the governor suffer.
由于这一份不满的心情，那学政不但要帮藩司的忙，还要给巡抚吃点苦头。

Yet an open criticism might lead the court to suspect partiality, making the wording difficult.
但是他不便公然指摘巡抚，让朝延疑心他有意袒护藩司，所以措词甚难。

Before passing the provincial and metropolitan examinations, the education commissioner had trained in legal work.
这位学政未曾中举成进士以前，原学过刑名，

After much thought, he found inspiration in the governor's claim to have “personally witnessed” the offence.
想了半天，从巡抚原奏的“亲见”二字中，欣然有悟，

His reply said that, although present, he could not verify it: “My place was in the forward rank; propriety forbade looking behind.”
随即提笔复奏，他说他丁祭那天，虽也在场，但无法复查这一案，因为他“位列前班，理无后顾”，不知道藩司失仪了没有？

Those unobtrusive words made the matter plain to the Grand Councillors.
就这轻描淡写八个字，军机大臣一看便知道，是巡抚有意找藩司的麻烦，

The governor too had knelt ahead of the treasurer.
因为行礼时巡抚也是跪在藩司前面，

How could he have seen misconduct behind him?
如何知道后面的藩司失仪？

He must himself have broken decorum by turning round.
照此说来，是巡抚抚失仪往后面看了，才发现藩司失仪。

Both officials were punished.
结果两个人都有处分。

With plaintiff and defendant treated alike, the plaintiff lost face, while the defendant, though punished, felt satisfied.
原被告各打五十板，自然是原告失面子，被告虽受罚，心里是痛快的。


“Truly, there was no trouble until a foolish man made it,” Wu said.
“这真是‘世不本无事，庸人自扰之’。”吴委员说，

“The fault lay in the governor's secretary failing to remonstrate firmly.”
“坏在那巡抚的幕友不能痛切规劝。”

“You've identified the essential point.”
“这话说中的症结所在。”

Qin glanced at Wang.
秦寿门向王有龄看了一眼，

“Once an employer has honoured us with his trust, we must hold to unshakable principles.
“我辈既蒙东家不弃，处事自有必不可摇的宗旨，

Compliance for a moment that leaves trouble for the future harms both him and us.
一时依从，留下后患，自误误人，

It must never happen.
千万不可。

Unfortunately, loyal advice often jars upon the ear, and few employers have no temper.”
只是忠言往往逆耳，难碍有几位东家没有脾气。”

“Rest assured,” Wang promptly declared.
“老大子请放心！”王有龄急忙表明态度，

“Having entrusted the post to you, I shall naturally leave legal affairs to your judgement.”
“我奉托了老替子，将来刑名方面，自然都请老夫子作主。”

“With that assurance, I can act confidently.
“有东翁这句话，我可以放心放手了。

Taking advantage of this hospitality, let me apologise in advance and ask you to forgive any future appearance of overstepping my authority.”
今天我借花献佛，先告个罪，将来要请东翁恕我专擅之罪。”

He raised his cup.
说着他举杯相敬，

Wang gladly accepted the toast.
王有龄欣然接受，

Host and guest were perfectly at ease, and everyone shared their pleasure.
宾主如鱼得水，在座的人亦都觉得很愉快。

After a noisy round of drinking, they returned to the interrupted subject.
轰然祝饮，闹过一阵，重拾中断的话题。


“Now for not fearing trouble when it comes,” Wu said loudly.
“现在要谈有事不可怕事。”吴委员提高了声音说道，

“Please give us an example of that too.”
“索性也请老夫子举例以明之。”

Qin considered briefly. “It means keeping one's composure.
秦寿门略略沉吟了一下说“有事不可怕事者，是要沉得住气，

A steady temper settles the mind; a settled mind allows clear thought.
气稳则心定，心定则神闲，

Then an apparently lost position may yield an inspired move.
死棋肚里才会出仙着。

However detailed the law, ancient or modern, there are always gaps.
大致古今律法，不论如何细密，总有漏洞，

Reasoning is similar.
事理也是一样，

Sometimes an argument is unsound, but familiarity keeps everyone from noticing.
有时道理不通，大家习焉不察，也就过去了，

Something apparently inconceivable may, on examination, prove entirely reasonable and beyond refutation.
而看来不可思议之事，细想一想竟是道理极通，无可驳诘。

With composure, breadth, and depth of thought, one can find the opening, avoid the heavier consequence, and turn a great problem into a small one, then into none.
所以只要心定神闲，想得广、想得透，蹈瑕乘隙，避重就轻，大事化小，小事化无，亦并不难。

Since we mentioned cord-fastened dispatches, let me tell you an ingenious story about one.
刚才提到‘ 钉封文书’，我就说个钉封文书的妙事。

I suppose my employer has seen them?”
在座各位，“他看着王有龄问道，”想来东翁一定见过这玩意？

“Yes,” Wang replied.
““见过。”王有龄答道，

“Originally their fastening signified confidentiality.
“原来钉封文书，用意在示机密，

They were used not only for execution orders but for arresting important criminals.
亦不光是州县处决犯人非受领钉封文书不可，访拿要犯也用钉封文书。

In time the practice became a formality: a flap fixed to the cover, tied with thin hemp cord.
久而久之，成为具文，封套上钉个‘瓣’，用细麻绳一拴，

Anyone could open it.
人人可以拆开来看，

The most confidential document became the least secure—an outcome surely never intended.”
最机密变成最不机密，真正是始料所不及！”

“Exactly.
“一点都不错。

This story turns upon that freedom to open them.
这件妙事，毛病就出在‘人人可以拆开来看’上面。

Such dispatches travelled by post relay.
钉封文书按驿站走，

Each county through which they passed added its official seal.
每经一县，都要加盖大印。

An inquisitive magistrate handling one might open it, read it, and tie it up again.
公事过手，遇着好事的县大爷，就拆开来看一看依旧封好。

One such magistrate was a heavy opium smoker.
有这么一位县太爷，鸦片大瘾，

Every evening he read official papers while reclining beside his pipe.
每天晚上在签押房里，躺在烟铺上看公事。

One night, half dazed, he opened a dispatch and accidentally burned its contents over the opium lamp.”
这天也是拆了一封钉封文书看，迷迷糊糊，把那通文书在烟灯上饶掉了，”


That brought him sharply to his senses.
这一下，那县太爷才惊醒过来，

Destroying a confidential dispatch was an appalling offence.
烧掉了钉封文书，是件不得了的事！

He hurried to seek his legal secretary's help.
急忙移樽就教，到刑名师爷那里求援。

“Do you still have the cover?”
“封套在不在？”那刑名师爷问。

“Yes.”
“封套还在。”

“Then don't worry.
“那不要紧！

Give it to me, and bring the official seal.”
请东翁交了给我。顺便带大印来。”

The magistrate obeyed.
县太爷照办不误，

The secretary folded a blank sheet, put it inside, tied the cord, stamped the seal, and handed it back.
等封套取到，那刑名师爷取张白纸折好，往里一塞，拴好麻绳，盖上大印，交了回去。

“Send it by relay to the next station.”
“交驿递发下一站！”

“Will that do?” the magistrate asked hesitantly.
“老夫子，”县太爷迟疑地问道：“这行吗？

“What if the next station discovers it?”
下一站发觉了怎么办？”

“Think for yourself.
“东家，请你自己去想。”那刑名师爷说，

Suppose you're the next magistrate.
“换了你是下一县，

You open it and find a blank sheet.
打开来一看，里头是张白纸，

What would you do?”
请问你怎么办？”

Qin needed to go no further.
秦寿门把那个故事讲到此处，不需再往下说，

Everyone understood.
在座的人应都明白，

Anyone finding the blank page would dare neither announce the discovery nor return it and cause trouble: that would first expose his own offence of opening a confidential document.
显然的，有人发现了是张白纸，也不敢声张，更不敢多事退回去。因为倘或如此，便先犯了窃视机密文书的过失，

The reasoning resembled the education commissioner's statement that his forward position forbade looking behind.
这与那学政的“位列前班，理无后顾”八字，有异曲同功之妙。


“Though legal advisers belong to the school of law, they should also read Laozi and Zhuangzi to gain such insights,” Wang reflected.
“刑名虽是‘法家’，也要多读老庄之书，才能有些妙悟。”王有龄感叹着说，

“A man must not allow his vision to be obstructed, seeing an autumn hair but missing a cartload of firewood.
“人不能有所蔽，有所蔽则能见秋毫，不见舆薪。

There are so many obvious truths that people nevertheless fail to see.
世上明明有许多极浅显的道理，偏偏有人看不破，

How can one explain it?”
这是哪里说起？”

The discussion moved to other matters.
这番议论一发，便把话题引了开去。

They talked until sunset, then left the table and rowed back to the city.
闲谈到夕阳衔山，方始散席，依旧荡桨回城。

The following day, Wang entertained the revenue secretary Yang Yongzhi aboard a pleasure boat on West Lake, again accompanied by Hu, Zhou, and Wu.
第二请钱谷师爷杨用之，在西湖里的一条画舫上设席，陪客依旧是胡雪岩和周、吴两委员。

Fukang was expected to use Huzhou Prefecture's and Wucheng County's public remittances to the provincial treasury as capital.
由于阜康钱庄创设以后，预计是要用湖州府和乌程县解省的公款，作为资本，

Since the revenue secretary was closely involved, Hu made a special effort to cultivate him.
这与钱谷师爷有密切的关系，因此胡雪岩对杨用之，特别笼络。

Yang was straightforward and honest, and therefore easy to manage.
杨用之赋性忠厚老实，是最容易对付的人，

Hu soon made him wholly accommodating, with the feeling that they should have met long before.
以胡雪岩的手腕，把他摆布得服服帖帖，颇有相见恨晚之感。

In fact, the method was simple.
其实胡雪岩的手腕也很简单，

Straightforward men liked to be consulted and generally shared all they knew.
凡是忠厚老实的人，都喜欢别人向他请教，而他自己亦往往知无不言，言无不尽。

Hu spoke well, but listened still better.
胡雪岩会说话，更会听话，

However dull another man's words, he could attend gravely, eyes fixed upon him, as though fascinated.
不管那人是如何地语言无味，他能一本正经，两眼注视，仿佛听得极感兴味似地，

He really did listen, adding a remark or developing a point at the crucial moment.
同时，他也真的是在听，紧要关头补充一两语。引申一两义，

The speaker then felt deeply understood, and congenial conversation became close friendship.
使得滔滔不绝者，有莫逆于心之快，自然觉得投机而成至交。


Yang was not exceptionally able, but his agreeable temperament had given him many acquaintances.
杨用之的本事不怎么好，但以他的性格随和，所以交游甚广，

Hu's company drew him into an animated account of contemporary figures.
加以遇着胡雪岩，不知不觉地提起了谈兴，讲了许多时人的轶闻，

Eventually, discussing Huzhou, he mentioned Qian Jiang and asked whether Wang knew him.
最后谈到湖州府的人物，他提起一个人叫钱江，问王有龄认不认识？

“I've heard of him.
“我听说过他，

He comes from Changxing County in Huzhou Prefecture.
是湖州府长兴县人，

He became known through being exiled to Ili with our Fujian statesman Lin Wenzhong.
曾跟我们福建的林文忠公，一起遣戍伊犁，由此出名。

They say he's an extraordinary man.
听说他是个奇士。

Someone appreciated by Lord Lin can't be ordinary.
想来林文忠公所赏识的人物，总不会错的。”

Why do you mention him?
王有龄问道：“怎么老夫子忽然提到这个人，

Is there news?”
莫非有他的新闻？”

“You could call it news.
“也好说是新闻。

But it affects local officials profoundly, and we don't yet know the court's view.”
不过这条新闻，与各州县利害关系甚大，还不知道朝廷的主张如何？”

“Please explain.”
“喔，要请教。”

“We must begin with a senior official.
“这要从一位达官谈起，

You know Lei Yixian?”
雷以諴其人，东翁总知道？”

“Yes.
“知道。”王有龄说，

A Hubei man.
“此公湖北人，

As senior vice censor-in-chief, he joined the Director-General of River Conservancy to inspect the Yellow River's outlet.
以左副御史会同河道总督巡视黄河口岸。

Recently I read that he volunteered to fight the rebels.
前些日子看邸抄，说他自请讨贼，

He has recruited ten thousand men, stationed them at Gaoyou north of the Yangtze, and is guarding the southeastern approach to Yangzhou.
现在募了一万人，驻军江北高邮，扼守扬州东南，

He's won several battles.”
很打了几场胜仗。”

“Exactly.
“是的，

Qian Jiang serves on his staff.
钱江就在他幕府里。”杨用之说，

Troops without pay cannot fight.
“有兵无饷，仗是打不下去的，

The court's position is that anyone able to recruit men and raise funds should devise his own means, and it will approve.
朝廷的宗旨，反正只要你能募兵筹饷，自己去想办法，无不赞成的。

I hear Qian has proposed collection offices and checkpoints at important land and water routes.
听说钱江现在为雷军划一策，在水陆要冲，设局设卡，

Travelling merchants are assessed on the value of their goods, generally one part in a thousand.
凡行商经过，看他所带货物，估价抽税，大致千取其一，

The levy is called lijin.
称为‘厘捐’，

Local shops pay on the same basis.
除了行商，当地店铺亦照此抽税。

The receipts are considerable, and other provinces are reportedly considering imitation.
收入颇为可观，听说各省都有仿照的意思。

But since it harms trade, the court may refuse it.”
只是此法病商，朝廷或者不许。”


This news, and Yang's view that the proposed lijin would harm merchants, gave Wang his opportunity.
杨用之所谈的新闻，以及认为在创议中的“厘捐”会“病商”的见解，恰好给了王有龄一个机会，

He and Hu had discussed the two secretaries carefully.
聘用刑、钱两幕友，他跟胡雪岩曾仔细谈过，

Law was outside Wang's expertise, so he must rely upon Qin and first test his ability.
刑名是外行，非倚托秦寿门不可，所以先要考一考他的本事。

Revenue administration was different: Wang understood it well.
钱谷则王有龄自己就很精通，

Yet secretaries traditionally worked independently and disliked interference.
但幕友的传统，向来独立办事，不喜东家干涉，

An accommodating one might give an outwardly polite response; an autocratic one would simply ignore his employer.
平和的还表面上有所敷衍，专断的根本就置之不理，

Hu's plan was therefore to win Yang's affection while Wang demonstrated enough knowledge to command respect.
所以胡雪岩设计，由他自己用感情来笼络杨用之，而王有龄则要拿点本事给他看看，

With gratitude and apprehension working together, Yang could be brought under effective direction.
这样双管齐下，让杨用之怀德畏威，把他收服，才能指挥如意。

Wang seized the moment to display his learning.
所以王有龄听了他的话，觉得不妨趁些机会，展示所学。

“I'm not sure it necessarily harms trade,” he began in an argumentative tone.
“ ‘病商’恐未必！”他一开口就是辩驳语气，

“Our dynasty's tax system differs from those of earlier times.
“本朝的赋税制度，异于前代，

Whenever war comes, military funds must be raised separately.
一遇用兵之时，必须另筹军费，

Comparatively speaking, lijin may still offer more benefit than harm.”
以我看，开办‘厘捐’，比较起来，还不失为利多害少的好办法。”

This broad proposition served as the introduction to an essay.
这笼统一句话，是做文章的一个“帽子”，

Intent upon demonstrating his knowledge, Wang began at the beginning.
王有龄既有炫耀之意，便得从头讲起。

From ancient times, the chief annual revenues had been land and poll taxes and grain levies.
自古以来，国家岁收的主要项目，就是地了与钱粮，

Repeated additional assessments late in the Ming had made life intolerable.
明朗未年不断“加派”，搞得民不聊生，

Farmers suffered so greatly that they abandoned their fields and fled.
庄稼人苦得要死，到最后只好弃地而逃，

This was a major cause of the spread of roaming rebels and, ultimately, the dynasty's fall.
此为“流寇”猖獗，终以亡明的一大关键。


After the Qing entered China, the Kangxi emperor's suppression of the Three Feudatories finally secured the dynasty's foundations.
清兵入关，到圣祖平定三藩之乱，始得奠定国基。

Taking warning from the Ming, he issued an edict promising never to increase taxation.
鉴于前朝之失，颁发“永不加赋”的诏令，

This was one of the dynasty's great benevolent measures and a principal reason the Manchus could long rule the central plains.
此为清朝的一大仁政，亦为满族得以长主中原的一大凭借。

Later emperors faithfully maintained it.
后世诸帝，对圣祖的这个诏谕，信守不坠。

Customs and salt duties also supplied annual revenue, but land and poll taxes represented two-thirds of the total.
此外国家岁收，还有关税、盐课两项，但地丁占岁收总额的三分之二，

With an undertaking never to increase them, annual receipts were effectively fixed.
既有永不加赋的限制，则岁收就有了定额。

They could cover expenditure in peaceful years of favourable weather.
风调雨顺、刀兵不起的太平岁月，固然可以支应，

But war brought extra military costs with no provision.
但一遇用兵，额外的军费负担，即无着落，

Drought or flood required both tax remissions and famine relief: income fell while expenditure rose.
倘或水旱年荒，一面要减免丁漕，一面要办赈济，收入减少，支出增加，

How could that be managed?
又如何应付？

If war and natural disaster coincided, both sides of the crisis intensified.
再如刀兵水旱一齐来，火上加油，两面发烧，更是件不得了的事。


“There are two ways to meet the shortfall,” Wang continued calmly. “The first is savings accumulated in ordinary times.
“这有两个办法弥补，一靠平时蓄积。”王有龄从容议论：

Though the emperor possesses all within the four seas, state revenue and palace revenue are separate.
“虽然天子富有四海，国家收入与宫廷收入，还是有区分的。

The distinction was already well developed under the Han: the Grand Minister of Agriculture managed public expenditure, while the Privy Treasurer managed the sovereign's private wealth.
这个制度从汉朝就很完备了，‘大司农’掌国家度支，‘少府’管天子的私财。

If the ruler has a surplus while the state lacks funds, disorder follows.
私财有余，国币不足，国家必乱。

When the founding Song emperor subdued the Ten Kingdoms, their gold, silver, and jewels went into the palace treasury, but were separately sealed as a special reserve.
宋太祖平服十国，所得金银珍宝虽输于内府，但另行封存，称为‘封桩银’。

He intended to accumulate enough to buy back the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun.
他的打算是积到相当数目，要把‘燕云十六州’买回来。

Unfortunately, the unworthy Huizong spent the palace reserves on the Genyue pleasure garden, after which the Jin invaded.
可惜徽宗不肖，以内府所积，用来起‘民岳’，才有金兵入寇之事。

The Ming needs no elaboration: its Board of Revenue was desperately poor while palace wealth piled high, only to fall into the rebels' hands.
前明更不必说，户部穷得要命，宫内蓄积如山，到最后，白白便宜了‘流寇’。

Our dynasty is different.
本朝就不同了，

Reserves are held in the state treasury, not the Imperial Household Department.”
蓄只于国库而非内务府。”


Wang then cited treasury balances: fifty million taels in Kangxi's forty-eighth year, falling to eight million by the end; after thirteen years of vigorous reform under Yongzheng, an unprecedented sixty million at Qianlong's accession; and seventy million in Qianlong's forty-sixth year.
接着王有龄便举了几个户部存银的数目，康熙四十八年到过五千万两，最后剩下八百万两，但雍正十三年的极力整顿，到乾隆即位时，库存到了前所未有的六千万两的巨数，以后乾隆四十六年，到过七千万两。

After Jiaqing, however, the position deteriorated, worsening further under Daoguang.
但嘉庆以后就不行了，到道光朝更是每况愈下。

“When the late emperor died, the Board held eight million taels.
“先帝崩逝当时，户部存银八百万两，

I don't know the figures for the last three years.
这三年来的数目不详。

Since Hong and Yang rose, money has flowed like water.
洪杨军兴以来，用财如流水，

I imagine the dynasty has never been poorer.”
想来现在正是开国以来最穷的时候。”


The mixture of narrative and analysis enlightened not only Zhou and Wu but Yang himself.
这一番夹叙夹议的谈论，不但周、吴等人有茅塞顿开之感，就是杨用之也觉得长了一番见闻。

Revenue was his profession, yet he knew only local finance and little of the central treasury.
钱谷一道虽是他的专业，却只了解一隅之地的财政，朝廷大藏，十分隔膜，

Hearing Wang explain it so coherently, he thought that, purchased qualification or not, his employer had considerable learning.
现在听王有龄讲得头头是道，心里便有这样一个想法：这位东翁，莫道他是捐班出身，肚子里着实有些货色。

At that very moment Wang turned to purchased office.
他想到了王有龄的出身，王有龄恰好也要谈到捐班，

“The second way to meet a public shortfall is through contributions paid for official qualifications.
“弥补国用不足，再有一个办法是靠捐纳的收入。”他说，

The system began under the Han, when money could obtain a position as a palace gentleman.
“捐官的制度，起于汉朝，即所谓‘纳赀为郎’。

Later dynasties retained it, but none used it as extensively as ours.”
此后历代都有，但不如本朝的盛行。”

He described its development and connection with central revenue.
接着，王有龄便细谈清朝捐纳制度演变的经过，以及对中枢岁收的关系。

Contributions for actual appointments had begun under Kangxi to fund the war against the Three Feudatories.
捐纳实缺虽由康熙为三藩之乱，筹措军费而起，

By Yongzheng's reign they had become a regular practice, their proceeds effectively part of annual revenue, though at a relatively modest average of around fifteen per cent.
但至雍正朝即成为“常例”，捐纳收入几为国家岁收的一部分，只是比例不大，平均总在百分之十五左右。

Excessive use began under Jiaqing.
捐例之滥，始于嘉庆朝，

The proceeds often equalled half the year's revenue, and in his seventh year exceeded eighty per cent.
它的收入常为岁收的一半，嘉庆七年那一年，更高达岁收总额百分之八十以上。

“Once the system is abused, its evils are beyond description,” Wang said evenly.
“捐例一滥，其弊不可胜言。”王有龄泰然说道，

“Though I myself entered by purchase, I can hardly respect that class of official.
“我自己虽是捐班出身，但也实在叫我无法看得起捐班的。

Anyone with money, however ignorant, can obtain office.
只要有钱，不管什么胸无点墨的人，都可以做官。

Having first invested capital, he treats administration like a business.
做官既要先花本钱，那就跟做生意一样，

Once appointed, he must recover principal and interest.
一补上实缺，先要捞回本息。

How can clean government result?”
请问吏治如何澄清得来？”


“That cannot be said of everyone,” Wu objected.
“这也不可一概而论。”吴委员说，

“Advancement by examination is naturally the proper path.
“赴试登进，自是正途，

But examination success doesn't depend on writing alone.
但‘场中莫论文’，

Fate, luck, and favourable circumstances play their part, leaving many capable men unrecognised.
要靠‘一命、二运、三风水’，所以怀才不遇的也多的是。

Purchase opens a door through which they can exercise their talents instead of being buried.
捐例开了方便之门，让他们有个发挥机会，不致埋没人才，

That too is a great service.”
也是莫大功德之事。”

The compliment to Wang was implicit and understood.
这是在暗中恭维王有龄，他当然听得懂，

He saw no need to disclaim it.
而且也不必客气，

“Cases like mine are uncommon.
“象兄弟这种情形到底不多。”他说，

Even one advantage cannot compensate for a hundred harms.
“纵有一利，奈有百害何？

Now military expenses are widening an already overused system until the streets are full of officials.
如今为了军费，越发广开已滥的捐例，搞得满街是官，

What sense does that make?”
那还成何话说！”

“Your view is entirely sound,” Yang answered, sincerely convinced.
“东翁见得极是。”杨用之倒是真的心悦诚服，

Without noticing his reversal, he changed his argument.
所以不自觉其矛盾地改了论调，

“Commercial taxes in our dynasty are not heavy.
“本朝的商税，原就不重，

Apart from such miscellaneous charges as brokers' licence fees, pawnshop duties, and livestock taxes, ordinary trade pays only the tax on goods brought from elsewhere for sale in local shops—the landing tax, also called the stationary tax.
杂赋中的牙帖税、当税、牲畜税以外，买卖的商税，只有买别地货物到店发卖的‘落地税’，也就是‘坐税’。

Goods in transit pay only customs duties.
至于货物经过的‘过税’，只有关税一种，

A moderate additional lijin levy would not be excessive.”
如今酌增厘捐，亦不为过。”

“Precisely!” Wang said, already wondering privately whether Zhejiang too might introduce it.
“就是这话罗！”王有龄口中这样在说，心中却己想到厘捐是否亦可在浙江开办？


The discussion had achieved its purpose.
一场议论，算是有了结果。

Hu changed the subject.
胡雪岩换了个话题，

Impressed by Qian Jiang, he asked whether Yang knew him.
他很佩服钱江，所以这样发问：“杨老夫子可识得那位钱先生？”

“Not only do I know him; we're distantly related.
“你是说钱江？”杨用之答道，“我们不但认识，而且还沾些亲。

His courtesy names are Qiuping and Dongping.
他字秋平，又字东平。

An ancestor was governor of Shandong, and his father also served there.
祖上曾做过山东巡抚，他老太爷也在山东做过官，

He was exceptional from childhood, quick at everything except that he disliked eight-legged essays.”
此人从小不凡，样样聪敏，就是不喜欢做八股文章。”

“How else would he be an extraordinary man?” Wu laughed.
“那怎么称做‘奇士’呢？”吴委员笑道，

“Someone like that must disregard conventional restraints and have ambitions of his own.”
“象这样的人，必是不中绳墨，别有抱负的。”

“He proposed another measure now being adopted across the provinces.”
“他还有一策，现在各省都已仿行。”

Yang suddenly looked at Hu.
杨用之忽然看着胡雪岩说，

“You could make use of it yourself.”
“雪岩兄大可一办！”

“What measure?”
“请问，办什么？”胡雪岩愕然相问。

“Another of Qian Dongping's ideas: obtain imperial permission to draw blank qualification certificates in advance and issue them as soon as contributions are paid.
“也是钱东平的主意，请旨预领空白捐照，随捐随发，

Everyone finds it convenient, so ‘business’ is excellent.
人人称便，所以‘生意’好得很。”杨用之笑道，

This province has begun doing the same.
“本省亦已照样进行。

You could purchase a qualification.”
雪岩兄大可捐个前程。”


That appealed to Hu.
这话倒把胡雪岩说动了，

His recent experience in official circles had taught him the importance of standing, not for display but for convenience.
这几个月他在官场打了几个滚，深知“身分”二字的重要，倒不是为了炫耀，而是为了方便，

When making or receiving calls and exchanging names, a recognised qualification settled the proper forms of address without awkwardness.
无论拜客还是客人来拜，彼此请教姓氏时，称呼照规矩来，毫无窒碍。

As an untitled commoner, he felt out of place everywhere.
是个“白丁”，便处处有格格不入之感，

Friends could address one another as brothers, but with unfamiliar officials he risked either diminishing himself or offending them.
熟人无所谓，大家可以称兄道弟，若是陌生的官儿，称呼上不是委屈了自己，就是得罪了别人，

It was a serious difficulty.
实在是一大苦事。

That evening he specially consulted Wang, who naturally approved.
因此，这天晚上他特地跟王有龄去商量。王有龄自然赞成：

“I've urged you to do it for ages!
“我早就劝你快办了！

I don't know why you've kept delaying.”
我真不知道你什么意思？一直拖着。”

“No time.
“都是为了没工夫，”胡雪岩说，

The business is troublesome.
“这件事麻烦得很，

Apart from the time it takes, there are objections and demands for fees at every stage, enough to destroy anyone's enthusiasm.
费辰光不说，还有层层挑剔需索，把人的兴致都消磨光了。

Immediate issue, with money handed over and the certificate received in return, is different.”
象现在这样。随捐随发，一手交钱，一手取照，自然又当别论。”

“There will still be demands.
“需索还是会有的。

‘Immediate’ won't be quite so immediate.
讲是讲‘随捐随发’，到底也没有那么快。

But avoiding collection from the ministry itself will certainly make it much faster.”
不过，部照不必到部里去领，当然快得多。”


“That shows how necessary it is to think.
“于此可见，凡事总要动脑筋。

In finance, opportunities are everywhere.”
说到理财，到处都是财源。”

Hu drew another lesson.
胡雪岩又得到启示：

“Whether an official dealing with the people or a merchant dealing with customers, if you want the money in their purses, make them comfortable enough to open those purses willingly.”
“一句话，不管是做官的对老百姓，做生意的对主顾。 你要人荷包里的钱，就要把人伺候得舒服，才肯心甘情愿掏荷包。”

“There's truth in that.”
“这话有道理。”

Wang nodded thoughtfully.
王有龄深深点点，

“At Huzhou, I too must find a way to ‘serve’ the people comfortably, so they'll gladly pay their taxes.”
“我这趟到湖州，也要想办法把老百姓‘伺候’得舒舒服服，好叫他们高高兴兴来完钱粮。”

“They're easy enough to serve.
“其实老百姓也很好问候，

Avoid official bluster and deal with realities; they'll call you a good official.”
不打官腔，实事求是，老百姓自会说你是好官。”

Hu returned to his own business.
胡雪岩又谈到他自己的事，

“What qualification should I purchase?”
“雪公，你看我捐个什么班子？”

“Department or county magistrate,” Wang answered without hesitation.
“州县。”王有龄毫不考虑地答说，

“Entrust it to Yang Yongzhi.”
“这件事你托杨用之好了。”

Taking his advice, Hu sent Yang a formal invitation the next day and entertained him at a restaurant.
胡雪岩受了他的教，第二天特地具个柬帖，把杨用之请了在馆子里小酌。


After three rounds of wine, they discussed the matter.
酒过三巡，谈起正事，

Yang readily agreed and made an announcement.
杨用之一诺无辞，而且声叫：

“Beyond the prescribed contribution, there are always miscellaneous charges from which everyone handling the business receives a benefit.
“报捐向来在正项以外，另有杂费，经手的人都有好处，

I'll deduct my own share and reduce the miscellaneous fees by thirty per cent.”
我的一份扣除，杂费还可以打个七折。”

“That won't do.
“这不好。

A gentleman may love money, provided he acquires it properly.
君子爱财，取之有道，

Whatever is due to you should be accepted without hesitation.”
该当你老夫子的，自然当仁不让。”

“Would that be friendship?”
“那还叫朋友吗？”

Yang waved his hand.
杨用之摇着手说，

“Leave that to me.
“你不必管这一层了。

What I need to know is whether you want the basic qualification or additional preferences.”
我且问你的意思，光是捐个班呢，还是要捐‘花样’？”

There were many variations in purchasing office.
捐官的花样极多，

The simplest was an empty title supported by a ministry certificate, conferring standing, family distinction, and local prestige.
最起码的是捐个空头名义，凭一张部照。就算是有了身分，可以光大门楣，炫耀乡里，

An actual appointment required choices concerning priority and the province in which one would serve.
如果要想补实缺。另有种种优先次序，补缺省份的花样。

Hu had other powerful support and no wish to travel to the capital, register with the Board of Civil Office, and await selection.
胡雪岩别有奥援，也不想进京到吏部报供候选。

He merely wanted the title “His Honour Hu” while continuing to run his bank.
捐官不过捐个“胡老爷”的尊称，依旧开自己的钱庄，

Additional expenditure was unnecessary.
那就无须多加花费，另捐花样了。

“I only need the ministry certificate.
于是胡雪岩说：“我只要有张‘部照’就可以了。

Am I really going to be an official?”
难道真的去做官？”

“It wouldn't be difficult, and you'd be a favourite of the first order.
“你要做官也不难，而且必是一等一的红员。

But each man has his ambitions.
不过人各有志。

Bring the silver tomorrow.
你明天就送银子来，

I'll pay it in and obtain the certificate as quickly as possible.”
我替你‘上兑’，尽快把捐照领下来。”


Hu thanked him and said no more about the purchase.
“拜托，拜找！”胡雪岩道过谢，就不再提这事了，

He diligently pressed wine upon Yang, strengthening their friendship while asking what opportunities existed around local revenue receipts and expenditure.
殷殷劝酒，一面拉拢杨用之，一面向他讨教州县钱谷出入之际，有些什么“花样”？

Honest though Yang was, and warmly as he regarded Hu, he would not say much on those matters.
杨用之人虽老实，而且也觉得他极够朋友，但遇到这些地方，他也不肯多说。

Hu's quick understanding nevertheless enabled him to infer several methods from the hints he received.
好在胡雪岩机警，举一反三，依旧“偷”到不少“决窍”。

The next day, he took the purchase money from the five thousand taels set aside for opening the bank.
第二天他从准备开钱庄的五千两银子中，提出一笔捐官的钱来，

The official contribution was made into a draft, the miscellaneous charges supplied in silver, and both delivered to Yang.
“正项”打成票子，“杂费”是现银，一起送到杨用之那里。

True to his word, Yang returned the portion of the fees that would have been his own benefit.
杨用之果然不肯受好处。把杂费中他应得的一份退了回来。


By now it was the end of the fourth month.
这时已是四月底，

Wang was overwhelmed with preparations for taking office, and Hu was busier still, both advising him and establishing the bank.
王有龄要打点上任，忙得不可开交。胡雪岩当然更忙，既要为王有龄参赞，又要忙自己的钱庄。

Fortunately, Liu was extremely capable.
亏得刘庆生十分得力，

He had taken a handsome building in pledge at Yunsi Hexia and personally supervised its painting and plastering.
在运司河下典了一幢极体面的房子，油漆粉恻，自己督工，

Signboards, furniture, employees—he managed everything inside and out.
此外做招牌、买家具、请伙计，里里外外，一手包办，

Rising early and retiring late, he grew dark and thin with fatigue, but his delight in the opportunity made the work seem no hardship.
每天起早落夜，累得人又黑又瘦，但人逢喜事精神爽，丝毫不以为苦。

An auspicious day had been chosen for Wang to take office: the ninth of the fifth month.
上任的黄道吉日挑定了，选定五月初九。

Invitations to farewell dinners poured in.
这一下设宴饯行的帖子，纷纷飞到。

Doing business was easier than being an official; social obligations could not be neglected.
做事容易做官难，应酬不能不到，

Wang was distressed by the lack of time.
王有龄时间不够，大感苦恼，

When Zhang's invitation arrived, he hoped to evade it.
等看到张胖子也来了一张请帖，就想躲懒了。

“你看，”他对胡雪岩苦笑， “张胖子也来凑热闹！

Please explain for me.
算了吧，托你替我去打个招呼，

Let him keep his dinner until I return to the provincial capital.”
留着他那顿酒，等我上省再叩扰。”

胡雪岩心想，张胖子的情分不同，利害关系，格外密切，王有龄实在不能不给他一个面子。

不过排排他的帖子，一天总有两三处应酬，也实在为难。

想了一下，他有了个主意：

张胖子人不错，应该要买买他的帐。

现在既抽不出工夫，就这样办，让张胖子那桌酒摆在船上，雪公，你看好不好？

““我，我还不大懂你的意思。”

在船上吃了张胖子的饯行酒，我们第二天再回来。”

“这倒不错！

In fact, Xueyan,” Wang smiled, “why return at all?
雪岩，”王有龄笑道，“其实你也不要回来了，

索性一路送到湖州，那又多好呢？”

“雪公，请你体谅我，

我等把阜康的事弄舒齐了，马上赶了来。

来在你也还没有到任，湖州怎么个情形，两眼漆黑，

我想帮忙也帮不上。

Besides, the bureau's affairs matter too.”
再说，海运局这面也是要紧的。”

“大概快了。”

“Press Yang to finish it quickly.

我已经跟麟藩台说过了，

As soon as the certificate arrives, you'll be appointed a convoy commissioner at the bureau.
等你部照下来，立刻委你为海运局的押运委员。

这样，你才好替我照料一切。”

“That isn't the best arrangement.
“这不好！”胡雪岩说，

Nominally, Zhou should act as executive director.
“名义上应该让周委员代理坐办。

He'll consult me on everything, so nothing will suffer.
反正他凡事会跟我商量，误不了事。

占了他的面子，暗中生出许多意见，反为不妙。”

Wang saw the reason and agreed.
想想他的话不错，王有龄也同意了。

“In any case, the sooner the purchase is completed, the better.”
不过他又说：“不管怎么样，此事总以早办妥为宜。”


“Yes.
“是的。

It concerns more than this one matter.
也不尽是这一桩。

等把你送上了任，我这里另外有个场面，搬个家，略略摆些排场，从头做起。”

“这也好！”

王有龄笑道：

Though teasing, he had expressed Hu's intention exactly.
这话虽带着调侃的意味，其实是说中了胡雪岩的心意。

Hu was limiting his public activities until he had the qualification, the bank was open, and the necessary appearance established.
他现在对外不大作活动，就是要等官捐到了，钱庄开张了，场面摆出来了，

示人以簇新的面目，出现了不凡的声势，做起事来才有得心应手、左右逢源之乐。

* * *出了海运局到信和。

张胖子正要出门，看见胡雪岩便即改变了原意，

要寻你说两句话，比见什么大官儿都难。”

有事你叫‘学生子’到我家里通知一声，我敢不来？”

“自己弟兄，

A joke or two shouldn't be taken seriously.”
说句把笑话，你不能当真。”

“Naturally not.
“哪里会当真？

But today I have come with a purpose...” Hu explained the proposed change to Wang's farewell dinner, and Zhang readily agreed.
不过，今天是无事不登三宝殿……”接着，他肥张胖子为王有龄饯行，希望改换一个方式的话一说，张胖子欣然表示同意。

“雪岩，”他又说，“听说你捐了个州县班子？”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

Before another question could follow, Hu gave the full history of the decision.
胡雪岩不等他再问，把这件事的来龙去脉，源源本本告诉了他。

If Zhang still felt any resentment, this openness dispelled it.
如果说张胖子对他还有些芥蒂，看他这样无话不谈的态度，心里也释然了，

“Xueyan,” he said with genuine pleasure, “you'll rise far.
“雪岩”，他是真的觉得高兴，“将来你得发了。

说起来是我们信和出身，我也有面子。”


Hu smiled without answering, then rose.
胡雪岩笑笑不答，站起身说：

“You were about to go out.
“刚才看你要出门，

I won't detain you.
我不耽搁你的工夫了，

改天再谈。”

只记得他女儿，不记得她老子。”

也不知道老张怎么打听到我这个地方？

他说他刚从上海回来，听说王大老爷放了湖州府，

上任要船，无论如何要挑挑他。

我说我不清楚这事，要问你。

我把你府上的地址告诉他了。”

“I can't help him either.
我也帮不得他的忙。

A new official has people arranging his journey.
人家新官上任，自有人替他办差。

If I interfere even in trifles like that, everyone will curse me.”
象这种小事情我也要插手，那不给人骂死？

“That's no concern of mine.” Zhang laughed.
““我不管了。”张胖子笑道：

“He'll come to see you.
“反正老张会去看你，

If you're not afraid of A'zhu cursing you, refuse him.”
只要你不怕阿珠‘骂死’，你尽管回他好了。”

“要么这样。”

Hu had a sudden idea.
胡雪岩灵机一动，

“We're accompanying Mr Xuexuan for a stage and returning the following day. We'll need a boat too.
“我们不是要送雪公一程，第二天回来不也要船吧？

那就用老张的船。”

“Exactly.
“对，对！

That gives you a satisfactory answer for A'zhu.”
这样子在阿珠面上也可以交代。”


Zhang's constant references to A'zhu revived Hu's feelings.
张胖子开口阿珠，闭口阿珠，倒勾起了胡雪岩的旧情。

Remembering her slight frowns and smiles, her changes from sorrow to happiness, he found much to dwell upon.
想想那轻颦浅笑，一会儿悲，一会儿喜的神态，着实有些回味。

因而第二天上午特意不出门，在家里开阜康开张以后，预备要去兜揽的客户名单，借此等老张上门，好订他的船。

谁知老张没有来，他老婆来了，

新用的一个小丫头阿香来报，说有位“张太太”要见他。

At first Hu was puzzled; then he thought of A'zhu's mother.
骤听之下，莫名其妙，随后才想到可能是阿珠的娘，

从玻璃窗望出去，果然！

Mrs Zhang, then!
张太太就张太太吧！胡雪岩心想，

她也是好人家出身，再则看阿珠的分上，就抬抬她的身分，

胡太太呢！”

女眷应该情请后厅相会，

但胡雪岩顾虑他妻子还不明究竟，先要向她说清楚，

所以故意把话扯了开去，

“Inside.
“在里头。”

太客气了！”

不过一点心意。”

那是她的拿手菜，无锡肉骨头，再有就是薰青豆、方糕和粽子，那是湖州出名的小吃。

“这倒要叨扰你，

都是外面买不到的。

你等等！”他很高兴地说，“我去叫内人出来。”

胡雪岩到了后厅，把这位“张太太”的真正身分，向妻子说明白，当然不会提到阿珠，

主人看客人觉得很对劲，客人看主人格外仔细，

彼此紧蹬着，从头看到脚，让旁观的胡雪岩觉得很刺目。

女眷总有女眷的一套家常，一谈就把他搁在一边了。

胡雪岩没有多少工夫，只好硬打断她他的话，

听他们谈到正事，胡太太不必再陪客，

胡太太贤惠，看来脾气也好。”

A'zhu's mother pressed the point.

Hu was surprised by this irrelevant concern.
不谈正事谈这些不相干的话，胡雪岩不免诧异，

“Quite good.”
“还好！”

He nodded.

“Of course.

Where?”

“Nothing could be better.
“那再好都没有了。

请胡老爷跟张老板说一说，他也不必费事备席，

就用我们船上的莱好了。”阿珠的娘说，

His Honour must be tired of shark's fin and sea cucumber.

只要菜好就是了。”

“Yes.

I understand.”
我有数。”

她起身告辞，又低声叮嘱一句：“早点来！”

自己的前程刚刚跨开步子，正要加紧着力，
