放下杯子，有着喜不自胜的神情，

“Brother Xueyan, meetings between people truly depend on what the Buddhists call yinyuan—causes and affinities.
“雪岩兄，人生遇合，真正是佛家所说的‘因缘’两字，

You cannot force them in the least.”
一点都强求不来。”

“Oh, so yinyuan comes from Buddhist scripture?” Hu had taken the word to mean the ties that bring a marriage about.
“喔，原来‘姻缘’两字，是佛经上来的？”


Ji was surprised.
这一说，嵇鹤龄不免诧异，

Hu spoke so well; how could he not know the origin of yinyuan?
看他吐属不凡，何以连“因缘”的出典都会不知道呢？

Yet the passing trace of condescension vanished at once.
但他轻视的念头，在心中一闪即没，

When friends take to one another, charitable explanations readily follow.
朋友投缘了，自会有许多忠恕的想法，

Though a merchant with little schooling, Hu was not vulgar.
他在想，胡雪岩虽是生意中人，没有读多少书，但并不俗气，

Through social intercourse he had acquired an elegant way of speaking that carried him creditably through formal occasions.
而且在应酬交往中，学到了一口文雅的谈吐，居然在场面上能充得过去，

That was no small achievement.
也真个难能可贵了。

Ji had not yet noticed that Hu understood a different word, also pronounced yinyuan: marriage ties rather than causes and affinities.
他还没有听出胡雪岩说的是“姻缘”，不是“因缘”。

He simply developed his thought.
只接着发挥他的看法：

“People speak only of affinity, but there must be a cause before affinity can arise.
“世俗都道得一个‘缘’字，其实有因才有缘。

Our temperaments are one such cause.
你我的性情，就是一个因，

You understood that I respond to kindness, not pressure, and that poverty hasn't destroyed my self-respect.
你晓得我吃软不吃硬，人穷志不穷的脾气，

That's why we get on.
这样才会投缘。

When people say they lack affinity, what they really lack is a cause for it.
所以有人说的无缘，其实是无因，

If their aspirations differ and their temperaments clash, how can they become friends?”
彼此志趣不台，性情不投，哪里会做得成朋友？”

Only then did Hu realise that Ji meant yin as in cause and effect, not yin as in marriage.
胡雪岩这才明白，他说的是因果之“因”，不是婚姻之“姻”，

He felt still more uncomfortable, but saw no need to conceal it.
心里越发不是味道，但也不必掩饰。

“Brother Heling,” he said sincerely, “when it comes to principles from books, I'm no match for you.
“鹤龄兄，”他很诚恳的说，“你跟我谈书上的道理，我不是你的对手。

But please go on.
不过你尽管谈，

Listening can only do me good.”
我听听总是有益的。”


This made Ji like him still more for his candour, though it also left him reluctant to continue displaying quotations and book learning.
这一说，益使嵇鹤龄觉得他坦率可爱，不过也因为他这一说，反倒不便再引经据典，谈谈书上的道理了，

“To understand the world is learning; to comprehend human dealings is literature.
“ ‘世事洞明皆学问，人情练达即文章’，

Brother Xueyan, there's no need to be so modest.
雪岩兄，你倒也不必忒自谦。”

When you have leisure, try reading a few poems and looking at mountains and water.
嵇鹤龄说，“我劝你闲下来，倒不妨读几首诗，看看山，看看水，

It would nourish your temperament and do you a great deal of good.”
这倒是涵泳性情，于你极有益处的。”

“Those words are a prescription,” Hu said with a smile.
“你这几句话是张药方子，”胡雪岩笑道：

“They could cure my vulgarity.”
“可以医我的俗气。”

“Exactly!”
“对了！”

Ji tapped in appreciation.
嵇鹤龄击节称赏，

“A man who sees that is no vulgar fellow.”
“你见得到此就不俗。”

His pleasure in conversation increased, and with it his appetite for wine.
这一来，他的谈兴越发好了，谈兴一好酒兴也一定好，

They ordered another two jin of Zhuyeqing.
又添了两斤竹叶青来。

The proprietor, too, knew how to oblige.
酒店主人也很识趣，

From a bamboo basket suspended in the lake, he took a black carp weighing three jin.
从吊在湖水中的竹篓里，捞起一条三斤重的青鱼，

Instead of preparing it in the traditional vinegar style handed down from the Southern Song, he borrowed a Shanxi method and made a fish soup with vinegar and pepper, refreshing to the stomach and calculated to clear the effects of wine.
别出心裁，舍弃从南宋传下来的“醋溜”成法不用，仿照“老西儿”的吃法，做了碗解酒醒脾的醋椒鱼汤，

He brought it himself, explaining that it was a complimentary dish.
亲自捧上桌来，说明是不收钱的“敬菜”。

Ji's appetite improved as well.
于是嵇鹤龄的饭量也好了，

After three bowls of dongchun rice, he rubbed his stomach.
三碗“冬春米”饭下肚，摩着肚皮说：

“This is the first time since my wife died that I've eaten and drunk to such contentment.”
“从内人下世以来，我还是第一次这么酒醉饭饱。”


The remark reminded Hu of something.
他这一说，倒让胡雪岩想起一件事，

“Brother Heling, your wife left five or six children.
“鹤龄兄，”他问：“尊夫人故世，留下五六个儿子，

Someone must manage the household.
中馈不可无人，

Surely you've considered marrying again?”
你也该有续弦的打算！”

“Ah!” Ji sighed.
“唉！”嵇鹤龄叹口气，

“Of course I have.
“我何尝不作此打算？

But consider it: five or six children to look after, and a wretched expectant official who doesn't know what year he'll receive a post.
不过，你倒想想，五六个儿女需要照料，又是不知哪一年补缺的‘灾官’，

What daughter of even a moderately respectable family would marry me?”
请问，略略过得去的人家，哪位小姐肯嫁我？”

“That's true,” Hu replied.
“这倒是实话。”胡雪岩说：

“Let me think about it for you.”
“等我来替你动动脑筋！”

Ji merely smiled.
嵇鹤龄笑笑不答。

Hu, however, really did think, and soon had an idea.
胡雪岩却真的在替他“动脑筋”，并且很快地想到了一个主意，

He kept it to himself for the moment and turned to other small talk.
但眼前先不说破，谈了些别的闲话，

The sun had sunk between the Northern and Southern Peaks, scattering ten thousand golden scales across the lake.
看着太阳已落入南北高峰之间，返照湖水，映出万点金鳞，

The heat was less fierce than at noon, and a breeze beneath the willows cleared their heads.
暑气也不如日中之烈，柳下披风，醉意一消，

Truly, “The setting sun is beautiful beyond measure, but twilight is near.”
真个“夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏”，

Twilight meant the city gates would soon close.
一到黄昏，城门快要关了，

Reluctantly, they parted, agreeing to meet the next day.
两人恋恋不舍地约了明天再见。


Hu went straight to Wang's house.
胡雪岩直接来到王家，

Wang was seeing a visitor out.
王有龄正好送客出门，

As soon as he saw Hu, he caught his hand and laughed.
一见便拉着他的手笑道：

“Xueyan, you're astonishing!
“雪岩，你的本事真大，

To win over a man like that—I can only admire you.
居然能把这么个人降服了，我不能不佩服你。

I've called on him and left eight taels as a condolence offering.
我去拜过他了，封了八两银子的奠仪，

That wasn't too little, was it?”
不算太菲吧！”

“The amount doesn't matter,” Hu replied.
“这无所谓。”胡雪岩答道，

“He's already volunteered.
“他已经自告奋勇，

He'll certainly return your visit tomorrow morning, and you can speak to him directly.”
明天上午一定会来回拜，你就开门见山跟他谈好了。”

“Volunteered?”
“自告奋勇？”

All Wang's worries vanished.
王有龄愁怀尽去，大喜说道：

“Excellent!
“好极，好极！

I'll give a dinner tomorrow evening and invite Brigade Commander Kui and the two gentlemen from Xincheng.
明天晚上我请个客，把魁参将和新城县的两个绅士约了来，

We can discuss everything properly.
好好谈一谈。

Come early.”
你早点来！”

The next afternoon, Hu finished lunch at home and went to Wang's as arranged.
第二天下午，胡雪岩依约，在家吃完午饭就到了王家。

Ji soon arrived too.
不久，嵇鹤龄也到了，

He had returned Wang's call that morning and accepted the dinner invitation.
他在上午已来回拜过王有龄，接受了晚宴的邀请，

They had also agreed that he should come early so they could devise a concrete plan.
同时应约早到，好先商量出一个具体办法，

Once Kui and the Xincheng gentlemen arrived, they could settle it together and begin work immediately.
等魁参将和新城县的绅士来了，当面谈妥，立即就可以动手办事。


“Brother Heling,” Wang began, “I've been considering matters ever since your visit this morning.
“鹤龄兄，”王有龄说，“早晨你来过以后，我一直在盘算，

The rebel monk Huixin has murdered the Xincheng magistrate, and the county's deputy magistrate is now holding the seal.
新城县令已为匪僧慧心戕害，现在是县丞护印。

I mean to recommend you to the governor as acting magistrate.
我想上院保老兄署理新城，

With the seal of authority in your hands, your work would be easier.
有‘印把子’在手里，办事比较方便。

Of course, this would only be temporary.
当然，这是权宜之计，

Xincheng has poor soil and impoverished inhabitants.
新城地瘠民贫，

You shouldn't be kept in such an unrewarding post.
不好一直委屈老兄。

Later I'll certainly help you transfer to a large county of the first class.”
将来调补一等大县，我一定帮忙。”

Ji clasped his hands. “Thank you for advancing my interests, Mr Xuexuan.
“多谢雪公栽培！”嵇鹤龄拱拱手说，

But for now I should retain the title of commissioner.
“不过眼前还是用委员的名义好。

Why?
何以呢？

First, I must adapt to circumstances.
第一，此去要随机应变，

I may have to enter the tiger's den and temporarily call those rebels brothers, drinking with them on friendly terms.
说不定我要深入虎穴，权且与那班乱民‘称兄道弟，杯酒言欢’。

As their magistrate, I would have to preserve the dignity of the court.
如果是父母官的身分，不能不存朝廷的体统，

That would constrain me everywhere and make things harder.
处处拘束，反而不便。

Second, the deputy magistrate is holding the seal and doing his best to sustain a city in danger.
其次，现在既是县丞护印，身处危城，能够尽心维持，

He must hope to gain something for his efforts.
他总也有所贪图，

If I take the acting appointment, his hopes disappear.
如果我一署理，他就落空了，

Even if he doesn't resent it and obstruct me at every turn, he'll certainly lose his enthusiasm.
即使不是心怀怨望，事事掣时，也一定鼓不起劲来干，

That would do our purpose no good.”
于大事无益。“


“Yes, yes!”
“是，是！”

Wang's admiration showed in both his words and expression.
王有龄钦佩之忱，溢于词色，

“Your analysis displays real insight.
“老兄这番剖析，具见卓识。

We'll do exactly as you advise.
这准定照老兄的吩咐，

Once this affair is settled, leave your substantive appointment to me.”
等这件事完了，老兄补实缺的事，包在我身上。

“That is for later.
““那是以后的事，

For now, please recommend to the authorities that if the deputy magistrate of Xincheng renders distinguished service, they should promote him to act as magistrate instead of sending someone else.
眼前我要请雪公先跟上头进言，新城县丞，倘或著有劳绩，请上头不必另外派人，就让他升署知县。”

‘A generous reward will bring forth brave men’ is sometimes a very useful principle.
嵇鹤龄说，“‘重赏之下，必有勇夫’这句话，有时候很用得着。

With that promise from above, my work in Xincheng would become much easier.”
如果上头肯这么答应，我到了新城，可得许多方便。”

“Quite right!
“对！

And he deserves it.
这也是应该的。

He's holding the place together in danger and should receive that recognition.
危城之中，也靠他撑持，理当有此酬庸。

It would be grossly unfair to leave him all the hardship, then let another man enjoy the fruits once order is restored.”
倘或受罪吃辛苦有分，局势平定了，别人来坐享其成，这也太不公平了。”

They went on to discuss the details of attempting conciliation before resorting to force.
接着，他们两人便谈到“先抚后剿”的细节。

Hu saw no part for himself and could contribute nothing, so he quietly withdrew and went straight to the inner rooms to see Mrs Wang.
胡雪岩看没有他的事，也插不进话去，便悄悄退了出来，径到上房来见王太太。


Mrs Wang was warmer than ever, calling him “Brother” at every turn and treating him almost as a member of her own family.
王太太越发亲热，口口声声“兄弟，兄弟”的，简直把他当做娘家人看待了。

Hu understood official households: they might be familiar, but others must not overstep the forms.
胡雪岩深知官场中人的脾气，只许他们亲热，不许别人越礼，

He therefore continued to address her properly.
所以仍旧按规矩称她：

“Mrs Wang, you needn't worry about Mr Xuexuan any longer.
“王太太！”他说，“现在你可以不必再为雪公担心了。

Ji Heling admires him, and he and I felt like old friends at our first meeting.
嵇鹤龄一则是佩服雪公，再则是跟我一见如故，

He's agreed to go to Xincheng.”
肯到新城去了。”

“It's all your doing, Brother!” she said with difficulty.
“这都是兄弟你的功劳！”王太太很吃力地说：

“Truly, I don't know how to thank you.”
“真正是，我不知道该怎么谢你？”

“There's no need.
“不必谢我！

Even if I have been of some help, with my friendship for Mr Xuexuan it was only right.
就算我出了力，以我跟雪公的情分来说，也是应该的。

Mr Ji is the one we truly owe.
倒是人家嵇老爷，

To speak plainly, we must appreciate what he's doing by going there.” Hu continued, “Just now Mr Xuexuan offered to recommend him as acting magistrate, but he firmly refused, saying it would make the work harder.
打开天窗说亮话，这一趟去，真正要承他的情。”胡雪岩又说，“刚刚雪公要保他署理新城县，他一定不要，说是这一来事情反倒不好办。

Think of it: an expectant official waits for nothing but a post.
王太太你想，候补候补。 就是想补个缺，

Why would he put aside rank and advancement when they're offered?
此刻不贪功名富贵，所为何来？

Simply for friendship.”
无非交情二字。“


“That's true,” Mrs Wang said.
“这是真的。”王太太说：

“Brother, we're among ourselves.
“兄弟我们自己人，

Give me some advice.
你倒替我出个主意看，

I can't inquire into official business or interfere with it, but personally he's doing your elder brother a great service.
虽说公事上头，我不能问，也插不进手去，私人的情分上他帮了你哥哥这么一个大忙，

I must show some consideration too.
我总也要尽点心。

If his wife were alive, it would be easier.
如果他太太在世，倒也好了，

We women could visit, and anything could be discussed.
内眷往来，什么话都好说，

Unfortunately, she's dead.”
偏偏他太太又故世了！”

This was the crucial point.
这就说到紧要关头上来了，

Hu had guided the conversation here in a few sentences and was about to state his purpose when someone arrived.
胡雪岩三两句话把话题引到此处，正要开门见山转入正文，不想来了个人，

He swallowed the words already on his tongue.
他只好把已到喉咙口的话，咽了回去。

“Please have some tea, Mr Hu.
“胡老爷请用茶。

It's flag-and-spear tea from Lion Hill, sent by Magistrate Chen of Qiantang. We've only just opened it.
钱塘县陈大老爷送的狮子山的‘ 旗枪’还是头一回打开来吃。

You're particular about tea—do try this fresh batch.”
胡老爷，你是讲究吃茶的，尝尝新！”

The speaker was Mrs Wang's trusted maid, Ruiyun.
说话的是王太太的一个心腹丫头，名叫瑞云，

Tall and graceful, she had a long face and a rather broad chin.
生得长身玉立，一张长隆脸，下巴宽了些，

In physiognomy, however, a full, well-shaped lower face was supposed to promise distinction.
但照相法上说，这是所谓主贵的“地角方圆”。

Her bearing did indeed suggest a young woman from a good family.
看瑞云的气度，倒确是有点大家闺秀的味道，

She spoke calmly, carried herself quietly, and showed no frivolity.
语言从容，神态娴静，没有些儿轻狂。

Her particular gift was household management: she kept everything in perfect order and was virtually Mrs Wang's right arm.
尤其好的是操持家务，井井有条，等于王太太的一条右臂。

Thus, though well into marriageable adulthood, she remained unmarried, simply because her mistress could not bear to let her go.
所以到了花信年华，依然是小姑居处，只为王太太舍不得放她出去。


“Thank you, thank you!”
“多谢，多谢！”

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地问道：

“Ruiyun, how old are you?”
“瑞云，你今年几岁？”

She dreaded being asked her age; the subject hurt her.
瑞云最怕人问她的年纪，提起来有点伤心，

Yet she was no ordinary woman and answered with composure.
但她到底与众不同，这时大大方方地答道：

“Twenty-two this year.”
“我今年二十二。”

She was actually twenty-five and had subtracted three years.
其实是二十五，瞒掉了三岁。

“You don't look twenty-two,” Hu said, deliberately trying to please her.
“二十二岁倒不象。”胡雪岩有意叫她开开心，

“I thought you were under twenty.”
“我当你二十岁不到。”

Ruiyun smiled openly and charmingly.
瑞云笑了，笑得很大方，也很妩媚，

Her mouth was rather large, but her even white teeth kept the smile from being unattractive in the least.
只是嘴大了些、好在有雪白整齐的一嘴牙，倒也丝毫不显得难看。

“Brother!”
“兄弟！”

Mrs Wang sounded anxious.
王太太有些紧张，

“Are you...”
“你……”

Hu coughed loudly to stop her.
胡雪岩重重咳嗽了一声，示意她不要说下去，

He knew what she was about to ask and thought it awkward to say before Ruiyun.
她要说的一句话他知道，当着瑞云诸多不便，所以阻止。

How could Ruiyun fail to notice?
瑞云怎会看不出来？

Taking one of Mrs Wang's teacups, she unobtrusively withdrew.
顺手取走了王太太的一只茶杯，毫不着痕迹地躲了开去。

Only then did Mrs Wang ask quietly, “Brother, do you mean to find Ruiyun a husband?”
这时王太太才低声问道：“兄弟，你是不是要替瑞云做媒？”


“I do have that thought, though I must first know your wishes,” Hu answered frankly.
“有是有这么个想法，先要看王太太的意思。”胡雪岩老实说道：

“I don't think it can be put off any longer.”
“我看耽误不得了！”

Mrs Wang blushed.
王太太脸一红，

“I won't conceal it from you.
“我也不瞒你，”

First, the higher matches are beyond us and the lower ones won't do.
她说，“一则来高不成低不就，

Second, I really can't manage without her.”
二则来，我实在也离不开她。”

“That was true before.
“这是从前的话，

Things are different now.”
现在不同了。”

“Yes, different.”
“是的，不同。”

She was merely agreeing politely; she did not really know how things had changed.
王太太说是这样说，其实不过礼貌上的附和，究竟如何不同，她自己并不知道，

Hu saw this.
胡雪岩看出这一点，

Trusting in the closeness of their friendship, he thought he must explain plainly, or the conversation would go no further.
自恃交情深厚，觉得有为她坦率指出的必要，不然，话就谈不下去了。

“Mrs Wang, a little over a year ago, before Mr Xuexuan went to the capital, I knew something of your circumstances.
“王太太！一年多以前，雪公还不曾进京，那时府上的境况，我也有些晓得。

It was your management that carried the household through those hard times and allowed his fortune to turn.
多亏王太太一手调度，熬过这段苦日子，雪公才能脱运交运，

Naturally, then, you couldn't do without a capable helper like Ruiyun...”
当时自然少不了瑞云这样一个得力帮手……”

“Ah!” She interrupted before he could finish, her face full of uneasy remorse.
“啊！”不等他的话完，王太太便抢着打断，是一脸愧歉不安的神情，

“You're right, Brother!
“兄弟，你说得不错！

Thank you for reminding me.”
真正亏得你提醒！”

He had made her see the difference between then and now.
今昔的不同，让胡雪岩提醒了。

The masters were enjoying official success and rising rapidly; what of the servants?
做主人家的，宦途得意，扶摇直上，做下人的又如何呢？

Ruiyun had helped them endure hardship and deserved some reward.
瑞云帮王家撑过一段苦日子，现在也该有所报答了，

How could Mrs Wang bear to neglect her future and let her youth slip away?
再不替她的终身着想，白白耽误了青春，于心何忍呢？

She was now not merely uneasy but anxious to find, immediately if possible, a promising husband of suitable age and appearance for Ruiyun.
因此，这时候的王太太，不仅是不安，甚至于可说有些着急，最好能立刻找到一个年貌相当，有出息的人，把瑞云嫁了出去。


“Tell me, Brother, whose family is it?
“兄弟，你说，你要替我们瑞云做媒的是哪家？

既然来到府上，这都是我该做的事，

只怕伺候得不周到，嵇老爷你多包涵！”

说着，深深看了他一眼，才低下头去盛粥。

看他们这神情，胡雪岩知道好事必谐，便忍不住要开玩笑了，

瑞云不响，她也懂胡雪岩那句话，只觉得怎么样说都不好，

所以仍旧是装作不懂，悄悄退了出去。

这样逼着问，嵇鹤龄不无受窘之感，

到了上海，我要看机会脱手，

我从命就是了。”

我也不会再续娶了，

将来把她扶正好了。”

哪里还有什么办法好挑？”

第一，我想以三方面的交情，你的聘礼可以免了。

两个办法你自己挑。”

聘礼不可免。”

这趟新城的差使办成功，黄抚台一定放你出去，说不定就是雪公湖州府下面的县缺。

那时候你还怕没有钱还帐。”

利息可要照算，不然我不借。”

胡雪岩不响，从马褂夹袋里掏出一叠银票，拣了一张放在嵇鹤龄面前，

你把银票收好，

我先写张借据。”

这也现成，

胡雪岩随身带着个“皮护书”，里面有空白梅红八行笺，墨盒和水笔。

不让我怕委屈了瑞云。”嵇鹤龄说：“果然如你所说的，新城之行，圆满归来，有个‘印把子’抓在手里，她不也算‘掌印夫人’了？”

到后来声音越说越大，

瑞云想不听亦不可得，

难道一定就知道自己不会反对？

摸一摸自己的脸，

果然有些发烫。

这样子走不出去。

江南缙绅之家，通称子女叫“官”，或者用排行，或者用名字，

因为一则不免羞涩，再则对他和胡雪岩还存着一丝莫名其妙的反感，有意矜持。

看她依旧站着，嵇鹤龄很快地又说了句：“你请坐啊！”

“I'm quite all right.”
“不要紧！”

She still would not comply.
她还是不肯依。

Without realising it, Ji rose too.
于是嵇鹤龄不自觉地也站了起来，

Holding his water pipe and twisting paper spills, he talked with her, chiefly asking about her family background.
捧着一管水烟袋，一路捻纸捻，一路跟她说话，主要的是问她的家世，

She answered every question.
瑞云有问必答，

They continued until the third watch before finally going to their separate rooms.
一谈谈到三更天，方始各归寝室。


This should have been Ji's most comfortable night since his bereavement.
这应该是嵇鹤龄悼亡以后，睡得最舒服的一夜，

Ruiyun had thoroughly put his bed in order: spotless white ramie curtains, a scrupulously wiped sleeping mat, and a fresh pillow cover.
因为他的床铺经瑞云彻底的整理过了，雪白的夏布帐子，抹得极干净的草席，新换的枕头衣。

The shelf behind the large bed was neatly arranged, with tea and books ready.
大床后面的搁板上，收拾得整整齐齐，有茶有书，

Outside the curtains, the oil lamp had been trimmed to burn brightly, so he could read if unable to sleep.
帐子外的一盏油灯，剔得极亮，如果睡不着可以看书消遣。

He could not sleep, but he did not read.
他睡不着，但也不曾看书，

His eyes were already dry and tired, while his mind remained excited and crowded with thoughts.
双眼已有些涩倦，而神思亢奋，心里想到许多事，

Above all, he was assessing the journey to Xincheng.
最要紧的一件是新城之行的估量。

At first, moved by Hu's friendship and Wang's courtesy, he had volunteered without counting the consequences.
最初激于胡雪岩的交情，王有龄的礼遇，挺身而出，不计后果，

Now he saw that he could not simply act on courage and consider the rest afterwards.
此刻想想，不能只凭一股锐气，做了再说。

What to do on arrival would necessarily depend on circumstances, but success and failure both required forethought.
到新城以后，如何下手，固非临机不可，但是成败之算，应有筹划。

No one entering a city in danger could devise an entirely safe plan.
身入危城，随便什么人不可能有万全之计，

If he were killed, what would become of his six children?
倘或被害，身后六个儿女怎么办？

Naturally there would be an allowance from the court and help from his superiors.
当然，朝廷有抚恤，上官会周济，

But these depended on others' generosity.
然而这都要看人的恩惠，

He needed someone truly dependable to whom he could entrust the children if they were orphaned.
总得有个切实可靠，能够托孤的人才好。


This naturally brought Hu to mind.
念头转到这里，自然就想到了胡雪岩。

Ji regretted not having considered it sooner.
心里不免失悔，如果早见及此，

Had he done so, he could have made a serious, explicit request that evening.
趁今晚上就可以切切实实拜托一番，

Now he could only leave something like a will.
现在只好留个“遗嘱”了。

He rose again, moved the lamp to the table, and laid out paper and brush, but hesitated.
于是他重新起身，把油灯移到桌上，展开纸笔，却又沉吟不定。

A will seemed too grave.
留遗嘱似乎太严重了些，

It would place a heavy burden on Hu.
这对胡雪岩会是很大的一个负担。

He considered for a long while, then suddenly found an ingenious solution that pleased him greatly.
考虑了很久，忽有妙悟，自己觉得很得意。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十二章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Twelve, first part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER TWELVE｜第十二章


To reach Xincheng, one first travelled to Fuyang by water along the Qiantang River.
到新城先到富阳，走钱塘江这条水路。

Once Wang, who had come to see him off, had left, Ji asked Hu to stay a little longer.
等送行的王有龄一走，嵇鹤龄把胡雪岩留了下来，

There were still a few things he wished to say.
说还有几句话要谈。

Seated in the cabin, he took a plum-red card from his visiting-card box and placed it before Hu.
到船舱中坐定，他从拜匣里取出一张梅红单帖，放在胡雪岩面前，

It read: “Ji Heling, known by his courtesy name.
上面写的是“嵇鹤龄，以字行。

Native of Luotian, Hubei.
湖北罗田人，

Born at the noon hour on the fourth day of the tenth month, in the twenty-first year of Jiaqing.”
嘉庆二十一年十月初四午时生。”

“Oh!” Hu laughed.
“喔！”胡雪岩笑道：

“You certainly don't waste time.
“你倒真巴结，

I ought to have obtained Ruiyun's birth particulars for you first.
应该我先去讨瑞云的八字来给你。

Though really, we could dispense with this.”
其实，这也可以不必。

“No, no!”
““不是，不是！”

Ji waved his hand.
嵇鹤龄摇着手说，

“The card is for you.
“这张帖子是交给你的。

Brother Xueyan, I hope you will grant me the honour of becoming my sworn brother.”
雪岩兄，我想高攀，我们拜个把子。”

“This...”
“这……”

胡雪岩愣了一下，接着喜逐颜开地说：

“The honour would be mine!
“那是我高攀了！

I haven't time to prepare a card now, but we must at least bow.”
不过，此刻来不及备帖子，但是也要磕个头。”

“这都好办，

We can perform the ceremony when I return from Xincheng.
等我新城回来再行礼。”嵇鹤龄说：

如果你不嫌弃，此刻我们就改称呼。

How old are you?”
你今年贵庚？”


“Much younger than you.”
“我小得多。”

Hu adopted the new form at once.
胡雪岩改了称呼，叫一声：

“Elder Brother!”
“大哥！”

接着便给“大哥”磕头。

Ji hastily knelt in return, naturally calling him “Second Brother.”
嵇鹤龄急忙也跪下还礼，自然称他“二弟”。

They exchanged a bow and became brothers of different surnames without even taking a pinch of earth to serve as incense.
两人对拜了一拜，连“撮土为香”都用不着，就结成了异姓手足。

When they rose, each felt a change in the weight on his shoulders.
拜罢起身，彼此肩上的感觉便都不同了，

Ji's had lightened; Hu's had grown heavier.
嵇鹤龄是减轻而胡雪岩是加重，

“Elder Brother,” Hu said, “go to Xincheng with your mind at ease and devote yourself entirely to the work.
“大哥！”他说，“你尽管放心到新城去，专心一致办事，

Don't spend a moment worrying about things at home.
家里一点都不用记挂，

I'll attend to everything.”
一切都有我！”

“Naturally I must rely on you.
“那自然要托你。”

But with Ruiyun there now, I have little cause for anxiety.
嵇鹤龄又说，“不过眼前有瑞云在，也没有什么不放心的，

Once I've gone, hurry to Shanghai yourself.
我走了，你也赶紧动身到上海去吧！

Go early and return early, and we'll exchange cards and give a feast.”
早去早回，我们换帖子请客。

“Very well.
““好的，

I understand.
我晓得，

A safe journey!”
一路顺风。”


Hu left the boat, went ashore, and took a chair into the city.
胡雪岩离船登岸，坐轿进城，

He reached Wang's house just after Wang himself, unable to suppress his smile.
等王有龄到家，他接着也到了他那里，脸上是掩抑不住的笑容，

Both husband and wife wondered what had made him so happy.
王有龄夫妇都觉得奇怪，问他什么事这么高兴。

“You'd never guess!
“你们两位再也想下到的，

In the few moments after Mr Xuexuan went ashore, Heling and I became sworn brothers.”
就雪公上了岸那一刻工夫，我跟鹤龄拜成把弟兄了。”

“Splendid!
“太好了！

Congratulations!”
恭喜，恭喜！”

Wang turned to his wife.
王有龄对他妻子说：

“太太，这一来我们跟鹤龄的情分也不同了。”

“Now we really are one family.
“真成了一家人，

至亲好友，原是越多越好。”

胡雪岩从马褂口袋里摸出个红封套递向王太太。

她不肯接，

“这是什么？”

话没有完，王有龄先就乱喊：

How could we take his money?
这怎么好收他的？

你还给他。”

你不要吵！”

Mrs Wang waved a hand.

她自己答应了没有？”

“哪有这么快？”

Mrs Wang was unconvinced.
王太太不信，

“她到底怎么说的？”

“It hardly needs to be said outright.”
“这也用不着明说。”

Hu recounted the previous evening.
胡雪岩把昨晚上的情形讲了一遍。

Affection conveyed in looks and unspoken understanding always made an engaging story, and he deliberately described every nuance.
这些眉目传情，灵犀暗通的事，本来就是最好的话题，胡雪岩又有意刻画入微，

The couple listened with relish, mouths slightly open and the corners lifted, ready to burst out laughing at any moment.
所以把王有龄夫妇听得津津有味，都是微张着嘴，耸起两面唇角，随时准备放声大笑的神态。

“差也差不多了。”等他讲完，王有龄点点头说。

“到底不是什么‘千肯万肯’，

总还要我来说两句，她才会松口。”

“拜托，拜托！”

Hu clasped his hands and used the opportunity to offer the red envelope again.
胡雪岩拱一拱手，趁势又把红封套递了过去。

Mrs Wang had just taken it when her husband snatched it back and thrust it at Hu.
王太太已经接到手里，王有龄一把夺了回来，塞回胡雪岩：

“We can't accept this.”
“这不能收的。”

“Of course we can,” she answered.
“没有什么不能收。”王太太接口，

兄弟，你把聘金交给我，

I have another use for it.”
我另有用处。”

“What use?”
“你有什么用处？”

Wang was thoroughly displeased and on the verge of quarrelling with her.
王有龄大为不悦，几乎要跟太太吵架了。

“I'll tell you!”
“我说给你听！”

Her voice rose too.
王太太的声音也很大，

“We shall provide Ruiyun's dowry ourselves.
“瑞云一份嫁妆归我们预备。

这一千两银了，我另外交给她，是她的私房钱。

请问王大老爷，可以不可以？

His expression changed at once.
“王有龄的表情立刻改变了，

歉意地笑着，却用埋怨的语气回答：

“It isn't too late to say it now.”

王太太拿着红封套，得意地走了。


“Xueyan.”

王有龄略有忧色，

Their principle had long been settled: conciliation first, force afterwards.
“先抚后剿”的宗旨是早已定好了的，

If conciliation failed, naturally troops would be sent.
抚既不成，自然是派兵进剿，

何需问得？

但胡雪岩了解他的内心，便不肯这么回答，只说：

鹤龄跟我说过，无论如何，自保之策，总是有的，

He must be very confident.
可见得他极有把握。

Besides, happy events lift a man's spirits.
而且，人逢喜事精神爽，

他此去没有后顾之虑，专心一致对付公事，

Of course he'll succeed.”
当然无往不利。

Hu spoke fluently and with such assurance that Wang was unconsciously encouraged.
“听他侃侃而谈，声音中极具自信，王有龄不知不觉受了鼓舞，

愁怀一放，连连点头。

Your fortune is at its height.

瑞云也要托你的福，她又是一副福相，

这个缺，一年起码有五万银子进帐。”

胡雪岩心想，归安县现在由王有龄兼署，

一时慷慨，终必失悔，却又是说不出的苦。

朋友相交，到了这地步一定不能善始善终，

我倒有个想法。”

一定是好主意。”

她的来意，胡雪岩明白，

一到松江，仍旧在出四鳃鲈的秀野桥上岸，

进去再说。”

代为开发轿子挑伕，把他奉为上宾，同时赶紧派人去通知尤五。

尤五家住得不远，不必再用轿马。

陈世龙一面走，一面把到了松江以后的情形。扼要地报告，

人是分开来往，陈世龙住在通裕，老张住在船上，阿珠就住在尤五家。

胡雪岩心里明白，尤五仍旧当阿珠是他的心上人，所以特加礼遇，

He put her aside for the moment; his concern was the goods.
这且不去管她，他关心的是货色。

“货色进上海丝栈了。”陈世龙说道，

“Uncle You arranged it.
“是尤五叔作的主。

It's at Yuji Silk Warehouse, on North Street by Eryangjing Bridge.
堆在上海二洋径桥北大街的裕记丝栈，

He has the warehouse receipt.
栈单在尤五叔那里，

He offered it to me, but I wouldn't take it.
他要交给我，我不肯收。

I do have a tally of the quantities.”
不过一张记数的单子，还在我手里。”

Chen showed some caution: while another man held the receipt, he kept a written tally as a form of evidence.
陈世龙算是机警的，栈单在人家那里，他自己留着一张计数的单子，多少算个字佯。

Yet it was really useless.
其实无用！

The proper course was to accept the warehouse receipt.
粑栈单收了下来，原是正办，

Otherwise, he might as well show complete trust.
否则就索性大方到底。

What was the point of clinging to a tally?
捏一张记数单子算是啥名堂？

This showed Chen's inexperience, precisely the sort of thing Hu must teach him.
这是陈世龙做事不够老到，也正是自己要教导他的地方，

But the time and place were unsuitable for a lecture, so he merely nodded.
但此时此地，不便多说，点点头就算了。


They found You's house full of important visitors.
到了尤五那里，只见高朋满座，

Hu was hesitating when You came out with exceptional warmth.
胡雪岩方在踌躇，尤五已迎了出来，神情显得异常亲热。

They exchanged clasped-hand greetings, and You took his hand.
两个人拱拱手打过招呼，尤五拉着他的手问道：

“I thought you wouldn't arrive for several more days.
“我以为你还有几天才来。

Has Mr Wang's official business begun to take shape?”
王大老爷的公事有了头绪没有？”

How did he know about Wang's business?
他怎么知道王有龄的公事？

Hu glanced at Chen, whose expression was quite natural.
看一看陈世龙，神态自如，

Evidently Chen had not told him.
显然不是他告诉尤五的。

How, then, was You so well informed?
然则消息何以如此灵通？

The question flashed through Hu's mind while he answered, “Yes.
胡雪岩飞快地在心里转念头，同时口中答道：“有头绪了！

Otherwise I couldn't have got away.”
不然我也抽不出身本。”

“Good.
“好的！

We'll discuss it later.”
回头我们细谈。”

You drew him aside and lowered his voice.
尤五把他拉到一边，低声说道：

“I won't introduce you to those ‘divinities’ in the hall.
“厅里那班‘神道’，我不替你引见了。

Do you understand?”
你懂？”

Hu understood after a moment's thought and answered crisply, “Yes.”
胡雪岩一想就明白，很爽脆地签了一个字：“懂！”

“Then go back to Tongyu first.
“那好。你先请到通裕去，

I'll come as soon as I've seen these ‘ghosts’ out.”
等我‘送鬼出门，马上就来。”

“No hurry.
“不要紧，不要紧！

Let's meet at the old master's instead.”
我们在老太爷那里碰头好了。”

“He often speaks of you.
“老太爷倒常提到你。

I'll send someone to take you.”
我派人领了你去。”

You patted Chen's shoulder.
尤五又拍拍陈世龙的肩膀说：

“This young fellow has met him too.
“这位小老弟也见过老太爷，

He's quite fond of him.”
蛮喜欢他的。”

Chen's face shone as though gilded.
听得这句话，陈世龙脸上象飞了金一样：

“Only out of regard for Mr Hu.”
“那还不是看胡先生的面子。”

It was partly modesty and partly the truth.
他一半谦虚，一半说的也是实话。


A man sent by You accompanied them to Old Master Wei's house.
于是由尤五派了人，陪看到他老头子那里。

The old man had retired and concerned himself only with matters affecting the brotherhood as a whole.
“老太爷”已经退隐，除了有关一般的大计以外，别的事都已不问，

Most of his leisure passed in conversation with disciples of various generations.
每天空下来的工夫，都在徒子徒孙陪侍闲谈中打发。

He had been out of spirits lately, but Hu's arrival delighted him.
最近兴致不佳，但见了胡雪岩却是十分高兴，

There were several reasons, the chief one being that Hu suited him perfectly.
这有许多原因，最主要的一点是，他觉得胡雪岩顶对劲。

After receiving Hu's greetings and gifts, he ordered everything opened.
问过安，献上土仪，老太爷叫都打了开来，

Most were tea snacks and similar delicacies.
大部分是茶食之类的东西，

He tried a little of each and repeatedly praised them.
他每佯都尝了些，不断说好。

Once the bustle had subsided and they were seated, he instructed the others, “Go outside for a while.
这样乱过一阵，算是坐定了，老太爷吩咐：“你们都到外头坐坐！

I have something to discuss with Mr Hu.”
我跟胡先生有话说。”

Usually only You was admitted to such private conversations.
摒人密谈的事。除非是对尤五，

To dismiss everyone for a visiting outsider surprised them, but no one dared ask why.
现在对一位远来的“空子”也是如此，大家不免诧异。不过也没有入敢问。

The dozen or so people in the room withdrew silently.
一屋中十来个人，都静悄悄地退了出去。

“Xueyan,” the old man said, resting a hand on him, “I've been very low lately.
“雪岩！”老太爷扶着他说道，“最近我兴致很不好。

With war and disorder everywhere, there's much to worry about.
兵荒马乱，着实有些担心，

Old Five is capable enough, but his luck is poor.
老五呢，能干倒能干，运气不好，

Since it became his turn to bear this burden, he hasn't had a single easy day.
轮着他挑这副担子，一天好日子都没有过过，

As his old master, I feel I've failed him.”
我做老头子的，觉得对不起他。”

“The younger generation has its own good fortune!
“儿孙自有儿孙福！老太爷，

You can afford to take an easier view.
你实在可以想开些，

A boat straightens as it reaches the bridge.
船到桥门自会直，

With Brother Five's standing outside, he can manage anything.
凭五哥在外头的面子，无往不利，

Why worry so much about the younger men?”
老太爷何必替小辈担心？”


“Among men of the waterways, perhaps.
“江湖上总还好说，

But when it comes to officials—and an imperial edict at that—what can he do?
官面上事，再是朝廷的圣旨，叫他有啥法子？

Xueyan, consider our position!”
雪岩，你倒想想我们的处境！”

Hu understood.
胡雪岩明白，

The transfer of grain transport to the sea route threatened the brotherhood's very existence.
这是指漕米改为海运，漕帮有解体之危。

He had thought about this before and meant to help, but one development after another had kept him too busy even to consider it.
这件事，他当初也想过，打算尽点心，部为接二连三地有所发展，忙得连想这件事的工夫都没有。

The old man's words immediately filled him with remorse.
所以这时一听老太爷的话，内心立即泛起浓重的歉仄。

“Officials nowadays—I don't mean to disparage them—are like the Jiangxi bowl-mender in the saying: each looks after himself.
“现在做官的人，不是我说句看不起他们的话，‘ 江西人补碗，自顾自’，

Wife, wealth, children, and salary come first!
妻财子禄最要紧！

Otherwise things would never have reached this state...”
不然，不会弄成今天这样子的局面……”

The old man poured out his grievances, but there was truth in what he said.
老太爷大发了一顿牢骚，说的却是实话。

Hu understood that his anger concerned the sea transport of grain, or rather the failure to make provision for the brotherhood afterwards.
这胡雪岩心里也很明白，是对漕米海运有所不满，或者说，不替漕帮谋善后之策有所不满。

Yet Hu felt the authorities could not bear all the blame.
不过他觉得这件事也不能完全怪官府，

This was neither the moment to say so nor likely to do any good.
但这话此时不便说，说也无益，

He remained silent until he could discover what the old man wanted, then decide how to respond.
所以保持着沉默，要等弄清了他的意思再作道理。


“I'm not flattering you, but the people who can actually serve the court and the common people now are men like you,” the old master continued.
“现在能替朝廷和老百姓办事的人，不是我恭维你，实在只有象你老弟这样的人！”老太爷又说，

“I know something of Mr Wang's official reputation too.
“王大老爷的官声，我也有点晓得，

He's a reasonable man, willing to work.
算是明白事理，肯做事的官。

That's why there's something I want to say to you.”
为此，我有句话想跟老弟你说！”

“Please give me your instructions.
“是的，老太爷尽管吩咐，

The brotherhood's men are all my good friends.
漕帮都是我的好朋友，

Wherever I can help, I'll treat their business as my own.”
效得上劳的地方，我当我自己的事一样。”

“That's why I want to speak to you.
“所以我要跟你谈，

Besides being a good friend who values loyalty, you see things clearly and won't misunderstand me.”
除了你够朋友、重义气以外，还有一层，你见得事明，决不会弄错我的意思。

He leaned closer and lowered his voice.
老弟，”老太爷凑过头来，低声说道：

“A man must always be left a way out.
“一个人总要放他条路走，

A desperate dog leaps a wall; a desperate man may hang himself.
狗急跳墙，人急悬梁，

And you know our brotherhood: when we're amenable, we're very amenable; when we're not, we're hard to manage.
何况我们漕帮的情形，你是晓得的，好说话很好说话，不好说话也着实难弄。

Arrangements must be made beforehand.
事情总要预先铺排，

Once relations have broken down, restoring peace is painfully difficult.
等抓破了脸，再想来摆平，交关吃力，

Xueyan, Mr Wang still holds the Sea Transport Bureau appointment.
雪岩，王大老爷还兼着海运局差使，

Ask him not to look only at what lies ahead and forget what follows behind.
请你劝劝他，不要顾前不顾后，

He must spare a thought for our brethren too.”
替我们漕帮弟兄也要想一想。”


Hu was inwardly alarmed.
这番话听得胡雪岩暗暗心惊，

Resentment within the brotherhood must be running high.
看样子漕帮内部怨气冲天，

Once the paper could no longer contain the fire, it might spread across the plains.
一旦纸包不住火，烧开来会成燎原之势。

The situation was chaotic enough already.
局势已经够乱了，

He had heard that the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom had links with the Hongmen society.
听说太平天国跟洪门有关，

If the Anqing brotherhood rose as well, matters would be still more terrible.
如果再加上“安庆”一起起事，越发不得了。

Trade required peaceful conditions, and peace could not depend on the authorities alone: everyone must work together.
做生意总要市面平靖，而市面的平靖，不能光靠官府，全需大家同心协力。

Hu had always thought so.
胡雪岩一向有此想法，

Considering the interests involved, he now felt duty-bound to make a serious effort for the brotherhood.
所以听了老太爷的话，细想一想其中的利害关系，自觉义不容辞，有替漕帮好好出番力的必要。

“Your words aren't merely for your own benefit,” he said solemnly.
于是他很郑重地说道：“你老人家的话，也不光是顾自己，

“You're thinking of the whole region.
是为地方着想。

The canal runs from south to north; provincial boundaries cannot divide its concerns.
一条运河，从南到北，没有什么省界好分，

Wherever I can be useful, I shall help.”
只要我用得上力，一定效劳。”

“Exactly!”
“对呀！”

The old man patted his back.
老太爷拍拍他的背说，

“That's why I say you see clearly.
“所以我说你‘见得事明’，

Once we understand that our fortunes are linked and cease dividing ourselves from others, matters become easier.”
晓得休戚相关，不分彼此，事情就好办了。”


“Then tell me what I should say when I return.”
“那么，老太爷，你请吩咐，要我回去怎么说？”

The old master thought briefly.
老太爷略想一想答道：

“First, times have changed.
“第一，时世不同了，

Sea transport certainly has advantages, but canal transport isn't entirely useless.
海运当然也有好处，不过河运也不是一点用处都没有。

Ask Mr Wang to preserve it wherever possible.”
请你跟王大老爷说，河运能维持还要维持。”

He meant that not all grain shipments need be transferred to the sea route.
这意思是漕米不必尽改海运，

The request was not excessive.
要求也不算过分。

Hu nodded.
胡雪岩点点头说：

“That ought to be possible.”
“这应该办得到的。”

“Second, some provision must be made for the brotherhood's transport workers.
“第二，”老太爷又说，“漕帮的运丁，总该有个安置的办法。

Mr Wang should speak for us on that point too.”
王大老爷也该替我们说说话。”

This was still more clearly a duty.
这更是义不容辞的事，

“Certainly!” Hu agreed readily.
“一定，一定！”胡雪岩满口答应，

“He certainly will.”
“一定会说。”

“I know you can shoulder responsibility.”
“我晓得你老弟是有肩胛的。”

The old master clasped his hands.
老太爷拱拱手说，

“Officials understand little of the hardships below.
“做官的不大晓得底下的苦楚，

How fortunate that someone like you can connect those above and those below and open a path for us.
难得有你老弟承上启下，可以替我们通条路子，

I entrust this to you!
拜托，拜托！

I bow in thanks on behalf of our whole association.”
我替我们一帮磕头。”


“You do me too much honour!
“老太爷这后言重了！”

But there's something I'd like to say, though you may not welcome it.”
胡雪岩又说，“不过，我倒有句话，怕不中听。”

“Go ahead.”
“你尽管说。”

“I think the brotherhood should seek a livelihood for itself too.
“我在想，漕帮自己也该寻条生路，

For instance, could the garrison lands be put in order?”
譬如‘屯田’可以整顿整顿。”

“You're right in principle.
“老弟这话，自然在道理上。

But those lands are a long story.
不过，说到‘屯田’，真正是一言难尽，

Over the years, who knows how many have been privately sold or pledged?
多少年下来，‘私卖’、‘私典’的不知道多少？

Songjiang has an exceptional amount of land held under other men's registered names.
松江独多‘挂户田’，

That's why ours has become an impoverished association.”
所以成了‘疲帮’。

Hu had never heard this term, so the old master explained.
““挂户田”这个名目，胡雪岩还是初次听到，因而老太爷替他作了一番解释。

Garrison farmland had originally been public property assigned to registered cultivators, who were in effect the emperor's tenants.
“屯田”原是官产，“屯丁”领来耕种。算是皇家的佃户，

They therefore bore a double burden: first, the regular land tax payable to the authorities; second, a silver payment per mu to subsidise the transport workers.
因此“屯丁”便有双重负担，一是向公家完纳正赋，再是论亩出银、津贴运了，

This was called transport-support silver and ranged from one fen to three or four fen of silver per mu.
名为“津银”，每亩银子一分到三、四分不等。

Thus, despite being called garrison land, it carried heavier obligations than ordinary private farmland.
所以名为“屯田”，其实比民田的负担还要重。

Many abuses followed.
这一来就有许多弊病出现，

Some cultivators fled, leaving fields untended.
一种是“丁逃地荒”，

Other land was seized by local bullies, unscrupulous gentry, or clerks in the garrison offices.
一种是为土豪劣绅，或者卫所衙门的书办等类的人霸占，

Still more was privately sold or pledged.
再有一种是私卖或者私典屯田——

Under the law governing the unauthorised pledging of military land, both parties to such a transaction were punishable.
照律法讲，以“私典军田例”，买卖双方均须治罪，

Hence the practice of holding land under another's registered name: the purchaser or pledge-holder kept it entered under the original cultivator or transport worker and paid the taxes through that name, leaving the registered tenure a mere fiction.
因此有了“挂户田”这个名目，就是买或典的人，仍旧在屯丁或运丁名下挂户，完粮纳税，成了有名无实。


“Between the thirteenth year of Yongzheng and the eighteenth year of Daoguang, these lands were investigated seven times.
“从雍正十三年到道光十八年，屯田清查过七次，

The authorities know every abuse, yet they've never managed to put things in order.”
其中什么毛病，上头都晓得，始终整顿不出一个名堂来。

The old man spread his hands.
老弟，”老太爷双手一摊，

“Consider it: if the court can't deal with the problem, how are we to reform it ourselves?”
“请你想想，朝廷都没法办的事，叫我们自己如何整顿？”

“I understand!” Hu said.
“我懂了！”胡雪岩说，

“Since the land has become a burden to the brotherhood, that actually makes things easier.”
“屯田既成为漕帮一家，这事情反倒好办。”

This sounded puzzling and required explanation.
这话听来费解，还需胡雪岩补充说明。

Hu regarded land as something that could tie a man's hands and feet.
他认为田地是样“绊手绊脚的东西”，

Countless people remained rooted in their native places, unwilling to leave a plot behind and venture boldly into business.
不知道多少人安土重迁，只为家乡有块田地舍不得丢下，不肯挺起胸来，去闯市面。

If the Songjiang brotherhood's lands offered real benefits, cultivators and transport workers might fight over them at home, making matters troublesome.
松江漕帮的屯田如果有好处，屯丁、运丁或者会在本乡本土，你争我夺，事情就麻烦了。

Since they were a burden, why not let them go?
既然是个累，丢掉就丢掉，

Provided the authorities could devise an arrangement, the men could change occupations without hesitation or disputes over what they were leaving.
只要公家筹得了办法，改行就行，无所瞻顾争执，

Wouldn't that make things simpler?
岂非反而省事？

“I truly admire you!” the old master exclaimed.
““老弟，真正要佩服你！”老太爷大为感叹，

“Heroes arise among the young.
“英雄出少年，

Your insight is far above the ordinary.”
你的见解，实在高人一等。”


At this point You came in.
说到这里，尤五闯了进来。

The old master briefly recounted his conversation with Hu.
老太爷便把刚才与胡雪岩的谈话，扼要地告诉了他。

You listened very attentively, but this was chiefly a display of filial respect.
尤五很仔细地听着，但这只是表示“孝顺”，

He thought the matter important yet impossible to influence; they could only let events take their course.
心里觉得这件事虽然重要，但有力无处使，只有听其自然，

At least for the present, it was not urgent.
至少在眼前来说是不急之务。

“I'll discuss it with Young Uncle in due course,” he answered, then changed the subject.
因而答了句：“我跟小爷叔慢慢商量。”就把话扯开去了。

He spoke casually of A’zhu's stay and how well she got on with the women of his household.
扯的是闲话，说阿珠在他家作客，跟他家内眷如何投缘。

Hu naturally expressed his thanks.
胡雪岩自然要客气几句。

From the turn of the conversation, he sensed that You had something to discuss with his old master and that the small talk concealed an awkwardness about Hu's presence.
他从话锋中听出来，尤五似乎有事要跟他老头子谈，说闲话便有碍着自己在座的意思在内，

Taking the hint, Hu rose and said he would rest at Tongyu until You joined him for a meal and a discussion of business.
因而很知趣地站起身来，说先回通裕休息，等尤五来一起吃饭，商量生意。

Before he had finished, You caught his arm.
话还没有完，尤五就拉住他说：

“Wait a moment, Young Uncle.
“小爷叔，你等一等。

I only need a few words with the old master.
我跟老太爷稍为说两句话，

Then we'll go together.”
一起走。”

“Very well.
“好的，

I'll sit outside.”
那么我在外面坐一坐。”

“No need,” the old master told You.
“不必！”老太爷对尤五说，

“Your Young Uncle is no stranger.
“你小爷叔不是外人，

You needn't keep anything from him.”
有话不必避他。”

“It isn't that I wish to keep it from him.
“不是我避小爷叔。

We have no choice: when people bring things to us, we can't stop our ears.
我们是无法，人家找到头上，不能把耳朵遮起来。

But he has no part in this.
小爷叔不相干的人，

Why make him know about it?
何必让他也晓得？

What he doesn't see needn't trouble him.”
眼不见，心不烦，多好呢！

“That's true.
““这话也是。

Then sit outside for a while, Xueyan.”
那么，雪岩，你就到外面坐一坐！”

The old man raised his voice.
老太爷提高了声音说：

“Someone come and show our guest my orchids!”
“来个人啊！陪客人去看看我的兰花。”


The old master kept several hundred pots of jianlan orchids, tended by a specialist.
老太爷养了好几百盆“建兰”，有专人替他照料，

This man escorted Hu round them, finding much to say about every flower and leaf.
就由这个人陪着胡雪岩去看兰花。一花一叶，都能谈出好些名堂来。

Hu had no such refined interest.
胡雪岩没有那么雅，

He responded politely to pass the time, thinking only of the confidential and troublesome business You regarded so gravely.
敷衍着混辰光，心里只在想，是什么机密而又麻烦的大事，尤五看得如此郑重？

Then he remembered You's phrase about seeing the “ghosts” out and understood.
想到尤五在他自己家所说的“送鬼出门”这句话，胡雪岩恍然了。

Those “divinities” were probably members of the Small Swords Society, or at least connected with Liu Lichuan.
那班“神道”大概是“小刀会”的，不然亦必与刘丽川有关。

The thought both alarmed and pleased him.

惊的是这要“造反”，尤五和他老头子不要被牵涉了进去，

Information that helped him avoid danger and seize favourable chances could greatly benefit his trade.
避凶趋吉，对自己的生意，大有益处。

Benefits without harm!
只要益处，不要坏处！

He must discuss that carefully with You.
他在心里说，这件事倒要跟尤五好好商量一下。

好久，尤五才跟老太爷谈完话出来，

通裕比较静，谈天方便。”

Going to You's house would mean seeing A’zhu first.
话中的意思是，到他家便可以先跟阿珠见面。

Hu felt no need for that just now.
在这时来说，无此必要，

栈单交了给你！”尤五首先交代这件事。

In Hu's hands, the receipt could serve many purposes.
栈单在胡雪岩手里有许多花佯好耍，

起码也可以作为表示实力和信用的凭证，

因而他不必作不必要的客气，接过来放在一边。

栈租特别克己。

不过你能早脱手，还是早脱手的好，

丝摆下去会变黄，价钱上就要吃亏了。”

“五哥说得不错。

不过，”

Hu paused.

“I don't understand this business particularly well, but never mind.

你先讲出来再说。”

“五哥跟洋行里很熟？”

“Yes.

是不是要我介绍洋商？”

另外。我有句话，不知道该不该问？

如果不该问，五哥老实不客气告诉我。

自己弟兄，千万不要存丝毫不好意思的心。”

有时候，我不能不顾忌。

不过对你不同。”

尤五这时对胡雪岩的看法，跟刚才又不同了，

胡雪岩很严肃地点着头，

而我呢，另有生意上的打算。”

尤五不即回答，

He slowly drank some wine, chewed a piece of dried fish for a long while, spat out the residue, and then spoke.
慢慢喝了口酒，夹了一块鱼干在嘴里嚼了半天，然后吐掉了渣滓说话。

这件事，我老实告诉你好了，

The Small Swords will rise within the next few days.
小刀会就这几天要起事，

They came to invite me to join them.
他们来请我‘入伙’，

I've decided to let them do it on their own.”
我决定随他们自己去搞。”


Just as Hu had thought!
果然是这么回事！

He first offered You a toast. “You've made the right decision, Brother Five.
“五哥，”胡雪岩先敬一杯酒，“你这个主意捏得好！

浑水要泼到你身上，要躲掉也蛮难的。”

胡雪岩了解他的难处，

有外国人夹在里头，事情就难弄了。”

胡雪岩一惊，

胡雪岩不作声，

He carefully considered these words and felt that another excellent opportunity had arrived.
默默地把他的话细想了一遍，觉得又是一个绝好的机会到了。

这个好机会自然要与尤五分享，

丝的来路会断，洋庄价钱看好，

我们可以趁此赚它一票。”

不过，你倒说说看，本钱呢？”

最大的困难，就是本钱。

胡雪岩已经有了成算，但需要先打听一下尤五这方面的情形，

“你能调多少？”

“I've already renewed the hundred-thousand-tael loan from the Big Three once.

I can't renew it again.
不能再转了！

眼前我先要凑这笔款子，

哪里还谈得到别的？”

“Only half.”
“还只有一半。”

“Half means fifty thousand.
“一半就是五万。”

胡雪岩问：“三天之内你还能调多少？”

“Twenty thousand at most.”
“最多再调两万。”

“那就是七万。

Good.
好了，

Go ahead and raise it.

Do foreign trading houses lend money against goods?”
洋行里可能做押款？”

“那么请五哥去打听一下。”

这有两个办法。”

His first proposal was to pledge the goods in the Yuji Silk Warehouse for a loan from a foreign firm, turn the warehouse receipt into ready silver, and buy silk locally in Shanghai.
他的两个办法是这样：第一，他预备把存在裕记丝栈的货色作抵押，向洋行借款，把“栈革”化成现银，在上海就地收货。

如果洋行借不到，再向钱庄去接头。

Hu smiled, a little sheepishly.

栈单给他们瞧一瞧，货色又在丝栈里不曾动，他们自然放心。

哪晓得我的栈单已经抵押了出去？”尤五也笑了：

第二办法，一直是胡雪岩的理想，丝商联合起来跟洋行打交道，然后可以制人而非制于人，

胡雪岩的打算是用尤五的关系和他自己的口才，说服在上海的同行——预备销洋庄的“丝客人”，彼此台作。

第一个，我们先付定金，或者四分之一，或者三分之一，货色就归我们，

等半年以后付款提货。

第二个办法是联络所有的丝客人，相约不卖，

照胡雪岩的办法，十万银子就可以做五十万银子的生意，

赚来的钱对分，每人有五万银子，

我们啥时候动身到上海？”

He called her in.
便喊住她说：

“Miss Zhang, I have something to tell you.”
“张小姐，我有句话告诉你。”

Considering herself Hu's woman, A’zhu used his form of address.
阿珠自以为胡雪岩的人，所以跟他用一样的称呼，

“Brother Five!” she said, and entered to sit beside her Fifth Sister-in-Law.
叫一声“五哥！”接着便走了进来，挨着“五嫂”一起坐下。

In her presence, however, You did not refer to Hu as “Young Uncle.”
在她面前，尤五却不叫胡雪岩为“小爷叔”，

“Xueyan asked me to tell you that he won't be visiting today.
他说：“雪岩托我告诉你一声，他今天不来看你了，

He has something to attend to this evening.”
因为晚上还有一件事要料理。”

A’zhu was naturally disappointed, but she told herself that he had many things to do and ought to be forgiven.
阿珠自然失望，不过心里在想：他事情多，应该原谅他。

She nodded.
所以点点头，

“I understand.”
“我晓得了。”

“He's leaving tomorrow, and I'm going with him.
“他明天动身，我跟他一起走。

I'm afraid he won't have time to see you before we leave, either.”
走以前，恐惶也没有工夫跟你见面。”

This was strange.
这话就奇怪了：

“Aren't we all going to Shanghai together?”
“我们不是一起到上海吗？”

“No,” You replied.
“不！”尤五答道：

“He means you to stay here with us.”
“他的意思，让你住在我这里。”

“Stay here,” Mrs You added, taking her hand.
“你就住在我们这里。”尤太太拉一拉她的手，接着她丈夫的话说，

“In a few days I'm going to Shanghai too.
“过几天我也要到上海，

You can come with me, and we'll enjoy ourselves.”
你跟我去，我们去玩我们的。”

A’zhu held back the tears welling in her eyes.
阿珠一泡泪，忍住在眼眶里。

The kinder her hosts were, the more hateful Hu seemed.
越是居停情重，越觉得胡雪岩可恶。

It looked as though his feelings for her were changing!
看起来他有些变心了！


“Miss Zhang, I'm meeting him early tomorrow.
“张小姐，明天一早，我就要跟他碰头，

Is there anything you'd like me to tell him?
你有什么话要跟他说？

I'll pass it on.”
我替你转到。”

“No!”
“没有！”

A’zhu's anger made her answer sharply.
阿珠因为负气，语气很硬，

As soon as she spoke, she felt it was wrong to treat You that way.
说出口来，自己觉得很不应该这样子对尤五，

She hastily softened her voice.
因而赶紧又用很漫柔的声音说：

“Thank you, Brother Five.
“谢谢你，五哥！

There's nothing I want to say to him.”
我没有什么话想跟他说。”

“Very well.
“好！

I'll tell him exactly that.”
我就把你这句话说给他听。”

Now she felt uneasy again.
这下，阿珠又有些不安了，

She was angry and even wanted to scold Hu to his face, but she did not want other people carrying her angry words back and forth.
她自己负气，甚至于见着胡雪岩的面，想骂他几句，但不愿旁人把她的气话传来传去。

Nor could she make out what You meant, so she could hardly say more.
不过她也弄不懂尤五的意思，不便再有所表示，

She merely asked, “What about my father and Chen Shilong?
只问：“我爹和陈世龙呢？

Are they leaving too?”
他们是不是一起走。”

“Of course.
“当然。

There's a great deal to do in Shanghai, and we're short of people.
上海有许多事情在那里，人手不够，

How could they stay behind?”
他们怎好不去。”

“All right.
“好的。

Then I'll go to the boat tomorrow to see my father.”
那我明天到船上去看我爹。”

Her mind was made up.
她已打定了主意，

Once aboard, she would surely meet Hu, and she would teach him a lesson.
明天到了船上，总可以遇见胡雪岩，一定要拿点颜色给他看，

What sort of lesson she had not yet decided.
是怎样的颜色，她却还不知道，

She would have to think it over.
得要慢慢去想了再说。


“What hot weather!”
“天气真热！”

Mrs You rose, still holding her hand.
尤太太拉着她的手站了起来，

“Let's cool off in the pavilion.”
“我们到亭子里乘凉去。”

The You family's back garden had its share of pleasant flowers and trees, as well as an artificial hill with a pavilion on top.
尤家后园，小有花木之胜，还有一座假山，山上一座亭子，

Its name was odd: the Bumai, or “No Purchase,” Pavilion, presumably because a clear breeze and a bright moon cost nothing to enjoy.
题名甚怪，叫做“不买亭”，大概是取“清凤明月不费一文钱买”的意思，

Oddly named though it was, the pavilion had a pleasingly simple, old-fashioned design and an excellent position.
但题名虽怪，亭子倒构筑得相当古朴，而且地势极好，

From its height, the green fields and distant mountains made a delightful prospect.
登高远眺，绿野遥山，颇能赏心悦目。

The garden wall was low.
园子的围墙不高，

Those on the hill could see passers-by, while those passing below could glimpse only the women's hair and graceful silhouettes inside the pavilion.
假山上望得见行人，行人只望得见亭子里的鬓丝丽影。

In a strictly proper household, the women would not have been allowed up there.
在谨饬的人家，这座亭子是不宜女眷登临的，

You's family was different.
但尤五家与众不同，

Its women never hid themselves from view, and no outsider dared entertain designs on them.
女眷向不避人，而外人也不敢订尤家女眷什么主意，

Since her arrival, A’zhu had therefore gone almost every evening with Mrs You to enjoy the cool air in the Bumai Pavilion.
所以从阿珠来了以后，几乎每天晚上都随着尤太太在“不买亭”纳凉。


They were often joined by You's younger sister, seventh among the children, whom the household called the Seventh Lady.
经常在一起的，还有尤五的一个妹妹，行七，尤家都叫她“七姑奶奶”。

Widowed young, she had quarrelled with her parents-in-law and returned to her own family.
七站奶奶早年居孀，与翁姑不和，住在娘家，

She was about thirty and strikingly beautiful.
三十岁左右，长得极艳，

Sitting in silence, she was a woman of exceptional loveliness; once she opened her mouth, she could frighten timid men away.
但坐在那里不讲话，是个绝色美人，一开口出来，会把胆小的男人吓走，

She had a man's bold, forthright manner and a strong flavour of the rougher world beyond respectable society.
因为她伉爽有须眉气概，而且江湖气极重，

Her speech was sharp and her face expressive: she could lower her brows, glare, and look positively murderous.
不独言词犀利，表情丰富，横眉瞪眼，杀气腾腾，

What men found hardest to bear was her utterly unguarded tongue, especially when she was abusing someone.
最让男人吃不消的是，口没遮拦，骂人也是如此，

There was no coarse expression she would not use.
什么“蠢话”都说得出口，

Her sister-in-law therefore called her “the female Zhang Fei,” after the famously fierce and outspoken warrior.
所以她嫂子叫她“女张飞”。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十二章（中）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Twelve, middle part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


The female Zhang Fei had a warm heart and was particularly fond of A’zhu.
“女张飞”心肠热，跟阿珠尤其投缘，

Seeing the unhappiness that flickered across the girl's face, she could not help asking, “What's the matter?
一看她眉宇之间，隐现幽怨，忍不住要问：“怎么了，

Tell me what's troubling you.”
有啥心事，跟我说！”

How could A’zhu confide in anyone about this, especially her?
这心事如何肯与人说？尤其是在她面前，阿珠更有顾虑。

“Nothing, nothing!”
“没有，没有！”

She did her best to sound carefree.
她竭力装得很轻松的，

“I couldn't be more comfortable here.
“住在你们这里，再‘笃定’不过，

What could trouble me?”
有啥心事？”

“There's something I don't understand.”
“我倒不懂了。”

The Seventh Lady spoke her mind without much thought for the consequences.
七姑奶奶心直口快，说话不大考虑后果，

“Since your Mr Hu has arrived, why hasn't he come to see you?”
“你们那位胡老爷，既然来了，怎不来看你呢？”

A’zhu was deeply embarrassed.
这一问阿珠大窘，

Alarmed, Mrs You hurried to stop her.
而尤太太大为着急，赶紧拦着她说：

“There you go again!
“你又来了！

A true headstrong Zhang Fei.”
真正是莽张飞。”

“Why?
“咦！

What's wrong with asking?”
这话有啥问不得？”

Mrs You was no fool either.
尤太太也是很厉害的角色，

Seeing how matters stood, she suddenly decided to use the female Zhang Fei to her advantage.
一看这样子，灵机一动，索性要利用“女张飞”，

She sighed deliberately.
“唉！”她故意叹口气，

“Every household has its own difficult scripture to recite.
“家家有本难念的经，

We must try to persuade our Sister Zhang to understand Mr Hu's difficulties.”
我们总要相劝张家妹子体谅胡老板。”

To speak of understanding and persuasion implied that Hu was at fault.
一说“体谅”，再说“相劝”，这就见得错在胡雪岩。

While A’zhu was still considering those words, the Seventh Lady could contain herself no longer.
阿珠还在玩味她这两句后，七姑奶奶忍不住了，

Taking her hand and looking straight at her, she said, “Of course something's troubling you!
拉住她的手，逼视着说道：“你明明有心事，

You've been badly treated.
有委屈嘛！

However busy he is, he can't spare a moment to see you?
不管再忙，说来见个面都抽不出工夫，

Tell that to the ghosts!
这话除非骗鬼！

Men are contemptible creatures.
男人都是犯贱的，

When they want you, you're an empress.
想你的时候，你就是皇后娘娘，

Once they change their minds, you can kowtow to them and get a fist in return.
一变了心，你给他磕头，他给你拳头。

I've seen plenty of that sort.”
这种人我见得多了。”


“My dear lady, my dear lady!”
“姑奶奶，姑奶奶！”

Mrs You sounded almost as though she were pleading for mercy.
尤太太仿佛告饶似地说，

“Will you spare me?
“你饶了我好不好？

What is all this shouting about?”
你这么大声小叫，算怎么回事？”

“Very well!”
“好！”

The Seventh Lady lowered her voice but spoke still faster and more urgently.
七姑奶奶把声音低了下来，但说得更快更急，

Holding A’zhu with one hand, she pointed at her sister-in-law with the other.
一只手把着阿珠，一只手指着她嫂了：

“Sister Zhang couldn't have made it clearer.
“张家妹子说得再清楚都没有了，

He agreed to establish a household in each place.
既然答应好两处立门户，

Why hasn't it been done long ago?
早就应该办好了，为啥到现在不办？

Now he comes to Songjiang and won't even see her.
索性到了松江都不肯见一面，

What is that supposed to mean?”
这算是啥？”

Turning to A’zhu, she continued, “I thought there was something wrong from the beginning and felt it unfair to you.
说到这里，她转过脸来，对阿珠说：“我老早就觉得这件事不大对，替你不平，

At first I wondered whether I'd misjudged him.
先还怕是我想错了，

Now it's plain enough: a devoted woman and a faithless man!”
照现在看，果不其然是‘痴心女子负心汉’！”

“Headstrong Zhang Fei, headstrong Zhang Fei!
“莽张飞啊莽张飞！

You really are...”
你真正是……”

Mrs You left the sentence unfinished.
尤太太不说下去了。

Listening beside them, A’zhu felt acutely uncomfortable, though she could not immediately tell whether the cause was the Seventh Lady or Hu.
阿珠在旁边听得心里好不舒服！但是这不舒服是由七姑奶奶，还是由胡雪岩而来。一时之间，她却弄不明白。

Ashamed and angry, she shifted quietly until her face was in shadow, hidden from the two women.
反正义羞又气，觉得忸怩得很，只有悄悄将身子挪一挪，把自己的脸避到暗处，不为她们姑嫂所见。


They would not allow even that.
她们姑嫂却偏不容她如此，

Both turned towards her.
双双转过脸来看着她，

Taking her other hand, Mrs You comforted her. “Sister Zhang, don't listen to her.
“张家妹子”，尤太太握住她另一只手，安慰她说：“你不要听她的话！

That's her nature: the moment she opens her mouth, she offends someone.”
脾气生就，开出口来就得罪人。”

A’zhu now had to be gracious.
这一来，阿珠倒不能不说客气话了，

“Seventh Sister means well by me.
“七姐也是为我。”她点点头，

I don't blame her.”
“我不会怪她的。”

“That's a fair-minded thing to say!”
“你说话有良心！”

The Seventh Lady looked still more indignant on her behalf.
七姑奶奶越发义形于色，

“This concerns your whole life.
“这是你终身大事，

Now that we've brought it into the open, let's think it through properly.” She asked Mrs You, “What exactly is Mr Hu thinking, behaving like this?”
既然说破了，我们索性替你好好想一想。”她问她嫂子。“胡老板这样子，到底存着什么心思？”

“Nine out of ten of your questions are impossible to answer,” Mrs You replied with a smile.
尤太太笑道，“你问的话，十句有九句叫人没法回答。

“Still...” She deliberately stopped and watched A’zhu carefully, trying to read her feelings.
不过她故意不说下去，很谨慎地看着阿珠的脸色，想知道她心里的感觉。

That was not easy.
这当然不容易看出来，

A’zhu considered their concern unnecessary and maintained her composure as a way of refusing their kindness.
因为阿珠觉得她们的关切，事属多余，所以极力保持平静，作为一种拒绝“好意”的表示。


The Seventh Lady hardly understood this signal; even if she had, it would not have restrained her tongue.
七姑奶奶不甚明白她的意思，就明白也拦不住她自己的嘴，

Assuming a gentler manner, she said, “Sister Zhang, you're such a fine young woman.
“张家妹子”，她换了比较文静的态度，“不是我说，你一表人才，

Why accept an inferior place?”
何苦委屈自己？”

Hearing her express the same view as her brother, Mrs You saw a chance to speak through her.
尤太太一听她的话，与她哥哥的意思一佯，正好借她的口来为自己表达，

When A’zhu remained silent, she supplied the next line like a performer in a duet.
所以看阿珠不答，便似唱戏对口一般，有意接一句：

“What do you mean, an inferior place?”
“怎么叫委屈自己？”

“Bowing and scraping as a lesser wife—isn't that accepting an inferior place?”
“做低服小，难道不是委屈自己！”

The speaker meant no particular wound, but her listener felt one.
言者无意，听者有心，

The words touched A’zhu's hidden sore, and composure became impossible.
这句话正触着阿珠的“隐痛”，要想保持平静也不可能了。

“Besides, it might be tolerable if the wife were good-tempered.
“再说，如果太太脾气好，也还罢了，

Otherwise, lowering yourself like that is simply pressing your warm face against someone's cold backside.”
不然做低服小，就是热面孔贴人的冷屁股。”

Another of her coarse expressions!
“蠢话”又来了！

Mrs You had repeatedly warned her that their guest was a young lady and such language must be restrained.
尤太太已经一再告诫过这位姑奶奶，人家是“大小姐”身份，不登大雅的话要少说，

Yet nature would have its way.
谁知到底还是本性难移。

Just now, however, she needed the Seventh Lady as her supporting player and could not stop to scold.
不过这时候要用她来做“配角”，也顾不得指责，

She merely sighed.
只叹口气说：“唉！

“Yes, that's precisely Mr Hu's difficulty.”
正就是为此，人家胡老板为难。”

There was a meaning behind this that A’zhu must discover, but someone else asked for her.
话里有话，阿珠必得问个究竟，不过用不着她费心，自有人代劳，

“What?
“怎么？”

Is the woman at home a tigress?”
七姑奶奶问：“胡家那个是雌老虎？”

“From what Mr Hu says, she's very fierce.”
“听胡老板的意思，厉害得很！”

“Then he's at fault!
“那就是他不对了！

既然家里有个醋坛，为啥来骗我们张家妹子？”

“这我倒要为胡老板说句公平话，”尤太太很认真地说，

“He intended to settle matters with his wife before holding the wedding.
“原来是想跟他太太商量好了，再办喜事，

When she wouldn't agree, he had to retreat.
商量不通，只好打退堂鼓。

That's hardly deception.”
这也不算骗人。”


“What?” A’zhu exclaimed.
“什么？”阿珠失声问道，

“Fifth Sister-in-Law, how do you know?”
“五嫂，你怎么知道？”

“Her brother—Brother Five—told me everything.” Mrs You indicated the Seventh Lady.
“她五哥，”尤太太指着七姑奶奶说，“都告诉我了。

“Mr Hu really does have difficulties.
胡老板实在有难处，

He couldn't bring himself to tell you, but keeping them to himself was no solution either, so he spoke to a close friend.
话又跟你说不出口，闷在心里不是回事，只好跟好朋友谈谈。

Don't worry, Sister Zhang.
张家妹子，你不要着急，

We'll think of a way.”
我们慢慢想办法。”

What way?
想什么办法？

The meaning was unclear, and A’zhu's mind was too tangled to examine it.
语意不明，而阿珠心乱如麻，也无法细想，

Her sole wish was to speak to Hu face to face.
此时她唯一的意愿是要跟胡雪岩当面谈一谈。

“There's always a way.
“办法总有的。

We needn't stand on ceremony with a heartless man.
对付没良心的男人，不必客气。

But...”
不过，”

The Seventh Lady lowered her voice.
七姑奶奶低声向阿珠问道：

“Tell me honestly.
“你要说句实话，

You've travelled back and forth together on the boat and stayed in the same place in Huzhou.
你们船上来来去去，在湖州又住在一起，

Have you and he ever...”
你到底跟他……”

Before she could finish, A’zhu cried out in embarrassment and alarm.
不等她说完，阿珠便又羞又急地叫了起来，

“No!”
“没有！”

Afraid they might not believe her, she spoke with absolute firmness.
她的语气异常决绝，唯恐他人不信：

“Absolutely not!
“绝对没有！

I'm not that sort of girl.”
我不是那种人。”

“I know, I know.”
“我晓得，我晓得。”

The Seventh Lady sounded greatly relieved.
七姑奶奶很欣慰地说，

“If he hasn't taken advantage of you, things are easier still.”
“没有吃他的亏，就更加好办了。”

“对！”尤太太附和，

“This isn't such a difficult affair yet.
“这件事还不算麻烦。

It all depends on you.”
全在你自己身上。”

Again there was a deeper meaning for A’zhu to consider, but the Seventh Lady talked too much to give her time.
这话又有深意了，阿珠得好好想一想，可是七姑奶奶的话实在多，不容她有细想的工夫。


“It's fortunate you found out early,” she said.
“幸亏发觉得早！”她说，

“Out of ten men, eleven want something new.
“你想想，男人十个有十一个好新鲜，

If he's treating you like this before he's even won you over, imagine what he'll do once he's had his way.
还没有上手，对你已经这个样子，等一上了手，尝过甜头，

He'll cast you aside, and then even your tears will do no good.”
还不是一丢了事。那时候，你就朝他哭都没有用。”

She considered this restrained language, but A’zhu, who understood relations between men and women only imperfectly, flushed and lowered her head, not knowing where to look.
她已经算是措词是含蓄了，但已把男女间事似解非解的阿珠听得红晕忸怩得不知如何是好。

Coarse though the female Zhang Fei's words were, they revealed a side of the matter she had never grasped.
低着头想想，“女张飞”的话虽粗鲁，却说中了她从未了解过的一面，

She had heard that men tired of the familiar and sought the new, but never had it been explained so plainly.
男人喜新厌旧，这话听人说过，只不如她来得透彻。

She remembered how Hu had sometimes overstepped the bounds, pressing further and further, and how she had stood firm when it mattered.
转念到此，想起胡雪岩几次“不规矩”，得寸进尺地到了紧要关头，总算自己还守得住，

真正是做对了！

庆幸之念一生，就不觉得那么羞窘了，

同时也不是那么一颗心系在胡雪岩身上，丝毫不能动弹了，

她抬起脸来，掠一掠鬓发，喝了口败毒消火的“金银花茶”，

平静地问道：“五嫂，七姐，你们说替我想办法，

想什么办法？”

尤太太是等着她来问这句话的，

这到了关系出入的地方，言语必须谨慎，

你说往东，替你想东的路子，

你说往西，我们来看看，往西走不走得通？”

这话阿珠明白，

七姑奶奶终于忍不住了，

“Fifth Sister-in-Law is absolutely right.

我们娇滴滴一朵鲜花，又不是落市的鱼鲜，怕摆不起，要硬挜给他！”

你想明白了。”七姑奶奶说，

何必再骂胡雪岩，徒结冤家？

他也是力不从心，不肯耽误张家妹子的青春，

你不要冤枉他。”

七姑奶奶有样好处，勇于认错。

阿珠的一颗心，一直动荡不定，只随着她们姑嫂俩的话，浮沉摆动。

“What are you crying for?”
“你哭点啥？”

“不要伤心，不要伤心！”尤太太也劝她，

“路差点走错，及早回头，

阿珠心想，怎么高兴得起来？

The Seventh Lady had said Hu's efforts had come to nothing.
七姑奶奶说胡雪岩费心费力一场空，

自己何尝不是？

这日子怎么过法？

她一个人怔怔地在想心事，尤太太使趁此机会给她小姑抛了个眼色过去，意思是不必再多说了。

但七姑奶奶却不明用意：

趁她起身去倒茶时，跟了过去，悄悄问道：“你有话要跟我说？”

就怕你嘴快！”尤太太说，

“他！”七姑奶奶惊喜地喊了起来。

尤太太埋怨她说，

“A true headstrong Zhang Fei!

一点都不晓得顾忌。”

七姑奶奶把声音放得极低。

尤太太很注意地问，

尤太太长于机变，便编了一套话，支吾了过去。

尤太太白天操持家务，相当劳累，

也去睡吧！”

我常常跟你说这句话，你总不大肯听。”

一点不会有虚伪。”

这该怎么说呢？

世间有许多事是只能在心里想，不能在口中说的，

这番道理阿珠懂，但讲不明白、

这有些说对了，可是不会承认，

语涉讽刺。 阿珠脸上有些挂不住了。

尤家倒不拿她当客人看，

等她漱洗出房，厅里已摆好早饭，尤太太和七姑奶奶已端起碗在吃了。

一定一夜没有睡着，

来，吃了早饭再去睡。

“阿珠不作声，只看着早饭发愁。

松江出米，一早就吃炒饭，

她的胃口不开，只想喝碗汤，吃不下饭。

“Go on without me.
“你们吃吧，”

I'm not hungry.”
他说，“我不饿！”

尤太太一听这话，便放下筷子，伸手到她额上摸了一下，又试试自己的额头，

皱眉说道，“你有点发烧，

请个郎中来看一看吧！”

“不要，不要！”

A’zhu felt she was not ill.

“I'm perfectly well.

五嫂也真想得出。”

“那么先弄点药来吃。”

The You household kept a great many prepared medicines, brought back by grain boats travelling north and south from famous shops in the capital such as Tongrentang and Xi Heniantang.
尤家成药最多。都是漕船南来北往，从京里有名的“同仁堂”、“西鹤年堂”等等有名的大药铺中，买了带回来。

They boiled a piece of shenqu, a medicinal ferment, with mature ginger and red dates and gave her the strong decoction.
当时便用老姜、红枣煎了一块“神曲”，浓浓地服了下去。

She perspired a little and felt much better, but her mind was weary, her eyes heavy and sore.
出了些汗。觉得舒服得多，但神思倦怠、双眼涩重，

All she wanted was a good sleep.
只想好好睡一觉。


Yet something remained unsettled.
但她心里还有事放不下，

She wanted to see her father but feared meeting Hu.
想去看看她父亲，却又怕遇见胡雪岩，

Everything she had planned in the night had been overturned.
夜里所想的那一套，此刻整个儿推翻了，

She could not understand what frightened her: a quarrel with Hu that might bring trouble on her parents, a shock she could not bear, or even the thought of making Hu uncomfortable face to face?
她自己都不明白，怕的是什么呢？是怕跟胡雪岩翻脸，以至于为她家父母带来纠纷，还是怕自己受不住刺激？甚至是怕胡雪岩面对面为难受窘？

Tired but unable to find peace, she was unbearably restless.
精神不好，偏偏心境又不能宁境，烦得不知如何是好呢。

How she regretted this journey!
想想真懊悔有此一行！

At least beside her mother, a fit of temper or a good cry would offer some release.
不管怎么样，在自己娘身边，就算发顿脾气，哭一场，也是一种发泄。

Here there was nobody to ease her unhappiness, and she had to force herself to maintain the proper manner of a guest.
现在不但没有人可为她遣愁解闷，还得强打精神，保侍一个做客人的样子，

It was misery.
其苦不堪！

Again she resented Hu.
想想又要恨胡雪岩了！

He himself had told her father to let her visit Shanghai.
是他自己跟她父亲说的，让她到上海来玩一趟。

What was the meaning of bringing her along and then abandoning her?
带了出来，却又这样一丢了事，这算是哪一出？

别的都不必说，光问他这一点好了。

If he could give no satisfactory answer, she would use it to mock him sharply and release some of the anger pent up since yesterday.
如果他说不出个究竟，便借这个题目，狠狠挖苦他几句，也出出从昨天闷到此刻的一口气。

这样想着，精神不自觉地亢奋了，

于是趁七姑奶奶不在场，向尤太太说道：“五嫂，我想去看看我爹。

Please send someone with me.”
请你派个人陪了我去。”

“Of course.
“那现在。

But you're not well, and there's no harm in waiting.
不过你身体不大好，不去也不要紧，

We're going to Shanghai in a few days.
反正我们过几天就要到上海，

You can meet him then.”
那时候再碰头好了。”

“I'd better go.
“还是去一趟的好，

Otherwise he'll worry.”
不然我爹会记挂我。”

说到这个理由，尤太太不便再劝阻，

She was looking for someone to accompany A’zhu to Old Zhang's boat when Chen arrived.
正在找人要陪她到老张船上，恰好陈世龙来了。

“来得巧！”尤太太一本正经地向他说：

“Take good care of her on the way to her father.
“你好好陪了她去看她爹，

Keep to the shade.
拣荫凉地方走！

She's feverish.”
她在发烧。”

两个人一前一后出了尤家，拣人家檐下，阳光晒不到的地方走。

陈世龙照顾得很周到，三步一回首地探视，口中不断在说：“走好走好！”

Their manner was neither that of brother and sister nor of husband and wife, and people stared.
那样子既不象兄妹，又不象夫妇，引得许多人注目。

阿珠有些发窘，心里嗔怪：

It was broad daylight and an easy road.
又不是黑夜，路也很好走，

Why call out all the way as though deliberately trying to attract attention?
何苦这样一路喊过去，倒象是有意要引人来看似的。

走出巷子，豁然开朗，临河是一条静悄悄的路。

阿珠遥望着泊在柳荫下的船，忽然停住了脚，喊一声：

“喂！”

Chen turned at the sound.
陈世龙闻声回头，奇怪地问道：

“你在跟哪个招呼？”

“There's nobody else here.
“这里又没有第三个人，

你的话问得可要发噱？”

“原来是叫我。

Have you something to say?”
有话说？”

“Naturally.
“自然有话说，

Why else would I stop you?”
不然叫住你做啥。”

阿珠想了想问道：

“你有没有听见什么话？

“What sort of thing?
““什么话？

From whom?”
听哪个说？”

She was growing angry.
阿珠有些生气了。

陈世龙才明白，

他的话很多，

不知道你问的哪一方面？”

只说要赶到上海去接头生意，过几天再来接你，

这当然不大对！”

听得这句批评，阿珠心里舒服了些，

说到“欺侮”，又想起胡雪岩的无端变心，

顿觉百脉偾张，眼眶发热，一下忍不注，

便顿着足，且哭且说：“他是存心好了的，

有意欺侮我！

有意把我丢在半路上！

他死没良心！”

陈世龙有些发慌，也有些伤心。

从湖州一路来，他下了许多功夫，谁知她一寸芳心，仍旧在胡雪岩身上。

不过转念一想，他把已馁之气又鼓了起来，

女人的委屈，最伯郁积在心里，朝思暮想，深刻入骨，

那就不容把她的一颗心扳转来，

因此，他默不作声，只把雪白的一方大手帕，递过去让她擦眼泪。

Somehow that small gesture made an impression on her and stirred a memory: when they had gone into town together in Huzhou, he had always offered just such a handkerchief to wipe away the sweat.
这个小小的动作，不知怎么，在阿珠的心里居然留下了一个印象，同时也唤起了回忆，想起在湖州一起上街，他总是拿这样一方手帕，供她拭汗。

心无二用，

一想到别的地方，便不知不觉地收住了眼泪，

没有什么好说的。”

阿珠这样叮嘱，

走吧！”

在别人家作客……”

爹不要冤枉人家。”

不然不会好端端地想家。”

等事情弄得略有些头绪了，再来接你，好好去玩两天。

这话没有啥不在道理上，

你很明白的人都想不通？”

阿珠一面听着，一面在心里冷笑，

听完，愤愤地说道：“他这张嘴真会说！

骗死人，不偿命。

You're the only one who still believes him.”
现在也只有你相信他了。”

“怎么？”

老张大为惊诧，

看她不答，便又转脸来问陈世龙：

陈世龙自不便实说，但光是用“不知道”来推托，也不是办法，

想了想，觉得最好避开，让他们父女私下去谈。

于是他说：“你问张小姐自己！”

接着，走出船舱，上了跳板，在柳荫下纳凉。

“阿珠！”船里的老张神色严重地问：“到底怎么回事，

Tell me.”
你倒说给我听听看。”

How?
怎么说？

Say that the man no longer wanted her?
说人家不要我了？

这话似乎自己作践自己，她不肯出口。

如说胡雪岩变心了，

It was too vague.
话不够清楚，

If her father insisted on getting to the bottom of it, she would still have no answer.
打破沙锅问到底，依然难以回答。

因而阿珠觉得很为难。

老张听不懂她的话，着急的说，

“Can't you speak plainly?
“你爽爽快快的说好不好？

到底为了啥？”

“Don't ask me.

你不会去问他？”

老张埋怨他女儿，

“You must learn to control your temper.

先听她爹的两句话，阿珠忍不住又要发火，但最后一句让她心软了，

到底还是亲人！

With parents like hers, she had been born under a fortunate star.
自己有这一双爹娘，总算“八字”不错。

这佯一转念，心境不由得变为豁达，

提不起，放不下的事，此时也提得起，放得下了！

“It's nothing so very serious!”
“没有什么大不了的！”

Unconsciously infected by the Seventh Lady's manner, she drew herself up with manly defiance and spoke loudly.
她不知不觉的受了七姑奶奶的感染，挺起胸来，摆出须眉气概，高声说道，

吵不出名堂来的，

看他到晚来睡在床上，自己摸摸良心，难过不难过？”

怎么一下子决裂得如此？

阿珠正找不到一句话可以开口，心里说不出的不对劲，

从今天起，就要叫她一颗心放在自己身上。

竟是这样一句话！

阿珠听人说话，有时不听意思，只听语气，

胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十二章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Twelve, concluding part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳

陈世龙颇有同感，

他也吃不消七姑奶奶。

现在要在阿珠身上下功夫，不能不多去。

这倒是个难题。

看他不说话，她觉得再坐下去也没有意思，

我还有话说。”

阿珠不即回答，

他是在自己身上打主意，当然有些紧要的话要说。

目己跟胡雪岩就是这样好起来的，

前车不远，应当警惕，

如果自己根据不容他打什么主意，那就不如趁早躲开。

这也没有什么不好。
