道谢以后，高声喊道：“你来看看！

You're fortunate indeed.
你真好福气，

Your mother has never worn jewellery as fine as this.”
你娘也不曾戴过这样好的首饰。”


Hidden in the after cabin and peering through a crack, A’zhu was already deeply moved.
躲向后舱，在缝隙中张望的阿珠，原来就激动得不得了，

At those words from her father, something swept through her heart, and hot tears suddenly covered her face.
一听她爹这两句，不知怎么心里一阵发麻，滚烫的眼泪一下子流得满脸，

She could not suppress her sobs.
同时忍不住发出哽咽的声音。

“Why, what's the matter...?”
“咦！好端端地……”

“Don't question her.”
“不要去说她！”

Hu waved a hand, interrupting Old Zhang.
胡雪岩摇手打断老张的话，

“She's probably feeling sorry for her mother.”
“阿珠大概是替她娘委屈。”

The words touched A’zhu's heart exactly.
阿珠觉得这句话正碰在心坎上，

Whether she felt gratitude towards her parents or towards Hu, she could not have said.
也不知是感激亲恩还是感激胡雪岩，

She simply lay down on her berth and wept.
索性倒在床上，呜呜咽咽地哭个不住。

The more she cried, the more relieved and confident she became.
心里是越哭越痛快，越器越胆大，

When she had finished, she wiped her eyes and walked openly into the cabin.
哭完了擦擦眼睛，大大方方地走了出去，

She was still too embarrassed to smile, however, and sat with a solemn face, waiting for her father or Hu to speak so that she could join in.
不过笑总还不好意思笑，绷着脸坐在那里，预备等他爹或者胡雪岩一开口，便好搭腔。

Hu obliged.
胡雪岩说了话：

“A’zhu, where's the tea you made us?”
“阿珠，你替我们泡的茶呢？”

“Oh dear, I'd forgotten!”
“啊呀！我倒忘记了。”

She rose.
阿珠站起身来，

“I'm afraid it's cold.”
“只怕已经凉了。”

“Cold tea is just what we want.
“就是凉茶好！

Bring it here.”
你拿来吧！”

She fetched it and poured a cup for Hu, then one for her father.
于是阿珠去取了茶来，倒一杯结胡雪岩，再倒一杯结她父亲，

Chen sat shyly to one side, looking very much like a bridegroom.
还有腼腼腆腆坐在一旁，蛮象个新郎官的陈世龙。

After a little hesitation, she poured him a cup too.
她迟疑了一会，终于替他倒了一杯，

She neither carried it over nor spoke, merely pushing it towards the edge of the table to indicate that he should take it himself.
只是不曾亲自捧给他，也没有开口，把茶杯往外移了移，示意他自己来取。


“Look for yourself.
“你自己看看！

Do you like them?”
中意不中意？”

Hu opened the presentation box.
胡雪岩把拜厘打了开来。

Faced with the glitter of pearls and gems, A’zhu was astonished.
望着那一片珠光宝气，阿珠反倒愣住了。

Were these really hers?
这是我的东西？她这样在心里自问，

She could scarcely believe it.
仿佛有些不大能相信它是真的。

“Never display your wealth!”
“财不露白！”

Old Zhang's long experience of the world made him genuinely uneasy.
久历江湖的老张，还真有些害怕，

“Put them away carefully.
“好好收起来，

You can look when you get home.”
到家再看。”

She had to obey, though reluctantly.
这一说，阿珠不能不听，但不免怏怏，

Closing the box, she lowered her head and said softly, “Mr Hu, thank you.”
盖好拜盒，低着头轻轻说了句，“胡先生，谢谢你！”

“A mere trifle!”
“小意思，小意思，”

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地说：

“When Shilong prospers, he'll buy you diamonds.”
“等世龙将来发达了，给你买金刚钻。”

Old Zhang too was moved, and his words now came more readily. “Shilong, you must never forget how well Mr Hu has treated you both.
“世龙！”老张也有些激动，口齿亦变得伶俐了，“胡先生待你们这样子好，你总要切记在心里，

You must repay him.”
报答胡先生。”

Chen nodded earnestly.
陈世龙深深点头，

While he was trying to find words that would express his gratitude, Hu spoke first.
正在想找一句能够表达自己感激的话来说明，胡雪岩先开了口。

“That isn't entirely right, Old Zhang.
“老张，你这话不完全对，

There's no question of repayment.
谈不到什么报答！

I've asked you to help me, and naturally I regard you as family.
我请你们帮我的忙，自然当你们一家人看，

We share good fortune and bad.
祸福同当，

If we run the business well, everyone benefits.
把生意做好了，大家都有好处。

Now...”
好了，”

He gave Old Zhang a meaningful glance.
他向老张使个眼色，

“Let's go to bed.
“我们上床吧，

A’zhu and Shilong can sort out our things so that we can part tomorrow morning.”
让阿珠和世龙替我们把东西理一理齐，明天上午好分手。”


He deliberately gave them a chance to be alone and exchange a few heartfelt words.
这是有意让他们能够单独相处，说几句知心话。

Chen took a lamp and saw the men to their berths.
陈世龙掌灯把他们送回铺位，

Returning, he first shut the cabin window, then placed a mirror on the table.
走回来先把船窗关上，然后取了一面镜子放在桌上，

“Do try on the jewellery,” he said gently.
温柔地说道：“这些首饰，你倒戴起来看看！”

Nothing could have pleased her more.
这是极可人意的话，

She opened the box and first put on the jadeite earrings shaped like autumn leaves.
阿珠听他的话，打开拜匣，首先把那副翡翠秋叶的耳环戴上，

Then she slipped a gold bracelet onto each wrist and put on a ruby ring.
然后双腕套上金镯，又取了个红宝石戒指戴。

Only the pearl flowers could not be worn: they belonged in a woman's hair bun, and she still wore her hair in a braid.
只有珠花没有办法上头，因为那是戴在发髻上的，而她一直是梳的辫子。

Seated opposite, Chen watched with a delighted smile.
坐在对面的陈世龙，含笑凝视，显得异常得意。

A’zhu had never looked particularly like a girl from a modest household.
阿珠原来就不大有小家碧玉的味道，

Adorned with jewellery, her oval face seemed still more gracious and distinguished.
这一戴上首饰，越觉她那张鹅蛋脸雍容华贵，

She did not look at all like a boatman's daughter.
绝不象摇船人家的女儿。

Turning this way and that before the mirror, she suddenly stopped smiling.
在镜子里左顾右盼的阿珠，突然收敛了笑容，

Slowly, she removed the ornaments and put each away.
慢慢摘下首饰，一件件放好。

Chen was puzzled.
陈世龙倒有些奇怪了，

What had made her lose interest?
不憧她这意兴阑珊的表情，从何而来？


“You...” he began awkwardly.
“你……”他很吃力地说，

“You don't seem very happy.”
“好象有点不大高兴。”

“It's not that I'm unhappy.
“不是不高兴，

It's a pity, that's all.”
有些可惜。”

“What's a pity?” he asked anxiously.
“ 什么可惜？”陈世龙急急说道，

“Surely you don't think a woman like you is unworthy of wearing such things?”
“难道象你这样的人，还不配戴这些东西？

“That isn't what I mean.
““不是这话！

‘A capable woman doesn't keep wearing the clothes she married in.’
‘好女不穿嫁时衣’，

It's a pity you didn't buy these for me.”
这些首饰，可惜不是你买给我的。”

Her words struck him deeply.
这句话让陈世龙震动了！

His thoughts turned over and over: how could he prove himself worthy of her?
心里千周百折，一遍遍在想，要如何争气，才对得起她？

After remaining lost in thought for some time, he finally forced out an answer.
这样愣了半天，终于逼出几句答复：

“You have ambition, and so do I.
“你有志气，我也有志气！

But unless you're willing to share a few years of hardship with me, I shan't be able to buy you jewellery like this one day.”
不过，你如果不肯跟着我吃几年苦，将来想替你办这样子的首饰，是做不到的事。

“Do you think I can't bear hardship?
““你当我吃不来苦？”阿珠答一声，

Wait and see!”
“你看着好了！”

“I believe you.”
“我相信，我相信。”

Chen smiled.
陈世龙笑道，

“In truth, how could I bear to make you suffer?
“说实在的，我哪里肯让你吃苦？

As things are, the business is going very smoothly, and we should live comfortably.
照现在的样子，生意十分顺手，日子会过得很舒服。

We owe it all to Mr Hu's help.”
这都是胡先生的提拔！

“We must never forget how we began.”
““为人总不好忘本。”

At last A’zhu voiced a heartfelt thought.
阿珠终于说了一句心里的话：

“Our first duty is to look after every part of his business.
“我们总要先把他的生意，处处顾到，

Only then shall we deserve what he's done for us.”
才对得起人家。”

The night was late and still.
夜深人静，

Even though they spoke quietly, Hu could just hear them from his berth.
即令是他们低声交谈，睡在铺上的胡雪岩，依然隐约可闻，

He felt that he had managed this affair extremely well.
他觉得这件事做得极好，

Pleased with the result and proud of himself, he fell peacefully asleep, his mind free of care.
不但欣慰，而且得意，于是心无挂碍，怡然入梦。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十五章（中）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Fifteen, middle part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


On reaching Hangzhou, Hu Xueyan stopped briefly at home, then went straight to Fukang.
* * *一到杭州，胡雪岩回家坐得一坐，立刻便到阜康，

Chen Shilong had already brought the luggage there and was waiting.
陈世龙已押了行李先在那里等候。

There was a great deal of it, but everything was a present for someone.
行李虽多，尽是些送人的礼物，

With Liu Qingsheng's help, the gifts were sorted, and one of the bank's errand clerks was sent with Chen to deliver them from house to house.
由刘庆生帮着料理，一份份分配停当，派了一个“出店”陪着陈世龙一家家去分送。

Hu used the interval to hear Liu's report.
胡雪岩则趁此刻工夫，听取刘庆生的报告。

“Mr Hu, please examine the accounts first,” Liu said gravely, bringing a pile of ledgers.
“胡先生，请你先看帐。”刘庆生捧着一叠帐簿，很郑重地说。

“No hurry, no hurry.
“不忙，不忙！

Give me a general account first.”
你先跟我说说大概情形。”

“Please look at the books before we talk.”
“请你看了帐再说。”

His insistence suggested that the books themselves would show how business had gone.
听他如此坚持，料知帐傅中就可以看出生意好坏，

Hu nodded and began with the deposits.
于是他点点头先看存款。

What he saw astonished him.
一看不由得诧异了，

There were many names such as Zhang Debiao, Li Desheng, Wang Zhankui, and Zhao Huchen, with sums ranging from a few hundred to more than ten thousand taels.
存户中颇多“张得标”、“李德胜”、“王占魁”、“赵虎臣”之类的名字，存银自几百到上万不等，

Nine out of ten entries bore the brief annotation: “Long-term; no interest.”
而名下什九注着这么四个小字，“长期无息。”

“Well, well!” Hu exclaimed.
“唷，唷！”胡雪岩大为惊异，

“Fukang really is going to prosper!
“阜康真的要发财了！

How did we acquire so many accounts?”
怎么会有这么多的户头？”

With restrained pride, Liu said, “Please look at this entry too.”
“胡先生！”刘庆生矜持着说：“你再看这一笔帐。”

He turned to a payment: “Twenty-fifth day of the eighth month: paid out eleven thousand taels, principal standing in Luo Shangde's name.
他翻到的一笔帐是支出，上面写着：“八月二十五日付罗尚德名下本银一万一千两。

Interest waived.”
息免。”

“Oh!
“喔，

So Luo has withdrawn his deposit?”
原来罗尚德的那笔款子，提回去了？”

“No.
“不是！”

Luo Shangde was killed in action.
刘庆生说，“罗尚德阵亡了，

In effect, I returned the money.
银子等于是我送还的。

I don't know whether I did the right thing...”
我不知道这件事做得对不对……”


Liu explained what had happened.
刘庆生细谈这件事的经过，

On the twenty-fifth of the eighth month, two officers had come to ask whether it was true that Luo had deposited money at Fukang.
是八月二十五那天，有两个军官到阜康来问，说是听闻罗尚德曾有一笔款子存在阜康，可有其事？

They said he had been killed in action but still had relatives in Sichuan.
又说罗尚德已经阵亡，但他在四川还有亲属，

If the deposit existed, they wished to withdraw it and send it home.
如果有这笔款子，要提出来寄回去。

Luo's passbook was in Liu's keeping.
罗尚德的存折在刘庆生手里，

Had he denied the account's existence, there would have been no other witness.
倘或否认其事，别无人证。

But he refused to act that way.
但他不肯这样做，

He acknowledged it at once, produced the passbook, and verified the amount.
一口承认，同时立即取出存折，验明银数，

He made clear, however, that he could not pay out the deposit on the two men's unsupported statement.
但他表示，不能凭他们两个人的片面之词就付这笔存款。

“What should we do, then?”
“那么该怎么办呢？”

“I know that Mr Luo was a friend of Mr Liu Er at the governor's office.
“我知道罗老爷跟抚台衙门的刘二爷是朋友，

Mr Liu Er and your commanding officer must jointly give Fukang written authorisation,” Liu replied.
要刘二爷跟你们营官一起出面，出条子给阜廉。”刘庆生说：

“Provided Luo really has been killed in action and you gentlemen accept responsibility, Fukang will pay immediately.”
“只要罗老爷是真的阵亡，你们各位肯担责任，阜康立刻照付。

The two officers brought Liu Er that same day, and a joint receipt was signed.
“于是那两个军官，当天便我了刘二爷来，公同具了领条，

Liu immediately produced eleven thousand taels and offered to calculate the interest as well, but they naturally refused anything more.
刘庆生立即捧出一万一千两银子，还要算利息，人家自然不肯再要。

The following day, Zhang Debiao, Li Desheng, and the others began coming to the bank.
这样到了第二天，张得标、李德胜等等，便都上门来了。


Hu was exceedingly pleased by the story.
胡雪岩听他讲完，异常满意，

“庆生，”他说，“阜康的牌子打响了！

你做得高明之极。

““老实说，”刘庆生自己也觉得很安慰，“我是从胡先生你这里学来的窍门。

To deal honestly, one need only hold firm to one's principles.
做生意诚实不欺，只要自己一颗心把得定就可以了，

诚实不欺要叫主顾晓得，到处去讲，那得要花点心思，

我总算灵机一动，把机会抓住了。”

做生意把握机会，是第一等的学问。

“这副扭子我怕挑不下。”

“Don't worry.
“不要紧！

你只要多用心思，凡事想停当了去做，

就冒点风险也不要紧。

Everyone can do business that involves no risk.
不冒风险的生意，人人会做，

如问能够比头？

只要值得，你尽管放手去做。“

“这话就很难说了，

What counts as worthwhile and what doesn't?
怎么叫值得，怎么叫不值得？

People see things differently.”
各人看法不同。”

“In life, people seek either profit or a good name.
“人生在世，不为利，就为名。

Business is the same.
做生意也是一样，

Whether a risk is worth taking depends on whether you can gain one of the two.”
冒险值得不值得，就看你两佯当中能不能占一样？”

Hu paused and pointed to the ledger.
胡雪岩停了一下指着帐簿说，

“Take this loan.
“譬如这笔放款，

I know the borrower is a rice merchant, using the money for trade.
我知道此人是个米商，借了钱去做生意，

你就要弄弄清楚，他的米是运到什么地方？

运到不曾失守的地方，不要紧，

为啥呢，

万一这笔帐放倒了，外面说起来是：哪个要你去帮长毛？

倒帐活该！

You lose both profit and reputation.
这一来名利两失，

Naturally, that risk isn't worth taking.”
自然犯不着冒险。”

“我懂了！”刘庆生深深点头，

There must always be a way to fall back.
“凡事总要有个退步。

Even if something goes wrong, we must be able to justify ourselves openly.”
即使出了事，也能够在台面上说得过去。”

胡雪岩拍着他的肩说，

“You understand completely.

我们的生意，不管是啥，都是这个宗旨，万一失手，有话好说。

接着便谈了些业务扩充的计划，

胡雪岩因为自己在杭州只有几天耽搁，一拖便无结果，

所以或可或否，当时便要作出决定。


In the midst of their deliberations, someone came in calling, “Second Brother! Second Brother!”
正在从长计议时，只听有人一路喊了进来：“二弟，二弟！”

听这称呼便知是嵇鹤龄，

胡雪岩急忙迎了出去，

身上穿一件极挺括的紫酱色线春夹袍，外面套一件黑缎“巴图鲁”坎肩，平肩一排珊瑚套扣，

卷着袖子，露出雪白纺绸的袖头，

左手盘一对核桃，右手拿昔支湘妃竹镶翠的短烟袋，

十足一副纨袴公子的打扮，

以前的那副不修边幅的名士派头，连影子都找不到了。

“你年轻了十几岁，

差点都认不得了。”

“It's all Ruiyun!”
“都是瑞云啊！”

Ji could not suppress his delight.
嵇鹤龄有着掩抑不往的喜色，

“After dressing up the children, she insists on dressing me up too.
“打扮了几个孩子，还要打扮我。

不作无益之事，何以遣有生之涯？

这且不去说它。

我是奉命来邀客，

洋枪多多益善。
