““那是以后的事。

What about this consignment?”
目前这批枪呢？”

“Huzhou will buy it, naturally.
“这一批枪，当然是我们湖州买！

Quite apart from what these guns may achieve in future, their immediate effect on the militia's morale will be important.
有了这批洋枪，将来的效用如何，且不去说它，起码眼前就可以激励团练的士气，关系甚重。”

I can hardly imagine how pleased Zhao Jingxian will be when he hears.”
王有龄又说，“赵景贤知道了这个消息不知道会高兴成什么样子！”


“Mr Xuexuan,” Ji intervened, “if Huzhou is determined to obtain them, that isn't the way to proceed.
“雪公！”嵇鹤龄插进来说，“既然湖州志在心得，事情就不是这么个做法。

You must guard against the governor keeping this consignment for himself.
明天要防黄抚台截留这批枪，

Better say nothing for the moment.”
还是暂时不说的好。”

“When should I tell him, then?”
“那么到什么时候再说？”

“I suggest the following steps,” Ji answered deliberately.
“我看要用这么个步骤，”嵇鹤龄慢条斯理地答道，

“First, obtain a transport permit for the foreign guns from the provincial treasurer.
“先跟藩司请一张洋枪的运照，

Then collect them and send them to Huzhou.
接着了这批枪，送到湖州，

Only afterwards tell Governor Huang.
然后再跟黄抚台去说。

By that time they'll have been distributed.
那时枪支已经发了下去，

Surely he couldn't order every one called back for his own personal troops?”
莫非黄抚台倒说，通通收了回来，给他的亲兵用？”

“Exactly, exactly!” Wang agreed.
“对，对！”王有龄说，

“With the two of you advising me, nothing can go wrong.
“有你们两个人替我画策，真正是万元一失！

Come, let's drink!”
来，吃酒！“


Over their wine, Hu explained another advantage of buying the guns: it would draw the British merchants towards them and make them less inclined to deal with the Taiping leaders Hong and Yang.
一面喝酒，一面胡雪岩又谈买这批洋枪，还有拉拢英商，叫他们少跟洪杨打交道的好处。

Ji listened silently, thinking of Hu's interests.
嵇鹤龄在一旁默默地听着，心里便在为胡雪岩想着，

When the conversation paused, he offered a reminder.
等他们谈话告一段落，使用提醒的语气说：

“Xueyan, shouldn't you discuss the price of this consignment with Mr Xuexuan?”
“雪岩，这批货色的价款如何算法，你要不要先跟雪公谈一谈？”

Before Hu could answer, Wang suddenly recalled something.
胡雪岩还不曾开口，王有龄矍然说道：

“That reminds me.
“提到这一层，我倒想起来了。

The militia is under official supervision but organised locally.
团练都是官督民办，

The locality raises its own funds and keeps charge of them.
地方上自己筹了饷，自己保管。

Huzhou is wealthy, its people are enthusiastic, and the militia has ample money.
湖州富庶，地方上也热心，团练经费很充裕。

I had meant to ask Zhao Jingxian to deposit the public funds at Fukang, but feared a polite refusal that would embarrass me, so I never raised it.
我本来想跟赵景贤说，叫他把公款存在阜康，又怕碰个软钉子，面子上下不来，所以一直不曾开口。

Now these guns will be just the catalyst we need.
现在好了，有了这批洋枪，是个很好的‘药引子’，

Zhao will be grateful to you, and I can speak easily.
赵景贤一定很见你的情，我就容易说话了。

As for the price, whatever you say will be accepted.
至于这一批货色的价款，说多少是多少，

The rebate is yours, naturally.”
回扣当然是你的。

Hu's greatest difficulties were a shortage of assistants and insufficient ready funds.
“胡雪岩此刻最感困难的，第一是人手不足，第二是头寸调不转。

A large deposit from the Huzhou militia would be like water to a fish: nothing could be better.
有了湖州团练的大笔经费存进来，如鱼得水，再妙不过。

With substantial business in prospect, he would not chase a small profit.
有了大生意，他就不肯贪小利了，

“No,” he said.
“不！”他说，

“I want this done handsomely.
“我的事需要做得漂亮。

Let the rebate go into the public funds or be divided among Jingxian's staff.
回扣或者归公，或者归景贤手下的人去分，

I'll perform the service for nothing.”
我完全当差。”

“There's no need to work for nothing,” Wang replied.
“白当差也不必。”王有龄说，

“Leave this to me.
“这件事你不必管了，

I'll speak to Zhao Jingxian.”
我来跟赵景贤说。”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十五章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Fifteen, concluding part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


One of the two matters had been settled.
要谈的两件事谈妥了一桩，

The other had to begin with Ji Heling.
另一桩得要从嵇鹤龄身上谈起，

“Mr Xuexuan,” Hu asked directly, “what has happened about Heling?”
“雪公！”他开门见山地问：“鹤龄的事怎么了？”

Wang lowered the glass he had almost raised to his lips and sighed dispiritedly.
一提到这话，王有龄把已送到唇边的酒杯又放下，意兴阑珊地先叹了口气。

“It has been keeping me awake at night.
“为这件事，我睡觉都不安枕。”王有龄说，

I was waiting to discuss it with you.
“我也正要等你商量。

I don’t know what the governor intends.
抚台不知打的什么主意？

It looks very much as though he means to destroy the bridge after crossing the river.
迹近过河拆桥，

How can I face Brother Heling?”
叫我怎么对得起鹤龄兄？”

He described his successive approaches to Huang Zonghan.
于是他把几次为嵇鹤龄的事，跟黄宗汉去谈的经过，说了一遍，

He had first made a request; when no definite answer came, he had submitted a recommendation.
先是请求，没有确实答复，便改做保荐，

That too had achieved nothing, so he had argued the case forcefully.
保荐依旧不得要领，就只好力争，

Still there had been no result.
无奈至今争不出名堂来。

“Xueyan, you judge these things more accurately than anyone.
“雪岩！”王有龄说到最后，又要请教他了，“你料事比别人来得准，

What do you make of it?”
倒看看，是何道理？”

“There is no death without a ghost at work,” Hu said bluntly.
“ ‘无鬼不死人’！”胡雪岩很坦率地说，

“There must be something underhand behind this.”
“其中必定有鬼。”

“I thought so too.
“我也想到了这一层。”

I asked the men handling the correspondence whether some little inducement was needed.
王有龄答道，“问过文案上的人，说要不要有所点缀？

They answered quite sincerely that everything depended on the governor.
文案上的人，回话很诚恳，说这件事全看抚台的意思，

They did not dare accept anything yet, for fear of taking a favor and then failing to accomplish the business.
他们此刻还不敢受好处，怕受了好处，事情办不成，对不起人。

Once Mr Ji’s appointment order was issued, of course, they would expect him to treat them to a celebratory drink.
等将来嵇某人的委札下来，自然少不得要讨他一杯喜酒吃。

Xueyan, surely that says all there is to say?”
雪岩，你听，这话不是说到头了吗？”


Comparing Wang’s account with Ji’s, Hu understood at once.
王、嵇两个人两样的活，摆到胡雪岩心里一辨味道，立刻就懂了。

The two thousand taels were wanted by Huang Zonghan, who was unwilling to have Wang supply them.
两千银子是黄宗汉要，却又不肯叫王有龄出，

That explained these answers.
所以才有这样的话，

If the money were merely for the correspondence staff, why would they care whether it belonged to Wang or Ji, so long as the silver was good?
如果是文案上要钱，管你这银子姓王姓嵇，只要成色足就行了！

Hu understood, but would not reveal it.
懂是懂了，却不肯说破。

If he did, Wang would still feel guilty that he had failed to do enough for Ji, even if he paid.
说破了，王有龄即或花了钱，仍旧会觉得替嵇鹤龄不曾尽到心而感疚歉，

And Ji, having declared that he would not buy an office, might bring the whole affair to an impasse.
在嵇鹤龄则既有那样不愿花钱买官做的表示，说破了更会成僵局。

Hu therefore smiled.
于是他笑笑说道：

“Let them play their ghostly tricks.
“他们闹鬼，

I am a Maoshan Taoist who specializes in catching such ghosts.
我就是专捉这路鬼的‘茅山道士’。

Just watch me!”
且看我的手段！

“And how do you intend to catch them?” Wang asked.
““那么，你预备如何‘捉鬼’？”王有龄问。

“Heaven’s secrets must not be disclosed.”
“天机不可泄漏。”

Hu pointed to Ji.
胡雪岩拿手一指嵇鹤龄，

“Mr Xuexuan, in his letter Heling mentioned that the tribute rice would go out to sea through Liuhe.
“雪公，鹤龄给我的信上，谈到漕米海运，由浏河出口，

Because the Small Swords uprising might cause trouble, he suggested a plan. See what you think of it.”
因为小刀会起事，怕出乱子，出了个主意你看行不行？”

Ji was astonished.
听得这话，嵇鹤龄大为诧异，

When had he suggested any plan?
自己何尝出过什么主意？

He was about to speak when someone gave him a light kick.
正要开口，发觉有人轻轻踢了他一脚，

Recognizing Hu’s signal, he remained silent.
这自然是胡雪岩递过来的暗号，嵇鹤龄便不作声了。


“What plan?” Wang asked attentively.
“什么主意？”王有龄极注意地问，

“Our superiors are worrying about it, and it is giving me a headache too.
“上头正为这件事在担心，我也很头痛，

Escorting tribute grain is a public duty, yet the troops make demands at every turn.
派兵护漕，原是公事，谁知百端需索，

The whole Green Standard Army ought to be abolished!”
绿营兵真正都该裁撤！”

“Then this suggestion will be useful,” Hu said calmly.
“那好！这个主意用得着了。”胡雪岩不慌不忙他说道，

“Heling knows my friendship with You Laowu and the extent of You’s influence.
“鹤龄晓得我跟尤五的交情，也晓得尤五的手面，

His idea is to contract the transshipment to You.
出的主意就是包给尤王驳运。

What do you think?”
你看如何？”

Wang considered, then struck the table in approval.
王有龄思索了一下，拍案称赏：

“A splendid idea!
“这个主意想绝了！

You belongs to the Songjiang grain-transport brotherhood, so the benefit would not go to outsiders.
尤五是松江漕帮，说起来便宜不落外方，

It can be justified on every side.
哪方面都交代得过。

Brother Heling, you truly have remarkable talent.
鹤龄兄，你真正才气纵横。

Please draw up a memorandum today, and I’ll present it to the governor in person tomorrow.
这样吧，请你今天就做个说帖，我明天上院面递。

If he still raises objections, there really must be a ghost at work!”
如果抚台再有罗嗦，那就真正是出了鬼了！”

“Certainly, certainly,” Ji replied.
“是，是！”嵇鹤龄答应是在答应，

His face and ears grew hot, though the wine concealed his embarrassment.
不免有些面红耳热，只是借酒盖脸，一时看不出来。

“Excellent!”
“甚好，甚好！”

Wang raised his glass.
王有龄举杯说道，

“I have drunk brandy several times, but none seemed as fragrant or mellow as this.”
“白兰地我也喝过几回，似乎都不如今天的来得香，来得醇。”

“‘Friendship with Zhou Gongjin is like drinking mellow wine,’” Ji quoted from the Records of the Three Kingdoms.
“ ‘与周公谨交，如饮醇醪’！”嵇鹤龄引了句《三国志》上的话，

He raised his glass toward Wang, but his eyes rested on Hu.
端杯向王有龄一举，眼却看着胡雪岩。

After they drank, Wang said, “That is enough wine.
干了这一杯，王有龄说：“酒差不多了。

Brother Heling still has his memorandum to write tonight.
鹤龄兄今晚上还要写说帖，

Come to my house tomorrow evening, and we’ll enjoy a proper drink.”
明天晚上到我那里再喝个痛快！”


As he finished, Ruiyun lifted the curtain and came out smiling.
话刚完，只听瑞云一面掀帘子走了出来，一面笑道：

“But I haven’t yet offered a toast to Master Hu or to you, sir.”
“我还没有敬胡老爷、敬老爷呢？”

“You certainly ought to toast Master Hu—to thank your matchmaker!”
“敬胡老爷应该，谢媒！”

That had indeed been her intention, but Wang’s saying it aloud made things difficult.
瑞云原有这意思，让王有龄一说破，便不好办了，

With the wine pot in one hand and a cup in the other, she stood awkwardly at a loss.
一手执壶、一手持杯，僵在那里有些手足无措，

It lasted only a moment before Ji came cleverly to her rescue.
幸好，这不过眨眨眼的工夫，因为嵇鹤龄很机警地替她解了围。

“Mr Xuexuan should be toasted first,” he said, taking the pot.
“还是应该先敬雪公！”他接过壶来说，

“Xueyan and I are brothers.
“雪岩跟我弟兄，

He is one of the family.”
那是自己人。”

“How unfortunate!” Wang laughed.
“糟了！”王有龄笑道，

“You are all family, and I’m the only outsider.”
“你们都是自己人，只剩下一个我是外人。”

“You mustn’t say that, sir.”
“老爷也不要这么说，”

Ruiyun recovered her composure and her skill in social conversation.
瑞云窘意消失。依然很会应酬了，

“Neither Master Hu nor Master Ji regards you as an outsider.”
“胡老爷跟格老爷都没有拿老爷当外人看。”

“Exactly!”
“对了！”

A little wine had sharpened Wang’s wit.
有了几分酒意的王有龄，词锋特别锐利，

“A woman’s heart turns toward her husband.
“女心外向，

It is you who regard me as an outsider.”
倒是你拿我当外人看了。”

“I would never dare.”
“我不敢！”

Though he was joking, she answered seriously.
虽是戏言，瑞云却当作正经话回答，

“I spent more than ten years in your household.
“我在老爷家十几年，

I could never forget your kindness and your wife’s.”
不敢忘记者爷、太太待我的好处。”

Even with wine as an excuse, Wang could hardly continue teasing after that.
说到这样的话，王有龄就是借酒盖脸，也不好意思跟她再说笑话，

He accepted her toast with proper courtesy.
规规矩矩受了她一杯酒。

She then toasted Hu and put down the cup to leave, but Hu stopped her and insisted she toast Ji as well.
接着，瑞云又敬了胡雪岩，放下杯子要走，他喊住了她，要她也敬嵇鹤龄。

Now she could not remain at ease.
这时候的瑞云可大方不起来了！

The more she demurred, the more Hu teased, until several children gathered behind the curtain to peep at the fun.
但越是不肯，胡雪岩越闹得厉害，把几个小把戏都招引了来，在门帘后面遮遮掩掩地看热闹，

Danhe, the most mischievous, giggled incessantly.
特别是最调皮的丹荷，格格地笑个不住。

By turning to scold his children, Ji gave Ruiyun another opportunity to escape.
嵇鹤龄借着去叱斥儿女的机会，算是替瑞云又解了围。


After dinner they returned to the study for tea and resumed their business.
饭罢回到书房里去喝茶，又谈正经。

“Have you discussed the transshipment with You?” Wang asked Hu.
王有龄问起胡雪岩说：“驳运一节，你跟尤五谈过没有？”

“We have discussed it, but nothing is settled.
“谈是谈过，没有定局。

I did not know your wishes.”
因为不知道你的意思究竟如何？”

“You might just as well have decided yourself.
“其实你就作了主也一样。”王有龄问：

What does You say?”
“尤五怎么说？”

“One word is enough with him.
“尤五还不是一句话！

The cost can be negotiated; he only needs an official communication from Zhejiang to the Jiangsu grain transport circuit intendant.”
费用好商量，不过要浙江给他们江苏督粮道一件公事。”

“The document is easily arranged.
“公事现成！

Even a letter to Governor Xu of Jiangsu would be no trouble.
哪怕就是给汪苏许抚台，也不费什么事。

But we need an approximate figure for the expense before we can plan.”
倒是费用一层，还要有个大概数目，才好筹划。”

“I imagine it will be much cheaper than having Green Standard troops provide an escort.”
“我想，”胡雪岩说，“总比请派绿营兵保护，要便宜得多。”

“Then that will do.”
“ 那行！”

Wang considered carefully.
王有龄很仔细的想了想道说：

“If You can truly guarantee its safety, this is an excellent arrangement.”
“只要尤五真的能够保险，这件事就太妙了！”

Hu heard the uncertainty about You.
胡雪岩听出他的意思，是有些不放心尤五，

There were many things he could not conveniently explain, such as You’s friendship with Zhou Lichun.
但许多话亦不便跟他说，譬如尤五跟周立春的交情之类。

Yet Wang’s concern, and the fact that the proposal was now being attributed to Ji, made reconsideration necessary. If something went wrong, it would jeopardize both men’s careers.
不过既然王有龄有这话，而且又扯上嵇鹤龄，算是他的“条陈”，那么一出纸漏，于他们两个人的前程，都有妨碍，不能不重新考虑。

“I am reasonably confident, but we must guard against the one chance in ten thousand,” Hu said, looking at Ji.
“事情是有七分把握，不过‘不怕一万，只怕万一’，我想，”胡雪岩看着嵇鹤龄说，

“Perhaps the memorial should leave some room for maneuver and let Governor Huang decide.”
“条陈里写活动些，让黄抚台去作主。”

“No, no!”
“不行，不行！”

Wang waved his hand.
王有龄摇着手说，

“He will not take the responsibility.”
“他不肯担责任的。”


The whole matter seemed to require fresh discussion.
这一下，事情变得就要重新再谈，

Hu felt the responsibility was too heavy for any plan to be entirely secure.
胡雪岩因为责任太重、总觉得很难有万全之计，

While he was pondering, Ji spoke.
方在沉思之际，嵇鹤龄开了口。

“We must first circle the horse and bend the bow—prepare the ground before acting.
“此事要盘马弯弓，有一番做作。”嵇鹤龄说：

Defense is pressing everywhere, and every locality needs more troops.
“现在防务吃紧，各地方都要增添兵力，

The existing forces are already insufficient.
原有的兵勇尚不敷用，

How could men be spared to escort the tribute rice?”
何能再抽人护送漕米？”

“Ah!” Wang exclaimed.
“啊，啊！”王有龄恍然大悟，

“I understand.”
“我懂了。”

“So do I,” Hu said.
“我也懂了。”胡雪岩说，

“But it would be better if those words did not come from you, Mr Xuexuan.”
“不过这话，最好不由雪公来说。”

“You mean the Green Standard officers should say it themselves?”
“你是说由绿营自己来说？”

Wang shook his head.
王有龄摇摇头，

“They won’t.
“他们不肯说的，

It is a comfortable and profitable assignment.
这是趟好差使，又舒服，又有出息，

Why would they refuse?”
何乐不为？”

“Not necessarily comfortable.
“舒服却未见得，

If they really encounter the Small Swords forces and have to fight, they will be no match for them.”
真的遇见小刀会，开起仗来，绿营不是他们的敌手。”

“Unfortunately, they do not think so, and I cannot say it.
“无奈他们不这么想。我也不能这么说。”

I’ll see the governor myself and act as circumstances require.”
王有龄下了个决定：“准定由我面见抚台，相机行事。”

“What about the memorandum?”
“那么，”胡雪岩问道，“条陈呢？”

“Have it drafted tonight all the same.
“条陈还是今夜把它拟好，

I’ll take it with me.
我带了去，

Better to have it ready and not need it than need it and not have it.”
宁可备而不用，不可要用而未备。”

“Then I’ll finish it tonight,” Ji said.
“既如此，我连夜赶起来。”

After a pause, he added, “I should like Xueyan to stay so that we can discuss it and make it as sound as possible.
嵇鹤龄慢了一下说，“我想把雪岩留下来，一起商量，斟酌尽善。

What do you think?”
雪公看如何？”

“Very well.”
“也好！”

Wang looked at Hu.
王有龄看着胡雪岩说：

“We shall meet tomorrow morning, then.”
“我们就明天上午碰头好了。”


With that agreed, Wang took his leave.
这样说停当了，王有龄告辞回家。

Hu and Ji began immediately.
胡雪岩和嵇鹤龄也就毫无耽搁，立即动手，

One arranged the arguments clearly; the other wrote fluently.
一个条理清楚，一个笔下来得，

They soon produced a draft, reconsidered it, settled the final wording and made a fair copy for Hu to take away.
不费什么事就已把草稿拟好，重新斟酌一遍，作成定稿，随手誊清，由胡雪岩带走。

The next morning Wang stayed home especially to await Hu.
第二天上午王有龄不出门，专诚在家等候胡雪岩。

As soon as he arrived, they shut themselves in the study.
一到便在书房里闭门密谈，

Since the Xincheng disturbances had been put down, Wang had gained still more of Huang’s confidence.
自从新城之乱平服，王有龄愈得黄宗汉的信任，

That also meant more jealous rivals and more obstruction.
因而妒忌他的人也不少，办事不免多掣时的人，

He had many troubles to pour out to Hu.
为此他有许多苦恼，要向胡雪岩倾吐。

“Xueyan, there is an important matter I want to discuss.
“雪岩，”他说，“我现在有件大事，要跟你商量。

I hear that Governor Huang may be transferred.
听说黄抚台有调动的消息，

If he leaves, who knows what his successor will be like?
如果他一走，来接他的人不知怎么样。

I am strongly tempted to withdraw while things are going well.”
所以我颇有急流勇退之想。”

Hu was greatly alarmed.
一听这话，胡雪岩大吃一惊，急急说道：

“Mr Xuexuan, why should you think of that?
“雪公你怎么起了这么个念头？

We have only just built things up, and everything is running smoothly.
局面刚刚摆开，正搞得顺手，

Why retreat now?”
为啥要打退堂鼓。

“First, if the new man and I do not get on, winding up the affairs I have handled could become troublesome.
““一则我怕后任一来，如果彼此不甚对劲，我许多经手的事，收拾起来就会有罗嗦，

It would be easier to hand them over while Governor Huang is here.
趁黄抚台在这里，办交卸比较容易，

Second, Jiang Zhongyuan has been promoted from judicial commissioner of Hubei to governor of Anhui.
二则江忠源由湖北臬司调升安徽巡抚，

We are old acquaintances, and he has written to ask whether I would join him there.
他跟我有旧，来信问我，愿意不愿意到安徽去？

He and Zeng Guofan are both enjoying great imperial favor.
他跟曾国藩两个，现在圣眷甚隆，

Going to him might be a good move.”
我想到他那里去也不错。”

“I disagree!”
“不然！”

Hu shook his head vigorously.
胡雪岩大为摇头，

“You do not know Anhui, and neither do I.
“安徽地方你不熟悉，我也不熟悉。

To speak plainly, if you go there, I shall not go with you, because I could do nothing to help you there.”
而且说句老实话，你到安徽，我不会去的，因为我去了也帮不了你的忙！”

“Very well.”
“好！”

Wang nodded.
王有龄点点头，

“Since you put it that way, there is no more to say.
“你说到这话，我不必再多说，

I will write today to decline Jiang’s kind invitation.”
今天就写信，回谢江忠源的好意。”


Hu was naturally reassured, but felt his responsibility grow heavier.
听他这样表示，胡雪岩自然感到安慰了，然而也不免觉得责任愈重，

After reflecting, he asked, “Is the report of Governor Huang’s transfer reliable?”
想了想说：“黄抚台调动的消息，确不确？”

“There is such a rumor, and we must be prepared.
“有此一说，不可不防。”

Besides, disturbances by bandits are occurring throughout Zhejiang.
王有龄又说，“现在浙江各地，都有土匪滋事的情形，

A spark can set the prairie ablaze.
星星之火，可以燎原，

The governor takes the matter very seriously.
黄抚台对这方面非常认真。

Because the Xincheng affair was handled well, I fear all these assignments will fall to me in future.
因为新城的案子办得不错，所以这些差使，以后怕都会落在我头上。

Meanwhile I cannot get free of the Sea Transport Bureau.
海运局的事又不能不拖在那里，

I really am beginning to lack the strength for everything.”
实在有点心余力绌。”

This made Ji’s appointment all the more important.
这就见得嵇鹤龄的事，格外重要。

In truth, Wang was more anxious about it than Ji himself, but he could not exert his full influence with Huang.
说实话，王有龄比嵇鹤龄本人还急，但他在黄宗汉面前，却是有力使不上，

In allocating the rewards for Xincheng, Wang had made a wrong move—or rather, failed to make a move at all.
因为论功行赏，王有龄走错了一着棋，或者说，这一着棋，他没有去走，

Huang had decided from the outset that Wang and Ji would receive one confidential recommendation and one open recommendation between them.
在黄宗汉，对新城一案的酬佣，是早就分配好了的，王有龄和嵇鹤龄两人，给一个密保，一个明保，

He had no preference as to which man received which.
谁密谁明，他没有意见。

Had Wang said when the report went forward, “Ji Heling did more of the work; please favor him with the confidential recommendation,” Huang would have agreed.
当初出奏的时候，如果王有龄说一句：“嵇鹤龄出的力多，请抚台赏他一个密保。”黄宗汉也会照办。

Because Wang had failed to say this, the confidential recommendation had gone to him.
就因为少了这一句话，把自己搞成了密保，

To press Ji’s claims again now might look opportunistic, and he feared displeasing Huang.
如果这时候，再力荐嵇鹤龄，仿佛投机取巧，他怕黄宗汉心里不高兴，

That was why he had never dared say too much.
因而始终不敢多说。

He could hardly confess this difficulty even to Hu.
这一层苦衷，甚至在胡雪岩面前，都难启齿。

As time passed, his sense of guilt, almost as though he had appropriated another man’s merit, deepened.
而时间隔得愈久，那种近似“冒功”的疚歉愈深，

He longed for Hu to devise a way to settle the appointment quickly.
渴望着胡雪岩能出个主意，把这件事，早早办成。

“As things stand,” Wang continued, “it will probably take more than a day or two.
“照现在看，恐怕还不是三天两天的事。”王有龄说，

I must first discuss defense and make the governor see that no troops can be spared.
“先要谈防务，让黄抚台晓得抽不出兵，

Then I must wait for him to ask whether there is another way.
然后就让他自己来问，可还有别的好办法？

Only then can I produce Heling’s memorandum.
那时我才能把鹤龄的条陈拿出来。

Think how many turns we have to take!”
你想想，这是多绕弯子的事？”


Hu agreed.
胡雪岩同意他的说法，

Reviewing the causes and consequences once more, he realized that he had been mistaken.
重新把前因后果考虑了一遍，发觉自己错了！

He had wanted Ji to display his abilities.
错在想为嵇鹤龄“显显本事”，

But the memorandum had little bearing on whether Ji could take over the Sea Transport Bureau.
其实，那个条陈对嵇鹤龄能不能接海运局差使的关系不大。

The decisive point still lay with the correspondence office.
关系还在丈案那里。

A pig’s head cooks when the fire is brought to it; official business proceeds when the money arrives.
“人到猪头烂，钱到公事办”！

How had he forgotten such familiar sayings?
怎么连这两句话都想不起？

“Mr Xuexuan, please wait a little.
于是他说：“雪公，我请你缓一缓，

See the governor tomorrow at the earliest, or the day after at the latest.”
快则明天，迟则后天，再去见黄抚台。”

“Why?
“怎么呢？”

What are you arranging now?”
王有龄问，“你又有什么安排？”

“The same answer as before.”
“还是那句话。”

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑道：

“Heaven’s secrets must not be disclosed.”
“天机不可泄漏。”

“Very well.
“好吧！

I won’t ask.
我也不问了，

I’ll wait for your word.”
听你的招呼好了。”

They went on to talk about events in Shanghai and Hangzhou.
于是彼此又谈了些在上海、在杭州的情形，

There was too much to finish at once, especially when Mrs Wang came out to entertain their guest and the subject turned to Ruiyun.
话太多一时说不尽，加上王太太又出来很应酬一番，谈起瑞云，越发说个没有完。

Hu put business aside for a while and joined in the conversation.
胡雪岩也索性丢开正事，聊了些闲天，

He stayed for lunch, then went straight to Fukang to attend to Ji’s affairs.
在王家吃了午饭，告辞出门，一直来到阜康替嵇鹤龄办事。


Using his own bank’s notes, he made out two: one for two thousand taels and one for two hundred.
他就用本号的银票，开了两张，一张两千，一张两百，

He sealed them in an envelope, inscribed it “A humble gift,” and signed beneath, “Your humble junior, Ji Heling.”
用个封套封好，上写“匪仪”二字，下面具名是“教愚弟嵇鹤龄”。

“Qingsheng, I must ask you to make a visit.
“庆生！拜托你走一趟，

Have Master Liu Er pass this to Master Chen in the correspondence office.
托刘二爷代为递到文案上的陈老爷。

Say that I shall be busy for a few more days, but once these miscellaneous affairs are settled, I should like him to come over for a talk.”
说我还有几天忙，杂务稍为定一定，请他过来叙一叙。”

“Very well.
“好的。”

Should I ask for a card acknowledging receipt?”
刘庆生又问：“要不要回片？”

“No.
“不必了。”

If he gives you one, bring it back.
胡雪岩说，“他给你就带了回来，

If not, there is no need to request it.
不给也不必要，

The intention will be understood.”
反正心到神知。”

Liu Qingsheng was quick.
刘庆生办事极快，

Within a double-hour he returned with a visiting card from Master Chen, a correspondence officer at the governor’s office.
不过一个时辰，就已回店，带来抚署文案委员陈老爷的一张名片，

On it were four characters: “Gratefully received, with thanks.”
上面有四个字：“拜领谢谢！”

That night Hu notified Wang that he could now see the governor about the matter.
于是胡雪岩当夜就通知王有龄，说可以去见抚台谈这件事了。

Wang had no idea what Hu had done, but was sure that following his advice would not lead him astray.
王有龄不知道他葫芦里卖的什么药？反正照他的话做决不会错，

The following day he dressed formally and went to the governor’s office.
因而下一天衣冠整肃地到了抚台衙门。

After his calling document was taken in, Liu Er returned.
手本递了进去，刘二回出来说：

“His Excellency says he has many visitors this morning.
“上头交代，上半天客多，

He asks that you come at three this afternoon.”
准定请王大爷下半天三点钟来。”

When a superior set aside a specific time for consultation, it was a sign of special regard: he meant to allow an unhurried discussion.
凡是上宪专约时刻会商，皆是格外看重的表示，意思是要抽出一段时间，可以从容细谈。

Wang therefore went home and returned in the afternoon.
王有龄听得这话，便打道回府，到了下午再来。


Huang received him in the Boat Hall in the rear garden of the governor’s residence.
黄宗汉在巡抚衙门后花园的“船厅”接见，

He first asked Wang to change into informal clothes, then invited him to share refreshments: layered cake, yanpi soup, water-chestnut cakes, sweet and savory dishes, hot and cold—all flavors of their native Fujian.
一到叫先换了便衣，接着便邀王有龄一起吃点心，千层糕、燕皮汤、地力糕，甜咸俱备，冷热皆有，都是他们八闽的家乡口味。

As they ate, they discussed the situation.
一面吃，一面谈，先谈时局，

Huang began with Xiang Rong’s Jiangnan Grand Camp, which consumed enormous sums every month.
说向荣的江南大营，每月耗饷甚巨，

Its official demands for money arrived with the urgency of a fire alarm and never ceased.
公文急如星火，催索不已，

It was a severe headache.
是件很伤脑筋的事。

“Zhejiang should not have to provide everything,” Wang offered.
“这也不该浙江一省出。”王有龄表示意见，

“The demands are endless and cannot be sustained.
“需索无底，难以为继，

Might you discuss an overall arrangement with Commander Xiang?
大人似乎可以跟向帅商量，是不是通盘筹划，

Jiangsu, Jiangxi and Zhejiang could each be assigned a fixed monthly sum, to be remitted when due.
由江苏、江西、浙江三省，每月确定额数，到期报解？

That would make it easier for everyone to raise the funds.”
这样子，大家筹措起来也比较容易。”

“A good suggestion.
“你这个主意不错，

I can try it,” Huang said.
我可以试一试。”黄宗汉又说，

“Your work in Huzhou is particularly important.
“你湖州这方面，关系甚重，

The province depends chiefly on that district for military funds.
通省的饷源，主要的就靠你那里。

I think the Sea Transport Bureau is indeed more than you can also manage.”
我看，海运局你真有点兼顾不到了！”


Wang grew uneasy.
王有龄心里有些嘀咕，

From this remark, it sounded as though the governor already had someone in mind.
听这意思，抚台夹袋中似乎有人，

If he named the man now, with superior and subordinate face to face and no room for an intermediary, would Ji not lose his chance?
倘或此时就提了出来，一个上司，一个下属，直来直往，中间没有缓冲的余地，嵇鹤龄岂不是就落空了？

Worse still, another man’s arrival would require an immediate handover.
这还在其次，如果换一个人来，立刻就得办移交，

Unless money could be found to cover the deficit at the Sea Transport Bureau, the shortage would be exposed.
海运局的亏空，除非能找一笔钱来补上，否则就会原形毕露，

That would be disastrous.
那怎么得了？

Sweat appeared on Wang’s forehead.
一想到此，额上便见了汗。

Unaware of the cause, Huang said, “This little spring in the tenth month is very warm.
黄宗汉不知就里，随即说道：“十月小阳春，天气太热。

Please remove your hat.”
你请升冠吧！”

To do so in a superior’s presence was discourteous.
升冠就是脱帽，是不礼貌的，

Wang wiped his brow with a handkerchief.
王有龄拿块手巾擦擦汗说：

“It’s quite all right.”
“不要紧，不要紧！”

Huang did not insist over a small matter and returned to business.
这是小事，黄宗汉也不再多说，又谈公事：

“That fellow Ji seems to have some ability.”
“那个姓嵇的，我看倒有点才气。”

At these words Wang felt his heart lighten and his senses clear.
听得这一句，王有龄顿觉心头一宽，耳目清凉，赶紧答道：

“Your Excellency has a discerning eye.
“大人目光如炬，

No true talent can escape your notice.”
凡是真才，都逃不过大人的耳目。”

The compliment was well judged, and Huang’s lean face broke into a smile.
这一声恭维，相当得体，黄宗汉瘦刮刮的脸上有了笑容，

“Let him take over your work at the Sea Transport Bureau,” he said as though seeking advice.
“让他接你的海运局。”他用征询的语气说：

“What do you think?”
“你看怎么样？”

“Nothing could be more suitable.
“那是再适当不过。”

Ji Heling’s ability is of the first order.
王有龄乘此机会答道：“嵇鹤龄此人，论才具是一等一，

Some call him too proud, but I do not entirely agree.
有人说他脾气太傲，也不见得。

Talented men may be proud of their gifts, yet their scorn is directed at those inferior to themselves.
有才气的人，总不免恃才傲物，不过所傲者，是不如他的人。

He understands very well how he ought to behave.
其实他也是颇懂好歹的，

If Your Excellency gives him an important appointment, I guarantee that he will repay the favor and give you complete satisfaction.”
大人能够重用他，我敢写包票，他一定会感恩图报，让大人称心如意。”

The last words implied more than competent public service.
最后一句话，意在言外，不尽关乎公事妥帖。

Huang did not really need Wang’s guarantee: Hu’s Fukang banknote carried greater force.
黄宗汉其实也不需他“写包票”，胡雪岩那张阜康的银票，比王有龄的“包票”更来得有力。

He nodded.
所以他点点头说：

“I know.
“我知道！

Go back and prepare to hand over.”
你就回去准备交卸吧！”


“Yes, sir!”
“是！”

Wang rose and made a formal obeisance.
王有龄站起身来请了一安：

“Your Excellency’s allowing me some relief from my burden is a great kindness.”
“大人容我暂息仔肩，真是体恤我。”

“Not at all.
“不敢当，

Please rise.”
快请起来。”

Huang stood too and made a gesture of assistance.
黄宗汉也站起来，虚抉一扶。

Remaining on his feet signaled that he was ready to see his visitor out.
这一站起来，不再坐下，便是等待送客的表示。

“I shall take my leave,” Wang said, adding a final sentence to make the matter firm.
“我就告辞了。”王有龄敲钉转脸地加了一句：

“I will tell Mr Ji at once of Your Excellency’s gracious encouragement and ask him to serve you wholeheartedly.”
“我回去就将大人这番栽培的德意，告诉秩某人，叫他实心报效。”

“You may tell him.
“可以，你就告诉他好了。

I will have the appointment order issued immediately.”
我马上叫人下委札。”


Wang’s first act on returning home was to send for Hu and Ji.
于是王有龄告辞回家，第一件事就是派人去请胡雪岩和嵇鹤龄。

Naturally, Hu arrived first.
自然是胡雪岩先到，

Fukang was nearby, and he had already told Wang’s gate attendants to look for him there whenever needed.
因为阜康离王家不远，而他是早就关照了王家门上的，有事到阜康招呼，所以一请就到。

“Wonderful, wonderful!” Wang said, raising his thumb.
“佩服，佩服！”王有龄翘看大拇指说，

“Xueyan, what miraculous powers do you possess, to judge events so exactly?”
“雪岩，你具何神通，料事如此之准？”

He recounted the interview in detail.
接着，他把会见黄宗汉的经过，细说了一遍。

Hu had not expected such smooth success either and was delighted.
胡雪岩也不曾料到事情是这样子的顺利，因而也有喜出望外之感，

After a moment he asked, “What happened about the memorandum?”
想了想问道：“那么，条陈是怎么说法？”

“I did not present it.
“条陈不曾上。”

Producing it would have made us seem to have planned everything beforehand.
王有龄答道，“一拿出来，倒显得早有成算似地。

There are two kinds of great men.
大人物分两种，

One likes others to anticipate his wishes and think everything through for him.
一种喜欢先意承志，事事先替他想到，

The other likes to exercise an unpredictable authority and does not want anyone to know his mind.
一种是喜欢用不测之威，不愿意别人知道他的心思，

Governor Huang is the second kind.
黄抚台就是这一类人。

I thought it better for Heling to make the request himself after taking office, or when he goes to thank the governor for the appointment.”
我觉得等鹤龄接了事，或者谢委的时候，当面请求比较好。”

“It must be done quickly.
“事情要快，

Let him raise it when he gives thanks.
就让他谢委的时候请求吧！”

And the papers for transporting the guns?”
胡雪岩又问，“运枪的公事……”

“Ah, I forgot about those.
“啊！把这件事给忘记掉了。”王有龄说，

Never mind—a letter from me will do.”
“不要紧，我写封信就行了。”

He had just finished writing when Ji arrived.
刚把信写完，嵇鹤龄到了。

Wang and Hu congratulated him and briefly explained what had happened.
王、胡二人一见他先道贺，然后略说缘由，

Ji could not quite grasp the sequence or tell whose influence had brought it about, so he thanked them both.
嵇鹤龄有点摸不清首尾，不知道是谁的力量使然？唯有向他们两个人都道了谢。

The male and female servants of the Wang household came to kowtow and offer congratulations.
这时王家的男女佣仆也都来磕头道喜，

Ji happened to have a thirty-tael note with him and generously gave it as a reward to be shared among them.
嵇鹤龄正带着一张三十两银子的银票在身上，很大方地发了“总赏”，

Some said Ruiyun should be congratulated too and praised her good fortune.
还有人说要给瑞云道贺，又说她福气好！

The two maids awaiting marriage were particularly envious of her rise from a lowly perch to the station of a phoenix.
尤其是待嫁的两名丫头，眼看瑞三“飞上枝头作风凰”，

Their admiration showed in every word and expression.
艳羡之意，溢于词色。

Hu felt almost as pleased as Ji himself.
这就不但是嵇鹤龄，连胡雪岩也觉得很得意。

After this happy bustle, Wang said, “Brother Heling, you had better go home.
这样喜气洋洋地乱过一阵，王有龄便说：“鹤龄兄，你请回去吧！

Messengers with congratulations may already be there.
说不定已有送喜信的人到府上去了。

Xueyan, go with him and help attend to matters.
雪岩帮着一起去招呼招呼，

We will talk again tonight.”
我们晚上再谈。”


By helping attend to matters, Wang meant seeing to the customary rewards.
叫胡雪岩去招呼，是招呼成赏，

Hu did not know the going rates very well, so he first asked Wang for details.
这方面的“行情”他不大熟悉，少不得先要向王有龄问清楚了，

Then he stopped at Fukang to leave instructions before accompanying Ji home.
然后顺道往阜康交代了几句话，才一起回到嵇家。

“Second Brother,” Ji said directly when they arrived, having thought it through in the sedan chair, “did you work through someone?”
“二弟！”嵇鹤龄在轿子里把事情想通了，一到家率直问道：“可是你走了门路？”

Because Ji had declared that he would not buy an office, Hu answered discreetly.
因为嵇鹤龄说过不愿买官做的话，所以胡雪岩的回答很含蓄：

“I merely asked someone to put in a word.”
“也不过托人去说过一声。”

“What sort of word?”
“怎么说法？”

“Only a request for help.”
“无非拜托而已。”

Ji reflected in silence.
嵇鹤龄静静地想了想说：

“I won’t ask further.
“我也不多问了，

I understand in my heart.”
反正我心里知道就是！”

Just then Liu Qingsheng arrived, carrying what Hu had instructed him to bring: a thousand-tael banknote, five hundred taels in silver, and a passbook showing another three thousand five hundred.
正说到这里，刘庆生也到了嵇家，他是奉了胡雪岩的指示，送东西来的，一千两银票、五百两现银，另外一扣存折，上面还有三千五百两。

Holding the passbook, Ji said, “Second Brother, this weighs heavily on me.
“二弟！”嵇鹤龄把存折托在手里说，“我觉得沉重得很，

I can scarcely bear it.”
真有点不胜负荷。”

He meant that he owed more kindness than he feared he could repay.
这是说欠他的情太多了，怕还不清，

“We are brothers.
“自己弟兄，

Why say such things?” Hu replied.
何必说这话？”胡雪岩答值：

“Water helps the boat, and the boat helps the water.
“而且水帮船，船帮水，

There will be plenty of occasions when I must depend on you.”
以后仰仗大哥的事还多。”

“That goes without saying.
“这用不着说，

Your business is mine.
你的事就是我的事。

I do not yet know the inner workings of the Sea Transport Bureau.
海运局的内幕，我还不大清楚，

I shall need your help to manage it.”
要你帮我的忙，才能顶得下来。“


Their conversation was interrupted by a servant showing in a visitor, a goshha from the governor’s office.
刚谈到这里，只见听差引进一位客来，是抚台衙门的一名戈什哈，

The Manchu word originally meant attendance or service, then came to denote a guard; later it was used for the officers who ran errands for governors and governors-general.
这是满洲话“侍奉”的意思，转用为护卫的名称，到了后来，凡是督抚左右跑腿的差官，叫做“戈什哈”，

This man wore a gold hat finial and held the eighth rank.
此人戴着个金顶子，也是个八品官儿，

But before Ji, an expectant magistrate of the seventh rank, he dared not stand on his own official status.
但遇见候补州县七品官的嵇鹤龄，不敢以官自居，

He hurried forward and made two formal salutations.
抢上来请两个安，一面口称，

“Congratulations, Master Ji!”
“恭喜嵇大老爷！”

He had plainly come with the good news.
这自是报喜信的，

Ji modestly disclaimed the honor, helped him up and asked his surname.
嵇鹤龄连称：“不敢当！”扶起来请教：“贵姓？”

“My unworthy surname is Zhu.
“不敢！敝姓朱。

The governor assigned me to the correspondence office.
抚台派我在文案上当差，

Master Chen sent me especially to congratulate you.”
文案陈老爷特别派来跟嵇大老爷报喜。”

From his document case he produced an appointment order bearing a large purple seal and offered it with both hands.
说着，从“护书”中，取出来一封盖着紫泥大印的委札，双手捧向嵇鹤龄。

The envelope was unsealed.
委扎不曾封口，

Ji took out the order and read it: he was indeed to succeed Wang as executive director of the Sea Transport Bureau.
取出来一看，不错，是接王有龄“海运局坐办”。

He passed it to Hu and turned back to Zhu.
嵇鹤龄顺手交了给胡雪岩，转脸向姓朱的说一声：

“Thank you for your trouble.
“劳你的驾，

Please sit down.”
请坐了说话！”

“I would not presume.
“不敢！”姓朱的说：

Master Chen asked me to congratulate you first and to say that he will call this evening.
“陈老爷交代，说先跟嵇大老爷道喜，晚上再来拜会，

He also said the governor is not feeling quite well today.
又交代：抚台今天身子不大爽快，

You need not go to thank him for the appointment until tomorrow.”
嵇老爷今天不必谢宴，等到明天上院好了。”

“Very well.
“好，好！

Please tell Master Chen how deeply grateful I am for his attention.
费心你转达陈老爷，多承他关照，心感万分。

I shall certainly visit his residence this evening.”
准定我今天晚上到他府上去拜访。”

“Yes, sir.
“是，”

May I have your visiting card to report completion of my errand?”
姓朱的又说：“请嵇大老爷赏个名片，我好回去交差。”


This had already been prepared: a visiting card and a red envelope containing twenty taels.
这是早准备好的，一张名帖，一封二十两银子的红包。

As soon as Zhu had been sent off, Ruiyun appeared in a lined purple satin jacket and a pale violet silk skirt, with a red flower in her hair.
刚打发了姓朱的，只见瑞云走了出来，穿一件紫缎夹袄，系一条雪青绸裙，一朵红花，

Smiling, she said, “Master Ji, I have come to congratulate you.”
盈盈笑道：“嵇老爷我来道喜！”

“What is this?”
“怎样！”

Ji was surprised and a little flustered.
嵇鹤龄有些意外，也有些手足无措似地，

“Must you observe these formalities too?
“你也来这一套，

There is no need.
何必！免了，

Please don’t.”
免了。”

“It is only proper.
“应该的。

My warmest congratulations, Master Ji.”
嵇老爷大喜！”

Resting a hand at her left waist, she made a formal curtsy, then called, “Danhe, bring your brothers and sisters to kowtow to your father.”
说着，她手抉左腰裣在为礼，随后又喊：“荷官，带了弟弟、妹妹来替爹爹磕头。”

Danhe led the children out from behind the door, pushing and jostling.
于是丹荷领头，一群小把戏，推推拉拉地都从门边出现，

Ruiyun had clearly arranged it all beforehand.
显然是瑞云早就安排好的，

Dressed as neatly as for New Year, they stumbled onto a long felt mat, laughing as they bowed.
一个个都象过年的样子，穿得整整齐齐的衣服，在一长条毡条上，七跌八撞地，一面磕头，一面笑着。

Ji helped one up and gathered another into his arms, while trying to answer mischievous Danhe’s demands for a reward.
嵇鹤龄扶住这个，抱住那个，嘴里还要应付调皮的丹荷“讨赏”，

The confusion and merriment could hardly have been greater.
乱到十分，也热闹到了十分。

When it subsided, Ji said, “Ruiyun, we really must thank Second Master.”
“瑞云！”嵇鹤龄等乱过一阵，这样说道：“实在要谢谢二老爷……”

“Yes,” she interjected, “but it isn’t merely thanks we owe him.
“是啊！”瑞云抢着按口，“不过倒不是谢谢二老爷，

We should congratulate him too.”
也是要跟二者爷道喜。”

“Congratulations all round!
“同喜，同喜！

Two joys at one door, and no end of celebratory wine!” Hu laughed.
双喜临门，喜酒吃不完。”胡雪岩笑道，

“Ruiyun, you brought all this good fortune.”
“瑞云，都是你带来的运气。”

The compliment filled her with delight.
这句话说得瑞云心花怒放。

She could not help glancing at Ji, then composed her expression.
不自觉地就瞟了嵇鹤龄一眼，然后正一正脸色说道：

“We shall be busy for several days.
“这有好几天可以忙了。

Well-wishers will arrive soon, so tea, tobacco and refreshments must be prepared.
马上就有道喜的人来，茶烟点心，都要早早预备，

Please make yourself comfortable, Second Master.
二老爷请宽坐，

I must leave you.”
我不陪你了。”

She curtsied again and withdrew.
说着又福了福，转身而去。


The bearing of a woman from a great household required composure: a noiseless step and a skirt whose folds did not stir were considered signs of good fortune.
大家妇女的派头，讲究稳重，行路无声，裙幅不动，才是福相，

To Hu’s surprise, Ruiyun already possessed this manner.
瑞云居然亦有这副风范，使得胡雪岩大感意外，

She had probably long meant to emulate the mistress she had served.
大概婢学夫人，早就有心了，

Her ambition was evident, and he could not help exclaiming, “Very good indeed!”
于此见得她的志气，不由得赞了一声：“实在不错！”

Ji too had noticed how completely she looked the part of an official’s lady, and was naturally pleased.
嵇鹤龄也看到了瑞云那俨然命妇的派头，自然也很得意，

His thoughts wandered back to his first meeting with Hu two months before.
得意思往，想到两个月前与胡雪合初见的光景，

It seemed like a dream—an intoxicating spring dream from which he would not soon wake, with still more delightful scenes ahead.
恍似梦寐，这是一个令人沉醉的春梦，而且一时不会醒，还有更妙的梦境在后面。

His boundless happiness turned into deep reflection.
无量欢喜竟化作浓重感慨，

“It is really rather amusing,” he said.
“提起来也真好笑！”他说，

“On the day we first met, I complained that you and Mr Xuexuan had laid a trap: one I could neither refuse nor willingly accept.
“记得我们第一天见面，我还埋怨你跟雪公做下圈套，令人拒之不可，受之不甘。

Who would have thought it was a trap like this?
谁知是这样的圈套，

Even the most uncompromising man might want to walk into it.”
只怕再耿介的人，也要去钻一钻。

The memory made Hu still prouder.
“提到这个回忆，胡雪岩更觉得意，

Since meeting Wang, he had devised many unusual schemes, but none pleased him more than winning over Ji Heling.
从与王有龄认识以来，他出过许多奇奇怪怪的花样，而以“收服嵇鹤龄”最足以自豪，

First, it had saved Xincheng from the disaster of armed conflict.
因为第一，救了新城地方一场刀兵之灾，

Second, it had greatly helped Wang.
其次，帮了王有龄一个大忙，

Third, it had allowed a worthy man to advance instead of lamenting that his talent went unrecognized.
复次，好人出出头，使得嵇鹤龄不致有怀才不遇之叹，

Fourth, it had brought about a happy match.
第四，促成了一头良缘，

Finally, Hu himself had gained a friend as close as flesh and blood.
最后，自己交了一个亲如骨肉的好朋友。

One action had achieved so many good things.
一举而众善备，

He felt that his ingenuity had served him well.
自觉这个脑筋动得实在不坏。

Half joking, he said, “You once told me how many extraordinary schemes Chen Ping devised for Emperor Gaozu of Han.
于是他半开玩笑他说道：“我听你谈过，说汉高祖的陈平，出过多少条奇计，

I have plenty of schemes too, for great matters and small.
我的奇计也很多，大小由之，

Great talents can be put to great use and lesser talents to lesser use.
大才大用，小才小用，

It all depends on the person concerned.”
只看对方自己怎么样。”


“Indeed,” Ji replied.
“是的！嵇鹤龄说：”

“You ought to be the honored adviser of a great lord.
你应该是诸侯的上客，

Your present position does not do you justice.”
象现在这样是委屈了。

“Not necessarily.
““那也不见得。

Things depend on human effort.”
事在人为！”

Talking with Ji had unconsciously given Hu’s speech a literary flavor.
胡雪岩跟嵇鹤龄交谈，话中不知不觉就有书卷气了，

“As the saying goes, generals and ministers are not born of a special breed; a man must strive for himself.
“俗语说得好，‘将相本无种，男儿当自强’，

I may not be a great lord’s honored adviser now, but if I help someone rise to that position, I shall naturally become one.”
我现在虽不是诸侯的上客，帮人做到诸侯的位分，自然就是上客了。”

“Well said!
“这话说得好！

Troubled times bring talent forward.
乱世本来是出人才的时候，

History gives us example after example.”
征诸史书，历历可见。”

“I don’t know what the books say.
“书上怎么说，我不晓得。

But, Elder Brother,” Hu’s face took on a rare expression of sober seriousness, “I believe you when you say this is an age in which talent can rise.
不过，大哥，”胡雪岩的脸上，显出那种在他难得有的、古板正经的神色，“你说现在是出人才的时世，我相信！

In troubled times, one need not be bound by seniority and established rules, so capable men have a better chance.
乱世故事，不必讲资格例规，人才容易出头。

There is something else.
再有一层，

If you go to Shanghai and deal with foreigners, you will see that they have real strengths.
你到过上海，跟洋人打交道，就晓得了，洋人实在有洋人的长处，

Call them cunning if you like, or cold and lacking in loyalty.
不管你说他狡猾也好，寡情薄义也好，

In one respect we cannot match them: they distinguish clearly between right and wrong.
有一点我们及人家不来，人家丁是丁、卯是卯，

If you are right, they acknowledge it and admit their own mistake.
你说得对，他一定服你，自己会认错。

We may know perfectly well that we are wrong and still refuse to admit it, as though doing so would cost our great celestial empire its dignity.
不象我们，明明晓得这件事锗了，不肯承认，仿佛认了错，就失掉了天朝大国的面子。

When people recognize your merits as foreigners do, you have more energy for work and more chance to use your abilities.
象洋人那样，不会埋没你的好处，做事就有劲了，才气也容易发挥了。

Talented people like to accomplish things; they are not necessarily thinking only of themselves.
凡是有才气的人，都是喜欢做事的，不一定为自己打算。

High office and generous pay alone may therefore produce no talent at all—only the ‘slaves’ that Bannermen call themselves before the emperor.”
所以光是高官厚禄，不见得能出人才，只出旗人对皇上自称的‘奴才’！

“Well!”
““嘿！”

Ji opened his eyes wide.
嵇鹤龄睁大了眼说：

“I never expected such a spirited argument from you.
“想不到你能这么痛快的议论。

I may have read a few more books, but in knowledge of the world I cannot compare with you.”
书，我比你多读了几句，论世故，我实在不及你。”

“I am only talking at random,” Hu said modestly.
“我是瞎说的。”胡雪岩谦虚着，

“My lack of reading remains a disadvantage.”
“吃亏还在书读得少。”


“Not at all, not at all.”
“不然，不然！”

Ji shook his head and changed the subject.
嵇鹤龄不断摇头，换了个后题，

“I told you that I wanted to meet some friends from the brotherhood world, You Laowu first among them.
“我说过，我想认识几个江湖上的朋友，第一个是尤五，

We shall certainly need his help now.
这一回少不得要借重他了，

After taking up my duties, I should like to visit Shanghai and Songjiang, both to inspect conditions at the sea outlet and to call on You in person.
我想接了事，先到上海、松江走一趟，一则看看海口的情形，再则专诚去拜访尤五，

Could you come with me?”
不晓得你能不能陪我一起走？”

“Yes.
“可以，

I have many things to attend to in Shanghai myself.
我本来在上海也还有好些事要料理。

But it is too early to settle that.
不过，此刻来说，言之过早。

Let us discuss it after you have thanked the governor and taken office tomorrow.”
等你明天谢了委、接了事再来商量，也还不迟。”

At this point Zhang Gui announced a visitor bearing congratulations.
说到这里，张贵来报，有道喜的客来了。

It was Qiu Fengyan.
这位贺客是裘丰言，

After greeting the host, he turned to Hu with almost reverential admiration.
向主人道过喜，便来跟胡雪岩招呼，将他奉若神明，

Qiu had always admired Ji above others.
因为裘丰言原来最佩服嵇鹤龄，

That Hu could win over such a proud man of talent and go on to become his sworn brother seemed like the Buddha’s subduing the Monkey King.
而胡雪岩能使得恃才傲物的嵇鹤龄服帖，进而结为昆季，这就象如来佛收服孙悟空一般，

It could not fail to inspire awe.
不能不令人倾倒。

Hu was fond of Qiu too.
胡雪岩也很喜欢裘丰言，

The man was warmhearted, good-tempered and willing to take a loss.
此人生来心肠热、脾气好、肯吃亏，

Most unusually, he could recognize the strengths of others and admire them sincerely.
最难得的是眼力高，识得人的长处，而且衷心敬服。

His tastes were distinctive.
同时他的趣味别具一格，

In some respects he was vulgar beyond description; yet he could do something so original and refined that it outdid the cultivated.
说他俗，俗到不堪言状，说他雅，做两件别出心裁的事，比雅人还雅，

That was one reason Ji was able to be his close friend.
这就是嵇鹤龄能够跟他成为好朋友的一大原因。

What Hu particularly liked was his lively spirit.
至于胡雪岩的喜欢他，是喜欢他那副生气勃勃的劲道，

Even if his family had no rice for the cooking pot, he looked as though he had eaten well, slept soundly and wanted only to enjoy himself.
哪怕家里等米下锅，外面看来是吃饱睡足只想找乐趣的样子。


Hu at once thought of a task suited to him.
胡雪岩因材器使，马上替他想到了一桩“差使”：

“Old Qiu, don’t go away today.
“老裘，你今天就不要走了！

Help our host entertain his visitors.”
替主人陪陪客。”

“A duty I cannot refuse!” Qiu replied cheerfully.
“义不容辞！”裘丰言笑嘻嘻地答道：

“Brother Heling is riding the spring breeze, and his reputation is soaring.
“鹤龄兄春风得意，声名鹊起，

There will be plenty of callers; leave them all to me.
贺客必多，都归我招呼。

I have plans for the celebration too—banquets and opera.
摆酒唱戏‘开贺’，我心里也有谱了，

We can have at least ten days of festivities.”
起码有十天好热闹。”

“Wait, my dear fellow!”
“嗳，老兄，老兄！”

Ji hastily stopped him.
嵇鹤龄连忙拦着他说：

“Spare me your schemes.
“你少给我出点花样，

You’ll make me look like a man who has suddenly come into money.”
弄出暴发户的样子来！”

“Every office has its appropriate ceremony.
“做此官，行此礼，

Who doesn’t celebrate a little?”
哪个不是这样子热闹热闹的？”

“What times are we living in?
“斯世何世？

The Long-Haired rebels have fought their way north of the Yellow River, and the Small Swords have risen in Shanghai.
长毛找到黄河以北，上海又是小刀会起事，

If we make a senseless uproar here and one of the censors in Beijing hears of it, a passing mention in a memorial on public affairs could bring us more trouble than we could carry.”
我们在这里瞎起哄，给京里‘都老爷’晓得了，随便什么奏陈时政的析子上，带上一笔，吃不了还兜着走呢！”

“That is true,” Hu agreed, recognizing the need for caution.
“这倒也是实话。”胡雪岩一想是该当心，

“Old Qiu, there is no need for extravagance now.
“老裘，眼前不必铺张，

A quiet day or two among friends will mark the occasion well enough.
自己人悄悄玩一两天，有个庆贺的意思，也就够了。

In any case, there will be another celebration by the end of the year.”
好在至迟年底，总还有一场热闹。”

“Quite right!”
“对，对！”

Qiu readily accepted the better counsel.
裘丰言“从善如流”地连声答应，

“Brother Heling, taking a concubine at year’s end will be as joyful as marriage, which people liken to success in the examinations.
“鹤龄兄，年底纳宠之喜，也就跟洞房花烛的‘小登科’一样。

Surely you cannot then slight that lady of ours, so talented, beautiful, virtuous and kind?”
到那时候，你总不能委屈我们那位才貌双全、既贤且惠的如嫂夫人了吧？”

“We shall see.
“这也再说。

If official business runs smoothly and I am free at the year’s end, a celebration would do no harm.”
如果公事顺手，年下无事，倒不妨热闹热闹。”

“Good!
“好，

That is all I needed to hear.
有这句话就行了。

Naturally I shall be the master of arrangements then.”
年下办喜事，自然也是我的‘总管？’。”


“Of course.
“当然，

We shall have to trouble you.
少不得要奉烦。”

Are you busy at present, Old Qiu?”
嵇鹤龄又问：“老裘，你现在忙不忙？”

“You know me—busy with nothing.”
“你晓得的，我是无事忙。”

“Then be busy with something useful.”
“那就忙点正经的。”

Ji turned to Hu.
嵇鹤龄向胡雪岩问道：

“What do you think of asking Old Qiu to help?”
“你看，请老裘来帮忙如何？”

“What objection could there be?”
“那还有什么话说？”

Then a thought struck Hu.
胡雪岩忽然想到一件享，便接下来问一句：

“What sort of help do you have in mind?”
“你请老裘在哪方面帮忙？”

“Escorting the shipments, naturally.”
“自然是押运。”

“That is what I thought.”
“我也猜到是这方面。”

Hu turned to Qiu.
胡雪岩问裘丰言说：

“Would you condescend to serve as a convoy commissioner for the Sea Transport Bureau?”
“老裘！请你当海运局的押运委员，你肯不肯屈就？”

“There is no question of condescending.
“谈不到这两个字。

I have never been on a sea-going vessel and don’t know whether I might be seasick.
海船我还没有坐过，不晓得会不会晕船？

But never mind all that.
这都不去说它了，

Whatever you two decide, I’ll do.”
反正你们两位说怎么，就是怎么！”

“Much obliged!”
“承情之至！”

Ji clasped his hands, then said to Hu, “I suspect you have another task for Old Qiu too.”
嵇鹤龄拱拱手，又向胡雪岩说道：“我猜你另外还有事托老裘？”


“Yes.
“是啊！

Burn incense and visit the monk—two errands accomplished in one journey.
‘烧香看和尚，一事两勾当’，

Once your memorandum is approved, we can ask him to go to Songjiang first.”
等你那个条陈准了，先请老裘到松江跑一趟。”

“I see!
“我懂了！”

You want him to bring back the guns.”
嵇鹤龄说，“你想把那批枪托老裘带了回来？”

“Exactly.
“对了！”

I had intended to send my young pupil.
胡雪岩说，“我本来想叫我那个‘学生子’去办，

But he may be too young and inexperienced, and after all, a ‘first-rank commoner’ still cannot compare in standing with our distinguished Master Qiu.”
一则伯他年纪轻，不够老练，再则，‘一品者百姓’的身分，到底比不上我们裘大老爷！”

“Enough, enough!” Qiu said in mock surrender.
“好了，好了！”裘丰言用告烧的语气说，

“Brother Xueyan, stop teasing me.
“雪岩兄，你不必调侃我了。

You have talked for so long, and I still don’t quite understand the business.”
说了半天是怎么回事？我还不甚明白。

Hu outlined the arrangements for transferring the tribute grain and buying guns from the British.
“于是胡雪岩把海运转驳和向英商购枪两事，说了个大概，

Qiu loved activity and friendship.
裘丰言好热闹，爱朋友，

Like Ji, he was eager to meet a man such as You Laowu, and transporting foreign guns sounded new and interesting.
对尤五这样的人，跟嵇鹤龄一样，渴望结交，运洋枪的差使，也觉得新鲜有趣，

He agreed without reservation.
所以满口答应。

“But to speak frankly, the journey is not entirely without risk,” Ji warned.
“不过，说句实话，此行也不是全无意外！”嵇鹤龄提出警告，

“Bandits are everywhere these days, and many secretly covet such effective weapons.
“这年头，萑苻遍地，洋枪这样的利器，暗中颇有人眼红。

You are famous as the Wine Muddlehead, Old Qiu.
老裘，你是有名的‘酒糊涂’，

You must drink less on the way.”
一路上要少喝。”

“I can drink a little less.
“少喝一点可以。

Don’t worry.
你放心好了，

At every meal I always stop just short of becoming muddled.”
我每顿总喝到快要糊涂为止。”


Ji and Hu laughed.
嵇、胡二人都笑了。

“Old Qiu,” Hu asked curiously, “have you ever been drunk in your life?”
“老裘！”胡雪岩好奇地问道，“你平生醉过没有？”

“Only once.
“只醉过一趟。”

On my wedding day, and then deliberately.”
裘丰言说，“是我娶亲那天，特意喝醉的。”

“Why?” Hu asked in surprise.
“为什么？”胡雪岩诧异地问。

“Out of resentment.
“负气！”裘丰言说，

My late father arranged the marriage.
“我那头亲人，是先父定下的，

I wanted to marry the girl next door, but he absolutely refused.
照我的心意，想娶东邻之女，先父说什么不许。

I had a stubborn notion of my own: I could not stop the bridal chair from entering, but whether husband and wife shared a heart as well as a room was my affair.
我心里存个拙见，花轿要抬进门，我设法阻挡，洞房之中，同床异梦，是我自己的事。

At the wedding feast, my young schoolfriends made a great commotion and pressed drinks on me.
所以吃喜酒的时候，同学少年起哄来灌，

I refused none of them and was already six or seven parts drunk.
我来者不拒，已吃到了六、七分。

When I entered the bridal chamber, instead of lifting the bride’s veil, I lifted the cover of a wine jar.
一进新房，我不揭新娘子的盖头，去揭酒坛子的盖头，

I drank until I collapsed unconscious and slept a whole day and night before waking.”
吃得颓然大醉，人事不知，整整睡了一天一夜才醒。”

“You deserved a beating!” Hu said, laughing with curiosity.
“该打屁股！”胡雪岩好奇地笑着，

“The bride must have cried all night.”
“新娘子必是哭了一夜？”

“She didn’t cry.
“新娘子倒没有哭，

My late mother did! She had never seen me drunk and was frightened.
先母从没有看我醉过，吓得哭了！

Do you know how drunk I was?
你道我醉得如何？

It was the eleventh month, yet a piece of bean curd placed on my chest became burning hot in no time.”
十一月的天气，一块豆腐放在胸口，要不了多久就滚烫了。“


“Good heavens!”
“好家伙！”

Hu clicked his tongue.
胡雪岩咋舌，

“You might have drunk yourself to death.”
“你这么喝，不把命都喝掉了？”

Ji had never heard this story.
嵇鹤龄没有听他谈过这一段，

He was more interested in the bride and quickly asked, “What did your wife do?
此时感兴趣的是他的新娘子，便抢着问道：“尊夫人如何？

Even if she didn’t cry, she must have pleaded with you.”
虽不哭，必是苦苦相劝？”

“Nothing of the kind!”
“没有那话！”

Qiu shook his head.
裘丰言摇摇头，

“You could guess until daybreak and never imagine what she did.”
“你们道内人如何？只怕猜到天亮也猜不着。”

“Then spare us the guessing and confess the truth.”
“那就不要猜了，你自己从实供来！”

“She sent the woman attending her back to her parents’ house with a message: the new son-in-law loved wine as dearly as life itself, so they should send twenty jars of good wine.”
“内人当时叫‘伴房’的回娘家，说新姑爷好酒若命，叫她娘家送二十坛好酒来……”

“Wonderful!” Ji exclaimed.
“妙！”嵇鹤龄失声而呼，

“And what did you do?”
“那你怎么样呢？”

“What could I do?
“我还有怎么样？

It is rare in life to find someone who understands you.
人生难得一知己，

I loved wine, and she found good wine for me.
我好酒，她寻好酒来我吃，

How could I fail to surrender?”
你想想，我怎么能不服帖？”

Ji and Hu laughed heartily, and Qiu laughed too at the happy absurdity of his younger days.
嵇鹤龄跟胡雪岩都大笑，裘丰言回忆着少年的妙事，自己也笑了。

“Strange to say, from that day I saw my wife differently.
“说也奇怪！”他又说，“从那一天起，我对内人的看法就两样了，

Before, I had thought her so plump that she looked stupid.
原来看她胖得有些蠢，

Now I reflected that Imperial Consort Yang was plump, Consort Wan of the Ming was plump, and Xue Baochai in Dream of the Red Chamber was plump too.
这时候想想，杨贵妃是胖的，明朝的万贵妃也是胖的，《红楼梦》上的薛宝钗也是胖的。

Her feet were a little large, admittedly.
脚是大了点，

Those three-inch golden lotuses of hers—” “Wait!” Ji interrupted.
她的三寸金莲……”“慢来，慢来！”嵇鹤龄抢着问道：

“How can three-inch golden lotuses be large feet?”
“三寸金莲怎么说是大脚？”

“I hadn’t finished,” Qiu replied calmly.
“我的话还没有完。”裘丰言不慌不忙地答道，

“My wife’s three-inch lotuses are measured across, like the feet of Guanyin herself.”
“内人的三寸金莲是横量，跟观音大士一样。”

Laughter erupted both inside and outside.
这一下，里里外外都是笑声。

The children might not understand his wit, but the adults’ merriment was contagious.
孩子们未见得听懂裘丰言的妙语，但极易受大人的感染，

Danhe had never seen her father and his guests laugh so uncontrollably; the spectacle itself struck her as comical, and she laughed harder than anyone.
第一个丹荷就不曾看见他父亲与客人们这么笑不可抑过，因而颇有滑嵇之感，便忍不住笑得比什么人都厉害。

Ruiyun was already so full of happiness that laughter came readily.
而瑞云则已内心充满了笑意，一触即发，

Besides, she understood Qiu’s wonderfully pointed description of his plump, large-footed wife.
况且裘丰言谈他那位大脚的胖太太，措词甚“绝”，她也是听得懂的。


Amid the laughter another distinguished visitor arrived: Wang Youling.
就在这一片笑声中，又有位贵客翩然而临，是王有龄，

The atmosphere naturally became more formal.
这下场面自然变得严肃了，

With Qiu present, neither host nor guests could speak with much hidden meaning.
有裘丰言在座，宾主都不便说什么涵意较深的话，

Once congratulations and thanks had been exchanged, Wang said, “Brother Heling, everything is ready for my handover.
一个道了贺，一个致了谢，王有龄便说：“鹤龄兄，我的移交现成，

You may take over at any time.
你随时可接，

Rather than choose a special day, why not use the opportunity at hand?
我看拣日不如撞日，

After thanking the governor tomorrow, come to the bureau and begin your duties.
你明天谢了委，就请移驾到局先视了事，

Then I can lay down the burden and breathe a little more easily.”
也好让我早卸仔肩，稍松口气。”

“Mr Xuexuan,” Ji replied apologetically, clasping his hands, “I am afraid I cannot comply in that respect.
“雪公！”嵇鹤龄拱拱手用歉意的声音说，“这一层实在不能从命，

Please let me first consult you properly before taking over.”
容我先好好跟你老请教了再接事，如何？”

“Then…”
“那么，”

Wang glanced at Qiu.
王有龄看了看裘丰言说，

“Brother Fengyan, will you join us for a simple dinner at my house?”
“丰言兄，一起到舍下便饭吧！”

Qiu was thoroughly versed in social affairs.
裘丰言也是熟透了人情世故的，

He understood that the others had already arranged to meet and would have private matters to discuss.
听这话便知他们预先有约，当然有好些体己话要说，

He must not make himself unwelcome, but he would not state the reason openly.
自己决不能去惹厌。然而他也不肯实说这层意思，

“I’ll impose on you another day,” he said, pointing to the floor.
“改天到府上叨拢，”他指指地下说，

“Brother Heling has charged me with receiving his well-wishers.
“鹤龄兄见委，要我为他接待贺客。

Tonight I shall impose on his household for my wine.”
我今天晚上一顿酒，就拢嵇府上的了。”

That suited everyone.
这样安排也很好。

Ji went inside especially to tell Ruiyun to look after their guest.
于是嵇鹤龄特地入内，关照瑞云，款待嘉宾，

With apologies and thanks to Qiu for his trouble, he left with Wang and Hu.
然后道声“拜托，偏劳”，与王有龄、胡雪岩一起出门。


At Wang’s house, Mrs Wang had ordered a banquet from the Xiaoyoutian Fujian restaurant, both to congratulate Ji and to welcome Hu home.
到了王家，王太太已特地从“小有天”闽菜馆叫了一桌席，为嵇鹤龄贺喜，兼为胡雪岩接风。

However sumptuous the dishes, a banquet for only three would lack the company to make it enjoyable.
三个人吃酒席，虽是盛馔，亦难下咽，

Hu therefore proposed inviting some colleagues from the Sea Transport Bureau.
因此胡雪岩出个主意，索性请些海运局的同事来赴席，

It would let Wang thank them for their usual assistance and introduce them to Ji.
一则作为王有龄酬谢他们平日帮忙，再则也为嵇鹤龄引见。

Summoning guests with hurried invitations was not particularly courteous, but among colleagues it mattered little.
临时飞笺召客，原是不甚礼貌的举动，不过都是局内同事，也就无所谓了。

While they waited, Wang took his visitors into the study to discuss the handover.
在等候甜这段时间，王有龄延客入书房，商谈移交。

There was a deficit in the bureau’s accounts.
王有龄在海运局有亏空，

By long-standing custom, a successor generally inherited his predecessor’s deficit as an outstanding item.
但历来相沿的习惯，大致前任亏空总归后任接收，作为一笔宕帐，

If he could cover it, he did; if not, he passed it on to his own successor.
能弥补就弥补，不能弥补就再移交给后任。

When it could no longer be passed on, serious trouble followed.
到了移交不过去时，那就要出大乱子了。

Much depended on the predecessor’s influence, on whether the successor was accommodating or exacting, and on their relationship.
当然前任是红是黑，后任是忠厚还是精明，以及彼此的交情，都有关系，

Here the outgoing and incoming men were virtually one person, so no disagreement was expected.
在目前这种情况下，前后任等于一个人，自然没有话说。

Hu nevertheless felt that a definite arrangement was necessary.
但胡雪岩觉得这件事应该有个明确的处置，

Otherwise Ji would bear the burden, which would trouble Hu’s conscience; and any eventual scandal would only make trouble for Hu himself.
否则就变成让嵇鹤龄受累，不仅于心不安，而且出了乱子，也就无异为自己找麻烦。

“Mr Xuexuan,” he began, “this is like taking over a shop.
“雪公！”他一开始就这样说，“现在等于做生意盘一爿店一样，

Even brothers should keep clear accounts.
亲兄弟明算帐，

The debt may remain outstanding, but its amount must be settled precisely.
帐尽管宕在那里，算不能不算清楚。

We can then decide how to clear it.
该如何归清，我们再想办法，

Once my Shanghai silk is sold, I think there will be no difficulty.”
等我上海的丝卖掉，我想就不要紧了。”

Wang understood at once.
听胡雪岩一说，王有龄心里有数，赶紧答道：

“Of course.
“应该应该。

We share good fortune and bad.
我们休戚相关，灾福相共，

We cannot simply dump a ruined concern on Brother Heling.”
决不能把个烂摊子甩了给鹤龄兄就算数。”

That made matters easier.
这一说，事情就好办了，

Whatever could be accounted for as expenditure would be so accounted for; whatever could not would remain outstanding, to be reconsidered if it could no longer be carried forward.
那笔宕帐，能报销的报销，不能报销的，宕在那里，宕不过去再说，

With Hu there, Ji would not be left in difficulty.
反正有胡雪岩在，不会叫嵇鹤龄为难。

Their existing relationship with Fat Zhang would continue unchanged.
至于张胖子那里，继续维持旧有的关系，也就没有什么可说的。

Ji listened, nodding without speaking.
嵇鹤龄一路听，一路点头，保持沉默，

That was the appropriate attitude.
这是最适当的态度，

He owed the appointment to Wang and Hu; this was no time to advance his own demands.
这个差使由王有龄和胡雪岩身上而来，此刻便不宜有所主张，

Once in office, he could exercise his abilities so long as he did not harm either of them.
等接了事，只要不伤害到他们两人，自己尽可发挥，

There was no need to assert himself now.
亦无须在此时有所主张。


When they turned to staffing, however, Ji did have something to say.
接着就谈到用人，这下嵇鹤龄却有话了，

“Mr Xuexuan, which men at the bureau must be retained?”
“雪公！”他问，“局里哪几位是非留不下可的？”

Wang understood.
王有龄懂得他的意思，

“I have no personal men there,” he replied, meaning none whose interests were closely bound to his own.
“我没有什么人。”这是表示没有什么利害关系深切的私人，

“But one or two have worked hard.
“不过，有一两位平日颇为出力，

Keep them if you can.
你能维持就维持，

If you really find them unsuitable, of course it is for you to decide.”
真的以为不行，当然也由你自己处置。”

He named two colleagues.
接着，王有龄说了两个可事的名字，

Ji noted their names and said he would do his best to retain them.
嵇鹤龄都把他记了下来，表示一定设法维持。

“Is there anyone else you would like a place found for?”
“那么，雪公另外有没有人要安插呢？”

Wang considered.
王有龄想了想说：

“A distant nephew has recently come from our native place.
“我有个远房侄于，最近从家乡来，

I do not want to take him to Huzhou, for fear people will say there are too many official relatives about.
我不想把他带到湖州，怕有人说闲话，‘官亲’太多。

If you could place him, I should be most grateful.”
你如果能设法安插，那就求之不得了。”

“Certainly.
“好！

Please have him give me an account of his qualifications.
请雪公叫令侄开个履历给我。”

Xueyan and I have also agreed that we should like to employ Qiu Fengyan.
嵇鹤龄又说：“我跟雪岩商量好了，预备用裘丰言。

What do you think?”
雪公看如何？”

This was Ji’s tact: he deliberately showed respect and cordiality.
这是嵇鹤龄的子腕，有意表示恭敬亲切，

Even had Wang disapproved, he would scarcely have objected to an arrangement Hu supported.
当然，王有龄即使不赞成，因为有胡雪岩的意思在内，也不会反对，

In fact, it did not concern his interests, and he thought well of Qiu.
而况事不干已，且对裘丰言的印象不坏，

He nodded repeatedly.
所以他连连点头：

“Very good, very good.”
“很好，很好！”


“There is another matter,” Hu added.
“再有，”胡雪岩接着说，

“I should like Old Qiu to go to Songjiang and collect the foreign guns on the same journey.
“到松江去接洋枪，我想请老裘顺便去跑一趟，

Please arrange another official document.”
请雪公再弄件公事。”

“The papers are easy.
“公文方便。

But will the Wine Muddlehead make a mistake on such an errand?
不过‘酒糊涂’办这种事，会不会出纰漏？”

I think it would be best to send that young fellow Chen with him.
王有龄说，“我看最好叫你那个姓陈的后生跟了他去，

He is young, but capable.”
这个人年纪虽轻，人倒能干。”

“Since you think him capable, why not give him some appointment in Huzhou?” Hu said without thinking.
“既然寻公看他能干，不妨在猢州给他一个什么差使。”胡雪岩毫不思索他说了这一句，

Then, realizing that this was not quite what he wanted, he quickly added, “A nominal appointment, of course.”
想想又不对，赶紧再接一句：“当然是挂名差使。”

“Why a nominal one?”
“挂名差使又何必？”

“There is a reason.
“有个道理。”

Chen Shilong is to marry at the end of the year.
胡雪岩说，“陈世龙年底要成亲了。

An appointment would put him among men entitled to official dress and make a better showing for both families.”
有个差使，便算衣冠中人，男女两家的场面上都好看些。”

“That can be done,” Wang replied casually.
“这可以！”王有龄随口答道，

“Whose family is the bride from?”
“女家是哪一家？”

“The bride is A’zhu.”
“新娘子就是阿珠。”

“Ah!”
“咦！”

Wang and Ji showed the same surprise and bewilderment, neither knowing how to pursue the question.
王有龄和嵇鹤龄不约而同的面现诧异之色，而且都非常困惑，不知这话怎么问下去？

They did not need to ask.
也不需他们动问，

Hu himself related how he had arranged the future of that fresh blossom from a humble home.
胡雪岩自己把那段移植蓬门清卉的经过，讲了一遍。

Both listened closely, but their reactions differed.
王有龄和嵇鹤龄自然都极注意的在听，但两人的反应不同，

Wang felt regret on Hu’s behalf; Ji approved heartily, saying that this spirited act had the chivalrous generosity of a hero from a Tang tale.
王有龄是替他惋惜，嵇鹤龄则颇为赞成，说胡雪岩这件“快举”，大有唐人侠义之风。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十六章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Sixteen, first part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER SIXTEEN｜第十六章


When Hu returned home that day, he sent A’fu to fetch Chen Shilong from the nearby inn.
当天回家，胡雪岩叫阿福把住在附近客栈里的陈世龙去找了来，

He had good news for him: Chen was no longer needed to collect the guns at Songjiang.
他是要告诉他一个好消息，到松江接枪，已经用不着他了。

There was nothing for him to do in Hangzhou just now either, so he could go back to Huzhou first and visit his “mother-in-law.”
眼前在杭州也没有什么事，可以先回湖州一趟，去见一见“丈母娘”。

“There’s no need,” Chen said.
“不必！”陈世龙说，

“Collecting the guns will be troublesome too.
“接枪的事情，也很麻烦，

I had better go with Mr Qiu.”
我跟了裘老爷去好了。”

“Why?”
“为什么呢？”

Hu was surprised.
胡雪岩倒有些诧异，

Surely this was a delightful errand anyone would welcome.
心想这是求之不得的“美差”，

Why should Chen refuse the kindness?
陈世龙不该不领情。

Chen was far from ungrateful.
他何尝不领情，

He longed to see A’zhu; a few days apart had seemed like years.
心里也巴不得去看一看小别数日，便如数年的阿珠，

But he wanted to repay Hu by doing whatever work he could.
只是为了感恩图报，自愿出力。

To explain that would take the meaning out of it, so he remained silent.
而这话他又不愿说，觉得说了便没意思了，因而沉默不答。

Hu needed only a little attention to read his expression and see into his heart.
胡雪岩是察言观色，只需稍力用点心，便可以看透他的腑肺，

Secretly pleased, he did not expose the reason.
心里暗暗欣慰，也不说破，只这样告诉他：

“Your visit to your mother-in-law is merely a dispatch carried on the way.
“叫你去看丈母娘是‘顺带公文一角’，

I cannot go to Huzhou just yet, and there are several things you must do for me.
湖州我一时去不了，有好些事，要你替我去办。

You are not going to Songjiang.”
你不必到松江去了！”

The final sentence had all the authority of an elder’s command.
最后一句话，完全是长辈的口气，

There was no room for bargaining.
没有讨价还价的余地，

Chen could only nod.
陈世龙只好点点头。


“First, tell your Uncle Four that, if he has spare funds, I need them.
“第一件，你跟你郁四叔去说，如果有多余的头寸，我要用，

Ask him to remit them to Fukang, preferably for a fairly long term.
请他汇到阜康来，期限最好长一点，

I will pay him an especially generous rate of interest.
利息我特别加厚。

Second...”
第二件……”

Hu paused.
说到第二件，他沉吟了，

He wanted to move Huang Yi elsewhere, but the silk firm had only just begun operations.
意思是想把黄仪调开，但丝行才开始做，

They ought at least to finish this season and settle how much net profit had been made and what bonus Huang should receive.
总得把这一“季”做出个起落来，净赚多少，该分多少花红，

A tangible settlement that let employer and employee part happily was the proper course.
有个实实惠惠的交代，则宾主尽欢而散，才是正办。

To move him now would look like destroying the bridge after crossing it, and word of that would damage Hu’s reputation.
照目前这样子，仿佛有些过河拆桥，传出去于自己的名声有损。

“Shilong, what do you think of Huang Yi?”
“世龙，”他问：“你看黄仪这个人怎么样？”

“He has ability, but doesn’t get on well with others,” Chen replied frankly.
“本事是有的，不大合得来群。”陈世龙直抒观感。

“Exactly.
“对！

You’ve put your finger on his weakness.
你说到了他的短处。”

Your father-in-law himself says he can’t manage him.
胡雪岩说，“你丈人自己说过，‘吃不住他’，

I must find a way to move him elsewhere, but the time isn’t right yet.
我要想个办法，把他调开，不过目前还不到时候，

Tell your father-in-law to get along with him as best he can for now.
你跟你丈人说，好歹先敷衍敷衍他，

I’ll have a suitable arrangement next year.”
到明年我自有妥当办法。”

“I understand.
“我晓得了。”

It would be best if you wrote Uncle Four a letter too.”
陈世龙又说，“郁四叔那里，最好请胡先生写封信。”

“I shall write, and there are things for you to take.
“信我是要写的，还有东西带去。

Ah!” Hu suddenly exclaimed.
啊！”胡雪岩突然喊了起来，

“That reminds me.
“我倒想起来了，

Old Huang writes very well.
老黄文墨很不错，

I’d like him to help me by attending solely to my correspondence.
我想请他来帮忙，专门替我写写信，

Sound him out.
你倒探探他的口气看！

I’ll pay enough to meet his needs.
送他的酬劳，一定够他用，

Find out what he thinks and write to tell me.”
你看他的意思如何？写信来告诉我。”


“That’s a good idea too.
“这倒也不错。

You’re the only person who can bring Old Huang round.
老黄这个人也只有胡先生能收服，

He works best on his own, without having to cooperate with anyone.
他做事最好自己做自己的，不跟人联手，

He would certainly do it well.”
一定做得好。”

With this agreed, Chen spent two full days buying the local delicacies and other gifts Hu wanted taken to Huzhou, together with cloth and food for his own offerings to his future parents-in-law, and rouge and scented face powder to please A’zhu.
这样商量定了，陈世龙便整整忙了两天，把胡雪岩要带到湖州送人的土仪什物，以及他自己“孝敬”丈人丈母娘的衣料与食物，向阿珠献殷勤的胭脂花粉，一起采办齐全，

The following day he boarded a passenger boat and went straight to Huzhou.
再下一天就下了航船，直放湖州。

His first call ashore was at Dajing Silk Firm.
一上岸先到大经丝行，

He met A’zhu’s mother coming towards him and, wholly unprepared, became awkward and flustered.
迎面就遇见阿珠的娘，心里没有预备，顿时搞得手足无措。

Even a greeting was difficult.
首先称呼就为难，

He could hardly call her Mrs Zhang any longer, yet could not bring himself to say “Mother.”
自然不能再叫“张太太”，但又老不出面皮喊声，“娘！”

She, however, was surprised and delighted.
阿珠的娘，却是又惊又喜，

“What brings you back?
“你怎么回来了？”

Come and sit down first.
她说，“来，先坐了再说，

Your father-in-law is inside too.”
你丈人也在里头。”

She turned and went ahead.
说着，她自己先转身走了进去。

Chen collected himself.
陈世龙定定神，

Evidently his future mother-in-law approved of him.
心里在想，看这样子，丈母娘对自己是中意的，

His one fear had been that, having received so much from Hu, she might dislike this marriage or silently harbour a grievance about it.
他唯一的顾虑，是怕阿珠的娘，觉得受胡雪岩的好处太多，不一定以这头亲事为然，或者口中不说，心里起了个疙瘩。

Now that worry seemed unnecessary.
现在，这个疑虑似乎是多余的了。


Beyond the shopfront and its screen, the second courtyard led into the reception hall.
由店堂绕过屏风，走人第二进就是客帚，

It was not the season for buying silk, and there was not a customer in the empty hall.
这时不是收丝的季节，空荡荡地一个客人都没有，

Huang Yi was in a side room, however.
但旁边厢房却有人，是黄仪，

Catching sight of Chen through the window, he called, “Why, the honoured new son-in-law has arrived!”
在窗子里望见了便喊：“啊呀，新贵人上门了！”

Still calling, he hurried out with a welcoming smile.
一路喊，一路抢了出来，笑脸迎人。

Chen stopped, somewhat embarrassed.
陈世龙有些发窘，站定了脚招呼一声：

“How are you, Mr Huang?”
“黄先生，你好！”

“You’ve filled out!”
“你发福了！”

Tilting his head, Huang looked him over from head to foot.
黄仪歪着头，从上到下把陈世龙端详了一遍，

“A few months in Shanghai have changed your appearance.”
“上海住了几个月，样子变过了！”

This drew the mother’s attention.
这一说引起了阿珠的娘的注意，

She too stepped back and stared.
也是退后两步，直盯着陈世龙看。

Clothes from the foreign settlement were always finer; and with a mother-in-law looking at her prospective son-in-law, her smile naturally grew broader and broader.
夷场上的衣饰总要漂亮些，又是“丈母娘看女婿”，所以她脸上的笑意越堆越浓，

Huang could not resist more teasing.
这样就更要惹得黄仪开玩笑。

“Mrs Zhang, you can study him at leisure when you get home.
“张太太，”他笑着说，“回去慢慢看！

Our new son-in-law is shy.
新贵人脸嫩，

You’re embarrassing him.”
看得他不好意思了。”

Already taking his side, she laughed. “If you know he’s shy, say a little less!
“晓得他脸嫩，你就少说一两句！”阿珠的娘已经在卫护女婿，这样笑着说，

Come inside, both of you.”
“都到里头来坐！”

“Yes!” Huang said enthusiastically.
“对！”黄仪兴味盎然地，

“I’ll come and watch you exchange the formal greetings.”
“我到里头来看你们‘见礼’。”

This gave her an idea.
阿珠的娘心里一动，立刻有了个主意，

A young man’s first visit to his future wife’s family ought to be made with a matchmaker or someone who knew both families, to spare everyone embarrassment.
她是体恤女婿，看陈世龙有点发窘，心里便想，“毛脚女婿”第一次上门，总要有个媒人，或者男女两家都熟悉的亲友陪着，彼此才不致尴尬。

Chen had come like a crab without legs.
现在陈世龙象个“没脚蟹”似地，

Why not enlist Huang?
要请黄仪来帮忙，

Custom required two matchmakers.
媒人照规矩是两位，

Hu was one; wasn’t the other standing ready before her?
有了一个胡雪岩，另一个不是现成在眼前？


“Mr Huang, Mr Hu is the matchmaker on our daughter’s side.
于是她说：“黄先生，我们女家的大媒是胡先生，

Would you be so kind as to act for the bridegroom?”
男家的大媒老爷，拜托了你好不好？”

“Gladly!
“怎么不好？

A ready-made match to arrange—what could be better?”
现成的媒人，求之不得。”

Chen understood her consideration.
陈世龙也听出丈母娘意存体恤，

Nothing could suit him better.
这样安排，再好不过，

He clasped his hands and bowed to Huang.
便向黄仪拱手作揖：

“I entrust it to you, Mr Huang.”
“黄先生，我重重拜托！”

“Of course, of course!”
“好说，好说！”

Huang was delighted.
黄仪很高兴地，

“Then, Mrs Zhang, I must greet you as our new relation by marriage.”
“那么，张太太，我要叫你亲家太太了！”

Talking and laughing, they entered the courtyard Hu had formerly occupied.
就这样说笑着，一起进了胡雪岩以前所住的那个院子，

Old Zhang came out at the sound, equally surprised and pleased.
老张闻声迎了出来，也有意外的惊喜，

“Father!” Chen called.
陈世龙喊一声：“爹！”

With a father, there was naturally a mother too.
有了爹自然有娘，

Guided by Huang in his new capacity as matchmaker, Chen kowtowed to the couple, formally paid his respects and adopted his new forms of address.
黄仪以媒人的身份，从中牵引，陈世龙便又替老张夫妇磕了头，正式见过礼，改了口，

A’zhu’s mother could scarcely stop smiling.
把阿珠的娘笑得合不扰口。

The firm’s clerks, outside errand man, cook and two or three women who reeled silk all came to watch.
这时大经丝行里用的伙计，出店、烧饭司务，还有两三个缫丝的女工，都跑了来看热闹，

Chen had always been well liked, so everyone was happy for him, though most had a joke to make.
因为陈世龙平常人缘极好，所以都替他高兴，但也多要开几句玩笑。

He had considered meeting his mother-in-law the hardest ordeal.
陈世龙觉得最艰难的是见丈母娘这一关，

Once through it, he no longer minded.
这一关一过就不在乎，

His skin had grown thicker; he let them say what they pleased and answered only with a restrained smile.
脸皮也厚了，随他们去说，只报以矜持的微笑。


Another ordeal now arrived, though it was A’zhu, rather than himself, for whom Chen was anxious.
然而另一个难关又来了，这一关不是他自己难过，是替阿珠担心，

By an awkward coincidence she had just come from home to the firm.
说巧不巧，阿珠从家里到丝行，

The half-suppressed smiles she encountered on her way in had already made her suspicious.
一路走进来，就看见大家想笑不笑，已在怀疑，

As soon as she entered the courtyard, she saw Chen.
等踏入院子，第一眼就看见陈世龙，

In sudden confusion she tried to slip away, but it was too late.
心里一慌，赶紧想溜，已来不及。

“A’zhu!” her father called from inside.
“阿珠！”老张在里头喊。

Ignoring him, she kept going out.
阿珠不理，依旧往外走，

A silk-reeling woman named A’cui, who loved to meddle, happened to be behind her and blocked the doorway.
有个缫丝的女工叫阿翠，生性最好事，偏偏就在她身后，堵着门不让她出去。

“Get out of the way!” A’zhu whispered angrily.
“走开！”她低声怒喝。

“Don’t run away!” A’cui laughed.
“你不要逃嘛！”阿翠笑道，

“It isn’t as though you don’t know him.”
“又不是不认识。”

Laughter broke out inside and outside.
于是里面也笑，外面也笑，

Only when A’zhu finally escaped through the door did Chen breathe freely.
终于让阿珠夺门逃走，陈世龙才算松了一口气。

Her mother was concerned for her daughter and considerate of Chen, whose heart, she guessed, had already flown after her.
阿珠的娘记挂着女儿，同时为女婿设想，料知他一颗心也早就飞了出去，

Looking at the hour, she proposed returning home and invited Huang to supper.
因而看一看天色，提议回家，顺便邀黄仪一起去吃晚饭。

He was delighted.
黄仪大喜。

He disliked gambling, did not chase women, and did not even smoke a dry pipe.
他不喜欢赌钱，也不会花花草草在外头搞女人，甚至连旱烟都不抽，

Food was his one indulgence, and he knew his employer’s wife could cook.
唯一的嗜好，是口腹之欲，这位“老板娘”的烹调手段，他是领教过的，

While Zhang and A’zhu were in Shanghai, she had been alone at home with her maid Aizhen, and he could hardly impose on them.
只是在老张父女到上海去的那些日子，只有阿珠的娘带着个使女爱珍在家，他不便上门去叨扰。

Since Zhang’s return he had dined there twice, but the everyday dishes, though excellent and beautifully prepared, had not been plentiful enough for him to eat his fill.
从老张回来以后，才又去吃过两次饭，家常肴馔、精洁有余，丰腆不足，未能大嚼，

Today they were entertaining both a prospective son-in-law on his first visit and a matchmaker.
今天又是款待“毛脚女婿”，又是请媒人，

A satisfying dinner was assured.
自然有一顿称心满意的晚饭好吃了。


“Go ahead,” Old Zhang told his wife.
“你先去！”老张对他妻子说，

“Shilong and I will sort out the presents Mr Hu has sent.
“胡先生带来送人的东西，我跟世龙先料理料理，

We’ll come when we’ve finished.”
弄好了就回来。”

“It’s late already.
“今天也晚了，

Leave them until tomorrow.
留到明天再说。”

Shilong had better stay at the shop, where tea and water will be handy.
阿珠的娘这样嘱咐：“世龙就住在店里好了，要茶要水也方便。

Let him choose whichever room he likes, have them clean it and fetch bedding from home.”
要住哪一问自己挑，挑好了叫他们打扫，铺盖到家里去拿。”

Her care was entirely a parent’s.
这番体贴，完全是父母之心，

Chen was deeply touched, but uneasy too.
陈世龙极其感动，但也很不安，

Already he felt his debt to his future wife’s family was too great to repay.
就此刻他已觉得岳家的恩情太重，不知何以报答？

Added to Hu’s efforts to advance him, it almost frightened him.
加上胡雪岩的一手提拔，越有恐惧不胜之情，

Inevitably he remembered A’zhu’s encouragement: “A good wife doesn’t depend on the clothes she brought at marriage.
于是不由得又想到阿珠的那番激励：“ ‘好女不穿嫁时衣’，

It’s a pity you didn’t buy these jewels for me yourself!”
这些首饰，可惜不是你买给我的！”

He also remembered Hu telling her, “When Shilong prospers, he’ll buy you diamonds.”
同时也记了胡雪岩对阿珠说过的那句话：“等世龙将来发达了，给你买金刚钻。”

The two remarks together fixed his determination.
两下凑在一起，陈世龙死心塌地了！

Once her mother had gone, he told Old Zhang, “Father, take Mr Huang home first.
“爹！”等阿珠的娘一走，陈世龙这样对老张说：“你先陪了黄先生回去。

I’ll come when I’ve finished Mr Hu’s business.
我把胡先生交代的事，办完了就来。

I’ll sleep at my own place tonight to save trouble.”
今天我仍旧回家去住，省得麻烦。”

“Why?” Huang urged.
“何必？”黄仪劝他：

“You can see to it early tomorrow.”
“明天一早来料理也一样。”

“No,” Chen insisted.
“不！”陈世龙固执地：

“Today’s work must be finished today.
“今日事，今日毕，

Tomorrow has its own business.
明天有明天的事，

Let them pile up and carry over to the day after, and they’ll never be cleared.”
积在一起，拖到后天，那就永远料理不清楚了！”

Huang, already middle-aged, nodded repeatedly.
听这一说，已入中年的黄仪不断点头，

“Old Zhang, your son-in-law has changed again.
“老张！”他说，“你这个女婿，人又变过了，

Clever and diligent, and now mature and dependable too!
不但聪明勤快，而且老成扎实！

An excellent match for your daughter.
真正是乘尤快婿，

Congratulations!”
恭喜，恭喜！”

Thoroughly honest and conscientious himself, Zhang valued this attitude still more.
老张是忠厚老实到了家的，自然更欣赏陈世龙的作风。

Here was someone he could rely on in later life.
要这样，后半世才有依靠！

He wanted to help at once, but having invited Huang to dinner, could hardly keep him waiting.
照他的想法，当时就想下手帮忙，但既邀了黄仪回家吃饭，也不便让他空等。

While hesitating, he saw an opportunity: they could discuss the wedding first.
就这踌躇之间，有了个主意，正不妨趁此机会跟黄仪先谈一谈如何办喜事。


As they entered the house, A’zhu withdrew from sight and Aizhen came to open the door.
陪他到家，刚一进门，里面阿珠便躲了开去，爱珍来开了门，

Her eyes searched first for Chen.
第一个先寻陈世龙，
