看看不见，便失望地问了出来：“咦！姑少爷呢？”

The sudden change of title startled Zhang before he understood.
骤然改口，老张倒是一愣，想一想才明白，随即答道：

“Sorting things out.
“在收拾东西，

He’ll come later.”
要等下才来。”

Aizhen hurried to the kitchen with the news.
听这一说，爱珍便急忙到厨房里去报告消息。

A’zhu was just as disappointed, though also somewhat relieved.
阿珠跟她一样失望，但似乎又觉得轻松。

Huang was still there, however; if she went out now, he would certainly embarrass her.
不过，还有个黄仪，这时一走出去，必定受窘，

This gave her another worry.
因而又有些上心事。

Her mother was too busy to notice.
她娘看不出她的心事，正忙得不可开交，

Preparing a respectable dinner within an hour or so required considerable effort.
要在个把钟头以内，弄出一桌象样的菜来，着实要费一番手脚。

Her tongue was as busy as her hands: while adjusting the seasoning, she explained every detail until A’zhu grew impatient.
而且不但手脚忙，口中也不闭，一面调理咸酸，一面不厌其详地讲解，让阿珠都听得有些烦了。

“Mother, how have you time for idle talk now?”
“娘！”她说，“这时候哪里有工夫讲空话？”

“You call it idle talk?”
“你当是空话？”

Her mother was displeased.
做母亲的大为不悦。

“You’ll soon have a household of your own.
“马上要自己做人家了，

Every little thing I can teach you will help, yet you won’t learn!
我教得你一样是一样，你还不肯学！”

You may have no mother-in-law above you, but other people will gossip.
阿珠的娘埋怨女儿，“虽然上头没有婆婆，旁人要说闲话。

Without some skill with a knife and spatula, how do you expect to keep a man at home?”
一把锅铲刀上没有点功夫，你想想，男人怎么会在家里耽得住？”

The words were unwelcome, but seeing her mother so busy, A’zhu would not argue.
话是不中听，但看娘忙成这个样子，阿珠不肯再跟她争辩，

Still, she was too accustomed to having her own way to offer no retort at all.
只是一向撒娇惯了的，不顶句嘴办不到，

“As you please! If you enjoy lecturing, go on!” she said with a smile.
便笑着说道：“随你，随你！你老太太喜欢罗嗦，尽管去罗嗦好了！”

In fact, her mother had no time for more lecturing.
阿珠的娘，实在也没有工夫“罗嗦”了，

Remembering the men outside, she said, “Go and listen.
却又惦记着外面，你去听听！“她说，

What are Mr Huang and your father discussing?”
“黄先生跟你爹讲些什么？”

This was precisely what A’zhu wanted.
这句话正中下怀，

She left the kitchen, concealed herself beneath a window, pricked a little hole in the paper with her hairpin and peered through.
阿珠随即出了厨房，躲在窗下，用发簪在窗纸上戳出个小孔，悄悄向外窥探。


Host and guest presented different pictures.
外面一主一宾，神态各别，

Zhang sat upright and looked extremely serious; Huang sat casually with one leg crossed over the other.
老张正襟危坐，显得极为郑重，黄仪却是翘着着“二郎腿”，很随便的样子，

He was speaking.
这时正是他在说话。

“Exchanging birth cards is easy enough.
“换个庚帖，方便得很，

Send your young lady to buy the full set of formal sheets later, and I’ll write them at once.
回头叫你们大小姐去买全帖来，我马上就写，

I can handle both families’ copies.
男女两家，归我一手包办。

What else?”
还有啥？”

“The bridegroom’s family must send the date.”
“还有，‘送日子’归男家。”

Zhang paused.
老张停了一下又说：

“Please ask Shilong when he intends to hold the wedding.”
“世龙预备啥时候办喜事，拜托你问他一声。”

“Why ask through me?” Huang laughed.
“这何必还要我问？”黄仪笑道，

“You two know each other so well.
“你们翁婿这么熟的人，

Do you need this matchmaker, who has had the whole affair ready-made for him, to carry messages?”
用得着我这个现成的媒人传话？”

“That is the custom too.
“这也是规矩。

We must ask our honoured matchmaker...”
总要请大媒老爷……”

“Old Zhang!” Huang suddenly interrupted.
“老张！”黄仪突然打断他的话说，

“Of the six rites—sending the proposal, asking the bride’s name, announcing the auspicious divination result, presenting the betrothal gifts, requesting a date and fetching the bride—there is only one in which I ought to serve the bride’s family.
“所谓六礼：纳采、问名、纳吉、纳征、请期、亲迎，只有一项，我该替女家效劳的。

What about the betrothal offerings?”
‘纳征’怎么说？”

Zhang had heard of the “six rites,” but the formal term Huang used for the offerings meant nothing to him.
“六礼”二字，老张倒听见过，“纳征”他就不懂了。

Behind the window, A’zhu was puzzled too.
后面的阿珠也在纳闷，

What new complication did his tone suggest?
听语气是不知出了什么花样？

She listened still more closely.
所以越发侧耳细听。

“I mean the betrothal gifts.
“纳征就是聘礼。

You can hardly raise that question yourselves, but I can ask for you.”
这个上头，你们自己不好开口，我倒可以替你去问。”

“Oh, those!
“原来是聘礼，

They have already arrived.
这个已经有了。

You may not know.
想来你还不晓得，

You ought to inspect them.”
应该请你过目。”


Zhang went inside himself and carefully brought out a red lacquer presentation box decorated in gold.
于是老张亲自入内，小心翼翼地捧了个朱漆描金的拜盒出来，

The four kinds of jewellery it contained greatly surprised Huang.
打开一看，是这么四件首饰，黄仪大出意外。

“Mr Hu sent them on Shilong’s behalf.”
“是胡先生代世龙送的。”

This surprised him still more.
这句话使黄仪更感意外。

Though his dealings with Hu had been limited, he had heard many accounts of his generosity.
他对胡雪岩的接触不算多，但却听见过许多说他慷慨的话，

Now he saw that they were true.
于今一看，果不其然。

His employer was thoroughly generous by nature.
这位“东家”本性着实宽厚，

Why should he not remain with such a man all his life?
就跟他一辈子亦何妨。

“Excellent, excellent!”
“好极，好极！”

Huang was happy for A’zhu too.
黄仪也替阿珠高兴，

“Decked in pearls and jade, the bride will look splendid.
“将来新娘子珠围翠绕，打扮出来，格外出色。

Old Zhang, since Mr Hu is arranging everything for Shilong, there’s no need to ask me about any of it.
我看老张，现在凡事有胡先生替世龙作主，啥事情你不必问我，

Ask him.”
问他好了。”

Those few words went straight to the point.
这一句话，确是要言不烦，

Zhang felt suddenly at a loss.
老张爽然若失，

All his questions had been wasted.
问了半天，原是白问，

Apparently Chen might not be free to decide for himself either.
照现在这样子看，只怕陈世龙也做不得自己的主。

Perhaps Hu had already given instructions; Zhang could ask Chen when he arrived.
说不定胡雪岩已有话交代，等下倒不妨问问他。

They talked idly for a while longer.
又闲谈了好一会，

Huang’s stomach was rumbling, and he was about to ask his host for a snack when Chen finally came.
黄仪肚子饿得咕咕叫，正想开口先向主人家要些什么点心来吃，总算还好，陈世龙到了。

On the way, Chen had thought matters out.
一路上他是想好了来的，

Becoming close relations merely added a new formal bond.
虽说结成至亲，不过多了一重名分，

He should behave in his future wife’s home as he always had.
在岳家他仍旧应该象从前一样，

That would be affectionate and natural, and would spare him much embarrassment.
才显得亲切自然，而且也为自己减除了许多窘相。

After greeting the men, therefore, he headed straight for the kitchen.
所以招呼过后，一直就往厨房里走去。


At the back of the house he met A’zhu coming towards him.
一踏到后面，顶头就遇见阿珠，

Both were startled by the unexpected encounter, but in the next instant an indescribable joy rose in both their hearts.
双方都以猝不及防而微吃一惊，但亦随即都在心头浮现了莫可言喻的喜悦。

Chen could only say, “A’zhu!” and fix his eyes on her.
陈世龙只叫得一声：“阿珠！”便把一双眼睛瞪住在她身上不放。

“How many days can you stay?” she asked quickly and softly.
“你有几天耽搁？”她很快地说，声音也很轻。

Asking about his departure before his arrival already showed how unwilling she was to part.
不问来，先问走，便已见得她的不舍之意，

That simple question stirred him deeply.
就这样一句平淡的话，已使得陈世龙回肠荡气，

He wanted to spend the rest of his days in his native town, always beside her.
真想终老家乡，一辈子厮守着阿珠。

At once he reproached himself: such thoughts showed a lack of ambition.
然而他也马上自谴，觉得起这种念头就是没出息，

Assuming an unconcerned manner, he answered, “That depends on Mr Hu.
因而放出那种无所谓的神态说：“要看胡先生的意思，

Wherever he sends me, I go.
他差遣我到哪里，就到哪里，

I shall leave as soon as his letter comes.”
信一来就走。”

She said nothing.
阿珠不响，

There was much in her heart, but this was no time or place to express it.
心里有许多话要说，而此时此地不是细诉衷曲的时候，

Moving aside, she gestured with her lips towards the kitchen, telling him to go and greet her mother.
便侧着身子努一努嘴，意思是让他到厨房里去跟她娘招呼。

He smiled and nodded.
陈世龙会意，微笑着点一点头，

As he passed her in the dim passage, he took her hand.
走过她身边时，在暗头里捏住了她的手，

At its touch his heart stirred, and he could not bear to move on.
柔荑一握，入手心荡，倒又舍不得走了。

A’zhu did not approve of this, but could not bear to refuse him either.
阿珠不赞成他这样的行为，只是不忍拒绝，

Trusting that her mother would be indulgent even if she saw, she let him hold her hand.
倚恃母亲的宽容，就看见了也不会责备，便尽着由他握着。

Just then, the tactless Aizhen came rushing out.
偏偏不识相的爱珍一头冲了出来，

A’zhu saw her first, pulled her hand free and hurried away.
阿珠眼尖，夺手便走。

Startled too, Chen tried to cover his confusion.
陈世龙也有些吃惊，搭讪着说：

“Aizhen, I’ve brought you two things from Shanghai: an ivory comb and a little box beautifully inlaid with different-coloured woods.
“爱珍，我有两样东西从上海带来送你。一样是象牙蓖箕，一样是一个五颜六色的木头，镶嵌得很好看的盒子，

I hope you’ll like them.”
不晓得你喜欢不喜欢？”

“I will!
“喜欢的！”

Thank you, young son-in-law!”
爱珍很高兴地说，“谢谢姑少爷！”

Even being called “young master” was new to Chen, let alone this title.
“少爷”这个称呼在陈世龙已觉得很新鲜，何况是“ 姑少爷”？

Repeating it silently twice, he suddenly realised that both his standing and the Zhang family’s had risen without their noticing.
他自己把这三个字，默默念了两遍，忽然发觉，他和张家的身分，都在无形中提高了！

This was Hu’s gift to them.
这自是受了胡雪岩的惠，

Yet had their standing really risen?
但自己和张家的身分，是不是真的提高了呢？

On that point he was uncertain.
这一点他却有些不大明白。


The thoughts flashed through him too quickly to examine.
这些念头如电闪一般在心头划过，一时也不暇去细思，

He was already in the kitchen.
因为人已到了厨房，

“Mother!” he called, then went over to watch her cook.
先喊一声，“娘！”然后去到他丈母娘身边去看她做菜。

“It’s dirty in the kitchen!” she said loudly, busy frying a fish.
“厨房里脏！”阿珠的娘一面煎鱼，一面大声说道：

“Go and sit outside.”
“你外头坐。”

“That doesn’t matter.”
“不要紧！”

Chen would not go.
陈世龙不肯走。

A crucian carp about a foot long had just gone into the pan, and the oil was hissing.
这时是一条尺把长的鲫鱼，刚刚下锅，油锅正“哗哗”地响，

She was too intent on it to talk.
阿珠的娘全神贯注着，没有工夫跟他说话，

Only after adding the seasonings and clear stock and covering the pan did she wipe her hands on her apron and ask with a smile, “Have you sorted everything out?”
等下了作料，放了清汤，盖上锅盖以后，才用围裙擦一擦手，笑嘻嘻地问：“东西都料理好了？”

“Everything.
“都料理好了，

I’ve asked the outside errand man to deliver the parcels tonight.
请出店一份份连夜去送，

It will let him earn a little in delivery fees too.
也挑他挣几个脚力钱。

Mother, I also bought cloth for two outfits for you.
娘。”陈世龙又说，“我给你剪了两件衣服。

The weather will soon be cold, so I bought you a white-copper hand-warmer as well.”
天气快冷了，我又替你买了个白铜手炉。”

“When do I ever have time to sit holding a hand-warmer?
“我哪里有闲下来烘手炉的辰光？”

Don’t buy anything next time.
做丈母娘的说，“下次不要买，

Nothing at all.
啥也不要买，

Why spend money on these things?
何必去花这些钱？

Besides, you don’t earn much yet.
再说，你现在也挣不到多少钱，

You must be economical in everything.”
一切总要俭朴。”

It was good advice, though Chen did not much take it in.
话是好话，陈世龙不大听得进去。

Still, he understood that parents everywhere felt this way.
不过他也了解，天下父母心都是如此。

Rather than answer that remark, he changed the subject.
所以不答这句腔，把话题扯了开去。

Thus he stayed close beside his mother-in-law, talking endlessly about Shanghai and Songjiang, with all the affection of a child at a parent’s knee.
就这样，他绕着丈母娘的身子转，谈到在上海、在松江的情形，絮絮不断地，真有那种依依膝下的意绪。

While she cooked, she listened with keen interest.
阿珠的娘，一面忙着做菜，一面也兴味盎然地听他讲话，

A’zhu had already told her some of the stories, but hearing them again was still a pleasure.
有些事已听阿珠讲过，但再听一遍，仍然觉得有趣。


When the food was ready, there was another exchange of polite refusals over the places at table.
等厨房里整备停当，人座时又有一番谦让，

Huang naturally took the seat of honour.
结果当然是黄仪上座。

Ordinarily A’zhu and her mother could have joined them, but that evening was an exception.
阿珠和她母亲，原可入席，而这天是例外，

They waited until the men had finished, then brought back the remaining dishes and ate a makeshift meal with Aizhen.
母女俩等前面吃完了，方始将残肴撤下来，叫爱珍一起坐下，将就着吃了一顿。

Afterwards they cleared up, washed the dishes and put out the fire.
吃完收拾，洗碗熄火，

Everything was done, but the talk in the front room was still lively.
请事皆毕，而前面却还谈得很热闹。

Zhang had been back for days and knew Shanghai well enough, yet he had never been good at conversation or fond of it.
老张回来多日，上海的情形他也很清楚，但一向不善同令也不喜说话，

Huang had learned little from him.
所以黄仪从他嘴里听不到什么。

With Chen it was different.
跟陈世龙在一起就不同了，

Chen spoke clearly and remembered well.
他说话本有条理，记性又好，

His descriptions of the foreign settlement and its varied inhabitants filled Huang, who scarcely ventured outside his own neighbourhood, with longing.
形容十里夷场的风光，以及各式各样的人物，把个足不出里门的黄仪，听得神往不止。

His expression betrayed him so plainly that even Zhang noticed, let alone Chen.
这种不自觉流露的表情，不要说陈世龙，就连老张都看出来了，

At a pause, Zhang said, “Shanghai is somewhere you really must see.
因此当谈话告一段落时，他向黄仪说道，“上海倒是不可不去，

When will you go?”
几时你也去走一趟？”

“I certainly shall.”
“那一定要的。”

Huang was not a man content to remain in obscurity.
黄仪也是个不甘雌伏的人，

Chen’s account had given him a new view of Hu: following such a man into the wider world of business would be exhilarating.
此时听了陈世龙的话，对胡雪岩有了一种新的想法，觉得跟了这个人去闯市面，是件很够劲的事，

He did not know how to express this and merely asked when Hu would next come to Huzhou.
不过这番意思却不知如何表达，只问了声：“胡先生啥时光到湖州来？”

“He probably won’t have time just yet,” Chen answered.
“他一时伯没有到湖州来的工夫。”陈世龙说，

“With all his affairs in Shanghai and Hangzhou, even four hands wouldn’t be enough.”
“上海、杭州方面的事，怕生了四只手都忙不过来。”

“We’re only sitting idle here, really.”
“其实，我们在这里也是闲坐。”

Chen recognised an opening but said nothing then.
陈世龙听出因头，当时不响。

When they left the Zhang house, he offered to walk Huang back to the firm.
辞出张家时，表示要送黄仪回店，

Still eager to talk, Huang gladly accepted.
那一个谈兴未央，欣然表示欢迎。

There they made tea, trimmed the lamp and resumed their conversation.
于是回到大经丝行，泡了壶茶，剔亮了灯，继续再谈。

Following Hu’s instructions, Chen drew Huang out until he knew what income Huang hoped for.
陈世龙依照胡雪岩的指示，以话套话，把黄仪所希望的“进帐”，探听清楚，

“Mr Hu admires your writing,” he then said.
然后说道：“胡先生很佩服你的文墨，

“He needs someone to take care of his correspondence.
他现在就少一个能够替他代代笔的人。

He handles a great deal of public and private business, some of which cannot be known to a third person.
胡先生经手的事，官私西面都很多，‘有些事情是不便叫第三者晓得的，

Only a trusted intimate can help with it.
只有心腹知己才可以代劳。

Such a man is hard to find.”
这一个人很难找。”


“What?” Huang asked with close attention.
“怎么样？”黄仪很注意地问，

“Does Mr Hu want me to go?”
“胡先生是不是想叫我去？”

“He didn’t tell me.”
“他没有跟我说。”

Chen had meant to add, “If you’re interested, I can write to him.”
陈世龙本来想说：如果你有意思，我可以写信给胡先生。

Then he reflected that this would suggest he stood closer to Hu than Huang did, which might make Huang suspicious.
转念一想，这样说法，即表示自己在胡雪岩面前的关系比他深，怕黄仪多心，

Instead he said, “If Mr Hu has that in mind, naturally he will discuss it with you himself.”
因而改口说道：“如果胡先生有这个意思，当然直接会跟你商量的。”

“Mm, mm.”
“嗯，嗯！”

It suddenly occurred to Huang that Dajing Silk Firm was a good place too; there was no need to hurry into a change.
黄仪忽然想到，大经丝行的事也不坏，不必亟亟乎改弦易辙，便即答道：

“Better to stay than move.
“一动不如一静，

We’ll wait and see.”
看看再说。”

Hearing the altered tone, Chen knew he had talked too much and deeply regretted it.
陈世龙一听话锋不对，知道是因为自己话太多了的缘故，心里深为澳悔。

He would say no more.
同时再也不肯多说，

Taking his leave, he went back to his own lodging.
告辞回到自己住处。

Dust lay thick after his long absence.
多日不曾归家，灰尘积得甚厚，

He spent another half-night putting things right, then hastily went to bed.
又忙了大半夜，草草睡下，

The day had exhausted him; his head scarcely touched the pillow before he slept.
这一天实在太累了，头一着枕，便已入梦。

In his dreams he seemed to hear footsteps in the room, but his eyes were too weary to open and he could not be bothered to ask.
睡梦头里仿佛听得屋里有脚步声，但双眼倦涩，懒得去问。

Turning over to seek another pleasant dream, he felt a sudden stab of light in his eyes.
翻个身想再寻好梦时，只觉双眼刺痛，

He shaded them with a hand and looked.
用手遮着，睁眼看时，

Bright sunlight filled the window, with a woman’s figure outlined against it.
但见红日满窗，阳光中一条女人的影子，

At first he could not tell who she was, but the slender silhouette drove away his sleepiness.
急切问，辨不出是什么人？只是睡意却完全为这条俏拔的影子所驱除，

Sitting up and pulling aside the bed-curtains, he looked more closely.
坐起来掀开帐门，细看，不由得诧异：

“You!”
“是你！”

“Yes, me.
“是我！

You didn’t expect me, did you?”
你想不到吧？”

“Certainly not.”
“真是不曾想到。”

He had never expected Crystal A’qi to appear.
陈世龙不曾想到水晶阿七会突然出现。

Still half in a dream, confronted by something beyond his imagining, he was utterly confused.
梦意犹在，而又遇见梦想不到的情况，他的脑子被搅得乱七八糟，

He looked from her to the window and back again, first trying to establish whether he was awake at all.
茫然不知所措，只是看看窗外，又看看阿七，先要把到底是不是在做梦这个疑问，作个澄清。


“I’ve been waiting for you for days,” A’qi said plaintively.
“我盼望你好几天了！”阿七幽幽地说，

She came closer, stepping out of the shadow into the light, and let her liquid eyes move over his face.
同时走了过来，由暗处到亮处站住脚，拿一双水汪汪的眼睛，在陈世龙脸上瞟来瞟去。

Now he could see her clearly.
这下陈世龙才把她看清楚，

She wore no powder or rouge, and her hair was loose, but the lack of grooming only revealed her natural attractions more fully.
脂粉未施，鬓发蓬松，但不假膏沐，却越显她的“真本钱”，

The white of her skin was snowy, the black of her hair jet-black.
白的雪白，黑的漆黑，

Perhaps from excess inner heat, her lips were as red as pomegranate flowers.
一张嘴唇不知是不是上火的关系，红得象榴花。

Her close-fitting black satin jacket swelled over her breasts; apparently she wore no bodice beneath it.
身上穿一件紧身黑缎夹袄，胸前鼓蓬蓬，大概连肚兜都未带。

This startling sight banished every remnant of sleep.
这触目惊心的一番打量，把他残余的睡意，驱除得干干净净，

He sprang up, opened all the windows and said loudly, “Please sit outside.”
跳起身来，先把所有的窗子打开，然后大声说道：“你请外面坐！”

“Why?”
“为啥？”

“It isn’t convenient.”
“不方便！”

“What is there to fear?
“怕什么！”阿七答道，

We’re talking properly.
“我们规规矩矩说话，

We haven’t done anything wrong.”
又没有做啥坏事。”

“That isn’t the point...”
“话不是这么说……”

In his anxiety, Chen could no longer explain patiently.
陈世龙心里十分着急，就无法跟她好好讲了，

Frowning, he waved his hand repeatedly.
紧皱着眉，连连挥手，

“You had better go home.
“你最好请回去！

Don’t come here.”
我这个地方你不要来。”

Her face changed sharply, with more anger than shame.
这一说，阿七脸色大变，但愤怒多于羞惭，

Nor could he expect one remark to drive her off.
同时也不能期望她能够为这么一句话气走，

Instead of leaving, she sat down and sneered.
不但不走，反倒坐了下来，冷笑说道：

“Little Monk, I know you’re tired of me now.”
“小和尚，我晓得你已讨厌我了。”

It looked as though she meant to make a scene.
看样子，她要撒泼。

A few months earlier he would not have cared: he could answer abuse with abuse and blows with blows.
如果换了几个月以前，他倒也不在乎她，对骂就对骂，对打就对打，

If she cried, he could simply walk away.
如果她要哭、自己就甩手一走，

She would have gained nothing.
反正没有她占的便宜。

Now matters were different.
但现在情形不同了，

His standing and reputation were involved, and above all there was the danger of suspicion.
这中间关碍着身分，脸面，而最要紧的是嫌疑，

Explaining himself to Yu Si would be troublesome enough; if word reached A’zhu, it would be disastrous.
在郁四面前分辩不清楚，固然麻烦，若是风声传入阿珠耳中，更是件不得了的事，

He must find some way to manage A’qi.
因而只好想办法敷衍。


“It isn’t that I’m tired of you.
“不是讨厌你，

I dare not get involved with you,” Chen replied.
是不敢惹你。”陈世龙这样答道，

“Think of your position now, and mine.”
“你不想想你现在啥身分？我啥身分？”

“I don’t know what your position is!
“你啥身分我不晓得！

But when you eat, don’t forget the man who grew the rice.
不过吃饭不要忘记种田人，

Where would you be today if I hadn’t spoken for you to Mr Hu?
不是我在胡老板面前替你说好话，你哪有今天？

I’m not boasting of my services or demanding gratitude.
这话不是我丑表功，要你见我的情。

I only want you to know what is in my heart.
我不过表表心，让你晓得，

You forgot me long ago, but I’ve never stopped thinking of you.”
你老早把我抛到九霄云外，我总是时时刻刻想着你。”

这番话叫陈世龙无以为答，唯有报以苦笑：

“Thank you.
“谢谢你！

But enough of that.
闲话少说，

If you have business, be like the Kitchen God going up to Heaven: make your report directly.”
你有啥事情，灶王爷上天，直奏好了。”

“Can’t I come to see you?
“不作兴来看看你，

Must I have business?”
一定要有事才来？”

“Enough!”
“好了，好了！”

His patience was failing again.
陈世龙又不耐烦了，

“You know Uncle Four’s temper.
“你晓得郁四叔的脾气的。

Besides, I...”
而且我……”

He had meant to say that he had promised Hu never to see her again.
他是要说，答应过胡雪岩，从此不跟她见面。

But there was no point in saying that, and he stopped.
但这话说出来，没意思，所以顿住了口，

A’qi gave him no respite.
而阿七却毫不放松：

“Be a man and say what you have to say!
“男了汉、大丈夫，该说就说！

What can’t you bring yourself to tell me?”
你有什么话说不出口。”

“Nothing that concerns you.
“跟你不相干！

总而言之，你来看我，我谢谢你。

现在看过了，你好走了！”

阿七一听这话，霍地站起身来，把脚顿两顿才骂道：

“You heartless wretch!” she said through clenched teeth.
“你死没良心！”她咬牙切齿的，

“我偏偏不走！”

“你不走，我走！”

Chen took his lined gown from the clothes stand and slipped it on, then bent to pull on his shoes without looking at her.
陈世龙摘下衣架上的夹袍，往身上一披，低头拔鞋，连正眼都不看她。

“好了，好了！”

She softened her voice and tried to make peace.
阿七软语赔罪，

“Why be so angry?”
“何必生这么大的气？”

He did not know whether to laugh or cry.
陈世龙啼笑皆非，

Nor could he now walk away.
同时也不能再走了，

If he did, people would say, first, that bullying a woman was unworthy of a man, and second, that he could not even cope with Crystal A’qi.
因为这样要甩手一走，就会有人批评：第一欺侮女人，不算好汉，第二，说他连水晶阿七这样一个女人都应付不了。

If he stayed, he must devise another approach.
不走就得另打主意，

His fit of temper had passed.
陈世龙发过一阵脾气，

More calmly, he reflected that trouble had sought him out: if he could not push it away, he must face it and hear what she had to say.
此时冷静下来，觉得麻烦要找了来，推不掉就只有挺身应付，且看她说些什么？

He would hold firmly to his resolve and give her no encouragement.
反正抱定宗旨，不理她，

When she left, he would tell Yu Si everything.
等她走后，再到郁四那里和盘托出，

He had to see him anyway with Hu’s message.
原来就要去看郁四，转达胡雪岩的口信，

As the saying went, burn incense and visit the monk—two errands accomplished together.
正好“烧香看和尚，一事两勾当”。

于是他拔上鞋子再扣衣纽，

A’qi came to help, lowering her head to fasten the buttons beneath his arm.
阿七还来帮他的忙，低着头替他扣腋下的扣子，

A stretch of white neck lay directly under his eyes.
露出雪白了这一段头颈，正在陈世龙眼下，

他把视线移了开去，但“元宝领”中的散发出来的甜甜、暖暖的香味，却叫他躲避不了。

好在这只是片刻工夫，

As soon as the buttons were fastened, he sat on a stool by the window, ready to deal with the difficulty.
等把衣纽扣好，随即走到窗前一张凳子上坐下，预备好好应付麻烦。

“I only arrived yesterday.
“我昨天刚刚到，

Mr Hu has several urgent matters for me to attend to, and Secretary Yang at the county yamen is waiting for me.”
胡先生有好些要紧的事情，叫我替他去办。县衙门里杨师爷在等我，”

陈世龙先表白一段，然后提出要求说：

“Say what you have to say plainly.
“你有话，爽爽快快说！

我实在没有工夫陪你。”


A’qi did not answer at once.
水晶阿七不即回答，

She thought for a good while before saying, “I had a bellyful of things to tell you, every detail of them.
想了好一会才说：“本来有一肚皮的话，要细细的告诉你，

That was why I got up specially early to come.
所以特为起个早来。

Since you have no time, and want me to be quick and plain, I’ll ask just one thing.
既然你没有工夫，要我爽爽快快地说，我就说一句：

Three years ago you made me a promise.
三年前头，你跟我说过的那句话，

Does it still count?”
算不算数？”

At the mention of three years ago, Chen knew he was in serious trouble.
提到三年前，陈世龙就知道麻烦不小，

Before A’qi had taken up with Yu Si, she and Chen had had a romance.
那时阿七还没有跟郁四，跟陈世尤有过一段情。

When their passion burned hot, he had said all sorts of things.
情热如火时，什么话都说出来，

He had no idea which promise she meant, but any promise she brought up now was sure to tell against him.
陈世龙不知道她指的是哪句话？不过也可以想象得到，这句话在这时候来说，一定对自己不利。

因此他先就来个“金钟罩”，概不认帐：

“How can anything said then still count?”
“那时的话哪里好作数？”

“什么？”阿七咄咄逼人地，

“Aren’t you ashamed to say that?
“亏你说得出口，

Your word doesn’t count?
说了话不算数？

Is Little Monk the sort of man who refuses to take responsibility?”
难道你小和尚是这种没肩胛的人？”

“That depends on what I’m supposed to take responsibility for,” Chen said.
“肩胛要看摆在什么地方？”陈世龙说，

“I don’t even know what you mean.
“我也不知道你指的是啥？

If I promised to buy you cloth, say, or have bracelets made, of course I’ll stand by it.
如果说，我答应过你什么，譬如买衣料、打镯子什么的，我自然有肩胛，

But if something was possible then and is impossible now, all the responsibility in the world won’t help.”
倘或有些事情，当时做得到，现在做不到，再有肩胛的也没有办法。”

“Of course it’s possible.
“你自然做得到。”阿七说道：

Think again.
“你倒再想想看，

What did you promise me?”
你答应过我一句什么话？”

“I can’t remember.
“我想不起，

Tell me.”
你说好了。”

“You said you wanted me to come and live with you.
“你说过，要我跟你。

That was the promise!”
就是这句话！”


This left Chen bewildered.
这句话却把陈世龙搞糊涂了，

He had assumed that she merely wanted a secret affair behind Yu Si’s back.
原来以为她只是想瞒着郁四来偷情，

He had never expected this.
不道是这样一句话！

“How could that be?” he blurted out.
“那怎么行！”他脱口答道，

“You’re Uncle Four’s woman.
“你是郁四叔的人，

How can you even speak of it?”
怎么谈得到此？”

He had made a false step.
这是陈世龙失言，

He had not stopped to reflect that if she were still living with Yu Si she could hardly make such a proposal.
他没有细想一想，如果她还是跟着郁四，怎么能说这话？

A’qi was quick enough to seize the opening.
阿七相当机警，捉住他这个漏洞，逼紧了问：

“You mean Old Yu is the obstacle?
“你是说，碍着郁老头？

Without that obstacle, of course you’d be a responsible man and keep your word.
如果没有这重关碍，你当然还是有肩胛，说话一定算话！

Isn’t that so?”
是不是？

There was something behind her words.
“话外有话，

Chen dared not answer rashly again.
陈世龙再不敢造次，

He considered her two remarks together, then asked, “Have you and Uncle Four parted company?”
先把她前后两句话的意思细想了一遍问道：“是不是你跟郁四叔散伙了？”

“Exactly.
“对！

Old Yu and I have parted company.”
我跟郁老头散伙了。”

So it was true.
果有其事，

Chen was astonished.
陈世龙不免诧异，

As far as he knew, Yu Si could not do without A’qi for a single day.
照他知道，郁四是一天都离不开阿七的，

Why should they have parted?
何以竟会散伙？

Had she behaved so badly that he could not tolerate her and had driven her out?
莫非阿七做下什么不规矩的事，为郁四所不能容忍，赶出门去？

“You’re surprised, aren’t you?” she said calmly.
“你奇怪是不是？”阿七神色泰然地说，

“Let me put your mind at rest.
“我先说一句，好叫你放心，

Old Yu and I parted on good terms.”
我跟郁老头是好来好散的。”

This was more incomprehensible still.
这就越发不能理解了！

“What happened?
“是怎么回事？”

I find it rather hard to believe.”
他说，“我有点不大相信。”

“Never mind you—I can hardly believe it myself.
“不要说你不相信，连我自己都不大相信。

But it must have been fated that you and I should come to this.
不过，这也该当你我要走到这一步，

When good fortune arrives, even a city wall can’t keep it out.”
真正运气来了，城墙都挡不住。”

看她那种兴高采烈、一厢情愿的神气，陈世龙又好笑，又好气，

本来想拦着不让她说，但这一来马上又要吵架，她如何跟郁四散伙的经过，就听不到了。

因而很沉着地听她讲完，催促着说：“你闲话少说！

就讲郁四叔为啥跟你散伙好了。”


“Ah!
“嗨！

提起来，真是说书先生的口头禅：”六月里冻杀一只老绵羊，说来话长！

‘“说到这里，阿七的神色忽显哀伤，”

你晓不晓得，阿虎死掉了？

“陈世龙大惊：

“什么？

A’hu dead?
阿虎死掉了，

怎么死的？”

“A sudden intestinal illness.

可怜，

八月十四下半天得的病，一夜工夫就‘翘’掉了，

连个节都过不过！”

陈世龙听得傻了，眼中慢慢流出两滴眼泪。

Yu Si had a daughter and one son.
郁四生一子一女，

A’hu, his only boy, was just twenty-two and had married the year before.
阿虎就是他的独子，今年才二十二岁，去年娶的亲。

Honest, kind and deeply loyal to his friends, he and Chen had been close as brothers.
为人忠厚，极重义气，跟陈世龙也算是要好弟兄，

Because his father forbade Chen to visit their house, A’hu had seemed almost apologetic and had treated him with particular consideration.
尤其因为他父亲不准陈世龙上门，他似乎倒怀着歉意，所以对陈世龙格外另眼相看，

三天两头不是来邀他听书、吃酒，就是来问问要不要铜钿用？

这样一个好朋友，一别竟成永诀，

陈世龙自然要伤心。

越觉得好事可成，因为这可以看出，陈世龙是有良心，重感情的。

死了，死了，死啦就了掉了！”

阿七停一下说，

阿虎不死，将来他老子的家当，归他独得，哪个也不能说话，

阿虎一死，又没有留下一儿半女，

你想想看，

自然有人要动脑筋了。

你晓得是哪个动脑筋？”

陈世龙摇摇头，

方在哀伤之际，懒得去想，也懒得说话。

是阿兰姐夫妇！”

阿兰姐是郁四的大女儿，今年快三十了，是个极厉害的角色，

年前，郁四跟他的同事，一个姓邢的刑房书办结了亲家。

老书办是世袭的行当，

老邢去世，小邢进衙门当差，比他老了干得还出色，

又可知是如何厉害的角色呢？

这对夫妇凑在一起，图谋回娘家来夺产，自是不足为奇之事。

陈世龙因为跟阿虎的交情，此时便想到阿虎嫂的将来，

不由得愤愤说道：“阿兰姐是嫁出去的人，

她凭啥来动脑筋呢？”

“就是这话罗！

‘嫁出去的女儿，泼出去的水’，

说来说去，是阿兰姐和她男人厉害，

没事找事，脑筋动到了我头上。”

陈世龙有些想不通，

风尘出身的，“凉药”吃得多，根本不能生育。

没有儿子，只能在族中替阿虎嫂过继一个，偌大家产，将来白白便宜了别人。

还要买两个？”

怕一个不保险，多弄一个。”

郁四听了女儿的话，决定跟阿七散伙。

走的时候，总算客客气气，

房子是他买的，早已过户到我名下，所以该他搬出，

另外给了我一个他钱庄里的折子，数目是五千两，

It’s money in my name, and naturally I mean to withdraw it.
是我名下的铜钿，我当然要提出来。

If he sees sense, well and good.
他识相的，拉倒，

If not, I’ll sue.
不识相我要打官司，

Luckily, Prefect Wang and Mr Hu are close friends...”
好在王大老爷跟胡老板是好朋友……

“Wait!”
““慢慢！”

Chen threw cold water over this at once.
陈世龙当头泼她的冷水：

“Don’t dream of it!
“你不要做梦！

Mr Hu and Uncle Four are practically brothers.
人家胡老板跟郁四叔等于弟兄一样，

If you sue, he’ll help him, not you.”
打到官司，一定帮他不帮你！”

“Then I don’t need his help!” she answered readily.
“那就不要他帮！”阿七答得极爽利，

“I’ll go into court myself and say his bank is about to fail and I don’t trust him.
“我自己到堂上去告，说他那爿钱庄要‘倒灶’了，我不相信他，

Can I withdraw it then or can’t I?”
可以不可以？”

Her confidence that everything would happen just as she wished made Chen laugh.
陈世龙为她那种自说自话的神态逗得笑了，

“Have it your own way!
“都随你！”

You and Sister A’lan are both formidable women.”
他说，“你跟阿兰姐一样，都算是厉害角色！”


“What’s formidable about me?
“我啥厉害？

All that matters is having a good heart.
做人全靠心好！

As for A’lan—hmph!
象阿兰姐，哼，

She has no son herself yet.
也是到现在没有儿子，

She’ll have trouble enough in years to come.
将来有苦头吃。

But never mind all that.”
这都不去说它了。”

A’qi grew earnest and excited.
话到此处，阿七的神情变得郑重而兴奋，

“Little Monk, since Old Yu and I parted, plenty of men have come with designs on me.
“小和尚，从我跟郁老头分手，就有好些上门来打我的主意，

I turned them all away.
都叫我回绝掉了，

If they wouldn’t take the hint, I simply cursed them out of the house.
不识相的，我就爽爽快快的把他骂了出去。

I hardly ever go out.
我平日都不出门，

When I do, it’s to ask for news of you.
出门就是去打听你的消息。

I’ve been waiting and waiting, and today I’ve finally found you.
我一直在守你，今天总算守到了。

Move in with me first.
你先搬到我那里去住，

We can talk everything over at leisure.”
有话我们慢慢再说，”

Having settled the matter to her own satisfaction in this long speech, she reached out and laid a hand on Chen’s shoulder.
长篇大套，自说自话完了，一只手就搭了过来，按在陈世龙肩膀上，

Her lively eyes played over him, as though she longed for a bowl of water to wash him down whole.
同时一双俏伶伶的眼睛瞟着，是恨不得弄碗水来，把他一口吞了下去的神气。

Chen found nothing amusing in this.
陈世龙并不觉得好笑，

He was alarmed.
是着急，

He had never imagined her wishful thinking could reach such a pitch of obsession.
没有想到她一厢情愿到痴的程度！

Perhaps throughout her two or three years with Yu Si she had been thinking of Chen all the time.
照此看来，只怕她跟郁四过了两三年日子，心里是对他想了两三年，

If she had been winding these tendrils around him for so long, there could be no gentle way to break free.
牵丝攀藤这么多日子下来，要想好好摆脱是无论如何办不到的事。

What was he to do?
那么怎么办呢？

“Tell me!” she urged.
“说嘛！”她又催促，

“When will you move?
“啥辰光搬？

Everything’s ready at my place.
我那里通通现成，

Not like here, where you get up in the morning and there’s neither tea nor water.
不象你这里，一早起来，要茶要水，什么都没。

You even have to go to a teashop to wash your face.
洗个脸都要到茶店里去。

Think what a miserable life it is, drifting about as a bachelor!”
这种光棍打流的日子，你自己想想看，苦不苦？”

This would never do.
不对了！

In those few moments another stout vine had wrapped itself around him.
就这片刻工夫，又是结结实实的一根藤缠了上来，

At this rate she would bind him so tightly he could not move.
这样下去，非让她捆得动弹不得不可。

Only one swift cut could sever the tangle.
陈世龙心想，只有快刀一挥，才能斩断纠葛，

It would hurt her badly, but to save himself he must be ruthless.
这在她自己受不了，但为了自保，不能不下辣手。

“A’qi, may Heaven destroy me if I’m lying!” He began with an oath, to show that this was no excuse.
“阿七！我骗你我天诛地灭！”他先罚个咒，让她知道决非设词推托：

“Little Monk already has his Little Nun!”
“小和尚老早有小厄姑了！”


A’qi’s face changed completely.
阿七的脸色大变，

Her eyes were still liquid, but now they seemed full of tears.
眼猜倒还是水汪汪的，不过象含了两泡泪水，

Her face turned pale and ashen by turns.
脸上一阵青、一阵白，

She shook her head.
摇摇头说：

“I don’t believe it.
“我不相信！

Who?”
是哪个？”

“A’zhu, from the Zhang family.”
“张家的阿珠。”

“Which Zhang family?”
“哪个张家的阿珠？”

“The one who used to work a boat and now runs the Dajing Silk Firm...”
“原来摇船，现在开大经丝行的……”

“What are you saying?”
“你在说啥！”

She broke in, utterly bewildered, and stared for a long moment before continuing.
阿七打断了他的话，显得十分困惑地，愣了好半天才说：

“I still don’t believe it.
“我还是不相信，

Isn’t the old boatman Zhang’s daughter Mr Hu’s woman?”
摇船老张的女儿，不是胡老板的人吗？”

“You’ve got it all wrong.
“你完全弄错了！

He treats A’zhu as a daughter.
人家是把阿珠当女儿看，

He never meant anything else.”
哪里有啥别的意思？”

Chen went on, “He arranged the match for me on this trip to Shanghai.
陈世龙又说，“就是这趟到上海，胡老板替我定下的亲事。

The betrothal gifts have already been sent—four kinds of jewellery, bought by Mr Hu himself.
聘礼都送过去，四样首饰，也是胡老板买的。

We’ll be inviting everyone to the wedding feast before the year is out.”
总在今年年底，就要请大家吃喜酒。”

He spoke with such assurance that it did not sound like a lie.
言之凿凿，不象撒谎，

A’qi was dumbfounded.
把阿七听得目瞪口呆，

Chills ran down her back, and she sank into a chair, muttering, “Such a thing!
背脊上一阵阵发凉，颓然坐倒，只是喃喃地说，“有这种事情？

I could never have imagined it.”
想都想不到的！”

“Exactly.”
“就是罗！”

Chen felt an enormous weight lift from him.
陈世龙此时如释重负，

“Just like you and Uncle Four parting.
“就象你跟郁四叔散伙一样，

Nobody could have imagined that either.”
也是想都想不到的。”

“But...”
“不过……”

A’qi suddenly rose, as though she still refused to admit defeat and meant to make one last attempt to wrest him from A’zhu.
阿七霍地站了起来，仿佛犹不死心，最后还想跟阿珠争夺一番似地，

Yet she had no strength for it, and her courage failed.
但是力不从心，终于气馁。


“A’qi,” Chen said soothingly, “everything depends on fate.
“阿七！”陈世龙安慰她说，“人都是缘分。

We weren’t meant for each other, and there’s nothing to be done.
我们缘分不到，没有话说。

Don’t be unhappy.
你也不要难过，

A woman like you need never fear that nobody will want her.
象你这样的人，不怕没人要。

You have a good heart, and a good heart gets its reward.
“他又说：”你的心好，好心自有好报。

Go home now.
你请回去吧，

I’ll see you off.”
我送你回去。

She hung her head like a defeated fighting cock and slowly rose without a word.
“阿七象斗败了的公鸡似地，垂头不语，慢慢站起身来，

None of the dazzling freshness of her arrival, like a peony wet with dew, remained.
脸上浑不似初来时那种芍药带露、艳光逼人的神采，

Her face was dull and grey; she seemed to have aged ten years in an instant.
气色灰暗，倒象一下子老了十年。

Remembering their old affection, Chen could not remain unmoved.
陈世龙瞻念旧情，不能无动于衷，

But as soon as pity stirred, he felt a heavy weight on each shoulder.
但怜念一生，马上又感到双肩都有沉重的压力，

On one rested his pledge to grow old with A’zhu, the promises he had made as he knelt before her on the boat and asked her to marry him.
一只肩上是与阿珠偕老的盟约，想到在船上跪在她面前求婚所许下的诺言，

On the other rested his debt to Hu Xueyan, who had encouraged and protected him as generously as if he had been his own flesh and blood.
一只肩膀上是胡雪岩的情分，想到他提携爱护，待自己嫡亲的子弟，亦不过如此，

How could he seek out a trouble that, once entangled in it, he would never shake off, wasting his energies, neglecting his work and disappointing Hu’s hopes?
自己何能去找这种一沾上便摆不开的麻烦，以致耗神废业，辜负了他的期望？

At this thought his heart hardened again.
这样一转念，他的心肠便又硬了。

Ignoring A’qi’s dejection, he went out of the alley and hailed a small sedan chair.
对阿七的神情，视如不见，走出巷，招手喊过一顶小轿来，

He already had a piece of silver in his hand, more than enough for the fare.
同时早就拈了块只多不少的碎银子在手里，

When the chair arrived, he gave it to the bearers, told them her address and stood aside, waiting for her to get in.
等轿子抬到，他把碎银子递了过去，交代了阿七的住处，使往旁边一站，意思是等她上轿。

“Little Monk!” she said, then stopped, looking at him in melancholy bewilderment.
“小和尚！”阿七这样喊了一声，欲言又止，只拿忧郁而惶惑的眼色看着他。

“Go home.”
“你回去吧！”

He felt that he must say something, however empty, to persuade her to enter, and added without thinking, “I’ll come and see you when I have time.”
陈世龙觉得要有句话，哪怕是敷衍的话，也得说一句，才能叫她上轿，因而顺口又说：“有空我来看你！”

She nodded gratefully and stepped over the lowered poles.
阿七点点头，脸上有着感激的意味，移步从放倒的轿杠上跨了进去，

Turning to back into the chair, she gave him one last deep look, leaving him burdened with all her unspoken sorrow.
回身倒退着进轿时，又是深深地一瞥，为陈世龙留下来无数幽怨。


The sun was high by now.
这时太阳已经很高了，

In this brief return of spring in the tenth month, its bright light was almost dazzling, and Chen felt rather dazed.
十月小阳春，阳光明亮，照得人有些目，陈世龙觉得有些晕淘淘，

He wandered into a little teashop, washed his face and had tea and something to eat.
信步踏进一爿小茶店，洗脸喝茶点心，

Only after sitting quietly for a while did his mind become fully clear.
静静坐了一会，脑子才算完全清醒。

He considered the day’s business.
想想这天该做的事，

First he must pay his respects before A’hu’s spirit tablet and deliver Hu’s message to Yu Si.
第一件就是到阿虎灵前一拜，同时把胡雪岩的话交代了郁四。

He gave the tea attendant money to buy plain candles and incense, then walked to Yu Si’s family home near the north gate.
于是他取钱托茶博士办来一份素烛清香，往北门郁四的老家走了去。

Tears began to flow as he entered, and continued all the way to the mourning altar.
进门就淌眼泪，一路淌到灵前，

He lit the candles and incense and bowed.
焚烛上香，

As he rose, A’lan appeared, a white flower pinned in her hair, walking gracefully with one hand resting on a little maid’s shoulder.
拜罢起身，只见阿兰头上簪一朵白花，手扶在一个小丫头的肩上，袅袅婷婷地走了出来。

At their meeting, each looked through tears at the other’s tearful face.
一见了面少不得又是“流泪眼观流眼泪”，

Wiping her eyes, A’lan told him how A’hu had fallen ill.
阿兰姐一面抹眼泪，一面为陈世龙说阿虎得病的经过。

She spoke of their family’s misfortune, and of her father losing his son in old age.
接着又说她父亲晚年丧子，家门如何不幸，

Then she turned to A’qi, accusing her of being restless and unfaithful.
然后再谈阿七，指她不安于室，

A’qi, she said, had clamoured day and night to enter the Yu family household.
又说阿七日夜吵着要进郁家的门，

Nor was that all: she wanted to become A’hu’s widow’s mother-in-law and have the young woman kowtow to her.
不但进门，还要做阿虎嫂的婆婆，要给她磕头。

“Little Monk, think!
“小和尚，你想想看！

Was such a thing possible?
这是做不做得到的事情？”

She knew perfectly well it wasn’t, yet every day she cried and made scenes.
阿兰姐说，“明晓得做不列，天天又哭又闹，

What was she after?
她打的是什么主意？

One moment’s thought makes it plain.
还不是一想就明白！

We all urged Father to let her go.
所以大家都劝爹，放她走路算了，

The whole affair stinks of duck dung.
这件事提来鸭屎臭，

Don’t mention it when you see him.
你见了我爹，不必说起。

It will only upset him.”
免得他老人家心里不舒服。”

In her account, A’qi was to blame.
照她说来，是阿七不对。

Chen did not entirely believe her, but it was no affair of his and there was no need to ask further.
不过陈世龙也不尽相信她的话，只觉得事不关己。不必多问，

He nodded.
所以点点头说：

“I understand.
“我晓得了。

Is Uncle Four at the teahouse?”
四叔是不是在茶店里？”

“Yes.
“是啊！”

When you sent over Mr Hu’s gifts yesterday, he learned you were back.
阿兰说，“你昨天叫人送了胡老板的礼来，他才晓得你回来了。

He went to Bilangchun early this morning to wait for you.
一早就要到碧浪春去等你。

Go and see him there.”
你就到那里去看他吧！”


At Bilangchun, Yu Si sat at his usual horse-head table.
到了碧浪春，只见郁四仍旧坐在马头桌子上，

He had grown much thinner.
人瘦了不少。

Chen greeted him as “Uncle Four,” and they looked at one another sadly.
陈世龙叫过一声：“四叔”，相顾黯然。

“You arrived yesterday?” Yu asked listlessly.
“你昨天到的？”郁四有气没力地说。

“Yes.
“是的。

Yesterday afternoon.” As he said this, a thought struck Chen.
昨天下半天到的。”说了这一句话，陈世龙忽然转到一个念头，

Within their brotherhood, his initiating master had been Yu Si’s fellow initiate.
在“家门”里，他的“前人”跟郁四是“同参”，

Since the master’s death, Yu counted as his closest elder.
师父一死，郁四就算嫡亲的长辈，

Forbidding him to visit because of A’qi did not mean that Yu had ceased to look after him.
为了阿七不准自己上门，并不是不照应自己，

At the very least, it was through this elder that he had come to know Hu Xueyan.
起码胡雪岩这条路子就是从这位长辈身上来的，

In the brotherhood, a man must remember the spring from which he drank: the favour of an introduction must never be forgotten.
“家门”里讲究饮水思源，“引见”之恩不可忘。

He should therefore have called on Yu as soon as he arrived yesterday.
照此说来，昨天一到，应该先去看他，

That had been a mistake.
自己是走错了一步，

Worse still, A’qi had paid him a secret visit this morning.
尤其这天早晨，阿七又来密访，

‘A crafty fellow has as many suspicions as hemp has fibres.’
“光棍心多，麻布筋多”，

If Yu put the two things together and misunderstood, Chen could never wash himself clean, even in the Yellow River.
如果郁四把这两件事摆在一起想一想，搞出什么误会来，那就“跳到黄河洗不清”了！

Here was his chance to explain without appearing to do so.
所以正好趁此刻先作一个不着痕迹的解释。于是他说：

“Uncle Four, the moment I arrived yesterday I meant to come and pay my respects.
“四叔！昨天一到，我就先要给你老人家来请安的，

But once I reached my father-in-law’s, they insisted on keeping me.”
哪晓得一到了老丈人那里，硬给他们留住了。”

This served two purposes: it explained his failure to visit the previous day, and announced that he was engaged and would no longer become entangled with A’qi.
这段话有两层用意，一是解释他所以昨天一到未去看郁四的原因，二是表示他已经定了亲，决不会再跟阿七搅七念三。

Yu, however, was bewildered.
然而郁四却有些莫名其妙，

“What are you saying?
“你说啥？”

What father-in-law?
他问“啥个老丈人？

When did you get engaged?
你几时定的亲，

Why didn’t I know?”
怎么我不晓得？”

“Nobody in Huzhou knows yet.
“湖州还没有人晓得，

Mr Hu arranged it for me on this trip.”
是这趟胡先生作主替我定下的。”

“Oh!”
“噢！”

The good news visibly heartened Yu.
郁四显然自这喜讯中，受到了鼓舞，

His dull eyes began to shine.
失神的双眼，有了闪闪的亮光，

“Splendid!
“好极！

Whose daughter is she?”
是哪一家的姑娘？”

“It’s a long story, and an interesting one.
“这话说来很长，也很有趣，

You’d never guess, Uncle Four.”
四叔万万想不到的。”

Chen put him off for the moment.
陈世龙先宕开一句：

“Mr Hu also has some business of his own for me to discuss with you.”
“ 胡先生还有他自己的事情，要我跟四叔谈。”

Yu understood: naturally, it concerned funds.
这话郁四明白，自然是头寸上的事，

He stood up.
于是他站起身来说：

“People are always coming and going here.
“这里人来人往，

There’s no peace.
静不下来。

Come along to Jucheng.”
走，到聚成去！”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十六章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Sixteen, concluding part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Jucheng Bank kept a room especially for Yu Si, and he dealt with much of his official business there.
聚成钱庄中，特为给郁四预备了一个房间，他有许多衙门里的公事，都在这里处理。

Today, however, he was free.
这天却是清闲无事，

Chen Shilong could talk at leisure.
陈世龙从容细谈，

He first gave a general account of Hu Xueyan's affairs in Shanghai and Hangzhou, then came to his need for funds.
先把胡雪岩在上海、杭州的情形，大致说了一遍，最后谈到他头寸的话。

Yu and Hu already had an arrangement: Fukang lent out Yu's money and paid him half the interest charged to its borrowers—a cost lower even than the interbank rate—and naturally no security was required.
郁四跟胡雪岩是有约定的，阜康代为放款，比同行拆息还便宜，照一般放款利息折半计算，当然也不需要什么担保。

Yu called in Jucheng's manager.
郁四把聚成的档手喊了进来，

On learning that thirty thousand taels could be made available, he instructed him to remit the money to Fukang in Hangzhou immediately.
一问可以调拨三万银子，便即关照，马上汇到杭州阜康。


Their business concluded, Chen turned to his private affairs and recounted, from the beginning, Hu's intentions and arrangements concerning A’zhu.
谈完“公事”，陈世龙谈私事，把胡雪岩对阿珠的用心及处置，从头细叙。

Yu found it more entertaining than a storyteller's performance.
郁四觉得比听书还要有味，

He listened on the opium couch, continued listening at the dining table, and returned to the couch for more.
从烟榻听到饭桌上，再由饭桌听到烟榻上。

When Chen finished, he said, “You have to admire Old Hu!
听完说道：“老胡这个人，真要佩服他！

The things he does are so original, and so beautifully managed.”
做出来的事，别出心裁，真正漂亮！”

“Uncle Four, the wedding should be towards the end of the year.
“四叔，”陈世龙说，“喜事总在年底，

When we send out invitations, I'll need you to represent me.”
那时候发帖子，要你老人家替我出面。”

“Naturally!”
“那当然！”

He gave a long sigh.
说到这里，长叹一声：

“Things have turned out well for you...”
“你倒好了……”

The occasion had evidently brought A’hu to mind.
这自是触景生情，想起阿虎，

Chen hastened to say, “Don't grieve, Uncle Four.
陈世龙赶紧说道：“四叔，你老人家不要难过！

A’hu is gone, but I'm still here to look after you.”
阿虎不在了，还有我侍奉你老人家。”

Yu's eyes reddened.
一听这话，郁四的眼圈红了，

Whether from grief for his son or gratitude to Chen, it was hard to tell.
也不知是伤子还是为陈世龙而感动？

At last he forced himself to rally.
但终于强自振作起来，

“Little Monk, you know I've wronged you in some ways.
“小和尚！”他说，“你晓得的，我这个做四叔的，也有对不起你的地方，

That's past, and we needn't say more.
现在事情过去了，也不必多说了。

Now you're establishing a home and a livelihood and taking the proper road.
你现在成家立业，朝正路上走去，

I'm delighted.
我高兴得很，

Of course I'll represent you in the marriage, and I'll take responsibility for everything.
亲事自然我来出面，一切都是我的。

Find out how much Old Hu paid for those four kinds of jewellery.
那四样首饰，你打听打听看，老胡是花多少银子办的，

I'll repay him.
我来还他。

With me here, he ought not to pay for your betrothal gifts.”
有我在，这笔聘礼不好叫他出。”


Naturally Chen was grateful.
陈世龙自然感激。

Yet, brief as his time with Hu had been, his intelligence, adaptability, and wholehearted willingness to learn had greatly advanced his understanding of the world.
但他虽只跟了胡雪岩短短一段日子，因为人既聪明灵活，又是衷心受教，人情世故的阅历上，大非昔比，

He had sincerely meant to comfort an elder; now Yu was treating him as family.
此时心里在想，自己是出于一番至诚，安慰长辈，而郁四居然拿自己当亲人看待，

That was good in itself.
原是好事，

But trouble would come sooner or later within Yu's household, and Sister A’lan was already scheming about her parents' property.
但郁家迟早要闹家务，阿兰姐正在动娘家的脑筋，

If he accepted benefits now, people might think he too was taking advantage of Yu's vulnerability.
自己再受郁四的好处，叫别人看来，仿佛他也是乘虚而入，在打郁四的主意，

He must avoid that suspicion.
这个嫌疑不可不避。

Even that was a lesser concern.
避嫌疑犹是小事，

A’lan appeared to be managing Yu's household now.
眼前看样子是阿兰姐在替郁四当家，

The four kinds of jewellery would cost a thousand taels; if Yu paid that sum back to Hu, A’lan would be displeased as soon as she heard, and there would be no end of talk.
买那四样首饰也要千两银子，由郁四捧出来还给胡雪岩，阿兰姐知道了，心里先将不舒服，闲话可就多了！

“Well?”
“怎么？”

Yu was puzzled by his silence.
郁四见他不作声，倒真有困惑了，

“What is there to say about it?”
“那还有什么话说？”

Chen had decided to decline but could not find the words.
陈世龙已决定辞谢郁四的好意，不过这话不知如何措词？

Pressed, he answered, “Uncle Four, it isn't that I fail to appreciate your kindness.
经他一逼，只好这样答道：“四叔！不是我不识拾举，

I want to prove myself and manage this myself.
我是想争口气，这件事我要自己来办。

Ultimately, that will do you credit too.
为来为去也是为四叔争气，

You'll be able to tell people that Little Monk paid for his own marriage.
说起来，四叔可以告诉人家，小和尚是自己讨的亲，

You offered to provide the betrothal gifts, but he didn't need it.
我要替他出聘礼，他用不着。

Won't that give you something to be proud of?”
这不是四叔也有面子。”


In their world, standing mattered, and so did the saying that a man should support himself.
江湖上讲究面子，也看重“人贵自立”这句话，

An elder could hardly withhold approval.
尤其是做长辈的，听他这样说，自然要嘉许，

“I'm pleased to hear you say that.
“你这两句话，我听了倒高兴。

But...”
不过，”

Yu's tone became admonitory.
郁四又以告诫的语气说，

“You're only just starting out.
“你刚刚出道，

Don't learn to boast before you learn anything else.
不要别的本事没有学会，先学会说大话。

That wouldn't do.”
那就不对了！”

“I'm speaking honestly.
“我是实实在在的话。

What would be the point of boasting, especially before you?”
尤其是在四叔面前，说大话算哪一出？”

“Then let me ask you seriously: where will you get the money to marry?
“那么，我倒问你。”郁四很认真地，“你哪里来的钱讨亲？

Didn't you say Old Hu bought the jewellery for you?”
你不是说四样首饰是老胡替你买的吗？”

“Yes.
“是啊！

Mr Hu advanced the money.
胡先生替我垫银子买的，

I can repay him from my share of the profits later.
将来我分了花红可以还他。

If you provided the money, wouldn't you scold me when I tried to pay you back?”
如果是四叔替我出了这笔钱，将来我说拿了来还四叔，不是要挨骂了吗？”

“It's all the same.
“那也一样。

When you have money, you can show your respect for me too.”
你有了钱也可以孝敬孝敬我的！”

“Of course!
“那还用说？

If I don't honour you with it, whom should I spend it on?
我有了钱不孝敬四叔，把哪个用？

For now, though, please help me keep my pride and prove myself.
不过眼前要请四叔，帮我做过面子争口气，

Let me manage everything.”
一切让我自己来。”

Yu was both pleased and perplexed.
听了他的话，郁四又高兴、又困扰，

The first part delighted him: even if it was flattery, it felt good.
高兴的是他前面那两句话，就算是米汤，心里也舒服。

The second troubled him.
困扰的是后面那两句话，

Leaving Chen to his own devices would help him prove himself and preserve his standing; paying for his wedding would apparently do the opposite!
不管他，让他自己去料理，是帮他争气做面子，出钱替他办喜事，反倒不是！

What sort of reasoning was that?
这成何话说。


Unreasonable though it sounded, Yu could not refute it.
虽不成话，却驳不倒！

Leaning back, he studied Chen and pointed at him with the opium needle.
郁四把头往后仰一仰，打量了陈世龙一番，拿签子指指点点地说：

“I haven't seen you for two or three months, and you've changed!
“两三个月不见，我看你是变过了！

In that long gown, you look quite like a senior business clerk.
长衫上身，倒也蛮象个‘大二先生’的样子，

And the things you say are so extraordinary that they're harder to answer than an official pronouncement from above.
说两句话，异出异样，比上头的‘官腔’还要难应付。

Did you learn all this from Old Hu?”
这都是你从老胡那里学来的？”

He sounded regretful but was secretly delighted.
其词若憾，其实深喜，

Chen merely smiled, then stood.
陈世龙笑笑不答，站起身来说：

“Uncle Four, I have several matters to attend to.
“四叔，我还有几桩事情，等着要去接头。

I'll come and see you again tomorrow.”
明天再来看你老人家。”

“Come to my house tomorrow—the North Gate house.”
“明天到我家来，北门！”

Yu made the address quite clear, then sighed again.
郁四特地交代明白，接着又叹口气，

“These days have been unbearable.
“唉，这一阵的日子，不是人过的，

Seeing you today has made me feel much better.
今天见了你，心里好过得多。

If you're free tonight, do come again.
你晚上有空，最好再来一趟，

I have more to tell you.
我还有些话要告诉你，

If you can't come tonight, you must come tomorrow morning.
如果今天晚上没空，明天上午一定来，

I seldom go to the tea shop now.
茶店里我这一向也少去，

I went today only to wait for you.
今天是为了等你，

Otherwise I'd have stayed brooding at home.
不然我也就在家里孵孵算了，

I even think of giving up my post at the yamen.
衙门里的差使，我都想辞掉。

There's no point!”
没有意思！”

He shook his head repeatedly.
说着，摇头不止。

That Yu could contemplate abandoning even his hereditary position showed how despondent he had become.
郁四居然连世袭的差使，都不想要了，可知心境灰恶。

Chen felt sorry for him and wanted to stay, entertaining him with interesting stories of the foreign settlement.
陈世龙于心不忍，颇想再陪他坐一会，说些夷场上有趣的见闻，为他遣愁破闷，

But the day had already been delayed too long, beginning with Crystal A’qi's visit.
无奈这一夭，从水晶阿七来访开始，已经耽误了太多的工夫，

He had to leave and attend to business.
不得不走，去办正事。


By the time he completed his rounds and finished the tasks Hu had entrusted to him, the evening light was fading.
等一个圈子兜下来，把胡雪岩交代的事情办妥，已是近夕照黄昏，

He hurried to Dajing Silk Firm, where Huang Yi came forward to greet him.
匆匆赶到大经丝行，只见黄仪迎着他说道：

“Your mother-in-law has just left.
“你丈母娘刚走，

She made up your room and waited quite a while, but when you didn't come, she had to go home.
把你的房间铺陈好，还等了好一歇辰光，看看你不来，只好回去。

Before leaving, she told me over and over to send you there for supper.
临走千叮万嘱，一定要你到家吃饭。

Nobody could fault the way she treats her son-in-law!”
丈母娘待女婿，真正是没话说。”

“I've been anxious too.”
“我心里也急。”

Chen felt uneasy.
陈世龙有些不安。

“I simply couldn't get away.
“实在是分不开身，

Even now I can't go immediately.
现在也还不能去，

I want to write to Mr Hu first and send the letter on the regular boat as soon as possible.”
我想先给胡先生写封信，好趁早叫航船带出。”

“You can write when you come back tonight.
“晚上回来写也不迟。

You're staying here anyway.”
好在你今天总要住在这里。”

“No!”
“不！”

Living at Dajing seemed to Chen much like marrying into his wife's household.
陈世龙觉得住在大经，便好似“入赘”一般，

A man with backbone would not live as a dependent son-in-law in his wife's family home.
有骨气的男子汉是不肯做赘婿住在岳家的，

He therefore said firmly, “I'm still staying at my own place.”
因而很坚决地表示：“我还是住在我自己那里。”

Huang understood.
黄仪了解他的用心，点点头说：

“That's up to you.
“这也随你。

But I'd advise you to go to the Zhangs soon.
不过我劝你早点到张家，

You can write the letter there just as well.”
信到那里去写也一样。”


Chen accepted that suggestion.
这个建议，陈世龙接受了。

When he reached the Zhang house, A’zhu herself opened the door.
赶到张家，正好是阿珠来开的门。

This time she was not as embarrassed as she had been the day before.
这一次不象昨天那样不好意思了，

“Why have you come so late?” she asked with a trace of reproach.
她用微带埋怨的口吻说，“怎么到这时候才来？”

“Several unexpected things happened.
“遇以好些意想不到的事。

Ah!”
唉！”

He shook his head.
陈世龙摇摇头。

“Sighing as soon as you come in! Why?” She was deeply concerned.
“一进门就叹气，”阿珠十分关切地，“为啥？”

“It isn't anything that's happened to me,” he said first, lest she misunderstand and worry.
“不是我的事。”陈世龙怕她误会，先这样说一句，好叫她放心，

“A close friend has died unexpectedly.
“一个要好弟兄，想不到死掉了。

Truly, storms come without warning, and a person's fortune can change overnight.”
真正天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福。”

His unhappy expression saddened her too.
看他神情不怡，阿珠也郁郁地不开心。

Closing the front gate, she led him into the sitting room.
关上大门，把他带到客堂说道：

“Father has gone to a wedding feast, so there's nobody to keep you company.
“爹吃喜酒去了。没有人陪你。

Would you like to come into the kitchen?”
要不要到厨房里来？”

“Certainly.
“要来的！”

I'll greet your mother there, then find a moment to write to Mr Hu.”
陈世龙说，“等我到厨房里去打个招呼，抽空给胡先生写信。”

The greeting took a long time.
这个招呼一打就是好半天工夫，

As she cooked, A’zhu's mother asked question after question about what Chen had done that day.
阿珠的娘一面炒菜，一面问长问短问陈世龙这天做了些什么？

Once they began discussing A’hu, there was no end to it.
于是谈阿虎就谈不完，

Naturally, he said nothing whatever about Crystal A’qi.
自然水晶阿七那一段，他只字不会提的。

“Well,” A’zhu said with a smile when the meal was ready, “you haven't managed to write your letter after all.”
“好了！”阿珠等要开饭时笑道，“信也写不成了。”

“I'll write after supper.
“吃了饭写，

It must be done today.”
今天非写不可。”


This was proper business, and A’zhu's mother regarded it as important.
这是正事，阿珠的娘把它看得很重要，

After the meal, she hurried to clear the table, make tea, and set out brush and inkstone.
吃完饭，忙着收桌子，泡上茶来，摆出笔砚，

A’zhu spread the paper and ground the ink for him.
阿珠又替他铺纸磨墨，

Even Chen felt that they were making too much of it.
连陈世龙自己都觉得这样子未免太郑重，

“This looks less like a letter than a memorial to the emperor,” he said with a self-mocking smile.
便自嘲似地说，“不象写信，倒象给皇帝写奏折。”

“Less chatter!
“闲话少说，

Finish it quickly and take it to the boat.
快点写好了，送到航船上。

If they've gone to sleep, you'll have to get up very early tomorrow to catch them.”
晚上，人家都睡了，那就得明天起个大早才赶得上。”

Tomorrow would have its own business.
明天有明天的事，

Determined to repay kindness through diligent work, Chen held to the rule of finishing today's tasks today.
陈世龙感恩图报，决心要好好巴结，守定今日事今日毕的宗旨，

He collected his thoughts and reported, item by item, how he had carried out Hu's instructions.
当时定一定心，把胡雪岩交代的事，办得如何，逐项写明。

At the end, he mentioned Yu: his only son's death, the threatened family troubles, and his low spirits.
最后提到郁四，说他独子病故，而且要闹家务，精神颓唐，

Naturally, Chen included news of his own marriage arrangements.
当然，也提到了他的喜事。

When he finished and looked at the clock, it had already struck nine.
写完看一看钟，已经九点敲过，

He hurriedly took his leave and delivered the letter himself to the boat bound for Hangzhou, then went straight home.
匆匆告辞，自己送到去杭州的航船上。然后径自回家。


Before he reached his door, he noticed something strange.
未曾进门就已发现了怪事，

There was light inside—and more than one lamp was burning.
他屋里亮着灯，而且不止一盏灯亮。

Chen never locked his door when he went out.
陈世龙出门向来不上锁，

There was nothing worth stealing, and forgetting or losing a key would be a nuisance.
因为没有什么东西好偷，而钥匙忘记带出来，或者虽带出来而遗失反倒麻烦，

Besides, neighbours who shared the entrance could keep an eye on the place.
好在同一个大门里的邻居会替他照看，不锁更不要紧。

Sometimes a visiting friend, finding him absent, would push open the door and sit down to wait.
有时朋友来访，见他不在家径自推门入内坐等，事或有之，

But that happened by day.
但都在白天，

This was the first such occasion at night, and it surprised and intrigued him.
象这样的情形，还是头一回，不免令人诧异，同时也逗人的好奇心，

Who could it be?
陈世龙心想，倒要看看是哪一个？

Instead of entering directly, he crept beneath the window and peered through a hole in the paper.
这样转着念头，就不肯直接推门去看，蹑手蹑脚走到窗下，找个窗纸破了的洞洞，凑眼过去张望。

One look told him he was in serious trouble.
一望就知道麻烦大了。

Crystal A’qi sat drinking tea by a lamp polished bright, her eyes fixed on another lamp across the room, as though turning over countless worries.
里面是水晶阿七，对着一盏擦得雪亮的油灯在喝茶，两眼怔怔地望着另一张桌上的油灯，仿佛有无数心事在盘算。

She wore a purplish-red, lined jacket of Ning silk.
看她身上穿一件紫红宁绸的小夹袄，

Its collar was unfastened and spread wide, revealing glimpses of the gold chain that held her underbodice.
领子上的纽扣未扣，敞得极大，一股系肚兜的金链子，隐约可见，

Anyone seeing her like this would certainly say that Crystal A’qi and Little Monk were having an affair.
这副样子让人看见了，不说“水晶阿七跟小和尚有一腿”，那才真叫有鬼！

Furious, Chen went to the door and raised his foot to kick it.
陈世龙十分火冒，走到房门口，提脚就踢，

At that instant, he checked himself.
但就在拉起脚的刹那，心中自语，

Wait!
慢来！

Who knew what she intended?
看样子阿七不知安着什么心？

Her heart was not bad, but her former occupation had stripped away her inhibitions, and she could be as wilful and defiant as anyone.
他知道她的为人，心是不坏，但吃了那碗饭，脸皮就撕破了，什么好刁泼辣的事，都做得出来。

Perhaps, having failed by persuasion, she deliberately meant to provoke a quarrel.
也许她是故意的，好说不行，存心来撩拨得自己跟她吵架，

If word reached A’zhu, there would be trouble enough.
传到阿珠耳朵里，这饥荒有得打。

Should the engagement break off, A’qi would have got just what she wanted.
万一吵散，阿七就得其所哉了！

Chen felt that this suspicion was mean-minded.
念头转到这里，自觉是“小人之心”，

Yet he remembered Huang's saying: never intend harm, but never fail to guard against it.
但记起黄仪常说的两句话：“害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无”，

He must be cautious with someone like A’qi.
象阿七这种人不可不防，

Her presence here already showed what he had failed to foresee.
只看眼前的情形，就是自己防不到的。


Once he had thought it through, his anger subsided.
想停当了，气也平了，

He pushed open the door.
伸手把门一推，

Apparently taken by surprise, A’qi sprang up with wide eyes.
阿七似乎猝不及防，霍地站起身来，两眼睁得极大，

Seeing Chen, she patted her chest.
看见陈世龙才拍拍胸说：

“Oh!
“咄！

You frightened me!”
吓得我来！”

“What about the fright you gave me?” he answered calmly.
“你倒不说我吓一跳！”陈世龙平静地答道，

“Don't you look like a fox spirit appearing in the middle of the night?”
“你这样子，象不象半夜里跑出一只狐狸精来？”

“Scold away!”
“你骂好了！”

She smiled untroubled.
阿七泰然地笑着，

“At least I know I haven't come to bewitch you.”
“好在我自己晓得，我不是来迷你的。”

“Then what have you come for?”
“那你来做啥？”

“I thought your bachelor's life looked pitiful.
“想想你光棍可怜，

With nothing else to do, I came to tidy this kennel of yours.
我又没啥事情好做，替你这间狗窝样的房子收拾收拾，

Surely there's no law against that?”
这总不犯啥法？”

Only then did Chen look round.
这一说，陈世龙才把视线扫了一遍。

The room had been put in order.
屋子里收拾得象个样子了，

The bed particularly caught his eye: it hardly seemed his own.
尤其使他触目的是，那张床不象自己的床，

He never folded his bedding, and with it folded now, the bed looked much larger.
他是从来不叠被的，此刻叠好了被一看，仿佛那张床大了许多。

“You've gone to a great deal of trouble.”
“难为你！”

He sat down.
陈世龙坐了下来。

“Freshly made tea.”
“刚刚泡的茶。”

She poured him a cup.
阿七倒了一杯茶给他，

“I've a pot of duck congee simmering for you on the veranda.”
“廊沿上我替你炖了一锅鸭粥在那里。”

“Where did the stove and pot come from?”
“哪里来的锅灶？”

“I bought them.”
“买的。”

She counted on her fingers.
阿七数着手指说，

“A portable stove, teapot, earthenware pot, and charcoal: two thousand copper cash altogether.”
“风炉、茶壶、砂锅，还有炭，一共用了两千铜钱。”


“What else did you buy for me?
“还替我买了啥东西，

How much have you spent in all?”
一共垫了多少？”

“Do you mean to pay me back?”
“你要还我？”

“Naturally.
“当然！”

We aren't setting up house together.
陈世龙说，“我又不跟你‘做人家’，

There's no reason for you to buy these things.”
没有要你来买的道理。”

His manner was calm, but there was no warmth in his words.
看他的神气倒还平静，但话中摸不到一丝热气，

A’qi reproached herself inwardly.
阿七心里便自怨，

Why come here to be snubbed?
何苦来自讨没趣？

Yet she could not bear simply to leave.
但一则不甘于就此一走，

Living respectably was one thing; enduring desolation and loneliness was another.
二则是觉得良家妇女好做，凄凉和寂寞难耐。

Alone beside a lamp on an autumn night of cold rain, she could bite her quilt to pieces and gain nothing.
秋宵冷雨，独对孤灯，把棉被咬破了都没用，

Better to stay here.
还不如在陈世龙这里的好，

Chen might show her no kindness, but at least there were two of them!
虽说他没有好脸嘴给人看，到底是两个人呀！

With this resolution, she gained the advantage.
这样转着念头，陈世龙就落下风了，

Chen had hoped that embarrassment would send her home.
他原来是想她自觉没趣，不如归去。

He had never imagined that she might feel unwelcome and stay anyway.
谁知她虽觉没趣而不走，是他再也猜不到的，

Not knowing this, he continued to meet every remark with an uncompromising rejoinder.
所以谈话依旧是一句顶一句，毫不放松。


A’qi went about her business.
阿七行所无事，

She brought in the pot of congee, set it on the floor, and hurried out again.
走到廊沿下去把一锅鸭粥端了进来，放在地上，接着又奔了出去，

Clattering sounds followed.
只听乒乒乓乓的响声，

Unable to imagine what she was doing, Chen went to look and discovered a little kitchen installed round the corner of the veranda: a plain wooden table and a bamboo cupboard against the wall.
不知在搞些什么？陈世龙忍不住也走出去张望，这才发现廊沿转角上已安下一个小小的厨房，一张白木方桌，靠壁置着一具竹子碗橱，

The noise came from her taking out bowls and chopsticks.
“乒乒乓乓”正就是她在取碗筷弄出来的响声。

She really seemed intent on setting up house with him!
她倒是真的想打算跟自己“做人家”了。

He was both annoyed and amused but could say nothing.
陈世龙又好气，又好笑，却不能说什么，

Returning to his seat, he was followed by A’qi with a tray.
他回身坐定，阿七已跟着走了进来，手里一个托盘，

Besides two sets of bowls and chopsticks, it held two side dishes: tudie preserved in wine lees, and radish pickled in sauce.
两副碗筷以外，还有两碟小菜，一碟是糟“吐瓞”，一碟是酱萝卜。

“I don't want any,” he said, determined to keep her at a distance.
“我不要吃！”陈世龙先来个拒人于千里之外。

“Then I'll eat!” she answered briskly.
“你不吃我吃！”阿七答得异常爽脆。

She served herself congee and sat down.
她自盛了一碗鸭粥坐下来吃，

Whether she was truly hungry or meant to annoy him, she ate with noisy relish.
也不知是真的饿了，还是有意气他？只见她唏哩呼噜，吃得好香。

The congee had simmered to perfection, and its rich aroma drifted continually towards him.
鸭粥熬得火候够了，香味浓郁，不断飘到他的鼻下，

Watching her bite into crisp pickled radish with an audible crunch made him swallow with longing.
再看她挟块绷脆的酱萝卜放在嘴里，咬得“嘎吱嘎吱”地响，越使得陈世龙要咽唾沫。


He began to feel aggrieved.
想想有点不甘心，

“You've made yourself comfortable!
“你这个人倒好！”他说，

Do you really think this is your home?”
“真的当这里是你的家了？”

“We're friends, aren't we?” she answered without concern.
“有交情的嘛！”阿七毫不在乎地说，

“Wouldn't you do the same at my place?”
“你到我那里，还不是一样？”

“I wouldn't be so insensitive.”
“我是不会这样子不识相的。”

“You mean I'm insensitive?”
“你是说我不识相？”

“A little.
“有一点。”

It's late.
陈世龙说，“天晚了，

I want to go to bed.”
我要睡觉了。”

“Little Monk, you're terribly small-minded,” she said quietly.
“小和尚，你气量真小！”阿七的声调幽幽地，

“You could at least let me finish this bowl before driving me away.”
“你就让我把这碗粥吃完了，再赶我走，也还不迟。”

The rebuke struck home.
这话说得很够分量，

Chen regretted his words.
陈世龙大为懊悔，

He was a grown man; low as his standing in their world might be, nobody had ever dared openly slight him.
堂堂男子汉，在江湖上辈分虽低，倒也从来没有哪个敢当面藐视过，

Yet today her two remarks had put him completely in the wrong.
不过今天“吃瘪”在她这两句话上！

He must recover his ground.
于是他要“找场”了！

“Small-minded?
“什么气量小，气量小？

That has nothing to do with it!
谈不到！”

I'm thinking of you, not driving you away.
他说，“我是为你好，不是啥‘赶你走，！

Stay as long as you please.
随你喜欢到啥辰光，

I don't mind.
我不在乎。

But you'll have to excuse me.”
不过我要少陪了。”


He took off his long gown, laid it across a chair, and sat on the edge of the bed to change into slippers.
说着脱下长衫，往椅背上一搭，坐到床沿上去换拖鞋。

The slippers he had worn that morning were no longer underneath it.
哪知早晨刚刚穿过的拖鞋，此时已不在床下，

A’qi must have moved them.
心知是阿七不知摆到哪里去了？

Unwilling to speak to her, he kicked off his shoes and flung himself onto the bed.
懒得跟她搭话，使把鞋子一甩，身子往床上一倒。

“Your slippers are here.”
“拖鞋在这里。”

She drew them from beneath a square stool at the head of the bed, then hung his gown on the clothes stand and cleared the table.
阿七从床头方凳下拖出一双拖鞋来，回身又把他的长衫挂到衣架上，接着又去收拾桌子。

Chen watched in silence, but could not lie comfortably.
陈世龙看在眼里不响，但身子却睡不宁帖，

He felt as though a thorn were sticking into his back.
倒象背上长了根刺在那里似地。

His only wish was that she would leave soon and never return.
他此时唯一的希望是，阿七早早离去，从此不来。

When she had finished, she sat down. “Little Monk, there's something I want to ask you.”
“小和尚！”阿七收拾完毕，坐下来说，“我有句话要问你。”

Too embarrassed to ignore her, he answered coldly, “Go ahead.”
不理不好意思，陈世龙只得冷冷地答道：“你说好了。”

“Honestly, I've never made such well-flavoured duck congee.
“说实话，我从来没有烧过这么入味的鸭粥，

Won't you have a bowl?”
你吃一碗好不好？”

He had never expected that.
想不到是这么一句话！陈世龙大出意外，

Nobody's heart was made of stone.
“人心都是肉做的”，

She had worked hard to prepare it, and now must beg him to enjoy it, as though eating a bowl would do her some great favour.
她辛辛苦苦烧好，还要哀求别人来享用，仿佛吃她一碗鸭粥，就是帮了她什么大忙似的。

He could not bring himself to refuse harshly.
这叫人无论如何硬不起心肠来峻拒，

“You've cleared everything away.
只好这样推托：“已经都收拾好了，

Why go to more trouble...?”
何必再费事……”


Before he could finish, she was on her feet.
一句话没有完，阿七已站起身来，连连说道：

“No trouble at all!”
“不费事，不费事！”

She hurried out, and he could not stop her.
说着，就走了出去。陈世龙无法阻拦。

Chen felt an indescribable vexation with himself.
心里有着说不出的懊恼，

How useless he was, unable even to deal with A’qi!
是恨自己无用，连个阿七都对付不了！

Sitting up, he argued inwardly with his own weakness.
于是自己跟自己赌气，一面从床上仰身坐了起来，一面心中自语：

Why fear her like a poisonous snake?
何必象见了一条毒蛇似地怕她？

The more he avoided her, the more tightly she would cling.
越是这样躲她，她越要缠住不放。

When she brought the congee with a smile, he offered no thanks, merely took his chopsticks and began to eat, crunching the radish as loudly as she had.
等阿七笑嘻嘻地盛了粥来，他也不说一声“谢谢”，扶起筷子就吃，也象她一样，把酱萝卜咬得“嘎吱嘎吱”地响，

He finished one bowl, then had another.
吃完一碗，再来一碗。

“Tastes good, doesn't it?” she asked proudly.
“味道不错吧？”阿七得意地问。

“Nothing remarkable.”
“不见得怎么样。”

“Hmph!”
“哼！”

She curled her lip at his insincerity.
她撇一撇嘴，笑他言不由衷，

“My congee may be poor, but your appetite seems good.”
“我烧的粥是不好，不过你的胃口还不错。”

“My appetite is poor, but you wouldn't be happy if I didn't eat.”
“我的胃口是不好，不过不吃你不开心。”

Chen imitated her phrasing.
陈世龙学着她的语气说。

A’qi said nothing, quietly savouring his words.
阿七不作声，静静地在咀嚼他这句话的滋味。


“Now it's my turn to ask a question.”
“现在该论到我问句话了。”

Chen set down his empty bowl.
陈世龙放下空碗说：

“What exactly do you want from me?”
“你到底要我怎么样？”

“Nothing much.
“没有啥！

Honestly, there's nothing for me to do at home.
说实话，我回去也没有事，

I lie alone in bed, thinking of everything, unable to sleep till morning.
一个人躺在床上想东想西，一夜到天亮都睡不着。

Talking to you makes me feel better.
跟你谈谈，心里好过些，

When it's time, you can go to bed and I'll go home.”
谈到差不多辰光了，你睡你的觉，我回我的家。”

It was a modest request, and Chen's view of her had changed since he came in.
所望不奢，而且陈世龙对她的观感，跟刚进门时，已有不同，

He nodded.
于是点点头答应：

“Very well.
“好嘛！

At worst, I'll sit with you till dawn.”
大不了陪你坐到天亮。”

She smiled, cleared away the bowls, and made fresh tea.
阿七嫣然一笑，先把碗筷收了出去，重新沏了一壶茶来，

Across the newly brightened lamp, they chatted, though she did most of the talking.
就隔着一盏剔亮了的油灯，跟陈世龙闲谈，自然是她的话多，

Yu Si, she said, was fairly decent in his dealings with people, but too easily influenced, especially by his daughter.
谈郁四的待人接物，说他“还算是有良心的”，只是耳朵软，喜欢听女儿的话。

She had truly meant to spend her life with him.
又说她本来已经死心塌地的预备跟郁四一辈子，

Who could have foreseen this change?
哪知道中途出此变故？

People called women of her former profession low and contemptible, she complained, but knew nothing of how hard it was to leave that life.
因而便发牢骚，说大家只骂风尘中人下贱，去不知从良也不是件容易事。

At this point, the talk became serious.
谈到这里就不是闲话了，

“Little Monk, I made inquiries this afternoon.
“小和尚！”她说，“我今天下午去打听过了，

Your engagement to the Zhang girl is real.
你跟张家的亲事不假，

I'm a step too late.
我晚了一步！

Then tell me, how am I to live from now on?”
那么，你倒替我想想，我以后的日子怎么过法？”

Her request for advice was sincere, and Chen could not evade it.
看她的神情是诚恳求教，陈世龙不能推托，

After thinking, he replied, “You must first say what you want, so that others can look for you.
想一想答道：“你自己总要有几句话摆出来，人家才好替你留意，

Could you endure hardship?
譬如说，你吃不吃得苦，

Would you accept being a concubine?
肯不肯做小？

What sort of man do you want?
要怎么样的人品？

Make it clear, and I'll look.
说清楚了，我替你去找。

Such a matter can be very difficult or very easy.
这件事说难很难，说容易很容易，

Mr Hu has arranged three matches in the past two or three months.
胡老板在这两三个月中，就做了三个媒。

He's as resourceful at it as at business.
在这上面，就跟他的做生意一样，顶有办法。

I'll entrust your case to him and guarantee good news within three months.”
我把你的事情托他，包你三个月之内，就有好消息。“


A’qi merely blinked, as though she herself could not decide what sort of respectable man she should settle with.
阿七不响，只是眨眼，仿佛连她自己都弄不清楚，该“从”怎么样的一个“良人”？

“Marriage can't be rushed,” Chen said, seizing the chance to encourage her departure.
“终身大事急不得！”陈世龙趁机劝她走路，

“Go home and think it over.
“你回去好好想一想。

You've suffered once.
已经吃过一次亏，

You mustn't suffer twice.”
不能再吃第二次。”

His earnest tone persuaded her, and she rose as though to leave.
语气很诚恳，阿七觉得他说得很中听，便站起身来有告辞的模样。

Chen moved quickly.
陈世龙的动作很快，

He took down the lantern he had brought from Dajing, which hung on a nail in a post, lit its candle, and placed it in her hand.
把他从大经丝行带来的钉在亭柱上的一盏灯笼，取了下来，点了蜡烛，交在阿七手里。

“Then I'll see you tomorrow!” she said.
“那么明朝会了！”

“Tomorrow, tomorrow!”
“明朝会，明朗会！”

An idea struck him, and he laid the groundwork.
陈世龙灵机一动，下个伏笔：

“Though you may find it hard to catch me these next two days.”
“不过这两天你怕不容易寻得着我。”

“Why?
“怎么呢？”

Are you that busy?”
阿七问道，“这样子忙法？”

“Yes.
“是啊！

You may not believe it, but I even have business from the prefectural yamen to attend to.”
说来你不相信，连知府衙门里的公事，我都要管。”

There was nothing unbelievable about that.
这也没有什么不能相信，

A’qi knew Hu and Prefect Wang were inseparable.
阿七知道胡雪岩跟王大老爷是分不开的，

As Hu's trusted man, Chen might naturally handle some official matters as well.
既然陈世龙是胡雪岩的亲信。附带办些知府衙门的公事，也是情理中事。

But official business was done by day, and he must return home to sleep at night.
好在公事总在白天，晚上亦总要回家睡觉，

She need not fear being unable to find him.
不怕寻不着他。


Night was precisely when Chen wanted to avoid her.
陈世龙要避她的，正在晚上。

As matters stood, sternness would not frighten her away, and he could not outlast her gentle persistence.
看阿七现在的样子，硬的吓不走她，软的磨不过她，

Of all strategies, retreat was best.
三十六计，走为上策，

He could not leave Huzhou, so there were two possibilities: find another house, or move into Dajing.
当然不能离开湖州，那就是两个办法，第一个是另外找房子搬家，第二个是住到大经丝行去。

On reflection, only the second would do.
细想一想，其实只有一个办法，搬到大经丝行，

If he found a new place, he would have to explain himself when people asked.
因为另外找房子搬家，别人问起来，总得有个说法，

Saying he wished to avoid A’qi would look like a guilty conscience and make an innocent matter seem suspicious.
说是为了避阿七，则变成自己心虚，无私有弊了。

Besides, she might call at Dajing.
同时，阿七说不定会到大经去找，

If he lived there, he could handle her more easily.
自己在那里，比较好应付，

Otherwise, a few careless words from her could arouse suspicions that even the Yellow River could not wash away.
否则，阿七在那里说两句不知轻重出入的话，引起嫌疑，就跳到黄河也洗不清了。

His mind settled, he slept peacefully.
打定了主意，安然入梦。

Early next morning he went to see several younger friends he knew well.
第二天一早出门去看了几个素日有来往的小弟兄，

Their drinking lasted until three in the afternoon.
一顿酒吃到下午三点钟，

Then he went home, packed his clothes, and took them to Dajing.
回家收拾随身衣服，带到大经丝行。


“Come along!”
“来，来！”

Huang hurried from his room, beckoning.
黄仪从屋里奔了出来，招手喊道：

“Your matchmaker has something to tell you today.”
“今天我这个媒人有话跟你说了。”

邀他到房间里，一谈经过，陈世龙大出意外。

That morning Yu had come to Dajing especially to see Old Zhang, addressing him as his fellow parent-in-law.
据说郁四在这天早晨，特地到大经丝行来看老张，口称“亲家”，

Chen, he explained, was his junior, but he now regarded him as a son.
说陈世龙是他的小辈，现在当儿子一样看待，

At the wedding, Yu would head the bridegroom's family.
将来办喜事，男家归他主持，

He had also brought a thousand taels in betrothal money.
同时送了一千两银子的聘金。

“Your father-in-law is an honest fellow and didn't know what to do.
“你丈人老实，有点手足无措，不知道怎么办？

He came to ask me.
特地来问我，

What was there to discuss?
这还有啥话说？

I told him to acknowledge the relationship.”
我叫你老丈人认了亲家。”

黄仪很高兴地说，

“That's a man of standing for you!
“到底是占码头的人物，

He does things magnificently.
做事漂亮之至，

送了我二百两银子，算是谢媒，

Refusing would have offended him, so I frankly accepted.
不收他会不高兴，我也就老实，

I've benefited through you, my young friend.”
叨你老弟的光了。

“陈世龙听这一说，觉得面子十足，心里非常高兴，但不肯在脸上摆出来，怕黄仪发觉他并不知道这件事。

年底下来不及。

看你的意思怎么佯？

我们先谈好了，再跟郁四叔去说。”

陈世龙有些不太愿意，

想了想问道：“不晓得阿珠怎么说？”

What could she say?
她会怎么说，

难道说越早出阁越好？”

想想不错，陈世龙失笑了，

“这件事我做不来主。”

黄仪拿了郁四的、吃了张家的，不能不把情况弄清楚，

人家虽帮你的忙，到底不是‘父母之命’。”

“父母之命，媒妁之言”这两句话，陈世龙也听到过，

但他的这头亲事，真所谓“如人饮水，冷暖自知”，

成家立业是一事的两面，

Hu had arranged the match both to advance Chen and to secure an able assistant for his own enterprises.
为胡雪岩想，是要提拔陈世龙，也为了他自己的事业，要觅个得力的帮手，引替陈世龙促成良缘，

All those ventures were now being actively developed, and only Hu knew when Chen would be needed.
此刻各样生意，都在着春进展之中，到什么时候，需要陈世龙出力，只有胡雪岩心里才有数，

倘或正要用人的时候，他在忙着办喜事，岂不耽误了生意，

除此以外，陈世龙还有一份感恩的心情，

为了尊敬“胡先生”，哪怕就没有耽误生意的顾虑，他也愿意请命而行。

否则做媒人的两头传话，南辕北辙，就吃力而不讨好了。

人家要好好预备嫁妆，因此耽误日子，我们做男家的要体谅。

大户人家的小姐，一到了十二三岁就在办嫁妆了，

阿七答道，“笨得象牛，蠢得象猪，

一吃过夜饭就要打瞌盹，上了床象死人一样。”

“这样子，夜里就寂寞了。

Doesn't anyone come to see you?”
也没有人来看看你？”

“有哪个？

鬼都没有得上门。”

我就做‘鬼’上你的门！”

啥叫‘做鬼上门’，

说得人吓兮兮地！

这在黄仪又有会心了，“动手动脚”不要紧，就怕让人看见。

他这样自言自语着，奔了出去。

间壁的陈世龙却不免诧异，

不懂阿七是什么意思？

莫非真个孤衾难耐，有意接受黄仪的勾引？

他想仔细看一看阿七的表情，无奈她背着身子，正朝窗外在望。

就这时候，听得黄仪的脚步声，接着是关门声和落闩声。

原来如此！

这下真有场“隔壁戏”好看了。

怎么坏法？”

黄仪仰脸闭眼，向空嗅了两下，

同时一只手从她膀子上慢慢摸了上去。

他还在不胜陶醉，陈世龙却在替他担心了。

因为阿七已经变态，眼睛渐渐睁圆，眉毛渐渐上竖，嘴巴渐渐闭紧，

最后扬起她那只多肉的手，使劲一掌，打在黄仪脸上。

睁开眼来，看到阿七的脸色，才知道是怎么回事？

这时才显出阿七的泼辣，

要出人命了。

幸好黄仪识趣，

窘笑着说，“何必呢！这样子认真。

早晓得你开不起玩笑，哪个孙子忘八蛋跟你罗嗦！”

我要走了。”

黄仪一言不发，乖乖地去开了门，放阿七走路。

这一下陈世龙却受罪了，使尽吃奶的力气，才能把笑声憋住，

不但不能讲出去，最好连黄仪面前，都要装作不知其事。

不然便要遭忌，

俗语说的“是非只为多开口”，正指此而言。

然而难题仍未解决，

阿七仍旧会来，

想不到撒泼放刁，也绝得很，

那条“烟熏鼠穴”之计，十分厉害，不能听其自然。

这样就还是只好跟黄仪去商量。

一个人出后门寻朋友一起吃晚饭，回列丝行，才踱到黄仪那里“打听消息”。

又说，要抽回本钱，最好跟你见个面。

总而言之，言而总之一句话：贱货！没有男人不过门。”

听他此刻的话，想起他当时咆哮如虎，而结果如丧家之狗的神情，

前后映照，使得陈世龙的肚肠根痒不可当，

“现在已经不是躲的事。”

就怕她不来，到处去放谣言，说你欠了她的钱，避不见面，

逼得你非出面跟她理论不可。”

照阿七的为人，还不至于这么坏！

不过她如缠住不放，而自己又始终避不见面，怨恨交加，

象她这样的女人就很难说了！

她现在逼得你没路走，世龙！

你要早点想办法。”

我现在不就是在向黄先生讨教？”

黄仪点点头，

一双眼睛突然变得深沉，沉思了好一会，才慢吞吞地开口：

要想一劳永逸，唯有这条路好走。”

看样子是极狠的一着，

“听说你跟县衙门的刑名师爷很熟？”

“熟也不太熟。

不过打着胡先生的旗号去，可以说得上话。”

“这就行了！”

黄仪很轻松地，

Her native place is Gaoyou.
原籍高邮。

你去托刑名师爷弄张牌票出来，转她个‘流娼’的罪名，递解回籍，

滚她拉块妈妈咸鸭蛋！”

想不到是如此一计，

实在太狠毒了一些，陈世龙心里暗暗吃惊，

原来黄仪是这么一个人！

以后共事，倒要好好防他。

“怎么样？”

黄仪催问：

非如此不足以放心！”

我知道黄先生完全是为我。

But...”
不过，”

陈世龙亦颇多急智，把这重公案扯到了郁四身上，

就表面看，黄仪这样够朋友，再不领情受教，就变成半吊子了。

陈世龙十分机警，用欣然的语气答道：

我明天就去办。”

这当然是敷衍，

陈世龙决不会照他的话去做的。

Reflecting alone, he felt that he had asked Huang for help only to gain more trouble, with additional complications he had never needed.
一个人静下来想想，原意托黄仪帮忙，谁知越帮越忙，反倒额外添了些麻烦。

Thoroughly unhappy, he went to bed early.
所以心中甚为不快，早早上床睡了。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十七章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Seventeen, first part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER SEVENTEEN｜第十七章


Chen had not been in bed long when a young apprentice knocked and brought him a letter just delivered by the night passenger boat.
刚睡下不久，小徒弟来敲门，送来一封夜班航船刚刚带到的信，

It was from Hu Xueyan.
信是胡雪岩寄来的，

In a few brief lines, Hu said that he had heard of Yu Si's bereavement and was deeply concerned.
拆开一看，寥寥数语，只说得知郁四有伤子之痛，深为惦念，

He had made time for a special journey to Huzhou to offer his condolences and would take a boat the very day he sent the letter.
特地抽空，专程到湖州来一趟，慰唁郁四，发信以后，即日下船。

All Chen's worries vanished.
这一下，陈世龙的愁怀尽夫，

With Hu coming, nothing need trouble him any longer.
有胡雪岩到，凡事都不碍了。

He slept soundly, then slipped down to the wharf early the next morning to wait.
一觉好睡，第二天一早，悄悄到码头上去等，

It was after ten when Hu arrived.
等到十点多钟，将胡雪岩等到了。

Once the boat had anchored and the gangplank was in place, Chen went aboard.
泊舟下碇，搭好跳板，陈世龙先到船上，

“Mr Hu!” he called with a smile.
笑嘻嘻叫过一声：“胡先生：”

“I never expected you to come.
接着又说，“没有想到胡先生会来，

This is wonderful.”
真是太好了。”

His manner told Hu that he had arrived at just the right moment: something needed his attention.
听他这样说法，便知自己这一趟适逢其分，有什么事要自己来料理，

He nodded.
胡雪岩便点点头说，

“I've hired a boat for the journey, and I have only three days.
“我是包了一只船夹的，只有三天的工夫。

Come, sit down.
来，你坐下来，

Let's go through everything first.”
我们先细谈一谈。”


The conversation proved a long one.
这一谈便长了，

From Yu's loss of his son, Chen passed to his household troubles; from A’qi to his own difficulties; and from himself to Huang Yi.
由郁四丧子谈到他的家务，由阿七谈到自己的麻烦，由自己又谈到黄仪。

Naturally, he also told Hu how Yu had put aside all past grievances and undertaken to arrange Chen's wedding, how Yu had formally met the bride's family and delivered the betrothal money, and how A’zhu's mother wished to prepare her daughter's dowry, which meant postponing the wedding until the following year.
自然，也谈到郁四尽释前嫌，替自己出面办喜事，如何会亲送聘金，以及阿珠的娘要替女儿办嫁妆，婚期得延到明年。

结语是：“我一切都要请胡先生来作主。”

“Who would have thought so many complications could arise the moment I left?”
“想不到我一走，出了这么多花样！”

胡雪岩紧皱着眉，想了好半天才开口：

“Your wedding can be arranged one way or another.
“你的喜事，怎么样都可以，

慢慢再说。

Your Fourth Uncle Yu's situation is more troublesome.
你郁四叔搞成这样子，倒有些伤脑筋了。

I've never met his daughter.
他的大小姐我没有见过，

What do you think of her?
你看她为人如何？

Is she naturally kind?”
天性厚不厚？”

“Sister A’lan has long been known for her intelligence and ability.
“阿兰姐的精明强干，早就有名的。

As for her nature...”
天性呢，”

Chen chose his words carefully.
陈世龙出语很谨慎，

“Surely she can't be too unkind.
“自然不会太薄，

She's his only daughter.”
郁四叔只有这么一个女儿。”

“现在是唯一的亲骨肉了！

I don't think she would fail in her duty to him—or dare to.”
我想，她不会不孝顺，也不敢不孝顺。”

The last words were not immediately clear.
最后一句话，骤然难以索解，

细想一想，才察出这句话中的分量，

If A’lan dared to mistreat her elderly father, Hu would certainly intervene as her father's friend.
如果阿兰姐敢于不孝顺老父，胡雪岩以父执的资格，一定会出来说话。

At the very least, he would advise Yu not to give her a single copper.
至少限度，他会劝郁四，一个沙壳子都不要给阿兰姐，

“A married daughter is water poured away”: however fiercely she fought at her parents' home, that would not secure her the property.
“嫁出的女儿泼出的水”，阿兰姐在娘家硬争是争不到财产的。

“胡先生，”陈世龙忽有灵感，“你何不帮郁四叔把家务料理一下子？”

胡雪岩沉吟不语，

显然是觉得陈世龙的提议，不无考虑的余地。

照他的性情，以及与郁四的交情来说，不能不管这桩闲事，
