Three days would not be enough; even another day or two might not suffice.
三天的工夫来不及，就算再加一两天，未见得能料理清楚，

Meanwhile, business in Shanghai and Hangzhou would suffer.
而上海、杭州的事却要耽误，

Like a hunchback taking a tumble, with both ends left in the air, he would fail on both fronts.
变成“驼子跌跟斗，两头落空”，

That would be foolish indeed.
不智之至。

“And there's A’qi,” Chen added with a troubled face. “She's a nuisance.
“还有，”陈世龙又说，带些愁眉苦脸地，“阿七是个麻烦！

I wasn't afraid of her before; she could do as she pleased.
从前我不伯她，随她怎么好了！

But now I can't go rolling in the mud with her.
现在我不能跟她一起在烂泥塘里滚。

What am I to do?”
胡先生，你看我该怎么办？”

Such was the predicament of men who had made their way on the streets.
这就是“混市面”的人的苦衷！

Who did not wish to better himself?
人之好善，谁不如我？

Once a man had acquired a little standing, he wanted to rise and become respectable.
略有身价，总想力争上游，成为衣冠中人，

Yet emerging from the mud without a stain was difficult.
但虽出淤泥，要想不染却甚难，

Old connections tugged at him.
因为过去的关系，拉拉扯扯，

He might value his good name and refuse to roll in the mire, but others clung to him and would not let go; in the end he remained involved in the same disreputable ways.
自己爱惜羽毛不肯在烂泥塘里一起打滚，无奈别人死拉住不放，结果依旧同流合污。

Hu understood this thoroughly and would naturally find a way to help Chen.
胡雪岩对这一点十分清楚，当然要替陈世龙想办法。

Yu's household was one difficult problem, Chen's predicament another.
郁四的家务是个难题，陈世龙的麻烦又是一个难题，

Together, the two suddenly gave Hu an idea.
两个难题加在一起，反激出胡雪岩的灵感，

He stood up.
站起身来说：

“Come.
“走！

Let's go ashore.”
我们上岸。”


Seeing the pleased look of discovery on Hu's face, Chen knew that another ingenious plan was forming.
看他欣然有得的神情，陈世龙知道他又要出“奇计”了，

“Mr Hu,” he asked with a smile, “you must have thought of something nobody else would imagine.
便笑嘻嘻地问道：“胡先生，你一定又有啥人家想不到的主意，

Could you tell me first?”
好不好先讲给我听听？”

“There's no reason not to.
“没有啥不好讲的。”

I mean to have A’qi moor her boat at the old landing.”
胡雪岩说，“我想叫阿七‘船并老码头’。”

Chen was startled.
陈世龙一愣，

Then, thinking it through, he felt profound admiration.
再细想一想，不由得衷心钦服，

He had long known that Yu could not do without A’qi.
郁四少不得阿七，是他早就深知的。

Their enforced separation was entirely the work of A’lan and her husband.
现在硬生生的拆散，完全是阿兰姐夫妇在捣鬼。

If the broken mirror could be made whole again, then, quite apart from A’qi's feelings, Yu would at least cease to be so dejected.
倘能破镜重圆，且不说阿七这方面，起码郁四的心情，就不会这么颓丧。

Naturally, Chen's own troubles would vanish too.
当然，自己的麻烦，就此烟消云散，更不在话下。

“Mr Hu, sometimes we fail to see things clearly and can't understand why.
“胡先生！真正是，有时候我们看事情总不够透彻，自己不晓得什么道理？

Now I know.
现在我懂了，

There's only a sheet of paper between us and the answer, thin enough to pierce with a finger, yet we simply can't see it!”
差的就是那一层纸，一个指头可以戳破的，我们就是看不到！”

“Don't flatter me.
“你不要恭维我。

We don't know yet whether it will work.
事情成不成，还不晓得。

Let me first find out how matters stand.
等我先去探探口气。”

We'll go and see your Fourth Uncle.”
胡雪岩说，“先去看你郁四叔。”


Chen went ashore and hired two sedan chairs at the wharf to carry them straight to Yu's house.
于是陈世龙上岸，在码头上雇了两乘轿子，一直抬到郁四家。

Getting out first, he hurried inside and found Yu drinking alone in low spirits.
陈世龙先下轿，一直奔了进去，只见郁四一个人在喝闷酒，

He greeted him, then announced, “Mr Hu is here!”
叫应一声，接下来说：“胡先生来了！”

Delight and surprise instantly appeared on Yu's face.
郁四顿有惊喜之色，

“Where?” he asked, rising.
“在哪里？”他站起身问。

“He's come straight here from the boat.
“从船上下来，就到这里，

He made the journey especially to see you, Fourth Uncle.”
他是专程来看四叔的。”

As Chen spoke, Hu had already entered the inner gate.
正说到这里，胡雪岩已经走进二门，

Yu hurried to meet him.
郁四急忙迎了上去，

They clasped hands and looked at one another, each seemingly with a thousand things to say and no idea where to begin.
执手相看，似乎都有千言万语，不知从何说起？

At last Hu said, “Brother Yu, don't grieve so.”
好半天，胡雪岩才说了句：“四哥，你不要难过！”

Until then Yu had held himself together.
不说还好，

Those words touched the heart of his sorrow, and tears streamed down his face.
一说正说到郁四伤心之处，眼泪簌簌地流个不住，

Stamping his foot, he cried, “There's no point in living!”
顿足哭道：“做人真没有意思！”

Between broken sobs, he went on: without a true friend, he could not even have a proper cry.
接着又哽哽咽咽，断断续续地说，不逢知己，连痛哭一场都不能够。

He had so much on his mind and nobody to tell; all his suffering could not be expressed at once.
自己有多少心事，无人可诉，这份苦楚，一时也说不尽。

Now that Hu had come, he would explain everything to him, resign his post at the yamen, and find somewhere quiet to eat vegetarian food and recite the Buddha's name for the rest of his days.
如今交代了胡雪岩，便要辞掉衙门里的差使，找个清静地方去吃素念佛，了此余生。

“Brother Yu, Brother Yu! There's no need for that!” Hu kept repeating.
“四哥，四哥！”胡雪岩连声叫唤，“不必如此，不必如此！”

With these consoling words, he half supported and half led Yu indoors.
就这样解劝着，他半搀半携地把郁四扶到里面，

A’lan came out to greet him.
接着阿兰姐出来拜见，

Although they had never met, she had long heard his name and knew that he was an influential friend of her father's.
虽是初见，久已闻名，她知道这是自己父亲的一个很够分量的朋友，

She was therefore scrupulously courteous, attending to him for a while before having fresh dishes and wine prepared and asking him to stay for a simple meal.
所以礼数甚恭，好好敷衍了一阵，接着重治酒肴，留客便饭。


At the table, Hu listened to Yu's complaints and said little.
胡雪岩在席问只听郁四诉苦，很少说话，

He wanted to hear more, and this was not the place for a confidential discussion.
一则是要多听，二则此时也不便深谈。

Only after Yu had poured out his distress and begun to look somewhat revived did Hu say, “Brother Yu, there are a few things I'd like to say in confidence.”
等郁四倾吐了心里的愁郁，精神显得振作了些，他才说道：“四哥，我有几句心腹话想说。”

“Ah!”
“噢！”

Yu understood.
郁四懂了他的意思，

“Let's go and sit at my bank.”
“到我钱庄里去坐。”

At Jucheng Bank, with nobody else in Yu's private room, they reclined together on the opium couch and spoke quietly.
到了聚成钱庄，郁四那间密室里没有第三者，两人靠在烟榻上，聚首密谈，

Hu's first question was, “Brother Yu, what exactly happened with A’qi?”
胡雪岩的第一句话是，“四哥，阿七到底是怎么回事？”

Yu gave a long sigh, then paused for some time.
“唉！”郁四长叹一声，又息了好一会才说：

“I don't know where to begin.
“我不晓得从何说起？

This affair...”
这件事……”

He shook his head and sighed again.
他摇摇头，又叹口气。

From his expression and manner, Hu could complete the unfinished sentence: I was wrong.
察言观色、这没有说完的一句话是：这件事我做错了。

Clearly, his question had touched the sore spot.
有此表示，见得胡雪岩的那句话一针见血！

There was no need for further indirect probing.
这就用不着再迂回试探了，

“Brother Yu,” he said plainly, “I'll get A’qi back for you.”
“四哥，”他开门见山地说：“我替你把阿七弄回来！”

Yu raised his head and stared, as though he could not understand and thought Hu must be joking.
一听这话，郁四仰直了头看着胡雪岩，仿佛弄不懂他的意思，当他在说笑话，

But of course he was not.
当然不会是笑话！

Hu never joked about such things.
胡雪岩从不说这些笑话的，

Even if it were a joke, Yu believed he had the means to make it real.
就算是笑话，他也相信胡雪岩有把笑话变成真事的手段。

He needed only to consider his own position.
要考虑的只是自己这方面。


“There would be a great many difficulties...”
“难处也很多……”

“No!” Hu interrupted.
“不！”胡雪岩打断他的话说，

“You needn't concern yourself with those.
“四哥，你不要管这些个。

I know the difficulties you mean.
你说的难处，我都知道，

First, you're afraid A’lan and A’qi won't get on.
第一，怕阿兰姐跟阿七不和，

Second, you're afraid A’qi is still angry and will deliberately make herself difficult to please.
第二，怕阿七心里有气，故意拿跷。

Neither is a problem.
这些都不是难处，

Leave them to me, and I'll arrange everything properly.
包在我身上，安排得妥妥帖帖，

It depends only on you.
只看四哥你自己。

If you're determined to act out Water Spilled Before the Horse and refuse to take her back, there's nothing more to discuss.
如果你一定要唱一出《马前泼水》，那就不必再谈。

Otherwise, leave it all to me.
否则，一切归我来办。

Tell me what you think.”
你倒说一句看！

“With a friend like you, what more can I say?”
““有你这样的好朋友，我还说什么？”

“That's settled, then.
“那就行了，

Your word is all I need.
我就要你这一句话，

Lie here and rest.
你请躺一躺，

I'll have a word with Shilong and come straight back.”
我跟世龙说句话，马上就回来。”

Hu rose from the couch, found Chen, and drew him aside to give him detailed instructions in private.
于是胡雪岩离榻而起，把陈世龙找到，拉至僻处，密密嘱咐了一番，

Only after Chen had left to carry them out did Hu return.
等陈世龙领计而去，他才回到原处。


“Brother Yu, let me say this first.
“四哥，”他说，“我话先说在前面，

If I speak too bluntly about your family affairs, will you be offended?”
谈到你的家务，只怕我言语太直，你会不会动气？”

“What a thing to ask!
“这叫什么话？

With our friendship, even if you reproached me outright, I should listen.”
你我的交情，哪怕你就责备我不是，我也要听你的。”

“Then I'll speak frankly.
“既然如此，我就老实说了，

Everyone says that daughter of yours is extremely formidable.
你那位令嫒，大家都说她厉害得很，

Is it true?”
可有这话？”

“Yes.”
“有的。”

Yu nodded.
郁四点点头，

“I'm on my guard against her myself.”
“我也在防她。”

“It's a miserable thing to have to guard against your own flesh and blood all the time.
“至亲骨肉，时时刻刻要防备，那就苦了。

Let's speak openly.
打开天窗说亮话，

Men die for wealth as birds die for food.
人为财死，鸟为食亡，

Whatever the twists and turns, it's all about money.
为来为去，为两个钱。

I advise you to take this opportunity to divide the estate.
我劝你不如趁此机会分家。

Give your daughter a share too, so that she needn't keep scheming.
女儿也得一份，叫她不必再想东想西，

Wouldn't that settle things neatly?”
岂不爽快吗？”

“Yes, yes.”
“嗯，嗯！”

Yu nodded slowly.
郁四慢慢点头道：

“That is one way.
“这倒也是个办法。

Go on.
你再说，

You must have more to say.”
你总还有话。”

“There are different ways to divide an estate.
“分家也有个分法。”

First I must ask whether you've made any plans yourself.”
胡雪岩说，“我先要问你，你自己总也有过打算？”


“What plans could I have?
“我哪里有什么打算？

When A’hu died, my heart turned to ice.
阿虎一死，我的心冰凉，

I wished I could become a monk.
恨不得出家做和尚！

Whatever they said was good enough for me.
他们怎么说，怎么好，

I'd abandoned everything; they could do as they pleased.
反正我都丢开了，随他们去搞。

But...”
不过，”

Yu paused, visibly moved.
郁四顿了一顿，显得有些激动，

“When Little Monk came and I heard how he was getting on, I began to feel a little happier.
“小和尚一来，听说了他的情形。我心里才高兴了些。

And today you've made time to travel all this way to see me.
今天，你路远迢迢抽出工夫来看我，

It makes me think there are still some good things in this world.
想想这个世界上也还有些好东西。

To tell you the truth, only now am I beginning to find a little pleasure in being alive.”
说句实话，到现在我才稍微有点做人的乐趣。”

These were words from the heart.
这才真的是肺腑之言，

Hu felt comforted and all the more determined to do his utmost.
胡雪岩觉得很安慰，也越觉得要替他尽心，

“Brother Yu, since you think so well of me, I can't avoid taking a hand.
“四哥，”他说，“承蒙你看得起我，我倒不能不多事了，

I might as well go further.
索性变得深些。

We must plan for the whole household.
府上的事，要通盘筹划，

However many difficulties there are, we mustn't shrink from them.
麻烦虽多，不能怕事，

Straighten your back, grit your teeth, and let's untangle everything at once.
挺一挺胸，咬一咬牙，把它一起理清楚了，

Shall we?”
好不好？”

“Yes!” Yu answered eagerly.
“好啊！”郁四很兴奋的回答，

He too had tried to plan for his household, but the more he thought, the worse his head ached.
他自己也盘算过家务，但越想越头痛，

He had never found the courage to sort out that tangled skein.
始终鼓不起勇气来清理这一团乱丝，

Hu's words alone lifted a burden from him, and he already felt much better.
现在听胡雪岩这样说法，先就如释重负，心里好过得多。

“Then let's take things one at a time.
“那么，一样样地谈。

First, what do you intend to do about your post at the yamen?”
我先请问，你衙门里的差使，将来怎么样处置？”


The revenue clerk's post was hereditary.
户书是世袭的差使，

In his hands was a fish-scale register, recording every landowner in the county, the location and acreage of each holding, and the tax assessed on it.
因为手中有一本将全县田地业主、座落、亩数、赋额记载得明明白白的“鱼鳞册”，

This provided an inexhaustible livelihood from generation to generation.
这就是世世代代吃着不穷的衣食饭碗。

Had A’hu lived, he would naturally have succeeded his father.
如果阿虎不死，自然归他承袭父职，

Now Yu had no son.
现在膝下无子，

Even if he later had another, it would take twenty or thirty years to bring the child to manhood.
即令将来有后，要把儿子教养成人，是二三十年后的事。

Such a distant and uncertain prospect could not form the basis of a practical plan.
渺焉无凭，作不得那佯不切实际的打算，

That was why Yu had once considered resigning, an exceedingly rare step.
所以郁四曾经一度想辞差，这是绝少有的事，

Ordinarily, a natural son inherited the post; failing that, the clerk adopted a son.
通常总是有亲子则亲子承袭，否则就收个螟蛉子，

He might even transfer it for a high price, with the successor changing his surname before taking over.
甚至高价顶让，改姓承袭。

Yu no longer meant to resign, but what should he do instead?
此刻当然已不作辞差打算，但究竟应该如何处理？

He could not decide.
郁囚却一时不得主意。

With Hu there, he could not be bothered to rack his brains.
遇见胡雪岩，他就懒得去伤脑筋了，

He simply shook his head.
直截了当地摇摇头：

“I don't know.”
“我不晓得。”

“Very well.
“好，

My second question concerns your daughter-in-law.
我再请问第二件。”胡雪岩说，“你那令媳，

What arrangements do you intend to make for her?”
你又如何替她打算？”


“That is my greatest difficulty!”
“这件事我最为难！”

Yu put down his opium pipe and sat up abruptly.
郁四放下烟枪，矍然而起，

“Think of it: she's only nineteen, and she has no son.
“你想想，今年才十九岁，又没有儿子。

How can she remain a widow?”
怎么守法？”

“What does she want herself?”
“她自己的意思呢？”

“Naturally, she wants to remain faithful to her husband.”
“她当然要守。”

“The longer a widow keeps that vow, the harder it becomes.
“守节是越守越难。

Plenty have held out until their forties and then faltered.
尽有守到四十出头出了毛病的！

Brother Yu, let me speak frankly.
四哥，我说句老实话，

We aren't some great scholarly family.
我们又不是啥书香门第，

We can afford to take a broader view.
不妨看开些，

Besides, earning a chastity arch for a son to be proud of has some point.
再说，为儿子挣座贞节牌坊，还有点意思，

With no son and nothing to look forward to, leave aside whether she could keep the vow: even if she won her arch, what pleasure would it give her?”
没有儿子，没有希望，守不守得住，且不去说它，就算守着了一座贞节牌坊，有啥味道？”

“You put it clearly.
“你说得透彻。

I've made up my mind.
我主意定了，

We'd better persuade her to remarry.
还是劝她嫁的好，

If there's a suitable man, I'll marry her off as my own daughter and give her a good dowry.
有合适的人，我把她当女儿嫁出去，好好陪嫁。

But...”
不过，”

Yu frowned again.
郁四皱眉又说，

“What if she insists on remaining a widow?”
“万一她一定要守，怎么办？”

Naturally, they could only respect her wishes and choose a nephew from the clan for her to adopt as a son.
这当然只好成全她的志向，为她在族中选一个侄儿过继为子，

Yet what would happen afterwards?
然而将来又如何呢？

While Yu lived, there would be no difficulty.
有郁四在自然没有话说，

If he died in three or five years, however, the widow and her fatherless child might well be bullied.
倘或三年五载以后，郁四撒手归西，则孤儿寡妇，难保不受人欺凌。


Hu had already considered these difficulties for him.
这些难处，胡雪岩早就替他想到了，

“With your standing outside the family, Brother Yu, there will be no shortage of people to look after your household when you're gone.
“凭四哥你在外头的面子，百年以后，不怕没有人照应府上。

But even an upright magistrate finds family disputes hard to judge.
不过清官难断家务事，

If your own clansmen cause trouble, outsiders can scarcely intervene.”
你们自己族里要出花样，外人就很难说话了。”

Having identified the heart of the problem, he explained his plan.
胡雪岩先这样把症结点明，然后才替他划策。

If A’hu's widow wished to remain unmarried, there must be someone to look after her after Yu's death: the future head of the household.
胡雪岩的想法，如果阿虎嫂愿意守节，应该有个在郁四身后可以朋料她的人，这个人就是未来的当家。

Yu should find a young, capable man who was, above all, honest and kind, adopt him as a son, and have him take the surname Yu.
郁四得找一个年轻、能干而最要紧的是忠厚的人，收为义子，改姓为郁，

He need not carry on Yu's ancestral line; his role would be to inherit the hereditary post.
不必顶他的香烟，只是继承他的世袭差使。

In return for this favour, he must undertake to care for A’hu's widow and her adopted son, as well as any young children A’qi might bear Yu.
此人受恩所须报答于郁四的，就是将来照应阿虎嫂母子，以及阿七可能为郁四生下的小儿女。

The plan covered everything, and Yu agreed entirely.
这是面面俱到的办法，郁四完全同意。

The difficulty lay in finding someone to whom orphans could be entrusted.
难题是这个可以“托孤”的人，不容易找，

He had able assistants in the revenue office, but some were too old, already with families of their own, and could hardly become another man's adopted son.
在户房中，郁四虽有些得力的帮手，但不是年龄太长，早已生儿育女，不可能做人家的螟蛉，

Others had ability but lacked character.
便是虽有本事，人品不佳，

While Yu lived, they would not dare misbehave; once he died, they would surely be uncontrollable.
有郁四在，不敢出什么花样，郁四一死，必定难制，

To entrust widows and orphans to them would be to put sheep into a tiger's jaws.
托以孤儿寡妇，会变成羊落虎口。

“Nothing is impossible to a determined man.
“世上无难事，只怕有心人，

Fortunately, there's no hurry.
好在这事也不急，

你慢慢留心好了。”

A thunderstorm had turned into a spring breeze.
一场雷雨，化作春风，

Hu felt wonderfully at ease as, smiling faintly, he saw them out.
胡雪岩心里异常舒畅，微微笑着，送他们出门。

In the front shop they came face to face with Huang Yi.
走到店堂，迎面遇着黄仪，

Both he and Hu were surprised and stopped involuntarily.
胡雪岩和他都有意外之感，不由得便站住了脚。

“Mr Huang!”
“黄先生！”

A’qi greeted him with perfect composure, lifting a hand.
阿七泰然无事，扬一扬招呼，

“See you tomorrow.”
“明朝会。”

With a smile back over her shoulder, she went away in triumph.
说着还回眸一笑，洋洋得意的走了。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十七章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Seventeen, concluding part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


During three days in Huzhou, Hu Xueyan accomplished two important things for himself.
湖州之行，三天之内，胡雪岩替自己办了两件要紧事。

First, he secured Huang Yi’s agreement to accompany him to Hangzhou as his secretary.
第一件是约妥了黄仪，随他到杭州去办笔墨。

Huang had changed his mind partly because he wanted to try his fortune elsewhere, and partly because serving an employer like Hu promised to be thoroughly satisfying.
黄仪改变了心意，一则想到外面去闯闯，二则是觉得跟了胡雪岩这样的东家，十分够味，

He also knew that Hu would not treat him poorly, so salary and remuneration were never even discussed.
当然也知道这位东家不会薄待，所以薪水酬劳等等，根本不谈。

Second, Hu strengthened his friendship with Yu Si.
第二件是进一步赢得了郁四的友谊。

Since making peace with A’qi, Yu had lost all his dejection and signs of age.
郁四自从跟阿七言归于好，他的颓唐老态，一扫而空，

He no longer spoke of resigning his post at the yamen and told Hu not to trouble himself further about his family affairs: he could now summon the energy to manage them himself.
不再谈衙门里辞差的话，家务也不劳胡雪岩再费心，表示自己可以打点精神来料理。

As Hu needed working funds, Yu arranged another fifty thousand taels for him to take away, in addition to the sum already transferred.
胡雪岩要头寸周转，除了已经拨付的那一笔以外，另外又调动了五万两银子，让他带走。

“Your business is mine.
“你的事就是我的事。

For a friend like you, even losing my entire fortune would be worthwhile.
为你这样的朋友，倾家荡产也值得。

Besides, I am sure you will find a way.
况且，我相信你一定有办法。”他这样对胡雪岩说：

Whenever you need funds, give me a little notice, and I will have them ready.”
“你要头寸，只要早点告诉我，我一定替你调齐。”

With Yu’s hundred thousand taels and that assurance, Hu’s ambitions soared again.
有了郁四的十万银子和他的那句话，胡雪岩又是雄心万丈了。

His greatest difficulty was liquidity.
他目前最困难的，就是头寸，

Most of his capital was tied up in the silk stored in Shanghai.
在上海堆栈里的丝，搁煞了他的大部分本钱，

Fukang was flourishing and had become one of the most respected names among the leading banks; for that very reason, it could not afford the slightest appearance of financial strain.
阜康钱庄的生意，做得极其热闹，已成“大同行”中的“金字招牌”之一，但唯其如此，决不能露丝毫捉襟见时的窘态，

Meanwhile, the Sea Transport Bureau was changing hands: its deficit must be reduced, not increased.
而海运局方面，正当新旧交替之际，亏空只能补，不能拉。

In this interval before fresh funds became available, Hu had considered selling the silk at a heavy discount.
在这青黄不接的当口，萌雪岩一度想把那批丝，杀价卖掉，

There would still be a profit, but a small one, making all his effort almost unrewarded.
虽仍有盈余，但已有限，费心费力的结果，变成几乎白忙一场，

He could not reconcile himself to that, nor did he wish to abandon the opportunity.
自是于心不甘，同时也不肯错过这个机会。

Caught between these difficulties, he found Yu’s help invaluable.
左右为难之下，有郁四的这一臂之力，帮忙帮得大了。


“Brother Yu,” he said excitedly, “if you trust me, I guarantee that the return on this money will be better than you could obtain from lending it to anyone else.
“四哥！”他兴奋地说，“只要你相信我，我包你这笔款子的利息，比放给哪个都来得划算。

I have made up my mind to commit these hundred thousand taels to the foreign trade too.
我已经看准了，这十万银子，我还要‘扑’到洋庄上去。

A few days ago in Hangzhou, I learned that Governor-General Yiliang intends to take a hard line with the foreigners.
前两天我在杭州得到消息，两江总督怡大人，要对洋人不客气了，

It is a rare opportunity, and whoever seizes it will make a fortune.
这是个难得的机会，一抓住必发大财。

When an opportunity comes, others do not know of it, but I do; others cannot judge it clearly, but I can.
不过，机会来了，别人不晓得，我晓得，别人看不准，我看得准。

That is why they cannot match me in business.”
这就是人家做生意，做不过我的地方。

What opportunity did he mean?
“说了半天是什么机会呢？

Yu knew who Yiliang was: the father-in-law of the influential Prince Gong, and therefore a relative of the imperial house.
两江总督怡良，郁四倒是晓得的，他是当权的恭亲王的老丈人，也算是皇亲国戚，

If he undertook any major action, the court would certainly support him.
如果有什么大举措，朝廷一定会支持他，

But what did taking a hard line with the foreigners mean?
然而对洋人是如何不客气？

“Surely,” Yu asked hesitantly, “we are not going to war with them again?”
“莫非，”他迟疑地问，“又要跟洋人开仗？”

“No, not that.” Hu explained that, according to his information, Yiliang was deeply displeased with the foreigners for two reasons.
“那是不会的……”胡雪岩说，他听到的消息是，因为两件事，两江总督怡良对洋人深为不满，

First, foreigners were sending arms and provisions from the settlement to Liu Lichuan of the Small Swords Society.
第一，小刀会的刘丽川，有洋人自租界接济军火粮食，

This was supporting rebellion instead of lawful authority.
这是“助逆”而不是“助顺”，

The court would scarcely tolerate it even if the supplies did Liu little practical good; in fact, they were a considerable help.
就算实际上对刘丽川没有什么帮助，朝廷亦难容忍，而况对刘丽川确为一大助力。

Second, since Shanghai had fallen, the foreigners had refused to pay the so-called foreign tax, the customs duty levied at five percent of value. They claimed that the disturbances had brought commerce to a halt.
第二是从上海失守以后，“夷税”也就是按值百抽五计算的关税，洋人借口虞乱影响，商务停顿，至今不肯缴纳。

Trade was inevitably affected, but to say it had stopped entirely was deception.
商务受影响自是难免，如说完全停顿，则是欺人之谈。

Payment of customs duties by foreign merchants depended on their consuls enforcing the obligation.
洋商缴纳关税，全靠各国领事代为约束，

If they deliberately refused, what could be done?
现在有意不缴，无奈其何！

There was only one answer: cease trading with them.
那就只有一个办法：不跟洋人做生意。


“The authorities cannot control affairs inside the settlement.
“租界上的事，官府管不到，

And even if we say we will stop trading with foreign merchants, are we to throw all our export goods into the Huangpu River?
再说不跟洋商做生意，难道把销洋庄的货色，抛到黄浦江里？

Obviously not.
这自然是办不到的，

So there is only one practicable step left, and it is a powerful one: prohibit silk and tea from the interior from entering the settlement.
所以，再退一步说，只有一个办法，这个办法也很厉害，内地的丝茶两项，不准运入租界。

That is something the authorities can enforce.”
这是官府办得到的事。”

“I see!” Yu nodded. “Your original plan again.
“我懂了！还是你原来的办法，”郁四点点头说，

The price of silk and tea already held there would certainly soar.
“那样子一来，丝茶两项存货的行情，一定大涨。

A fine idea!”
这倒是好主意！”

“A fine business, certainly.
“自然是好生意。”胡雪岩说，

I already have silk, and this is not the season to buy more.
“丝我有了，而且现在也不是时候，收不到货，

But there is plenty to be done with tea.
茶叶上面，大有脑筋可动，

Officials move slowly.
官府做事慢，

Before the proclamation appears, I still have time to acquire stock.
趁告示没有出来以前，我还来得及办货。

Besides, I want to open a pawnshop and a pharmacy, and establish a Shanghai branch of Fukang.”
此外，我还想开一爿当铺，开一家药店，阜康也想在上海设分号……”

“Old Hu,” Yu interrupted, “I want to say something you may not like.
“老胡，”郁四打断他的话，“我说一句，怕不中听，

But let me make it clear first: I have no ulterior motive.
不过我声明在先，决不是我有啥别的心思，

It is only a reminder.
无非提醒你，

You will still conduct the business, and whatever you decide will be done.”
事情还是你去做，你说怎么办就怎么办。”

“With our friendship, Brother Yu, such an explanation is unnecessary.”
“四哥，我们的交情，你这番表白是多余的。”

Unnecessary though it was, it had to be made.
话虽多余，不能不先交代，

This was one of the formal observances of the brotherhood world.
这就是江湖上的“过节”，

Indeed, what Yu went on to say was almost unnecessary too.
其实就是郁四以下要说的话，也近乎多余，

However capable a man might be, his energy was limited.
他劝胡雪岩说，一个人本事再大，精力有限，

With too many undertakings, something would escape his attention.
头绪太多，必有照顾不到的地方。

Moreover, Hu’s businesses were interconnected: pull one thread and the whole fabric moved.
而且他的生意，互相关联，牵一发而动全身，

A collapse could become irretrievable.
一垮下来，不可收拾。

Better to restrain himself for the present and advance steadily.
不如暂时收敛，稳扎稳打。

The earnest advice showed Yu’s concern.
这番话语重心长，见得郁四的关切，

But how could Hu be unaware of these dangers?
但胡雪岩自己何尝不知道？

He understood the interests involved far better than Yu did.
其间的利害关系，他远比郁四了解得更透彻，

He believed he could manage them and had carefully planned emergency measures for trouble in each quarter.
不过他自己足以应付得了，哪一处出了毛病，该如何急救？也曾细细策划过，

Confident of his resources, he intended to follow his own course.
有恃无恐，所以我行我素。

Yet when a friend whose fortunes were bound to his offered such advice, he ought not argue even if he could not follow it.
只是郁四说到这样的话，休戚相关，虽不能听，亦不宜辩，

He therefore nodded repeatedly, as though accepting it.
因而不断点头，表示接受。


Acceptance could not be reduced to an empty assurance.
接受不是一句空话可以敷衍的，

Yu had invested a large amount with him, and Hu had to consider his interests.
而郁四有大批本钱投在自己名下，也得替他顾虑。

Hu’s thoughts were always wide-ranging and thorough.
胡雪岩的思考向来宽阔而周密，

Was there something behind Yu’s advice?
心里在想郁四的话，可有言外之意？

He must find out.
却是不能不问清楚的。

“Brother Yu, what you say is entirely sound.
“四哥，你的话十分实在。

I have decided to put the pawnshop and pharmacy aside for now.
当铺、药店，我决定死了心，暂且丢下。

But there is something I must ask, and you must answer frankly.”
不过，我要请问一句，四哥一定要跟我说实话。”

“That remark is unnecessary too.
“你这话也是多余的。”郁四答道，

When have I ever lied to you?”
“我几时跟你说过假话？”

“Of course, of course.
“是的，是的，

I know.” Hu nodded repeatedly.
我晓得。”胡雪岩连连点头，

“But I may have overlooked something and need your guidance.
“不过，我怕我或者有啥看不列的地方，要请四哥指点。

Do you think we should sell our Shanghai silk now?”
你看，我们在上海的那批丝，是不是现在脱手比较好？

“Ah!” Yu’s expression and voice showed deep regret.
““嗐！”郁四的神色和声音，大似遗憾，

“You have completely misunderstood me.
“你完全弄错我的意思了！

You think I am worried about the capital I have entrusted to you.
你当我不放心我投在你那里的本钱，

Not at all!
决不是！

I have told you before: I trust you.
我早就说过了，我相信你，

You conduct the business; I do not interfere.”
生意你去做，我不过问。”


“You trust me, Brother Yu, but if the result is a foul mess, how could I answer to you?”
“四哥是相信我，结果弄得‘鸭屎臭’，叫我怎么对四哥交代？”

“You needn’t answer for it!
“不要交代！要啥交代？

Business has losses as well as gains.
做生意有亏有蚀，

There is nothing to complain of.
没话可说！

The only foul men are those who call you one of their own and then swallow all the profit themselves.
只有‘开口自己人，独吃自己人’的才是‘鸭屎臭’，

You are not such a man.
你不是那种人。

I’ll say more: even if you deliberately took advantage of me, I would accept it.
再说一句，就算你要存心吃我，我也情愿，

I am not saying this only now.
这话不是我现在说，

Ask A’qi.” He called repeatedly, “A’qi!
你问阿七。”说着便连声喊着：“阿七，

A’qi!
阿七！

Boss Hu has something to ask you.”
胡老板有话问你。”

A’qi was extremely busy preparing local gifts for Hu to take away, but at the mention of his request she came out.
阿七在打点送胡雪岩的土仪，正忙得不可开支，但听说是胡雪岩有话问，还是抽出身子来了。

“What did I tell you last night about the silk in Shanghai?” Yu asked.
“我昨天晚上跟你谈到上海的那批丝，我是怎么跟你说的？”郁四问。

“You said you treated the capital in it as money lost at gambling.
“你说，那批丝上的本钱，你只当赌铜钿输掉了。

If it made a profit, you would not call for a settlement; if it made a loss, you would still sleep soundly.”
赚了，你不结帐，蚀了，你也睡得着觉。”

Hu felt both grateful and uneasy.
听这样一说，胡雪岩既感激，又不安，

Yu almost seemed to intend the capital as a gift, which Hu could not accept with an easy conscience.
听郁四的口气，大有把那笔本钱奉送之意，这无论如何是受之有愧的。

But there was no need to protest at once.
但此时无需急着表白，

Friendship was not measured in a single day.
朋友相交不在一日，

If that was indeed Yu’s intention, Hu would make a special effort and give him a great surprise in the future.
郁四果有此心，自己倒要争个面子，将来叫他大大地出个意外。

“Brother Yu, that gives me courage,” he said.
于是他说：“四哥你这样说，我的胆就大了。

“It is rare to find a friend who understands one.
人生难得遇着知己，

If I don’t venture out while I have the chance, I shall scarcely be doing myself justice.”
趁这时候我不好好去闯一闯，也太对不起自己了。”


At that moment Hu had a new idea.
在这一刻，胡雪岩又有了新的主意，

Once the silk was sold, he would use Yu’s rightful share to buy land for him in the Shanghai settlement.
但决定等那批丝脱手以后，把郁四名下应得的一份，替他在上海买租界上的地皮。

The thought came suddenly, but it bore examination.
这是一个突如其来的念头，细细想去，

First, the settlement was protected from bombardment.
第一，不受炮火的影响，

More and more people would flee there from troubled districts, and its commerce would flourish.
各地逃难到上海租界的人，一定会越来越多，市面当然要兴旺，

Second, the court might dislike foreigners, but having signed commercial treaties, it could not prevent them from coming.
第二，朝廷对洋人不欢迎，但既然订了商约，洋人要来，不欢迎也办不到。

Of the five treaty ports, Shanghai was the busiest.
“五口通商”只有上海这个码头最热闹，

Once Hong and Yang were defeated, refugees would return home together, but businessmen would remain.
一旦洪杨战败，逃难的人会相携还乡，但做生意的人，是不会走的。

Buying cheap, unproductive reed beds and vacant land in the settlement now would therefore bring a great fortune later.
所以，趁现在把上海租界里那些无甚入息，地价便宜的苇塘空地买下来，将来一定会大发其财。

That, however, lay five or ten years ahead.
不过，这是五年、十年以后，

A man with idle money could buy land and leave it.
如果有闲钱无甚用处，不妨买了摆在那里，

A man like Hu, urgently needing working funds, ought not to consider it for himself.
象自己现在这样，急需头寸周转，就不必去打这个主意。

“Old Hu,” Yu asked, noticing his silence, “what are you thinking about?”
“老胡！”郁四见他沉吟不语，便即问道：“你在想啥？”

“Business again.”
“还不是动生意上的脑筋。”

Then Hu remembered Yu’s warning.
说了这一句，胡雪岩才想起郁四劝他的话，

He should not propose another venture now.
自然不宜再出花样，

Waving his hand, he added, “Never mind.
因而自己摇着手说：“不谈，不谈。

It is only a fancy.”
是空想！”

“Stop thinking so much.
“不要去多想了！

Let’s have a drink and talk of something amusing.”
我们吃酒，谈点有趣的事。”


There was plenty to amuse them.
趣事甚多，

Hu told the story of the Seventh Lady’s visit to a courtesan house, and A’qi listened spellbound.
胡雪岩讲了七姑奶奶逛堂子的笑话，把阿七听得出了神。

Yu too found it remarkable and said he would like to meet such an extraordinary woman.
郁四也觉得新奇，表示很想会一会这样一个“奇女子”。

“Easily arranged,” Hu replied.
“那容易得很！”胡雪岩说，

“If you can find the time, I’ll go with you.
“只要你抽得出空，我陪你走一遭，

Both Brother You and his sister would certainly take to you.”
尤家兄妹一定也会觉得你很对劲。”

“Indeed,” A’qi urged Yu, “you ought to go out and see something of the world.
“真的，”阿七接口向郁四说，“你也该到外头走走，见见世面。

At your age, why not take things easily, enjoy good food and drink, and travel about?
年纪一大把，乐得看开些，吃吃喝喝，四处八方去逛逛，

Let me broaden my horizons too.”
让我也开开眼界。”

This tempted Yu.
这番怂恿把郁四说动了心，

He had never traveled beyond his home district.
平生足迹不出里门，

All he knew of the colorful world outside came from other people’s stories, which was a real regret.
外面是怎么样的一个花花世界，只听人说，未曾目睹，到底是桩憾事，

Traveling with A’qi and meeting friends from the brotherhood would be a great pleasure in his later years.
如果能带着阿七去走一走，会一会江湖上的朋友，也是暮年一大乐事。

But how could he free himself?
只是怎么能抽得出身。

He thought again of finding a replacement for his work at the yamen.
因此，他又想到衙门里的差使，要找个替手这件大事，

“Old Hu,” he asked without hesitation, “did you ask Little Monk about taking the post I mentioned last time?”
“老胡，”他毫不考虑地问了出来，“上次我跟你谈过的，想叫小和尚来当差，你可曾问过他？”

“Not yet.”
“还不曾问。”

Hu thought Chen would probably be unwilling.
胡雪岩心想，陈世龙大概不会愿意，

Moreover, with A’qi there, it would be unwise for Chen to become too closely involved with the Yu household.
而且有阿七在，陈世龙也实在不宜过分接近郁家，

Hu’s own affairs would also make it hard to spare him.
再为自己打算，也难放手，

He therefore added, “I think there is no need to ask.
所以索性再加一句：“我想不问也罢。

I am almost certain he would refuse.”
我看他十之八九不肯！”

“Then let it drop,” Yu said disconsolately.
“那就算了。”郁四偶惘地说，

“I’ll look for someone else.”
“我另外物色。”


A’qi listened closely to this exchange.
这两句对答，使得阿七深为注意，

In the past, she would immediately have asked questions whenever Chen was mentioned.
在过去，如果谈到陈世龙，她立刻会插嘴来问，

But since their two private meetings, when she had poured out her feelings, she had developed a guilty conscience and took care to avoid suspicion in Yu’s presence.
但自从有了那两番私晤，倾诉心曲的经历，变得“做贼心虚”，在郁四面前，处处要避嫌疑，

She dared not join in then.
所以当时不敢搭腔，

Only later did she find an opportunity to ask Hu privately what it was about.
过后才找个机会，悄悄问胡雪岩是怎么回事？

Hu had wanted just such a chance to question her.
胡雪岩也正要这样一个单独相处的机会，好问她一个明白，

After explaining, he went straight on: “Sister-in-Law Yu, there is something I do not know whether I may ask.
因而说明其事以后，紧接着便是这样一句：“郁四嫂，我有句话，不晓得能不能问？

If I ask, I fear you will be displeased; if I don’t, I cannot feel at ease.
问了伯你不高兴，不问，我心里总不安稳。

I really do not know what to do.”
真正不知道该怎么办？”

A’qi was intelligent and candid.
阿七是很聪明、也很爽荡的人，

Blushing slightly, she said, “I know what you want to ask.
微微红着脸说：“我晓得你要问的是啥？

I was wrong about that.
那件事我做错了。

But at the time I did not know it was wrong.”
不过当时并不晓得做错。

“What do you mean?”
““这话怎么说？”

Hu found this interesting.
胡雪岩觉得她的话，很有意味，

“Did you realize you were wrong only after making peace with Brother Yu?”
“是你跟郁四哥讲和以后，才晓得自己错了？”

“Yes.” She gave a shy, charming smile.
“是的！”阿七羞涩地一笑，别具妩媚之姿，

“When I think it over, the old man is best after all.
“想想还是老头子好，

He gives way to me in everything.
样样依我，

With someone else, I would have to give way to him in everything, and I could never do that.”
换了别人，要我样样依他，这在我，也是办不到的。”


Given her temperament and background, Hu felt that another question would not be too presumptuous.
胡雪岩觉得以她的脾气和出身，还有句话提出来也不算太唐突，

“Then what were you thinking before you went to see Shilong?”
所以接着又问：“那么你去看世龙之前，是怎么个想法？”

A’qi grew tense.
一听这话，阿七有些紧张：

“Did Little Monk tell you everything I said?”
“小和尚把我的话，都告诉你了？”

Now Hu had to consider.
这下胡雪岩倒要考虑了，

Her expression showed that she did not want a third person to know her secret.
看阿七的神气，是不愿意让第三者晓得她的秘密，

To spare her feelings, he could deny it.
如果为了叫她心里好过，大可否认。

But then he would never discover exactly what she felt for Chen.
只是这一来，就不会了解她对陈世龙到底是怎么一种感情？

After reflecting, he decided to tell the truth.
想一想，还是要说实话。

He nodded and said clearly, “Everything, from beginning to end.”
于是他点一点头，清清楚楚地答道：“源源本本地告诉我了。”

She was deeply embarrassed.
阿七大为忸怩，

“The wretch!” she complained.
“这个死东西！”她不满地骂，

“I was only teasing him, and he took it seriously.
“跟他闹着玩的，他竟当真的了！

How shameless!”
真不要脸！”

It was an excuse.
这是掩饰之词，

Determined to get to the bottom of it, Hu pressed her again.
胡雪岩打破沙锅问到底，又刺她一句：

“Even if you were teasing, you went very far—actually calling on him!
“你说闹着玩，也闹得太厉害了，居然还寻上门去，

If A’zhu had found out and become jealous, wouldn’t you have done harm?”
如果让阿珠晓得了，吃起醋来，你岂不是造孽？”

“Then he would have been partly to blame himself.” A’qi would not admit fault.
“那也要怪他自己不好。”阿七不肯承认自己的错处，

“Whatever else, there was still a bond between us.
“无论如何香火之情总有的。

At that time I was anxious all day and could not settle down.
那时候我心里一天到晚发慌，静不下来，

All I wanted was someone to talk to.
只望有个人陪我谈谈。

He wouldn’t grant me even that.
他连这一点都不肯，

I was angry, so I deliberately bothered him to make his life uncomfortable too.”
我气不过，特为跟他罗嗦，叫他的日子也不好过！

She smiled with satisfaction.
“说着，她得意地笑了。

Hu judged her account about seven-tenths credible.
这翻话照胡雪岩的判断，有十分之七可靠，

The doubtful part was her continued refusal to admit having felt an attraction to Chen.
不可靠的是她始终不承认对陈世龙动过心！

But circumstances had changed; there was no need to pursue the past.
然而事过境迁可以不去管它，

They need only discuss the future.
只谈以后好了。

“What about now?” he asked.
“以后呢？”他问，

“How do you regard Shilong?”
“你怎么样看待陈世龙？”

“What is there to regard?” she answered frankly.
“有啥怎么样？”阿七说得很坦率，

“I have settled my heart on the old man, and Shilong is going to marry.
“我死心塌地跟了老头子，他也要讨亲了，

What more is there to say?”
还有啥话说？”

Hu had nothing further to ask.
于是胡雪岩也没话说了，

His expression relaxed; he could be at ease.
神色轻松，大可放心。


“Boss Hu,” A’qi said, posing a difficult question in return, “how could you let a girl like the Zhang family’s A’zhu go?”
“胡老板，”阿七出了难题给他来回答，“张家阿珠这样的人品，你怎么舍得放手？”

Hu considered. “If I explain, you won’t believe me.
“这话，”胡雪岩想了想答道，“说来你不会相信，

You will think I am a quack selling his remedies and boasting.
只当我卖膏药、说大话。

But I know for myself that I am as pleased with arranging that affair as I am with persuading Brother Yu to bring you back.”
不过我自己晓得，我做这件事就象我劝郁四哥把你接回来一样，是蛮得意的。

“What is there to be pleased about?” she asked, deliberately retaliating.
““得意点啥？”阿七有意报复，

“A flower just coming into bloom, and Little Monk gets the benefit.
“刚开的一朵鲜花，便宜了小和尚。

Aren’t you sorry?”
你倒不懊悔！”

“If I have any regrets,” Hu replied, teasing in turn, “it is that I persuaded Brother Yu to take you back.
“要说懊悔，”胡雪岩也有意跟她开玩笑，“我懊悔不该劝郁四哥把你接回来，

I ought to have tried for you myself.
我自己要了你好了，

At worst I would have been rebuffed like Huang Yi.” A’qi laughed.
大不了象黄仪一样，至多讨一场没趣。”阿七笑了，

“Of all the examples you might follow, you choose his!”
“好样不学，学他！”

Then she grew serious.
接着，神色一正，

“Boss Hu, let me ask you a proper question.”
“胡老板，我规规矩矩问你一句话。”

“Very well.
“好！

I shall listen properly.”
我规规矩矩听。”

“Is your wife fierce?”
“你太太凶不凶？”

“Why do you ask?” Hu laughed.
“你问她作啥？”胡雪岩笑道：

“Are you going to find me a match?”
“是不是要替我做媒？”

“Exactly.
“对！

Why else would I ask?”
不然何必问？”


“Then tell me about her.
“那么，你打说来听听，

What sort of person is she?”
是怎么样一个人？”

“Ten times better than I am, though her life has been harder.
“人是比我胜过十倍，不过命也比我苦。”阿七说道，

She is a young widow.”
“是个小孤孀。”

A’qi went on to praise the widow’s beauty and character.
接着，阿七便夸赞这个“小孤孀”的品貌，

Hu began to feel interested and asked cautiously, “What is her family situation?
胡雪岩被她说得心思有些活动了，试探着问道：“她家里怎么样？

If she chooses to remarry instead of remaining a widow, both her husband’s family and her own must agree.
守不住改嫁，夫家娘家都要答应，

There could be a great deal of trouble.”
麻烦很多。”

“Some trouble, but nothing that cannot be managed.
“麻烦是有一点，不过也没有料理不好的。”阿七说道，

There is no one in her husband’s family.
“她夫家没有人。

On her own side, there is a worthless uncle and a younger brother.
倒是娘家，有个不成材的叔叔，还有个小兄弟，

Whoever marries her must take the boy into the household too.”
如果娶了她，这个小兄弟要带在身边。”

“That would not matter.”
“那倒也无所谓。”

Hu pondered in silence.
胡雪岩沉吟着，好半天不作声。

“Boss Hu,” she urged, “you often come to Huzhou.
“胡老板，”阿七怂恿着说，“你湖州也常要来的，

Having a household here would make everything convenient.
有个门口在这里，一切方便，

And she really is both beautiful and good.
而且，说人品真正是又漂亮、又贤惠！

Would you like to see her?”
要不要看看？”

“Certainly.
“那好啊！

How would we arrange it?
怎么个看法，

Surely not by having a matchmaker bring her round?”
总不是媒婆领了来吧？”

“Of course we cannot be so blunt.”
“当然不能这么青。”

A’qi thought for a moment. “Tomorrow morning I’ll invite her to burn incense at Tiansheng Temple by the North Gate.
阿七想了想说，“这样吧，明天一早我邀她到北门天圣寺烧香，

Wait there.
你在那里等，

When you see me, pretend not to know me and don’t greet me.
见了装作不认识我，不要打招呼。

I won’t tell her the purpose either.
我也不跟她说破，

With no reason for self-consciousness, you will be able to see her as she is.”
这样子没有顾忌，你就看得清楚了。”

“Very well.
“也好！

Let us do that.”
准定这么办。”


The next day Hu took Chen Shilong with him to Tiansheng Temple.
到了第二天，胡雪岩找陈世龙陪着，到了北门天圣寺，

He first burned incense, then drew a fortune slip.
先烧香，后求签，

It bore a poem: “Evening clouds for a thousand li blur the peaks of Wu; through falling leaves, a distant temple bell is faintly heard.
签上是这样一首诗：暮云千里乱吴峰，落叶微闻远寺钟；

Beyond the autumn grass, the gaze follows the Yangtze as far as sight can reach; where does the beauty gather lotus blooms?”
目尽长江秋草外，美人何处采芙蓉？

Hu did not understand the verse.
胡雪岩看不懂这首诗，

He saw only that the fortune was rated middling, and its explanation seemed no more illuminating.
只看签是“中平”，解释也不见得高明，

He dismissed it with a smile and strolled around the temple with Chen.
便一笑置之，跟阵世龙寺前寺后，闲步随喜。

Chen was puzzled.
陈世龙却有些奇怪，

Hu had said that he wanted to visit Tiansheng Temple but had given no reason.
只听胡雪岩说要到天圣寺走走，未说是何用意？

Why had such a busy man suddenly developed a taste for ancient temples?
他这样的一个大忙人，力何忽发雅兴，来游古刹。

At first Chen thought that, since Hu had not explained, he need not ask; once they arrived, the purpose would become clear.
先是心里打算，他既不说，自己也不必问，但等到了天圣寺，自然明白，

Now, seeing no sign of it, he could not help inquiring.
这时看不出名堂，就忍不住要问了。

“Mr Hu, are you waiting for someone, or…”
“胡先生，你是不是等什么人？还是……”

“Exactly.
“对！

I am waiting for someone.
我正是等人。

I may as well tell you.” When Hu explained, Chen laughed.
跟你说了吧！”一说经过，陈世龙笑道：

“Ah, I understand!
“幄。我晓得了！”他说，

It must be the young widow from the He family.
“一定是何家的那个小孤孀，

A’qi has a good eye.
不错！阿七的眼光不错，

Whether the match can be made is another question.”
不过，这个媒做得成，做不成，就很难说了。”

Hu was rather surprised. “So you know about her too.
“原来你也晓得。”胡雪岩颇有意外之感，

Come, let us sit over there.”
“来，我们到那里坐一坐。”


They sat at a refreshment stall by the temple gate and talked over bowls of sweet rice dumplings.
两人在庙门口一家点心摊子上坐了下来，一面吃汤圆，一面谈何家的小孤孀。

According to Chen, the widow was celebrated for her beauty.
据陈世龙说，此人颇有艳名，

Many men had been interested since her husband’s death.
自从居孀以后，很有些人打她的主意，

His family was reasonably accommodating, but her father’s brother was extremely difficult.
但夫家还好说话，娘家有个胞叔，十分难，

That was why no match had yet succeeded.
所以好事一直不谐。

“He can only want a little more money,” Hu said.
“无非是多要几两银子。”胡雪岩问，

“What is difficult about that?”
“有什么难的？”

“Every indulgence—women, gambling, fine food and clothes—he enjoys them all.
“那家伙嫖赌吃着，一应俱全，

Anyone who becomes his relative will have him at the door every few days making trouble.
哪个跟他做了亲戚，三天两头上门来罗嗦，

It would be intolerable.”
就吃不消了。”

“There is no need to fear him.
“这倒不必怕他。”胡雪岩又问，

What was her maiden surname?”
“她娘家姓啥？”

“Liu.
“娘家姓刘。

Her uncle is Liu Sancai.
他叔叔叫刘三才，

People change a character of his name and call him Liu Bucai—Liu the Good-for-Nothing.
人家把他的名字改了一个字，叫做刘不才。

That tells you what he is like.”
由这上头，胡先生就可以晓得他的为人了。”

“Surely he is useful in some way?”
“总有点用处吧！”

“In some ways, yes.
“用处是有点的。

But nobody dares employ him.
不过没有人敢用他。

He is too slippery and unreliable.”
这个人太滑、太靠不住。”

“Never mind that.
“不管它！

Tell me what he is good at.”
你倒说来我听听，刘不才有何用处？”

“He is an eloquent talker, thoroughly versed in every romantic and fashionable amusement—the very material for a rich man’s hanger-on.” Chen added a warning.
“他能说会道，风花雪月，无不精通，是做篾片的好材料。”陈世龙接着又用警告的语气说，

“Only never let money pass through his hands.
“就是银钱不能经他的手。

To put it as a joke, if his father died and he were given money for the coffin, he would spend it on himself first.” Hu laughed incredulously. “Can anyone be like that?”
说句笑话，他老子死了，如果买棺材的钱经他的手，他都会先用了再说。”胡雪岩笑了，“有这样的人？”是不甚相信的语气。

“He is exactly like that.
“就有这样的人！”陈世尤特为举证：

I often met him in gambling houses and saw plenty of such behavior.”
“我跟他在赌场里常常碰头，诸如此类的事，见得多了。”


Hu nodded, put Chen’s words aside and pursued his own thoughts.
胡雪岩点点头，抛开陈世龙的话，管自己转念头。

A hanger-on had his uses.
他心里在想，篾片有篾片的用处，

Among officials, such a companion was called a cultivated guest; among wealthy young idlers, he was a miepian, a strip of bamboo.
帮闲的人，官场中叫清客，遇着纨袴子弟便叫篾片，

Just as a basket’s framework could not hold together without bamboo strips, a grand social establishment needed such men.
好似竹篓子一样，没有竹筐片，就拧不起空架子。

Hu too could use a few to help with entertaining and social obligations.
自己也要几个篾片，帮着交际应酬。

If Liu Bucai was not bad at heart, merely prone to making a mess of things, it might be worth finding a way to win him over as an assistant.
如果刘不才本心还不坏，只是好拆烂污，倒不妨动动脑筋，收服了他做个帮手。

“Here they are!” Chen suddenly tugged at Hu’s clothes and spoke softly.
“来了，来了！”陈世龙突然拉着他的衣服，轻轻说道。

Hu collected himself and looked up.
胡雪岩定定神，抬头望去，

At once he felt something unusual.
这一望，心里立刻便是异样的味道。

The young widow was a dark-complexioned beauty.
何家的小寡妇是个“黑里俏”，

Apart from her complexion, he could find nothing to criticize.
除了皮肤以外，无可批评。

Her waist was extremely slender, and as she walked she swayed like a willow in the breeze.
腰肢极细，走几步路，如凤摆杨柳，

Yet there was none of the calculated display of a courtesan; her grace was natural.
却又不象风尘中人的有意做作，而是天然袅娜。

Alighting from her chair, she rested a hand on a maid of eleven or twelve and walked past the stall.
她下了轿子，扶着个十一二岁的小丫头。一步一步的走过点心摊子。

Hu’s face followed her until his back was turned to Chen.
胡雪岩的脸便随着她转，一直转到背脊朝陈世尤为止。

Chen had already paid.
陈世龙已会过了帐，

He gave Hu a quiet tug, and they followed the women through the temple gate.
悄悄的拉了他一把，两个人跟着又进了山门。

A’qi had noticed them long before.
阿七是早就看到了他们的，

Now she dropped back a step, turned slightly and made a small warning gesture with her hand.
此时落后一步，微微转近身来摇一摇手。


“What does she mean?” Hu asked.
“她什么意思？”胡雪岩问。

“Probably that we should not follow too closely.”
“大概是关照不是靠得太近。”

Hu stopped and stared after the widow.
听这一说，胡雪岩便站住了脚，尽自盯着她的背影看。

She wore black from head to foot, with a soft white mourning flower in her hair that stood out strikingly.
从头到脚，一身玄色，头上簪一朵穿孝的白绒花，显得格外触目。

“What do you think, Mr Hu?” Chen asked softly.
“胡先生，”陈世龙轻声问道：“怎么样？”

“Only that her complexion is a little dark.”
“就是皮肤黑一点。”

“She is famous as Black Lotus.”
“有名的‘黑芙蓉’嘛！”陈世龙说。

“Why Black Lotus?
“怎么叫黑芙蓉？

I have only heard of Black Peony.”
只听说过黑牡丹。”

“Her name is Furong—Lotus.”
“她的名字就叫芙蓉。”

“Furong!” Hu tilted his head and frowned.
“芙蓉！”胡雪岩偏着头，皱着眉想，

“Where have I heard that name?” He repeated it, thinking hard, until at last he remembered.
“好象什么地方听说过个名字？”就这样不断念着“芙蓉、芙蓉”，皱眉苦思，到底起起来了。

“Here!” He showed Chen the fortune slip.
“原来在这里！”他把刚才求的那张签，拿给陈世龙看。

“What a coincidence!” Chen laughed with interest.
“巧了！”陈世龙极感兴趣的笑着，

“It looks like a marriage destined in a former life.”
“看起来是前世注定的姻缘。”

“Not necessarily.
“不见得！

‘Where does the beauty gather lotus blooms?’ means that the lotus cannot be gathered.”
‘美人何处采芙蓉’，是采不到的意思。”

Hu shook his head in disappointment.
胡雪岩摇摇头，大为快怏之意。

Chen had never seen him so anxious about gaining or losing something, almost dejected, and was secretly amused.
陈世龙从未见过他有这样患得患失、近乎沮丧的神情，心里有些好笑。

Then he reflected that Hu had plainly fallen in love at first sight.
但随即想到，胡雪岩对芙蓉，可说是一见钟情，

Whatever happened, he must help gather this lotus for Hu.
无论如何得把她“采”来供养，

That would be a way to repay his kindness.
才是报答之道。


“Let us go farther in and have another look,” Hu said.
“再进去看看！”胡雪岩说。

“You had better go alone, Mr Hu.
“胡先生，你一个人去好了，

She knows me a little, and meeting her might be awkward.
她有点认识我的，见面不大方便，

I should keep out of the way.”
我先避开为妙。”

Once Chen left, Hu stood beside the great incense burner, as tall as a man, in front of the main hall.
等陈世龙一走，胡雪岩一个在大殿前面那只高可及人的大香炉旁边，

His thoughts rose and fell.
七上八下想心里，

He wanted to go inside for a closer look, yet feared that disregarding A’qi’s warning would spoil the affair.
又想闯进殿去细看一看，又怕不依阿七的暗示，会把好事搞坏，

He could not make up his mind.
左思右想只是打不定主意，

It seemed ridiculous even to him: in transactions involving tens of thousands of taels, he decided instantly and felt no regret.
自己都觉得有些好笑，几万银子上落的生意，都是当机立断，毫无悔尤，

Yet such a small matter left him at a loss.
偏偏这么点事会大为作难！

Time slipped away until A’qi and Furong emerged from the hall.
辰光就这样空耗着，耗到阿七和芙蓉出殿，

He could not remain inactive.
他不能再没行动了，

“Bah!” he said to himself in annoyance.
“嗐！”他自己对自己不满，

What was so important?
这有什么大不了的！

Whether it succeeded or failed, why take it so seriously?
成也罢，不成也罢，何必看得那样认真？

The thought swept away his hesitation and timidity.
这一转念，犹豫和怯意一扫而空，

It also sent A’qi’s agreement and warning clean out of his mind.
同时也把阿七的约定和暗示，都抛到九霄云外，

With an easy, confident step he went forward and called clearly, “Sister-in-Law Yu!”
踏着从容潇洒的步子迎了上去，清清朗朗地喊一声：“郁四嫂！”


Since he had called, A’qi had to answer.
既然叫出来了，阿七不能不理，

She assumed an expression of mild surprise and pleasure. “Ah, Boss Hu!
装出略如惊喜的神态说道：“啊，胡老板，是你！

How do you find the time?
怎么有空？

Have you come to burn incense, or what?”
来烧香，还是啥？”

“I happened to be passing and came in for a stroll.”
“偶然路过，进来逛一逛。”

As he spoke, Hu studied Furong.
胡雪岩一面说，一面打量芙蓉。

Her eyes were lively yet composed.
她那双眼睛很活，但也很静，

On first seeing him, she had glanced swiftly at him; ever since, she had kept them lowered toward the ground.
在初见胡雪岩，视线飞快地一绕之后，一直垂着眼皮，看着地下。

A’qi decided that, since Hu had chosen to show himself, she might as well bring them together openly and let him display his own abilities.
阿七心想，一不做，二不休，既然胡雪岩自己要出头，索性彰明较著替他们拉拢，让他自己来显显本事，

It would save her a great deal of trouble.
倒省了许多心。

“Boss Hu, I mean to take advantage of you.
于是她说：“胡老板，我要敲你的竹杠，

You must give us a proper treat.”
好好请一请我们……”

At the word “us,” Furong nudged her hand and protested. “Really! How can you behave like that?”
一说到“我们”两字，芙蓉便推一推她的手埋怨：“你这个人！哪里有这样子的？”

“What is there to fear?” A’qi answered as though her conduct were perfectly justified.
“怕啥！”阿七一副理直气壮的态度，

“Boss Hu is no stranger.
“胡老板又不是外人，

He is my old man’s close friend.”
是我们老头子的要好弟兄！”

“Exactly,” Hu said with a smile.
“正是这话。这位……”胡雪岩微笑着说：

“This young lady need not stand on ceremony.”
“这位小姐，不必见外！”

“Oh, let me introduce you,” A’qi went on.
“喔，”阿七趁机说道，“胡老板，我来引见，

“This is a young friend of mine.
这是我的小姐妹，

Her maiden surname is Liu, and she married into the He family.
娘家姓刘，夫家姓何，

Her personal name is Furong.
小名叫芙蓉。

You may call her that.”
你叫她名字好了。”

Furong frowned at the introduction.
听这番介绍，芙蓉只是皱眉，

Hu did not know what displeased her and dared not be rash.
胡雪岩不知道她因何不满，不敢鲁莽，

“Certainly not!
“没有这个道理！

I must at least address her respectfully as Miss.”
至少该尊称一声小姐。”

He bowed. “Miss Furong.”
说着作了个揖，“芙蓉小姐！”

“You are too kind.”
“不敢当。”

Blushing, she returned the greeting, then turned to A’qi. “I must leave you now.”
芙蓉带着羞意，还了礼，接着转脸对阿七说：“我先走一步了！”


“Don’t spoil my pleasure!” A’qi caught hold of her.
“你不要扫我的兴！”阿七一把拉住她，

“I have long wanted a vegetarian meal at Baiyi Nunnery.
“我老早想到白衣庵去吃素斋，

Today, by good fortune, I have someone to treat me and someone to keep me company.”
难得今天凑巧，又有人做东道，又有人陪我。”

Furong said nothing, which amounted to assent.
芙蓉不响，自是默许了。

Hu eagerly agreed. “Very well!
胡雪岩便一叠连声地说：“好，好！

Let me offer a modest meal.
我做个小东。

But where is Baiyi Nunnery, and how does one arrange to eat there?
不过白衣奄在哪里？在它那里吃素斋是怎么个规矩？

I know nothing about it.”
我都不知道。”

“I know.
“我知道！”阿七接口答说，

But this will be no modest treat, Boss Hu!
“不过，胡老板，这个东道倒不是小东道！

Its vegetarian dishes are famous in Huzhou.
白衣奄的素菜，湖州有名的，

To keep up appearances, a guest must enter at least five taels in the donation book.”
吃一顿斋，缘簿上总要写五两银子才够面子。

“If the food pleases you, what are five taels?”
““只要你吃得中意，五两银子算啥？”

Hu stepped aside and asked, “Are your chairs outside the gate?”
胡雪岩避开一步问道：“轿子可是在山门外？”

“We sent them away.
“已经打发走了。

Please hire two for us at the gate.
胡老板，拜托你到山门口去雇两顶，

Baiyi Nunnery is at the foot of the city wall by the West Gate.
白衣庵在西门城脚下，

Every bearer knows it.” Hu agreed and hurried ahead.
轿伕都知道的。“胡雪岩答应着，抢步先行，

By the time the women came out, the chairs were waiting with their shafts lowered.
等阿七和芙蓉一出山门口，轿子已经倾倒轿杠在等着了。

But matters had changed.
但事情起了变化，

Furong, who had tacitly agreed, suddenly said that her younger brother had a fever.
芙蓉原已默许了的，突然变卦，说她的小兄弟在发烧，

She was too worried to stay and must go home.
甚不放心，一定要回家。

A’qi resisted, but Furong was firm.
阿七自然不肯，无奈芙蓉的主意也很坚决。

With so many eyes upon them, they could not argue or pull one another about.
众目睽睽之下，不便拖拖拉拉地争持，

Hu therefore helped persuade A’qi not to press her: there would be another occasion to meet.
于是胡雪岩反帮着她阿七，说不必勉强，改天还有相叙的机会。

Once Furong had departed in her chair, A’qi reproached him. “What other occasion?
“哪里还有相叙的机会？”等芙蓉坐上轿子回家，阿七这样埋怨胡雪岩，

I told you not to greet me, and you wouldn’t listen.
“我关照你不要叫我，你不听！

You have spoiled a perfectly good match yourself!”
好好一头姻缘，让你自己搅散了！”

This was no place for a detailed discussion.
此时此地，不宜细谈此事，

Hu admitted fault. “It was all my doing.
胡雪岩自己认错：“都怪我不好。

Let us go home and talk.”
回家去说。”


Back at the house, they learned that Yu had gone to spend a leisurely spell at Yiyuan Bathhouse.
一回到家，说郁四到沂园“孵混堂”去了。

As Hu was a close family friend, there was no need for formal reserve.
好在通家之好，不避形迹，

A’qi kept him to lunch and discussed Furong.
阿七便留胡雪岩吃午饭，谈芙蓉的事。

“I had already hinted at the matter to her.
“我已经露口风给她了，

I didn’t name the man, but once you appeared it was obvious.
虽然没有指出人来，不过你一露面，也就很清楚了。”

She and I are very close.
阿七又说：“她跟我的交情很够，

If I had been allowed to work on her gradually, it would certainly have succeeded.
等我慢慢来说，一定可以成功。

Who would have thought you were in such a hurry?
哪晓得你心这么急？

Now things are at an impasse.”
现在事情弄僵了！

“Not necessarily,” Hu replied.
““也不见得。”胡雪岩说，

“Perhaps she understood and felt embarrassed.
“也许是她心里有数，所以不好意思。

You might sound her out.”
你不妨去探探她的口气看！”

“Of course.
“当然！

We cannot simply abandon it.
总不能就此算数。

But it will be difficult.” A’qi shook her head.
不过，很难！”阿七摇摇头说，

“I know her temperament.”
“我懂她的脾气。”

“What is it like?”
“她的脾气怎么样？”

“She is straightforward too.
“她也是很爽快的人，

When she agrees, she agrees; when she refuses, she refuses.”
一肯就肯，说不肯就不肯。”

“I don’t believe it.”
“我倒不相信！”

Hu had initially been indifferent enough, but now felt he must win Furong.
胡雪岩心想，本来也还无所谓，照现在看，非要把芙蓉弄到手不可！

Otherwise, if the story spread, it would become a subject of gossip.
不然传出去便成了一个话柄。

There was certainly no time on this visit.
不过这一趟是无论如何来不及了！

He would wait until he was free near the year’s end and give the matter serious thought.
且等年下有空，好好来动一番脑筋。

Having settled on that, he put Furong aside for the moment and went to the prefectural yamen to call on the two secretaries, Yang and Qin, and take his leave.
心里存了这么个主意，便暂且抛开了芙蓉，自去知府衙门访杨、秦两位老夫子辞行，

He intended to stay one more day and then return to Hangzhou with Huang Yi.
准备再住一天就带着黄仪回杭州。


“You seldom come.
“来一趟不容易，

Why not stay a few more days?” Yu urged.
何妨多住几天。”郁四挽留他说，

“You want to establish yourself in Shanghai.
“你不是要在上海打局面，

I have several friends in Nanxun whom you ought to know.”
我有几个南得的朋友，不可不文。”

This interested Hu.
这一说胡雪岩心思活动了。

He had long wanted to visit Nanxun, which had more silk merchants engaged in the export trade than anywhere else.
他一直想到南浔去一趟，因为做洋庄的丝商，南浔最多，

They ought to build connections and act together in dealing with foreigners.
一则应该联络一气，以便对付洋人，

Besides, there were many intricacies of the export business that outsiders did not know and insiders would not readily disclose.
再则洋庄方面还有许多奥妙，非局外人所知，他们也不肯随便透露，

With Yu’s introduction, he could learn from them.
现在有郁四介绍，正好叨教。

“Very well,” he answered gladly.
于是他欣然答道：“好的！

“I’ll stay another two days.”
我就多留两天。”

“Two days?” Yu replied slowly.
“两天？”郁四慢吞吞地答道：

“That should be enough.
“也够了。

But I have business at the yamen and cannot accompany you.
不过，我这两天衙门里有事，不能陪你，

I’ll find someone else to go with you.
我另外找个人陪你去，

It will be just as good as going with me.”
就同我去一样。”

“When do we leave?”
“好的。什么时候动身？”

“Whenever you like.
“随便你。

Tomorrow morning would do.
明天一早动身好了。

I’ll bring your companion here tonight so that you can meet.”
晚上我把陪你去的人找来，你们先见一见面。”

The man was one of Yu’s assistants, quiet and sparing of words but widely acquainted and well connected.
那人是郁四手下的一个帮手，沉默寡言，但人头极熟，交游极广。

His surname was Liu and his given name Quan.
他姓刘，单名一个权字，

He was a native of Nanxun, where the Liu clan was a great family.
原是南浔人。南浔刘家是大族，

Through his clan connections, he had contracted to collect its taxes.
刘权以同族的关系，包收南得刘家的钱粮。

This made him an ideal companion and guide for Hu.
以这样的关系，陪着胡雪岩同行引路，可说是最适当的人选。


“Which day will you return to Huzhou?” Yu asked.
“你哪一天回湖州？”郁四问道，

“Let us fix it.”
“我们把它说定规！”

“I should think two days will be enough.”
“我想两天工夫总够了。”

“Tomorrow and the next day.
“明天，后天，

Good.
好！

Then be sure to return the day after that.
你准定大后天回来，

I am giving a dinner for a particular occasion, and you must be there.”
我有事要请个客，你一定要赶到。

“Certainly,” Hu agreed without hesitation.
““一定！”胡雪岩毫不迟疑地应承。

“Then I leave it to you,” Yu told Liu Quan.
“那就拜托你了。”郁四向刘权说，

“Old Liu, you know that Boss Hu is Prefect Wang’s good friend.”
“老刘，你晓得的，胡老板是王大老爷的好朋友。”

He meant Liu to make this special relationship known and add weight to Hu’s standing.
这是指点刘权，要把胡雪岩的这种特殊关系说出去，好增加声势，

As the saying went, people feared not officials in general but the official who had authority over them.
果然，“不怕官，只怕管”，

Through his connection with Wang, Hu received exceptional courtesy during his two days in Nanxun.
就因为王有龄的关系，胡雪岩在南浔的两天，极受优礼，

On the third day his hosts still urged him to remain, but he could not break his promise to Yu and firmly took his leave.
到第三天东道主还挽留，胡雪岩因为郁四有事请客，不能失约，坚辞而回。

Boarding in the morning, he reached Huzhou after noon.
早晨上船，过午到湖州，

Chen met him at the landing and said that Yu was waiting at Yiyuan.
陈世龙在码头迎接，告诉他说，郁四在沂园等他。

“Good.
“好，

I was just wanting a bath.”
我正要淴个浴。”

“I knew you would, Mr Hu.”
“我也晓得胡先生一定要淴浴。”

Chen raised the bundle in his hand.
陈世龙把手里的包裹一扬，

“I have brought your clean underclothes and socks.”
“我把胡先生的干净小褂裤、袜子都带来了。”

It was a small matter, but it showed Chen’s thoughtful attention to him, and Hu was pleased.
这虽是一件小事，显得陈世龙肯在自己身上用心，胡雪岩相当高兴。

They walked to Yiyuan, talking of Nanxun on the way.
一路谈着南浔的情形，走到沂园。

After greeting Yu, Hu undressed and washed away the dust of travel, feeling light and refreshed.
跟郁四见面招呼过，随即解衣磅礴，一洗征尘，顿觉满身轻快，

The success of his journey added to his spirits, and he seemed especially energetic.
加以此行极其顺利，所以精神抖擞，特别显得有劲。


After much talk of Nanxun, Hu noticed that evening was approaching.
谈了好些在南浔的经过，看看天色将晚，

“Brother Yu, whom are you entertaining today?
胡雪岩便问：“四哥，你今天请哪个？

What is the occasion?”
是啥事？”

“A guest who requires special courtesy,” Yu replied, glancing at the shoes in front of Hu’s couch.
“很客气的一位客人。”郁四说着，便向放在软榻前面的胡雪岩的那双鞋子，看了一眼。

Hu was quick to understand. “These shoes have traveled a long way and are rather dirty.
胡雪岩是极机警的人，立刻便说：“我这双鞋子走过长路，不大干净，

They might not make a good impression on a guest I haven’t met.”
恐怕在生客面前，不大好看吧！”

“Between ourselves, they are not very presentable.
“自己人说老实话，是不大光鲜。

Never mind.” Yu called an attendant.
不要紧，”郁四叫过跑堂来说，

“Go to my house and ask Fourth Mistress for my new ning-silk robe with its plush lining and my gong-cloth riding jacket.
“你到我那里去一趟，跟四奶奶说，把我新做的那件宁绸衬绒袍子，直贡呢马褂拿来。

Bring a pair of new shoes too.”
另外再带一双新鞋子。”

“Why should I wear your new robe?” Hu protested.
“何必？”胡雪岩说，“你新做的袍子怎么拿来我穿？

“My clothes are still almost new.
我的这身衣服也还有八成新，

Have them brushed, and they will do.
叫他们刷刷干净，也还可以将就。

There is no need to fetch shoes either.
鞋子也不必去拿，

I can buy a pair when we go out.”
回头走出去现买一双好了。”

Yu ignored him and waved the attendant away to carry out the order.
郁四没有理他，挥挥手示意跑堂照办，

Then he said, “You are standing far too much on ceremony.
然后才说：“你也太见外了，

What is a suit of clothes between friends?”
套把衣服算得了什么？还要客气！”

Hu could hardly object further.
听这一说，胡雪岩还能有何表示？

He changed the subject to his plan to return to Hangzhou the following day.
丢开此事，谈到他预备第二天就回杭州。

Yu urged him to stay; Hu refused.
郁四还要留他，胡雪岩不肯，

They argued back and forth without reaching a decision, until the attendant returned with the clothes.
两人翻覆争执，没有结果，而跑堂的已把衣服取来了。

“Let us go,” Yu said.
“走吧！”郁四说，

“It is getting late.
“时间不早了。

We can discuss your departure later.”
你到底哪天动身，回头再说。”


“Wait.”
“慢点！”

Looking at the double-ridged satin shoes and the new clothes, Hu touched his face. “I ought to have a shave.
胡雪岩看着那双双梁缎鞋和一身新衣服，摸着脸说，“要剃个头才好，

Is there time?”
不知道辰光够不够？”

“Plenty.
“够，够！

Go ahead.”
你尽管剃！”

A traveling barber was called.
于是唤了个剃头担子来，

Hu had his head and face shaved and his queue redressed before putting on the new robe and shoes.
胡雪岩剃头修脸，重新打过辫子，才穿上新袍新鞋，

He was transformed from head to foot.
里里外外，焕然一新，

The attendant joked, “Master Hu looks like a bridegroom!”
跑堂的打趣说道：“胡老爷象个新郎官！”

“And I?” Yu asked.
“我呢？”郁四接口问道：

“Do I look like an honored matchmaker?”
“你看我象不象个‘大冰老爷’？”

He too was dressed in new clothes and beaming, very much like a matchmaker attending a wedding feast.
郁四也是上下簇新，喜气洋洋，很象个吃喜酒的冰人。

Before the attendant could answer, another man appeared in fresh clothes and a clean hat, looking like a guest come to offer congratulations.
跑堂的还不曾接口，又出现了一个衣帽鲜洁，象个贺客佯的人，

It was Chen Shilong.
那是陈世龙。

Hu was surprised.
胡雪岩不觉诧异，

“Why have you come back?
“你怎么又来了？”他问，

Is there something you need to tell me?”
“是找我有话说？”

Chen only smiled and looked at Yu.
陈世龙笑笑不响，只看着郁四。

“He is invited too,” Yu said.
于是郁四说道：“我请客也有他一个。

“Let us go.”
走吧！“



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十八章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Eighteen, first part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER EIGHTEEN｜第十八章


They left Yiyuan and entered their sedan chairs.
走了沂园，坐上轿子，

Chen Shilong gave the bearers a place-name Hu had never heard.
陈世龙吩咐了一个地名，是胡雪岩所不曾听说过的，

After winding through several long lanes, they reached a quiet, out-of-the-way spot near the city wall.
只觉得曲曲折折，穿过好儿子长巷，到了一处已近城脚，相当冷僻的地方，

Hu alighted before a neat stone-gated house.
下轿一看，是一座很整齐的石库房子，

Both black lacquered doors stood open, giving a view straight through to a brightly lit hall full of moving figures.
黑漆双扉洞开，一直望到大厅，灯火通明，人影幢幢，

Palace lanterns hung beneath the eaves, and red candles burned inside.
再细看时，檐前挂着宫灯，厅内烧着红烛，

There seemed to be some celebration.
似是有何喜庆的模样。

“Where are we?” Hu asked.
“这是哪里？”胡雪岩问。

“At a house of mine,” Yu replied.
“是我的房子。”

An idea struck Hu.
“幄！”胡雪岩灵机一动，

“Brother Yu, is it your birthday?
“四哥，莫非今朝是你的生日？

Why didn’t you tell me?”
怎么不先告诉我！”

Yu smiled and nodded. “Go in and you will see.”
郁四微笑着点点头说：“你进去看了就知道了。”

Inside were the two secretaries, Yang and Qin, Huang Yi, Old Zhang, and friends from the banks whom Hu knew.
走到里面一看，有杨、秦两位老夫子，黄仪、老张，还有胡雪岩所认识的钱庄里的朋友，

As they entered, everyone clasped hands and offered congratulations.
看见他们进来，一齐拱手，连称“恭喜”。

Hu assumed these were meant for Yu and had nothing to do with him.
胡雪岩只当是给郁四道贺，与己无干，

He stepped quietly aside to inspect the house, thinking that, if it was spacious and favorably situated, he might discuss buying it or taking possession under a redeemable property pledge and establish a home in Huzhou.
悄悄退到一边去打量这所房子的格局，心里盘算，倘或地方够宽敞，风水也不错，倒不妨跟郁四谈谈，或买或典，在湖州安个家。

Then he noticed something odd.
这一打量发现了怪事，

Two red candles shone on the central table, which was draped in red.
正中披了红桌围的条桌上，红烛双辉，

It was certainly a celebration, but a birthday should have cakes, longevity peaches, candles and noodles, with an image of the venerable God of Longevity.
有喜庆是不错，但做寿该有“糕桃烛面”，供的应该是寿头寿脑的“南极仙翁”，

There were no peaches or noodles.
现在不但看不到寿桃寿面，

Instead, a five-colored silk tapestry depicted the Two Immortals of Harmony.
而且供的是一幅五色缂丝的“和台二仙”。

This was a wedding celebration.
这不是做寿，是娶亲嫁女儿的喜事。

“Why!” Hu rubbed the back of his head.
“咦！”胡雪岩摸着报脑说：

“This is like trying to reach the head of a twelve-foot guardian deity—I can make neither head nor tail of it!
“真正‘丈二金刚摸不着头’！

What is going on?”
怎么回事？”


The room burst into laughter.
这一回引得哄堂大笑，

Through it came a woman: A’zhu’s mother, her hair smoothly dressed and adorned with a red flower, wearing a satin jacket and gauze skirt.
笑声中出现一位堂客，是阿珠的娘，梳得极光的头，簪着红花，身上是缎袄罗裙。

Hu had never seen her so splendidly attired and stared again.
胡雪岩从未见她如此盛装过，不由得又愣住了。

“Mr Hu!” she said, smiling.
“胡先生！”阿珠的娘笑道：

“Congratulations!”
“恭喜，恭喜！”

At last he understood.
胡雪岩恍然大悟，

Turning to the company, he apologized. “Forgive me!
回身以歉意的声音说道：“对不起，对不起！

So it was me you were congratulating.
原来各位刚才是跟我道喜。

How discourteous I have been!”
我倒失礼了！”

He clasped his hands repeatedly, provoking another burst of laughter.
说着，连连拱手。这一来又引得大家发笑。

Then a new question occurred to him.
胡雪岩倒又发觉一桩疑问，

He caught Yu by the arm. “Where is Sister-in-Law Yu?”
一把拉住郁四问道：“郁四嫂呢？”

“Probably inside with the bride.”
“大概在里头陪新人。”

“Exactly!” A’zhu’s mother smiled delightedly.
“对了！”阿珠的娘笑得异常愉悦，

“Such a fine young woman!
“真正好人才！

You are fortunate, Mr Hu.
胡先生，你好福气，

Come and see her.”
还不快来看？”

Everyone surged toward the inner rooms to look at Hu’s new concubine.
于是一拥而进，都要来看胡雪岩的新宠。

Only Hu himself hesitated.
而他本人反倒脚步趑趄了，

What a strange affair: everyone knew he was taking a concubine except the man concerned!
心想，世人有这种怪事，自己娶妾，别人都知道，就是本人被瞒在鼓里！

Now that the secret was out, he must at least learn the details, or he would make a fool of himself at every turn.
现在既已揭晓，总也得问问清楚，不然言语之间接不上头，岂不是处处要闹笑话。


He fell back a step or two and detained Chen. “Tell me what has happened.”
于是，他落后两步，拉住陈世龙说：“到底怎么回事？你先告诉我。”

“Uncle Four has arranged everything.
“四叔都说好了，

All you need do is be the bridegroom.”
就请胡先生做现成的新郎官。”

Those few words explained it.
这两句话要言不烦，胡雪岩完全明白，

Yu had organized the whole scene.
今天的局面，是郁四一手的经营，

Encouraging Hu to visit Nanxun had been a stratagem to lure the tiger away from its mountain, giving Yu two days to arrange the marriage.
劝自己到南得去走一趟，原是“调虎离山”，好趁这两天的辰光办喜事。

Influential as he was in Huzhou, the time had been desperately short.
虽说他在湖州很够面子，时间到底太匆促，

It was almost like cooking raw rice in the time it took to drink a cup of tea—hard to imagine.
好比喝杯茶的工夫要拿生米煮成熟饭，近乎不可思议。

Liu Bucai was also difficult to deal with.
刘不才又是个很难惹的家伙，

To bring him to terms in two days, Yu had probably used threats and inducements, persuasion and pressure together.
郁四能在短短两天之内，让他就范，大概威胁利诱，软硬齐来，

Who knew how much effort it had cost?
不知花了多少气力！

Hu was deeply moved by such generosity.
转念到此，胡雪岩不由得想到了“盛情可感”这句话，

Money was a small matter.
钱是小事，

What was rare was the thought and effort behind it.
难得的是他的这片心、这番力！

There was real savor in friendship carried to such lengths.
交朋友交到这样，实在有些味道了。


“Hey! What are you doing?” Yu called back.
“嗨！”郁四回身喊道，“你怎么回事？”

This brought Hu to himself.
这一喊才让胡雪岩警省，

Looking up, he saw A’qi coming joyfully from a room on the east side, dressed in a red jacket and skirt, heavily made up and glittering with pearls and jade.
抬眼望去，恰好看到珠翠满头的阿七，红裙红袄，浓妆艳抹，从东首一间屋里，喜气洋洋地迎了出来。

Yu was particularly happy and began by teasing her.
郁四这时候特别高兴，先拿阿七打趣，

“Well!” He looked her up and down.
“唷！”他将她上下一看：

“You look just like the bride yourself.”
“你倒象煞个新娘子！”

Ignoring him, she addressed Hu by a new title. “Brother Hu!
阿七不理他，冲着胡雪岩改口喊做：“胡大哥！”

How will you thank me?” she asked triumphantly.
她得意地问道：“你怎么谢我？”

“I am deeply obliged.” Hu clasped his hands.
“承情之至！”胡雪岩拱手说，

“I shall burn incense morning and evening and pray that you soon bear a fine son.”
“我早晚一炉香，祝你早生贵子。”

This auspicious wish made her smile still more broadly.
这是善颂善祷，阿七越发笑容满面，

Assuming the role of hostess, she attended to every guest with easy social skill, until Yu grew impatient.
接着便以居停主人的身分，招待宾客，一个个都应酬到，显得八面玲玫，而郁四却有些不耐烦了。

“Enough!
“好了，好了！”他拦着她说，

The proper ceremony comes first.
“办正经要紧。

Bring her out to pay her respects.”
请出来见礼吧！”

When a concubine entered a household, custom required only that she kowtow to its master and mistress.
娶妾见礼，照规矩只是向主人主母磕头，

The mistress was absent, leaving Hu alone.
主母不在，只有主人，

He thought the ceremony quite unnecessary, but the guests unanimously insisted that propriety must be observed and pressed him into the principal armchair.
胡雪岩觉得此举大可不必。无奈贺客们众口一词，礼不可废，把他强按在正中太师椅上。

The eastern curtain lifted.
然后只见东首那道门帘掀开，

A’qi, acting as attendant to the bride, brought Furong out.
阿七权充伴娘，把芙蓉扶了出来，

She bowed to the floor and softly addressed him as “Master.”
向上磕了个头，轻轻喊了声：“老爷！”

Both Furong and Hu felt embarrassed, while the guests were delighted.
芙蓉忸怩，胡雪岩也觉得忸怩，贺客们则大为高兴，

Secretaries Yang and Qin, in particular, appraised her appearance without restraint.
尤其是杨、秦两位老夫子，评头品足，毫无顾忌。

A’zhu’s mother came to the rescue by urging everyone to take their places at dinner.
阿珠的娘便来解围，连声催促，邀客入席。


There was only one banquet table, set in the hall, and all those seated at it were men.
喜筵只有一席，设在厅上，都是男客，

Finger-guessing drinking games and other revelry continued until the second watch.
猜拳行令，闹到二更天方散。

The guests then took their leave, except for Yu and Chen.
贺客告辞，只郁四和陈世龙留了下来。

“Come inside,” Yu said, taking Hu by the arm. “See your new home. A’qi arranged it all. I hope it pleases you.”
“到里面去吧！”郁四说，“看看你的新居，是阿七一手料理的，不晓得中不中你的意？”说着，他拉着胡雪岩就走。

“Wait, Brother Yu!
“慢点，慢点！”胡雪岩说，“四哥，

You have taken such trouble that I don’t know how to thank you.
你这么费心，我不知道怎么说才好？

How much have you advanced for me altogether?”
一共替我垫了多少？”

“Why discuss accounts now?
“这时候算什么帐？

We can do that tomorrow.”
明天再说。”

“Very well.
“好，明天再说。

But there is something I don’t understand.
不过，有件事我不明白。”

What about her uncle?”
胡雪岩问：“她那个叔叔呢？”

“Liu Bucai?” Yu paused.
“你是说刘不才？”郁四略停一下说道，

“How could he have the face to come?”
“你想，他怎么好意思来？”

An uncle could scarcely attend a wedding feast at which his niece became a concubine.
侄女儿与人做妾，做叔叔的自不好意思来吃喜酒。

Hu reflected that Liu evidently retained some sense of dignity.
胡雪岩心想，照此看来，刘不才倒还是一个要脸面的人。

“He has not come today,” Yu added, “but he will appear sooner or later.
“不过今天不来，迟早要上门的。

He is troublesome.
这个人有点麻烦，

I’ll tell you about him tomorrow.”
明天我再跟你谈。”

Hu wanted to explain his plan to win Liu over as an assistant, but Yu would not let him linger and kept urging him onward.
胡雪岩本想把他预备收服刘不才做个帮手的话，说给郁四听，但郁四不容他如此从容、一叠连声地催着，

He had to put the uncle aside and go to see the niece.
便只好先丢开“叔叔”，去看他的“侄女儿”。


The bridal chamber dazzled him.
一踏进新房，看得眼都花了，

Everywhere he looked were brilliant reds and greens.
触目是一片大红大绿，

In the freshly papered room, the furniture, utensils, bed curtains and bedding were all new.
裱得雪亮的房间里，家具器物，床帐衾褥，无不全新，

To Hu, of course, the newest thing of all was Furong herself.
当然，在他感觉中，最新的是芙蓉那个人！

She was eating with A’zhu’s mother and A’qi.
新人正由阿珠的娘和阿七陪着吃饭，

At the sound of footsteps she rose, looking rather at a loss.
听见脚步声响，她先就站了起来，有些手足无措似地。

Hu felt awkward too.
胡雪岩也觉得不无僵窘之感，

“Please sit.
只连声说道：“请坐，请坐！

Go on eating.
你们吃你们的。

I am only looking round.”
我看看！”

Searching for something to say, he noticed a sheet of tiger-patterned paper mounted in red silk on the wall.
借故搭讪，看到壁上悬着一幅红绫裱的虎皮笺，

Huang Yi had written the calligraphy.
是黄仪写的字，

Hu had little literary learning, but could make out its phrasing because he knew the poem: it was the verse on his fortune slip.
胡雪岩腹中墨水不多，但这幅字，却能读得断句，因为是他熟悉的一首诗——签上的那首诗，

Only two characters in the final line had changed.
只最后一句改了两个字，

Instead of “Where does the beauty gather lotus blooms?”
原来是“美人何处采芙蓉”，

Huang had written, “Upon the river the beauty gathers lotus blooms.”
黄仪却写成“美人江上采芙蓉”。

Hu smiled and looked back at Chen, who smiled too.
胡雪岩笑了，回头看到陈世龙，他也笑了。

Plainly this was a trick the two of them had devised.
显然的，这是他跟黄仪两个人搞的把戏。

The others did not understand their amusement.
别人却不明白，不知他们笑些什么？

Impatient A’qi asked first, and Chen laughingly told how Hu had drawn the slip and been disappointed by the words “where does.”
阿七最性急，首先追问，陈世龙便将胡雪岩的如何求签，又如何因“何处”二字而失望的故事，笑着讲了一遍。

Everyone found the story entertaining, especially Furong.
大家都感觉这件事很有趣，特别是芙蓉本人，

As she listened, she repeatedly raised her eyes to look at Hu.
一面听，一面不断拾起头来看一看，

Each glance seemed to him as bright as a flash of light.
每一看便如流光闪电般，那眼神在胡雪岩觉得异常明亮。

“Then there is no more to say!” A’qi told her.
“那就没有话说了！”阿七对芙蓉说，

“You were born to join the Hu family.”
“ 你天生该姓胡！”

“Indeed, a match ordained beforehand,” Yu agreed.
“是啊，真正姻缘前定。”郁四也说，

“I have never arranged anything so smoothly.”
“我从没有办过这样顺利的事。”


“Even so, we owe it to you both,” Hu said.
“话虽如此，到底是两位的成全。

“Let me borrow another’s flowers to make an offering and drink a toast to Brother Yu and his wife.”
借花献佛，我敬四哥四嫂一杯酒。”

Quick-handed A’zhu’s mother immediately brought two cups, one for A’qi and one for Yu.
阿珠的娘手快，听胡雪岩这一说，已把两杯酒递了过来，一杯给她，一杯给郁四。

“Wait!
“慢来，慢来！

That is not the way,” A’qi directed.
不是这样。”阿七用指挥的语气说，

“You had better all sit down first.”
“你们索性也坐了下来再说。”

She arranged the seats herself.
于是阿七亲自安排席次，

Hu and Furong took the two places of honor; A’zhu’s mother and Chen faced one another on the east and west.
上首两位，胡雪岩和芙蓉，阿珠的娘和陈世龙东西相对，

“Old man,” A’qi told Yu, “we will sit at the lower end and act as hosts.”
然后她和郁四说：“老头子，我们坐下首，做主人。”

Everyone sat except Furong, who hesitated as though afraid that sitting beside her master would overstep her rank.
大家都坐定了，只有芙蓉畏畏缩缩，仿佛怕礼节僭越，不敢跟“老爷”并坐似地，

Hu took her hand without hesitation, and she blushed and sat.
胡雪岩就毫不迟疑地伸手一拉，芙蓉才红着脸坐了下来。

“First drink the bridal cross-cup toast, then thank your matchmakers together.”
“你们先吃交杯盏，再双双谢媒。”

From this beginning A’qi devised one amusement after another.
由这里开始，阿七想出花样来闹，

Laughter never ceased, and she herself became drunk.
笑声不断，她自己也醉了。

Hu had drunk a good deal too, but his mind was clear.
胡雪岩酒吃得不少，但心里很清楚，

He feared that A’qi might disgrace herself.
怕阿七醉后出丑，

If she said something improper to Chen, the damage might be irreparable.
万一跟陈世龙说几句不三不四的话，那就是无可弥补的憾事，

He kept signaling to A’zhu’s mother to intervene.
所以不断跟阿珠的娘使眼色，要他们劝阻。


“We ought to leave and let the newlyweds retire early,” A’zhu’s mother said.
“好了！我们也该散散了，让新人早早安置。”阿珠的娘说到这里，

Turning round, she asked, “Why, where is Shilong?”
回头看了看便问：“咦！世龙呢？”

Chen had seen the danger and slipped away long before.
陈世尤见机，早已逃席溜走。

Hu grew anxious that pursuing the question would draw A’qi’s attention.
胡雪岩心里有些着急，怕她一追问，正好惹得阿七注意，

He hurriedly changed the subject. “Sister-in-Law Yu has had quite a lot.
便赶紧乱以他语：“郁四嫂酒喝得不少，

Help her lie down for a while.”
先抉她躺一躺吧！”

Before he finished, A’qi vomited all over the floor, leaving the brand-new bridal chamber in a dreadful mess.
一句话未完，阿七张口就吐，狼藉满地，把簇新的洞房，搞得一塌糊涂，

Yu sighed repeatedly in exasperation.
气得郁四连连叹气。

Hu naturally took no offense.
自然，胡雪岩不会介意，

Furong was even more attentive: forgetting her embarrassment and reserve, and heedless of her splendid clothes, she personally cared for A’qi while directing a newly engaged maid and the young maid she had brought with her to clean up.
芙蓉更是殷勤，忘却羞涩矜持，也顾不得一身盛装，亲自下手照料，同时指挥新用的一名女仆和她自己带来的一个小大姐，收拾残局。

Once she had been sick, A’qi sobered.
等呕吐过后，阿七的酒便醒了，

She was terribly ashamed and apologized over and over.
老大过意下去，连声道歉。

Yu scolded her for making an exhibition of herself, while the others intervened to soothe them.
郁四又骂她“现世”，旁人再夹在中间劝解，

The commotion was considerable.
倒显得异常热闹。

Eventually the visitors departed.
乱过一阵，贺客纷纷告辞，

Furong saw them to the inner gate, and Hu accompanied them to the street.
芙蓉送到中门，胡雪岩送出大门，

Before Yu entered his chair, Hu took his hand. “Brother Yu, you have set me a problem.
在郁四上轿以前，执着他的手说：“四哥，这一来你倒是给我出了一个难题。

I fear I shall have to stay in Huzhou a few more days.”
湖州怕还要住几天了。”

Yu smiled without answering.
郁四笑笑不响，

Chen spoke instead. “Mr Hu, if there is business in Hangzhou, I can go for you.”
陈世龙却接上了话，“胡先生！”他说，“如果杭州有事要办，我去跑一趟。”

“Certainly!” A’zhu’s mother agreed.
“对呀！”阿珠的娘说，

“Send Shilong wherever he is needed.”
“尽管叫世龙去！”

“Let me think.
“等我想一想，

We will discuss it tomorrow.”
明天再说。”


Hu returned and closed the main gate himself.
回进门来亲自关了大门，

In the hall the wedding candles still burned, their glowing red light giving everything a dreamlike air.
走进大厅，喜烛犹在，红艳艳的光晕闪耀着，给胡雪岩带来了梦幻似的感觉。

“It really is like a dream,” he murmured, sitting in a new chair.
“真正象做梦！”他自语着，在一张新椅子上坐了下来，

Looking at the armrest, he recognized the wood known in Guangdong as suanzhi rosewood.
看着扶手，识得那木料，在广东名叫“酸枝”，

The design was Cantonese too.
样子也是广式，

Finding a whole new suite of such furniture would be difficult even in Hangzhou, let alone Huzhou.
在杭州地方要觅这样一堂新家具，都不容易，何况是在湖州？

Yu’s painstaking care deeply moved him.
见得郁四花的心血，真正可感。

From Yu he thought of A’qi, then of Old Zhang and his wife, daughter and son-in-law-to-be, of Huang Yi and the two secretaries, and finally of the day’s gathering.
由郁四想到阿七，再想到老张和他的妻儿女婿，还有黄仪和衙门里的两位老夫子，最后想到这天的场面，

His feelings rose.
胡雪岩十分激动——

There were, after all, more good people than bad in the world.
世界上实在是好人多，坏人少，

Today alone proved it.
只看今天，就可明白，

They had not merely brought about his happiness; they had taken elaborate pains to send him away beforehand so that it would come as an unexpected delight.
不但成全自己的好事，而且为了让自己有一番意外的惊喜，事先还花了许多心血“调虎离山”。

This was affection, not favor calculated from advantage.
这完全是感情，不是从利害关系生出来的势利。

While he sat absorbed, savoring the thought, someone called softly, “Master.”
正想得出神，咀嚼得有味，听见有人轻轻喊道：“老爷！

He turned. Furong stood there holding a covered teacup.
转脸一看是芙蓉，正捧了一盏盖碗茶来，

She had removed her evening makeup; her lips were red and her teeth white, and her glossy black hair was dressed in a new court-style bun.
她已卸了晚妆，唇红齿白，梳个又光又黑的新样宫署，

Smiling shyly before him, with a different depth of feeling in her eyes, she stirred an excitement he had never known.
这时含羞带笑地站在胡雪岩面前，那双眼中荡漾着别样深情，使得胡雪岩从心底泛起从未经验过的兴奋，

He swallowed twice to moisten his dry throat before he could speak.
咽了两口唾沫，润湿了干燥的喉咙，方能开口答话。


“Thank you.”
“谢谢！”

He accepted the cup with one hand and gently held her left arm with the other.
他一只手接过茶碗，一只手捏住她的左臂。

“Let us sit outside a little longer before going in,” Furong said.
“索性在外面坐一坐再进去吧！”芙蓉说，

“I have burned some incense in there, but the smell from earlier may not have cleared yet.”
“我熏了一炉香在那里，气味怕还没有散尽。”

“Sister-in-Law Yu is very amusing.
“郁四嫂真有趣。”

Have you known each other long?”
胡雪岩问道：“你们是很熟的人？”

“Only two years.
“认识不过两年，

After she married Master Yu, we met at a gathering.”
从她嫁了郁四爷，有一次应酬……”

Furong smiled and stopped.
芙蓉笑笑不说下去了。

“What happened?
“怎么呢？”胡雪岩奇怪，

Another amusing incident?”
“又是闹了什么笑话？”

“No.” She answered calmly.
“不是闹笑话。”芙蓉语声从容地答道，

“The others scarcely spoke to her that day, probably because they disapproved of her background.
“那夭别人都不大跟她说话，想来是嫌她的出身。

I did not know who she was.
我不晓得她是什么人？

I only thought her frank and lively and talked with her for a long time.
只觉得她很爽朗，跟她谈了好些时候。

That is how we became friends.”
就此做成了好朋友。”

“I see.”
“原来如此！”

Hu admired her attitude.
胡雪岩很欣赏芙蓉的态度，

Remembering how she had cared for A’qi without shrinking from the mess, he congratulated himself on having taken such a kind and capable woman into his household.
同时又想到她刚才不嫌龌龊，亲自照料呕吐狼藉的阿七的情形，庆幸自己娶了个很贤慧的妇人。

His view of Furong changed.
这一转念间，胡雪岩对芙蓉的想法不同了。

A man saw many distinctions between wife and concubine, the chief one expressed in the saying that a wife was chosen for virtue, a concubine for beauty.
在一个男人来说，妻妾之间的区别甚多，最主要的是“娶妻娶德，娶妾娶色”。

Hu himself had been captivated by Furong’s clear eyes and slender waist.
胡雪岩看中芙蓉，也就是倾心于她的翦水双瞳，柳腰一捻，

Though she was now composed and dignified, her graceful figure could still draw a man like a moth to a flame, willing to perish without regret.
此刻虽然矜持庄重，而那风流体态，依然能令人如灯蛾扑火般，甘死无悔。

But to think of her only that way would be a waste.
但是，光有这样的想法，胡雪岩觉得可惜，

It was like the British gold coin attached to his watch chain.
就好比他表链上所系的那个英国金洋钱一样，

A sovereign was worth more than other foreign coins, but used as an unusual and attractive ornament, it had a value beyond its silver equivalent.
英镑诚然比什么外国钱都来得贵重，但拿来当作表坠，别致有趣，比它本身的价值高得多。

To treat it merely as money would diminish it.
这样，如果只当它一个可以折算多少银子的外国钱来用，岂不是有点儿糟蹋了它？

Finding a beautiful concubine like Furong was not so difficult; finding beauty joined with virtue was a rare good fortune that could not be commanded.
要娶芙蓉这样一个美妾，也还不算是太难的事，但有色又有德，却是可遇而不可求的事，

She deserved special care.
应该格外珍惜。

His mood changed again.
这样想着，他的心思又变过了，

A moment before, he had been absorbed in excitement and thoughts of leading her behind the gauze bed curtains.
刚才是一味兴奋，所想到的是“携手入罗帏”，

Now he felt a contented joy, as though contemplating a rare flower or savoring mellow wine, to be enjoyed slowly.
此刻是满足的欣悦，如对名花，如品醇酒，要慢慢的欣赏。


He said nothing, only blinking or smiling from time to time.
看他未曾说话，只是一会儿眨眼，一会儿微笑，

Furong wanted to know what gave him such pleasure, but the sense of being strangers was still strong, and she could only observe proper courtesy.
芙蓉很想知道，他想什么想得这么有趣？然而陌生之感，到底还浓，只有尽自己的礼法。

“Shall we go inside?” she ventured.
便试探育说道：“请到里面去坐吧！”

“Certainly.
“好！

After you.”
你先请。”

His politeness made her more constrained.
这样客气，越使她有拘束之感，

Stepping back, she said, “Please go first, Master.
退后一步说：“老爷先请！

I have things to attend to.”
我还有事。

Her task was to fulfill a housewife’s responsibilities.
“她分内之事，就是尽一个主妇的责任，

She extinguished the candles, closed the doors and windows, and checked the kitchen before returning to the bridal chamber.
吹灭烛火，关上门窗，又到厨房里去，检点了一番，才回人“洞房”。

Hu was drinking alone.
胡雪岩一个人在屋里小饮，

Four small dishes and a pot of wine had been prepared.
四碟小菜、一壶酒是早就预备在那里的，

As he raised his cup and recalled the day, countless questions pressed for answers.
把杯回想这天的经过，心里有无数急待解答的疑问，

Seeing her immediately begin arranging the bedding, he called, “Furong, come here.
所以看见她一进来就又忙忙碌碌地整理衾枕，便即说道：“芙蓉，你来！

Let us talk first.”
我们先谈谈。”

“Yes, of course.”
“嗯！好。”

She came over and sat, moving a dish of ham within his reach and filling his cup.
芙蓉走了过来，拉开椅子坐下，顺手便把一碟火腿，换到他面前，接着又替他斟满了酒。

He held it to her lips; she took a sip.
他把酒杯递到她唇边，她喝了一口，

He offered her a slice of ham, and she ate that too.
又夹了一片火腿来，她也吃了。


“Do you know what a fool I made of myself today?”
“你晓不晓得我今天闹个大笑话？”

It was a good beginning, seeming to make them familiar at once.
这个开始很好，似乎一下子就变得很熟了，

She looked at him with interested concern.
芙蓉以极感兴趣和关切的眼色看着他，

“How?”
“怎么呢？”她问。

“When I came in with Yu, everyone said ‘Congratulations.’
“我跟郁老四一起进门，大家都说‘恭喜’，

I knew nothing and thought it was his birthday and they were congratulating him.
我莫知莫觉，只当是郁老四做生日，大家是跟他道喜，

Imagine such a thing!”
你想想，世界上有这种事！”

Furong burst into laughter, then quickly pressed her lips together and tried to look serious.
芙蓉忍俊不禁，“噗”地一声笑了出来，却又赶紧抿着嘴。摆出正经样子：

“Did you really know nothing beforehand?”
“难道你自己事先一点都不知道？”

“Nothing at all.
“一点都不知道。

To keep it from me, they even sent me on a visit to Nanxun.”
为了瞒着我，他们还特地把我弄到南浔去玩了一趟。”

“Then…”
“那……”

She hesitated, looking intently at him.
芙蓉迟疑了一会，双目炯炯地看着他问，

“Was taking me not your wish?”
“要我，不是你的意思？”

“How could you think that?”
“哪有这话！”

Hu hastened to explain.
胡雪岩赶紧分辩，

“I could not have wished for anything better.”
“我是求之不得！”

She nodded, and her expression softened.
芙蓉点点头，神色和缓了，

“I never expected it either,” she said with lowered eyes.
“我也不曾想到。”她低着头说：

“I am rather afraid.”
“我实在有点怕！”

“Afraid of what?”
“怕什么？”

“That I am clumsy and do not know how to speak properly, and will eventually displease the old mistress and your wife.”
“伯我自己笨手笨脚，又不会说话，将来惹老太太、太太讨厌。”

“That will never happen.
“那是决不会有的事！
