You may be completely at ease.”
你千万放心好了。”

At this reassurance, she smiled immediately.
得到这样的保证，芙蓉立刻绽开了笑容，

The smile was faint but seemed rooted deep.
笑容很淡，但看起来却根深，

She was one of those naturally compelling women whose slightest expression made a profound impression.
她是那种天生具有魔力的女人，不论怎么一个淡淡的表情，受者都会得到极深的感受。

“Sister-in-Law Yu has probably told you about me,” Hu said.
“我的情形，你大概总听郁四嫂说过了。”胡雪岩问道，

“What did she say?”
“她是怎么说我？”

“A great deal.”
“话很多。”

Furong compressed it all into one sentence.
芙蓉把那许多话，凝成一句：

“In short, she urged me to enter your household.”
“总之，劝我进你们胡府上的门。”

“And you?
“那么你呢？

Were you willing?”
乐意不乐意？”

This seemed difficult to answer.
这话在芙蓉似乎很难回答，

After a long silence, she lowered her eyes and said, “It is the fate I was born to.”
好半晌，她垂着眼说：“我夭生是这样的命！”

Her voice held infinite sadness, suggesting many hidden hardships.
话中带着无限的凄楚，可知这句话后面隐藏着无限波折坎坷。

Hu felt tender concern and wanted to ask, yet feared touching some painful secret she did not wish to tell.
胡雪岩怜惜之余，不能不问，但又怕触及她什么身世隐痛，不愿多说。

He hesitated, unsure how to begin.
所以踌躇着不知如何启齿？


Thinking of her relatives gave him a way forward.
一个念头转到她的亲属，立刻觉得有话可说了，

“Don’t you have a younger brother?
“你不是有个兄弟吗？”他问，

Why wasn’t he here today?”
“今天怎么不见？”

“He is with my uncle.”
“在我叔叔那里。”

Furong raised her head and spoke earnestly.
芙蓉抬起头来，很郑重地，

“I wanted to ask your wishes before making arrangements for him.”
“我要先跟老爷说了，看老爷的意思，再来安排我兄弟。”

“What arrangements had you in mind?
“我不晓得你预备怎么安排？”胡雪岩说，

Sister-in-Law Yu told me from the beginning that you wanted him with you.
“当初郁四嫂告诉过我，说你要带在身边。

You need not ask me.
这是用不着问我的，

Do as you wish.
你愿意怎么样，就怎么样，

Raising and educating him will naturally be my responsibility.”
将来教养成人，当然是我的责任！”

At those last words, two bright tears rolled from her constantly blinking eyes.
听到最后一句，芙蓉的不断眨动的眼中，终于滚出来两颗晶莹的泪珠，

She bit her lip and forced the tears back.
咬一咬嘴唇，强止住眼泪说：

“Even my parents in the next world would be grateful.”
“我父母在阴世，也感激的。”

“Don’t say that.”
“不要这样说！”

Hu handed her a handkerchief.
胡雪岩顺手取一块手巾递了给她，

“I want to help not only your brother but your uncle too.
“不但你兄弟，就是你叔叔，我都想拉他一把，

Now that we are one family, I must look after them if I can.
既然做了一家人，能照应一定要照应。

In time you will learn what I am like.”
日子一长，你就晓得我的脾气了。”

“I know.
“我晓得，

Sister A’qi told me.” Furong sighed.
我听阿七姐说过。”芙蓉叹口气：

“I don’t know what to say.”
“唉！我不知道该怎么说？”

“I have heard that your uncle is nicknamed Liu the Good-for-Nothing.
“我也听说过，你的叔叔，外号叫做‘刘不才’，

That does not matter.
这不要紧！

Others may not dare employ him; I do.
别人不敢用，我敢用，

My only concern is whether he has ability.” Then he abruptly added, “I know nothing of your family’s circumstances.”
就怕他没有本事。”说到这里，胡雪岩便急转直下地加了一句：“你家是怎么个情形，我一点都不晓得。”

She nodded.
芙蓉点点头：

“Of course I must tell you.”
“我当然要告诉你。”


The Lius had been a business family too.
刘家也是生意人家，

Furong’s grandfather owned a large medicinal-goods shop called Liu Jingde Hall.
芙蓉的祖父开一家很大的药材店，牌号叫做“刘敬德堂”。

He had three sons.
祖父有三个儿子，

The eldest was Furong’s father; the second had died young; the youngest was Liu Bucai.
老大就是芙蓉的父亲，老二早夭，老三便是刘不才。

Liu was exceptionally clever, but had been a spoiled spendthrift from childhood.
刘不才绝顶聪明，但从小就是个纨袴，

Furong’s father was an extremely honest, kindly man, unable to discipline his younger brother.
芙蓉的父亲是个极忠厚老实的人，无力管教小兄弟，

Afraid that friends and relatives would call him harsh, he supplied money as generously as possible for Liu’s extravagance.
又怕亲友说他刻薄，便尽量供应刘不才挥霍。

Thus, although Liu Jingde Hall did a large trade, the family was not solidly prosperous.
因此，刘敬德堂的生意虽做得很大，却并不殷实。

Then, ten years earlier, a terrible disaster struck.
不幸地，十年前出了一个极大的变故，

Furong’s father had gone to Sichuan to buy medicinal ingredients.
芙蓉的父亲到四川去采办药材，

Sailing down through the Three Gorges, his boat was wrecked at Xintan. He died, and an entire cargo of valuable medicines was lost in the river.
舟下三峡，在新滩遇险，船碎人亡，一船的贵重药材，漂失无遗。

Liu hurried to Sichuan to handle the aftermath, behaving everywhere like a grand young gentleman and spending lavishly.
刘不才赶到川中去料理后事，大少爷的脾气，处处摆阔，

Hiring men to recover the body alone cost several hundred taels.
光是雇人捞尸首，就花了好几百银子，

They never found it, so he held rites for the dead locally, spending still more.
结果尸首还是没有捞到，便在当地做法事超度，又花了好些钱。

“Think of it,” Furong said.
“你想想，

“How could the business prosper with Third Uncle behaving like that?
我三叔这样子的弄法，生意怎么做得好？

Within a year it could no longer be kept going.
一年工夫不到，维护不下去了，

After reckoning what others owed us and what we owed them, there was still a debt of seven thousand taels.
人欠欠人清算下来，还差七千银子。

Third Uncle was proud then.
那时我三叔的脾气还很硬，

He handed over the whole shop—the building, fittings and stock—at a valuation of ten thousand, receiving three thousand as the balance.”
把店给了人家，房子、生财、存货，一塌刮子折价一万，找了三千银子回来。”

He spent those three thousand within another year.
三千银子，下到一年就让刘不才花得光光。

Then came pawning possessions, followed by selling furniture and utensils.
于是，先是上当铺，再是卖家具什物，

When nothing remained to pawn or sell, they lived by borrowing.
当无可当、卖无可卖，就只好以贷借为生。

People could help in an emergency, but not support endless poverty.
“救急容易救穷难”，

At last there was nowhere left to borrow.
最后连借部没处借了。

Furong shook her head and stopped.
谈到这里，芙蓉摇摇头，不再说下去，

The misery needed no further description.
那不堪的光景，尽在不言，

After reflecting, Hu asked, “What about your mother?”
墒雪岩想了想问：“你娘呢？”


“She died long ago.
“娘早就死了，

My brother was born after my father’s death, and Mother died in childbirth.
我兄弟是遗腹子，我娘是难产。”芙蓉又说，

When I was fifteen, Third Aunt too was driven to her death by my uncle’s behavior.
“到我十五岁那年，我三婶也让我三叔把她活活气杀！

I don’t know how he managed it: our rice jar was empty every day, yet every day he came home drunk.
我也不知道我三叔哪里学来的本事？家里米缸，天天是空的，他倒是天天吃得醉醺醺回来，

I supported my brother by embroidering for other people.
就靠我替人绣花，养我兄弟，

I hoped to save a few taels so that he could go to school.
想积几两银子下来，将来好叫我兄弟有书读，

But that was a dream!”
哪晓得？妄想！”

“Why?”
“怎么是妄想？”

“Third Uncle!”
“我三叔啊！”

Her expression mingled anger and amusement with a resignation born of despair.
芙蓉是那种又好气，又好笑，出于绝望的豁达的神情：

“Wherever I hid the money, he found it.
“不管把钱藏在什么地方，他都能寻得着！

Fate, surely!”
真正是气数。”

Hu could not help smiling.
胡雪岩也失笑了，

“A kind of ability in itself.
“这也是一种本事。”他说，

But it could not go on.
“那样下去也不是一回事。

What did you do?”
你怎么办呢？”

“Exactly.
“就是这话罗！

I thought and thought, then made up my mind.”
我想了又想，下定决心。”

She paused and straightened herself.
芙蓉略停一停，挺一挺胸说，

“When I was twelve, a fortune-teller read my birth details and said I was destined to be a secondary wife.
“我十二岁的时候批过一张八字，说我天生偏房的命，

If I refused to believe it, I would bring disaster upon my husband’s family.
如果不信，一定会克夫家。

So I told Third Uncle: since that was my fate, he might as well sell me as a concubine.
所以我跟我三叔说，既然命该如此，不如把我卖掉，

Two or three hundred taels would let him resume the family trade, open a small medicine shop and support my brother.
能够弄个二三百两银子，重新干本行，开个小药店，带着我兄弟过日子，

There would be some hope for the future.”
将来也有个指望。


“Do you know what he said?”
你晓得我三叔怎么说？

Hu understood men like Liu perfectly.
“胡雪岩对刘不才这样的人，了如指掌，

What they prized was empty dignity.
所好的就是虚面子，

“He refused, for fear of losing face.”
所以这样答道：“他一定不肯，怕失脸面。”

“Exactly.
“一点不错！他说，

He said, ‘A family like ours may be poor, but its foundations remain.
我们这样的人家，穷虽穷，底子是在的，

How could we give a daughter to be someone’s concubine?
那有把女儿与人做偏房的道理？

Anything else can be discussed, but never that.’
别的好谈，这一点万万办不到。”芙蓉说，

That was one thing that made me feel there was still hope for him.”
“我也就是在这一点上，看出我三叔还有出息。”

Her tone did not quite accord with what she had said earlier.
前后话锋，不大相符，

Hu had questions, but would not interrupt.
胡雪岩心中不无疑问，但亦不便打断她的话去追问，

He nodded.
只点点头说：

“And afterward?”
“以后呢？”

“Afterward I married the man who is now dead.”
“以后就嫁了我死去的那个。”

Her voice darkened.
芙蓉黯然说道：

“In little more than a year, the prediction came true.”
“一年多工夫，果然，八字上的话应了！”

Hu now understood: she was willing to become a concubine because she accepted what she believed to be her fate.
胡雪岩这才明白，她现在愿意做人的偏房，是“认命”。

But what about Liu?
但是，刘不才呢？

Had he remained as stubborn as before?
可是依旧象从前那样，

What means had Yu used to bring him round?
郁四是用了什么手腕，才能使他就范？

Should Hu ask Furong now or Yu tomorrow?
这些情形是趁此时问芙蓉，还是明天问郁四？

While he considered, Furong spoke again.
他正在这样考虑，芙蓉却又开口了，

“There is one thing I cannot reconcile myself to.
“有件事，我不甘心！”她说，

My first husband died of an epidemic disease.
“我前头那个是死在时疫上。

At the beginning it was not severe.
初起并不重，

Even ordinary medicines such as Huoxiang Zhengqi Pills or Zhuge Marching Powder would have saved him.
只要有点藿香正气丸，诸葛行军散这种极普通的药，就可以保得住命，

But he was on a boat, in the middle of the night, and could not obtain even those.
偏偏是在船上，又是半夜里，连这些药都弄不到。

I often think that, if our shop had still been open, such medicines would have been everywhere.
我常常在想，我家那爿药店如果还开着，这些药一定随处都是，

I would certainly have put some in his traveling chest before he left, and they would have been ready when needed.
他出门我一定会塞些在他衣箱里，那就不会要用的时候不凑手。

He ought not to have died, yet he did.
应该不死偏偏死，

That is what I cannot accept.”
我不甘心的就是这一点！”


Hu said nothing.
胡雪岩不作声。

Her story had given him an idea that required careful thought.
芙蓉的话对他是一种启发，他需要好好盘算。

As they sat facing each other in silence, there was a soft crack.
就在这默然相对之中，只听“扑”地一声，

He looked up: a large bright tuft had burst from the red candlewick.
抬眼看时，红烛上好大的一个灯花爆了。

“It is late,” Furong asked gently.
“时候不早了！”芙蓉柔声问道：

“You must be tired?”
“你恐怕累了？”

“You must be too.”
“你也累了吧！”

He held her hand and lightly squeezed her arm.
胡雪岩握着她的手，又捏一捏她的手臂，

Even through the purple satin jacket, he could feel that it was soft without being weak or slack.
隔着紫缎的小夹袄，仍能清楚地感觉到，她臂上的肌肉很软，却非松弛无力，

“You are not thin, after all.”
便又说道：“你不瘦嘛！”

Her eyes shifted playfully.
英蓉的眼珠灵活地一转，

Pretending indifference, she asked, “Do you like women thin or plump?”
装作不经意地同道：“你喜欢瘦，还是喜欢胖？”

“Neither thin nor plump—just as you are.”
“不瘦也不胖，就象你这样子。”

She said nothing, but looked pleased.
芙蓉不响，但脸上是欣慰的表情，

“What about your wife?
“太太呢？”她问，

Is she thin or plump?”
“瘦还是胖？”

“She was much like you, but grew plump after childbirth.”
“原来跟你也差不多，生产以后就发胖了。”

An important question suddenly occurred to him.
胡雪岩忽然提起一句要紧话：

“Have you any children?”
“你有孩子没有？”

“No.
“没有！”芙蓉又说，

The fortune-teller said I was destined to have two sons.”
“算命的说，我命里该有两个儿子。”

This pleased Hu considerably.
听得这话，胡雪岩相当高兴，

Cupping her face, he said, “I can read faces too.
捧着她的脸说，“我也会看相，

Let me have a good look.”
让我细看一看。”

With their eyes meeting directly and no room to evade his gaze, Furong felt deeply ill at ease.
这样四目相视，一点腾挪闪转的余地都没有，芙蓉非常不惯，

Smiling in embarrassment, she pulled his hands away.
窘笑着夺去他的手，

“There is nothing to look at.”
“没有什么好看！”

She moved aside.
说着，她躲了开去。


Taking her hand, Hu sat with her on the edge of the bed. “Tell me something.
“我问你的话，”胡雪岩携着她的手，并坐在床沿上说，

The other day you agreed to the vegetarian meal.
“那天你先答应去吃素斋，

Why did you change your mind as soon as we left Tiansheng Temple?”
一出天圣寺的山门，怎么又忽然变了卦？”

“I was a little afraid.”
“我有点怕！”

“Of what?”
“怕什么？”

She gave a secretive smile and kept shaking her head, unwilling to answer.
芙蓉诡秘地笑了一下，尽自摇头，不肯答话。

“Tell me.
“说呀！”胡雪岩问道，

What is so difficult to say?”
“有什么不便出口的？”

After hesitating, she finally spoke.
迟疑了一下，她到底开了口：

“I was afraid of being taken in by you.”
“我怕上你的当！”

“Taken in how?” Hu laughed.
“上什么当？”胡雪岩笑道：

“Did you think I would put poison in the food?”
“莫非怕我在吃的东西里面放毒药？”

“Not poison—I was afraid you would slip me a bewitching potion!” She laughed herself, then turned and buried her face in a white satin quilt embroidered with a phoenix greeting the rising sun, too embarrassed to look up.
“倒不是伯你放毒药，是伯你放迷魂药！”说着，她自己笑了，随即一扭身，伏在一床白缎绣春丹凤朝阳花样的夹被上，羞得抬不起头来。

Whether or not she meant it, Hu found the answer delightful.
不管她这话是真是假，胡雪岩只觉得十分够味，

He bent over her, kissing her neck and hair, then kicked both feet and sent his brand-new satin shoes flying far away.
因而也伏身下去，吻着她的颈项头发，随后双脚一甩，把那双簇新的双梁缎鞋，甩得老远。


The next morning he did not rise until the clock struck ten.
第二天早晨，他睡到钟打十点才起身，

Drawing back the bed curtains, he saw Furong already neatly dressed and tidying her dressing table.
掀开帐子一看，芙蓉已经打扮得整整齐齐，正在收拾妆台。

At the sound of the curtain hook, she turned, smiled shyly and asked softly, “Won’t you sleep a little longer?”
听得帐钩响动，她回过头来，先是娇羞地一笑，然后柔声说道：“你不再睡一息？”

“No.”
“不睡了！”

Hu stepped down barefoot.
胡雪岩赤着脚走下地来，

“A happy occasion refreshes the spirit.
“人逢喜事精神爽，

Why sleep?”
还睡什么？”

“Look at you!” she said anxiously.
“你看你！”芙蓉着急地说，

“The chill of the brick floor will rise through your feet.
“砖地上的寒气，都从脚心钻进去了，

Get back on the bed.”
快上床去！”

She draped a lightly padded jacket over him, pushed him onto the bed’s edge and put on his socks, leggings and shoes.
说着，取了一件薄棉袄披在他身上，推着他在床沿上坐定，替他穿袜子、穿套裤、穿鞋，

Then she drew him to his feet, tied his waistband and helped him into his long robe.
然后又拉着他站起身来，系裤带，穿长袍。

Hu had never been attended to like this and felt a strange new pleasure.
胡雪岩从来没有这样为人伺候过，心里有种异样的感受，

“No wonder they call a concubine an attendant,” he murmured.
“怪不得叫妾侍！“他不由得自语，”

“So that is what the word means.”
‘侍，是这么个解释！

She had not heard clearly and looked up. “What did you say?”
““你在说啥？”芙蓉没有听清楚他的话，仰着脸问。

“That I really am enjoying a fortunate life.
“我说我真的享福了！”胡雪岩又说，

Now let us talk about serious matters.”
“我们谈谈正经！”


Hu had countless serious matters, but only two concerned Furong—or, in a sense, only one: making provision for her uncle and brother.
胡雪岩的“正经事”无其数，但与芙蓉佰共的只有两桩，也可以说，只有一桩，胡雪岩要安置她的一叔一弟。

“What is your brother’s name?”
“你兄弟名字叫啥？”

“He was born in the Year of the Rabbit.
“我小弟是卯年生的，

His childhood name is Little Rabbit.”
小名就叫小兔儿。”

“Send for him today.
“今天就去接了他来！

Your uncle won’t refuse to let him come, will he?”
你叔叔不会不放吧？”

Hu understood human motives thoroughly, those of decent men and scoundrels alike.
胡雪岩人情透熟，君子小人的用心，无不深知，

At present Liu could not be treated as a gentleman.
刘不才在此刻来说，还不能当他君子，

Judging him by a less generous standard, Hu feared that he might use the boy as something valuable to bargain with.
所以胡雪岩以“小人之心”去猜度，怕他会把小兔儿当作奇货，

Hence the question.
因而有些一问。

It was well founded.
这一问还真是问对了，

Furong immediately looked worried.
芙蓉顿有忧色，

“He might.
“说不定！”她委委屈屈地说，

I mentioned it to Third Uncle.
“我跟我三叔提过。

He said that, as the boy was of the Liu bloodline, it would be improper—improper…”
他说，刘家的骨血，不便，不便……”

She did not know how to continue.
芙蓉不知如何措词，

Her face reddened: repeating the words would humiliate both herself and her family.
脸涨得通红，话说出来屈辱了自己，也屈辱了娘家。

Liu had spoken harshly.
刘三才的话说得很难听，

“You say you are destined to be a concubine and choose it yourself.
“你说你命中注定要做偏房，自己情愿，

I have nothing more to say.
我也没话说。

Yu is influential, and I cannot stand against him.
郁四有势力，我也搞不过他。

But Little Rabbit is of our family’s blood.
不过小兔儿是我们刘家的骨血，

What would taking him to that man Hu mean?
你带到姓胡的那里，算啥名堂？

You have already lowered yourself.
你自己已经低三下四了，

Must your brother become someone’s little servant too?”
莫非叫你兄弟再去给人家做小跟班？”

She had been near tears with anger, yet could not argue.
当时自己气得要掉眼泪，但也无法去争，

She had intended to find a solution gradually.
原来打算慢慢再想办法，

Now Hu had raised the matter first, and she did not know how to explain.
此刻胡雪岩先提到，就不知道怎么说了！

Improper in what way?
不便什么？

Hu quickly understood: it was a question of status.
胡雪岩的心思快，稍微想一想就明白，自然是名分上的事。

That was easily settled.
那好办！他说：

“Naturally, a child of the Liu family will retain the surname Liu.
“你们刘家的骨血，自然让他姓刘。

I am his brother-in-law now.
我现在算是姐夫资格，

Surely I can look after your own flesh and blood?”
难道就不能管你的同胞骨肉？”


Furong wondered whether she had heard correctly.
芙蓉怕是自己听错了，

Thinking it over, she was certain he had said “brother-in-law.”
回想一遍，是听得清清楚楚，有“姐夫”二字，

Surprise and gratitude filled her, yet she could scarcely believe that such good fortune existed.
惊喜感激之余，却仍有些不大相信，世界上没有这样的好事！

“What other difficulty is there?” Hu asked.
“还有啥难处？

“Tell me, and we can discuss it.”
你说出来商量。”

What difficulty remained except the fear that he might not mean it?
这还有什么难处？就怕他的话靠不住！

She would not let the crucial point slip.
芙蓉在要紧关头上不放松，特意问一句，

“You mean Little Rabbit may call you Brother-in-Law?”
“你说小兔儿叫你‘姐夫’？”

“What else should he call me?
“不叫我姐夫叫啥？

Master, as you do?”
难道也象你一样，叫我老爷？”

Furong’s use of “Master” was conventional; a principal wife used it too, so it did not openly mark a difference in status.
芙蓉叫“老爷”是宫称，就是正室也如此叫法，身分的差别不显，

But for Little Rabbit, calling him Master would mean something different.
小兔儿就不能这么叫。

Hu’s generosity and delicate consideration left her completely content.
难得胡雪岩这等宽宏大量，体贴入微，芙蓉真个心满意足，

She gazed at him with a smile, unable to speak for a long time.
凝眸含笑，好半天说不出话来。

Her emotion confirmed that his guess had been right.
这翻衷情，让胡雪岩发觉，自己的猜测，完全对了，

“Then your uncle should have nothing more to say?”
“这一来，你叔叔该没话说了吧！”他问。

“Certainly!” she answered brightly.
“当然！”芙蓉的声音很响亮，

“I will go and fetch my little brother myself.”
“我自己去接我小弟。”


Hu did not immediately answer that.
胡雪岩先不答她这话，只说：

“I should like to meet your uncle.
“我想跟你叔叔见个面。

Do you think I should call on him, or invite him here?”
你看是我去拜会他，还是请他到我们这里来？”

“He may not come.
“他怕不肯来，

You need not trouble with him yet.”
你暂时也不必理他。”

She was thinking chiefly of Hu.
芙蓉一大半是为胡雪岩打算，

“To be honest, it is best to avoid him if you can.”
“我叔叔，说实在的，能避他还是避开他的好。”

“Tell me, how well does he know the family trade?”
“我倒问你，他对本行生意，到底怎么样？”

She had not expected the question, and its purpose was unclear.
没有料到他会提起这句话，而且意义也不明显，芙蓉不知如何作答？

After thinking carefully, she guessed that Hu meant to recommend him for employment at a medicinal-goods firm.
细细想一想，才略略猜出他的意思，大概是要给她三叔荐到什么药材行去做事。

His skill was not poor, but he could not be trusted with money; if trouble arose, it could implicate whoever had guaranteed him.
论本事倒还不差，就是银钱上头，不能叫人放心，将来一走连累保人。

Yet Hu was offering help, and the man was her own uncle.
然而人家既有这番好意，自己这面又是嫡亲的叔叔，

She could hardly reject an opportunity for him.
也不能说有机会不要，

Torn between these considerations, she found it still harder to answer.
左恩右想，十分为难，就越发无话可答了。

“I mean his ability,” Hu clarified.
“我是说他的本事。

“Does he know the trade?”
对本行是不是在行？”

“How could he not?
“怎么不在行？

It is the family business.
祖传的行当，

He could have learned it simply by watching from childhood.”
从小看也看会了。”

An idea suddenly occurred to her.
芙蓉说到这里，突生灵感，

“Master, I have a suggestion, though I don’t know whether it can be carried out.”
“老爷，”她说，“我倒有个主意，不晓得办不办得到？”

Liu possessed several secret family formulas for pills, powders, ointments and medicinal preparations.
这个主意是这样，刘不才千里有几张家传的丸散膏丹的秘方，

They had been adapted from prescriptions used at the Ming court, and half the business of Liu Jingde Hall had depended on them.
是根据明朝大内的“宫方”，加以斟酌损益而成，“刘敬德堂”的生意，一半要靠这几张方子。

When the shop failed and its accounts still showed a debt of seven thousand taels, someone had proposed accepting the formulas in settlement.
生意“倒灶”，清算帐目时，还差七千银子，有人提议拿这几张秘方作价了清。

Liu had preferred to give up the premises and fittings and keep them.
刘不才却是宁愿不要店面和生财，要留着那几张方子，

Poor as he was, he had retained his ambition.
当时他倒是“人穷志不穷”，

He told the creditors, “Liu Jingde Hall failed in my hands, and it must be restored in my hands.
对债主表示：“刘敬德堂从我手里败掉的，自然还要从我手里恢复。

When the old shop opens anew, I shall need these formulas myself.”
将来‘老店新开’，这几张方子，我自己要用。”


“Reopening it now looks like a foolish dream,” Furong said.
“老店新开，看来是痴心妄想！”芙蓉说道，

“I can be at ease about Little Rabbit, since he can depend on you.
“小兔儿倚靠得着你，我也可以放心了。

As for Third Uncle, except for smoking opium, he has committed every disreputable act I can think of.
我三叔，照我看，除掉一样吃鸦片，没出息的事，都做绝了。

But I am his niece.
我做侄女儿的，

However badly he has treated me, I cannot watch him go hungry without helping.
不管他怎么对不起我，总没有眼看他没饭吃，不拉他一把的道理。

Nor dare I ask you to find a way for him and bring trouble on you.
不过，我也不敢请你替他想办法，害你受累，

That would only make trouble for myself.
岂不是变成我自讨苦吃？

So I thought of persuading him to sell the formulas.
所以我这样在想，要劝他把那几张秘方卖掉。

Someone once offered seven thousand taels.
从前有人出过七千银子，

Might they fetch ten thousand now?
现在不晓得能不能卖到一万银子？

With ten thousand, he could squander money on women and gambling and still live for several years.
有一万银子，随他去狂嫖烂赌，总也还有几年好混，

Or perhaps he would reform, use it in business, behave decently, live frugally and become dependable.
倘或他倒回心向善了，拿这一万银子做做生意，真个安分守己，省吃俭用，变得可以靠得住，

Then you would naturally be willing to help him.
那时候你也自然肯提拔他。

That would truly show the hidden merit accumulated by our ancestors.”
这才真正是我们刘家祖上的阴功积德！

Listening to this long explanation, Hu felt respect deepen within his affection.
“听她长篇大论说这一套，胡雪岩对芙蓉越发爱中生敬，

She was both sensible and naturally kind.
因为她不但明白事理，而且秉性淳厚，

Her words also gave him a clearer view of Liu: the man had ability and retained ambition.
再从她的话中，对刘不才又多了一番认识，此人不但有本事，也还有志气，

Disreputable though he was, so long as he did not smoke opium, he was not beyond recovery.
人虽烂污，只要不抽鸦片，就不是无药可救。

Hu immediately made a decision and felt excited by it.
这样转着念头，心中立刻作了个决定，他对自己的这个决定很兴奋，

But nothing could be settled until he met Liu.
但一切都要等与刘不才见了面，才能定局，

It was too early to tell Furong the whole truth.
此时还不宜对芙蓉细谈实话。


“Your plan is excellent.
“你的打算真不错。

Never mind whether the formulas are worth ten thousand taels.
那几张秘方值不值一万银子，不去管它，

If he is willing to part with them, I can certainly get that price for him.
只要他肯拿出来，我一定可以替他卖到这个价钱。

Let us visit Third Uncle together this afternoon.
这样子，”胡雪岩说，“今天下午我们一道去看你三叔。

You may wear a red skirt.”
你穿了红裙子去好了！”

Traditionally, only a principal wife married through the proper ceremonies was entitled to wear red.
向来明媒正娶的正室，才有穿红裙的资格，

Furong was grateful and delighted.
所以听得胡雪岩这一说，芙蓉既感激又高兴。

Even if she could overstep the rule only temporarily because Mrs Hu was absent, it gave her dignity.
虽然只有胡太太不在这里，权且僭越，但总是有面子的事。

Then another worry arose.
不过从而一想，又不免犯愁，

If she was destined to be a concubine and assuming a principal wife’s position would bring harm to her husband, could she wear that red skirt?
天生是偏房的命，做了正室，便要克夫。这条红裙穿得穿不得？

She must consult a fortune-teller before deciding.
还得要请教算命先生才能决定。

Instead of thanking him, she merely nodded vaguely.
因此，她便不谢，只含含糊糊地点一点头。

Just then A’zhu’s mother and A’qi arrived independently, each having had the same thought: both had sent bearers carrying food boxes with dishes and refreshments.
就在这时候，阿珠的娘和阿七不约同至，而且还有不约而同的一件事，都叫人挑了食盒，送了菜和点心来。

Naturally, their meeting brought teasing.
相见之下，自然有一番取笑，

A’zhu’s mother was comparatively restrained; A’qi had no such limits and even asked about the pleasures of the bridal chamber, embarrassing Furong terribly.
阿珠的娘还比较客气，阿七则是肆无忌惮，连房筛燕好的活都问得出来，把芙蓉搞得其窘无比。

Fortunately, Yu and Chen soon arrived and interrupted her outrageous jokes.
幸好又来了两个男客，一个是郁四，一个是陈世龙，这才打断了阿七的恶谑。


After lunch together, the men and women separated.
一桌吃过了午饭，男客和女客分做两起，

Furong took A’zhu’s mother and A’qi aside to ask whether she might wear the red skirt, while Hu invited Yu into the outer hall to talk.
芙蓉拉着阿珠的娘和阿七去请教，那条红裙穿得穿不得？胡雪岩邀了郁四在外面厅上坐，有话要谈。

The subject was Liu Bucai.
谈的是刘不才。

Yu too felt that this remained unfinished business.
郁四也正感到这是桩未了之事；

A’qi had persuaded Furong, and the He family had long said she could decide for herself, so they had raised no obstacle.
游说芙蓉，是阿七建的功，何家早就表示过，愿意放她自主，自然不会留难。

With Liu, Yu had intended to let him name a price and meet it unless it was absurd.
刘不才那里，郁四原预备让他“开价”，只要不是太离谱，一定照办，

Instead, Liu had answered with unexpected pride.
不想刘不才的话说得很硬气：

“Poor as I am, I have not sunk to selling my niece.
“穷虽穷，还下到卖侄女儿的地步。

A first marriage is for the father to arrange; remarriage is the woman’s own affair.
初嫁由父，再嫁由己，

If she chooses to become a concubine of the Hu family, I have nothing to say.
她愿意做胡家的偏房，我没话说。

But I do not intend to acknowledge the Hu family as my relatives.”
不过我也不想认胡家这门亲戚。”

“That is unlike his usual behavior,” Yu said.
“这不象他平日的行为。

“I don’t know what he is planning.
也不知道他打的什么主意？”郁四又说，

We ought to settle matters cleanly.
“事情总要料理清楚，

Leaving a loose end is tiresome.
留下个尾巴也讨厌，

I was about to suggest finding some way to give him money.”
我正要跟你商量，还是得想个办法，送他一笔钱！”

“You have taken more than enough trouble, Brother Yu.
“四哥，你费心得多了，

This need not concern you further.
这件事不必再劳你的神。

Furong has explained everything.”
芙蓉已经阳我仔细谈过，”

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑道，

“He may refuse to acknowledge me, but I am determined to acknowledge him.”
“他不想认我这门亲，我却非认他不可！”

“How?” Chen asked with youthful curiosity.
“怎么个认法？”陈世龙颇有童心，

“Liu Bucai is very difficult.
“刘不才难惹得很，

I should like to see how you deal with him.”
我倒要看胡先生怎么跟他打交道？”

“I shall ask you to go ahead and clear the way.”
“我要请你先替我去做个开路先锋！”

Hu briefly recounted what Furong had told him, gave Chen a few instructions and sent him to sound out the ground.
于是他把芙蓉所谈的情形，扼要谈了些，又嘱咐了陈世龙几句话，让他先去探路。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十八章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Eighteen, concluding part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Chen Shilong found out where Liu Bucai lived and went straight there.
陈世龙打听到了刘不才的住处，一径就寻上门去，

Like Ji Heling, Liu had rented spare rooms in the house of an old family fallen on hard times, though his quarters had a separate entrance.
他跟嵇鹤龄一样，也是祖了一家式微世家的余屋住，不过另外开了个门，

After two knocks, a fine-featured but very thin boy opened the door.
敲了两下，有个眉清目秀，但十分瘦的孩子来开门，

His dark eyes turned towards Chen.
转着乌黑的一双眼珠问道：

“Who are you looking for?”
“你找谁？”

Remembering Hu Xueyan's account, Chen guessed that this must be Furong's brother.
陈世龙听胡雪岩谈过，猜想他必是芙蓉的弟弟，

“Little Rabbit, where is your Third Uncle?”
随即说道：“小兔儿，你三叔呢？”

“Inside.”
“在里头。”

But when Chen tried to enter, the boy blocked the doorway.
等陈世龙要踏进去，他却堵着门不放，

“Don't come in.
“你不要进来，

Tell me your name first.”
先告诉我，你姓啥？”

“Why?
“怎么？”陈世龙答道，

Are you afraid I've come to collect a debt from your uncle?
“你怕是我跟你三叔来讨债的？

No, no!
不是，不是！

My name is Chen.
我姓陈，

I've come to bring him money.”
送钱来给你三叔的。

Little Rabbit remained doubtful, but at last let him through.
“小兔儿有些将信将疑，但毕竟还是让步了。

At once a delicious aroma made Chen swallow.
陈世龙一进门就觉得香味扑鼻，不由得咽了口唾沫，

He recognised the scent of stewing ham.
仔细辨一辨味道，是炖火腿的香味。

“The fellow certainly knows how to enjoy himself!”
“这家伙，真会享福！”

Before he had finished, Liu appeared, strolling out and humming an operatic tune.
一句话未完，看见刘不才的影子，哼着戏踱了出来，

He wore an old padded jacket of Hu silk and black imported-crepe trousers, their ankles tied with such neat precision that he looked remarkably brisk.
身上穿一件旧湖绪棉袄。下面是黑洋绉扎脚裤，两只裤脚扎得极其挺括，显得极有精神。


“Little Monk!
“小和尚！

I didn't expect you.”
想不到是你。”

“刘三爷！待为来跟你老人家请安。”

过于谦恭，反成戏谑，刘不才便骂：“去你的，

寻什么穷开心！”

“That isn't what I mean.
“不是这话。”陈世龙答道，

“从前叫你刘不才，

Now things are different.
如今不同了，

You've become my elder, and I must observe the proper forms.”
你变成我的长辈，规矩不能不讲。”

“咦！”

刘不才眨着眼说，

“I never expected a younger relation to spring up so suddenly.
“我倒没有想到，忽然爆出来的这么个晚辈！

Tell me, where have you come from?”
是怎么来的，你说来听听！

“You've become related to my teacher.
““你跟我先生结成亲戚，

Doesn't that make you my elder?”
不就是我的长辈？”

Liu paused, then assumed an arrogant expression.
刘不才愣了一下，换了副傲慢的神色：

“I don't know who your teacher is.
“我不晓得你的先生是哪个？

反正我最近没有跟什么人结亲，

谦称奉壁，

蜗居也不足以容大驾，

请！”

说着将手向外一指，竟下了逐客令。

Chen felt embarrassed, but could hardly quarrel.
陈世龙有些发窘，但当然不能翻脸，

在平时，翻脸就翻脸，也无所谓，

此刻是奉命差遣，

He must endure it and find some way to make Liu Sancai withdraw the dismissal.
不能不忍一忍，同时还得想办法让刘三才取消逐客令。


He forced the most natural smile he could.
于是他尽量装出自然的笑容，

“Third Master Liu, you're no friend!
“刘三爷，你真不够朋友，

Stewing something so delicious and keeping it all to yourself—aren't you ashamed?
炖着那么好吃的东西，一个人享用，好意思？

Or don't you expect to meet me at the gambling table again?”
莫非，”他说，“你不想在赌场里见面了？”

Mention of gambling weakened Liu's defiance.
提到赌场，刘三才的气焰一挫。

They were not close friends, but after losing, he had forgotten his dignity and borrowed gambling money from Chen two or three times.
彼此的交情虽不深，但输了就顾不到体面、曾有两三次向陈世龙伸手借过赌本，

Remembering the obligation—and the hold it gave Chen—he could no longer maintain his stern face.
想起这点情分，也是话柄，他的脸板不成了。

“Blame your own tactlessness!
“要怪你自己不知趣！

You always pick up the kettle that won't boil.
‘哪壶水不开，偏提哪一壶’，

你晓得我讨厌我那个侄女儿，你偏要拿她来触我的心境，

How could I help being angry?”
叫人光火不光火？”

“Very well.
“好了，好了，

Let that be the end of it.
说过算数。

If you'll keep me to dinner, you provide the food and I'll provide the drink.
如果你留我吃饭，你出菜，我出酒。

Little Rabbit, come here!”
小兔儿，你来！”

Chen took out a scrap of silver weighing five or six qian.
陈世龙摸出块五六钱的碎银子问道：

“你会不会上街买东西？”

“你要买什么？”刘不才问。

“I've tried the Shaoxing spirit at the shop by the lane entrance.
“巷口那家酒店的‘绍烧，我吃过，

It's good.
不坏，

Ask them to send two jin and take the money.”
叫他们送两斤来，把酒钱带去给他。”

He put the silver into the boy's hand.
说着，他把银子塞到小兔儿子里，

“Keep the change for pear-syrup sweets!”
“多下的送你买梨膏糖吃！”

“There's no reason for you to spend money!”
“没有要你破费的道理！”

Liu hurried between them, reaching with one hand for the silver and pushing Chen with the other, as though preventing payment.
刘不才赶上来插在他跟小兔儿中间，一只手到他侄儿手里去夺银子，一只手又推陈世龙，仿佛不让他给钱似地。

It was pure sleight of hand, like pretending to fight over a restaurant bill while holding only the other man's unoccupied left hand.
这就象下馆子抢着惠帐，只拉住了别人的不管用的左手一样，完全是“障眼法”。

The silver ended up in Liu's possession, while Little Rabbit was sent to obtain the liquor on credit.
结果是那块碎银子到了刘不才手里，却叫小兔儿到酒店里去赊帐。

Chen saw through him.
从这个行为上，陈世龙看透了他；

His backbone was not so stiff after all!
骨头硬不到哪里去！

He would never truly break with Furong either.
他跟芙蓉也决不会决裂。


“Come along!”
“来，来！”

Liu's spirits had recovered.
刘不才的兴致又很好了，

Lifting the earthenware pot's lid, he sniffed twice and smiled proudly.
把沙锅盖一揭，鼻子闻了两下，得意的笑道：

“‘Thank your feet for bringing you here.’
“ ‘走得着，谢双脚’，

You're fortunate in your food!
你的口福不坏！

With aged ham, everything depends on cleaning it properly.
陈火腿全靠收拾得干净，

I've spent the whole morning plucking every hair from it.”
整整搞了一上午，才把上面的毛钳干净。”

我今天来拉拢一桩生意。”

“Business?”
“生意？”

Liu was unconvinced.
刘不才不信他，

“Why come to me?
“怎么找到我头上？

What business could we discuss?”
跟我有啥生意好谈？”

“There is some.
自然有！

I'll tell you shortly.”
等下我再告诉你。

Only when they had their cups in hand did Chen explain.
“等酒杯一端上手，陈世龙才道明来意，

A friend intended to open a very large medicine shop in Hangzhou.
他说他有个朋友，预备在杭州开一家极大的药店，

Knowing Liu Jingde Hall's reputation and Liu's expertise, he had asked Chen to inquire whether Liu would become his partner.
知道“刘敬德堂”的名气，也知道刘不才是行家，特地托他来探问一下，想邀刘不才合伙。

“A partner?
“合伙？

On what terms?”
怎么合法？”

Liu shook his head.
刘不才摇着头说，

“We can discuss anything else, but this won't work.
“别的事都好谈，这件事谈不拢，

Where would I find capital?”
我哪里有股本？”

“Haven't you several medicinal formulas handed down in your family?”
“你不是有几张祖传的药方子？”

Liu's expression darkened immediately.
这话一说出口，刘不才的脸色顿时就很难看了，

His smile vanished.
笑容尽敛，

“So that's what you're after!
冷冷笑道：“原来是打我这个主意！

No wonder!
怪道，

I thought it strange that someone should be kind enough to overlook my poverty and invite me into partnership.”
我说世界上还有这样子的好人，不嫌我穷，来邀我台伙！”


His words and manner angered Chen.
话和神色，都让陈世龙忍不住心头火发，

“咦！”他也很不客气地回敬：

“怪道叫你刘不才！

你晓得人家是怎么说？”

刘不才的态度变得受商量了，

何必到我面前来卖这种膏药？”

如说要邀我合伙，看中我那几张祖传秘方，请他趁早少打主意。”

你要晓得，人家并不要你的什么宝贝方子！”

将来开了药店，清他以股东的身分在店里坐镇，这几张方子上的药，请他自己修合。

何虑秘方泄漏？

原来人家不是来图谋自己的秘方，刘不才倒觉得刚才的态度，未免鲁莽，

这且不去说它！”

应该大家商量商量。”

因为你想定得高，

人家既然为了济世，自然要定得低。”

陈世龙觉得这话说得不好，便又补了一句：“再说，薄利多卖，生意才会好，

竹杠把人家敲怕了，不上你的门，药再好也无用。”

“这话也对。

不过既然薄利，我的成头要多抽些。”

陈世龙也很精明，

怎么说要多抽？”

接着他又自下转语，

一定会谈得很投机。”

用手抓着一块火腿脚爪在嘴里啃，同时一双眼珠骨碌碌地转着，见得他在心里有极周详的盘算，

Little Monk, when shall we meet?
小和尚，你说，哪天跟他碰头？

事情既然决定了，就不必耽搁，

越快越好！”

等你们见了面，有话自己谈，就没有我的事了。”

刘不才原就想开口，听陈世龙这一说，恰中下怀，

我带到杭州去。”

什么时候碰头，我明天一早来给你回音。”


Next morning Liu rose unusually early.
一夜过去，刘不才起来得特别早。

His home might be shabby, but his visiting clothes remained splendid.
他家里不象样，“出客”的衣服，依旧很漂亮，

Not only their material but even their patterns were carefully chosen.
不但料子，连花样都有讲究，

His iron-grey robe of moben satin had a subtle design of pine, bamboo, and plum.
一件铁灰摹本缎的袍子，松竹梅的暗花，

The plum blossoms were only just opening, appropriate to the morning.
梅花还只含苞初放，因为这是早晨，

For an afternoon outing, he had another robe on which they were in full bloom.
倘或下午穿出去，还有一件，那梅花就开得极盛了。

Dressed, he sat waiting for Chen's message.
打扮好了，在家坐等陈世龙的回音。

At nine, someone knocked.
到了九点钟只听有人敲门，

Opening the door himself, he was astonished to find two sedan chairs and four people: an older woman servant, a maid, an exceptionally beautiful young woman, and his own niece.
刘不才亲自去开门一看，不由得愣住了，门外两顶轿子四个人，一个老妈子，一个丫头，一个是极艳丽的少妇，还有一个是自己的侄女儿！

“Third Uncle!”
“三叔！”

Furong, wearing a red skirt, called to him.
穿着红裙的芙容，叫了一声，

Without waiting for his reply, she turned to introduce her companion.
不等他应声，便回身为那少妇引见：

“This is Mrs Yu.
“这位是郁太太，

This is my Third Uncle.”
这是我三叔！”

Mrs Yu was naturally A’qi.
郁太太自然是阿七，

With a graceful smile, she greeted him.
当时盈盈含笑地喊道：

“Third Master Liu!”
“刘三爷！”

He grew anxious.
刘不才有些发急。

He cared about appearances, and his home was in chaos.
他好面子，而家里乱六八糟，

How could he receive this radiant Mrs Yu, her hair resplendent with jewels?
如何好意思接待这位珠翠满头、艳光照人的郁太太？

Flustered, he desperately sought some way to keep them from entering.
一时有些手足无措，拚命在想，怎么样得能挡驾，不让她们进门？

Just then, Little Rabbit slipped beneath his arm.
而就在这时候，从他胁下钻出来一个人，是小兔儿！


“Sister!”
“姐姐！”

“Little Rabbit!”
“小免儿！”

Furong caught her brother in her arms, then held his face to inspect it.
芙蓉一把将她兄弟揽在怀里，接着便捧着他的脸端详了一下，

“Look how dirty you are! Your nostrils are like chimneys. I don't suppose you've washed your face for three days!” Distressed, she pulled the embroidered handkerchief from her button and wiped his nose without a thought for the cloth.
痛心地埋怨：“看你，脏得这个样子！两个鼻孔象烟囱，只怕三天没有洗过脸了！”一面说，一面扯下衣纽上的绣花手帕，毫无顾惜地为小兔儿去擦鼻子。

“Third Master Liu, forgive the intrusion,” A’qi said.
“刘三爷！冒昧得很，

“I've brought my younger sister to pay respects to her uncle.
我送我这个妹妹来见叔太爷，

请到里面坐了，好行礼！”

Suddenly the visitor had taken command.
这一下反客为主，

Liu lost his bearings, while Furong had already led Little Rabbit indoors.
刘不才枪法大乱，而芙蓉已经搀着小兔儿走了进去。

Now he had no course of his own.
到此地步，刘不才已经毫无主张，

Whatever concerned Furong must wait.
芙蓉的一切，暂时也无从去考虑，

His sole immediate task was to receive the beautiful Mrs Yu properly.
觉得眼前的唯一大事，是要打点精神来应酬这位艳丽的郁太太。

Smiling apologetically, he said, “I'm terribly sorry to trouble you.
于是他赔笑说道：“劳动郁太太，真正过意不去。

胡雪岩讲的这个故事，出在雍正年间，京城里有家小药店，

头一年冬天不冷，雪下得不多，

这家药店的主人，配了一种药，专治时气，托内务府大臣面奏皇帝，说是愿意奉送每一个举子，带入闱中，以备不时之需。

Yongzheng, an emperor keenly attentive to people's circumstances, had already been worrying about the candidates.
雍正是个最能体察人情的皇帝，本来就有些在替举子担忧，

一听这话，大为嘉许。

足见药的功效。
