“那还用说。

Little Monk, you look at people through a crack in the door!” Liu was offended.
小和尚，”刘不才不悦，“你真是门缝里看人！”

Hu had instructed Chen, and Furong had described her uncle fully.
陈世龙是受了胡雪岩的教，听了芙蓉细谈过她三叔，

Deliberately seeking to rouse Liu's resolve, Chen answered casually, “I'm not looking through a crack to make you seem small.
有意要逼刘不才发愤，因而若无其事地答道：“不是我门缝里看人，把你刘三爷看扁了，

I'm much like you myself and know this won't be easy.
只因为我也跟刘三爷差不多，知道这件事不大容易办得到，

Besides, mentioning it might hurt our friendship.
而且说出来伤感情，

That's why I have to be certain.”
所以不能不问个清楚。

He gave a calculated sigh.
唉！”他有意做作：

“Perhaps I'd better not say it.”
“想想还是不说的好！”

Liu ground his teeth but could hardly lose his temper.
刘不才气得直咬牙，但不便发作。

After restraining himself repeatedly, he managed, “Say it or don't, as you please!
忍了又忍，才说了这样一句：“说不说随便你！

I refuse to believe that I, Liu, will give you reason to despise me.”
我倒不相信我刘某人会叫你小和尚把我看轻了！”

“That's hard to say.
“这也难说。

There's one thing you may not be able to do.”
我说句话，你刘三爷就不见得做得到。”

“Tell me!”
“好，你说！”

Liu struck the table with his fist and rose, bracing both hands on it and leaning forward, looming like a mountain about to crush Chen to the floor.
刘不才用拳将桌子一捣，站起身来，双手撑桌，上身前俯，以泰山压顶之势，仿佛要把陈肚龙一下子打倒在地上似的。


“Then can you do as I've done and never enter a gambling house again?”
“那么我说，你能不能象我一样，从此不进赌场？”

At the question, Liu's body sank involuntarily back into his chair.
听得这一声，刘不才的身子不自觉地往下坐，依然坐了下来，

For a long time he could not speak.
半晌作声不得。

“Mr Hu says that only such a resolution will prove your sincerity.
“胡先生说过了，你要有这个决心。才显得是真心。

He asks nothing else.
他又说他不希望你别样，

Of fine food, clothes, brothels, and gambling, he only wants you to give up one.
‘吃着嫖赌’四个字，只希望你少一个！”陈世龙说，

In my view, if you can't abandon even that...”
“照我看，如果这一个字都不能少，那……”

Chen shook his head.
他摇摇头。

“There's no need to say more.
“不必再说，

It would sound unpleasant.”
说下去就难听了！”

Even without the words, Liu could imagine them.
他不说，刘不才也想象得到，

Indulging all four would certainly reduce him to beggary.
吃着嫖赌，四字俱全，非搞得讨饭不可！

“Mr Hu also says that gambling is a contest of minds, and business is a contest of minds too.
“胡先生又说，赌钱是赌心思，做生意也是赌心思，

Why not put your gambler's ingenuity into business?
何不把赌钱的心思，花到做生意上头来？

Once you learn its ways, you'll naturally find it interesting.
只要你生意做得入门了，自然会有趣味。

Then you won't want to gamble.”
那时就不想赌钱了！”

Liu considered in silence.
刘不才沉吟不语，

Gradually his expression changed.
但神态慢慢在变，

The flightiness, impatience, and anger faded, giving way to calm and steadiness.
飞扬浮躁，带些怒气的脸色，渐渐消失，代之而起的是平静、沉着，

At last he nodded.
最后终于点头。

“That's sound advice.”
“话不错！”

His words were clear.
他清晰地吐出来五个字：

“I'm giving up gambling!”
“我要戒赌了！”

“Congratulations!”
“恭喜，恭喜！”

Chen smiled and clasped his hands, pushing the passbook towards him again.
陈世龙笑容满面地拱手，同时仍旧把那个存折推了过来。


“Then let's discuss business.
“那么，我们谈正事。

After all this talk, how should I begin?
讲了半天，到底要我如何着手？

I want to understand.”
我要弄个明白。”

That naturally required Hu.
这自然又只有请胡雪岩来谈。

With matters settled, there was no further need to borrow Jucheng's premises.
事情到了这地步，已经无须借聚成的地方，

Hu easily persuaded Liu to come home with him, and the estrangement between uncle and niece dissolved almost without their noticing.
自然而然地，胡雪岩一邀就把他邀到了家，跟芙蓉叔侄之间的芥蒂，当然也就不知不觉地消除了。

An evening's discussion brought the undertaking into shape.
一夕之谈，谈出了头绪。

The shop would be called Hu Qingyu Hall, and Liu would take charge of preparations.
胡雪岩的药店，定名“胡庆余堂”，请刘不才负责筹备，

They agreed that he would accompany Hu to Hangzhou in three days.
约定三天以后，跟他同船回杭州，

Details could be discussed there.
细节到了杭州再谈。

“Third Uncle,” Furong urged, “you really ought to settle down.
“三叔！”芙蓉劝他，“你也真该收收心了。

If there's a suitable woman, marry her and give me a new aunt.”
有适当的人家，娶位三婶娘回来。”

“It's too early for that.”
“现在还谈不到此。”

Liu shook his head.
刘不才只是摇头，

“My whole mind is on Hu Qingyu Hall.”
“我现在的心思，完全在胡庆余堂上头。

He immediately changed the subject. “Xueyan, I think we should draw up plans and build our own premises.”
雪岩，”他马上把话题扯了开去，“我想，房子要画图样自己盖。”

“I think so too.
“我也是这么样想。

Start everything from the beginning!”
一切从头做起！”

“Exactly,” Liu replied.
“对，从头做起！”刘不才说，

“That's what I'm doing myself.”
“我自己也是这样。”


He truly began afresh.
果然，刘不才是重新做人，

During those three days, he produced a detailed plan for Hu Qingyu Hall, covering the purchase of land, construction, staffing, supplies, layout, and management.
就在这三天工夫当中，他开了个“节略”，把胡庆余堂从购地建屋到用人进货，如何布置，如何管理，都详详细细地写了下来。

Hu had never before planned a business so thoroughly.
胡雪岩做生意，还是第一次有这样周到的盘算。

Yet never before had he undertaken one on so uncertain a basis.
然而他做生意也是第一次这佯不着实。

This time the boastful man was Hu, not Liu.
如今说大话的不是刘不才，是胡雪岩，

He had spoken of raising an initial hundred thousand taels, but did not know where the money would come from.
“初步我想凑十万两银子的本钱”，这话是说出去了，银子却还不知道在什么地方？

Yu had offered to invest, yet was already supporting him to the limit of his resources.
郁四虽说过愿意加股的话，但他已倾全力支持，

Hu could hardly ask him to sell his land, and in these unsettled times property could scarcely be turned into cash anyway.
胡雪岩总不好意思要他卖田卖地来帮自己的忙，而况这个年头，兵荒马乱，不动产根本就变不成现钱。

Fortunately, no immediate payment was required.
好的是还不需要马上拿钱出来。

Hu intended to consult Wang Youling in Hangzhou.
胡雪岩的打算是，到了杭州跟王有龄商量，

A medicine shop was a sound business, with the admirable purpose of saving lives and helping people.
开药店是极稳妥的生意，又有活人济世的好名目，

Perhaps Huang Zonghan would contribute part of his well-filled official purse, investing under a member of his family's name.
说不定黄宗汉的极饱的宦囊中，肯拿出一部分来，用他家人的名义投作股本。

With Governor Huang taking the lead, finding other wealthy officials to provide the rest would be easier.
如果有黄抚台提倡，另外再找有钱的官儿来凑数，事情就容易成功了。

This was only an initial plan, aimed at getting the enterprise established.
这当然是初步打算，只求把事业办成，

There could be no talk yet of profits, much less of conducting it entirely according to Hu's ideals.
谈不到赚钱，更谈不到照自己的理想去做。

Liu never imagined these calculations.
当然，刘不才绝不会想到他肚子里是这么一把算盘，

Still enthusiastic, he talked of the shop whenever they met, all the way to Hangzhou.
依旧兴高采烈，见了面就谈药店，这样一路谈到杭州，

There Hu lodged him at the bank and assigned a young clerk to accompany him on daily outings, treating him with the greatest consideration.
胡雪岩把他安置在钱庄里，派了一个小伙计，每天陪他到各处去逛，招待得非有周到。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十九章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Nineteen, first part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER NINETEEN｜第十九章


Spending every day at leisure could not go on.
这样老是玩不是事。

What tormented Liu Bucai most was having nothing to do.
刘不才最感苦恼的是，无事可做，

His fingers itched, and he kept wanting to gamble.
手会发痒，老想赌钱，

But whenever the thought arose, he remembered what he had told Chen Shilong and fought it down.
但每一转到这个念头，随即想起自己对陈世龙说过的话，拼命压制着。

After ten days of this, he could bear it no longer.
如是十天下来，他实在忍不住了。

What he could no longer bear was waiting for Hu Xueyan to tell him something definite.
忍不住的是要胡雪岩说句话，

He waited another two days and finally caught him on the third.
等了两天，到第三天终于把胡雪岩等到了。

“Xueyan!” he said with some agitation.
“雪岩！”他有些激动，

“I’ve been here more than half a month and haven’t done a thing.
“来了半个多月，什么事也没有做，

I know you’re busy, but if this goes on I shall fall ill from boredom.”
我也晓得你事情忙，不过，这样子下去，我要闷出病来了！”

“I know, I know!
“我晓得，我晓得！

I’m terribly sorry.
实在对不起，

There were matters in several places that I had to attend to myself.
几处的事情，都非我亲自料理不可。

Most are now in hand.
现在大致有了头绪，

Above all, the transfer of cargo for sea transport has at last been settled.
尤其海运转驳，总算办妥当了。

I can spare some time.
我可以抽得出工夫来，

Tomorrow we shall begin by looking at sites.” Then Hu asked, “Third Uncle, how much can you drink?”
明天开始，我们第一步就是去看地皮。“胡雪岩问道，”三叔，你酒量怎么样？

“I can hold my own.”
““还可以对付。”

“Then let me introduce you to a friend.”
“那么，我先给你介绍一个朋友。”


The friend was Qiu Fengyan.
他介绍的是裘丰言。

He had carried out the escort of the foreign guns very efficiently.
押运洋枪的差使，裘丰言办得很妥当，

Wang Youling had given him a sum of money and praised him warmly, so he had lately been in excellent spirits.
王有龄送了他一笔钱，看实夸奖了一番，所以他最近的心境极好，

He and Liu took to one another at once.
跟刘不才一见如故，

Moreover, Hu had asked Qiu to look after him, and Qiu made a special effort to please.
加以受了胡雪岩的委托，刻意敷衍，

Liu felt that acquiring such a friend was something to be happy about.
因而刘不才也觉得交了裘丰言这个朋友，是件很可以叫人高兴的事。

Qiu therefore undertook to accompany him in looking at land.
陪着看地皮的事，便由裘丰言来承当，

Every morning they began with tea at a teahouse by Fengle Bridge.
每天一早到丰乐桥茶馆里喝茶。

Qiu had lived in Yangzhou and was particular about his morning meal.
裘丰言在扬州住过，早晨这一顿很讲究，

He ordered two stir-fried dishes to go with his early wine, followed by noodles.
炒两个菜吃早酒，酒罢吃面，

Then a broker led them out to inspect sites.
然后由赔客领着去看地皮，

Some were too small; elsewhere they could not agree on the price.
有的嫌小，有的价钱不合，

By the time they had weighed one consideration against another, it was three in the afternoon, and Qiu wanted tea and wine again.
这样一番折中下来，到了下午三点钟，裘丰言又要喝茶吃酒了。

With his company, Liu was no longer so bored.
刘不才因为有他作陪，不如以前那样无聊，

The days passed peaceably, and his desire to gamble subsided.
倒也相安无事，把想赌的念头歇了下来。


One morning Hu unexpectedly came to see Liu and began, “Third Uncle, I need you to entertain a guest.
突然间有一天，胡雪岩一大早来找刘不才，第一句话就是：“三叔，我要请你陪一位客，

He knows everything about women, gambling, fine food and clothes.
这位客嫖赌吃着，无所不精，

You are the only man who can keep him company.”
只有你可以陪他。”

For a moment Liu could not answer.
刘不才一时开不得口，

First, the request was unexpected.
第一，觉得突兀，

Second, it contradicted Hu’s original intention: he had wanted Liu to give up gambling, and now was asking him to gamble.
第二，觉得胡雪岩违反了他自己的来意，本来要求人家戒赌的，此刻倒转头来，请人去赌，

Third, Liu had promised to stop and had actually done so.
第三，觉得自己说了戒赌，而且真的已经戒掉，

To break that resolution now, throwing away his hard-won determination and self-control, seemed a pity.
却又开戒，这番来之不易的决心和毅力，轻易付之东流，未免可惜。

“Third Uncle,” Hu said seriously, “have no misgivings.
“三叔！”胡雪岩正色说道，“你心里不要嘀咕，

This is precisely where I need your help.
这些地方就是我要请你帮忙的。

To put it plainly, I am making use of your strengths.”
说得再痛快一点，这也就是我用你的长处。”

There was nothing more to say.
那就没话好说了，

“If it will help you, of course I shall do it.
“既然是帮你的忙，我自然照办。”

But first you must explain what it is all about.”
刘不才问，“不过是怎么一回事，你先得跟我说清楚。”

Hu hesitated.
胡雪岩略微踌躇了一下，

“It is a long story, with complications I cannot explain in a moment.”
“说来话长，其中有点曲折，一时也说不清楚。”

He paused.
他停了停又说：

“In a word, if we keep this young gentleman amused, it will be a great help to my business.”
“总而言之一句话，除这位公子哥儿玩得高兴了，对我的生意大有帮助。”

“Mm, I understand.
“嗯，嗯！我懂了，

You want me to be his companion and entertainer?”
你要请我做清客？”

“Not a dependent companion—a wealthy guest.
“不是做清客，是做阔客。

Of course, a wealthy guest who also entertains him will be all the more effective!”
当然，以阔客做这位公子哥儿的清客，不就更加够味道了！”

Only now did Liu truly understand.
这一下，刘不才方始真的懂了，

Nodding gravely, he said, “Provided you don’t mind the expense, I know how to play the rich man, and how to make friends with rich men.”
点点头很沉重地道：“只要你不心疼，摆阔我会，结交阔客我也会。”


“Of course!
“自然！

Why should I mind the expense?
怎么谈得到心疼的话？

Third Uncle, what is the most you have ever lost at one sitting?”
三叔，”胡雪岩问，“你一场赌，最多输过多少？”

“I once lost...” Liu said.
“输过……”刘不才说，

“I lost a pawnshop.
“输过一爿当店，

Not a large one.
规模不大，

It was worth thirty thousand taels.”
折算三万银子。”

“Good.
“好的，

You have seen high play.
你经过大场面。

That will do.
那就行了！”

Have no worries: I can put thirty or fifty thousand taels in ready silver into your hands.
胡雪岩说，“你不必顾虑，三五万银子，我捧现银给你，

More would be no trouble either.
再多也不要紧，

I can raise it whenever it is needed.
我随时都调得动。

Losing does not matter.
总之，输不要紧，

What matters is never to look small-minded or mean.”
千万不能露出小家子气的样子来！”

“You can trust me there.
“这你放心好了，

At the gaming table my nerve is second to none.” They agreed that Hu would return that afternoon and accompany him to meet the young gentleman, bringing banknotes then.
赌上头，我的胆子最大。”当时约定，胡雪岩下午来陪他去结交那位公子哥儿，银票在那时带来。

Liu went off in high spirits to have his head shaved and dressed himself as an elegant man of the world, then sat waiting.
刘不才便也精神抖擞地去剃了头，打扮成个翩翩浊世公子的样子，在那里坐等。

Shortly after noon Hu returned.
午后不久，胡雪岩又来了，

Liu wore a grey-squirrel fur robe faced with iron-grey satin, a maroon Baturu waistcoat, and a little black satin cap with a coral knot on top and a piece of green jade carved with the longevity character at the front.
看刘不才穿的是铁灰色缎面的灰鼠皮袍，枣红色巴图鲁坎肩，头戴一顶珊瑚结子的玄色缎子的小帽，正中镶着一块寿字纹的碧玉。

There was a snow-white spun-silk jacket, crisply fitted trousers bound at the ankles, and a pair of double-ridged Zhangzhou velvet shoes.
雪白的纺绸褂子，下面是笔挺的扎脚裤和一双漳绒的双梁鞋。

“Splendid!
“漂亮得很！

I have brought two things that will go perfectly with your clothes.”
我有两样东西带了来，正好配你这一身打扮。”

One was a gold repeating watch on a very thick gold chain; the other, a thumb ring of mutton-fat white jade.
那两佯东西是一个金打簧表，带着恨极粗的金链子，一个羊脂白玉的班指。

There were also twenty thousand taels in banknotes, none smaller than five hundred taels.
另外有两万银票，起码是五百两一张。


“It is still early.
“时候还早，

Let me tell you who this rich young gentleman is.”
我先把这个阔少的来历告诉你。”

His surname was Pang.
这位阔少姓庞，

Hu had met him during his two days in Nanxun, and everyone called him Second Master Pang.
是胡雪岩到南得去的那两夭认识的，大家都叫他庞二爷。

His family had been in the silk trade for generations, accumulating wealth; then, when foreign trade opened late in the Daoguang reign, they had made large profits in the export business.
这位庞二爷是丝业世家，几代蓄积，再加上道光末年中外通商，在洋庄上很赚了些，

Even if their fortune did not rival a state’s, its depth was far beyond what outsiders imagined.
所以虽不是富堪敌国，而殷厚之处，远非外人所能想象。

Second Master Pang was an idler of the first rank, but his family upbringing had given him a thorough knowledge of business.
庞二爷虽然是一等一的纨袴，但家学渊源，做生意极其在行，

That was why Hu wanted to deal with him.
此所以胡雪岩要跟他打交道。

He had purchased the rank of circuit intendant, though naturally he would never wait at an official headquarters for an appointment or an assignment.
庞二爷是个捐班的道台，自然不会“辕门听鼓”去候补等差使，

He did not ordinarily wear official dress.
平常也不穿官服，

But if any prefectural or county official put on airs before him, Pang could outdo them all in official grandeur.
但如果有什么州县官在他面前，以官派骄人，那一下他摆出来的官派，比什么人都足，

That alone showed his character: he could be won by courtesy, but never bullied.
就从这一点上，把庞二爷吃软不吃硬的性情，完全显出来了。

So that was the man!
原来是他！

Liu listened and considered.
刘不才一面听，一面心里在想。

As a fellow Huzhou man, he naturally knew of Second Master Pang, but among wealthy young gentlemen he himself had stood at least two grades lower.
同是湖州人，他自然知道庞二爷，不过论“少爷班子”的等级，刘不才起码要比他差两等。

Now he had fallen on hard times as well.
而且现在已经“落薄”了，

To be introduced as “the third son of the old Liu Jingde Hall family” was hardly glorious.
提起来，说是“当年刘敬德堂的老三”，这句话并不见得光彩，

He could not help wondering beforehand what Pang would think.
庞二爷心里作何感想，却不能不预先顾虑。


“Third Uncle,” Hu continued, “to draw Second Master Pang closer, I specially asked Prefect Wang to give this party.
“三叔，”胡雪岩接下来说，“为了拉拢庞二爷，我特地托王大老爷出面请客，

He is your district’s governing official.
他是你们湖州的父母官，

However busy Pang may be, he cannot refuse.
庞二爷再忙也不能不到。

Today is only a dinner, so the gaming will not be on a very large scale—just some mahjong.
不过今天只是为了请客吃饭，‘场头，拉不大，只不过打打麻将。

You must show your skill and make him want a second game with you after the first.
你要拿本事出来，让他跟你赌过一场，还愿意跟你赌第二场，

That is how the friendship will grow.”
这样子交情才可以越拉越拢。”

“I understand.
“我晓得了。

You can rely on me for that.
这一点你放心！

But...”
不过，”

Liu found it difficult to say.
刘不才很吃力地说，

“We have never met, and he spends most of his time in Shanghai, but he probably knows who I am.”
“我们虽没有会过，他是在上海的时候多，大概总也晓得我这个人。”

“That does not matter.
“ 晓得也不要紧，

A prodigal who reforms is worth more than gold.
‘败子回头金不换，，

Nobody will laugh at you.
没有哪个笑话你！

Besides, I have spoken to Prefect Wang.
再说，我跟王大老爷关照过了，

He will treat you with particular courtesy.
对你会特别客气，

With the host showing you such respect, nobody will be able to fathom your circumstances.”
有主人抬举着，人家也识不透你的底细。”

Hearing this, Liu looked down at his finery and then at the twenty thousand taels in notes.
刘不才听了他的话，看一看自己那身装柬，再看一看那两万银票，

His outlook changed.
想法变过了，

Everything else might be a pretence, but money was real.
什么都可以假，银子不假，

Money gave a man courage.
钱就是胆，

What was there to fear?
怕什么！

“You are right, Xueyan.”
“雪岩，你的话不错。”

His spirits rose.
他精神抖擞地问，

“When do we leave?”
“我们什么时候走？”

He opened the repeating watch.
说着，便打开那只打簧表，

It was only two in the afternoon.
一看才午后两点钟。

“We are expected at four.
“约的是四点，

Naturally I must arrive early.
我自然要早到。

Rest a little longer and come to Mr Wang’s residence at the appointed time.”
你再养养神，准时到王公馆好了。”

Hu left a slip of paper bearing the address.
胡雪岩留下一张纸条，上面写着王家的地址。

With this agreed, they parted.
约定了各自分手。

Liu duly reclined on a couch and closed his eyes, carefully considering Pang’s temperament and how best to approach him.
刘不才果然靠在一张软榻上，闭目养神，把庞二爷的脾气作了一番很周详的考虑，然后又细想应付的态度。

Feeling fairly confident, he opened his eyes cheerfully, made a few further adjustments to his appearance and hired a small chair to take him to the party.
自己觉得颇有把握，欣然睁眼，重新又修饰了一番，方始雇一顶小轿，专程赴约。


At the Wang residence the host was indeed most courteous, addressing him at every turn as “Brother Sancai.”
到了王家，主人果然很客气，口口声声称他“三才兄”，

They sat exchanging civilities while the other guests arrived.
坐下寒暄了一阵，请的客人陆续都到了，

Apart from Ji Heling and Qiu Fengyan, there were two wealthy young men.
除了嵇鹤龄和裘丰言，另外两个都是阔少，

One was Zhou Wu, fifth in his family and a younger brother of the former Tianjin customs intendant.
一个是做过天津海关道的周道台的弟弟，行五，

The other was Gao Si, the fourth son of a family whose members combined official service with commerce.
一个是亦官亦商的高家老四。

Their conversation had no serious purpose.
坐下来言不及义，

Either they spoke of how much they had lost at pai gow, or of some extraordinary beauty newly appeared aboard the Jiangshan pleasure boats.
不是说一顿牌九输了多少，就是谈“江山船”上出了怎么样的一个尤物。

Second Master Pang arrived last.
最后，庞二爷到了，

He was thirty-four or thirty-five, with a broad, pale face like a silver basin, resembling Cao Cao on the stage.
三十四五岁年纪，一张银盆大脸，赛似戏台上的曹操。

His grandfather had recently died, so mourning restrictions obliged him to wear a plain grey-cloth robe lined with sheepskin.
因为祖父死了不久，有限制在身，只穿一件灰布羊皮袍，

Yet on his hand was an “oil diamond” ring full of fire.
但手上戴一只翻头十足的“火油钻”戒指，

He wore the stone turned inwards; whenever he raised his hand, flashes from his palm caught the eye all the more.
戒面朝里，偶尔扬手之间，掌中光芒乱闪，格外引人注目。

The host made the introductions.
主人一一引见，

Only Ji, Qiu and Liu were new acquaintances for Pang.
庞二爷初见面的只是嵇鹤龄、裘丰言和刘不才。

Hearing Liu’s Huzhou accent, he warmed to him.
听到他是胡州口音，便觉亲热，

“Brother Liu,” he asked, “where do you live?
“刘三哥，”他问，“你府上哪里？

How is it that we have never met?”
我怎么没育见过？”

Liu gave his address.
刘不才声明住处，

“I have long heard of you, Second Master Pang.
接着又说：“久仰庞二爷的大名，

I am delighted to make your acquaintance.”
幸会之至。”

“The pleasure is mutual.”
“彼此，彼此！”

Pang was courteous, without the airs of a grand young idler. “Come, come!” cried the impatient Zhou.
庞二也很客气，不象有架子的纨袴.“喂，喂！”周老五性子最急，

“Time to play!”
“该上场了！”

Their host led them into a side room, where a mahjong table had been prepared.
于是主子引寻，进入厢房，里面已摆好一桌麻将牌在那里，

They stood discussing who should join.
站着商议入局，

Pang, Zhou and Gao were obvious choices.
庞、周、高三人是用不着说的，

For the fourth place, the host deferred to Ji, Ji to Liu, and Liu to Hu.
剩下一个搭子，主人让嵇鹤龄，嵇鹤龄让刘不才，刘不才让胡雪岩，

Hu declined, settling the matter: Liu would play.
胡雪岩一推辞，便即定局，仍由刘不才上场。


They drew seats and agreed on “one-two” mahjong, a base stake of ten thousand taels, a forty-point base score and sixteen rounds.
扳好位于坐定，讲好一万银子一底的“幺二”，四十和底十六圈，

Soon the tiles were clattering.
随即噼噼啪啪打了起来。

Liu was in no hurry to go out; first he studied the others’ play.
刘不才先不忙着和牌，细看各人的牌路，

Pang and Gao were both highly skilful, but Gao had one weakness: he liked building elaborate hands.
庞二和高四都打得很精，但高四有个毛病，喜欢做牌，

Zhou played as impatiently as he did everything else, taking any winning hand, large or small.
周五打牌跟他的脾气一样，性子急，不问大小，见牌就和，

Once he needed only one tile, he turned his tiles face down and stared into the pool of discards as though longing to snatch out the one he wanted.
一等张便把脾扣了下来，两眼瞪着“湖”里，恨不得拣一张来和牌似地。

Yet bad player though he was, luck favoured him.
然而牌虽打得蹩脚，手气却是他好。

In four rounds he made two all-one-suit hands and a Three Dragons hand.
四圈牌下来，和了两副清一色，一副三元，

He had won nearly a full base stake and was delighted.
已经赢了将近一底，把他高兴得不得了。

“All because Gao insists on building big hands and discards so freely,” Pang said coolly as he threw the dice to change seats.
“这都是老四做牌做得太厉害，张子太松！”庞二一面掷骰子扳位，一面冷冷地说，

“If you sit below me this time, watch out!”
“这回圈如果你坐我下家，可要当心一点儿！”

As it turned out, Liu sat immediately before Zhou, with Gao before him and Pang opposite.
结果刘不才坐了周五的上家，他的上家是高四，跟庞二对面。

Gao persisted in his old habit: if seven of his thirteen tiles belonged to the same suit, he aimed for an all-one-suit hand.
高四老脾气不改，十三张牌只要七张花色一样，就想做清一色，

His discards were therefore still generous.
所以张子仍旧很松。

Liu decided he must not claim too many of them.
刘不才心想，不能多吃，

Otherwise his own discards would become loose, allowing Zhou to profit; once Zhou’s luck gained momentum, it would be hard to check.
不然自己的张子也会松，让周五捡了便宜，手风一上去就很难制了。

He refused even tiles that would complete an edge or a gap in a sequence and concentrated on the player after him, keeping Zhou firmly pinned down.
打定这个主意，连边嵌都不吃，全神贯注在下家，把周五钉得死死地，

Within two rounds, Zhou had lost half his winnings.
两圈牌下来，周五“氽”出去一半，

But Pang, the heaviest loser, had made no recovery.
但大输家的庞二却并无起色。

Liu now decided that besides restraining Zhou, he must help Pang win.
于是刘不才又想，现在不但要扣住周五，还得想办法让庞二和牌才好。

He played so well that a little attention to the tiles Pang drew and discarded showed him what Pang needed.
他的牌打得极精，稍微注意一下进出张子，就能料到庞二要的牌，

Just as Pang reached a waiting hand, Liu would discard the winning tile.
总是在他刚听张的时候“放铳”。

Pang went out twice in succession; his luck turned and he recovered his losses.
庞二连着和了两副，手风一顺扳了回去。

When they stopped for dinner after eight rounds and counted up, three were winning from one.
等八圈下来吃饭，计算一下，成了三吃一的局面，

Gao was the heavy loser.
大输家是高四。


“You play extremely well,” Pang told Liu as they left the table.
“老兄的牌打得很高明。”下了牌桌，庞二这样对刘不才说，

“And I admire your conduct at play still more.”
“牌品更是佩服之至。”

“You are too kind!”
“哪里，哪里！”

Liu was gratified, and felt some admiration in return: Pang was a man who appreciated a favour.
刘不才觉得很安慰，同时也有些佩服庞二，是个识好歹的人。

After dinner Pang’s luck grew stronger.
到了饭后，庞二的手风转旺了，

Whenever he became dealer he retained the position, and his winning hands grew larger.
逢庄必连，牌也越和越大，

This too owed something to Liu.
这也要归功刘不才，

He no longer fed Pang winning tiles, but concentrated on holding Zhou and Gao back, particularly preventing either from making a big hand.
但他已下再放张子，只是专门扣住周、高二人，尤其是不让他们俩和大牌，

At any sign of danger, he either went out quickly himself or let someone else win a small hand.
一看风色不对，不是自己抢和，就是放人家和小牌。

By the final reckoning, Pang was the great winner and Zhou the great loser.
等到打完结帐，庞二一家大赢，周五一家大输。

“Always the same—win first, lose afterwards!” Zhou said bitterly. “Losing is nothing, but the tiles are infuriating.
“每次都是这样，先赢后输，输倒不要紧，牌真气人！”周五恨恨地说，

That is why I dislike mahjong.
“所以我不喜欢打麻将！

There is no pleasure in it.”
真没意思。”

Pang and Gao, accustomed to this performance, merely exchanged smiles.
庞二和高四是看惯了他这副样子，相视而笑，不说什么，

Liu spoke.
刘不才却开口了：

“Brother Zhou is impatient.
“周五哥的性子急，

Pai gow would suit him better.”
推牌九就配胃口了！”

“Exactly!
“对！”

Let me take the bank.”
周五接着说道：“我来推个庄！”


Gao was willing either way, and Liu said nothing.
高四无可无不可，刘不才也不作声，

Only Pang hesitated.
只有庞二迟疑着说：

“Isn’t it too late?
“太晚了吧？

We ought not impose on our host.”
打搅主人不方便。

“Not at all!” Hu answered for Wang.
““不晚，不晚！”胡雪岩代表主人答话，

“Please enjoy yourselves.
“各位尽管尽兴，

Shall we have supper before playing, or...”
是吃了消夜再上场，还是……”

“Too early for supper,” Zhou broke in.
“吃消夜还早。”周五抢着说道，

“Let me bank a game first.”
“等我先推个庄再说。”

Pang knew his temper.
庞二深知他的脾气，

If Zhou took the bank, win or lose he would not stop before daylight.
若是他做庄，不管输赢，不见天光不散，

Pang therefore spoke at once.
因而紧接着他的话说：

“We are all friends.
“都是自己人，

Let us keep it modest.
小玩玩。

We can rotate the bank, playing big or small pai gow as you please, with ten thousand taels to each bank.
这样好了，推‘轮庄牌九’，大小随意，一万两银子一庄，

Lose it all and give way; even a winning banker may play only four sets.”
输光让位，赢的也只能推四方。”

“Four is too few.
“四方太少了，

At least eight.”
起码要八方。”

“Come now.
“算了，

Four each makes sixteen sets.
四四十六牌九推下来，

After that, we can enjoy our host’s supper and go home to bed.”
扰了主人的消夜，回家睡觉正好。”

“Quite right,” Gao agreed.
“这话不错。”高四也说，

“I have business tomorrow morning.
“明天上半天，我还有事，

Let us finish early.”
早些散吧！”


Zhou could not carry the argument alone and had to agree.
周五孤掌难鸣，只得依从。

When the dominoes appeared, Zhou naturally banked first.
等把牌拿出来，自然是他第一个做庄，

From his clothes he produced an ivory case shaped like a bean pod, slid off its lid and tipped out four dice.
掏出随身携带的一个豆荚样的象牙盒，抽开盖子倒出四粒骰子来。

He had many little rituals.
周五的花样很多，

He threw all four until they showed a four and a five, then removed the red die.
四粒骰子一掷，要有一个四，一个五，才把红的那粒拣出来，

He threw the other three until he obtained a four and a six, and only then would he use the red one. Four and five made nine, which sounded like the word for wine; six and four made ten, made to sound like meat.
余下三粒再掷，掷出一个四，一个六，才用红的那粒四加五是九，谐音为“酒”，六加四是十，谐音为“肉”，

He called it “treating the dice to wine and meat.”
说是“请骰子吃酒吃肉”。

“Mahjong should be quiet, but pai gow needs a lively crowd,” he announced loudly. “Everyone must join in.
“麻将要打得清静，牌九要赌得热闹，请大家都来玩！”周五大声说道，

You can bet even a single tael.”
“一两银子也可以下注。”

Qiu had not yet left.
这时袭丰言还没有走，

Liu gave him two hundred taels of “luck money” so that he could place bets of five or ten.
刘不才分了二百两“红钱”给他，让他五两、十两押着玩。

Wang was persuaded to play too.
王有龄也被请了下场，

Hu disliked gambling, but naturally had to contribute to the fun.
胡雪岩虽不喜欢赌钱，但此时当然要助兴，

Taking a hundred-tael note, he placed it on the upper gate, where Pang sat.
取了一张一百两的银票，押在庞二所坐的上门。

“Big pai gow or small?” Pang asked.
“是大，是小？”庞二问说。

“You’ll know when I open the hands.”
“看我‘开门’就知道了。”

With Zhou’s temperament, it was bound to be small pai gow, where the whole issue was settled at a single turn of the tiles.
依周五的性格，开出“门”来，自是“一翻两瞪眼”的小牌九。

His bank lasted only two sets before Pang and Gao broke it.
他这个庄只推了两方牌九，就让庞二和高四把他打坍了。

Pang banked next and went through his four sets without much gain or loss.
接下来是庞二推庄，四方牌九，平平而过。

Zhou, however, lost over ten thousand more.
周五却又输了一万多，

Gao was the chief winner, while Liu won five or six thousand taels.
大赢家是高四，刘不才也赢了五六千银子。


Liu was the third banker.
第三个庄家是刘不才，

Rolling up his snow-white cuffs, he shuffled and stacked the dominoes.
他卷起雪白的袖头，洗牌砌好，

As he opened the hands, he said, “Since Brother Zhou likes small pai gow, I shall play that too.”
一面开门一面说：“周五哥喜欢小牌九，我也推小的。”

Zhou’s temper was rising with his losses.
周五赌得火气上来了，

“Exactly!
一听他的话，脱口答道：“对！

‘In spring, never ask the way.’
‘春天不问路’，

I’m sitting at Heaven’s Gate, so that is the gate I’ll back.”
坐天门就打天门。”

He pulled a sheaf of notes from his clothes and slapped them on the table.
说着，从身上掏出一叠银票，往桌上一摔，

“I’ll take the whole stake!”
“我包了！”

“Come now!”
“嗐！”

Pang objected sharply.
庞二大不以为然，

“We are all here to enjoy ourselves.
“大家好玩嘛！

What pleasure is there if you leave nobody else room to bet?”
你这样子不让别人下注，多没意思！”

“Why not?
“怎么叫没意思，

Each man can play his own game.
各人赌各人的，

If you fancy your lower gate, shift my stake over to it.
你要看得你下门好，你可以移我的注码，

Isn’t that just as good?”
不是照样赌？”

“Shifting stakes” meant that players at the side gates gambled against one another.
“移注码”是旁家跟旁家做输赢，

If the banker won from all or paid all, the person who had shifted a bet was unaffected.
如果统吃统赔，移注改押的人毫无干系，

But if one gate won and another lost, the difference was considerable.
倘或一家配、一家吃，那出入就大了。

In pai gow and dice-shaking games, some players particularly liked shifting other people’s bets.
牌九、摇摊，专有人喜欢移别人的注码，

If the original gate lost and theirs won, they won from both banker and fellow player, doubling their profit.
彼吃此配，赢了庄家赢旁家，双倍得利，

They could also congratulate themselves on their judgment, which was very satisfying.
而且还可自诩眼力，是件很得意的事。

But shifting stakes often became a contest of pride.
但“移注码”往往会变成闹意气，

One man shifted a stake across; the other shifted it back.
一个移过去，一个移回来，

Back and forth it went, each move doubling the gain or loss at issue, until the gambling grew wild.
一个再移过去，一个再移回来，每移动一次，就加了双倍的输赢，那就赌得“野”了。

Zhou and Pang were now showing signs of such a quarrel.
现在周五跟庞二就有点闹意气的模洋。

When gambling spoiled the harmony, others naturally had to intervene.
赌钱失欢，旁人自然要排解，

But both were wealthy young gentlemen who could afford to lose money and could not endure losing a single word of argument.
但两个人都是阔少，银钱吃亏可以，话上吃不得一句亏，

Making peace was difficult, and Hu grew anxious.
所以要排解也很难，胡雪岩不免有些着急。


Just as Pang, beginning to lose his temper, was about to shift Zhou’s stake by declaring that Heaven’s Gate must follow the lower gate, Liu spoke first.
就在这庞二爷有些光火，要想说“天门归下门看”，移周五的注码时，刘不才抢先一步，开口说道：

“Brother Pang is quite right.
“庞二哥的话不错，

We are all friends.
都是自己人，

This is only a friendly parlour game...”
‘书房赌’，小玩玩……”

As expected, the hot-tempered Zhou interrupted.
果然，脾气暴躁的周五打断他的话说：

“What sort of thing is that for the banker to say?
“你庄家说的什么话？

Tell me—if he is right, am I wrong?”
倒要请教，他的话不错，我的话错？”

“You are right too,” Liu answered calmly.
“你的话也不错。”刘不才神色从容地答道，

“And Brother Pang need not shift any stakes.
“庞二哥也不必动注码了。

Since Brother Zhou is keen to play, I ought to oblige him.
周五哥有兴趣，我做庄的理当奉陪，

How about a private side bet of ten thousand taels?”
‘外插花’赌一万银子好不好？

It was Qiu who cried, “Good!
“说“好”的是裘丰言：“好！

That satisfies both sides.”
这样子就两全其美了。”

A separate wager between the banker and another player was nobody else’s concern.
庄家跟旁家额外“做交易”，谁也不能管，

There could be no reasonable objection.
道理上是说得过去的。

With ten thousand taels Liu had given both men a way to save face.
刘不才花一万银子，把面子卖了给两个人，

It was skilfully done, and the money was not necessarily lost.
这一手做得很漂亮，而那一万银子，也还不一定会输。

Hu silently approved.
胡雪岩暗暗心许，

Liu certainly knew how to handle a social occasion.
刘不才在应酬场中，果然有一套。


The dice showed seven.
骰子掷了个七点，

Zhou seized the two dominoes dealt on the outside and turned them up.
周五抢起分在外面的那两张牌一翻，

Now he truly stared: an Ox-head and a Three–Six.
真是瞪眼了！一张牛头、一张三六。

His face turned livid with anger.
把他气得脸色铁青。

“What do they call that?” Qiu said.
“这叫什么？”裘丰言说，

“I heard a saying in Songjiang: ‘A black devil shouldering a foreign rifle!’”
“我上次到松江听来的一句话，叫做‘黑鬼子抗洋枪’！”

He spoke without a smile, in complete seriousness, so it did not sound like mockery.
他是不带笑容，一本正经地在说，便无调侃的意味，

Everyone laughed, and Zhou laughed too.
大家都笑，周五也笑了。

The banker swept all the gates.
这一牌是统吃。

Liu could have put aside the ten thousand taels won on the private side bet, recovering his original stake and making the rest of his bank pure profit with nothing left to lose.
那“外插花”的一万两银子，刘不才原可以另外收起，等于赌本已经收回，这一庄变成有赢无输，

Instead, with a fine gesture, he left it in play.
但他很漂亮，放在外面，

He counted the money and announced the total—twenty-seven thousand taels—so that the other players could judge how much to bet.
数一下，报个数，是两万七，好让旁家斟量下注。


His bank was steady, taking more than it paid and showing a gain on every deal.
他这个庄很稳，吃多配少，每把牌都有进帐，

By the third deal of the third set, custom called for omitting the final deal and shuffling again.
推到第三方第三条，照例末条不推，重新洗牌，

Instead, Liu offered to play on.
他却“放盘”了。

“Only one set remains,” he said.
“只有一方牌了！”他说，

“I’ll play the last deal.
“我推末条，

Place your bets quickly!”
要打尽快！”

“My friend,” Pang cautioned him, “the remaining tiles favour the lower gate.
“老兄，”庞二劝他，“ ‘下活’的牌，

You had better leave this deal alone.”
这一条你还是不推的好！”

“Thank you for the warning.
“多谢关照！”

But that is the pleasure of banking at pai gow.
刘不才说，“推牌九的味道就在这上头，

If the dice help, the banker alone may have the high hand and sweep everything in.
骰子帮忙，‘独大拎进’！

It happens often enough.”
也是常有的。”

“Then let’s try it!
“那就试试看！

I don’t believe the lower gate will come up empty.”
我倒不相信下门会‘活抽’。”

Zhou took out another handful of notes.
周五又摸出一把银票，

“How much has the banker?”
“庄家有多少？”

Liu counted: forty thousand taels in all.
刘不才点了点数，一共是四万银子。

“Let everything follow the lower gate.”
“统归下门看。”

Zhou put his notes there.
周五拿银票往下门一放，

“I’ll take whatever remains.”
“多下的是我的。”

Everyone grew tense.
这一下大家都紧张了。

There were no draws in small pai gow.
小牌九是没有“和气”的，

On this one deal, the banker would either turn his forty thousand into eighty thousand or lose everything and surrender the bank.
这一牌，庄家不是由四万变八万，就是输光让位。

It was the largest single wager of the evening.
从赌到现在，这是最大的一笑输赢，

So much money changing hands commanded even Pang’s close attention.
一进一出不是小数，连庞二都很注意了。


Liu’s face and voice remained unchanged as he cast the dice.
刘不才声色不动，把骰子掷了出去，

The three gates showed their hands: the upper gate had nine points, Heaven’s Gate seven, and the lower gate a Heaven tile with a Red Nine.
等三门摊牌，上门九点，天门七点，下门天牌配红九，

They had agreed that this combination would count as one point, not as the special Heaven Nine hand.
讲好不作天九作一点。

“You see?
“你们看，

The lower gate is the live one!” Zhou declared, with something of bravado covering unease.
下活嘛！”周五有些色厉内荏的神气，

“One hand overcomes the next.
“一副克一副，

What else would you call it?”
不是下活是什么？”

“Live it may be, but the point count is too small,” Pang replied.
“下活是下活，点子大小了！”庞二说道，

“The last deal often produces strange hands.
“末条常会出怪牌，

A full bowl of rice is easy to swallow, Old Five; a mouthful of boasting is harder.”
老五，满饭好吃，满话难说。”

“Any points will bring money!”
“有点子就有钱！”

Zhou persisted.
周五索性硬到底了，

“If this hand loses, I’ll eat the dominoes.”
“这副牌再输，我把牌吃下去。”

The enormous wager was interesting enough.
不要说是巨额赌注的本身，引人瞩目，

But Zhou’s boast, which might make the outcome impossible to manage, fascinated everyone in the room, from the players seated at the table to the servants and maids standing beside them.
光是周五这句可能会搞得无法收场的话，就使得一屋子的人，从坐在赌桌上的到站在旁边伺候的听差丫头，无不大感兴味，

All longed to see what the banker would turn up.
渴望着看看庄家的那两张牌，翻出来是什么点子？

A Mixed Seven and a Mixed Five would make an ordinary two-point hand, enough to beat the lower gate’s one-point Heaven Nine.
倘或是一张杂七、一张杂五凑成的“无名二”就赢了下门的“天九一”，

What an expression Zhou would wear then, after his sweeping claim!
那时看说了“满话”的周五，是何尴尬的神色。

Yet nobody, not even Pang, expected what happened.
但包括庞二在内，谁也没有想到，

Liu did not turn over his dominoes at all.
刘不才根本就不翻牌，

“Brother Zhou, you are right.
“周五哥！”他说，“不错，

Your single point is worth a great deal.”
你的一点很值钱。”

With a calm, natural smile, he pushed the money forward.
说着，他把面前的钱推了出去，脸上带着平静自然的笑容，

He seemed to lose to Zhou entirely willingly—indeed, almost to have defeated him.
竟象心甘情愿地输给周五，而更象自己赢了周五。


By now Pang liked Liu very much and sided with him at every turn.
庞二此时对刘不才已大有好感，所以处处偏向着他，

“You haven’t even looked at your tiles!” he reminded him.
“你牌还没有看！”他提醒他，

“Can you really fail to beat one point?”
“真的一点都会赶不上？”

“All the other tiles are out,” Liu said.
“牌都在外面。”刘不才说，

“There is no need to look.
“用不着看了，

One point loses to one point.”
一点输一点，”

“I don’t believe it.” Pang began sorting through the exposed tiles, starting with the highest “Treasure” combination.
“我倒不相信。”庞二说着，就动手理牌，从最大的“宝子”理起，

He found a Two–Four but no Ding tile.
找到一张二四，却找不到“幺丁”，

If the banker’s one point lost to the other one point, his hand ought to be a Man-and-Ding One. Pang searched for the Man tiles.
既然说是一点输一点，那么庄家应该是一副“人丁一”找人牌，

Sure enough, only one was there.
果然只有一张。

When the banker’s tiles were turned over, there it was: a Man-and-Ding One.
翻出来，可不是“人丁一”？

Ten red spots made the single black spot stand out all the more sharply.
十个红点，衬得那里黑的一点格外触目。

The silent room erupted in regret and laughter, astonishment and exclamations.
极静的屋子里，立刻晌起一片喧哗，叹惜和笑声、惊异和感叹，

Naturally, Zhou was the loudest.
自然声音最大的是周五。

“Come, come!
“来，来，

I’ll make the payments.”
归我来配！”

He drew the bank’s money and his own notes in front of him, paid the smaller wagers and kept the remainder as his winnings.
他把庄家的钱和自己的银票，都携到面前，配完了小注，余下的便是他的盈余。

“To think there really was such a hand!”
“真有这样的牌！”

Pang shook his head.
庞二摇摇头，

“He couldn’t even turn up two points.”
“就翻不出一个两点。”

He regretted the banker’s loss so keenly that he almost resented it.
他替庄家遗憾，甚至引为恨事，

Liu, however, behaved as though nothing had happened and pushed the dominoes towards Gao.
刘不才却若无其事地，把牌推向高四，

This was the last bank.
这是最后一庄，

Its four sets also passed without much gain or loss.
推完四方，也是平平而过。

Their host then invited everyone into the hall for supper.
于是主人招呼到厅上吃消夜，

As they ate and talked, the conversation inevitably returned to Liu’s hand.
一面吃一面谈，不知不觉又谈到刘不才的那副牌。


“You have a remarkable eye,” Pang said.
“你老兄的眼光真厉害。”庞二说，

“You saw at once that a Man tile and a Ding were missing.
“一下子就看到了外面少一张人牌，少一张‘钉子’，

That is a skill one cannot acquire in three or five years.”
这点道行，倒也不是三年、五年了。”

“Old Liu is a man of real quality,” even Zhou admitted.
“老刘是个角色。”连周五都心服，

“Losing to you is a pleasure.
“跟你赌，输了也有味道。

We must have a proper game some time.”
几时我们好好赌它一场。”

“Why some time?”
“何用‘几时’？”

Pang put in.
庞二接口说道，

“Tomorrow.”
“就是明天。”

“But we have already agreed to dine with Old Hu tomorrow.
“明天不是约好了，扰老胡的，

Make it the day after.”
后天好了。”

“Tomorrow will do just as well,” Hu said.
“明天也一样。”胡雪岩说，

“Tell me whom you would like to play with, and I can send additional invitations.”
“你们约哪几位来玩，我补帖子也一样。”

“No need,” Pang replied.
“不必，不必！”庞二说道，

“The day after tomorrow, I shall invite you all to dinner and bring in a few friends for a proper game.”
“后天我请大家吃饭，找几个朋友来，好好赌他一场。”

He turned particularly to Liu.
他特意向刘不才问道：

“Are you free that day?”
“后天你空不空？”

“I am free any day.”
“哪一天都空。”

“Good.
“好的，

Come early, then.
那你后天早一点请过来。”

I hope everyone will honour me.
庞二又说，“通通请赏光，

Those who like to play can play; the others can simply dine.
喜欢玩的玩，不然就吃饭。

I have a new cook who does shark’s fin rather well.
我新用了一个厨子，做的鱼翅还不错，

Come and try it.”
请大家来品尝一番。”

“Thank you,” Wang said, “but I return to Huzhou the day after tomorrow.”
“我谢谢了！”王有龄说，“后天我回湖州。”

They settled it there and then: everyone except Wang would accept Pang’s invitation.
于是即席约定，除了王有龄以外，后天都赴庞二的约。

Ji Heling was naturally included.
嵇鹤龄自然也请在内，

Pang admired him greatly, said they must be sure to have him and expressly asked Hu to convey the invitation.
庞二很佩服他，说一定要请到，特意拜托胡雪岩代为致意。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十九章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Nineteen, concluding part
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


The next day, Hu Xueyan borrowed Wang Youling's house to entertain the guests, again for “a little play.”
第二天胡雪岩借了王有龄家请客，依旧是“小玩玩”。

Over the two days, Liu Bucai won more than ten thousand taels and was greatly excited.
两天下来，刘不才赢了一万多银子，大为兴奋。

Hu reminded him, however, not to let this alter his original intentions: gambling could never establish a man's career.
胡雪岩却提醒他，不可因此改变初衷，赌上绝不能成功立业，

Once more, he urged Liu to win Pang over completely, then find an opportunity to put their proposal to him.
同时也喜一次拜托，务必把庞二笼络得服服帖帖，然后好相机进言。

“We seem to get on very well,” Liu said.
“看样子我们很投缘。”刘不才说，

“A long line flies the kite far; enough fire will soften the pig's head...”
“长线放远鹞，‘火到猪头烂’……”

“No!”
“不！”

Hu would not allow such leisurely patience.
胡雪岩不容如此闲豫，

“What I need from him is urgent.
“我要托他的事，很急！

Third Uncle, you must use tomorrow's opportunity to win him over.
三叔，你无论如何，趁明天这个机会，就要把他收服。

Yesterday you did wonderfully.
象昨天那样子就很好，

Even I admired you.
连我都佩服。

But today you went wrong.
不过你今天就不大对了，

You put your whole mind into gambling and neglected the real business.”
全副心思放在赌上，误了正事。

“The opportunity was good today.
““今天的机会很好，

I wanted to win something first, to use as gambling capital.”
我先弄它几个，好做赌本。”

Liu smiled sheepishly.
刘不才不好意思地笑一笑，

“There may be no chance later.
“以后没有机会了，

Let me off this once.”
你就先放我一马！”

“You needn't worry about capital.
“赌本你不必愁。

Naturally, if there's a chance to win something, I've no reason to object and insist on your losing.
有机会能赢几个，我自然也没有反对你，非要你输的道理，

But remember why you went there to gamble.”
只是你要顾到你去赌的原意。”

Hu emphasised his point.
胡雪岩又重重地说：

“That's how business works.
“做生意就是这样！

Wherever you are, never forget what you're there for.”
处处地方不要忘记自己是为的什么！”

Liu considered, then nodded.
刘不才想了一会，点头答道：

“Very well.
“好！

Tomorrow I'll give all my attention to Pang Er.”
我明天全副精神对付庞二。”


Pang's entertainment was on a grand scale.
庞二请客的场面很阔，

His family had a villa at the foot of Geling Hill beside West Lake, and he received his guests there.
他家在西湖葛岭山脚下有一所别墅，请客就请在那里。

Outside, the north-west wind of the eleventh month penetrated even heavy furs.
十一月的天气，外面西北风刮得人重裘不暖，

Inside the villa, it was warm as spring.
但在庞二的别墅中，却是温暖如春，

The luncheon was served in a heated room with the hill behind it and the lake in front.
在那间背山面湖的温室中开筵，

There were three tables of guests, drawn from widely differing ranks, though their informal clothes made those distinctions difficult to see.
一共三桌客，身分极杂，但都穿的便衣，也就不容易分得出来了。

By the time they finished eating, it was already two in the afternoon.
宴是午宴，吃完已经下午两点，

Apart from a few exceptions, they were all well-known gamblers.
除了少数几个人以外其余都是知名的赌客，

As soon as they left the tables, they discussed what to play.
一散席便商量如何赌法？

“Let our host bank a dice-shaking game!” Others immediately agreed.
“做主人的摇场摊吧！”这个提议，立刻有人附和。

Pang was famous for his fondness for the game, and of everyone present he was naturally the best qualified to act as banker.
庞二喜欢摇摊是出名的，而在这个场合中，最有资格做庄的，自然也是庞二。

Willing though he was, he hesitated: he lacked an assistant.
在他虽有当仁不让之心，却不免踌躇，因为缺少一个帮手。

Then he caught sight of Liu and readily agreed.
但转眼看到刘不才，立即欣然答应：

“Very well!
“好的！

Since you're in the mood, I'll shake a few dozen rounds first.”
各位有兴致，我就先遥儿十摊。”

Apart from one table of mahjong, nearly twenty people prepared to play.
于是除了一桌麻将以外，近二十个人都预备打摊。

While servants arranged the table, seats, and equipment, Pang drew Liu aside.
听差的准备桌子、座位、赌具，庞二却把刘不才找到一边有话说。


“Old Liu, let's be partners.
“老刘！我们合伙。

Sixty per cent for me, forty for you.
我六成，你四成，

How does that sound?”
你看如何？”

“Excellent, of course.
“当然好罗！

But let me first feel out the scale of the game.
不过，我先要‘灵一灵’市面，

I've only thirty thousand taels on me.
我只带了三万银子在身上，

If the stakes are too large, I'll have to send home for more.”
场面太大，我要派人回去拿钱。”

“No need.
“不必，不必，

I have the money.
钱我有。

You needn't put up any capital beforehand; we'll settle when the game breaks up.
你也不要先拿本钱，等场头散了再算。

There's just one thing: I'd like you to handle the collection and payment of bets.” Pang continued, “I've a bad habit at this game.
只有一件事，请你替我做‘开配’。”庞二又说，“我摇摊有个臭脾气，

If the man settling the bets isn't up to the mark, I lose all enthusiasm.
开配不灵光，我摇起来就没劲。

The other day, at Zhou's, I asked a friend to help at short notice.
那天在周五家摇摊，临时请了位朋友帮忙，

I'd only thrown five Old Treasures and lost less than twenty thousand taels when his hands began to tremble.
我不过出了五个‘老宝’，输不到两万银子，那位开配朋友的手就有些发抖了。

It's not that I fail to appreciate someone helping me and still complain about him, but the way that fellow handled the settlements made me lose all face!”
不是人家帮我的忙，我不见情，还要说人家，象那位朋友开配，真把我的脸面都丢完了！”

“I've never done it for you before.
“我没有替你做过开配，

Naturally, if you ask, there's nothing more to say.
不过，你的事，自然没话说。

I'm only afraid I won't be able to manage.”
就怕我应付不下来，”

“Don't be modest.”
“你别客气了。”

Pang clasped his hands.
庞二拱拱手，

“Help me put on a good show.
“捧我小弟的场！

I'll be grateful indeed.”
承情，承情。”


Liu took his place to settle the bets.
于是刘不才到场执行开配的任务。

The table was already prepared.
只见台面已经布置好了，

Made specially for the game, it had a zitan-wood frame and a boxwood top and was one size larger than an ordinary square table.
那张台子，是专为摇摊用的，紫檀桌子，黄杨木的桌面，比平常方桌大一号，

Ivory inlay marked the boundaries at its four corners.
四角用象牙嵌出界线，

Each side also had ivory dots the size of teacups: one on the banker's side, three opposite, two to his right, and four to his left.
每一方又用象牙嵌出茶杯大的圆点，庄家一点，对门三点，右方是二，左方是四，

The left was the Green Dragon, the right the White Tiger.
左青龙，右白虎，

The settling clerk customarily stood at the upper-left corner between three and four, the auspicious Green Dragon Corner.
开配照例站立在左上角的三与四之间，那是吉利的“青龙角”。

Once Liu stood there, a servant brought him a box of counters.
等他在青龙角上站定，随即便有听差送过一盒筹码来，

They were ivory tallies four cun long, engraved in gold with the identifying words “Pang of Shizai Hall.”
筹码是四寸长的牙筹！上面刻着金字“世载堂庞”四字，作为标识，

There were five kinds.
筹码共分五种，

Four bore the Heaven, Earth, Man, and Harmony markings from domino tiles; the fifth bore only the hall's name and was naturally the lowest denomination.
分别刻着骨牌中“天、地、人、和”的点子，另外还有一种只刻堂名的白筹，自然是最小的码子。

Liu assigned them five values: one thousand, five hundred, one hundred, fifty, and ten taels.
刘不才把筹码定为五等，一千、五百、一百、五十、十两，

Only when the players had bought their counters did Pang, the “emperor,” sit down.
等赌客买好筹码，才是“皇帝”庞二落座，

He picked up a blue-and-white shaking bowl from the Chenghua kilns of the Ming dynasty and gave it three rattling shakes.
拿起一个明朝成化窑的青花摇缸，“察浪浪，察浪浪”地摇了三下，

Opening it, he found twelve points, which counted as four.
打开摇缸来看，十二点是四。

“Good!
“不错！

An opening Green Dragon!” he said, and shook again.
‘开青龙’！”庞二说着又摇。


The first three throws were called “showing the game,” allowing the players to chart its course.
前三下，名为“亮摊”，好供赌客“画路”，

There were many kinds of patterns: main patterns, minor patterns, “meat” patterns, and “vegetable” patterns.
摊路的名堂甚多，大路、小路、荤路、素路，

Each player believed in his own.
各人相信各人的。

Only after the fourth shake did betting formally begin.
到第四下摇过，那才正式开始下注，

The scene grew lively, and Liu had to display his ability.
场面极其热闹，刘不才的本事也就要拿出来了。

Of all gambling games, this was the fairest: the players suffered no disadvantage, and they had the widest variety of wagers.
摇摊在赌里面最公平，做下手的一点亏都不吃，而下手押注的花样也最多，

As in pai gow, besides betting a “corner” or “across the hall,” they could bet a “big head.”
跟牌九一洋，打“角”、打“横堂”以外，还可以打“大头”。

With corner and across-the-hall bets, player and banker each held two of the four numbers, so the wager was one against one.
角与横堂，下手与庄家各占两门，所以是一赌一，

A big-head bet also gave each side two numbers, but the method of winning differed.
“大头”就不同了，虽也是各占两门，但赢法有差别，

With a two-led big head carrying one, a White Tiger paid double, while an Entrance was a draw.
二带么的大头，开出“白虎”赢两倍，开出“进门”算和气。

Then there was “flying a kite”: the player backed three numbers, and on a win the settlement was “take two, pay three.”
此外还有“放鹞子”，下手打三门，赢了吃二配三，

In money terms, this meant staking three to win one: large capital for a small return, seemingly a disadvantage.
在钱上是以三赌一，大本钱卜小利，好象吃亏，

With the dice, however, the player held the advantage, winning on three numbers and losing on only one.
但在骰子上，下手占了便宜，赢三门输一门，

Of course, the unbacked number could still come up.
当然，偏开不下注的一门，也是有的，

Then all three stakes were taken, the whole force was wiped out, and the flying kite's string had snapped.
那一下三注都吃，全军皆墨，就变成“放鹞子断线”了。


Whether the wager was a kite or a single-number bet, collecting and paying it was straightforward enough.
“放鹞子”还是“孤丁”，照吃照配，不伤脑筋，

The difficult part was a changed wager.
伤脑筋的是改注码，

One player might turn a big head into a single-number bet; another might transfer his stake from one number to another without moving the counters, merely announcing the change.
有的大头改为孤丁，有的把这门注码移到另一门，注码不动，只凭口说，

The settling clerk had to remember it all.
都要开配记住。

Nobody complained if he paid a bet that did not deserve payment, but if he collected a stake that should not have been taken, someone would protest.
不该配的配了，自然没有人说话，不该吃的吃了，便有人提出抗议。

Losing money was a small matter.
赔钱是小事，

Making a mistake showed incompetence and would embarrass Pang.
出了错便是不够格，会替庞二丢面子，

Liu dared neglect nothing; he watched every wager.
所以刘不才不敢轻忽，每一注都得注意。

Inwardly attentive but outwardly at ease, he waited for the bowl to be opened, then collected the losing bets and calculated each payment and its proper multiple.
暗中用心，表面却很悠闲，等摇缸亮出，该吃的吃进，该配的配多少倍，一一计算清楚，

There were no complaints and no disputes.
没有下手说闲话，更不曾起争执。

He worked not only accurately but exceptionally fast, so the banker never grew bored waiting and shook with increasing enthusiasm.
刘不才不但计算得清楚，而且计算得特别快，庄家不会等得无聊，所以摇起来格外起劲。

Before long, twenty rounds were over.
不多时候，二十摊已经摇完，

Halfway through his turn as banker, Pang finally looked at the banknotes in front of him.
做庄做了一半，庞二才看一看面前的银票。

The settling clerk kept only counters and less than ten thousand taels in notes beside him.
开配手边，只存筹码和不足一万的银票，

Once the notes reached ten thousand, he had to put them before the banker.
满了一万，就得摆到庄家面前，

This was auspiciously called “bringing money into the bank,” but its real purpose was to prevent the clerk from slipping money into his own pocket.
名为讨口彩的“进庄”，其实是防范开配落入自己荷包。

Newly acquainted with Pang and charged with winning his trust, Liu was especially careful over such details.
刘不才与庞二初交，兼以负有争取信任的责任，对这些细节，自然特别当心。

Pang made a quick count: there were fourteen or fifteen stacks.
庞二这时略略点了下，共有十四五叠之多，

His own capital had been a hundred thousand taels.
自己是十万银子的本钱，

The winnings were by no means small.
算来赢得也不能说少。


The second half went less well.
但后半场的手风就不如前半场了，

Liu kept reaching towards Pang for money, and before long only seven stacks remained.
只见刘不才不断伸手到他面前取钱，转眼间，只剩下七叠。

The sequence was worse still: a Green Dragon followed by a White Tiger, swinging back and forth.
而摊路更坏，一缸青龙，一缸白虎，来回地甩，

This was called a “swaying course,” or “rowing.”
这名为“摇路”，又称“摇橹”，

Zhou judged it ripe and placed twenty thousand taels on White Tiger as a single-number bet.
周五看准了，一下就在白虎上打了两万孤丁，

Another ten thousand or so was already on that number.
另外在这一门上还有万把银子，

If the banker threw a two, he would have to pay ninety thousand taels.
假如庄家开个二，便得配九万银子，

Although he could collect the stakes on the other three numbers, they were negligible.
虽有三门可吃，为数极微，

The money before him would not cover the loss.
庄家面前的钱是不够输的。

It was the settling clerk's responsibility to warn him, but some bankers disliked being told that even everything they had would not cover the payouts.
这是开配的责任，得要提醒庄家，但也有些庄家不爱听这罄其所有还不够配的话，

Liu hesitated.
所以刘不才有些踌躇。

Looking up, he happened to catch Hu's eye and frowned involuntarily.
一抬眼恰好看到胡雪岩，不自觉略一皱眉，

Hu immediately gave him a warning glance.
胡雪岩立刻便抛过一个阻止的眼色来。

Liu took the hint, indicated the money before Pang with his lips, and resumed his usual expression.
刘不才警觉了，嘴向庄家面前一努，随即恢复常态。

“Old Liu, how is it?” Pang naturally had his own reckoning.
“老刘！”庞二自己当然有个计算，问道：“怎么样？”

He meant: was the capital enough?
这一问当然是问本钱够不够？

Liu must not discourage him, yet could not confidently undertake to cover everything.
刘不才不能给他泄气，但也不便大包大揽，说得太肯定，

He merely answered, “Open it.”
只这样含含糊糊地说：“开吧！”

The result was three.
开开来是三，

Liu breathed freely.
刘不才松了口气，

When collection and payment were complete, a servant of the Pang household quietly laid two banknotes before Pang.
等吃配完毕，只见庞家的听差，取了两张银票，悄悄往庞二面前一放。

He glanced at them, looked slightly surprised, and nodded without speaking.
他看了看，略有诧异之色，欲言又止地点一点头，

Whether in understanding or approval, it was hard to tell.
不知是表示会意，还是嘉许。

“Old Five,” he told Zhou, “go on betting.
“老五！”庞二看着周五说，“你打吧！

I've added more capital—another hundred thousand.”
我添本钱了，再添十万。”

Strangely enough, the extra capital seemed to change his luck.
说也奇怪，一添本钱，手风便又不同，

The sequence became unpredictable, repeatedly favouring whichever number carried the smallest stake.
摊路变幻莫恻，专开注码少的那门。

When the forty rounds were over, the accounts showed a profit of seventy thousand taels.
等四十摊摇完，结帐赢了七万银子。


Zhou took the bank next and also asked Liu to settle the bets.
接下来是周五做庄，也要求刘不才替他做开配，

After twenty rounds, they saw that it was eight in the evening and stopped for dinner.
二十摊终了，看钟已是晚上八点，暂停吃饭。

Pang used the interval to take Liu into his study.
趁这空隙，庞二把刘不才找到书房里，

Opening a drawer, he brought out two envelopes and offered them to him.
打开抽屉，取出两个信纣，递了给他。

Liu would not take them.
刘不才不肯接，

“Brother Pang, what are these?”
“庞二哥！”他问，“这是啥？”

“Open them and see.”
“你打开来看。”

The first held three banknotes.
打开第一只信封，里面是三张银票，

Two, issued by Fukang Bank, were for fifty thousand taels each; the third, from another bank, was for five thousand.
两张由阜康钱庄所出，每张五万，另外还有一张别家钱庄的，数目是五千。

“Old Hu is a true friend.
“老胡很够朋友，

He had my servant bring me a hundred thousand taels to add to my capital.
叫我听差送了十万银子约我添本钱，

I didn't need it, but I appreciate the kindness.
我用不着，不过盛情可感。

The five thousand is a share of the luck.
五千银子算是彩，

Please take it to him.”
请你转交给他。”

“Xueyan won't accept...”
“雪岩不肯收的……”

“Never mind that,” Pang interrupted.
“你别管。”庞二打断他的话说，

“I'm only asking you to deliver it.”
“只托你转交就是了。”

Liu too had been brought up as a wealthy young master.
刘不才也是大少爷出身，

He knew that refusing on Hu's behalf would offend Pang, so he accepted the envelope.
知道替胡雪岩辞谢，反拂他的意，便收了下来。


The second envelope held more than thirty-two thousand taels in notes.
看第二只信封，里面是三万二千多两银子。

“This is your share,” Pang explained.
“这是你的一份。”庞二解释，

“We agreed on forty and sixty per cent, but I think an even division would be better.”
“原说四六成，我想还是‘南北开’的好。”

Even in his former days of extravagant gambling, Liu had seldom played on a scale that involved thirty thousand taels in a single session.
刘不才当年豪赌的时候，也很少有一场赌三万银子进出的手面，

Now, almost without understanding how, he had won such a sum.
而此时糊里糊涂的赢了这么一笔钱，

He could scarcely believe it and stood speechless.
有些不大能信其为真实，因而愣在那里，说不出话来。

Pang found this puzzling.
庞二不免觉得奇怪。

Could Liu be dissatisfied?
他在想，莫非他意有不足？

The suspicion vanished as soon as it arose.
这个疑惑的念头，一起即灭，

That was impossible.
那是绝不会有的事！

He must be considering what to say.
然则必是在想一句什么交代的话。

A mere thank-you would hardly suffice: thirty-two thousand taels was no small sum.
这交代，并非道一声谢，就可以了事的，三万二千银子，不是小数目，

Pang already felt pleased with himself for being able to confer so great a benefit.
庞二对自己能给人带来这么大的好处，已觉得很得意。

Naturally, he wanted a few words that would give him further satisfaction.
当然还想再听两句“过瘾”的话，

Such was the temperament of a wealthy young master.
大少爷的脾气，就是这样。


Liu was deeply moved, but the unexpected windfall had not turned his head.
刘不才的感动，不言可知，不过他倒也没有让这笔倘来之财，冲昏了头脑，

Hu wanted him to win Pang's confidence and, if possible, place Pang under some obligation to him.
心想，胡雪岩的意思，是要自己争取庞二的信任，最好还能叫他见自己的情。

Accepting this enormous sum would put the obligation the other way round.
现在分到了这笔巨数，就得见人家的情了。

Besides, ready money was what counted at a gambling table.
再说，赌场里讲究的就是“现钱”两个字，

Having agreed to a partnership on a forty-sixty basis, Liu should have supplied his capital first and handed over the thirty thousand taels in notes he carried.
当时讲好四六成比例合伙，就该先出本钱，把身上的三万银票交了过去，

Then he could take his profit with a clear conscience.
到此刻来分红，就毫无愧作了。

Pang was famously wealthy and might not care, but if the other man behaved generously, Liu must conduct himself handsomely too.
虽然庞二是有名的阔少，不在乎此，但人家漂亮，自己也要漂亮，

Only then could they be friends on equal terms.
这才是平等相交的朋友，

Otherwise, he would become a hanger-on clinging to a powerful patron, and his words would carry quite a different weight.
不然就成了抱粗腿的篾片，说话的分量，大不相同。

The principle was clear.
道理是想通了，

To gain Pang's friendship and carry out Hu's business, he must refuse the money.
要交庞二这个朋友，要替胡雪岩办事，这笔钱就不能收。

Yet it was thirty-two thousand taels.
不收呢，到底是三万二千银子，

Added to the ten thousand and more he had won the previous day, it would provide enough capital to restore Liu Jingde Hall.
加上前一天赢的一万多，要把“敬德堂”恢复起来，本钱也够了。

So much was at stake that the decision was agonising.
因为出入关系太大，决心可真难下，

There was no time for leisurely reflection.
但此时不容他从容考虑，

Gritting his teeth, he told himself that silver and copper could be spent to the last coin; another chance to make friends like Hu and Pang might never come.
咬一咬牙在心里说：铜钱银子用得光，要想交胡雪岩和庞二这样的朋友，今后未见得再有机会。


With an awkward, apologetic expression, Liu smiled.
于是他做出为难而歉然的神色，笑一笑说道：

“Brother Pang, everyone knows how generous you are.
“庞二哥，你出手之阔是有名的，

This is as good as giving me thirty-two thousand taels.
这等于送了我三万二千银子。

To refuse would be ungrateful, but to accept would leave me very uneasy.
我不收是不识抬举，收了心里实在不安。

Let me suggest this.
我想这样，

Friendship isn't a matter of one day.
做朋友不在一日。

Whether we play together again or undertake some proper business, we'll have other chances to be partners.
以后无论是在一起玩，还是干啥正经，总还有合伙的机会。

I'll leave this money on deposit with you.”
这笔钱，我存在你这里。”

He put the envelope back before Pang.
说着，把那个信封放回庞二面前。

“You...”
“你……”

Pang scratched his head.
庞二搔搔头皮，

“That won't do!
“没有这个道理！

Let's settle one account at a time.
我们一笔了一笔，

Whatever we do later, gambling or business, there'll always be a share for you.”
以后再说，无论一起玩，还是干啥正经，总有你一份就是了。”

Liu hastily clasped his hands.
刘不才急忙拱手：

“If you say that and regard me as a friend, Brother Pang, that's more than enough.
“庞二哥说到这话，当我一个朋友，这就尽够了！

Come, let's eat.”
来来，吃饭去！”

Speaking as he went, he walked out.
一面说，一面走了出去。

Pang could only write “Liu's deposit” on the envelope and put it in the drawer.
庞二无可奈何，只好在那个信封上写了“刘存”二字，藏入抽斗。


When play resumed after dinner, Liu felt that his conduct had fulfilled Hu's commission.
等吃了饭再赌，刘不才觉得刚才那样做法，对胡雪岩的委托来说，已经做到，

With that concern removed, he gave his whole mind to gambling, following the three rules of coolness, precision, and ruthlessness.
所以心无牵挂，全副精神摆在赌上，用“冷、准、狠”的三字诀，

During Zhou's twenty rounds, he bet only three times.
在周五所摇的二十摊中，只下了三次注，

Judging Old Treasure to be the right number, he staked two thousand taels on it alone and won six thousand.
看准了“老宝”打两千银子的孤丁，赢了六千，

He put down capital and winnings together once more, and the sum became eighteen thousand.
连本带利再扑一记，变成一万八。

On the third bet, he set aside ten thousand and wagered eight thousand.
第三记收起一万打八千，

If he won, his original two thousand would have become thirty-four thousand; after deducting the capital, the profit would exactly equal the thirty-two thousand he had declined.
如果赢了，就是两千变成三万四，除去本钱，恰好是那辞谢未受的三万二千银子。

Instead, the stake was taken, and Zhou's turn as banker ended.
结果吃掉了，周五的庄也做完了，

Liu had won eight thousand taels.
刘不才赢了八千银子。

They changed to pai gow and played until dawn without any substantial change in his fortunes.
以后换了推牌九，赌到天亮，没有什么进出，

Having won twenty thousand taels in three or four days, Liu felt he had every reason to be satisfied.
而刘不才觉得三四天工夫就赢了两万银子，大可知足。


Stretching, he left the card table and drew back a window curtain.
伸个懒腰，离开牌桌，走到窗前把窗帘拉开，

The sudden brightness dazzled him.
顿觉强光炫目，

He closed his eyes for a moment, then looked through the foreign glass, a luxury few households possessed.
闭一闭眼，再从那难得几家有的外国玻璃窗望出去，

“What a snowfall!” he exclaimed.
不由得讶然失声：“好大的雪！”

“Indeed!” Gao said. “We've gambled ourselves blind to the world.
“真是！赌得昏天黑地，”高四也说，

We didn't even know it was snowing so heavily.”
“外面下这么大的雪都不知道。”

“The view is magnificent.”
“雪景倒真不坏！”

Liu looked over West Lake, white as far as he could see.
刘不才望着弥望皆白的西湖说，

“Brother Pang's villa is wonderfully situated—a paradise.”
“庞二哥这个庄子的地势真好，真正是洞天福地。”

“Then don't leave,” said Zhou, whose appetite for gambling remained unsatisfied.
“你说好就不要走。”周五赌兴未已，

“There are plenty of guest rooms.
“多的是客房，

Sleep a while, and we'll return to battle.”
睡一觉起来，我们再盘肠大战。”

Ordinarily, Liu never refused a game.
刘不才遇到赌是从不推辞的，

But now he remembered Hu's business.
但此时想到胡雪岩的正事，

Hu had long since returned to the city, and he must meet him before considering anything else.
而他本人又早已回城，必得跟他碰个头才谈得到其他，

He therefore pleaded an important appointment: he would rather return to town and come out again.
所以推说有个紧要约会，宁可回了城再来。

“There's no need to come again,” Pang said.
“再来就不必了。”庞二说道，

“Let's rest today.
“今天歇一天吧！

If you're interested, we could tour West Lake.
如果有兴，倒不妨逛一逛西湖，

I'll send a boat to wait at the Yongjin Gate wharf.”
我派船到涌金门码头去等你们。”

Zhou drew in his neck at once.
一听这话，周五先就将脖子一缩，

“I haven't that refined taste.
“我可没有这个雅兴，”他说，

Better come to my place for hotpot, then another game.”
“不如到我那里去吃火锅，吃完再赌一场。”

“No!” Pang laughed.
“不行！”庞二笑道，

“This is the best place to admire the snow.
“我这个地方，就是赏雪最好，

I'll imitate the elegant scholars for once and stay out of town today.”
我也学一学高人雅士，今天不想进城。”

Gao too said he had business, and several other guests said nothing.
高四也说有事，还有几位客，都不开口，

Zhou's proposal came to nothing.
周五的提议，就此打消。

After a plentiful breakfast, they each took a sedan chair into the city.
在庞家吃了丰盛的早饭，各自坐轿进城。

Liu went directly to a bathhouse called Huaqing Pool instead of returning to the bank.
刘不才不回钱庄，直接到一家招牌叫“华清池”的澡堂，

He soaked in its scalding communal bath, then lay on a padded couch and fell asleep while an attendant pounded his legs.
在滚烫的“大汤”中泡了一会，躺在软榻上叫人捶着腿便睡着了。


He did not wake until two in the afternoon and still felt no wish to leave the bathhouse.
这一觉睡到下午两点才醒，还不想离开澡堂子，

He called an attendant to order dishes from a restaurant and, at the same time, wrote a note for delivery to Hu's house, giving his whereabouts and asking Hu to meet him.
喊来一名跑堂，到馆子里，叫菜来吃饭，同时写了张条子，吩咐送到胡雪岩家，说明行踪，请来相会。

By the time Hu arrived, Liu had been enjoying a hotpot of ten varieties of sliced raw ingredients, had drunk four liang of strong clear spirits, and was eating his rice.
等他说着一只十景生片火锅，喝完四两白干，正在吃饭时，胡雪岩到了，

Looking at him closely, Hu said, “You look particularly well today.
一见他便很注意的说：“ 你今天的气色特别好。

Things must have gone your way.”
想来得意？”

“Quite well.
“还不错。

Everything went smoothly.
一切都很顺利。

Let me finish this bowl of rice, then I'll tell you all about it.
等我吃完这碗饭，再细谈。”刘不才说，

It's bitterly cold.
“天气太冷，

Go and have a soak first.”
你先到池子里泡一泡。”

Hu undressed and entered the pool.
于是胡雪岩解衣入池，

When he returned to his place, Liu was waiting at ease over his tea.
等他回到座位，刘不才已很悠闲的在喝着茶等。

An envelope lay on the low table, bearing two lines of writing: “Kindly deliver by hand to my elder friend Xueyan.”
炕几上摆着个信封，看上面写着两行字：“拜烦袖致雪岩老哥。”


“Why did you leave yesterday before Pang finished his turn?” Liu asked.
“你昨天怎么不等庞二把摊摇完，就走了？”

“Naturally, I had to leave early.
“我自然要先走，

Getting the city gate opened at night would have been troublesome.
不然，到晚上‘叫城门’就麻烦了。”胡雪岩说，

I had two notes drawn up and carried them with me.
“我开了两张票子，带在身上，

I'd handed them to Pang, but I didn't know whether the bank had enough deposits to cover them.
交是交了给庞二，号子里有没有这么多存款，还不知道，

I had to hurry back into town and make the arrangements.”
必得赶进城来布置好。”

“Fortunately, Pang didn't lose the money.
“亏得庞二不曾输掉，

Otherwise, there would have been trouble.”
否则就麻烦了。”

Liu shuddered at the thought.
刘不才这时倒有不寒而栗之感，

“I'd agreed to a forty-sixty partnership.
“你想，我说了跟他四六成合伙，

If he had lost everything, including your hundred thousand, that would have been two hundred thousand.
倘或连你这十万一起输光，就是二十万。

My forty per cent would be eighty thousand.
我派四成，得要八万，

After offsetting the accounts, there would be only twenty thousand to give back.
划个帐，找两万银子。

A hundred thousand reduced to twenty thousand!
十万剩了两万，

What a risk.
险呀！

We must never do that again.”
这种事下次做不得了。

“So you know it shouldn't be done!” Hu laughed.
““你也知道做不得！”胡雪岩笑道，

“You were gambling at the table, and I was gambling outside it.
“你在场上赌，等于我在场外赌。

But my gamble would have been worthwhile whether you won or lost.”
不过我这场外赌，无论输赢，都是合算的。

“Winning made it especially worthwhile.
““赢了是格外合算。

Look!”
你看！”

Liu pushed the envelope towards him and explained what had happened.
刘不才把信封推了给他，说明经过。


Only then did Hu open the envelope.
胡雪岩这时才打开信封，

He put away his own two banknotes and held up Pang's note for five thousand taels.
把他自己的两张银票收了起来，扬着庞二的那张五千两的银票说：

“Naturally, I can't take this five thousand.
“我当然不能要他这五千银子，

But it would be awkward to return it.
但也不便退回。

There's only one course: donate it to a charitable institution in his name.
只有一个办法，用他的名义，捐给善堂。

After last night's heavy snow, there must be at least twenty or thirty bodies lying in the roads.
昨天夜里一场大雪，起码有二三十具‘倒路尸’，

My bank has already given four coffins.”
我钱庄里已经舍了四口棺材了。”

“Good works are only right.
“ ‘做好事’应该！

I'll give a thousand taels too.”
我也捐一千银子。”

“No, no!”
“算了，算了！”

胡雪岩不便说他有了钱，“大少爷脾气”就会发作，

事由不明，无法为他出什么主意，

不必谈了。”

你跟洋人会谈，

这样总行了吧？”

有庞二的全权委托，不但对洋商的交易，可以顺利达成，而且自己的声望，立刻就会升高。

Old Liu has told me about you.

送到哪里？”

刘不才也在旁边帮腔，说胡雪岩对这种徘难解纷的事，最为擅长，此行少不得他。

庞二哥有什么难处，尽管跟他商量。”

还有武的一面。”刘不才插嘴问庞二：“郁四，你认不认识？”

郁四听见是庞二哥的事，不敢不尽心。”

这是胡雪岩拿高帽子往庞二头上戴，意思是以庞家的名望，郁四自然要巴结。

只是恭维得不肉麻，庞二听了非常舒服，

心里在想，他们杭州人的俗语，“花花轿儿人抬人”，

请你替我写介绍信。”

我不耽搁你的工夫，

明天一早，我把信送来。”

这天晚上胡雪岩备下三封极其切实的信，第二天一早带到庞二那里。

投桃报李，他交给胡雪岩的两封信也很实在，一封是委托书，一封是写给他在上海的管事的，

特意不封口，请胡雪岩代发，意思是让他过了目，好放心。

这使得胡雪岩对庞二又有深一层的了解，

做事不但豪爽，而且过节上的交代，一丝不苟，十分漂亮。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第二十章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Twenty, first part
逐句英中对照

CHAPTER TWENTY｜第二十章


Now that he had the letter of authorisation, Hu Xueyan needed to think carefully.
有了这封委托书，胡雪岩要好好的动脑筋了。

He had kept up a steady correspondence with Gu Yingchun, who handled his business contacts in Shanghai and passed on all news of You Laowu.
他不断跟古应春有书信往来，上海方面的生意，是托古应春代为接头，尤五的一切情形，也是由古应春代达。

Once the agreement with Pang Er was settled, his first act was to write to Gu.
所以庞二这面谈成功，他第一件事，就是写信告诉古应春，

Then he attended to the affairs in his charge in Hangzhou, intending to leave for Shanghai early in the twelfth month and sell the silk before mid-month to meet his public and private obligations.
然后料理杭州这方面所经手的事务，预备在十二月初动身到上海，尽月半以前把丝卖出去，好应付公私帐目。

After the New Year, he would launch fresh plans and make a great effort.
然后开了年，另外再推出新的计划，大干一番。

Gu's reply arrived a few days later with an unpleasant surprise: the foreign merchants had changed their minds and had no intention of buying silk before the year ended.
不多几天，古应春的回信来了，让胡雪岩大出意外的是，洋人那方面变了卦，表示年关以前，无意买丝。

They claimed that letters from home reported ample stocks and advised suspending purchases.
表面是说，他们国内来信，存货已多，可以暂停。

In Gu's view, however, they had grown shrewd.
实际上照古应春的了解，外国人也学得门槛精了，

They knew the Chinese business custom of settling accounts at the three major festivals and making a final reckoning at year-end, when large sums of ready money were needed.
知道中国商场的规矩，三节结帐，年下归总，需要大笔头寸。

They meant to “slaughter the New Year pig.”
有意想“杀年猪”。

Yet if Hu did not hold out for too high a price, their interest in future dealings would keep them from driving him entirely to the wall.
如果胡雪岩价钱不是扳得太高，则洋人为了以后的生意，也下会赶尽杀绝。

“This makes things difficult!” Hu told Liu Bucai.
“事情麻烦了！”胡雪岩跟刘不才说，

“My own need for funds is secondary.
“我自己要头寸在其次，

Many small dealers won't get through the year.
还有许多小户，不能过关，

They'll have to turn round and beg the foreigners.
一定会倒过来恳求洋商，

Their small quantities won't affect the whole market, but we Chinese will lose face!”
虽然他们这点小数，不至于影响整个行情，但中国人的面子是丢掉了！”

Liu now admired him so completely that he thought no difficulty could defeat him. His answer was therefore quite casual. “There's only one solution.
“那就只有一个办法，”刘不才已经把胡雪岩佩服得五体投地，认为世上没有难得倒他的麻烦，所以语气非常轻松，

Raise some money to help the small dealers: buy their goods or lend against them.
“你调一笔头寸帮小户的忙，或者买他们的货，或者做押款，

Keep them out of the foreigners' trap, and the problem is solved.”
叫他们不要上洋人的圈套，不就完了吗？”

That had been Hu's original plan.
胡雪岩最初的计议就是如此，

The difficulty was the lack of money.
难就难在缺头寸，

He could only smile bitterly.
所以听了他的话，唯有报以苦笑。

Liu understood.
这一下，刘不才也看出意思来了，

“Old Hu, I think Pang Er responds to persuasion but resists pressure.
“老胡，”他说，“我看庞二也是吃软不吃硬的脾气，

听见洋人这样可恶，一定不服帖，

你何不跟他商量一下看？

如果愿意照这个办法做，岂不就过关了？

True enough.

但自己有许多公私帐务，一定要有个交代，

那又如何说法？

The whole matter required careful consideration.
这非得细细地通盘筹划一番不可。


That night Hu and Liu Qingsheng worked over the accounts until morning.
这天晚上，胡雪岩跟刘庆生算了一夜的帐，

各处应付款项，能展期的展期，能拖一拖的拖一拖，无论如何要三十万两银子才能过关。

头寸还缺一半，更不用说替丝商小户张罗过年的现款。

这就到了必须向洋商屈服的时候了。

胡雪岩想想实在于心不甘，

So much time and effort had gone into securing the advantage of a unified grip on the business.
多少时间心血花在上面，就为的是要弄成“一把抓”的优势，

如今有庞二的支持，优势已经出现，

这是从何说起？

一方面不甘屈服，一方面急景调年，时不我待，胡雪岩彻夜彷徨，想不出善策。

急得鬓边见了白发。

而刘庆生却又提出警告，该付的不付，面子要弄得很难看了！

这个警告的意味，他很了解，

这样一“挤兑”，雪上加霜，非倒闭不可。

于是他又想到刘不才的话，

Pang Er seemed a man with whom one could share adversity.
觉得庞二是个可共患难的人，

与其便宜洋商，不如便宜自己人！

向庞二去开口，当然是件失面子的事，然而，这是同样的道理，与其丢面子丢给洋人，倒不如丢给自己人。

“三爷！你陪我到湖州去一趟。”他这样跟刘不才说，

“This journey will depend on my luck.
“这一趟去要看我的运气，

If Pang's family dispute has been settled smoothly, I can speak more easily.
如果庞二闹家务，已经顺顺利利了结，我说话也就容易了。

If his own affairs are in a muddle, how can I open my mouth?”
不然，他自己都弄得‘头盔倒挂’，我怎么还开得出口？”

“Very well.
“好的。”

I think we should go straight to Nanxun.
刘不才说，“我看我们直接赶到南浔去吧，

不必先到湖州，再走回头路就耽误工夫了。

Hu nodded without committing himself.
“胡雪岩点点头，未置可否，

He was considering the arrangements needed in both Hangzhou and Shanghai.
心里在盘算杭州跟上海两方面的交代，

On reflection, even three or five days were hard to spare.
细想一想，就是三、五天的工夫也不容易抽出来，

Business at year-end might not change every instant, but unexpected developments were frequent.
年底下的商场，虽不是瞬息万变，却往往会出意外，

If something happened while he was unprepared, it could ruin everything.
万一有何变化，自己措手不及，岂不误了大事，

Seeing his hesitation and understanding that he must remain in charge in Hangzhou, Liu ventured, “Xueyan, why don't I go in your place?”
刘不才看他踌躇不决，知道他必须坐镇在杭州，因而试探着说：“雪岩，你看是不是我代你去走一趟？”

这倒是个办法。

刘不才的才干，办这样一件事，可以胜任。但他还有一件事不放心，

大少爷的脾气，你是最明白不过的，”

刘不才想想不错，

Once they started gambling, he might delay Hu's business.
这一赌下来，说不定就耽误了胡雪岩的工夫，

He must not play.
千万赌不得！

“I'll tell him I have a great deal to attend to in Hangzhou and must hurry back.

On New Year's Eve I'll come to Nanxun and play as many games as he likes.”
到年三十，我赶到南浔来，陪你好好赌几场。”

“Exactly.
“对！

Say just that.” Hu added solemnly, “Third Master, you mustn't let me down!”
就是这么说。”胡雪岩又郑重的加了一句：“三爷，你可不能拆我的烂污！”

“If you don't trust me, don't send me.”
“你不相信我，就不要叫我去。”

After that, Hu could say no more.
说到这话，胡雪岩不能再多提一句，

He wrote the letter and hired a boat, adding extra hands to speed it on its way through the night to Nanxun.
当时写了信，雇了一只船，加班添人，星夜赶到南浔去会庞二，

They agreed that, successful or not, Liu must return in three days.
约定无论事成与否，三天以后，必定回来。

这三天自是度日如年的光景，

But Hu would never sit helplessly with his troubles and leave everything to fate.
但胡雪岩决不会独坐愁城，听天由命，

He needed a fallback.
他要作万一的打算，

Each morning he took his place at Fukang and kept sending people out to make contacts and test possibilities, hoping to find some means of raising the large sum.
所以依然每天一早，坐镇阜康，不断派出人去联络试探，希望能找出一条得以筹集这笔巨款的路子来。

The first two days produced nothing.
第一天第二天都毫无结果，

On the third he was beginning to lose his composure.
到了第三天，他就有些沉不住气了，

While he sat frowning in thought, Ji Heling called at the bank.
正在攒眉苦思时，嵇鹤龄到阜康钱庄来相访，

几天不见，

How have you grown so thin?”
你何以清瘦如此？”

There was no need to conceal anything from a sworn brother.
异姓手足，无需掩饰，

胡雪岩老实答道：“还差三十万银子，

怎么不急得人瘦？”

听这话，嵇鹤龄大吃一惊，

“你怎不跟我说？

那天我问你，你不是说可以‘摆平’吗？”

他带些责备语气地问。

Not serious?
怎么又说不要紧？

Plainly he was trying to put Ji at ease.
显见得他是故意叫人宽心。

嵇鹤龄想了想问道：“你总得想办法罗！”

“是的。”他说了遣刘不才到南浔乞援的事，

“In my letter, I offered to sell Pang a quantity of silk at the current market price, so the benefit would stay among ourselves.
“我给庞二的信上说，我愿意照市价卖多少包丝给他，便宜不落外方。

我这样吃亏还卸面子，他应该可以帮我这个忙。”

“年底下一下子要调动三十万的头寸，不是件容易的事。”

“其实，有一半也可以过关了。”

“十五万也不是少数。”

Ji beckoned.
嵇鹤龄招招手说，

“Come here.
“你来，

我跟你句话。”

到得僻处密谈，嵇鹤龄告诉他一个消息，是裘丰言谈起的，

A foreign merchant had approached Gong Zhenlin of the Cannon Bureau and his son Gong Zhitang.
说有个洋商走了“炮局”龚振麟、龚之棠父子的路子，

龚家父子又走了黄抚台三姨太的路子，决定跟洋商买一万五千支洋枪，每支三十二两银子，价款先发六成，

The contract was to be signed and the money paid within the next day or two.
就在这两天要立约付款了。

Hu was astonished.
听得这个消息，胡雪岩大为诧异，

Buying foreign guns had been his own initiative.
买洋枪是他的创议，

If the trial proved satisfactory and a large purchase followed, surely he, as the original agent, should handle it.
如果试用满意，大量购置，当然是他原经手来办，

Why had the business changed hands, with the Gongs acting as intermediaries?
何以中途易手，变成龚家父子居间？

Obviously there must be some trick behind it.
当然，这是不用说的，其中必有花佯，

“No.
“不知道。

I hear he's Prussian.”
听说是个普鲁士人。”

“Then it isn't Hudson.
“那就不是哈德逊了。”

There's at least twelve taels of padding in the price of each gun.
胡雪岩说，“这笔生意，每支枪起码有十二两的虚头，

On fifteen thousand guns, that's a hundred and eighty thousand, before counting any commission.
一万五千支枪是十八万，回扣还不算。

Their consciences must be very black to handle public business like this.”
这样子办公事，良心未免太黑了一点。”

“Leave that aside.
“这不去说它了。

I'm telling you so that you can consider whether the money might pass through your hands.
我告诉你这个消息，是提醒你想一想，这笔款子，能不能在你手里过一过，

If that could be arranged, wouldn't it solve your immediate difficulty?”
能够办得到，岂不是眼前的难关，可以过去？”

It was a fresh suggestion.
这倒是个很新鲜的意见。

Hu always took an interest in an idea that had not occurred to him.
胡雪岩对任何他不曾想到的主意，都有兴趣，

于是扳着手指数道：“一万五千乘三十二，总价四十八万银子，

Sixty per cent in advance is two hundred and eighty-eight thousand.
先付六成就是二十八万八，

弄它一升半就差不多了。”

“Do you know the Gongs?
“你跟龚家父子认识不认识？

我倒有个朋友，跟小龚很熟，可以为你先容。”

“Excellent!
“好极了！

Let me think.
等我想一想。

This avenue is bound to be useful.”
这条路子一定有用的。”

胡雪岩略为一想，就看出了这桩交易之中的不妥之处，

Fifteen thousand foreign guns were a consignment of arms that would attract enormous attention.
一万五千支洋枪，是一批极惹人注目的军火，

The Small Swords Society nearby in Shanghai and the Taiping forces farther away in Jinling would certainly covet them.
近则上海的小刀会，远则金陵的太平军，一定都会眼红，

如果在上海起运，不管陆路水路，中途都难免会出纰漏。

“I suspect something isn't sound here.”
“我看这件事，怕有点靠不住！”

“Not sound?
“怎么靠不住，

The information is absolutely certain.”
千真万确有些事。”

“I don't doubt that the transaction exists.
“我不是说没有这件事，

I mean it may go wrong and land the Gongs in serious trouble.” He explained his concerns.
是说这笔生意，怕要出乱子，龚家父子会惹极大的麻烦。”接着，胡雪岩将他的顾虑，跟嵇鹤龄细谈了一遍。

“I see,” Ji said.

这倒是很麻烦的事。”

“I have it!”
“有了！”

Hu summoned Liu Qingsheng.

I recall it's a hundred taels at each festival and two hundred at New Year.

请你另外封四百两，连例规一起送去，

说我拜托他务心帮个忙！”

The favour was to obtain a copy of the original draft contract.
要刘二帮忙的，就是把合同的原底子设法抄了来。

For two red envelopes containing banknotes worth six hundred taels, Liu Er could hardly refuse.
刘二看在两个红封，总计六百两银票的面上，这个忙非帮不可，

Besides, he resented the Gongs for bypassing him. As people from the same native place, their womenfolk called frequently on the governor's household, and they had used that advantage to approach the third concubine directly.
又因为龚家父子越过他这一关，以同乡内眷，经常来往的便利，直接搭上了三姨太的线，心里原就有气，

这时猜测胡雪岩的用意。大概要动脑筋打消这笔买卖，自所乐见，

He was particularly obliging.
格外巴结，

That same day, fifty taels bought the cooperation of Huang Zonghan's young male favourite, who also served as a junior attendant in the official signing room.
当天就用五十两银子买通了黄宗汉的娈童兼值签押房的小听差，

The attendant stole out the draft.
把合同的底稿偷了出来，

The contract specified delivery by boat at the Zhejiang border.
合同上写的是由船运在浙江边境交货。

Hu was puzzled.
胡雪岩倒弄不明白。

What remarkable powers did this Prussian, Rudolf, possess that would let him pass safely along the waterway from Shanghai to Jiashan?
这个名叫鲁道夫的普鲁士人，具何神通？能够安然通过上海到嘉善的这一段水路？

倘或中途出险，不能如约交货，又将如何？

A closer reading revealed a tremendous loophole.
细看合同，果然有个绝大的漏洞，

The seller had guarantors, two Shanghai banks, but their guarantee covered only shortages in quantity and discrepancies in specifications.
这笔买卖，在卖主方面自然有保人，由上海的两家钱庄承保，但保的是“交货短少”及“货样不符”，

There was also a special clause: “After the seller has transported the guns from overseas to Shanghai, the Zhejiang governor's yamen shall be requested to appoint commissioners to inspect them jointly at the customs house.
又特为规定一样：“卖方将枪支自外洋运抵上海后，禀请浙江抚台衙门委派委员，即就海关眼同检验，

Only after the specifications and quantities have been verified as conforming may the goods be released for onward shipment.”
须验得式样数目相符，始得提领交运。”

It looked like careful administration, wholly intended to protect the buyer.
看起来好象公事认真，完全为了维护买方的利益，

In reality, it provided precisely the means for the seller to escape responsibility.
实际上是正好为卖方脱卸责任。

“What skilful legal drafting!”
“好刀笔！”

Ji, studying the contract beside him, could not suppress a scholar's indignation.
在一起细看合约的嵇鹤龄，书生积习，不免愤慨，

“This is how public business is done!
“公家办事，就是如此！

They think themselves clever and fall into someone else's trap.”
自作聪明，反上了别人的当。”

“Perhaps they're pretending to be clever,” Hu replied.
“恐怕不是自作聪明，是故作聪明。”胡雪岩说，

“Under this contract, once the guns reach Shanghai and the Zhejiang commissioners have verified their quantity and specifications at customs, the seller has discharged his responsibility.
“照这个合约来看，卖方只要把洋枪运到上海，在海关经过浙江的委员眼同检验，数量式样相符，卖方就已尽了责任，

If they're robbed on the way, it's like the rule on a pawn ticket: ‘The pawnbroker is not liable for natural or human disasters.’
如果中途遇劫，那就好比当票上的条规：”天灾人祸，与典无涉。

The guarantors don't cover war risks.
‘保人是不保兵险的。

If a dispute arises, the foreigner need only say, ‘They were stolen in your country.
真的闹将开来，洋人只要说一句：在你们中国地方被抢的。

你们自己不能维持地方平靖，与外人什么相干？

We couldn't refute him.
这话驳不到，

We'd have to hold our noses and swallow it.”
还只能捏着鼻子受他的！

Ji, himself exceptionally able and perceptive, nodded repeatedly.
“嵇鹤龄也是才气横溢，料事极透的人，听了胡雪岩的话，连连点头，

A deep, cryptic smile appeared at the corners of his mouth.
嘴角中现出极深沉诡秘的笑容，

眼睛不断眨动，似乎别有深奥的领悟似地。

“I'm taking your argument a step further.

也许是‘小人之心’，但是，人家未必是君子，

所以我的猜测也不见得不对。”

What, after all that, did he mean?
说了半天，到底是指什么呢？

Hu grew impatient.
胡雪岩有些不耐，催促着说：

“Tell me quickly!
“大哥！你快说吧，

There may be some way forward in this.
这件事上，也许可以生发出什么办法来，

Time is short.
如今时间不多了，

We must think and act fast.”
我们得要快动脑筋，快动手。”

Ji needed only one question to make his point.
于是嵇鹤龄提纲挈领的只问了一句，胡雪岩就懂了，所问这一句是：

“Could it be a fraud?”
“这会不会是个骗局？”

Under the contract, fraud was certainly possible.
如果要行骗，根据合约来说，并不是不可能：

The guns would reach Shanghai customs, and Zhejiang's commissioners would report the quantity and specifications correct.
洋枪运到上海关，浙江所派的委员验明了数目式样，无不相符，

During onward shipment, the seller could claim robbery, an unforeseen calamity for which he bore no responsibility.
但交运中途，说是遇到劫盗，意外灾祸，不负责任。

Whether the guns had actually been stolen would be impossible to establish.
至于是不是真的抢走了洋枪，无可究诘，

那就可以造成骗局。

With collusion arranged beforehand, the commissioners might merely go through the motions.
倘或事先有勾结，浙江的委员虚应故事，

Even if the quantity were short and the specifications wrong, they could report conformity.
数目既不够，式样也不符，而以“相符”禀报，

及至被动，亦是无可究诘，

这个骗局就更厉害了。

这件事你我先都还不便出面，

叫裘丰言去！”

Hu clapped his hands.
胡雪岩抚掌称善，

“Let's get him here at once.”

于是就借嵇鹤龄的地方，由瑞云设炉置酒，叫人去请裘丰言。

时已深夜，天气已冷，

Having drunk himself pleasantly tipsy at dusk, Qiu had long since gone to bed.
裘丰言黄昏时分喝得醺醺然，早已上了床，

但听说嵇、胡二人请他围炉消夜，立刻披衣起床，

冒着凛冽的西北风，兴冲冲地赶到嵇家。

一进门他就把“寒夜客来茶当酒”这句诗改了一下，朗然而吟：“寒夜客来酒当茶！”

只见小丫头把门帘一掀，她一手提个酒瓶，一手提把酒壶，

中国酒、外国酒都有，你尽管喝！”

Qiu bowed deeply, took a bottle of brandy, pulled out the stopper, and drank straight from its mouth.
裘丰言兜头一揖，然后接过一瓶白兰地，拔开寒头，先就嘴对嘴喝了一口。

Ruiyun laughed again.
这一下惹得瑞云又笑，

“Mr Qiu makes drinking so easy.
“裘老爷喝酒倒省事，”她说，

There's no need to prepare food!”
“用不着备菜！”

“You might say that elsewhere, but I won't let you say it here.”

今天正好有这两样东西。”

没有说嫌自己家里的东西吃残的。”

裘丰言感于知遇，特别实力，

好在洋酒容易发散，

我有公事。”

裘丰言一天到晚无事忙，从未动笔办过公。事，而况又是如此深宵，说有公事，岂非奇谈！

“赶快回去跟你胖太太交帐，好让她早早筹划打年货！”

Qiu opened it and found a banknote for four hundred taels.
裘丰言抽开封套看，是一张四百两银子的银票，

Gratitude mingled with a sense of unworthiness, and his eyes reddened.
心里愧感交集，眼圈有些发红。

Hu would not let him say anything.
胡雪岩不肯让他说出什么来，

Gently urging him away, he said, “Off you go!
推着他说：“请吧，请吧，

I won't keep you.
我不留你了，

See you at Ji's later.”
回头嵇家见。”


Chen's unexpected arrival had surprised Hu, but the explanation was simple: Liu Bucai had pressed him into service.
陈世龙的不速而至，在胡雪岩颇感意外，但说穿了就不希奇，是刘不才“抓差”。

Negotiations at the Pang household had gone fairly smoothly, largely because of Hu's own earlier efforts.
到庞家的交涉，还算顺利，主要的还是靠胡雪岩自己，

His two letters had naturally led Wang Youling to treat Pang with special consideration and instruct his legal secretary to mediate the inheritance dispute.
由于他那两封信，王有龄对庞二自然另眼相看。嘱咐刑名老夫子替他们调解争产的纠纷。

The plaintiff, a distant uncle of Pang's, saw that with the prefect intervening, continuing the lawsuit would bring him no advantage.
原告是庞二的一个远房叔叔，看见知府出面调停，知道这场这司打下去得不到便宜，

It would be foolish to reject a cup offered courteously only to drink one imposed as punishment, so he accepted mediation.
那时“敬酒不吃吃罚酒”，未免不智，所以愿意接受调解。

Pang had already said that he did not mind spending a little, provided he could avoid litigation and appearing in court.
庞二早就有过表示。花几个钱不在乎，能够不打官司不上堂，
