胡雪岩实在不愿她离开，但又无法阻拦，只好怏怏然答应。

Alone at the inn, he felt utterly bored, without the slightest interest in anything.
一个人在旅馆里，觉得百无聊赖，做什么都没有兴致。

Forcing down his restlessness, he sat quietly and thought.
勉强把烦躁的心情按捺了下来，静坐着细想，

Suddenly he realised that he had never felt like this before.
突然发觉，这是从来不曾有过的事，

Even in his worst days, when Wang had gone to the capital and he had been dismissed from the bank and sat idle at home, he had never been so dispirited.
哪怕是王有龄到京里，他被钱庄辞退，在家赋闲的那段最倒霉的日子，也没有这样意兴阑珊过！

“What can it mean?” he murmured, secretly alarmed.
“这是什么道理？”胡雪岩喃喃自语，暗暗心惊，

“How have I suddenly lost all my drive?”
“怎么一下子卸掉了劲道？”


Perhaps he was simply too tired.
他在想，可能是自己太倦了。

Years of rushing about and dealing with countless difficulties had overdrawn his reserves of energy; he really needed a good rest.
经年奔波，遭遇过无数麻烦，精力形成透支，实在需要好好休息一下，

But he could not rest amid all the glitter and bustle of the foreign settlement.
但是在这夷场上，十丈软红尘中，无法休息，

Best of all would be to take A’qiao to a borrowed villa by West Lake and live quietly for two months, doing nothing, worrying about nothing.
最好是带着阿巧姐，借一处西湖的别墅，安安静静住上两个月，什么事不做，什么心不用，

They could row a boat or look at the hills at leisure.
闲来划划船、看看山，

In the evening they could get a fresh fish, cook the middle section in vinegar sauce, make soup from the head and tail, warm a jin of Bamboo-Leaf Green wine, and drink together by lamplight.
到晚来弄条鲜鱼，中段醋溜，头尾做汤，烫一斤竹时青跟阿巧姐灯下对酌，

That would be a life fit for immortals.
那就是神仙生活了。

He contemplated it longingly, then suddenly laughed at himself.
这样不胜向往地想着，忽又自笑，

His business had grown, yet his ambitions had shrunk.
事业做得大了，气局却反变得小！

In his first flush of success he had thought of buying all the land around his home, building a fine garden, giving daily banquets, keeping his seats filled with guests, and making a splendid display.
刚得意的那一刻，曾经想过，要把现在住处附近的地皮都买下来，好好盖座花园，日日开宴，座客常满，大大地摆一番场面。

Now he wanted only to withdraw quietly with A’qiao.
如今却只愿跟阿巧姐悄悄厮守，

Why?
这又是什么道理？

Putting his loss of drive and his shrinking ambitions together, he easily saw their common source: both feelings had appeared only in these past few days with A’qiao.
两件事并在一起想，很容易发觉相同之处：这些感觉，都是这几天跟阿巧姐在一起以后才有的。

People said that a woman's tender embrace was the easiest place for a man's ambition to waste away.
有人说：温柔乡中，最容易消磨一个人的志气。

There seemed to be something in it.
这话看来有道理。

Recognition brought alarm, and alarm gave way to defiance.
想到了这个道理，接着便是警惕，由警惕又生出不服气的感觉，

He decided to put A’qiao out of his mind and think about serious matters.
决定抛开阿巧姐，去想正经事。

That thought brought him out in a sweat.
这一想，就是一身汗！

There was no end of important business, yet somehow he had forgotten it all.
正事不知有多少，不知为何都抛在脑后！

To continue like this would be dangerous indeed.
这样下去，可真是危险了。


When A’qiao returned, he said, “Just make us something simple.
于是等阿巧姐回来，他说：“你马马虎虎弄顿饭来吃。

I have to go out after eating.”
吃完了，我要出门。”

“Listen to you!” She laughed.
“你看你！”阿巧姐笑道：

“When you're extravagant, every meal must come from a restaurant.
“阔气起来，要顿顿在馆子里叫菜，

When you're stingy, you won't even go out for a bowl of noodles.”
小气起来，连外面去吃碗面都不肯。”

This reminded him, and he laughed too.
这一下提醒了他，自己也失笑了，

“It's all because you talked about keeping house.
“都是你那‘做人家’这句话害的，

I kept thinking I had to eat lunch at home before going out.” He began to walk away.
我总以为要在家里吃了午饭再出门。”他一面走，一面说：

“All right, all right.
“好了，好了，

I'll eat outside.”
我到外面去吃。”

“Wait!”
“慢点！”

She caught hold of him and pointed to the basket.
阿巧姐拉住他，指着篮子说：

“What am I to do with all this food?”
“我一篮子的菜怎么办？”

“We'll eat it tonight.”
“晚上来吃！”

This pleased her greatly.
这句话使得她深为满意，

“Invite them all,” she said.
“请他们都来！”她说，

“There's more than we can finish.”
“菜多吃不完。”

“Good.
“也好！

You might as well make a little more and give Fifth Master You a farewell dinner.”
你索性多做些，就算替尤五爷饯行。”


Once outside, however, Hu felt at a loss.
等出得门来，却有些茫然，

His real purpose was to struggle against himself, refusing to sink into the comforts of love.
因为他的本意，只是自己跟自己较劲，不愿沉溺在温柔乡中。

There was much to be done, but some matters were not yet ripe, and others depended on news from other people before he could decide his next move.
要办的事虽多，或者还不到时候，或者要听候他人的消息，再定行止，

At this moment he could do nothing.
此时一事不能办，

Where should he go?
何去何从？

After some hesitation, he decided to try Yuji Silk Warehouse and find Chen first.
倒费踌躇。想一想还该先到裕记丝栈，找着了陈世龙再说。

Unfortunately, Chen had just gone out.
事不凑巧，陈世龙刚刚出门，

The clerk was most courteous and insisted that Hu stay, pressing tea and tobacco on him with every attention.
丝栈里的执事非常客气，一定要留胡雪岩在那里坐。奉茶奉烟，极其殷勤。

Hu could hardly refuse, but felt no inclination to make conversation.
他情不可却而懒于应酬，便这样答道：

“Please don't trouble yourselves over me.
“你们不必招呼我，

I'll have some tea and wait.
我喝喝茶等着，

Go about your business, or I shan't dare impose on you.”
尽管请便，不然我就不敢打搅了。”

The clerk understood that he did not want to sit among miscellaneous visitors and led him into a small room where You also held private conversations.
执事的听他这样说。知道他不愿跟闲杂人等在一起，便将他引入一间小屋，那也是尤五跟人约会谈体已话的地方，

The furnishings were nothing special, but there was a finely made, very comfortable reclining wicker chair, ideal for lying back and thinking.
布置不见得好，却有很精致舒服的一张藤靠椅，躺着想心事，最为合适。

“This is excellent,” Hu said happily.
“这里好！”他欣然说道，

“I can have a nap here.”
“我正好在这里打个盹！”

That made his wish not to be disturbed still clearer.
这就更明白表示出来，不愿有人搅扰了，

The clerk agreed at once, had a young apprentice bring in a freshly brewed covered bowl of tea, four dishes of fruit, and a water pipe, and arranged them on a square stool serving as a tea table.
执事的连声称是，叫小徒弟把一碗现泡的盖碗茶，四个果盘子，还有一支水烟袋都挪了进来，取张方凳当茶几，

Everything ready, he withdrew and closed the door.
安设停当，掩上门迟了出去。


Hu lay back in considerable comfort.
胡雪岩躺了下来，觉得相当舒服，

As his mind grew quiet, he became aware of voices in the next room, every word distinct.
心一静，便觉得隔室的谈话声，历历入耳。

Listening closely, he found they were discussing the land business.
留神细听，谈的是地皮生意。

He too had considered entering it, and now let nothing escape him.
胡雪岩亦曾有意于此，便一字不肯放过。

The two men knew a good deal about the foreign settlement and the foreigners' intentions.
那两人对洋场的情况，和洋人的动向，相当清楚，

They said that foreigners and Chinese did things differently.
说洋人跟中国人不同，

In China, roads emerged from use: people gathered, a market formed, and naturally a track was worn.
中国人的路是走出来，人多成市，自然走出一条路来，

By the time anyone planned a proper road, shops and stalls hemmed it in on both sides, leaving no room for widening.
等到预备修路，路面为两旁的市房摊贩所限制，已无法扩充。

The foreigners built their roads first.
洋人的办法不同，同先开路，

Roads brought people, people brought houses, and trade naturally flourished.
有了路便有人到，有人到便有房屋，自然市面会热闹起来。

That was why Chinese commercial districts could not grow on the same scale.
因此中国人的市面做不大，

One had to admire the foreigners' breadth of vision and boldness.
不能不佩服洋人的规模、气魄。

Hu had never heard anything like this.
这番话，在胡雪岩可说闻所未闻，

The more he considered it, the more sense it made.
细细玩味，果然大有道理。

Wang had told him about the capital, and now he understood why its commercial streets were different.
他听王有龄谈过京城里的情形、如今才知道京城的市面与众不同，

Its great population under the emperor's very feet explained only half of it.
一半固然因为天子脚下，人烟稠密，

The other half lay in its planning, which resembled the foreigners' method: broad roads laid out first, land divided into districts, separate places assigned to government offices, homes, and shops.
一半就因为京城里的建制，也跟洋人一样，先开好大路，分好地段，哪里做衙门，哪里住人，哪里开店，

Commercial areas were further distinguished: theatres and teahouses could open here, cattle, sheep, donkeys, and horses could be sold there.
开店又分出来，哪里可以开戏园茶楼，哪里可以贩牛羊驴马，

Such planning naturally produced an impressive result.
这样子的规模，自然就可观了。

“Look at Shanghai's layout,” one of the voices continued.
“照上海滩的地形看，

“With First Road, Second Road, and more laid out on that pattern, you can see how the northern and southern districts will prosper.
大马路、二马路，这样开下去。南北方面的热闹是看得到的，

But there's even greater promise to the west.
其实，向西一带，更有可为，

A man with foresight should buy all he can now, whether reed marsh or paddy field.
眼光远的，趁这时候，不管它芦荡、水田，尽量买下来，

Once the foreigners' roads reach it—good heavens!—he can sit at home and grow rich.”
等洋人的路一开到那里，乖乖，坐在家里发财。“


How could Hu lie there quietly after hearing that?
胡雪岩听隔室说到这里，哪还能静心躺下去？

Yet he had said he wanted a nap, so abruptly taking his leave would seem odd.
但说了睡个午觉，突然告辞而去，也不大合适。

He could only restrain himself and wait, though this kind of business talk was impossible for him to put out of his mind.
因而只好按捺心情强忍着，无奈遇到这种生意经，胡雪岩就是抛不开。

He did not know Shanghai's geography well enough to make plans.
他对上海的地形不熟，要筹划也无从筹划去，

What he longed to do was find Gu, climb into his Hengsimei carriage, and drive west as far as the area around Jing’an Temple.
这时候渴盼的，就是找到古应春，坐了他的那辆亨斯美往西一直到静安寺一带，

Only an inspection on the spot would satisfy him.
实地去看一看才符心愿。

Fortunately, Chen soon returned.
幸好，不久陈世尤就回来了。

Hu thanked the clerk warmly and left.
于是胡雪岩向执事殷殷致谢，辞了出来。

The first thing he said in the street was, “Shilong, do you know the area to the west?”
走到街上，第一句话就问：“世龙，你对西面一带熟不熟？”

“If you don't know it, Mr Hu, how could I?”
“胡先生部不熟，我怎么会熟？”

“Never mind.
“不管它，

Let's get a carriage and go for a drive.”
我们弄部马车去兜兜风。”

They hired a clean carriage and set off west from the mud city wall, taking whatever roads offered themselves.
于是雇了一辆干净车，由泥城墙往西，不择路而行。

After turn upon turn among paddy fields and stretches of water, Hu could scarcely tell which direction they were facing.
七兜八转，尽是稻田水荡，胡雪岩几乎连方向都辨不清楚了“。


As they drove without a fixed destination, Hu told Chen what he had overheard.
一路漫无目的地兜风，一路他把刚才所听到的话告诉了陈世龙。

Now Chen understood.
原来如此！陈世龙提出了一个见解：

“Mr Hu, there are two ways to approach this.
“胡先生，这件事有两个做法，

I'm afraid the first isn't practicable.”
第一个做法恐怕办不到。”

“Never mind that.
“你不管它，

Tell me.”
说来看！”

“The first requires money to spare.
“第一个办法是有闲钱。

Land is cheap, so even if it earns nothing, you buy it and leave it there until the price rises, then decide what to do.
反正地价便宜，譬如不赚，买了摆在那里，看哪一天地价涨了，再作道理。

It would make sense if you were providing for future generations.
依我看，为子孙打算，倒不妨这么办。

But your money has to keep working, Mr Hu, which is why I say it isn't practicable.”
不过胡先生，你手里的钱是要活用的，所以说办不到。”

He paused.
陈世龙停了停又说：

“The second would depend on Mr Gu.
“第二个做法，一定要靠古先生，

Find out which road the foreigners intend to build, get ahead of them, and buy the land nearby.
先去打听洋人准备修哪条马路，抢先一步，把附近的地皮买下来，

Then you could make a fortune in no time.”
那一来，转眼之间，就可以发财！”

“Yes!
“对！

That's right!”
这话对！”

Hu considered his suggestion, then suddenly saw something further.
胡雪岩拿他的话细想了一想，忽有启发，

“Though not entirely right.
“你的话也不全对。”

The cleverest course is to get the foreigners to build the road you want.”
他说，“最高明的做法是，叫洋人修那条马路！”

“But...”
“这……”

Chen understood, yet thought it impossible.
陈世龙想懂了他的意思。认为办不到，

“Why would the foreigners let someone else direct them?
“洋人岂肯听别人摆布，

Would they build whichever road you told them to?”
叫他修哪条路，他就修哪条路？”

“It depends on what men do.
“事在人为。

There must be some way.
总可以想得出办法。

Fortunately, there's no hurry over this.
好在这事也不急，

We can think it through.”
慢慢儿再说。”

That was Hu's way.
胡雪岩做事就是这样，

While he lacked information, his urgency to obtain it was like a house on fire.
不了解情况时，为求了解，急如星火，

Once he understood the facts and had a direction, he grew calm.
等到弄清楚事实，有了方针，他就从容了。

Chen knew that his talk of taking time meant neither delay nor abandonment.
陈世龙知道他的脾气，说是说“慢慢儿”，决不是拖延，更不是搁置，

Anyone working for him had to understand this and quietly make preparations.
帮着他做事，须知这一点，自己暗暗去做准备，

One day Hu might finish his thinking and produce a plan worked out in every detail, ready to put into effect at once.
说不定哪一天，他筹划好了，拿出来的计划详详细细，立刻可以动手，

If Chen had made no preparations, he would be unable to match Hu's pace or meet his requirements.
自己没有准备，就合不上他的步子和要求了。


“I must find some more men,” Hu said on the journey back.
“我还要多找几个人。”胡雪岩在归途中说：

“Keep an eye out for me when you return.”
“你这趟回去，随时替我留心。”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

After a moment's thought, Chen asked, “What work do you intend to give me eventually?
陈世龙想了想问：“胡先生将来到底叫我做什么？

I don't want to stay shut up in Huzhou.”
我不想死守在湖州。”

“I know.
“我知道。”

You like travelling about.
胡雪岩说，“你喜欢在外头跑，

Don't complain when the time comes.”
将来不要叫苦！”

“Why?”
“怎么呢？”

Hu considered without replying.
胡雪岩沉吟不答，

After a long silence, he asked, “Do you think the Shanxi remittance houses can be beaten?”
好久好久才问：“你看山西的票号，打不打得倒？”

“You can't bring them down.
“打是打不倒的！

They've built up credit over many years.
人家多年信用。

But if our banks were more flexible, instead of clinging to old rules as the remittance houses do, we ought to be able to win the market in the five southern provinces.”
不过饯庄的做法如果活络些，不象票号那样墨守成规，那么，南五省的地盘，应该可以拿得到。”

Hu liked this answer.
胡雪岩很欣赏陈世龙的态度，

Chen might look rather glib and superficial, but his words were sound.
看他的样子近乎浮滑一路，说话倒很实在，

He therefore told him what was in his mind.
因而将心里的话告诉了他。

“I've thought things over properly today.
“今天我好好细想了一想，

Banking is still my foundation.
我的基础还是在钱庄上面。

But I must change how I work.
不过，我的做法还要改。”

People speak of power and profit together: the two can't be separated.
他说，“势利、势利，利与势是分不开的，

With power comes profit.
有势就有利，

So for now, I needn't pursue profit.
所以现在先不必求利，

I must gain power.”
要取势。

“Power?”
““势？”

Chen thought carefully.
陈世龙很用心地想着，

“Do you mean influence, Mr Hu?”
“胡先生，你说的势是指势力？”

“Exactly.
“不错！

Influence in business and influence in official circles.
势力。商场的势力，官场的势力，

I want both.
我都要。

Even both won't be enough.”
这两样要到了，还不够。”

“And influence among the foreigners!”
“还有洋场的势力！”

Chen completed the thought.
陈世龙接着他的话说。

“Good!”
“好！”

Hu raised his thumb excitedly in sincere approval.
胡雪岩很兴奋地翘起大拇指，衷心夸赞陈世龙，

“If you can see into my mind like that, you're getting there.”
“你摸得到我的心思，就差不多了。”

Chen too was delighted, though he answered with restraint. “How could I compare with you? I'm not a tenth as good.
“我哪里及得上胡先生？十分之一部没有。”陈世龙也很高兴，矜持他说，

But I do understand something of how you work.”
“不过胡先生的路子，我总还不至于不懂。”


“As long as you understand!” Hu replied.
“你懂就好！”胡雪岩说，

“Times are changing.
“现在风气在变了！

You're a few years younger, after all; you can't compare things as I can.
你到底比我要轻个几岁，比较不出来，

Officials used to despise merchants—truly despise them.
从前做生意的人，让做官的看不起，真正叫看不起，

Even the great salt merchants of Yangzhou, who bought official rank as high as circuit intendant, would submit meekly to every order from a man who had risen through the examinations.
哪怕是杨州的大监商，捐班到道台，一遇见科举出身的，服服贴贴，唯命是从。

Only after the five ports opened to trade, when people saw that foreign merchants and officials were treated much the same, did their ideas begin to change.
自从五口通商以后，看人家洋人，做生意的跟做官的，没有啥分别，大家的想法才有点不同。

In this past year or so, I'd say the position has shifted further: officials have to depend on merchants.
这一年把，照我看，更加不对了，做官的要靠做生意的！

Why do I want influence among the foreigners?
为啥我要洋场的势力，

Because official power doesn't reach into their sphere.
就因为做官的势力达不到洋场，

The authorities need men like me to make the connections.
这就要靠我这佯的人来穿什引线。

Once I have influence in official circles and among the foreigners, extending my influence in business will naturally be easier.”
所以有了官场的势力，再有洋场的势力，自然商场的势力就容易大了。”

Chen listened, nodding and considering each point.
陈世龙一面听，一面点头，细细体味着胡雪岩的话，

Hu's words gave him much to understand.
悟出来许多道理。


As they talked, they found themselves back among crowded streets without noticing the time.
就这样谈着，不知不觉又回到人烟稠密之区，

Only then did Hu remember A’qiao's request to invite You and Gu home for dinner.
胡雪岩这时才想起阿巧姐的话，要约尤五和古应春到家吃饭，

It was already late, and he feared they might have other engagements.
一见时候不早，深怕他们另有约会，

He hurried to Yiqing House, but nobody was there, not even Second Miss.
便即赶到怡情院，谁知一个人都不见，连怡情老二亦不在那里。

There was, however, a message.
人虽不遇，却留着话，

The male attendant told him that You had said, “Ask Mr Hu to wait.
“相帮”的告诉胡雪岩，说尤五关照：“请胡老爷等他，

I'll be back at six sharp.”
他准六点钟回来。”

And what would happen when they met at six?
六点钟见了面怎么样？

Suppose You had another engagement, or was entertaining guests at Yiqing House himself?
如果他说另有约会，或者自己在怡情院请客，那么，

How could Hu explain that to A’qiao?
阿巧姐那里就不好交代了。

The thought made him visibly restless.
这样想着，便有些坐立不安的神气。

Chen had seldom seen him in such a state and was surprised, though still more concerned.
陈世龙很少看见他有过这种样子，不免诧异，当然，更多的是关切，

When he asked and learned the reason, he was inwardly amused.
一问起来，才知究竟，心里好笑，

A proverb came to mind: “Even a hero finds a beauty hard to resist.”
不由得想起一句俗语：“英雄难过美人关”。

Men of the highest ability often became helpless and utterly at a loss in such matters.
一等一的厉害角色，在这上头，往往手足无措，一筹莫展，

Here another saying applied: “The onlooker sees clearly.”
这便又用得着“旁观者清”这句话了。

“There's no difficulty.
“这不用为难，

Either I can go and let her know, or I can stay here to wait.”
或者我去通知一声，或者我留在这里等！”

“Yes, yes!” Hu interrupted before he had finished.
“对，对！”不待他说完，胡雪岩就说，

“Go and tell her I'm waiting here for them and will return as soon as they arrive.
“你去一趟吧！这样告诉她：我在这里等他们，等到了就回来。

If I can't bring the guests, I'll certainly come home for dinner myself.”
如果客人约不来，我一定回家吃饭。”


Chen went on this errand and found A’qiao sitting quite at ease.
陈世龙衔命而去，只见阿巧姐很安闲的坐在那里，

She greeted him politely, heard his message, and replied without concern, “That's all right.
一见很客气，听陈世龙讲完，毫不在乎的说：“不要紧！

There aren't many dishes.
没有几样菜，

The steamed ones can go on steaming; I'll wait until everyone arrives before putting the others in the wok.”
蒸的蒸着，要炒的，等人到了再下锅。”

Her calm self-possession had a different charm from Furong's gentleness.
看她从容不迫的样子，跟芙蓉那种宛转的神态，是不同的风味。

Mr Hu was certainly fortunate in love, Chen thought.
栋世龙心里便想：胡先生的艳福倒真不浅！

Another difference was A’qiao's remarkable fluency.
还有一样不同的，是阿巧姐的谈锋极健，

Chen considered himself a good talker, but beside her he felt at a disadvantage.
陈世龙也算很善于词令的，相形之下，自觉见绌，

As the conversation continued, he suddenly realised that he might have said too much.
而且谈到后来，忽然发觉，自知可能是失言了，

Through indirect questions she had drawn a great deal from him about Hu's family.
因为阿巧姐的旁敲侧击，他把胡雪岩的家庭情况，透露了许多。

Fortunately, he had not mentioned that Mrs Hu was both formidable and highly capable.
所幸的是，不曾说出胡太太是很厉害也很能干的妇人。

Now on his guard, and feeling that he should not stay too long, he rose to leave.
一则起了戒心，再则亦不便久坐，陈世龙便起身告辞。

A’qiao knew that he was Hu's trusted man and naturally wished to win him over.
阿巧姐知道他是胡雪岩的心腹，当然要加以宠络，

She repeatedly urged him to stay, finally saying, “I only dispense with ceremony because you're one of Mr Hu's own people.
一再挽留，最后这样说道：“你是胡老爷自己人，我才不作客气，

Otherwise I wouldn't insist.
不然，我也不会留你。

Unless, of course, you don't regard me as one of his own.”
除非你不当我自己人看待。”

She was plainly speaking as Hu's woman established in a separate household.
说到这样的话，俨然以胡雪岩的外室自居，

Chen could see how deeply Hu liked her, but the eventual outcome was still entirely uncertain.
陈世龙已看出“胡先生”对她极其喜爱，而将来结局如何，尚在未定之天，

If he insisted on leaving, it might indeed suggest that he refused to accept her as belonging to Hu, and arouse her suspicions.
如果坚决告辞，仿佛真的不当她“自己人”，在阿巧姐会起疑心，

That would be unwise.
似乎不妥，

He changed his answer.
因而改了主意：

“I'd better go back and give Mr Hu your message first.
“我还是先回去，跟胡先生说一声，

Then we'll come together.”
回头再一起来。”

“Well, you must be sure to come back!”
“那么，”阿巧姐悦，“回头一定要来噢！”

“Certainly, certainly.”
“一定，一定！”


Chen left Daxing Inn and walked at an easy pace.
出了大兴客栈，安步当车，

He had gone only a few steps when a woman called, “Shilong!”
刚走得不多几步路，忽然听得有女人在喊：“世龙！”

Looking up, he saw the Seventh Lady.
定睛一看，是七姑奶奶，

Gu was driving the carriage himself and had also noticed him.
古应春亲自驾车，也发见了陈世龙，

He stopped.
停下来问道：

“Where are you going?”
“你到哪里去？”

“Back to Yiqing House.”
“我回怡情院去。”

“No need.
“不必了！”

We've come specially to fetch Sister A’qiao.
古应春说，“我们特为来接阿巧姐，

We're all gathering at our place tonight.
今晚上，在我们那里聚会，

You must come too.”
你也去。”

Chen therefore turned back, and the three went into Daxing Inn together.
于是陈世龙又折回，三个人一起又到大兴客栈，

The Seventh Lady and A’qiao had never met.
七姑奶奶跟阿巧姐是初见，

One was punctiliously polite, the other warmly affectionate; both were talkative.
一个守礼，一个亲热，而都健谈，

Holding hands, they ranged far and wide over all they had heard of one another.
所以拉着手，前朝后代，大谈渊源，

The Seventh Lady said that Gu had told her how capable and pretty A’qiao was.
七姑奶奶说听古应春谈过，知道她能干漂亮，

A’qiao replied that Second Miss had described this frank, lively lady who dared to visit a place like Yiqing House.
阿巧姐则说听怡情老二说起，有这样一位豪爽有趣，敢到怡情院这种地方的堂客。

They took to one another at once and seemed to regret not having met sooner.
彼此都很投机，大有相见恨晚之意，

Gu, however, grew impatient.
古应春却不耐烦了：

“My dear lady, you've talked for ages.
“我的姑奶奶，谈了半天，

Say something about why we're here!”
你倒说点正经话啦！”

They had come specially to invite her.
正经话是特地来邀客，

As Hu and You were about to leave for Suzhou and Hangzhou, the Seventh Lady had ordered a farewell banquet from an Anhui restaurant.
因为胡雪岩和尤五要动身到苏杭，七姑奶奶特地在徽馆叫了一桌席，替他们饯行。

Hu, meanwhile, wanted everyone at Daxing Inn to try A’qiao's cooking.
胡雪岩又要邀到大兴客栈，尝试阿巧姐的烹调手段，

The result was a deadlock.
变成僵持的局面。

“It makes no difference whether we eat at your place or mine,” the Seventh Lady said.
“我在想，到你这里，到我那里都一样。

“But first, I can't cancel the banquet, and it would be a pity to waste several taels.
不过，第一，叫了席不能退掉，几两银子也可惜，

Second, my place is more convenient.
第二，到我那里比较方便。”

The weather isn't hot yet.
七姑奶奶又说：“天气也还不热，

Even if your dishes are already cooked, they'll keep overnight.
就做好了菜，摆一夜也不会坏。

I'll come and eat them tomorrow!”
明天我来吃！”


A’qiao naturally agreed without hesitation.
阿巧姐自然一诺无辞，

Saying that she must change, she asked them to sit in the outer room, then quietly drew Chen aside.
以换衣服为名，请他们在外屋坐，却把陈世龙悄悄找到一边，

Taking out four foreign silver dollars, she said, “Young Master Chen, may I ask a favour?
模出四块银洋说道，“陈少爷！我拜托你一件事。

It's my first visit to the Seventh Lady.
第一趟上七姑奶奶的门，

I can't arrive empty-handed.
不能空手，

Please buy four kinds of food for me and bring them to her house.”
托你替我办四样吃食东西，带到七姑奶奶那里去。”

“I don't know where she lives.”
“七姑奶奶家，我不认识。”

Then Chen had an idea.
陈世龙转念有了主意，

“But never mind.
“不过不要紧，

Leave it to me.”
你交给我。”

Once she had changed, all four rode together to the Seventh Lady's door.
等她换好衣服，四个人一辆马车到了七姑奶奶门口。

Now that Chen knew the address, he said, “I'll be back in a moment,” and turned away.
阵世龙认清了地方说：“我马上就来！”说完掉身就转，

At the mouth of the lane were a confectioner's shop and a fruit stall.
在弄堂口就有茶食店、水果摊，

He bought a basket of American oranges, a basket of Tianjin duck pears, and a large box of pine-nut candy.
买了一篓花旗橘子，一篓天津鸭梨、茶食店里买了一大盒松子糖，

Two dollars remained.
还剩下两块钱，

He asked the shopkeeper to take down an aged ham, and when the total came to forty cents more than he had, he advanced the difference himself.
叫店家拿一条陈火腿下来，算一算差四角饯，陈世龙替她垫上。

“These are Sister A’qiao's gifts to the Seventh Lady,” he said with a smile.
“这是阿巧姐送七姑奶奶的。”陈世龙笑道：

“I'm the junior here, so today I shall eat for nothing.”
“我是小辈，今天就白吃了。”


“Why stand on ceremony?” the Seventh Lady said.
“何用客气。”七姑奶奶说，

“Sister A’qiao, we're like family.
“阿巧姐，我们象自己人一样，

I'll open the skylight and speak plainly: I don't care for all this, and I'm no good at it myself.”
我跟你‘打开无窗说亮话’，我不喜欢这一套，我自己也弄不来这一套。”

Gu could not help reproaching her. “Listen to yourself.
“你看你，”古应春忍不住埋怨她，

She means well, and that's all she gets from you.
“人家一番好意，倒落得你这么两句话。

Sister A’qiao knows your nature, but wouldn't anyone who didn't think you unfeeling?”
阿巧姐是晓得你的脾气的，不晓得的人，岂不是要怪你不近人情。”

“Not at all!”
“不会，不会！”

A’qiao put in quickly.
阿巧姐抢着说道，

“I know the Seventh Lady dislikes empty formalities.
“我也晓得七姑奶奶不喜欢这些虚文，

But we're so used to them that we can't change.
不过，我们是弄惯了，改不过来，

Fortunately, Young Master Chen chose well.
好在陈少爷买得好，

These are all useful things.
都是实惠的东西，

Even if I hadn't brought them, she'd have to spend money buying them.”
就我不送。七姑奶奶也要花钱买的。”

“That's true enough,” the Seventh Lady said, smiling.
“这倒是实话。”七姑奶奶笑嘻嘻的说，

Then she added apologetically, “I always say whatever comes into my head.
又表示歉意，“我说话一向是想到哪里，说到哪里，

Don't take offence if I say something wrong.”
说错了你不要怪我。

Nobody else found these two sentences remarkable, but Chen was astonished.
“这两句话，别人都不觉得什么，只有陈世龙大为惊异，

She had never spoken like that before.
因为她以前决无这种口吻，

It seemed that Gu's quiet influence was having its effect.
看来是古应春的潜移默化之功。


Chen was about to make a teasing remark when he heard footsteps on the stairs.
正想要说一两句调侃的话，作为取笑，只听楼梯上有声音，

You and Hu appeared together, still talking as they walked.
接着是尤五和胡雪岩一路走，一面谈着，相偕出现，

They offered brief greetings and continued their conversation.
略略招呼了一下，继续谈话，

Chen gathered that they had been visiting someone who could be very useful in settling the trouble within the Zhejiang brotherhood.
陈世龙听出来，他们去拜访了一位人物，这位人物对于调处浙江溜帮的纠纷，大有用处，

They were now discussing whether to invite him to Hangzhou as well.
现在是在商量，是不是要把这位人物一起请到杭州去。

“Can't your conversation ever end?
“你们有啥谈不完的话？

Talk later.
回头再谈，

Dinner's ready.”
要开席了。”

Then the Seventh Lady had another thought.
七姑奶奶忽然又说：

“There aren't enough of us to make it lively.
“人少了欠热闹。

Why not invite Second Miss?”
何不把老二也请了来。”

“No need, no need!”
“不必，不必！”

You waved his hands.
尤五插手说道，

“She's gone out on a banquet engagement.
“她出局去了，

She'll come later.”
回头会来的。”

Dinner was served in the main room.
于是在堂屋中开席，

Six people sat at a round table that seemed rather too large.
一张圆台面，坐了六个人，似乎嫌大。

Unable to resist the Seventh Lady's insistence, A’qiao shared the place of honour with Hu.
阿巧姐经不住七姑奶奶的硬作主张，与胡雪岩并居首席，

Men and women sitting interspersed was a complete departure from custom, and A’qiao had never occupied the seat of honour before.
这样官客与堂客夹杂而坐，大反惯例，而坐首席更是阿巧姐的破题儿第一遭，

She was therefore rather constrained and kept well away from Hu.
所以相当拘谨，跟胡雪岩隔得远远地。

After the first round of wine, he asked her, “What have you and the Seventh Lady been talking about?”
酒过一巡，胡雪岩对阿巧姐说道：“你跟七姑奶奶谈了些什么？”

“All sorts of things.
“话多了。

She's so frank.
七姑奶奶脾气直爽，

It was delightful.”
谈得真有趣。”

“Why don't you come and keep her company more often?”
“那你何不常跟七姑奶奶来作伴。”

You coughed.
说到这里，尤五咳嗽了一声，

Only then did Hu remember that You was urging his sister to return to her family home.
胡雪岩才想起，他是极力主张七姑奶奶回娘家的，

Wouldn't frequent visits from A’qiao give her an excuse to stay in Shanghai?
如说阿巧姐常来跟作她伴，岂不是给了她一个留在上海的借口？


The Seventh Lady paid no attention to these considerations.
七姑奶奶却不理会这些，

“Little Uncle is right.
“小爷叔这话对！”

Why don't you come to Songjiang with me for a few days?”
她说，“你陪我到松江去住几天好不好？”

“Excellent!”
“这很好！”

You was slightly surprised and hastened to encourage the idea.
尤五微觉意外，赶紧怂恿，

“Sister A’qiao, do go and stay there.
“阿巧姐，你就到那里去住几天。

It's easy to travel back and forth.
好在来去方便，

You can return to Shanghai whenever you please.”
你想回上海，随时可以回来。”

“I should feel awkward imposing on your household.” Though she said this, her bright eyes kept turning towards Hu.
“打搅府上，不好意思。”说是这样说，一双俏眼只瞄着胡雪岩，

His attitude would determine what she did.
要看他的态度定行止，

He naturally expressed approval, but Gu had a different opinion.
胡雪岩自然表示赞成，反倒是古应春有了意见。

“I don't think she need go to Songjiang or stay in Shanghai.
“我看松江也不必去，上海也不必留，

Why not simply accompany Little Uncle on a visit to Suzhou?”
索性跟小爷叔到苏州去逛一趟。”

“That's another possibility.”
“这倒也是个办法。”

You looked at them both.
尤五看着他们俩问：

“What do you think?”
“怎么样？”

Hu genuinely found it hard to decide.
胡雪岩实在有些委决不下，

On one hand, A’qiao's company would make the journey warm and delightful.
一方面觉得有阿巧姐作伴，此行一定温馨愉快，

On the other, after sharing a bed and living together, travelling together as well would hammer in the nail and bend its point: the case would become unassailable.
一方面又觉得双宿双飞之余，更加以相携相将，越发变成敲钉转脚，铁案如山，

He would be able only to go forward, never retreat.
只可进不可退了。

It therefore depended on what A’qiao herself wanted.
这就要看阿巧姐自己的意思。

She had come from misunderstanding Hu to understanding him, and from understanding him to accepting Second Miss's advice.
而她对胡雪岩由误解而了解，由了解而接受抬情老二的劝告，

Her mind was already made up.
已经下定决心，

But she had known many people and understood the world thoroughly.
不过阅人已多，世故熟透，

She would never force his hand at every turn and make him wary of her, keeping a respectful distance.
决不肯事事勉强，引起胡雪岩的忌惮敬远之心，

For the moment, she said nothing.
所以此时默不作声。


“Well?” the Seventh Lady pressed.
“怎么样？”七姑奶奶催问着，

“Songjiang or Suzhou?”
“还是到松江，还是到苏州？”

Put like that, A’qiao could naturally only answer Songjiang.
这一问，在阿巧姐当然只能回答到松江。

Gu was more perceptive in such matters than the Seventh Lady and spoke before she could reply.
古应春在这些地方，自比七姑奶奶更机敏，便不等她开口回答，先就抢着说了句：

“Suzhou, of course.”
“当然是到苏州。”

“Suzhou it is,” Hu decided, though he still had to ask the woman concerned.
“到苏州就到苏州。”胡雪岩定了主意，但不能不问一问本人，

“Will you come?”
“去不去？”

Here A’qiao showed her skill.
这就是阿巧姐能干了，

She said neither yes nor no, but merely, “The Seventh Lady has been so kind...”
她不说去，也不说不去，只说：“七姑奶奶一片好意……”

She meant to accept, while still acknowledging the Seventh Lady.
意思是答应了。还照顾着七姑奶奶，

Though only a verbal courtesy, it made a favourable impression.
虽是口头上的人情，也惹人好感。

“Never mind, never mind!” the Seventh Lady replied.
“不要紧，不要紧！”七姑奶奶说，

“Once you're back from Suzhou, I'll come and take you to Songjiang.”
“等你苏州回来，我再来接你到松江去玩。”

That settled the matter.
事情就这样定局了，

Everyone had packing to do, so they broke up early, agreeing to lunch the following day in Second Miss's little house and then board their separate boats.
各人要收拾行装，早早散去，约定第二天中午在怡情老二小房中吃中饭，吃完分别上船。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十三章起连续正文（之一；底本未标第二十四章）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Continuous text beginning with Chapter Twenty-Three, part one (the source supplies no Chapter Twenty-Four heading)
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER TWENTY-THREE｜第二十三章


Back at Daxing Inn, A’qiao packed the things they would need and asked Hu Xueyan about the purpose of the journey.
回到大兴客栈，阿巧姐一面收拾随身动用什物，一面问起胡雪岩此行的目的，

There was no reason to conceal it.
这没有什么隐瞒的必要，

He knew, moreover, that she was no ignorant woman without judgment or a sense of what mattered, so he told her the truth.
而且也深知她不是那种无知无识，不懂轻重的妇女，所以他把实话都告诉了她。

“What sort of official is an education commissioner?”
“学台是个啥个官？”

“He oversees the examinations for licentiates.”
“专管考秀才的。”

“Does he have any extra income?”
“有没有外快？”

“That I don't really understand.
“这我倒不大懂了。”胡雪岩说，

I hear that Sichuan and Guangdong are lucrative appointments.
“听说四川学台、广东学台是肥缺。

I don't know about Jiangsu.
江苏就不晓得了。

But with war and disorder everywhere, there are many places he can't even visit.
照我想，现在兵荒马乱，好些地方连去都不能去。

With his territory reduced, any extra income must be limited.”
地盘一小，就有外快也有限。

“If that's so, asking Commissioner He to seek office in a good province may not work.”
““如果是这样子，要请何学台去谋干一个好地方的官，只怕不成功。”

“Why?”
“怎么呢？”

“It takes money!”
“要钱呀！”

She smiled.
阿巧姐笑一笑又说，

“Not that I understand these things.
“我是不懂啥！

But once, at Yiqing House, a Mr Wang awaiting a circuit appointment gave a party and talked at length about the business side of official life.
有一次一个候补道台汪老爷在怡情院请客，大讲官场的生意经，

You have to send money to the great gentlemen in the capital, he said.
说是京里的大老倌那里，都要送钱的。

The more money, the easier promotion becomes.”
钱越多，越容易升官。”

“Mm, mm.”
“嗯，嗯！”

Reminded of this, Hu privately formed a plan, but did not explain it.
胡雪岩被提醒了，暗地里打了主意，却不愿说破，

Too much depended on it; even to a woman like A’qiao, it was better left unsaid.
因为其中出入关系甚大，即令是对阿巧姐这样的人，也是不说的好。

“You must at least take some gifts,” she added.
“总还要送点礼啊！”阿巧姐又说。

“I have those—four kinds of foreign goods.”
“那有了，备了四色洋货。”

“Where is Commissioner He from?”
“何学台哪里人？”

“Yunnan.”
“云南。”

“Then wouldn't things from Yunnan be better?”
“那不如送云南东西……”

“Ah, exactly!”
“啊，对！”

Hu praised her warmly.
胡雪岩大力赞赏：

“A’qiao, you have a very good head.”
“阿巧，你的脑筋真不错。”


Early the next morning, Hu went to Gu Yingchun for help in finding Yunnan specialities.
于是第二天一早，胡雪岩便去寻古应春，要觅云南土产，

They eventually found a Yunnan official awaiting appointment as an assistant departmental magistrate, who had escorted copper to the Jiangsu provincial treasurer's yamen.
结果找着一个解铜到江苏藩司衙门的云南候补州判，

From him they obtained four local products: Xuanwei ham, purple datoucai, jizong mushrooms and dried salted beef.
在他那里转让了四佯云南土产。这四样土产是宣威火腿、紫大头菜、鸡踪菌和咸牛肉干，

Unfortunately, there was not much of any of them, but their scarcity made them all the more precious.
可惜数量不多，但也正因为数量不多，便显得物以稀为贵了。

After lunch at Second Miss's, the party agreed not to see one another off.
中午在怡情老二那里吃了饭，彼此约定，互不相送。

When the man Gu had arranged to escort Hu arrived, Hu courteously asked his name, and they boarded together.
等古应春替他安排护送的那个人一到，胡雪岩很客气地请教了“尊姓台甫”，然后一起上船，

Their vessel was a ‘Wuxi fast boat’ towed by a small steam launch.
船是小火轮拖带的一条“无锡快”，

Hu and A’qiao occupied the aft cabin, while the forward cabin was left to their escort.
胡雪岩带着阿巧姐住后舱，前舱止给护送的那个人住。


His name was Zhou Yiming, and he came from Hunan.
此人名叫周一鸣，湖南人，

He had once served as a detachment officer in the Jiangnan naval force, but was fond of drinking and making trouble.
原在江南水师中当哨官，因为喜欢喝酒闹事，

After injuring his superior's younger brother-in-law, he had received twenty strokes of the military cane and been dismissed.
一次打伤了长官的小舅子，被责了二十军棍，开革除名。

Though badly behaved in drink, Zhou was generous and loyal to his friends.
但同一鸣的酒德虽不好，为人倒极豪爽重义气，

His naval service had acquainted him with many boatmen, so at first he went round the wharves seeking handouts, which people willingly gave.
由于在水师当差，认识的船户颇不少，所以起先是跑码头、打秋风，大家也乐予周济，

Sometimes they asked him to carry a message.
有时托他带个把口信，

Having accepted their support, he faithfully discharged their business, making certain that every errand was properly done.
他倒也“食人之禄，忠人之事”，一定确确实实做到，

Gradually he earned a reputation and began helping at the Shanghai boatmen's tea association.
慢慢地有了信用，便在上海船户的“茶会”上帮忙。

Such associations existed in every trade and functioned much like guildhalls.
各行各业的茶会，犹如同业公所，

Whether to arrange business, deal with officials or settle disputes over tea, members discussed their affairs there.
或者按头生意，或者与官场打交道，或者同业中有纠纷“吃讲茶”，都在茶会上商谈，

Zhou became an important figure in the boatmen's association.
周一鸣就成了船户茶会上的一名要角，

In particular, when officials imposed requisitions for boats or other compulsory service, he handled the negotiations.
特别是“抓船”、“派差”等等官面上硬压下来的公事，都由周一鸣出面去接头。

He had official business in Suzhou on this occasion.
这次也是有公事到苏州，

Gu, who knew him, therefore entrusted Hu to his care.
古应春跟他相熟，正好把胡雪岩托了他，

He would hire the boat and provide the escort, for an agreed twenty taels.
连雇船带护送，都归他包办，讲好送二十两银子。

Hu was famous for his generosity.
胡雪岩的出手大方是出名的，

As soon as they boarded, he put a thirty-tael note into a red envelope and presented it with both hands.
一上船就找了个红封套，装了一张三十两银子的银票，当面双手奉上。

Zhou tried to decline, but Hu was so earnest that he accepted with repeated thanks.
周一鸣还要客气，禁不住胡雪岩言词恳切，他千恩万谢地收了下来。

His attentions throughout the journey were naturally all the more thorough.
这一路招呼得自是格外周到。


Hu never liked taking a personal attendant on his travels, so Zhou volunteered to manage everything on arrival in Suzhou: hiring chairs, carrying luggage and finding an inn.
胡雪岩出门一向不喜欢带听差，于是周一鸣自告奋勇，到了苏州雇轿子，提行李，下客栈，都由他一手经理。

The inn stood outside Chang Gate and was called Jinchang.
客栈在阎门外，字号就叫“金阎”，

等安置停当，周一鸣要告辞了。

“胡大老爷！”因为胡雪岩是捐班候补知县，所以他这要称呼他，“我在苏州有个‘门口’，现在回去看一看。

Tomorrow morning I must deliver documents and attend to business at the naval yamen.
明天上半天到水师衙门去投文办事，

I'll come to wait on you at midday.
中午过来伺候。

Would that suit you?”
你老看，行不行？”

“I have a rather troublesome favour to ask.
“我有个不情之请。”胡雪岩说，

Four gifts and a letter—could you deliver them now?”
“有四件东西，一封信，想拜托你此刻就送一送。”

“Certainly.
“是了。”周一鸣问，

Where to?”
“送到哪里？”

“To Education Commissioner He.
“送给何学台。

First we must find out where he's staying.”
还得先打听一下，何学台公馆在哪里？”

“That's easy.
“这容易，

Leave it to me.”
都交给我好了。”

Hu had Jinchang Inn's bookkeeper prepare a formal visiting card, with the address below: “Lodging outside Chang Gate, Jinchang Inn, west side of the third courtyard.”
于是胡雪岩托金间栈的帐房，写了个手本，下注：“寓阊门外金阎栈第三进西头”，

连同四样云南土仪和一封王有龄的信，都交了给周一鸣。

信是胡雪岩密封了的，内中附着一张五千两的银票，作为王有龄送何桂清的，

这封信当然重要，所以胡雪岩特别叮嘱：

“老周，还要麻烦你，务必跟何公馆的门上说明白，讨一张有何学台亲笔的回片。”

“Yes.
“是！”周一鸣问，

Shall I bring it back today?”
“今天要不要把回片送来？”

Hu reflected that one should not employ a man one distrusted, or distrust a man one employed.
胡雪岩心想，疑人莫用，用人莫疑，

Zhou valued loyalty and had an established background.
而且周一鸣人既重义气，又是有来历的，

因而很快地答道：“如果回片上只写收到，那就不必来了，

明天再说。”

等周一鸣一走，胡雪岩的迫不及待的想跟阿巧姐去观光。

Suzhou was unlike Shanghai.
苏州不比上海，

Women there liked visiting temples to burn incense and joining the crowds at festivals and processions, but for a man and woman to appear together, whether at Xuanmiao Temple or along Shantang by Tiger Hill, was to parade themselves before the public and invite gossip.
虽然妇女喜欢小庙烧香，凡有出会报赛等等人声鼎沸的场面，都要去轧个热闹，但一男一女不论是出现在玄妙观，还是虎丘山塘，总是招摇过市、惹人物议的一件事，

A’qiao was a native of the district and might meet acquaintances, which required still greater caution.
而且阿巧姐是本乡本土，难免遇见熟人，尤须顾忌，

因此，她更觉为难。

就在这软语相磨，未定行止之际，只见周一鸣把顶红缨帽捏在手里当扇子扇，

跑得满头大汗，却是笑容满面，

胡雪岩当是何桂清有什么话交代，赶紧迎了出去。

“Delivered!
“送到了！”周一鸣说，

Here is the reply.”
“回贴在这里。”

接过回贴来一看，

只见上面写着一行字：“王太守函一件，收讫。

外隆仪四色，敬领谢谢。”

贴尾又有一行字，“敬使面致。”

“胡大老爷，真要谢谢你挑我。”周一鸣垂着手打个千说：

Commissioner He is most generous.
“何学台出手很阔，

He gave me twenty taels.”
赏了我二十两银子。”

This enhanced Hu's own standing, and he was pleased.
听这一说，胡雪岩觉得很有面子，便说：

“Excellent.
“很好，

Keep it.”
你收下好了。”

“I came specially to tell you that the commissioner is staying at the Suzhou Prefectural Academy.”
“我特为跟你老来说一声，何学台住在苏州府学。”

“Oh.
“喔，

Did you see him?”
你见着何学台没有？”

“No.
“见是没有见着。

But his steward came out and said he was delighted.”
不过听他们二爷出来说，学台很高兴。”

Whether He was delighted by the five thousand taels, the four Yunnan gifts, or both, Hu could not tell.
高兴的是收到五千两银子，还是四色云南土产，或则两者兼而有之？胡雪岩就不知道了。

In any event, he owed it to A’qiao.
不过不管怎么样，都算是得阿巧姐的力。


For that reason, Hu accepted her wishes and did not press her to go out with him.
因为如此，他便依从了她的意思，不勉强她一起出游。

He still intended to take a walk alone, but first sought her advice.
但打算一个人出去逛逛，这得先跟阿巧姐请教，

They were discussing Suzhou's famous gardens and old temples when the innkeeper hurried straight in.
正在谈着苏州城里的名园古刹，突然发现金阎栈的掌拒，行色匆匆，直奔了进来。

“Your Honour!
“胡大老爷，胡大老爷！”掌柜说道：

Education Commissioner He has come to call.
“何学台来拜，

He's already out of his chair.”
已经下轿了。”

Hu was alarmed.
听这一说，胡雪岩倒有些着慌，

First, he had no attendant to receive the visiting card.
第一，没有听差“接贴”，

Second, he ought to put on official dress to welcome his visitor, and there was no time.
第二，自己该穿公服肃迎，时间上来不及了。

For a moment he did not know what to do.
所以一时有手足无措之感。

A’qiao was more composed.
还是阿巧姐比较沉着，

“What is the commissioner wearing?”
“何学台穿啥衣服来的？”她问。

“Informal clothes.”
“穿的便服。”

“That's a relief,” Hu said.
“这还好！”胡雪岩接口说道：

“There's no time.
“来不及了，

I shall have to receive him informally too.”
我也只好便服相迎。”

He went out.
说着，他便走了出去，

A’qiao hastily tidied the luggage they had unpacked but not yet put away, then watched at the window, ready to withdraw as soon as He arrived.
阿巧姐也赶紧将屋里刚刚倒散未曾归理的行李，略略收拾了一下，在窗口张望，只等何桂清一到，便要回避。


He Guiqing met Hu at the middle gateway of the second courtyard.
何桂清是走到第二进中门遇着胡雪岩的。

虽然穿的便衣，但跟着两名青衣小帽的听差，便能认出他的身分，

胡雪岩却还下敢造次，

站住脚一青，

The visitor was about his own age, with an exceptionally fair, clean-cut face, exactly as Wang had described.
这位来客年纪与自己用仿，生得极白净的一张脸，这模样与王有龄所形容的何桂清的仪表，完全相符，

便知再不得错了。

“何大人！”他迎面请个安说：

“真不敢当。”

“请起，请起！”

何桂清拱拱手说：

“You must be Brother Xueyan?”
“想来足下就是雪岩兄了？”

“I don't deserve that form of address.
“不敢当此称呼！

I am Hu Xueyan.”
我是胡雪岩。”

“幸会之至。”说着，何桂清又移动了脚步。于是胡雪岩引路，将何桂清引到自己屋里。

就这几步路，做主人的转了好些念头，

The situation was awkward.
他发觉情况很尴尬，

An official of the second rank was calling on a new acquaintance at an inn, with neither a proper reception hall for such a guest nor servants to attend them.
二品大员拜访一个初交，地点又是在客栈里，既没有象佯的堂奥可以容纳贵客，又没有听差可以供奔走之役。

The ceremonies of official life would be difficult to observe.
这样子就很难讲官场的仪节了。

He would simply treat He as an intimate.
索性当他自己人！

Having decided, he first changed his form of address.
胡雪岩断然作了这样一个决定，首先就改了称呼，

He's courtesy name was Genyun; following the familiar respectful form he used for Wang as Mr Xuexuan, Hu addressed He as Mr Genyun.
何桂清字根云，便仿照“雪公”的例，称他“云公”。

“Mr Genyun,” he said on bringing him into the reception area, “we mustn't neglect propriety.
接入客座，他这样说道：“公云，礼不可废，

请上坐，让我这个候补知县参见！”

This was merely an opening flourish.
这是打的一个“过门”，

Informal dress and so familiar an address showed that he had no intention of observing full official ceremony.
既是便服，又是这样的称呼，根本就没有以官场礼节参见的打算，

He, a man of exceptional intelligence, understood at once.
何桂清是绝顶聪明的人，一听就懂，

Putting himself in Hu's place, he rather admired this unconventional solution.
再替他设身处地想一想，倒又佩服他这别出一格的处置，

He smiled.
因而笑道：

“Brother Xueyan, don't spoil the occasion.
“雪岩兄，不要说杀风景的话。

I've heard Xuexuan speak of you and have long felt I knew you.
我听雪轩谈过老兄，神交已久，

Let's dispense with formalities.”
要脱略形迹才好！”

“Certainly.
“是！

Obedience is better than ceremony.”
恭敬不如从命！”

Hu made a deep bow, then straightened.
胡雪岩一捐到地，站起身来说：

“Please come inside.”
“ 请里面坐吧！”


This was truly dispensing with formality: at their first meeting, Hu invited him straight into the inner room.
这才真的是脱略形迹，一见面就延入内室，

He hesitated briefly, then entered.
何桂清略一踌躇，也就走了进去。

But he immediately stepped out again on seeing a woman's mirror case and two articles of female clothing.
一进门却又赶紧退了出来，因为看到一具闺阁中用的镜箱，还有两件女衣。

“宝眷大此，

I mustn't intrude.”
不好唐突！”

“不妨，不妨。”胡雪岩一面说，一面便喊：“阿巧，你出来见见何老爷。”

何桂清还在迟疑之际，突然眼前一亮，就不肯再退出去了，

望着走几步路如风摆杨柳似的阿巧姐，向胡雪岩问道：“怎么称呼？

是如嫂夫人？”

“不是！”胡雪岩说：

Just call her by her own name, A’qiao.”
“云公叫她小名阿巧好了。”

就这对答间，阿巧姐已经含笑叫一声：

“Mr He.”
“何老爷！”

同时盈盈下拜。

“I don't deserve this.
“不敢当，不敢当！

Please rise!”
请起来。”

Propriety forbade physical contact between men and women, so he could not help her up and had to accept the kneeling salutation.
男女授受不亲，不便动手去扶，到底让阿巧姐跪了一跪，

She rose, invited him to sit and went lightly out.
她站起来说一声：“何老爷请坐！”然后翩然走了出去，

They heard her calling to the inn's waiter for tea in lidded cups.
听她在喊客栈里的伙计泡盖碗茶。


Treated genuinely as one of the household, He dropped his reserve.
真是当做自己人看待，何桂清也就不再拘束，

坐在窗前上首一张椅子上，首先向胡雪岩道谢：

“多蒙专程下顾，隆仪尤其心感。

My home is so far away in the south, with war between us as well.
天南万里，何况烽火，

居然得尝家乡风味，太难得了。”

“说实话，是阿巧姐的主意。”

何桂清的视线又落在正在装果碟子的阿巧姐身上。

“没有好东西请何老爷吃，意思意思。”阿巧姐捧了四个果碟子走过来说，

四个果碟子是她带在路上的闲食，一碟洋糖、一碟蜜枣、一碟杭州的香榧、一碟是昆山附近的黄埭瓜子。

何桂清目光随着她那一双雪白的手转，

蓦然警觉，这忘形的神态是失礼的，便收拢眼光，看着胡雪岩说：

“雪岩兄是哪天到的？”

“今天刚到。”

“从杭州来？”

“No.
“不，

I've been in Shanghai for several days.
到上海有几天了。”胡雪岩说，

何桂清拱拱手，

“不知道雪岩兄有儿日勾留？”

It was his time with Ji Heling that enabled Hu to understand such elegantly literary wording as ‘linger’ instead of the plain ‘stay’.
不说耽搁说勾留，这些文绉绉的话，胡雪岩是跟嵇鹤龄相处得有了些日子，才能听懂，

因而也用很雅饬的修辞答道：

顺道访一访灵岩、虎丘，总有三、五日盘桓。”

A’qiao did not understand his words, but guessed that they concerned her and were complimentary.
阿巧姐听不懂他说的什么，但估量必是在说自己，而且料定是好话。

再看这位“何老爷”，是“白面书生”的模样，不道已经戴上了红顶子，说来有些叫人不能相信，

转念又想，“说书先生”常常讲的，落难公子中状元，放作“七省巡按”，随带上方宝剑，有恩报恩，有仇报仇，

怕正就是象眼前“何老爷”这样子的人。

心里如此七颠八倒的在想，一双勾魂摄魄的眼睛，便不住看着何桂清。

那位阿巧姐眼中的“白面书生”，心里也是说不出的滋味。

同时不断在想：她是什么路数，

与胡雪岩是怎么回事？

So absorbed was he in these questions that he scarcely knew what he was saying to his host.
因为如此，口中便不知道跟胡雪岩在讲些什么？

Only when A’qiao quietly rose and her lovely figure disappeared did he come to himself, embarrassed and amused.
直到阿巧姐悄悄起去，倩影消失，他才警觉，既不安、又好笑，

He had better leave.
想想不能再坐下去了，

If he stayed, who knew what foolishness his distraction might produce?
否则神魂颠倒，不知会有什么笑话闹出来？

“I must take my leave,” he said.
“我告辞！”他说，

“今晚上奉屈小酌，

I have much to ask you.”
我要好好请教。”

“不敢当。”

“雪岩兄！”何桂清很认真地说，“我不是客套。

雪轩跟你的交情，我是知道的，

他信中也提起，说你‘足智多谋，可共肝胆’，

我有好些话，要跟老兄商议。”

“In that case, I shall obey.”
“既如此，我就遵命了。”

“Excellent.

正好配得上你。”

阿巧姐白了他一眼。

她不再说话，胡雪岩也懒得开口，

一个人歪在床上想心思，想东想西，百无聊赖。

Your Honour!”
胡大老爷！”

这声音喊得人心慌，

请胡大老爷就动身吧！”

我就走。”

胡雪岩回到屋里，只见阿巧姐已取了一件马褂，作势等他来穿。

这应该算作绝顶荒唐的念头，

主客初会，身分不同，离通家之好还有十万八千里，

就算一见如故，脱略形迹，而她是“妾身未分明”，

怎能入官宦之家？

再迟一步而论，算是有了名分，胡家的姨太太，也得何家的内亲眷派人来接，

因此，阿巧姐的表情应该是惊异，或者笑一笑，照苏州人的说法：“亏你想得出！”

是怎么样的不好意思，

考虑到轿子将停，他大致已经有了主见，

暂且搁下，抖擞精神来对付这个新交的贵人。

何桂清是借住在苏州府学的西花厅，

厅中用屏风隔成三间，

最外一间，当作“签押房”，接见是在第二间，书房的格局，布置得雅洁有效。

胡雪岩到时，他正在写大字，

放下未写成的对联，欢然待客。

这副打扮，哪里象个考秀才的学台？倒象洋场中的纨袴.“雪岩兄！”

何桂清潇洒的将手一摆，

“As you see, there are only the two of us.
“你看，就你我俩，

无话不可谈。”

This was no ordinary declaration.
作此表示，非同寻常，

胡雪岩相当感动，但也格外慎重，

“云公，”他以端然的神色说，“雪公把信交给我的时候，特别叮嘱，云公如果有什么吩咐，务必照办。

这句话，我亦不肯随便出口，因为怕力量有限办不到。

如今我不妨跟云公说，即使办不到，我觉得云公一定也会体谅，

所以有话尽请吩咐。”

This was as far as such an assurance could go.
这话已经说到头了，

He put aside his remaining doubts and spoke openly.
何桂清也就无所顾虑，很坦率他说：

“Huang Shouchen passed in the same examination year as I did.

他如果不走，我不便有所表示，

现在听说他有调动的消息，

论资格，我接他的缺，也不算意外，所以雪轩为我设谋，倒也不妨计议计议。

你看，浙江的情形，到底怎么样？”

胡雪岩不懂“爵之无味，弃之可惜”的“鸡肋”作何解？

不过整段话的意思，大致可以明白，是问浙江巡抚这个缺分的好坏。

不过，有一点比江苏好！到底还不曾打仗。”

为人作嫁，颇不上算。”

何桂清颇有深获我心之感，

本职以外，常有奏疏论军务，

本意以为他越俎代庖，迹近多事，

这汽锅，我曾托人到宜兴仿制，怎么样也不合适。”何桂清说到这里，忽然问道：“雪岩兄到敝处去过没有？”

肯提到这一点，也就表示不讳他的身世，

仓场侍郎驻通州，专管漕粮的接收、存贮，下面有十一个仓监督，

是个肥缺，

做两三年下来，外放巡抚，便有了做清官的资格，因为宦囊已丰，不必再括地皮。

胡雪岩的脑筋快，一下子想到浙江的海运，

From Wang to Ji, the Sea Transport Bureau had faced many difficulties.
从王有龄到嵇鹤龄，海运局的麻烦还很多，

一定遵照云公的意思办理。

嵇某人是我拜把的兄弟。”

何桂清欣喜中有惊异，

而且由江苏调过去，不论谁来办，必都是熟人，

自然一切容易说话。”

In short, you and the post are perfectly suited.”
说到这里，胡雪岩作了一个结论：“总而言之，云公去干这个缺，是人地个宜。”

“With the right man in the right place, administration runs smoothly and people live in harmony.”
“能人地相宜，就可以政通人和。”

He paused.
何桂清停了一下，又说，

“It was only a passing thought at first.
“我本来只是随便起的一个念头，

Talking with you has given it substance.
不想跟你一谈，倒谈出名堂来了。

I've already written to the capital and mean to go there.
我已写了信到京里，想进京去一趟，

The imperial order summoning me to an audience should come soon.
‘陛见’的上谕，大概快下来了，

I'll definitely seek a transfer to the granaries.”
准定设法调仓场。”


For He to speak so openly meant he now regarded Hu as a confidant with whom he could discuss anything.
何桂清肯说到这样的话，便见得已拿胡雪岩当作无话不谈的心腹。

Hu understood that friendships and connections were established and strengthened by some concrete expression of commitment at just such a moment.
听话的人了解，人与人之间，交情跟关系的建立与进展，全靠在这种地方有个扎实的表示。

Fail to take that step, and even close friends could become mere acquaintances.
这一步跨越不了，密友亦会变成泛泛之交。

He would not let this opportunity slip.
因此，胡雪岩当然不会轻易放过。

There is no time to lose.
事不宜迟，

You should go ahead.
就该放手进行。

But there's something I don't know whether I may venture to say.”
不过，有句话，我不知道说得冒昧不冒昧？

““你不曾说，我怎么知道？”

He picked at his nails, looking down at his hands as though preparing to receive the presumptuous remark.
何桂情剥着指甲，眼睛望着他自己的手，是准备接受他那句“冒昧”话的神气。

“听说藩司进一趟京，起码得花两万银子，

Is that true?”
可是有这话？”

“One can't generalize.
“这也不能一概而论，

中等省份够了，象江苏这样一等一的大省就不够。

It would cover merely attending an imperial audience and reporting on one's duties.
仅仅陛见述职够了，

如果有公事接头，或者请款，或者报销，那‘部费’就没得底，

两万银子哪里够？

“Then it would be still less adequate if one were seeking an appointment.”
““照这样说，有所谋干，就更不够了。”

象我这趟去，就花不了多少钱。”

“那么，”胡雪岩敛眉正视，一个字、一个字很清楚地问：“到底要多少呢？”

何桂清不即回答，

Blinking repeatedly and murmuring, he counted on his fingers.
乱眨着眼，念念有词地数着指头，

好久才说：“若有一万五千银子，尽足敷用。”

我们这行生意，最怕‘烂头寸’，

You must use some of mine for this journey.”
你老这趟进京，总要用我一点才好。”

He's expression became complicated: delighted surprise mixed with uncertainty, as though he had not quite understood.
这一说，何桂清的表情便很复杂了，惊喜而兼困惑，仿佛还不十分懂他的话似地，

是有点不懂，

Only after reflection did he grasp the meaning, and even then he doubted his interpretation.
细想一想才算弄明白，但亦不知道自己的解释对不对，

He spoke hesitantly.
所以话说得不很利落。

“雪岩兄，你的意思是想放一笔款子给我？”

“是的。”胡雪岩很率直，也很清楚地回答：

“I'd like to lend you fifteen thousand taels.
“我想放一万五千银子的帐给云公。

The interest would be especially modest.
利息特别克己，

I have plenty of funds, and that is better than leaving them idle.”
因为我的头寸多，总比烂在那里好。”

“And the term?”
“期限呢？”

“Whatever you say.”
“云公自己说。”

Again the commissioner had no answer.
何桂清又答不上来了，

He needed to calculate, but had no basis for doing so.
他要好好盘算一下，却又无从算起，

因为只知道仓场侍郎的缺不错，一年到底有多少进帐并不知道。

在京城里，我替云公介绍一家票号，

云公的款子都存在他那里，看情形办，钱多多还，钱少少还，期限不定，

How would that be?”
你老看如何？”

“好，好，

Let us do that.
就是这么办。

But I don't need so much.
不过我不必用那么多，

Ten thousand will be enough.”
只要一万就可以了。”

胡雪岩知道，五千已有着落，还是自己听了阿巧姐的话，亲手封进去的银票，

但不便说破，

怎么呢？不还差五千吗？他故意这样问。

The commissioner likewise would not reveal that Wang's letter had enclosed five thousand.
何桂清也不肯说破，王有龄在信中，已附了五千银子，

只是这样答道：“不敷之数，我另外找人凑一凑，

That should be enough.”
也就差不多了。”

Understanding perfectly, Hu nodded.
胡雪岩肚子里雪亮，便点点头说：

“Then please tell me where I should send the ten thousand.”
“那么，请云公的示，我那一万银子，送到哪里？”

It was an ordinary question, apparently easy to answer, yet the commissioner could not speak.
这平平常常的一句话，应该是极容易回答的，而何桂清竞开不得口！

The whole affair was so sudden as to seem scarcely believable.
因为这件事说起来未免令人觉得突兀而骤难相信。

Ten thousand taels was no small sum.
一万银子不是小数，

At a first meeting, after a few words, a man offered it as a loan, without an intermediary or guarantor, without even settling the interest or the term.
初次见面，三言两语便大把捧出来借与人，不要中，不要保，还不必讲利息和期限，

Was that not extraordinary?
这不太少见？

While he wondered, a thought struck him.
这样茫然想着，忽有领悟，

Hu's conduct might be explained by his friendship with Wang, but did he also have some purpose of his own?
胡雪岩这样做法，固可解释为王有龄的交情使然，但他本人是否有所图谋呢？

A businessman's calculations were certain to be shrewd.
生意人的算盘，无论如何是精明的，

还是先问一问清楚的好。

“Brother Xueyan,” he said with difficulty, “is this money really idle, as you say?”
“雪岩兄”，他很吃力他说，“你真的是所谓‘烂头寸’？”

At this question, Hu felt there was no need to maintain the fiction.
问到这话，胡雪岩觉得不必再说假话，

He answered ambiguously, “Even if it weren't, I could hardly fail to do my utmost to help with your important affairs.”
因而这样模棱地答道：“就算头寸不烂，云公的大事，我亦不能不勉力效劳。”

“感激得很。

Only, if I accept such a favour, how am I to repay it?”
只是我受你此惠，不知何以为报？”

The words were an ordinary expression of gratitude, but his eyes were different.
话是一句普通见情的话，但他的眼神不同，

双目的的地望着胡雪岩，是等候回话的神态。

Hu's acute understanding caught the meaning at once: this was not merely thanks, but an inquiry about his conditions.
这一下，玲珑剔透的胡雪岩就了然了，这句活不仅是内心感激的表示，还带着“问条件”的意味。

Naturally, there were conditions, but to state them would mark him as a fool.
条件自然有，但决不能说，说了就是草包。

Moreover, he felt slightly displeased that He should rate his friendship with Wang so lightly.
同时明雪岩也觉得他的这一问，未免看轻了他自己跟王有龄的交情，所以意中微有不满。

我不曾读过书，不过《史记》上的《货殖列传》、《游侠列传》也听人讲过。

区区万金，莫非有所企图，才肯出手？”

“Yes, yes!”

何桂清大为不安，连连拱手：

“I've spoken wrongly.
“是我失言了。

Brother Xueyan, I never expected it.
雪岩兄，我真还想不列。

You are a man who has truly profited from learning.”
你是读书有得的人。”

Hu was inwardly amused and, naturally, pleased with himself.
胡雪岩心里好笑，自然也得意，

A few Han-dynasty stories heard from Ji had actually overawed an education commissioner of Hanlin background.
听嵇鹤龄讲过几个汉朝的故事，居然把翰林出身的学台大人都唬住了，

It would make a fine story to boast of later to Wang and Ji.
将来跟玉有龄、嵇鹤龄他们谈起来，倒是一件值得夸耀之事。

“Not at all.
“哪里，哪里，

To say that is almost to mock me.”
云公这话，等于骂我。”

It was half truth, half modesty.
他一半实话，一半谦虚的话。

But He really did regard him with fresh respect.
而何桂清却真的刮目相看了，

“No wonder Xuexuan admires you.
“怪不得雪轩佩服你。”他说，

Even in his unsuccessful days, he was proud and exacting.
“雪轩以前虽不得意，却也是眼高于顶的人，

He praised few of the people he judged, yet he always spoke differently of you.
平日月旦人物，少所许可，独独对你不同，

Now I see that you really are different.”
原来你果然不同。”

胡雪岩报以矜持谦虚的微笑，拿话题又拉回到借款上：

“I can have the ten thousand ready as soon as I reach Shanghai.
“我那一万银子，一到上海就可以备妥，

Shall I send it here, or would you prefer another arrangement?”
是寄了来，还是怎么样？”

“There is no need to send it.”
“不必寄来。”

He considered.
何桂清想了想说，

“When I go to the capital, I'll first come to Shanghai and travel north by sea.
“等我进京，自然是先到上海，由海道北上，

The route is more peaceful, and I can also inspect the sea transport arrangements.
一则路上比较平靖，再则也看看海运的情形。

We can discuss it when we meet in Shanghai.
到了上海，我们见面再说。

I shall probably have other troubles for you then.”
那时少不得还有麻烦你的地方。”

“Excellent.”
“好，好……”

Hu volunteered eagerly.
胡雪岩自告奋勇：

“Let me know beforehand when you are going.
“云公什么时候进京，先给我一封信，

I'll attend to everything in Shanghai—finding you a residence and booking your cabin.”
在上海备公馆，定船舱都归我办差。”

“Please don't speak as though you were attending to official duties.”
“ ‘办差’两个字请收回。”

He hesitated.
何桂清又踌躇着说：

“There is one thing.
“倒是有一件，

At the earliest, I cannot leave until about the Dragon Boat Festival.
我动身至快也得端午前后，

By then you may have returned to Hangzhou.”
那时候，恐怕你已回杭州了。”

“Then I'll come back to Shanghai from Hangzhou,” Hu answered readily.
“我从杭州赶回上海。”胡雪岩答得极其爽利，

“Besides, I have people in Shanghai.
“而且，我上海也有人，

You needn't concern yourself with any of it.”
一切不需云公费心。”

By now, they had talked and drunk enough.
谈话到此，酒也够了，

Hu asked his host to favour him with rice.
胡雪岩请主人“赏饭”，

After the meal he sat a little longer, then took his leave.
吃完略坐一坐，随即起身告辞，

He again sent him by chair to Jinchang Inn, where A’qiao was sitting alone by lamplight, waiting for his return.
何桂清仍旧用轿子将他送回金阊栈。阿巧姐正灯下独坐，在守候他回来。



胡雪岩

“Have you eaten?”

今天总算到口了。”

说着，她服侍他卸衣洗脚，一面问起何桂清那里的情形。

胡雪岩不便将那些如何进京活动调任的话告诉她，但除此以外，就没有什么可说的了，

想到哪里去？”

看她的神气，这不是假话，

只要有钱给他们，他们啥也不管。”

两千银子倒是狮子大开口了，

在上海“长三”中，娶个红倌人也不过花到这个数目，

如果说一句“两千就两千”，这样出手，不能博得豪阔之名，

I should be back about noon.” She asked Jinchang Inn to hire a sedan chair for the return journey.
大概中午就可以到了。”说着，便托金阊栈代为雇一顶来回的轿子，

Hu felt it would be rather shabby to let her go empty-handed without making any gesture himself.
胡雪岩想想让她空手回去，自己一无表示，也不好意思，

He took out a hundred-tael note, saying it was for her parents to buy nourishing medicines.
便取了一张一百两的银票，说是送她父母买补药吃。

Naturally delighted, she seemed still more reluctant to part when she got into the chair.
阿巧姐自然高兴，上轿时便越发有那种依依不舍的神情了。


She had scarcely left when He Guiqing sent another invitation, this time to lunch at the Lion Grove Garden.
也不过是她刚走，何桂清又派人送了柬贴来，约他午间在狮子林小酌。

Hu had been wondering where to go and gladly accepted.
胡雪岩正愁无处可去，自然是欣然许诺，

He sent back a reply, tipped the messenger and took a sedan chair through Chang Gate.
给了回片，发了赏钱，坐轿进阊门，

After drinking a bowl of tea at Xuanmiao Temple and buying a few small jade objects at the temple market, he hired another small chair outside the temple shortly before noon and went to keep the appointment.
到玄妙观里喝了一碗茶，在庙市上买了几样小件的玉器，到了近午时分，就在庙前雇一顶小轿，去赴何桂清之约。

The Lion Grove was famous for its rockery, said to have been designed by Ni Yunlin himself.
狮子林以假山出名，据说是倪云林亲手所经营，

Its paths twisted, rose and fell in strange, unpredictable ways.
曲折高下，诡异莫测，

He personally conducted Hu through it, pointing out its features with the utmost attentiveness.
何桂清亲自引导游览，随处指点，极其殷勤。

A circuit took about an hour and left them tired enough to find the food especially good.
一圈逛下来，去了个把钟头，走得累了，便觉得饮食格外有味，

Only after they had eaten a fair amount did conversation become lively.
吃到半饱，话才多了起来。

Official affairs were unsuitable for such an occasion, and He knew nothing of commerce, so they talked of scenery and romantic pleasures.
这种场合，自然不宜谈官场，谈商场则何桂清是外行，于是只好谈山水、谈风月了。

With a little wine in him, He grew more expansive and less guarded.
有了几分酒意的何桂清，谈兴愈豪，话也更小顾忌，

When they reached the subject of family, he suddenly said, “Brother Xueyan, there's something I must ask, though I'm embarrassed to do so.
一谈谈到家庭，他忽然说道：“雪岩兄，我有件事，要腼颜奉托。

My wife is frail and often ill, and she has the most generous disposition.
内人体弱多病，性情又最贤慧，

She frequently urges me to take a concubine who could share her burdens and attend to my meals and daily needs.
常劝我置一房妾侍，可以为她分劳，照料我的饮食起居。

I do see the necessity.
我倒也觉得有此必要，

But as an official serving in Jiangsu, I am strictly forbidden to take a woman under my jurisdiction as a concubine.
只是在江苏做官，纳部民为妾，大于禁例。

On this journey to the capital, I shall need someone close to look after me.
这一次进京，沿途得要个贴身的人照料，

Could you find a suitable woman for me in Shanghai or Hangzhou?”
不知道你能不能替我在上海或者在杭州，物色一个？”

“Nothing could be easier.
“这容易得很。

Tell me what sort of woman you like.”
请云公说说看，喜欢怎样的人？”

“Someone like A’qiao would be ideal,” He answered without thinking.
“就象阿巧姐那样的，使是上选。”何桂清脱口而答。


Hu started.
胡雪岩一愣，

Studying He's expression, he concluded that this did not seem to be a disguised request for A’qiao herself, and felt somewhat better.
细看一看他的脸色，不象饰词巧索，心里使好过些了，

“I understand,” he said, nodding.
“我知道了。”他点点头，

“Before you leave, I shall certainly have something to report.”
“总在云公动身以前，我必有以报命。”

“Thank you!
“拜托，拜托！”何桂清说，

I'll send five hundred taels over presently.
“回头我先送五百两银子过来。

Please arrange it within that sum.”
请雪岩兄在这个数目之内替我办。”

“It won't cost so much.
“用不了这么多。”胡雪岩说：

Nor need you send the money.
“云公也不必送来，

Once it's settled, we'll reckon everything together.
办成了，我跟云公一起算，

I'll even ask for a reward.”
顺便还要讨赏。”

“You put it too strongly.
“言重，言重！

I ought to thank my matchmaker.”
该我谢媒。”

Hu had agreed, but back at Jinchang Inn he realized that finding another woman like A’qiao would be no easy matter.
答应是答应下来了，回到金阊栈，细想一想，要找象阿巧姐这样的人，却真还不大容易。

“Ah!
“嗐！

How foolish I've been!”
我傻了！”

Breaking through the obstruction in his mind, he solved the difficulty, only to be left with a sense of loss.
胡雪岩突破心头的蔽境，解决了难题，却带来怅然若失的情怀。

Why seek someone like A’qiao when A’qiao herself was already there?
何必再去寻阿巧姐这样的人？阿巧姐不就在眼前？

Yet letting her go felt different from giving up A’zhu.
然而胡雪岩这一次撒手，跟放弃阿珠的感觉不大相同，

When he had redirected the match, joining A’zhu's red thread of marriage to Chen Shilong's, his conscience had been clear and he had felt positively pleased.
当时移花接木将阿珠与陈世龙之间的那条红丝联系起来，不但心安理得，而且有快心惬意之感，

Now, at the thought of sending A’qiao into another man's arms, his heart was sour with unhappiness.
如今要将阿巧姐送入别人的怀抱，心里却是酸溜溜的，很不好受。

He paced back and forth, turning the matter over repeatedly.
因此一个人徘徊又徘徊，翻来覆去的在想，

Was there no better way?
除此以外可还有更好的办法？


His thoughts went round and round like an ant circling a millstone until it was almost dark.
这样蚁旋磨转的一直到天快黑，

Then someone called from outside, “Mr Hu!”
听得外面有人在喊：“胡大老爷！”

The voice was familiar, though for a moment he could not place it.
声音很熟，却一时想不起是谁？

Going out, he dimly made out Zhou Yiming.
出门一看，才影绰绰的辨清楚，是周一鸣。

“When I called at noon, you were out?”
“中午我来伺候，胡大老爷出去了？”

“Oh, I'm sorry to have missed you.
“喔，对不起，失迎！”胡雪岩答道：

Education Commissioner He invited me to the Lion Grove.”
“何学台约我逛狮子林。”

“And the young mistress is away too?”
“姨太太也不在？”

“She's gone home to Mudu.
“她回木渎去了。”胡雪岩又补了一句：

She isn't my concubine, by the way.
“那不是小妾，

There's no need to call her that.”
你的称呼用不着。”

This was something of a rebuff.
这也算是碰了一个钉子，

Zhou could find no answer and said, merely to fill the silence, “Why haven't you lit a lamp?”
周一鸣答不上来了，没话找话说了句：“胡大老爷怎不点灯？”

“Ah!”
“啊！”

Only now did Hu notice.
胡雪岩这时才醒悟，

Amused at himself, he gave half the truth.
自己也觉得好笑，说了一半实话：

“I've been so absorbed in something on my mind that I forgot.
“我大想一件心事，想得出神了。

Old Zhou, let's go for a drink.”
老周，我们吃酒去。”

“Certainly.”
“是！”

Zhou smiled ingratiatingly.
周一鸣赔笑说道：

“I'd been hoping to act as host and offer you a cup, but I was afraid you wouldn't honour me and didn't dare suggest it.”
“我本来就打算做个小东，请胡大老爷喝杯酒。只怕胡大老爷不肯赏脸，不敢说。”

“Nonsense!
“笑话！

Why wouldn't I?
啥叫不肯赏脸？

You're far too polite.”
你说得太客气了。”

Hu liked him and wanted to talk, so he added earnestly, “I'll be your guest.
胡雪岩很中意周一鸣，想跟他谈谈，便很恳切的说：“我扰你的。

But I won't go to a restaurant.
不过，下馆子我可不去，

It isn't that I'm afraid of making you spend too much.
不是怕你多花饯。

First, I've had too much rich food at lunch.
第一，中午油腻吃得太多，

Second, I'd like to see what Suzhou's little taverns are like and how they differ from Hangzhou's.”
第二，想看看苏州的小酒店是怎么个光景，跟我们杭州有什么不同。”

“Then I'll do as you say.
“胡大老爷这样说，我就恭敬不如从命了。

There are plenty of places devoted to drinking in front of Xuanmiao Temple.
这种专门吃酒的酒店，玄妙观前多得很，

They're clean, and we could sit awhile.”
地方很干净，可以坐一坐。

“Good.
““那好，

Let's go.”
我们就走吧！”


Hu slipped on an outer jacket, told an inn servant to lock his door and hired a carriage with Zhou to go into the city.
胡雪岩随手套上一件马褂，关照店伙计锁了门，与周一鸣雇了一辆马车进城。

The area before Xuanmiao Temple blazed with lights and bustled with people.
玄妙观前灯火辉煌，十分热闹，

Since Jiangning had fallen, Suzhou had become the province's foremost city.
江宁失守，苏州成了全省的首善之区，

Several hundred civil and military officials had appeared almost overnight.
文武官员，平空添了数百，

Most had not brought their families and had nowhere to go when work was done.
大多不曾带家眷，公余无处可去，

They congregated here, some strolling, others drinking themselves tipsy, and the market remained busy until the second watch.
多集中在玄妙观前，闲逛的闲逛，买醉的买醉，市面要到二更才罢。

Every tavern was full.
酒店家家客满，

At last they found seats facing the street in one called Yuandachang.
最后在一家字号叫“元大昌”的。找到了一副临街的座头，

They sat down and ordered Shaoxing huadiao.
两个人坐下来，要了绍兴花雕，

Two or three older women, neatly and cleanly dressed in blue cotton, promptly approached with baskets of braised snacks to accompany the wine.
随即便有两三个青布衣衫，收拾得十分干净挺括的上了年纪的妇人，挽着篮来卖下酒的卤菜。

The duck heads and wings looked good enough, though their flavour was unremarkable.
那些鸭头和鸭翅膀，看样子很不坏，但味道不怎么样，

But Hu had come to savour the atmosphere of a Suzhou tavern, not its food, and did not much mind.
好在胡雪岩旨在领略苏州酒店的情趣，不在口腹，倒也不甚介意。

Once settled, after their first round of wine, he looked about him and began to observe.
等坐定了，吃过一巡酒，他放眼四顾，开始观察，

Suzhou natives were easily recognized by their composed manners, courteous deference and scholarly air.
苏州本地人雍容揖让，文文气气，一望而知，

The two men at the next table were examples: both white-bearded, both speaking the local dialect in wonderfully soft voices.
他们问壁一桌就是，两个都是白须老者，但一口道地的苏州话，却是其软无比，

Merely listening to their animated conversation was a pleasure.
只听他们高谈阔论，也是一种乐趣。

War blazed on every side, yet Yuandachang was full of warm wine, gentle voices and leisurely enjoyment.
四外烽火连天，这“元大昌”中却是酒温语软，充满了逸兴闲情，

The two old men were recalling the Jiaqing years, discussing inkstones, Yixing Gongchun teapots and bamboo carvings—the elegant playthings of scholars in a peaceful, prosperous age.
隔座那两位白须老者，谈的是嘉庆年问的旧话，谈砚台、谈宜兴的“供春壶”、谈竹雕，都是太平盛世、文人墨客的雅玩。


“What is a man alive for?” Hu asked, suddenly moved.
“人生在世，为什么？”胡雪岩忽生感慨，

“Simply to eat and drink his way through life?”
“就是吃吃喝喝过一生？”

Zhou stared blankly.
这句话问得周一鸣直着眼好愣，

He could not answer; he could scarcely even understand the question.
不但不能回答，甚至也无从了解他的意思。

“I mean people like those two old gentlemen,” Hu explained, lowering his voice.
“我是说，象隔壁那两位老太爷，”胡雪岩放低了声音说：

“They're probably country gentry living on rents.
“大概是靠收租过日子的乡绅。

We have plenty of such families in Hangzhou.
这样的人家，我们杭州也很多，

An ancestor held office and acquired some land.
祖上做过官，挣下一批田地，

Unless a spendthrift appears, quiet living leaves enough to feed a generation or two.
如果不是出了个败家精，安分度日，总有一两代好吃。

The men themselves generally have some examination standing.
本身也总有个把功名，

The better ones are licentiates admitted to the schools; otherwise they've paid twenty or thirty taels for the status of an Imperial Academy student.
好一点是进过学的秀才，不然就是二三十两银子捐来的监生，

They count as people of standing too.
也算场面上的人物。

All year round they're busy doing nothing: they sit in teahouses by day and have a bowl of wine at night.
一年到头无事忙，白天孵茶馆，晚上‘摆一碗’，

They drift pleasantly on until sixty or seventy, then stop breathing and go home to meet the King of Hell.
逍遥自在到六七十岁，一口气不来，回老家见阎王，

‘I've had my turn in the world of the living,’ they say.
说是我阳世里走过一遭了。

Ask what they did there, and the answer is nothing!
问他阳世里做点啥？啥也不做！

Even being a ghost would be meaningless for someone like that.”
象这样的人，做鬼都没有意思。

Whether he was mocking himself or teasing others was unclear, but Zhou understood this much.
“这番不知是自嘲，还是调侃他人的话，周一鸣倒是听懂了，

He too had ambitions and felt considerable sympathy.
此人也算是有志向的人，所以对胡雪岩的话，颇有同感，

“Quite so.
“是阿！”他说，

A man should accomplish something in his lifetime, if only to do right by his parents.”
“人生在世，总要做一番事业，才对得起父母。”

有这句话，胡雪岩觉得可以跟他谈谈了，

“Old Zhou, I hear you were quite a figure in the navy.”
“老周，”他问，“听说你在水师，也是蛮有名的人物。”

“I wouldn't say I had a name, but I got on well with people.”
“名是谈不到，人缘是不错。”

Zhou took a drink and poured out his grievance.
周一鸣喝了口酒，满腹牢骚地说，

“Boatmen used to call me ‘Officer’ and treat me with great respect.
“从前船户都叫我‘老总’，见了客气得很，

Now it's ‘Old Zhou’, and I have to run every kind of errand.
现在都叫我老周，啥跑腿的事都要干。

It leaves a bitter taste.”
想想真不是味道。”

“You'd like to return to the navy, then?”
“你的意思，仍旧想回水师？”

“Wishing won't help.”
“想也不行！”

He shook his head.
周一鸣摇摇头，

“My old commanding officer has risen higher still.
“从前我那个长官，现在官更大了，

He listened to that damned brother-in-law of his and hates me like poison.
听了他娘的小舅子的话，把我恨得要死。

The only way to get back on the rolls would be to change my name and start again as a common soldier.
要想再回去补个名字，除非移名改姓，从小兵干起，

How long would it take to get anywhere?
那要干到什么时候才得出头？

I can only give it up.”
想想只好算了。”

“If you really want to go back, I could help.
“果真你要回去，我倒可以帮你的忙。”胡雪岩说，

A naval commander can hardly be so very high an official.
“想来水师管带，官也不会大到哪里去，

我替你请何学台写封信，你看怎么样？”

“求得到何学台的信，我又不必回原地方了，

He and Governor Xu of Jiangsu passed the metropolitan examination in the same year.
何学台跟江苏巡抚许大人是同年，

I could enter the troops under the governor's direct command.
有何学台的信，我投到‘抚标’去当差，

That would be far better than my old post.”
比原来的差使好得多。”

“Very well.
“那好！”胡雪岩说，

I don't know much about these things.
“这上头我不大懂。

Tomorrow I'll take you to see the commissioner, and you can tell him yourself.”
明天我带你去见何学台，你当面跟他说。”

Remembering how courteously He had treated Hu, Zhou concluded that they must be close friends and that success was assured.
听得这话，再想到何桂清对胡雪岩的客气，料知他们交情极深，事必有济，

所以他极其兴奋，连连道谢，应酬得格外殷勤了。

酒吃到六分，胡雪岩不想再喝，

叫了两碗“双浇面”，一碗是焖得稀烂的大肉面，一碗是熏鱼面，

两下对换，有鱼有肉，

They ate and drank to their hearts' content for less than half a tael.
吃得酒醉饭饱，花不到五钱银子，

胡雪岩深为满意。

“It isn't how much money you have, but how you use it.
“钱不在多，只要会用。”他说，

I've seldom enjoyed a meal as much as this.”
“吃得象今天这么舒服的日子，我还不多。”

“这是因为胡大老爷晓得我做东，没有好东西吃，

You'd prepared yourself, so it seems good.”
心里先就有打算了，所以说好。”

“That's what they mean by ‘contentment brings lasting happiness’.
“这就叫‘知足常乐’。”胡雪岩说，

If you can step back a little in your thinking, there's nothing to trouble you.”
“凡事能够退一步想，就没有烦恼了。”

That night, he approached the question of letting A’qiao go in this same spirit.
这天晚上他再想阿巧姐的去留，就是持着这种态度，

Suppose he had never met her.
譬如不曾遇见她，

Suppose she had died.
譬如她香消玉殒了，

譬如她为豪客所夺，
