那么阿巧姐呢？”

“At the inn, packing.
“她在客栈里收拾东西，

She sent me to fetch you.
叫我来接胡先生。”周一呜说，

When she heard from the attendants that you were leaving today, she had some of the luggage sent aboard already.”
“听客栈里的人说，你老今天动身，所以有些行李已经发到船上去了。”

“I see.
“噢。”胡雪岩问道：

Do you know where Sun Chunyang is?”
“孙春阳在哪里，你知道不知道？”

“Yes, in Wuqufang.”
“知道。在吴趋坊。”

Zhou led the way, and they walked at an easy pace to the shop just north of Wuqufang.
于是周一鸣领路，安步当车到了吴趋坊以北的孙春阳，

A huge tree stood outside, too broad for a man to encircle with his arms.
门口一株台抱不交的大树，

Its bare branches bore a few new shoots, proving that it was not dead.
光秃秃的却有几枝新芽，证明不是桔树。

Zhou told Hu that the tree dated from the Ming dynasty, and that Tang Bohu had once studied on this spot.
周一鸣告诉胡雪岩说，这株老树还是明朝留下来的，此地原是唐伯虎读书之处。


Hu had no interest in the historic site.
胡雪岩对这个古迹，不感兴趣，

What interested him was Sun Chunyang’s signboard.
感兴趣的是孙春阳的那块招牌，

Its gilt ground had darkened, and the three characters of the name were barely legible, yet the shop itself was full of life.
泥金的底子，已经发黑，“孙春阳”三字，亦不甚看得清楚，然而店它却有朝气，

At a glance he saw everyone attending to his duties, briskly and solemnly.
一眼望去，各司其事，敏捷肃穆。

A white-bearded old man stood in the middle of the shop holding a water pipe.
有个白胡子老头，捧着管水烟袋，站在店堂中间，

Looking from side to side, he pointed with the paper spill in his hand, directing clerks and apprentices as they served customers.
左右顾眼，拿着手里的纸媒儿，指东指西，在指挥伙计、学徒招呼客人。

The curious thing was that there were customers but no goods in sight.
奇怪的是有顾客，不见货色，

A customer would make a purchase, pay, and then walk toward the back with a small slip of paper.
顾客交易，付了钱手持一张小票，往后走去，

What was the arrangement?
不知是何花样？

“That is Sun Chunyang’s system,” Zhou explained.
“孙春阳的规矩是这样，”周一鸣为他解释，

“The business is divided into six departments.
“办事分六房，

Not Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Punishments, and Works, as in government, but southern goods, northern goods, delicacies from the sea, cured meats, preserved fruits, and candles.
下是衙门里吏、户、礼、兵、刑、工六帚，是南货、北货、海货、腌腊、蜜饯、蜡烛六房。

You pay at the front and get a ticket, then collect your goods at the back.”
前面付钱开票，到后面凭票取货。”

“But if customers cannot see the goods, how do they choose?
“顾客看不见货色，怎么挑？

What if they are unsuitable?”
或者货色不合，怎么办？”

“There is no need to choose.
“用不着挑的，

You get exactly what you ask for: genuine goods at fair prices.
说啥就是啥，货真价实。”周一鸣说：

Sun Chunyang has earned its reputation.
“孙春阳做出牌子，

Its goods are the finest, its weights are full, and it cheats neither young nor old.
货色最道地，斤两最足，老少无欺。

If you are dissatisfied here, you will not find anything better elsewhere.”
如果这里的货色不满意，就没有再好的货色了。”

“It cannot have been easy to build such an unassailable reputation.”
“牌子做到这么硬，倒也不是件容易的事。”


Hu went to the counter himself and bought tea snacks and candles, along with several hams that he intended to take back to Hangzhou and compare with Jinhua hams.
于是胡雪岩亲自上柜，买的是茶食和蜡烛，也买了几条火腿，预备带回杭州跟金华人腿去比较优劣。

Having paid and received his ticket, he went to the appropriate department and asked for his purchases to be delivered to Jinchang Inn.
付款开票，到货房交涉。要店里送到金阎栈。

Sun Chunyang proved unassailable in another sense too.
孙春阳的牌子真是“硬”，

They politely refused: delivering purchases to customers was not their practice.
说是没有为客送货的规矩，婉词拒绝。

“That is a mistake,” Hu said quietly to Zhou.
“这就不对了！”胡雪岩悄悄对周一鸣说：

“A shop’s rules should not be rigid.
“店规不是死板板的。

Some things allow no compromise; others need improvement.
有些事不可通融，有些事要改良，

The world changes every day.
世界日日在变，

Once there were no foreigners here; now there are.
从前没有外国人，现在有外国人，

That is change.
这就是变。

What matters in business is the ability to adapt.
做生意贵乎随机应变。

Sun Chunyang has survived from the Ming dynasty because until now very little has changed since those days.
孙春阳从明朝传到现在，是因为明朝下来，一直没有怎么变，

Things are different today.
现在不同了，

The restrictions on maritime trade have been thrown open, and circumstances are changing profoundly.
海禁大开，时势大变，

If they cling unchanged to the same old rules handed down for hundreds of years, I doubt this famous name will survive much longer.”
如果还是那一套几百年传下来的古规矩，一成不变，我看，孙春阳这块招牌也维持不久了。”

Zhou also thought it unreasonable for a shop to refuse delivery of such a large purchase.
周一鸣也觉得大宗货色，店家不送，是件说不通的事。

He carefully considered Hu’s words, knowing that Hu was teaching him.
听了胡雪岩的话，心里好好体会了一番，因为他晓得这是胡雪岩在教导，

When he followed him into business, he must remember this lesson: adapt to circumstances and always consider the customer’s needs.
以后跟着他做生意，得要记住他这番话，随机应变，处处为顾客打算。


Hu had intended to have lunch in the city before returning to Jinchang Inn.
照胡雪岩的打算，本想在城里吃了午饭再回金阊栈，

Now, encumbered with several large baskets of snacks and other purchases, he had to hire a porter and accompany the load out of the city.
现在因为有几大篓的茶食之类的拖累，不得不雇个挑伕，押着出城。

At the inn he found that A’qiao had packed his trunks and belongings neatly and stacked them to one side, ready for the boatmen to collect.
到了金阊栈，只见阿巧姐已将他的箱笼什物，收拾得整整齐齐， 堆在一边，只等船家来取。

He called an attendant, ordering lunch and asking for his account to be prepared.
于是唤来金阊栈的伙计，一面准备午饭，一面吩咐结帐。

After the meal he paid the bill, and A’qiao escorted him to the boat.
等吃了饭，付过帐，阿巧姐送胡雪岩到船上，

Once aboard, however, she said it was still early and she might as well sit for a while.
送到船上，却又说时候还早，不妨坐一回。

Zhou tactfully found an excuse to go ashore.
周一鸣知趣，托词避到岸上去了。

Hu was eager to be home and impatient to set off, but with A’qiao still there he could hardly order her away.
胡雪岩归心如箭，急待开船，但阿巧姐不走，却不便下逐客令。

Her silent, preoccupied air puzzled him.
看她站在那里，默然有所思的神气，又不免诧异，

“Is there something else you want to tell me?” he asked.
当即问道：“可是还有话要跟我说？”

Absorbed in her own thoughts, she had not quite heard.
阿巧姐在想心事，一时未听清他的话，

She blinked and forced a smile.
眨着眼强笑道：

“What did you say?”
“你说啥？”

“I asked whether you had something else to tell me.”
“我说：你是不是还有话要跟我说？”

“Something to tell you?”
“话？”

She hesitated.
她迟疑了一下，

“Perhaps I have.
“又象有，

Perhaps I haven’t.”
又象没有。”

What she meant was merely that she could not bear to leave and wanted to stay a little longer.
这就是说，不过不忍舍去，想再坐一会。

Hu found her manner strange.
胡雪岩觉得她的态度奇怪，

Unless he understood it, he knew the puzzle would trouble him all the way home.
不弄弄清楚，一路回去，想起来心里就会有个疙瘩，

He sat down first, leaned sideways, and pulled out an oblong stool, indicating that she should sit too.
所以自己先坐了下来，歪身过去，拉开一张骨牌凳，示意她也坐下。


He waited for her to speak while she searched for something to say.
一个是在等她开口，一个是在找话好说，

At last a question occurred to her.
想来想去，想到有件事要问：

“Why exactly did Young Master Pan invite you to lunch yesterday?
“昨天，潘家三少请你吃饭，到底为啥？

Was he asking you to buy land and build houses in Shanghai?”
是托你在上海买地皮、造房子？”

“So you know already.”
“你已经晓得了。”

“I know something about it, but not very clearly.”
“晓是晓得，不太清楚。”

Hu gave her a brief account of their meeting.
于是胡雪岩很扼要地把昨天聚晤的情形，约略说了一遍。

“Then you will be coming back to Suzhou after the festival?”
“照这样说，你过了节还要到苏州来？”

“Not necessarily.
“不一定，

It depends on whether I have time.
要着我有没有工夫。

I doubt I shall manage it; I shall probably have to ask Old Zhou to make the journey.”
我看是来不成功的，将来总是让老周辛苦一趟。”

“By then…” A’qiao said.
“那时候……，”阿巧姐说，

“I wonder where I shall be?”
“我不晓得在哪里？”

This was an indirect inquiry about her own future: where was she to go, and with whom would she settle?
这是变相的询问，问她自己的行止归宿？

Hu replied, “By then, I think there is sure to be good news.”
胡雪岩便说：“到那时候，我想一定有好消息了。”

“Good news?
“好消息？”阿巧姐问：

What good news?”
“什么好消息？”

The meaning was plain enough.
这是很明白的，

He was naturally referring to He Guiqing’s setting her up in a home of her own.
自然是指何桂清筑金屋，

Hu could not tell whether she was pretending not to understand or had really failed to think of it.
胡雪岩不知道她是明知而装傻，还是真的没有想到？

He felt a flicker of irritation and could not be bothered to explain.
心里不免略有反感，便懒得理她，

He merely smiled.
笑笑而已。


“If you have time, you had better come yourself.”
“有工夫，你最好自己来！”

“Why?”
“为什么呢？”

“I may have something to tell you then.”
“到那时候，我也许有话要跟你说。”

“What?
“什么话？

Why not tell me now?”
何不此刻就说？”

“Because the time has not come yet.” A’qiao added, “Perhaps I shall, perhaps I shan’t.
“自然还不到时候。”阿巧姐又说，“也许有，也许没有，

We shall see when the time comes.”
到时候再说。”

Her evasiveness only deepened his suspicions.
言词闪烁，越发启人疑窦。

Hu calmly put her remarks together with her reluctance to leave, and at last understood what was in her mind.
胡雪岩很冷静地将她前后的话和恋恋不舍的神态，合在一起来想，终于明白了她的心思。

She was still wavering.
此刻她还在彷徨，

One hand had already taken hold of He, while the other was unwilling to let go of Hu.
一只手已经抓住了那一何，这一只手却还不肯放弃这一胡。

Yet this was not a clever attempt to gain an advantage.
然而这倒不是她取巧，

They had spent these days together, affection had grown easily, and she could not cut it off all at once.
无非这几日相处，易生感情，遽难割舍罢了。

Understanding this, Hu felt he should make his position clear, but not so harshly as to wound her needlessly.
意会到此，自己觉得应该有个表示，但亦不宜过于决绝，徒然刺伤她的心，

In a tone of earnest persuasion, he said, “You must stop letting your thoughts run away with you.
所以用恳切规劝的语气说道：“你不要胡思乱想了！

Your future is settled.
终身已定，

All you need do now is enjoy your good fortune.”
只等着享福就是了。”

“Ah,” A’qiao sighed softly.
“唉！”阿巧狙忽然幽幽地叹了口气，

“Where am I to find any ‘Heavenly Official Bestows’?”
“啥地方来的天官赐？”

Hu stared, then understood.
胡雪岩一愣，旋即明白，

Suzhou people liked to leave the last word of a familiar phrase unspoken.
苏州人好说缩脚语，

“The Heavenly Official Bestows” omitted the word “blessings.”
“天官赐”是隐个“福”字，

He smiled.
于是笑道：

“You really do not know how fortunate you are.
“你真是得福不知，

There, there.”
好了，好了，”

His manner showed that he wished to discuss it no further.
他摆出不愿再提此事的神态，

“Please go ashore.
“你请上岸吧！

I shall have Old Zhou take you back.”
我叫老周送你回去。”


“It is still early!”
“还早！”

A’qiao refused to go.
阿巧姐不肯走，

Besides, she now really had remembered some things she wanted to say to him.
同时倒真的想起一些话，要在这时候跟胡雪岩说。

Never mind, Hu told himself.
算了，算了！胡雪岩在心里说，

So many days have passed already; why begrudge her one afternoon?
多的日子也过去了，何争这一下午？

He would see what she was up to.
倒要看看她，究竟有些什么花样。

He took out the pine-nut sweets and other tea snacks he had bought at Sun Chunyang, opened the packets one by one, and covered the table with them.
所以索性取出孙春阳买的松子糖之类的茶食，一包包打开，摆满了一桌子说：

“Take your time. You can eat while you talk.”
“你慢慢吃着谈。”

A’qiao smiled.
阿巧姐笑了，

“You are a little annoyed with me, aren’t you?”
“有点生我的气，是不是？”

“I have changed my mind.
“我改了主意了。

I am not leaving today.
今天不走！”胡雪岩又说，

I shall give you dinner before you go, as well as these snacks.”
“不但请吃零食，还要请你吃了晚饭再走。”

“And you say you are not speaking in anger?”
“这还不是气话？”

“There, there!”
“好了，好了！”

Afraid she might really misunderstand, Hu added, “How could I be angry with you?
胡雪岩怕真的引起误会，“我怎么会生你的气，

There is nothing to be angry about.
而且也没有什么可气的。

You must still have a great deal to say.
你一定还有许多话，

Tell me everything while I am here.”
趁我未走以前，尽量说吧！”


“That is true.
“这倒是真话，

I want you to take a message to Shanghai.”
我要托你带两句话到上海。”

A’qiao picked up a preserved yangmei berry and put it in her mouth.
阿巧姐拈了颗杨梅脯放在嘴里，

“Please tell Second Miss…”
“请你跟二小姐说……”

Tell her what?
说什么呢？

Her hesitation was irritating.
欲言又止，令人不耐，

“Well?” Hu prompted.
胡雪岩催问着：“怎么样，

“What do you want to tell her?”
要跟老二说啥？”

“Let me ask you something.
“我倒问你，

What exactly are things like in Young Master You’s household?
尤五少府上到底怎么样？”阿巧姐补了一句：

I mean Mrs You.
“我是说尤五奶奶，

Does she keep him on a very tight rein?”
是不是管五少管得很紧？”

Before she could go further, Hu understood.
问到这话，胡雪岩便不必等她再往下说，就明白了她的意思，

“You want to advise Second Miss to ask him to take her into his household, don’t you?”
“你是想劝者二，跟尤五少说一说，让他接口家去，是不是？”他问。

“Yes.
“是啊！

Keeping her in a rented place outside is hardly a proper arrangement.”
外面借小房也不是一回事。”

“You need not worry about that.
“这件事，用不着你操心，

The Seventh Lady is there; she will arrange things between them.
有七姑奶奶在那里，从中自会安排。”胡雪岩说，

Mrs You is a most accommodating wife and does not interfere with his affairs.”
“五奶奶人最贤慧，不管尤五少的事。”

“Then why have they not celebrated the marriage already?”
“那么，为什么不早早办了喜事呢？”

The reason, of course, was that You’s circumstances had not been going well, and he was in no mood for a wedding.
这自然是因为尤五的境况，并不顺遂，无心来办喜事。

There was no need to tell A’qiao this.
不过这话不必跟阿巧姐说，

Hu merely replied, “I have not asked him, so I do not know why.
他只这样答道：“我倒没有问过他，不知是何缘故。

I shall pass your message on to Second Miss.”
我把你的话带给老二就是了。”


Just then a head appeared at the cabin door.
说到这里，只见舱门外探进一个人来，

It was the boatman, urging them to depart.
是船老大来催开船，

It was getting late, he said; once the water gate closed, they could not leave until morning.
说是天色将晚，水关一闭，就得明天早晨才能动身。

“Never mind,” Hu replied.
“不要紧，”胡雪岩说，

“I have Education Commissioner He’s visiting card.
“我有何学台的名片，

I can request official assistance.”
可以‘讨夫’。”

The implication was that as soon as A’qiao left, he intended to sail, even if the water gate had closed.
这意思是只等阿巧姐一走，哪怕水关闭了，他也要开船。

Once she understood that, she really could not linger any longer.
意会到此，她实在不能再逗留了，

She rose.
便站起身来说：

“I am going.”
“我要走了！”

Hu did not ask her to stay.
胡雪岩也不留，

He sent someone ashore to fetch Zhou while he saw her off.
一面派人上岸招呼周一鸣来接，一面送客。

When she had stepped gracefully onto the bank, the boatman withdrew the gangplank and was preparing to cast off when Zhou came running.
等阿巧人袅袅娜娜地上了岸，船老大油去跳板，正侍开船，忽然周一鸣奔了来，

“Wait! Wait!” he shouted.
大声喊道，“慢慢，慢慢！”

Hu, who was standing at the cabin door, asked at once, “What else is it?”
胡雪岩就站在舱门口，随即问道：“还有什么话？”

“Sister A’qiao has dropped a ring on the boat.”
“阿巧姐有个戒指，掉在船里了。”


The gangplank was put back and A’qiao came aboard again.
于是重新搭起跳板，让阿巧姐上船，

Hu asked what sort of ring she had lost.
胡雪岩问她，是掉了怎么样的一个戒指？

She gave evasive answers and kept her head down, searching the deck.
她支支吾吾地，只是在般板中低头寻找。

It looked suspicious.
这就令人可疑了。

Deliberately ignoring her, Hu stood still, neither speaking nor helping her search.
胡雪岩故意不理，不说话也不帮她找，只站着不动。

He found it amusing and wanted to see how she would bring the performance to an end.
他是出于好玩的心理，要看她如何落场？

A’qiao, however, thought he had seen through her lie, was displeased, and was deliberately creating an impasse.
阿巧姐却以为胡雪岩是看出她说假话，心中不快，有意造成僵局，

Her embarrassment began to turn to anger.
不免有些恼羞成怒了。

She straightened up, planted her feet, and declared with a girl’s petulance, “I will not leave until I find that ring!”
于是，她仰起身子站定脚，用女孩子赌气的那种声音说：“寻不着这个戒指，我不走！”

Then she sat down sulkily and looked away, furious at his indifference.
说完，气鼓鼓地坐了下来，眼睛偏到一旁去望，是气胡雪岩漠不相关的态度。

This surprised him.
这让他诧异了，

Had she really lost a ring?
莫非真的掉了一个戒指？

Perhaps he had misjudged her.
看样子是自己弄错了。

With an apologetic smile he said, “You have not told me what sort of ring it is.
因而赔笑说道：“你又不曾说明白，是怎样一个戒指，

Even if I wanted to help, I would not know what to look for.”
我想帮你寻，也无从寻起。”

The reasoning was weak, and A’qiao challenged it.
这话道理欠通，阿巧姐便驳他：

“A ring is a ring.
“戒指总是戒指，

Must I describe it exactly before you will trouble your precious hands to help me?”
一定要说明白了，你才肯劳动贵手，帮我去寻？”


“All right, all right!”
“好，好！”

Hu waved a hand.
胡雪岩摇摇手说：

“I am about to leave.
“我都要走了。

Why must we have a quarrel as well?”
何必还斗两句口。”

He steadied himself and considered.
他定神想了想，

The only solution was to cut the tangle with one stroke.
只有用“快刀斩乱麻”的办法，

“Come, let us go ashore.”
“走，我们上岸！”

“Ashore?” A’qiao asked in surprise.
“上岸？”阿巧姐愕然相问：

“Where are we going?”
“到哪里去？”

“Into the city.
“进城。”胡雪岩说，

Stop looking for your ring.
“你的戒指也不要寻了，

I shall replace it.
我赔你一个，

You can choose one yourself at a jeweler’s.”
到珠宝店里，你自己去挑。”

It was like a sudden cry of “Check!” in a game of chess: A’qiao was trapped and did not know how to respond.
这一下就象下象棋“将军”，一下子拿阿巧姐“将”住了，不知如何应付？

She faltered, “Never mind.
支支吾吾地答道：“算了，算了，

I do not want you to replace it.” Hu answered instantly.
我也不要你赔。”胡雪岩回答得极快：

“Then stop looking.
“那也就不要寻了！

Sit a little longer, and let Old Zhou take you back to the Pan household.
你就再坐一会儿，让老周送你回潘家。

I shall write to you when I reach Shanghai.”
我到了上海，自会写信给你。”

A little more time with him, and a promise like that, were enough to satisfy her.
能够再与胡雪岩相聚片刻，而且又听得这样一句话，她觉得也可满意了，

The tense look on her face faded without her noticing.
所以刚才那种绷紧了脸的神情，不知不觉的消失，

She made certain of his promise.
重重的钉了一句：

“You said it yourself: you will write.
“你自己说的，要写信来！

We shall see whether you keep your word.”
看你守不守信用。”


“I certainly shall.
“一定会守。

If I have no time to write myself, I shall ask Young Master Gu, or the Seventh Lady.”
我自己没有空写信，请古大少写，或者请七姑奶奶写。”

“The Seventh Lady can read and write?”
“七姑奶奶通文墨？”

“Very well indeed.
“好得很呢！

She has a good deal of learning.
她肚子里着实有些墨水。”胡雪岩说，

More than I do.”
“我都不及她。”

A’qiao found this a fascinating discovery.
这在阿巧姐听来，好象是件极新鲜有趣的事，

“You would never guess!”
“真看不出！”

She still sounded a little doubtful.
她还有些不信似的，

“The way she looks, she does not seem a literary sort of person.”
“七姑奶奶那副样子，不象是通文墨的人。”

“You mean she lacks a scholarly air?
“你是说地不够‘文气’是不是？”胡雪岩说：

You must not judge by appearances.
“人不可貌相！

The Seventh Lady has a way of doing things entirely her own.
七姑奶奶的为人行事，另有一格，

You could never dream of it.” He told her the Seventh Lady’s remarkable exploit: deliberately getting Gu Yingchun drunk, then falsely claiming that he had slept with her while drunk, until he was forced to swear by heaven that he would marry her and never prove faithless.
你们做梦都想不到的。”接着，他讲了七姑奶奶的那段“ 妙事”，有意灌醉了古应春，诬赖他“酒后乱性”，以至于逼得古应春指天发誓，一定要娶七姑奶奶，决不负心。

A’qiao listened in astonishment.
阿巧姐听得目瞪口呆，

“That really is something new.
“这真正是新闻了。

Who ever heard of doing such a thing?
哪里有这样子做事的？”她说、

A woman’s reputation is more important than anything.
“女人的名节最重，

Even if something of that kind had happened, she would try to clear herself.
真有这样的事还要撇清，

Here nothing happened, and she smeared her own face with mud!
没有这样的事，自己拿烂泥抹了一脸。

The Seventh Lady certainly has an extraordinary mind.”
这位七姑奶奶的心思，真是异出异样！”

“Indeed she does.
“是啊，她的心思异出异样。

But she is formidable too.
不过厉害也真厉害，

How else could she have made Old Gu so obedient?”
不是这样，如何叫老古服服帖帖？”

Hu produced a learned quotation.
胡雪岩掉了一句文：

“‘Before you can take, you must first give.’
“欲有所取，先有所予，

The Seventh Lady went about it the right way.”
七姑奶奶的做法是对的。”


A’qiao fell silent, her expression slowly growing somber.
阿巧姐不作声，脸色慢慢转为深沉，

After a long while she said, “I could never learn to be as clever as the Seventh Lady.”
好久，说了一句：“我就是学不到七姑奶奶那样的本事。”

Her look, together with those words, carried a good deal of unspoken meaning.
那副神色加上这么句话，言外之意就很深了，

Hu smiled and declined to take it up.
胡雪岩笑笑，不肯搭腔。

Seeing this, A’qiao knew that he had, as the saying went, swallowed an iron scale weight: his heart was set like iron.
见此光景，阿巧姐知道胡雪岩是“吃了秤砣——铁心”了，

To linger any longer would be humiliating.
再挨着不走，也未免大自轻自贱！

She sprang to her feet, turned her face aside, and said coldly, “I am going.”
所以霍地站了起来，脸扬在一边，用冷冷的声音说：“我要走了！”

Hu did not answer her.
胡雪岩不答她的话，

He merely called out, “Put down the gangplank!”
只向外高喊一声：“搭跳板！”

The plank had not been removed, and he could see that perfectly well.
跳板根本没有撤掉，而且他也是看得明明白白的，

He had called out deliberately.
是有意这样喊一声。

A’qiao understood: he was driving in the nail and bending its point over, as the saying went.
阿巧姐心里有数，这就是俗语说的：“敲钉转脚”，

He was making her departure doubly certain.
将她离船登岸这回事，弄得格外牢靠，

Even if she changed her mind, she could no longer stay.
就算她改变心意，要不走也不行了。

How ruthlessly he was behaving!
做出事来这么绝！

The delicate affection she felt for him had turned to resentment, which now grew still stronger.
阿巧姐那一片微妙的恋意所转化的怨恨，越发浓了，

“Hmph!” she sneered.
“哼！”她冷笑一声，

“You are infuriating.
“真正气数，

Anyone would think I was the god of pestilence.
倒象是把我当作‘瘟神’了！

You are so afraid I might not go!”
就怕我不走。”


Under this reproach, Hu could only give a bitter smile.
这一骂，胡雪岩亦只有苦笑，

One hand was in his pocket.
一只手正插在袋里，

His fingers touched the little golden goat attached to his watch chain, and suddenly emotion surged through him.
摸着表链子上系着的那只“小金羊”，突然心潮起伏，

He almost cried out, “A’qiao, don’t go!”
几乎想喊出来：“阿巧，不要走！”

But she was already leaving.
然而她已经走了，

In her anger she walked quickly and heavily, making the gangplank dip and sway beneath her.
因为负气的缘故，脚步很急也很重，那条跳板受了压力，一起一伏在晃荡，

Though she held the bamboo pole the boatman extended as a handrail, it was still dangerous.
她虽握着船老大伸过去的竹稿当扶手，到底也是件危险的事！

Terrified that she would miss her footing and fall into the water, Hu stared with his mouth open, frightening himself until he forgot every word he had meant to say.
胡雪岩深怕她一脚踩空，失足落水，瞠目张口，自己吓自己，什么话都忘记说了。

By the time he recovered and tried to speak, she was already in her sedan chair.
等他惊魂一定，想要开口说句什么，阿巧姐已经上了轿，

He could only call out, “Old Zhou, please take good care of her!”
他只有高声叫道：“老周，拜托你多照料！”

“I will.
“晓得了！

Do not worry.”
请放心。”

Zhou waved again.
周一鸣又扬扬手说，

“I shall return to Shanghai in a few days.
“过几天我就回上海，

If anything urgent comes up, write to me care of Jinchang Inn, and they will forward it.”
有要紧事写信，寄到金阎栈转好了。”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十六章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Six, Part One
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER TWENTY-SIX｜第二十六章


On reaching Shanghai, Hu Xueyan again put up at the Daxing Inn.
胡雪岩到了上海，仍旧在投大兴客栈，

Before he had even settled his luggage, he wrote a note and had a man from the inn take it to the Seventh Lady’s lodgings, asking Gu Yingchun to call.
行李还不曾安顿好，就写条子叫客栈专人送到七姑奶奶的寓所，请古应春来相会。

In less than an hour Gu arrived, driving his Hengsimei carriage himself.
不到一个钟头，古应春亲自驾着他的那辆“亨斯美”赶到大兴客栈，

After their first greetings, he said nothing but looked Hu’s luggage carefully over.
一见面叫应了，什么话不说，先仔细打量胡雪岩的行李。

“What is it, Gu?”
“怎么回事，老古！”

“Where is A’qiao?”
“阿巧姐呢？”

“She hasn’t come,” Hu replied.
“没有来！”胡雪岩说，

“Things have taken a turn you could never have imagined.”
“事情大起变化，你想都想不到的。”

“What has happened?”
“怎么样呢？”

“It’s a long story.
“说来话长。

We’ll talk when we have time.
回头有空再谈。

Tell me, has Brother Five come back?”
喂，”他问，“五哥回来了没有？”

“Not yet.”
“还没有。”

Gu returned to his question.
古应春又问：

“What about A’qiao?
“阿巧姐呢？

What has changed?
怎么事情起了变化？

Give me the gist of it.”
你要言不烦说两句。”

Unable to understand this particular concern for her, Hu asked a question of his own.
胡雪岩不知道他何以对阿巧姐特别关心，便反问一句：

“Did you send someone to Mudu to discuss her affairs?”
“你是不是派人到木渎去谈过？”

“Never mind that for the moment.
“你先不用管这个，

Just tell me what has happened to her.”
只说阿巧姐怎么样了？”

“That lovely flower has found her owner, and I arranged the whole thing.
“名花有主，是我一手经理。

Before long she will be Education Commissioner He’s concubine.”
不久，就是何学台的姨太太了。”

He went on to explain how he had transplanted this celebrated flower.
接着，便讲移植这株名花的经过，

Eloquent as he was, the affair had too many twists to be disposed of in a few words.
胡雪岩虽长于口才，但经过太曲折，三言两语说不完，

He stood talking for a quarter of an hour before he had made it clear.
站着讲了一刻钟，才算说清楚。

“That’s a good outcome too!”
“这样也好！”

Gu took him by the sleeve.
古应春拉着他的袖子说，

“Come along.
“走！

I know Seventh Sister’s impatience. If we’re late, she’ll be blaming me again.”
去晚了，七姐的急性子，我是晓得的，又要埋怨我。”

“Not so fast!”
“慢来，慢来！”

Hu pressed down his hand.
胡雪岩按住他的手说，

“I’ve told you my story.
“我的话告诉你了，

You must have something to tell me.
你一定也有话，

Why keep it to yourself?”
怎么不告诉我？”

“Of course I’ll tell you.
“当然要告诉你的。

When we get home.”
到家再说。”

Once they were in the carriage, Gu admitted that he had sent someone to Mudu about A’qiao.
等坐上马车，古应春承认曾派人到木渎去谈过阿巧姐的事，

Nothing had come of it, and his messenger had proved so incompetent that he could not even explain why he had failed.
但一场无结果，派去的人下会办事，竟连未能成功的原因何在，都弄不清楚。

“I know more about it than you do.
“我倒比你清楚。

A’qiao had quite a fright, and through that affair I made three friends, all wealthy young men from Suzhou, with a large sum they want me to put to work for them.” Hu laughed.
阿巧姐吃了一场惊吓，由此让我还交了三个朋友，都是苏州的阔少，有一大笔款子要我替他们用出去。”胡雪岩笑道：

“Gu, the trouble I took on this trip to Suzhou was certainly not wasted.
“老古，我这一趟苏州，辛苦真没有白吃，

Three days and three nights would hardly be enough to tell you all the twists and turns.”
谈起个中的曲折，三天三夜都谈不完。”

There was so much to relate that he darted from one subject to another.
事情大多，东一句，西一句，扯来扯去，

Gu could not immediately make sense of it all, but he understood that the journey had yielded a great deal.
古应春一时也听不清楚，只知道他这趟大有收获。

Their business fortunes were bound together, and Hu’s resourcefulness naturally excited him too.
彼此在生意上休戚相关，胡雪岩有办法，他自然也感到兴奋。


They soon reached the Seventh Lady’s lodgings.
转眼间到了七姑奶奶寓所，

Recognising the sound of the horse’s hooves, she came downstairs to open the door herself and called out from a distance, “Little Uncle, you’re back!”
马蹄声音是她听熟的，亲自下楼来开门，老远就在喊：“小爷叔，你回来了。”

“Yes, I’m back!
“回来了，回来了！”胡雪岩说：

First, something to make you happy.
“先告诉你一桩开心的事，

You’re always saying how good Suzhou sweets are, so I’ve brought you a whole big hamper.
你总说苏州的糖食好吃，我替你带了一大篓来，

Keep them in a lime jar, and I guarantee you won’t finish them in half a year.”
放在‘石灰缸，里，包你半年都吃不完。”

“Thank you, thank you!”
“谢谢，谢谢！”

Though she was speaking to Hu, her eyes were on Gu.
七姑奶奶口中是对胡雪岩说话，眼睛却看着古应春。

“A’qiao isn’t coming,” Gu told her quietly.
“阿巧姐不来了！”古应春轻声对她说，

“And she won’t be taking the name Hu.”
“她也不会姓胡了。”

“Have they quarrelled?”
“怎么闹翻了？”

“No, no.
“不是，不是。

Don’t start guessing.
你不要乱猜，

I’ll tell you later.
回头再跟你说。

At any rate, we can stop worrying.”
总而言之，可以放心了！”

“Good, good!”
“嗯，嗯！”

She patted her chest with evident relief.
七姑奶奶很高兴地拍拍胸。

This exchange left Hu more puzzled than ever.
胡雪岩听他们这番对答，越觉困惑，

“Gu,” he asked in a low voice, “what is all this about?
“老古，”他用低沉的声音问：“到底是怎么回事？

What can we stop worrying about?”
什么事可以放心？”

“There won’t be a head-on collision now,” the Seventh Lady put in.
“现在不会‘白板对煞，了，”七姑奶奶搭腔，

“We can all relax.
“大家都可以放心。

Come upstairs, Little Uncle, and see who’s here.”
小爷叔，快上楼来，看看哪个来了？”

He went up and lifted the curtain.
上楼掀帘一看，

It was Furong who gazed at him with a smile.
合笑凝睇的竟是芙蓉，

Amid his delighted surprise, the meaning of that “head-on collision” suddenly became clear.
胡雪岩惊喜之余，恍然大悟所谓“白板对煞”作何解。

“How did you get here?”
“你是怎么来的？”

“I came with Third Uncle,” Furong replied.
“我跟三叔一起来的。”芙蓉说，

“I’ve been staying with Seventh Sister ever since we arrived.
“一到就住在七姐这里。

I meant to write and tell you, but she said there was no need, as you would soon be back.”
本来要写信告诉你，七姐说不必，你就要回来的。”


“And where is Third Uncle?”
“那么三叔呢？”

“At an inn quite close by.” Gu laughed.
“他就住在不远一家客栈。”古应春笑道：

“He really is a character.
“这位先生真是妙人！

Do you know who has been happiest since he arrived?”
从他一来，你晓得哪个最开心？”

“Who?”
“哪个最开心？”

Hu considered.
胡雪岩想了想说：

“As far as I can see, only the man himself.” Everyone laughed.
“照我看，只有他自己。”大家都笑了，

“There’s someone else.”
“还有一个，”

Gu pointed to the Seventh Lady.
古应春指着七姑奶奶：

“Her!”
“她！”

Once again Hu was mystified.
这一说，胡雪岩又大惑不解了，

“Why should Seventh Sister be the happiest?”
“何以七姐最开心？”

“What do you think?
“你想呢？

Our lady here cannot sit still for a moment.
我们这位姑奶奶一刻都静不下来的，

Now that she has taken your advice and means to behave like a sheltered young lady, never stepping beyond the outer gate or the inner door, how can she bear to stay put?
现在听了你小爷叔的话，要学做千金小姐，大门不出，二门不迈，叫她怎么坐得住？

Third Master Liu has been her salvation.
刘三爷一来算救了她了，

Every day he goes about seeing all sorts of strange and wonderful things, then comes back and tells her about them.
他每天到各处去逛，看了希奇古怪的花样，回来讲给她听，

It is as good as listening to a storyteller.”
真好比听大书。”

“No storyteller could make me laugh as much as Third Uncle Liu does,” she said, laughing freely herself.
“听大书都没有听刘三叔说笑话来得发噱。”七姑奶奶也爽郎地笑着，

“He is wonderfully entertaining.”
“这个人真有趣。”

“Here he comes,” Gu said.
“来了，来了！”古应春说，

“There’s no mistaking his footsteps.”
“他的脚步声特别。”


At that remark Hu looked first at the feet below the door curtain.
因为有此一句话，胡雪岩便先注意门帘下的脚，

Liu Bucai was wearing the sort of black leather shoes otherwise worn only by foreigners, dressed and polished to a brilliant shine.
原来刘不才着的是一双只有洋人用的黑色革履，上了油，擦得闪闪发亮。

He wore a long robe without a riding jacket.
身上只穿长袍，未着马褂，

The robe was jet black, neither silk nor satin.
那件袍子纯黑，非绸非缎，

Only on closer inspection did Hu realise that it was made from the woollen cloth foreigners used for formal dress.
细细看去，才知是洋人用来做礼服的呢子，

With characteristic ingenuity Liu had had it made into a Chinese robe, complete with rhinestone clasps.
刘不才别出心裁，做成长袍，配上水钻的套扣，

The effect was strikingly unusual and decidedly frivolous.
显碍相当别致，也相当轻佻。

“Ah!”
“喔！”

Liu spoke first.
刘不才先开口，

“You’re back at last!
“你总算回来了！

You seem to have put on a little weight.” Hu answered him, then surveyed him from head to foot, suppressing a laugh.
人象胖上点。”胡雪岩先答他的话，忍着笑将他从头看到底，

“Third Master Liu,” he said, half in mockery and half in admiration, “you are the very height of fashion!”
“刘三爷，”他又似嘲弄，又似佩服他说：“你真正时髦透顶了！”

“Third Master Liu is wonderfully open-minded,” Gu added.
“刘三爷真开通。”古应春也说：

“I would never dare parade through the streets in an extraordinary outfit like that.”
“叫我就不敢穿了这一身奇装异服，招摇过市。”

“What does it matter?
“这有啥要紧？

People wear clothes; clothes don’t wear people,” the Seventh Lady said in Liu’s defence.
人穿衣服，不是衣服穿人。”七姑奶奶帮刘不才说话，

“‘For a woman to look fair, let her wear mourning white; for a man to look fine, let him dress in black.’
“ ‘女要俏，一身孝，男要俏，一身皂’，

Third Master Liu looks handsome indeed!
刘三爷这身打抢真叫俏！

It takes more than ten years off him.”
看上去年纪轻了十几岁。”


Everyone laughed at this.
这一说大家都笑了，

“Enough talk,” Gu said.
“闲话少说，”古应春问道：

“Shall we eat out or at home?”
“我们是下馆子，还是在家吃饭？”

“At home,” Hu replied.
“在家吃吧！”胡雪岩说，

“I don’t feel like going out again.”
“我不想动了。”

The Seventh Lady and Furong went down to the kitchen to direct the maidservant’s preparations for dinner, while Hu began an expansive account of his journey.
于是七姑奶奶和芙蓉都下厨房去指挥娘姨料理晚餐，胡雪岩开始畅谈此行的经过，

With Liu present, he naturally concealed some of the complications concerning A’qiao.
因为有刘不才在座，关于阿巧姐的曲折，自然是有所隐讳的。

“照此看来，刘不才来得正好，”等听完了，古应春异常兴奋他说，

“Let Third Master Liu go to meet Lu Zhixiang on the seventh day of the fifth month.”
“五月初七去接陆芝香，就请刘三爷去。”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

Hu nodded.
胡雪岩点点头，

“That was my thought too.
“我也这么想，

In future, entertaining them—food, drink and amusements—will all be Third Master Liu’s responsibility.
将来陪他们吃喝玩乐，都是刘三爷的事。

He can also receive Education Commissioner He when he passes through Shanghai.”
何学使经过上海，也归刘三爷接待。”

“Gladly!” Liu agreed.
“好的！”刘不才欣然答应，

“Leave them all to me.
“都交给我。

I guarantee they’ll be perfectly satisfied with my attentions.”
包管伺候得他们服服帖帖。”

“As for those clothes of yours,” Gu said, “Lu Zhixiang may not mind, but Commissioner He is certain to disapprove.”
“你这身衣服，”古应春说，“陆芝香或许不在乎，在何学使一定看不顺眼。”

“I know, I know!
“我懂，我懂！”刘不才说，

I know how to dress for the company I’m keeping.”
“陪啥人穿啥衣裳，我自己有数。”


“I was thinking,” Hu said, “that Third Master Liu will be dealing with officials in future, and may even be invited into their homes.
“我在想，”胡雪岩说，“将来刘三爷跟官场中人打交道，甚至到家里去的机会都有，

An official qualification would make things much easier.
有个功名在身上，比较方便得多。

Why not purchase a rank?”
我看，捐个官吧？”

“Better not.
“最好不捐。

A first-rank commoner outranks them all.”
一品老百姓最大。”

Hu was quick to detect his meaning: if Liu were to buy a rank at all, he wanted a respectable one.
胡雪岩很机警，听出刘不才的意思，不捐官则已，要捐就要捐得象样，

Yet Hu himself belonged only to the class of subprefectural and county magistrates, and could hardly buy Liu the rank of prefect.
不过自己也不过“州县班子”，不能替刘不才捐个“知府”，

He therefore said, “We are in business, not in government service.
所以这样说道：“我们是做生意，不是做官，

High rank or low doesn’t matter; it is simply to make business easier.
大小不在乎，只为了做生意方便。

Suppose you need a favour at a customs post or checkpoint.
譬如说逢关过卡，要讨个情，

Send in a visiting card with an official title, and you can meet on equal terms and call one another brother.
一张有官衔的名帖投进去，平坐乎起，道弟称兄，

That makes it far easier to speak than if you were a first-rank commoner.”
比一品老百姓，就好说话很多了。”

“Little Uncle is right.
“小爷叔的话不错，

I’ve been thinking of buying a rank too—a county assistant magistrate, full eighth rank.”
我也想捐一个，捐他个正八品的县丞，”

“There’s no need for that.
“那也不必，

Let us all join the magistrates’ class and enjoy being addressed as ‘Your Honour.’”
都是州县班子好了，弄个‘大老爷’做做。”

Laughter came from across the room as Hu finished.
接着胡雪岩的话，那边笑了；

Holding a bottle of foreign wine, the Seventh Lady called out, “Your Honours, dinner is served!”
七姑奶奶手里捧着一瓶洋酒，高声说道：“各位‘大老爷，请上桌吧！”


“Oh dear!” Gu exclaimed suddenly.
“啊呀！”古应春突然说道，

“I’ve forgotten someone we ought to have invited.”
“我倒忘记了，有位仁兄应该请了他来。”

“Who?” Hu asked.
“谁啊？”胡雪岩问。

“Qiu Fengyan.”
“裘丰言。”

“Oh, he’s here too.
“喔，他也来了。

We really shall have a lively time.”
这可真有得热闹了。”

Hu smiled, then shook his head.
胡雪岩笑着说了这一句，却又摇摇头：

“But there’s no need to fetch him tonight.
“不过今天不必找他。

We still have a great deal to discuss.”
我们还有许多事要谈。”

Much of their business was confidential to the two of them; even Liu Bucai ought not to hear it.
生意上的许多机密，只有他们俩可以知道，连刘不才都不宜与闻，

At dinner, therefore, they avoided serious matters and listened to Liu describe the Western circus he had seen that afternoon: a blonde, blue-eyed beauty performing on horseback, displaying her charms and her figure with astonishing freedom.
因此饭桌上言不及义，只听刘不才在大谈这天下午所看的西洋马戏，马背上的金发碧眼的洋美女，如何婀娜多姿，大露色相。

The others took it in their stride, but Furong, on her first visit to this foreign world, listened in open-mouthed amazement.
别人倒都还好，英蓉初涉洋场，听了目瞪口呆，

“How could anyone be so shameless, so careless of appearances?” she kept saying.
只是不断他说：“哪有这样子不在乎、不顾脸面的？

“I don’t believe it!”
我不信！”


“Seeing once is better than hearing a hundred times,” Hu told her.
“百闻不如一见。”胡雪岩说，

“Go and see for yourself tomorrow, and you’ll know it’s true.”
“你明天自己去看一次就晓得”对的！

The Seventh Lady was interested too.
“七姑奶奶的兴致也来了，

“Let’s go to a performance tomorrow.”
“明天我们也去看一场，”

“Are women allowed to watch?”
“女人也许看吗？”

“Aren’t women people?
“女人难道不是人？

Why shouldn’t they be?”
为啥不许！”

“Do women actually go?” Furong asked her uncle.
“有没有女人去看？”英蓉问她三叔。

“Yes, yes.
“有，有。

Not only do they go, they sit beside men they don’t even know—” “There goes Third Uncle talking nonsense again,” Furong said bluntly.
不但有，而且还跟不认识的男人坐在一起……”“三叔又要瞎说了。”芙蓉老实不客气的指责，

“I simply don’t believe that.”
“这话我绝对不信。”

“You blame me before I’ve finished!
“我话没有说完，你就怪我！”刘不才说，

I mean Western women.”
“我说的是西洋女人。”

Gu, with his cup at his lips, could not contain himself and spat out a mouthful of wine.
古应春衔杯在口，忍俊不住一口酒喷了出来，

Only a quick turn of his head saved the dinner table.
亏得脸转得快，才没有喷到饭桌上，

As it was, he choked, coughed and laughed for quite some time before recovering.
但已呛了嗓子，又咳又笑好半天才能静下来。

“Little Uncle,” the Seventh Lady said to Hu, laughing too, “our Third Master Liu and His Honour Qiu, that Wine Muddlehead, are a perfect pair of treasures.
“小爷叔！”七姑奶奶也笑着对胡雪岩说：“我们这位刘三爷跟‘酒糊涂’裘大老爷，真正是‘宝一对’，

When they put on their double act and start joking, they nearly make you split your sides.
两个人唱双簧似他说起死后来，简直把人肚肠都要笑断。

I would gladly provide them with good wine and good food every day just to hear their jokes.
我情愿每天备了好酒好菜请他们吃，听他们说说笑话，

It would clear the phlegm, settle the spirits and lengthen one’s life!”
消痰化气、延年益寿。”

“You do live grandly,” Gu laughed.
“你倒真阔！”古应春笑道，

“Two gentlemen of magistrate rank as your entertaining companions!”
“请两位州县班子的大老爷做清客。”


“That reminds me,” she said.
“我倒想起来了。”七姑奶奶问道：

“Were you saying just now that Third Master Liu means to purchase an official rank?”
“刚才你们在谈，是不是刘三爷也要捐个官做？”

“Gu too,” Hu put in.
“老古也是！”胡雪岩接口，

“Gu understands foreign affairs, and that is just the knowledge people need nowadays.
“老古槽通洋务，现在刚正吃香的时候，

Someone may come to value his services and actually give him a substantive appointment, with an official signboard of his own.
说不定将来有人会借重，真的挂牌出来，委个实缺。

Seventh Sister, then you will be the wife of an official who holds a seal.”
七姐，那时候你就是掌印夫人了。”

“Thank you very much!”
“谢谢！”

She curled her lip.
七姑奶奶撇着嘴说，

“I have no wish to be an official’s wife.”
“我才不要做啥官太太。”

“Gu!”
“老古！”

Hu had begun in jest, but on reflection the idea seemed worth taking seriously.
胡雪岩先是当笑话说，转一转念头，觉得倒不是笑话，

“Really, Gu, an official career might be a very good path for you.
“说真的！考古，我看你做官，倒是蛮好一条路子。

It would benefit you and the rest of us as well.”
于你自己有益，对我们大家也有好处。

Quick as ever, the Seventh Lady asked, “Never mind for the moment whether it would benefit him.
“七姑奶奶口快，紧接着问：“对老古自己有没有益处，且不去说它，

How would it benefit everyone?”
怎么说对大家都有好处？”

“Naturally it would,” Hu replied.
“自然罗！”胡雪岩答道，

“Look at Mr Xuexuan.
“你只看王雪公，

Haven’t we all benefited from his holding office?”
他做了官，不是我们都有好处？”

“Oh, I understand.
“喔，我懂了，

We would have official influence behind our business.
是仰仗官势来做生意。

In that case Gu might consider it for his friends’ sake.”
既然如此，老古为朋友，倒不妨打算打算。”

“You!” Gu sighed.
“你啊！”古应春叹口气说，

“A puff of wind, and you proclaim a downpour.
“得着风，就是雨。

Those who know you call you enthusiastic; those who don’t would think you mad.”
晓得的人，说你热心，不晓得的人，当你疯子。”

Since taking Hu’s advice, the Seventh Lady had greatly moderated her temper.
七姑奶奶听了胡雪岩的劝，脾气已改得好多了，

Under this scolding she merely smiled and said nothing.
受了古应春的这顿排揎，笑笑不响。

Gu turned back to Hu. “Little Uncle, I admire you in everything, but I cannot admire this advice to become an official.
“小爷叔！”古应春转脸又说，“我样样佩服你，就是你劝我做官这句话，我不佩服。

We are enjoying what we do now.
我们现在槁到兴兴头头，

Why put ourselves at the mercy of great men’s moods?”
何苦去伺候贵人的颜色？”

Hu tactfully let the subject drop when he saw that they could not agree.
胡雪岩很知趣，见这上头话不投机，就不肯再说下去，换了个话题说：

“From tomorrow we shall be extremely busy again.
“从明天起，我们又要大忙特忙了。

Let us break up early tonight.”
今天早点散吧！”


“Quite right!”
“对！”

The Seventh Lady glanced at Hu and Furong with a smile.
七姑奶奶看一看胡雪岩和芙蓉笑道，

“A short separation makes a reunion sweeter than a wedding.
“你们是小别胜新婚，

Go and enjoy yours.
早点去团圆，

I won’t keep you here.
我也不留你们多坐。

Leave as soon as you’ve eaten.”
吃了饭就走好了。”

They stopped drinking and finished their meal.
于是止酒吃饭。

Gu took a Western leather horsewhip from behind the door and waited, apparently intending to drive them back to the Daxing Inn himself.
古应春拿起挂在门背后的一支西洋皮马鞭，等在那里，是预备亲自驾车送他们回大兴客栈的样子。

“You live close by, so there’s no hurry for you to leave,” Hu told Liu. “Stay and chat with the Seventh Lady to keep her amused.”
“你住得近，不必忙走！就在这里陪七姑奶奶谈谈闲天解解闷。”胡雪岩向刘不才说。

Free and easy as she was, propriety did not allow her to receive a male guest alone.
虽然七姑奶奶性情脱略，但道理上没有孤身会男客的道理，

Liu therefore hesitated.
所以刘不才颇现踌躇，

Gu, however, understood Hu’s purpose: if Liu followed them to the inn, there would be things they could not discuss.
而古应春却懂得胡雪岩的用意，是怕刘不才跟到大兴栈去，有些话就不便谈了。

He added, “Third Master Liu, do stay a little longer.”
因而附和着说：“刘三爷，你就再坐一会好了。”

With Gu saying so too, Liu reluctantly agreed.
既然古应春也这么说，刘不才勉强答应了下来。

Gu accompanied Hu and Furong downstairs.
古应春陪着胡雪岩和芙蓉下楼，

Jinfu, the young groom in his Western peaked cap, had already harnessed the horse.
戴着顶西洋鸭舌帽的小马伕金福，已经将马车套好，

Gu handed him the whip and told him to drive, taking a seat astride the carriage shaft himself so that he could talk to Hu.
他将马鞭子递了过去，命金福赶车，自己跨辕，以便于跟胡雪岩谈话。

“Let’s stop at the silk warehouse first and see whether there are any letters.”
“先到丝栈转一转，看看可有什么信？”

At the Yuji Silk Warehouse the manager was out.
先到裕记丝栈，管事的人不在，

Gu left word that His Honour Hu had returned from Suzhou to Shanghai, and that any letters for him should be sent straight to the Daxing Inn.
古应春留下了话，说是胡大老爷已从苏州回到上海，如有他的信，直接送到大兴客栈。

Then they drove on.
然后上车又走。


At the inn, Furong assumed the role of hostess, seeing to tea and tobacco before turning to the luggage Hu had brought from Suzhou.
到了客栈，芙蓉便是女主人，张罗茶烟，忙过一阵，才去检点胡雪岩从苏州带回来的行李。

Hu began asking Gu about their silk venture.
胡雪岩使向古应春问起那笔丝生意。

They had scarcely exchanged a few sentences when Furong called out, “Why, where did this come from?”
刚谈不到两三句，只听芙蓉在喊：“咦！这是哪里来的？”

He turned to see her approaching with a small embroidered wrapping of soft white satin laid on her palm.
转脸一看，她托着一方白软缎绣花的小包袱走了过来，

On it lay a lock of hair and two fingernail clippings.
包袱上是一给头发，两片剪下来的指甲。

She picked up the fine black hair and sniffed it. “It still smells of hair oil.
“头发上还有生发油的香味，”芙蓉拈起那一络细软而黑的头发，闻了一下说，

It can’t have been cut long ago.”
“铰下来还不久。”

Hu remained composed.
胡雪岩很沉着地问：

“Where did you find it?”
“你是在哪里寻出来的？”

“In that leather bag of yours.”
“你的那个皮包里。”

Plainly A’qiao had deliberately left this token of their private attachment while packing his things.
不用说，这是阿巧姐替他收拾行李时，有意留置的“私情表记”，

Hu saw no need either to conceal the matter or to defend himself.
胡雪岩觉得隐瞒、分辩都不必要，

He nodded calmly.
神色从容地点点头说：

“I see.
“我知道了！

I’ll explain it all to you later.”
回头细细告诉你。”

Furong was naturally displeased at the sight, but she deserved her reputation for gentleness and good sense.
芙蓉看了这两样东西，心里自然不舒服，不过她也当得起温柔贤慧四个字，

Reading his expression and observing how untroubled he was, she was willing to give him a chance to explain.
察言观色，见胡雪岩是这样地不在乎，也就愿意给他一个解释的机会，

She put the objects away again and continued sorting the rest of the luggage.
仍旧收好原物，继续整理其他的行李。


“The foreigners have changed their attitude lately,” Gu continued their interrupted discussion.
“洋人最近的态度，改变过了。”古应春也继续谈未完的生意，

“I hear that both the British and the Americans have been into Jiangning.
“听说，英国人和美国人都到江宁城里去看过，

They think Hong Xiuquan and his followers are making a poor business of things, so they would like to sit down and talk properly with our officials.
认为洪秀全那班人搞的花样，不成名堂，所以有意跟我们的官场，好好坐下来谈。

The trouble is that they come to the shrine and cannot find the god.”
苦的是‘上门不见土地’。”

“What do you mean?”
“这叫什么话？”

“They cannot find anyone to negotiate with.
“找不着交涉的对手。”古应春说，

It has always been the rule that the court does not deal directly with foreigners.
“历来的规矩，朝廷不跟洋人直接打交道，

All foreign affairs fall to the Governor-General of Liangguang as an additional duty.
凡有洋务，都归两广总督兼办，

So when the British and American ministers ask to see the Governor-General of Liangjiang, his office refers them to Guangzhou and refuses to receive them.
所以英国、美国公使要见两江总督，督署都推到广州，拒而下见。

Yet they really do come with good intentions.”
其实，人家倒是一番好意。”

“How do you know?”
“何以见得？”

“There is a public notice to prove it.
“这是有布告的。

The British, American and French consuls have issued a joint proclamation forbidding their nationals to assist Liu Lichuan of the Small Swords Society.”
英、美、法三国领事，会衔布告，通知他们的侨民，不准接济小刀会刘丽川。”

Gu went on, “I also have very reliable information that the American minister, McLane, came from Hong Kong to Shanghai and called on Ji’erhang’a, the Jiangsu provincial treasurer.
古应春又说，“我还有个很靠得住的消息，美国公使麦莲，从香港到了上海，去拜访江苏藩司吉尔杭阿，

He declared in person that they had no intention of helping the rebels.
当面声明，并无助贼之心。

They merely wanted to put trade and taxation in order, and wished to see Governor-General Yi of Liangjiang.
只是想整顿商务、税务，要见两江怡大人。

I have also heard that the British, American and French ministers have sent a joint diplomatic note protesting against the new inland customs office in Shanghai.”
此外又听说英、美、法三国公使，会衔送了一个照会，为了上海新设的内地海关，提出抗议。”

“What is that about?”
“这是什么意思？”

“One more customs office means another levy.
“多设一道海关，多收一次税，

Naturally the foreign merchants object.”
洋商自然不愿。”


Hu considered this carefully.
胡雪岩很用心地考虑了一会，

To him, the whole situation showed that the foreigners wanted nothing more than to trade in China, while the Chinese authorities, from the court down to the local administrations, wanted only to restore stability.
认为整个形势，都说明了洋人的企图，无非想在中国做生意，而中国从朝廷到地方，有兴趣的只是稳定局势，

The two aims could in fact be pursued together.
其实两件事是可以合起来办的，

Trade required peaceful markets, and peaceful markets required victory in the war.
要做生意，自然要求得市面平静，要求市面平静，当然先要在战事上取胜，

That was precisely the purpose of the three countries’ ministers in forbidding their nationals to support Liu Lichuan.
英美法三国公使，禁止他们的侨民接济刘丽川，正就是这个意思。

The best course now was to speak frankly with the foreigners and agree on terms of cooperation.
当今最好的办法，是开诚布公，跟洋人谈合作的条件。

When he explained his view, Gu sighed.
当他陈述了自己的意见，古应春叹口气说：

“Little Uncle, if only you were Governor-General of Liangjiang!
“小爷叔，要是你做了两江总督就好了，

Unfortunately our officials cannot see that far.
无奈官场见不到此，

Come to think of it, even you could do nothing in that post if the court forbade it.
再说一句，就是你做了两江总督也不行，朝廷不许你这样做也是枉然，

Let us confine ourselves to our own business.”
我们只谈我们自己的生意。”

He reminded Hu, “The new silk will soon be coming onto the market.”
他提醒他说：“新丝快要上市了。”

New silk might be coming onto the market, but so long as it could not be brought to Shanghai for sale to foreigners, the stock already there would retain its scarcity value.
新丝虽快上市，不准运到上海与洋人交易，则现有的存货，依然奇货可居。

The question was how long that situation could last.
疑问是这样的情势，究竟可以维持多久？

If they held out for a high price and the ban was suddenly lifted, falling silk prices would be one danger.
板高不售，一旦禁令解除，丝价下跌是一可虑，

Another was that old silk was inferior to new: the foreigners would certainly prefer the fresh crop, depressing the value of the old stock still further and perhaps making it impossible to sell.
陈丝品质不及新丝，洋人要买一定买新丝，陈丝的身价更见下跌，说不定卖不出去是二可虑。

Realising this, Hu started in alarm.
胡雪岩意会到此，矍然而惊，当即问道：

“Gu, in your opinion, should we sell our stock or hold it?”
“考古，照你看，我们的货色是卖，还是不卖？”

Gu said nothing.
古应春不作声。

The decision itself was easy enough, but its consequences were so considerable that he had to appear to weigh it with great seriousness if he was to persuade Hu.
这个决定原是很容易下的，但出入太大，自己一定要表现出很郑重的态度，才能说动胡雪岩，

His silence was like a horseman wheeling about with his bow drawn: its real purpose was to command Hu’s attention and impress on him the importance of the matter.
所以他的沉默，等于盘马弯弓，实际上是要引起胡雪岩的注意和重视。

“Say something!” Hu urged.
“你说一句啊！”胡雪岩催促着。

“It cannot be settled in a word.
“这不是一句话可以说得尽的，

We must consider the whole situation and identify its unalterable direction.
贵乎盘算整个局势，看出必不可易的大方向，

Only by following that direction can we make our position secure.”
照这个方向去做，才会立于不败之地。”

Hu nodded as he listened.
胡雪岩一面听，一面点头，

“Exactly.
“不错。”他说，

This is where foresight matters.
“所谓眼光，就是要用在这上头。

In my view, Hong and Yang are bound to fail, and cooperation with the foreigners is inevitable.”
照我的看法洪杨一定失败，跟洋人一定要合作。”

“Yes.
“对！

That is my view too.
我也是这样的看法。

Once we recognise that general direction, the course for our business is quite clear.”
既然看出这个大方向，我们的生意应该怎么做，自然就很明白了。”

“Since we shall have to cooperate sooner or later, we may as well show the foreigners some goodwill and leave ourselves room for future dealings.”
“迟早要合作的，不如放点交情绪洋人，将来留个见面的余地。”

Hu spoke decisively.
胡雪岩很明确他说：

“Gu, I have decided to sell the silk.
“老古，丝我决定卖了！

Go and negotiate with them.
你跟洋人去谈。

Naturally, every extra bit we can get on the price is welcome.”
价钱上当然多一个好一个。”


Gu merely nodded.
古应春只点头，不说话。

Plainly the approach to the negotiations still required thought.
显然的，怎样去谈，亦须有个盘算。

After a pause he said, “That will make things easier: we shall no longer have to conceal things from one another.
古应春想了想说：“这样做法，不必瞒来瞒去，事情倒比较容易办。

But there can be no question of manipulating the market.”
不过‘操纵’二字就谈不到了。”

Hu’s expression changed.
这句话使得胡雪岩动容了，

He had a vague sense that, in business, Gu had shown himself a move ahead of him.
他隐隐然觉得做生意这方面，在古应春面前象是差了一着，

Yet he quickly suppressed his competitive impulse.
然而那股好胜之心，很快地被压了下去。

Business was not a contest of pride; the essential thing was to recognise an opportunity and adapt.
做生意不是斗意气！他这样在想，见机最要紧。

“Do you think I don’t want to control prices?
“ ‘操纵，行情，我何尝不想？

But in my original calculations I overlooked the most important factor of all, one that favours the foreigners and puts us at a disadvantage.
不过当初我计算的时候，没有想到最要紧的一件事，这件事，洋人占便宜，我们吃亏。

It makes controlling the market very difficult unless we have enormous resources.”
所以要想操纵很难，除非实力厚得不得了。”

“What factor?
“哪一件事！”古应春间，

The foreigners’ advantage is that they come to trade with warships—” “Exactly!”
“洋人占便宜的是，开了兵船来做生意……”“着啊！”

Hu clapped his hands.
胡雪岩猛然一拍手掌，

“That is just what I mean.
“我说的就是这件事，

When foreigners trade, their officials and merchants work together.
洋人做生意，官商一体，

Their officials protect the merchants: if difficulties arise, the officials fend them off; if there is trouble, the officials deal with it.
他们的官是保护商人的，有困难，官出来挡，有麻烦，官出来料理。

Their merchants can also speak frankly to their officials.
他们的商人见了官，有什么话也可以实说。

With us it is quite different.
我们的情形就不同了，

Officials have no sympathy for merchants’ difficulties, and merchants never dare expect them to bargain on our behalf.
官不恤商艰，商人也从来不敢期望官会替我们出面去论斤争两。

That leaves us with no certainty in trading with foreigners.
这样子的话，我们跟洋人做生意，就没有把握了，

You see a promising course, and suddenly the authorities devise some new measure that wipes out all your previous efforts.
你看这条路子走得通，忽然官场中另出一个花样，变成前功尽弃。

Take an inland customs office.
譬如说，内地设海关，

We control it, and its existence disadvantages foreign merchants while favouring Chinese ones.
其权操之在我，有海关则不便洋商而便华商，

That gives us scope to devise a plan that profits from precisely those disadvantages.
我们就好想出一个办法来，专找他们这种‘不便’的便宜，

Now that the foreign consuls have protested, what if the customs office is abolished?
现在外国领事提出抗议，如果撤消了这个海关，

Wouldn’t our whole scheme come to nothing?”
我们的打算，岂不是完全落空？”


Hu knew that Gu was thinking hard.
胡雪岩知道他在动脑筋，

This venture demanded an agile mind.
这笔生意，脑筋不灵活是无法去做的，

Dealing with the foreigners was difficult enough; there was also a collection of silk merchants and small independent dealers to keep in line.
跟洋人打交道已经不容易，还有一批丝商散户要控制。

It had been Hu’s idea to unite the small dealers against the foreigners, and his connections and skill had brought Pang Er’s group, the strongest of them all, into the same alliance.
主意是胡雪岩所出，集结散户，合力对付洋人，并且实力最强的庞二这个集团，亦已由于胡雪岩的交情和手腕，联成了一条线。

Yet the responsibility for directing it fell on Gu.
而指挥这条线的责任，却落在古应春的身上。

To persuade everyone to act together, they had made enticing promises: if they united and forced the foreigners to yield, they were certain to reap large profits.
以前为了说服大家一致行动，言语十分动听，说是只要团结一致，迫得洋人就范，必可大获其利，

Those promises now had to be fulfilled.
如今这句话必得兑现，

If silk fetched less than expected, everyone would blame them.
倘或丝价不如预期之高，一定要受大家的责难。

Some of the dealers had also received advances; if prices were too low to recover those advances in full, a loss would be unavoidable.
其中还有一部分是垫借了款子的，丝价不好，垫出去的钱不能十足收回，就非吃赔帐不可。

Gu considered the bad possibilities and the good for some time before broadly deciding on a course.
这样考虑了好一会，盘算了坏的这方面，又盘算了好的这方面，大致决定了一个做法，

“Little Uncle, I propose to speak frankly to the foreigners first.
“小爷叔”，他说，“我想先跟洋人去谈，开诚布公说明白，

We can explain that we should all work together to sustain the market and ask them to give us a firm price.
大家一起来维持市面，请他们开个底价给我。

We should not reveal that actual figure to our own fellow merchants, but leave ourselves a margin for bargaining.
这个底价在我们同行方面，不宜实说，留下一个虚数，好作讨价还价的余地。

Do you think that would be sound?”
你看我这样子做，是不是妥当？”

“I don’t know the foreigners’ circumstances as well as you do,” Hu replied.
“洋人这方面的情形，我没有你熟。”胡雪岩说，

“But I think frankness would serve us with our own fellow merchants too.”
“不过我们自己这方面的同行，我觉得亦用得着‘开诚布公’这四个字。”

“You mean that whatever price the foreigners offer, we should tell them exactly that?”
“你是说，洋人开价多少，我们就实说多少？”

“Yes.
“对，我就是这个意思。”胡雪岩说，

How much we make on this venture comes second.
“这趟生意，我们赚多赚少在其次，

We must make our fellow merchants understand that we are acting for everyone’s good, not trying to get rich at the smaller dealers’ expense.”
一定要让同行晓得，我们的做法是为大家好，决不是我们想利用小同行发财。”

“That is a far-sighted approach, Little Uncle, and I agree.
“小爷叔是眼光看得远的做法，我也同意。

But the advances we made to bring the small dealers in were a very high proportion of the value of their silk.
不过，”古应春说，“当初为了笼络散户，垫出去的款子，成数很高，

If we sell now and deduct the advances in full, very little will remain for them.
如今卖掉了丝，全数扣回，所剩无几，

I’m afraid they may complain.”
只怕他们有得罗嗦。”


“Never mind,” Hu said.
“不要紧！”胡雪岩说：

“I worked it out on the journey.
“我在路上已经算过了，

With the Pang family’s funds, the money from the Pan family and the others in Suzhou, and the proceeds of this silk, we shall have ample funds in hand.
有庞家的款子，还有苏州潘家他们的款子，再把这票丝卖掉，手上的头寸极宽裕，

If they want to borrow, let them.”
他们要借，就让他们借。”

“Wait!”
“慢慢！”

Gu waved a hand.
古应春挥着手说：

“Are we to lend on credit, lend against security, or pay deposits?”
“是借，是押，还是放定金？”

The reminder came at exactly the right moment.
这句话提醒得恰是时候，

A loan meant unsecured credit; a secured advance required goods as collateral; a deposit meant buying the crop in advance—the small dealers’ new silk for the year.
借是信用借款，押是货色抵押，放定金就得“买青”——买那些散户本年的新丝。

The same sum could be put out on very different terms.
同样一笔钱，放出去的性质不一样，

Hu thought for a moment.
胡雪岩想了想说：

“That will depend on what you arrange with the foreigners.
“要看你跟洋人谈下来的情形再说，

If they think well of our conduct and are willing to cooperate, we can sign a contract to sell them another batch this year.
如果洋人觉得我们的做法还不错，愿意合作，那就订个合约，我们今年再卖一批给他们。

Then we shall need to pay the small dealers deposits for their silk.
那一来，就要向散户放定金买丝了。

Otherwise we can turn to other business.
否则，我们改做别项生意，

In any case, I am determined to open a Shanghai branch of Fukang.”
我的意思，阜康的分号，一定要在上海开起来。”

“The two things can proceed together perfectly well.
“那是并行不悻的事，

Having a bank of our own will only make the silk business easier.”
自己有了钱庄，对做丝只有方便。”

“Then there is nothing more to discuss.
“这样子说，就没有什么好商量的了。

Put your abilities to work.
你拿出本事去做，

Whenever you think you can decide a matter yourself, go ahead.”
你觉得可以做主的，尽由自己做主。”

Reviewing Hu’s remarks from the beginning, Gu realised that all the difficulties troubling him had suddenly vanished.
将胡雪岩的话从头细想了一遍，古应春发觉自己所顾虑的难题，突然之间，完全消失了。

Tomorrow he could talk openly with the foreigners and agree on a price that left neither side at a disadvantage.
明天找洋人开诚布公去谈，商量好了一个彼此不吃亏的价钱，

Then he would invite all the merchants and small dealers in their alliance and ask whether they wished to sell.
然后把一条线上的同行、散户都请了来，问大家愿不愿意卖？

If they did, so much the better; if not, they could make their own arrangements.
愿意卖的最好，不愿意卖的，各自处置，

The loans were secured by warehouse receipts in any event, so there was no danger of losing them through default.
反正放款都用栈卑抵押，不至于吃倒帐。

Business need not be so difficult after all.
生意并不难做。


His face relaxed as this reasoning became clear to him.
这样想了下来，神色就显得轻松了，

“Little Uncle,” he said with a smile, “working with you really is a pleasure.”
“小爷叔，”他笑道，“跟你做事，真正爽快不过。”

“You’re straightforward too.
“你也是爽快人，

I needn’t explain everything.
不必我细说。

In short, I always look for the good in people.
总而言之，我看人总是往好处去看，

I scarcely believe there are bad people in the world.
我不大相信世界上有坏人。

People do bad things because they lack ability; capable people are sure to do good.
没有本事才做坏事，有本事一定会做好事。

And since wrongdoers have no ability, there is no need to fear them.”
既然做坏事的人没有本事，也就不必去怕他们了。”

Gu could not immediately decide whether the logic of this was sound.
古应春对他的这套话，在理路上一时还辨不清是对还是错，

Fortunately, it was only casual conversation and required no answer.
好在这是闲话，也就不必去理他。

He rose to take his leave, wanting to be alone to work out how he would open negotiations with the foreigners the following day.
起身告辞，要一个人去好好筹划，明天如何踉洋人开谈判？


Only after Gu had left could Hu give Furong his undivided attention.
等古应春一走，胡雪岩才能把全副心思摆到英蓉身上。

Reunited after a short separation, they naturally had intimate things to discuss.
小别重逢，自然有一番体己的话，

He asked about her daily life in Huzhou and about her younger brother.
问她在湖州的日常生活，也问起他的兄弟。

She told him she had resolved that the boy should study and make something of himself.
芙蓉告诉他，决计叫他兄弟读书上进，

She had placed him with a scholarly family named Zhu, where his lessons and meals together cost three taels a month, on the understanding that he was not to come home on ordinary school days.
附在一家姓朱的书香人家读书，每个月连柬脩和饭食是三而银子，讲好平日不准回家。

Hu was astonished.
胡雪岩听见这话，大为惊异，

He had never imagined that Furong, so gentle in temperament, could be so firm in bringing up her brother.
想不到芙蓉那样柔弱的性情，教养她的兄弟，倒有这样刚强的处置。

“And Little Rabbit?
“那么小兔儿呢？”他问，

Doesn’t he get homesick, living alone with the Zhus?”
“一个人住在朱家，倒不想家？”

“Of course he does.
“怎么不想？

On his third day there he ran home.
到了朱家第三天就逃了回来，

I gave him a beating on the palms and sent him back.”
让我一顿手心又打回去了，”

“Could you really harden your heart like that?”
“你倒真狠得下这个心？”

“If you understood my heart, you would know why I could.”
“你晓得我的心，就晓得我狠得下来了！”

“I know you have a good heart.
“我只晓得你的心好，

I didn’t know you had a hard one.”
不晓得你心狠。”

Hu sensed that she had something very serious to say.
胡雪岩已估量到她有个很严重的说法，

Unwilling to make their conversation solemn and dry, he deliberately spoke with a touch of teasing.
为了不愿把气氛弄得枯燥严肃，所以语气中特地带着点玩笑的意味。

Furong, gentle and compliant as ever, guessed that just then he wanted warmth and laughter rather than serious discussion.
芙蓉最温柔驯顺不过，也猜到胡雪岩在这时刻只愿享受温情笑谑，厌闻什么一本正经的话，

She smiled and said nothing, bringing out the snacks she had brought from Huzhou—roasted green beans, flaky sugar sweets and the like—for him to enjoy at his leisure.
所以笑笑不响，只把从湖州带来的小吃，烘青豆、酥糖之类摆出来供他消闲。


She had understood him, but not entirely.
她将他的心思倒是猜着了，但也不完全对，

Hu could joke at any time, discuss serious matters at any time, and even find humour in a serious discussion.
胡雪岩的性情是什么时候都可以说笑话，也什么时候都可以谈正经，而且谈正经也可以谈出谐谑的趣味来，

Now he smiled again.
这时便又笑道：

“What sort of heart have you got, then?
“你是啥个心，

Why won’t you tell me?
怎么不肯说？

Must I feel for myself?”
是不是要我来摸？”

He caught her by the arm and let his hand wander to her breast.
说着顺手捞住芙蓉的一条膀子，一摸摸到她胸前，

She slipped lightly away, then noticed someone hurry past the window.
芙蓉一闪，很轻巧地避了开去。接着便发现窗外有人疾趋而过，

From the man’s back she recognised a servant of the Daxing Inn.
看背影是大兴客栈的伙计。

Evidently that frivolous gesture had been seen by an outsider.
显然的，刚才他的那个轻桃的动作，已经落入外人眼中，

Gentle and compliant though she was, she could not help taking offence.
即令芙蓉温柔驯顺，也忍不住着恼，

She flung her hand aside, sat apart and turned her head away from Hu.
手一甩尘到一边，扭着头不理胡雪岩。

He felt guilty for having displeased her in a moment of forgetfulness, but did not think the matter serious enough to go over and coax her with apologies.
一时忘形，惹得她不快，他自然也感到歉疚，但也值不得过去赔笑说好话，

It would soon pass.
等一会事情也就过去。

He sat eating roasted beans and considering what he ought to ask her about Huzhou.
所以只坐着吃烘青豆，心里在想着，湖州有哪些事要提出来问她的？

Then a chance glance showed him that she had drawn a handkerchief from the fastening under her arm and was wiping away tears.
偶然一瞥之间，发觉芙蓉从腋下钮扣押出一条手绢，正在擦眼泪，

Alarmed, he hurried over and took her face in his hands.
不由得大惊失色，奔过去，捧有她的脸一看，

There was no mistaking the tear marks.
可不是泪痕宛然？

“What—what is the matter?”
“这，这是为什么？”

“Nothing.”
“没有什么！”

She sniffed, wiped her eyes, stood and straightened her clothes, then sat down again, trying to appear unaffected.
芙蓉醒醒鼻子，擦擦眼泪，站起来扯了扯衣襟，依旧坐了下来，要装得没事人似的。

“There must be a reason,” Hu said deliberately.
“一定有缘故。”胡雪岩待为这样说：

“If you won’t tell me, I shall begin to suspect things.”
“你不讲，我要起疑心的。”

“I was thinking of something that makes me sad.
“我自己想想难过！

I blame no one but my own unhappy fate.”
不怨别人，只怨自己命苦。”

Turning her face aside, she spoke calmly.
她将脸偏到一边，平静他说，

“If we were husband and wife on equal terms—husband and wife in bed, but proper and respectful out of it—you would surely treat me with respect.
“如果是平起平坐的夫妇，上床夫妻，下床君子，你一定也要尊重人家，

You would not paw me about like that and let strangers look down on me.”
不会这样动手动脚，叫不相干的人看轻了我，”


Her resentment, expressed without anger, made Hu all the more uneasy.
越是这样怨而下怒的神态，越使得胡雪岩不安，

Explanation would be difficult and unnecessary.
解释很难，而且也多余，

The only course was to admit his fault.
唯一的办怯是认错。

“I was wrong,” he said, lowering his head.
“我不对！”他低着头说，

“I shall remember next time.”
“下次晓得了。”

It was kind-hearted Furong who then felt obliged to explain.
忠厚的芙蓉反倒要解释了，

“I am not saying that you don’t respect me.
“我也不是说你不尊重我，

But my position sets a limit, and there is nothing to be done about it.” She continued, “Now you ought to understand why I can be hard on Little Rabbit.
不过身分限在那里，也是没有办法的事。”她又说，“你现在应该想得到了，我为什么对小兔儿狠得下心来，

I want him to make something of himself.
我要他争气！

I want him to forget that he has a sister like me.”
要他忘记了有我这样一个姐姐！”

“Well…”
“这……”

Hu was deeply uncomfortable.
胡雪岩颇感不安，

“You attach too much importance to that.
“你也把这一点看得太重了！

It is perfectly ordinary for a man to have several wives and concubines.
男人家三妻四妾，也是常事，

I have never looked down on you.”
我又没有看轻过你。”

“That is not what I mean.”
“话不是这么说。”

Furong too felt that further discussion of her status would be pointless, so she turned back to her brother.
芙蓉也觉得这身分上的事，再谈下去也无味，所以避而不谈，只谈她兄弟，

“I have thought it all through on my own.
“我一个人前前后后都想过了，

If Little Rabbit stays with me, he will never amount to anything.
小兔儿在我身边，一定不会有出息，

Why?
为啥呢，

First, he has no worries about food or clothing, and I give him whatever he wants.
第一，不愁吃，不愁穿，他要啥，我总依他，

If I merely support him without teaching him, he will be useless.
只养不教，一定不成材；

Second, with Third Uncle about, he will learn no good example.
第二，有三叔在那里，小兔儿学不到好样，

In time he will take to women, gambling, fine food and clothes—the whole lot.
将来嫖赌吃着，一应俱全。

Then our Liu family will never rise again.”
我们刘家就再没有翻身的日子了！”


For a long while Hu could say nothing.
这番话说得胡雪岩半晌作声不得，

Though silent, he had much on his mind, above all the words, “I have misjudged you.”
口虽不言，心里却有许多话，最想说的一句是：“我把你看错了！”

He had always thought of Furong as a little dough figurine: with a few lumps of coloured dough and an ivory modelling knife, one could shape her into whatever one wished.
他一直看芙蓉是个“面人儿”，几块五颜六色的粉，一把象牙刻刀，要塑捏成怎样一个人，就是怎样一个人。

Now he saw his mistake.
此时方知不然！

Outwardly weak, she was inwardly strong.
看似柔弱，其实刚强，

Such people thought deeply, and their words and actions could be all the more surprising.
而越是这样的人，用的心思越深，做出来的事，说出来的话，越是出人意外。

From now on he must never underestimate anyone, or he might suffer a disastrous fall.
从今以后，更不可以小觑任何人了！不然就可能会栽大跟斗。

This warning made him still more reluctant to answer hastily.
由于这样的警惕，他更加不肯轻易答腔，

He rose and paced slowly, turning her words over in his mind.
站起来一面踱方步，一面回味她的话，

The more he considered them, the more deeply he understood, until he had grasped even what she had left unsaid.
越想越深，把她未曾说出来的意思都琢磨到了。

“You have thought a long way ahead,” he said, coming to a stop.
“难为你想得这么深！”他站定了脚说，

“But let me advise you: this is no way to lead a fortunate life.
“不过，我倒要劝你，你这样子不是福相！

I really am worried about you.
我实在替你担心。

You cannot let anything go; you keep working away at everything inside.
你什么事放不开，一个人在肚子里用功夫，

It drains your heart and mind.
耗心血的，

No wonder you are so thin.”
怪不得人这么瘦！”

Furong knew herself well enough to realise that all her inward brooding could not match a quick turn of his mind.
芙蓉颇有自知之明，知道自己怎么样在肚子里用功夫，也抵不上他脑筋略为一转，

Those few remarks showed that he had understood what she had not said: had she been his formally married first wife, the wife who had shared his hardships, he would have treated Little Rabbit, his young brother-in-law, as his own younger brother and naturally taken responsibility for his upbringing.
就凭这两句话，便可以想见他已了解自己所不曾说出来的一番意思——如果她是他明媒正娶的结发糟糠，小兔儿这个小舅子，他就会当自己同胞的小弟弟看待，自然而然地负起教养之责，

Since he had not thought to do so, she, the boy’s sister, had had to make the decision herself.
惟其他念不及此，所以只有靠她做姐姐的，自己要有决断。

It was enough that he understood now.
只要他知道了就好，

He would surely find a way.
他一定会有办法！

Thinking this, Furong kept silent and waited to hear what he would say.
茎蓉这样在想，先不必开口，且听他说些什么？


“That was my fault.
“这是我不对！

I didn’t think of Little Rabbit.
我没有想到小兔儿。

But remember, I failed to think of him; that does not mean I refuse to look after him.
不过，话说回来，是我没有想到，不是不管他。

I have so much to do that even if he were my own brother, I might have no time for him.
我的事情实在太多，就算是我自己的兄弟，只怕也没有工夫来管。

So don’t blame me.
所以，你不要怨我，

You need only mention it, and I shall find a way and do my duty.”
只要你跟我提到，我一定想办法，尽责任。”

Hu paused.
胡雪岩停了一下说，

“He is your only close blood relation.
“你就只有这么一个亲骨肉，

If you can bear to let him go, the rest is easy.
只要你舍得，事情就好办了，

Tell me, what do you want him to become?
你倒说，你希望小兔儿将来做啥？

An official?”
做官？”

“Not necessarily.
“也不一定是做官，

I just hope he can stand on his own feet.”
总巴望他能够自立。”

She thought for a moment, her eyes lowered, plainly reluctant to say what she felt she must.
芙蓉想了想，低眉垂眼，是那种不愿说而又非说不可的神态，

“Whatever happens, I don’t want him to turn out like Third Uncle.”
“无论如何，不要象三叔那种样子。”

Hu understood the painful reflection on her own life behind those words.
胡雪岩明白，这是她感怀身世，痛心疾首的一种感慨。

Had Liu Bucai been more capable, then even if she believed the fortune-tellers and physiognomists who said she was born to be a concubine, she could at least have remained unmarried rather than accept a secondary wife’s place.
如果不是刘不才不成材，她即使相信算命算相的话，生来是偏房的命，但不能为人正室，不嫁也总可以！

But she had a younger brother, and no prospect of relying on their uncle to bring his nephew up.
只力有了一个兄弟，又不能明望叔父能教养侄儿成人，

In the end she had been obliged to become a concubine, and the purpose of that sacrifice was simply to provide for Little Rabbit.
终于不得不做人的偏房，而委屈的目的，无非是为了小兔儿。

Her circumstances were pitiable and her resolve hard-won.
其情哀，其志苦，

Hu felt not only sympathy but admiration, and all the more strongly acknowledged his duty towards the boy.
胡雪岩对她不但同情，而且钦佩，因而也愈感到对小兔儿有一份必须要尽的责任。

“I understand,” he said.
“你的意思我懂了。”他说，

“Your uncle may not be a reformed prodigal worth more than gold, but he has his own ways and will prosper in time.
“你三叔虽不是败子回头金不换，也有他的道理，将来会发达的。

Don’t think too little of him.”
你不要太看轻了他。”

“I don’t.
“我不是看轻他，

He is my uncle; our surname Liu is the same word, however you write it.
他是我叔叔，一笔写不出两个刘字，

I always respect him.
我总尊敬他的。

But…”
不过……

She suddenly waved a hand.
“芙蓉忽然摇摇手，”

“Let us leave him out of it.
这也不去说他了。

I only hope you will treat Little Rabbit as one of your own.”
我只望你拿小免儿当自己人。

“Of course.
““当然。

What else could he be?” Hu replied.
不是自己人是啥？”胡雪岩说、

“Enough of that.
“闲话少说，

Tell me what you want him to become.”
你倒说，你将来希望小兔儿做啥？”

“Naturally, I hope he will bring honour to his ancestors.”
“自然是巴望他荣宗耀祖。”

“Then he must become an official.
“荣宗耀诅，只有做官。

A purchased rank like mine is nothing remarkable.
象我这样捐来的官不希奇，

It is the rank won by real combat in the examination hall that counts.”
要考场里真刀真枪拼出来的才值钱。”

Hu spoke calmly.
胡雪岩平静他说，

“Provided Little Rabbit is willing to work hard and do you credit, it can be arranged.
“只要小兔儿肯替你争气，事情也很好办，

I shall find you the best possible teacher for him.”
我替你请个最好的先生教他读书。”


To show that this was no casual promise, Hu immediately called for writing materials and began a letter to Wang Youling, asking him to approach the educational official and find a learned licentiate willing to serve as a private tutor.
为了表示不是信口敷衍，胡雪岩当时就要笔墨纸张，给王有龄写信，请他代为托“学老师”，觅一个饱学秀才“坐馆”。

Of course, he had many other things to discuss with Wang.
当然，他也还有许多事要跟王有龄谈，

Literary composition was not his strength, and some matters, such as his meeting with He Guiqing, had to be set down in his own hand.
文墨上的事，胡雪岩不大在行，有些话，象跟何桂清见面的经过，又非亲笔不可，

When the clock struck twelve, the letter was still unfinished.
所以这封信写到钟敲十二下，还没有写完。

Furong began to feel very apologetic.
芙蓉倒觉得老大过意不去，

At first she had thought he might be writing in a fit of pique; later, seeing the length of the letter, she realised he must be discussing other matters.
先是当他有些负气，后来看看不象，长篇大套在写，当然是谈别的事。

Still, Little Rabbit had prompted it, and such solemn attention made her uneasy.
不过因头总是由小兔儿身上而起，这样慎重其事，未免令人难安。

“Do take a rest,” she said gently.
“好歇歇了！”她温柔他说，

“The lotus-seed soup has boiled to a paste.
“莲子羹都煮成泥了，

Have your supper and go to bed.
吃了点心睡吧，

You can finish tomorrow.”
明天再说。”

“Almost done, almost done,” Hu answered without raising his head.
“马上就好，马上就好。”胡雪岩头也不抬他说。

Despite his words, he laboured over the letter for another hour before putting down his brush.
说是这样说，仍旧又很费劲地写了一个钟头才罢手，

He handed Furong the first sheet.
他把头一张信纸，递了给芙蓉。

She could read, and began aloud: “‘To His Excellency the Prefect, my honoured elder brother Mr Xuexuan, I respectfully beg to report—’” She laughed.
芙蓉是识得字的，接过来念道：“雪公太守尊兄大人阁下，敬禀者，”念到这里笑了，

“What a long-winded address!”
“好罗嗦的称呼！”

“Read on.” She continued, “‘Dispensing with formal compliments, I have a younger brother-in-law, Liu Xiaotu—’” Again she laughed.
“你看下去。”于是芙蓉又念：“套言不叙。今有内弟刘小兔，”到这里，芙蓉又笑了，

“Why have you written down Little Rabbit’s childhood name?”
“你怎么把小兔儿的小名也写了上去？”

“What does it matter?
“那要什么紧，

This is not an official statement of his career.
又不是官场里报履历，

Prefect Wang and I are intimate family friends.
我跟王大老爷通家至好，

A childhood name is quite all right.”
就写小名也不要紧。”

On reflection she agreed.
恩想也不错，

Smiling, she said, “However much I argue, I can never get the better of you.”
她便笑道：“说来说去，总说不过你。”

“You needn’t tell me.
“不用你说，

I know that already.
我自己晓得，

Look here.”
你看，”

He pointed to “younger brother-in-law.”
他指着“内弟”二字。

“You can have no complaint about that, can you?”
“这你总没话说了吧？”

He was declining to treat her as merely a concubine.
这是不拿芙蓉视作妾媵，

Naturally she was grateful, though she could not easily express it.
她自然感激，却不便有何表示，

She read on quietly.
只静心看下去，

The tutor, Hu wrote, must be learned, good-tempered and not too old; a generous fee would be offered to anyone willing to accept.
见胡雪岩对聘师的要求是学问好、性情好，年纪不宜过大，如愿就聘，柬脩从优。

It was clear that he was thinking seriously of her and Little Rabbit.
这见得他是真为自己跟小兔儿打算，

Warmth rose in her heart and turned to an ache; two tears rolled down before she knew it.
心头由热而酸，不知不党的滚下两滴眼泪。


“Now I think perhaps this isn’t right,” she said, wiping her eyes.
“我想想又不对了！”她揩一揩眼睛说，

“Little Rabbit may not have enough good fortune to bear it.
“怕小兔儿福薄，当不起！

Besides, all this trouble makes me uneasy.”
再说，这样费事，我心也不安。”

Hu could only feel helpless.
这话让胡雪岩没奈何了，

“One may believe in fortune-telling and face-reading, but there is no need to become so obsessed with them.”
“算命看相，可以相信，不过一个人也不要太迷这些花样。”

He scratched his head.
他搔搔头说，

“You are good in every other way.
“你样样都好，

It is only here that you cannot take a broader view.”
就是这上头看不开。”

“I think he had better go on sharing another family’s tutor for the time being.”
“我看，还是先附在人家馆里的好。”

“Why?”
“为啥呢？”

Whatever form her reasoning took, it came back to the fear that Little Rabbit did not possess the good fortune needed to support having a teacher all to himself.
为来为去，还是为了芙蓉怕小兔儿没有那种专请一位先生来教导的福分，

She placed immense faith in the eight characters of a birth horoscope, even believing that her own fate had destined her to be a concubine.
她最相信八字，连自己的终身，都相信是注定了偏房的命。

Once Hu understood this, he found a solution.
胡雪岩意会到此，便有了办法。

“Then do this.
“我看这样，

First have Little Rabbit’s horoscope drawn up and see what sort of fortune he has.
你先去替小兔儿排个八字看，到底福命如何？

If he is destined to become an official, follow my advice.
若是注定要做官的，就照我的话做，

Otherwise, do as you please.”
不然就随便你。”

“That is a good idea!
“这话说得好！

You have reminded me.
你倒提醒我了。

I shall have it done tomorrow.”
明天就替他去排个八字看。”

Furong found a sheet of red paper.
美蓉去找了一张红纸，

“Please write down Little Rabbit’s birth particulars for me.”
“劳动你把小兔儿的生辰八字写下来。”


After he had written down the particulars and they had eaten their late supper, they went to bed.
写完小兔儿的生辰八字，也吃了消夜，上床在沈头上，

On the pillow, Furong still had a “case” to try: the lock of black hair and the two nail clippings wrapped in embroidered white satin.
芙蓉还有一桩“官司”要审，就是那方白缎绣花小包袱中，包着的一绺黑发，两片指甲。

“Where did they come from?” she asked.
“这是哪里来的？”她说，

“There is no need to deny it or tell lies.”
“你用不着赖，也用不着说假话。”

“From your tone, you seem certain that I shall deny it and lie.
“听你的口气，当我一定要赖，一定要说假活。

In that case I had better say nothing.
那，我就最好不说话，

Even if I tell the truth, you won’t believe me.”
说了真话，你也一定不相信。”

“I can’t argue with you!”
“我说不过你！”

Furong was a little cross.
芙蓉有些着恼，

“If you won’t tell me, I shan’t give the packet back.”
“你不说，那包东西我不还你。”

“Keep it by all means.
“你尽管拿去好了，

Burn it or throw it away; I won’t ask what you have done with it.”
不管拿它烧掉、摔掉，我决不过问。”

“Wouldn’t that hurt you?”
“你不觉得心疼？”

“What is there to hurt?”
“心疼点啥？”

Hu was perfectly composed.
胡雪岩泰然自若地，

“If you don’t believe me, I’ll burn it before your eyes.” Furong sighed.
“你要不相信，我当面烧给你看！”“唉！”芙蓉叹口气说，

“‘A devoted woman and a faithless man.’
“ ‘痴心女子负心汉’，

I really feel sorry for whoever gave you those things.”
我真替那个送你这些东西的人难过。”

Her words had an unexpected effect.
这句话却发生了意想不到的效用，

Hu became deeply troubled.
胡雪岩大为不安，

“You can call me anything else and I won’t mind, but I cannot accept that.”
“你说”我别样，我都不在乎，就是这一样不能承认。

He defended himself emphatically.
“他加重语气分辩，”

“I am certainly not a man without a conscience, either towards my friends or towards the women I have loved.”
我决不是没有良心的人，对朋友如此，对喜欢过的女人，也是如此。“


“So you did love this woman?”
“这样说起来，你对这个女人是喜欢过的？”

“Yes.”
“不错。”

Judging from Furong’s tone, Hu felt certain she would not be jealous and saw no harm in speaking plainly.
胡雪岩已经从芙蓉的语气，料准了她不会吃醋，觉得直言不妨，所以又说，

“It was quite recently, but now I have made a clean break.
“就是前不久，我喜欢过，现在已经一刀两断。

Somehow she has suddenly made hot chestnuts pop in a cold pan.
她不知道怎么，忽然‘冷镬里爆出热栗子’，

I certainly cannot take advantage of returning to an old berth.
在我决不能捡‘船并旧码头，的便宜。

So I shall simply treat these things as though I had never seen them.”
所以对这两样东西，我只当做不曾看见。”

“I don’t understand you,” Furong said.
“你的话我弄不明白。”芙蓉问，

“What is her name, and what is her background?”
“她叫啥名字，啥出身？”

“Sister A’qiao.
“叫阿巧姐。

She comes from a pleasure house.
是堂子里的，

The Seventh Lady has met her too.”
七姑奶奶也见过。”

Furong was very surprised.
芙蓉深为诧异：

“The Seventh Lady is so outspoken and talks to me about everything.
“七姑奶奶这样直爽的人，跟我无话不谈，

Why has she never mentioned this?”
怎么这件事不曾提起？”

“What a funny thing to say.
“你说话叫人好笑，

Must an outspoken person blurt out everything, whether it ought to be said or not?”
直爽的人，就该不管说得说不得，都要乱说？”

Hu cautioned her, “The Seventh Lady really is a heroine among women.
胡雪岩提醒她：“七姑奶奶真正叫女中豪杰，

Do not be deceived by her wild ways.
不要看她疯疯癫癫，

She has a good deal of judgement and strategy in her head.
胸中着实有点丘壑，

Don’t misjudge her.”
你不要看错了她！“


“Enough, enough!
“好了，好了！

Don’t change the subject.
你不要把话扯开去。

Tell me how close you two were.”
你倒讲讲看，你们怎么样好法？”

“Like this!”
“就是这佯子！”

Hu rolled over and gathered Furong into his arms.
胡雪岩翻个身，一把抱住芙蓉。

“Hmph!”
“哼！”

She gave a cold laugh.
芙蓉冷笑，

“I can see that you still cannot forget her.
“看你这样子，心里还是忘不掉她，

You’re using me as her substitute.”
拿我来做替身！”

She tried to free herself, but he was stronger and held her all the tighter.
说着，便要从他怀抱中挣扎出来，无奈他的力气大，反而拿她抱得更紧了，

“I’m not using you as a substitute.
“我不是拿你做她的替身，

I’m comparing you with her,” he said.
我是拿你来跟她比一比。”他说，

“Her waist isn’t as slender as yours, and her skin isn’t as smooth.
“她的腰没有你细，皮肤没有你滑。

To tell you the truth, I like you better.”
说真的，我还是喜欢你。”

Those words were like a great ladle of water poured into a vinegar jar: they diluted the sourness.
这两句话等于在醋罐里加了一大勺清水，酸味冲淡了，

“Stop feeding me flattery!”
“少来灌米汤！”

After a pause she added, “Tell me the whole story, properly, from beginning to end.”
她停了一下又说，“你把跟她的事，从头到尾，好好讲给我听。”

“It’s a long one.”
“讲起来话长！”

Hu took his watch from beneath the pillow and looked at it.
胡雪岩从枕头下掏出表来看了一下说，

“Two o’clock!
“两点钟了！

If I start now, we shall be talking till dawn.
再讲就要讲到天亮，

Tomorrow.”
明天再说。

“If you won’t tell me, you’ll make me suffer.”
““你不讲就害我了！”

“What do you mean?”
“这叫什么话？”

“You’ll keep me awake all night.”
“你不讲，害我一夜睡不着。”

“Very well, I’ll tell you.”
“好，我讲。”

When he had given her a rough account of A’qiao’s story, he said, “Now you can sleep.
等把阿巧姐的故事，粗枝大叶讲完，胡雪岩又说，“这一来，你可以睡得着了，

No more questions!”
不许再罗嗦！”


“May I ask just one?”
“问一句话可以不可以？”

“Yes, but only one.”

照规矩说，她自己也要有数，是人家何家的人了，在你面前要避嫌疑，

怎么又在替你收拾行李的时候，私底下放了这两样‘私情表记，？

而且送你上了船，推三阻四，不肯下船，

这你难道看不出来，她的心又变过了。

不理她就是了。”

“你倒说得容易！

可见你不懂女人的心。”

Hu could no longer keep to his own limit on questions.
这一下，胡雪岩使不能不打破自己的戒约，往下追问：

女人不同，

有那么容易？

你倒试试看！”

这一番话把胡雪岩的瞌睡虫赶得光光的，

我的话错不错？”

亏得你提醒我。”

不要等她走在你前面叫明了，

事情就会弄僵，

话说出口，她怎么收得回去？”

“That is true.

不晓得怎么快法？”

生米煮成熟饭，还有啥话好说。”

不过官场里有样规矩你不懂，做哪个地方的官，不准娶哪个地方的女子做妾，

That is where the difficulty lies.”
麻烦就在这里。”

谈到官场的规矩，芙蓉就无法置喙了。

但即使如此，她的见解对胡雪岩仍旧是个很大的帮助。

When Hu woke early the following morning, this was the first matter on his mind.
第二天一早醒来，首先想到的也就是这件事，

His head was clearer at that hour.
大清早的脑筋比较清醒，

Considering it calmly, he concluded that although the raw rice could not immediately become cooked rice, once it was in the pot there would be no turning back.
他很冷静地考虑下来，认为“生米”虽不能一下子就成“熟饭”，但米只要下了锅，就不会再有变化，

The best course was to ask Pan Shuya to act as his representative and explain the arrangement to He Guiqing first.
于今为计，不妨托出潘叔雅做自己的代表，先向何桂清说明白，

Once the matter was settled, A’qiao would resign herself to it.
事成定局，阿巧姐自会死心，

That would put the raw rice in the pot.
这就是将“生米”下锅的办法。

Someone would still be needed to carry messages between them.
不过，这件事还要个居问奔走的人。

Zhou Yiming was ready to hand; failing him, Liu Bucai was also well suited to that kind of errand.
现成有个周一鸣在那里，不然还有刘不才，也是千这路差使的好材料。

Since the situation was unlikely to change immediately, Hu could wait until Zhou returned before proceeding.
好在事情一时还下会生变，不妨等周一鸣回来了再说。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十六章（下）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Six, Part Two
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Having thought his way through this difficulty, Hu felt considerably relieved.
等把这个难题想通了，胡雪岩觉得心情相当轻松，

Gu Yingchun would certainly be busy dealing with the foreigners that day, so there was no need to disturb him.

赌法是三十六门开一门，其中两门永远不开，所以实际上是三十四门猜一门，

一赔二十八，等于多占五门。”七姑奶奶说，
