赌法是每天早晚各开一次，称为‘早筒’、‘晚筒’。

By custom, the winners of the previous two draws are excluded, which is why only thirty-four of the thirty-six entries can win.
向例前面两筒开过的围不开，所以三十六门实际上只开三十四门。

The thirty-six stand for thirty-six men, said to have been the thirty-six bandit chiefs of Liangshan Marsh originally.
“三十六门是三十六个人，据说最初就是梁山泊的三十六响马巨头，

Over time, the names of Song Jiang, Wu Yong and the others were all changed.
但久而久之，宋江、吴用等等名字，完全改过了。

Each man has a different status and a ‘guardian star’, which may be something that flies in the sky, crawls on land or swims in the water.
三十六个人的身分，各个不同，另外每个人有座‘本命星’，天上飞的、陆上爬的、水中游的都有，

Number twenty-five, for instance, is Lin Taiping, an emperor, whose guardian star is a dragon.
象第二十五，名叫林太平，身分是皇帝，本命星就是一条龙。

You can choose only one of the thirty-four.
“三十四门只能挑一门，

But which?
怎么挑法？

This seems as good as that, and you're too anxious and uncertain to decide, so you seek an answer in a dream.
这样也好，那样也好，心里七上八下拿不定主意，那就只好祈梦了。

Dream of a dragon, and naturally you bet on Lin Taiping; dream of a black dog, and you bet on number twenty-eight, Luo Bide.”
梦见龙，当然押林太平，梦见黑狗，就要押第二十八罗必得。”

She paused.
七姑奶奶停了一下问，

“Do you know where people go to seek these dreams?”
“你晓得祈梦到哪里去祈？”

“A temple, of course.”
“自然是庙里。”芙蓉答说。

“No.
“不是！

A grave in some lonely wilderness.”
荒山野地的坟头上。”

Furong was horrified.
芙蓉大骇，

“At night?”
“是晚上？”她问。

“Of course.
“当然是晚上，

Who seeks such dreams in daylight?”
哪有白天祈梦的？”

“Sleeping on a grave at night?”
“晚上睡在坟头上？”

Furong shook her head repeatedly.
芙蓉不断摇头，

“Wouldn't you die of fright?”
“不吓死人！”

“Money makes people brave.
“为了钱，胆就大了，

And not just any grave—the newer, the better.”
不但是坟头上，而且越是新坟越好……”

This followed the belief that “a new ghost is strong, an old ghost weak”.
这是由于“新鬼大，故鬼小”的说法，

The occupant of a fresh grave had died recently, so the spirit was more easily summoned.
新坟则墓中人新死不久，魂灵易聚，

One scraped a spatula about in an empty iron pot, and the ghost was said to come at the sound.
招魂的方法是用一口空铁锅，拿锅铲空铲一阵，据说鬼魂就会闻声而至。

A bet based on the ensuing dream, they claimed, would never fail.
然后根据梦兆去押，百不失一。


“Does it really work?”
“那么，灵不灵呢？”

“How could it?” the Seventh Lady replied.
“怎么会灵？”七姑奶奶说。

“Suppose you dream of a yellow dog and I dream of a black one.
“譬如你梦见黄狗，我梦见黑狗，

We each bet accordingly; at least one dream must be wrong.
各押各的，总有一个不灵。

Everyone has a different state of mind and dreams their own dreams.
各人有各人的心境，各人做各人的梦，

For all of them to come true, all thirty-four entries would have to win.
个个要灵，除非三十四门全开。

Where's the sense in that?”
哪有这个道理？”

“Perfectly explained!”
“讲得透彻！”

Liu, whose repeated reverses had given him plenty of gambling experience, slapped the table in admiration.
对赌之一道三折肽的刘不才，击案称赏，

“Gambling depends on calculation.
“赌钱全靠算！

Sudden inspirations are no guide.”
‘触机’不足为据。

Furong nodded thoughtfully, then asked, “But how does it destroy a woman's honour?”
“芙蓉也深有所思地点点头，接着又问：“那么，怎么说是败坏名节呢？”

“Think of a woman sleeping alone in the wilderness.
“你想想，一个女人独自睡在荒郊野外，

How could she escape being violated?”
还有个不被人糟踏的？”

“Oh!”
“啊！”

Furong shuddered.
芙蓉悚然，

“This flower lottery really does cause endless harm.
“这花会说起来真是害人无穷！

Third Uncle, you should go less often too.”
三叔，你也少去！”

“Don't worry.
“你放心，

That game is for people who don't know how to gamble.
这种赌是不会赌的人玩的。

It won't catch me.
迷不到我！

I simply enjoy gambling and wanted to see what it was like.
我不过喜欢赌，要会见识见识而已。”刘不才又说，

Winning over two hundred taels today was nothing remarkable.
“今天赢了二百多两银子，不足为奇。

But I saw something extraordinary that truly earned my admiration.”
遇见一桩妙事，说起来，倒着实叫我佩服。”

The Seventh Lady brightened at once.
听这一说，七姑奶奶首先就高兴了，

“Tell us!”
“快说，快说！”

She brought him a cup of tea.
她捧杯茶给刘不才，

“If you call it extraordinary, it must be.”
“你说的妙事一定妙！”


Liu described someone he had seen at a local branch.
刘不才所讲的，是他在一处“分筒”中亲眼得见的一位人物。

It was a large establishment frequented by many prosperous households, and the stakes were heavy.
这处分筒，规模极大，赌客中颇多殷实富户，下的赌码极重，

Among its customers was a rich widow whose husband's surname was Liang and who was known by her family's rank as Fourth Madam Liang.
其中有个富孀，夫家姓梁，行四，所以都叫她“梁四太太”。

Unlike others, she always bet on a single entry: number sixteen, Li Hanyun.
梁四太太打花会与众不同，专打一门，这一门在三十六门中，名列十六，叫做李汉云。

Curiously, while she persisted in backing that one, the main office never drew it.
奇的是她专打这一门。总筒中偏偏不开这一门。

In a little over a year she had lost more than ten thousand taels.
这样一年多下来，已经输了上万的银子。

That afternoon she arrived by sedan chair as usual.
这天下午，她照例坐轿到了那里，

Such an important customer was naturally welcomed with every attention.
因为是大户，自然殷勤接待，

After a cup of tea, the branch's clerk asked with a courteous smile, “Fourth Madam, will you give me your slips?”
一盏茶罢，分筒执事便赔笑相问：“四太太，把条子交下来吧！”

The slip naming one's choice was customarily sealed and opened only after the main office announced the winner.
花会打那一门的那张“条子”照例是封缄的，要等总筒开出来才能揭晓。

Otherwise, the main office could total the stakes on each entry and choose the one carrying the smallest sum.
不如此则总筒可以统计每一门下注的数目，避重就轻拣注码最少的一门开。

Yet fraud remained possible.
话虽如此，弊端还是有的。

At the clerk's question, Fourth Madam Liang said angrily, “Losing money is a small matter.
梁四太太这时听执事问到，便愤愤地说：“钱输了，还是小事，

What I don't believe is that I can never win once.
我就不相信一次都不会中。

I must win at least once before I'm satisfied.”
我总要着一次才服气。”

“I'd advise you to change your choice.
“我劝四太太换一门的好！”分筒执事说，

There's something uncanny about gambling.
“赌上面真是有鬼的，

When a number won't come up, it simply won't.”
不开起来一定不开。”


“I shall certainly win today.
“今天开出来，我一定会中。

Look.”
你看，”

She took a handful of slips from her handkerchief bundle.
梁四太太便从手巾包里取出一把纸条来，

“I've backed all thirty-four entries.
“今天我打三十四门，

Surely I must win now?”
莫非还不中？”

“What a way to gamble!” the clerk laughed.
“哪有这种赌法的？”分筒执事笑道，

“Think, Fourth Madam.
“四太太你不想想，

Only one of the thirty-four can win.
三十四门，只中一门，

Even with twenty-eight paid back, you'll still lose four stakes.
赔了你二十八，还要输四门。

What sort of reckoning is that?”
这叫什么算盘？”

“Naturally, I've staked different amounts.
“当然下注有多少。

If one of my heavy bets wins, I'll come out ahead.
开出来是我的重门，我就赢了。”梁四太太说：

I must win once before I can make up my mind to stop.”
“总要中一回，我才能死心歇手。”

The clerk gathered that this would be her last visit.
分筒执事，听她的口风，这是最后一回来赌花会，

It was a pity to lose such an important customer for nothing, but he could hardly try to dissuade her now.
平白失去这么一个大户，未免可惜。但此时亦不便相劝，

He took up his brush to record the stake on each entry.
只拿笔来记每一门所下的注码。

When all were listed, there were only thirty-three.
一注注写完，却只有三十三门，

Puzzled, she thought carefully.
梁四太太奇怪，凝神细想一想说道：

“I counted them when I got out of the chair.
“下轿的时候我还数过的，

There were thirty-four slips.
是三十四张条子，

I must have dropped one.
大概是数弄掉了一张，

Will you look for it?”
你们替我去找一找看？”

Cunning and practised daily in every trick of the business, the clerk immediately decided that even if the slip was found, he must not give it back.
那分筒执事，工于心计，而且日夕从事，对于这上面的舞弊，精到极点，当时心里就打算好，这张条子就寻着了，也不能够给她。

Sure enough, it lay beneath the threshold, but the report to her was, “We've looked everywhere.
果然在门槛下面找到了，但回复梁四太太却是如此：“到处找过，

Nothing.”
没有！”

“Then never mind.
“没有，就算了！

Surely that won't be the very entry drawn?
莫非偏偏就开那一门？

I don't believe the world contains such coincidences.”
我想，世界上没有那么巧的事！”

The branch wanted both to take all her stakes and to prevent a win from putting an end to her visits.
分筒一则要“统吃”梁四太太，再则怕她今日一中，明日不来，

They would therefore have that very entry drawn.
于是便革开那一门，

Opening the recovered slip, they found number thirty-five, Zhang Jiuguan, and immediately told the main office to draw him.
打开捡到的那张条子，看是第三十五门张九官，当即通知总筒，开出张九官来。


“I arrived at almost the same time as she did,” Liu said, “and watched her thirty-three slips being opened.
“我跟这位梁四太太前后脚到。”刘不才说，“眼看她的三十三张条子拆封，

The very first was Zhang Jiuguan.”
第一封拆开来就是张九官……”

Impatient, the Seventh Lady broke in.
七姑奶奶心急，打断他问：

“How could that be?
“这是啥道理？

How strange!”
好奇怪！”

“There are stranger things yet.
“怪事还多呢！

Don't hurry me.
你不要心急，

Listen.
听我说！”刘不才又说：

The second was Zhang Jiuguan too.”
“拆开第二封，还是张九官。

“And the third?
““第三封呢？”七姑奶奶问，

Surely not Zhang Jiuguan again?”
“莫非也是张九官？”

“Of course!
“这还用说！

All the way to the thirty-third, every one was Zhang Jiuguan.
一直拆到第三十三封，都是张九官，

Fourth Madam Liang won more than twelve thousand taels.
梁四太太一共赢了一万两千多银子，

In one stroke, she recovered everything she had lost over the past year and made a profit besides.”
一年多输下去的，一下子扳本反赢钱！”

At the revelation, Furong stared open-mouthed.
这个故事的谜底揭开来，将芙蓉听得目瞪口呆，

“Who could think of such a devilish trick?” she exclaimed incredulously.
不信地说：“真想得出这种恶刻的法子？”

“Her brains can compare with Little Uncle's!” the Seventh Lady said longingly.
“这梁四太太的脑筋，可以跟小爷叔比了！”七姑奶奶不胜向往他说，

“I'd love to make her acquaintance.”
“我们真想结识结识她！”

“Easy enough,” Liu replied.
“那也容易，”刘不才说，

“Go to that branch a few times, and you're sure to meet her.”
“只要到那处分筒去几回，一定遇得见她。”


“Spare yourself!”
“省省吧！”

Furong intervened at once.
芙蓉赶紧劝阻，

“This lottery does terrible harm.
“这种花会，害人不浅，

All that guessing at other people's schemes would shorten your life by years.
这样子猜心思，寿命都要短几年，

You've already given it up.
你既然已经戒掉了，

Whatever you do, don't go back.”
千万别去。”

“That's true,” Liu said, sounding deeply repentant.
“这话也是！”刘不才大有忏悔之意，

“Gambling is no fun without a battle of wits.
“赌这样东西，不赌心思没有趣味，

Yet once you pit your wits against others, however clever you are, there's always someone cleverer.
要赌心思，真叫‘强中自有强中手’，

You can never be sure of anything.
永远不会有啥把握。

When I think about it, there's really no point.”
想想真没意思！”

“Does that mean you'll give up gambling too, Third Master Liu?”
“照这样子说，刘三爷，你也要洗手戒赌了？”

“Listen to him!”
“你听他的！”

Furong curled her lip and told the Seventh Lady, “Third Uncle has promised to stop seventeen or eighteen times already.”
芙蓉撇撇嘴，对七姑奶奶说，“我们三叔说要戒赌，总有十七八回了。”

Liu smiled in embarrassment.
刘不才不好意思地笑了一下，

The Seventh Lady came to his rescue.
七姑奶奶便为他解嘲：

“Even if he hasn't stopped, he's always thinking of stopping.
“虽然没有戒掉，总常常想着在戒，

That's something to admire.”
这就蛮难得的了！”

“What's admirable?” someone asked from the doorway.
“怎么难得？”门外有人在搭腔，

They turned to find Qiu, who had slipped out unnoticed and now slipped back in.
大家转脸看时，是不知道什么时候溜了出去，如今又溜了回来的裘丰言。

The Seventh Lady retold the story she had just heard.
于是七姑奶奶将刚刚听来的故事，又讲了一遍。

Qiu too was full of admiration for Fourth Madam Liang.
裘丰言也对梁四太太赞叹不止，

Their conversation continued until after ten, when Gu and Hu returned one after the other.
这样谈到十点多钟，古应春和胡雪岩陆续归来，

The boat had been hired, and Hu's purchases sent directly to the inn.
船已雇好，胡雪岩所买的东西，已直接送回客栈。

They agreed to meet at the Seventh Lady's again at noon the next day and go aboard together.
约定第二天中午，仍在七姑奶奶那里会齐，一起下船。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十七章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Seven, Part One
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN｜第二十七章


On reaching Songjiang, they moored below Xiuye Bridge and went ashore, stopping first at the You household to rest.
到了松江，船泊秀野桥下，都上了岸，先到尤家休息。

Mrs You was greatly surprised and busied herself with greetings and arrangements.
尤五奶奶大出意外，少不得有一番寒暄张罗。

The family always kept plenty of guest rooms ready.
尤家常年备着好些客户，

Furong had already agreed to stay with the Seventh Lady; Mrs You now insisted that Hu and Qiu stay in the house as well.
除了芙蓉是七姑奶奶早就约好，跟她一起往以外，尤五奶奶又坚邀胡、裘二人在她家下榻。

Once they had settled in, they went to see the Old Master.
略略安顿，随即去见老太爷。

Since Qiu Fengyan was a stranger and an official, the old man observed every courtesy.
因为裘丰言是生客，又是一位官儿，老太爷十分客气，

He had his long robe and riding jacket brought out, dressed formally, and sat with them in solemn state.
叫人取来长袍马褂，衣冠整齐，肃然陪坐。

Qiu was deeply uncomfortable, and even Hu felt constrained.
这一下不但裘丰言大为不安，连胡雪岩亦颇为局促，

Fortunately, the Seventh Lady soon followed.
幸好，七姑奶奶接踵而至，

Her easy, affectionate conversation dispelled the stiffness.
有她在座，能说会道，亲切随和，才把僵硬的气氛改变过来。

After some small talk she came to the point.
说过一阵闲话，七姑奶奶谈到正事，

“Old Master, I have something very important to tell you today.
“老太爷，”她说，“今天我有桩大事来禀告你老人家。

Only I find it rather hard to say.”
不过，有点说不出口。”

He had already seen that Qiu knew her well, so there was no need to restrain his own remarks.
老太爷已经看出来，裘丰言跟她也相熟，这样，自己说话，就无需有所避忌：

“Now that is something new!” he said, half smiling.
“真正新鲜话把戏！”他似笑非笑地说，

“Is there anything you find hard to say?”
“你还有啥说不出口的话！”

“You make me sound quite shameless.”
“老太爷也是，就看得我那样子的老脸厚皮。”

She rose with a laugh.
七姑奶奶笑着站了起来，

“I shall go in and talk to Old Aunt first.
“我先进去跟老姑太太谈谈，

Little Uncle can tell you for me.”
请小爷叔代我说吧！”

Old Aunt was the Old Master’s sister, also over seventy, hard of hearing and slow of speech.
老姑太太是老太爷的妹妹，也七十多了，耳聋口拙，

There was little to discuss with her.
没有什么可谈的，

The Seventh Lady merely wanted to withdraw so that Hu could speak of her marriage.
七姑奶奶无非是托词避开，好让胡雪岩谈她的亲事。

Her unsettled future had long weighed on the Old Master.
七姑奶奶的没有一个归宿，原是者太爷的一桩心事，

Hu’s detailed account delighted him, especially the news that Wang Youling, a prefect, had condescended to take a woman of her background in the brotherhood as his sworn sister.
所以听得胡雪岩细谈了经过，十分高兴。尤其是听说王有龄以知府的身分，降尊纡贵，认出身江湖的七姑奶奶作义妹，

He considered that a great honour.
更觉得是件有光彩的事。

It was all Hu’s doing, and, remembering the source of these blessings, he thanked him repeatedly.
这一切都由胡雪岩而来，饮水思源，说了许多感谢的话，

Since Qiu was to represent Hu and coordinate arrangements between the You and Wang families, he also entrusted the matter to Qiu and thanked him.
同时因为裘丰言作胡雪岩的代表，在尤家与王家之间，要由他来从中联合安排，所以老太爷又向裘丰言拜托道谢。

His heartfelt sincerity was deeply moving.
言出至诚，着实令人感动。


“Old Master,” Hu said, finally turning to his own request, “there is something else.
“老太爷，”胡雪岩最后谈到他自己的请求，“有件事，

Since Brother Five is away, I must trouble you to muster a few men for me.”
尤五哥不在这里，要劳动你老人家替我调兵遣将了！”

“Certainly!” the old man said eagerly.
“噢！”老太爷一叠连声地说：

“Tell me what you need!” Hu explained that he wanted two men to accompany a shipment.
“你吩咐，你吩咐！”等胡雪岩说明，要派两个人护送，

He had expected this to be easily arranged, but the Old Master fell into thoughtful silence.
料想是件轻而易举的事，却不道老太爷竟沉吟不语。

Puzzled, Hu could not help asking, “Is there some difficulty?”
这就奇怪了，他忍不住要问：“老太爷，莫非有什么难处？”

“Yes.
“是的。”

You are one of us, my young friend, and Mr Qiu already feels like an old acquaintance.
老太爷答道，“你老弟是自己人，裘爷也是一见如故的好友，

This is a most unfortunate coincidence—and a fortunate one too.
这件事说不巧真不巧，说巧真巧。

Never mind the unfortunate part.
不巧的不去说它了，

The fortunate part is that you have told me.
只说巧的是，亏得你跟我说，

Otherwise, I should have done a friend a very serious wrong.”
不然，真要做出对不起朋友的事来了。”

Hu’s shrewdness and Qiu’s long experience both told them that something lay behind these words.
听得这话，以胡雪岩的精明老到，裘丰言的饱经世故，都察出话中大有蹊跷，

They exchanged a glance.
两人面面相觑，交换了一个眼色，

Naturally it was Hu who spoke.
自然还是胡雪岩开口。

“Since you regard us as your own people, why not tell us the unfortunate part as well?”
“老太爷既当我们是自己人，那么，是怎么的‘不巧’？何妨也说一说！”

“There is no need.
“不必说了！

The misfortune is that Old Five is away.
不巧的是老五不在这里，

Had he been here, this would never have happened.” The Old Master calmly asked, “When do you intend to leave, Mr Qiu?”
在这里就不会有这件事。”老太爷平静地问道：“裘老爷预备什么时候走？”


“My cargo is still in Shanghai.
“我的货色还在上海，

Hiring boats and loading them will take three to five days.
雇船装货，总得有三、五天的工夫。

I shall follow your instructions.”
我听老太爷的吩咐！”

“I would not presume to give instructions.
“吩咐不敢当。”老太爷说，

Please go back to Shanghai tomorrow and make your preparations.
“你明天就请回上海去预备。

Today is the fourteenth day of the fourth month.
今天四月十四，

Be ready to sail on the twentieth.
准备四月二十开船，

We shall meet in Shanghai on the nineteenth.”
我们四月十九，在上海会齐。”

“What?”
“怎么？”

Hu did not understand his use of “we.”
胡雪岩不解“我们”两字，

“Surely you do not mean…”
“莫非……”

“Yes.
“是的。”

I shall escort Mr Qiu myself.”
老太爷说，“我送了裘老爷去！”

“How could we allow that?”
“那怎么敢当？”

Hu and Qiu exclaimed together.
裘丰言跟胡雪岩异口同声地说。

“No!”
“不！”

The old man made an emphatic gesture.
老太爷做了个很有力的手势，

“I must go in person.”
“非我亲自送不可。”

His lips moved as though he had more to say.
说着，嘴唇动了两下，

He looked at Qiu, but finally left the words unspoken.
看看裘丰言，到底不曾说出口来。

Recognising the seriousness of the situation, Hu abandoned ceremony. “Forgive me, Qiu.
“对不起，老裘！”胡雪岩看事态严重，也就顾不得了，径自直言：

Would you sit outside for a moment?
“你请外面坐一坐，

I must have a word with the Old Master.”
我跟老太爷说句话。”

“Of course.”
“是，是！”

Qiu understood and hastily rose to withdraw.
裘丰言也会意了，赶紧起身回避。

“There is no need.
“不必！

Please stay here, Mr Qiu.”
裘老爷请这里坐！”

The Old Master rose and apologised.
老太爷起身又道歉：

“I am very sorry.
“实在对不起！

I must speak to our friend Hu about something within the brotherhood.
我跟我们胡老弟说句‘门槛里’的话。

I do not mean to treat you as an outsider, but, to be frank, there are things you would be better off not knowing.”
不是拿你当外人，因为有些话，说实在的，裘老爷还是不晓得的好。”

With this explanation he took Hu to the family’s Buddhist shrine room, the most solemn and secluded place in the house.
交代了这番话，老太爷陪着胡雪岩到佛堂里去坐，这是他家最庄严、也最清静的一处地方，

Hu understood such observances.
胡雪岩很懂这些过节，

He immediately assumed a grave expression, joined his palms, lowered his head and eyes, and silently paid reverence to the Buddha.
一进去立刻摆出极严肃的脸色，双手合十，先垂头低眼，默默地礼了佛，

Only then did he quietly take a seat below the scripture table.
才悄悄在经桌的下方落座。


The Old Master sat beside him and spoke slowly.
老太爷在他侧面坐了下来，慢慢吞吞地说道：

“My young friend, I did not know you had a hand in this affair.
“老弟台，我不晓得这件享有你‘轧脚’在内，

Had I known earlier, things would have been easier.
早晓得了，事情就比较好做。

Now it is like a sore about to burst: there is nothing for it but to squeeze out the pus.”
现在，好比生了疮，快要破头了，只好把脓硬挤出来！”

Hu listened closely, still unable to guess what connection the old man could have with the arms Qiu was escorting.
胡雪岩很用心地听着，始终猜不透，裘丰言押运的这一批军火，跟他有何关系？

One thing was clear: the Old Master was in a very difficult position.
但有一层是很清楚的，老太爷的处境相当为难，

Yet Hu could not imagine where the difficulty lay.
只是难在何处，却怎么佯也想不出。

Among men of their world, consideration for one another mattered above everything.
江湖上做事，讲究彼此为人着想，

Hu felt that all other questions could wait; first he must make his own position clear.
所以胡雪岩在这时候，觉得别样心思可以暂时不想，自己的态度一定得先表明。

“Old Master, I know you treat my concerns as your own.
“老太爷，”他说，“我晓得你拿我这面的事，当自己的事一样，

Let us regard this as something we are both involved in, and work out a solution together.
既然这样子，我们就当这件事你我都有分，好好商量着办。

If you shoulder all the difficulty alone, I shall not accept it, even if you succeed.”
如果难处光是由你老一肩挑了过去，即使能够办通，我也不愿意。”

Stretching out a hand all knuckles and calluses, the old man gripped Hu’s wrist. “My young friend, I have not been mistaken in choosing you as a friend.
“老弟台！”老太爷伸出一只全是骨节老茧的手，捏着胡雪岩的手腕说：“我真没有白交你这个朋友。

Let me explain.”
我把事情说给你听。”


It was indeed just as he had said: an unfortunate coincidence, yet a fortunate one.
真如他自己所说的：“事情说巧真巧，说不巧真不巧”，

The shipment of arms concerned one of his fellow initiates, a man named Yu Wucheng, whose territory lay around Yangzhou and Zhenjiang.
这一批军人跟他的一个“同参弟兄”有关，这个人名叫俞武成，地盘是在扬州、镇江一带。

Though the Taiping forces had withdrawn from Yangzhou, they had left Lai Hanying holding Chenzhou, where he was locked in a stalemate with the Qing naval forces under Lei Yixian, left vice-minister of punishments.
这时太平军虽已退出扬州，但仍留赖汉英扼守辰州，与清军刑部左侍郎雷正诚的水师，相持不下。

Determined to break the deadlock, the Taipings had been dealing with foreign merchants in Shanghai in the hope of buying arms.
太平军全力谋求打开局面，所以跟上海的洋商有交易，希望买到一批军火。

“The foreign merchants are to blame for this,” the Old Master said.
“这件事要派洋商的不是！”老太爷说：

“They had originally promised the rifles Zhejiang has bought to the Longhairs.
“浙江买的那批洋枪，原来洋商是答应卖给‘长毛’的，

They had already taken their deposit and agreed on a shipping date, with a British warship to carry the cargo.
已经收了人家的定洋，约期起运，由英国兵舰运了去。

Then the arrangement changed.
哪知道事情变了卦，

I hear that the man negotiating for Zhejiang was extremely resourceful…” Hu interrupted with pleasure.
听说替浙江方面出头交涉的人，手腕很灵活……”“老太爷，”胡雪岩很高兴地抢着说，

“That was none other than the Seventh Lady’s future husband, Gu Yingchun.”
“这个人不是别人，就是未来的‘七姑爷’古应春。”

“Oh!
“噢！

I had no idea.
我不晓得。

Old Five has been in Shanghai these past two months, and I have been cut off from the news.
老五这两个月一直在上海，消息隔绝了。

Never mind that for now.
这且不去说他，

Let us return to my brother Yu Wucheng.”
先说我那个同参弟兄俞武成。”

Yu knew Lai Hanying well.
俞武成跟赖汉英相熟，

Appealing partly to their friendship and partly through a substantial gift, Lai had enlisted him to intercept the arms as soon as they left Shanghai and entered the inland waterways.
因而一半交情，一半重礼，赖汉英托出俞武成来，预备等这批军火从上海起运，一入内河，就要动手截留。

Since this was the territory of the Songjiang Grain Transport Brotherhood, Yu had made a special journey to call on his senior fellow initiate and courteously notify him.
由于是松江漕帮的地盘，所以俞武成专程到松江来拜访他这位老师兄，很客气地打了招呼。

“It was my own carelessness,” the Old Master said regretfully.
“这怪我一时疏忽。”老大爷失悔地说，

“I have long stopped attending to these matters and left everything to Old Five.
“我是久已不管闲事，一切都交给老五，

Unfortunately, he had gone to Hangzhou.
偏偏者五又到杭州去了。

And Wucheng is a brother who knelt with me before the same stick of incense!
俞武成又是当年一炷香一起磕头的弟兄！

After fifty years, only three of our fellow initiates remain.
五十年下来，同参的只剩了三个人，

I could not disregard that friendship.
这个交情，我不能不买。

Who could have imagined the flood would wash into the Dragon King’s own temple?
哪晓得大水冲了龙王庙！

Now there is nothing for it.
如今说不得了，

I shall have to break my word.”
只好我说了话不算！“


“How can that be right?” Hu replied.
“那怎么可以？”胡雪岩口答道，

“Elder Yu may be your fellow initiate, but you have given him your word.
“俞老虽是你老的同参，但是答应过他的，

You cannot simply change your face and tell him that the goods belong to friends and must not be touched.
也不能脸一抹，说是自己人的东西，不准动！

A man of our world does not cut off another man’s livelihood.
光棍不断财路，

Let me find a way.”
我来想办法。

“There is no reason for you to rack your brains over it.
““老弟台！没有叫你伤脑筋的道理。

I have told you what lies within our doors because I regard you as one of us.
我是因为当你自己人，所以拿门槛里的话告诉了你，

Under our rules, I ought not to have spoken at all.
照规矩是不能说的。”老太爷又说：

I ask only for your advice.
“我只请你做个参赞，

The responsibility is mine, and I must bear it whatever happens.
事情是我的，无论如何要掮它下去，

Tell Mr Qiu he need not worry.”
你请裘老爷放心好了。”

“How can we stop worrying?” Hu said.
“怎么放得下心！”胡雪岩说，

“For now we must hold our position.
“如今只有‘按兵不动’，

Leave the rifles where they are until we have reached an understanding with Elder Yu.”
那批洋枪先放在那里，等跟俞老谈好了再说。”

The Old Master did not answer.
老太爷不答，

Leaning back, he stared into space with his lips tightly closed, utterly absorbed in finding a way out.
身往后一靠，双眼望空，紧闭着嘴唇，是那全心全意在思索如何解开这难题的神气。

Hu watched uneasily, working through the problem himself.
胡雪岩见此光景，颇为不安，心里也在打算：

Had Yu not been the old man’s fellow initiate, matters would have been simpler.
如果俞武成不是他的“同参弟兄”，事情就好办，

Had the weapons not been destined for the Taipings, that too would have made things easier.
若是这批军火，不是落到太平军手里，事情也好办。

But now they dared not strike at the rat for fear of breaking the precious vessel, nor could they readily let go.
此刻既是投鼠忌器，又不能轻易松手，

Neither firmness nor persuasion offered a clear path.
槁成了软硬都难着力的局面，

Even Hu could think of no immediate solution.
连他都觉得一时真难善策。


“It is difficult,” the Old Master said.
“难！”老太爷说，

“After turning it over and over, I can see no way but to stand firm myself.”
“想来想去，只有我来硬挺。”

“That will not solve it.
“硬挺不是办法。”

How close do you think Elder Yu is to the people on the other side?”
胡雪岩问道，“照你老看，俞老跟那面的交情如何？”

“I do not know.
“这就不清楚了。

But among men of our world, a promise is a promise.
不过江湖上走走，一句话就是一句话，

He has promised them, and I have promised him.
他答应了人家，我又答应了他，

Whatever the circumstances, if I prevent him from laying hands on this cargo, our brotherhood is at an end.”
反正不管怎么样，这票东西，我不让他动手，我们弟兄的交情就算断了。”

“Not necessarily!”
“话不能这么说！”

An idea flashed into Hu’s mind.
胡雪岩脑际灵光一闪，欣然说道：

“I have a way out where there seems to be none.
“我倒有个无办法中的办法，

Send a special messenger to invite Elder Yu here, and put everything openly before him.
我想请你老派个专人，将俞老请来，有话摆在台面上说：

Both sides are friends.
两面都是自己人，

You cannot help one at the other’s expense.
不能帮一面损一面。

Ask him himself what ought to be done.”
事情该怎么办？请俞老自己说一句。”

“What sort of solution is that?”
“这叫什么办法？”

The old man smiled.
老太爷笑道：

“It would simply mean that I cannot manage the affair and must withdraw from it.”
“那不就表示：这闲事我管不下来，只好不管吗？”

“Exactly!”
“正就是这话！”

Hu nodded.
胡雪岩点点头，

“If you decline to intervene, he cannot blame you.
“你老不肯管这闲事，俞老怨不着你。

And we, on our side, shall be endlessly grateful.”
而在我们这面，就承情不尽了。

The old man considered.
“老太爷略想一下问道：

“Have you some other plan?
“莫非你另有法子，

Perhaps you mean to seek protection from government troops and settle things by force with Wucheng?”
譬如请官兵保护，跟武成硬碰硬较量个明白？”

“How could I do that?” Hu laughed.
“我哪能这么做？”胡雪岩笑道，

“If I did, could I ever move among men of the brotherhood again?”
“我这样一做，将来还想不想在江湖上跑跑？”

“Then what would you do?”
“那么，你是怎么办呢？”

“I must speak to Elder Yu first.
“我想跟俞老谈了再说。”

I shall tell him plainly that if the Taipings were not the intended buyers, I could give way, let his clients buy the cargo, and negotiate another purchase with the foreigners myself.
胡雪岩答道，“我要跟他老实说明白，这票货色，如果不是太平军那面要，我可以放手，由他那面的户头承买，我另找洋商打交道，

But as things stand, I cannot.
现在可不行，

I shall ask him to stay out of it.
这是请俞老不要管闲事。

As for the handsome gift they have given him, I shall match it.”
至于那面送了怎样一笔重礼，我照送就是。”

“I hear it was ten thousand taels.”
“听说是一万银子。”

“Ten thousand is no great matter.
“一万银子小事，

I can afford to bear the cost.
我贴也贴得起。

I doubt Elder Yu attaches that much importance to it either.
我看俞老也不见得看得如何之重！

What I must persuade him of is that he must never help the Longhairs.
我要劝他的是，一定不可以帮长毛。

A man cannot fail to distinguish loyalty from rebellion.”
为人忠逆之辨，总不可以不分明。”


At these last words the Old Master looked at him intently.
听到最后一句，老太爷很注意地望着他，

After a long pause he nodded.
好久，才点点头说：

“Though you are an outsider, you know the origins and history of the Grain Transport Brotherhood very well.
“老弟台，你虽是空子，漕帮的来龙去脉，清清楚楚，

To tell you the truth, two hundred years have passed.
说句实话，二百年下来，

These are no longer the times in which our three patriarchs, Weng, Qian, and Pan, founded the brotherhood.
现在的时世，不是翁、钱、潘三祖当年立家门的时世了。

When the Longhairs first rose, we thought highly of the two Xius, Hong Xiuquan and Yang Xiuqing.
长毛初起，我们漕帮看得两‘秀’很重。

Who could have foreseen how disgraceful they would become?
哪晓得越来越不象话，

Before they had even won the empire, they had swept away all the proper bonds of human relations.
天下还没有到手，伦常名教倒已经扫地了。

Worshipping Heaven and Earth while showing no respect for parents, men’s divisions and women’s divisions, and a whole tangle of other nonsense!
什么拜天地不敬父母，什么‘男行’、‘女行’，乌七八糟一大堆。

Now Liu Lichuan of the Small Swords Society is worshipping Heaven and Earth too.
现在小刀会刘丽川也在拜天地了，

I cannot stomach it.
这些情形我也看不惯。

So if you can persuade Wucheng to change his mind and stop helping the Longhairs, there will be no breach of the loyalty we owe one another.
所以，你如果能劝得武成回心转意，不帮长毛，这就不算在江湖道上的义气有亏缺。

But how do you mean to persuade him?”
不过，我不晓得你要怎么劝他？

“That must depend on the circumstances.
““那自然见机行事。

At present I do not know myself what I shall say.”
此刻连我自己都还不晓得该怎么说？”

The next step was clear: someone must be sent to find Yu Wucheng.
谈到这里，就该马上做一件事，派人去把俞武成找来，

The Old Master did not know where he was, but the brotherhood’s connections were extensive.
老太爷不知道他此刻在何处？但漕帮的声气甚广，

Once word went out, every wharf, large and small, would hear within a day, and someone would find him.
只要交代一句下去，大小码头，旦夕皆知，自会找出人来，

Yu was no obscure figure, which made the search easier still.
而况俞武成亦非无名小卒，找起来更容易。

Only the distance was uncertain.
只是要看他是近是远，

If he was near, he would come quickly; if far away, more slowly.
在近处来得快，在远处来得慢，

No date could be fixed.
日子无法预定。

“I know you are anxious,” the Old Master said, “but haste will not help. We can settle it in the end.
“我晓得你心里急，不过急也无用，事情是总可以摆平的。”老太爷说，

We seldom have a chance to be together.
“难得相聚，

Stay a couple of days.”
且住两日再说。”

“Of course.
“当然，当然。”

I have delayed this long already.
胡雪岩说，“多的日子也耽搁下来了，

Another two days will make no difference.”
不争在这两天。”


Hu felt that way, and Qiu was still less concerned.
他是如此，裘丰言更不在乎，

这一夜照样开怀畅饮，听老太爷谈他当年走南闯北，涉历江湖所遭遇到的奇闻异事，直到深宵不倦。

谈来谈去谈到俞武成，

“Songjiang is an impoverished branch of the brotherhood, while his is a prosperous one.
“松江是‘疲帮’，他们那一帮是‘旺帮’，

Among our circle, Wucheng was the dandy.
所以武成在我们这伙人当中，是花花公子，

Women, gambling, fine food and clothes—he enjoyed them all and knew everything about them.”
嫖赌吃着，样样来，样样精。”

The old man sighed.
老太爷不胜感慨地说，

“Who could have imagined that after a lifetime of pleasure, he would suffer in old age?”
“哪晓得快活了一辈子，老来苦！”

“The Longhairs are to blame,” Hu said.
“这都是叫长毛害的。”胡雪岩说，

“Without their rebellion, he could have lived comfortably in Yangzhou and Zhenjiang.
“不闹长毛，他好好在杨州、镇江，

How would he have come to this?
何至于此？

That is why I cannot understand his dealings with them.”
所以俞老跟‘他们’搞在一起，我真弄不懂！”

“Be careful with such remarks when you meet him.
“老弟台，你见了武成，这些话要当心。

He has one bad fault: he will never admit he is wrong.
他有样坏毛病：不肯认错！

Leave him alone and there may be hope; tell him he is wrong and he goes still further down the wrong road.
不说还好，一说偏偏往错里走。

Only his mother can rebuke him, and then he dare not disobey.
除非他老娘说他，他不敢不听，

Anyone else, even the Lord of Heaven himself, could tell him he was wrong and he would refuse to accept it.”
不然，天王老子说他一句错，他都不服。”

“Then he must be a devoted son,” Qiu observed.
“这样看起来，倒是位孝子！”裘丰言说，

“Most admirable.”
“可敬之至。”

“That is why everyone respects him.
“大家敬重他，也就是为此。”

老太爷说，“他今年六十七，到了九十岁的老娘面前，还会撒娇。

想想也真有趣。”

“Oh!” Hu asked.
“喔！”胡雪岩问：

“His mother is still alive?”
“她娘还在？”

“Indeed.”
“还在！”

“在镇江？还是扬州？”

“Neither.
“不！

Who could live in those places now?
那两个地方怎么还能住？”

She has moved to Suzhou.
老太爷说，“搬在苏州。

Last year she passed through Songjiang on a pilgrimage to Hangzhou and stayed with me for a few days.”
去年到杭州烧香，路过松江，在我这里住了几日。”


“A lady of ninety, still traveling so far to offer incense?
“九十岁的老太太，还能出远门烧香。

She must be remarkably strong.”
倒健旺？”

“Very strong.
“健旺得很呢！”老太爷说，

In her day she was a formidable woman.
“这位老太太，当年也是好角色。

Third Uncle Yu—Wucheng’s father—was murdered by an enemy.
俞三叔——武成的老爹，是叫仇家害死的，

She took a fruit knife and went to the murderer’s door.
她带了一把水果刀找上仇家的门去，

As soon as she saw him, she stabbed him.
见面就是一刀！

Then she went straight to the magistrate’s office.
出来就到衙门，

The magistrate was a good man: he said she had avenged her husband and discharged her in court.
县官倒是好官，说她替夫报仇，当堂开释。

She was four months pregnant at the time.
那时她还有四月的身孕在身，

The child was Wucheng.”
生下来就是武成。”

“So Elder Yu was born after his father’s death.
“原来俞老是遗腹子！

No wonder he is so devoted to her.”
怪不得孝顺。”

“He would not dare be otherwise.
“他也不敢不孝顺。”

And it was thanks to this Third Aunt Yu of mine that he later took charge of the branch.
老太爷又说，“武成后来管帮，也亏得我这位俞三婶。

When Third Uncle died, he had no son.
当时俞三叔一死，还没有儿子，

The members agreed that his fifth brother should manage affairs in his place.
帮中公议，由他家老五代管。

If the unborn child proved a girl, there was nothing more to say.
遗腹子生下来，如果是女的，不必说，

If a boy, then when he reached twenty, Yu the Fifth was to yield his throne and surrender his realm.
是男的，到二十岁，俞老五‘推位让国’。

But the man proved black-hearted and refused to step aside when the time came.
哪晓得俞老五黑心，到时候不肯让出来。

Once again Third Aunt Yu intervened.
又是俞三婶出面，

She took the case to the Director-General of Grain Transport and won.
告到僧运总督那里，官司打赢，

Only then could Wucheng inherit his father’s position.”
武成才能够‘子承父业’。

“Then this old lady understands affairs outside the home very well?”
““照此说来，这位老太太对外头的事情，也很明白？”

“Of course.
“当然！

Exceptionally well.”
是极明白的人。”

“Does she also manage their branch’s business?”
“也管他们帮里的事吗？”

“She used to, though not much in recent years.
“早先管，这几年不大管了。”

In the old days she not only managed the branch but intervened in disputes throughout our world.
老太爷又说，“早先不但管他们帮里的事，还管江湖上的闲事，

The name of Widow Yu the Third commanded respect everywhere.”
提起俞三寡妇，真个是响当当的字号。”


During this conversation Hu had worked out an excellent plan.
就在这一番闲谈之中，胡雪岩已筹划好一条极妥当的计策，

To carry it out, however, he would need one person’s help, and must consult her before speaking to the Old Master.
不过欲行此计，少不得一个人，先要跟这个人商量好了，才好跟老太爷去谈。

That person was the Seventh Lady.
这个人就是七姑奶奶。

It was too late to disturb her when he returned to the You house.
回到尤家已经深夜，不便惊动。

Rising early the next morning, he washed hurriedly and summoned the boy attending him, asking him to go inside and tell her that he urgently needed to discuss something important.
第二天一早起身，匆匆漱洗，便唤过来伺候他的小厮，进去通知，立请七姑奶奶有要紧事商量。

Entirely unselfconscious, she invited both Hu and Qiu to her rooms.
七姑奶奶大方得很，说是请胡雪岩、裘丰言到她屋里去谈。

Qiu naturally hesitated to enter an unmarried lady’s quarters, especially with Furong there too.
“小姐”的闺房，又有芙蓉在，裘丰言自然不便入内。

“It is quite all right,” Hu said.
“不要紧！

“We really are intimate family friends.
我们真正是通家之好，

Come and listen, and save me having to repeat it afterwards.”
你一起去听听，省得回头我再说一遍。”

Qiu could only accompany him.
听得这话，裘丰言只好相陪。

A breakfast table had already been laid in the outer room.
到七姑奶奶住的那间屋子，堂屋里已经摆好了一桌早饭，

The people of Songjiang ate firm, cooked rice for breakfast, which he found novel.
松江人早餐吃硬饭，裘丰言颇感新奇，

There was wine as well as rice, putting him entirely in his element.
不但有饭还有酒，这在他倒是得其所哉，

He sat down gladly and took a great mouthful.
欣然落座，举杯便喝了一大口。

“Not too much, Qiu.
“老裘，你少喝点，

We have work to do today.”
今天还有事！”

“What work?” the Seventh Lady asked.
“什么事？”七姑奶奶接口说道，

“We have little else to offer him but wine.
“裘老爷来，没有啥款待，只有酒。

Little Uncle, do not spoil his pleasure.”
小爷叔，你不要拦他的高兴。

“He will be pleased enough once he hears what I have to say.
““老裘不会不高兴，我一说出来就晓得了。

Seventh Sister, do you know someone called Widow Yu the Third?”
七姐，我问你个人，你晓不晓得？”胡雪岩说，“俞三寡妇！”


“Do you mean Uncle Yu’s mother?”
“是不是俞师叔的老娘？”

“Yes.”
“对。”

“No one calls her Widow Yu the Third now.
“现在不叫俞三寡妇了，

Everyone calls her Third Granny.
大家都叫她三婆婆。

I have met her.
我见过的，

When she came to Songjiang last year, she wanted to take me as her sworn daughter.
去年到松江来，说要收我做干女儿，

Then we worked out the generations and found they did not fit, so nothing more was said.”
后来算算辈分不对，才不提起的。”

“Excellent!
“好极了！

Then she likes you.
照此说，她很喜欢你的。

Seventh Sister, you must come to Suzhou with me.”
七姐，你要陪我到苏州去一趟。”

At this Qiu understood.
说到这一句，裘丰言恍然大悟，

Delighted, he raised a large cup of spirits.
高兴地端起一大杯烧酒：

“Now I really must drink a full cup!”
“这下我非浮一大白不可了！”

The Seventh Lady and Furong were still bewildered, so Hu briefly explained Yu Wucheng’s designs on the rifles and the Old Master’s predicament.
七姑奶奶和芙蓉，却是莫名其妙，于是胡雪岩约略将俞武成打那票枪械的主意，以及老太爷如何为难的情形，略略谈了些。

Before he could go further, the Seventh Lady understood his purpose.
这些七姑奶奶不等他了再讲下去，也就明了他们的用意了。

“Little Uncle, you mean to bring out Third Granny and make her put pressure on Uncle Yu?”
“小爷叔，你是想搬出三婆婆来，硬压俞师叔？”

“That is the idea, but it must be done in a particular way.
“是的，意思是这个道理。不过有一套做法。”胡雪岩说，

My chief purpose is to spare the Old Master embarrassment.
“我动到这个脑筋，主要的是不让老太爷为难。

This is my plan.
我想这样做，

Tell me whether you think it will work.”
你看行不行？”

Hu proposed to prepare a handsome gift, then visit Third Granny Yu with Qiu, both in formal dress.
胡雪岩的做法是，备一笔重礼，跟裘丰言俩肃具衣冠，去拜访俞三婆婆，

They would explain that the Old Master had already given Yu his word and could not go back on it.
见面道明来意，要说老太爷因为已经答应了俞武成，不便出尔反尔。

With no other course open to them, they had come to ask her advice.
万般无奈，只有来求教俞三婆婆，

What ought they to do?
应该怎么办？

Would she tell them?
请她说一句。


“Everyone has a human heart.
“人心都是肉做的，

With Little Uncle showing her such respect, and me putting in a word beside her, Third Granny is sure to intervene.
小爷叔这样子尊敬她，我再旁边敲敲边鼓，三婆婆一定肯出面干预。

If she speaks, Uncle Yu dare not disobey.
只要她肯说一句，俞师叔不敢不依。

Certainly I shall go with you.
好的，我准定奉陪，

When do we leave?”
什么时候走？”

“First I must discuss it with the Old Master.
“ 我先要跟老太爷谈一谈。

Please get ready.
请你先预备，

We shall leave at a moment’s notice.”
我们说走就走。”

“There is nothing I need to prepare.
“我没有啥好预备的。”

But what about Third Granny’s present?
七姑奶奶说，“倒是送三婆婆的礼，

What have you in mind?”
小爷叔你是怎么个打算？”

Hu had already considered that.
这一层，胡雪岩自燃已有打算，

He assigned the task to Qiu, asking him to reach Shanghai that day and tell Liu Bucai to buy two roots of old wild mountain ginseng from Jilin, together with three other gifts suitable for an elderly person to eat or use.
分派裘丰言去办，请他当天赶到上海，转告刘不才，采办两支吉林老山人参，另外再配三样宜乎老年人服食使用的礼物，

Qiu would bring them to Suzhou.
由裘丰言带到苏州，

Once again, Jinchang Inn outside Chang Gate would serve as their meeting place and point of contact.
仍旧以阊门外的金阊客栈为联络聚集的地点。


Qiu accompanied Hu to the Old Master’s house.
于是，裘丰言跟着胡雪岩到了老太爷那里，

When they began to take their leave, the old man was greatly surprised and did not understand.
开口说到“辞行”，老太爷不解所谓，深为诧异。

“I have thought of a way to spare you embarrassment with Elder Yu,” Hu explained.
“我想到了一个办法，可以免得你老人家在俞老面前为难。”胡雪岩说。

“Qiu and I shall be like Jiao Zan and Meng Liang, going to enlist the help of Old Lady Yu.
“我跟老裘，好比焦赞、孟良，预备把余太君去搬请出来。

But you must play your part in our double act.”
不过你老要跟我们唱出双簧。”

The Old Master’s part was simple.
这出双簧，在老太爷这面轻而易举，

Once Yu arrived, he was to tell him that Hu and Qiu had come with an urgent request, but that he had refused because he had already given Yu his word.
只要找了俞武成来，当面跟他说明：胡、裘二人，上门重托，他因为答应俞武成在先，已经拒绝。

He must also say that Third Granny Yu had sent someone looking for him, leaving instructions that he return to Suzhou at once to discuss a matter of great urgency.
同时告诉他，说俞三婆婆派人来寻过，留下了话，叫他立即赶回苏州，有紧急大事要谈。

Having heard the plan, the old man bowed deeply.
听胡雪岩讲完，老太爷兜头一揖：

“My young friend, this scheme will be a tremendous help.
“老弟台，你这条计策，帮了我的大忙，

You have preserved the friendship between two old, white-haired brothers.
保全了我们白头老弟兄的交情，

I am deeply grateful.
感激之至。

But though Old Lady Yu can bring him to heel, we must consider his difficulties too.
不过虽拿余太君把他压了下去，他的难处也要替他想想，

Leave that to me.
这归我来办。

You need not trouble yourselves.”
你们不必管了。”

“There is no reason to burden you with that either.
“这也没有叫老太爷劳神的道理。”

To be frank, there is a commission on the foreign rifles.
胡雪岩说，“老实奉告，洋枪上是有一笔回扣的，

We shall use it to make a friend of Elder Yu.
我们就拿这笔钱交俞老一个朋友，

When I meet him in Suzhou, I shall speak to him myself.
在苏州见着了他，我当面跟他谈，

I am sure we can settle it.
一定可以摆平。

You need only pretend to know nothing.”
反正你老只要假装糊涂好了。”

“That I can do.
“装糊涂我会。”

When do you leave?”
老太爷问道：“你们啥时候动身？”

“We must make the pretence convincing.
“装就要装得象。

We leave tomorrow and shall not call on you again before then.
我们明天就走，回头也不再到你老这里来了。

It would be awkward if we happened to meet Elder Yu.”
怕一见俞老，反而不好。”

“In that case I shall not keep you.
“既然这样说，我就不留你们了。

But once everything is settled in Suzhou, you must return to Songjiang and stay a couple of days.”
不过，在苏州把事情说妥当了，无论如何再要到松江来往两天。”

“Certainly!”
“一定，一定！”


They took their leave, and Qiu set out for Shanghai immediately.
两人辞了出来，裘丰言当即动身到上海。

Hu reflected that an unforeseen turn of events was taking him to Suzhou yet again.
胡雪岩心里在想，意料不到的，又有苏州之行。

Since he had the opportunity, he ought to untangle the affair with A’qiao.
既然有此机会，阿巧姐的纠葛，应该理个清楚，

Fortunately, Furong was with him and could serve very well as a shield.
巧的是有芙蓉，大可以拿她作个挡箭牌。

Back at the You house, he asked, “Would you like to visit Suzhou?”
因此，回到尤家，他问芙蓉：“你要不要到苏州去玩一趟？”

“I cannot be bothered to move.
“我懒得动，

Besides, you will be back in two or three days, and Fifth Sister-in-Law and I get on very well.
而况你们两三天就回来了，尤五嫂跟我也很谈得来，

I might as well stay where I am.”
我就一动不如一静了。”

Their hostess also urged her to remain.
做女主人的，也在殷勤留客，

Unable to explain in Mrs You’s presence, Hu could only give the Seventh Lady a meaningful glance.
胡雪岩当着尤五嫂的面，不便多说什么，只好向七姑奶奶使个眼色。

Its meaning was not easy to grasp, and she spoke with her usual directness.
这个眼色用意，不易了解，七姑奶奶心直，当时就说：

“Little Uncle, say whatever you want.
“小爷叔，你有话尽管说，

What are you afraid of?”
怕啥？”

Helpless, he could only reply, “Seventh Sister, come here a moment.
“七姐！”胡雪岩无可奈何，只好这样说：“你请过来，

I have something to tell you.” Once he explained, she understood.
我有句话说。”一说自然明白，

If Furong went with him and A’qiao saw her, the latter could scarcely say anything.
七姑奶奶也认为芙蓉跟着到了苏州，阿巧姐一见，当然什么话都说不出口，

It was an excellent shield.
这是个极好的挡箭牌。

She quietly persuaded Mrs You not to insist on keeping her guest.
于是悄悄劝尤五嫂，不必强留。

Furong too changed her mind when she heard the reason and agreed to accompany the Seventh Lady to Suzhou.
至于芙蓉，听说有此关系，随即也改了主意，愿意跟七姑奶奶作伴到苏州。

They packed that night and boarded their boat early the next morning.
于是连夜收拾行李，第二天一早下船，

There were four in the party: Hu, the two women, and a young man named A’tu.
一行四众，胡雪岩和两位堂客之外，另外带了个后生，名叫阿土，

He had once been sent to Suzhou by You with birthday presents for Third Granny Yu, so they took him as their guide.
他曾奉了尤五的命令，到苏州去送过俞三婆婆的寿礼，所以带着他做“向导”。


Suzhou proved a lively gathering place.
到了苏州可热闹了，

At Jinchang Inn they found Zhou Yiming, who had been staying there all along, Qiu, who had arrived afterwards, and Liu Bucai, who had come along to join in the excitement.
在金阊栈的，有原来住在那里的周一鸣，随后来的裘丰言，还有跟了来“轧闹猛”的刘不才，

They occupied two courtyards, but everyone assembled in Hu’s rooms to receive his instructions.
分住了两座院落，却都集中在胡雪岩那里，听他发号施令。

“Seventh Sister, you and A’tu will go first.
“七姐！你带着阿土是第一拨，

Give Third Granny our regards and tell her that we wish to call.
见着三婆婆，先替我们问好，再说要去拜访她。

If she asks why we did not come with you, say we feared she might think us presumptuous and decline to see us.
如果她问：为什么不跟着你去？你就说怕她嫌我们冒昧不见。

Then ask whether we may visit early tomorrow.
然后问她，明天一早去见她，行不行？

If she agrees, send A’tu back to tell us.”
她若是允了，你就派阿土回来通知。”

“I understand.
“我晓得了。

But she is certain to ask why you want to see her.
小爷叔，”七姑奶奶问道，“三婆婆一定会问，为啥要去看她，

我怎么说？”

“Only that we have been unable to find Elder Yu, so we must come to her.
“你只说我们寻俞老寻不着，只好来见三婆婆，

她若问起寻俞老又是何事？你只说不晓得，不过决无恶意。”

“Very well.”
“好的，我懂了。”

She set off with A’tu at once.
七姑奶奶说完，立刻带着阿土离去。

“Zhou, go to Guanqian immediately and get me a full set of seventh-rank official dress, from head to foot.”
“老周！你即刻上观前去一趟，替我办一身七品服色！从上到下，全套都要。

“Oh dear!” Qiu exclaimed.
““啊呀！”裘丰言说，

“I have not brought my formal robes either.”
“我也没有带袍褂来。”

“Easily settled.
“那容易，

Get two sets.”
一共办两身。”

As soon as Zhou left, Hu turned to Liu.
等周一鸣一起，胡雪岩对刘不才说，

“Third Master, now for your assignment.
“三爷，如今是你的差使了！

你身上多带些钱，进城到花家柳巷去走走，挑个最好的地方‘开盘子’，

You must make an impression as a wealthy customer.”
要做阔客！”


“There you go!”
“你倒好！”

Furong complained at once.
芙蓉先就埋怨了，

“No sooner have we arrived than you set Third Uncle to no good.”
“一到就不叫三叔干好事。”

“Never mind whether it is good or bad,” Liu said.
“好事坏事，不去说它！”刘不才问道，

“Tell me what it is for, so I know what I am doing.”
“这是为了啥？你说了，我心里好有个数。”

“We shall need to entertain a guest in a few days.
“是为了过几天好请客。”

I hear Yu Wucheng is an old hand at pleasure: women, gambling, fine food and clothes—he knows every one of them thoroughly.
胡雪岩说：“听说俞武成是个‘老白相’，嫖赌吃着，式式精通，

等他一来，我就把他交给你了！”

“Then I came at just the right time!
“这一说，倒是我来对了！

Do not worry.
你放心，你放心，

I shall look after him when he comes.
等他一来，归我招呼，

包管他服服帖帖！”

Liu went off delighted.
说完，刘不才高高兴兴地走了。

His forces deployed, Hu turned with a smile to Furong and Qiu.
调兵遣将已毕，胡雪岩笑着对芙蓉和裘丰言说：

“今天没有事了，

Where shall we go for a look round?”
我们到哪里去逛逛？”

“Never mind that,” Qiu said.
“算了，算了！”裘丰言说，

“There will be time enough once the business is settled.”
“等事情办妥了，再去逛也不迟。”

“Why, you never worry even if the sky falls.

这回怎么放不下心来？”

“Different times call for different responses.
“彼一时也，此一时也！”裘丰言说，

I have thought this through from beginning to end.
“这件事，我通前彻后想过了，

It is not simply a matter of brotherhood affairs.
不全是江湖道上的事，

The Longhairs are involved.
有长毛夹在里头，

只怕俞老身不由己！”

Hu sprang up in alarm.
这一说，胡雪岩矍然而起，

“You are right.
“你的话对，

We must guard against that.”
不可不妨！”

He considered, then added, “There is no time to lose.
他想了想又说，“事不宜迟，

We must write to Songjiang at once.
赶快给松江写封信回去。

Qiu, you must write the letter.”
老裘，你来动笔！”


This was plainly Qiu’s responsibility.
这是裘丰言责无旁贷的事，

He brought out the writing materials himself and asked what the letter should say.
一面亲自搬出文房四宝来，一面问胡雪岩，这封信如何写法？

They asked the Old Master, once Yu reached Songjiang, to discover exactly what arrangement he had made with Lai Hanying and how the interception was originally to be carried out.
信中拜托老太爷，等俞武成到了松江，务必设法探明跟赖汉英那方面订下了怎样的约定，原来的计划是如何动手？

Most important of all, was Yu himself under Lai’s control or coercion, unable to act freely?
还有最要紧的一层，俞武成是不是自己在赖汉英的挟制胁迫之下，有身不由主的模样？

Just as they finished, A’tu returned to the inn, breathless from running.
刚把信写完，阿土已经回到客栈，跑得气喘吁吁地说：

他是个‘总爷’。”

The Green Standard forces had junior ranks called qianzong and bazong, and civilians accordingly addressed even ordinary soldiers as “Captain.”
绿营武官中有‘千总“、”把总“的名目，是低级武官，所以老百姓见了绿营兵丁，都尊称一声”总爷“。

Hu attached little importance to the title.
胡雪岩觉得这不值得重视，

What pleased him was Third Granny’s courtesy: it plainly meant she was willing to receive them.
倒是三婆婆有此礼遇的表示，自然是肯接见了，值得高兴。

“Good.
“好的，

I understand.”
我知道了。”

On reflection, A’tu was no longer needed in Suzhou and could carry the letter back.
他想了一想，认为阿土在苏州已无用处，正好派他回去送信，

“A’tu, please return to Songjiang at once and deliver this to the Old Master.
