你跟老太爷说，信中所谈的事，一有结果，立刻给我回信。

I must trouble you to make another journey.” He then called Furong and had her give A’tu ten taels for his traveling expenses.
就劳驾你再辛苦一趟。”说着，又喊芙蓉，取出十两银子送他做盘缠。


Just then an attendant brought in a military officer, followed by four mounted orderlies.
就这时，只见金阊栈的伙计引进一名武官来，后面还跟着四名马弁。

His bearing suggested more than a mere “Captain.” Sharp-eyed Hu quickly told Qiu, “He has a crystal button on his cap.”
一看这气派，不象“总爷”、胡雪岩眼尖，赶紧向裘丰言说道：“是个水晶顶子。”

That denoted fifth rank.
顶戴用水晶，是五品官员，

“Ah, a garrison commander!” Qiu exclaimed.
裘丰言失声说道：“啊！是守备。

“This is awkward.
糟了，

Receiving him in ordinary dress seems discourteous.”
便衣接见，似乎失礼。”

It was too late to remedy the omission.
失礼也无可补救了，

Holding the visiting card high, the attendant announced in a drawn-out voice, “Master Yu calls!”
只见伙计已经高举名帖，拉长了声音唱道：“俞老爷拜！”

More familiar with official ceremony, Qiu tugged at Hu, lifted the curtain, and walked out with measured steps to receive their visitor in the outer room.
裘丰言比较熟于官场仪注，拉一拉胡雪岩，掀开门帘，踱着方步，迎到外屋，

Master Yu and his orderlies were standing beyond the doorway.
只见“俞老爷”带着马弁站在门外，

Qiu averted his gaze and took the card from the attendant.
便闪开了视线，从伙计手里接过名帖来看，

It read, “Your junior, Yu Shaowu, bows his head in greeting.”
上面写的是：“侍晚俞少武顿首拜。”

Clearly this was Yu Wucheng’s son.
不用说，是俞武成的儿子。

“We are unworthy of the honour!
“不敢当，不敢当！

Please ask Master Yu to wait.
请你替我们挡俞老爷的驾，

Traveling away from home, we have brought no official dress and dare not receive him with such disrespect.”
身在客边，未带公服，不敢亵慢！”

Before the attendant could answer, Yu stepped in.
伙计还未接话，俞少武已经跨了进来，

With a sweep of his hands he lowered his horseshoe-shaped cuffs and made the formal kneeling salutation.
两手一挥，将马蹄袖放了下来，接着便请了个安。

Military ranks might count for little, but they still felt unworthy of receiving such respect.
虽说武职官儿品级不值钱，到底受之有愧，

Both Hu and Qiu were considerably embarrassed.
所以胡雪岩和裘丰言都觉得相当尴尬。


Fortunately, Yu appealed to old family ties rather than official rank.
幸好，俞少武不叙官阶叙世谊，

Rising, he addressed them as “my honoured uncles.”
站起来口称：“两位老世叔！”他说，

“My grandmother has specifically sent me to pay her respects.
“家祖母特意命少武来请安。

She feels she cannot presume to trouble you to visit her.
家祖母的意思，不敢劳动两位老世叔光降，

If you have any instructions, please give them to me.”
有什么吩咐，告诉少武就是了。”

“Certainly, certainly!” Qiu replied with clasped hands.
“是，是！”裘丰言拱手答道：

“My young friend, please sit and let us talk.
“世兄，诸先坐了叙说。

My surname is Qiu.
敝姓裘，

This is Brother Xueyan.”
这位是雪岩兄！”

They exchanged fresh courtesies and sat down.
彼此重薪又见了礼，坐定攀谈，

Qiu made the customary official inquiries about Yu’s qualifications.
裘丰言有一番官场中请教“功名”的话头，

He learned that Yu had passed the highest military examination, been appointed a garrison commander, and been assigned to the Governor-General of Liangjiang’s headquarters forces.
这才知道，俞少武是一名武进士，授职守备，派在两江“督标”当差。

The commander of those forces knew that he came from the Grain Transport Brotherhood.
督标中军知道他是漕帮子弟，

Impressed by his fine appearance and ready speech, he had specially recommended him to the governor-general, who wrote to the Board of War and secured his appointment as capital dispatch officer.
又见他仪容出众，言语灵便，特为报请总督，行文兵部，将他补了一名“提塘官”，

Stationed in Beijing, he handled the submission of memorials from the Liangjiang governor-general’s office.
专驻京城，接理两江总督衙门的奏折呈递事宜。

He had recently taken leave to visit his family and would remain for another month or so.
最近是请假回籍省亲，还有个把月的勾留。

“So you earned your rank through the examinations!
“原来世兄是科甲出身！

I have failed to show you proper respect.”
真正失敬之至。”

Qiu raised a thumb.
裘丰言翘一翘大拇指，

“Heroes arise among the young, and these are times for heroes.
“英雄出少年。如今亦正是英雄的时势，

Your prospects are splendid.
前程如锦，

My congratulations!”
可喜可贺。”


When the courtesies were over, Yu repeated the purpose of his visit and asked what they required.
等到寒暄告一段落，俞少武重申来意，请示有何吩咐！

Now that they had reached the real business, Qiu gave Hu a glance, leaving him to answer.
这是谈到了正经上头，裘丰言使个眼色，让胡雪岩回答。

“There is something on which we need your father’s advice.
“有件事，要请教令尊。

Since his movements are uncertain, we have come to ask Third Granny.
只为令尊行踪不定，特意来求三婆婆。”

We cannot properly begin without first paying our respects.
胡雪岩说：“未尽道理，不便启齿，

Please tell your grandmother that Qiu and I will certainly call early tomorrow.
我想烦世兄回去禀告令诅母，我跟裘兄准定明天一早，登堂拜谒，

We beg her to allow us, her juniors, an opportunity to put our case.”
务必请三婆婆容我们晚辈，有个申诉的机会。”

“You do us too much honour.”
“实在不敢当。”

Yu rose.
俞少武站起身来答道：

“My grandmother says that even here in Suzhou she is living under another’s roof.
“家祖母说，现在住在苏州，亦是寄人篱下，

She fears she cannot receive you adequately and would not trouble you to come.
只怕接待简慢，不敢劳驾，

Please give me your instructions now.”
有话还是请这时候吩咐。”

“That is her consideration for us.
“这是三婆婆体恤我们晚辈，

As juniors, however, we must know how to honour age and virtue.
做晚辈的自己要知道敬老尊贤。”

Brother You of Songjiang and I are as close as brothers by birth.
胡雪岩又说，“我跟松江尤五哥如同亲弟兄一样，

He does not regard me as a man outside the brotherhood’s doors.
他不当我‘门槛’外头的人看待，

We are virtually one family.
说起来等于一家人，

How could we fail to pay Third Granny our respects?
我们岂有不去给三婆婆请安的道理？

Let that be settled: we shall call early tomorrow.
准定这样，明天一早到府上。

Though we have a matter to put before her, we certainly shall not cause her anxiety or put her in a difficult position.
虽有话要申诉，决不会让老人家操心为难，

Please be assured of that.”
请放心！”

Hearing this, Yu could only reply, “Then we shall respectfully await you both tomorrow morning.”
俞少武听得这样说，只好答道：“那就明天上午，恭候两位老世叔的大驾！”

He made his salutation and took his leave.
说完，请安告辞。

Hu and Qiu escorted him to the inn’s main entrance and gave gratuities to the four orderlies.
胡雪岩和裘丰言送出客栈大门，又开发了四名马弁的赏钱，

Watching him ride away, they began talking at the doorway.
眼看客人骑马走了，两个人在门口就谈了起来。


“I never imagined Yu Wucheng had such an excellent son,” Hu said admiringly.
“想不到俞武成有这样一个好儿子！”胡雪岩赞叹着说，

“With a mother like that to shelter him as well, I truly envy his good fortune.”
“上头又有那么一位老娘替他遮风雨，我倒着实羡慕他的福气。”

“Never mind that.”
“闲话少说。”

Familiar with official conventions, Qiu reminded him, “When we visit Third Granny tomorrow, we must observe particularly solemn courtesies.
裘丰言熟于官场的种种，提醒胡雪岩说：“明天去见三婆婆，着实该有一番重的礼节，

In my view she must be a lady holding an imperial honorary title.”
照我看，三婆婆必是一位则封的命妇。”

This reminded Hu of something.
“喔！”胡雪岩倒想起来了，

Ever since purchasing his rank, he had wanted to obtain honorary titles for his parents, a filial act that would bring distinction to the family.
从他捐了官以后，一直就想替父母请个封典，也算是荣宗耀祖的一番孝心，

Qiu’s words therefore interested him greatly.
所以听裘丰言提到此事，特感兴趣，

“I have been meaning to ask you about that.
“老裘，我正要请教你，

How does one apply for such honours?”
这封典是怎么请法？”

“Let us go inside and discuss it.”
“到里头去谈。”

Once indoors, they put aside the Yu family’s affairs while Qiu explained.
回到里面，丢下俞家的事，裘丰言细讲封典，

Under the Collected Statutes, civil and military officials of the third rank and above could obtain titles for three generations: their wives, parents, and grandparents.
照《会典》规定，文武官员三品以上封三代，妻子，父母，祖父母，

Those of the seventh through fourth ranks could obtain them for two generations, their wives and parents; those of the eighth and ninth ranks only for their wives.
七品到四品封两代，妻子、父母，八、九品只封妻子，

Officials outside the graded ranks could obtain none.
未入流就谈不到封典了。

A son wishing to honour his elders could surrender the title intended for his wife and request its transfer to an earlier generation.
人子为尽孝心，将妻子的封典让出来，让求改封上人，叫做“败封”，

Thus officials of the third rank and above could seek titles for their great-grandparents, and those of the seventh through fourth for their grandparents.
所以三品以上的官员，可以请求败纣曾祖父母，七品到四品，可以请求败封祖父母。

In the Yu family’s case, Shaowu must surely have obtained such a title for Third Granny.
以俞家的情形来说，俞少武一定替三婆婆请了封典。


“Such honours are distinctions conferred by the court.
“封典亦是朝廷的名器，

In the old days they were granted very carefully.
从前很慎重的，

Since the war began, they too have become indiscriminate.
军兴以来也滥了，

Like official rank, honorary titles may now be purchased.”
跟捐官一样，封典亦可以捐的。”

“Oh?”
“喔，”

Hu grew still more interested.
胡雪岩更感兴趣，

“How?”
“怎么捐法？”

“An untitled commoner cannot buy one.
“白丁是不可以捐的，

Once you have an official position, however, you may purchase additional rank.”
有了官职，可以加捐品级。”

“Good!
“那好！

What would it cost to obtain ‘Lady of the First Rank’?” Qiu laughed.
捐个‘一品夫人’什么价钱？”裘丰言笑了，

“That cannot be bought.
“一品夫人是捐不来的，

There are limits to the additional rank you may purchase.
捐加品级，也有个限制，

Shaowu, for instance, is of the fifth rank.
象俞少武是五品，

He could buy his grandmother the third-rank title of Shuren, Lady of Virtue.”
可以替他祖母捐个‘三品淑人’。”

After a pause he added, “When we visit tomorrow, we shall have to wear official dress and kowtow.
他略停一下又说：“明天我们去见她，势必至于要穿公服，也势必至于要磕头。

The ritual manuals do not specifically prescribe it, but by analogy with the courtesies a subordinate owes a superior, that is what we ought to do.”
这虽是礼书所不载，但比照下属见上官的礼节，应该如此！”

“Not only that,” Hu replied.
“不但要行大札，”胡雪岩说：

“People in the brotherhood care greatly about face.
“江湖上的人，最讲究面子，

I should like to honour the old lady still further.
我还想捧一捧这位老太太。

Suppose we borrowed a ceremonial escort and made a splendid procession to her house.
譬如说我们借一副‘导子’摆了去，让她家热闹，

Would that do?”
你看行不行？”

“There is no reason why not, though it might be considered vulgar.
“这也没有什么不行，不过嫌俗气而已。

If you do not mind people laughing behind your back, I can borrow one.”
只要你不在乎人家背后笑你，我就可以借得到。”

“Whose?”
“借哪个的？”

“The county magistrate’s, of course.
“当然是借县官的。

I know Magistrate Sun of Wu County.
吴县孙大令，跟我相熟，

He will certainly lend me his escort.
要借他的导子一定借得到。

But if we arrive with gongs beating and men clearing the way, and her house is too small or the lane too narrow, we may block everything and embarrass our hosts.
不过巡锣喝道而去，如果她家地方太小，或者巷子太狭，塞得实实足足，害做主人的不自在，

That would defeat the purpose.”
那反倒不好了。

“True.
““这话也是，

Let us wait until Zhou returns.”
等老周回来了再说。”


Zhou had not yet returned when the Seventh Lady came back from the Yu house.
周一鸣还没有来，七姑奶奶却从俞家折回，

Third Granny had sent her specially to invite Furong.
她是奉了俞三婆婆之命，特意来接芙蓉去相会的。

She told Hu that the old lady had at first been suspicious.
据她告诉胡雪岩，说俞三婆婆起先有所疑忌，

She had thought her son might have become entangled with the Zhejiang authorities, who had sent two officers to investigate.
当是她儿子跟浙江官面上有什么纠葛，特意派两名“差官”来“办案”。

Only after Shaowu returned and reported Hu’s assurance that they would cause her no anxiety or embarrassment did she understand that they meant no harm.
后来俞少武回去一说，提到胡雪岩的声明，决不让她“操心为难”，才知他们此来，并无恶意。

“When I mentioned Aunt Furong,” the Seventh Lady said, “Third Granny told me, ‘Since these two gentlemen have come expressly about Wucheng, they are honoured guests of our family.
“三婆婆听我提到芙蓉阿姨，她说：”照规矩，他们两位既然特为武成而来，就是我家的贵客，

We ought to act as proper hosts.
该尽地主的道理。

But I am a woman and cannot conveniently receive them myself, while Shaowu belongs to the younger generation.
不过我是女流，不便出面，少武又是晚辈。

We must do this instead: invite Mr Hu’s lady first.
只好这样了，把胡家姨太大先请了来，

That will at least express our wish to entertain them.’
也算是个做东道的意思‘。

Little Uncle, I think she means it most sincerely.
小爷叔，我看三婆婆的意思很诚恳，

Let Aunt Furong go.” Hu readily agreed.
就让芙蓉阿姨去走一趟好了。“胡雪岩欣然许诺：

“We must accept such kindness.”
“三婆婆的盛意，不可不领。

Turning to Furong, he said, “Go with Seventh Sister for a visit, and take our gifts along.”
这样，”他转脸对芙蓉说：“你就跟七姐去玩一趟，顺便先把我们的礼带了去。”

Furong hesitated.
芙蓉有些踌躇，

She was poor at social dealings, and hearing what a formidable figure the old lady had once been filled her with an unfamiliar dread.
她拙于交际应酬，又听说俞三婆婆早年是那样一个“狠角色”，心里有种异样的畏惮。

The Seventh Lady saw this and encouraged her.
七姑奶奶看出她的心思，便即鼓励她说：

“Never mind.
“不要紧！

I shall take care of everything.”
一切有我。”

“Exactly!”
“对了！”

Hu understood too.
胡雪岩也明白她的心境：

“With Seventh Sister protecting you, what is there to fear?”
“有七姐保你的驾，你怕什么？”

“Very well.”
“也好！”

Furong finally nodded.
芙蓉终于点点头，

“I simply shall not leave her side.”
“我总归寸步不离七姑奶奶就是了。”

“Look at her!” The Seventh Lady laughed.
“你看！”七姑奶奶笑道，

“Our Aunt Furong is so honest and timid that one cannot help feeling for her.
“我们这位芙蓉阿姨，真正忠厚得可怜。

Enough talk.
闲话少说，

Change your clothes, and we shall go.”
你快换衣裳，我们就走。”


While Furong was changing, Hu explained their plans for the next day to the Seventh Lady.
趁芙蓉更衣的片刻，胡雪岩把他们第二天的部署，告诉了七姑奶奶。

Such displays of ceremony required someone to direct the courtesies, drawing the threads together so that two parties who had never met could respond to one another in perfect accord.
凡是这种摆虚场面的事，从中必要有个“赞礼”的人，穿针引线，素昧平生的双方，礼尚往来，才会若合符节。

With her quick and perceptive mind, she understood immediately.
七姑奶奶是玲珑七窍心，当然心领神会，

She readily promised that neither hosts nor guests would suffer an awkward moment over etiquette, and that everyone would be delighted.
一口应承，包管主客双方，不但不至于会在礼节上出现僵窘，而且皆大欢喜。

After Furong left, Yu sent orderlies with a banquet of bird’s-nest dishes.
等芙蓉一走，俞少武又派马弁送了一桌燕菜席来。

Halfway through the meal, a messenger arrived to say that Third Granny was keeping both women overnight.
吃到一半，又有人来通知，说七姑奶奶和芙蓉，这天都让俞三婆婆留着，住在俞家了。

These signs of mutual goodwill suggested that once they met the old lady, every difficulty would be readily resolved.
这种种情谊相孚的迹象，都显示着明天见了俞三婆婆，一切难题都可迎刃而解。

They needed only a prompt reply from A’tu confirming that Yu Wucheng was not under Lai Hanying’s coercion, and success would be almost assured.
现在只望阿土能赶快送个信来，说俞武成不会受到赖汉英那方面的挟制，大功便近乎合成了！

Rising early the next morning, Hu and Qiu washed and dressed, each putting on a brand-new robe and riding jacket.
第二天一早起身，漱洗装扮，胡雪岩和裘丰言一个人一身簇新的袍褂，

Zhou acted as their attendant, carrying the visiting-card box.
由周一鸣当跟班，捧着拜匣，

One of Qiu’s servants followed the sedan chairs with a bundle of clothes and a strip of red felt.
另外裘丰言的一名听差，挟着衣包和红毡条，跟在轿子后头，

They went straight into the city to the Yu house in Tieping Lane.
一直进城，直奔铁瓶巷俞家。

Having learned the outline of their intentions from the Seventh Lady, the household was ready.
俞家从七姑奶奶那里得知梗概，也早有准备，

The main gates stood wide open, and Shaowu waited outside.
大门洞开，俞少武候在门口，

When the chairs arrived, he ordered the bearers to carry them in as far as the eaves before the main hall.
等轿子一到，命轿夫抬了进去，到大厅滴水檐前下轿。

After they had exchanged bows and greetings, Hu said, “Please ask the old lady to come out, so that we may pay our respects.”
彼此作揖招呼过后，胡雪岩便说：“把老人家请出来吧！我们好行礼。”


“We really are unworthy of such an honour.”
“实在不敢当！”

Bowing with his hands lowered, Shaowu replied, “My grandmother asks you both to change into ordinary clothes and take tea in the rear hall.”
俞少武垂手弯腰答道：“家祖母有话，请两位老世叔换了便衣，到后厅待茶。”

“The proper courtesies cannot be omitted,” Qiu said.
“礼不可失！”裘丰言说道：

“On a first visit, we must make our formal obeisance in the main hall.” After repeated polite refusals, Shaowu said, “Obedience is the best way to show respect,” and withdrew behind the marble screen.
“初次拜谒，一定要‘堂参’的！”谦辞再三，俞少武说了句：“恭敬不如从命！”便转到大理石屏风后面去了。

Zhou and Qiu’s servant moved an armchair into the place of honour, spread the red felt before it, and waited quietly.
于是周一鸣和裘丰言的听差，一起动手，移一张太师椅正中摆好，椅前铺下红毡条，静等俞三婆婆出临。

Soon footsteps could be heard, and skirts and robes came into view.
不久，听得脚步隐隐，望见去裙衫绰约，

The Seventh Lady herself was supporting Third Granny as she walked shakily out.
是七姑奶奶亲自搀着俞三婆婆，颤巍巍地走了出来。

Hu and Qiu rose together and stood side by side below the place of honour.
胡、裘二人，一齐站起，在下首并立。

Hu looked closely at her face and could not conceal his surprise.
胡雪岩定睛凝视，一见了俞三婆婆的面，不免诧异，

Knowing her reputation for heroic deeds, he had imagined a tall, sturdy woman of the sort found in Shandong.
在他的想象中，俞三婆婆早年既有‘英雄’的名声，想来必是象山东妇女的那种刚健高大的体魄，

Instead she was tiny.
谁知她生得又矮又小，

Nothing seemed to show beneath her pleated red skirt; he supposed her feet must be bound into three-inch golden lotuses.
而且百褶红裙下，浑如无物，料想必是一双三寸金莲。

How could so frail a woman have commanded the fearful respect of countless bold men?
这样纤弱的一个妇人，怎能叫无数江湖好汉畏服？

One truly could not judge by appearances.
真正是人不可貌相了。

Her face, however, revealed something extraordinary.
然而看到脸上，才知道她果有不凡之处。

It was wrinkled like orange peel, and her mouth had sunk inward as though all her teeth were gone.
那张脸皱得象橘皮一样，口中牙齿大概掉完了，瘪得很厉害，

Yet her eyes remained quick and lively.
但是一双眼睛，依然十分灵活，顾盼有神，

Looking towards her guests, she turned to the Seventh Lady.
视线转到客人身上，她侧脸问七姑奶奶：

“Which is your Little Uncle?”
“哪位是你的小爷叔？”

“The taller gentleman.”
“个子高的那位。”

Hu stepped forward.
胡雪岩便踏上一上，

“I am Hu Xueyan.
“我是胡雪岩！”

I have come expressly to pay Third Granny my respects.”
他说，“特地来给三婆婆请安。”

“Oh, you overwhelm me!
“哎呀！这话折煞我了。

Mr Hu, you must not speak like that.”
胡老爷你千万不要这样说。”


“Third Granny,” the Seventh Lady said, “Little Uncle belongs to the same generation as Uncle Yu.
“三婆婆！”七姑奶奶说，“小爷叔跟师叔一辈，

Please sit, so that he and Mr Qiu may make their bows.”
你请坐下来，好让小爷叔跟裘老爷行礼。”

“And Mr Qiu too!
“喔，还有裘老爷，

I am still less deserving of the honour.”
更不敢当了！”

After much mutual deference, Third Granny would only stand beside the chair while the two gentlemen kowtowed.
谦之又谦，让之又让，俞三婆婆只肯站在椅子旁边，受了两位“大老爷”的头，

Her grandson returned their bows by kowtowing in turn.
由他的孙子，磕头还礼。

“My honoured uncles, please change into ordinary dress and come through to the rear.”
“两位老世叔，请换了便衣，后面坐吧！”

Supported once more by the Seventh Lady, Third Granny went in ahead of them.
于是俞三婆婆仍旧由七姑奶奶搀着，先回了进去，

Hu and Qiu changed out of their robes and riding jackets, and Shaowu escorted them to the second hall.
胡雪岩和裘丰言换去袍褂，在俞少武陪同之下，接到二厅款待，

The reception was splendidly arranged: eight dishes of fresh and dried fruit and covered tea bowls on silver stands.
八个干湿果盘，银托了的盖碗茶，排场相当讲究。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十七章（中）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Seven, Part Two
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“Really, this is more than I deserve!
“真正不敢当！

Such elaborate courtesies from you, Mr Hu and Mr Qiu, and such valuable gifts as well!
胡老爷、裘老爷这么隆重的礼数，又赏了那么贵重的东西，

You leave an old woman quite at a loss for words.”
叫我老婆子真不知道怎么说才好。”

Third Granny Yu turned to the Seventh Lady.
俞三婆婆说到这里，又转脸对七姑奶奶说，

“My hearing is poor.
“我的耳朵不好，

If these gentlemen have any instructions for us, listen carefully on my behalf.”
回头两位有什么吩咐，你替我仔细听着！”

This revealed what a formidable woman she was.
这就显得俞三婆婆是个角色了！

Her hearing and sight were perfectly clear, yet she deliberately said this to leave herself a way out: if Hu Xueyan asked for something she could not provide, she could pretend not to have heard or understood, and still have room to manoeuvre.
她明朗耳聪目明，却偏这样子交代，为的是留下一个退步，等胡雪岩有所干求而无法办到时，便好装聋作哑，得有闪转腾挪的余地。

Hu therefore took even greater care.
因为如此，胡雪岩越发不敢大意，

He explained his purpose briefly and plainly.
要盲不烦地叙明来意，

On the one hand, he wished to spare the Songjiang grain-transport brotherhood any embarrassment, thus relieving the Old Master of his predicament; on the other, he was reluctant to request a military escort, for fear of a clash with Yu Wucheng that would damage their bonds of loyalty.
一方面表示不愿使松江漕帮为难，开脱了老太爷的窘境，一方面又表示不愿请兵护运，怕跟俞武成发生冲突，伤了江湖的义气。

His words were a needle wrapped in cotton: soft on the surface, but with a sharp point within.
这番话真如俗语所说“ 绵里针”，表面极软，骨子里大有讲究。

Third Granny Yu knew the world and its ways.
俞三婆婆到底老于江湖，熟悉世面，

When Hu spoke of his reluctance to request a military escort, she was secretly alarmed.
听胡雪岩说到“不愿请兵护运”这句话，暗地里着实吃惊。

His words amounted to an accusation that Yu Wucheng intended to seize military arms, a crime more serious than ordinary robbery.
话中等于指责俞武成抢劫军械，这是比强盗还重的罪名，

If pursued in earnest, it could destroy his entire household.
认起真来，灭门有余。


“Mr Hu!
“胡老爷，

Mr Qiu!”
裘老爷！”

Third Granny Yu put on a show of furious indignation.
俞三婆婆装出气得不得了的样子，

“That son of mine has no respect for law or heaven!
“我这个儿子，真正无法无天！

Over sixty years old, and still he has less sense than his own son.
活到六十多，实在还不及我这个孙子懂事。

For my sake, gentlemen, please do not be angry.
两位看我老婆子的面上，千万不必生气，

Let me have him brought here and question him.”
等我找了他来问。”

She turned, struck the floor with her stick, and ordered Yu Shaowu sternly, “Send more men at once.
她回头拄一拄拐杖，厉声吩咐俞少武：“赶快多派人，

Find that muddleheaded father of yours and bring him home!”
把你那个糊涂老子找回来！”

Whether her anger was real or assumed, her guests were deeply uncomfortable.
不管她是真的动气，还是有意做作，来客都大感不安，

“Granny!”
“三婆婆！”

Hu hastened to soothe her.
胡雪岩急忙相劝，

“We must not blame Brother Yu.
“这件事怪不得俞大哥！

We have only heard rumours, and do not yet know whether there is any truth in them.
我们也是道听途说，事情还不知道真假，

I cannot believe Brother Yu would confuse friend and foe.
我想俞大哥亦不至于敌友不分。

We came to ask you to decide what should be done.
我们的来意，是想请三婆婆做主，

Even if there is nothing in the story, we shall still need the protection of Brother Yu’s great name.”
就算没有这回事，少不得也要仰仗俞大哥的威名，保一保我们。”

Her expression softened.
听得这一说，俞三婆婆的脸色和缓了，

Turning to the Seventh Lady, she said, “That is better!
转眼对七姑奶奶说：“这倒还罢了！

I did not think your Uncle Yu could be quite so foolish.”
我想你师叔也不至于这么糊涂！”

After a pause she addressed her guests again.
略停一下，她又对客人说道：

“Since you have honoured me with your confidence, Wucheng ought to serve you.
“既承两位看得起我，武成理当效劳。

He is a straightforward man who speaks his mind and has offended many people; they are forever spreading stories about him.
他心直口快，外面得罪的人多，每每有人造他的谣言，

Fortunately, you gentlemen are too discerning to be misled by gossip.
亏得两位贤明，决不会误听人言。

This will be easily settled.
事情好办，

Spend two or three days enjoying Suzhou, and I promise to send you back to Hangzhou happy.”
请两位在苏州玩个两三日，我一定叫两位高高兴兴回杭州。”

Hu took in every word, and could not help admiring her.
胡雪岩将她的话，一字一句，听得明明白白，心里着实佩服俞三婆婆，

With a few casual remarks she had washed away the entire suspicion that Yu Wucheng intended to seize the arms.
就这么轻描淡写地，将俞武成意图劫械的一行罪嫌，洗刷掉了。

“Rumours”; “we do not yet know whether there is any truth in them”: those were Hu’s own words.
话是从自己口里说出去的：“道听途说”、“不知真假”，

Even if they later became enemies, he could hardly retract them.
即使将来翻脸，要想改口，已是不能。

Old ginger was indeed the hottest.
真正姜是老的辣！

Without realizing it, he had been tricked into making a concession.
自己竟糊里糊涂被她骗了一句话去、

In more than a year of uninterrupted success, this was the one occasion on which he had stumbled—and he had to acknowledge himself fairly beaten.
可以说是这一年多一帆风顺的境遇中，唯一的一次栽跟斗。然而，这个跟斗栽得不能不服输。


“Thank you, Granny.
“多谢三婆婆，

We must not trouble you further, and shall await your good news.”
我们不敢打搅了。静听好音！”

Hu rose.
胡雪岩站起身说：

“There is just one more thing.
“不过，我们还有句话，

We would very much like to make Brother Yu’s acquaintance.
实在想交一交俞大哥。

When he comes, please be sure to send word, so that we may explain things to him in person.”
等他来了，务必请三婆婆派人给我们个信，我们好当面跟俞大哥解释。”

“We are all good friends and understand one another.
“都是好朋友，一切心照，

What need is there for explanations?” she replied.
何用解释？”俞三婆婆说，

“Your kindness to Wucheng makes all three generations of our family grateful.
“两位抬举武成，我们母子祖孙三代都是感激的。

As soon as he returns, I shall send him to pay his respects.”
等武成一回来，我马上叫他给两位去请安。”

Nothing could have been more gracefully said.
这几句交代，漂亮之至。

Hu and Qiu were entirely satisfied, but when they tried to leave, she detained them.
胡雪岩和裘丰言，心满意足，但要告辞，却被留住了。

“You must at least allow my grandson and me to show a little hospitality.
“无论如何，要让我们租孙，尽一点意思，

Have a simple meal before you go.
吃了便饭再请回去！”

Besides, seeing you has reminded me of something that has been weighing on my mind.
俞三婆婆又说：“看见两位，我倒想起有件心事，

I have an important favour to ask.”
还要重托。”

This was really an excuse to keep them.
俞三婆婆的话，其实是留客的托词。

A banquet had been prepared beforehand, and the family had invited other guests to help entertain them: some were Yu Shaowu’s colleagues, others fellow disciples of Yu Wucheng.
筵席是早就预备好的，俞家还请了陪客，有些是俞少武的同僚，有些是俞武成的师兄弟。

Whatever their standing, all treated Hu and Qiu with the utmost respect.
不管是何身分，对胡、裘二人的礼数，都极恭敬。

Fortunately, Hu’s easy eloquence and Qiu’s wit soon dispelled the stiffness.
好在胡雪岩长于词令，裘丰言为人风趣，所以很快地都消除了拘束的感觉，

They talked freely and drank heartily, and the occasion became thoroughly enjoyable.
快谈豪饮，颇为酣畅。


Halfway through the drinking, Yu Shaowu excused himself and returned to the second hall.
酒到一半，俞少武告个罪，回到二厅，

Another sumptuous table had been laid there, where Third Granny Yu was entertaining Furong and the Seventh Lady herself.
那里也有一桌丰盛筵席，是俞三婆婆亲自做主人，款待芙蓉和七姑奶奶。

This gathering was less relaxed than the one outside, chiefly because Furong, installed in the seat of honour, felt uncomfortable and was excessively reserved.
这一桌就不如外面那样轻松自如了，主要的原因是，芙蓉被奉为首席，深感不安，过于矜持。

Shaowu first offered the ladies a toast.
俞少武一进来，先敬堂客的酒。

In official usage he addressed Furong as “Madam Hu,” with the title given to a concubine, but followed the polite Beijing custom of altering the tone of the word yi so that it suggested “also”: she was “also a wife.”
照官称叫芙蓉是“胡姨太太”，他也学了京里的规矩，将“姨”字念成“亦”子，表示“亦是一位太太”。

After toasting her, he drank to the Seventh Lady.
敬了“胡亦太太”，再敬七姑奶奶，

They had known one another since childhood: he called her Seventh Sister, and she affectionately called him her eldest little brother.
她跟俞少武是青梅竹马之交，一个叫“七姐”，一个叫“大弟弟”。

When these courtesies were over, he helped his grandmother into the main hall to toast the gentlemen.
这一番周旋过后，俞少武才搀着祖母到大厅向官客来敬酒。

All the guests there belonged to a younger generation, and Hu and Qiu likewise treated her as their elder.
在座的陪客都是她的晚辈，胡、裘二人亦以晚辈自居，

They rose from their seats together and repeatedly protested that she was too kind.
所以一齐起身离座，再三谦辞。

In the end she drank one toast to the whole company, then told her grandson, “Shaowu, you must kowtow to Mr Hu and Mr Qiu and thank them.
结果由俞三婆婆总敬一杯，然后向他孙子说道：“少武，你要向胡老爷、裘老爷磕头道谢。

These are men who truly understand loyalty.”
这两位真正够义气！”

Shaowu now knew what his father had been doing, and understood how grave the consequences would be if the matter were pursued.
俞少武也已知道他父亲的所作所为，倘或认真，是件不得了的事，

He readily agreed and stepped forward to perform the ceremony.
所以连声答应着，要来行礼。

Hu and Qiu naturally refused to accept it, moving away from their seats to avoid receiving his bow.
胡雪岩和裘丰言，自然不肯受这个头。逊席相避，

Third Granny Yu spoke again.
于是俞三婆婆又说话了。


“Gentlemen, hear me out.
“两位请听我说。

This is my only grandson.
我就是这个孙子，

He now holds an imperial appointment, however modest, and in a family such as ours that brings honour to our ancestors.
如今大小也是朝廷的命官，在我们这种人家，也算荣宗耀祖了。

But a background in the brotherhoods does not sit easily with official life.
不过，江湖上的家世，跟官场难免合不拢，

That has always worried me, and I have long wanted someone to look after him.
这是我一直不放心的一件事，总想托个人照应，

To tell you the truth, we do know a few officials, but either they look down on us or we feel we are reaching above ourselves.
说实话，官场中也认识几位，不是人家看不起我们，就是自己觉得高攀不上。

You gentlemen have been exceptionally kind.
难得两位赏面子，

If I may speak freely, I also find you different from other officials: you value affection and honour your obligations.
再说句放肆的话，我也看得两位跟官场中人不同，真正是重情分，讲义气。

So today, before everyone here, I entrust my grandson to you.
所以，今天当着大家的面，我把我这个孙子，托付给两位，

I shall not feel at ease until Shaowu has kowtowed to you.”
要让少武磕了头，我才放心。”

To the others, this lengthy speech showed only how highly she valued her distinguished guests.
这一套长篇大论，旁人只觉得俞三婆婆是特别看重两位贵客，

Hu heard the meaning beneath it.
在胡雪岩却听出弦外之音，

In asking them to protect Yu Shaowu, she was really asking them to shield Yu Wucheng.
拜托照应俞少武，实在是拜托回护俞武成。

Her calculations went deep: at every turn she was guarding against their using official power against her son.
照此看来，俞三婆婆用的心思极深，处处在防备自己这方面会动用官面上的力量来对付她的儿子。

Such suspicions could do no good.
有此疑忌存在，总不是件妙事。

To dispel any possible misunderstanding, Hu abandoned polite refusals.
为了消释可能会有的误会，胡雪岩不肯说谦辞的话，

“Since those are your instructions, Granny, we must have the effrontery to accept Shaowu’s bow.
“既然三婆婆如此吩咐。我们倒不能不老着脸受少武一个头。”他说，

From today, I shall treat his affairs as I would my own brother’s.”
“三婆姿，从今天起，少武的事，就等于我自己兄弟的事一样。”

“You have that wrong, Mr Hu,” she said calmly.
“胡老爷，你的话错了！”俞三婆婆平静地说：

“Your nephew’s.”
“是你侄儿的事。”

“Nephew or brother, I shall treat them as my own affairs.”
“侄儿也罢，兄弟也罢，只当我自己的事！”

“Shaowu!” she said, deeply pleased.
“少武！”俞三婆婆极欣慰地说：

“Did you hear that?
“你听见没有？

Hurry and bow!
还不快磕头！

You say you want a transfer home so that you can stay with me.
你说想调回来，跟在我身边，

Mr Hu is sure to find a way for you.”
胡老爷一定会替你想法子。”

Shaowu now knelt with even greater willingness, and Hu accepted his solemn obeisance without further demur.
这一说，俞少武更是心甘情愿地跪了下来，胡雪岩也就坦然受了他的大礼。

In the brotherhoods, a pledge was binding.
江湖上重然诺，

After this bow before the assembled guests, Shaowu’s future fortunes were intimately linked with Hu’s.
经此当筵一拜，俞少武的穷通富贵，便与胡雪岩息息相关了。

A father’s and a son’s safety and prosperity could not be separated; if Wucheng encountered trouble, Hu’s obligation to Shaowu would prevent him from standing aside.
而父子的安危祸福是不可分的，所以俞武成如果遇到了什么难题，胡雪岩由于对俞少武有责任，自然也不能袖手。

Third Granny Yu had played a masterly move, though Hu alone understood its full significance.
俞三婆婆这着棋，实在高明，然而也只有胡雪岩喻得其中的深意。


This made Hu particularly anxious for news from Songjiang.
因此，他对松江的消息，特感关心。

Unwilling to alarm Qiu, he bore the worry alone, silently working through a fresh and more searching assessment of Yu Wucheng’s position.
为了不愿让裘丰言担心，他只好独任其忧，在肚子里默默做功夫，将俞武成的情况，重新作一番深入的估计。

The more he thought, the deeper his misgivings grew.
想得越多，疑虑越深，

When the following morning came without news, he felt that he must stop waiting passively and letting his opportunities slip away.
到了第二天早晨，尚无消息，他觉得不能再因循株守，坐失时机了。

He arranged to meet Yu Shaowu at the Wuyuan teahouse, found a secluded place, and asked quietly, “Do you know where your father is at present?”
于是约了俞少武在吴苑茶馆见面，找个僻静之处，悄悄问道：“你晓不晓得令尊此刻在哪里？”

“Probably at Chadaijiao, near Qingpu.
“大概是在青浦叉袋角。”

To be frank with you, Uncle, my father keeps another household there.
俞少武说，“不瞒老世叔说，家父在那里有一房家眷，

There are also several large gambling houses at Chadaijiao, and he likes to visit them.
叉袋角又有几家大赌场，是家父喜欢去的地方。

Yesterday I sent people off in different directions to look for him.
我昨天就请人分头去找了，

There should certainly be news by tonight.”
到今天晚上一定会有消息的。”

“Tell me, then: what exactly is your father’s relationship with this Lai?
“我倒要问问你，令尊跟赖某人到底是啥交情？

Did you know he intended to lay hands on that consignment of ‘goods’?”
他想动那票‘货色’，你知道不知道？

Shaowu’s face became intensely serious.
“这一问，俞少武的脸色显得异常认真，

He answered in a tone that came close to swearing an oath.
用一种近乎要赌咒的语气答道：

“I would not dare tell you a single falsehood, Uncle.
“在老世叔面前，我不敢说一个字的假话，

I knew absolutely nothing.
我一点都不晓得。

My father would not tell me, and it would hardly be proper for me to question him.
家父不会跟我说，我也不便去问。

Besides, I have been in the capital all this time and returned less than a fortnight ago.
而且我一直在京城里，回来还下到半个月，

I have seen him only twice, and we exchanged very few words.
一共见过家父两面，谈不了几句话。

If I had known of any such plan, I would have done everything I could to persuade him to abandon it.”
如果我晓得有这件事，无论如何要想法子，劝家父打消了它！”


His sincerity and frankness convinced Hu that he need not be as guarded with him as with his grandmother.
话说得很诚恳，也相当坦率，胡雪岩觉得跟他谈论，不必象对他祖母那样，要加几分小心，

He spoke his mind.
便直抒所感，

“I foresee trouble here.
“这件事，照我看有麻烦。

Your father is living away from his own territory, and his men are not here.
令尊客居异地，手下的弟兄都不在这里，

Even if he takes the lead, he must depend on others to carry it through.
虽然出头来主持，无非因人成事。

It is easier to climb the mountain than to come down.
上山容易下山难，

He cannot necessarily call the whole thing off with a word.
不是凭一句话就可以罢手的。

What if he cannot extricate himself?”
如果脱不得身，怎么办？”

As a serving military officer, Shaowu readily grasped the point.
俞少武是现任的武官，当然能够领会胡雪岩所说的话，

Seizing a shipment of arms was no small undertaking.
想一想果然，截掠军械，是件非同小可的事，

Men had to be deployed, the attack planned, the captured weapons delivered to Lai Hanying.
调兵遣将，如何下手，得手以后，如何将这批枪械运交赖汉英？

And what would they do if government troops came in force to intercept and suppress them?
官军派出大队拦截剿办，又如何应付？

Arrangements must already have been made.
自然得有一番布置，

If the men were not his father’s own, how could he change his mind halfway through and cancel everything with a word?
而入不是自己的人，中途变卦，想凭一句话就撤消原有的布置，哪有这么容易的事？

As Shaowu followed the implications, anxiety clouded his face.
这样一层一层想下来，脸上顿现愁云：

“There is no time to lose.
“事不宜迟！”

The sooner we dissuade him, the easier it will be.
他说，“及早劝阻，还容易着手。

I shall go to Qingpu at once.”
我马上就到青浦去一趟。”

Hu was reassured by his decisiveness, but his own calculations went further.
见他如此果断，胡雪岩深感安慰，不过他的计算到底比俞少武深得多，

He laid a hand on Shaowu’s.
按着他的手说：

“You should not go.
“你不宜去！

He may be your father, but you are an imperial military officer of the fifth rank.
因为虽是父子，到底是朝廷的五品武官，

Your presence could arouse suspicion.
去了容易让人起疑。

Besides, if your father was at Qingpu, he will certainly have reached Songjiang by now.
而且，只要令尊是在青浦，这时候就一定到了松江，

You would miss him.”
你去了也是扑空。”

“Then tell me what to do, Uncle.
“那么，老世叔说怎么办，

I shall obey.”
我听命。”

“I think I had better hurry back to Songjiang and see for myself.
“我想我马上赶回松江去看看。

Send a capable man with me.
你派个得力的人跟了我去。”

And if your grandmother has any instructions, it would be best for him to carry them too.
胡雪岩紧接着说，“令祖母有什么话交代，最好也由这个人带了去，

That will save trouble.”
那就更省事了。”

“Certainly.
“是！”

I shall go straight home and tell her.
俞少武说，“我马上回去告诉我奶奶。

Would you like to come with me?”
老世叔是不是一起到舍下坐坐？”

“No.
“不必！”

I shall return to the Jinchang Inn to make arrangements and wait there for your message.
胡雪岩答道：“我先回金阊栈料理，在那里等你的信息。

Please also tell the Seventh Lady that I must trouble her to look after Furong.”
再托你转告七姑奶奶，小妾烦她照应。”

“Of course.
“是，是！

My grandmother and Madam Hu get on wonderfully.
我奶奶跟姨太太极谈得来，

Let her spend a couple of days at our house; we shall attend to everything.
就请她在舍下玩两天，一切我们都会伺候，

Please set your mind at rest.”
老世叔请放心！”

“I am sorry to impose on you.
“打搅不安。

I shall thank your grandmother when I return.”
只有等我回来，再给三婆婆道谢了。”


They parted at the Wuyuan and went their separate ways.
于是就在吴苑分手，各奔东西。

Hu’s bearers carried him swiftly to the Jinchang Inn, where he found Qiu drinking alone.
胡雪岩轿去如飞，到了金阊栈，只见裘丰言一个人在那里独酌。

Qiu rose when he entered.
裘丰言见他进来，便站起身来说，

“Where have you been?
“你到哪里去了？

Third Master Liu and Old Zhou are both out, and I did not dare leave the place unattended.
刘三爷和老同又不在，我一个人又不敢走开，

I was bored to death and could only drink to pass the time.”
无聊之极，只有借酒遣闷。

Hu had much on his mind, but it was in his nature never to let worry show in his face or voice.
“胡雪岩虽有事在心，但天生是什么忧烦都不肯现于词色的人，

He smiled and teased him.
便笑笑调侃他说：

“Nobody has forbidden you your morning wine.
“没有哪个不准你吃早酒，

Why bother inventing an excuse?”
何必还要想套话来说？”

Just then Liu Bucai floated in on light feet.
刚说到这里，只见刘不才脚步轻飘飘地走了进来，

Warmed by the wine, Qiu turned his jokes upon this old partner in banter.
裘丰言一见，便趁着酒兴向他这位谐谑惯了的好朋友取笑，

“Third Master, enjoying the spring breeze of success?
“三爷，春风得意？”他说，

I envy you.
“我真羡慕，

What a delightful commission Old Hu gave you!
老胡委派了你那么好一个差使。

Tell us what the land of tender pleasures is like.”
说说看，温柔乡中是何风光？”

Hu had sent Liu out the previous day to seek attractive women.
胡雪岩昨天派他的差使，是去寻芳问艳，

Liu had done his duty, visiting house after house until he found a particularly fine establishment, presided over by one of Jinchang’s celebrated beauties.
刘不才不辱所命，连走数家，到底访着了一处极出色的妆阁，主政是金阊的一朵名葩。

“First, tell us her charming name.”
“你先说，芳名叫啥？”

“Look!”
“你看！”


Liu drew an invitation card from his pocket.
刘不才从口袋里掏出一张“局票”，

On yellow paper was printed a silver ingot, without a word of writing.
黄笺纸印着一个银元宝，只字皆无。

Even Hu could not fathom his meaning.
连胡雪岩那样的人，都猜不透他是什么用意？

“I asked for the lady’s professional name.
“我是问那个姑娘的花名，

What are you showing us a piece of paper for?”
你弄这张纸头给我们看干什么？”

Qiu turned the card over twice and handed it back.
裘丰言把局票翻过来、翻过去看了两遍，交还刘不才。

Liu would not take it.
刘不才不接，

“Look more closely.
“你再仔细看看，”

Her name is hidden in the card.”
他说，“这张局票上就隐着她的名字。”

With that hint Hu immediately guessed half the answer.
这一指点，胡雪岩马上就猜到了一半：

“Her surname is Huang—yellow?”
“姓黄？”

“Exactly!
“对！

Huang Yinbao: Silver Ingot.”
叫做黄银宝。”

“Excellent!
“妙！

Once you explain it, there can be no doubt.”
说穿了一点不错。”

Qiu examined the card appreciatively.
裘丰言仔细欣赏那张局票，

In one corner were the words “Finely made by Rongbaozhai, Liulichang, Beijing.”
角上有“北京琉璃厂荣宝斋精制”的字样，

He praised it again.
不由得又夸一声：

“Refinement beneath apparent vulgarity.
“似俗而雅，

Quite unusual.”
倒也难得。”

“Precisely!
“一点不错！

Refinement beneath apparent vulgarity.”
似俗而雅。”

Liu clapped his hands.
刘不才抚掌说道，

“Her name is common enough, but the woman herself is wonderfully elegant.
“名字俗气，人倒雅得很，

Like a chrysanthemum.”
象朵菊花似地。


“Then you must be Tao Yuanming!
“那么你就是陶渊明了！

‘Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence, at leisure I see the southern hills.’” Qiu laughed.
‘采菊东篱下，悠然见南山’。”裘丰言笑道，

“Did you pick the flower last night?”
“昨天晚上采了花没有？”

“Do you think it is so easy?
“哪有这么容易的事，

You value these women far too cheaply.”
你看得她们太不值钱了。”

“So you stayed out all night on a ‘dry bed’?” Hu asked.
“那么昨天一夜不回是借的干铺？”胡雪岩说，

“Being allowed even that on the first night is not bad.”
“刚刚头一夭肯借干铺，也就不错的了。”

“In that case you ought to show your gratitude today!” Qiu said eagerly.
“照这样说，你今天就该‘报效’了！”裘丰言兴致勃勃地说，

“Tonight we shall drink your ‘fringed banquet’ wine.
“今天晚上吃你的‘镶边酒’！

Let me draw up the guest list: Old Hu for one, Yu Shaowu for another—” “Wait, wait!” Hu interrupted.
我替你看看客人看，老胡一个，俞少武一个……”“慢点，慢点！”胡雪岩打断他的话，

“Leave me out.
“不要算上我，

I have to go to Songjiang at once—” Now it was Qiu who interrupted.
我马上要到松江……”这下是裘丰言打断了他的话：

“Whatever makes you say that?”
“何出此言？”

“It is true.
“是真的。

Leave the courtesans’ banquet for later.”
吃花酒的事，摆在一边再说。”

Hu paused, then said decisively, “We must discuss serious business first.”
胡雪岩略顿一下，毅然说道：“我们先商量正经。”

He had initially wished to spare the others his worries, but the possible danger had grown beyond his power to avert alone.
先是不愿他人分忧，到此地步，已非胡雪岩一个人的力量所能消弭可能有的祸患，

He could only tell them frankly what he feared.
因此，他唯有直言心中的顾虑。

Qiu had already foreseen trouble and, with his greater experience, was not especially shaken.
裘丰言已有先见，经验也多，倒还不怎么样，

Liu, once a rich young idler and now well suited to life as a gentleman’s entertaining companion, could charge fearlessly through any battle of wine and drinking games; but at the hint of a venture concealing deadly danger, his face changed completely.
刘不才从前是纨袴，此刻成了清客的材料，酒阵拳仗，一往无前，但听得这种隐伏杀机的勾当，顿时脸色大变，

He even forgot Huang Yinbao.
连黄银宝都置诸脑后了。

Hu hastened to reassure him, patting him on the back.
胡雪岩一见他这样子，赶紧加以安慰，拍拍他的背说：

“You have no part in this.
“没有你的事，

Stay here in Suzhou with Old Qiu.”
你跟老裘坐守苏州。”

“Even if I have no part in it, how can I be easy about your going?”
“就没有我的事，我也不放心你去啊！”

“Quite right,” Qiu put in.
“这话不错。”裘丰言接口：

“This is my business.
“是我的事，

I cannot sit here doing nothing.”
我没有袖手闲坐的道理。”

“Enough, enough!”
“算了，算了！”

Hu stopped them before they could go further.
胡雪岩急忙拦在前头，

“I have no time to argue.
“我没工夫跟你们争论，

What matters now is getting things done.
现在办事要紧，

Listen to me, and do not throw our arrangements into confusion.”
你们要听我的，不要乱了阵脚。”


They would only unsettle him by going on, so Qiu and Liu fell silent.
这是所谓徒乱人意，裘丰言和刘不才不敢再开口。

Hu reassessed the situation, distinguishing three possibilities and three difficulties.
于是胡雪岩又估计情势，分析出三种情况，三种难处。

First, Yu Wucheng might have joined forces with the Taipings, completed all the deployments, and then found himself constrained by circumstances and no longer free to act.
三种情形是：第一，俞武成跟洪杨合作，调兵遣将，已经布置就绪，而且身不由己，无形中受了挟制。

Second, the arrangements might be complete but still under his control, so that fighting could be averted, though disbanding the men would cost a considerable sum.
其次，虽已布置就绪，但收发由心，仍可化干戈为玉帛，只是一笔遣散的费用，相当可观。

The third possibility, and the one they all hoped for, was that Yu could simply withdraw, having at most to return the payment he had received.
最后一种情况，也正就是大家所希望的，俞武成可以说不干就不干，至多将已收的酬金退还给对方而已。

“We must always allow for the worst,” Qiu said.
“凡事总要作最坏的打算。

“Suppose it is the first case.
算它是第一种情形，

I do have a plan.”
我倒也是个逢盘。”

He hesitated.
裘丰言略一踌躇，

“But tell us your three difficulties first, Old Hu.”
“老胡，你先说，是哪三种难处？”

“The first is our obligation to the Yu family.
“第一是俞家的交情。

Third Granny Yu is formidable.
俞三婆婆实在厉害，

Somehow this wet shirt has been slipped over my head, and now it clings to me.
如今这件‘湿布衫’好象糊里糊涂套到我身上了，

I cannot strike at the rat for fear of breaking the vessel: at every turn I must consider Yu Wucheng’s safety.
投鼠忌器，处处要顾着俞武成，

That is the greatest difficulty.”
这是最大的难处。”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

Qiu nodded gravely.
裘丰言深深点头，

“And it is not only our friendship with the Yu family.
“又不光是俞家的交情，

The Songjiang brotherhood is involved too.
牵涉到松江漕帮，

Whatever happens, those ties must be preserved.”
无论如何这份交情要保全。”

“That is what I think.
“我也是这么想。

So my first idea is this: if the worst case proves true, we must at least find a way to get Yu Wucheng out of the affair, helping neither side.”
所以我初步有这么个打算，倘或是第一种情形，至少要想法让俞武成退出局外，哪面也不管。“


“You mean that if Lai Hanying insists on forcing the issue, we must deal with him ourselves?”
“你的意思是，如果赖汉英一定要蛮干，就是我们自己来对付？”

“Exactly.
“对！

We must find Yu Wucheng a reason for withdrawing that the other side cannot refuse to accept.”
我们要替俞武成找个理由，让那方面非许他抽身不可。”

“That should be easy enough.
“这容易想。

The difficulty is how we deal with them ourselves.
难的是我们自己如何对付？”

At that point, I imagine we should have to request a military escort.”
裘丰言说，“照我看到那时候，非请兵护运不可。”

“That is precisely the trouble.
“难就难在这里，

Troops are not easy to obtain just now.
目前请兵不容易，

Even if we secured them, those grand gentlemen of the Green Standard Army would be hard to satisfy.
就请到了，绿营的那班大爷，也难伺候，

They need money to march, money to pitch camp, money to send out a detachment; compensation for the dead and rewards for victory cost still more—” “Enough, enough!”
开拔要钱，安营要钱，出队要钱，阵亡抚恤，得胜犒赏更要钱……”“算了，算了！”

Qiu waved both hands.
裘丰言连连摇手：

“That road is blocked.
“此路不通！

No point discussing it.”
不必谈了。”

“Then take the third difficulty.
“那么谈第三种难处。

Suppose we can settle it peacefully, and their men either withdraw or disband.
譬如能够和平了结，他们的人或者撤回，或者遣散，

Naturally, we shall have to raise a sum to send them.
我们当然要筹笔钱送过去。

The money itself matters less than this: what if someone accuses us of ‘colluding with rebels’?
钱在其次，万一有人告我们一状，说我们‘通匪’，

That is no charge to trifle with.”
这个罪名，不是好开玩笑的！”

Qiu started.
裘丰言瞿然而惊，

“I had not thought of that.”
“我倒没有想到这一层。”

His relief was like that of a man waking from a nightmare.
他是那种做了噩梦而惊醒的欣慰：

“Thank goodness you look so far ahead!”
“亏得你想得深！”


Liu, who had been silent for some time, grew increasingly anxious and could not resist breaking in.
在旁边半天不曾开口的刘不才，听得满腹忧烦，忍不住插了句口：

“All I hear is how difficult it is!
“只听你们说难！

Surely we are not completely helpless?”
莫非真的一筹莫展？”

“Then suggest a good solution.
“你倒说，有什么好办法？

It really is difficult!”
事情是真难！”

Qiu turned to Hu.
裘丰言看着胡雪岩，

“Old Hu, I think we shall have to do as I propose and settle the whole thing once and for all.”
“老胡，我看只有照我的办法，一了百了。”

He deliberately withheld his plan to let them guess, but even Hu’s quick mind had to admit defeat.
他故意不说，留下时间好让人去猜。可是连胡雪岩那样的脑筋，亦不得不知难而退：

“Tell us, Old Qiu.
“老裘，你说吧！

What miraculous move have you found inside this dead position?”
看看你在死棋肚里出了什么仙着？”

“I say we cancel that consignment!”
“依我说，这票货色，拿它退掉！”

He affected a Beijing accent.
他撇眷京腔说，

“Your lordship isn’t playing any more!
“大爷不玩儿了！

Let us see what they can do then.”
看他们还有辙没有？

“What sort of suggestion is that?”
““这，这叫什么话。”

Long accustomed to joking with Qiu, Liu jeered sharply.
刘不才是跟他开惯玩笑的，便尖刻地讥嘲：

“The weather is not even hot yet, and your ideas are already going sour!”
“天气还没有热，你的主意倒有点馊了！”

“You must not put it that way, Third Master,” Hu said.
“三爷，话不是这么说！

“An unexpected move can be a brilliant one.
出的主意能够出其不意，就是高着。

If we really did that, all their scheming would come to nothing, which would be no bad thing.
真的如此，叫他们自费心思一场空，倒也不错。

If all we wanted was to keep ourselves safe, seeking no achievement and merely avoiding blame, we could do it.
不过，为了明哲保身，不求有功，但求无过，不妨这么办。

But we are trying to build something.
现在，我们是在打开下，

We cannot retreat like that.
就决不能这么退缩。

Our standing matters!”
面子要紧！

That standing involved Hu’s credit, Qiu’s prospects, and Wang Youling’s reputation.
“这个面子关乎胡雪岩的信誉，裘丰言的前程，还有王有龄的声望。

They had to uphold it.
非绷了起来不可。

After all their discussion, they returned to Hu’s plan: first find a reason to release Yu Wucheng from the affair, then decide the next step according to circumstances.
说来说去还是得照胡雪岩的办法，初步找个理由让俞武成脱身事外，第二步看情形再作道理。

“The reason is easy enough,” Qiu said.
“这个理由太容易找了！”裘丰言说：

“Everyone in the brotherhoods knows that Yu Wucheng is a dutiful son.
“俞武成是孝子，江湖上尽人皆知。

If his mother says no, then no it must be.
如今者太太说不行，就叫不行！

He cannot disobey her.
俞武成母命难违，

What better reason could there be?”
不是很好的理由吗？”


Before Hu could answer, four mounted attendants appeared again, followed by Yu Shaowu escorting a man of singular appearance.
胡雪岩还未及答言，只见又是四名马弁出现，随后便见俞少武陪着一个人进来，这个人的形象生得极其奇特，

His eyebrows, eyes, and nose were crowded close together in a round face.
一张圆脸上眉眼鼻子凑得极近，

He was about sixty, and his sunken mouth drew upwards, making his features seem even more tightly clustered.
年纪有六十了，一张瘪嘴缩了上去，越显得五官不分，

It was difficult not to laugh.
令人忍不住好笑。

“Uncle, let me introduce Yang Fengmao, my senior fellow disciple.”
“老世叔，我替你引见一个人，是我大师兄杨凤毛。”

Seeing Yang’s age, Hu had assumed he belonged to the generation of Shaowu’s father.
看杨凤毛年纪一大把，胡雪岩总当他是俞少武的父执辈，

On hearing “senior fellow disciple,” he realized that this must be Yu Wucheng’s first disciple, probably a man who managed the brotherhood on his master’s behalf and carried considerable weight.
如今听说是“大师兄”，知是俞武成的“开山门了的徒弟，大概代师掌帮，是极有分量的人物，

Hu hurried forward and took his hand.
所以赶紧走上去拉着他的手说：”

“A great pleasure to meet you!”
幸会，幸会！

But despite his years, Yang was extraordinarily supple and nimble.
“哪知杨凤毛年纪虽大，腰脚极其轻健，

Repeatedly protesting that the honour was undeserved, he had already dropped to his knees and kowtowed before Hu could prevent him.
一面口中连称“不敢”，一面已跪了下去磕头。

While Hu was still protesting, Yang pressed on with his courtesies and performed the same full ceremony before Qiu and Liu.
胡雪岩谦谢不遑，而杨凤毛“再接再励”，对裘丰言和刘不才都行了大礼。

“What is all this?” Hu asked uneasily.
“这是怎么说？”胡雪岩很不安地，

“With such elaborate courtesies, you make it difficult for us even to talk.”
“这样子客气，叫我们倒难说话了。”

Yang stood with his hands respectfully at his sides. “Those were Third Granny’s instructions. I am to treat Mr Hu and his friends as I would my own master.
“是我们三婆婆交代的，见了胡老爷跟胡老爷的令友，就跟见了师父一样。“杨凤毛垂手说道：”

Mr Hu, she has sent me to accompany you to Songjiang.”
胡老爷，三婆婆派我跟了你老到松江去。

He looked about him, apparently hesitating.
“接着张目四顾，显得很踟蹰似地。


Hu understood.
胡雪岩懂得他的意思，

Secrecy mattered greatly in the brotherhoods; there were things that could not be told even within a family, between father and son.
江湖上最重秘密，有些话是连家人父子都不能相告的、

Qiu and Liu would never reveal what they heard, but as the saying went, hemp has many fibres and a worldly man has many precautions.
虽然裘、刘在座共闻，决不会泄漏，不过“麻布筋多，光棍心多”，

Since Yang had reservations, a private conversation would be best.
杨凤毛既然有所顾忌，不如单独密谈的好。

Hu beckoned.
于是他招招手说：

“Brother Yang, let us step aside for a word.”
“杨兄，我们借一步说话！”

“Pray excuse us.”
“告罪，告罪！”

Yang bowed deeply to Qiu and Liu, then followed Hu into the inner room.
杨凤毛又向裘丰言、刘不才作了两个大揖，才跟着胡雪岩走到套间，

It was small, and they sat on the edge of the bed.
地方大小，两个人就坐在床沿上说话。

“Mr Hu, Third Granny tells me that although you stand outside our threshold, you are one of our own.
“胡老爷！三婆婆跟我说，胡老爷虽在‘门槛’外头，跟自己人一样，

She says I need not trouble with polite speeches, but should tell you plainly whatever there is to say.
关照我说话不必叙客套，有什么说什么。

There is something frank I should like to tell you, though I do not know whether I ought.”
所以，我有句老实话，不晓得该不该说？”

Such a preamble suggested that his frankness would not be particularly agreeable.
这样招呼打在前头，可知那句“老实话”，不会怎么动听。

Hu, however, was not a man who wanted only sweet words.
只是胡雪岩不是那么喜欢听甜言蜜语的人，

He nodded.
便点点头说：

“Never mind that.
“没有关系！

Say whatever you wish.”
你尽管说好了。”

“I have made inquiries too, and know you are an exceptional man.
“我也打听过，胡老爷是了不起的人物。

But a threshold can divide people as completely as a mountain.
不过隔道门槛就象隔重山，

There may be things you have never experienced.”
有些事情，胡老爷怕没有经过。”

Yang paused.
杨凤毛略停一下又说：

“It is best not to become involved in the affairs of the brotherhoods.
“江湖上的事，最好不沾上手，

Once you do, it is like going onstage: after you pass through the entrance, you cannot turn back.”
一沾上就象唱戏那样，出了上场门就不容你再缩回去了。”

“I know.
“我知道。

This is a play I have no choice but to perform.
这出戏不容我不唱，

Even if the audience boos, I must finish it.”
哪怕台下唱倒彩，我也要把它唱完。”

“And this particular play is no easy performance: Nine Watches of the Night, with a turn rolling on a bed of nails!”
“现在这出戏不容易唱，‘九更天带滚钉板’！”

Yang’s face was earnest.
杨凤毛满脸诚恳地说，

“If you can avoid performing it, that would be best.”
“能不唱最好不唱。”


These words put Hu on his guard.
一听这话，胡雪岩起了戒心。

Clearly Yang was involved in Yu Wucheng’s plan to seize the foreign guns, and their relationship suggested that his role must be important.
俞武成想动那批洋枪，显然的，杨凤毛也是参预其事的一个，而且以他们的关系来说，必还是一个重要角色。

Third Granny had handled matters admirably, and Shaowu had been quite frank, but both stood outside the actual undertaking.
虽然三婆婆极其漂亮，俞少武相当坦率，然而都算是局外人，

The man before him was directly concerned with the success or failure of his mission.
只有眼前的这个杨凤毛，才是对自己此行成败，大有关系的人物，

Given their respective positions, it was not yet clear whether they were friends or enemies.
而照彼此的立场来说，是敌是友，还不分明，

Hu would have to handle him carefully.
倒要好好应付。

“Thank you for your kindness, brother,” he answered cautiously.
因此，他很谨慎地答道：“多谢老兄的好意。

“But I have no choice.
事出无奈，

Never mind Nine Watches of the Night—even if the play were A Tour of the Ten Courts of Hell, I should have to go on.
不要说是‘九更天’，就是‘游十殿’我也只好去。

Still, people carry one another in the flowered bridal chair: respect must be mutual.
不过，‘花花轿儿人抬人’，

Since Third Granny thinks so well of me, I must consider her at every turn in this performance.”
承三婆婆看得起我，我唱这出戏，总要处处顾得到她老人家。”

The words sounded soft but were firm beneath.
这番表白，似软实硬，

Without his regard for Third Granny, he implied, he would meet force with force and settle the matter outright.
意思是不着三婆婆的面子，就要硬碰硬干个明白。

As for people carrying one another in the bridal chair, he meant the saying in reverse: “I show her such respect—can you have the heart to leave me stranded?”
至于“花花轿儿人抬人”这句俗话是反着说：“我是如此尊敬三婆婆，莫非你们就好意思让我下不去？”

Yang, Yu Wucheng’s ablest assistant, was widely experienced and had some learning as well.
杨凤毛是俞武成最得力的帮手，见多识广，而且颇读过几句书，

He had come intending first to test Hu: was this a man of sufficient weight, able to weather great storms?
此来原是先要试探试探胡雪岩，看他是不是够分量、能经得起大风大浪的人？

If he proved feeble and useless, or capable but lacking sound judgment, Yang would make other plans.
如果窝窝囊囊不中用，或者虽中用是个半吊子，便另有打算。

The test now left him impressed, and he offered his confidence.
现在试探下来，相当佩服，这才倾心相待。

“Uncle Hu!”
“胡大叔！”

Even his form of address had changed.
他将称呼都改过了，

“Since you understand our position and are willing to shoulder the responsibility, I shall speak from the heart.
“既然你老能体谅我们这方面，愿意担当，那么我就掏心窝子说实话。

We are in considerable trouble.”
事情相当麻烦。”


It was indeed the first of the possibilities Hu had foreseen.
果然，是胡雪岩所估计的第一种情形。

Yu Wucheng was partly to blame for his own impatience.
这当然也要怪俞武成沉不住气，

Having lost his territory around Zhenjiang, he found it galling to live dependent on others.
自觉失去了镇江一带的地盘，寄人篱下，不是滋味，

The men of the grain-transport brotherhood were also struggling to survive, and he had to find some means of supporting them.
同时漕帮弟兄的生计甚艰，他也必须得想办法，

In his haste to break through these difficulties, he had placed himself under constraints and lost his freedom of action.
为了急谋打开困难，以致身不由己，受到挟制。

“Uncle Hu, my master is no longer his own master,” Yang said.
“胡大叔，”杨凤毛说，“我师父现在身不由己。

“The men are theirs, and so are all the arrangements.
人是他们的一切布置也是他们的，

They merely put my master’s name out in front to conceal who they really are.”
不过抬出我师父这块招牌，挡住他们的真面目而已。”

“Then I do not understand.
“那我就不懂了，

Have they sent men over from Zhenjiang and Yangzhou?
莫非他们从镇江、扬州那方面派人过来？

Are they not afraid the government troops will discover them and surround them?”
不怕官军晓得了围剿？”

“That is where they depend on my master to provide cover.
“这就要靠我师父帮他们遮盖了。”

There are not actually many men from Zhenjiang and Yangzhou.
杨凤毛答道，“镇江、杨州派来的人倒还不多，

Most belong to the Small Swords Society.
一大半是小刀会方面的。

Zhou Lichun’s men were scattered, but now they have gathered again.”
周立春的人本来已经打散，现在又聚了拢来了。

“And if your master stopped providing cover?
““如果你师父不替他们遮盖呢？”胡雪岩问：

What would happen then?”
“那会变成啥样子？”

“They would be unable to remain in this district.”
“变得在这一带存不住身。”

So that was why the other side had to keep Yu Wucheng tied to them.
这就是对方非要绊住俞武成不可的道理。

The position was plain.
事情很明显了，

He was riding a tiger and could not easily dismount.
俞武成是骑虎难下，

Even if he managed to jump down, he could scarcely escape the name of a man who had betrayed his own people.
纵能从背上跳下来，亦难免落个出卖自己人的名声。

Nothing mattered more in the brotherhoods.
江湖上最着重这一点，

Whether his mother’s instructions would have any effect, and whether he could remain an invariably obedient son, were now very doubtful.
所以俞三婆婆的话，有没有效力，俞武成是不是始终能做个百依百顺的孝子，都大成疑问。


Those were Hu’s thoughts, but he could still put his proposal into words.
想是这样想，话不妨先说出来：

“You peel a radish one section at a time as you eat it.
“ ‘萝卜吃一截剥一截’，

I think our first step must be to get your master out of the trouble, helping neither side.
我想第一步只有让你师父跳出是非之地，哪一方面都不帮。

Surely that can be done?”
这总可以办得到吧？”

“We shall have to try it before we know.”
“那也要做起来看。”

“Why?”
“怎么呢？”

“If the other side refuses to release him, there is bound to be a breach.
“那方面如果不放，势必至于就要翻了脸。”

If a breach settled everything, well and good, but the trouble would remain.
杨凤毛说，“翻了脸能够一了百了，倒也罢了，是非还在！

How would you deal with it, Uncle Hu?
胡大叔，请问你怎么对付？

You would have to bring in government troops, and that would make matters worse.”
除非搬动官军，那一来是非更大了。”

In other words, even if the rider dismounted, the tiger would still bare its teeth and claws.
这就是说，跳下了虎背，老虎依然张牙舞爪，

How to deal with it remained a problem.
如何打虎，仍旧是个难题。

With thorns obstructing every path, an idea suddenly flashed into Hu’s mind, and he spoke without realizing it.
就这处处荆棘之际，胡雪岩灵机一动，不自觉地说出来一句话。

“Become the tiger-taming arhat and bring it to heel!”
“做个伏虎罗汉，收服了它！”

Yang stared in puzzlement.
杨凤毛不懂他的话，愕然问道，

“What was that, Uncle Hu?”
“胡大叔！你说点啥？”

Hu realized that he had been thinking aloud.
胡雪岩这才醒悟，自己忘形自语，

“Oh,” he said, smiling, “I was considering something.
“喔，”他笑道，“我想我心里的事。

There may be a way through.
有条路或许走得通，

I rather think it is the only way.”
我觉得这条路，恐怕是唯一的一条路。

“If it leads anywhere, we shall follow it with all our strength.
““只要走得通，我们一定拼命去走。

Tell me!”
胡大叔，你说！”

Hu collected himself.
胡雪岩定定神答道：

“I am an outsider, and what I say may offend against your rules.
“我是‘空子’，说话作兴触犯忌讳，

Still—” “Uncle Hu!”
不过……”“唉，胡大叔！”

Yang was growing impatient.
杨凤毛有些不耐，

“We do not regard you as an outsider.
“我们没有拿你老当空子看。

There is no need to explain yourself.”
胡大叔，你何需表白。”


“Very well.
“好！

I shall speak plainly.”
那我就实说。”

Recalling the Old Master’s words, Hu continued calmly.
胡雪岩回忆着老太爷的话，从容发言：

“I know something of the origins of your grain-transport brotherhoods.
“你们漕帮的起源，我也有些晓得，

When Hong and Yang first rose, you all thought highly of them.
洪杨初起，你们都很看重的，

Who could have known that the Long-haired rebels would behave so perversely, in complete defiance of the great principles taught by the sages in the Classics?
哪晓得长毛做出来的事，不伦不类，跟圣经贤传上所说的大道理，全不对头，

They are acting against Heaven itself and can never amount to anything.
简直可以说是逆天行事，决计成不了气候。

Since that is so, there is no need to stand on ceremony with them.
既然如此，无需跟他们客气。

Besides, your territory in Zhenjiang and Yangzhou was lost to them.
再说，你们镇江、扬州的地盘，就失在他们手里。

Only when it is recovered will you have a way to make a living.
有朝一日光复了，你们才有生路。

Am I right?”
你说我这话是不是？”

“You are.”
“是的！”

Yang nodded deeply.
杨凤毛深深点头，

“My master acted a little rashly this time,” he added gloomily.
忧郁地说：“我师父这一次是做得莽撞了些。”

“A crooked shot may still hit the mark.”
“歪打可以正着！

Hu patted his back. “Brother, let me suggest a way out for you and your master.
老兄，”胡雪岩抚着他的背说，“我替你们师弟想条路子！

I know something of the Small Swords Society too.
小刀会这方面的情形，我也有点晓得，

Zhou Lichun and his men merely lost their heads for a time.
周立春他们那班人，亦不过一时鬼摸头，

How could they not regret it?
心里何尝不懊悔？

They simply cannot find a path back to an honest life.
只不过摸不到一条改邪归正的路子。

Now it must depend on you two.
如今要靠你们师弟两个。

Since Zhou Lichun’s scattered followers have gathered again, why not bring them over to our side?”
我的意思是，周立春下面那批打散了的人，既然已经聚拢，何不拿他们拉过来？”

Yang’s sunken mouth tightened until his chin tilted upwards.
一听这话，杨凤毛那张瘪嘴闭得越紧，以至于下巴都翘了起来，

His eyes blinked rapidly, but shone with a mixture of bewilderment and delight.
一双眼睛眨得很厉害，不过眼中发亮，是既困惑又欣喜的神情。

“Uncle Hu, you mean to secure an amnesty and bring these men into government service?”
“胡大叔，你是说‘招安’这批人？”

“Yes.
“是啊！”

If the Long-haired men sent by Lai Hanying are willing to come over too, so much the better.
胡雪岩说，“赖汉英那里来的长毛，如果肯一起过来最好，

Otherwise, let them get the hell out.
不然就滚他娘的蛋，

That would be treating them fairly enough!”
也算对得起他们了！”

Yang found Hu’s approach remarkably conciliatory.
杨凤毛觉得胡雪岩的做法很平和。

Thinking further, he saw that even if Yu Wucheng withdrew, his neutrality would be only apparent.
再往深处去想，就算俞武成能退出来成为局外人，也只是表面如此看法，

In reality he could never stand entirely apart.
实际上是决不能置身事外的，

If government troops attacked and matters grew serious, the brotherhoods would still accuse him of failing his friends.
倘或官军围剿，事情闹大了，江湖上还会批评他不够朋友。

This was therefore the only proper course.
所以唯有这样子才是正办，

Even if the attempt to obtain an amnesty failed, he would at least have done his best for his friends and could account honourably for his conduct.
退一步说，招安不成，他总算为朋友尽过心力，对江湖上也有了交代了。


Once he saw all this, Yang regarded Hu as nothing less than a saviour.
想通了这些道理，顿时将胡雪岩敬如天神，

He rose and immediately dropped to his knees in a kowtow.
站起来便磕了个头。

Startled, Hu hurried aside and caught his arms.
胡雪岩大惊，急忙避开，拉着他的胳膊说：

“What are you doing?
“怎么，怎么，

Why this ceremony all of a sudden?”
无缘无故来这一套！”

“Uncle Hu, you have saved my master’s whole family.
“胡大叔，你算是救了我师父一家，

You may not realize it, but Third Granny has not faced such trouble for decades.
你老怕还不晓得，三婆婆几十年没有为难过，

This time she has been too anxious to sleep.
这一趟她老人家，急得睡不着觉，

We are strangers in Suzhou.
在苏州，我们是客地，

If this affair comes to light, penal military exile or execution could await us.
这件事要闹开来，充军杀头都有分！

And she dotes on her grandson.
再说，她老人家又疼孙子，

Shaowu is an imperial military officer.
少武是朝廷的武官，

If what my master has done became known, would it not ruin his career?
我师父做这件事，传出去不断送了少武的前程？

Now things will be all right!
如今好了！

But”—Yang gave an ingratiating smile—“since you have begun this good work, please carry it through to the end.
不过，”杨凤毛又赔笑说：“你老送佛到西天，

I know you are on friendly terms with Education Commissioner He.
我晓得你老跟何学台有交情，

We shall still need your wholehearted assistance over the amnesty.”
招安的事，还要仰仗鼎力。”

He bowed deeply again.
说着，又作了个大揖。

Hu had not thought of He Guiqing.
胡雪岩倒不曾想到何桂清。

At Yang’s reminder, he exclaimed inwardly, “Excellent!”
如今听杨凤毛一提醒，立刻在心里喊一声：妙！

He Guiqing had submitted plenty of memorials discussing warfare on paper.
何桂清纸上谈兵的套折，上了不少，

If he could accomplish this, it would be a substantial achievement and a great help to his efforts in the capital.
现在能办成这事，是大功一件，对于他进京活动，大有帮助。

In fairness to himself, Hu felt that his own idea was really quite good.
这样看来，自己的这个主意，凭心而论，着实不坏。

He answered readily, “You have my word.
于是他很爽快地答道：“一句话！

If I would not do such a worthwhile thing, what would I do?”
这样好的事情不做，还做啥！”

“Thank you, Uncle Hu.”
“多谢胡大叔！”

Yang’s face became solemn.
杨凤毛的脸色转为严肃，

“I await your instructions.”
“我听你老的差遣。”

Hu was an expert listener.
胡雪岩最会听话，

He understood that this was a modest way of saying the reverse: Yang actually had proposals of his own.
听出这是句表示谦虚的反话，实际上是杨凤毛有一套话要说，所以这样答道：

“You and your master must take the lead.
“事情是你们师弟为头，

Wherever I can help, I shall spare no effort.
我只要能尽力，决不偷半分的懒。

不必客气，

Tell me what is to be done.”
该怎么办请你分派。”

“Then I shall take the liberty.
“那我就放肆了！

First, I think this should remain between the two of us.”
我想，第一，这话只有你老跟我两人晓得。”

“Certainly.
“当然！”

Your Yang clan’s hall is called the Hall of the Four Knowings: Heaven knows, Earth knows, you know, and I know.”
胡雪岩说，“你们杨家的堂名叫‘四知’，天知、地知、你知、我知。”

“Yes.
“是。

Second, I should like to go there first.
第二，我想我先去一趟，

Please wait for my news before approaching Commissioner He.”
请胡大叔听我的消息，再去见何学台。”

“Of course.
“那也是一定的。

The other side must agree before we can go on to discuss terms.”
总要那方面点了头，才好进一步谈条件。”


“You understand perfectly.
“你老最明白不过，

I need say no more,” Yang said.
那我就不必多说了。”杨凤毛说，

“I shall leave at once to see my master, and return within a day and a night at most.”
“我马上赶去见我师父，最多一昼夜的工夫，一定赶回来。”

“Your master is probably in Songjiang.
“你师父怕是在松江，

我们一起去也可以。”

“No.
“不！

He is not in Songjiang.”
不在松江。”

不在松江在哪里呢？

Yang did not say, and Hu could hardly ask.
他不说，胡雪岩也不便问，

But one thing was now perfectly clear to him: Yang knew exactly where Yu Wucheng was.
不过心里已经雪亮，俞武成的行踪，杨凤毛一定清楚。

说是最多一昼夜定能赶回来，则隐藏之地亦决不会远。

“There is no time to lose.
“事不宜迟。

I shall leave now.”
我现在就走。”

Yang gave a solemn reminder.
杨凤毛郑重叮嘱：

我人不到一定有信到。”

After he left, Qiu naturally asked about their conversation.
等杨凤毛告辞，裘丰言自然要问起谈话的情形。

Hu kept his promise and revealed nothing.
胡雪岩谨守约定，只字不吐，

只笑着说：

几台花酒吃下来，就有好消息了。”

Greatly relieved, Qiu went off happily with Liu.
裘丰言宽心大放，喜滋滋地跟着刘不才走了。

Left alone, Hu quietly reviewed everything that had happened and felt that he had chosen the right course.
胡雪岩一个人静了下来，将前后经过情形细想了一遍，觉得自己的路子走对了，

Whether it would work would be clear by this time tomorrow; he could leave it alone for now.
走得通，走不通，明日此时，可见分晓，且不去管它。

He had a whole day before him.
眼前有一整天的工夫，

Time was gold and should not be wasted.
光阴如金，不该虚耗，

He could use it to make some headway with the Pan family’s commission and Sister A’qiao’s future.
正好将潘家所托，以及阿巧姐的终身，办出个头绪来。

For that he needed Zhou Yiming.
这就得找周一鸣了。

奇怪的是一早不见他的面，

只好留下话，如果来了，让他在金阊栈等候，

然后坐轿进城，先去拜访何桂清。

何桂清将他请到书斋，执手寒暄，极其殷勤，自然要问起如何又到了苏州？

办得差不多了。”

“喔！”何桂清很高兴地问：“是怎样一个人？”

“For virtue, the upper of the three middle grades; for looks, the middle of the three upper grades; for talent, the highest grade of all.
“德是中上，貌是上中，才是上上，

将来体贴殷勤，一定没话可说。”

Since A’qiao had already taken a fancy to He, Hu assumed that she would be exceptionally compliant once she entered his household, and so made this sweeping promise.
胡雪岩因为阿巧姐自己看中过何桂清，料想进了何家的门，必然驯顺非凡，所以此时夸下这样的海口。

He naturally believed him.
何桂清当然相信他的话，

Overjoyed, he could not help rubbing his hands.
喜心翻倒，忍不住搓着手说：

“Could I meet her?”
“能不能见一面？”

“A little patience, Mr Genyun,” Hu said with a smile.
“请云公稍安毋躁。”胡雪岩笑道：

“As soon as you reach Shanghai, you can see her.”
“几时到了上海，立刻就能见面。”

After all, He was a senior official of the second rank and could not appear indecently eager.
到底身分是二品大员，不便做出猴急相，

He forced himself to restrain his itching desire and composed himself.
何桂清只得强自按捺着那颗痒痒的心，定一定神答道：

“The weather will soon be hot.
“天气快热了。

A long journey in the height of summer is a great hardship, so I should like to leave a little earlier.
炎暑长行，一大苦事，我想早一点走。

By my reckoning, the imperial instructions must arrive within the next few days.”
算日子，也就在这几天必有旨意。”

“Then you should be able to set off by the middle of the fifth month.”
“这样说起来，总在五月中就可以动身了。”

“Yes.”
“对了。”

“Shall we make a provisional arrangement for the fifteenth day of the fifth month?”
“那我跟云公暂且作个约定，以五月十五为期，如何？”

“Very well.
“好的。

I shall make my plans accordingly.” He continued, “I have attended to the matter you entrusted to me.
我也照这个日子去作安排。”何桂清又说：“你托我的事，我替你办了。

Pan Shuya is a cultivated fellow, and we now see one another often.
潘叔雅人倒不俗，我们现在常有往来。

He is kind enough to send frequent gifts.
承他的情，常有馈遗，

I have thought of declining them, but since he is a friend of yours, that might seem discourteous.
想辞谢吧，是你老兄面上的朋友，似乎不恭，

I could only accept them with some embarrassment.”
只好愧受了。”


His words showed that he was quite willing to condescend to a friendship with Pan Shuya.
话中是很愿屈尊交潘叔雅这样一个朋友，

Pan’s respect for him was equally plain in those frequent visits and gifts.
而后叔雅对他的尊敬，则从“常有往来，常有馈遗”这些话中，表现得明明白白。

Bringing the two together had been Hu’s intention, and he was naturally pleased.
胡雪岩的愿意，就是要替他们拉拢，所以听得何桂清的话，当然感到欣慰。

Courtesy required an acknowledgment.
照规矩，他亦还需有所表示，

“Your kindness extends from me to my friends, Mr Genyun, and I feel it as though it were shown to myself,” he said, clasping his hands.
“云公爱屋及乌，真是感同身受。”他拱拱手说。

“Not at all, not at all!”
“哪里，哪里！”

He thought of the saying that after only three days apart one must look at a man with fresh eyes.
何桂清心里在想，真叫“三日不见，刮目相看”，

They had been separated for so short a time, yet Hu had learnt to turn a literary phrase!
相隔没有多少日子，不想他也会掉文了！

Even if it was merely a conventional expression from letter-writing, it was a creditable accomplishment.
虽是尺牍上的套话，总算难能可贵，

Smiling, he said, “Brother Xueyan, in no time at all your conversation has become quite different.
这样想着，便又笑道：“雪岩兄，曾几何时，你的谈吐大不相同，

How pleasing!”
可喜之至。”

Hu looked a little embarrassed.
胡雪岩略有窘色，

“You flatter me, Mr Genyun.”
“叫云公见笑！”

He abruptly changed the subject.
他急转直下地说：

“There is something on which I should like your advice.”
“有件事，想跟云公请教。”

He glanced at the attendant by the door.
说着，他看了看站在门口的听差。

Understanding that an important confidence was coming, He dismissed the man, moved from the seat opposite Hu to the place beside him on the less honoured side, and inclined his head to listen.
这是有要紧话说，何桂清便吩咐听差回避，然后由对面换到胡雪岩下首，侧过头来，等他发话。


“I should like to ask you about a certain matter, Mr Genyun,” Hu began in a low voice.
“我想请教云公一件事，”胡雪岩低声说道，

“There is a group of men who lost their heads for a time and wrongly took up arms against the government.
“现在有一批人，一时糊涂，误犯官军，

They are anxious to mend their ways.
很想改过，

Could the court give them a chance to make a fresh start?”
不知道朝廷能不能给他们一条自新之路？”

“Why ever not?
“怎么不能？

That would be an excellent thing!”
这是件绝好之事！”

He grew highly excited.
何桂清大为兴奋，

“Where are these men?”
“这批人是哪里的？”

Hu would certainly not disclose that.
问到这话，胡雪岩当然不肯泄底，

“The request reached me through intermediaries.
“我亦是辗转受人之托，

The man handling it is very cautious and will not yet give the details.
来手做事很慎重，详情还不肯说。

But the person who approached me is someone I trust.
不过，托我的那人，是我相信得过的。

I too thought it a good thing, and knowing that you have both courage and a willingness to act, I came expressly for your advice.”
我也觉得这是件好事，心想云公是有魄力、肯做事的人，所以特地来请教。”

He paused.
他略停一下又说：

“What I need now is your word: can it be done?
“如今我要讨云公一句话，此事可行与否？

Does the court have any regulations for granting assurances or rewards?”
朝廷可有什么安抚奖励的章程？”

“They are all subjects of the court.
“一般都是朝廷的子民，

If they repent and reform, the court will naturally treat them generously.
如能悔过自新，朝廷自然优容，

Such assurances and rewards are therefore left to the provincial authorities to arrange as circumstances require.
所以安抚奖励，都责成疆吏，相机处理。”何桂清又说，

I asked where they were because we must see whose jurisdiction they come under.
“我为什么要问这批人在哪里，就是要看看归谁管，

West of Suzhou, around Changzhou, Zhenjiang, and Yangzhou, they would fall under the Jiangnan and Jiangbei Grand Camps.
如果是苏州以西，常州、镇、扬一带，归江南、江北两大营，

Even Governor-General Yi would find it difficult to intervene.
怡制台都难过问。

But east of Suzhou, Governor Xu is a fellow graduate of my year.
倘或是苏州以东，许中丞是我同年，

I can speak to him, and everything will be easier.”
我可以跟他说，诸事都好办。”

Hu was secretly delighted.
听得这话，胡雪岩暗暗心喜，

“Then I shall ascertain the facts and report back to you.
“那么，等我问清了再回报云公。

But I imagine,” he ventured, “that winning men over generally comes down to giving them appointments and paying them.
不过，”胡雪岩试探着问：“我想，招抚总不外有官做、有饷领，

Would you agree?”
云公，你说是不是呢？

“Appointments are certain.
““给官做是一走的，

According to their numbers and their weapons, they would be reorganized as government troops and commissions issued for suitable posts.
看那方面人数多少，枪械如何，改编为官军，要下委札派相当的官职。

As for pay, at most they could receive a special gratuity when they first came over.
饷呢，至多只能过来的时候，关一次恩饷，

Afterwards, it would depend on whose command they entered; the military finance office would arrange their regular pay.”
以后看是归谁节制，自有‘粮台’统筹发放。”


This was what Hu had expected.
胡雪岩所想象的，亦是如此。

Appointments and pay, however, belonged to the second stage of negotiation.
只是授官给饷，都还在第二步争取，

First there was something of far greater importance that he had to establish.
首先有句话，关系极重，不能不问清楚。

“Mr Genyun,” he said, deliberately assuming a grave, anxious expression, “I have heard that in some places men who laid down their arms and accepted pacification were badly deceived, and regretted it when it was too late.
“云公，”他特意摆出担忧的沉重脸色，“我听说有些地方弃械就抚的，结果上了大当，悔之莫及。

Is there any truth in that?”
不知可有这话？”

“You mean the killing of men who surrender?”
“你是说‘杀降’？”

He shook his head emphatically.
何桂清大摇其头，

“Since ancient times we have been warned that killing those who surrender brings ill fortune.
“杀降不祥，古有明训。

If you entrust this affair to me, I shall take care over that even without your asking.
这件事你托到我，就是你不说，我也一定要当心。

Why should I bring such evil upon myself for no reason?
你想想，我无缘无故来造这个孽干什么？

And how could I answer to you?”
再说，我对你又怎么交代？”

“Of course, of course!”
“是！是！”

Hu rose hastily and bowed.
胡雪岩急忙站起来作了个揖：

“I know your kindness to me.
“云公厚爱，我自然知道，

I merely wished to remind you.”
只不过提醒云公而已。”

“Since it is your affair, I am ready to accommodate you in every way.
“是你的事，我无有不好说的。

But it must be done quickly.
不过，这件事要快，

If it is delayed, it will be beyond my reach.”
迟了我就管不到了。”

“I understand.
“我明白，

Within the next two or three days it will certainly be settled one way or the other.
就在这两三天内，此事必有个起落。

There is just one more thing for which I must ask your understanding.
不过还有句话，我要先求云公体谅。”

The people who approached me told me only that such a matter existed.
胡雪岩说：“人家来托我，只是说有这件事，

I know none of the details.
详情如何，一概不知。

Circumstances may change and the whole thing be dropped.
也许别有变化，作为罢论，

If that happens, I beg you not to pursue it.”
到那时候，我求云公不要追究。”

“Naturally.
“当然。

I shall not make trouble.”
我不会多事的。”

“And please do not mention it to anyone.”
“还要求云公不必跟人谈起。”

“I understand.
“我知道，我知道。

If it is dropped, I shall behave as though you had never told me.
如果此事作为罢论，我就当根本没有听你说过。

In any event, I shall certainly cause you no difficulties.”
总而言之，我决不会给你惹麻烦。”


“With such consideration from you, Mr Genyun, there will be many more ways in which I can be of service.”
“云公如此体恤，以后我效劳的地方就多了！”

The words carried a deeper meaning.
这句话中有深意，意思是说，

If He would follow Hu’s advice instead of acting on his own initiative, Hu could devise any number of ways to help him gain promotion and wealth.
只要何桂清肯言听计从，不是自作主张，他就会有许多办法拿出来，帮何桂清升官发财。

“That is exactly the assistance I hope to rely on,” He replied.
“正要倚重。”何桂清说：

“I have the greatest admiration for your extraordinary commercial gifts.
“老兄阛阓奇才，佩服之至。

A few days ago I received another long letter from Xuexuan, telling me how much you had done for him.
前几天又接得雪轩的长函，说老兄帮了他许多忙。

My friendship with him is no ordinary one.
我跟雪轩的交情，不同泛泛，

In future, I hope you will treat me as you treat him.”
以后要请老兄以待雪轩者待我！”

This led them into reminiscence, and the talk went on and on.
于是由此又开始叙旧，一谈就谈得无休无止。

Many other visitors arrived; He instructed his attendant to seat them in the reception pavilion, yet repeatedly put off seeing them while he continued to entertain Hu.
许多客来拜访，何桂清都吩咐听差，请在花厅里坐，却迟迟不肯出见，尽自应酬胡雪岩。

This made Hu uncomfortable, and he also had many matters still to attend to.
这让客人很不安，同时也因为还有许多事要料理，

He repeatedly tried to leave, but his host repeatedly detained him, finally insisting that he stay for dinner.
所以一再告辞，而主人一再挽留，最后还要留着吃晚饭，

Hu would not agree.
胡雪岩无论如何不肯。

By the time he managed to take his leave, the sun was almost down.
等到脱身辞了出来，太阳已快下山了。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十七章（下）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Seven, Part Three
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


When the chair bearers asked where to go, Hu hesitated.
轿伕请示去处，胡雪岩有些踌躇，

He ought to call on Third Granny Yu, but it would be inconvenient after dark.
照道理要去看一看三婆婆，却又怕天黑了不方便。

If he returned to Jinchang Inn, there would be no reason to come into the city again, and wasting the whole evening at the inn seemed a pity.
如果回到金阊栈，则出了城就无需再进城，这一夜白耗费在客栈里未免可惜。

Caught between the two, he thought of a third destination: Pan Shuya's house.
左右为难之下，想到了第三个去处，去拜访潘叔雅。

Yet a call after dark might seem discourteous.
不过天黑拜客，似乎礼貌有亏，

Besides, Pan would ask about the business he had entrusted to him, and Hu needed to consider his answer carefully.
而且一见要谈到他所托的事，如何应付，预先得好好想一想，

Better not meet him in haste.
仓促之间，还是以不见面为宜。

Then he thought of a fourth possibility.
于是又想到了第四个去处，

“Tell me, do you know where a famous courtesan called Huang Yinbao lives?”
“喂！”他问轿伕：“有个有名的姑娘，叫黄银宝，住在哪里，你晓不晓得？”

The bearer smiled apologetically.
轿伕歉然赔笑：

“I'm afraid not.”
“这倒不晓得了。”

“Where are most of the houses in Suzhou?”
“苏州的堂子，多在哪一带？”

“Along Shantang.
“多在山塘。

Dingjia Lane in Shangtang has the most.
上塘丁家巷最多。”轿伕建议：

We could carry you there and ask.”
“我们抬了胡老爷到那里问一问就知道了。”

Hu had no time to search from house to house for a beauty.
一家一家去访艳，胡雪岩觉得无此闲工夫，大可不必。

Even if he found her, it would mean no more than drinking with Qiu Fengyan in her company; nothing useful would be done.
而且就寻到了，无非陪着裘丰言吃一顿花酒，也干不了什么正经。

He made up his mind: back to the inn first.
这样一想，便断然决定了主意，回客栈再说。


As soon as he reached Jinchang Inn, he saw Zhou Yiming, who greeted him as though he had found a treasure.
一到金阊栈，迎面就看到周一鸣，一见胡雪岩如获至宝，

“Mr Hu!
“胡先生，胡先生！”

I've been waiting all afternoon.”
他说，“等了你老一下午。”

Before Hu could answer, a young man stepped forward.
胡雪岩未及答言，只见又闪出来一个后生，

Tall, fair and extremely presentable, he had a delicate, almost feminine face.
长得高大白皙，极其体面，那张脸生得很清秀，而且带点脂粉气，

Hu felt he had seen him somewhere before and stood speechless for a moment.
胡雪岩觉得仿佛在哪里见过似地，一时愣在那里，忘了说话。

“This is Fushan,” Zhou explained.
“他叫福山。”周一鸣说，

“A’qiao's brother.”
“是阿巧姐的兄弟。”

“No wonder!
“怪不得！”

I thought you looked familiar, as though we'd met before.
胡雪岩恍然大悟，“我说好面熟，象是以前见过！

That explains it.
这就不错了，

You and your sister look very much alike.”
你跟你姐姐长得很相象。”

Somewhat shyly, Fushan said, “Master Hu.”
福山有些腼腆，“胡老爷！”

His Suzhou accent sounded even more feminine.
那一口苏州话中的脂粉气更浓，

Then he knelt and kowtowed.
然后，跪了下去磕头。

“Get up, please!”
“请起来，请起来！”

His sister had specifically insisted on this courtesy.
福山是他姐姐特地关照过的，非磕头不可，

Hu had to pull and lift him to his feet.
胡雪岩连拖带拉把他弄了起来，

He was very pleased, though he could not tell whether it was the young man's fine appearance or affection extending from the sister to the brother that pleased him.
心里十分高兴，但他自己也不知道是因为福山长得体面，还是爱屋及乌的缘故。

“I went to Mudu early this morning,” Zhou said, “especially to bring him to meet you.”
“我一大早到木渎去了。特地把他带了出来见胡先生。”周一鸣说。


“No wonder you didn't come this morning.”
“怪道，早晨等你不来。”

Hu turned to Fushan.
胡雪岩接着又转脸来问福山：

“How old are you?”
“你今年几岁？”

“Nineteen.”
“十九岁。”

“You've been learning the cloth trade?”
“学的布店生意？”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

“For how many years?
“有几年了？”

Have you finished your apprenticeship?”
胡雪岩问，“满师了没有？”

“I finished a year ago.”
“满师满了一年了。”

In only a few questions, three discrepancies had emerged.
只问了两句话，倒有三处不符的地方。

Hu's memory was excellent, and he remembered what A’qiao had told him.
胡雪岩的记性极好，记得阿巧姐告诉过他的话，因而问道：

“Isn't your childhood name A’shun?”
“你的小名不是叫阿顺吗？”

“Yes.
“是的。”

When I entered the cloth shop, the proprietor called me Fushan, and the name stuck.”
福山答道，“进布店学生意，老板叫我福山，就这样叫开了。”

“I remember your sister saying you were eighteen and hadn't finished your apprenticeship.”
“我记得你姐姐说你今年十八岁，还没有满师。”

“I'm nineteen.
“我是十九岁。

My sister remembered wrong.”
我姐姐记错了。”

“But surely she couldn't be mistaken about whether you'd finished?” Zhou explained for him. “You could say he has, or that he hasn't.
“那么，你满师不满师，你姐姐总不会记错的罗？”“也可以说满师，也可以说不满师。”周一鸣代为解释：

His training is complete, but by custom he must serve his master for another three years.
“他学生意是学满了，照例要‘帮师三年’，

That term isn't finished yet.”
还没有帮满。”

“Is everything settled now?” Hu asked Zhou.
“现在都弄妥当了？”胡雪岩看着周一鸣问。

“All settled.
“早已弄妥当。”

We've got his apprenticeship contract back.”
周一鸣答道，“ ‘关书’已经拿了回来。”

“Good.”
“那好。”

He turned to Fushan again.
胡雪岩又问福山，

“Your sister has entrusted you to me.
“你姐姐拿你托付给我，

Tell me, what would you like to do?”
我倒要问你，你想做点啥？”

“I should like Master Hu to...”
“要请胡老爷……”

“Don't call me Master,” Hu interrupted.
“不要叫老爷！”胡雪岩打断他的话说，

“Call me Mr Hu.”
“叫先生好了。”

“Yes, sir!”
“噢！”

Fushan too had found “Master” awkward on his tongue and gladly adopted the new form of address.
福山也觉得叫“老爷”碍口，所以欣然应声：“先生！”


“Since you've learned the cloth business, I suppose you can judge silks and satins?”
“你是学布生意的，对绸缎总识货罗？”

“I can, but the shop was small and didn't stock much.
“识是识。不过那爿布店不大，货色不多，

There are some costly silks I've never seen.”
有些贵重绸缎没有见过。”

“That doesn't matter.
“那倒不要紧，

I'll take you to Shanghai, where you'll have the chance.
我带你到上海，自然见识得到。”

The most important tool in business is an abacus.”
胡雪岩又说，“做生意最要紧一把算盘。”

“He's good with one,” Zhou put in.
“他的算盘打得好。”周一鸣插嘴说道：

“Very quick.”
“飞快！”

“Then let me test you.
“噢，我倒考考你。

Get an abacus and sit down.”
你拿把算盘坐下来。”

Once Fushan was ready, Hu casually gave him a problem.
等福山准备好了，胡雪岩随口出了一个题目，

Four bolts of cloth cost ten taels in all.
四匹布一共十两银子，

Their lengths differed: forty-seven, fifty-six, thirty-two and forty-nine chi.
每匹布的尺寸不同，四丈七、五丈六、三丈二、四丈九，

What was the price per chi?
问每尺布合到多少银子？

He spoke quickly.
他说得很快，

Besides testing the boy's abacus, he wanted to test his intelligence.
用意是考福山的算盘之外，还要考他的智慧。

If he could remember all those troublesome figures after hearing them once, he had promise.
如果这些罗里罗嗦的数目，听一遍就能记得清楚，便是可造之材。

Fushan did not disappoint him.
福山不负所望，

His fingers flew, and the beads clicked briskly and smoothly.
五指翻飞，将算盘珠拨得清脆流利，

The sound alone, like “large and small pearls falling onto a jade dish”, showed an expert hand.
只听那“大珠小珠落玉盘”似的声音，就知道是好手。

When it stopped, he reported, “The four bolts total a hundred and eighty-four chi.
等声音一停，报告结果：“四匹布一共一百八十四尺，

At ten taels altogether, each chi costs five li, four hao, three si and four hu of a tael, with a fraction left over.”
总价十两，每尺合到五厘四毫三丝四忽挂零。”

胡雪岩亲自拿算盘复了一遍，果然不错，

深为满意。便点点头说：

“你做生意是学得出来的。

不过，光是记性好、算盘打得快，别样本事不行，只能做小生意。

Large business needs another set of skills, more than I can explain at once.
做大生意是另外一套本事，一时也说不尽。

你跟着我，慢慢自会明白，

今天我先告诉你一句话：要想吃得开，一定要说话算话。

所以答应人家之前，先要自己想一想，做得到，做不到？

做不到的事，不可答应人家，答应了人家一定要做到。”

他一路说，福山一路深深点头，等胡雪岩说完，他恭恭敬敬地答一声：“我记牢了！”

“城里不熟。”

“那么，山塘呢？”

“山塘熟的。”福山问道，

“先生要问山塘啥地方？”

“I'm not going myself.

I want you to run an errand.
想请你去跑一趟。

There's a courtesan called Huang Yinbao.
有个姑娘叫黄银宝，

Two friends of mine are there, one named Qiu and one Liu.
我有两个朋友在那里，一个姓裘，一个姓刘，

你看看他们在那里做什么？回来告诉我。”胡雪岩紧紧接着又说，“你不要让他们知道，有人在打听他们。”

不过，他这种小后生，到那种地方去，总不大相宜！”

我看他那个样子，早就在迷魂阵里闯过一阵子了。

我倒不是考他，就是要看看他那路门径熟不熟？”

Better enter the garden of pleasure young than in old age.

我用人跟别人不同，

别人要少年老成，

我要年纪轻的有才干、有经验，什么事看过经过，

到了要紧关头，才不会着迷上当。”

这番见解，在周一鸣不曾听说过，

一时无话可答，仔细想想，似乎也有些道理。

不过，他在想，年轻后生，一个个都见过世面，经过阵仗，学得调皮捣蛋，驾驭可就不容易了。

“也只有胡先生，有本事吃得住他们。”周一鸣毕竟想通了，

Other people wouldn't dare do things your way.”
“旁人不敢象胡先生这样子做法。”

“Exactly!”
“对！”

Hu was pleased.
胡雪岩表示欣慰，

“Now you understand me.”
“你算是懂得我了。”

Zhou still worried about Fushan. “But he hasn't much money.
“不过，”周一鸣又替福山担心，“他身上没有什么钱，

就找到了黄家，那种‘门口’怎么踏得进去？”

不去管他。

我倒问你，阿巧姐怎么样？”


“Still at the Pans'.

Fushan's business was settled only two or three days before you arrived.

如果你老不来，我已经带着福山回上海。

现在是怎么样一个情形，请胡先生吩咐。”“唉！”胡雪岩摇摇头，

你问的话，我现在无法告诉你，

你跟福山先住下来再说。

于是周一鸣到楼房去作安排，

胡雪岩一个人倚枕假寝，心里一桩一桩的事在想。

发觉自己犯了个极大的错误，因而想到一句话：“君子务本”。

His own essentials were banking first and silk second.
自己的根本，第一是钱庄，第二是丝。

For the bank, Pan Shuya's money was ready to hand.
钱庄现成有潘叔雅的一笔钱在那里，

New silk would soon reach the Huzhou market.
丝则湖州方面的新丝又将上市，

Was he going to trade in it this year, and if so, how?
今年是不是还做这生意？要做是怎么个做法？

He must decide promptly and tell Chen Shilong what to do.
得要赶快拿定主意，通知陈世龙去办。

这样子专管闲事，耽误了正经，将来是个不了之局。

于是，他当机立断，作了个决定，

Tomorrow he would hear what Yang Fengmao had to say.
只等明天杨凤毛回来，看怎么说，

If the business proved troublesome, he would follow Qiu's suggestion and leave the guns in Shanghai for the time being, then hurry back to Zhejiang with the Seventh Lady and attend to real work.
事情如果麻烦，只好照裘丰言的办法，把那批洋枪丢在上海再说，自己赶紧陪着七姑奶奶回浙江去干正经，

He would deal with other matters if he could; if not, they must wait.
闲事能管则管，不能管的只好丢下再说。

想停当了，便又另有一番筹划，将能管的闲事，派定了人去管，
