第一个是刘不才，可以管潘家的事，第二个是周一鸣，可以管何桂清跟阿巧姐的事。

多少天来积压在心头的沉重之感，就由于这样一转念间，大见轻松，

然而三件闲事毕竟有一件不能不管，

心思集中，顾虑便能周详，心里在想：

何必路远迢迢先回杭州，再转湖州？

There was a canal from Suzhou to Huzhou.
由苏州到湖州，现成的一条运河，

Suzhou lay east of Lake Tai and Huzhou south of it; that ought to be the shorter route.
算起位置来，苏州在太湖之东，湖州在太湖之南，应该是条捷径。

“胡先生是问运河？”

I've travelled it.

到了平望分两支，

一支往南到嘉兴叫南塘河，

一共一百二十里路。”

Hu made up his mind.
于是胡雪岩打定了主意，

He trimmed the candle, ground ink and wrote a letter himself.
剪烛磨墨，亲笔写好一封信，

“ 都是那里的人，娘姨、小大姐，拥了一屋子。”

Only Mr Qiu is drinking.” Hu laughed.
福山又说，“只有裘老爷一个人在吃酒。”胡雪岩笑了：

“One a drunkard, the other a gambler.

到哪里都一样。”

怎么晓得是他们两位？”

“I know an attendant there.
“那里有个‘相帮’，我认识，”他说，

He's from Mudu too.

我托他领我进去看的。”

这就见得胡雪岩说他“在迷魂阵里闯过一阵”的话，有点道理了。

福山刚受了鼓励，因而自告奋勇，

胡先生有啥事，我去好了。”

这意思是，盘缠费用，实报实销，

不宜说破，

胡雪岩这才明白，杨凤毛所以要先回俞家，

Wujiang's county town was tiny; people joked that a shout of “Hello” at the east gate would be answered at the west.
吴江县城极小，有人说笑话，东门喊一声“喂”，西门会有人答应，

““我晓得，我晓得。

But although your elder brother is no longer young, some of the things he says and does are very immature.
不过，你大哥虽说年纪也一大把，说实在的，有时候做出来的事、说出来的话嫩得很，

He's far less seasoned than Fengmao, and farther still from you.”
远不如凤毛来得老到。比姑爷你，那就差得更远了。”

Hu smiled. “Mother, you make him sound so bad that even I feel inclined to defend him.”
“干娘！”胡雪岩笑道，“你把大哥说成这个样子，连我都有点替他不服。”

“He's my own son, and my only one.
“是我自己的儿子，而且就是他一个，

Why would I deliberately belittle him?
哪有故意贬他的道理？

It's simply the truth.
实在情形是如此！

Before outsiders, I must cover his shortcomings.
在外人面前，我做娘的，要替他遮羞，

Before you, I needn't.
在你面前我不必。

You'll see in time.
你以后就知道了。

What I ask is really a warning: if Wucheng says or does anything improper, please bear with him for my sake.”
现在我要重托你，其实是跟你打个招呼，如果武成说话、行事有什么不上路的地方，你看我的面子！“


Hu found this puzzling, but there was no time to examine it closely.
这番话说得胡雪岩莫明其妙，但此时亦无暇去细作推敲，

He readily agreed.
只满口应承下来。

“Set your mind at rest.
“干娘，你请放心。

When I meet him, I'll respect him as my own elder brother.
我这趟去，见了大哥，自然当自己长兄一样敬他。”

He's always had a great tree to shelter under, and I've heard that he's had a young master's temper from childhood.
胡雪岩又说，“大哥是‘大树下面好乘凉’，我也听说了，他从小就是公子哥儿的脾气，

Whatever he may say, I certainly won't take offence.”
倘或有什么话，我自不敢跟他计较！”

“Son-in-law!”
“姑爷！”

Third Granny Yu was moved.
俞三婆婆激动地说，

“Those words are a blessing to the Yu family.
“有你这两句话，就是我们俞家之福。

I need say no more.
我什么话也不用说了，

When you return, I'll give you a proper welcome.”
等你回来，我好好替你接风。

“A welcome and a celebration of success,” Hu added to please her.
““不光是接风，”胡雪岩凑她的兴说，“还要庆功！”

“May your golden words come true.”
但愿如你金口。

She turned and called, “My lady, come out.”
“三婆婆转脸喊道：”姑奶奶，你请出来吧！

She meant Furong.
“她口中的姑仍奶便是芙蓉，

With Yang present, Furong had not felt free to appear earlier.
因为有杨凤毛在，先不便露面，

At the summons, she came out with measured, dignified steps.
此时听得呼唤，才踏着极稳重的步子走了出来。

“These past two days have counted as a visit to your mother's home.
“这两天你算是‘回门’，

Your husband has come to fetch you today.
今天姑爷来接，

Go back together.”
你们一起回去吧！”


If Furong went back now, she would have to return tomorrow when Hu left for Tongli.
今天去了，明天胡雪岩到同里，还得回来，

Why make the needless journey?
何必多此一举？

Staying where she was would also demonstrate her devotion to her new mother.
一动不如一静，反可以显出自己的“孝心”。

Furong paid close attention to such social considerations.
芙蓉对人情世故也很留意的，

Having decided, she smiled.
这样打定了主意，便笑着答道：

“I'm more comfortable here with you, Mother.
“还是在干娘这里舒服，

I'm not going back.”
我不回去！”

Hu did not want her to go back either.
胡雪岩也不愿她回去，

That night he had matters to discuss with Liu and Qiu.
因为这一夜要跟刘不才、裘丰言有所商议，

They might talk late, or go to Huang Yinbao's to drink through the night.
也许谈得很晚，也许到黄银宝那里作长夜之饮，

With Furong present, he would have to watch both his words and his movements.
有芙蓉在，言语行动都不免顾忌，

Her answer suited him perfectly, and he supported it at once.
所以听得她的答语，正中下怀，随即便帮了两句腔。

“Let her stay and keep you company.
“让芙蓉在这里陪你老人家，

I'll fetch her when I return from Tongli.”
等我同里回来，再来接她。”

“As you please.
“随你们的便。

This is your home too.
好在我这里也是你们的家。”三婆婆又说：

Or you could stay here yourself.”
“或者你就住在这里也好。”

“There's no need.
“那不必了，

Brother Fengmao and I still have a little business to discuss.”
我跟凤毛兄，还有点事要商量。”

Hu seized the chance to take his leave.
胡雪岩趁机告辞：

“We set off early tomorrow, so I'll say goodbye now.”
“明天一早就走。我此刻就跟干娘辞行。”

He bowed.
于是作了个揖，

After exchanging reminders and good wishes, he and Qiu found Liu at a gambling table.
彼此叮咛了一番，胡雪岩跟裘丰言在赌桌上找到刘不才，

Yang accompanied them back to Jinchang Inn, where they agreed when to board the boat next day.
由杨凤毛陪着一起回金阊栈，约定了第二天上船的时刻，

He then left.
杨凤毛随即辞去。


“I don't think Yu Wucheng will be easy to deal with.”
“我看俞武成不大好对付。”

Hu looked troubled.
胡雪岩面有忧色，

“I must have another force in reserve.” He asked Zhou, “Do you know Tongli?”
“我要另外安一支伏兵。”他问周一鸣：“同里地方你熟不熟？”

“I know all the waterways and landing places in this district.”
“这一带的水路码头，我都熟的。”

“Good.”
“那好！

Hu turned to Qiu. “Once we've left tomorrow, you and Old Zhou follow us.
明天等我们一走，”胡雪岩对裘丰言说，“你跟老周随后赶了来，

Find an inn, stay there and wait for my message.
找一家客栈住下，听我的招呼，

You'll have to put up with it for a day or two.
你们要委屈一两天，

Neither of you must leave.”
一步不可走开。”

“Very well.”
“好！”

Qiu smiled.
裘丰言笑道：

“I've bought two collections of poetry and haven't opened them yet.
“我买了两部诗集子，还没有打开过，

I can drink and read at the inn.”
正好在客栈里吃酒读诗。”

“Exactly.
“对！

That will do.” Hu asked Zhou, “Which inn?
就这样好了。”胡雪岩又问周一鸣：“在哪家客栈？

Decide now.”
你先说定了它！”

Zhou thought for a moment.
周一鸣想了想答道：

“I can't recall any inn in Tongli.
“同里的客栈倒想不起了。

Whenever I've passed through, I've stayed on the boat or at a friend's house.
每趟经过同里，不是住在船上，就是住在我一个朋友家，

I've never used an inn.”
从没有住过客栈。”

“Then we'll send messages through your friend's house,” Liu suggested.
“那就在你朋友家通消息好了。”刘不才说。

“Good.
“好的。

He's in your line of business, Third Master Liu.
我那个朋友跟刘三爷你是同行，

Go to East Street in Tongli and ask for the proprietor of Yanghetang Pharmacy.
到同里东大街，问养和堂药店老板，

You'll find me.”
就找到我了。”

Hu nodded.
胡雪岩点点头说：

“Settled.
“就这样！

Once you've found lodgings, Old Qiu must stay out of sight.
你们到了同里，找地方住定以后，老裘不要露面，

Old Zhou can inquire along the waterfront about what Yu Wucheng is doing in Tongli.
老周不妨到水路上去打听打听，俞武成在同里干些啥？

But keep it discreet.”
不过，老周，事情要做得隐秘。”

“I understand.”
“我晓得。”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十八章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Eight, Part One
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER TWENTY-EIGHT｜第二十八章


Only after arranging for this reserve force did Hu Xueyan feel at ease.
安下了这支伏兵，胡雪岩才算放下心来。

Early the next morning, he had just finished washing and dressing when Yang Fengmao arrived.
第二天一早起身，漱洗穿戴，刚刚停当，杨凤毛就到了，

They breakfasted together and boarded the boat waiting at the Chang Gate landing.
一起吃了早饭上船。船就停在阊门码头，

The two oars flew.
双桨如飞，

They passed beneath Wujiang’s famous Chuihong Bridge and reached Tongli at noon.
穿过吴江有名的垂虹桥，中午时分就到了同里。

The boat drew up at the back door of a house; once they stepped onto the landing, they had arrived.
船是停在一人家后门口，踏上埠头，就算到了目的地。

On the journey Yang had explained that their hosts, the Zhu family, were rice merchants.
在船上，胡雪岩就听杨凤毛谈过，这家人家做米行生意，姓朱，

The eldest Zhu brother was a disciple of Yu Wucheng, and therefore Yang’s junior fellow disciple.
朱家老大是俞武成的徒弟，也就是杨凤毛的后弟。

Whenever Yu came to Tongli, he stayed here.
俞武成只要一到同里，就住他家，

Eldest Brother Zhu treated his master with the greatest respect, so Hu and Liu Bucai could also make the house their quarters.
朱老大待师父极其恭敬，所以胡雪岩、刘不才不妨亦以朱家为居停。

Hu had left all the arrangements to Yang.
胡雪岩此来一切听从杨凤毛的安排，

Although he thought it might be inconvenient to stay with a family he had never met, he could hardly object.
虽觉得住在素昧平生的朱家，可能会十分不便，但亦不便表示异议，

Fortunately, Zhu was attentive and easy-going.
幸好朱老大殷勤随和，

They took to one another at first sight, and much of Hu’s anticipated discomfort disappeared.
一见之下，颇觉投缘，把那嫌拘束的感觉，消除了许多。

After introductions and greetings, Zhu said to Yang, “Elder Brother, Master has gone to Qingpu.
引见寒暄以后，朱老大随即向杨凤毛说道：“大哥，师父到青浦去了，

If he does not return tonight, he will certainly be back tomorrow morning.
今天晚上如果不回来，明天早晨一定到。

He asked you to apologise to our honoured guests for his absence, and said they must stay here.”
临走留下话，请大哥代为向贵客道歉，失迎不安。又说，请贵客一定住在这里。”

He turned to Hu and Liu.
说到这里，面向胡雪岩和刘不才：

“Our house is small.
“舍间太小，

I fear we cannot entertain you properly and shall put you to some inconvenience.” Hu naturally replied with the customary thanks and modest assurances.
只怕款待不周，让两位委屈。”于是胡雪岩少不得也有几句谦谢的门面话，

As he did so, he considered how to make good use of the half-day ahead rather than let it go to waste.
一面应酬，一面在心里转念头，觉得这半天的工夫，白耗费了可惜，应该如何想法子的好好利用。


Before he had decided, a servant came to announce lunch.
念头还没有转定，朱家的佣工来请吃饭，

In this land of fish and rice, food was plentiful and delicious.
鱼米之乡，饮食丰美，

An ordinary meal resembled a banquet, yet Zhu still said, “Forgive this poor reception.
虽是便饭，亦如盛筵，朱老大还说：“简慢不恭，

Tonight we shall give you a proper welcome.”
到晚上替贵客接风。”

Besides the four hosts and guests, three others joined them: the third Zhu brother, the accountant and the family tutor.
同席的除了宾主四人，另外还有三个人作陪，朱家的老三、帐户和教书先生。

They talked pleasantly of Wujiang’s scenery and local life.
席间谈谈吴江的风物，轻松得很。

After lunch Yang asked whether Hu would like to take a nap in the guest room before deciding what to do, or go for a walk.
饭罢，杨凤毛征询胡雪岩的意见，是在朱家客房中睡个午觉起来，再作道理，还是出去走走。

“I have long heard that Tongli is a blessed place.
“久闻同里是个福地，

Let us go and admire it.”
去瞻仰瞻仰吧！”

Accompanied by Yang and Zhu, they went out through the front door, having arrived by the back.
于是由杨凤毛、朱老大陪着，出去走走，后门进来，前门出去。

Before them stretched a long street paved with exceptionally even blue-grey stone slabs, its rows of buildings presenting a remarkably orderly appearance.
一条长街，铺得极平整的青石板，放眼望去，鳞次栉比的楼房，相当整齐。

Nine out of ten passers-by wore silk robes.
街上行人，十九穿的绸衫，

Even country people in straw sandals were dressed in spotless short jackets and trousers of fine blue cotton.
哪怕是穿草鞋的乡下人，都是干干净净的一身细蓝布短衫裤，

Most carried a long pipe of mottled bamboo.
手中多半持一支湘妃竹的早烟袋，

Some wore white-jade thumb rings; others had jade ornaments at their waists.
有的套一个白玉扳指，有的腰上拴一挂玉石佩件。

These villagers alone gave some idea of the grace and refinement of the people of the Wu region.
吴中人物的俊雅，光看这些乡下人，就不难想见了。

Outside a house hung with lanterns and festive decorations, Zhu stopped.
走到一家挂灯结彩的人家，朱老大站住脚说：

“Would you two like to go in and amuse yourselves?”
“两位要不要进去玩玩？”

Several gambling tables were visible through the gate.
从大门中望进去，里面有好几桌赌，

“May strangers go in?” Hu asked.
胡雪岩便问：“不认识的也可以进去吗？”

“Certainly.
“可以，可以，

That is our custom here.”
敝处的风俗是如此。”

They went in and looked about.
于是进去看了看，

There was pai gow and the dice-shaking game.
有牌九、有摇摊。

Hu was interested in local customs and wanted only to observe, so he declined to play.
胡雪岩入境问俗，志在观光，不肯出手，

Liu, following his three rules—keep cool, wait, strike hard—was not yet willing to play either.
刘不才则守着“冷、等、狠”三字诀，不愿出手，

They entered several more houses, making a circuit of each before leaving, until they had almost reached the northern end of the long street.
这样连闯了几家，都是转个圈子就走，由南到北，一条长街快到尽头了。


Neither guest seemed particularly entertained, and Zhu felt uneasy.
因为胡雪岩和刘不才都有些鼓不起兴致来的样子，朱老大颇感不安，

Quietly he asked Yang, “What about calling on Little Jinxiu?”
悄悄向杨凤毛问道：“到小金秀那里去坐坐，怎么样？”

Yang hesitated.
杨凤毛略有些踌躇，

Hu, sharp of hearing and quick of mind, understood that Little Jinxiu must be a celebrated local beauty.
胡雪岩耳朵尖，心思快，听出来小金秀必是当地的一朵“名花”，

A pleasure house was enjoyable only when one went with friends familiar with it; otherwise it could be thoroughly dull.
勾栏人家要熟朋友同去，才有点意思，否则就会索然寡味，

He promptly intervened.
所以赶紧接口：

“Please don’t trouble yourselves.
“不必费心，

A walk like this is quite enough.”
就这样走走很好。”

As they spoke, they came to another lively house, different from the others.
说着话，又到了一处热闹的人家，这家的情形与众不同，

Its stone-framed gate stood wide open.
石库门开得笔直，

Vendors of cooked food stretched from outside the entrance into the house, apparently even into the courtyard beyond the second gate.
许多卖熟食的小贩，由门外延入门内，似乎二门院子里都有。

The people coming and going were not uniformly well dressed as elsewhere, but a mixture of every sort and station.
进出的人物，也不象别家衣冠楚楚地相当整齐，三教九流，龙蛇混杂，

Hu could not make out what kind of establishment it was.
胡雪岩摸不清它是什么路道？

Liu recognised it at once.
刘不才却一望而知，

The others offered private gambling in gentlemen’s studies; this was a true gambling house.
别家是“书房赌”，这一家是真正的赌场。

“If we mean to play, this is the sort of place,” he said.
“如果要玩，就要在这种地方，”他说，

“‘A man who opens a restaurant cannot be afraid of big appetites.’
“ ‘开了饭店不怕大肚汉’，

Here one can gamble freely.”
赌起来爽气。”

Zhu understood and admired his discernment. “Third Master Liu has a good eye!
“刘三爷眼力真好！”朱老大听懂了他的话，由衷地佩服，

This is the only proper gambling house in Tongli.
“真正的赌场，在同里就这一家。

Would you like to look inside?
要不要进去看看？

It is the only place that plays White Star Treasure.”
只有这一家赌‘白星宝’。”

At the name, Liu’s fingers began to itch.
听说是“白星宝”，刘不才技痒了，

“That is a contest of minds.
“这是赌心思！”他问，

It is popular in eastern Zhejiang.
“这种赌在浙东很流行，

How did it reach your town?”
怎么也传到了贵处？”

“It came from eastern Zhejiang originally.”
“原是从浙东传过来的……”

A Shaoxing man named Zhang had opened a distillery in Tongli.
有个绍兴人姓章的，到同里来开酒作坊，

An inveterate gambler, he had first gathered his friends to play behind closed doors.
生性好赌，先是聚集友好，关起门来玩，

Before long others heard of it and joined them, and the operation grew.
不久有人闻风而至，场面便大了，

Just then a new police inspector, Mr Wu, arrived in Tongli.
正好驻同里的巡检换人，

As Zhang’s fellow townsman, he took advantage of the situation, protected him in opening a regular gambling house, and collected a share of the gaming fees without lifting a finger.
新任的吴巡检是章老板的同乡，因势利用，包庇他正式开赌场，而巡检老爷则坐抽头钱，

Money poured in daily; in two years he had amassed a hundred thousand.
日进斗金，两年下来，已经腰缠十万了。

After hearing this account, Liu judged that the play must be substantial and worth a look.
听朱老大说明了来历，刘不才认为一定赌得很硬，不妨进去看看。


In the main hall they found pai gow and the dice-shaking game, but relatively few players.
到了大厅上一看，有牌九，有摇摊，赌客却并不多，

When they passed through a side passage into the second hall, the scene was quite different.
从夹弄穿到二厅，情况就大不相同了，

Three sides of a large square table were packed three rows deep: the first row seated, the second standing, the third standing on benches.
一张大方桌，三面是人，人有三排，第一排坐，第二排立，第三排则站在条凳上，

Shoulders touched shoulders and heads pressed against heads, leaving scarcely a gap.
肩叠着肩，头并着头，挤得水泄不通，

Fortunately Zhu had some local standing.
好在朱老大也是当地有面子的人物，

He found acquaintances willing to make room, and the party squeezed in.
找着熟人情商，才腾出空位，让他们挤了进去。

Whether it was the dice-shaking game of Jiangnan or Cantonese fan-tan, in which counters were gathered and counted, the result was an unknown quantity.
不管是江南用骰子摇的摇摊，广东抓棋子数的番摆，都在未知之数，

White Star Treasure alone was a game whose result could be deliberately set by the house.
只有白星宝是庄家可以操纵的“做宝”，

That was why Liu called it a contest of minds: the players were matching wits with someone who was not in the room.
所以刘不才说“这是赌心思”，赌客跟一个不在场的人赌心思。

This man, the setter, stayed upstairs.
这个人名为“做手”，住在楼上，

To prevent cheating and keep the fortunes of the table from disturbing his cool judgement, the staircase was closed off.
为了防止弊端，也为了不以场上的胜负得失影响他的冷静思考，所以楼梯是封闭的，

A small opening in the wooden partition allowed the treasure box to travel in a basket.
只在板壁上开一个小孔，用一只吊篮传递宝盒。

A boy upstairs attended to the errands.
楼下有个小童专司奔走之役，

When the bell rang, the basket was hauled up, and he took the copper box to the setter, who reclined on an opium couch amid clouds of smoke.
铃声一响，将篮子吊了上去，拿着那个铜制的宝盒，送给在烟榻上吞云吐雾的做手，

Once the result had been set, another bell signalled that the basket should be lowered.
做好了室，再用铃声通知，将篮子吊了下来，

Only when the box reached the table did the players place their bets.
等宝盒上桌，赌客方才下注。

The betting was exactly as in the dice-shaking game, except that four pai gow tiles—Heaven, Earth, Man and Harmony—represented the Vermilion Bird in front, the Dark Warrior behind, the Green Dragon on the left and the White Tiger on the right.
赌注跟摇摊完全一样，只是前朱雀、后玄武、左青龙、右白虎是用天、地、人，和四张牌九来表示。

Though the result was deliberately set, it still had a “pattern.”
而且，虽是“做宝”，一样也有“路”。

Liu borrowed another player’s chart of the results and studied it.
刘不才借了旁人所画的“路”来一看，

The setter, he decided, was an expert: his choices were so unpredictable that they seemed to fit every pattern and in fact fitted none.
认为这个做手是高手，做的宝变幻莫测，哪一条路都是，其实哪一条都不是，

Liu resolved to watch a little longer.
因而决定等着看一看再说。


The same result, or “Old Treasure,” had already appeared three times in succession, each time the Earth tile.
这时候已经连开了三记“老宝”，都是地牌，

When the fourth box was opened, it too was Old Treasure.
第四宝开出来还是老宝。

For the fifth round, the bell upstairs failed to ring.
到了第五宝，楼上的铃声还不响，

The croupier remained composed, but the players grew impatient and urged him to hurry.
宝官沉得住气，赌客却不耐烦了，连声催促，

He sent someone to ring the bell and ask for the box.
于是宝官叫人去拉铃，催上面快将宝盒送下来。

They rang and rang without any response.
催管催，上面只是毫无动静，

Only on the third attempt did a bell answer.
催到第三遍，才听见铃响。

Yet when the players looked at the box, they hesitated over their bets.
但是赌客望着宝盒，却都踌躇着不知如何下注，

After four repetitions of Old Treasure and such a long delay before the fifth, they imagined the setter upstairs must have exhausted his ingenuity to devise an infallible choice.
因为连开了四记老宝，第五宝又拖延了这么多时候，料想楼上的做手，殚精竭虑算无遗策，

This round would be especially hard to guess.
这一宝十分难猜。

“If I follow the pattern, it ought to be this gate,” someone said, placing his stake on Heaven.
“我照路打，应该这一门！”有人把赌往放在无牌那一门上。

“You can’t follow the pattern now.
“不能照路了！

It must be Old Treasure,” another declared, betting accordingly.
一定是老宝。”另一个人说，随即在“老宝”上下注。

“Quite right,” a third agreed.
“有理，有理！”又一个赌客连连点头，

“All that delay was to work up the nerve to set Old Treasure again.”
“拖延了这许多工夫，就为的要狠得下心来做老宝。”

These two reinforced one another’s conviction, unconsciously influencing the others, who followed them with their stakes.
由于这两个人一搭一档，认定是老宝，别的赌客在不知不觉中受了影响，纷纷跟着下注，

When the box was opened, cheers broke out.
开出宝来，哗然欢呼，

It was indeed another Earth tile, and the house had to pay heavily on the most popular gate.
果然又是一张地牌，庄家赔了个大重门。


The sixth round took even longer.
到第六宝越发慢了，

When the box was at last brought down, fewer people bet on Old Treasure.
等把室盒子催了下来，打老宝的人就少了，

Yet Old Treasure appeared again.
但是开出来的，居然又是老宝。

Astonishment now outweighed every other response: six Earth tiles in succession, and the surprise only grew as the run continued.
这一次是惊异多于一切，而越到后来越惊异，连开六记地牌。

“There’s a gambling ghost about!” someone told the croupier.
“出赌鬼了！”有人向宝官说：

“Burn a string of paper ingots for it.”
“弄串长锭去烧烧！”

“Nonsense!
“笑话！

There’s no such thing.”
哪里有这种事？”

With fewer and fewer players backing Earth, the house was collecting large stakes and making small payouts.
宝官因为打地宝的越来越少，吃重赔轻，

The croupier was well satisfied and rejected the suggestion.
得其所哉，所以拒绝了那人的提议。

When the ninth round produced Old Treasure again, the gamblers looked at one another and held back.
到第九记再开出老宝来，赌客相顾歇手，

No one believed it could appear yet another time.
没有一个人相信还会出老宝。

The man who had spoken of a gambling ghost now told a story.
于是道有赌鬼的那人便谈掌故，

During the Qianlong reign, a gambling house had once thrown four nineteen times running in a single night.
说乾隆年间有家赌场摇摊，曾经一晚上一连出过十九记的“四”，

At last the players discovered the secret and all placed single-number bets on four, forcing the establishment to close its box and shut its doors.
后来被人识破玄机，在场赌客都押“四孤丁”，逼得赌场只好封宝关门。

“What was the secret?”
“什么玄机？”

“The Qianlong Emperor’s dragon boat was spending the night in Tongli on his southern tour.
“那晚上，乾隆皇帝南巡的龙船在同里过夜。

With the true dragon present, how could anything but four appear?”
真龙出现，还会不出四？”

“Of course!”
“对，对！”

Four was the Green Dragon.
四是青龙，

The questioner understood, but the present case still puzzled him.
问的那人领悟了，但对眼前却又不免迷惑，

“What is happening now, then?
“那么此刻又是什么花样？

The Emperor is in the capital.
皇帝在京城，

There can be no true dragon in Tongli.
同里不会出现真龙，

And the Earth tile is Entrance!”
而且地牌是‘进门’！”

“That is why I say there is a gambling ghost.”
“所以我说有赌鬼。”

“Then you think Old Treasure will come up again?”
“照你这样说，还要出老宝？”

“I don’t know.”
“不晓得！”

The man shook his head.
那人摇摇头：

“Even if I knew it would, I couldn’t bring myself to bet on it.
“就明晓得是老宝，也打不下手，

To my mind, this round certainly won’t be ‘two eyes in a straight line.’”
照我看，这一记决不会‘两眼笔直’了！”

That expression described the Earth tile.
“两眼笔直”是形容地牌。

The other gamblers agreed with him.
别的赌客都以其人之言为是，

Liu, who had been listening and watching coolly throughout, had an idea of his own.
一直冷静在听，在看的刘不才，却独具机抒，

If one was following patterns, a strange pattern demanded a strange response: one should keep backing Old Treasure.
他认为如果是讲“路”，则怪路怪打，还该追老宝，

If it was a contest of minds, then setting Old Treasure until no one dared bet on it was the cleverest strategy of all.
若是讲赌心思，则此人做老宝做得别人不敢下注，这才是一等一的好心思！

On that reasoning, there might well be several more repetitions to come.
照此推论，着实还有几记老宝好开。


He had observed the first two rules, coolness and patience.
“冷、等”两字做到了，

Now it was time to strike hard.
现在所要的是个“狠”字，

Just as the croupier was about to lift the lid, Liu called softly, “One moment, please.”
正当宝官要揭宝盒子时，他轻喝一声：“请等一等！”

“Certainly.”
“可以。”

The croupier withdrew his hand.
宝官缩住手说：

“We wait for every wager.”
“等足输赢。”

“What is the limit on a gate?”
“请问，多少‘封门’？”

“A thousand taels.”
“一千两。”

“A thousand it is.”
“一千两！”

Liu took a roll of banknotes from his clothes, selected one and laid it on Earth.
“刘不才从身上掏出一卷银票来，取一张，摆在地牌那一门上。

Every eye turned towards him.
“这一下便令全场侧目。

He was a stranger, and his unhurried manner, treating a thousand taels as casually as a string of copper cash, made him seem all the more mysterious and intriguing.
由于刘不才是生客，而且看他气度安闲，将千把两银子，看得如一吊铜钱似的不在乎，越发觉得此人神秘莫恻，因而也越增好奇的兴趣。

Under more than a hundred watching eyes, the box was opened. Once again it was “two eyes in a straight line.”
百多只眼睛注视之下，开来居然又是“两眼笔直”！

The room boiled over.
于是场中象沸了似的，

Astonishment, envy, anger and regret found expression in a confusion of voices and gestures.
诧异的、羡慕的、气愤的、懊恼的，众声并作，诸态毕陈。

Liu’s face remained unchanged.
刘不才却是声色不动，

He merely turned and said quietly to Zhu, “A lucky chance.”
只回头向朱老大轻声说了句：“侥幸！”

Now everyone knew that this unfamiliar high-stakes gambler was Zhu’s friend, and admiring looks followed.
这一下大家才知道这个生面孔的大赌客是未老大的朋友，纷纷投以仰慕的眼光。

To men of this world, reputation mattered above all.
江湖中人最爱的是面子，

Zhu was naturally proud of a friend who had won such acclaim with a single wager.
朱老大自然以有这样一个“一赌惊人”的朋友为得意，

His face seemed gilded with delight, his heart as pleasantly warmed as though smoothed by an iron.
脸上象飞了金，心上象拿熨斗烫过，舒坦异常。

Eager to cultivate his customers, the croupier added his compliments and told the settling clerk at the Green Dragon corner to waive the house commission, known in the trade as “water money,” normally three or five li.
宝官笼络赌客，也凑兴表示佩服，而且关照站在“青龙角”上的“开赔”，免抽头钱，行话叫做“水子”，三厘、五厘不等。

Liu, for his part, knew how to make a handsome gesture.
当然，刘不才也是很漂亮的，

When the clerk paid him three thousand taels in counters, he took an ivory counter worth a hundred taels and tossed it towards the Green Dragon corner.
等开赔将三千两的筹码赔到，他取了根一百两的牙筹，往青龙角上抛了过去。


When the box was placed on the table again, everyone waited to see how Liu would bet before deciding for themselves.
等宝盒子再放到赌台上时，大家都要看刘不才如何下手？再定主意。

There was a term for this too: a “lantern.”
这也有句红话，叫做“灯笼”。

A lantern illuminated the path, and it might be red or black.
灯笼照“路”，有红有黑，

Gamblers avoided black luck and sought red.
赌场里讲究避黑趋红，

Suppose people had been backing Old Treasure throughout, while one man had missed several rounds and only joined in when, as the saying went, he consulted the almanac on New Year’s Eve and found all the auspicious days already gone.
如果刚才一直有人在追老宝，而有人错过了好几宝不出手，到“年三十看皇历，好日子过完了”再来下注，

That man was plainly unlucky.
则其人之黑可知！

A player skilled at reading such signs would withdraw his stake and move it elsewhere.
善于趋避的人，就会抽回注码，改押别处，

Liu, however, was a red lantern.
但刘不才这盏灯笼是红灯笼，

He had dared to back Old Treasure when no one else would, and had won.
别人对老宝不敢再押，就他敢，而且居然追到了，

What magnificent luck!
这是多旺的手气？

Everyone wanted to follow him.
所以都要跟着他下注。

As soon as he placed another thousand taels on Earth, wagers rained down beside it.
于是等刘不才将一千两银子一押在地牌上，赌注如雨，纷纷跟进。

The box was opened.
开出盒子来，

The croupier and settling clerk exchanged stricken looks, while the players rejoiced.
宝官与开赔，相顾失色，而赌客则皆大欢喜，

On this round of Old Treasure the house paid out more than twenty thousand taels.
庄家在这一记者宝赔了两万多银子。

The whole room erupted.
这一下，全场鼎沸，

Even gamblers from the front hall came rushing in.
连大厅上的赌客都赶了进来，

Liu was treated like a god; the men on either side pressed themselves away, afraid of crowding him.
刘不才则被奉若神明，他左右的两个赌客，都尽量将身子往外缩，怕挤得他不舒服。

At that moment someone tapped his shoulder.
而就在这时候，发觉有人拍一拍他的肩，

He turned to see Hu signalling with his eyes, then pursing his lips towards the door to indicate that they should leave.
回头看时，是胡雪岩在向他使眼色，接着努一努嘴，示意他离去。

Liu was intensely reluctant to rise, but he did not dare disregard Hu.
刘不才实在舍不得起身，但又不敢不听胡雪岩的指挥，

At last he ostentatiously took out his gold watch, glanced at it and nodded, as though the hour of an appointment had arrived.
终于装模作样地掏出金表来看了看，点点头，表示约会的时间到了，

He gathered up his banknotes and stood.
然后一把抓起银票，站起身来。

The hangers-on who made their living around gambling houses saw that he had won six thousand taels and crowded round with attentions.
赌场里专有班在混的人，一看刘不才赢了六千银子，便包围上来献殷勤，

Liu understood the customary courtesies.
刘不才自然懂“规矩”，

When he went to the cashier to exchange his winnings, he bought a hundred taels’ worth of small counters and gave one to everyone who approached, refusing no one.
到帐房里去兑现时，顺便买了一百两的小筹码，一人一根，来者不拒。


Even as he distributed these shares of his good fortune, he complained to Hu.
一面“分红”，一面便有怨言，

“You shouldn’t have hurried me away.
“你不该催我，”他向胡雪岩说，

I had worked out the setter’s pattern.
“做手的路子，让我摸到了，

There were at least three more Old Treasures to come.”
起码还有三记老宝。”

“It was precisely because you had worked it out that I hurried you away.
“就因为你摸到了，我才催你走。

Everyone was following your bets.
大家都跟着你打，

A couple more rounds and you could have ruined the place.
再有两下，就可以把赌场打坍。

Why should we arrive in Tongli and immediately bring someone else to grief?”
何苦一到同里，就害得人家栽跟斗？”

“Uncle Hu,” Zhu said, adopting Yang’s form of address, “you really understand the ways of the world, and you have a proper sense of honour.”
“胡大叔！”朱老大跟着杨凤毛这样称呼，“你老人家真正是老江湖，够义气。”

Liu did not agree.
刘不才心里不服，

At the gambling table there were no fathers and sons; considering friendship and loyalty only meant losing oneself.
“赌场无父子”，讲情面义气，自己倒霉，

But in front of their host, and seeing Zhu’s respect for Hu, he could only keep his thoughts to himself.
但当着主人，又见朱老大是那样尊重胡雪岩，只好隐忍不言。

On reflection, he had won six thousand taels in a matter of moments.
再退一步想想，片刻工夫，赢进六千银子，

Truly, if only one could gamble without losing, it would be the finest occupation in the world.
真正“赌能不输，天下营生第一”！

A smile came to his face.
不由得便有了笑意。

“Third Master Liu plays well, but Uncle Hu does still better by not playing,” Yang told Zhu.
“刘三爷赌得好，胡大叔不赌则更好！”杨凤毛对朱老大说：

“No wonder he is so well liked.
“怪不得胡大叔有那么好的人缘，

We ought both to learn from him.”
你我都要学他老人家。”

“You are far too kind!”
“言重，言重！

Hu rubbed his face with a smile.
胡雪岩摸着脸笑道：”

“You two are making me blush.”
你们两位说得我脸红了。

“Enough compliments,” Yang said.
““闲话收起。”杨凤毛问道：

“Where shall we go next?”
“再到哪里去坐坐？”

“Uncle Hu and Third Master Liu must be tired,” Zhu replied.
“恐怕胡大叔、刘三爷也倦了，

“Let us return to my house, rest a little and have a drink.”
回到舍间息一息，吃酒吧！”


They walked leisurely back to the Zhu house.
于是安步当车，仍旧回到朱家。

Its finest accommodation was a pavilion overlooking the water.
他家最好的一处房子，是座水阁，

When the guests arrived, some women relatives of the family had been staying there, but it had now been vacated, and Zhu invited Hu and the others inside to rest.
在嘉宾莅止时，正好有朱家亲戚女客住在那里，这时已腾了出来，朱老大便将胡雪岩等人，延入水阁休息。

They had scarcely sat down when an old servant called softly from the doorway, “Eldest Young Master!”
刚刚坐定，朱家老仆，在门外轻叫一声“大少爷！”

With a glance he drew Zhu outside and whispered, “Mr Zhang from the gambling house is here.
使个眼色把他请了出去，悄悄说道：“赌场里的章老板来了，

He says he wants to see one of our guests, and he has brought four kinds of gifts.
说要看我们家一位客人，还带了四样礼，

Will you come and see him?”
请大少爷先出去看看。”

This was an unexpected visitor indeed.
这真是不速之客了！

Zhu could not imagine whom he wanted to see: none of them had any previous connection with him.
朱老大不知他要看哪个？想想哪个也跟他没有渊源，

Puzzled, he hurried to the reception hall.
这件事倒着实猜它不透。于是匆匆出厅接见，

Since the two knew each other, there was no need for preliminaries, and Zhu asked his purpose at once.
彼此熟人，见面不用寒暄，直问来意。

It emerged that Zhang wanted to see Hu.
一问才知道他要看的是胡雪岩。

From the idlers who had solicited gifts from Liu, he had learnt that Hu, out of kindness, had deliberately removed the “lantern” and saved the gambling house from a grave disaster.
章老板是从那些向刘不才讨彩的闲汉口中，得知胡雪岩用心仁厚，特意将刘不才那盏“灯笼”拿走，解了赌场的一个大厄。

He had come expressly to offer thanks and make a friend.
因而专诚拜访，一则道谢，二则想交个朋友。

“Uncle Hu is my master’s friend and related to him by an adopted family tie,” Zhu said.
“这位胡大叔，是我师父的朋友，还有点干亲，

“He is generous to everyone.
为人四海得很，

Thanks are unnecessary, but he will certainly be willing to make a friend.
道谢不必，交朋友一定可以。

As for these four gifts, however, you really needn’t have brought them.”
不过，“朱老大说：”你这四样礼，大可省省。

“I know.
““我也晓得，

A few things to eat are hardly an adequate token, but I felt awkward coming empty-handed.”
几样吃食东西，不成敬意，不过空手上门，不好意思。”

Zhang too realised that these modest gifts were inappropriate.
章老板也觉得这四样水礼送得不妥，

Offered as payment for a kindness, they might seem to belittle Hu’s intentions.
如果说是谢礼，反倒象轻看胡雪岩的一番意思，

He hesitated, then said, “Do this: don’t mention them to Mr Hu.
所以踌躇了一下说：“这样吧，你不必跟胡先生说起。

But since they are here, taking them back would be a nuisance.
不过，东西带都带来了，再拿回去也麻烦，

Just leave them in the kitchen.”
你就丢在厨房里好了。”

“That is sensible.
“这倒也是句话。

Come along, and I shall take you in.”
来，来，我带你进去。”


Zhu led him straight to the waterside pavilion, introduced him and explained why he had come.
一直带到水阁，引见以后，朱老大代为道明来意，

Hu modestly disclaimed the unexpected praise, but Zhang was utterly sincere.
胡雪岩对此不虞之誉，谦谢不受。章老板却是一脸诚意，

He bowed to the ground and nearly went down on his knees.
一揖到地，差点就要跪了来。

“Mr Hu, you have done me an enormous service.
“胡先生，你帮我这个忙帮大了。

To tell you the truth”—he pointed to Liu—“in twenty or thirty years of gambling I have never met anyone like Third Master Liu.
说实话，”他指着刘不才说：“这位刘三爷也是我在赌上混了二三十年，头一遭遇见的人物。

If he had played a little longer, with everyone following him and backing Entrance on the same side, I would have been ruined today.”
如果刘三爷再玩一会，大家跟着他‘一条边’打‘进门’，我今天非倾家荡产不可！”

“How so?” Hu asked.
“怎么呢？”胡雪岩问道：

“Did Old Treasure keep coming up?”
“下面还是出老宝？”

“Sixteen times in all.
“一共出了十六记。

It really is something extraordinary.
说起来，也是一桩新闻。

Fortunately”—Zhang still seemed shaken at the thought—“Third Master Liu was the only one who saw through it.
幸好，”章老板仿佛提起来仍有余悸的神情，“只有刘三爷一个人看得透。

Once he left, no one dared back Old Treasure.
刘三爷一走，大家都不敢押老宝，

Taking the whole session together, the house still came out ahead.”
通扯起来，庄家还是赢面。”

Liu naturally looked pleased.
刘不才听见这话，自然面有得色，

With a deliberate smile he said, “I merely answered a strange pattern with a strange wager and happened to strike lucky.”
于是特地笑道：“我也不过怪路怪打，瞎碰瞎撞而已。”

“Gambling is about seizing an opportunity.
“赌就是赌个机会，

When a chance like that comes once in a thousand years, Third Master Liu alone can take it.
千载一时的机会，只有刘三爷一个人抓得住。

It sounds incredible, but the setter prepared only four Old Treasures, while sixteen appeared.
说起来叫人不相信，做手只做了四记老宝，但开出来的是十六记，

The trouble began with the fifth.”
毛病出在第五记上……”

“Ah, I remember,” Liu interrupted.
“啊，我想起来了。”刘不才插嘴说，

“The fifth box wouldn’t come down.
“第五记上，宝盒子老不下来，

They rang three times before they got it.
拉铃拉了三遍才催到。

What happened?”
出了什么毛病？”

The setter had been struck by a sudden illness and lost consciousness on his opium couch.
是做手得了暴疾，昏迷在烟榻上。

The boy who carried the box did not understand.
传递宝盒子的小童，不知就里，

He pushed and shook him but could not wake him.
拼命推他椎不醒，

Panicked by the insistent bell below, he simply sent the same box down again.
下面铃声催得心慌，便不问青红皂白，将原盒子送了下来。

After the sixteenth round, faint crying was heard upstairs.
做到十六记上，隐隐听得楼上有哭声，

Someone unlocked the staircase door and went up.
拿钥匙开了楼门，上去一看，

Cut off from those below and unable to summon help, the boy had grown more and more terrified until his face was drained of colour.
那小童因为上下隔绝，呼援无门，越想越害怕，已是面无人色。

As for the setter, his body was already cold.
再看那做手，连身子都凉了。


It was an unheard-of occurrence.
这是闻所未闻的怪事，

Even Liu, who had spent half his life in gambling houses, found it scarcely believable.
连在赌场里混过半辈子的刘不才，都觉得不可思议，

In peaceful, prosperous Tongli, untouched by the alarms of war, even the Zhang family’s dog nursing the Li family’s kitten could become an endlessly relished piece of news.
在那烽火不惊、平静富足的同里，连张家的母狗哺育了李家的小猫，都会成为谈来津津有味的新闻，

A marvel like “a dead man setting the treasure” was bound to cause a sensation.
对这样一件“死人做宝”的怪事，自然会轰动。

At the very moment Zhang was visiting Hu, teahouses and taverns everywhere were discussing it.
所以，就在章老板访胡雪岩的那时刻，茶坊酒肆便到处在谈论。

The two guests at the Zhu house instantly became the talk of Tongli.
于是朱老大家的两个客人，立即成了同里的风头人物。

Qiu Fengyan and Zhou Yiming, who had arrived that afternoon and were rewarding themselves with a quiet drink in a tavern, heard the story too.
这件新闻，下午刚到，在酒店里小酌自劳的裘丰言和周一鸣也听到了，

They exchanged delighted smiles.
两人相视而笑，十分兴奋，

Qiu remained restrained, but Zhou could not contain himself.
裘丰言倒还持重，周一鸣却忍不住了，

During his time with Hu he had learnt something of the art of building a name.
同时他跟胡雪岩这许多日子，也懂了很多扬名创招牌的花样，

He revealed who Hu and Liu were, explaining that they were not simply Zhu’s friends but friends of Zhu’s master, Yu Wucheng.
于是将胡雪岩和刘不才的身分揭露了出来，道是并非朱老大的朋友，是朱老大的师父，俞武成的朋友。

In everyone’s mind, Yu’s name at once acquired a new resonance as well.
这一下。在大家的心目中，俞武成这个名字，似乎也很响亮了。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十八章（中）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Eight, Part Two
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


News travelled remarkably fast.
消息传播得真快，

Early the next morning, as Yu Wucheng returned from Qingpu to Tongli, he stopped for tea in a village along the way and was already being asked about Hu Xueyan and Liu Bucai.
第二天一早，俞武成从青浦回同里，中途在一处村镇歇脚吃茶，便有人向他打听胡雪岩和刘不才。

Thus, when he first met Hu in Eldest Brother Zhu’s waterside pavilion, his opening words were, “You have only just arrived, brother, and already your name is on everyone’s lips.
因此，在朱老大家的水阁初见面，他向胡雪岩说的第一句话就是：“老兄一到，名气就响。

Those of us who have spent decades in the brotherhoods must acknowledge ourselves outdone!”
我们在江湖上混了几十年的，真要甘拜下风了！”

There was an unpleasant edge to this, which Hu naturally detected.
这话不是句好话，胡雪岩自然听得出来，

He could only reply, “We owe it all to your reputation, Brother Yu.
只好这样答道：“我们是仰仗大哥的声光。

Such pointless attention is better avoided.
这种毫无道理的风头，不出为妙，

That is why I have not ventured outside today, but have waited here expressly for you, ready to follow your instructions in everything.”
所以今天步门不敢出，专诚等候大哥，一切听大哥的吩咐。”

Their first encounter had scarcely begun before host and guest seemed at odds.
宾主之间，一见面便有些格格不入的模样，

Alarmed, Yang Fengmao tugged at Yu’s sleeve.
杨凤毛大为不安，赶紧将俞武成的袖子一拉：

“Master,” he said softly, “please come this way.”
“师父！”他轻声说道：“你老请到这面来！”

Drawing him aside, Yang explained in detail how highly Third Granny valued this new bond of adopted kinship.
将俞武成拉到一边，杨凤毛将三婆婆如何看重这门干亲，一一细陈，

Finally, with particular gravity, he said, “Before I left, Third Granny called me aside especially to give you this message: Uncle Hu is an exceptionally capable and loyal man.
最后极郑重地说：“临走之前，三婆婆特为拿我喊到一边，叫我告诉师父：这位胡大叔是极能干、极讲义气的人。

She says that in all her decades of experience she has seen plenty of ruthless men and plenty of kindly, honest ones, but this is the first time she has met a man who is both ruthless and kindly.”
她老人家说：几十年工夫当中，看过的也不少，狠的有，忠厚的也有，象胡大叔这样又狠又忠厚的人，还是第一趟见……”


“What?” Yu asked.
“什么？”俞武成说，

“I do not understand her.
“我倒不懂她老人家的话，

How can a man be both ruthless and kindly?”
怎么叫又狠又忠厚？”

“Kindly in his nature, ruthless in his methods.
“忠厚是说他的本性，狠是说他办事的手段。”杨凤毛又说：

I must say Third Granny’s judgment is extraordinary.
“我倒觉得三婆婆的眼光到底厉害，

No one else could have found those words.”
这‘又狠又忠厚’五个字，别人说不出。”

“And do you think she is right?”
“那么，你说对不对呢？”

“Of course she is!” Yang continued to relay the maternal instructions.
“自然说得对！”杨凤毛接下来又转述“慈训”：

“Third Granny says it is no way to go on, living here dependent on others and having to swallow their slights.
“三婆婆说，我们在这里，寄人篱下，受人的气，也不是办法。

Our chance to improve matters rests entirely with Uncle Hu.
想要打开局面，都在胡大叔身上。

You must treat him with particular respect.”
师父要格外尊敬他！

“And what happened at Boss Zhang’s gambling house yesterday?”
““昨天章老板赌场里又是怎么回事？”

“That,” Yang replied with an excited expression, “brought you credit too, Master!”
“ ”这件事，“杨凤毛的神色显得很兴奋，”师父也有面子！

He recounted the whole affair.
“接着，他将当时的情形，细说了一遍。

“That is unusual.
“这倒难得！

She was right to call him kindly,” Yu said.
说他忠厚不错。”俞武成又说，

“That fellow Liu looks like an old hand at the pleasures of life, yet he obeys Hu meekly enough.
“那姓刘的，看起来也是‘老白相’，居然对他服服帖帖，

You can see from that that Hu has some ability.”
这就看得出来，有点本事的。”

“More than a little.
“本事不止一点点。

Once you talk to him, Master, you will see for yourself.”
师父，你老跟他一谈就知道了。”


When Yu resumed his conversation with Hu, his manner was quite different.
于是俞武成再跟胡雪岩交谈时，态度就大不相同了，

He was exceedingly courteous and insisted that Hu and Liu take the places of honour on the raised couch.
他很客气，一定要让胡雪岩和刘不才“升炕”，

In reckoning their relationships, Liu, as Furong’s uncle, belonged to the senior generation, so their forms of address differed accordingly.
而叙起礼节来，刘不才是芙蓉的叔叔，长了一辈，所以称谓亦自各别，

Yu called Hu “Old Hu,” but addressed Liu formally as “Third Master Liu.” Liu in turn respectfully called him “Elder Yu,” which, compared with Hu’s “Brother Yu,” seemed to put Liu a generation below him again.
俞武成叫胡雪岩“老胡”，叫刘不才则是官称“刘三爷”，刘三爷却又尊称他“俞老”，跟胡雪岩所叫的“大哥”一比，仿佛又矮了一辈。

In the brotherhoods everyone reckoned such relationships separately.
反正江湖上各叙各的，

The titles might be confused, but in practice they were all friends on an equal footing.
称呼虽乱，其实都是一律平等的朋友。

Yu enforced strict rules among his disciples.
俞武成的门规甚严，

Yang and Zhu remained standing to attend to their needs, while he sat in a grand armchair beside the pavilion window, talking at length with Hu about the Songjiang grain-transport brotherhood.
杨凤毛、朱老大都是站着服劳，他自己则坐在水阁临窗的一张太师椅上相陪，跟胡雪岩大谈松江漕帮。

He referred to the Old Master as the “Songjiang Chief” and told many stories of their adventures together in their youth, lamenting that life was harder now than it had been.
他称“老太爷”为“松江老大”，说起许多他们年轻时一起闯荡江湖的故事，感叹着日子不如从前好过。

Liu could only sit and listen.
刘不才在这场合，只有静听的份儿。

As he did so, he studied Yu.
一面听，一面打量俞武成，

Although over sixty, the man dressed like a wealthy young idler, in satin shoes and a satin robe, with snow-white cuffs that he kept turning up and down.
年纪六十开外，打扮得却如纨袴子弟，缎鞋、缎袍、雪白的袖头，不时卷上翻下，

When lowered, the cuffs covered his hands, so he had to raise a thumb to hold the cuff back before he could move freely.
等袖子翻下来时，已经盖过手面，所以必得翘起一只大拇指来，将袖口挡住，才便于行动，

This was a characteristic gesture among men of the brotherhoods, but Yu’s imposing build and splendid clothes gave it a particular flourish.
这原是江湖上人特有的一种姿态，只是俞武成身材魁梧，服装华丽，

Whenever his thumb rose, the ring of glass-clear green jade upon it flashed brilliantly, adding still further to his air of distinction.
大拇指一翘起来，那只通体碧绿的“玻璃翠”扳指，异常耀眼，所以格外显得有派头。


What both fascinated and puzzled Liu, however, was the way Yu’s satin robe, glittering in the slanting sunlight, moved without any breeze.
然而刘不才感觉兴趣，也感到困惑的是，俞武成那件在斜阳里闪闪发光的缎袍，无风自动，

A bulge would appear here, something would wriggle there.
不时东面凸起一块，西面蠕动片刻，

What could cause it?
不知是何缘故！

He watched intently for a long time without solving the mystery, until his curiosity became almost unbearable.
目不转睛地看了半天，总想不透，心便痒得厉害，

Just as he was about to ask, the answer appeared.
正忍不住要动问时，谜底揭晓了。

Zhu brought in a large platter of cherries from Dongting East Mountain in Lake Tai.
朱老大捧了一大冰盘出于太湖中洞庭东山的樱桃来款客，

Yu took a cluster and held out his open palm.
但见俞武成抓了一串在手里，平伸手掌，

A furry little squirrel promptly emerged from his sleeve.
很快地，袖子里钻出一只毛茸茸的小松鼠来，

Its large, bright eyes darted about; then it raised its forepaws, grasped a cherry in Yu’s palm, and began nibbling.
一对极大、极明亮的眼睛，灵活地转了转，然后拱起两只前爪，就俞武成掌中捧着樱桃咬。

Liu broke into a broad smile.
刘不才嘻开了嘴笑，

“Elder Yu, you certainly know how to amuse yourself!
“俞老，你真会玩！”他问：

Why keep a squirrel on your person?
“怎么养只松鼠在身上？

Is it not a nuisance?”
不觉得累赘？”

“Once it is tame, there is no trouble.”
“养熟了就好了。”

“You keep it there all day?”
“整天在身上？”

“Yes.”
“嗯！”

Yu nodded.
俞武成点点头，

“We hardly ever part.”
“几乎片刻不离。”

“Does it not bother you, crawling all over you from morning to night?”
“一天到晚，在你身上爬来爬去，不嫌烦吗？”

“It sleeps sometimes, naturally.
“自然也有睡觉的时候；

Put it in my pocket and it settles down.
只要拿它一放到口袋里，它就不闹了。”俞武成又说：

If you like it, Third Master Liu, take it and amuse yourself.”
“刘三爷喜欢，拿了去玩！”

“No, no!”
“不，不！”

Liu waved his hands.
刘不才播着手说：

“A gentleman does not deprive another man of something he loves.
“君子不夺人所好。

Besides, to tell the truth, I should find it rather creepy having it crawl all over me.”
而且，说实话，在我身上爬来爬去，也嫌肉麻！”


Yu smiled without answering, then turned to Zhu.
俞武成笑笑不响，回头问朱老大：

“Will the meal be ready soon?”
“快开饭了吧？”

“Whenever you and Uncle Hu wish, Master.
“听胡大叔跟师父的意思。”朱老大答道，

If you are not particularly hungry, it would be better to wait a little.
“如果不怎么饿，不妨稍等一等，

The shark’s fin stewed with ham needs more time over the fire.”
火腿煨鱼翅，火功还不大够。”

“Then let us wait.
“那就等一下。

Bring Uncle Hu some refreshments to take the edge off his hunger.
先弄些点心来给胡大叔点饥，

Once we have discussed our business, we can enjoy our wine properly.”
等我们谈好了正事，痛痛快快吃酒。”

The significant words were “discussed our business.”
这段话中要紧的是“谈正事”这一句，

Hu feared that Yu might not wish Liu to hear their secrets, and gave him a casual-looking glance.
胡雪岩怕他不愿刘不才与闻机密，便不经意地使个眼色，

Liu understood and rose.
刘不才会意，站起身来说：

“You talk.
“你们谈吧！

I shall use the time to go into town and see a friend.”
我趁这会儿工夫，上街去看个朋友。

“Then I shall accompany you,” Zhu volunteered.
““那么，”朱老大自告奋勇，“我陪着刘三爷一起去。”

Liu intended to see Zhou Yiming, their reserve force concealed from view.
刘不才是想去看周一鸣，这是暗中埋伏的援兵，

He could hardly let Yu’s people know about him.
不便让俞武成这方面的人知道，

Clasping his hands, he said, “Please do not trouble yourself.
所以拱拱手说：“不敢，不敢！

You are our host and must stay here.
你做主人，要留在府上，

Besides, I know Tongli well; there is no danger of my getting lost.”
而且，同里我也熟，绝不致迷路。”

This was untrue: it was his first visit to Tongli too.
这是假话，他也是第一次到同里，

Unless he said so, however, Zhu would send someone to guide him.
只是不如此说，朱老大还会派上引路。

Sure enough, his host pressed the matter no further and let him go alone.
果然，做主人的不再客气，放他一个人走了。


Yu, Hu, and Yang then conferred in private.
于是，俞武成跟胡雪岩，还有杨凤毛在一起密认。

Yu said that he was willing to follow Hu’s arrangements and explained the position frankly.
俞武成表示愿意听从胡雪岩的安排，老实相告，

The men who had been preparing to seize the boatload of foreign guns were all under the direction of Lame Changgen, one of Zhou Lichun’s capable subordinate leaders.
原来准备动那船洋枪的人马，都由周立春手下一个得力的头目“跷脚长根”安排。

They needed Yu because this water route lay within the Songjiang brotherhood’s sphere of influence: he had to approach the Songjiang Chief and clear the way.
所要借重俞武成的，是因为这条水路，是松江漕帮的势力范围，必须请他出面，来打通“松江老大”的路子。

Now Songjiang had adopted the position that, since both sides were friends, it could only stand aside and remain neutral.
现在松江方面，由于守着“两方面都是朋友，只好袖手中立”的立场，

Changgen therefore hesitated to act.
所以“跷脚长根”也踌躇着不敢下手。

The proposed way out suited him very well, but he would have to discuss the terms with Hu.
如今得有这样一条出路，深符所愿，但条件如何？必得跟胡雪岩谈一谈。

“Naturally,” Hu said.
“那当然。”胡雪岩问道，

“How can I meet this friend?”
“怎么样跟这位朋友碰头？”

“That still has to be arranged.
“那还得再联络。

Old Hu, I am a plain-spoken man.”
老胡，我是直心直肚肠，”

Yu’s tone became solemn.
俞武成很郑重地说：

“There is something I want to ask you first.
“有句话我想先请教你，

You are family now, and my mother’s judgment is never wrong, so of course I trust you.
你是一家人了，而且我老娘的眼光是不会错的，我当然相信。

But I have suffered at the hands of those officials, and cannot put much faith in them.
不过，那批做官的，我吃过他们的苦头，实在不大相信。

When my son first wanted to take the provincial military examination, I told him, ‘There is nothing so wonderful about being an official.
当初我儿子要去考武举，我就跟他说：”做官也没啥意思，

Do not bother with it.’
不要去考。

But my mother wanted her grandson to make a name for himself; she arranged everything and escorted him to the examination herself.
‘也是我老娘’望孙成龙‘亲自料理，亲自送考。

As for this amnesty, it makes no difference to me personally.
至于招抚这一节，我是无所谓的，

If it succeeds, the men can draw military pay and at least feed themselves.
办成功了，帮里弟兄，可以去吃一份粮，也算是糊口，

Bringing them over would also be a service to the court.
再说，拿他们拉过来，也总算是替朝廷出了力。

What I fear is that those grand officials will say one thing and mean another.
就怕那批做官的老爷，口是心非，

If something goes wrong, blaming you will be no use.
等出了毛病，我怪你也无用，

And for me it will then be more than a question of whether I can still get along in the brotherhoods!”
那时候，我就不是在江湖上好混不好混的事了！“


This long speech, with its barbed insinuations, left Hu rather puzzled.
听他这夹枪带棒一大顿，胡雪岩相当困惑，

What exactly did Yu mean?
不知他说的什么？

He seized on the phrase “something goes wrong” and thought hard until the meaning gradually became clear.
只是抓住“出了毛病”这四个字极力思考，慢慢悟出道理来了。

“You mean that once the men have gone over, the officials might turn on them and disown their promises?”
“你是说，人过去以后，当官儿的，翻脸不认人，是不是？”

“Exactly!
“对了！”俞武成说，

If they merely turned their backs on them, we could still manage.
“光是翻脸不认人，还好办，

What I fear is—” Yu shook his head.
就怕……”他摇摇头，

“If they really did that, it would be terrible.”
“真的有那么一下子，那就惨了。”

“Do you mean”—Hu found the question difficult to utter—“that they might kill the men who surrender?”
“你是说……”胡雪岩很吃力地问：“会‘杀降’？”

“There is no telling.”
“保不定的。”

“They will not!”
“不会！”

Only now did Hu speak with absolute firmness.
这时候胡雪岩才用斩钉截铁的声音：

“I guarantee they will not.
“我包你不会，

Brother, let me tell you plainly: my contact is Education Commissioner He.
大哥，我跟你实说吧，我接头的是何学使的路子，

He is about to receive an excellent appointment.
他马上要放好缺了。

The leading grand councillor in the capital graduated in the same examination year as he did, and so did many provincial governors.
京里大军机是他们同年，各省巡抚也有许多是他同年。

His year is very much in favour, and their words carry weight.”
这一榜红得很，说出话来有分量的。”

“And how close are you to Commissioner He?”
“那么，何学使跟你的交情呢？”

“He has asked me to find him a concubine.
“何学使托我替他置妾。

That is all there is to our friendship!”
交情如此而已！”

“Then there is nothing more to say.”
“那就没话说了。”

Yu looked pleased.
俞武成欣然问道，

“Did he mention what advantages he could offer?” He hurriedly added, “I do not mean for me.
“何学使可曾谈起，给点啥好处？”他赶紧又补了一句，“不是说我。

I mean for Changgen and his men.”
是说对跷脚长根他们。”


“On that point, brother, you can imagine the answer without my telling you.
“提到这一层，就我不说，大哥也想象得到：

If they abandon darkness for the light, the court will naturally reward them.
弃暗投明，朝廷自然有一番奖励，

Official appointments will certainly be available.”
官是一定有得做的。”

Hu went on, following He Guiqing’s instructions.
接下来，胡雪岩便根据何桂清的指示说道：

“The men should at least receive a special gratuity equal to a month’s pay.
“弟兄们总可以关一个月恩饷，作为犒赏。

After that, their pay will come from the military finance office wherever they are assigned.
以后看拔到哪里，归哪里的粮台发饷。

A single month’s gratuity may seem a little meagre, but there is really no help for it.
本来，一个月的恩饷好象少了点，不过也实在叫没法子，

So much territory has been lost that tax receipts have fallen greatly.
地方失得太多，钱粮少收不少，

You know the circumstances as well as anyone.”
这些情形，大哥你当然清楚。”

Yu certainly did: the fact that he and his followers had nothing to do was itself evidence of the decline in imperial revenue.
俞武成当然清楚，他自己和这一帮无事可做，便是朝廷岁入减少的明证，

He nodded.
所以点点头表示领会，

“The gratuity is not the main thing.
“恩晌不恩饷，倒不在话下，

Changgen wants to choose where his men are stationed after they become government troops.
照跷脚长根的意思，将来投过去，变成官兵，驻扎的地方要随他挑，

To be frank, he wants to remain in this district.
说老实话，也就是仍；日想驻扎在这一带。

That is something”—he seemed to find it difficult to say—“we really must arrange.”
这一点，”俞武成很难出口似地，“总要把它做到！”

Hu was no expert in such matters, but common sense told him this would be difficult.
胡雪岩对这方面虽不在行，但照情理而论，觉得不容易做到，

After a moment’s thought he asked, “Then let me ask you, brother: if he were ordered to fight the Small Swords Society, would he agree?”
他略想一想问道：“那么我倒请问大哥，如果叫他去打小刀会，他肯不肯？”

“No.
“还不肯的。

They have all stood on the same gangplank.
原来是一条跳板上的人，

How could he bring himself to do it?”
怎么好意思？”

“Then we have a difficulty.
“这样子就难了！”胡雪岩说，

The troops stationed here are all intended to fight the Small Swords Society.
“这一带驻了兵，都是要打小刀会的。

If the military situation became urgent, a single order would require them to march.
军情紧急，一道命令下来，就要开拔，

Refusing to go would be disobedience.
如果不肯出队，就是不服调度。

Imagine you were their commanding officer.
大哥，你想想看，你做了长官，

How would you deal with it?”
会怎么样处置？

“I had not thought of that.”
““我倒没有想到这一层……”

Yu scratched his head, looking deeply troubled.
俞武成搔搔头皮，显得很为难似的。


Hu could see that Yu had probably thumped his chest and promised without reservation that this could be arranged; hence his present anxiety.
胡雪岩看得出来，俞武成大概已拍了胸脯，满口应承，必可做到，所以才有此着急的神情。

While Hu was still puzzling over a way to help him, Yang spoke.
正在替他伤脑筋时，杨凤毛已先开了口。

“Master, you must tell him it would be better to accept a posting farther away.
“师父只有这样回复他，还是调得远些的好，

If he remains in his home district, the Small Swords men may fail to understand his position.
本乡本土，如果小刀会不体谅他的处境，

或者事急相投，

If he turns them away, he will hurt their feelings; if he helps them, harbouring rebels is no trifling charge.
拒而不纳，就伤了感情，要帮忙呢，窝藏叛逆的罪名，非同小可。

何不远离了左右为难的窘境？”

“这话说得透彻。”胡雪岩趁机劝道：

“Give him that answer, brother.
“大哥，你就照此回复，

跷脚长根如果明道理、讲道理，一定不会再提什么人家做不到的要求。”

Their arguments relieved Yu.
这两个人一说，俞武成释然了，

“That will do for today.”
“今天就谈到这里。”

He rose.
他站起身来，

“I think we should be able to reach agreement on the main points.
“我想，大致可以谈得拢了。

Let us eat.”
我们吃饭吧！”


They had to wait for Liu before beginning the banquet, but he was slow to return.
开席要等刘不才，而刘不才迟迟不回，

They took some refreshments and sat talking until it was quite dark, when he finally hurried in.
于是一面先用些点心，一面闲谈坐等。等到天黑净了，才见刘不才赶回来，

He apologized to his host, but found a moment to signal to Hu that something had developed with Zhou.
进门向主人道歉，却偷空向胡雪岩使了个眼色，暗示着周一鸣那里有了什么花样。

Hu’s face and manner betrayed nothing.
胡雪岩声色不动。

At dinner he talked and laughed freely with Yu about every imaginable subject.
席间谈笑风生，跟俞武成无所不谈，

Afterwards they drank tea.
散了席又喝茶，

Hu gave a yawn that might or might not have been deliberate, and Zhu suggested that the guests rest.
有意无意打个呵欠，朱老大便提议让客人休息，

He escorted them to their rooms, and they exchanged goodnights.
送入客房，各道安置。

Hu and Liu had separate rooms connected by a door.
胡雪岩和刘不才各住一间屋，但有门相通，

As a precaution, Hu first made sure that no member of Zhu’s household was staying nearby, then beckoned Liu in and asked for the details.
为了慎重，他先看清了没有朱家的人住在临近，才招招手将刘不才邀了过来，细问究竟。

“Old Zhou knows this district well and has friends everywhere along the waterways.
“老周在这一带很熟，水路上到处有朋友，

From what he has heard, old Yu is in a very awkward position.
据他听到的消息，俞老头的处境，相当窘迫。

Has he said anything to you about it?”
不知道他自己跟你谈了没有？”

“A little, but nothing about being in an ‘awkward position.’
“略为谈了些。却不是什么‘窘迫’。”胡雪岩问：

What does Zhou say?”
“老周怎么说？”

“He has heard that this is the Songjiang brotherhood’s territory.
“老周是这么说，他听人谈起，这一带是松江漕帮的势力，

Many people know about your friendship with You Laowu.
也很有人知道你跟尤五的交情，

So when the Songjiang Chief announced that he was withdrawing, it might have been called neutrality, but everyone else took it to mean that he was no longer backing old Yu.
所以‘松江老大’一说退出，名为中立，在旁人看，就是不管俞老头的事了。

Loyalty matters in the brotherhoods, but it depends on personal acquaintance.
江湖上虽重义气，但也要是熟人才行，

Yu has lost all his own territory and relies here on the Songjiang Chief’s name.
俞老头的地盘都丢掉了，在这里是靠松江老大的牌头，

松江老大一不管，就没有人买他的帐了。“


Comparing this account with what he had seen of Yu’s circumstances, Hu found Zhou’s information quite credible.
胡雪岩拿这些话跟俞武成自己的情形，合作一起来想，觉得周一鸣所得到的消息，相当可靠。

Yu was indeed in a predicament.
照目前的情形看，俞武成确在窘境之中，

He lacked the power either to bring anything about or to prevent it, and had become a man of little consequence.
成事不能，败事不足，变成无足轻重的人物，

If he retained any usefulness, it lay in the thread that still connected him with Changgen.
如果说他还有什么作用，无非是他身上，还维系着跷脚长根这条线索而已！

“I do not see why you need to humour old Yu so much,” Liu said.
“我看，你也犯不着这么敷衍俞老头。”刘不才说，

“He is like the dregs left after brewing medicine: his strength is spent and he is no use.”
“我看他跟药渣子一样，过气无用了。”

“That is not the way to put it.
“话不是这么说。

Once we have made a friend, we cannot be too calculating.”
既然交了朋友，也不便太过于势利。”

“Friendship is one thing; serious business is another.
“朋友是朋友，办正事是办正事。

If he is no use any more, why keep yourself entangled with him?”
他已经没得用了，你还跟他搅在一起做什么？”

“No.”
“不！”

Hu was not yet ready to tell him about Changgen.
胡雪岩还不想跟他说跷脚长根的事，只这样答道：

“I need him to lead me to someone important.
“我要从他身上牵出一个要紧人来！

That is why I must still work with him.”
所以还要跟他合作。”

“Whether you work with him is your affair.
“你跟他合作是你的事，

But have you considered whether the other man will?”
不过，你要想想人家会不会跟他合作呢？”

That brought Hu up short.
这句话提醒了胡雪岩，心里在想：

Yes: Changgen must also know how sharply Yu’s standing had fallen.
是啊！跷脚长根当然也已晓得，俞武成的行情大跌，

Whether he would trust Yu as openly as Hu did was therefore very doubtful.
然则是不是会象自己一样，跟他推心置腹，就大成疑问。

Perhaps the people Zhou meant when he said that nobody paid Yu any heed were precisely Changgen’s men.
说不定周一鸣所说的“没有人买他的帐”，正就是跷脚长根那面的人。

The thought convinced Hu that placing Zhou in reserve had been an indispensable move.
念头转到这里，觉得自己布下周一鸣这支伏兵的做法，还真是一步少不得的棋。

He quietly told Liu about his private discussion with Yu and their agreement to arrange a meeting with Changgen.
于是他将俞武成跟他密谈商定，要与跷脚长根见一次面的话，都悄悄说了给刘不才听，

Then he instructed Liu to see Zhou again early the next morning and ask him to use his friends along the waterways to investigate Changgen thoroughly, particularly his relationship with Yu.
然后嘱咐他第二天一早，再去看周一鸣，托他找水路上的朋友，好好去摸一摸跷脚长根的底，看看俞武成跟他的关系如何？


The next morning Liu again slipped out alone on the pretext of visiting a friend.
到了第二天早晨，刘不才依旧托词看朋友，一个人溜了出去，

Hu took morning tea with Yang and Zhu.
胡雪岩则由杨凤毛和朱老大相陪吃早茶，

They said that Yu had gone out early on business and would not return until the afternoon.
说俞武成一清早有事出去了，到午后才能回来。

Hu understood that he had gone to arrange the meeting with Changgen.
胡雪岩心里有数，是安排他跟跷脚长根的约会去了。

After lunch, thoroughly bored, Hu was thinking of using the spare time to inquire into the silk market when Liu hurried back.
到得吃过午饭，胡雪岩深感无聊，正想利用这段闲工夫，去打听打听丝市，刘不才匆匆赶了回来，

The moment he saw Hu, he beckoned discreetly, drew him into a secluded spot, and asked in a low voice, “Has old Yu returned?”
一见胡雪岩便悄悄招手，拉到僻处，压低声音问道：“俞老头回来了没有？”

“How did you know he had gone out?”
“你怎么知道俞老头出去了？”

“Never mind that for the moment.”
“你先不必问。”

“He has not come back yet.”
“还没有回来！”

“Good, good!
“还好，还好，

You were clearly destined to be saved.”
真是命中该救。”

“What?”
“咦！”

Hu was badly startled.
胡雪岩大吃一惊，

“What do you mean?”
“你怎么说？”

“Zhou Yiming is a capable fellow.
“周一鸣真得力。

What he has discovered will give you a shock.
打听来的消息，说出来要吓你一跳。

Changgen is preparing a Hongmen banquet—a feast that conceals a trap.
跷脚长根摆下了‘鸿门宴’，

It is meant to catch not only you, but old Yu as well.”
不但你，连俞老头都要陷在里面。”

“This—” Hu steadied himself and thought for a moment, then asked calmly, “Take your time.
“这……”胡雪岩定定神先想一想，然后沉着地问：“你慢慢儿说，

What has happened?”
是怎么回事？”


According to Zhou’s information, Changgen had heard that the Songjiang Chief had changed his mind and that Yu was talking about an amnesty.
据周一鸣打听来的消息是如此，跷脚长根听说“松江老大”变了卦，俞武成又谈什么招安，

Suspecting Yu of intending to betray his friends, he had decided to carry matters through without half measures and seize Yu as well.
疑心他要出卖朋友，因而一不做，二不休，决定连俞武成一起下手，

He planned to abduct them and demand the boatload of foreign guns as ransom.
预备绑架勒索，条件就是那一船洋枪。

His scheme was to invite Yu and Hu to his house for a meeting, trap them there, and move them to a secret place.
跷脚长很的打算是，请俞武成跟胡雪岩到他家会面，一入牢笼，移换密处，

Once he had obtained what he wanted, he would take the guns and join the Taipings.
等所欲既偿，便带着那船洋枪，投奔洪杨。

Fearing that Hu might refuse to venture so far into the tiger’s den, he had also prepared an alternative venue: a private brothel in the busy part of Tongli.
而且还怕胡雪岩不敢深入虎穴，预备了第二处地方，是同里闹市中的一家“私门头”，

Two sisters who had fallen into prostitution lived there, the younger named Miaozhu and the elder Miaozhen.
内中有一双坠溷的姊妹花，妹妹叫妙珠，姐姐叫妙珍，

Miaozhen was Changgen’s exclusive mistress.
是跷脚长根的禁脔。

Like Zhu’s house, theirs had a landing just outside the back door.
她家跟朱老大家一样，开出后门，就是河埠，

The captives could be bundled into a boat in the middle of the night without anyone knowing.
半夜里绑架落船，人不知，鬼不觉。

The report was astonishing, but also highly doubtful.
这消息太可惊了，但也太可疑了，

Hu could scarcely believe it.
胡雪岩实在不能相信，

Such conduct would be a grave violation of the brotherhoods’ code.
因为这样做法，在江湖上来说，是异常“伤道”的，

If Changgen intended it, his preparations must be extremely secret.
跷脚长根纠有此心，部署一定异常机密，

How could Zhou have discovered them so easily?
如何轻易能让周一鸣打听得到？

“I thought the same,” Liu replied when Hu raised the question.
“我也是这么想。”听胡雪岩提出疑问以后，刘不才这样答道，

“But Old Zhou is adamant that the information is completely reliable.
“但老周说得斩钉截铁，消息万分可靠。

He says he happened to meet someone who knew the inside story.
他又说，这也是无意中遇到一个知道内幕的人，

他承认事情太巧，说是你鸿运当头，才有这种逢凶化吉的机遇。”

“Very well.
“那好！

We can test it easily enough.
这一试就试出来了。

What did you say the sisters were called?”
你说，那私门头姐妹叫什么名字？”

“Miaozhen and Miaozhu.”
“妙珍，妙珠。”


Hu nodded and looked around.
胡雪岩点点头，四面一望，

A writing desk stood by the window, with a brush and inkstone.
窗前就是书桌，有副笔砚，

The inkstone was covered in dust, only half an inkstick remained, and the brush he took from its rack had a worn-out point.
砚台尘封，墨剩了半段，拔出笔架上的笔来看，笔锋已秃，

They would have to make do.
这都只得将就了，

He poured a little tea into the inkstone himself, began grinding the ink, and beckoned Liu closer.
他亲自倒了点茶汁在砚台中，一面磨墨，一面招手将刘不才唤到跟前，

“Find any scrap of paper,” he said softly, “and write this for me.
低声说过：“你随便找张纸，替我写下来，

Just one sentence: ‘If not at Changgen’s, then at Miaozhen’s.’”
写一句话好了：不在长根家，就在妙珍家。”

He went outside to keep watch.
说着，他走到门外去替刘不才“望风”。

In his haste Liu could find no paper.
急切间就是找不到纸，

Necessity supplied an idea: he spread a snow-white Hangzhou silk handkerchief on the table, wrote the ten characters, folded it, and handed it to Hu, who carefully hid it in the pocket of his underjacket next to his skin.
情急智生，刘不才将一方雪白的杭纺手绢，铺在桌上，提笔写了那十个字，然后折了起来，交到胡雪岩手里，他很慎重地藏在贴肉小褂子的口袋里。

Hu now changed his plans.
这一来，胡雪岩就改了主意，

Claiming that he wanted an afternoon nap, he shut himself in his room to consider how to meet this possible and unexpected turn of events.
托词想睡午觉，把自己关在屋子里，筹划应付可能会有的这一番意外变化，

Liu meanwhile joined the gaming table arranged by their host.
刘不才则在主人的安排下，上了牌桌。

Shortly after four, when refreshments were being served, Yu returned and immediately asked for Hu.
到了四点多钟吃点心的时候，俞武成回来了，一来便问胡雪岩。

By then Hu had actually fallen asleep.
他倒是真的睡着了，

Zhu woke him and invited him to the waterside pavilion to meet Yu.
为朱老大唤醒，请到水阁跟俞武成见面。


“I have seen Changgen.
“我去看了跷脚长根，

He was delighted to hear you had come, and wants to give you a welcoming dinner tomorrow evening, when you can discuss everything in detail,” Yu said.
他听说你来了，很高兴，明天晚上替你接风，详谈一切。”俞武成说，

“I told him all you said.
“我把你的话都告诉了他，

He quite understands that the provincial treasury is not what it once was.
他也很体谅，藩库已不比从前，

A month’s gratuity will at least give the men something to show for it.”
一个月的恩饷，对弟兄也总算有了交代。”

Yu spoke enthusiastically, but Hu was noticeably cool.
俞武成说得很起劲，胡雪岩却显得相当冷淡，

He asked calmly, “Where does he intend to give me dinner?”
平静地问道：“他预备请我在哪里吃饭？”

“Wherever suits the guest.
“主随客便！”俞武成说，

If you do not mind the journey, you can go to his house.
“如果你不嫌路远，就到他那里，

He lives at Pingwang, which is not really so far away.
他住在平望，说远也不远。

Otherwise, here in Tongli.
不然，就在同里，

He has a long-standing mistress here, a well-known private courtesan.
他有个老相好是这里出名的私门头，

名叫？”他敲敲自己的额角，

“My memory has grown poor these last two years.
“这两年的记性坏了，

Why has it suddenly escaped me?”
怎么一下子就想不起？”

“是不是叫妙珍？”

“妙珍，妙珍！”俞武成一叠连声地：

Old Hu, how did you know?”
“老胡，你怎么知道？”

“大哥！”胡雪岩用极冷静的声音答道：“我给你看样东西。”

不用说，就是刘不才的那块杭纺手绢，

展开来铺在桌上，潦潦草草十个大字：“不在长根家，就在妙珍家。”

“老胡，”俞武成疑云满面，“这，这是啥讲究？”

胡雪岩不答他的话，只顾自己说：

“Brother, we are in the same boat now, with our lives bound together.
“大哥，今天我们同船合命，

有哈话你无论如何不能瞒我！”

His grave expression told Yu that there was much behind this, and that the situation might be urgent.
看他面色凝重，俞武成便知内中大有文章，而且事机可能非常急迫，

于是拉着他的膀子说：“来，来！

到我房间里去谈。”


The quarters Zhu had prepared for his master were not only elegant but secure: a little courtyard thick with flowers and trees, with three single-storey rooms along its northern side.
朱老大为他师父预备的住处，不但讲究，而且严密，是个花木扶疏的小院落，北面三间平房，

Yu occupied the innermost room.
俞武成往在最里面那一间，

He led Hu inside and sat beside a small round rosewood table at the window, facing outwards so that nobody passing could escape his notice.
引客入内，在一张临窗的红木小圆桌旁边坐下，脸朝着外，窗外若是有人经过，绝逃不脱他的视、

The precaution was really unnecessary.
其实这是顾虑，

Ever since the plot to seize the foreign guns had begun, these three fine rooms had been forbidden ground.
从开始筹划要动那票洋枪开始，这三间精舍，便成了禁地，

Apart from Zhu and Yang, nobody dared enter without permission.
除却朱老大和杨凤毛以外，什么人都不敢擅自入内的。

“Old Hu, I imagine you must have another channel of information,” Yu said.
“老胡，我想你一定另外有路子！”俞武成说，

“Since you say our lives are bound together, do not keep it from me if your side has other plans.”
“既然你说同船合命，你那边如果另有打算，也不要瞒我。”

A worldly man’s eyes were sharper than shears: he had seen the clue at once.
真是“光棍眼，赛夹剪”，一下就看出端倪来了，

Hu naturally concealed it no longer.
胡雪岩自然不肯再隐瞒，

“We have no other plans.
“另外打算是没有，

Another channel of information, yes.
另外有路子，倒是真的。

不过这条路，来得也意外，

回头我当然一五一十都要告诉大哥你听。”

他停了一下说：

“First let me ask you something.
“我先请问大哥一句话，

What sort of man is Changgen?
跷脚长根为人怎么样？

跟大哥的交情够不够？”

“He has always been a schemer.
“要说他为人，向来是有心计的，

至于跟我的交情，那就难说了。”

“I am not particularly close to him personally, but his master belonged to my generation.
“我跟他本人交情不算深，不过，他的‘前人’跟我一辈，

叫做‘金毛狗炳奎’。

我救过金毛狗的性命，这话一时也说不清楚。”俞武成紧接着说：

Changgen was one of his favourite disciples.
“长根是金毛狗最喜欢的一个徒弟，

On his deathbed, the Golden-haired Dog told his disciples, ‘I cannot repay my debt to Yu in this life.
金毛狗临死的时候，关照徒弟：俞某人的恩，我今生是无法报答了！
