“He explained frankly to Mr Xuexuan that we wanted the sworn family connection for the weight of his name, to persuade our old clan head.
“五哥跟王雪公老实说了，结这门干亲，是借重他的名望，好叫我们那位老族长服帖。

Mr Xuexuan was very understanding.
王雪公很体谅，

Since that was the purpose, he said, we might as well propose the marriage first.
他说，既然如此，不妨先提亲事，

The weather is growing hot; there's no need to trouble Seventh Sister with a journey.
现在天气也热，不必劳动七姐。

When we marry in the cool of autumn, he'll find time to attend the feast and complete the sworn-sibling ceremony then.
秋凉办喜事，他抽空来吃喜酒，再补认亲的礼节。

If he can't come, I can take her to him afterwards, combining her customary post-wedding family visit with the ceremony.”
如呆他不能来，就让我送七姐去，回门带认亲，一事两便。”

“Excellent!
“好极了！

Since he says so, obedience is the best respect.
雪公既有这话，恭敬不如从命，

I needn't return to Hangzhou for now.
我暂时不必回杭州，

Once Changgen's business is finished, I'll go from Suzhou to Shanghai.
办完了跷脚长根的事，由苏州回上海。”

What about Old Qiu?”
胡雪岩又问：“老裘怎么办？”

“He was due to leave Shanghai today.
“预定今天从上海动身。

I've met Yu's son too: mature beyond his years and thoroughly dependable.
俞老的那位少君，我也见着了，少年老成，人很妥当。

Brother Five has made arrangements throughout Songjiang.
松江一带，五哥已经关照过了，

The passage is sure to go smoothly.
必定一路顺风，

Set your mind at rest.”
你放心好了。”

This succession of good news lifted Hu's spirits and put him in an expansive mood.
由于这一连串诸事顺利的好消息，胡雪岩的心境开朗，兴致大好，

He decided to entertain on a grand scale.
决定大大地请一次客。

There was no time to choose another date; that evening's banquet must be enlarged.
另外挑日子已不可能，就拿这晚上的宴会扩大，

He put Liu Bucai in charge.
这件事交给刘不才去办，

After consulting Yang Fengmao and Zhu, Liu invited everyone locally connected with the Grain Transport Brotherhood.
他跟杨凤毛、朱老大商议，将当地与漕帮有渊源的人，统统请到。

Another difficulty was Changgen's position: before visiting dignitaries like You, he could hardly occupy the chief seat, yet making him merely another guest would slight him.
又顾虑到跷脚长根当着尤五他们这班远客，不便高踞首座，而又不宜委屈他做个陪客，

Liu explained this to Hu and proposed listing Changgen as a fellow host, with his name first on the invitations.
特地向胡雪岩说明，将跷脚长根也当作主人，发帖子拿他列在前面，

That would honour him handsomely.
这样也就算很捧他了。


By evening the distinguished guests had gathered, at least forty in all, but Changgen, one of the hosts, had still not appeared.
尴尬的是到了傍晚，嘉宾云集，总数不下四十，主人之一的跷脚长根始终不曾露面。

Hu was hard pressed to attend to everyone alone, and his private misgivings made it more unpleasant still.
胡雪岩一个人八面周旋，未免吃力，而心里犹自不断嘀咕，更觉得不是滋味。

“Sister Zhen, where has Changgen gone?” he asked quietly.
“珍姐！” 胡雪岩悄悄问妙珍，“长根到底到哪里去了？

“Surely you have some idea?”
你总有点数吧？”

“I can't guess.
“我也猜不透。

One of his men came for him early this morning.
一早有他一个弟兄来叫，

They spoke privately for a while, and he left without saying anything further.
背人谈了一会就走了，临走什么话都没有留下。

I think we should serve the meal. We can't keep the guests waiting.”
我看，”妙珍倒很有决断，“不便让客人久等，就开席吧！”

Four tables were laid.
于是筵开四席，

After much polite yielding over places, everyone sat down.
推让多时，方始坐定。

Liu had prepared a list of Tongli's celebrated courtesans and passed it round.
刘不才早就有了准备，将同里的“名花”列成一张单子，在席间传观，

Those wishing to summon an acquaintance marked her name.
有熟识愿意招呼的，便拿笔做个记号，

Notes went flying out, and the beauties arrived one after another.
然后飞笺催花，莺莺燕燕，陆续而至，

Those with familiar customers joined them; Liu matched the others as he thought suitable.
有熟客的自然去就熟客，没有熟客的，由刘不才看情形撮合。

Strings, flutes and singing followed in succession, with chairs and horses at the front and boats at the back.
一时丝竹歌喉，接踵而起，前门轿马后门船，

The excitement was extraordinary.
热闹非凡。

Passers-by stopped to stare and ask which wealthy guest could put on such a display.
这番豪举，吸引了无数路人，驻足探望，纷纷探询，是哪位阔客有此手面，

When told that Changgen was the host, some wondered how he had suddenly come to such magnificence.
等听说是跷脚长根做主人，便有人诧异，不知道他何以忽然有此阔绰的场面。

Changgen himself was equally surprised.
还有个诧异的人，就是跷脚长根自己，

Finding Miaozhen's house so crowded, he hesitated to push his way in and stopped an attendant.
一见妙珍那里如此热闹，倒有些不便乱闯，进门拉住一个相帮问道：

“Who's giving this party?”
“是什么人在这里请客？”

“Why, Seventh Master Li, that's a funny question!
“咦！李七爷，你这话问得可要叫人好笑？

Aren't you hosting it with Master Hu?”
不是我自己跟胡老爷一起请客吗？”

Changgen understood: Hu was giving him face.
跷脚长根明白了，是胡雪岩替他做面子，

Rather than enter the hall at once, he went round a side passage to the back, found Miaozhen and learned the details.
于是先不进大厅，由备弄绕到后面，把妙珍找了来，细细一问，才知究竟。

Then he entered the hall, clasped his hands and bowed all round. “Forgive me!
“对不起，对不起！”跷脚长根走到厅上，握拳作了个罗圈揖，

For a host to arrive late is a grave discourtesy.
“我做主人的迟到，失礼之至。

There is nothing to say.
没有什么说，

I'll drink three penalty cups.”
罚我三杯。”

He took Hu's cup and drained it three times, then greeted the guests in order of seniority.
说着，便端起胡雪岩面前的酒杯，连着干了三杯，然后看行辈大小，到席前一一招呼。

His manners were both graceful and attentive.
那番应酬，相当漂亮周到。


When the banquet ended, the tables were cleared for serious gambling.
盛筵已毕，接着便拉开台子豪赌，

Once the guests were settled, Changgen drew Hu aside and spoke reproachfully.
安排好了客人，跷脚长根将胡雪岩拉到一边，用埋怨的口气，说道：

“Old Hu, you handled something badly.
“老胡，有件事你做得不对了。

There was nearly serious trouble.”
差点出大乱子！”

“What?”
“怎么？”

“You ought to have told me before shipping the guns out of Shanghai.”
“你从上海起运洋枪，也该先跟我说一声！”

“Oh!”
“喔！喔！”

Hu hastened to admit his fault.
胡雪岩急忙认锗：

“An oversight.
“这是我疏忽。

I'm sorry.”
对不起，对不起！”

“I only learned this morning.
“我今天一早才晓得，

It took me until the afternoon to settle things.”
忙到下午才算摆平。”

He then disclosed the state of his forces.
于是，跷脚长根透露了他部下的情形，

Not all his more than twenty-seven hundred men obeyed him willingly.
两千七百多人，并非个个都肯听他的指挥，

One group was unreliable, and he had held it down for the moment by the weight of his seniority.
有一批人态势不稳，只是他以大压小，暂时制服着。

When he abruptly changed course and made peace, they turned against him and prepared to follow the original plan, seizing the boatload of guns under Qiu's escort.
及至跷脚长根翻然变计，化干戈为玉帛，那一批人便有反他的意思，而且预备依照原定计划硬夺裘丰言所押运的那一船洋枪。

Fortunately, the plot leaked.
幸好，事机不密，

One of Changgen's trusted men learned the details, hurried to Tongli through the night and roused him from Miaozhen's bed at dawn.
为跷脚长根的一个心腹探明究竟，星夜赶来同里，这天一清早将他从妙珍的香衾中唤了起来，

He went to the border between Qingpu and Jiading and managed to intercept them.
赶到青浦与嘉定交界之处，才算截住了那批人。

“I stopped them, but it took a great deal of effort.
“截是截住了，费了好大的手脚。

The guns have passed Jinshanwei now.
那船洋枪，已过金山卫，

With the Old Master's men there, they're safe.
有松江老大的人在，不要紧了。

But...”
不过……”

He shook his head and would say no more.
跷脚长根摇摇头，不愿再说下去。


Hu felt both grateful and uneasy.
胡雪岩感激而不安，

Changing his form of address, he said, “Seventh Brother Li, you've done me a great service.
“李七哥，”他改了称呼，“你帮了我这个大忙，

If you're in difficulty now, it's my turn to help.
现在你自己有为难之处，该我出力。

Tell me.
你说，

Whatever lies within my power, I'll do.”
只要我力量用得上，无不从命。”

Changgen thought for a long time, then spoke firmly.
跷脚长根想了好一会，毅然说道：

“You're different from other men.
“你老兄与众不同，

I'll tell you the truth.
我就跟你说实话吧，

Their leader was a disciple of one of my fellow initiates.
那批人为头的是我一个‘同参’的徒弟，

I had him done away with.”
让我‘做’掉了……”

Hu would dare almost anything and cared little for most dangers, but these words changed his expression.
胡雪岩什么事都敢做，什么事都不在乎，只有听见这话，脸色一变，不由得抢着问道：

“What?
“怎么？

You killed him?”
你拿他杀掉了？”

Changgen nodded gravely.
跷脚长根脸色凝重地点点头。

“Then won't his family come to settle accounts?” Hu exclaimed.
“那么，”胡雪岩失声而言：“他家不要找你算帐？”

“By the rules of our world, I wasn't wrong.
“照江湖上的规矩，我做得不算错，

He disobeyed; the business was too important and too urgent.
他不听话，而且这件事关系太大，事情又紧急，

No one can say I acted improperly.
我这样做，没有人可以说我不对。

But public duty and private feeling are separate.
不过，公是公，私是私，

The rules obliged me to put him to death; personal feeling obliges me to attend to what follows his death.”
为了家门的规矩，我不能不做掉他，论到私情，他的后事我不能不料理。”

“I understand.
“喔，喔，我懂了，我懂了！

Like Zhuge Liang executing Ma Su, whose family had an eighty-year-old mother—you can't ignore her.”
好比诸葛亮斩马谡，他‘家有八旬老母’，你不能不管。”

Hu paused, then asked directly, “Do you need money?”
胡雪岩略停一下，直截了当地问道：“李七哥，你是不是要铜钱用？”

“Yes.
“是的。

Compensation for his family, for one thing.
一面是抚恤，

Then some men won't speak openly but don't want to stay with me.
一面有些人嘴里不敢说，心里不肯跟我，

Better let them go.”
我想不如打发掉的好。”

“Quite right.
“对！

That makes a clean settlement.
这样做倒也干净。”胡雪岩问道：

How much?
“你要多少？

I have ten thousand taels ready.
万把银子我现成，

More can be found, but it would take two or three days.”
再多也有，不过要隔个两三天。”

“That's enough.
“够了，够了！

Two thousand for the family, ten taels apiece to those leaving—there are a little over three hundred of them.
两千银子抚恤，打发走路的十两银子一个，大概有三百多人，

Lend me five thousand.”
你借我五千银子好了。”


He limped to the window, took the brush and ink used for writing invitations to courtesans, and laboriously drew up a promissory note.
说着，他一跷一拐地走到窗前，取出写局票用的笔砚，很吃力地写了一张借据，

The handwriting was crooked, but the wording entirely proper: “Received on loan from my friend Hu Xueyan the sum of five thousand taels of standard silver.
字迹歪歪斜斜，措词却很得体：“今借到胡雪岩兄名下纹银五千两整。

As we are close friends, no guarantor or interest is required.
彼此至好，无保无息，

Repayment is agreed within three months.
约期三个月归清。

This note is made as evidence.”
特立笔据存照。”

He signed it “Li Changgen”.
下面具名是“李长根”。

While he wrote, Hu found Liu and prepared the money.
他在写借据的当儿，胡雪岩已去寻着刘不才，准备好了银数，

When he returned and Changgen handed him the note, he did not even look at it, but held it to the candle and burned it.
等回进来，跷脚长根递过那张借据，胡雪岩看都不看，就在蜡烛火上点燃烧掉，

“Seventh Brother Li, my business partner Gu Yingchun tells me I've made a good profit on silk.
“李七哥，我那个合伙做生意的好朋友古应春告诉我，我在丝上赚了一票。

Our own people should share misfortunes and blessings alike.”
自己人有难同当，有福同享，”

He handed over a bundle of banknotes.
他将一叠银票递了过去：

“Here is your share of the profit: ten thousand taels.”
“你分一万银子的红。”

“But...but...”
“这，这……”

Changgen, normally so shrewd, capable and eloquent, could not find words.
一向精明强干长于词令的跷脚长根不知道怎么说才好。

“We have many years of friendship ahead.”
“李七哥！交朋友的日子长得很。”

Hu patted his back and walked away smiling.
胡雪岩拍拍他的背，微笑着走了。


The gathering ended in complete enjoyment.
这一夜尽欢而散。

After the guests had gone, Hu offered to settle the account in cash, but Miaozhen refused.
送走了客人，胡雪岩要用现银开销，妙珍不肯收，

Changgen had told her to put everything on his account.
因为跷脚长根已有话关照，都归他算。

Besides, she had collected more than two hundred taels in gaming commissions and felt embarrassed to charge her guests anything further.
妙珍又说，头钱打了两百多两银子，她亦不好意思再要客人有何花费。

Hu had to let her have her way.
胡雪岩只得由她。

A late supper was set out, and they gathered round one table.
于是摆上消夜，团团一桌，

Taking up his chopsticks, Hu said at once, “Let's finish early.”
胡雪岩扶起筷子，先就说了一句：“早点散吧！”

“Finish?” Changgen asked.
“散？”跷脚长根问道：

“Aren't you staying here tonight?” Miaozhen urged him to stay too, but he insisted that urgent work must be done that night.
“今天不住在这里？”于是妙珍也劝他留宿，而胡雪岩因有事要连夜赶办，执意不从。

Miaozhu's face fell.
妙珠的脸色便不好看了，

Pleading a headache, she excused herself and left the table.
托词头痛，告个罪离席而去。

“This rather spoils the occasion,” Gu said.
“这未免煞风景了！”古应春说，

“Old Hu, why do it?”
“老胡，何苦？”

Hu said nothing.
胡雪岩不响，

He rose and went to see Miaozhu.
站起身来，去看妙珠，

In her room he found her sitting alone at the dressing table, wiping away tears.
进房就发现她一个人坐要梳妆台前面抹眼泪。

“What's wrong?”
“怎么样？”

He rested his hands on her shoulders and spoke gently.
他走过去，扶着她的肩，用服软的声音说道：

“Are you angry with me?”
“是生我的气？”

She shook her head. “No.”
“没有！”妙珠摇摇头。

“Then why these sudden tears?”
“那么，好端端，淌什么眼泪？”

“My own feelings.
“是我自己心里有感触。”

I was born to a bitter fate, earning my living in this miserable trade.” Her voice was full of sorrow and resentment.
妙珠不胜幽怨地，“生来命苦，吃这碗断命饭！”


Hu could think of no suitable reply.
胡雪岩觉得有些搭不上话，

After a moment he took out a two-hundred-tael note and pressed it into her hand.
想了想，取出二百两银票塞到她手里说：

“I return to Suzhou tomorrow afternoon.
“明天下午我就回苏州了。

Buy yourself something to eat with this.”
这给你买点东西吃。”

“I don't want it.”
“我不要！”

She pushed it away.
妙珠将银票往外一推，冷冷答道：

“I sell smiles, not tears.”
“我卖笑不卖眼泪。”

Beneath the angry words lay a deeper feeling.
这句气话的情分就深了，

Hu stood stunned, unable to speak for a long while.
胡雪岩愣在那里，好半天作声不得。

“Please go.
“你请吧！

Didn't you say you had important work to do in the middle of the night?”
不是说半夜里还有要紧事要办？”

“I'm not deceiving you.”
“我不骗你。”

He changed his approach.
他改变了办法：

“Then I'll do it here.
“这样，我就在你这里办。

Have you any writing paper?”
你这里有信纸没有？”

“There's a stationer's next door.
“间壁就是笺纸店，

We can knock them up even now.”
敲开门来也不要紧。”

“Good.
“那就是了。

Send someone for the best letter paper and envelopes, and make a pot of strong tea.
你叫人去买点顶好的信笺、信封，再沏一壶浓茶，

Mr Gu and I must discuss some letters.” He warned her solemnly, “They are confidential.
我跟古老爷要商量写信。”胡雪岩又郑重地告诫：“是机密信，

That's why I meant to go home to write them.
所以我先要回家写，

Since I'm staying here, you must never repeat anything you hear.”
此刻在你这里写，你听见了什么，千万不可以说出去。”

“Set your mind at rest.
“你放心！

I won't even listen.”
我听都不听。”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十九章（中）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Nine, Part Two
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Hu therefore kept Gu Yingchun with him and used Miaozhu’s dressing table as a desk.
于是胡雪岩将古应春留了下来，就拿妙珠的梳妆台当书桌，

She was as good as her word.
她倒是心口如一，

After providing paper, brushes and tea, she sent the maids to bed and withdrew into the adjoining room herself.
备好了纸笔茶水，关照娘姨、大姐都去睡觉，然后自己也避了到套房里。

“Gu,” Hu said quietly, sitting on the edge of the bed, “this whole amnesty business was only settled tonight, when Changgen came back.
“老古，”胡雪岩坐在床沿上低声说道：“直到今天晚上，长根回来，这件招抚的大事，才算定局。

I’ll tell you everything that happened.
我把前后经过，详详细细说给你听，

Please write a letter to Education Commissioner He for me, and tomorrow morning Old Zhou can take it there specially.”
请你替我写封信给何学台，明天一早交给老周专送。”

“Aren’t you about to return to Suzhou yourself?
“你不是马上就要到苏州去了，

Wouldn’t it be better to speak to him in person?”
当面谈倒不好？”

“When the situation was uncertain and nothing was settled, it was better not to leave anything in writing.
“情形不稳，事未定局，不好留什么笔迹。

As matters stand now, a formal written account is needed to show that we take it seriously.
照现在的样子，一个要有个正式的书面，才显得郑重。

Besides, Commissioner He still has to discuss it with the military affairs office.
而况，何学使还要跟营务处去谈，

An oral message might be misunderstood.
口头传话，或许误会意思，

Put it clearly on paper, and there can be no mistake.”
不如写在纸上，明明白白，不会弄错。”

By the time the long letter was finished, the clock was striking three.
这一封长信写完，自鸣钟正打三下。

It was near the summer solstice, when the days were longest and the nights shortest.
夏至前后，正是昼最长、夜最短的时候，

A faint dawn was showing outside, though the deep night was still cool as water.
看窗外曙色隐隐，夜深如水，

Imagining Miaozhu fast asleep, Hu did not want to wake her and suggested that he and Gu share the large bed.
想来妙珠的好梦正酣，胡雪岩不忍唤醒她，便跟古应春商量，两个人睡一张大床。

“Why should we?” Gu laughed.
“这又何必？”古应春笑道：

“With such warm, fragrant beauty waiting to fill your arms, it would be a shame to waste Heaven’s gifts.
“放着‘软玉温香’，不去‘拥满怀’，未免暴殄天物。

Naturally, I shall take the small bed and you two the large one.”
自然是我用小床，你们用大床。”

The remark stirred Hu, and he changed his mind.
一句话说得胡雪岩动了心，便改了主意，

“You take the large bed yourself.
“你一个人睡大床吧！”他说，

I’ll squeeze in beside her.”
“我跟她去挤一挤。”

“There are pleasures in being squeezed together too.
“挤有挤的味道。

As you please.”
随便你。”

Gu undressed and got into bed.
说着，古应春便解衣上床了。


Hu quietly pushed open the adjoining door.
胡雪岩悄悄推开套房的门，

A flame still flickered, and the gauze curtains hung half drawn.
只见残焰犹在，罗帐半垂，

Wrapped in a lined coverlet, Miaozhu lay facing the wall, snoring faintly.
妙珠裹着一幅夹被，面朝里睡，微有鼾声。

He tiptoed in, closed the door softly, undressed, put out the light and felt his way into bed beside her.
他蹑手蹑脚地走了进去，轻轻关好了门，卸衣灭灯，摸到床上，跟妙珠并头睡下。

He had no wish to disturb her, but could not settle his own thoughts.
他不想惊动她，但心却静不下来，

In her hair she wore a string of pearl orchids, flowers particularly suited to a pillow: mingling with a woman’s hair oil, their scent grew fuller, rich and alluring enough to set the heart astir.
只为了她头上的一串珠兰，此物最宜枕上，沾染妇人的发脂而香味愈透，浓郁媚冶，令人心荡。

Crowded into the little bed, Hu also recalled his time with A’zhu aboard Old Zhang’s Wuxi fast boat.
胡雪岩挤在这张小床上，又想起从前在老张那条“无锡快”上与阿珠相处的往事，

Those memories brought a sense of melancholy and left him still more restless.
心中不免惆怅，越发难以平静。

Without realising it, he turned from side to side and woke Miaozhu.
不知不觉的转身反侧，吵醒了妙珠，

Discovering a man beside her in her sleep naturally frightened her.
睡梦里头忽然发觉有个男人在自己身边，自然一惊，

As though possessed, she suddenly raised herself halfway, clasped her arms across her body and stared sideways with wide eyes.
她仿佛着魔似的，倏然抬起半身，双手环抱，眼睛睁得好大地斜视着。

“It’s you!”
“是你！”

She let out a breath.
她透口气，

“You gave me such a fright.”
“吓我一大跳。”

“You might say you gave me one!” Hu laughed.
“你倒不说吓我一跳。”胡雪岩失笑了。

“Sneaking about like a ghost!
“真正是，鬼头鬼脑！”妙珠嗔道：

Why creep in like that?”
“为啥要这样子偷偷摸摸？”

“Creeping about makes it more amusing.”
“偷偷摸摸才有趣。”

He took her arm and drew her down again.
胡雪岩伸手一拉，把她拉得又重新睡下，

“I didn’t mean to wake you.
“我本来不想吵醒你，

I simply couldn’t sleep.”
实在是睡不着。”


“Where is Mr Gu?”
“古老爷呢？”

“In the large bed.
“他在大床上，

He has only just lain down too.”
也是刚睡下。”

“Then he may still be awake.
“恐怕还不曾睡着，

Keep your voice down.” She asked, “Is the letter finished?”
声音轻一点。”妙珠又问：“信写好了？”

“Of course. We wouldn’t go to bed before finishing it.”
“自然写好了才睡。”

“Who was it to?”
“写给谁的？”

“Someone in Suzhou.”
“写到苏州去的。”

“Aren’t you going back to Suzhou?
“你不是要回苏州了吗？

Why write, then?
为啥还要写信？

Does that mean you’ll stay another couple of days?”
照这样说，你还住两天？”

The succession of questions plainly revealed her wish to keep him.
这一连串的问句中，留他的意思，表露无遗。

Hu thought that the truth would only upset her again, so he answered vaguely, “Well, well, nothing is fixed.”
胡雪岩心想，如果说了实话，又惹她不快，因而使含含糊糊地答道：“嗯，嗯，也没有定规。”


Miaozhu began asking about his family.
于是妙珠便问胡雪岩家里的情形。

Since her tone suggested nothing more than idle conversation to pass the time, Hu was unguarded.
由于她是闲谈解闷的语气，胡雪岩便不作戒备，

He told her frankly that his elderly mother was still living, that he had a wife and a concubine, and that he had no son yet.
老母在堂，一妻一妾，还没有儿子等等，都老实告诉了她。

“Third Master Liu is so shrewd and capable.
“刘三爷是极精明、极能干的人，

I imagine your ‘Huzhou wife’ must be formidable too.”
想来你那位‘湖州太太’也厉害得很！”

“Not in the least.
“一点不厉害。

She is goodness itself, a truly gentle soul.”
真正阿弥陀佛的好人。”

“That is your good fortune.”
“这是你的福气！”

“Thank you.”
“谢谢你！”

Hu smiled with some satisfaction.
胡雪岩带些得意的笑着，

“My luck is not bad.”
“我的福气还不错。”

“It is your Huzhou wife’s good fortune too.”
“也是你那位湖州太太的福气。”

“Not necessarily.”
“这倒不见得。”

“To marry someone as capable and considerate as you, Master Hu, and live comfortably without a care about food or clothing!
“嫁着你胡老爷这样又能干、又体贴的人，过的是不愁吃、不愁穿的你心日子。

You are so well liked, too.
你胡老爷人缘又好，

Wherever you go, there is lively company and every distinction.
走到哪里都是热热闹闹，风风光光。

Isn’t that good fortune?”
这还不叫福气？”

“When I’m easy to deal with, I’m very easy.
“我这个人好说话时很好说话，

When I’m difficult, I can be very difficult indeed.”
难弄的时候也很难弄。”

“I can’t see that.
“我倒看不出来。”

You seem the most accommodating of men.”
妙珠紧接着说，“照我看，你最随和不过。”

“Being accommodating has its drawbacks.
“随和也有随和的坏处，

It is easy to get involved with women elsewhere.
外头容易七搭八搭，

Someone jealous could be driven wild.”
气量小的会气煞。”

“It is perfectly ordinary for a successful man to have several wives and concubines.” Miaozhu suddenly asked, “If you have a Huzhou wife, surely you have a Shanghai wife and a Suzhou wife too?”
“男人家有出息的，三妻四妾也是常事。”妙珠忽然问道，“你有了湖州太太，总还有上海太太、苏州太太？”

“Not yet.
“那倒还没有。”

I haven’t happened to meet anyone who suits me.”
胡雪岩说，“一时也遇不着中意的人。”


Miaozhu longed to bring her face close and ask, “What do you think of me?”
妙珠恨不得凑过脸去说一声：你看我怎么样？

But she could not bring herself to offer herself so openly, and feared that he might think less of her.
但这样毛遂自荐，一则老不起这张面皮，二则也怕他看轻了自己，

She held back.
只好忍着。

Then she reflected: with all her qualities, in what way was she inferior to anyone else?
但转念一想，放着自己这样的人才，哪一样比别人差？

For him to say in her presence that he had not met anyone who suited him was rather hard to bear.
他竟说“遇不着中意的人”，倒着实有点不服气。

“Then what sort of person would suit you?”
“那么，”她问，“要怎样的人，你才算中意呢？”

Hu now heard where this was leading and chose his answer carefully.
胡雪岩听出因头来了，答话便很谨慎，

“That is hard to say,” he replied, deliberately evading her.
“这很难说，”他有意闪避，

“Beauty lies in a lover’s eyes.
“情人眼里出西施，

There is no fixed rule.”
没有定规的。”

That left her nothing to say.
这一来，妙珠就说不下去了，

She could hardly demand, “Am I not your lover?”
总不能这样质问：难道我不是你的情人？

Even if she could bring herself to ask, what pleasure would there be in it?
这话就问得出来，也乏味。

Her heart was wholly devoted to him, yet he treated her as a roadside willow or a flower on a wall, to be plucked and thrown away at will.
自己这佯一片痴心待他，而他真当自己路柳墙花，随折随弃，

It chilled her.
真是叫人寒心。

With that thought came an inexpressible sense of injustice.
念头转到这里，顿觉有无限难诉的委屈，

Sorrow filled her heart, her eyes grew hot, and tears began to roll down.
心头凄楚，眼眶随即发热，眼泪滚滚而下。


Their cheeks were touching.
两个人是贴着脸的，

Both looked up at the bed curtains, so Hu could not see her crying, but her warm tears ran onto his right cheek.
虽然眼睛都朝着帐顶，他看不见她哭，但热泪下流，沾着胡雪岩的右颊，

He could hardly fail to notice.
不能没有感觉，

Turning towards her, he exclaimed in alarm, “Why, you’re crying again!
转脸一看，大惊问道：“咦！你又哭了！

What is it?”
为什么？

“I have something on my mind.
““我有心事。

You don’t understand.”
你不晓得！”

“What has touched your feelings this time?”
“又是触动什么心境了？”

“I was thinking that Sister Zhen will soon have a settled home.
“我在想，珍姐倒快有归宿了，

Seventh Master Li told her that once he has accepted the amnesty and become an official, he means to live properly and accomplish something.
李七爷跟她说，这次招安做了官，要好好做人，干一番事业，

He plans to take her into his household.
预备把珍姐接了回去。

We are only a year apart and have never been separated since childhood.
我们姐妹相差一岁，自小到现在没有分开过。

Now she will go her way and I mine.
从今以后，她归她，我归我，

How can I help being sad?”
想想可要伤心？”

“So it is sisterly affection.”
“原来为的姐妹情深。”

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑道：

“I have an idea.
“我倒有个主意，

Why don’t you marry Seventh Master Li along with your sister?”
何不你跟你姐姐一起嫁了李七爷？”

It was a disastrous remark.
这句话说坏了，

Miaozhu’s tears poured out like a river bursting its banks.
妙珠的眼泪，倾江倒海一般，

She jerked round to face the wall, pulled the coverlet over her head and began sobbing aloud.
身子一蹦，面朝里边，拉起夹被蒙着头，“嗬嗬”地哭出声来。

Hu regretted it bitterly, yet was too bewildered to understand why a single joke should distress her so much.
胡雪岩悔恨莫及，同时也有些昏头搭脑地弄不明白，一句笑话，何至于惹得她如此？

There was no time to examine the question.
当然，这时不暇细思，

He explained as gently as he could, then apologised, asking only that she stop crying.
只有好言解释，继以赔罪，只求她住了哭声。

Instead, her sobbing grew louder.
哭声不但不止，且有变本加厉之势，

At last there was a sound at the door.
结果，门上有了响声，

Gu had been woken and had come to ask what was wrong.
古应春被惊醒了，来探问究竟。

“Listen!”
“你听！”

Hu nudged her.
胡雪岩推着她说，

“You’ve woken him.”
“拿人家吵醒了。”

She paid no attention.
妙珠不理，

In fact she welcomed a third person who might mediate, giving her hopes a chance of fulfilment.
心里倒巴不得有个第三者从中排解，好事方始有望，

She cried harder still.
所以反哭得更起劲了。

“The more you’re supported, the drunker you get!”
“你真是，‘越扶越醉’！”

Helpless, Hu rose to open the door.
胡雪岩无奈，只好起床去开了门。


“What has happened?” Gu asked as he entered, studying Hu’s face.
“怎么回事？”古应春踏进来问说，同时仔细看着胡雪岩的脸色，

It wore an expression between laughter and tears.
是啼笑皆非的神情。

“How should I know?
“哪晓得怎么回事？

We were talking quite pleasantly, and suddenly she said she couldn’t bear her sister leaving the profession to marry, and became upset.”
讲话讲得好好地，忽然说舍不得她姐姐从良，伤起心来。”

Before he had finished, Miaozhu threw back the coverlet.
最后一句话不曾说完，妙珠将被一掀，

“You heartless wretch!” she said bitterly, then turned away again and covered her face to weep.
恨恨他说：“你死没良心！”然后又将头转了过去，掩面而啼。

She was deliberately creating a mystery for Gu to investigate, and he duly fell into the trap.
这是有意抛出一个疑团，好让古应春去追问，果然，他中了她的计。

“Little Uncle, how have you offended her?
“小爷叔，你有啥地方得罪妙珠了？

She seems to hate you so much.
拿你恨得这样子，

I can’t understand it.”
真叫人不懂！”

“Neither can I.”
“你不懂，我也不懂。”

Hu could only pretend ignorance.
胡雪岩唯有装傻，

He did not want Gu to intervene, so he shifted aside and gestured towards the door.
而且不希望古应春介入，所以接着便做了个送客出门的姿态，将身子往旁边一挪，手一扬，

“It is almost daylight.
“天快亮了，

Go back to bed.
请上床去吧，

You haven’t much time left to sleep.”
睡不了多少时候了。”

At this, Miaozhu raised her voice, as though losing the third person would leave her helpless and unable to obtain redress.
听这一说，妙珠的哭声突然提高，仿佛第三者一走，她就孤立无援，有冤难诉似地，

Gu hesitated.
于是古应春踌躇了。

“What is it really about?”
“到底为什么？”

“She wants to belong to me, but won’t discuss it properly.
“她要跟我，又不肯好好谈。

Instead, she goes through the whole performance—first tears, then a scene, then threats to hang herself.
弄这‘一哭二闹三上吊’的一套，

Isn’t it absurd?”
你说好笑不好笑？”

Taken by surprise, Gu said without thinking, “But that is a good thing!”
古应春大感意外，不假思索他说了句：“这是好事啊！”

“Good things take time and trouble.
“好事多磨！

We must talk it over slowly and work things out before we can agree.”
总也要慢慢儿谈，慢慢儿磨，才可以谈得拢。”

Hu yawned and again urged him to leave.
胡雪岩打个呵欠，又催他走：

“Please go.
“你请吧，

I want to sleep too.”
我也要睡了。”


Once Gu left, Miaozhu stopped crying.
等古应春一走，妙珠的哭声也停住了，

Hu had at least given some indication of his position, and she waited for him to talk.
因为胡雪岩已有表示，她便等着他来谈。

Instead, he blew out the lamp, got into bed and said nothing.
谁知他一口将灯吹熄，上了床却不开口。

They had reached a deadlock.
事情成了僵局，

Ashamed and angry, and encountering his methods for the first time, she found her love turning to resentment.
妙珠又羞又恼，而且初次领略到胡雪岩的手段，真个因爱成仇，

Unable to turn her thoughts aside, she pursued them deeper into a blind alley.
心思拨不转，拼命往牛角尖里去钻。

The more she thought, the angrier she grew and the less life seemed worth living.
越想越气，越想越觉得做人乏味，

When she looked at Hu and heard him snoring loudly, her thoughts were driven to the brink.
再看胡雪岩时，鼾声大起，这一下更把她的心思迟到了绝路上，

Quietly she rose, found a sash through her tears and brought a chair to the foot of the bed.
悄悄起床，流着眼泪，找了根带子出来，端张椅子到床脚，

She tied the sash to the rail above the bed and put her head into the loop.
在床顶栏杆上，将圈套结好，头一伸上了吊。

Hu’s snoring was feigned.
胡雪岩的鼾声是假的，

He was deliberately ignoring her to escape her entreaties.
有意冷落妙珠；好逃避纠缠，

He knew that she had climbed over him and got up, though not what she was doing.
她起来从他身上跨过下了地，他都知道，只不知道她下了地做些什么，

Suddenly the bed shook.
只觉得床突然一震，

He opened his eyes and was horrified by what he saw.
不由得眼开了眼，一望之下，吓得心胆俱裂，

Leaping out barefoot, he caught her lower body and lifted her until the loop came free.
跳起身来，赤脚下了地，将妙珠的下半身一抱，往上一耸，那个圈套总算卸掉了。

Her breath had only just begun to fail.
妙珠的气刚要闭过去，

Once she had put her head into the loop, she had realised too late that she regretted it; in that instant everything in the world had seemed precious and everyone dear.
上了圈套，后悔嫌迟，那一刹那，只觉得世间样样可爱，人人可亲，

Now, rescued, she forgot his coldness.
所以此时遇救，把胡雪岩的薄情都抛在九霄云外，

Her whole heart was filled with gratitude.
一片心中，除了感激，还是感激，

She threw her arms about his head and burst into uncontrollable sobbing.
趁势抱往他的头，“哇”地一声大哭而特哭。

This woke not only Gu but Miaozhen and the people in both courtyards.
这一下，不但惊醒了古应春，也惊动了妙珍和前后院的闲人，

They hurried over, though, uncertain of their welcome, most remained at the doors and windows, peering in and whispering.
纷纷赶来探望，但心存顾忌，只在窗前门外，探头探脑，窃窃私议，

Miaozhen alone pushed straight inside.
只有妙珍排闼直入，

She found her sister sobbing on the bed and Hu sitting barefoot in a white foreign-cotton undershirt and trousers, looking thoroughly embarrassed.
但见妙珠伏在床上抽噎不止，胡雪岩穿一身白洋布小褂裤，赤着脚坐在那里，样子相当窘迫。

Gu stood to one side as though faced with an impossible problem. Miaozhen could only ask him, “Mr Gu, what is all this about?
她只有向站在一边，仿佛遭遇了绝大难题，不知如何应付的古应春探问：“古老爷，到底为了啥？

Has Miaozhu offended Master Hu?”
是不是妙珠得罪了胡老爷？”

Gu did not answer.
古应春不答，

He pursed his lips and glanced upwards.
只将嘴一努，视线上扬，

Following his gaze, she saw the white silk sash tied to the vermilion bed rail.
她顺着他的眼风看过去，才发觉朱漆床栏杆上，束着一条白绸带子，

Had Miaozhu tried to take her life?
莫非妙珠曾寻死觅活来着？

She wondered, but could not bring herself to ask.
心里疑惑，却怎么样也问不出口来，

It seemed too incredible.
因为这太不可思议了。


Hu was deeply troubled and divided in his feelings, but his mind was exceptionally clear.
这时的胡雪岩，心里异常矛盾，异常难过，但也异常清醒，

To meet whatever difficulties might follow, he felt he must first establish a firm position on the rights and wrongs of the matter.
为了应付可能会有的麻烦，他觉得非先在理上占稳了地步不可。

He therefore put on a stern expression.
于是他沉着脸说：

“Sister Zhen, there is something I must ask you.
“珍姐，我有句话要请教你。

We have only just met, but with Seventh Master Li connecting us, none of us is a stranger.
彼此初会，但有李七爷的关系在那里，大家都不算外人，

I come to Tongli as a guest, and Miaozhu wants to involve me in a court case over a death.
我到同里来作客，妙珠要害我吃一场人命官司，

I really cannot understand why she should treat me like this.”
我真不懂，为啥要这样子跟我过不去？”

Miaozhen was alarmed, and even Gu thought the accusation excessive.
这几句话，不但说得妙珍大为惶恐，连古应春都觉得太过分了，

He hastened to intervene.
所以抢着说道：

“Little Uncle, you mustn’t put it like that.”
“小爷叔，话不好这样子说……”

“There is nothing wrong with what I said.”
“我说得并不错。”

Hu deliberately appeared aggrieved.
胡雪岩有意装出不服气的神情，

“Put yourself in my place.
“你倒设身处地替我想一想，

If she had stopped breathing, I would have been dragged into a case over her death for no reason at all.
她一口气不来，害我无缘无故打这场人命官司，

Is that a matter to joke about?”
是可以开得玩笑的事吗？”

Miaozhen still understood only half of it.
妙珍至今还只明白了一半。

She could not fathom why her sister had tried to hang herself or how she had survived.
她实在不懂妙珠为何要上吊，为何上吊又不死？

Hearing Hu speak this way, she felt sincerely apologetic.
只是听胡雪岩这样发话，衷心感觉歉疚，便只好这样说，

“Master Hu, I suppose Miaozhu must have offended you.
“胡老爷，我想总是妙珠得罪了你，

Please don’t be angry.
你千万不要生气，

Let me ask her.
等我来问她，

Afterwards I shall kowtow and apologise.”
回头给胡老爷磕头赔罪。”

“Very well!”
“好！”

Hu took the opportunity to rise.
胡雪岩趋势站了起来，

“Ask her how I have wronged her.
“你问问她！问她看看，我哪里亏待了她？

We have known one another for only three days.
前后不过三天的工夫，

What terrible grievance could she have against me, to do this?”
哪里来的深仇大恨，要这样子害我！”

On the bed, Miaozhu felt both remorse and injustice, and cried still more bitterly.
在床上的妙珠，既感愧悔，又感委屈，哭得越发伤心。

Gu pitied her, but did not yet understand Hu’s intentions and could say little.
古应春倒起了一片怜惜之心，但还弄不明白胡雪岩的意思，不便说什么，

He merely accompanied him outside.
只陪着他走到外面。


“Little Uncle, how did it come to this?
“小爷叔！为啥会搞得她要上吊？

What did you say that hurt her enough to make her try to hang herself?”
到底你说了什么话，叫她如此伤心？”

“Quiet!”
“轻点，轻点！”

Hu reproached him.
胡雪岩埋怨他说，

“You ought to be helping me keep up the performance.
“你要帮着我‘唱双簧’才对，

Why do you speak for the other side whenever you open your mouth?”
怎么开出口来，总是帮人家说话？”

Gu gave a wry smile, then said as if to himself, “Why hasn’t Changgen appeared?
古应春报以苦笑，然后自语似他说了句：“长根怎么不露面，

I’ll find him.”
我去找他来。”

Hu’s silence signified consent.
胡雪岩不响，这是默许的表示，

Gu went outside, ignoring the many idlers who drew away at the sight of him, and continued straight to Miaozhen’s courtyard.
古应春便开门走到外面，闲人甚多，见他的面都避了开去，古应春也不理他们，一直寻到妙珍所住的那座院落。

“Where is Seventh Master Li?” he asked a maid.
“李七爷呢？”他问一个娘姨。

“He didn’t stay here last night.
“昨天没有住在这里。

He went back to Shengze during the night, but he’ll return by noon.”
当夜就回盛泽去了。不过中午就要回来的。”

Gu had to go back.
于是古应春只好折回原处，

Miaozhen was now talking to Hu.
只见妙珍正在跟胡雪岩说话，

Both looked at him expectantly when he entered, as though hoping for his help.
发现他来，两个人不约而同地投以期待的眼光，仿佛都要向他求援似地。

“Mr Gu, you must say what is fair.”
“古老爷，要请你说句公道话。”

Miaozhen sounded aggrieved from the outset.
妙珍一开口便是受了委屈的语气，

“My sister has high standards.
“我妹子眼界高，

No customer has ever caught her eye.
从来没有啥客人是她看得上眼的，

Today she was ready to give up her life for Master Hu.
今天为了胡老爷，连命都不要了！

Surely that alone deserves some answer from him.”
只看这一层，胡老爷也该有句话。”

“Not so fast.”
“慢来，慢来！”

Hearing resentment in her tone, Gu first tried to soothe her.
古应春听她话中略有负气的味道，所以先出以安抚的态度，

“We can discuss it calmly.
“有话慢慢儿谈，

Come over here and tell me what has happened.”
你请过来，怎么回事，先说给我听。”

She followed him aside and stated her request briefly.
妙珍听他这样说，便跟着古应春走到一边，简单扼要地提出要求，

Miaozhu had sworn to marry no one but Hu, while Hu had refused outright and seemed unwilling to reconsider.
妙珠已自誓非胡雪岩不嫁，而胡雪岩一口拒绝，似乎没有转圜的余地。

She hoped Gu would see justice done.
希望古应春主持公道。

But how could he do that?
这公道如何主持？

Whatever the circumstances, he could only advise Hu, who was free to listen or not.
不论从哪一方面来说，他对胡雪岩只有谏劝，听不听在人家。

He was puzzled too.
不过，他也很困惑，

Hu was usually so accommodating.
胡雪岩为人最随和，

Even if he could not accept this affection, he ought to decline gently.
这番好意，就是难接受，也该婉言辞谢，

Why had he spoken so harshly that Miaozhen herself was angry?
何以话锋硬得竟连妙珍也感到气愤了。

“Wait here.
“你等一下，

Let me ask our Little Uncle first.”
让我先来问问我们小爷叔。”

Hu had another account.
问到胡雪岩。他又有一番说词，

To him, Miaozhen’s words bordered on coercion.
认为妙珍的话，迹近要挟，

Besides, practical circumstances made it impossible to agree.
同时事实上也无法相许，

Exhausted in body and mind by the past few days, he had no patience for further entanglement and had refused simply and directly.
加以这几天身心交疲，不耐烦多作纠缠，所以干脆回绝。

He too seemed to be acting partly out of resentment.
看起来胡雪岩也有些负气，

Yet Miaozhen’s angry words were understandable: she loved her sister and felt her pain.
但论道理，妙珍是骨肉连心，疼她妹子，说几句气话是可以原谅的。

Hu’s exhaustion and short temper were understandable as well.
不过，胡雪岩身心交疲，肝火不免旺些，似乎也是情有可原，

Both were in a bad mood, and afterwards they could come to understand one another, helped by someone else’s explanation.
反正都是一时情绪不佳，事后自然相互谅解，旁人亦可以代为解释得清楚的。

The real question was what he meant by saying that practical circumstances made agreement impossible.
症结是在“事实上无法相许”这句话，

Gu had to ask.
不能不问。


“Little Uncle, tell me what the difficulty is.
“小爷叔，你有啥难处，说来听听。”古应春问道，

Is it that our Auntie at home would never agree?”
“可是我们那位婶娘那里说不通？”

“Exactly.
“正是！

There has been a great quarrel over Furong, and it still hasn’t been settled.
为了芙蓉，大打饥荒，至今还不曾摆平，

Why should I invite more trouble?”
我何苦又惹麻烦？”

Gu thought for a while.
古应春想了一会说：

“There must be a way to arrange that.
“这总有办法可以弄妥当。

What matters most is whether you like Miaozhu.”
最主要的是，你到底喜欢不喜欢妙珠？”

Hu found this hard to answer.
这话叫胡雪岩就难回答了，

He did not want to deny his own feelings, but neither would he openly admit them.
既不愿作违心之论，也不肯公然承认，

He changed the subject.
顾而言他他说：

“There is another thing.
“还有一层，

I brought Furong on this journey.
我这趟是带着芙蓉来的，

To take up with someone else while she is here—think how she would feel.
当着她在这里，倒又弄上一个人！你想想，她心里是何滋味？

Besides, how could I explain it to Third Master Liu?”
再说，我对刘三爷也不好交代。”

Gu, seeing more clearly from outside, understood at once.
古应春旁观者清，听他这两句话，立刻了解了他的本心。

Hu did like Miaozhu.
他是喜欢妙珠的，

His wife in Hangzhou was no insuperable obstacle; it was Furong who prevented this happy arrangement for the moment.
杭州的那位太太，也不足为碍，只碍着芙蓉，一时做不成这件“好事”。

“You are speaking honestly.
“你说的是实话，

I understand.” Gu warned him, “Miaozhu is completely devoted to you.
我懂了。”古应春提出警告：“妙珠一片痴心，

If her hopes come to nothing, she may try again.
如果落空，说不定还会第二次的举动。

Why burden yourself with a death when you could be living happily?
好好的日子不过，弄件命债在身上，

It would be a terrible price.”
太划不来了。”

The word “death” startled Hu.
“命债”二字，说得胡雪岩悚然一惊，

Deeply uneasy, he rubbed his hands.
极其不安，搓着手说：

“Are there really people so foolish that they will give up their lives?”
“世上真有那样傻的人，连性命都不要？”

“There may be.”
“说不定的！”

Gu’s face grew serious.
古应春又正色说道：

“If she had died the first time, that would have been one thing.
“她第一次真的上吊死了，倒也罢了，

If something happens a second time, you will have stood by and let her die.
第二次出毛病，就是你见死不救，

Your conscience will never be easy.”
良心上一辈子不安。”

Hu had scarcely slept all night.
胡雪岩几乎一夜不曾睡，

After these shocks and troubles, his head felt as though it would split, and his thoughts were clouded.
又遭遇了这些惊吓烦恼，只觉得头痛欲裂，神思昏昏，

He told Gu frankly that he must find somewhere quiet and sleep properly.
于是老实告诉古应春，他必须找个清静的地方，好好睡一觉，

He asked him to deal with the two sisters on his behalf and leave everything until the afternoon.
托他代为敷衍珍珠姐妹，一切都摆到下午再谈。


For quiet, the best place was still Zhu’s house.
要寻清静之处，自然还是朱老大家。

Hu entered by the back door, went to his room, told the servant assigned to him to refuse all visitors, shut the door firmly, undressed and got into bed.
到了那里，从后门人内，走到自己卧室，关照朱家派来词候他的佣工，谢绝访客，然后关紧房门，解衣上床。

He was utterly exhausted and fell asleep as soon as his head touched the pillow.
他实在是累了，着枕使即人梦，

He did not rise until noon.
直到中午才起身。

Liu was waiting over tea in the outer room.
刘不才就在他外屋喝茶守候，

Hearing movement, he knocked.
听见响动，便来叩门，

As soon as Hu opened the door, he asked, “How did things come so close to someone dying?”
等胡雪岩开了门，他第一句就问：“怎么会险险乎闹出人命来？”

After a good sleep, Hu’s feelings were steadier and his mind clearer.
经过一觉好睡，胡雪岩的情绪稳定了，脑筋也清楚了，

Instead of answering, he asked about Gu.
不先答他的话，却问到古应春：

“Has Gu come back?”
“老古回来了没有？”

“Yes.
“回来了。

He was the one who told me.”
我就是听他说的。”

“Then Elder Yu, You Laowu and the others know too?”
“那么，俞老跟尤五他们也知道了，”

“Naturally.
“自然。”

They all think you are somewhat to blame.”
刘不才说，“大家都有点派你不是。”

Anyone else can accuse me of being heartless, Hu thought, but you, of all people, cannot.
胡雪岩在心里说：别人都可以说我薄情，派我的不是，唯独你不能！

Aloud he asked, “And you?”
这样想着，口中便问了出来：“你呢？”

“It makes no difference to me.
“我无所谓！

Your affairs have nothing to do with me.”
你的事跟我不相干。”

That indicated that if Hu really did marry Miaozhu, Liu would not object.
这表示胡雪岩果真要娶妙珠，他亦不会反对。

What the future might bring was uncertain, but at least a small obstacle had been removed, which was some comfort.
将来如何，虽不可知，但总算去了一个小小的障碍，自是可令人安慰的。

Still, this was a side issue.
不过这件事到底是“闲事”，

Hu decided to put it off with an accommodating manner for the present.
胡雪岩决定采取敷衍的态度，先拖着再说。

Much serious business remained.
眼前还有许多正经事要办，

He therefore made an immediate decision.
因而当机立断地作了决定：

“Go and pack.
“你去收拾收拾行李吧！

We shall return to Suzhou today, settle Changgen’s important business and hurry back to Shanghai.”
我们今天就回苏州，交代了长根的大事，赶紧回上海。”


“I don’t think we can go today,” Liu replied.
“ 今天走怕不行。”刘不才说：

“I heard from You Laowu that they mean to give a banquet for you together tonight.”
“我听尤五说，今天晚上他们要公请你。”

“A banquet?”
“公请？”

Hu was surprised.
胡雪岩诧异：

“Why?”
“为什么？”

“They must have something to say.
“总有话跟你说。

They’re shut up together now, discussing who knows what.”
此刻他们关起门来，不知在商量什么？”

This reminded Hu of something.
这让胡雪岩想起来了，

“Has Changgen arrived?” he asked quickly.
急急问道：“长根来了没有？”

“Of course.
“自然来了。”

He has been the busiest man of all these past two days.
刘不才说，“他这两天最忙了。

I hear he went to Shengze early this morning and hurried back specially.”
据说，一早到盛泽去了一趟，特地赶回来的。”

Hu nodded.
胡雪岩点点头：

“Today they have brotherhood affairs to discuss.
“今天是他们帮里有事要谈，

Outsiders shouldn’t intrude, and we needn’t disturb them.
外人不便插足，我们也不必打搅他们，

Find Gu.
你把考古去找来，

We can go somewhere to eat and talk about our own business.”
我们寻一处地方，一面吃饭，一面谈谈我们自己的事。”

When Gu arrived, he suggested returning to Miaozhen’s.
等把古应春找了来，他建议仍旧到妙珍那里去盘桓，

She knew that she had lost her composure and was deeply anxious.
因为她自知失态，异常惶恐，

She had begged him to bring Hu to lunch so that she could apologise.
托古应春无论如何要将胡雪岩请了去吃午饭，好让她有个赔罪的机会。

Avoiding her would avoid trouble, but trouble often multiplied when one tried to escape it.
不去是逃避麻烦，而麻烦往往是越避越多，

Hu was in quite a different mood now.
胡雪岩此时的心情已大不相同，

After a moment’s thought he answered decisively, “Very well.
想了一下，毅然决然地答道：“也好！

Let us hear what she has to say.”
我倒要听听她怎么说？”

The three walked leisurely to her house.
于是三个人安步当车到了妙珍那里。

Her earlier haughtiness had given way to deference.
她的神态前倨而后恭，

“Please don’t be angry, Master Hu,” she kept saying.
口口声声：“胡老爷不要动气，

“Miaozhu is young and foolish.
妙珠年轻不懂事。”

If nothing else, for Seventh Master Li’s sake, let us treat it as though nothing happened.”
又说：“千不看，万不看，看李七爷面上，当没那回事。”

This wording made Hu uneasy.
这样措词，反令胡雪岩不安，便问一句：

“Where is Miaozhu?
“妙珠呢？

Why don’t I see her?”
怎么不见她的面？”

“She’ll come.
“会来的！

She’ll come.
会来的！”妙珍问道：

It’s getting late.
“时候不早了，

Shall I serve the meal now, or would you like some refreshments first?”
是马上开饭，还是先用些点心？

“No refreshments, and no wine either.
““点心可以省了，酒也不必，

Let us eat.”
就吃饭吧！”

Gu had come expressly to act as a conciliator and agreed.
古应春是有心来做“串客”的，便顺着他的意思说：

“Quite right.
“对！

In this heat, leave out the wine.”
天气大热，酒，免了。”

“Then let us have a little yangmei liquor,” Miaozhen suggested.
“这样吧，吃点‘杨梅烧’，

“I steeped it last year and have been saving it.
是我去年泡的，一直舍不得吃，

Today I shall offer it to Master Hu.”
今天请请胡老爷。”

Gu promptly changed his tone. “That would be pleasant.
“那好。”古应春又改了口气，

Yangmei liquor dispels the summer heat.
“杨梅烧可以祛暑，

A cup would do no harm.”
不妨来一杯。”


Miaozhen arranged their places herself at a small round table with a marble top.
于是在一张大理石面的小圆桌上，妙珍亲自安席，

The silver-mounted ebony chopsticks and Jingdezhen porcelain were particularly fine.
乌木银镶筷，景德镇的瓷器，餐具相当精致。

After the cold dishes had been set out, she brought a white porcelain jar, removed its cloth seal and lifted the lid.
等摆上冷荤碟子，妙珍亲手捧出一个白瓷坛，打开布封口，一揭盖子，

A mellow, pure fragrance rose from the liquor.
便有一股醇冽的酒香透出来，

It was sorghum spirit steeped with white yangmei berries from the Dongting hills.
这种用洞庭山白杨梅泡的高粱酒，

The strength of the spirit had passed into the fruit, while the deep-red liquor itself tasted sweet and mild, slipped down easily and was especially suited to an early-summer midday.
酒味都到了杨梅里面，其色殷红的酒，甜而淡，极易上口，最宜于这种初夏午间饮用。

As they sat down and poured, Miaozhu appeared.
坐定斟酒之际，妙珠翩然而至，

She wore no rouge or powder; her glossy black hair was simply dressed, with a row of jasmine blossoms.
不施脂粉，只梳一个乌油油的头，插着一排茉莉，

Their fragrance reached the company before she did.
情影未到，香风先送，

She greeted Liu first, then the others, and finally said softly, “Master Hu.”
走到席前，从刘不才招呼起，最后才轻轻地喊一声：“胡才爷！”

Her eyes moved towards him, bright with tears.
秋波流转，盈盈欲泪，

Apparently remembering that this was no time or place for grief, she mastered herself, lowered her head and sat beside him.
但仿佛警觉到此时此地，不宜伤心，所以极力忍住，低着头坐在胡雪岩身边。

No one, Hu included, referred to the dawn incident when her life had hung by a breath.
包括胡雪岩在内，谁都不提这天黎明时分，性命呼吸的那一段事故，

Miaozhen exerted all her powers as a hostess, handling each matter with the ease of a musician plucking the strings while watching wild geese fly.
妙珍也放出全副本事，手挥五弦，目送飞鸿般，

The table became lively, yet no one’s eyes could quite leave Miaozhu.
应酬得席面上非常热闹，但彼此的视线，总离不开妙珠，

Whether still resentful or merely embarrassed, she kept her head lowered, occasionally raising her brows to steal a quick look at Hu and turning away before he could notice.
她不知道是别有幽怨，还是不好意思，一直低着头，偶尔扬眉，飞快地看胡雪岩一眼，不等他发觉，便又避了开去，

No one could tell what she meant.
实在猜不透她是什么意思。

Hu’s own feelings were complicated.
在胡雪岩却是别有滋味在心头，

Remembering his words and manner that morning, he thought he had been too harsh and felt guilty.
想起一早跟她说的话，对她的态度，自觉过分，不免歉疚，

Under the table he quietly reached for her hand.
便悄悄从桌子底下伸过一只手去，想握住她的手，

Alert to his movement, she moved it aside and left him grasping nothing.
她灵得很，拿手一移，让他扑了个空。

This touch of resentment only deepened his feeling.
越是这种带些负气的动作，越使胡雪岩动情，

Smiling, he asked, “Still angry with me?”
便笑嘻嘻地问道：“还在生我的气？”

“How would I dare?”
“我哪里敢？”

“It is not a question of daring,” Gu put in.
“不是什么敢不敢！”古应春接口，

“Miaozhu isn’t angry at all, are you?”
“妙珠根本没有生气，是不是？”

“Of course not,” Miaozhen added.
“是啊！”妙珍也说，

“Why should she be?
“好端端地生什么气？

Miaozhu!”
妙珠！”

She indicated Hu’s empty cup with a movement of her lips.
她努一努嘴。意思是胡雪岩的酒杯空了，要妙珠替他斟酒。

Miaozhu hesitated, took the silver ladle from the jar and filled the cups, beginning with Liu’s and leaving Hu’s until last.
妙珠迟疑了一下，取起酒坛中的银勺子，舀了一勺酒，从刘不才斟起，最后才替刘雪岩斟满。


“Everyone else has berries.
“别人都有杨梅，

Why haven’t I?” Hu demanded deliberately.
为何我没有？”胡雪岩故意这样质问。

Without speaking, Miaozhu ladled out two berries, put them on a little dish and pushed it towards him.
妙珠不响，舀了两个杨梅，放在一只小碟子里，推到他面前。

“Things one has to beg for don’t taste good.
“讨出来的不好吃。

I don’t want them.”
我不要了。”

“I know you don’t!”
“我也晓得你不要！”

She gave a cold laugh.
妙珠冷笑，

“You simply find me tiresome.”
“你就是看见我讨厌。”

“Miaozhu!”
“妙珠！”

Her sister’s sharp call carried a warning.
她姐姐重重地喊，带着警告的意味。

Hu felt uneasy.
这让胡雪岩颇为不安，

If the elder sister tried to discipline the younger and the younger answered back, it would spoil the whole occasion.
怕姐姐要管妹妹，妹妹不服顶嘴，岂不煞风景？

Miaozhu did not answer back.
妙珠倒不曾顶嘴，

Her eyes merely reddened and filled again, making her all the more pitiable.
只又是眼圈发红，盈盈欲涕，越惹人怜惜。

Miaozhen sighed and seemed about to complain or reproach her, but could not bear to speak.
于是做姐姐的叹口气，欲言又止，似乎想埋怨、想责备，总觉得于心不忍似地。

Women of the pleasure quarters were skilled at acting, all the more so when the performance drew on real feeling.
风尘中人，善于做作，而况是带着真情的做作，

This air of grief and near despair moved everyone.
那番低徊欲绝的神情，真是满座恻然。

Liu, whose habit was to seek enjoyment, was the first to find it unbearable.
刘不才一向是个寻快乐的人，首先就心酸酸地忍不住，

Yet his position made it difficult to speak.
但以他的身分，颇难为词，

He signalled to Gu to take matters in hand.
便递个眼色给古应春，示意他有所主张。

Gu understood, but could hardly decide another man’s affairs.
古应春懂他的意思，但这样的事，何能擅作别人的主张，

Nor could he urge Hu in front of the sisters not to disappoint her love, lest they mistake his advice for a promise on Hu’s behalf.
也不便当着珍珠姐妹劝胡雪岩莫负芳心，怕她们误会他代胡雪岩作了承诺。

After considering it, he could offer only general comfort.
想了一下，唯有不着边际地劝慰一番。

“Miaozhu, it has all happened rather suddenly.
“妹珠，”他说，“事情是来得突然了一点。

It isn’t that Master Hu doesn’t like you.
胡老爷不是不中意你，

He has difficulties of his own.
他有他的难处。

Given time, things work themselves out.
凡事事缓则圆，

So long as both have affection, a happy union may come one day.”
只要郎有情，姐有意，总有成其好事的一天。”

To Gu, this was a dumpling with no filling, a distant, indefinite assurance that said almost nothing.
在他觉得这是遥遥无期，说如不说的“空心汤团”，

Miaozhu, however, found enlightenment in it.
而在妙珠却大有领悟，

She loved listening to sung storytelling and reading songbooks in seven-character lines.
她平时喜欢听小书，也喜欢看那些七字句的唱本，

Her mind held countless stories of gifted scholars and beautiful women whose devoted love overcame every obstacle and ended in reunion.
才子佳人，痴心苦恋，历尽艰难，最后终了大团圆的事，在肚子里记着好多，

Gu’s words were a key opening a treasure chest she had lost and found again.
这时听得古应春的话，就象一把锁匙开启了她失而复得的一具百宝箱，心想：

Exactly!
对啊！

Had Hu himself not said that good things took time and trouble?
他自己不也说过“好事多磨”，

She would patiently wear down his resistance.
我且耐着性子磨，

However many edges and corners he possessed, she would smooth him until he rolled easily into her arms.
哪怕他有棱有角，要磨得他圆转自如，滚入自己怀中。


Her expression changed with that thought.
这样想着，脸色就不同了，

Head bowed and eyes lowered, she silently considered her plan, hearing none of the conversation.
低眉垂眼，神思不属地在悄然思量。席间的谈话，一概不闻。

The others were untroubled, but Hu was like a bird startled by a bowstring.
别人倒还好，胡雪岩是惊弓之鸟，

Had she formed another foolish resolution?
心里在想，莫非她又生了拙见？

He had often heard it said that a person taking their own life, at the instant before death, remembered the splendour of the world and bitterly regretted it.
常听人说：一个人自尽，在刚要断气的刹那，想起尘世繁华，一定痛悔轻生。

Once rescued, such a person would never think of suicide again.
所以遇救之后，决不会再想到自尽，

If they truly did still wish to die, the resolve must be exceptional; anticipating another rescue, they would devise some means others could not prevent.
如果真的想死，则其志坚决，异于寻常，预先顾虑到可能会再度遇救，想出来的寻死的办法，是别人所防不到的，

Then death would be certain.
那就死定了！

The thought frightened him.
转念到此，悚然自惊，

He looked up quickly at Miaozhu.
急急抬眼去看妙珠，

Yet she seemed composed and at ease, hardly as though planning to die.
但见她神态安闲，又不象是在想寻死的样子，

He was puzzled.
倒有些困惑了。

“Miaozhu.”
“妙珠，”

This time she did not refuse his outstretched hand.
这次他伸过手去，她不曾拒绝，

“What are you thinking about?” he asked directly.
“你在想啥心事？”他率直地问。

“I’m thinking…”
“我在想……”

Suddenly she smiled beautifully.
她突然嫣然一笑，

“I shan’t tell you!”
“不告诉你！”

The smile brought Hu immense relief.
这一笑，使胡雪岩大为安慰，

All his fears vanished.
一切顾虑，都抛在九霄云外，

To him, such a smile could never belong to someone contemplating suicide.
因为这个笑容，决不会出现在想寻死的人的脸上。

Gu was relieved as well and teased her. “You mean to tell him, of course, but it will be more interesting in private.
“告诉是要告诉的，”古应春也觉得安慰，所以打趣她说，“要私底下说，才有味道。

Isn’t that it?”
是不是？”

Miaozhu did not answer.
妙珠不答，

She took up the ladle, filled everyone’s cup again and raised her own, looking at her sister.
拿起银勺子来，又替大家斟酒，然后取起自己面前的杯子，看着妙珍说道：

“Sister Zhen, have a drink.”
“珍姐，你吃点酒！”


“The older you get, the less you understand manners!”
“越大越不懂规矩！”

Miaozhen seemed half amused and half annoyed.
妙珍仿佛又好笑，又好气他说：

“Why toast me instead of our honoured guests?”
“怎么不敬贵客，来敬我？”

“Naturally, I have a reason.”
“自然有道理在里头。”

“Tell us.
“你讲！

What reason?”
啥道理？”

“Drink first, and then I’ll tell you.
“你先吃了我再讲，

If my reason is no good, I’ll drink two cups for your one.”
讲得没有道理，我一杯罚两杯！”

“Fair enough!”
“这话对！

Liu put in. “I’ll be the witness.
我做见证，”刘不才插嘴，

Miaozhen, drink first and hear what she says.”
“妙珍你就先吃了。看她怎么说。”

Miaozhen drained the half-cup before her, put it down and joined the others in watching her sister.
于是妙珍将面前的半杯酒，一饮而尽，放下杯子，与他人一样，都注视着妙珠，

What did she have to say that required such ceremony?
要听她有什么出以如此郑重态度的话说。

Certain that she had hit upon an excellent idea, Miaozhu was perfectly composed.
妙珠自觉绝妙的智珠在握，神态极其从容，

“Sister Zhen, since our parents died, you have looked after me.
“珍姐，从爹娘故世，多亏你照应。

Now Seventh Master Li is going to become an official, and you will soon be an official’s wife.
如今李七爷要做官去了，眼看珍姐你是现成的一位官太太。

That drink was to congratulate you.”
刚才这杯酒是恭喜你！”

She looked at Liu and Gu.
她看着刘不才和古应春问道：

“Wasn’t it right for her to drink it?”
“这杯酒，珍姐是不是该吃？”

“Yes, yes!” they answered together.
“对，对！”两人异口同声附和。

“Enough,” Miaozhen urged.
“好了，好了。”妙珍催促，

“If you have something to say about yourself, say it.”
“你自己有话快说。”

“That was a drink of celebration.” Miaozhu laughed with sly brightness.
“刚才这杯是喜酒。”妙珠慧黠地格格一笑，

“I do have something very important to say, but you must drink another cup before I can say it.”
“我是有两句极要紧的话，珍姐你再吃一杯，我才能说。”

“You wretched girl!” Miaozhen was amused and exasperated.
妙珍又好笑，又好气，“死丫头！”

She clenched her teeth.
她咬一咬牙，

“I won’t fall for your tricks again.”
“我再不上你的当了。”


Everyone laughed at the sisters’ exchange except Miaozhu herself.
看她们姐妹俩的神情，大家都笑了，只有妙珠例外，

“Really, it is important.
“真的！是极要紧的话！“她说，”

Everyone can judge whether what I say is reasonable.
说出话来，有没有道理，是要大家评的。

If it isn’t, I’ll drink three cups for your one.”
如果没有道理，我一杯罚三杯。

“That is bold!” Liu urged her on.
““真硬气！”刘不才撺掇着说：

“Miaozhen, you mustn’t let your sister beat you.”
“妙珍，你不能输给你妹妹。”

This sort of exchange made a meal lively.
席面上原要这样才热闹，

Miaozhen therefore assumed a serious air.
妙珍就装得很认真他说：

“Master Liu, I’ll take your advice.
“刘老爷，我听你的话。

But if she has no good reason, you must judge fairly.”
回头她的话没有道理，你可要说公话。”

“Of course!”
“当然！当然！”

He ladled more than half a cup for her himself.
刘不才亲自执勺，替妙珍斟了大半杯酒。

When she had finished it, Miaozhu asked, “Sister Zhen, you are climbing to a higher branch.
等她干了酒，妙珠问道：“珍姐，你倒爬上高枝儿去了，

What is to become of me, left all alone?”
丢下我一个怎么办？”

“Quite right!” Liu said at once.
“对！”刘不才脱口就说：

“A reasonable question.”
“问得有道理！”

Gu and Hu agreed, but their minds moved quickly.
古应春和胡雪岩亦以为然，但他们的心思都快，

The question was not merely reasonable; it was formidable.
觉得她这句话不但问得有道理，而且问得很厉害，

Hu in particular felt as though a net were descending over him.
尤其是胡雪岩仿佛看到一片罗网迎头罩了下来。

Miaozhen had indeed been thinking along those lines.
妙珍也确是这样的心思，

Having Hu take Miaozhu into his household would provide an excellent future for her.
打算着让胡雪岩娶了妙珠回去，也是个极好的归缩，

But that was a private plan she could not openly disclose, or Hu might resent it: so she was eager to leave the profession herself, yet could not abandon her duty to her sister, and therefore meant to trap him into taking it on.
但这是私下打算，不便公然透露，否则胡雪岩会起反感：原来你自己急着要从良，而抚妹之责，又不能不尽，才套到我头上。

He might refuse for that very reason.
我偏不要！

This concern left her momentarily speechless.
因为有此顾虑，一时愣在那里说不出话来，

Miaozhu took her opportunity.
妙珠趁机又说：

“I know you are in a difficult position, Sister Zhen.
“我也知道珍姐为难，

I must make some plans for myself.
自己不能不打算打算。

Let me leave first.”
珍姐，你让我先走一步。”

“Leave?” Miaozhen asked in astonishment.
“先走？”妙珍愕然，急急问道：

“Where?”
“走到哪里去？”

“I mean to move out.”
“我想先搬出去住。”

Miaozhu spoke calmly and firmly.
妙珠以从容而坚决的语气答道：

“I have earned my living this way for the last time.”
“这碗饭，吃到现在为止了！”

Now everyone understood.
这一说，大家才算明白，

Though she had not married out of the profession, she wished to leave it first.
虽未从良，愿先“脱籍”。

That was a good thing, but she needed somewhere to go.
这也是好事，但总得有个着落，才是办法。


“I have thought about where to live too,” she continued.
“至于住的地方，我也想过了。”妙珠说道，

“There are plenty of convents.
“多的是庵堂，

Surely one will let me practise devotion without taking the tonsure, and work towards a better next life.”
让我带发修行，修修来世，总也是办得到的。”

“How can you?”
“这，怎么可以？”

Liu shook his head.
刘不才大摇其头，

“So young, and talking like this!
“年纪轻轻，说出这种话来，

Won’t it break your sister’s heart?”
岂不叫你的姐姐伤心？”

“If you truly have the resolve to give up this livelihood, I approve,” Miaozhen said slowly.
“我想，”妙珍慢条斯理他说，“果然有志气不吃这碗饭，我倒也赞成。

“You may move out first.
先搬出去住也可以，

But there is no need to live in a convent.
住庵堂就不必了。

Master Hu, don’t you agree?”
“她又加了一句：”胡老爷，你说是不是？

Miaozhu seemed guileless, Hu thought, yet she had no end of manoeuvres.
“胡雪岩心想，妙珠似乎胸无城府，花样倒真不少，

He would put her in check and see how she answered.
且“将”他一“军”，看她怎么说？

“I don’t believe that someone so young has seen through the world and wants to cultivate a future life.
“我不相信妙珠年纪轻轻，会看破红尘，要修什么来世？

If”—the first remark was harmless; the trouble lay in that “if”—“if she really wants to practise devotion, I’ll build her a private convent.”
如果，”前一句话倒没有什么毛病，坏就坏在“如果”，他说：“如果真的要修行，我替妙珠造一座家庵。”

Everyone was startled.
这真是语惊四座，

Both sisters changed colour, and Liu and Gu were deeply uncomfortable.
珍珠姐妹无不变色，刘不才和古应春也深为不安，

The words went too far.
觉得他这句话太重了。

Miaozhu felt anger, but still more hatred.
在妙珠，不但气，更多的是恨，心里在想：

How cruel he was!
真看不出他，好狠的心肠，

Even her attempt to die had not changed his mind, and now he wanted to force her into a convent.
一死回不了他的意，现在还要逼自己出家。

Yet she too was proud.
然而她也是好强的性格，

To go back on her words would invite ridicule.
说了不算，叫人笑话。

Very well, she thought, I will match my stubbornness against yours.
于是她又想：好！我就跟你赌这口气！

Impulsively, without further reflection, she rose and curtsied. “Master Hu, that is a promise.
冲动之下，不假细思，“胡老爷一言为定。”她站起身来福了福：

I thank you in advance.”
“我先谢谢你！”

“He was joking!” Liu exclaimed first.
“说笑话的！”刘不才先喊了起来，

“Why take it seriously?”
“妙珠，你怎么当真？”

“It is certainly no joke.”
“决不是说笑话。”

Her face was deathly pale.
妙珠的脸色煞白，

“I understand his wishes.
“我懂胡老爷的心思，

He would like nothing better than for me to cut off my hair here and now.
最好我在这时候就一剪刀拿头发剪了起来。

I am sorry to disappoint him.
这可对不起了，

Devotion is in the heart; it does not depend on becoming a nun.”
修行在心，不在乎做不做尼姑！”

The more unreasonable her accusation, the more clearly it revealed that her whole heart was fixed on Hu.
越是这种不进理的诬指，越见得她一片深心都在胡雪岩身上。

Yet the situation was hardening into an impasse from which there seemed no escape.
但局面越来越僵，僵得有无法收场之势，

Hu regretted his rashness and was acutely embarrassed.
胡雪岩当然自悔轻率，尴尬万分。

Miaozhen and Liu could only interrupt and change the subject.
妙珍和刘不才也只有从中打岔，乱以他语，

Gu, however, suddenly saw a way of bringing the whole matter together.
倒是古应春，忽有妙语，通前彻后，

After a moment’s thought, he made a bold decision.
略想一想，作了个“大胆”的决定。


“Miaozhu.”
“妙珠！”

He rose and beckoned.
他起身招招手说，

“Come here.
“你来，

I want to ask you something.”
我有句话问你。”

“Mr Gu, if you have something to say, say it here,” she refused bluntly.
“古老爷！”妙珠率直拒绝，“有话，你在这里说好了。”

“Oh dear!”
“喔唷！”

Gu deliberately rubbed his forehead.
古应春故意抚摸着前额，

“What a sharp nail I’ve run into!”
“这个钉子碰得好厉害。”

Though a joke, it contained a reproach.
虽是玩笑，含有指责之意，

The first rule of the pleasure quarters was never to offend a guest, so Miaozhen apologised for her.
勾栏人家以不得罪客人为第一要诀，所以妙珍代为道歉：

“I’m so sorry, Mr Gu.
“对不起，对不起，古老爷！

She is young and knows no better.
她年纪轻，不懂事，

Please forgive her.”
一切包涵。”

Then she sternly scolded her sister.
接着，便正色向妙珠训斥：

“Can’t you tell good from bad?
“你怎么连好歹都不懂！

If Mr Gu wants a word with you, naturally he means well.
古老爷有话问你，自然是好意。

Like the dog that bit Lü Dongbin, you don’t recognise a kind heart.
‘狗咬吕洞宾，不识好人心’！

Apologise at once!”
还不跟古老爷赔罪。”

Miaozhu knew she had been wrong, but could not immediately change her expression into one fit for an apology.
妙珠也觉得自己不对，但要她赔罪，却又一时变不出那样的脸色来，

Fortunately, Gu understood.
幸好古应春体恤，连声说道：

“No apology is needed.
“赔什么罪，赔什么罪。

Come, let us talk over here.”
来，来，我们到这面来谈。”

Speaking as he drew her aside, he gave her a way to yield.
一面说，一面拉，妙珠也就顺势收篷，

She followed and whispered, “Mr Gu, I really am sorry.
跟到一边，悄悄说道：“古老爷，真对不起，

I didn’t mean it.”
我不是有心的。”

“I know.
“我知道，我知道，

No need to discuss that.
这不必去谈了。

Tell me”—he paused, then asked very seriously—“are you absolutely determined to take the name Hu?”
我问你，”古应春停了一下，用很郑重的语气问道：“你是不是下定决心，非姓胡不可？”

She raised her large eyes for a quick glance at him, lowered her head and nodded faintly.
妙珠抬起一双大大的眼睛，很快地看了他一眼，接着便垂下头去，然后，微微颔首。

“Very well.
“好的！

But it cannot happen at once.
不过事情一时不会成功，

It may be half a year or a year, perhaps two or three.
一年半载，说不定三年两年，

Can you wait?”
你等得及吗？”

“There is nothing I cannot wait for,” she answered very softly.
“没有啥等不及！”妙珠用极轻的声音回答。

“Then let Master Hu build you a private convent.
“那就让胡老爷替你造一座家庵，

You will only be practising devotion without taking the tonsure.
反正带发修行，

Even if you really became a nun, you could grow your hair again and return to ordinary life.
不要说带发修行，就真的做了尼姑，也可以留起头发来还俗的。”

Think: if you live in a house built for you by a man named Hu, aren’t you already one of his household?”
古应春又说：“你想想，你住的是姓胡的替你造的房子，还不算是胡家的人？”

His words showed her the way out of confusion.
这不但是一句话指点了迷津，

More than that, knowing he was on her side gave her confidence.
也因为古应春站在自己这边，越发增加了信心，

Her face brightened with smiles, and she whispered her thanks repeatedly.
因而妙珠眉开眼笑地不断低声称谢：

“Mr Gu, thank you, thank you!”
“古老爷，谢谢你，谢谢你！”

“Keep what I’ve said to yourself.”
“我的话，你摆在心里。”

“Yes.
“是的。

I understand.”
我晓得。”


Even so, Miaozhu was no worldly, calculating nine-tailed fox.
话虽如此，妙珠到底不是那种老于世故，深于城府的九尾狐，

Her new happiness appeared on her face before she knew it.
开朗的心情，不知不觉地摆在脸上。

Miaozhen and Liu were naturally relieved to see her at ease.
妙珍和刘不才看她神情舒坦，自然都感到快慰，

Hu alone felt divided.
只有胡雪岩的心情矛盾，

On the one hand, she had a face that charmed in pleasure and in anger alike; freed of sorrow, she looked more radiant than ever.
一方面觉得妙珠是宜喜宜嗔春风面，一扫愁苦之容，格外显得明艳照人，

He saw her and loved her.
看在眼里，爱在心头，

On the other, he feared that Gu had acted on his own and promised whatever she wanted.
一方面又怕古应春擅作主张，投其所好，

If those promises were beyond Hu’s power to fulfil, how would he settle the consequences?
如果所许的愿心是自己办不到的，则又何以善其后？

After a long period of uncertainty, he took advantage of Liu’s discourse on gambling to ask her quietly, “What did Mr Gu say to you?”
心里六上八下半天，终于趁刘不才大谈赌经时悄悄问妙珠：“古老爷跟你说点啥？”

Her bright eyes glanced sideways across his face.
她眼波闪耀，斜着从他脸上飘过，

With deliberate indifference, she replied, “Something that cannot be told to a third person.”
故意洋洋不睬地答了句：“不好跟第三个人说的。”

Since she was pretending, he would tease her.
她装假，他便有意逗她：

“Perhaps he has taken a fancy to you?
“想来是他看中了你了？

Be careful.
你可当心！

Mr Gu has a female Zhang Fei keeping him in order.”
古才爷有个‘女张飞’管着。”

“A female Zhang Fei?”
“女张飞？”

Her curiosity was aroused.
妙珠触发了好奇心，

“How did she get such a name?
“怎么叫出这么个名字来。

Tell me.”
你倒说给我听听。”

“Come.”
“来！”

Hu took the opportunity to draw her away.
胡雪岩趋势将她一拉，

Behind a screen they sat side by side on a chaise longue.
两人走到屏风背后，在一张杨妃榻上，并排坐了下来，

Naturally, the female Zhang Fei was forgotten.
“女张飞”自然不谈了，

Yet neither had anything else to say.
但却别无话说，

He held her hand and gazed at her; she lowered her head and remained silent.
一个拉着她的手凝视，一个低头不语。


“Master Hu,” she said at last, “you promised to build me a private convent.
“胡老爷！”是妙珠先开口，“ 你说要给我造一座家庵，

Will you keep your word?”
这话算不算数。”

“I was only joking.”
“我跟你说说笑话的。”

Hu welcomed the chance to take it back.
胡雪岩正好改口，

“Would I really do such a wrong, sending someone so young into a convent to live that sort of life?”
“莫非我真的作孽？年纪轻轻的，送你进庵堂去过那种日子？”

Miaozhu gave a faint, cold laugh.
“哼？”妙珠微微冷笑，

“A convent would cost several hundred taels.
“造一座庵，也要几百两银子，

Naturally, you can’t bear to part with the money.”
自然舍不得了！”

Shrewd as he was, Hu did not realise that she was provoking his pride.
胡雪岩再精也想不到这是激将之计，

当即答道：“几百两银子小事。

Even if we had only just met, giving you that much would be no great matter, let alone when we have been close.”
不要说你我有过交情，哪怕初见面，送你几百两银子，也没有什么了不得的。”

“Then I thank you.
“既然你这样说，我先谢谢你，

明天等家庵造好了，我供你一个‘长生禄位’。”

“不行，不行！

We shall hear no more about a private convent.”
‘家庵’两字，再不用提起。”

Miaozhu had not truly renounced the world or decided on a religious life.
妙珠也不是真的看破红尘，要去带发修行，

就这片刻之间，她照古应春的指点，另外打定了主意，

你总归给我几百两银子，让我造间新房子住就是了。”

Will you?”
她又加了一句：“你肯不肯？”

“There is no question of whether I will.
“谈不到什么肯不肯。

If you don’t believe me, I can give you the money now.”
你如果不相信，我马上给你银子好了。”

“There is no need.
“那倒不必。

Your word is enough.”
说过算数，”

She extended her slender little finger, curved like a new moon.
接着，她伸出春葱样的一只小指，一钩新月似地弯着，

胡雪岩也伸出小指来跟她勾了勾。

接着，便一手揽住了她的腰，说了句真心话：

又舍不得你，又怕你。”

“怕我什么，

我又不是吃人的老虎。”

“老虎倒不是，是一条……”

“A what?”
“一条什么？”

He had meant to say a snake that coiled round a man.
胡雪岩想说：是一条会缠人的蛇。

Having experienced her temper, he dared not be rash.
但因已领教过妙珠的脾气，不敢造次，

所以话到口边，又缩了回去，

等她再追问时，自然也不肯出口，笑笑而已。

“我知道你怕我。”

妙珠有些悔恨不胜似地，

“I know what my temper is like too, but I can’t change it.”
“我也知道我的脾气，就是改不掉。”

Someone with self-knowledge was easier to deal with, Hu thought.
一个人能有自知之明，便容易相处了，胡雪岩心想，

不管将来如何，能劝得她稍敛那种刚烈性情，总是好事，

“妙珠，”他先恭维她一顿，“说良心话，我从杭州看到上海，上海看到苏州，象你这佯的人品，真是顶儿尖儿，

再没有话好说……”

不要替我乱戴高帽子。

The higher you lift me, the harder I shall fall.
捧得高，跌得重，

下面就要说到我的坏处了。”

Having been forestalled, Hu could hardly continue.
一说破，胡雪岩倒又不便再出口了，

Once again he could only smile.
仍然只能付之一笑。

“Enough of that,” she said suddenly.
“闲话少说。”妙珠忽然问道，

“What arrangement do you like in a house?”
“你住房子喜欢怎样一种格局？”

The question was so abrupt that he needed a moment to understand it.
这话问得太突兀。胡雪岩想了一下，方始明白，

但也不愿说破，只反问一句：“你呢？

你喜欢怎样的格局？”

“我喜欢高大凉爽，前后空地要多。”

如果要修怎么样一座亭台楼阁的大花园，我力量不够，

普通一所住宅，我还送得起。”

You will live there, not I.
胡雪岩又说，“房子是你住，不是我住，

Naturally, it should be as you like it.”
良然是你喜欢怎么样就怎么样。”

最后一句话，是有意这样说的，暗中拒人于千里以外，

这，妙珠也懂，不过她受了古应春的教，已打字一个“磨”字的主意，

所以并不觉得失望，

神态自若地问道：“你们杭州的房子是怎样的格局？”

“普通人家前后厢房，中间是正屋，

有个名堂，叫做‘四盘一汤’。”

She found the description novel.
妙珠觉得这个说法很新奇，

Closing her eyes, she pictured the house from above: side rooms at the four corners, and a hall in the middle.
闭上眼想一想，若是临空下望，前后厢房，分布四角，中间一座厅，

It did indeed make that shape.
果然是这样一种形状，

She smiled.
于是笑道：

“Good.
“好的！

We’ll have four dishes and a soup too.”
我们也来个四盆一汤。”

Hu understood this almost entirely one-sided assumption.
这近乎一厢情愿的想法，胡雪岩自然也懂，

It was better to stop; the more he said, the harder it would be to make his position clear.
认为不宜再说下去了，话越来越多，也越描越黑。

Again he only smiled.
因而又是笑笑不响。

“You do know how to smile!
“你倒真会笑！

Once, twice, three times.”
一笑、两笑、三笑了！”

The words had no obvious purpose, yet from her lips they had a special flavour.
是不明用意的废话，但出之于她的口中，另有一种味道，

Hu was a skilful banterer and replied with a smile, “You surpass Qiuxiang, but unfortunately there is no Tang Bohu.”
胡雪岩斗口也是很在行的，随即笑道：“你倒是胜过秋香，可惜没有一个唐伯虎！”

This too was a covert refusal.
这又有暗中见拒之意，

One day, she told herself, I shall make it impossible for you to get away.
妙珠心中自语：总有一天叫你脱不得身。

A sly smile appeared on her face.
这样想着，脸上便露了诡黠的笑容。

这让胡雪岩又起警惕，

What was she planning?
不知道她在打什么主意？

As he studied her closely, she suddenly burst into laughter.
凝神细看，妙珠忽然“噗哧”一声，笑了出来。

This puzzled him still more.
这一笑，越使胡雪岩困惑，

Yet one thing was clear: their earlier resentment had gone.
不过有一点倒是很清楚的：前嫌尽释！

There was no need to waste further effort on it.
既然如此，就不必再瞎费什么工夫了，

He would leave it for now.
且丢开了再说。


They returned to the table and resumed their lively drinking.
回到席间，重又闹酒，

Lunch did not finish until four in the afternoon.
一顿午饭，吃到下午四点才罢。

Miaozhu excused herself and withdrew.
妙珠道声“得罪”退了出去。

Soon afterwards, a trusted maid who attended Miaozhen’s rooms came in, exchanged a glance with her mistress and drew her outside.
接着便有个替妙珍收拾房间的心腹娘姨，进来使个眼色，将妙珍调到外面。

这一去好久不见进来，

Neglecting guests was a grave fault in a pleasure house, especially guests as important as these.
冷落客人是娼门大忌，而况是这几位特客？

Though the men continued their wide-ranging talk, each privately wondered what was happening.
所以胡雪岩等人，虽在海阔天空地闲谈，暗地里却都抱着一个疑团。

Near dusk, a group of customers arrived.
天快黑下来时，来了一班押客，

Amid the noise, one sentence from an attendant could be heard distinctly: “Second Miss has closed her rooms.”
嘈杂的人声中有一句话听得很清楚，是她们那里的相帮在说：“二小姐收房间了。”

“Second Miss” meant Miaozhu.
“二小姐”就是妙珠，

Closing her rooms was equivalent to taking down one’s nameplate at a Shanghai changsan house: it signified leaving the profession to marry.
“收房间”等于上海长三堂子里的“卸牌子”，是从良的表示。

问津有心的那班狎客，一看名花有主，无不惘叹，

少不得有人打听，是何豪客，量珠来换去了这一粒“妙珠”？

相帮以“弄不清楚”作答。

别人不清楚，妙珍屋里的三个人，心中雪亮，

古应春笑笑说道，

“Little Uncle, you are favoured by beauty indeed.
“小爷叔！艳福不浅，

Everywhere you go, someone loses her heart.”
到处有人留情。”

Hu could not smile.
胡雪岩却笑不出来，

“I am no false moralist and needn’t pretend.
“我不是假道学，用不着口是心非。

人呢，当然有可取之处，

不过我现在实在没有工夫来享这份艳福。”

He looked at Liu.
他看着刘不才说，

“Third Master, why don’t you take over?”
“三爷，你来接收了去吧！”

Liu shook his head vigorously. “You must be joking. How could I do such a thing?
“说笑话了！我怎么能做这种事？”刘不才大摇其头，

Even if it were possible for me to accept, her heart is fixed on you.
“退一万步说，妙珠一片心在你身上，

Nine oxen couldn’t turn it.
九牛拔不转，

I couldn’t take her over if I tried.”
就算我可以接收也接收下到。”

“What a nuisance!”
“麻烦！”

Hu sounded resentful.
胡雪岩有些怨恨，

“Gu, you must have been her wretched strategist.
“老古，一定是你替她做了狗头军师！

Tell the truth: what rotten scheme did you suggest?”
你说实话，你替她出了什么馊主意？”

Gu thought for a moment.
古应春想了一下，这样答道：

“Little Uncle, my advice is to ignore it and let things take their course.
“小爷叔，我劝你最好置之不理，听其自然，

Then you will have neither trouble nor worry.”
那就不会有麻烦，更不会有烦恼了。”

“That makes sense.”
“这话倒说得有道理。”

Hu nodded gravely.
胡雪岩深深点头，

“I shall do as you say.”
“我就照你的话做。”

“I’m only afraid you won’t find it easy.”
“只怕不容易做到。”

Surprised and displeased at this apparent reversal, Hu said, “Now I don’t understand.”
听他的话又翻覆，自然诧异，而且不满：“这话，我弄不明白！”

“It is simple.
“很容易明白！

As the saying goes, we cannot help having feelings; who can dismiss them?
小爷叔，有道是：”未免有情，谁能遣此？

I fear you cannot put her out of your heart.
‘我怕你心里抛不开。

If so, it would be better to face the facts.”
倘或如此，倒不如实事求是的好。

Hu considered for a while.
“胡雪岩沉吟了一会，

He did indeed find it hard to let her go, and could make no reply.
果然有些割舍不下，因而便无话可答了。



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十九章（下）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Nine, Part Three
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Just then a party arrived, led by Changgen, followed by Yu Wucheng, then You Laowu and his fellow men of the brotherhood, with Yang Fengmao and Zhu bringing up the rear.
就在这时候，到了一班客人，领头的是跷脚长根，其次是俞武成，再后面就是尤五跟他的那班江湖弟兄，殿尾的是杨凤毛和朱老大，

The room was packed.
挤得满满的一屋子，

Miaozhen and her maids hurried to attend them, adding to the confusion.
加上妙珍领着娘姨、大姐来招呼，乱得不可开交。

Drawing Hu away from Gu and Liu, You whispered, “Little Uncle, I have something important to discuss.
“小爷叔！”尤五避开古应春和刘不才，将他一拉，悄悄说道，“我有几句要紧话，想跟你说。

Where can we find somewhere quiet?” Hu asked Miaozhen, who answered at once, “Miaozhu's room is empty.”
看哪里有清静的地方？”这里找主人，胡雪岩便又去问妙珍，她毫不迟疑地答道：“妙珠的房间空着。”

“Of course!
“不错！”

That reminds me.
胡雪岩倒想起来了，

What's happened to her?”
“妙珠是怎么回事？”

Miaozhen gave him an odd glance.
听此一问，妙珍的神情很奇怪，瞟了他一眼，

Her voice was half reproachful, half teasing.
用又象埋怨，又象调侃的声音说，

“I should be asking what's happened to you, Master Hu.”
“我都要问胡老爷是怎么回事？”

Once begun, that conversation would never end.
这样一扯开来，话就说不完了，

Concerned though he was, Hu had no time to inquire.
事虽关心，苦于此时无暇深问，胡雪岩只说得一句：

“回头再谈！”转身而去。

将尤五领到妙珠原来的住处，进房便觉异样。

古应春睡过的那张大铜床，裳枕皆已收起，只剩下一张藤棚，

妆台上胭脂花粉，一扫而空，玻璃镜子上还蒙了个布套子，

格外有股人去楼空，天涯何处的凄凉味道。

“唉！”胡雪岩不知不觉地轻轻叹了口气。

You had spent the day discussing important business and knew nothing of this.
尤五一天都在忙着商谈“大事”，布解所谓，便愕然相问：

“小爷叔，你叹啥气？”

胡雪岩是深感于这短短一天之中，妙珠由一念轻生到毅然脱出风尘。已经历了好一番沧桑，情动乎中，不能自已，

但到底算是闲情，

Why speak of them now?
这时候何必去谈它？

所以问而不答，只说：“你们今天跟长根谈得怎么样？”

长根自然是厉害角色，不过自己人面前，不作兴说‘法兰西话’……”

“What?” Hu interrupted.
“ 什么？”胡雪岩打断他的话问：

Some people understand English, but when a man speaks French, you only hear his tongue rolling and have no idea what he's saying.
说洋文，英国话还有人懂，法兰西语，只听他舌头上打滚，不晓得他说些什么？

So when someone talks only to suit himself and neither side can ever agree, we call it speaking French.”
所以说人自说自话，彼此永远谈不拢，就说他是说‘法兰西话’。”

“A good expression.

长根不说‘法兰西话’，说的什么话呢？”

人心都是肉做的。

小爷叔这样待他，他不能做半吊子。

又说：吃不穷，着不穷，不长眼睛一世穷！

这句话也很实在。

小爷叔，江南江北的漕帮，以后都要靠你老人家了！

尤五慢吞吞他说：

听我讲完。”

He described a plan for the brotherhood's survival.
讲的是他们江南江北漕帮的一条自救自保之策。

Since the rising of Hong and Yang had blocked the waterways and grain tribute had been diverted to sea transport, its members had struggled to make a living.
从洪杨起事，河道阻塞，漕米改为海运以后，漕帮生计维艰，

只是遍地烽火，各地纷纷办团练自保，朝廷焦头烂额，只顾军务，尚且不暇，自然无法来管漕帮的生计。

这层苦衷，漕帮的头脑，无不体谅，

因此各地帮口小弟兄闹事，他们都是好言相劝，共体时艰，

But every household had mouths to feed, old people and children alike.
但朝天一张口，家家有老小，总得要喂饱肚子才行。

这就不是苦口婆心的劝导所能济事的。

You, Yu, Changgen and other leaders had therefore reached the same conclusion: they must find a livelihood for themselves.
因此，尤五、俞武成、跷脚长根还有另外一班漕帮管事的人物，人同此心，心同此理，都觉得唯一的办法是自己来寻一条生路。

这条生路，不但要你替我们来寻，而且要请你领我们来走。”

“啊！”胡雪岩吸着气，已感到双肩沉重不胜了，

但是，无论如何说不出拒绝的话来，

只有三个字：想办法！

他们也谈到过许多能够走、走得通的路。不过，这些想头，也大都是胡雪岩的启发而已。

现在难民多，有时要搭船觅个铺位，还真不容易。

难处是怕官府不准。

“对啊！”

尤五十分欣慰，

“That's why we want you to lead us.
“我们要请小爷叔来出头，

就是这些关节，都要仰仗大力来打通。”

“I can't promise they can be cleared.
“打不打得通，还不敢说。”

What other businesses did you discuss?”
胡雪岩又问：“你们还谈些什么生意，”

“Exports of silk and tea seem certain to recover.
“丝、茶两项销洋庄，现在看样子是一定可以恢复的了。

We thought of pooling capital and asking you to trade for us.”
我们想集一笔资本，请小爷叔替我们来做。”

“That is possible.
“这当然可以。

But first, would the profits belong to individuals or to the whole body?”
不过我先要问一问，这两项生意，赚了钱，是私人的，还是公众的。”

You was taken aback.
这话问得尤五一愣，

“True.
“是啊！”

I hadn't considered that.
他搔搔头皮说，“我倒没有想到这一点，

We're asking you to find a livelihood for our brothers.
现在是请小爷叔来替漕帮弟兄想办法，

If the profits are shared by everyone, naturally there's no objection.
如果赚钱公众分，当然没话说。

Otherwise that business must wait.”
不然，就只好搁在后头了。”

“That's my view too.”
“我也是这个意思。

Hu hesitated, then asked, “Brother Five, are your own intentions public or...”
五哥，”胡雪岩迟延了一下，终于问了出来，“我倒要请教，你的意思，是为公，还是……”

“You know my situation.
“我的情形，你晓得的，

There's no distinction between public and private.
无所谓公私。

When there's money, I first set aside the Old Master's expenses.
有钱，老太爷的用度先提起一份，

The rest is for everyone.
此外就是大家用，

Those who reach farther take more; those who move slowly take less.”
手长的多用几个，脚慢的少用几个。”

“这不是办法，

You must establish rules.
你总要定个章程出来。

Never mind being the leader of a branch—even in my own business I must treat the employees fairly if I want them sincerely to accept things.”
不要说你是一帮之主，就是我自己的生意，对伙计们也要一碗水往平处端，大家才会心服，”

“是！小爷叔说得是。”尤五深深点头。

“这件事你不妨请老古替你参赞。

现在不必会谈它。

丝、茶两项生意，当然要做的，不过应该还有别的，大家有饭吃的生意好做。

When I have some leisure, I'll think them through for you.”
等我空一空来替你们动脑筋。”


“Good.
“是的。

I wanted to explain first.
我先跟你说明白了，

The others will have more to say at dinner.”
回头席面上，他们还有话说。”

That night's banquet was given expressly by the brotherhood as a whole.
这一夜的盛宴，算是漕帮公众特请，

It was no trap, yet the meal was hard to endure.
虽非鸿门宴，但这顿饭也着实难吃，

The more they praised Hu, the heavier his responsibility felt.
大家越是恭维，胡雪岩越觉责任沉重。

As he answered modestly, he reflected that sometimes a man moving in their world had to put on a bold front, promising everything even beyond his ability.
所以一面谦虚，一面腹中寻思：江湖上行事，有时要“充”，不会的也得要大包大揽，满口答应，

Sometimes he had to charge ahead, whether he could accomplish a thing or not.
有时要“冲”，不管做得到做不到，硬做了去。

But sometimes neither pretence nor a headlong charge would do: honesty must come first, steadiness second.
但是，有时既不能充，更不能冲，一要诚实，二要稳健。

This was such an occasion.
象此时的情形，

Even if he carried off the bluff or forced his way through, he might gain little credit.
充对了、冲过了，未见得见好，

If he failed, he would ruin important affairs for others and earn only blame for his efforts.
充不好、冲不过，则误人大事，吃力而不讨好，

That would be folly.
不智之甚！

When their speeches ended, he spoke calmly.
因此，他等大家的话告一段落，从容冷静他说道：

“Brother You has explained your wishes.
“刚才尤五哥跟我说，

You honour me so greatly that I cannot refuse.
承各位台爱，我说不出推辞的话来。

But there are two things I must make clear first.”
此刻想想，有两句话，一定先要向各位说明白。”

First, his own business and the many other affairs he had undertaken had reached a point where further delay was impossible.
这不能不预先声明的两点苦衷是：第一，他个人的生意，以及招揽在身上的闲事很多，而且也都到了不容再拖，必须料理的时候，

He could not immediately devote himself to the brotherhood.
所以一时还无法为漕帮效劳，

Second, he sighed, “Doing the work is easier than dealing with people.”
其次，他感叹着说：“做事容易做人难”，

He could not hope to satisfy everyone and asked for their understanding.
将来必不能尽如人意，希望大家谅解。

They all readily accepted the first point.
对于第一点，自是同声应承，

The second, however tactfully expressed, made several uneasy.
提到第二点，尽管他措词委婉，仍有好些人觉得不安，

Yu in particular laboured to assure him that nobody harboured any prejudice and that he must not suspect them.
尤其是俞武成，很费劲地申述，大家决没有任何成见，希望他不要多心。

Hu was wary of the familiar saying, “Hemp has many fibres; worldly men have many suspicions.”
胡雪岩对“麻布筋多，光棍心多”这句江湖上人人皆知的谚语，深具戒心，

He had meant to say more on the subject, but now held his tongue.
所以本来还想在这方面再发挥几句的，见此光景，也只好缄口不言了。

By the time the drinking ended, the stars had wheeled far across the sky.
这一顿酒吃下来，已是斗转参横，

Everyone except Changgen returned to the Zhu house to sleep.
除掉跷脚长根，其余都回到朱家歇宿。


With the Tongli business finished and much still awaiting him in Songjiang and Shanghai, You decided to leave early next morning.
尤五因为同里事毕，而松江、上海都还有许多事要等他去料理，决定第二天一早离去，

He came especially to say goodbye to Hu, but once they began talking there was no end to it.
特地到胡雪岩那里话别。 不想一谈起来就没有完，

Hu repeatedly urged him to go, yet he was reluctant to leave.
胡雪岩一再催促，他总舍不得走，

There would be other chances to say all this; they had simply met again after a long separation and hated to part so soon.
话虽多，其实以后有机会再谈亦可以，只是久别重逢，乍逢又别，觉得依依不舍而已。

They talked until dawn.
就这样一谈谈到夭亮，

You decided to board at once and sleep on the way to Songjiang.
尤五索性直接上船，睡到松江。

Since his friends were travelling with him, courtesy obliged Hu to see them off.
由于有他的朋友在一起，胡雪岩在礼节上不能不送行。

After their handclasps by the river, Hu was exhausted and ready to return to Zhu's and bury himself in bed.
河千握别，人已疲乏不堪，正待回朱家蒙头大睡，

Gu, beside him, caught his arm.
在一起的古应春眼尖，拉了他一把，急急说：

“Look!”
“你看！”

A small sedan chair swept past.
注目看时，一顶小轿，如飞而过，

只从两方镶嵌的玻璃小窗中，看出是个女人，却不辨是何面貌。

“是哪个？”

“Who else?”
“还有哪个？”

Gu smiled.
古应春笑道：

“What other woman in Tongli concerns you?”

He plainly meant Miaozhu.
这当然是指妙珠，

Hu felt unfairly cornered by the insistence that he cared for her.
但古应春这样硬指他对妙珠关心，却使他感到有口难辩的委屈。

就在这苦笑无以为答之际，只见轿子已转入一条小巷，

果不其然，轿子已经停了下来。

胡雪岩心想，既已如此，不如看个明白，因而不必古应春相劝，先就走了过去。

“妙珠也姓胡？”

“I don't know.”
“我不晓得。”

“This is strange!
“这就有点奇怪了！”

Such high-handed compulsion—I've never seen the like.
胡雪岩狐疑满腹，“这样‘霸玉硬上弓’的事！我还是第一回看见。

I must ask Miaozhen when we get back.”
回去倒要问问妙珍！“


“Why go to that trouble?
“何必那么费事？

Miaozhu is here.
现在有妙珠在这里，

Why not ask her?”
为啥不问？”

说着，古应春伸手便去叩门，胡雪岩想要阻止，已是不及，古应春拉起铜环“当当”地拍了两下。

The black-lacquered doors opened.
黑漆双扉开启，

The maid with hanging hair was A’jin, Miaozhu's attendant.
垂鬟小婢正是妙珠身边的小大姐阿金。

“胡老爷！”面团团象“无锡大阿福”的阿金，笑嘻嘻他说：

一早就寻得来了。”

Hu had no wish to joke.
胡雪岩无心跟她逗笑，只问：

“Where is Second Miss?”
“二小姐呢？”

“Just back.”
“刚刚回来。”

一句话不曾完，妙珠已掀帘而出，

布衣布裙，屏绝铅华，已俨然“人家人”的样子了。

这样的举止，是以胡家的主妇自居，

胡雪岩心想：这就不必再问她的本姓了。

难为你觅得着，

倒真凑巧。”

古老爷，你下次来就好了。”

The silk trade must bring you to Tongli.

如果没有地方落脚，就住在这里好了。

这里，古老爷，你当它自己的家一样。”

“多谢，多谢。”古应春说，

修行的话也不说起了！

胡雪岩心里好笑，

但嘴角掩不住那种近乎捉住人错处的笑容，

使得妙珠忍不住要问。“胡老爷，你笑啥。

“顾前不顾后”五个字，不堪寻味，胡雪岩却不说破，只问：

“Rented.”
“租的，”

“房东卖不卖？”

“卖也可以谈。”

胡雪岩略停一下说：

为啥不能贴那张条子？”

“对，”

妙珠抢着说道，“那时再换一张条子，叫做‘胡氏家庵’。”

“那也随你的便。

There are plenty of people called Hu.
反正天下姓胡的多得很，

随你高兴姓啥就姓啥。”

依然是拒人千里的语气，

妙珠觉得他太过于簿情，脸色便有些不大好看了。

胡雪岩神思困倦，肝火上升，认为妙珠过于惫赖，

有意想跟她吵一架，吵散了拉倒。

I remember now.
想起来了，

不要紧。”

什么事不要紧？”

根本无事，如何作答？古应春便信口胡扯：

胡雪岩啼笑皆非，

妙珠却是想想滑稽，这古老爷莫非有痰疾？

这破颜一笑，便至少是安抚了一方，

古应春旁观者清，此时若得妙珠的一番柔情蜜意，则百炼钢可以化为绕指柔，

因而先抛个眼色，然后指着胡雪岩对妙珠说：

你让他好好睡一觉吧！”

你这两天精神耗费得太多了，

难得几样大事都已有了头绪，正该好好息一息，养足了精神，

我们明天一起到苏州，转上海。

““古老爷是好话！”妙珠从容接口，

“One should know good advice from bad and listen to the good.”

胡雪岩也实在是倦得眼都要睁不开，勉强撑持在那里，

经他们两人这样相劝，一念把握不住，如水就下，浑身劲泄，

不但懒得动，连话都懒得说了。

看古应春刚要出门，他想起一句话，非说不可，

如果有啥信息，你赶紧派人来通知我。”

“我知道了。

你尽管安心在这里休息好了。”

等古应春一走，妙珠亲自去绞了一把热毛巾，递到胡雪岩手里，同时问道：

“饿倒不饿，

心里有点发虚。”

“It's your body that's weak.

我煨了一罐莲芯粥在那里，

你吃一碗，就上床去吧！”

She left, and soon A’jin brought a bowl on a Fujian lacquer tray: lotus-seed porridge with osmanthus and rock sugar.
一面说，一面便走了开去，不多片刻，阿金捧着一只闽漆托盘，端来了一碗桂花冰糖莲芯粥。

Hu liked sweet things.
胡雪岩本来就爱甜食，

It was delicate, rich, sweet and soft, and he wanted more when it was gone.
那碗粥清腴甘糯，吃完了意有未尽。

As though anticipating his thought, Miaozhu immediately brought a second bowl.
妙珠仿佛预知他的心意似地，紧接着端来了第二碗。

就只有这一碗了。

我马上再炖，等你起来再吃。”

What else would you like?
妙珠又向：“另外还想吃点啥？

好趁早动手。”

Her tenderness swept away his defences.
这样深情款款，胡雪岩心头的樊篱尽撤，

只要你的人！”

嘴里说着话，一只手便伸过来拉，妙珠腰肢一扭，翩然避开，

“A gentleman uses words; a small-minded man uses his hands,” she teased.
带着顽皮的笑容说：“君子动口，小人动手。”

Hu laughed, stretched and rose.
胡雪岩一笑而罢，伸过懒腰，站起身来，

Miaozhu led him to a spacious bedroom, not yet fully arranged, but with curtains hung and clean bedding ready.
妙珠便引着他到卧房，房间甚大，却犹未布置妥帖，不过窗帘已经装好，床上衾枕整洁，尽堪安卧，

He sank onto the bed and would not move.
身子一歪，倒在床上，就不想动了。

“Get up a moment so I can make it properly.”
“起来嘛！等我铺床。”

“It's good enough.”
“马马虎虎好了。”

His eyes were already closing.
胡雪岩的眼睛已经合拢，

“I don't want to move.”
“我不想再动了。”

Helplessly, she called A’jin.
妙珠无奈，叫进阿金来，

Together they removed his boots and loosened his clothes, turning him this way and that with considerable effort.
替他脱靴宽衣，一个身子拨过来拨过去，费了好半天的事，

His head had barely reached the pillow before he was snoring.
刚把他的头搬到枕上，鼾声已经起了。


He slept until afternoon.
他这一觉睡到下午才醒，

The first thing he heard was a soft, languid tune hummed through the nose.
首先听到的是柔靡的小调，用鼻音低低哼着，

Turning towards the room, he looked through the white mesh curtains and saw Miaozhu combing her hair by the window.
转身朝外，从雪白方孔纱帐中望出去，只见妙珠正坐在窗前通头发，

It reached her waist, too long for a single stroke; she had to lift a smooth white arm and take the ends in her other hand.
发长及腰，一梳子通不到底，不能不抬起又白又腻的一弯手臂，反握发梢，才料理得了。

The sight stirred him.
胡雪岩看在眼里，痒在心头，

He coughed, and when she lifted the curtain to look, he quickly pulled her towards him.
便咳嗽一声，等她揭帐来视，很快地将她一拉。

Taken by surprise, she protested, “Always so rough!”
猝不及防的妙珠，恨声说道：“总是这样子蛮来！”

When he released her, she stepped back and said seriously, “This is a different place now.”
等她一放手，她脱身退后，正色而言：“这里地方不同了。”

Hu paused, then understood.
胡雪岩愣了一下，才明白她的意思，

She was a respectable woman now, no longer keeping a courtesan's house with her sister.
是良家妇女了，不同于她们姐妹一起张艳帜的时候。

Overnight, her status had changed.
一夜之隔，居然身分不同，

But was it not absurd to say this to a man lying in her bed?
然而对一个睡在她床上的男人，说这样的话，不太可笑吗？

Without thinking, he asked, “Then what am I, sleeping here?”
因此，他不假思索地问了一句：“那么我呢？睡在这里，算是啥名堂？”

“Ask yourself.
“问你自己！

Until you explain, I can only treat you as a guest.”
你不说明白，我只好拿你当客人看。”

“A guest!”
“客人？”

He could not help laughing.
胡雪岩忍不住好笑，

“A guest sleeping in the hostess's bed!”
“睡在女主人床上的客人！”

She too suppressed a smile, then grew stern again.
妙珠也忍不住抿嘴笑了，但很快地又绷起脸来，

“Just this once.
“难得一次。”

Next time, I'm afraid...”
她说，“下次再来，就对不起了。”

“What?
“怎么样？

You'll turn me out?”
莫非赶我出门？”

Unable to answer, she called A’jin for washing water.
妙珠词穷不答，只叫阿金舀脸水进来，
