“Shanghai gathers people from every quarter, and everyone has an opinion.
『上海五方杂处，议论最多。』

How do they compare me with Governor-General He?”
他问∶『他们是怎么拿我跟何制军相比？』


Since Wang pressed him, Xiao had to answer.
既然追问，不能不说，

He composed himself. “They all say that you are a truly loyal servant of the throne.
萧家骥定定神答道∶『都说王大人才是大大的忠臣。

Set beside Governor-General He, the difference between worth and unworthiness becomes all the clearer.
跟何制台一比，贤愚不肖，更加分明了。

Everyone prays that danger will turn to safety for you and misfortune to good.”
大家都在保佑王大人，逢凶化吉，遇难成祥了。』

“Ah!”
『唉！』

Wang let out a long breath.
王有龄长长地舒了口气，

“If that is what people say, then justice does indeed live in human hearts.”
『有这番舆论，可见得公道自在人心。』

After a pause he asked, “Xueyan must have sent a letter?”
他略停一下又问∶『雪岩总有信给我？』

“Mr Hu feared that I might encounter the Longhairs on the road, so he wrote nothing.
『怕路上遇到长毛，胡先生没有写信，

He entrusted me with a spoken message.”
只有口信。』

Xiao remembered the private conversation Hu had described, in which Wang had asked him to care for his child after his death.
萧家骥心想，胡雪岩所说，王有龄向他托孤的话，

Its purpose had been to establish Xiao’s credentials.
原是为了征信之用；

Now that Wang already accepted his identity, he need not mention it and cause further grief.
现在王有龄既已相信自己的身分，这话就不必再提，免得惹他伤心，

He went straight to the business. “The rice we bought arrived four days ago and is lying in the middle of the river.
所以接下来便谈正题∶『采办的米，四天前就到了，停在江心；

Because you told Mr Hu that you would send someone to contact him as soon as the grain boats arrived, he has not dared leave them.
胡先生因为王大人曾交代，米船一到，自会派人跟他联络，所以不敢离开。

He waited until yesterday without news.
一直等到昨天，并无消息；

Anxiety has robbed him of his appetite and his sleep.
胡先生焦躁得食不甘味，夜不安枕，

He therefore sent me ashore at great risk to bring this message: please dispatch troops quickly to open the supply route so that the rice can be landed.”
特为派我冒险上岸来送信，请王大人赶快派兵，打通粮道，搬运上岸。』

Before he had finished, tears were streaming down Wang’s face.
话还未完，王有龄双泪直流，

He shook his head repeatedly and sobbed, “We learned of it yesterday.
不断摇头，哽咽着说∶『昨天就得到消息，

We sent troops out this morning.
今天也派兵出城了。

It was no use!
没有用！

The Longhairs have penned us in until we have not a scrap of strength left.
叫长毛困死了；困得一点气力都没有了。

We can see it, but cannot reach it.
可望而不可即；

Food is there, yet we cannot put it into our mouths.
有饭吃不到口，

How can I close my eyes in death?”
真教我死不瞑目。』

He broke into a great cry of anguish.
说到这里，放声一恸；

Everyone in the household, old and young, wept with him, calling upon Heaven and earth.
王家大小，亦无不抢天呼地，跟着痛哭。

Xiao’s heart ached; tears poured down his cheeks, and he too sobbed aloud.
萧家骥心头一酸，眼泪汨汨而下，也夹在一起号啕。

Tearful eyes met tearful eyes as they comforted one another and at last brought their grief under control.
『流泪眼看流泪眼』，相互劝慰着收住了眼泪；

Xiao then returned to the interrupted discussion.
萧家骥重拾中断话头，

He needed a definite decision.
要讨个确实主意。


The question brought Wang fresh anguish.
问到这话，又惹王有龄伤心；

This was the only road to survival for hundreds of thousands of people.
这是唯一的一条生路，关乎全城数十万生灵，

Even knowing that it lay beyond their reach, how could he take the terrible decision to say, “There is no hope.
明知可望而不可即，却又怎么能具此大决断，说一声∶『算了！

Go”?
你们走吧！』

And what if the boats stayed and waited for a chance?
不走等机会又如何？

If that were possible, it would naturally be best.
能办得到这一点，自然最好；

A painted cake could not satisfy hunger, but the thought of plums might ease thirst.
虽然画饼不能充饥，但是望梅或可止渴，

With so much rice lying in the Qiantang, the troops might find fresh courage and work a miracle.
有这许多米停泊在钱塘江心，或者能激励军心，发现奇迹——

Wang had seen such a miracle in childhood: when a neighbor’s house caught fire, a man who had been bedridden with crippled legs somehow leaped up and ran out of the flames.
王有龄见过这样的奇迹，幼时见邻家失火，有个病足在床的人，居然能健步冲出火窟。

The hidden strength summoned by a desperate will to live could be astonishing.
人到绝处想求生时，那份潜力的发生，常常是不可思议的。

Yet such things might occur; they could not be commanded.
然而这到底是可遇而不可求的事。

All that rice was sure to tempt the Longhairs. Even if they had enough food themselves, they would devise every possible means of depriving the besieged of their last hope.
这许多米摆在那里，长毛必起觊觎之心∶就算他们自己不绝粮，但为了陷敌于绝境，亦必千方百计动脑筋不可，

Whether by open assault or a secret raid, one attack might very well send Hu Xueyan to his death in the Qiantang.
或明攻、或暗袭，只要有一于此，胡雪岩十之八九会葬身在钱塘江中，

He would join Wu Zixu beneath its waters, his bitter grief sounding in the tides morning and evening for a thousand years.
追随伍子胥于地下，呜咽朝夕，含恨千古。

At the thought, Wang wept sorrowfully, shook his head, and sighed. “Why drag another man down with me when I die?
转念到此，王有龄凄然下泪，摇头长叹∶『何苦「临死还拉个垫背的」？

Mr Xiao, tell Xueyan that our will outstrips our strength.
萧义士，你跟雪岩说∶心余力绌，

We can only sit and await death.
坐以待毙。

Ask him to leave at once.”
请他快走吧！』

This was, in fact, the answer Xiao had come hoping to obtain.
其实这倒是萧家骥想讨到的一句话；

But now that Wang had spoken it, he could not bring himself to assent.
但听王有龄说出口来，他反答应不下了。


“Governor Wang, think it over once more. There may be a way.”
『王大人！再筹划筹划看！』

“There is nothing left to think over.
『不用筹划了。

I hope all day and plan all night.
日日盼望，夜夜盘算；

Even sending someone to contact Xueyan is almost beyond us.
连想派个人跟雪岩联络，都不容易办得到。

Ah!”
唉，

Wang was in mortal anguish. “I did nothing wrong except in two matters.
『王有龄痛心欲绝地说∶』我什么都不错，只错了两件事，

First, someone advised me at the beginning to build a ramp from the city wall down to the riverbank and guard it with a strong force to secure our supply route.
一件是当初有人劝我从城上筑一条斜坡，直到江边，派重兵把守，以保粮路，

I feared the burden on the people.
我怕深累民力，

The undertaking was so vast that I worried we might have to abandon it halfway, wasting all their labor.
而且工程浩大，担心半途而废，枉抛民力，

I did not accept the proposal.
不曾采纳。

Now I see how terribly wrong I was.”
如今想来，大错特错。

It really had been an excellent plan.
『这实在是个好办法，

Such a route would naturally have been attacked by the Longhairs, but even if nine attempts failed and one succeeded, the city could have prolonged its existence a little.
有了这条路，当然也难免遭长毛的袭击；但九次失败，一次成功，城内亦可暂延残喘，

It could never have been trapped as completely as it was now, without the smallest opening toward life.
决不会象现在这样被困得一点点生路都找不到。


To say so, however, would only deepen Wang’s grief.
当然，这话要说出来，会更使王有龄伤心，

Xiao therefore argued the opposite.
所以只好反过来说，

“Not necessarily.
『那也不见得。』

From what I saw on the way, there are so many Longhairs that even with such a ramp, I doubt it could have been held.”
他说，『照我一路看到的情形，长毛太多，就有这条斜坡，也怕守不住。』

“Let us leave that.
『这不去说他了。

The second mistake was the worst.”
第二件事最错！』

Wang spoke dejectedly. “When the siege began, some said we must close the gates; others said we should open them and let the people out.
王有龄黠然说道∶『被围之初，有人说该闭城，有人说要开城放百姓，

There was endless argument and no agreement.
聚讼纷纭，莫衷一是。

I should not have listened to those who urged closure.
我不该听了主张闭城的人的话，

The proper course was to throw all ten gates wide and let the people escape.”
当初该十门大开，放百姓去逃生才是正办。』

“You must not torment yourself, Governor.
『王大人，你老也不必懊悔了。

If the gates had been opened, the Longhairs might have charged in and Hangzhou might have fallen long ago.”
说不定当初城门一开，长毛趁机会一冲，杭州早就不保。』

“That was precisely what we feared.
『原来顾虑的也就是这一点。

We thought relief would come in ten days or a fortnight, and that we might as well hold out.
总当解围是十天半个月的事，大家不妨守一守；

Opening the gates to let the civilians go would shake the army’s resolve.
开城放百姓，会动摇军心。

Who could have known that, in the end, we should fail to hold the city anyway?
哪知道，结果还是守不住。

If it was to come to this, why did we do it?
既有今日，何必当初？

I have failed the people of Hangzhou!”
我对不起杭州的百姓啊！』

Again he broke into loud sobs.
说到这道，又是一场号啕大哭；

Xiao wept with him, but a plan had already formed in his mind.
萧家骥再次陪泪，而心里却已有了打算，

Choking back his tears, he called, “Governor Wang!
哽咽着喊道∶『王大人，王大人，

Please listen to what I have to say.”
请你听我说一句。』


When Wang’s grief had eased a little, Xiao proposed a plan.
等王有龄悲伤略减，萧家骥提出一个办法，

It might have been called a promise, though in truth it was a hope: that the grain boats could remain safely where they were for another three days, and, more urgently still, that within those three days the troops inside the city could fight their way to the river and bring the rice ashore.
也可以说是许诺；而实在是希望——希望粮船能再安然等待三天；更希望城内官军能在这三天以内，杀出一条血路，运粮上岸。

“May it be so!”
『但愿如此！』

Wang forced himself to rally.
王有龄强自振作着说，

“Let us work together, inside and outside, and stake our lives on these next three days.”
『我们内外和继，尽这三天以内拼一拼命。』

“Yes!”
『是！』

To encourage the defenders, Xiao ventured another promise. “If the troops from the city can reach the riverbank, the foreign soldiers aboard the boats will certainly support them.
为了鼓舞城内官兵，萧家骥又大胆作了个许诺∶『只要城内官兵能够打到江边，船上的洋兵一定会得接应；

There are not many of them, but their firearms are powerful and highly effective.”
他们的人数虽不多，火器相当厉害，很得力的。』

“That would be best.
『能这样最好。

If Heaven grants our wish and Hangzhou is relieved, I shall be responsible for rewarding the foreign troops.
果然天从人愿，杭州能够解围，将来洋兵的犒赏，都着落在我身上。

I may not be able to manage more, but twenty thousand taels!”
多怕不行；两万银子！』

Wang struck his chest.
王有龄拍着胸脯说，

“Even if I must sell my modest property to make up the sum, I shall not mind.”
『哪怕我变卖薄产来赔，都不要紧。』

“Very well.”
『是了。』

Xiao rose. “I must take my leave and return as quickly as possible to arrange matters.”
萧家骥站起身来说∶『我跟王大人告辞；早点赶回去办正事。』


“Thank you, gallant Mr Xiao.”
『多谢你！萧义士。』

Wang spoke with heartfelt gratitude. “Hangzhou is no longer merely a city in danger; it is a place of certain death.
王有龄衷心感激地说∶『杭州已不是危城，简直是绝地；

You have risked your life to bring this message.
足下冒出生入死的大险来送信，

For such boundless generosity, it is not only I who thank you, but every civil and military official, every soldier, and every citizen of Hangzhou.
这份云天高义，不独我王某人一个人，杭州全城的文武军民，无不感激。

Mr Xiao—” He struggled shakily to his feet.
萧义士——』他一面说，一面颤巍巍地起身，

“Allow me to bow to you.”
『请受我一拜！』

“I could not accept it!”
『不敢当，不敢当！』

Xiao hurried to support him. “Governor Wang, this is a duty I could not in honor refuse.” One insisted on offering thanks, the other steadfastly declined the honor.
萧家骥慌忙扶住∶『王大人，这是我义不容辞的事。』一个坚辞，一个非要拜谢，

After a long impasse, Wang’s eldest son finally made the obeisance on his father’s behalf.
僵持了好一会，终于还是由王有龄的长子代父行礼；

Xiao was deeply moved.
萧家骥自然也很感动，

Reflecting that this parting in life was almost certainly a parting in death, he felt hot tears fill his eyes and a lump rise in his throat.
转念想到生离几乎等于死别，不由得热泪盈眶，喉头梗塞，

He managed only, “Take care of yourself, Governor Wang,” then turned away.
只说得一声∶『王大人，请保重！』扭头就走。


He had stumbled through the inner gate when he heard voices calling from within. “Please come back!”
踉踉跄跄地出了中门，只听里面在喊∶『请回来，请回来！』

Wang had another important trust to place in him. Recalled to the room, Xiao received the governor’s final memorial. This time Wang’s voice was quite calm. “Mr Xiao, please give this to Xueyan for safekeeping.
请了萧家骥回去，王有龄另有一件大事相托；将他的『遗疏』交了给萧家骥∶『萧义士！』这一次王有龄的声音相当平静∶『请你交付雪岩保管。

While the city stands, I live; when it falls, I die.
城在人在，城亡人亡，

News that Hangzhou has fallen will mean that my life is over.
只听说杭州失守，就是我毕命之日；

Ask Xueyan to take this final memorial in person to Governor Xue of Jiangsu and request that he have it transcribed and submitted to the throne.
请雪岩拿我这道遗疏，面呈江苏薛抚台，请他代缮出奏。

It concerns the final accounting of my entire life.
这件事关乎我一生的结果，

Mr Xiao, I entrust it to you with all my heart.”
萧义士我重重拜托了。』

Faced with such grave solemnity, Xiao dared show no hesitation.
见他是如此肃穆郑重的神情，萧家骥不敢怠慢，

“I shall,” he answered firmly.
重重地应一声∶『是！』

He folded the draft into four and placed it in the pocket of the short undergarment next to his skin.
然后将那道遗疏的稿子折成四叠，放入贴肉小褂子的口袋中；

Anxious lest it slip out and be lost, he pressed it twice through his outer clothes to make sure it was secure.
深怕没有放得妥当会遗失，还用手在衣服外面按了两下。


“Oh, one more instruction.
『喔，还有句话要交代，

Please have this final memorial submitted under the names and titles of both General Rui and myself.
这道遗疏请用我跟瑞将军两个人的衔名出奏。』

The general and I have agreed to die for our duty together.
王有龄又说∶『我跟瑞将军已经约好了，一起殉节，

Neither will survive the other.”
决不独生。』

He spoke so calmly and firmly, with such readiness to meet death, that the respect Xiao felt overwhelmed his sorrow.
听他侃侃而谈，真有视死如归的气概；萧家骥内心的敬意，掩没了悲伤，

He took his leave with composure.
从容拜辞，

“Governor Wang, I shall not fail your trust.
『王大人，』他说，『我决不负王大人的付托。

May this draft remain forever in Mr Hu’s keeping!”
但愿这个稿子永远存在胡先生手里！』

“May it be so,” Wang said in a low but perfectly clear voice. “And tell Xueyan again that he must not grieve for me.”
『但愿如此！』王有龄用低微但很清晰的声音说∶『再请你转告雪岩，千万不必为我伤心。』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第三章（本章第1部分，共4部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER THREE
第三章


How could Hu Xueyan not grieve?
胡雪岩岂有不伤心之理？

His eyes reddened as soon as he received Wang Youling’s final memorial.
接到王有龄的遗疏，他的眼圈就红了；

What hurt most was the knowledge that Wang had abandoned hope.
而最伤心的，则是王有龄已绝了希望。

Hu could imagine it all: Wang had pinned his hopes on the grain boats, first fearing that Hu might not reach Shanghai safely, then that, even if he obtained the grain there, he might fail to overcome the obstacles on the journey back to Hangzhou.
他可以想象得到，王有龄原来一心所盼的是粮船，只怕胡雪岩不能顺利到达上海；到了上海办来粮食，又怕不能冲破沿途的难关到达杭州。

Who could have foreseen that, after all those hardships, the food would arrive only to remain within sight but beyond reach?
哪知千辛万苦，将粮运到了，却是可望而不可即，

There was nothing left to hope for.
从此再无指望，

With that last thread of hope severed, the last thread of life had snapped. No sorrow is greater than a deadened heart.
一线希望消失，就是一线生机断绝∶『哀莫大于心死』，

Wang’s heart had turned to ice; the days left to him were merely a wait for death.
王有龄的心化为成冰，有生之日，待死之时，

Such an extremity of human suffering seemed without equal, a grief to be mourned for all time.
做人到此绝境，千古所无，千古所悲。

Yet Hu had to search for hope in hopelessness.
然而胡雪岩却不能不从无希望中去找希望，

Perhaps a miracle would occur within these three days.
希望在这三天中发生奇迹。

It was a tenuous hope, and even to cling to it seemed difficult.
这是个飘渺的希望；但就悬此飘渺的希望亦似乎不易——

Overnight, the situation had grown more threatening.
形势在一夜之间险恶了；

Boat after boat of rebels circled them, keeping just beyond gunshot.
长毛一船一船在周围盘旋，位置正在枪弹所够不到的地方；

Their intention needed no explanation.
其意何居，不言可知。


The foreign escort kept urging them to settle the matter and leave.
因此，护送的洋兵，已在不断催促，早作了结。

“It will be difficult to persuade them to wait three days,” Li Delong said.
『要请他们等三天，只怕很难。』李得隆说，

“While the man we sent had not returned, we could argue that we must wait for definite news.
『派去的人没有回来，总要有了确实信息再说；

Whether they liked it or not, they could hardly dispute that.
这句话在道理上，他们就不愿也没奈何。

Now Jiaji is back.
现在家骥回来了，

After what was just said about Hangzhou, everyone knows the situation.
刚才一谈杭州的情形，大家也都知道了。

They will not stay here in great danger, waiting uselessly for something hopeless.”
没有指望的事，白白等在这里冒极大的危险，他们不肯的。』

“They must agree, whatever it takes.
『无论如何要他们答应。

Having come all this way, I cannot bear to turn back just like that.
来了一趟，就此回去，于心不甘。

Besides, it is only three more days of danger.
再说，有危险也不过三天；

We have already faced far greater risks.
多大的危险也冒过了，

What are three days more?”
何在乎这三天？』

“Then we should tell them promptly.
『那就早跟他们说明白。』

The Sea-Junk Guild does not look very willing either.”
李得隆说，『沙船帮看样子也不大肯。』

“Once the foreign soldiers agree, the boatmen will have protection and nothing more to say.
『只要洋兵肯了，他们有人保护，自然没有话说。

We must approach this from two directions.
这件事要分两方面做，

A generous reward will always find brave men.
重赏之下，必有勇夫。』

Ask the liaison officer to pass this on: I have two proposals, and they may choose between them.”
胡雪岩说∶『请你们两位跟联络的人去说∶我有两个办法，随他们挑——。』

Hu considered whether two proposals were enough—whether there might be a third course that took everyone’s interests into account.
胡雪岩盘算着，两个办法够不够；是不是还有第三条兼筹并顾的路；

After much thought, he could find only the two.
想了半天，只有两个办法。


“The first is this.
『第一个办法，

If the troops in the city can fight their way out, I ask the escort to help them.
如果城里能够杀出一条血路，请他们帮忙打，

The twenty thousand taels Governor Wang has offered as a reward will be paid as soon as I reach Shanghai, and I shall add ten thousand of my own.
王抚台犒赏的两万银子，我一到上海就付；另外我再送一万。

For anyone killed or wounded, I shall pay twice the compensation laid down in their regulations.
如果有阵亡受伤的，抚恤照他们的营规加一倍。

They are to wait three full days and nights on these terms.
这样等过实足三昼夜，

If nothing happens, we sail for Ningbo, and I give them three thousand taels.”
如果没有动静，开船到宁波，我送三千银子。』

“That is a generous reward.
『这算得重赏了。

It would be worth risking their lives for,” Li said. “But men differ.
他们卖命也卖得过。』李得隆又问∶『不过人心不同，

Suppose they refuse and insist on sailing?”
万一他们不肯，非要开船不可呢？』

“Then there is my second proposal: let them push me into the Qiantang River before they sail.”
『那就是我的第二个办法，他们先拿我推在钱塘江里再开船。』

As he spoke, Hu’s face was utterly bloodless.
胡雪岩说这话时，脸色白得一丝血色都没有；

Li and Xiao stared at one another in dismay and remained silent for a long time.
李得隆、萧家骥悚然动容，相互看看，久久无语。

“I am not trying to frighten them.
『不是我吓他们！

I never make empty statements.
我从不说瞎话，

If, after I have done everything that loyalty and friendship require, they still refuse, tell me what course remains to me except death.”
如果仁义义尽他们还不肯答应，你们想想，我除死路以外，还有什么路好走？』

His determination to sacrifice himself both moved the foreign soldiers and alarmed them.
由于胡雪岩不惜以身相殉的坚决态度，一方面感动了洋兵；一方面也吓倒了洋兵，

Through the liaison officer, however, they imposed one condition: he must keep his word.
但通过联络官提出一个条件，要求胡雪岩说话算话，

Once the three days were over, he must devise no further excuse for delay.
到了三天一过，不要再出花样，拖延不走。

“We do what we can, then submit to Heaven’s decree,” Hu said.
『「尽人事而听天命。』胡雪岩说，

“These three days are only to make sure that we have done all that lies in our power.
『留这三天是尽尽人事而已；

I know they will be of no use.”
我亦晓得没用的。』


For all his words, Hu forgot both food and sleep, fixing his entire mind on the deliverance he expected.
话虽如此，胡雪岩却是废寝忘食，一心以为鸿鹄之将至，

Day and night he stood at the bow and gazed into the distance.
日日夜夜在船头上凝望。

The moaning river drowned his stifled sobs, but its cutting wind and the bitter winter nights brought on such violent coughing that it could be heard even inside the cabins.
江湖呜咽，虽淹没了他的吞声的饮泣；但江风如剪，冬宵寒重，引发了他的剧烈的咳嗽，却是连船舱中都听得见的。

“Mr Hu,” Xiao urged him, “Governor Wang’s affairs, in life and death, depend on you.
『胡先生，』萧家骥劝他，『王抚台的生死大事，都在你身上，

Your own family is waiting for you too.
还有府上一家，都在盼望。

Your life is too precious for you to neglect yourself like this.”
千金之躯，岂可以这样不知道爱惜？』

The reproach, coming from a younger man, made his concern all the more touching.
晚辈而有责备之词，情意格外殷切；

Hu had to yield.
胡雪岩不能不听劝。

Yet even lying in his berth, he strained his ears.
但睡在铺上，却只是竖起了耳朵，

Whenever a patrolling foreign soldier fired a shot, he would insist on going out to see what had happened.
偶尔听得巡逻的洋兵一声枪响，都要出去看了明白。

Though every day seemed a year, the three days finally passed.
纵然度日如年，三天到底还是过去了；

The foreigners allowed no latitude.
洋人做事，丝毫没有通融，

When the full three days and nights expired, at eight in the evening, they insisted on sailing.
到了实足三昼夜届满，正是晚上八点钟，却非开船不可。

Hu could do nothing.
胡雪岩无奈，

Turning north, he bowed several times, offering what was, in effect, a farewell tribute to a man still alive.
望北拜了几拜，权当生奠。

Then they departed, and he broke into uncontrollable weeping.
然后痛哭失声而去。


Only when they reached the vicinity of Zhenhai, at the mouth of the Yong River, did they learn that the Taiping commanders Huang Chengzhong and Fan Ruzeng had advanced from Cixi and Fenghua respectively, and that Ningbo had fallen two days earlier, on the eighth day of the eleventh month.
到了甬江口的镇海附近，才知道太平军黄呈忠和范汝增，从慈溪和奉化分道进攻，宁波已经在两天前的十一月初八失守。

Ningbo, however, had a foreign settlement, British and American consuls, and British and French warships.
不过宁波有租界，有英美领事和英法军舰；

The two consuls had marked out an area for foreign residence and commerce and were negotiating with Huang and Fan to keep the Taiping troops from entering it.
而且英美领事，已经划定『外人居住通商区域』，正跟黄呈忠和范汝增在谈判，不准太平军侵犯。

“What do we do now?” Hu asked weakly.
『那怎么办？』胡雪岩有气无力地说，

“Return to Shanghai?”
『我们回上海？』

“There is no reason to do that.
『哪有这个道理？

You are exhausted, Mr Hu.
胡先生，你精神不好，

Leave this to me.”
这件事变给我来办。』

Xiao hired a small boat and approached a British warship.
于是萧家骥雇一只小船，驶近一艘英国军舰，

After an exchange between the vessels, he was allowed aboard and met its captain, Kaobaituo.
隔船相语，军舰上准他登船，同时见到了舰长考白脱。

He explained that he wished to contact Yang Fang’s Ningbo firm and asked for an escort from the warship.
他的来意要跟杨坊开在宁波的商号联络；要求军舰派人护送。

He also told the captain that they had a large quantity of grain with which to supply Ningbo.
同时说明，有大批粮食可以接济宁波。

The news was warmly welcomed.
这是非常受欢迎的一件事，

“There are seventy thousand Chinese refugees in the neutral zone.
『在「中立区」避难的华人，有七万之多，

Food supplies have become an enormous problem.
粮食供应，成为绝大的问题；

You and your grain have arrived at just the right moment.
你和你的粮食来得正是时候。

But I am very sorry,” the captain added with a shrug. “At present I cannot do what you ask.
不过，我非常抱歉，』考白脱耸耸肩说∶『眼前我还没有办法达成你的意愿。

Could you stay aboard my ship for two or three days?”
你是不是可以在我船是上住两三天？』


“Why?”
『为什么？』

“The consular body is negotiating with the occupying forces.
『领事团正在跟占领军谈判。

We want them to respect the neutral zone and keep the markets functioning.
希望占领军不侵犯中立区，同时应该维持市百。

Once an agreement is reached, your grain can be brought in openly.
等谈判完成，你的粮食可以公开进口；

For the moment, however, we must abide by the existing understanding.
但在目前，我们需要遵守约定，

We cannot escort any Chinese person ashore.”
不能保护任何中国人上岸。』

“Could you send a letter for me, then?”
『那末，是不是可以为我送一封信呢？』

The captain considered. “Yes. Write a letter, and I shall ask the consulate to have it delivered.
考白脱想了想答道∶『可以你写一封信，我请领事馆代送。

I must also tell our consul this good news.”
同时我要把这个好消息告诉我们的领事。』

Xiao did as he suggested.
萧家骥如言照办。

The captain acted promptly and efficiently, sending a junior officer ashore in a small boat with the letter.
考白脱的处置也异常明快，派一名低级军官，立即坐小艇登岸送信；

At the same time, he ordered him to call on the British consul at Ningbo, Xiafuli, and report the welcome arrival of a large consignment of grain.
同时命令他去谒见英国驻宁波的领事夏福礼，报告有大批粮食运到的好消息。


While waiting for a reply, Xiao was tempted to accept the captain’s invitation to stay aboard. Yet he was uneasy about his own vessels.
为了等待复信，萧家骥很想接受考白脱的邀请，在他的军舰上住了下来但又不放心自己的船，

Though several dozen foreign soldiers guarded them, a clash with the Taiping forces would cause serious trouble.
虽说船上有数十名洋兵保护，倘或与太平军发生冲突，麻烦甚大。

If he could ask for a British flag to fly, that would provide excellent protection.
如果跟考白脱要一面英国国旗一挂，倒是绝好的安全保障，

But he feared that the men serving under the American Ward might regard this as an insult and refuse.
却又怕属于美国籍华尔的部下，认为侮辱而拒绝。

After turning the problem over, he could see no alternative but to return and keep watch himself.
左思右想，只有先回船守着再说。

Just as he rose to leave, the captain received a report informing him that Ward’s men were present.
乃至起身告辞时，考白脱正好接到报告，知道有华尔的兵在，

He wished to establish contact and asked Xiao to introduce them.
愿意取得联络，请萧家骥居间介绍。

This unexpectedly solved Xiao’s difficulty.
这一来无形中解消了他的难题，

Delighted, he readily agreed.
喜出望外，连声许诺。

A lifeboat was lowered from the warship, and he accompanied a British officer back to his own vessel.
于是由军舰上放下一条救生艇，陪着一名英国军官回到自己船上；

After the soldiers had conferred, Ward’s men accepted the British suggestion.
洋兵跟洋兵打交道的结果，华尔的部下接受了英国的建议，

The grain boats hoisted British flags and came under the captain’s protection.
粮船悬挂英国国旗，置于考白脱的保护之下。

Now they were truly safe.
到这地步，算是真正安全了。

Proud of how well he had managed the negotiations, Xiao hurried off to tell Hu.
萧家骥自觉这场交涉办得异常得意，兴冲冲要告诉胡雪岩。

But when he entered the cabin, he found him looking utterly drained, with a dreadful colour in his face.
到了舱里一看，只见胡雪岩神色委顿异常，面色难看得很。


“Mr Hu!” he exclaimed in alarm.
『胡先生，』他大惊问说，

“What is wrong?”
『你怎么了？』

“I am going to be ill.”
『我要病了。』

Xiao laid a hand on his forehead.
萧家骥探手去摸他的额头，

It was burning hot.
其烫无比，

“You are ill already.
『已经病了！』他说，

Lie down at once.”
『赶快躺下来。』

Once Hu lay down, he could not rise again.
这一躺下就起不来了。

He burned with fever and rambled continually, calling now for Xuexuan, now for his mother.
烧得不断谵语，不是喊『雪公』就是喊『娘』；

In his delirium, he knew only that he had been taken ashore; where he was lying ill, he had no idea.
病中神志不清，只记得已到了岸上，却不知卧疾何处？

One night he woke at midnight and saw someone sitting by a lamp—a woman.
有一天半夜里醒过来，只见灯下坐着一个人，且是女人；

The slender figure, seen from behind, seemed familiar, yet for the moment he could not remember who she was.
背影苗条，似乎很熟，却一时再也想不起来是谁？

“Am I dreaming?”
『我在做梦？』


Though he had only murmured to himself, the woman heard.
虽是低声自语，自也惊动了灯下的人，

She turned and raised the lamp’s flame so that he could see her face.
她旋转身来，扭亮了洋灯；让胡雪岩看清了她的脸——

Now it truly seemed a dream.
这下真的象做梦了；

He could scarcely find his voice.
连喊都喊不出来！

“You—you look so like A’qiao!”
『你，你跟阿巧好象！』

“I am A’qiao.”
『我就是阿巧！』

She wiped away a tear and forced a smile.
她抹一抹眼泪强笑着，

“You never thought it would be me, did you?”
『没有想到是我吧？』

Without answering, Hu struggled to sit up.
胡雪岩不答，强自抬起身子；

He was too weak and swayed as though about to fall.
力弱不胜，摇摇欲倒，

A’qiao hurried forward to support him.
阿巧赶紧上来扶住了他。

“What do you want?
『你要做啥？

Some tea?”
是不是要茶水？』

“No,” he said with difficulty.
『不是！』胡雪岩吃力地说，

“I want to see whether I am dreaming.
『我要看看，我是不是在做梦？

Where is this?
这是哪里；

Are you really A’qiao?”
你是不是真的阿巧？』

“Yes, I really am.
『是啊！我是真的阿巧。

I came especially to see you.
我是特为来看你的；

Lie down.
你躺下来，

We can talk slowly.”
有话慢慢说。』

There was so much to ask that he did not know where to begin.
话太多了，无从说起；

In truth, his head was too clouded even to think.
其实是头上昏昏沉沉地，连想都无从想起。

He could only lie back, look up at the canopy, then turn his eyes towards A’qiao.
胡雪岩只好躺了下来，仰脸望望帐顶，又侧脸望望阿巧，

First he must discover what had happened between the onset of his illness and this moment.
先要弄清楚从得病到此刻的情形。


“Where is he?” he asked without explanation.
『人泥？』他没头没脑地问。

“Do you mean young Mr Xiao?
『你是说那位萧少爷？』

He is sleeping in the outer room.”
阿巧答道，『他睡在外房。』

Xiao had already heard their voices.
在外房的萧家骥，已经听见声音，

Hastily throwing on his clothes, he came to the bedside.
急急披衣起床来探视，

Hu was haggard, but his eyes had regained a clear look.
只见胡雪岩虽然形容憔悴，但眼中已有清明的神色，

Surprised and delighted, Xiao asked, “Mr Hu, do you recognize me?”
便又惊又喜地问道∶『胡先生，你认不认得我？』

“You?” Hu replied in bewilderment. “Are you not Jiaji?”
『你？』胡雪岩不解地问∶『你不是家骥吗？』

“And this lady?”
『这位太太呢？』

“She is Madam He.
『她是何姨太太。』

Why are you asking me these things?
胡雪岩反问一句∶『你问这些做啥？

You make it sound as though I could not recognize anyone.”
倒象我连人都认不得似的。』

“Exactly!” Xiao said, smiling with relief. “For the past few days, you really did not recognize people.
『是啊！』萧家骥欣慰地笑道∶『前几天胡先生你真的不认得人。

This damp-fever illness came on terribly fiercely.
这场湿温的来势真凶，

At last you have turned the corner.”
现在总算「扳」回来了。』

“As bad as that?”
『这么厉害！』

Hu could scarcely believe it.
胡雪岩自己都有些不信，

“I had no idea,” he said, catching his breath.
咽着气说∶『我自己都想不到。

“How many days?”
几天了？』

“Eight.”
『八天了。』

“Where are we?”
『这是哪里？』

“In the British settlement, at Mr Yang’s firm.
『在英国租界上；杨老板号子里。』

You are extremely weak.
萧家骥说，『胡先生你虚极了，

Do not talk too much.
不要多说话；

Have some rice gruel, then your medicine, and sleep.
先吃点粥，再吃药。睡过一觉，

When you feel stronger tomorrow, we shall tell you everything.”
明天有了精神，听我们细细告诉你。』

His “we” plainly included A’qiao, who added, “Young Mr Xiao is right.
这『我们』很明显地包括了阿巧姐，所以她接口说道∶『萧少爷的话不错，

The first thing is to get well.”
你先养病要紧。』

“It does not matter.
『不要紧。』

I know nothing of what has happened, and it weighs on me.
胡雪岩说，『我什么情形都不知道，心里闷得很。

What news of Hangzhou?”
杭州怎么样？』


“None.”
『没有消息。』

Hu turned towards A’qiao to question her, but she was already rising.
胡雪岩转脸想问阿巧姐时；她正站起身来，

“I shall warm the gruel,” she said, going out.
一面向外走，一面说道∶『我去热粥。』

Watching her still graceful figure recede, then noticing Xiao’s curious half-smile and studied air of indifference, Hu again felt as though this meeting had taken place in a dream.
望着那依然袅袅婷婷的背影，再看到萧家骥似笑非笑，有意要装得不在意的诡秘神情，胡雪岩仍有相逢在梦中的感觉，

“How did she come here?” he asked quietly.
低声向萧家骥问道∶『她是怎么来的？』

“She arrived yesterday and came straight to me.
『昨天到的。』萧家骥答道∶『一到就来找我——

I had met her once at my master’s house, with his wife, so I knew her.
我在师娘那里见过她一次，所以认得。

She said she had heard you were seriously ill and had hurried here especially to nurse you.
她说，她是听说胡先生病重，特为赶来服侍的；

She wanted to stay.
要住在这里。

My master’s wife knew about it, so I could hardly refuse.”
这件事师娘是知道的，我不能不留她。』

Hu stared blankly for a while, then frowned. “I do not understand.
胡雪岩听得这话，木然半晌，方始皱眉说道∶『你的话我不懂；

Trying to think makes my head ache.
想起来头痛。

How could such a thing happen?”
怎么会有这种事？』

“No wonder you are puzzled.
『难怪胡先生。

It is a long story, and I do not fully understand it myself.
说来话长，我亦不太清楚；

She says she was visiting my master’s wife just as my letter arrived.
据她说，她看师娘，正好师娘接到我的来信，

When she heard how ill you were, she wanted to come and nurse you.
听说胡先生病很重，她要赶来服侍。

Naturally, my master’s wife approved and asked my master to make the arrangements.
师娘当然赞成；请师父安排，

He sent someone to escort her on a British steamer.”
派了一个人护送，坐英国轮船来的。』

“Strange!” Hu said. “She belongs to the He family, and I am a Hu.
『奇怪啊！』胡雪岩说∶『她姓人可何，我姓古月胡；

Why should a concubine of the He household come to nurse me?”
何家的姨太太怎么来服侍我这个病人。』

“Surely that is obvious.
『那还用说？

She must have left the He household.
当然是在何家下堂了。』萧家骥说，

Anyone can see that.
『这是看都看得出来的，

But she was embarrassed to explain, and I was embarrassed to ask.
不过她不好意思说，我也不好意思打听。

You can question her yourself presently.”
回头胡先生你自己问她就明白了。』

Hu now understood the broad outline.
这一下，大致算是了解了来龙去脉。

A’qiao could hardly have run away in secret, he thought, or Gu and his wife would not have sent someone to escort her to Ningbo.
他心里在想，阿巧姐总不会是私奔；否则古应春夫妇不致派人护送她到宁波。

Yet—
但是——。


“But can we trust what she says?
『但是，她的话靠得住靠不住？

How do you know your master’s wife approved of her coming?”
何以知道她是你师娘赞成她来的？』

“There is no doubt about it.
『不错！

Her escort was Old Huang, the senior outside clerk at my master’s firm.”
护送的人，就是我师父号子里的出店老司务老黄。』

Hu was reassured.
胡雪岩放心了。

He too knew the man, also called Old Huang of Ningbo.
老黄又叫『宁波老黄』，他也知道这个人。

He was about to ask more when he heard footsteps.
胡雪岩还想再细问一番，听得脚步声，

Falling silent, he looked towards the doorway.
便住口不语，望着房门口；

The curtain stirred, and A’qiao’s back appeared first.
门帘掀动，先望见的是阿巧姐的背影，

Carrying a tray, she had no free hand to lift the curtain and had slipped in sideways.
她端着托盘，腾不出手来打门帘，所以是侧着进来。


Xiao helped place a small table across the bed and took the tray from her.
于是萧家骥帮着将一张炕儿横搁在床中间，端来托盘，

It held a pot of fragrant rice gruel and four small dishes, light but delicately prepared.
里面是一罐香粳米粥，四碟清淡而精致的小菜，

One was an egg preserved in wine lees, a particular favourite of Hu’s.
特别是一样糟蛋，为胡雪岩所酷嗜，

At the sight, his mouth watered and his stomach began to rumble.
所以一见便觉得口中有了津液，腹中也辘辘作响了。

“Mr Hu,” Xiao said, making a point of explaining where the food came from, “even the rice for the gruel was brought from Shanghai by Madam He.”
『胡先生，』萧家骥特地说明这些食物的来源，『连煮粥的米都是何姨太从上海带来的。』

“Young Mr Xiao,” A’qiao interrupted, “please call me A’qiao.”
『萧少爷，』阿巧姐接口说道∶『请你叫我阿巧好了。』

This was a still clearer sign that she had left the He family.
这更是已从何家下堂的明显表示。

“Madam He” had already begun to sound jarring, so Xiao was happy to comply.
本来叫『何姨太』就觉得刺耳，因而萧家骥欣然乐从；

Out of respect for Hu, however, he felt he should not simply call her by her personal name, and glanced at him for guidance.
不过为了尊敬胡雪岩，似乎不便直呼其名，只拿眼色向他征询意见。

“Call her Sister A’qiao.”
『叫她阿巧姐吧。』

“Yes.”
『是。』

With a warmth tempered by respect, Xiao addressed her: “Sister A’qiao!”
萧家骥用亲切中显得庄重的声音叫一声∶『阿巧姐！』

“There!” she replied readily, quite like an elder sister.
『嗯！』她居之不疑地应声，真象是个大姐姐似的，

“Now we sound like a family.”
『这才象一家人。』


Neither he nor Hu felt able to respond to that.
这话在他、在胡雪岩都觉得不便作何表示。

A’qiao said no more.
阿巧姐也不再往下多说，

Lowering her eyes, she ladled out the gruel.
只垂着眼替胡雪岩盛好了粥，

It was steaming, so she pursed her moist lips and blew on it until it was cool enough, then set it down.
粥在冒热气，她便又嘬起滋润的嘴唇吃得不太烫了，方始放下；

Taking a white handkerchief from beneath her arm, she wiped a pair of ivory chopsticks and placed them before Hu with the bowl.
然后从腋下抽出白手绢，擦一擦那双牙筷，连粥碗一起送到胡雪岩面前，

“Would you like me to feed you?” she asked.
却又问道∶『要不要我来喂你？』

This reminded Xiao that, with such an attentive person to care for Hu, there was no need for him to stand there in the way.
这话提醒了萧家骥，有这样体贴的人在服伺，何必自己还站在这里碍眼，

He smiled and quietly left.
便微笑着悄悄走出去。

Both Hu and A’qiao watched his retreating figure until it disappeared.
四只眼睛都望着他的背影，直待消失，

Then they looked back at one another and remained silent for a long moment.
方始回眸，相视不语，征征地好一会，

Suddenly her eyes reddened.
阿巧姐忽然眼圈一红，

She quickly lowered her head, took up the handkerchief, and pretended to blow her nose while wiping away her tears.
急忙低下头去，顺手拿起手绢，装着擤鼻子去擦眼睛。

Hu too was filled with conflicting emotions, but was reluctant to question her.
胡雪岩也是万感交集，但不愿轻易有所询问；

Since she did not want him to see her tears, he pretended not to notice and picked up his chopsticks to eat.
她的泪眼既畏见人，他也就装作不知，扶起筷子吃粥。


Once he began, he could think of nothing else.
这一吃粥顾不得别的了。

He had not eaten a grain of rice for days and was ravenous, slurping the gruel with extraordinary energy.
好几天粒米不曾进口，真是饿极了，唏哩呼噜地吃得好不有劲；

When the first bowl was empty, A’qiao was already waiting with a filled ladle.
等他一碗吃完，阿巧已舀着一勺子在等了，

As she served him more, she laughed happily. “Worse than a hungry ghost let out on the fifteenth of the seventh month!”
一面替他添粥，一面高兴地笑道∶『赛过七月十五鬼门关里放出来的！』

For all her teasing, once he had finished the second bowl she would allow no more.
话虽如此，等他吃完第二碗，便不准他再吃；

His illness had only just begun to recede, and overeating might upset his stomach.
怕病势刚刚好转，饱食伤胃。

Hu was not satisfied, however, and after much persuasion she gave him another half-bowl.
而胡雪岩意有未厌，说好说歹才替他添了半碗。

“Ah!” he sighed, laying down his chopsticks. “At least I have had my fill.”
『唉！』放下筷子他感慨着说∶『我算是饱了！』

A’qiao knew what lay behind the words.
阿巧姐知道他因何感慨。

She too understood Hangzhou’s plight, but feared that mentioning it would distress him.
杭州的情形，她亦深知，只是怕提起来惹他伤心，

Without replying, she gathered up the dishes and went out.
所以不理他的话，管自己收拾碗筷走了出去。

“A’qiao, do not go.
『阿巧，你不要走，

Let us talk.”
我们谈谈。』

“I shall be right back.
『我马上就来。』

Your medicine is simmering.
她说，『你的药煎在那里，

It should be ready now.”
也该好了。』

Soon she brought in the decoction, helped him drink it, and urged him to sleep.
过不多久，将煎好了的药送来。服侍他吃完，劝他睡下；

Hu refused, saying that he felt quite alert and that the scar on his leg itched unbearably.
胡雪岩不肯，说精神很好，又说腿上的伤疤痒得难受。

“That is a good sign.
『这是好兆头。

New flesh is growing over the wound, and you are recovering.
伤处在长新肉，人也在复原了。』她说，

Let me wash your feet.
『我替你洗洗脚，

You will feel more comfortable.” Before she said this he had scarcely noticed, but now he felt itchy all over and longed for a good soak in a public bath.
人还会更舒服。』不说还好，一说胡雪岩觉得混身发痒，恨不得能在『大汤』中痛痛快快泡一泡才好——

Like the people of Yangzhou, he had long enjoyed “water inside the skin in the morning, skin inside the water in the afternoon”—tea first, a bath later.
他也象扬州人那样，早就有『上午皮包水，下午水包皮』的习惯。

Since Hangzhou’s situation had grown critical, he had not visited a bathhouse.
自从杭州吃紧以来，就没有泡过『澡塘』；

On reaching Shanghai, his injured leg had again prevented him from bathing.
这次到了上海，又因为腿上有伤，不能入浴。

A male servant at Gu’s house had washed him once, and he had changed from head to foot into new clothes that the Seventh Lady had a tailor make specially.
虽然借助于古家的男佣抹过一次身，从里到外换上七姑奶奶特喊裁缝为他现制的新衣服，

But on the hazardous voyage since then, cold sweat from worry and fear had broken out and dried, then broken out again, countless times.
但经过这一次海上出生入死的跋涉，担忧受惊的冷汗，出了干、干了出，不知几多次？

His whole body was coated in grime.
满身垢腻，

He was deeply uncomfortable and longed to bathe, yet could hardly ask A’qiao to undertake such a task.
很不舒服，实在想洗个澡，无奈万无劳动阿巧姐的道理。



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第三章（本章第2部分，共4部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


While he was thinking this, she had already gone to put her words into action.
他心里这样在想，她却说到就做，已转身走了出去，

Somehow she found a brand-new wooden footbath on high legs.
不知哪里找到了一只簇新的高脚木盆，

She brought a kettle of hot water, poured it into the basin, and lifted the quilt to take hold of his feet.
提来一铫子的热水，冲到盆里；然后掀被来捉他的那双脚。

“No, no!”
『不要，不要！』

Hu drew them back.
胡雪岩往里一缩，

“I have not washed them since I boarded the boat in Shanghai.
『我这双脚从上海上船就没有洗过，

They are filthy.”
太脏了。』

“What does that matter?” she said without hesitation.
『怕什么？』阿巧姐毫不迟疑地，

“I have come all this way to nurse a sick man.
『我路远迢迢赶了来，就是来服侍病人的；

Nothing would make me happier than to see you recover properly.”
只要你好好复原，我比什么都高兴。』

Her words filled Hu with both gratitude and reflection.
这两句话在胡雪岩听来，感激与感慨交并。

Through war and chaos, he had narrowly escaped death.
兵荒马乱，九死一生；

Thinking of his missing family, the people of Hangzhou on the verge of starvation, and Wang Youling trapped in a hopeless position, moving step by step towards hell, he had often asked himself what people lived for.
想到下落不明的亲人，快要饿死的杭州一城百姓，以及困在绝境，眼看着往地狱里一步一步在走的王有龄，常常会自问∶人生在世，到底为的什么；

Was it merely to endure suffering worse than death?
就为了受这种生不如死的苦楚？

Now he felt differently.
现在却不同了，

Life held joy as well as sorrow.
人活在世界上，有苦也有乐；

Which one a person experienced depended on his own actions.
是苦是乐，全看自己的作为。

It was just as the Treatise of the Exalted One on Response and Retribution said: misfortune and happiness have no fixed gate; people bring them upon themselves.
真是『太上感应篇』上所说的∶『祸福无门，惟人自召』。

With this change of thought, his heart seemed to come back to life, like a withered tree touched by spring.
这样转关念头，自己觉得一颗心如枯木逢春般，又管用了。

His mind grew active too.
脑筋亦已灵活；

Where he had been too weary to think about anything, thoughts now came readily and quickly.
本来凡事都懒得去想，此刻却想得很多，想复很快。

Once A’qiao had washed his feet, he smiled. “A’qiao, since you have started a good deed, see it through.
等阿巧姐替他将脚洗好，便又笑道∶『阿巧，送佛送到西天，

Give my body a wipe as well.”
索性替我再抹一抹身子。』

“That would not be wise.
『这不大妥当。

You are weak and must not catch cold…”
你身子虚，受不得凉┅┅』


“It does not matter!”
『不要紧！』

Hu thrust out his withered arm and punched the air twice, trying to look vigorous. “I feel well enough to get up.”
胡雪岩将枯瘦的手臂伸出来，临空捣了两下，显得很有劲似地说∶『我自己觉得已经可以起床了。』

“Nonsense!
『瞎说！

Lie down properly.”
你替我好好睡下去。』

She tucked his feet and hands beneath the quilt, pressed him back onto the bed, and pulled the covering snugly around him.
她将他的脚和手都塞入被中，硬扶他睡倒，而且还掖紧了棉被。

“Truly, A’qiao, I am well again.”
『真的。阿巧，我已经好了。』

“How can you be?
『哪有这种事？

After an illness like this, you do not recover just because you say so.
这样一场病，哪里会说好就好？

Even an elixir could not work that fast.”
吃仙丹也没有这样灵法。』

“Good fortune lifts the spirits.
『人逢喜事精神爽，

You are my elixir.
你就是仙丹。

Once it arrives, every illness vanishes.”
仙丹一到，百病全消。』

“Hmph!”
『哼！』

Her lips curled slightly.
阿巧微微撇着嘴，

“You are good at sweet talk.
『你就会灌米汤。

Go to sleep.”
睡吧！』

With a slender finger she brushed his eyelids shut.
她用纤行一指，将他的眼皮抹上。

As soon as she turned away, his eyes opened again.
等她转身，他的眼又睁开了。

He stared at the canopy and thought.
望着帐顶想心事；

There were many things he wanted to know, but for the moment, A’qiao was the one person he wished to talk to.
要想知道的事很多，而眼前却只有阿巧好谈。


She did not return for a long time.
阿巧却好久不来；

Unable to restrain himself, he called out.
他忍不住喊出声来，

It was Xiao who answered.
而答应的却是萧家骥，

“Mr Hu, you must not tire yourself.
『胡先生，』他说，『你不宜过于劳神。

It is two in the morning.
此刻半夜两点钟了，

Please rest.”
请安置吧！』

“Where is A’qiao?
『阿巧呢？』

Where is she sleeping?”
胡雪岩问道∶『她睡在哪里？』

Large wholesale firms commonly provided guest rooms and beds, but they did not ordinarily accommodate women.
做批发生意的大商号，备有客房客铺，无足为奇，但从不招待堂客；

Some merchants and their customers even objected to a woman’s presence, believing that a menstruating woman might offend the God of Wealth worshipped on the premises.
有些商家的客户，甚至忌讳堂客，因为据说月事中的妇女会冲犯所供的财神。

Yang’s Ningbo firm, also called Daji, specialized in wholesaling seafood and sundries.
杨坊的这家招牌也叫『大记』，专营海鲜杂货批发的商号，

It was comparatively broad-minded and did not forbid women to come and go, but it had few private guest rooms.
虽然比较开通，不忌妇女出入，但单间的客房不多；

Xiao had therefore arranged for A’qiao to stay at a clerk’s house, where she had shared a bed with the man’s newly married wife for one night.
所以阿巧姐是由萧家骥代为安排，借住在大记的一个伙计家中，与此人的新婚妻子同榻睡了一夜。

“That will not do tonight.
『今天不行了，

It is the clerk’s turn to sleep at home, and he gets only one night in ten.
是轮到那伙计回家睡的日子；十天才有这么一天，

Sister A’qiao said, ‘Such a fresh, sweet young bride!
阿巧姐说∶』人家喷喷香、簇簇新的新娘子；

How could I keep the two of them apart?’
怎好耽误他们夫妻的恩爱？

The clerk was very considerate and insisted it did not matter, but she would not agree.”
「那伙计倒很会做人，一再说不要紧；是阿巧姐自己不肯。

“Then where will she sleep tonight?”
『』那末今天睡在哪里呢？

“There.”
『『喏，』

Xiao pointed to a door panel and two benches standing to one side. “I have everything ready to make her a temporary bed.
萧家骥指着置在一旁的一扇门板，两张条凳说∶『我已经预备好了，替她搭「起倒铺」。

Still—” He smiled and said no more.
不过——。』他笑笑没有再说下去。

Something knowing in his expression invited suspicion, and Hu naturally pressed him. “Still what?”
神情诡秘，令人起疑，胡雪岩当然要追问∶『不过什么？』

“This bed looks quite large.
『我看这张床蛮大，

Why not let her sleep at the foot of it?
不如让阿巧姐就睡在胡先生脚后头。』

She wants to stay in this room so that she can look after you.
萧家骥又说，『她要这里搭铺就为了服侍方便；

Would sharing the bed not be more convenient still?”
睡在一床上，不更加方便了吗？』

Hu could not tell whether he was serious or joking, nor did he know what A’qiao herself intended.
不知他是正经话，还是戏谑？也不知阿巧姐本人的意思究竟如何？

He could only smile without answering.
胡雪岩只有微笑不答。


In the end, Xiao did set up a temporary bed for her.
到最后，萧家骥还是替阿巧姐搭了『起倒铺』；

Naturally, she arranged her own mattress, quilt, and pillow.
被褥衾枕自然是她自己铺设。

Once she had given the patient his medicine and closed the door, Hu spoke.
等侍候病人服了药，关好房门，胡雪岩开口了。

“Your mattress is too thin, and you have no bed curtains.
『你的褥子太薄，又没有帐子，

You would do better to sleep on the inner side here.”
不知睡到我里床来！』

He patted the place beside him.
他拍拍身边。

A’qiao, who was removing her hair ornaments and make-up, said nothing.
正在卸妆的阿巧姐没有说话，

She brought her quilt over, but took the outer side so that she could get up easily.
抱衾相就；不过为了行动方便，睡的是外床——

Ningbo people took pride in their beds.
宁波人讲究床铺；

This one, carved from boxwood, was enormous, with more than enough room for two.
那张黄杨木雕花的床极大，两个人睡还绰绰有余。

An oil lamp stood on a shelf at the inner side, its flame turned low. Its faint light fell on her close-fitting, light lined jacket of pale green satin.
里床搁板上置一盏洋灯，——捻得小小的一点光照着她那个葱绿缎子的紧身小夹袄；

Looking at her, Hu once again felt that their reunion was a dream.
看在胡雪岩眼里，又起了相逢在梦中的感觉。

“A’qiao, surely it is time you told me what has happened to you?”
『阿巧！你该讲讲你的事了吧？』

“It is a long story,” she replied gently. “You have tired yourself tonight and have just taken your medicine. Sleep well.
『说来话长。』阿巧很温柔地说∶『你这半夜也累了；刚吃过药好好睡一觉。

We can talk tomorrow.”
明天再谈。』

“I feel very alert now.”
『我现在精神很好。』

“It is good that you do.
『精神好自然好。

But listen—the cocks are already crowing.
你听，』阿巧姐说，『鸡都在叫了。

These last hours of sleep before dawn matter most.
后半夜这一觉最要紧，

Go to sleep.
睡吧！

I am here now.
好在我人都来了，

What is there to hurry about?”
你还有什么好急的？』

There was a depth of meaning in this that gave Hu plenty to think about.
这句话的意思很深，足够胡雪岩想好半天。

But his illness had only just begun to recede, and his strength was limited.
到底病势初转，精神不够，

Soon he grew drowsy and slept until daylight.
很快地便觉得困倦，一觉睡到天亮。


When he woke, she woke too and hurried to get up and attend to him.
他醒她也醒了，急急要起床料理，

Hu wanted her to rest a little longer.
胡雪岩却愿她多睡一会；

Holding her back, he said, “It is too cold.
拖住她说∶『天太冷，

Do not get up yet.
不要起来。

Let us have a proper talk.”
我们好好谈谈。』

“About what?
『谈什么？』

I only want you to get well soon.
阿巧姐说，『但愿你早早复原；

Everything else can wait until we are back in Shanghai.”
回到上海再说。』

“I thought it over last night.
『我昨天晚上想过了，

If I come safely through this, I shall never be an official again.
只要这一次能平平安过去，我再也不做官了；

I shall mind my own business and be content if I can meet a few good friends regularly for a chat.”
安安分分做生意，能够跟几个好朋友常在一起叙叙，我就心满意足了。』

“You think only of your friends,” she said with a trace of reproach.
『你只晓得朋友！』阿巧姐是微带怨态的神情，

“You never make plans for yourself.”
『就不替自己打算打算。』

Plans for himself would naturally have to include her.
替他自己打算，当然也就要包括她在内。

The implication was delicate.
言外之意，相当微妙；

Hu showed no reaction, but calmly asked, “How did you leave the He household?
胡雪岩很沉着地不作表示，只是问说∶『你是怎么从何家出来的？

Can you tell me now?”
现在可以告诉我了吧！』

“Of course I must tell you.
『当然要告诉你的。

But you are always thinking of your friends.
不过你处处为朋友，

I am afraid it will distress you.”
听了只怕心里会难过。』

She was counting He Guiqing among Hu’s friends—and his situation was now pitiable indeed.
她的意思是将何桂清当作胡雪岩的朋友——这个朋友现在惨不可言。

One mistaken decision at Changzhou had brought dismissal and an order for his arrest and investigation.
只为在常州一念之差，落得个『革职拿问』的处分；

For two years the matter had dragged on, largely because Xue Huan had contrived excuses and delays on his behalf.
迁延两年，多靠薛焕替他支吾敷衍，

Yet he had suffered more than enough of a fugitive’s existence.
然而『逃犯』的况味也受够了。


“It was no life for a human being,” A’qiao sighed. “With his status so compromised, he could go nowhere.
『这种日子不是人过的。』阿巧姐喟叹着说∶『人嘛是个黑人，哪里都不能去；

Whenever a visitor was announced, we first had to find out exactly why he had come.
听说有客人来拜，先要打听清楚，来做什么？

Most frightening of all was a call from the Shanghai magistrate: we feared he might have come to make an arrest.
最怕上海县的县大老爷来拜；防是来捉人的。

I have learned the truth of that saying, ‘Do no wrong by day, and a midnight knock will not frighten you.’
「白天不做亏心事，半夜敲门心不惊」这句俗语，我算是领教过了，

It could not be truer.
真正一点不错。

If I felt like that, imagine how he felt himself.”
我都这样子，你想想本人心里的味道？』

“In his place, I should have steeled myself and surrendered.”
『叫我，就狠一狠心，自己去投案。』

“He often said the same.
『他也常这样说；

But saying it was all he could do; he could never bring himself to act.
不过说说而已，就是狠不下心来。

Now…”
现在——。』

Now even those days of constant apprehension were nearly over.
现在，连这种提心吊胆的日子也快不多了。

Since the late emperor’s death, the accession of a child sovereign, and the two empress dowagers’ assumption of government behind the curtain with Prince Gong in high favour, a new spirit prevailed at court.
从先帝驾崩，幼主嗣位，两宫太后垂帘听政，垂用恭王，朝中又是一番气象；

To restore morale, civil and military officials who had lost armies and dishonoured the state were to be dealt with severely.
为了激励士气，凡是丧师辱国的文武官员，都要严办。

Worst of all, Zeng Guofan had been appointed governor-general of Liangjiang and placed in command of military affairs in Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, and Zhejiang.
最不利的是，曾国藩调任两江都督，朝命统辖江苏、安徽、江西、浙江四省军务；

All officials in those four provinces, up to governors in the civil administration and commanders-in-chief in the military, were subject to his authority.
四省官员，文到巡抚，武到提督，悉归节制。

He Guiqing had sent intermediaries to ask for an opportunity to redeem himself through service.
何桂清曾经托人关说，希望能给他一个效力赎罪的机会，

The reply had been brief: willing to help, but unable to do so.
而得到的答复只有四个字∶『爱莫能助。』

“Half a month ago someone brought word that Mr Zeng had recommended an intendant named Li to lead troops to defend Shanghai.
『半个月以前，有人来说，曾大人保了个姓李的道台，领兵来守上海。

They say that as soon as he arrives he will take over from Governor Xue.
这位李道台，据说一到上海就要接薛抚台的手；

He is Mr Zeng’s pupil and will naturally obey his teacher.
他是曾大人的门生，自然听老师的话。

Governor Xue will no longer be able to help, however much he wishes.
薛抚台再想帮忙也帮不上了。

Because of that—” Because of that, He had to make his final arrangements. He settled his household affairs and dismissed his concubines.
为此之故——。』为此，何桂清不能不作一个最后的打算∶家事已作了处分，姬妆亦都遣散，

That was how A’qiao had left his household.
阿巧姐就是这样下堂的。


Remembering how well he had treated her, she had felt uneasy about leaving him at such a moment.
想想他待她不错，在这个时候，分袂而去，未免问心不安。

But he would not change his mind, and she had no choice but to obey.
无奈何桂清执意不回；她也就只好听从了。

“He must have tried to provide for the rest of your life before you left,” Hu said. “Though how much could he have had left?
『那天，他也总要为你的后半辈子打算打算。』胡雪岩说∶『不过，他剩下几个钱，

Two years of living on his capital must have brought him close to the end.”
这两年坐吃山空，恐怕所余已经无几。』

“Ordinary expenses did not amount to much.
『过日子倒用不了多少，

Most of it was swindled out of him.
都给人骗走了，

One man said he could work through influential contacts in the capital; another said a gift must be sent to someone or other.
这个说，可以替他到京走门路；那个说某某人那里送笔礼。

Who knows how much money went down those holes?
这种塞狗洞的钱，也不知道花了多少。』

Before I left, he said he would scrape together two thousand taels for me.
阿巧姐说，『临走以前，他跟我说，要凑两千银子给我。

I would not take it.”
我一定不要。』

“That was loyal of you.
『你倒也够义气。

But in times like these, to be frank, you are better off relying on yourself than on others.”
不过，这种乱世，说老实话∶求人不如求己。』

“I have not left myself entirely without provision.
『我也不是毫无打算的，

I entrusted a little chest to the Seventh Lady.
我有一只小箱子托七姑奶奶替我收着；

The things in it must be worth thirty to fifty thousand taels.
那里面一点东西，总值三、五万。

When we return to Shanghai, I shall give it to you.”
到了上海我交给你。』

“What for?
『交给我做什么？』

I have no heart for managing investments for you just now.”
胡雪岩问道∶『我现在还没心思来替你经营。』

A’qiao said nothing.
阿巧姐先不作声，

She blinked and bit a fingernail, as though considering something of great importance.
一面眨眼，一面咬指甲，仿佛有极要紧的事在思索似的。

Ever since Hu had bade his distant farewell to Wang across the Qiantang River, he had felt that every desire was extinguished.
胡雪岩是从钱塘江遥别王有龄的那一刻，便有万念俱灰之感，

He had neither wished nor been able to think about anything, and had sunk into illness.
什么事都不愿、也不能想，因此恹恹成病，

Though he was now out of danger and recovering quickly, the old listlessness remained.
如今病势虽已脱险，而且好得很快，但懒散如旧，

He did not care to guess her thoughts.
所以不愿去猜她的心事，

Turning his face towards her, he merely admired her at leisure, as he might contemplate a piece of ancient jade he loved.
只侧着脸象面对着他所喜爱的古玉似的，恣意鉴赏。


It had been six years since he had looked at her in this way.
算一算有六年没有这样看过她了。

Six years of war and separation was a long time.
离乱六年，是一段漫长的岁月，

How many people had vanished, their survival uncertain, their whereabouts unknown?
多少人生死茫茫，音信杳然，

How many had risen or fallen, their fortunes utterly changed?
多少人升沉浮降，荣枯异昔，

Yet A’qiao as she had been six years ago seemed only a night and a dream away.
而想到六年前的阿巧姐，只如隔了一夜做了个梦；

Her appearance then came vividly before his mind.
当时形容清晰地浮现在脑际，

Comparing the two, he saw what had changed and what had not.
两相比较，有变了的，也有不变的。

The most obvious change was in her figure: she was fuller now.
变得最明显的是全体态，此刻丰腴了些；

Before, she had been rather too slender, so the change had made her more beautiful.
当时本嫌纤瘦，所以这一变是变得更美了；

She was also more composed and worldly-wise.
也更深沉老练了。

What had not changed was the feeling in her eyes, as deep and pure as ever.
不变的是她这双眼中的情竟，依然那么深，那么纯；

It seemed that, in her mind, there was no one but Hu Xueyan—not even herself.
似乎她心目中除了一个胡雪岩以外，连她自己都不关心。

At that thought, a spark appeared among the cold ashes of his heart.
转念到此，他那颗心就象冷灰发现一粒火星；

It was the beginning of a rekindled fire, and he himself felt how precious it was.
这是火种复炽的开始，他自己都觉得珍贵得很。


Without quite realizing it, he reached for her hand.
于是他不自觉地伸手去握住她的手；

“I came close to death on this journey,” he said with feeling.
感慨地说∶『这趟我真是九死一生——

“I do not mean that I was timid or feared the dangers on the road.
不是怕路上有什么危险，胆子小；

I mean what happened to my heart.
是我的心境。

From Hangzhou to Ningbo, it grew utterly cold.
从杭州到宁波，一路上我的心冷透了；

I lay in bed all day asking why one person should care for another.
整天躺在床上在想，一个人为啥要跟另外一个人有感情？

Without affection, he could be himself and I could be myself, and I need never fret over him.
如果没有感情，他是他，我是我，用不着替他牵肠挂肚，

So I told myself that, once my mind was at peace again, I would be more distant towards everyone.”
所以我自己对自己说，将来等我心境平静了，对什么人都要冷淡些。』

He had said this in a single rush and had to pause for breath.
一口气说到这里，有些气喘，停了下来；

A’qiao did not realize that he had more to say.
阿巧姐不曾听出他的语气未完，

Taking it as an indirect message to her, she changed colour.
只当他借题发挥，顿时脸色大变。

“Are you saying this especially for me?”
『你这些话，』她问，『是不是特为说给我听的？』

“Yes—” Only then did Hu notice her expression.
『是的——。』说了这两个字，胡雪岩才发觉她的神情有异；

He understood her mistake at once and hastened to add, “I have never said this to anyone else.
立刻明白她是误会了，赶紧又接了一句∶『这话我什么人面前都没说过；

There is a reason why I am telling you alone.
只跟你一人说，是有道理的。

I wonder whether you can guess it.”
不晓得你猜得着，猜不着？』

The meaning remained obscure, but she could see how anxious he was to correct the misunderstanding.
意思仍然令人莫名其妙，但他急于解释误会的态度，她是看出来的，

Half reassured, she waited for what he would say next.
心先放了一半，另一半要听他下一句话如何？

“Do not make me guess.
『你不要让我猜了！

You know I can match wits with other people, but I am far behind you.”
你晓得的，赌心思，跟别人我还可以较量较量；在你面前差了一大截。』

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑了，

It was not a handsome smile.
笑容并不好年；

His wasted face made his mouth seem large, and the two pointed canine teeth looked almost like fangs.
人瘦显得口大，两颗虎牙看上去象獠牙。

But it was a happy smile, and she was glad to see it.
但毕竟是高兴的笑容，阿巧姐还是乐意看到的。


“You still know just what to say.”
『你还是那样会说话。』

He grew serious. “I spoke of my state of mind because there was one thing I wanted to tell you: I have changed my mind now.”
他正一正脸色说∶『我特为谈我的心境，是想告诉你的一句话；此刻我的想法变过了。』

“How?”
『怎么变法？』

“People must have feelings after all.
『人还是要有感情的。

Even if they suffer for them, even if they die for them—” Before he finished, a warm, soft hand covered his mouth. “With so many things you could say, why talk so recklessly?”
就为它受罪，为它死——。』一句话未完，一只又软又暖的手掩在他口上∶『什么话不好说；说这些没轻重的话！』

“Very well, I shall not say it.
『好，不说，不说。

So long as you understand.” He asked, “You seemed to be thinking hard about something just now.
你懂我的意思就可以了。』胡雪岩问道∶『你刚才好象在想心事？

Why not tell me?”
何妨跟我谈谈。』

“There is much to say.
『要谈的话很多。

But as things are, you have no heart to listen, and I have no heart to speak.
现在这样子，你没心思听，我也没心思说，

Nothing need be hurried.
一切都不必急，

We can talk once you are well.”
等你病养好了再说。』

“I shall not be fully well for some time.
『我的病一时养不好的。

Fortunately—” He had meant to say that at least he would not die, but remembering her objection to the word, he stopped himself.
好在是——。』他想说『好在是死不了的』；只为她忌讳说『死』，所以猛然咽住；

After a pause he continued, “In a day or two, I mean to return to Shanghai.”
停了一下又说∶『一两天我就想回上海。』

“How can you?”
『那怎么行？』

“Why not?
『没有什么不行。

Here in Ningbo, news is slow and there is nothing to do.
在宁波，消息不灵，又没有事好做；

A healthy man would fall ill from sheer boredom.
好人都要闷出病来，

How can a sick one recover?”
怎么会养得好病？』


“It cannot be helped.
『那是没有办法的事。

You have only just begun to improve.
你刚刚才有点好，

If you travel in the bitterest winter cold, exposed to the sea wind, and your illness returns, there will be no one to help in the middle of the ocean, however loudly we call.
数九寒天冒海风上路，万一病势反复；在汪洋大海里，叫天天不应，叫地地不灵，

It would mean two lives lost.”
那就是两条人命。』

“Why two?”
『怎么呢？』

“Have you not thought?
『你不想想，

If anything happened to you, what could I do but throw myself into the sea?”
万一你有个三长两短，我除了跳海，还有什么路好走？』

Faced with such devotion, extending to life and death, Hu could no longer bear to oppose her.
是这样生死相共的情分，胡雪岩再也不忍拂她的意了。

Privately, however, he thought that with care over his diet and A’qiao’s attentive nursing, there would be no great risk.
但是，他自己想想，只要饮食当心，加上阿巧姐细心照料，实在无大关碍。

Yet without the doctor’s agreement, he could not silence her objections, and Xiao would probably object as well.
不过，若非医生同意，不但不能塞阿巧姐的嘴，只怕萧家骥也未见得答应。

He decided to ask Xiao to sound out the doctor privately.
因此，他决定嘱咐萧家骥私下向医生探问。

But he could never find an opportunity.
但始终找不到机会；

From the moment she got up, A’qiao scarcely left his side.
因为阿巧姐自起床以后，几乎就不曾离开过他——

Snow had begun to fall again, and Xiao suggested that she set up all her operations in the room.
天又下雪了，萧家骥劝她就在屋子里『做市』；

With a brazier burning brightly, she prepared medicine, cooked gruel, and made dishes there.
就着一只熊熊然的炭盆，煎药煮粥做菜，都在那间屋里。

Hu found the bustle lively and amusing.
胡雪岩倒觉得热闹有趣，

Using a Hangzhou saying, he teased her about conducting a grand religious ceremony inside a snail shell.
用杭州的谚语笑她是『螺蛳壳里做道场』；

But it meant that, although Xiao was right before him, there was no chance for a private word.
但也因此，虽萧家骥就在眼前，却无从说两句私话。


The time was not wholly wasted.
不过，也不算白耗功夫。

Helping A’qiao prepare the food, Xiao told Hu everything that had happened over the past few days.
萧家骥一面帮阿巧姐做『下手』，帮她料理饭食，一面将这几天的情形都告诉了胡雪岩。

Apparently the negotiations between Huang Chengzhong and Fan Ruzeng and the British consul, Xiafuli, had gone well.
据说黄呈忠、范汝增跟英国领事夏福礼的谈判很顺利，

The commanders had promised to do all they could to protect foreign residents.
答应尽力保护外侨；

Two rebel soldiers who had attacked a British missionary had been arrested and executed.
有两名长毛侵袭英国教士，已经抓来『正法』。

Proclamations had also been issued to reassure the population, allowing trade outside the four gates.
而且还布告安民，准老百姓在四门以外做生意；

Business in Ningbo had largely returned to normal.
宁波的市面，大致已经恢复了。

“Our rice made the difference.
『得力的是我们的那批米。

Food is the people’s first necessity.
民以食为天，

Once there is no panic over grain, it is easier for them to settle down,” Xiao said consolingly. “At least that should ease some of your regret, Mr Hu.”
粮食不起恐慌，人心就容易安定。』萧家骥劝慰似地说∶『胡先生，你也可以稍稍弥补遗憾了。』

“It is a good deed that earns unseen merit,” A’qiao added. “For that deed alone, the Bodhisattva will surely protect your mother, turn danger into safety, and bring her through her troubles.”
『这是阴功积德的好事。』阿巧姐接口说道∶『就看这件好事，老太太就一定会有菩萨保佑，逢凶化吉，遇难成祥。』

Hu remained silent.
胡雪岩不作声。

Joy and sorrow mingled in him, and he could find no words adequate to express what he felt.
一则以喜，一则以悲；没有什么适当的话好表达他的复杂的心情。


“There is something important I must ask you,” Xiao continued.
『有句要紧话要告诉胡先生，

“The people at Daji wanted to know how the rice was to be accounted for.
那笔米价，大记的人问我怎么算法？

Should they sell it and divide the proceeds with us, or take it over at an agreed price?
是卖了拆帐、还是作价给他们？

I told them to receive the rice first.
我说米先领了去，

The terms could only be settled after I had asked you.
怎样算法，要问了你才能定规；

If they would not agree to that, I had no authority to do otherwise, and the rice would have to return on the same boats.
如果他们不肯答应，我作不了主，米只好原船运回。

Daji accepted.
大记答应照我的办法；

Now I must ask you.
现在要问胡先生了。

In my view, sharing the proceeds would be the more advantageous arrangement.”
照我看，拆算比较合算！』

“No,” Hu answered firmly. “I do not want money.”
『不！』胡雪岩断然答道∶『我不要钱。』

What did he want, then?
那末要什么呢？

Rice—and vessels to carry it.
胡雪岩要的是米；要的是运粮的船，

Once Hangzhou was recaptured, he wanted them available within three days.
只等杭州一旦克复，三天以内就要。

His purpose was easily understood.
他的用意是很容易明白；

When the city was recovered from the rebels, the roads would surely be strewn with those who had starved, and the city full of distressed survivors.
等杭州从长毛手里夺了回来，必定饿殍载途，灾民满城，

What they would need was rice.
那时所需要的就是米。

“Why arrange it like that?” Xiao urged.
『何必这么做？』萧家骥劝他∶『胡先生，

“Speaking strictly as a businessman—and everyone admires your calculations—would this not leave your capital tied up and idle?
在商言商，你的算盘是大家佩服的，这样做法，不等于将本钱「搁煞」在那里。

Besides, the recapture of Hangzhou may be a long way off.”
而况杭州克复，遥遥无期。』

“Not necessarily.
『不见得。

Fortunes will turn,” Hu said with some agitation.
气运要转的。』胡雪岩显得有些激动，

“The rebels’ conduct is erratic and unreliable.
『长毛搞的这一套，翻覆无常，

I do not think they can last.
我看他们不会久了。

In three or five years they will be finished.”
三、五年的功夫，就要完蛋。』

“Three or five years is a long time.
『三、五年是多少辰光，

With interest compounding, one dan of rice can become two or three.
利上盘利，一担米变成两三担米；

Even for the sake of Hangzhou’s people, you ought to consider the calculation.”
你就为杭州百姓，也该盘算盘算。』

“That is true.”
『话不错！』

Hu grew calmer again.
胡雪岩又比较平静了，

“But I have my own reasons.
『我有我的想法，

First, I have not entirely given up hope.
第一、我始终没有绝望，

Reinforcements may arrive, and Hangzhou may not fall.
也许援兵会到，杭州城可以不破，

If the supply route can be opened, I shall want to send rice at once.
如果粮道可以打通，我立刻就要运米去接济，

If it were not readily available, we might lose the opportunity.
那时候万一不凑手，岂不误了大事；

Second, if the city does fall, keeping rice ready means it can be dispatched whenever the place is recovered.
第二、倘或杭州真的失守，留着米在那里，等克复以后，随时可以启运——

It is a hope with which I comfort myself.
这是一种自己安慰自己的希望；

To put it plainly, I am deceiving myself, but at least I shall have done what I can for Hangzhou.”
说穿了，是自己骗自己，总算我对杭州也尽到心了。』

“That makes sense too.
『这也有道理，

I shall negotiate with Daji on those terms.”
我就跟大记去交涉。』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第三章（本章第3部分，共4部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“There is no hurry about that,” Hu said. “When does the doctor come?”
『这不忙。』胡雪岩问道∶『医生啥时光来？』

“Every day after lunch.”
『每天都是中饭以后。』

“Then let us eat early, so she has time to clear everything away.”
『那就早点吃饭；吃完了她好收拾。』

He turned to A’qiao.
胡雪岩又问阿巧姐，

“When the doctor comes, will you need to withdraw?”
『等会医生来了，你要不要回避？』

Women of the household did not receive male visitors, but doctors were an exception; she need not necessarily hide herself.
虽然女眷不见男客，但对医生却是例外，不一定要回避；

His question, however, implied that he wanted her to withdraw.
只是他问这句话，就有让她回避的意思，

Understanding perfectly, she gave the answer he desired. “I shall listen from behind the screen.”
阿巧姐当然明白，顺着他的心意答道∶『我在屏风后面听好了。』

Hu had deliberately asked because he knew she would offer to leave.
胡雪岩是知道她会回避，有意这样问她；

But listening behind a screen hardly amounted to leaving at all: he had lured the tiger aside without getting it off the mountain.
不过她藏在屏风后面听，调虎不能离山，在自己等于不回避，

He needed another plan.
还要另动脑筋。

That was simple enough.
这也简单得很，

First he asked Xiao to write a letter for him, keeping his hands occupied.
他先请萧家骥替他写信，占住了他的手；

Then he said he fancied some sweet soup and sent A’qiao to the kitchen for foreign sugar.
然后说想吃点甜汤，要阿巧姐到厨房里去要洋糖，

Once she was out of the way, he could speak privately.
这样将她调遣了开去，就可以跟萧家骥说私了。

“You need not write the letter, Jiaji.
『家骥，你信不必写了，

There is something I want to tell you.
我跟你说句话，

Come here.”
你过来。』

Xiao came to the bedside.
萧家骥走到床前，

“I have decided to return to Shanghai at once,” Hu said.
他说∶『我决定马上回上海，

“Speak to the doctor.
你跟医生说一说；

Whatever happens, I must go.”
我无论如何要走。』

“Why?” Xiao asked in surprise.
『为什么？』萧家骥诧异，

“What is the hurry?”
『何必这么急？』


“No particular reason.
『不为什么？

I simply must go.
我就是要走。

Only in Shanghai can I find out what is happening.” Hu continued, “My heart had gone completely cold.
到了上海，我才好打听消息。』胡雪岩又说，『本来我的心冷透了。

But after talking with A’qiao this morning, I feel very differently.
今天一早跟阿巧谈了半天，说实话，我的心境大不相同。

I have two things to do now.
我现在有两件事，

The first is to save Hangzhou.
第一件是救杭州，

However hopeless its condition, I shall treat even a dead horse as though it could still be saved.
不管它病入膏盲，我死马要当活马医。

The second is to attend to my business.
第二件，我要做我的生意；

In business one cannot afford to fall a single step behind.
做生意一步落不得后，

The sooner I reach a place where news travels freely, the better.
越早到消息灵通的地方越好。

Do you understand?”
你懂了吧？』

“I understand the second point, but not the first.
『第二点我懂，头一点我不懂。』

How are you going to save Hangzhou?”
萧家骥问道∶『你怎么救杭州？』

“There is no time to explain.”
『现在没法子细谈。』

Hu glanced anxiously towards the window.
胡雪岩有些张皇地望着窗外。

A slender figure had just passed outside; A’qiao was about to come in.
这是因为苗条一影，已从窗外闪过，阿巧姐快进来了。

Seizing the few moments left, he instructed Xiao to negotiate privately with the doctor and let her know nothing of it.
胡雪岩就把握这短短的片刻，告诫萧家骥跟医生私底下『情商』，不可让阿巧姐知道。

Xiao could not readily understand his purpose, but there was no time to ask.
是何用意，不易明了；但时机迫促，无从追问，

He could only do as he was told.
萧家骥只有依言行事。

By the time Hu had finished a bowl of longan-and-egg soup sweetened with foreign sugar and A’qiao had put everything in order, the doctor arrived.
等胡雪岩喝完一碗桂圆洋糖蛋汤，阿巧姐收拾好了一切，医生也就到了。


The physician enjoyed a considerable reputation, distinguished as much for his professional integrity as for his skill.
那医生颇负盛名，医道医德都高人一等。

Though Hu was still thin and weak, his eyes shone brightly.
见胡雪岩人虽瘦弱，双目炯炯有光，

The doctor was astonished: in a single night, more than half the illness seemed to have gone.
大为惊异，一夜之隔，病似乎去了一大半，

He acknowledged that he had seldom seen such a thing in forty years of practice.
他自承是行医四十年来罕见之事。

“That is naturally due to your skill, sir.”
『这自然是先生高明。』

Somewhat apologetically, Hu asked, “May I know your surname?”
胡雪岩歉意地问∶『先生贵姓？』

“Dr Zhang,” Xiao answered for him, adding a flattering introduction.
『张先生。』萧家骥一旁代答，顺便送上一顶高帽子，

“The foremost physician in Ningbo.
『宁波城里第一块牌子；

His is a family of scholarly doctors, seven generations in the profession.
七世祖传的儒医。

Dr Zhang himself holds a scholarly degree.”
张先生本人也是有功名的人。』

Presumably that meant he had qualified as a licentiate.
所谓『功名』，想起来是讲过学的秀才，

“I have been wanting in respect,” Hu said. “I have no degree at all.”
『失敬了！』胡雪岩说∶『我是白丁。』

“You are too modest, Your Excellency.
『胡大人太客气了。

Wherever one goes in this great world, a man entitled to the hat button of the third rank is above ten thousand others.”
四海之大，三品顶戴无论如何是万人之上。』

“A pity there is still more than one man above me!” Hu laughed loudly at his own expense.
『可惜不是一人之下。』胡雪岩自嘲着纵声大笑。


He laughed too suddenly, caught his breath the wrong way and began coughing violently.
笑得太急，呛了嗓子，咳得十分厉害；

Xiao hurried to pat his back, but the cough only grew worse.
萧家骥赶紧上去替他捶背，却是越咳越凶，

Dr Zhang too was helpless and could only wait for it to stop.
张医生亦是束手无策，坐等他咳停。

A’qiao became desperately anxious.
这一下急坏了阿巧姐；

She knew Hu’s complaint: his throat needed stroking, and honey water would quiet the cough.
她知道胡雪岩的毛病，要抹咽喉，喝蜜水才能将咳嗽止住；

Xiao was using the wrong method, so naturally it did no good.
萧家骥不得其法，自然无效。

Honey water could not be procured at once, but the other remedy was within reach.
蜜水一时无法张罗，另一点却是办得到，

“Mr Xiao,” she could not help calling from behind the screen, “tilt his head back and stroke his throat.”
『萧少爷，』她忍不住在屏风后面喊∶『拿他的头仰起来，抹抹喉咙。』

The voice was soft and sweet, with the gentle inflections of the Wu dialect.
是娇滴滴的吴侬软语，

Curious, Dr Zhang turned to look and asked directly, “Is there a lady here?”
张医生不免好奇，转脸张望；而且率直问道∶『有女眷在？』

A physician might ask anything without offence.
医生是什么话都可以问，不算失礼；

Xiao, however, found the question awkward.
但萧家骥却很难回答，

As he stroked Hu’s throat, he replied indistinctly, “Mm, yes.”
一面替胡雪岩抹着喉头，一面含含糊糊地答道∶『嗯，嗯，是！』

The doctor seemed about to say more, then stopped.
张医生欲语又止；

Once the coughing ceased, he took Hu’s pulse, inspected his tongue and asked carefully about his food, sleep and daily habits.
等胡雪岩咳停了才切脉看舌苔，仔细问了饮食起居的情形，

He then announced with satisfaction, “The illness is no longer dangerous.
欣慰地表示∶『病势已经不碍，

He needs only nursing and rest.
只须调养，

He should recover in about a fortnight.”
大概半个月以后可以复原。』


“Thank you, thank you!”
『多谢，多谢！』

Hu clasped his hands. “Jiaji, take Dr Zhang to your room to write the prescription.”
胡雪岩拱拱手说∶『家骥你陪张先生到你那里开方子去吧！』

Xiao understood.
萧家骥会意，

When the prescription was finished, he raised the question of Hu’s wish to return to Shanghai.
等开好方子，便谈到胡雪岩想回上海的话。

The doctor was deeply perplexed.
张医生深为困惑，

“It would be inadvisable even to move him to another bed.
『病人连移动床铺都是不相宜的。』

His grave illness has only just begun to improve.
他问，『大病刚有转机，

How can he act so rashly?”
何可这样子轻率冒失？』

“There really is important business in Shanghai that cannot be managed without him,” Xiao said. “The journey takes only a day or two.
『实在是在上海有非他到场不可的大事要办。』家骥说∶『路上也只有一两天的功夫，

If you would prescribe several doses to support his recovery, and we were especially careful in looking after him, surely he would come to no harm?”
请张先生多开几服调理药带去；格外当心照料，想来不碍。』

“Look after him?
『照料！

Who would do that?
那个照料？

If the illness returned, I should not be aboard.
万一病势翻覆，我又不在船上；

What would you do then?”
你们怎么办。』

“Quite so,” Xiao said.
『是！』萧家骥说，

“We shall have to abandon the idea.”
『那就只好算了。』

But Hu had sharp ears.
而间壁的胡雪岩耳朵尖，

Listening from the next room, he had already found an answer: invite Dr Zhang to make a professional visit to Shanghai and care for him during the voyage.
听了张医生的话，已经有了主意，请他到上海出诊，随船照料。


Once the doctor had taken his leave and entered his sedan chair, A’qiao no longer needed to remain hidden.
等张医生开好方子，告辞上轿，阿巧姐自然也不必回避了，

With Xiao present, Hu revealed his idea.
胡雪岩便当着萧家骥透露了他的意思。

It was not inherently impracticable.
这个想法亦未始不可行；

Wealthy households often paid handsomely to engage a doctor in this manner and sent special carriages or boats to fetch him.
富室巨户，多有这样重金礼聘，专用车船奉迎的，

But at this particular time and place, both A’qiao and Xiao thought it would be difficult.
但是眼前时地不同，阿巧姐和家骥都觉得不易办到。

“It would be ideal if he agreed,” Xiao said. “I only fear he will not. First, Ningbo is still unsettled.
『他肯去当然最好；就怕他不肯。』萧家骥说∶『第一、宁波的市面还不甚平靖，

He may be uneasy about leaving his home.
离家远行，恐怕不放心；

Second, the New Year is approaching.
第二、快过年了，

Ningbo people attach great importance to the family reunion.
宁波人的风俗，最重过年团圆，

Even those doing business elsewhere hurry home.
在外头做生意的，都要赶回家来，

Who sets off on a long journey then?”
哪里反倒有出远门的？』

“There is still time before New Year.
『过年还早，

I shall certainly send him back beforehand,” Hu replied. “It is for me to ask and for him to agree or refuse.
我一定赶年前送他回来。』胡雪岩又说∶『说不说在我，肯不肯在他；

Why not go and speak to him?”
你何妨去谈一谈。』

“Of course I can.
『那当然可以。

I must go to his Qingyi Hall to have the prescription made up anyway, so I can see him there.”
我本来要到他清仪堂去撮药；顺便就看他。』

“He owns a pharmacy too?” Hu said.
『原来他也开着药店？』胡雪岩说，

“Excellent!
『那太好了！

Even if he will not come to Shanghai, I should like to talk with him.”
就是他不肯到上海，我也想跟他谈谈。』

Everyone knew Hu wanted to open a pharmacy.
胡雪岩想开药店是大家知道的；

An idea occurred to Xiao, and he nodded. “You might well find much to discuss.”
萧家骥心中一动，点点头说∶『这倒或许会谈得投机。』

“That is another matter.
『那是另外一回事，

Jiaji, so long as he agrees to come, we shall accept whatever terms he names.
家骥，只要他肯去，他怎么说，我们怎么依他。

And appeal to his particular interests.
还有，要投其所好。

You understand?”
你懂我的意思吧？』

“I understand.”
『我懂，』

Xiao smiled.
萧家骥笑道，

“But I fear you must invite him here and speak to him yourself.”
『不过，恐怕要请了他来，你自己跟他谈。』

More than two hours later he returned.
去了一个多时辰，萧家骥回来了，

Dr Zhang had accepted an invitation to dinner, he reported, and was fond of calligraphy and painting.
说张医生答应来吃晚饭，又说他喜欢字画。

Asked about inviting him to accompany them as physician, Xiao said he had not yet found it convenient to raise the matter.
问到邀他同行照料的话，萧家骥表示还不便开口；

He added that A’qiao ought to make the request.
又说最好由阿巧姐来说，

It was an unreasonable favour to ask; a lady’s appeal would be more likely to succeed.
因为这是不情之请，只有女眷相求，容易成功。


“That is true.
『这话也是。

When a man speaks, his word must mean what it says.
男人说话，一句就是一句，

If he is rebuffed or has to climb down, his words will carry less weight afterwards.
碰了钉子或者打了折扣，以后说话就不值钱了。

A’qiao, will you ask him?”
阿巧，』胡雪岩问道∶『你肯不肯说？』

“I ought to refuse.
『本来是不肯说的，

So a woman’s word is worth nothing, and it does not matter if she is rebuffed or has to climb down?
女人的话就不值钱；碰钉子、打折扣都不要紧？

What treatment!
真正气数！

Still—” She deliberately assumed a helpless expression. “Ah, there is nothing for it.
不过——』她故意做个无可奈何的表情∶『唉！不说又不行；

I shall have to do the asking.”
只好我来出面了。』

That settled, they had to prepare dinner for their guest.
说停当了，要准备肴馔款客。

Hu thought ordering dishes from a restaurant would be more respectful.
胡雪岩认为不如到馆子里叫菜，比较郑重；

A’qiao welcomed the saving of trouble and readily agreed.
阿巧姐也想省事，自然赞成；

Xiao was less enthusiastic.
但萧家骥不甚同意，

He had something else to say to her, out of Hu’s hearing.
他肚子里另有一番话，要避着胡雪岩跟阿巧姐说。

“You need not trouble about these small matters, Mr Hu.
『胡先生，这些小事，你不必操心了，

I shall discuss them with A’qiao.
我要跟阿巧姐去商量。

Let me go with you to look at the kitchen first.”
阿巧姐，我陪你到他们厨房里看了再说。』

When they reached a secluded stretch of the corridor where Hu could not hear, Xiao stopped.
走到廊下僻处，估量着胡雪岩听不见了，他站住脚，

“A’qiao, do you really mean to help Mr Hu carry this through?”
要问她一句话。『阿巧姐，你是不是真的想帮胡先生办成功这件事？』

“Yes.
『是啊！

I did not approve at first, but if he insists, I can only do as he wishes.”
本来我不赞成的，不过他一定要这样做，我无论如何只有依他。』

“If you mean to do as he wishes whatever happens, there is something I must say.
『既然无论如何要依他，那末，我有句话说出来，

But you must not strike me.”
你可不能动手。』


“I shall not.
『不会的。

Tell me.”
你说好了。』

“Dr Zhang is very interested in you.
『姓张的很关心你。

I do not know how he discovered it, but he knows you as Madam He.
也不知道他怎么打听到的，晓得你姓何；

It was ‘Madam He’ this and ‘Madam He’ that; he never stopped asking.”
何姨太长，何姨太短，不停地问。』

Xiao paused to watch her face.
说到这里，萧家骥停下来看她的脸色。

Naturally, she did not look pleased.
她的脸色自然不会好看，

She flushed scarlet with anger. “A doctor like that!
气得满脸通红∶『这种郎中，

A heartless beast!
狼心狗肺；

He deserves to be cut into a thousand pieces!”
杀千刀！』

“There, you see?” Xiao said calmly. “I knew you would be angry.”
『是不是？』萧家骥很冷静地说∶『我知道你要动气。』


That reminded her that he had more to say; if she carried on like this, she would never hear it.
一句话提醒了阿巧姐，知道他还有未说出来的话；如果自己还是这样子，那些话就听不到了。

On reflection, her own awkward position was to blame.
转念又想，总怪自己的身分尴尬，

Madam He appearing in a man named Hu’s quarters—people would hardly suppose her a respectable woman.
何姨太出现在姓胡的这里，在人家看，当然也不是什么好女人；

Since that was so, she might as well use a little crooked ingenuity herself.
既然如此，就不妨动动歪脑筋了。

As these thoughts passed through her mind, her expression softened.
这样转着念头，脸色自然就缓和了，

“Let him talk whatever nonsense he pleases.
『随他去胡说八道，

So long as I behave properly, that is enough.
只要我自己行得正，坐得正好了。』

Go on.”
她催促着，『你再说下去。』

“Mr Hu must leave, and he cannot leave unless Dr Zhang comes too.
『只为胡先生不走不可；要走，就非姓张的一起走不可。

So I had to try a little trick.
所以，我只好耍记花枪。

You are an understanding woman, A’qiao, and for Mr Hu’s sake I am sure you will not blame me.”
阿巧姐，你是明白人，又看在胡先生分上，一定不会怪我。』

This sounded ominous and rather alarmed her, though she kept her wariness to herself. Outwardly she took a different tone. “Of course not.
话风不妙，阿巧姐有些吃惊，不过戒心起在暗中∶表面上又是一种态度∶『不会，不会。

I know you are doing it for him.
我晓得你是为他。

Tell me, and we shall discuss it.”
你说出来商量。』

“I thought that if I simply asked him to accompany us to Shanghai, he would refuse.
『我在想，如果直言相谈，说请他一起陪到上海；他一定不会答应。

Once he had said no, we should be at an impasse.
这话等他一出口，事情就僵了；

So an idea came to me.
所以我灵机一动，

I said, ‘Madam He specially asked me to invite you.
说是∶』何姨太特为要我来奉请，

She will cook a couple of dishes herself this evening and hopes you will join her for wine.
晚上她亲手做两样菜，请张先生喝酒。

She begs the honour of your company.’
一定要请你赏光。

He was delighted and said, ‘Certainly, certainly!’”
「他很高兴地答应了，说是」一定来，一定来！

It was a beauty’s lure.
「『这用的是一条美人计，

A’qiao naturally disliked it, but the thought that it was for Hu’s sake kept her from resenting Xiao.
阿巧姐心里当然不是味道；不过一想到是为胡雪岩，她自然就不会对萧家骥介意，

“What else did he say?” she asked calmly.
她很平静地问道∶』他还有什么话？『


“He said more, of course.
『自然还有话，

‘Why should Madam He invite me?’ I told him, ‘To thank you for curing Intendant Hu.
他问我∶』何姨太为什么要请我？「我说∶『是因为你看好了胡道台，略表谢意。

She also has another favour to ask.’
另外还有件事求你。」

He kept asking what it was, but I would not tell him.
他一再问我什么事，我不肯说。

Now everything depends on you.”
回头全要看你了。』

A’qiao nodded and considered all he had said.
阿巧姐点点头，将他前后的话细想了一遍，

A plan formed in her mind, but one point had to be settled first.
心里有了主意；只是有一点必须先弄清楚。

“When he asked why I was here, what did you tell him?”
『问到我怎么会在这里？你是怎么告诉他的？』

“I said, ‘Madam He has now been dismissed from her household.
『我说∶』何姨太现在下堂了。

She is Intendant Hu’s sister-in-law, the elder sister of his wife.
她是胡道台的大姨子；

Suzhou is occupied, so she cannot return to her own family and has had to seek refuge with a close relation.’ He said, ‘That explains it!
苏州现在沦陷在那里，娘家回不去，只好来投奔至亲。「他说∶『怪不得！

In troubled times one cannot be overparticular about appearances.
人在难中，谈不到避嫌疑；

It is only right that a wife’s elder sister should nurse her brother-in-law.’”
大姨子照料妹夫的病，也是应该的。

A’qiao understood.
「『阿巧姐明白，

This supposed sister-in-law relationship implied that she had a younger sister who was one of Hu’s concubines.
所谓』大姨子『是意指她有个妹妹嫁做胡雪岩的偏旁；

The arrangement made them close enough, yet not too close: it explained her freedom to come and go in his rooms and care for him, while leaving the amorous doctor enough hope to take the bait.
关系如此安排，是疏而亲，亲而疏，不但她穿房入户，照料病人，可以说得过去，而且让色迷迷的张郎中希望不绝，才会上钩。


She greatly admired Xiao’s ingenuity, but could not help laughing.
阿巧姐十分欣赏萧家骥的机智，但也不免好笑，

“You dreadful boy!
『要死快哉！

How ever did you think of such a thing?” she said in the broadest Suzhou dialect.
耐那哼想得出格介？』她用道道地地苏州话笑着说。

Xiao laughed too.
萧家骥自己也笑了，

“It appears that he would like to become Mr Hu’s brother-in-law by marrying his wife’s sister.
『看起来，他是想跟胡先生做「连襟」；

With so close a family connection, anything could be discussed.”
既然至亲，无话不好谈。』

He reminded her, “This play is certain to come off beautifully.
他提醒她说，『这出戏包定唱得圆满，

But whether you ought to prepare Mr Hu first is for you to decide.”
不过，要不要先跟胡先生说好？你自己斟酌。』

After considering it, A’qiao concluded that she must tell Hu something, but not everything.
阿巧姐考虑结果，认为不可不说，亦不可全说。

She had known the world of the pleasure quarters.
她是在风尘中打过滚的，

Other workings of a man’s mind might escape her, but in this one respect she understood him perfectly.
男人的心，别样摸不透；只有这一层上，她真是了如指掌。

A man might be generous by nature, yet he could not endure a rival taking the woman he loved.
男人的气量大，固然不错，却就是论到夺爱，不能容忍；

It was not merely jealousy; his pride was involved as well.
因为这不但关乎妒意，还有面子在内。

Having made some arrangements for the food and wine, she found a moment when Xiao was absent.
于是略略安排了酒食，找个萧家骥不在眼前的机会，

“Must you really have Dr Zhang accompany you to Shanghai?” she asked Hu.
问胡雪岩说∶『你是不是一定要姓张的郎中陪到上海？』

“Yes!”
『对！』

His answer was decisive.
胡雪岩答得斩钉截铁，

“Unless he comes, you will not feel easy.
『他不陪去，你不放心。

We must find a way to persuade him.”
那就只好想办法说动他了。』

“Xiao and I have settled on a way.
『办法，我跟萧家骥商量好了。

But there is something I must say first.
不过有句话说在前面，

We can only proceed if you agree.”
你要答应了，我们才好做。』


Hu could hear at once that there was more behind her words.
一听就知道话中有话，

He trusted them both and might as well be magnanimous.
胡雪岩信得过他们两人，落得放漂亮些，

“You need not tell me.
『不必告诉我。』

Do whatever you think best.”
他说∶『你们觉得怎么好，就怎么做。』

“Oh, how generous you sound!”
『唷，唷，倒说得大方。』

Her voice held a warning. “Do not turn mean afterwards.”
阿巧姐用警告的口吻说∶『回头可不要小气。』

That deserved some thought.
这就不能不好好想一想了。

Hu prided himself on his generosity and his readiness to accept a loss, and did not relish being called mean.
胡雪岩自负是最慷慨、最肯吃亏的人，所以对这『小气』的两字之贬，倒有些不甘承受。

Yet A’qiao knew the world and was a shrewd judge of men; she would be especially unlikely to misjudge him.
转念又想，阿巧姐阅历甚深，看男人不会看错；看自己更不会看错，

There must be a reason for the word.
然则说『小气』一定有道理在内。

Though his mind was not as quick as usual, it was still quicker than most.
他的心思，这时虽不如平时敏捷，但依旧过人一等，

He recalled Xiao’s hesitation on returning, his air of having something awkward to say, and soon grasped the clue.
很快地想到萧家骥从家回来那时，说话带些吞吞吐吐，仿佛有难言之隐的神情，终于看出因头了。

Deliberately, he said, “If you think I shall be mean, you must be planning to give him something I treasure.
于是他故意这样说∶『你看得我会小气∶一定是拿我什么心爱的东西送他。

Is that it?”
是不是？』

“Yes. What do you treasure?”
『是啊』你有什么心爱的东西？

“Only one thing.”
『『只有一样，』

Hu smiled. “A living treasure.”
胡雪岩笑道∶『是个活宝。』

“You are the living treasure!”
『你才是活宝！』

A’qiao smiled radiantly and said no more about it.
阿巧姐嫣然一笑；不再提这件事了。


Dr Zhang arrived early.
张医生早早就来了。

Naturally he first went to see his patient, and Hu offered the customary courtesies. “You have taken so much trouble that I do not know how to thank you.
一到自然先我看病人，少不得也要客气几句∶『多蒙费心，不知道怎么样道谢。

This simple meal is only a goose feather brought a thousand li—a small token of heartfelt regard.
谢过来吃顿便饭，真正千里鹅毛一片心；

But I hope the day will come when I can repay you properly.
不过，我想总有补报的日子。

Let us be friends, Dr Zhang.”
张先生，我们交个朋友。』

“Then the honour is mine,” the doctor said.
『那是我高攀了。』张医生说，

“I do feel there is an affinity between us. With the same illness and the same medicine, one patient responds to a single dose, while in another the drug sinks like a stone into the sea.
『我倒觉得我们有缘同样的病，同样的药，有的一服见效，有的吃下去如石沉大海；

That is the difference between a doctor and patient who have an affinity and those who do not.”
这就是医家跟病家有缘没有缘的道理。』

“Indeed,” Xiao interjected. “You have an affinity with all of us.”
『是的。』萧家骥接口说道∶『张先生跟我们都有缘。』

“Life is all a matter of affinity,” Hu declared, launching into a little discourse.
『人生都是个缘字。』胡雪岩索性发议论，

“I never dreamt that I should come to Ningbo.
『我做梦也没有想到会到宁波，

Even after arriving, I never imagined I should fall ill and owe my life to you—” “You are too kind!” Dr Zhang protested.
