“Exactly!” she said delightedly.
『对！』七姑奶奶高兴地说，

“Third Uncle Liu, you have a worldly man’s quick understanding.
『刘三叔你真是「光棍玲珑心，

One hint is enough!”
一点就透」！』


“Seventh Sister,” Liu said gravely, “put those two arguments to Xueyan’s wife and she will have nothing to say against them. She is a thoroughly reasonable woman.
『七姐！』刘不才正色说道∶『拿这两个理由去说，雪岩夫人极明白事理的人，一定没话好说。

But she will not be happy at heart.
不过，她心里是不会舒服的。

Is it worth forcing this concession from her?
七姐，你这样「硬吃一注」，犯不犯得着，

Think it over.”
你倒再想想看！』

“Thank you, Third Uncle Liu.
『多谢你，刘三叔！』

But for Little Uncle’s sake, I have no choice.”
七姑奶奶答道∶『为了小爷叔，我没有法子。』

“That is not the way to put it.
『话不是这么说。

Our friendship is close enough that we need not fear displeasing one another.
大家的交情到了这个地步，不必再顾忌对方会不高兴什么的。

In doing this, Seventh Sister, you must ask whether it will benefit the whole Hu family.
做这件事，七姐，你要想想，是不是对胡家全家有好处？

You cannot regard the matter as settled merely because Xueyan gets his way for the moment.”
不是能教雪岩一个人一时的称心如意，就算有了交代！』

His view went deeper.
刘不才的看法很深；

Reflecting upon it, she suddenly understood.
七姑奶奶细想一想，憬然不悟。

Yet there was a difference between them.
然而她到底跟刘不才不同，

Liu was an intimate of the Hu household and lived with them.
一个是胡家的至家，而且住在一起，

Whatever private troubles that family had, he naturally knew far more of them than she did.
这家人家有本什么『难念的经』，当然他比她了解得多。

She felt that they must discuss the matter afresh.
因此，七姑奶奶觉得此事要重谈了。

“Third Uncle Liu, I must listen to that.
『刘三叔，你这句话我要听；

I ought to do what is best for the whole family.
我总要为胡家全家好才好。

Besides, once we are all in Shanghai, it will mostly be the women who visit one another.
再说，将来大家住在上海，总是内眷往来的时候多；

If Mrs Hu harbours a grievance against me and we are only outwardly cordial, where will the pleasure be?
如果胡家婶娘跟我心里有过节，弄得面和心不和，还有啥趣味？

There is just one thing I still do not understand.
只有一层，我还想不明白，

If we arrange this, will it really disturb the harmony of the whole household?”
这件事要做成功了，难道会害他们一家上下不和睦？』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第六章（本章第2部分，共5部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“That is hard to say.
『这很难说！

From what I know, Xueyan’s wife has her own way of running the household.
照我晓得，雪碉岩夫人治家另有一套；

Break her rule once, and her words will carry less weight thereafter.”
坏了她的规矩，破一个例，以后她说的话就要打折扣了。』

“Little Uncle has said it would be this once only, never again.
『小爷叔说过的∶』只此一遭，下不为例。

If anything of the sort happens in future, I shall stand up for Mrs Hu before she even needs to speak.” Liu suddenly chuckled, then sighed without answering.
「将来如果再有这样子的情形；不用胡家婶娘开口发话，我先替她打抱不平！『听到这里，刘不才』噗哧『一声笑了；叹口气不响。

His manner suggested that she did not understand what she was doing, which rather annoyed her.
这大有笑人不懂事的意味，七姑奶奶倒有些光火；

“Third Uncle Liu, have I said something wrong?”
立即追一句∶『刘三叔，我话说错了？』

“Your words are right, and your heart is warm.
『话不错，你的心也热。

But that is precisely how you will bring trouble upon yourself.
不过，惟其如此，你就是自寻烦恼。

As the saying goes, even an honest magistrate cannot settle a family quarrel.
俗语道得好∶』清官难断家务事「；

Seventh Sister, even if you were Judge Bao himself and judged the matter perfectly, you would still have trouble.”
七姐，就算你是包公，断得明明白白，依旧是个烦恼！

“How?
『』怎么呢！

I do not understand.”
这话我就听不懂了。

“Seventh Sister, you are clever in everything else and confused only here.
『『七姐，你聪明一世，懵懂一时，

In a lawsuit, either the plaintiff wins or the defendant does.
打到官司，不是原告赢，就是被告赢，

You mend one thing and damage another.
治一经，损一经，

Why put yourself through it?”
何苦来哉！』

She understood at once.
七姑奶奶恍然大悟，

If she sided with Mrs Hu in future, she must offend Hu himself.
将来如果帮胡太太，就一定得罪了胡雪岩；

Was that not mending one thing at the cost of another?
岂不是治一经，损一经？

“Enough, enough!
『好了，好了，

Really, Third Uncle Liu, if you have a sound reason, why not state it plainly instead of going round in such circles?
刘三叔，你也是，有道理不直截了当说出来，要兜这么大一个圈子！

Fortunately I have changed and have the patience to question you.
亏得我不比从前，有耐心盘问，

Otherwise you would have led me astray!”
不然不是害我走错了路？』

Her complaint was quite unreasonable, but amusingly so.
这番埋怨的话，真有点蛮不讲理，但不讲理得有趣；

Liu could only laugh.
刘不才只好笑了。


“I do not want to be a female Judge Bao.
『我也不要做啥「女包公」！

I would rather remain a female Zhang Fei.”
还是做我的「女张飞」来得好。』

There was something behind this, which Liu recognised at once.
话外有话，刘不才一下子就听了出来，

He had to answer. “What do you intend, Seventh Sister?
不能不回∶『七姐！你是怎么个打算？

A female Zhang Fei is all very well, but a rash Zhang Fei would be another matter.”
做女张飞还则罢了，做莽张飞就没意思了。』

“Zhang Fei could be subtle beneath his roughness too.
『张飞也有粗中有细的时候，

Naturally I know where to stop.
我自然有分寸。

Rest assured: there will be no trouble.”
你放心好了，不会有啥风波。』

Liu considered. “Then do you still want me to prepare Xueyan’s wife?”
刘不才想了一下问道∶『那末，是不是还要我在雪岩夫人面前去做功夫？』

“Yes.
『要！

But the argument will no longer be the same.”
不过话不是原来的说法了。』

That puzzled him.
这下搞得刘不才发楞。

Surely this was a question of yes or no: either forget the matter entirely or raise it.
是一非二的事，要么一笔勾销不谈此事；要谈，

How could there be another way of raising it?
还要另一个说法吗？

“The first half can still be used.
『前半段的话，还是可以用，

Mrs Hu should understand how A’qiao and Little Uncle became attached again. If she knows the whole story, she will not begin with a prejudice against A’qiao.”
阿巧姐怎么跟小爷叔又生了感情，总有个来龙去脉，要让胡家婶娘知道，才不会先对阿巧姐有成见。』

The Seventh Lady paused. “The latter half must be changed as follows.”
七姑奶奶停了一下说∶『后半段的话改成这个样子——。』

Her plan was first to reassure Mrs Hu, which would also reassure Hu himself.
她的做法是先安抚胡太太，也就是先安抚胡雪岩。

Once the family reached Shanghai, his separate mistress could not be concealed.
因为胡家眷属一到上海，胡雪岩有外室这件事，是瞒不住的；

He would also ask the Seventh Lady what she had achieved.
而且胡雪岩本人也会向七姑奶奶探问结果，

She therefore needed his wife’s cooperation to keep the situation calm for the time being.
所以她需要胡太太跟她配合，先把局面安定下来。


“I need time to work patiently upon A’qiao.
『我要一段辰光，好在阿巧姐面前下水磨功夫。

My fear is that, before I have made any progress, husband and wife will already be quarrelling.
就怕事情还没有眉目，他们夫妇已经吵了起来；

Once people openly fall out, a deadlock often follows.
凡事一破了脸，往往就会弄成僵局。

Mrs Hu had best pretend to know nothing.
所以胡家婶娘最好装作不知道这回事；

If Little Uncle stays away from his own camp at night, she need not investigate.”
如果小爷叔「夜不归营」，也不必去查问。』

“I understand, and Xueyan’s wife can certainly do that.
『我懂你的意思，雪岩夫人也一定做得到。

But he often springs surprises.
不过，雪岩做事，常常会出奇兵，

What if she pretends ignorance and he comes straight out with the truth, face to face?”
倘或一个装糊涂；一个倒当面锣、对面鼓，自己跟她老实去谈了呢？』

“I doubt that will happen.
『我想这种情形不大会有，

If it does, she should neither agree nor object, but put him off as best she can.”
如果是这样，胡家婶娘不承认，也不反对，一味敷衍他就是了。』

“I suppose that is the only course.”
『我想也只好这样子应付。』

Liu nodded.
刘不才点点头，

“In a word, overcome firmness with softness.”
『一句话∶以柔克刚。』

“Which means tact.
『以柔克刚就是圆滑。

Tell Mrs Hu that I undertake to settle the matter within three months.
请你跟胡家婶娘说，总在三个月当中，包在我身上，将这件事办妥当。

What do I mean by settle?
什么叫妥当呢？

Her rule will remain intact.
就是不坏她的规矩，

If A’qiao will not enter the Hu household, she will certainly have joined some other man’s.”
如果阿巧姐不肯进门姓胡；那就一定姓了别人的姓了。』

“So you mean to transplant the blossom to another branch.”
『原来你是想用条移花接木之计。』

Liu was intrigued. “Have you already found a man for her?”
刘不才兴致盎然地问∶『七姐，你是不是替阿巧姐物色好了什么人？』

“No, no.
『没有，没有！

I must look slowly.” Suddenly she laughed. “Actually, Third Uncle Liu, you would be quite a match.”
要慢慢去觅。』七姑奶奶突然笑道∶『其实，刘三叔，你倒蛮配！』

“You are joking!
『开玩笑了！

How could I graduate in the same class as Xueyan?”
我怎么好跟雪岩「同科」？』


It was already the chou watch, after midnight, when Hu returned home, but he was still in excellent spirits.
回家已经午夜过后的丑时了，但是胡雪岩的精神却还很好，

Sitting by the dressing table as A’qiao removed her make-up, he asked about the women’s outing that evening.
坐在统妆台畔看阿巧姐卸妆，同时问起她们这一夜出游的情形。

“We went for a foreign dinner first.
『先去吃大菜。

There was nothing very good to eat.
实在没有什么好吃；

Their fried quail was not as good as the eight-piece fried chicken in a Beijing restaurant.
炸鹌鹑还不如京馆里的炸八块。

And with only the two of us, we looked like—” She shook her head and smiled bitterly, unwilling to finish.
又是我们这么两个人；倒象——。』阿巧姐摇摇头，苦笑着不肯再说下去。

Like what?
象什么？

Hu closed his eyes and imagined himself as one of the waiters serving them.
胡雪岩闭起眼睛，作为自己是在场执役的『两崽』去体会；

Two ladies without male companions, boldly showing themselves in public and handling knives and forks over a foreign dinner—what sort of women would they seem?
这样两位堂客，没有『官客』陪伴，抛头露面敢到那里『动刀动枪』去吃大菜，是啥路道？

Judging by their ages and their dress, they would look like two remarkably fine proprietresses of expensive courtesan houses.
照她们的年纪和打扮来说，就象长三堂子里的两个极出色的『本家』。

That must have been A’qiao’s thought, and the reason she refused to finish.
阿巧姐的想法必是如此，所以才不愿说下去。

Understanding this, he understood her feelings as well.
了解到这一点，自然而然地意会到她的心境，

Even if she did not aspire to an aristocratic mansion, she had certainly come to despise the pleasure quarters.
即令不是向往朱邸，确已鄙弃青楼，

Her desire for a respectable life was sincere.
真有从良的诚意。

This made it harder still to give her up.
由于这样的看法，便越觉得阿巧姐难舍；

He blurted out, “What did Seventh Sister say to you?”
因而脱口问道∶『七姐怎么跟你说？』


“What do you mean, what did she say?”
『什么怎么跟我说？』

A’qiao’s hands stopped in the act of undoing her hair.
阿巧姐将正在解髻的手停了下来，

“What should she have to say to me?
『她会有什么话跟我说？

You knew beforehand, did you not?
你是先就晓得的是不是？

Then tell me: why did she suddenly leave Master You at home today and invite me out to the theatre and a foreign dinner?”
你倒说说看，她今天拿五爷丢在家里，忽然要请我看戏吃大菜，到底是为了什么？』

This volley of questions threw Hu into confusion.
这一连串的疑问，将胡雪岩搞得枪法大乱，

He could not parry it.
无法招架。

But he possessed one gift: a smile could conceal any embarrassment, and his embarrassment never lasted long.
不过他有一样本事，善于用笑容来遮盖任何窘态；而那种窘态亦决不会保持得太久，

He soon recovered his composure.
很快地便沉着下来。

“I do not understand what you mean.
『我不懂你说的啥？』

I was asking whether she told you why she suddenly felt like taking you out.
他说，『我是问你，七姐有没有告诉你，她何以心血来潮约你出去玩？

Apparently you do not know.
看样子你也不知道；

Then I know still less.”
那我就更加不知道了。』

“Even a man as clever as you does not know?”
『连你这样聪明的人都不知道？』

She gave a faint, cold smile.
阿巧姐微微冷笑，

“Then there is nothing more to say.”
『那也就没有什么好说的了。』

“We are husband and wife chatting together.
『夫妇闲谈，

What harm is there in talking?”
说说何妨？』

She suddenly raised her head, her clear, bright eyes fixed upon him. “Husband and wife?
阿巧姐倏然抬头，炯炯清眸，逼着胡雪岩∶『夫妇？

Am I so fortunate?”
我有那么好的福气？』

His careless remark seemed to have given her a weapon, but it did not defeat him.
无意间一句话，倒似乎成了把柄；不过也难不倒胡雪岩，

“Here we are husband and wife,” he answered calmly.
『在这里我们就是夫妇。』他从容自在地回答。

“Then,” she nodded as though speaking to herself, “there is all the more reason not to listen to the Seventh Lady.”
『所以，』她点点头，自语似的，『我就更不能听七姑奶奶的话了。』

“What did she say?”
『她说了什么话？』

“She advised me to go back.”
『她劝我回去。』

“Go back” could mean either returning to her own family or entering Hu’s household as a concubine.
这『回去』二字可有两个解释，一是回娘家，二是进胡家的大门做偏房。

Her family home was in Mudu, near Suzhou, which was now in the Longhairs’ hands.
她的娘家在苏州木渎，而苏州此刻在长毛手里，

There could be no reason to advise her to go there.
自然没有劝她回娘家的道理。


Once her meaning was clear, he ought to ask what she intended.
弄清楚了她的话，该问她的意志；

But he already knew the answer, so there was no point.
但不问可知，就无须多此一举。

After a long silence he burst out, “Tomorrow I really must look for a house.”
停了好一会，他口中爆出一句话来∶『明天真的要去找房子了。』

His manner was rather inscrutable.
他的态度有些莫测高深。

A’qiao remembered how, when they had discussed finding a house a few days earlier, he had hinted that she should live with his principal wife.
她记起前几天谈到找房子的事，曾经暗示要让她跟大妇住在一起；

Did he still mean that?
而此刻还是那样的心思？

She must find out.
必得问一问。

“If you cannot find one in time,” she ventured, “why not let them stay here first?”
于是她试探地说∶『如果真的一时找不到；不如先住到这里来。』

“There is not room.”
『住不下。』

Did he mean there was no room in any case, or no room if she remained?
这住不下是说本来就住不下叱；还是连她在一起住不下？

She still could not tell and had to try again.
阿巧姐依然不明白！就只好再试探了。

“They can squeeze in for the moment.
『暂时挤一挤。』

Refugees cannot expect every comfort.”
她说，『逃难辰光也讲究不来那么多。』

“And you?”
『那么，你呢？』

“I?”
『我？』

She spoke resolutely.
阿巧姐毅然决然地说，

“I shall move elsewhere.”
『另外搬。』

“Why trouble?
『那又何必？

Better to leave things as they are.”
一动不如一静。』

Hu thought for a moment and decided plain speaking would be best.
胡雪岩想了一会，觉得还是把话说明了好，

“I feel as you do.
『我跟你的心思一样，

Continuing just like this would be best.
就照这个样子最好。

I have already asked the Seventh Lady to plead with my wife when she arrives, to say a few kind words for us and persuade her to make a special exception.”
我已经托了七姑奶奶了，等我太太一来，请她去疏通，多说两句好话，特别通融一次。』

“That is strange!”
『那就奇怪了！』

A’qiao sounded angry.
阿巧姐有些气愤，

“She urged me to go back instead—the exact opposite of what you asked.
『七姑奶奶反而劝我回去；跟你托她的意思，完全相反，

Why?”
这是为啥？』


Hu deeply regretted his carelessness.
胡雪岩深为失悔，自己太疏忽了！

Knowing what the Seventh Lady had advised, he should not have told the truth and made her seem disloyal to the task entrusted to her.
明知道七姑奶奶劝她的话是什么；不该再说实话，显得七姑奶奶为人谋而不忠。

At the same time, A’qiao’s question alerted him to something.
同时也被提醒了，

Yes—what did the Seventh Lady mean by acting so?
真的，七三奶奶这样做是什么意思，

It was puzzling.
倒费人猜疑。

Whatever the reason, he must defend her now.
然而，不论如何，眼前却必须为七姑奶奶辩白，

“Perhaps she was only trying to discover your attitude.
『也许她是先探探你的口气。』

What did she say?”
他问∶『她怎么说？』

“She said, ‘A woman must have a proper settled place.
『她说∶』妇道人家总要有个归宿，

Better to join the Hu family formally and kowtow upon entering the household.
还是正式姓了胡，进门磕了头的好。

Otherwise you should make a firm decision.’”
不然，就不如拿个决断出来！

“What did she mean by a firm decision?”
「『』何谓」拿个决断出来「？

“Ask her.”
『『你去问她。』

The weariness of A’qiao’s tone showed that this “decision” meant a course she could not possibly accept.
阿巧姐这懒得说的语气，可知所谓『决断』，是一种她绝不能同意的办法。

Putting her remarks together, Hu understood the Seventh Lady’s intention, but not why she had formed it.
胡雪岩将前后语言，合起来作一个推敲，懂了七姑奶奶的心思；只不懂她为何有那样的心思？

“She often takes unexpected measures.
『七姑奶奶做事，常有教人猜想不到的手段。

Do not be angry yet.
你先不必气急，

Calm yourself and wait to see what happens.”
静下心来看一看再说。


“How long must I wait?” A’qiao suddenly cried, her voice high and shrill. “Do you know what she said about you?
『要看到什么时候？』阿巧姐突然咆哮，声音又尖又高∶『你晓不晓得七姑奶奶怎么说你？

That you are slippery!
说你滑头；

That you have no constancy and fall in love with every woman you see!
说你没有常性，见一个爱一个！

Dogs have eaten the conscience of a man like that.
这种人的良心让狗吃掉了，

She urged me to part from you soon, or I should suffer for it later.
劝我早早分手；不然将来有苦头吃。

Well, I think she was right in every word.
我看啊，她的话一点不错。

Hmph!
哼！

You could deceive a person to death and never pay for it.”
骗死人不偿命。』

The barrage, striking both directly and by insinuation, left Hu bewildered.
这样夹枪带棒一顿乱骂，拿胡雪岩搞得晕头转向，

He could scarcely believe his ears.
几乎不相信自己的耳朵。

Naturally he was angry too—not with A’qiao, but with the Seventh Lady.
心里当然也很生气；气的不是阿巧姐，而是七姑奶奶，

She had not merely failed to act loyally for him: she had betrayed a friend.
不但为人谋而不忠，简直是出卖朋友。

With such friendship between them, how could she resort to so underhand a trick?
彼此这样的交情，而竟出此阴险的鬼蜮伎俩！

It was more than he could swallow.
这口气实在教人咽不下。

He had never been so angry.
胡雪岩从来没有这样生气过；

His face turned livid and his lips pale.
气得脸青唇白，

Just as he was about to erupt, a thought warned him.
刚要发作，突然警觉，

The Seventh Lady was called a hero among women.
七姑奶奶号称『女中丈夫』，

She was neither without judgement nor ignorant of loyalty between friends.
胸中不是没有丘壑的人，更不是不懂朋友义气的人，

There must be a reason for what she had said—a very deep reason, too deep even for him to fathom.
她这样说法，当然有她的道理在内——这层道理一定极深；深得连自己都猜不透。

At that thought his expression softened at once.
这样一转念间，脸色立刻缓和了，

“What else did she say?” he asked.
先问一句∶『七姑奶奶还说点啥？』

“What else?”
『说点啥？』

A’qiao’s anger was not merely lingering; it grew as she thought.
阿巧姐岂仅余怒不息，竟是越想越恨，

“Unless you had given her some hint that you meant to abandon me, would she have said such things?
『不是你有口风给她，打算不要我了，她会说这样的话！

You heartless—” Suzhou women were fond of the curse “may you be cut into a thousand pieces”, but some tenderness remained in A’qiao, and she swallowed the words.
死没良心的——。』苏州女人受骂『杀千刀』；而阿巧姐毕竟余情犹在，把这三个字硬咽了回去。

Hu offered no defence. Until he understood the Seventh Lady’s purpose, he feared that defending himself might spoil it.
胡雪岩不作辩白∶因为不知道七姑奶奶是何道理，怕一辩就会破坏了她的用意。

Yet he could not say nothing at all.
然而不辩白又不行；

He answered vaguely, “Why must you listen to her?”
只好含含混混地说∶『你何必听她的？』


“Then whom should I listen to?
『那末，我听谁？

You?”
听你的？』

A’qiao pressed him harder. “Speak!
阿巧姐索性逼迫∶『你说，

Give me one plain, firm assurance.”
你倒扎扎实实说一句我听。』

What assurance did she mean?
何谓『扎扎实实说一句』？

He was genuinely puzzled.
胡雪岩倒有些困惑了，

“Tell me what you want me to say.”
『你说！』他问，『你要我怎么说一句？』

“There!
『你看你！

I knew your heart had changed.”
我就晓得你变心了。』

She stamped her foot and spoke bitterly. “Do you really not know what to say?
阿巧姐踩着脚恨声说道∶『你难道不晓得怎么说？

You simply refuse to say it.
不过不肯说而已！

Enough, enough!
好了，好了，

At last I know you.”
我总算认识你了。』

Her angry cries in the quiet night roused the maids and older servants.
静夜娇叱，惊起了丫头娘姨；

Shadows gathered outside the window; they seemed to want to enter and mediate but dared not.
窗外人影幢幢，是想进来解劝而不敢的模样，

Hu felt thoroughly uncomfortable.
胡雪岩自觉无趣，

He rose and urged, “It is late.
站起身来劝道∶『夜深了，

Let us sleep.”
睡吧！』

Then he quietly made his way into the adjoining room, where there was another bed used occasionally for afternoon naps.
说完，他悄悄举步，走向套间；那里也有张床，是偶尔歇午觉用的，

It offered a convenient refuge from the lioness’s roar.
此时正好用来逃避狮吼，

He turned up a lamp and sat alone, lost in thought.
一个人捻亮了灯，枯坐沉思。

Seeing no further disturbance, the servants withdrew.
丫头姨娘看看无事，各自退去；

A’qiao, offended, ignored him and went to bed by herself.
阿巧姐赌气不理胡雪岩，一俱上床睡下。

Hu did not dare provoke her again and made do with a night apart.
胡雪岩见此光景，也不敢去招惹她，将就睡了一夜。

The next morning, when he came out of the adjoining room, she was already sitting at the dressing table.
第二天起身，走出套间，阿巧且倒已经坐在梳妆台前了，

Silent and pale, she looked thinner than ever.
不言不语；脸儿黄黄，益显得纤瘦；

On closer inspection he thought he saw tear marks.
仔细看去，似有泪痕，

Perhaps she had wept enough in the night to soak her pillow.
只怕夜来将枕头都哭湿了。


“Why do this to yourself?” he said. “You are ruining your health.”
『何苦！』他说∶『自己糟蹋身子。』

“I have thought it over,” she said dully. “This cannot come to a proper end.
『我想过了。』阿巧姐木然地说∶『总归不是一个了局。

And I cannot match you.
你呢，我也弄不过你。

Enough, enough.”
算了，算了！』

She waved her hand and turned her head aside, as though relinquishing everything.
一面说，一面摆手，而且将头扭到一边，大有一切撒手之意。

Naturally he felt distressed, but could think of nothing suitable to comfort her.
胡雪岩心里自不免难过，但却想不出什么适当的话去安慰她。

“I am giving Chief Yu lunch today,” he said, meaning that he must go out early.
『今天中午要请郁老大吃饭。』他说，意思是要早点出门。

“Go, then.”
『你去好了。』

There was coldness in her voice.
阿巧姐说；声音中带着些冷漠的意味。

He hesitated, longing to say another word or two of reassurance.
胡雪岩有些踌躇，很想再说一两句什么安抚的话，

Yet he had no adequate assurance to give and could only abandon the attempt.
但实在没有适当的意思可以表白，也就只好算了。

It was barely ten when he reached Gu’s house.
到古家才十点钟，

The Seventh Lady was already up and vigorously directing the servants in preparing to receive their guests.
七姑奶奶已经起身；精神抖擞地在指挥男佣女仆，准备款客。

The rosewood chairs in the main hall all wore bright red satin covers embroidered in gold.
大厅上的一堂花梨木机智椅，全部铺上了大红缎子平金绣花的椅披；

Fresh flowers stood in the vases, and eight tall silver dishes, polished to a brilliant shine, held fresh and dried fruit.
花瓶中新换了花；八个擦得雪高的高脚银盘，摆好了干湿果子。

The weather was fine, sunlight filled the courtyard and there was no wind.
这天的云气很好，阳光满院，又没有风，

All the doors in the screen and the windows stood open, making the house especially spacious and cheerful.
所以屏门窗子全部打开，格外显得开阔爽朗。


“You are early, Little Uncle!
『小爷叔倒来得早！

Have you eaten?” Suddenly she noticed his appearance.
点心吃了没有』『七姑奶奶忽然发觉∶』小爷叔，

“You look very unwell.
你的气色很不好；

Are you ill?”
是不是身子不舒服？

“No.
『』不是！

I scarcely slept last night.”
『胡雪岩说∶』昨晚上一夜没有睡好。

“Why?” She added, “Even one sleepless night should not leave you looking like this.
『』为啥？『七姑奶奶又补了一句∶』就一夜不睡，也不致于弄成这个样子，

There must be a reason.”
总有道理吧？

“There is.
『『对。其中有个缘故。』

Where is Old Gu?”
胡雪岩问道∶『老古呢？』

“At the firm.
『到号子里去了。

He will be back at half past eleven.”
十一点半回来。』

“It is still early for the guests.
『客来还早。

Are you busy, Seventh Sister?
七姐有没有事？

If not, I should like a few words.”
没有事我有几句话想跟你说。』

Her eyes blinked several times.
七姑奶奶的眼睛眨了几下，

Calmly she answered, “I am free.
很沉着地回答说∶『没有事。

Let us talk in Yingchun’s study.”
我们到应春书房里去谈。』

Once there, Hu could not begin.
到得书房，胡雪岩却又不开心口；

He held his tea and stared into space.
捧着一碗茶，只是出神。

She already had some idea of his trouble.
七姑奶奶已经有点猜到他的心事；

If she was right, the effect had come rather quickly.
如果是那样的话，发作得未免太快，

She needed time to consider what to say.
自己该说些什么，需要好好想一想。

His silence therefore suited her, and she remained silent too.
所以他不说话，她也乐得沉默。


At last he spoke. “Seventh Sister, A’qiao had a terrible quarrel with me last night.
终于开口了∶『七姐，昨天晚上，阿巧跟我大吵一架？』

What exactly did you say to her?”
他问∶『你到底跟她说了些啥？』

Instead of answering, she asked, “How did she quarrel with you?”
七姑奶奶不即回答，反问一句∶『她怎么跟你吵？』

“She said I had hinted to you that I meant to abandon her.
『她说∶我有口风给你，打算不要她了。

There is no truth in that, is there?”
七姐，这不是无影无踪的事？』

She smiled.
七姑奶奶笑一笑，

“What else?”
『还有呢？』

With difficulty he answered, “She said you called me slippery, said dogs had eaten my conscience, and said I fell in love with every woman I saw.”
她再问。『还有，』胡雪岩很吃力地说∶『说你骂我滑头，良心让狗吃掉了。又说我是见一个爱一个。』

She smiled again, this time with a trace of embarrassment.
七姑奶奶又笑了，这一笑似乎有点不好意思，

“Little Uncle,” she asked almost teasingly, “were you angry?”
『小爷叔，』她带点逗弄的意味，『你气不气？』

“A little at first.
『先是有点气。

Then I thought again and ceased to be angry.
后来转念想一想，不气了∶我想，

You are not a woman without judgement.
你也不是没有丘壑的人，

There must be a reason for speaking that way.”
这样子说法，总有道理吧？』


Relief and gratitude spread over her face.
听到这话，七姑奶奶脸上顿时浮起欣慰而感激的神色，

“Little Uncle, it was only because I knew you understood my intentions that I dared act so rashly.
『小爷叔，就因为你晓得我的本心，我才敢那样子冒失——

In fact, it was not rash.
其实也不是冒失，

I discussed it with someone beforehand and thought it through carefully.
事先我跟人商量过，也好好想过，

I concluded that this was the best course.
觉得只有这样子做最好。

But I could not tell you first.
不过，不能先跟你说，

Had I done so, it would not have worked.”
说了就做不成了。』

Setting that aside, she asked again about A’qiao. “What did she say?
她撇开这一段，又问阿巧姐∶『她怎么个说法？

Why did she quarrel with you?
为啥跟你吵？

Because she believed me?”
是不是因为信了我的话？』

“She believes I hinted that I meant to leave her, and that you said those things for that reason.
『她是相信我给了你口风，打算不要她了；所以你才会跟她说这些话。』

I should have thought the same in her place.
胡雪岩说，『换了我，也会这样子想，

With our friendship as it is, why else would you run me down so completely before her?”
不然，我们这样的交情，你怎么会在她面前，骂得我一文不值？』

“Quite right.
『不错；

Entirely right.” She asked with great concern, “And you, Little Uncle—did you defend yourself?”
完全不错。』七姑奶奶很在意地问∶『小爷叔，那末你呢，你有没有辩白？』

“No.
『没有。』

From the way things stood, there seemed little use.”
胡雪岩说，『看这光景，辩亦无用。』

His unwitting cooperation, like drum and drumstick answering one another, fixed her resolve beyond alteration.
由于胡雪岩是这样无形中桴鼓相应的态度，便和七姑奶奶的决心无可改变了。

She had accepted Liu Bucai’s advice and considered the awkward situation between Hu and A’qiao from the standpoint of the whole family’s harmony.
她是接受了刘不才的劝告，以胡家的和睦着眼，来考虑阿巧姐跟胡雪岩之间的尴尬局面，

A clean cut through the tangle seemed the best solution.
认为只有快刀斩乱麻，才是上策。

Yet she could not control matters single-handed, nor could she explain her intention to Hu in advance.
但话虽如此，到底不能一个操纵局面；同时也不能先向胡雪岩说破，

She could only act as opportunity offered, saying as much as each stage allowed.
那就只有见机行事，到什么地步说什么话了。



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第六章（本章第3部分，共5部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Her first step had really been a test.
第一步实在是试探。

If A’qiao had trusted Hu alone, laughed off the Seventh Lady’s remarks behind his back about his inconstancy and apparent heartlessness, and forgotten them, the play would have been difficult to continue.
如果阿巧姐不信她只信胡雪岩∶拿她批评胡雪岩用情不专，迹近薄幸的种种『背后之言』，付之一笑，听过丢开；这出戏就很难唱得下去了。

If Hu’s infatuation had been so deep that he strenuously denied every charge and won A’qiao’s understanding, it would have been harder still.
或者，胡雪岩对阿巧姐迷恋已深，极力辩白，决无其事，取得阿巧姐的谅解；这出戏就更难唱得下去了。

Instead, A’qiao suspected that Hu had authorised the remarks, while Hu seemed to accept the accusation in silence.
谁知阿巧姐疑心她的话，出于胡雪岩的授意；而胡雪岩居然是默认的模样，

To let such a chance slip would betray the Seventh Lady’s own purpose.
这个机会若是轻轻放过，岂不大负本心？

She therefore composed her face and spoke with great earnestness. “Little Uncle, you must give A’qiao up.
于是，她正一正脸色，显得极郑重地相劝∶『小爷叔！阿巧姐你不能要了。

An onlooker sees clearly.
旁观者清，

I have considered it for you: if you refuse to let go, there will be no end to the trouble.”
我替你想过，如果你一定不肯撒手，受累无穷——。』

She advanced four reasons. First, if A’qiao insisted on establishing a separate household, breaking Mrs Hu’s rule would set husband and wife against each other.
照七姑奶奶的说法，胡雪岩对阿巧姐有『四不可要』∶第一、阿巧姐如果一定要在外面『立门户』，坏了胡太太的家法，会搞得夫妇反目。

Second, even if she agreed to join the family, she would do so unwillingly; the grievance in her heart would destroy harmony between wife and concubine.
第二、即令阿巧姐肯『回去』，亦是很勉强的事，心中有了芥蒂，妻妾之间会失和。

Third, since she had left He Guiqing, and Hu himself had arranged that union, he ought now to avoid suspicion.
第三、阿巧姐既由何家下堂，而且当初是由胡雪岩撮合，如今就该避嫌疑；

Otherwise people might say he had originally offered a beauty in exchange for advancement—a profoundly ugly reputation.
不然，保不定会有人说他当初不过『献美求荣』，这是个极丑的名声。

Fourth, she had come from the pleasure quarters and had seen the great world in a governor-general’s residence.
第四、阿巧姐出身青楼，又在总督衙门见过大世面；

Whether such a woman could settle permanently into respectable life with Hu was very doubtful.
这样的人，是不是能够跟着胡雪岩从良到底，实在大成疑问。

“Little Uncle,” she urged finally, “when Hangzhou fell and Governor Wang died, your roots were cut and your support collapsed.
『小爷叔！』最后七姑奶奶又恳切地劝说，『杭州一失守，王雪公一殉难；你的老根断掉了，靠山倒掉了。

You must begin again.
以后等于要重起炉灶，

It will take real effort to recover your former position.
着实得下一番功夫，才能恢复从前那种场面。

If you were like Fatty Zhang, content to hold what you have and keep the family fed and clothed, I should have nothing to say.
如果说，你是象张胖子那样肯守的，只要一家吃饱穿暖就心满意足，那我没有话说；

But if you mean to build a career, this is the one time when you must not have domestic trouble.
想要创一番事业，小爷叔，你这个时候千万闹不得家务。

More than that, you need your wife’s solid support.
不但闹不得家务，还要婶娘切切实实助你一臂之力才行。

Think carefully what you stand to gain or lose.”
这当中的利害关系，你倒仔细想一想！』

Hu thought the first four reasons little more than alarming suppositions.
前面的『四不可要』，胡雪岩觉得也不过『想当然耳』的危言耸听；

But the last warning—that this was no time for domestic trouble—truly startled him.
最后一句『这个时候千万闹不得家务』，却真的让他悚然心惊了。

“Seventh Sister, you know I am not like Fatty Zhang.
『七姐，你晓得的，我不是张胖子那种人，

I mean not merely to begin again and build a career, but to build a great one.
我不但要重起炉灶创一番事业；而且要大大创它一番事业。

You have reminded me: my mind cannot be in two places at once.
你提醒了我，这个时候心无二用，

Where have I the time for family quarrels?”
哪里有功夫来闹家务——。』

“Exactly!” she broke in. “You may not want domestic trouble, but domestic trouble will come looking for you.
『是啊！』七姑奶奶抢着说∶『你不想闹家务；家务会闹到你头上来！

You cannot push it away or throw it off.
推不开，摔不掉，

That is when you will suffer.”
那才叫苦恼。

“That is just what I fear.
『』我就是怕这个！

It seems I must listen to you.”
看样子，非听你的不可了。

“At last!
『』这才是！

Thank Heaven, Little Uncle, you have come to see it!” she said joyfully.
谢天谢地，小爷叔，你总算想通了。『七姑奶奶高兴地说，』

“A’qiao is a fine woman, of course, but she is not the only one in the world.
阿巧姐自然是好的；不过也不是天下独一无二就是她！

There will be others in the future.”
将来有的是。

“The future!”
『』将来！

Hu stamped his foot. “Let it be for the sake of the future.
『胡雪岩顿一顿足∶』就看在将来上面。

Seventh Sister, let us discuss this properly.”
七姐，我们好好来谈一谈。『


They needed to decide what to do for A’qiao.
要谈的是如何处置阿巧姐。

Here the Seventh Lady hesitated. “To be honest, I must still think of a way.”
提到这一层，七姑奶奶不免踌躇∶『说实话，』她说，『我还要动脑筋！』

Hu seemed uneasy. “There is one thing you must promise me.
『七姐，』胡雪岩似乎很不放心，『我现在有句话，你一定要答应我。

Whatever plan you devise, explain it to me first.”
你动出啥脑筋来，要先跟我说明白。』

This made her a little uncomfortable and a little resentful. “Oh, listen to you! You make it sound as though I might secretly push her into some dreadful fate.”
这话使得七姑奶奶微觉不安，也微有反感∶『哟！哟！你这样子说法，倒象我会瞒着你，拿她推到火炕里去似的。』

She defended herself with considerable feeling.
她很费劲地分辩，

“A’qiao and I have always got on well.
『我跟阿巧姐一向处得很好，

Now, for your sake, I am acting against my conscience, and you seem to blame me for taking too much upon myself—” “Seventh Sister, Seventh Sister!”
现在为了你小爷叔，抹熬良心做事；你好象反倒埋怨我独断独行——。』『七姐，七姐！』

Hu stopped her with a deep bow.
胡雪岩不容她再往下说，兜头长揖，

“I must not be the dog that bites Lü Dongbin and fails to recognise a benefactor.
『我不能「狗咬吕洞宾，不识好人心」，

I merely feel I have wronged her and want to compensate her properly.”
无非我自己觉得对不起她，要想好好补报她一番而已。』

“Do I feel otherwise?
『我还不是这样？

Rest assured.
你放心好了，

I shall never devise anything to harm her.”
我决不会动她的坏脑筋。』

Suddenly her eyes brightened.
说到这里，七姑奶奶的眼睛突然发亮；

A smile broke over her face as she gazed into space.
同时绽开笑靥，望空出神。

A very good idea had occurred to her.
这是动到了极好的脑筋。

Hu dared not interrupt, though he was impatient to hear it.
胡雪岩不敢打搅她；但心里却急得很！渴望她揭开谜底。

She, however, seemed determined to take a little revenge. “I have most of it worked out.
七姑奶奶却似有意报复∶『我想得差不多了。

But forgive me, Little Uncle: I have not begun yet.
不过，小爷对不起，我现在不没有动手，

When I do, I shall explain it clearly, and you will certainly approve.”
到开始做的时候，一定跟你说明白；你也一定会赞成。』

“Why not tell me first?” he asked with an ingratiating smile.
『七姐！』胡雪岩陪笑说道∶『你何妨先跟我说说？』

“No.
『不行，

At least let me think it through before I tell you.
起码要等我想妥当，才能告诉你。』

I am not deliberately keeping you in suspense.
七姑奶奶又说，『不是我故意卖关子，

I am simply not yet sure of it, so I had better say nothing for the moment.”
实在是还没有把握，不如暂且不说的好。』

Her evasions left him entirely uncertain what she was planning.
听她言词闪烁，竟不知她葫芦里卖的什么药？

Knowing her temperament, he realised further questions were useless and gave up with a sigh.
以她的性情，再问亦无用，胡雪岩只好叹口气算了。


The next day Hu called again.
到了第二天，胡雪岩又去看七姑奶奶，

Gu was there too.
恰好古应春也在，

They discussed the approaching arrival of Hu’s family and the need to find a house, furnish it and obtain everyday necessities.
谈起家眷将到，另外要找房子，置家具，备办日用物品，

Normally A’qiao could have been asked to see to these things, but now it seemed awkward to trouble her.
本来可以关照阿巧姐动手的，此刻似乎不便麻烦她了。

“Never mind!”
『不要紧！』

The Seventh Lady was always most enthusiastic about such matters and enjoyed them greatly.
七姑奶奶在这些事上最热心，也最有兴趣，

“Leave it all to me.”
慨然应承∶『都交给我好了。』

Listening beside them, Gu was puzzled.
在一旁静听的古应春，不免困惑，

“Why can A’qiao not help?”
『为啥不能请阿巧姐帮忙？』他问。

“There is a reason,” his wife interrupted. “I shall tell you later.”
『其中自然有道理。』七姑奶奶抢着说∶『回头告诉你。』

“What new device is this?” He warned her, “Do not give Little Uncle ill-considered advice.
『又是什么花样？』古应春跟他妻子提忠告∶『你可不要替小爷叔乱出主意。

At this moment, peace is what matters most.”
现在这个辰光，顶要紧的就是安静二字。』

“Peace is precisely the purpose.”
『正是为了安静两个字。』

She did not want her husband interfering and hurried him along. “Were you not invited to a courtesan banquet?
七姑奶奶不愿丈夫打搅，催着他说∶『不是说，有人请你吃花酒；

You can go now.”
可以走了。』

“One waits for a reminder before going to such a banquet.
『吃花酒要等人来催请，

Who hurries off on his own at this hour?”
哪有这么早，自己赶了去的？』

Gu saw what she meant and thought it best to comply.
古应春看出妻子的意思，觉得还是顺从为妙；

Finding his own way out, he added, “Still, I can visit a friend first.”
所以又自己搭讪着说∶『也好！我先去看个朋友。』

“Wait!” she said.
『慢点！』七姑奶奶说，

“I remember Mr Qin once mentioning that a relative of his had a house on Third Road, available either for sale or under a redeemable property pledge.
『我想起来了，有次秦先生说起，他的亲戚有幢房子在三马路，或卖或典都可以，

Ask about it for Little Uncle.”
你不妨替小爷叔去问一问。』

Mr Qin was the accountant at their firm.
秦先生是她家号子里的帐房。

Obedient to his wife’s command, Gu agreed to question him at once and asked Hu to return for news the following day.
古应春恪遵阃令，答应立刻去看秦先生细问；请胡雪岩第二天来听消息。

“Better still,” she said, “ask Mr Qin to come here early tomorrow.”
『这样吧，』七姑奶奶说，『你索性请秦先生明天一早来一趟。』

“You probably want him to write another letter,” Gu observed.
『大概又是请他写信。』古应春说，

“If he is free tonight, I shall send him over then.”
『如果今天晚上有空，我就叫他来。』


Once her husband had gone, the Seventh Lady returned to A’qiao’s affairs.
于是七姑奶奶等丈夫一走，便又跟胡雪岩谈阿巧姐，

“Little Uncle, is your mind made up?
『小爷叔，』他问∶『你的主意打定了？

You will not regret it later and complain behind my back that I struck apart a pair of loving mandarin ducks?”
将来不会懊悔，背后埋怨我棒打鸳鸯两分离？』

“How could I?
『哪有这样的事？

Do you still not know my temper?”
七姐在现在还不明白我的脾气？』

“I know: you do what you say, and do not regret what you have done.
『我晓得，小爷叔是说到做到、做了不悔的脾气。

Still, I had better ask.
不过，我还是问一声的好，

Since you are determined, I shall begin tomorrow.
既然小爷叔主意打定，明天我就要动手了。

You must merely pretend to know nothing.
你只装不知道，

Whatever unusual thing you notice, keep it to yourself.”
看出什么异样，放在肚子里就是。』

“I understand.
『我懂！』

But what if she presses me with questions?”
胡雪岩问∶『她如果要逼着我问，我怎么样？』

“She will not.
『不会逼着你问的，

Everything will continue as before, without a change.
一切照旧，毫无变动，

What would she ask?”
她问什么？』

“Very well.
『好的！

As we say in Hangzhou, I shall watch the fire from City God Hill.
那就是我们杭州人说的那句话∶』城隍山上看火烧！

I shall wait and enjoy the spectacle.”
「我只等着看热闹了。

Between less intimate friends, this might have sounded offensive or sarcastic.
『如果不是极深的交情，这句话就有讽刺意味的语病了。

Even so, she warned him not to suppose that he had removed himself from the affair.
不过七姑奶奶还是提醒他，不可自以为已经置身事外；

Once the fire began, events might alarm him and draw him in despite himself.
一旦火烧了起来，也许会惊心动魄，身不由主，

He must remain firm, act as though he saw nothing and above all avoid losing his composure and intervening.
那时一定要有定方，视如不见，切忌临时沉不住气，横身插入，

那一来，她说∶『就会引火烧身；我也要受连累，

总而言之一句话，不管阿巧姐说什么，你不要理她！』

Hu’s need to buy a house had given her an idea.
原来七姑奶奶由胡雪岩要买房子，想到一个主意，

She would use it to provoke A’qiao into leaving of her own accord and settle the matter once for all.
决定借这个机会刺激阿巧姐，能把她气走了，一了百了。

但也可能会发生极大的风波，所以特意提出警告。

购屋之事，相当顺利；

The house Mr Qin recommended stood on Third Road near the famous Huajin Lane.
秦先生所介绍的那幢房子，在三马路靠近有名的画锦里，

虽是闹事，但屋宇宏深，关紧大门，就可以隔绝市嚣，等于闹中取静。

Hu liked it very much.
胡雪岩深为中意，

The price was modest too—only two thousand five hundred eagle silver dollars—so he completed the purchase that day.
问价钱也不贵，只有鹰洋两千五百元；所以当天就成交了。

The Seventh Lady was full of zeal.
七姑奶奶奶非常热心，

『小爷叔，』她说，『你再拿一千块钱给我；一切都归我包办。

这三天你去干你的事；

到第四天你来看，是啥样子？』

『这还有啥好说的？

But it is so much trouble for you, Seventh Sister.”
不过，七姐，太费你的心了！』

He knew her ways.
胡雪岩知道她的脾气，

That polite acknowledgement was enough.
这样说句客气话就行了。

If he worried that she was overworking and sent someone to share the burden, he would only displease her.
如果觉得她过于劳累，于心不安，要派人去为她分劳，反使得她不高兴，

He gave her a thousand silver dollars and neither asked nor interfered.
所以交了一千银洋给她，不闻不问。

During the three days he examined the accounts at his own bank and enquired into its business, accomplishing some solid work.
趁这三天功夫，在自己钱庄里盘一盘帐，问一问业务，倒是切切实实做了些事。

On the third day he came home from Fukang Bank in Jixian Lane and found A’qiao with her hair dressed, her face carefully powdered and her lips coloured.
第三天从集贤里阜康钱庄回家，只见阿巧姐头光面滑，点唇涂脂，是打扮过了；

Yet she wore informal clothes.
但身上却穿的是家常衣衫，

Was she about to go out or had she just returned?
不知是正要出门，还是从外面回来？

“I have only just come back.
『我刚回来。

I went to see the Seventh Lady,” she said.
我去看七姑奶奶了。』阿巧姐说，

“The house on Third Road has been made very handsome.”
『三马路的房子，弄得很漂亮啊！』


Her tone was calm, but Hu thought he heard a reproach for keeping it from her.
语气很平静，但在胡雪岩听来，似有怨责他瞒着她的味道；

Embarrassed, he hardly knew how to answer.
因而讪讪地有些无从接口。

“She asked whether I liked the house.
『七姑奶奶问我∶房子好不好？

Naturally I said yes.
我自然说好。

Then she asked if I wanted to live there.
她又问我想不想去住；

Do you know what I told her?
你道我怎么回答她？

That I was not so fortunate.” Hu almost replied, “I fear I am the one without that good fortune,” but checked the words.
我说∶我没有这份福气。』胡雪岩本来想答一句∶只怕是我没有这份福气。话到口边，忽又缩住；

Casually he said, “What good fortune is there in one of these so-called lane houses in the foreign settlement?
用漫不经意的口吻答道∶『住这种夷场上的所谓「弄堂房子」，算啥福气？

When Hangzhou is recovered, I shall build a proper estate beside West Lake.
将来杭州光复，在西湖上好好造一座庄子；

To live in such a paradise would indeed require merit accumulated in a former life.”
住那种洞天福地，可真就要前世修一修了。』

A’qiao said nothing.
阿巧姐不作声，

She went to the dressing table to remove her ornaments, while a maid helped Hu take off his riding jacket and change into slippers.
坐到梳妆台前去卸头面首饰；胡雪岩便由丫头伺候着，脱掉马褂，换上便鞋，

He sat by the window with his tea.
坐在窗前喝茶。

“I think I had better accumulate merit for the next life,” she said suddenly.
『我看，』阿巧姐突然说道∶『我修修来世吧！』

“In the next life we shall be husband and wife,” he answered without thinking.
『来世我们做夫妻。』胡雪岩脱口相答。

Her face changed dramatically.
阿巧姐颜色大变——

He meant that, since she would not become his concubine in this life, he could only hope that in the next they might be one husband and one wife, growing old together.
在胡雪岩的意思，既然她今生不肯嫁胡家的偏房；那就只好期望来世一夫一妻，白头到老。

But she misunderstood.
而阿巧姐误会了！

“I wondered why the Seventh Lady said those things.
『我原在奇怪，七姑奶奶为啥说那些话？

So your heart really has changed!
果不其然，你是变心了！

If you have something to say, say it yourself.
有话你很可以自己说，

Why go round corners and get someone else to do it?”
何必转弯抹角去托人？』


Hu knew he had spoken wrongly.
胡雪岩知道自己失言了。

Yet he could hardly be blamed.
然而也实在不能怪自己；

He had asked the Seventh Lady what to say if A’qiao pressed him about her future.
那天原就问过七姑奶奶，如果阿巧姐逼着要问她的归宿？如何作答。

She had assured him that, with everything unchanged, no questions would arise.
七姑奶奶认为『一切照旧，毫无变动』，她不会问。

But things were different now.
照现在看，情形不同了！

A’qiao had seen the new house; the change had begun.
新居既已为她所见，『变动』便已开始，

She would keep asking, and he could not have her fly into a rage every time, as she had now.
以后她不断会问；总不能每次一问，便象此刻一样，惹得她怨气冲天。

It seemed he must rely on his own ingenuity after all.
看来还是要靠自己动脑筋应付！他这样对自己说；

He began studying her attitude closely.
而且马上很用心地去体察她的态度。

Why did she not consider her own refusal to live with his principal wife?
为什么她不自己想一想，她这样不肯与大妇同住，

She was defying accepted practice and asking the impossible, yet repeatedly accused him of a change of heart.
悖乎常情，强人所准；而偏偏一再要指责他变心？

Could it be that she herself wished to leave but could not say so, and was pressing him and shifting blame in order to make him responsible for the break?
莫非她自己有下堂求去之意，只是说不出口，有意这样诿过，这样逼迫；想把决裂的责任，加在他头上？

The thought seemed almost absurd.
这是个看来近乎荒诞的想法。

Was he judging her with a petty mind?
胡雪岩自问∶果真自己是小人之心？

Not necessarily.
不见得！

She had once given her heart to He Guiqing too.
阿巧姐当初对何桂清亦曾倾心过，

Whatever might be said, in the end she had failed him—and when he was in misfortune.
到后来不管怎么说，总是负心；而且是在何桂清倒霉的时候负心。

Was it not rather naive to regard her as a paragon?
这样看起来，将她看成一个『君子』，似乎也太天真了些。

In that moment Hu felt his own heart harden.
就这一念之间，他自己觉得心肠硬了；

In a quiet voice, almost cold, he said, “I have nothing to say.
用不大带感情的、平静得近乎冷漠的声音说∶『我没有什么话好说。

If you wish to cultivate good fortune for another life, I can only hope that we shall be husband and wife then.”
你愿意修修来世，我当然也只好希望来世再做夫妻。』

She turned and looked directly at him. “You mean you do not want me in this life?”
『你的意思是，今生今世不要我了？』阿巧姐转过脸过来，逼视着他问。

He avoided her eyes.
他将视线避了开去，

“I did not say that.
『我没有说这话，

Only—” He stopped.
不过——。』他没有再说下去。


“Say it!
『说啊！

A grown man should not mumble and hesitate.”
男子汉大丈夫，说话不要吞吞吐吐！』

If she had been willing to yield for the sake of peace, she might have wept at his tone, but would not have pursued the question.
遇到他这种口吻语气，如果她是愿意委屈息事的，至多流泪，不会追问，

By pressing him, she showed that she was prepared for an open break.
既然追问，便有不惜破脸的打算。

Hu felt it was enough to understand her position.
胡雪岩觉得了解她的态度就够了；

There was no need to quarrel now—better never to quarrel, but to part amicably.
此时犯不着跟她破脸——最好永不破脸，好来好散！

He smiled. “Neither of us is a two- or three-year-old child.
于是他笑笑说道∶『我们都不是三岁两岁的小孩，

Why make ourselves ridiculous before the servants?”
这个样子教底下人笑话，何必呢？』

“Hmph!”
『哼！』

She gave a cold laugh and turned back to the mirror to remove her make-up.
阿巧姐冷笑了一下，依然回过脸去，对镜卸妆。

Hu felt thoroughly weary of the place, a feeling he had never known before.
胡雪岩觉得无聊得很。这种感觉是以前所从不曾有过的；

He spent little time at home, but whenever he returned, the mere sight of A’qiao had made it seem the most comfortable place in the world.
他在家的时候不多，所以一回到家，只要看见阿巧姐的影子，便觉得世界上只有这个家最舒服，

Only absolute necessity could draw him out again.
非万不得已，不肯再出门。

Now he wanted to go somewhere—anywhere, even for a walk in the street.
而此刻，却想到哪里去走走；哪怕就在街上逛逛也好。

The impulse grew irresistible.
此念一动，不可抑制；

Rising, he said, “I must go out again.”
站起身来说∶『我还要出去一趟。』

Then, feeling apologetic, he asked, “Is there anything you would like to eat?
说了这话，又觉歉然，因而问道∶『你想吃点啥？

I shall bring it back.”
我替你带回来。』

She merely shook her head, as though even speech were too much trouble.
阿巧姐只摇摇头，似乎连话也懒得说。

A chill passed repeatedly down his back.
胡雪岩觉得背上一阵一阵发冷；

He left at once, going straight downstairs in his slippers, without putting on his riding jacket.
拔步就走，就穿着那双便鞋，也不着马褂，径自下楼而去。


Outside the door he felt at a loss. A’fu, one of his sedan-chair bearers, hurried after him. “Where are you going, sir?
走出大门，不免茫然∶『轿班』阿福赶来问道∶『老爷要到哪里去？

I shall fetch the men.”
我去叫人。』

There were four bearers.
轿班一共四个人；

Hu had said on returning that he would not go out again that evening, so the other three, who lodged at Fukang Bank, had already left.
因为胡雪岩回家时曾经说过，这夜不再出门，所以那三个住在阜康钱庄的都已走了，

Only A’fu remained.
只剩下阿福在家。

“No need!”
『不必！』

Hu waved a hand and went out of the lane alone.
胡雪岩摆一摆手，径自出弄堂而去。

He wandered without purpose, dispirited.
茫然闲步，意兴阑珊；

He tried to think of something pleasant, but could not put A’qiao out of his mind.
心里要想些有趣的事，偏偏抛不开的是阿巧姐。

Her lovely, expressive eyes and enchanting smile remained before him; her soft Wu voice, sweet as an oriole’s, sounded clearly in his ears.
美目盼兮，巧笑倩兮，那些影子都在眼前；其美如莺的吴枕软语亦清清楚楚地响在耳际。

Suddenly he was seized by overwhelming regret.
突然间，胡雪岩有着浓重的悔意；

He turned and walked home at great speed.
掉头就走，而且脚步极快。


The stone-framed outer door was already shut.
到家只见石库墙门已经关上了，

He knocked several times with the bronze ring.
叩了几下铜环，

A’fu opened it, and Hu went straight upstairs.
来开门的仍是阿福；胡雪岩踏进门便上楼，

One glance chilled his heart.
一眼望去，心先凉了！

“Where is your mistress?”
『奶奶呢？』

Pointing to the dark bedroom, he questioned Suxiang, the maid who had come out of another room to meet him.
他指着漆黑的卧室；向从另一间屋里迎出来的丫头素香问说。

“She has gone out.”
『奶奶出去了。』

“Where?”
『到哪里？』

“She did not say.”
『没有说。』

“When did she leave?”
『什么时候走的？』

“As soon as you had gone, she said she was going out.
『老爷一走，奶奶就说要出去。』

I asked her a question and she scolded me: ‘Mind your own business.’”
素香答说∶『我问了一声，奶奶骂我∶少管闲事。』

“How did she go?
『那，怎么走的呢？』

Why did she not take you?”
胡雪岩问∶『为什么没有要你跟去？』

“She would not have me with her.
『奶奶不要我跟去；

She said she would be back shortly.
说是等一息就回来。

I asked if I should hire a chair, and she said she could get one herself at the entrance to the lane.”
我说∶要不要雇顶轿子？她说，她自己到弄堂口会雇的。』

Hu was deeply disappointed and full of misgivings.
胡雪岩大为失望，而且疑虑重重，

He had returned to tell her that everything would remain as before, without a change.
原来想跟阿巧姐来说∶『一切照旧，毫无变动』；

Whatever his wife might say, he had resolved to maintain this separate household.
不管胡太太怎么说，他决意维持这个外室。

Unless A’qiao herself wished to choose another man, he would never change his heart.
除非阿巧姐愿意另外择人而事，他是决不会变心的。

Now all that warmth sank into an abyss.
这一番热念，此刻全都沉入深渊。

Her movements seemed deeply suspicious.
而且觉得阿巧姐的行踪，深为可疑；

Suxiang was her personal maid and always accompanied her outside.
素香是她贴身的丫头，出门总是伴随的，

If she had left the girl behind, she must have gone somewhere the maid could not go—or somewhere she wished to conceal even from Suxiang.
而竟撇下不带，可知所去的这个地方，是素香去不得的，或者说，是她连素香都要瞒住的。


With that thought, an inexpressible bitterness and despondency filled him.
意会到此，心中泛起难以言宣的酸苦抑郁；

He stood in the sitting room without speaking for a long time.
站在客堂中，久久无语。

Suxiang grew frightened.
这使得素香有些害怕，

“Sir,” she asked timidly, “will you dine at home?
怯怯地问道∶『老爷！是不是在家吃饭？

I shall tell the kitchen.”
我去关照厨房。』

“I am not hungry.
『我不饿！』

Where is A’xiang?”
胡雪岩问∶『阿祥呢？』

“A’xiang has gone out.”
『阿祥，出去了。』

“Out?
『出去了！

Where?”
到哪里？』

“You would have to—” Suxiang faltered. “You would have to ask A’fu.”
『要——，』素香吞吞吐吐地说∶『要问阿福。』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第六章（本章第4部分，共5部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Her manner too seemed suspicious, and Hu nearly lost his temper.
这神态亦颇为可疑，胡雪岩忍不住要发怒；

Then he steadied himself.
但一转念间冷静了，

“Fetch A’fu.”
『你叫阿福来！』他说。

Once the bearer had been called and questioned, the truth emerged.
等把阿福喊来一回，才知究竟，

A’xiang was “amusing himself” at a little grocery nearby.
阿祥是在附近的一家小杂货店『白相』。

Its elderly owners had only one child, a daughter of seventeen.
那家杂货店老夫妇两个，只有一个十七岁的女儿；

Hu had seen her: she resembled a cheerful Wuxi clay doll, with a plump, round face and a smile that never left it.
胡雪岩也见过，生得象『无锡大阿福』，圆圆胖胖的一张脸，笑口常开。

A’xiang had set his heart on her.
阿祥情有所钟，

As soon as Hu went out, he would linger in the shop, acting as an unpaid assistant and errand boy, without even receiving his meals.
只等胡雪岩一出门，便到那家杂货店去盘桓；是他家不支薪工饭食的伙计兼跑街。

“If you want him, sir, I shall fetch him.”
『老爷要喊他，我去把他叫回来。』

“No need.”
『不必！』

The news made Hu feel rather better.
胡雪岩听得这段『新闻』；心里舒服了些，

He might as well leave A’qiao aside and concern himself with A’xiang’s affairs.
索性丢下阿巧姐来管阿祥的闲事，

“That sounds promising.
『照这样说，蛮有意思了！

What is the girl’s name?”
那家的女儿，叫啥名字？』

“The same as—” A’fu struggled to get the words out. “The same familiar name as our mistress.”
『跟——，』阿福很吃力地说∶『跟奶奶的小名一样。』

So she too was called A’qiao.
原来也叫阿巧，

“A coincidence indeed!” Hu laughed with interest.
『那倒真是巧了！』胡雪岩兴味盎然地笑着。


“I told A’xiang not to call her directly by her name.
『我跟阿祥说，你叫人家的时候，不要直呼直令地叫人家的名字；

It is our mistress’s name too, and a servant ought not to be so disrespectful.”
那样子犯了奶奶的讳。做下人的不好这样子没规矩。』

This was the sort of observation one expected from a man versed in books and propriety.
这是知书识礼的人才会有的见解，

Hearing it from a muddy-legged chairbearer surprised and pleased Hu.
不想出现在两条烂泥腿的轿班身上，胡雪岩既惊异又高兴；

But his questions remained about A’xiang.
但口中问的还是阿祥。

“What does he call her, then?
『他不叫人家小名叫啥？』

Sister?
胡雪岩问∶『莫非叫姐姐、

Little Sister?
妹妹？

That would be rather sickly.”
那不是太麻肉了。』

“Yes, far too sickly.
『是啊！那也太肉麻。

He told me they never use each other’s names.
阿祥告诉我说，他跟人家根本彼此都不叫名字，

They simply say ‘Hey!’ to one another.
两个人都是「喂」呀「喂」的。

When he speaks of her to her parents, he calls her ‘your young lady’.”
在她父母面前提起来，阿祥是说「你们家大小姐」。』

“Excellent!”
『这倒妙！』

Hu thought that when a young man and woman needed only “Hey!” and recognised each other by their voices, theirs was no ordinary acquaintance.
胡雪岩心想男女之间，彼此都用『喂』字称呼，辨声知人，就决不是泛泛的情分了；

But how did her parents feel?
只不知道∶『她父母对阿祥怎么样？』

“They are very pleased with him.”
『她家父母对阿祥蛮中意的。』

“How pleased?
『怎么叫蛮中意？』

Do they regard him as a prospective son-in-law?”
胡雪岩问∶『莫非当他「毛脚女婿」看待？』

“Something like that.”
『也差不多有那么点意思。』

“Then you ought to lend a hand and earn a cup of wedding wine.”
『既然如此，你们应该出来管管闲事，吃他一杯喜酒啊！』

“A’xiang was bought into your household, sir.
『阿祥是老爷买来的，

Everything must be decided by you.
凡事要听老爷作主；

We would not dare interfere.
我们怎么敢管这桩闲事，

Besides, we could not arrange it.”
再说，这桩闲事也管不了。』

“Why not?”
『怎么呢？』

“A wedding needs—” Hu understood and nodded. “I see.
『办喜事要——。』胡雪岩会意，点点头说∶『我知道了。

Fetch him for me.”
你把阿祥替我去叫回来。』


Before a cup of tea could have been drunk, A’xiang was back.
用不到一盏茶的功夫，阿祥被找了回来。

His embarrassed expression showed that A’fu had explained the matter on the way.
脸上讪讪地，有些不大好意思；显然的，他在路上就已听阿福说过，知道是怎么一回事了。

“How old are you?”
『你今年十几？』

“Seventeen.”
『十七。』

“Seventeen!”
『十七！』

Hu hesitated slightly.
胡雪岩略有些踌躇似的，

“Rather early.”
『是早了些。』

After a pause he asked, “And how old is ‘their young lady’?”
他停了一下又问∶『「他们家大小姐」几岁？』

He was playfully repeating A’xiang’s own phrase, but it sounded like mockery to the boy, who grew painfully embarrassed.
这句对阿巧的称呼，是学着阿祥说的；自是玩笑，听来却有讥嘲之意，阿祥大窘，

“Two months older than I am.
嗫嚅着说∶『比我大两月，

I was born in the ninth month; her birthday is the seventh of the seventh month.”
我是九月里生的，她的生日是七月七。』

“You even know her birth particulars!”
『连人家的时辰八字都晓得了！』

Hu could scarcely keep from laughing, but restrained himself to preserve his dignity. “What is the family’s surname?”
胡雪岩有此忍俊不禁；但为了维持尊严，不得不忍笑问道∶『那家人家姓啥？』

“Wei.”
『姓魏。』

“How does Mr Wei treat you?
『魏老板对你怎么样？』

Is he thinking of giving you his daughter?
胡雪岩说，『不是预备拿女儿给你？

Do not be shy.
你不要难为情，

Tell me the truth.”
跟我说实话。』

“Of course I would tell you the truth, sir.
『我跟老爷当然说实话。』

Mr Wei has said nothing, but his wife has dropped a hint.
阿祥答道∶『魏老板倒没有说什么；老板娘有口风透露了，

She says they have only one daughter and cannot bear to part with her.
她说∶他们老夫妇只有一个女儿，舍不得分开。

Whoever marries her must join their household.”
要娶她女儿就要入赘。』

“What did you say?”
『你怎么说呢？』

“I pretended not to understand.”
『我装糊涂。』

“Why?
『为啥？』

Are you unwilling to marry into the Wei family?”
胡雪岩说∶『是不肯入赘到魏家？』

“It would be no use if I were willing.
『我肯也没有用。

I have taken my master’s surname.
我改姓了主人家的姓，

How could I change it again to Wei?”
怎么再去姓魏？』

“You have a conscience, at least.”
『你倒也算是有良心的。』

Hu nodded approvingly.
胡雪岩满意地点点头，

“I shall see what can be done.”
『我自有道理。』

That plainly meant the happy outcome was possible.
这当然是好事可谐了！

A’xiang was delighted.
阿祥满心欢喜；

Yet he was still shy.
但脸皮到底还薄，

He knew this was an excellent opportunity, but could not bring himself to ask and settle the matter while the chance was before him.
明知是个极好的机会，却不敢开口相求，就此『敲打转脚』拿好事弄定了它。


Saying nothing left him awkward and uncomfortable, so he found an excuse to speak. “You have probably not eaten, sir.
不说话却又感到僵手僵脚，一身不自在；于是搭讪着问道∶『老爷恐怕还没有吃饭？

I shall tell them.” He called, “Suxiang!
我来关照他们！』接着便喊∶『素香，

Suxiang!”
素香！』

She emerged from the servants’ room without looking him in the face.
素香从下房里闪了出来，正眼都不看阿祥；

Passing him, she muttered, “Must you call as though summoning a soul?” Then she asked Hu, “Did you call me, sir?”
走过他面前，低低咕哝了一句∶『叫魂一样叫！』然后到胡雪岩面前问道∶『老爷叫我？』

He saw it all and understood.
做主人的看在眼里，恍然大悟；

No wonder she had seemed reluctant to answer when he asked where A’xiang was.
怪不得问她阿祥在哪里？她有点懒得答理的模样！

She was jealous of his attachment to the Wei girl.
原来阿祥跟魏阿巧好了，她在吃醋。

The falling blossom was willing, but the flowing water felt nothing: A’xiang had disappointed her.
照此说来，落花有意，流水无情；阿祥倒辜负她了。

Hu felt sorry for her.
这样想着，便有些替素香委屈。

Yet there was no reason to interfere blindly and upset what was already taking shape.
不过事到如今，没有胡乱干预，扰乱已成之局的道理，

He could only pretend not to understand and find her something to do.
惟有装作不解；找件事差遣素香去做。


“I shall not dine at home.” He told A’xiang, “Go straight to Mr Zhang and say I invite him for wine.
『我不在家吃饭了。』他嘱咐阿祥∶『你马上到张老板那里去，说我请他吃酒。

What is the name of the tavern at the entrance to the lane?”
弄堂口那家酒店叫啥字号？』

“Wang Baohe.”
『叫王宝和。』

“I shall wait for him there.
『我在王宝和等他。

Be quick, and ask him to come at once.”
你去快点，请他马上来。』

“Yes, sir!”
『是！』

The boy answered as loudly as though he had received a general’s command, then hurried downstairs.
阿祥如奉了将军令一般，高声答应，急步下楼。

After he had gone, Hu finished the tea Suxiang had poured and went out too.
等他一走，胡雪岩喝完一杯素香倒来的茶，也就出门了。

As he looked into Wang Baohe, the sharp-eyed proprietor hurried forward, bowing repeatedly. “What brings Your Excellency here?
走到王宝和，朝里一望；王老板眼尖，急忙迎了出来，哈腰曲背地连连招呼∶『胡大人怎么有空来？

Are you looking for someone?”
是不是寻啥人？』

“No.
『不是！

I have come for a drink.”
到你这里来吃酒。』

Mr Wang was overwhelmed by the honour. “Please come in!
王老板顿时有受宠若惊之感∶『请！请！

The private table is free.
正好雅座有空。

You have chosen just the right moment.”
胡大人来得巧了。』

The private space was a small projecting recess, about a square zhang, furnished with a narrow side table and a square dining table.
所谓雅座是凸出的一块方丈之地，一张条案配着一张八仙桌；

On the side table stood a shrine containing a tablet to the ancestors of the Wang family.
条案上还供着一座神龛，内中一方『王氏昭穆宗亲之位』的神牌。

The setting deepened Hu’s homesickness.
胡雪岩看这陈设，越发勾起乡思；

He seemed to be in a little tavern near Salt Bridge in Hangzhou, remembering the days when he and Fatty Zhang would drink together in their leisure.
仿佛置身在杭州盐桥附近的小酒店中，记起与张胖子闲来买醉的那些日子了。

“Your Excellency, I shall open a jar of genuine Shaoxing Huadiao—guaranteed.
『胡大人，我开一坛如假包换的绍兴花雕；

Try it.”
您老人家尝尝看。』

“As you please.
『随你。』

What have you to eat with it?”
胡雪岩问∶『有啥下酒菜？』

“Razor clams have just come into season.
『蛏子刚上市。

There are tender whip bamboo shoots too, as well as soy-braised duck and chicken in wine lees.”
还有鞭笋；嫩得很。再就是酱鸭，糟鸡。』

“Bring them all.
『都拿来好了。

And two other things: one-legged crabs and fried stinking bean curd.”
另外要两样东西，「独脚蟹」，油炸臭豆腐干。』

“One-legged crabs” meant sprouted beans, available in every tavern, large or small.
『独脚蟹』就是发芽豆，大小酒店必备；

The bean curd was harder.
油炸臭豆腐干就难了，

“The vendors have all passed by at this hour,” Mr Wang said.
『这时候，担子都过去了。』王老板说，

“I do not know whether any can still be found.”
『还不知有没有？』

“I must have it,” Hu insisted.
『一定要！』胡雪岩固执地说，

“Send someone a little farther to look.
『你叫个人，多走两步路去找，

He must bring some back.”
一定要买来！』

“Certainly, certainly!
『是，是！

We shall find it.”
一定买来，一定买来！』王老板一叠连声地答应，

Mr Wang sent a young apprentice searching, with particular orders to hurry back.
叫个小徒弟遍处去找，还特地关照一句∶『快去快回。』


Hu began drinking alone.
于是，胡雪岩先独酌。

Of all the dishes on the table, he touched only the sprouted beans.
一桌子的酒菜，他单取一样发芽豆；

What he savoured was not the beans, but the little pleasures wrested from hardship in his humble days.
咀嚼的不是豆子，而是寒微辰光那份苦中作乐的滋味。

An inexpressible mixture of pain, comfort and lingering longing filled him.
心里是说不出的那种既辛酸、又安慰的隽永向往的感觉。

Suddenly he looked up and saw Fatty Zhang smiling before him.
一抬眼突然发觉，张胖子笑嘻嘻地站在面前；

Only then did he realise how far his thoughts had wandered.
才知道自己是想得出神了。

Collecting himself, he asked, “Have you eaten?”
定定神问道∶『吃了饭没有？』

“I was just having a drink when A’xiang arrived.”
『正在吃酒，阿祥来到。』

Zhang sat down. “You must be at leisure today, to think of drinking here.”
阿胖子坐下来问道∶『今天倒清闲；居然想到这里来吃酒？』

“Not at leisure.
『不是清闲，

At a loose end.”
是无聊。』

Zhang had never heard such dispirited words from him.
张胖子从未听他说过这种泄气的话，

His eyes widened and he was about to ask, but the fragrance of the warmed wine reached him, and drinking took precedence.
不由得张大了眼想问∶但烫来的酒，糟香扑鼻，就顾不得说话先要喝酒了。

“Fine wine!” he declared after a sip, smacking his lips.
『好酒！』他喝了一口说；啧啧地咂着嘴唇，

“True Shaoxing Huadiao.”
『嫡路绍兴花雕。』

“However fine it is, it cannot taste as good as the spirits we drank at Salt Bridge.”
『酒再好，也比不上我们在盐桥吃烧酒的味道好。』

“Oh!”
『呕！』

Zhang looked around.
张胖子抬头四顾，

“This does resemble the Chunhao tavern we used to frequent.”
『倒有点象我们常常去光顾的那家「纯号」酒店。』

“Who knows what has become of it?” Hu sighed faintly and drained a bowl.
『现在也不晓得怎么样了？』胡雪岩微微叹息着；一仰脸，干了一碗。

“You must not drink like that.
『你这个酒，不能这样子喝！

You will be drunk.”
要吃醉的。』

Zhang set down his own cup, looking troubled. “What has upset you?”
张胖子停杯不饮，愁眉苦脸地说∶『啥事情不开心？』

“Nothing.
『没有啥！

I miss Hangzhou, and the old days.
有点想杭州，有点想从前的日子。

Old Zhang, ‘Never forget friends made in poverty; never cast out the wife who shared your bran and chaff.’
老张，「贫贱之交不可忘，糟糠之妻不下堂」；

Here, I drink to you.”
来，我敬你！』

Zhang did not know what had stirred him and watched uneasily. “Less, less!
张胖了不知他是何感触？惴惴然看着他说∶『少吃点，少吃点！

Take it slowly.”
慢慢来。』

Fortunately, Hu was broad-minded and well behaved in drink.
还好，胡雪岩是心胸开阔的人，酒德甚好；

After two bowls he wanted to think only of pleasant things.
两碗酒下肚，只想高兴的事。

Remembering A’xiang, he asked, “Old Zhang, do you know the owner of the grocery up ahead? His name is Wei.”
想到阿祥，便即问道∶『老张，前面有家杂货店，老板姓魏，你认不认识？』


“We are in the same trade.
『我们是同行，

Of course I know him.
怎么不认识？

You must have a reason for asking.”
你问起他，总有缘故吧？』

“He has a daughter called A’qiao, with a round face—the sort of face that promises sons.
『他有个女儿，也叫阿巧，长得圆圆的脸，倒是宜男之相。

You must know her well too?”
你总也很熟？』

Zhang’s interest awakened.
听这一说，张胖子的兴致来了，

He sat up briskly and looked at Hu, nodding as he answered slowly, “Very well.
精神抖擞地坐直了身了，睁了眼睛看着胡雪岩，一面点头，一面慢吞吞地答道∶『我很熟，

She comes to my shop every week or so.”
十天、八天总要到我店里来一趟。』

“Why?”
『为啥？』

“When her father needs money to restock, he borrows from me.
『她老子进货，到我这里来拆头寸；

She is always the one he sends.”
总是她来。』

“Then his little grocery must be rather hard pressed.”
『这样说，他这个杂货店也可怜巴巴的。』

“Yes.
『是啊，

He has always had very little capital.
本来是小本经营。』张胖子说，

That is just what you want.
『就要他这样才好。

If the family were comfortably off and cared little for money, her parents might not agree.”
如果是殷实的话，铜钾银子上不在乎；做父母的就未必肯了。』

“Agree to what?”
『肯什么？』

Hu did not understand.
胡雪岩不懂他的话。

“You tell me!
『问你啊！

Did you not say she had a face that promised sons?”
不是说她宜男之相？』

Hu stared, then suddenly understood.
胡雪岩楞了一下，突然意会；

He sprayed out a mouthful of wine and hastily turned aside, coughing and laughing, while Zhang was left completely bewildered.
一口酒直喷了出来，赶紧转过脸去，一面呛，一面笑。将个张胖子搞得丈二金刚摸不着头。

“Old Zhang, you have spent your whole life thinking yourself clever.
『啊老张，你一辈子就是喜欢自作聪明；

Where has your imagination taken you?”
你想到哪里去了？』

“Were you not thinking of taking a concubine who could bear you sons?” Zhang asked hesitantly.
『你，』张胖子嗫嚅着说，『你不是想讨个会养儿子的小？』

“That is why I say you are too clever by half.
『所以说，你是自作聪明。

Nothing of the sort!
哪有这回事？

But there is a marriage to arrange, and I still want you to be the matchmaker.” He then told Zhang the whole story of A’xiang and the Wei girl’s affection.
不过，谈的倒也是喜事；媒人也还是要请你去做。』接着，胡雪岩便将阿祥与阿巧的那一段情，都说给了张胖子听。


“Excellent!” Zhang said delightedly.
『好啊！』张胖子秀高兴地，

“This match certainly will not become a bowl of ‘spring-plum pulp’.”
『这个媒做来包定不会「春梅浆」！』

That was a Hangzhou expression.
『春梅浆』是杭州的俗语，

If a matchmaker brought together an unhappy couple, both families blamed him.
做媒做成一对怨偶，男女两家都嗔怨媒人，

Every dispute was referred back to him for negotiation, burdening him without end; such a predicament was called “spring-plum pulp”.
有了纠纷，责成媒人去办交涉，搞得受累无穷，就叫『春梅浆』。

Zhang’s words showed that he approved of the match, which made Hu feel still more satisfied with what he was doing.
老张说这话，就表示他对这头姻缘，亦很满意；使得胡雪岩越发感到此事做得惬意称心。

In his good humour, he made the terms more generous.
一高兴之下，又将条件放宽了。


“Tell Mr Wei that A’xiang may marry into his household, but may not change his surname.
『你跟魏老板去说，入赘可以，改姓不可以；

With her son-bearing looks, there should be no shortage of sons.
既然他女儿是宜男之相，不怕儿子不多，

Mr Wei can choose one to continue his family line.
将来他自己挑一个顶他们魏家的香烟好了。

I shall put A’xiang into the grocery trade too, lending him a thousand silver dollars as capital.”
至于阿祥，我叫他也做杂货生意；我借一千银洋给他做本钱。』

“Then there is no need to discuss a separate betrothal payment.
『既然这样，也就不必谈聘金不聘金了。

The groom’s side can provide everything—the trousseau, the feast and the rest.
嫁妆、酒席，一切都是男家包办；

Once the marriage ceremony is held, the two households will become one.
拜了堂，两家并作一家。

Mr Wei need spend nothing, and he will have a son-in-law to support them in old age.
魏老板不费分文，有个女婿养他们的老，

Such favourable terms should satisfy him completely.
有这样便宜的好事，他也该心满意足了。

You will see: I shall settle it tomorrow, and we can choose a day for the wedding at once.”
你看我，明天一说就成功；马上挑日子办喜事。』

“Then I entrust it to you.
『那就重重拜托。

I shall have a red packet ready to thank the matchmaker.”
我封好谢媒的红包，等你来拿。』

“Thank me?
『谢什么媒！

Have you not helped me often enough already?”
你帮我的忙还帮得少了不成？』


Just then the apprentice arrived with a great plate of fried stinking bean curd.
谈到这里，小徒弟捧来一大盘油炸臭豆腐干；

Hu had no time for further talk.
胡雪岩不暇多说，

He ate three pieces in succession, almost wolfing them down, which gave the talkative Zhang another opening.
一连吃了三块，有些狼吞虎咽的模样，便又惹得爱说话的张胖子要开口了。

“You leave the other dishes alone, but how you enjoy those sprouted beans and that bean curd!”
『看你别的菜不吃，发芽豆跟臭豆腐干倒吃得起劲！』

Hu nodded and set down his chopsticks. “My old sworn brother Ji Heling once told me a story. A poor scholar went to live in a temple and became friends with an old monk.
胡雪岩点点头，停箸答道∶『我那位老把兄嵇鹤龄，讲过一个故事给我听∶从前有个穷书生，去庙里住；跟一个老和尚做了朋友。

The monk would dig up taro roots and roast them in hot ashes, and the scholar ate them with delight.
老和尚常常掘些芋头，煨在热灰里；穷书生吃得津津有味。

Later, after ten years of study in obscurity, the scholar won fame at a single stroke, rose rapidly and became a great official.
到后来穷书生十年寒窗无人问，一举成名天下知，飞黄腾达，做了大官。

Returning home in glory, he remembered the flavour of those taros and went specially to visit the monk and taste them again.
衣锦还乡，想到煨芋头的滋味，特地去拜访老和尚，要尝一尝，

This time he said they were no good.
一尝之下，说不好吃。

The monk answered, ‘The taros have not changed.
老和尚答他一句∶芋头没有变，

You have.’
你人变了！

My wish for beans and stinking bean curd today means something rather like that.”
我今天要吃发芽豆跟臭豆腐干，也就仿佛是这样一种意思。』

“So that is it!
『原来如此！

You remember how those were always the two things we ate with a bowl of wine at Chunhao.” Zhang asked, “Now you have tasted them, do they taste as they did before?”
你倒还记得，当初我们在纯号「摆一碗」，总是这两样东西下酒。』张胖子接着又问∶『现在你尝过了，是不是从前的滋味？』

“Yes.”
『是的。』

“That is remarkable!”
『那倒难得！』

His tone suggested he doubted Hu’s sincerity.
张胖子有点笑他言不由衷的意味，

“Shark’s fin and sea cucumber have not spoiled your palate?”
『鱼翅海参没有拿你那张嘴吃刁？』

“You misunderstand.
『你弄错了，

I did not say they tasted good.
我不是说它们好吃！

They did not then, and they do not now.”
从前不好吃，现在还是不好吃。』

“I do not understand that!
『这话我就不懂了！

Why eat what you do not like?
不好吃何必去吃它？』张胖子说。

We ate them countless times in the old days, and I never heard you say they were no good.”
『从前也不晓得吃过多少回，从来没有听你说过，发芽豆、臭豆腐干不好吃。』

“There is no need to say it.
『不好吃，不必说；

Find a way to get better things to eat.
想法子去弄好吃的来吃。

Empty talk achieves nothing; it only makes others unwilling to endure hardship.”
空口说白话，一点用都没有；反而害得人家都不肯吃苦了！』

These words left Zhang staring for a long time before he could speak.
这几句话说得张胖子楞住了，怔怔地看了他好半天，

“Old Hu, we have been friends far longer than three or five years, but only today have I understood your nature.
方始开口∶『老胡，我们相交不是三年、五年；到今天我才晓得你的本性。

No wonder!
这就难怪了！

You have climbed from apprentice to great proprietor, while I have gone from senior bank clerk to owner of a tiny grocery.
你由学生意爬到今天大老板的地位；我从钱庄大伙计弄到开小杂货店，

There is a reason for both.”
都是有道理的。』

The habitually cheerful Zhang was suddenly overcome by feeling, and his face grew gloomy.
一向笑嘻嘻的张胖子，忽然大生感触，面有抑郁之色。

Hu understood the disappointment beneath his complaint.
胡雪岩从他的牢骚话中，了解他不得意的心情；

They had shared poverty and adversity for so many years that he too felt distressed.
多年的患难贫贱之交，心里自然也很难过。


He wanted sincerely to comfort his friend.
他真想安慰他。

He thought of the plan he had discussed with Liu Bucai and Gu Yingchun.
因而想到跟刘不才与古应春所商量的计划，

Once they had made contact with Little Zhang of Hangzhou and Sun Xiangtai of Jiaxing, they intended to trade on a large scale in imported and southern goods.
不久联络好了杭州的小张和嘉兴的孙祥太，预备大举贩卖洋广杂货，

Why not give Fatty Zhang a share?
不正好让张胖子也凑一股？

Naturally Hu would advance the capital.
股本当然是自己替他垫；

Zhang need only lend a hand; it would certainly offer more promise than clinging to a little grocery.
只要他下手帮忙；无论如何比株守一爿小杂货店来得有出息。

He was about to speak when he thought better of it.
话已经要说出口了，想想不妥；

Zhang could not keep his mouth shut, and the trading scheme served a particular purpose.
张胖子嘴不紧，而这个贩卖洋广杂货的计划，是有作用的，

He ought not to know of it.
不宜让他与闻。

Better to find another way of helping him.
要帮他的忙，不如另打主意。

After a moment, an idea came.
想了一下，倒是有个主意，

“Old Zhang, I know that your present position is beneath you.
『老张，』他说，『我也晓得你现在委屈。

But the times are wrong.
不过时世不对，

You must hold on for a while.
暂时要守一守。

You know my bank: with its old roots in Hangzhou cut off, its living source of funds is gone.
我的钱庄，你晓得的，杭州的老根一断，就没有源头活水了！

We too are struggling to keep it going.
现在也是苦撑在那里的局面。

There is certainly hope, but work must be put into it.
希望是一定有的；要摆功夫下去。

Would you come and help me?”
你肯不肯来帮帮我的忙？』

“Between us, willingness does not enter into it.
『你我的交情，谈不到肯不肯。

But forgive me, Old Hu: I have had my heart chilled by banking.
不过，老胡，实在对不起，饭庄饭我吃得寒心了；

Think of my former employer.
你想想，我从前那个东家，

I worked so hard for him, and in the end he turned against me.
我那样子替他卖力，弄到临了，翻脸不认人。

Without your great help, I might have faced a lawsuit.
如果不是你帮我一个大忙，吃官司都有份。

From that day I swore never to earn my living in a bank again.
从那时候起，我就罚过咒，再不吃钱庄饭！

However small my own business, at least I am its proprietor.”
自己小本经营，不管怎么样，也是个老板。』

Realising he had spoken awkwardly, he hurried to qualify it. “With you, naturally, it would be different.
说到这里，张胖子自觉失言；赶紧又作补充∶『至于对你，情形当然不同。

But I swore not to work in another man’s bank, and I made that oath kneeling before Lord Guan.
不过我罚过咒，不帮人家做饭庄；这个咒是跪在关帝菩萨面前罚的，

It is not a thing to treat lightly.
不好当耍。

A thousand words come to one: I am sorry, Old Hu.”
老胡，千言万语并一句∶对不对你！』

He raised his cup in apology.
说完，举杯表示道歉。


“I cannot drink to that.
『这杯酒，我不能吃。

Let me ask you two questions.
我有两句话请问你，

Your oath was that you would not work in someone else’s bank?”
你罚咒，是不帮人家做钱庄？』

“Yes.”
『是的。』

“That is, you would not be another man’s clerk?”
『就是说，不给人家做伙计？』

“Exactly!” Zhang answered emphatically.
『是的！』张胖子重重地回答。

“Then understand this first, Old Zhang: I am not asking you to become a clerk at Fukang.”
『那末，老张，你先要弄清楚，我不是请你做阜康的伙计。』

“What, then?” Zhang asked in surprise.
『做啥？』张胖子愕然相问。

“A shareholder.
『做股东。

In effect, your own proprietor.
等于你自己做老板！

However solemn your oath, that cannot violate it.”
这样子，随便你罚多重的咒，都不会应了。』

“A shareholder!”
『做股东！』

He was tempted.
张胖子心动了，

“But I have no capital.”
『不过，我没有本钱。』

“I shall lend it to you.
『本钱我借你。

I shall assign ten thousand taels as your share.
我划一万银子，算你的股份；

You will manage the business and draw a separate salary.
你来管事，另外开一份薪水。』

I have thought of a solution for your grocery too: transfer it to A’xiang, and he will naturally combine it with his father-in-law’s.
胡雪岩说，『你那家小杂货店，我也替你想好了出路；盘给阿祥，他自然并到他丈人那里。

Does that not all follow neatly?”
你看，这不是顺理成章 的事？』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第六章（本章第5部分，共5部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


With such terms and such friendship behind them, Fatty Zhang ought, by all ordinary reasoning, to have accepted without hesitation.
这样的条件，这样的交情，照常理说，张胖子应该一诺无辞；

Yet he still wavered.
但他仍在踌躇，

For one thing, the blow he had suffered in banking had truly chilled his heart.
因为第一，钱庄这一行，他受过打击，确实有些寒心；

For another, friendship required feeling to be repaid with feeling: precisely because Hu Xueyan treated him so generously, he must consider whether he could open up new business and put the bank in order.
第二，交朋友将心换心，惟其胡雪岩如此厚爱，自己就更得忖量一下，倘或接手以后，没有把握打开局面，整顿内部，

If he could not be sure of doing so, it would be better to decline now and preserve their friendship than to disappoint his friend later.
让好朋友失望，倒不如此刻辞谢，还可以保全交情。

Of course, he could neither bring himself to refuse nor bear to let the opportunity go.
当然，他说不出辞绝的话，而且也舍不得辞绝；

After thinking it over and over, he said, “Let me look into it first.”
考虑了又考虑，说了句∶『让我先看一看再说。』

“Look into it?
『看？

There is no need!” Hu replied. “Fukang is naturally less lively than it was when Governor Wang was alive.
你用不着看了！』胡雪岩说∶『阜康的情形比起从前王雪公在世的时候那样热闹，自然显得差了。

Compared with the other Shanghai banks, I can honestly say that we fall short of the best but stand well above the worst.
跟上海的同行比一比，老实说一句，比上不足，比下着实有余。

There is absolutely no deficit.
阜康决没有亏空，

Our borrowers are reliable, and the few large depositors are all substantial men.
放款出去的户头，都是靠得住的；几个大存户亦都殷实得很，

They will not all descend on us to withdraw their money at once.
不至于一下子都来提款。

The trouble is that I cannot give it my whole attention.
毛病是我不能拿全副精神摆在上头；

The chief clerk I engaged is a straightforward fellow, but his health is poor; the place has become lifeless and never gets ahead.
原来请的那个大伙，人既老实，身子又不好，所以弄得死气沉沉，没有起色。

With you there, things would certainly be different.
你去了，当然会不同；

Let me provide an idea or two and you carry them through.
等我来出两个主意，请你一手去做，

Working together, we shall polish Fukang’s signboard until it shines like gold again.”
同心协力拿阜康这块招牌再刷得它金光闪亮。』

Put that way, the venture was worth undertaking.
照这样说，大可一干；

Still, Zhang asked, “In exactly what capacity am I to join Fukang?
不过，『我到底是啥身分到阜康呢？』他说，

You know the rules of banking.”
『钱庄的规矩，你是晓得的。』

By those rules, authority rested entirely with the chief clerk; shareholders were not to interfere.
钱庄的规矩，大权都在大伙手里，股东不得过问；

Hu had already thought this through.
胡雪岩原就有打算的，

“In relation to me, you are a shareholder,” he answered without hesitation.
毫不迟疑地答道∶『对我来说，你是股东；

“In relation to Fukang, you are the chief clerk.
对阜康来说，你是大伙。

You will be working for yourself, not serving another man.”
你不是替人家做伙计，是替自己做。』

The explanation was complete, and Zhang was satisfied.
这个解释很圆满，张胖子表示满意，

“Then it is settled,” he said firmly.
毅然决然地答道∶『那就一言为定。

“You supply the ideas; I carry them out.
主意你来出，事情我来做；

You represent us outside; I take charge within.”
对外是你出面，在内归我负责。』

“Excellent!
『好极！

That is exactly what I mean—”
我正就是这个意思——。』


“Wait!”
『慢来。』

A sudden thought struck Zhang, and he asked urgently, “What about the man already there?”
张胖子突然想到，迫不及待地问∶『原来的那位老兄呢？』

“You need not worry about him.
『这你不必担心。

His health is poor, and his son has made his way in the world.
他身体不好，而且儿子已经出道；

He is a comprador with an American trading firm and has long urged his father to retire and enjoy life.
在美国人的洋行里做「康白度」，老早就劝他回家享福。

The old fellow is grateful for my treatment of him.
他因为我待他不错，

He has offered his resignation several times, but when I refused to let him go he felt ashamed to insist.
虽然辞过几次，我不放他，也就不好意思走。

He could wish for nothing better than to have you take over.”
现在有你去接手，在他真正求之不得。』

Zhang was relieved.
张胖子释然了，

“I was afraid of breaking another man’s rice bowl.”
『我就怕敲了人家饭碗！』

Once more he grew reflective.
他又生感慨，

“My own employer treated me badly.
『我的东家不好；

We must not make him say behind our backs that his employer treated him badly too.”
不能让他也在背后骂东家不好。』

“Do you think I am that sort of man?” Hu asked.
『你想想我是不是那种人？』胡雪岩问道，

“Old Zhang, once a gentleman gives his word, four horses cannot overtake it.
『老张，君子一言，驷马难追；

From this moment, we are partners.
从此刻起，我们就算合伙了！

Now let us talk business.
倒谈谈生意经；

How do you think we should proceed?”
你看，我们应该怎么个做法？』

That stumped Zhang.
这一下，将张胖子问住了。

He had begun as an apprentice and risen step by step to chief clerk.
他是钱庄学徒出身，按部就班做到大伙，

Before advising on internal management he would have to examine the actual position, and before discussing expansion he would have to study the market.
讲内部管理，要看实际情形而定；谈到外面的发展，也要先了解了解市面。

Asked to produce an idea out of thin air, he was helpless.
如要他凭空想个主意出来，可就抓瞎了。

At last he said, “The price of silver fluctuates sharply nowadays.
想了好一会，他说∶『现在的银价上落很大；

With prompt information, we could make a handsome profit simply buying and selling.”
如果消息灵通，兑进兑出一转手之间，利息不小。』

“Certainly.
『这当然。

You can deal with that yourself; there is no need to consult me.
归你自己去办，用不着商量。』

What we must discuss is how to let out a long line and fly our kite far ahead: three years from now, once affairs have settled down, how can we make a sudden leap into prosperity?”
胡雪岩说∶『我们要商量的是，长线放远鹞，看到三年以后，大局一定，怎么样能够飞黄腾达，一下子窜了起来。』

“That,” Zhang said with a laugh, “is beyond my abilities.”
『这——』张胖子笑道，『我就没有这份本事了。』


Business talk always roused Hu’s enthusiasm.
谈生意经，胡雪岩一向最起劲；

Now, pleasantly warmed by wine, he was more eager than ever.
又正当微醺之时，兴致更佳，

“We seldom have time to ourselves.
『今天难得有空，

Let us make some proper plans today.
我们索性好好儿筹划一番。』

Old Zhang, you must know the practices of the Shanxi remittance houses?”
他问∶『老张，山西票号的规矩，你总熟悉的吧？』

“Different trades are mountains apart.
『隔行如隔山；

Banks and remittance houses may look like the same business, but their methods differ.”
钱庄、票号看来是同行，做法不同。』

Before Hu, Zhang dared give nothing but an honest answer.
张胖子在胡雪岩面前不敢不说老实话，

“Besides, their influence does not extend south of the Yangtze.
『而且，票号的势力不过长江以南；

I have had no opportunity to see their inner workings.”
他们的内幕，实在没有机会见识。』

“For us bankers, the Shanxi houses are the only formidable rivals.
『我们做钱庄，唯一的劲敌就是山西票号。

Know yourself and your enemy, and you can win a hundred battles.
知己知彼，百战百胜；

That is why I always pay close attention to them.
所以这方面，我平时很肯留心。

Let me tell you something about them first.”
现在，不妨先说点给你听。』

As Hu understood it, the Shanxi houses had originally dealt chiefly in remittances, with the capital as their centre.
照胡雪岩的了解，山西票号原以经营汇兑为主；而以京师为中心。

In recent years, war and difficult roads had made it inconvenient to transport government funds to Beijing.
这几年干戈扰攘，道路艰难，公款解京，诸多不便；

Almost without a formal arrangement, the houses had taken over some of the duties of the central and provincial treasuries.
因而票号无形中代理了一部分部库与省库的职司，

They paid no interest on government balances, while their remittance charges were substantial: naturally, the profits were great.
公款并不计息，汇水尤为可观，自然大获其利。

Moreover, wealthy merchants and high officials in the provinces considered the capital the safest place under heaven.
还有各省的巨商显宦，认为天下最安稳的地方，莫如京师；

They therefore sent much of their ready cash there, which in practice meant depositing it with the houses.
所以多将现款，汇到京里，实际上就是存款。

Such deposits were intended to preserve capital, not earn income, so the interest paid was very low.
这些存款的目的不是生利，而是保本，所以利息极轻。


“Once you have deposits, you must find an outlet for them.
『有了存款要找出路。

Leave funds to rot, and large ingots will never give birth to little ones,” Hu said.
头寸烂在那里，大元宝不会生小元宝的。』胡雪岩说，

“In recent years, the Shanxi houses have commonly lent to officials in the capital.
『山西票号近年来通行放款给做京官的，

They call it making ‘capital loans’.
名为「放京债」；

I hear that against a note for ten thousand taels they actually advance seven thousand—” “What?” Zhang interrupted loudly.
听说一万两的借据，实付七千——』『什么？』张胖子大声打断，

“What sort of loan is that?
『这是什么债，

Worse than the usurers who collect their instalments every day!”
比印子钱还要凶！』

“You think it worse, but the borrowers agree willingly enough.
『你说比印子钱还要凶，借的人倒是心甘情愿；

The wool comes off the sheep’s back in the end.
反正羊毛出在羊身上，

It is the common people who suffer.”
老百姓倒霉！』

“How so?”
『怎么呢？』

“Think about it.
『你想，

When an official borrows, what can he repay with?
做官借债，拿什么来还？

Naturally, the people repay for him.
自然是老百姓替他还。

Suppose someone is appointed provincial treasurer of your Zhejiang.
譬如某人放了你们浙江藩司，

He must make payments in the capital and pay for his journey.
京里打点，上任盘费；

Once he arrives, he needs a residence, chairs and horses, servants—what does not cost money?
到任以后置公馆、买轿马、用底下人，哪一样不用钱？

So he first takes a capital loan.
于是乎先借一笔京债；

After assuming office, he finds some public money to divert and pays it off, then gradually makes up the sum.
到了任想法子先挪一笔款子还掉，随后慢慢儿弥补；

Unless he devises ways to extract it from the people, he will be left with a deficit in his accounts.”
不在老百姓头上动脑筋，岂不是就要闹亏空了？』

“But is that not risky?
『这样子做法难道没有风险！

Suppose he refuses to acknowledge the debt once he takes office?”
譬如说，到了任不认帐？』

“He will not.
『不会的。

First, there is a guarantor, who must also be an official in the capital.
第一、有保人；保人一定也是京官。

Second, there is a signed note.
第二、有借据；

If he repudiates the debt, a petition can be lodged with the Censorate.
如果赖债，到都察院递呈子，

One impeachment from a censor, and the debtor loses his post.
御史一参，赖债的人要丢官。

Third, others will help the houses and prevent defaults.
第三、自有人帮票号的忙，不准人赖债。

Why?
为啥呢，

The poor Hanlin scholars live on loans.
一班穷翰林平时都靠借债度日；

They hope to be sent out as examiners or education commissioners, collect ceremonial gifts from their pupils and repay their debts.
就盼望放出去当考官，当学政，收了门生的「贽敬」来还债；

Having repaid, they can borrow again and keep going.
还了再借，日子依旧可以过得下去。

If anyone defaults, the houses may act together, declare officials untrustworthy and stop lending.
倘若有人赖了债，票号联合起来，说做官的没有信用，从此不借；

The poor scholars would panic.
穷翰林当然大起恐慌，

They will help recover the money.”
会帮票号讨债。』

Hu paused, then went on. “There is only one real risk: something may happen to a newly appointed official on his journey.
胡雪岩略停一下又说∶『要论风险，只有一样；新官上任，中途出了事，

He may die or lose his appointment.
或者死掉，或者丢官。

Even then, it depends.
不过也要看情形而定，

A sound guarantor will shoulder the whole obligation.”
保人硬气的，照样会一肩担承。』

“No wonder!” Zhang exclaimed. “These past few years the Qi, Tai and Ping groups of remittance houses have been opening branches all over the provinces.
『怪不得！』张胖子说∶『这几年祁、太、平三帮票号，在各省大设分号。

So this is the advantage!”
原来有这样的好处！』

Eager to try it himself, he asked, “Why should we not learn from them?”
他跃跃欲试地，『我们何不学人家一学？』

“Exactly!”
『着啊！』

Hu drained his cup.
胡雪岩干了一杯酒，

“That is just what I have in mind.”
『我正就是这个意思。』


Hu intended to follow their example with two kinds of loan.
胡雪岩的意思是，仿照票号的办法，办两项放款。

The first would go to officials.
第一是放给做官的。

With travel between north and south so difficult and circumstances so altered, transfers and promotions in recent years had often departed from normal procedure.
由于南北道路艰难，时世不同，这几年官员调补升迁，多不按常规；

The requirement that officials be sent to the appropriate ministry and presented for an imperial audience had not been abolished, but exceptions were commonly made.
所谓『送部引见』的制度，虽未废除，却多变通办理；

In particular, among civil and military officials recommended for promotion on the strength of wartime service, there were even provincial treasurers and judicial commissioners—men responsible for the finances or justice of an entire province—who had never been to Beijing.
尤其是军功上保升的文武官员，尽有当到藩司、皋司，主持一省钱谷、司法的大员，而未曾进过京的。

A man appointed from the capital could, of course, take a capital loan.
由京里补缺放出来，自然可以借京债；

But an official promoted within the lower Yangtze region—a Jiangsu magistrate made prefect in Hubei, for instance—could not move without money for the journey and for establishing his household.
如果在江南升调，譬如江苏知县，调升湖北的知府，没有一笔盘缠与安家银子就『行不得也』！

Hu proposed to help such men with loans on the same model.
胡雪岩打算仿照京债的办法，帮帮这些人的忙。

“There is risk, of course.
『这当然是有风险的。

But we must reckon the whole account, using the surplus here to cover the shortfall there.
但要通扯扯算，以有余补不足。

Since the likin taxes began, goodness knows how many men have grown rich.
自从开办厘金以来，不晓得多少人发了财；

Someone given a tax post gains an extra day’s profit for every day earlier he arrives.
象这种得了税差的，早一天到差，多一天好处，

However high the interest, he will borrow, and we shall not suffer a bad debt.
再高的利息，他也要借；而且不会吃倒帐。

Our method is to earn more from these accounts to make up for losses on others.
我们的做法是要在这些户头上多赚他些，来弥补倒帐。

We can say it plainly from the start: we shall ‘take from the rich to help the poor’.”
话不妨先说明白，我们是「劫富济贫」的做法。』

“Take from the rich to help the poor!” Zhang repeated the phrase once or twice and nodded. “I understand the principle.
『劫富济贫！』张胖子念一两遍，点点头说∶『这个道理我懂了。

What is the second kind?”
第二项呢？『


“The second is for families of the inland gentry who have fled to Shanghai.
『第二项放款是放给逃难到上海来的内地乡绅人家。

At home, most lived on rents.
这些人家在原籍，多是靠收租过日子的，

In the morning they carried a birdcage to the teahouse; in the afternoon they slept at the bathhouse; in the evening they sat down to a drinking party and went home tipsy.
一早拎只鸟笼泡茶店；下午到澡塘子睡一觉；晚上「摆一碗」，吃得醉醺醺回家。

Of the three hundred and sixty days of the year, at least three hundred passed like that.
一年三百六十天，起码三百天是这样子。

To flatter such men, you call them young gentlemen of leisure.
这种人，恭维他，说他是做大少爷；

Less politely, they are idle vagabonds.
讲得难听点，就是无业游民。

Had their ancestors not earned merit and left them great estates, they would certainly have become generals of the outstretched hand.
如果不是祖宗积德，留下大把家私，一定做「伸手大将军」了。

When they first fled here, they had some cash and valuables, so they did not immediately fall on hard times.
当初逃难来的时候，总有些现款细软在手里，一时还不会「落难」；

But spend without earning, and even a mountain is exhausted—especially in this foreign settlement, with its feasting and pleasure.
日久天长，坐吃山空，又是在这个花天酒地的夷场上，

After these few years, a good many once-famous young gentlemen are close to begging.”
所以这几年下来，很有些赫赫有名的大少爷，快要讨饭了！』

This was no exaggeration.
这话不是过甚其词，

Zhang had encountered several himself; the most wretched even depended on their wives and daughters to earn a living entertaining men.
张胖子就遭遇到几个；境况最凄惨的，甚至倚妻女卖笑为生。

He therefore sympathised deeply with Hu’s account, but disapproved of lending to such people.
因此，胡雪岩的话，在他深具同感；只是放款给这些人，他不以为然，

“It is easy to relieve an emergency and hard to rescue poverty.
『救急容易教穷难！』

We should be certain to lose the money.”
他说，『非吃倒帐不可！』

“No,” Hu said.
『不会的。』胡雪岩说，

“We must look further ahead.
『这就要放开眼光来看；

The Longhairs’ allotted days are almost over.
长毛的气数快尽了！

Once Jiangsu and Zhejiang are recovered, the refugees will go home.
江浙两省一光复，逃难的回家乡，
