According to official custom, when a superior made such an invitation, the attendants had two duties: to ask the guest to change into informal clothing, and to arrange his move to a garden reception room or even the private apartments.
照官场中的规矩，长官对属下有这样的表示，听差便得做两件事，第一件是请客人更换便衣；第二件是准备将客人移到花厅甚至『上房』中去。

Ordinarily Hu would bring a servant on a visit, carrying a bundle of clothes and ready to help him change.
在正常的情况之下，胡雪岩去拜客，自然带着跟班；跟班手中捧着衣包，视需要随时伺候主人更换。

Today he had come alone and naturally had nothing informal to wear.
但此时只有胡雪岩一个人，当然亦不会有便衣；

Zuo therefore ordered the attendant to bring one of his own lightly padded gowns for “Mr Hu”.
左宗棠便吩咐听差，取他自己的薄棉袍来为『胡大人』更换。

Zuo was short and stout, Hu tall and lean.
左宗棠矮胖；胡雪岩瘦长，

The sleeves hung loosely, while the hem stopped far too high, exposing a long stretch of boots caked with yellow mud.
这件棉袍穿上身，大袖郎当，下摆吊起一大截，露出一大截沾满了黄泥的靴帮子，

The effect was not merely inelegant but rather comical.
形容不但不雅，而且有些可笑。

Yet the kindness behind it was touching, and Hu felt thoroughly comfortable in it.
但这份情意是可感的。所以胡雪岩觉得穿在身上很舒服。

Moving to a garden reception room was equally impossible.
至于移向花厅，当然也办不到了。

In this little temple, where could spare rooms be found?
一座小关帝庙里，哪里来的空闲房屋，

The governor-general’s audience room, office and bedroom were all confined here.
闽浙总督的官厅，签押房与卧室，都在那里了。

Behind the temple, however, was a small earthen hill with a thatched pavilion, a modest place from which to enjoy a view.
不过，庙后倒有一座土山，山上有座茅亭，亦算可供登临眺望的一景；

To escape interruptions from officers seeking audiences, Zuo ordered the meal served there.
左宗棠为了避免将领请谒的纷扰，吩咐就在茅亭中置酒。


The wine was naturally excellent.
酒当然是好酒。

Shaoxing had long since been recovered, and the province’s highest official was supplied with aged wine that had survived the war undamaged in its cellars.
绍兴早经克复，供应一省长官的，自然是历经兵燹而无恙的窑藏陈酿；

The food was Hunan style.
菜是湖南口味，

Though only two men were dining, there were great dishes and long chopsticks.
虽只两个人对酌，依然大盘长筷，

Finally the cook, wearing a hat with a red tassel, personally brought a food box.
最后厨子戴着红缨帽，亲自来上菜，

He opened it to reveal nothing more than a small plate of Hunan cured pork.
打开食盒，只是一小盘湖南腊肉。

Why such ceremony?
不知何以郑重如此？

“My wife prepared this herself,” Zuo explained.
『这是内子亲手调制的，

“It came all the way from Hunan through countless difficulties.
间关万里，从湖南送到这里，

It is no longer good to eat.
已经不中吃了。

I keep it simply to remind myself of all the pains she once took to manage our affairs in trying circumstances.”
只不过我自己提醒我，不要忘记内子当年委曲绸缪的一番苦心而已。』

Hu had heard something of Madam Zhou.
胡雪岩也听说过，左宗棠的周夫人，

She came from a wealthy family, but when she married Zuo he was a poor scholar.
是富室之女；初嫔左家时，夫婿是个寒士。

She understood that this man, who “owned not half a mu yet worried for all under heaven”, possessed extraordinary talent.
但是周夫人却深知『身无半亩，心忧天下』的左宗棠，才气纵横，

Though he repeatedly failed the metropolitan examination, one day he would burst through the wall and soar.
虽然会试屡屡落弟，终有破壁飞去的一日；

She encouraged and consoled him with unceasing care.
所以鼓励慰藉，无怕不至。

Later he moved into her family’s home.
以后左宗棠移居岳家，

The large Zhou clan could hardly admire a poor son-in-law with such a temper.
而周家大族，不会看得起这个脾气的穷姑爷。

Afraid that her husband might storm away in anger, yet anxious to uphold his family’s dignity, she mediated on every side until mind and strength were exhausted.
周夫人一方面怕夫婿一怒而去，一方面又要为夫家做面，左右调停，心力交痤，

Now, at last, her day of vindication had come.
如今到底也有扬眉吐气的一天了。

Hu drew another lesson from this.
这对胡雪岩又是一种启示。

Gratitude, more than anything else, lay behind Zuo’s present respect for his wife.
左宗棠如今尊重周夫人，报恩的成分，多于一切，

Clearly he was a man of deep feeling, unwilling to fail those who had helped him.
足见得是不会负人，不肯负人而深具性情者，

Compared with Li Hongzhang, who controlled his subordinates through rewards, advancement and political manoeuvring, this was the man Hu would rather befriend wholeheartedly.
这比起李鸿章 以利禄权术驾驭部下来，宁愿倾心结交此人。

Accordingly, when Zuo asked questions, he held back still less.
因此，当左宗棠有所询问时，他越发不作保留，

From Hangzhou’s reconstruction to raising military funds, he had a method for everything and spoke without reserve.
从杭州的善后谈到筹饷，他都有一套办法拿出来，滔滔不绝，言无不尽。

Host and guest soon approached the point where all formality could be discarded and nothing was beyond discussion.
宾主之间，很快地已接近脱略形迹，无所不谈的境地了。


Their meal lasted two double-hours.
一顿酒喝了两个时辰方罢。

At last Zuo sighed. “Brother Xueyan, now I am troubled.
左宗棠忽然叹口气说∶『雪岩兄，我倒有些发愁了。

In what capacity should I ask your help?
不知应该借重你在哪方面给我帮忙？

Reconstruction is the immediate need, yet the monthly military payroll of two hundred and fifty or sixty thousand taels still has no assured source, and there too I must rely on you.
当务之急是地方善后，可是每个月二十五、六万的饷银，尚无的款，又必得仰仗大力。

If only you could be in two places at once!
只恨足下分身无术！

Tell me yourself: what would you like to do?”
雪岩兄，请你自己说一说，愿意做些什么？』

“Raising funds is important, but once a method is established, anyone whose integrity can be trusted can carry it out.”
『筹饷是件大事，不过只要有办法，凡是操守靠得住的人，都可以干得。』

Hu sounded apologetic.
胡雪岩歉然地说，

“I have a small selfish wish: to do something for my native place.”
『光墉稍微存一点私心，想为本乡本土尽几力。』

“How is that selfish?
『这哪里是私心！

It shows your generous and honourable heart.
正见得你一副侠心义肠。

Since the war began, Hangzhou has suffered most grievously.
军兴以来，杭州被祸最惨，

Its reconstruction has countless threads to draw together.
善后事宜，经纬万端，

As acting governor, I cannot evade responsibility.
我兼摄无篆，责无旁贷，

To have a man of your ability, willing to labour and bear complaints, helping me serve his homeland—that is excellent indeed.” Zuo asked, “You have met Jiang Xiangquan, I suppose?”
有你老兄这样大才，而且肯任劳任怨，又是为桑梓效力的人帮我的忙，实在太好了。』左宗棠说到这里，问道∶『跟蒋芗泉想来见面了？』

“Yes.”
『是！』

“What do you think of him?”
『你觉得他为人如何？』

“He is very straightforward.
『很直爽的人。

We got on extremely well.”
我们谈得很投机。』

“Excellent, excellent!” Zuo asked gladly, “Then you must have discussed the work of reconstruction?”
『好极，好极！』左宗棠欣然问道∶『地方上的一切善后，总也谈过了？』

“Not in depth.
『还不曾深谈。

But Treasurer Jiang has honoured my little bank by entrusting it with the business of the provincial treasury.
不过承蒋方伯看得起，委托我的一个小小钱庄，为他代理藩库；

I shall do my utmost to meet the immediate expenses.”
眼前急需的支出，我总尽力维持。』

“Better still.
『那更好了。

Nothing is more urgent than relief.
万事莫如赈济急；

With ten thousand shi of rice, the soldiers and people can be fed for a month or two, until further supplies arrive.
如今有一万石米，在军需民食，能维持一两个月，后援就接得上了。

And with your bank meeting the treasury’s expenses, there will be advances available for helping the wounded and caring for the dead.
再有宝号代为支应藩库的一切开销，扶伤恤死，亦不愁无款可垫。

Relief in Hangzhou should therefore begin at once.
然则杭州的赈济事宜，应当马上动手。

I propose establishing a reconstruction bureau.
我想，设一善后局，

Brother Xueyan, will you serve as its director?”
雪岩兄，请你当总办，如何？』

“Yes.” Hu answered solemnly. “Both public duty and private feeling forbid me to decline.”
『是！』胡雪岩肃然答说∶『于公于私，义不容辞。』

“Then I thank you on behalf of Hangzhou’s people.”
『我就代杭州百姓致谢了。』

Zuo clasped his hands.
左宗棠拱拱手说，

“I shall have the papers prepared at once and send them through Jiang Xiangquan.”
『公事我马上叫他们预备，交蒋芗泉转送。』


This arrangement was precisely what Hu wanted.
这样处置，正符合胡雪岩的希望。

He had always taken “arouse no jealousy” as his guiding rule.
因为他为人处世，一向奉『不招忌』三字为座右铭；

His status was much the same as Jiang Yili’s, but under Zuo he was, after all, only an invited adviser.
自己的身分与蒋益澧差不多，但在左宗棠手下，到底只算一个客卿，

If he appeared too intimate with Zuo, or even bypassed Jiang to take orders directly, Jiang could hardly feel comfortable. Hu had only to put himself in the other man’s place to see that.
如果形迹太密甚至越过蒋益澧这一关，直接听命于左宗棠，设身处地为人想一想，心里也会不舒服。

Though Hu was present, the appointment would be sent through Jiang.
现在当着本人在此，而委任的札子却要交由蒋益澧转发，

This respected the provincial treasurer’s authority and quietly helped Hu draw closer to him.
便是尊重藩司的职权；也是无形中为他拉拢蒋益澧，

Such a small official procedure, yet so much lay behind it!
仅不过公事上小小的一道手续，便有许多讲究；

Holding office and employing men were no simple matters.
只见得做官用人，不是件容易的事。

His admiration for Zuo increased, and he wanted to do a little more for him—or at least devise a few more useful ideas.
这样想着，他对左宗棠又加了几分钦佩之心；因而厚意替他多做一点事，至少也得为他多策划几个好主意。

Just then Zuo returned to military finance, and Hu decided to offer an ingenious scheme.
心念刚动，左宗棠正好又谈起筹饷，他决定献上一条妙计。

He had long thought it through.
这一计，他筹之已熟；

Originally he had meant to sell his wares to a buyer who knew their worth, waiting for the proper price: without sufficient reward, he would not readily have disclosed it.
本来的打算是『货卖识家』，不妨『待价而沽』。这也就是说，如果没有相当的酬庸，他是不肯轻易吐露的；

Now, feeling that Zuo had recognised his worth, he emptied his store of ideas before him.
此刻对左宗棠，多少有知遇之感，因而就倾囊而出了。


“There are many ways of raising military funds, but broadly they fall into two kinds.
『筹饷之道多端，大致不外两途，

One is the likin tax.
第一是办厘金，

That depends on a thriving market and cannot be forced.
这要靠市面兴旺，无法强求；

The other is soliciting contributions.
第二是劝捐，

In recent years, everyone able to give has already given, and persuasion is difficult.
这几年捐得起的都捐过了，「劝」起来也很吃力。

But I have thought of a class of people who can afford to contribute and will certainly be willing.
如今我想到有一路人，他们捐得起，而且一定肯捐；

We might turn our attention to them.”
不妨在这一路人头上，打个主意。』

“They can afford it and are willing?
『捐得起，又肯捐，

What could be better?” Zuo asked eagerly. “Who are they?”
那不太妙了吗？』左宗棠急急问道∶『是哪一路人？』

“The Longhairs.
『是长毛！』胡雪岩说，

They have held the southeast for more than ten years and amassed a great deal by plunder.
『长毛盘踞东南十几年，搜括得很不少；

Is it not only right that they should now contribute something?”
现在要他们捐几文，不是天经地义？』

Understanding dawned on Zuo.
这一说，左宗棠恍然大悟，

He nodded repeatedly. “Yes, yes.
连连点头∶『对，对，

Go on.” Hu explained that during those years, quite a number of rebels had recognised the right moment, made their fortunes and retired into hiding.
请你再说下去。』于是胡雪岩为他指出，这十几年中，颇有些见机而作的长毛，发了财退藏于密；

Once the Hong-Yang rebellion was suppressed, those who had joined it would naturally be punished by law.
洪杨一旦平定，从逆的当然要依国法治罪。

Yet though rebellion was an unpardonable crime, many had been forced into it—too many to prosecute.
可是叛逆虽罪在不赦，而被裹胁从逆的人很多，办不胜办。

To implicate large numbers and keep society in turmoil would not allow a country exhausted by great disorder to recover.
株连过众，扰攘不安，亦非大乱之后的休养生息之道；

The best course was to leave an opening in the net, a way for people to begin anew.
所以最好的处置办法是，网开一面，予人自新之路。

Still, to overlook everything would let them off too cheaply.
只是一概既往不咎，亦未免太便宜了此辈；

There should be a mild punishment, with each person free to choose between a beating and a fine.
应该略施薄惩。愿打愿罚，各听其便。

“Your Excellency knows human nature,” Hu said. “People prefer a fine to a beating, unless they cannot afford it.
『大人晓得的，人之常情，总是愿罚不愿打；除非罚不起。』胡雪岩说，

I know there are many who can.
『据我知道，罚得起的人很多。

Most hide in the foreign settlements, relying on foreign protection, and for the moment the authorities can do little about them.
他们大都躲在夷场上，倚仗洋人的势力，官府一时无奈其何，

Yet they remain men without a lawful identity, unable to emerge openly.
可是终究是个出不了头的「黑人」，

Explain the advantages and risks, appeal to their sense of right: their money was ill-gotten anyway.
如果动以利害，晓以大义；反正手头也是不义之财，

Why should they not part with some of it in exchange for a fresh start?”
舍了一笔，换个重新做人的机会，何乐不为？』

“Quite so,” Zuo said with a smile.
『说得是。』左宗棠笑道，

“Such men will not be content with obscurity.
『此辈不甘寂寞，

They may want not only to become respectable again, but to take office.”
不但要爬起来做人，只怕还要站出来做官。』

“Exactly.”
『正是这话。』

Hu raised two fingers.
胡雪岩撮起两指一伸，

“Men of that kind must contribute twice.”
『象这种人，要捐他两笔。』


“How so?”
『怎么呢？』

“Once to become respectable, and once to become officials.
『一笔是做人；另外一笔是做官。

Does entering office not require a contribution?” Zuo laughed.
做官不要捐吗？』左宗棠失笑了，

“I had confused myself.
『我倒弄糊涂了！』

In that case, I had better request several thousand blank contribution certificates from the ministry at once.”
他说，『照此看来，我得赶快向部里领几千张空白捐照来。』

“Yes.
『是！

Please send the official request.”
大人尽管动公事去领。』

“Suppose I obtain them, Brother Xueyan,” Zuo asked deliberately. “Whom shall I entrust with them?”
『领是领了。雪岩兄，』左宗棠故意问道∶『交给谁去用呢？』

Hu was silent for a while. “Allow me time to find a suitable man and recommend him.”
胡雪岩不作声，停了一会方说∶『容我慢慢物色好了，向大人保荐。』

“I do not think you need look.
『我看你也不用物色了，

You must undertake the difficulty yourself.”
就是你自己勉为其难吧！』

“I fear that—” “No, no!”
『这怕——。』『不，不！』

Zuo waved aside his objection.
左宗棠挥手打断了他的话，

“Do not decline.
『你不必推辞了！

Once you have met me, Brother Xueyan, you can no longer insist on your own wishes.
雪岩兄，你遇见我，就容不得你再作主张。

That may sound unreasonable, but it is not.
这话好象蛮不讲理；不是的！

I know now that your abilities are as vast as the sea.
足下才大如海，我已深知。

Never mind these two tasks: you could handle several more with ease.
不要说就这两件事，再多兼几个差使，你也能够应付裕如。

You must have capable men under you.
我想，你手下总有一班得力的人；

Give me their names, and I shall instruct Jiang Xiangquan to appoint them all.
你尽管开单子来，我关照蒋芗泉，一律照委。

You need only travel between Shanghai and Hangzhou and provide the ideas.”
你往来沪杭两地，出出主意就行了。』

Such confidence reminded Hu of two lines Wang Youling had often repeated during the siege: “Bend every effort to the task; cease only in death.” He answered with spirit. “If Your Excellency believes I can do it, I shall try.”
如此看重，不由得使胡雪岩想起王有龄在围城中常说的两句话说∶『鞠躬尽痤，死而后已。』便慨然答道∶『既然大人认为我干得了，我就试一试看。』

“No need to try.
『不用试，

I guarantee you will succeed,” Zuo said.
包你成功！』左宗棠说，

“I want you to attend to both matters together.
『我希望你两件事兼筹并顾。

Military affairs in Zhejiang are at a crucial stage.
浙江的军务，正在紧要关头上，

We must on no account have a disturbance over unpaid wages.”
千万不能有「闹饷」的活把戏弄出来。』

“I shall do my utmost.
『是。我尽力而为。』

What I need your instructions on now is the name of this contribution.
胡雪岩说，『如今要请示的是，这个捐的名目。

I suggest ‘penalty contribution’.”
我想叫「罚捐」。』

“That describes it accurately.
『罚捐倒也名副其实。

But—” He pondered for a long time without finishing.
不过——。』他沉吟着，好久未说下去。


He plainly had a misgiving, and Hu could imagine it.
这当然是有顾忌；胡雪岩也可以想象得到，

A scheme of “penalty contributions” might provoke criticism and the charge of “sheltering rebels”, a very serious offence.
开办『罚捐』可能会惹起浮议，指作『包庇逆党』。这是很重的一个罪名。

Yet whether it amounted to sheltering them depended on the circumstances.
然而是否『包庇』，要看情节而定；

That and allowing people to reform were superficially similar but different things.
与予人自新之路，是似是而非的两回事。

Hu kept these thoughts to himself, watching Zuo’s expression closely to see whether he would take responsibility.
他心里这样在想，口头却保持沉默；而且很注意左宗棠的表情，要看他是不是有担当？

Zuo naturally would; indeed, that was one of the qualities on which he prided himself.
左宗棠自然是有担当的；而且这正也是他平时自负之处。

What troubled him was finding a different name.
他所考虑的改换名目；

He thought for some time without discovering a suitable term and finally decided to use this one for the present.
想了好一会，竟找不出适当的字眼，便次定暂进先用了再说。



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第八章（本章第7部分，共9部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Another question followed. “Should this penalty contribution be reported to the throne?
接着，又有疑问∶『这个罚捐，要不要出奏？』他问，

What do you think?”
『你意下如何？』

“If it is reported first, opposition may prevent the scheme from starting.
『出奏呢，怕有人反对，办不成功；

If it is not, the ministry may later raise procedural objections, or a censor may impeach us.
不出奏呢？又怕将来部里打官腔，或者「都老爷」参上一本。』

There are advantages and disadvantages on both sides.
胡雪岩说，『利弊参见，

Your Excellency must decide.”
全在大人作主。』

“It must be done.
『办是一定要办；

But though I am not afraid of trouble, there is no reason to take the blame unnecessarily.
不过我虽不怕事，却犯不上无缘无故背个黑锅，

Think again: is there a way to prevent interference while leaving us a defensible position?”
你倒再想想，有什么既不怕他人掣肘，又能为自己留下退步的办法。』

“Act impartially in the public interest, and there will always be a way to defend ourselves.
『凡事只要秉公办理，就一定会有退步。

I suggest not reporting before we begin.
我想，开办之先，不必出奏；

Once the scheme has produced results, memorialise the throne with the amounts collected.
办得有了成效，再奏明收捐的数目，

Thereafter, notify the ministry directly for its records, providing the basis for the eventual accounting.”
以后直接咨部备案，作为将来报销的根据。』

“Good!
『好！

We shall do exactly that.”
准定这样办。』

Zuo was delighted. “‘Act impartially in the public interest, and there will always be a way to defend ourselves’—very well said.
左宗棠大为赞赏∶『「凡事只要秉公办理，就必有退步。」这话说得太好了。

But the results you mention are important too.
不过，你所说的「成效」也很要紧；

The state once kept more than ten million taels sealed in the inner treasury for major campaigns.
国家原有上千万的银子，经常封存内库，就为的是供大征伐之用。

That great sum was squandered by Saishang’a and his fellow Banner grandees.
这笔巨款，为赛尚阿之流的那班旗下大爷挥霍一空；

So the saying ‘The emperor does not send hungry soldiers on his errands’ no longer applies.
所以「皇帝不差饿兵」那句俗语，不适用了！

Now the court not only sends hungry soldiers and requires each province to find its own military funds; it also demands remittances for the capital’s military expenses.
如今朝廷不但差的是饿兵，要各省自己筹饷；而且要协解「京饷」。

If we establish a productive tax or contribution and are forbidden to continue it, very well: let the court assign us a reliable source for the same amount.”
如果说，我们办得有成效的税捐，不准再办；那好，请朝廷照数指拨一笔的款好了。』

That brought his argument to its conclusion.
这番话说到尽头了；

Hu now understood more deeply Zuo’s position, his thinking and his response to circumstances.
胡雪岩对左宗棠的处境、想法、因应之道亦由这番话中有了更深的了解。

Any method of raising military funds that was not utterly wicked could gain his approval.
只要不是伤天害理，任何筹饷的办法，都可以得到他的同意。


Hu remained at Zuo’s headquarters for two days before returning to Hangzhou.
胡雪岩在左宗棠行辕中盘桓了两天，才回杭州。

His homecoming was far more splendid than his departure.
归来的这番风光，与去时大不相同；

An escort of Zuo’s personal guards was only to be expected.
左宗棠派亲兵小队护送，自不在话下，

What surprised him most, outside Wulin Gate, was a welcoming party of distinguished-looking men.
最使他惊异的是，到了武林门外，发现有一班很体面的人在迎接，

More than half were active members of Hangzhou’s gentry, including Licentiate Zhang; the rest wore official robes, though Hu knew none of them.
一大半是杭州的绅干，包括张秀才在内；其余的都穿了官服，胡雪岩却一个都不认识。

A great green-covered sedan chair stood in the gateway.
此外，还有一顶绿呢大轿，放在城门洞里；

What was that for?
更不知作何用处？

Puzzled, he asked Officer He, “Have they come to meet me?”
胡雪岩颇为困惑，『是接我的吗？』他问何都司。

Before He could answer, the sight of Liu Bucai and young Zhang settled the question.
不用何都司回答，看到刘不才和小张；胡雪岩知道接自己是不错的了。

Zhang ran up beaming, caught the ring of his horse’s bridle and cried, “The news reached us the night before last!
果然，小张笑容满面地奔了上来。一把拉住马头上的嚼环，高声说道∶『这里前天晚上就得消息了！

We have awaited you like clouds and rain in a scorching drought.”
盼望大驾真如火旱之望云霓！』

What news?
是何消息？

Why such eagerness for his return?
盼望他回来又为何如此殷切？

Before Hu could ask, a guard officer bowed before his horse.
胡雪岩正待动问，却不待他开口；首先是一名武巡捕在马前打躬，

“Please dismount, Your Excellency, and take the sedan chair.”
同时说道∶『请胡大人下马，换大轿吧！』

Young Zhang hurried to explain.
『是这样的，』小张赶紧代为解释，

“Treasurer Jiang sent this officer.
『这是蒋方伯派来的差官；

The green-covered chair is his own, brought specially for you.”
绿呢大轿是蒋方伯自己用的，特为来伺候。』

“Yes.”
『是！』

The officer opened a visiting-card box and presented Jiang’s card and invitation.
那名武巡捕打开拜匣，将蒋益澧的一份名帖与一份请柬递了上来，

“My superior sent me to attend you.
『敝上派我来伺候胡大人；

He expressly instructed me to say that he intended to come himself, but several urgent matters require immediate decisions, and he cannot get away.
特为交代，本来要亲自来迎接，只为有几件紧要公事，立等结果，分不开身。

He asks to see you as soon as you arrive.
敝上又说∶』请胡大人一到就会个面，

There is much awaiting discussion.”
有好些事等着商量。

Hu understood.
『这一说胡雪岩明白了，

The “news” was his appointment as director of the reconstruction bureau.
小张所说的』消息『，是指他奉委为善后局总办一事；

Everyone’s eagerness, and Jiang’s insistence on seeing him at once, arose naturally from the urgency of relief.
大家如此殷切盼望，以及蒋益澧立等会面，当然是因为』万事莫如赈济急『，

The work of reconstruction awaited his decisions before it could begin.
一切善后事宜，都待他来作了决定，方能动手兴办。


Precisely for that reason, he thought it unwise to see Jiang first.
领会及此，他觉得不宜先跟蒋益澧见面。

Yet Jiang was now effectively the head of the province.
但此刻的蒋益澧。『等于一省长官，

To reject such attentive hospitality would be discourteous; only an excellent excuse would do.
这样殷勤相待，如果不领他的情，是件很失礼的事；必得找一个很好的借口才能敷衍得过去。

Hu thought quickly.
他的心思很快，

By the time he dismounted, his answer was ready.
下马之顷，已想好一套说词，』

“Please tell your superior that I too am anxious to pay my respects and seek his instructions on many matters.
拜烦回复贵上，『他说∶』我也急于要进见，有好些公事请示。

But after these days of travelling back and forth, I am disgracefully dirty.
不过，这几天来回奔波，身上脏得不成样子；

To visit a superior in this state would be disrespectful.
这样子去见长官，太不恭敬。

Let me wash and change into clean clothes, and I shall come at once.
等我稍为抹一抹身子，换一套干净衣服，马上就去。

His green-covered chair is not one I am entitled to ride in, but it would be rude to refuse his kindness.
贵上的绿呢大轿，不是我该坐的；不过却之不恭，

Please ask the bearers to follow me with it empty.”
请你关照轿班，空轿子跟着我去好了。

He went first to the Zhang house for a short rest and wrote an outline of the principal reconstruction measures and the support he needed from Jiang.
『于是先到张家暂息，将善后应办的大事，以及要求蒋益澧支持的事项，写了个大概，

Only then did he attend the banquet.
方始应约赴宴。

They met warmly.
相见欢然，

Jiang handed him the letter of appointment, and Hu took out a sheet of paper in return.
蒋益澧当面递了委札；胡雪岩便从身上掏出一张纸来，递了过去，

It was headed “Urgent Reconstruction Measures” and contained seven proposals.
上面写的是∶『善后急要事项』，

First: bury the dead within half a month.
一共七条∶第一、掩埋尸体，限半个月完竣。

Great epidemics followed great wars; this would both give the departed rest and prevent disease.
大兵之后大疫，此不仅为安亡魂，亦防疫疠。


Second: provide free porridge for six months.
第二、办理施粥，以半年为期。

The government should supply the grain, while impartial local gentlemen supervised its distribution.
公家拨给米粮，交地方公正绅士监督办理。

Third: invite merchants to bring in food, clothing, bricks, tiles, timber and other necessities, exempting these goods from likin to encourage trade.
第三、凡粮食、衣着、砖瓦、木料等民生必需品类，招商贩运，免除厘税，以广招徕。

Fourth: investigate those who had died loyally in the disaster, collect accounts of their deeds, and petition the throne for a shrine commemorating the loyal dead.
第四、访查殉难忠烈，采访事迹，奏请建立昭忠祠。

Fifth: trace the families of women rescued from the rebel camps and send them home with trustworthy escorts.
第五、贼营拔出妇女，访查其家，派妥人送回。

Sixth: make every effort to arrange spring cultivation, on which livelihoods in the coming autumn and winter depended.
第六、春耕关乎今年秋冬生计，应尽全力筹办。

Seventh: reopen the academies and give favourable treatment to scholars.
第七、恢复书院，优待士子。


“Quite right, quite right!” Jiang said.
『应该，应该！』蒋益澧说，

“I agree to everything.
『我无不同意。

If you need men, appointments or official papers, tell me, Mr Xueyan.
至于要人，或者要下委札，动公事，请雪翁告诉我，

Whatever lies within my power shall be done.”
只要力之所及，一定如命。』

“Thank you, Mr Xiang, for helping the people of Zhejiang.
『多谢芗翁成全浙江百姓。

But there is one matter on which I must ask your exceptional support.”
不过眼前有件事，无论如何要请芗翁格外支持。』

Hu spoke plainly. “The troops must be kept under discipline.”
胡雪岩率直说道∶『弟兄们的纪律一定要维持。』

Jiang reddened.
蒋益澧脸一红，

He knew his men’s discipline was poor, but offered a defence. “To be honest, the men have gone hungry for so long—” “Mr Xiang,” Hu interrupted, “I shall take responsibility for their pay.
他也知道他部下的纪律不好；不过，他亦有所辩解∶『说实话，弟兄们亦是饿得久了——。』『芗翁，』胡雪岩打断他的话说，『饷，我负责；

Please take responsibility for their discipline.”
军纪，请芗翁负责。』

Jiang reflected that Hu could now see Zuo directly and was said to have all his advice accepted.
蒋益澧心想，胡雪岩现在直接可以见左宗棠，而且据说言听计从；

If he raised the matter with their superior and an order came back down, Jiang would lose face.
倘或拿此事跟上面一说，再交下来，面子就不好看了。

Better to resolve it himself.
既然如此，不如自己下决心来办。

He therefore decided on two measures: a proclamation reaffirming military discipline, with offenders to be executed on the spot; and, from the next day, his own presence throughout the day at Guanxiangkou in the city centre to enforce military law personally.
于是他决定了两个办法∶一是出告示重申军纪，违者就地正法；二是他从第二天开始，整天坐镇杭州城中心的官巷口，亲自执行军法。

Discipline did indeed improve considerably, and reconstruction became easier to undertake.
这一来，纪律果然好得多了。善后事宜，亦就比较容易着手；

The burden fell on Hu, who slept fewer than three double-hours a day and lost several jin in weight.
只是苦了胡雪岩，一天睡不到三个时辰，身上掉了好几斤的肉，

Yet he remained vigorous and showed no fatigue.
不过始终精神奕奕，毫无倦容。


Zuo reached the provincial capital on the second day of the third month.
左宗棠是三月初二到省城的；

The first man he summoned after stepping from his chair was Hu.
一下了轿，约见的第一个人就是胡雪岩。

“Terrible!”
『惨得很！』

There was an unusually dejected look on his face.
左宗棠脸上很少有那样沮丧的颜色，

“Since the war began, I have visited many places, but never seen one devastated like Hangzhou.
『军兴以来，我也到过好些地方；从没有见过杭州这样子遭劫的！

What was its former population?”
以前杭州有多少人？』

“Eight hundred and ten thousand.”
『八十一万。』胡雪岩答说。

“And now?”
『现在呢？』

“A little over seventy thousand.”
『七万多。』

“A little over seventy thousand!” Zuo sighed.
『七万多？』左宗棠嗟叹着；

Then he looked up. “Mr Xueyan, you do not say eighty thousand or sixty thousand, but a little over seventy thousand.
忽然抬眼问道∶『雪翁，不说八万，不说六万，独说七万多；

On what evidence?”
请问何所据而云然？』

“It is an estimate, but not an idle guess.
『这是大概的估计。不过，亦不是空口瞎说。』

I have calculated it from the tokens issued at the porridge kitchens and the places selling grain at reduced prices.”
胡雪岩答道∶『是从各处施粥厂、平粜处发出的「筹子」算出来的。』

“Excellent!”
『好极！』

Zuo was full of praise.
左示棠大为嘉许，

“You truly combine great ability with care for detail.
『雪翁真正才大心细。

What do you consider the most urgent measures now?”
照你看，现在办善后，当务之急是哪几样？』


“Naturally, reviving trade.
『当务之急，自然是振兴市面；

A market can flourish only if people are willing to come and do business.
市面要兴旺，全靠有人肯来做生意；

Merchants are timid.
做生意的人胆子小，

If Your Excellency can make them confident enough to come to Hangzhou, trade will revive, the people will have a livelihood, and public revenue from likin will rise.
如果大人有办法让他们放心大胆地到杭州来，市面就会浴量，百姓有了生路，公家的厘金税收，亦会增加。

It will benefit both the government and the people enormously.”
于公于私，都有莫大的好处。』

“That simply means taking still greater pains to enforce discipline.
『这无非在整饬纪律四个字，格外下功夫，

Tell the merchants not to be afraid.
你叫商人不要怕，

Let them come and trade in Hangzhou.
尽管到杭州来做生意。

If they suffer any wrong, they may complain directly at my office.
如果吃了亏，准他们直接到我衙门来投诉；

I shall punish the offenders severely.”
我一定严办。』

“With that assurance, they will dare come.” Hu added, “Reconstruction covers a vast range of matters.
『有大人这句话，他们就敢来了。』胡雪岩又问，『善后事宜，千头万绪，包罗太广；

At present, relief and reassurance are the chief tasks.
目前以赈抚为主，

Might the reconstruction bureau be renamed the relief bureau?”
善后局是否可以改为赈抚局。』

“Yes.
『不错！

An excellent suggestion.”
这个意见很好。』

Zuo immediately issued a written instruction.
左宗棠随即下条子照办；

Everything else remained as before; only the name changed.
一切如旧，只是换了个名字。

The bureau’s troublesome, minute affairs consumed so much of Hu’s time that he could never find a suitable opportunity for another meeting with Zuo.
赈抚局的公事，麻烦而琐碎，占去了胡雪岩许多的功夫；以致想见一次左宗棠，一直找不到适当的时间。


Half a month passed in this way.
这样迁延了半个月，

Then the courier who had carried the special memorial announcing Hangzhou’s recovery returned from Beijing with good news for Zuo personally.
专折奏报克复杭州的折差，已由京里回到杭州，为左宗棠个人带来一个好消息，

“The Grand Secretariat has received an oral decree: Since taking charge of military affairs in Zhejiang, Zuo Zongtang, Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang, has successively recovered prefectural, subprefectural and county seats.
『内阁奉口谕∶闽浙总督左宗棠自督办浙江军务以来，连克各府州县城池。

He has now taken the provincial capital of Hangzhou and the county seat of Yuhang, demonstrating skilful direction.
兹复将杭州省城、余杭县城攻拔，实属调度有方。

As a special favour, he is granted the title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and permission to wear the yellow riding jacket.”
着加恩赏太子少保衔；并赏穿黄马褂。』

Jiang Yili too received the yellow riding jacket. “Zuo Zongtang shall investigate the services of all officers and men involved and recommend the most deserving for reward.”
此外，蒋益澧亦赏穿黄马褂∶『所有在事出力将士，着左宗棠查明，择优保奉。』

When the news spread, every civil and military official in the city entitled to see the governor-general dressed in formal robes and went to headquarters to offer congratulations.
消息一传，全城文武官员，够得上资格见总督的无不肃具衣冠，到总督行辕去叩圆。

Wearing his new yellow jacket, Zuo received them in groups with generous words of encouragement.
左宗棠穿上簇新的黄马褂，分班接见，慰勉有加；

When he saw Hu kowtowing with the expectant circuit intendants, he specially instructed a guard to wait at the second hall and detain him.
看到胡雪岩随着候补道员同班磕头，特为嘱咐戈什哈等在二堂门口，将他留了下来。

After the guests and staff had dispersed, the two met in informal dress in the garden reception room.
等宾僚散尽，左宗棠在花厅与胡雪岩以便服相见。

Hu naturally congratulated him again.
一见少不得再次致贺；

Zuo spoke of the weight of imperial favour and how difficult it was to repay.
左宗棠自道受恩深重，对朝廷益难报称，

Then he apologised: the memorial recommending rewards for the recovery of Hangzhou was already drafted and about to be sent, but Hu’s name was not in it.
紧接着又向胡雪岩致歉，总克复杭州有功人员报奖，奏稿已经办好，即将拜发；其中并无胡雪岩的名字，

This first list was confined to those who had stormed the city.
因为第一次保案，只限于破城将士，

When the reconstruction staff were recommended later, Hu would certainly head the list.
以后奏保办理地方善后人员，一定将他列为首位。


Hu thanked him and briefly reported progress.
胡雪岩自然要道谢，同时简单扼要地报告办理善后的进展，

His guiding principles were “relief through work; revival through trade”, so that assistance to the needy also accomplished the work of restoration.
奉『以工代赈，振兴市面』八个字为宗旨，这样一方面办了赈济；一方面做了复旧的工作。

Zuo nodded repeatedly in approval and asked what difficulties he faced.
左宗棠不断点头，表示满意。然后问起胡雪岩有何困难？

“There are naturally too many to recount.
『困难当然很多，言不胜言，

I would not trouble Your Excellency with them.
也不敢麻烦大人；

Whatever I can manage, I shall attend to myself.
只要力所能及，我自会料理，请大人放心。

不过，人无远虑，必有近忧；

It is already late in the third month, and the hungry fifth and sixth months will be upon us before we know it.
如今已经三月下旬了，转眼「五荒六月』；

Every household must meet its immediate needs.
家家要应付眼前。

青黄不接的当口，能够过得过去，都因为有个指望；指望秋天的收成，还了债好过年，

Your Excellency, that may be difficult this year.”
大人，今年只怕难了！

『一句话提醒了左宗棠，

悚然而惊，搓着手说∶』是啊！

秋收全靠春耕。

This is the time to transplant rice seedlings.
目前正是插秧的时候，

If we miss it, the consequences will be dreadful.”
如果耽误了，可是件不得了的事！

“With Your Excellency recognising that, the people of Zhejiang can be saved.”
『』大人说这话，两浙的百姓有救了。

『『你不要看得太容易，

We must discuss it carefully.
这件事着实要好好商量。

Mr Xueyan, how should we encourage cultivation?”
雪翁，你看，劝农这件事，该怎么样做法？』

『大人古书读得多，

Every dynasty has known great disorder.
历朝历代，都有大乱；

You must remember clearly how they helped country people return to their fields afterwards.”
大乱之后，怎么帮乡下人下田生产，想来总记得明明白白？』

『啊，啊，

A sound observation.
言之有理。』左宗棠说，

I do.
『我有，

The early Han handled this well.
这方面是汉初办得好，

Empress Dowager Bo followed the teachings of the Yellow Emperor and Laozi: quietness and non-interference.
薄太后的黄老之学，清静无为，

才是真是与民休息。

就不知道当今两宫太后，能否象薄太后那样？

『胡雪岩不懂黄老之学，用于政务，便是无为而治；也不知道薄太后就是汉文帝的生母。

不过清静无为、与民休息这两句成语是听得懂，便紧接着他的话说∶『真正再明白不过是大人！

To bring life back to abandoned fields, the method is simple: do not disturb them.
要荒了的田地有生气，办法也很简单。三个字∶不骚扰！

Your authority is as firm as a mountain; your orders are obeyed.
大人威望如山，令出必行，

One command will bring the people boundless benefit.”
只要下一道命令，百姓受惠无穷。』

『当然，

That command must be issued.
这道命令是一定要下的。

雪翁，你且说一说，命令中要禁止些什么？』

『是！』胡雪岩想了一下答说∶『第一、军饷的来源是厘金、是殷实大户的捐献，

They have nothing to do with ordinary farmers.
与种田的老百姓无干。

I presume Your Excellency intends to seek remission of this year’s land taxes.
今年的钱粮，想来大人总要奏请豁免的；

My fear is that county revenue clerks may demand supposed arrears under false pretexts.
就怕各县的「户书」假名追征旧欠。

That will frighten the people away from their fields.”
那一来，老百姓就吓得不敢下田了！』

“Impossible!”
『那怎么行？』

Zuo’s expression hardened.
左宗棠神色凛然地，

“Anyone who did that would be utterly heartless.
『若有此事，简直毫无心肝了，

He would be executed without pardon.”
杀无赦！』

『第二、怕弟兄们抓差拉夫。』

I prohibited it long ago.
我早就下令严禁；

Requisitioned service must be paid for.
征差要给价。

I can reaffirm the order now: during the busy farming season there must be no disturbance at all, and the farmers must be protected.
如今我可以重申前令，农忙季节，一律不准骚扰，而且还要保护。』

What else?”

『还有就是怕弟兄们杀耕牛！』

『那也不会，

谁杀耕牛，我就杀他。』

至于种籽、农具，我去备办；

Whether they are to be lent by the government or sold for cash at fair prices, Your Excellency can settle the rules later.
将来是由公家贷放，还是平价现卖，请大人定章 程。

好在不管怎么样，东西早预备在那里，总是不错的！』

『不错，不错。

Please obtain them—and advance the money too.
请你去预备，也要请你垫款。』

Apart from money, there is nothing here that cannot be discussed.”
左宗棠说道，『除了钱以外，我这里什么都好商量。』

『是！』胡雪岩答道∶『我是除了钱以外，什么事都要跟大人商量，

I ask you to stand behind me.”
请大人做我的靠山。』

『那还用说，

If you need men or official authorisation, you have only to speak.”
要人要公事，你尽管开口。』

『有件事要跟大人商量。

Silk from the counties of Huzhou is the lifeblood of northern Zhejiang.
湖州府属的丝，是浙北的命脉；

Raising silkworms is extremely troublesome.
养蚕又是件极麻烦的事，

They are called ‘silkworm babies’ because they are so delicate.
以蚕叫「蚕宝宝」，娇嫩得很，

家家关门闭户，轮流守夜，按时喂食，

生客上门都不接待的。

如今蒋方伯正带兵攻打湖州，

大军到处，可能连茶水饭食都不预备；可是这一来，蚕就不能养了。

还有，养蚕全靠桑叶，

倘或弟兄们砍了桑树当柴烧，蚕宝宝岂不是要活活饿死？』

“Oh!”
『噢！』

Zuo listened intently.
左宗棠很注意他，

“I have always taken an interest in practical statecraft, but I did not know that raising silkworms required so much care.
『我平日对经济实用之学，亦颇肯留意；倒不知道养蚕有这么多讲究。

As you explain it, the matter is vital.
照你所说，关系极重；

我得赶紧通知蒋芗泉，格外保护。

除了不准弟兄骚扰以外，最要防备湖州城里的长毛突围乱窜，扰害养蚕人家。』

“With such an order, all will be well.”
『大人这么下令，事情就不要紧了！』

Hu was relieved.
胡雪岩欣慰地说，

“In the lower Yangtze region, the fourth month is the crucial one.
『江南是四月里一个月最吃重，

唱山歌的话∶』做天难做四月天「，

Rice transplanting and silkworm raising both take place then: one needs rain, the other clear skies.
因为插秧、养蚕都在四月里，一个要雨，一个要晴。

With the court’s blessings and Your Excellency’s authority, may next month bring favourable weather and success in the campaign.
托朝廷的鸿福，大人的威望，下个月风调雨顺，军务顺手，

If we can pass that month in peace, Zhejiang’s suffering can end.”
让这一个月平平安安过去，浙江就可以苦出头了！

“I understand.
『』我知道了，

I shall do what I can to fulfil everyone’s hopes.”
总想法子如大家的愿就是。

Then Zuo’s brow tightened.
『说到这里，左宗棠眉心打了个结，』

“But there is a matter on which I must consult you, Mr Xueyan.
倒是有件事，雪翁，我要跟你商量；

Have you a clever way of dealing with those verminous clerks?”
看看你有没有高招，治那一班蠹吏！

Hu did not understand the expression and stared, unable to answer.
『』蠹吏『二字，胡雪岩没有听懂，瞠然不知所答。

Only after Zuo explained further did he realise that he meant the clerks in the Ministries of Revenue and War in Beijing.
及至左宗棠作了进一步的解释，才知道指的是京里户部与兵部的书办。

『户部与兵部的书办，盼望肃清长毛之心，比谁都殷切；

在他们看，平了洪杨，就是他们发财的机会到了。

On the twenty-first of the first month, Zeng the Ninth took Tianbao Fort.
正月廿一，曾老九克了天保城，

Jinling is encircled, and Hong Xiuquan is like a doomed spirit beneath the cauldron.
金陵合围，洪秀全已如釜底游魂。

Li Shaoquan’s Huai Army will take Changzhou before long.
李少荃的淮军，攻克常州，亦是指顾间事；

Once it falls, that army can sweep west, join Feng Zicai, who has held on so stubbornly at Zhenjiang, and go through Danyang to support Zeng.
常州一下，淮军长驱西进，会合苦守镇江的冯子材，经丹阳驰援曾九，

It seems they may be eating Dragon Boat Festival dumplings in Jiangning.”
看起来可以在江宁吃粽子了。』

『没有那么快！』胡雪岩接口便答。

Zuo was startled and displeased. “Why do you say that?”
这一答，使得左宗棠错愕而不悦∶『何以见得？』他问。

Hu knew he had spoken too bluntly.
胡雪岩知道自己答得大率直了。

Zuo had left one question unspoken: “Am I less qualified than you to judge military affairs?”
左宗棠有句没有说出来的话∶『莫非论兵我还不如你？

Hu therefore changed his approach at once. “Your Excellency’s conduct of war is inspired.
因而很见机地改口∶』大人用兵，妙算如神，

How could I presume to offer a careless opinion?
我何敢瞎议论。

But after two years of seeing and hearing things in Shanghai, I believe I understand Governor Li’s character thoroughly.
不过，我在上海那两年，听到看到，关于李中丞的性情，自以为摸得很透。

Even if Changzhou is taken, he may not lead his men west.
常州如果攻了下来，他未必肯带兵西进；

He is not foolish enough to claim a share of the great victory that Marshal Zeng the Ninth is determined to win alone.”
因为，他不会那么傻，去分曾九帅一心想独得的大功。

“Ah!”
『』啊！

Zuo struck his thigh hard.
『左宗棠重重一掌，拍在自己大腿上，』

“You think so too?”
你也是这么想？『



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第八章（本章第8部分，共9部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“Perhaps I am mistaken.”
『只怕我想得不对。』

“You are not!” Zuo sighed.
『不会错！』左宗棠叹口气，

“I have thought the same all along, but refused to admit it to myself.
『我一直也是这么在想，不过不肯承认我自己的想法；

Li Shaoquan is, after all, a Hanlin scholar.
我总觉得李少荃总算也是个翰林，

His learning may amount only to a well-rehearsed Book of Songs, but he must understand loyalty to his sovereign and love of country.
肚子里的货色，虽只不过温熟了一部诗经，忠君爱国的道理总也懂的，

Having received such great favours, how could he disappoint his sovereign’s earnest wish to destroy this great bandit and bring peace to the empire?
而况受恩深重，又何忍辜负君父灭此大盗，以安四海的至意？

Now you have reached the same conclusion independently, which shows that we are both right.
如今你跟我的看法不约而同，就见得彼此的想法都不错。

Shaoquan is not the sort to flatter Zeng the Ninth merely for his own sake.
论少荃的为人，倒还不致巴结曾九；

But his teacher commands military affairs in five provinces and stands high in imperial favour.
只为他老师节制五省军务，圣眷正隆，

His own eagerness for advancement makes him yield and accommodate others.
不免功名心热，屈己从人。

As for Zeng the Ninth, though he cannot help openly, he will do all he can in secret, supplying money and arms.
至于他对曾九，虽不便明助，睹底下却要帮忙，助饷助械，尽力而为；

The recovery of Jinling cannot be far away.”
所以金陵克复的日子，仍旧不会远。』

“Yes.
『是的。

That is plain to see.
这是明摆在那里的事；

Jiangning is surrounded and outside help cut off.
江宁合围，外援断绝，

Once the food in the city is exhausted, the Longhairs are finished.
城里的存粮一完，长毛也就完了。

In my view, success must come around the turn of summer and autumn.”
照我看，总在夏秋之交，一定可以成功。』

『那时候就有麻烦了。

Look at this first.”
你先看着这个——。』


Zuo took a thick letter from inside his robe, perhaps ten or more sheets, examined it and selected two to hand to Hu.
说着左宗棠从怀中掏出一封信来，厚甸甸地，总有十来张信笺；他检视了一下，抽出其中的两张，递了给胡雪岩。

The two sheets concerned a single piece of news.
这两张信笺中，谈的是一件事；也就是报告一个消息。

The clerks in the Ministries of War and Revenue saw that the Hong-Yang rebellion would soon be suppressed.
说兵部与户部的书办，眼看洪杨肃清在即；

When military operations ended, the war accounts would have to be submitted for audit, and they were already congratulating themselves.
军务告峻，要办军费报销，无不额手相庆。

The Xiang and Huai armies had risen from the countryside; their commanders knew little of official regulations and could hardly know how military expenditure should be accounted for.
但以湘淮两军，起自田间，将领不谙规制，必不知军费应如何报销？

Someone had therefore organised clerks from both ministries to undertake the work as a package.
因而有人出头，邀约户兵两部的书办，商定了包揽的办法，

They would hire extra copyists, prepare brushes, ink and paper, and travel south specially to compile the armies’ accounts on the spot.
多雇书手，备办笔墨纸张；专程南下，就地为湘淮两军代办报销。

The commanders need trouble themselves with nothing, merely paying the customary “ministry fees”.
一切不用费心，只照例奉送『部费』即可。

The clerks considered this mutually beneficial and were certain both armies would welcome it.
在他们看，这是利人利己的两全之计，必为湘淮两军乐予接纳，

They had not only agreed on a plan but raised twenty thousand taels as capital.
所以不但已有成议，而且已经筹集了两万银子，作为『本钱』，

Their purchases of fine lianshi paper for the accounts alone had emptied the stocks of several paper shops in Liuli.
光是办购置造报销的连史纸，就将琉璃几家纸店的存货都搜空了。

“An ingenious arrangement,” Hu said, deliberately keeping his manner light.
『这个花样倒不错！』胡雪岩有意出以轻松的姿态，

“But the ministry fees will be substantial.
『不过这笔「部费」可观。

I dealt with them for the late Governor Wang.
我替殉节的王中丞经手过，

They amount to at least two per cent.”
至少要百分之二。』

“Exactly!” Zuo said.
『就是这话罗！』左宗棠说，

『我要跟你商量的就是这件事。

I have spent seventy million taels in all.
我前后用过七千万的银子，

At the customary rate, I should have to pay two hundred thousand.
如果照例致送，就得二十万银子。

Leave aside where I could find such spare money: even if I had it, I would not stuff it down a dog’s hole.
哪里来这笔闲钱，且不去说它；就有这笔闲钱，我也不愿意塞狗洞。

Think of a way to put an end to this.”
你倒想个法子看，怎么样打消了它！』

“Putting an end to it is easy.
『打消是容易，

Send word declining their services.
放句话出去挡驾就是。

But afterwards?
可是以后呢？

The trouble may be endless.
恐怕不胜其烦了！

Auditing military expenditure is the most tedious business.
军费报销是最噜苏的事，

A single case can remain unsettled for years.
一案核销，有几年不结的。

Consider carefully, Your Excellency: is dealing with these men worth your precious time and energy?”
大人倒仔细想一想，宝贵的精神，犯得着犯不着花在跟这些人打交道上头？』


“No!”
『不！』

Zuo disagreed emphatically.
左宗棠大不以为然，

“I mean that there should be no audit at all.
『我的意思是，根本不要办报销。

Military accounts were scrutinised most strictly in the Qianlong reign, when the ministry clerks had the most tricks.
军费报销，在乾隆年间最认真；部里书办的花样也最多。

But those were different times.
不过此一时，彼一时，

Then, under another man’s eaves, one had to bow one’s head.
那时是「在人檐下过，不敢不低头」；

Why should I bow mine now?
如今我又何必低头？

The Ministry of Revenue has no right to demand my accounts.”
户部也没有资格跟我要帐！』

这话说得太霸道了些。

The Xiang and Huai armies had indeed raised their own funds locally; the ministry had paid none of their expenses.
诚然，湘军和淮军的军费，都是在地方自筹，户部并没有支付过；

Yet whether the money came from likin or contributions, it was still public money.
但在地方自筹，不管是厘金、捐募，总是公款，

How could the ministry have no right even to ask for an account?
何致于户部连要个帐都没有资格？

Hu disagreed and remained silent.
胡雪岩不以左宗棠的话为然，因而沉默未答。

“Mr Xueyan,” Zuo pressed, “if you have an opinion, please enlighten me.”
『雪翁，』左宗棠催问着，『有何高见，请指教！』

Hu had to answer.
这就不能不回答了，

After a moment, he said, “This does not concern Your Excellency alone.”
胡雪岩想了一下答道∶『那不是大人一个人的事。』

“True.
『是啊！

But when the trouble comes, I cannot escape it.”
不过事情来了，我可是脱不了麻烦。』

“Even so, it will hardly be greater than the trouble facing the governor-general at Liangjiang.”
『就有麻烦，也不致于比两江来得大。』

Zuo understood.
这一说，左宗棠明白了，

“You mean we should prompt Grand Secretary Zeng to resist?”
『你的意思是，策动曾相去顶？』他问。

He meant Zeng Guofan, whose concurrent appointments as assistant grand secretary and governor-general of Liangjiang entitled him to be addressed as a chief minister.
这是指曾国藩，他以协办大学士兼领两江总督，也算入阁拜相，所以称之为『曾相』；

Hu nodded. “An argument presented by him seems more likely to succeed.”
胡雪岩正是此意，点点头答说∶『似乎以曾相出面去争，比较容易见效。』

“I have thought of that.
『我也想到过，

It is useless.
没有用。

Zeng fears slander and criticism; he is as timid as a mouse.
曾相忧谗畏讥，胆小如鼠；

He recently sent a confidential memorial asking the court to appoint another trusted minister to share his responsibilities.
最近还有密折，请朝廷另简亲信大臣，分任重责。

How could he disregard suspicion and request exemption from an audit?
你想，他怎么肯不避嫌疑，奏请免办报销？

Besides, the time is not yet ripe for such a memorial.”
何况时机亦还未到可以上折的时候？』

“That is the difficulty,” Hu said.
『难处就在这里。』胡雪岩说，

“The campaign is not over.
『军务究竟尚未告竣，

A premature request could only create needless complications.”
贸然奏请免办报销，反会节外生枝，惹起无谓的麻烦。』

“But we must remove the hidden danger now.
『可是消弭隐患，此刻就得着手。

Suppose the clerks win over the ministry’s departmental officers, then persuade its senior officials, and finally have the Grand Council present the matter to the two empress dowagers.
倘或部里书办勾结司员；然后说动堂官；再进而由军机奏闻两宫，

Once a decision is made, it will be hard to undo.”
一经定案，要打消就难了。』

Hu could not dismiss that concern.
胡雪岩觉得这番顾虑，决不能说是多余；

The words about clerks conspiring with departmental officers gave him an idea, and he answered without hesitation, “Then we might block the clerks at the first stage.”
而且由他的『书办勾结司员』这句话，触机而有灵感，不暇思索地答说∶『既然如此，不妨在第一关上就拿书办挡了回去。』

“Ah, ah!”
『喂，喂！』

Zuo pondered.
左宗棠一面想，

“There is something in that.
一面说，『你这话很有意味。

But how?”
然而，是如何个挡法呢？』


“The clerks cannot decide so great a matter themselves.
『这等大事，书办不能做主；

As you say, they must secure departmental support.
就如大人所说的，得要勾结司官。

An officer could throw cold water on the scheme from the outset, or seem to acquiesce and then speak out at the crucial moment.
司官给他们来盆冷水，迎头一浇；或者表面上敷衍，到紧要关头，挺身出来讲话，

If his argument is sound, the ministry’s senior officials cannot ignore it.”
只要有理，户部堂官亦不能不听。』

“True.
『话是有理。

But where shall we find a Revenue officer with the breadth of view and courage to do it?”
难在哪里去找这么一位明大体、有胆识的户部司官？』

“He need not possess either.
『不一定要明大体、有胆识。』

He need only see an advantage to himself.
胡雪岩答说，『只要这位司官，觉得这么做于他有利；

Then he will step forward.”
自然就会挺身而出。』

“Exactly!”
『着！』

Zuo again struck his thigh.
左宗棠又是猛拍自己的大腿，

“Your insight is a cut above others’, Mr Xueyan.
『雪翁，你的看法，确是高人一筹，

It clears away confusion.”
足以破惑。』

After a pause, he added, “You sound as though you have someone in mind already.”
略停一下，他又说道∶『听你的口气，似乎胸有成竹；已经想到有这么一个人了。』

“I do.
『是的。

A man from Hangzhou.”
就是杭州人。』

“A Hangzhou man?”
『杭州人，』

Zuo tilted his head.
左宗棠偏着头想，

“Who is serving as a departmental officer in Revenue?
『在户部当司官的是谁？

I cannot recall.”
我倒想不起来了。』

“He gained his metropolitan degree in the second year of Xianfeng and was assigned to Revenue.
『这个人是咸丰二年的进士，分发户部，

He began as a secretary and is now a director in charge of a departmental seal.
由主事做起，现在是掌印郎中了。

His name is Wang Wenshao.
他叫王文韶；

Have you heard of him?”
大人听说过此人没有？』

Zuo concentrated for a while, then remembered. “I seem to have heard him mentioned.
左宗棠凝神了一会，想起来了∶『似乎听人提起过。』他问，

Is his courtesy name Kuishi?”
『他的号，是叫夔石吗？』

“Yes.
『正是。

Wang Kuishi.”
王夔石。』

“What sort of man is he?
『此人怎么样？

Capable?”
很能干吧？』

“Very capable, and very smooth.
『很能干，也很圆滑；

He is well liked.
人缘不错。

Moreover, Shen Guifen, the ministry’s left vice-minister, was his examiner in the provincial examination and looks after this pupil.
加以户部左侍郎沈桂芬是他乡试的座师，很照应这个门生，

Wang is consequently well placed at Revenue.”
所以王夔石在户部很红。』

“If he is so smooth, he may not be willing to lead an argument.
『既然人很圆滑，只怕不肯出头去争！』左宗棠说，

Only a rather upright, outspoken man would do that.”
『这种事，只有性情比较耿直的人才肯做。』

“You are right.
『大人见得是。

But I do not propose urging him to argue openly.
不过，我的意思不是鼓动王夔石出头去力争，

I would ask him to work quietly behind the scenes.
是托他暗底下疏通。

For the sake of his own prospects, I think he would be willing.”
我想，为了他自己的前程，他是肯效劳的。』

“Why?
『何以见得？

Explain in detail, Mr Xueyan.”
雷翁，请道其详。』


In Hu’s view, a capital official who relied on himself rather than connections had two resources: learning or practical ability.
照胡雪岩的看法，做京官若说不靠关系靠自己，所可凭借者，不是学问，便是才干。

Hanlin scholars depended on learning, departmental officers on ability.
当翰林靠学问；当司官就要靠才干。

That meant the capacity to get things done, not some grand theory of government: when a practical difficulty arose, a man must produce a concrete solution, or at least find a way to get past it.
这才干是干济之才，不在乎腹有经纶，而是在政务上遇到难题，能有切切实实的办法拿出来。至少也要能搪塞得过去。

This was precisely Wang Wenshao’s strength.
王文韶之所长，正就是在此。

Yet in the capital, ability was a less useful resource than learning.
可是，做京官凭才干，实在不如凭学问。

A learned official advancing through the usual stages found constant opportunities to display his gifts.
因为凭学问做京官，循资推转，处处得以显其所长；

A Hanlin scholar could serve as a daily lecturer and recorder of the emperor’s activities, then enter the offices of the heir apparent and rise to senior metropolitan rank.
翰林做到兼日讲起注官，进而『开坊』升任京堂，

Such officials could submit memorials directly—another opportunity to show their learning.
都可以专折言事，更是卖弄学问的时候。

One memorial might catch the emperor’s attention and bring rapid advancement, even a red hat-button within three or four years.
也许一道奏疏，上结天知，就此飞黄腾达，三数年间便能戴上红顶子。

Practical ability offered no such convenient path.
而凭才干做官。就没有这样便宜了！

“Why?” Hu asked.
『为啥呢？

“Because a hero needs a field on which to use his weapons.
因为英雄要有用武之地。

Departmental officers handle official matters daily and wield considerable power to approve or reject.
做部里司官，每天公事经手，该准该驳，权柄很大；

There is a reason for approval and a reason for rejection.
准有准的道理，驳有驳的缘故，

Put the case correctly, and your ability shows.
只要说得对，自然显的的才干。

But you cannot remain a departmental officer all your life.
可是司官不能做一辈子；

Wang Kuishi has been a director for years.
象王夔石，郎中做了好多年了，

If he rises to a fourth-rank metropolitan post, he may go to the Court of State Ceremonial or the Office of Transmission.
如果升做四品京堂，那些鸿胪寺、通政司，

Those offices are like a deaf man’s ears: without them, the appearance is wrong; with them, they serve no purpose.
都是「聋子的耳朵」，没有它不象样子，有了它毫无用处。

However great Wang’s abilities, he cannot use them in an idle office with nothing to do.”
王夔石就有天大的本事，无奈冷衙门无事可做，也是枉然。』

Hu paused. “There is another route for departmental officers: examination for a censor’s post.
胡雪岩略停一下又说∶『司官推转，还有一条出路就是考御史；

But a censor’s work requires literary composition above all, and Wang cannot manage it.
当御史更是只要做文章 的差使，王夔石搞不来。

Nor is he a stern, impartial man.
而且他也不是什么铁面无情的人；

He always tries to avoid making enemies.
平时惟恐跟人结怨，

How could he be a censor?”
哪里好当什么都老爷？』

“I understand!” Zuo said.
『我懂了！』左宗棠说，

“He does not want to remain in the capital.
『王夔石是不愿做京官，

He wants a provincial appointment?”
只想外放？』

“Yes, as a prefect.
『是的。外放做知府；

If he does well, he can become a circuit intendant in two or three years.”
做得好，三两年就可以升道员。』

Hu smiled. “A provincial official must rely on governors and governors-general.”
胡雪岩笑笑说道∶『做外官，就要靠督抚了！』

Zuo now understood completely.
这一下，左宗棠一心领神会，彻底明了。

No one knew better than he how dependent provincial officials were on their superiors.
因为做外官靠督抚，没有比他更清楚的。

Under the Qing, governors and governors-general held great power.
清朝的督抚权重，

If they disliked a capital official appointed as a prefect or intendant, they had formerly been able to declare him unequal to his duties and request his return to the capital—effectively overturning the imperial appointment.
京官外转府道；督抚如果不喜此人，从前可以『才不胜任』的理由，奏请『请京任用』，等于推翻朝旨。

Early in the Qianlong reign, an edict had sharply rebuked this practice and forbidden its repetition.
乾隆初年，虽曾下诏切责，不准再有这样的事例；

Even so, provincial chiefs still had ways to prevent a man from taking up his post or to request his transfer.
可是督抚仍旧有办法可以不使此人到任，或者奏请调职。

For officials sent to a province merely to await vacancies, with no specific appointment, the timing and the richness or poverty of the eventual post lay still more completely in their hands.
至于未经指明缺分，只分省候补任用的，补缺的迟早；缺分的优瘠，其权更操之督抚。


If Wang Wenshao wished to serve outside the capital, he must therefore cultivate them.
因此可以想象得到，王文韶如果志在外官，就必得与督抚结缘；

Securing exemption from the audit of expenditure against the Hong-Yang rebellion was an opportunity that might never come again.
而能够设法搞成免办平洪杨的军费报销，正是可遇而不可求的良机。

Every Xiang and Huai commander would be grateful.
因为这一条，湘港将领，无不感戴；

Consider the provincial chiefs then in office: Zeng Guofan at Liangjiang, Zuo himself in Fujian and Zhejiang, Li Hongzhang in Jiangsu, Liu Changyou in Zhili, Luo Bingzhang in Sichuan, Guanwen in Huguang, Zhang Zhiwan in Henan, Shen Baozhen in Jiangxi, Yan Shusen in Hubei, and Guo Songtao in Guangdong.
而天下督抚，就眼前来说，两江曾国藩、闽浙是左宗棠自己、江苏李鸿章 、直隶刘长佑、四川路秉章 、湖广官文、河南张之万、江西沈荷桢、湖北严树森、广东郭嵩焘，

Every one had spent great sums on the war.
哪一个都花过大把银子的军费；

Exemption from an audit would leave each personally obliged to Wang.
能够免办报销，个人要见王文韶的情，

If he were assigned to their province, how could they fail to favour him?
等他分发到省，岂有不格外照应之理？

Half the knot in Zuo’s mind loosened.
想到这里，左宗棠心头的一个疙瘩，消减了一半，

“If Wang is truly capable, he should seize this chance to make friends with governors throughout the empire.”
『王夔石果然是能干的，就得好好抓住这个机会，普结天下督抚之缘。』

Then he recalled something surprising in Hu’s account.
他又回想了一下胡雪岩的话，发现有件事令人惊异，

“Have you ever been to Beijing, Mr Xueyan?”
便即问道∶『雪翁，你到京里去过没有？』


“Not yet.”
『还不曾过去。』

“That is strange.
『那就怪了！

You have never visited the capital and are half official, half merchant.
你没有上过京，又是半官半商，

How do you know so much about promotion through the metropolitan service?”
何以倒对京官的推迁升转，如此熟悉？』

“Originally I knew nothing.
『我本来也不懂。

I met Wang Kuishi in Shanghai the year before last, and we talked for several nights.
前年跟王夔石在上海见面，长谈了好几夜；

I heard it all from him.”
都是听他说的。』

“So that is it.
『原来如此！

Still, to explain the whole course of it so clearly is no small achievement.
不过能说得清源流，也很难得的了。』

Do you know him well?”
左宗棠又问∶『你跟王夔石很熟？』

“Yes, though we are not close friends.”
『是的。』胡雪岩又说，『不过并无深交。』

“Your conversations seem to have gone deeply into things.”
『看你们谈得倒很深。』

“Common interests can make a discussion profound.
『有利害关系，谈得就深了；

Friendship is another matter.
交情又另是一回事。

Wang has no great brilliance or ambition.
王夔石没有什么才气，也没有什么大志，

He is so smooth in dealing with people that he lacks sincerity.
做人太圆滑，未免欠诚恳。

I do not like him.”
我不喜欢这个人。』

These words suited Zuo’s taste and gave him a clearer understanding of Hu’s nature.
左宗棠觉得胡雪岩这几句话，颇对自己的胃口；同时对他的本性，也更为了解，

Here was a man with whom he could discuss great matters and share adversity.
确是个可以论大事、共患难的人。

He nodded repeatedly in silent approval.
因而不断点头，表示心许。


“Then Your Excellency would like me to write to Wang and ask him to do what he can?”
『大人的意思是，』胡雪岩问道∶『让我写封信给王夔石，请他从中尽力？』

“Yes.
『是的。

But I fear he cannot accomplish it alone.
我有这个意思。不过，我怕他一个人的力量不够；

If he goes knocking at every door and stirs up a public commotion, he will do harm rather than good.”
四处去瞎撞木钟，搞得满城风雨，无益有害。』

“His own strength is indeed insufficient, but he knows what is at stake.
『他一个的力量，诚然不够；不过事情的轻重，他是识得的。

He is cautious by nature, not a flighty man who will talk recklessly everywhere.
他的本性也是谨慎小心一路，决不致于飞扬浮躁，到处瞎说。

Since you mention it, I shall particularly stress secrecy.”
大人这样说，我信上格外关照，叫他秘密就是。』

“That would be best.”
『能这样最好。』

Zuo turned to his attendants. “Bring the Official Register.”
说到这里，左宗棠向左右吩咐∶『拿「缙绅」来！』

This was a directory printed by Beijing booksellers, its full title the Complete Register of Officials of the Great Qing.
缙绅是京师书坊刻的一部职官录，全名叫做『大清缙绅全书』。

Beginning with the Imperial Clan Court and continuing down to the subordinate and miscellaneous officials in every province, it gave brief records of every holder of an official title, from princes to men below the ranked service.
由『宗人府』开始，一直到各省的佐杂官儿，从亲王到未入流，凡是有职衔的，无不有简历记载。

Zuo wanted to examine the Ministry of Revenue.
左宗棠索取缙绅，是要查户部的职官。

At the head of that section he found: “Woren, Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, supervising the affairs of the Ministry of Revenue.”
翻到『户部衙门』这一栏，头一行是『文渊阁大学士管理户部事务倭仁』。

His face brightened immediately. “Good!
左宗棠顿时喜孜孜地说∶『行了！

There is hope of success.”
此事可望有成。』


“Oh?” Hu asked. “What have you discovered?”
『喔，』胡雪岩问道∶『大人参透了什么消息？』

“Grand Secretary Woren is a Mongol, but his family has long served in the Kaifeng garrison, so he is much like a Henan man.
『这倭相辊蒙古人。他家一直驻防开封；所以跟河南人没有什么两样。

Henan is a home of Neo-Confucian learning.
河南是讲理学的地方，

He follows every rule and convention; a little pedantic, perhaps, but an orthodox moralist through and through.
这倭相国规行矩步，虽然有点迂，倒是不折不扣的道学先生；

The late emperor valued him highly, and both empress dowagers respect him.
先帝对此人颇为看重，所以两宫太后亦很尊敬他，

If we can get the old gentleman to speak, the matter cannot fail.”
能得此老出头说话，事无不成之理。』

“May I tell Wang Kuishi this?”
『那末，』胡雪岩问道∶『这话可以不可以跟王夔石说？』

“He knows these circumstances far better than we do.
『这些情形，王夔石比我们清楚得多。

You may tell him or leave it unsaid.” Zuo added, “Woren and Zeng passed the metropolitan examination in the same year.
说亦可、不说亦可。』左宗棠又说，『这倭相国与曾相会试同榜；

Presumably he would help an old examination colleague.”
想来他亦肯帮帮老同年的忙的。』

“Then why not write to Grand Secretary Zeng and ask him to make a firm appeal to Woren?”
『既然如此，何不由大人写封信给曾相；结结实实托一托倭中堂？』

“That is one method.
『这也是一法。

But I fear Zeng may be too full of moral propriety to write such a letter.”
我怕曾相亦在道学气，未见得肯写这样的信。』

“Yes,” Hu said, while thinking differently.
『是！』胡雪岩口里答应着，心中另有盘算。

The affair was important, but did not concern him personally.
兹事体大，而不与自己相干。

Even Zuo need not be so anxious.
甚至左宗棠亦不必太关切；

If the sky fell, the tallest men would hold it up.
天塌下来有长人顶，

The Zeng brothers had spent several times as much on the war as Zuo.
曾氏弟兄所支销的军费比左宗棠所经手的，多过好几倍；

An audit would strike them first, and they would naturally seek a way to resolve the difficulty.
要办军费报销，曾氏弟兄，首当其冲，自然会设法疏通化解。

In advising Zuo, Hu need not be overzealous.
如今自己替左宗棠出主意，不须太起劲；

Better to avoid mistakes before trying to win credit.
不求有功，先求无过，最为上策。


This reflection made him more cautious.
这样转念，步子便踏得更稳了，

“For safety’s sake, we might first write to Wang, tell him the idea and ask his opinion.
『为求妥当，我看莫如这么办，先写信透露给王夔石，问问他的意思，

Can it be done?
看看能不能做得到？

If so, how should we begin?
要做，如何着手；

Let him send a brief outline.”
请他写个节略来！』

“Nothing could be better.
『这样做再好都没有。

But will he agree?”
可是，』左宗棠怀疑地问，『他肯吗？』

“Certainly.
『一定肯！

I have a favour on account with him.”
我有交情放给他。』

“Did you not say you were not close friends?”
『你不是说∶你们没有深交吗？』

Having a “favour on account” was an expression from the world outside official circles, and did not mean close friendship.
『放交情』是句江湖上的话，与深交有别，

Zuo did not understand it, so Hu explained. “I mean that Wang owes me a favour.
左宗棠不懂这句话，胡雪岩便只好解释∶『我是说，王夔石欠下我一个人情在那里；

If I ask him to do something, he will not begrudge the trouble.”
所以我托他点事，他一定不会怕麻烦。』

“Then that settles it.
『那就是了。

Success will benefit you as well.
此事能办成功，与你也有好处；

Zeng and Li Shaoquan will both be obliged to you.” Zuo laughed heartily.
曾相、李少荃都要见你的情。』说罢，左宗棠哈哈一笑。

There was something unfathomable in the laugh.
这一笑便有些莫测高深了。

People said this man liked to assert his own heroic superiority; naturally, he liked political manoeuvring too.
胡雪岩心想，大家都说此公好作英雄欺人之谈；当然也喜欢用权术。

Was he testing Hu with that remark and inexplicable laughter?
他说这话，又打这么一个莫名其妙的哈哈，莫非有什么试探之意在内？

On reflection, whether it was a test or not, Hu could use the opportunity to declare his intentions.
继而转念，不管他是不是试探？自己正不妨借此机会，表明心迹，

He answered seriously. “Your Excellency, I am different from Wang Kuishi.
因而正色说道∶『大人！我跟王夔石不同，

He seeks rapid advancement in office.
王夔石是想做官上头飞黄腾达；

I want to do business on a grand scale.
我是想做大生意。

When I look at myself in the mirror, I do not see the makings of an official.
因为自己照照镜子，不象做官的材料。

I therefore care nothing whether Grand Secretary Zeng or Governor Li feels obliged to me.
所以曾相跟李中函见不见我的情，我毫不在乎；

Even if they do, I shall not seek their favour.
他们见我的情，我亦不会去巴结他们的。

There is only one man whose favour I seek.”
如今，我倒是只巴结一个人！』

He paused deliberately to see Zuo’s response.
谈到这里，他有意停了下来，要看左宗棠是何反应？

Zuo naturally asked, with great interest, “Whose?”
左宗棠当然要问；而且是很关切地问∶『巴结谁？』

“Whose else but Your Excellency’s?
『还有谁？自然是大人。』

I seek your favour not to obtain office, but out of gratitude.
胡雪岩说，『我巴结大人，不是想做官，是报答。

First, you have saved Zhejiang, above all by recovering Hangzhou.
第一、大人是我们浙江的救星，尤其是克复了杭州；

When drinking water, one remembers its source.
饮水思源，

I can return home today, and Governor Wang’s spirit can rest in peace.
想到我今天能回家乡；王雪公地下有知，可以瞑目，

How could I not be grateful?
不能不感激大人。

Second, you have thought well of me and recognised my worth at our first meeting.
第二、承蒙大人看得起我，一见就赏识，

‘A man will die for one who understands him.’ Whose favour should I seek if not yours?”
所谓「士为知己者死」不巴结大人巴结谁？』

“Too much, too much!
『言重，言重！

My dear fellow, you flatter me excessively,” Zuo replied, his face wreathed in smiles.
你老哥太捧我了。』左宗棠笑容满面地回答。



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第八章（本章第9部分，共9部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“Those are my true feelings.
『这是我的真心话。

I believe Your Excellency can see that,” Hu continued.
大人想来看得出来。』胡雪岩又说，

“Beyond that, naturally, I have ambitions of my own.
『除此以外，我当然也有我的打算，

I want to build something substantial.
很想做一番事业，

If a man is to achieve anything, half depends on ability and half on opportunity.
一个人如果要想有所成就，一半靠本事；一半靠机会。

Meeting you is an opportunity for me.
遇见大人就是我的一个机会；

Naturally I am unwilling to let it pass lightly.”
当然不肯轻易放过。』

“You speak honestly.
『你的话很老实，

It is precisely your kind of nature that I find congenial.
我就是觉得象你这路性情最投缘。

Tell me what sort of enterprise you wish to build.”
你倒说与我听听，你想做的是什么事业？』

That was an easy question—so easy that it might seem unnecessary.
这一问，很容易回答；容易得使人会觉得这一问根本多余。

Yet a plain answer would be flat and tasteless.
但照实而言，质直无味；

Hu was no master of rhetoric, but his friendship with Ji Heling had taught him a roundabout manner of expression that sometimes lent elegance to ordinary thoughts.
胡雪岩虽不善于词令，却以交了嵇鹤龄这个朋友，学到了一种迂回的说法，有时便觉俗中带雅。

Fortunately, his quick mind could make up for his limited store of learning.
好在他的心思快，敏捷可济腹笥的不足；

An anecdote occurred to him that he could put to good use.
此时想到一个掌故，大可借来一用。


“Your Excellency must know the story of the Qianlong Emperor at Jinshan Temple in Zhenjiang during his southern tours?”
『大人总晓得乾隆皇帝南巡，在镇江金山寺的一个故事？』

Zuo smiled.
左宗棠笑了。

His reasons were complicated, and even he could not have defined everything in that smile.
笑的原因很复杂，笑的意味，自己亦不甚分明。

To call the ruler “the Qianlong Emperor” instead of “Gaozong” or “Emperor Chun” was one cause for amusement.
不称『高宗』或者『纯庙』，而说『乾隆皇帝』是一可笑；

Qianlong had made six southern tours and, as Zuo remembered it, stayed at Jinshan Temple each time.
乾隆六次南巡，在左宗棠的记忆中，每次都驻驾金山寺，

There were many stories; which did Hu mean?
故事不少，却不知指的是哪一个？

That was a second cause. Third, here was a man who spent his life turning somersaults through the hole in a copper coin, proposing to discuss imperial tours with him.
是二可笑∶『铜钱眼里翻跟斗』的胡雪岩，居然要跟他谈南巡故事，那就是三可笑了。

Amusing as it was, Zuo remained indulgent.
可笑虽可笑，不过左宗棠仍持着宽容的心情；

It was like hearing a small child utter a solemn grown-up remark: one could only smile and hear him out.
好比听稚龄童子说出一句老气横秋的『大人话』那样，除笑以外，就只有『姑妄听之』了。

“Go on.”
『你说！』

His encouraging glance invited Hu to tell his tale.
他用一种鼓励的眼色，表示不妨『姑妄言之』。

Hu naturally did not pretend to expertise.
胡雪岩当然不会假充内行，

“I do not know in which year of the southern tours it happened.
老老实实答道∶『我也不晓得是哪一年乾隆皇帝南巡的事？

An older sworn brother told me, and I found it interesting enough to remember.
我是听我的一个老把兄谈过，觉得很有意思，所以记住了，

They say—” They said that once Qianlong and the abbot were standing before the temple, gazing idly at the sails scattered over the Yangtze.
据说——。』据说∶有一次乾隆与金山寺的方丈，在寺前闲眺，遥望长江风帆点点；

The emperor asked how many boats were on the river.
乾隆问方丈∶江中有船几许？

“Only two,” the abbot replied.
方丈答说∶只有两艘，

“One for fame, one for gain.”
一艘为名；一艘为利。

The story arose from the Yangzhou salt merchants’ knowledge of Qianlong’s temperament: to receive the imperial party, they had specially engaged monks skilled in witty exchanges.
这是扬州的盐商，深知乾隆的性情，特意延聘善于斗机锋的和尚，承应皇差的佳话。

Long repetition, however, had made the anecdote commonplace and stale.
只是传说既久，变成既俗且滥的一个故事；

Zuo naturally supposed he knew Hu’s point.
胡雪岩引此以喻，左宗棠当然知道他的用意，

His enterprise was merely business on a grand scale, pursued for profit.
是说他的事业，只是『做大生意』图利而已。


But Hu unexpectedly gave it a new meaning.
然而，他没有想到，胡雪岩居然另有新义，

“In my view, the old monk was not necessarily right.”
『照我说，那位老和尚的话，也不见得对。』

He lifted a hand and pointed into the distance with animation. “There is really only one boat on the Yangtze: it sails for both fame and gain.”
胡雪岩很起劲地举手遥指∶『长江上的船，实在只有一艘，既为名，亦为利！』

“Oh!”
『噢！』

Zuo looked at him with fresh respect.
左宗棠刮目相看了，

“How do you make that out?”
『何以见得？』

“Fame and gain are really the same thing.”
『名利原是一样东西。』

Hu seemed a little uneasy.
胡雪岩略有些不安地，

“Your Excellency, I am only talking at random.”
『大人，我是瞎说。』

This went deeper than saying a boat pursued both fame and gain, hoping to obtain the two together.
这比『既然为名，亦为利』，企求兼得的说法，又深一层了。

Zuo was increasingly interested and about to press him when an attendant slipped quietly to his side.
左宗棠越感兴味；正待往下追问时，但见听差悄悄掩到他身边，

“Will Mr Hu stay for a meal?”
低声问道∶『是不是留胡老爷便饭？』

“Of course.
『当然。』

What time is it?”
左宗棠问道∶『什么时候了？』

“The middle of the wei hour.”
『未正！』

That meant two in the afternoon.
未正就是午后两点，

Zuo was surprised.
左宗棠讶然，

“We have talked until I forgot the time.” He asked apologetically, “You must have been hungry for a while, Mr Xueyan?”
『一谈谈得忘了时候了。』他歉然地问，『雪翁，早饿了吧？』

“Until you mentioned it, I did not notice.”
『大人不提起，倒不觉得饿。』

“Nor did I.
『是啊！

Our conversation was so congenial that I forgot to eat.
我亦是谈得投机，竟尔忘食。

Come, we can talk over the meal.”
来吧，我们一面吃，一面谈。』


Lunch was served in the garden reception room.
于是午饭就开在花厅里。

Zuo ate and drank heartily, but his dishes were abundant rather than refined.
左宗棠健于饮啖，但肴馔量多而质不精；

Part of the reason was the general shortage after the catastrophe; there was little scope for indulging the palate.
一半是因为大劫以后，百物皆缺，亦无法讲求口腹之欲，

The finest dish was a great platter of young chicken stir-fried with red chillies.
席中盛馔，不过是一大盘红辣椒炒子鸡。

There was also a small plate of cured pork.
再有一小碟腊肉；

Hu knew it had been sent all the way from Hunan by Madam Zhou.
胡雪岩知道是左宗棠的周夫人，远自湖南寄来的，

A guest must eat it, and praise it lavishly, so it was the first thing he took with his chopsticks.
客人非吃不可，而且非盛赞不可，所以下箸便先挟腊肉。

Before he could properly commend her virtue, Zuo hurried back to their interrupted discussion.
腊肉进口，左宗棠顾不得听他夸赞周夫人的贤德，急于想重拾中断的话题，

“Mr Xueyan, I do not think I have heard anyone say before that fame and gain are the same thing.
『雪翁，』他说，『你说名利原是一样东西，这话倒似乎没有听人说过；

You must have a reasoned explanation.”
你总有一番言之成理的说法吧？』

“I was only speaking casually,” Hu answered calmly. “I often wondered whether a man should seek fame first or profit.
『我原是瞎说。』胡雪岩从容答道∶『我常在想，人生在世应该先求名、还是先求利？

One day I put the question to a friend.
有一天跟朋友谈到这个疑问，

‘I know nothing of other matters,’ he said, ‘but in business reputation must come first.
他说∶别的我不知道，做生意是要先求名，

Otherwise, why do we speak of a golden signboard?’
不然怎么叫「金字招牌」呢？

That made excellent sense.
这话大有道理，

Once you establish such a reputation, business naturally flourishes far and wide.
创出金字招牌，自然生意兴隆通四海，

Fame comes, and substance follows.
名归实至。

Does that not make fame and gain the same thing?”
岂非名利就是一样东西？』

“An interesting reversal of the saying ‘Substance comes, and fame follows’,” Zuo remarked.
『你把实至名归这句话，颠倒来说，倒也有趣。』左宗棠又问，

“But apart from trade, can your argument be applied elsewhere?”
『除了做买卖呢？别处地方可也能用得上你这个说法不能？』


“In some cases.
『也有用得上的。

Take a scholar: once he becomes famous, the great men in the capital all want him as a pupil.
譬如读书人，名气大了，京里的大老，都想收这个门生，

Before he even sits the metropolitan examination, his selection for the Hanlin Academy seems assured.”
还不曾会试，好象就注定了一定会点翰林似的。』

At this point Hu remembered Zuo’s repeated failures in that examination.
说到这里，胡雪岩记起左宗棠数上春官，铩羽而归，

He still held only the provincial degree, and talk of metropolitan success and Hanlin appointments left him with a sour feeling.
至今还是一个举人，所以听见人谈中进士、点翰林，心里便酸溜溜地不好受；

The example was ill chosen.
自己举这个例，实在不合时宜。

Fortunately, Hu’s wits were quick, and an excellent alternative lay immediately before him.
好在他的机变快，就地风光，恰有一个极好的例子可举。

“Take Your Excellency yourself.
『再譬如大人。』

Years ago, far away in Zhejiang, we heard of an extraordinary ‘Adviser Zuo’ in Hunan.
他说，『当年我们远在浙江，就听说湖南有位「左师爷」，真正了不起！

Your name was known throughout the empire, even to the emperor.
大人名满天下，连皇上都知道，

He told a Hanlin scholar from your province, ‘Tell that fellow Zuo to come and work for me.’
跟贵省的一位翰林说∶叫左某人出来给我办事。

And so it proved: either you held no office, or you became governor at once.
果不其然，不做官则已，一做便是抚台。

No one begins official life as a provincial governor.
从来初入仕途，没有一下子就当巡抚的；

The favour shown you was without precedent and will never be repeated.
大人的恩遇，空前绝后。

That too is fame bringing substance in its wake.”
这也就是名归实至的道理。』

The compliment lifted Zuo’s spirits to the heavens.
这顶高帽子套在左宗棠头上，顿时使他起了与天相接之感，

He seemed to float among the clouds, light and exhilarated.
仿佛在云端里似的，飘飘然好不轻快！

Unconsciously stroking his short, greying moustache, he raised his cup with a smile. “You praise me too highly, but it is true.
不自觉地拈着花白短髭，引杯笑道∶『虽蒙过奖，倒也是实情。

To begin with only a provincial degree and enter office as a provincial chief—mine alone has been that exceptional fortune.
一介举人而入仕便是封疆大吏，这个异数，老夫独叨，

It should hearten every poor scholar in the empire.
足令天下寒儒吐气！

Come, Mr Xueyan, I drink to you!”
雪翁，来，来，我敬你一杯！』

With that friendly cup, their intimacy deepened almost to the point of complete confidence.
就这杯酒交欢之间，左宗棠与胡雪岩的情谊又加深了；深到几乎可以推心置腹的地步。

Their conversation accordingly grew freer still.
因而说话亦越发无所隐讳顾忌。

Returning to the Hunan scholar whom the Xianfeng Emperor had told to summon Zuo, Hu asked whether he was Guo Songtao, now governor of Guangdong.
谈到咸丰曾向湖南一位翰林表示，『叫左某人出来给我办事』时；胡雪岩问说，这位翰林可是现任广东巡抚郭嵩焘？

“The very man!”
『正是他！』

Zuo’s voice rose involuntarily, as though stirred by strong feeling.
左宗棠的声音不自觉地高了，似乎有些激动似的。


Hu was puzzled.
这使得胡雪岩不免困惑。

He had heard that Guo had once saved Zuo.
因为他曾听说过，郭嵩焘救过左宗棠；

Such an unusual tone towards an old friend and benefactor sounded distinctly jarring.
对于己有恩的故交，出之以这种的异样口吻，听来真有些刺耳。

Zuo too was adept at reading expressions, and had grievances he wished to air.
左宗棠也是善于察言观色的人；而且心里也有牢骚要吐，

He quickly asked, “You presumably know the connection between us?”
所以很快地接下来问∶『他跟我的渊源，想来你总知道？』

“Not much of it.”
『知道得不多。』

“Then let me tell you.
『那么，我来说给你听。

It happened in the eighth year of Xianfeng—” In the spring of that year, Fan Xie, brigade-general of Yongzhou in Hunan, had been greedy, lawless and unrestrained.
是咸丰八年的事——。』咸丰八年春天，湖南永州镇总兵樊燮，贪纵不法，

He had also offended the immensely powerful “Adviser Zuo”.
又得罪了势焰熏天的『左师爷』，

Zuo accordingly drafted a severe impeachment.
因而为左宗棠主稿上奏，严劾樊燮，

When the memorial was dispatched, a cannon was fired according to custom.
拜折之时，照例发炮；

Luo Bingzhang heard it from his office and wondered: it was not the time for the noon gun, so what was happening? An attendant told him, “Adviser Zuo is sending a military memorial.”
骆秉章坐在签押房里听见声音，觉得奇怪。看时候不是午炮，然则所为何来『听差的告诉他说∶』左师爷发军报折。

Zuo had always acted with such independence in Luo’s secretariat, earning another nickname, “Left Censor-in-Chief”.
『左宗棠在路秉章 幕府中，一向这样独断独行；因而又有个外号叫『左都御史』——

Governors routinely carried two additional titles: Right Vice-Minister of War, to give them authority over military officers, and Right Deputy Censor-in-Chief, to allow them to discipline and impeach officials.
巡抚照例挂两个衔∶一个是兵部右侍郎，便于管辖武官；一个是右副都御史，便于整饬吏治，参劾官吏。

Since Adviser Zuo’s power exceeded Luo’s, calling him “Left Censor-in-Chief”—a play on his surname—implied that the official on the right had to obey him.
而『左师爷』的威权高过骆秉章 ，称他『左都御史』是表示右副都御史得要听他的。

Luo had heard nothing beforehand of the impeachment of Fan.
这一次参劾樊燮，骆秉章 事前亦无所闻；

Now he asked to see the memorial.
此时才要了奏折来看，

Its language was severe, but the charges were not groundless.
措词极其严厉，但也不是无的放矢，

The claim that Fan could not read a single character, for example, was true.
譬如说樊燮『目不识丁』，便是实情。

Since the memorial had already been sent, there was no recalling it.
既已拜折，没有追回来的道理，

Luo let the matter rest.
也就算了。


At the time, the court relied heavily on provincial chiefs commanding armies, and almost every impeachment they submitted was accepted.
其时朝廷正倚任各省带兵的督抚，凡有参劾，几乎无一不准；

Fan therefore lost his post.
樊燮就此革了职。

Convinced that Zuo had acted from a private grudge, he indignantly lodged a complaint with the governor-general of Huguang and sent someone to Beijing to petition the Censorate.
只以左宗棠挟有私怨，大为不服；便向湖广总督衙门告了一状，又派人进京向都察院呈控，

His charge was against Zuo, but implicated Luo as well: the Hunan governor’s office, he said, had “one post and two seals”.
告的是左宗棠，也牵连到路秉章 ，说湖南巡抚衙门是『一官两印』。

So grave a case naturally required investigation.
这是大案，当然要查办。

The commissioners appointed were Guanwen, governor-general of Huguang, and Qian Dingqing, chief examiner of the Hubei provincial examination.
查办大员一个是湖广总督官文；另外一个是湖北乡试的主考官钱定青。

Guanwen’s attendants had already accepted Fan’s bribes, and matters looked unfavourable for Zuo.
官文左右已经受了樊燮的赌；形势对左宗棠相当不利。

Fortunately, Hu Linyi, governor of Hubei, had established a special family connection with Guanwen: the latter’s favourite concubine was the adopted daughter of Hu’s mother.
幸亏湖北巡抚胡林翼，与官文结上一层特殊的关系——官文的宠妾是胡老太太的义女；

Even Guanwen therefore addressed Hu as “Brother Hu”.
所以连官文都称胡林翼为『胡大哥』。

The adopted daughter often told Guanwen, “You understand nothing.
这位胡老太太的义女，常对官文说∶『你什么都不懂！

Just hold your office quietly and enjoy yourself.
只安安分分做你的官，享你的福；

Leave everything to Brother Hu, and you cannot go wrong.”
什么事都托付给胡大哥，包你不错。』

Guanwen genuinely listened to her.
官文亦真听她的话；

Hu Linyi could therefore mediate and work hard to settle the affair, giving Zuo great assistance.
所以胡林翼得以从中斡旋，极力排解，帮了左宗棠很大的一个忙。


“In short, Guo Yunxian has soared into the clouds.
『总而言之，郭筠仙平地青云，

Within two years, a fortunate conjunction of circumstances has made him a provincial chief.
两年之间，因缘时会，得任封疆，

His rise has been abrupt.
其兴也暴；

He should be modest and self-disciplined, striving to make his qualities match his reputation.
应该虚心克己，以期名实相称。

Otherwise he will become a laughing-stock, perhaps even ruin himself utterly.
不然，必成笑柄；甚至身败名烈！

I am very anxious for him.”
我甚为筠仙危。』

At this point, Zuo suddenly could not contain his amusement.
说到这里，左宗棠忽然忍俊不禁了，

“Grand Secretary Zeng looks so solemnly moral, but sometimes his remarks have a wonderfully dry edge.
『曾相道貌俨然，出语亦有很冷隽的时候了。

Someone came to camp a few days ago and reported Guo’s complaint: ‘Zeng Disheng has recommended many men in his life.
前几天有人到营里来谈起，说郭筠仙责备「曾涤生平生保人甚多，

Unfortunately, one of them was the ill-chosen Mao Jiyun.’
可惜错保了一个毛寄云」。

When Zeng heard it, what do you think he did?”
这话传到曾相耳里，你道他如何？』

“With his self-command, surely he merely smiled?”
『以曾相的涵养，自然付之一笑？』

“Not at all.
『不然。

He said, ‘Mao Jiyun has also recommended many men in his life.
曾相对人说∶』毛寄云平生保人亦不少，

Unfortunately, one of them was the ill-chosen Guo Yunxian.’
可惜错保一个郭筠仙！

Point for point—exquisite!”
「针锋相对，妙不可言。

Zuo burst out laughing.
『左宗棠说完大笑。

Hu laughed too, reflecting that Guo was assailed on all sides in his governorship.
胡雪岩亦不由得笑了；一面笑一面心里在想，郭嵩焘做这个巡抚，可说四面受敌，

Remarkable that he could hold on!
亏他还能撑得下去！

He seemed a tough man, worth getting to know if the opportunity arose.
看起来是一条硬汉；有机会倒要好好结识。

But for some reason Zuo’s smile vanished, and anxiety appeared.
左宗棠却不知怎么，笑容尽敛，忧形于色，』

“Mr Xueyan, sometimes the thought frightens me.
雪翁，『他说，』我有时想想很害怕！

One hand cannot clap.
因为孤掌难鸣。

For wealth, Jiangsu and Guangdong stand together, each drawing riches from Chinese and foreign trade through its maritime customs.
论天下之富，苏、广并称，都以海关擅华洋之利。

Now Zeng and Li have Jiangsu and Shanghai, while Guangdong supplies funds to the Zeng brothers.
如今江苏跟上海有曾、李；广东又为曾氏兄弟饷源。

Guo’s official reputation may be poor, but once Jinling falls, Zeng the Ninth will naturally be pleased with himself.
郭筠仙虽然官声不佳，但如金陵一下，曾老九自然要得意；

Remembering where his resources came from, he can be expected to support Guo vigorously for his fundraising.
饮水思源，以筹饷之功，极力维持郭筠仙，亦是意中之事。

In that situation, I shall have very little room to move.
照此形势，我的处境就太局促了！

What advice can you give me?”
雪翁，你何以教我？『


Zuo spoke gravely and with profound intent.
这番话，左宗堂说得很郑重，很深；

Hu listened just as carefully.
胡雪岩亦听得很用心，很细。

There was meaning beneath the words, purpose beneath the thought.
话外有话、意中有意；

This was a great matter touching Zuo’s future and perhaps Hu’s own interests.
是有关左宗棠的前程，也可能有关自己利害的一件大事，

There was neither need nor reason to answer hastily.
不宜也不必遽尔回答，

With equal gravity, he replied, “Your Excellency looks far ahead.
便以同样严肃的神色答道∶『大人看得很远；

I must think carefully before answering.”
要让我好好想一想，才能奉答。』

“Good.
『好！

Please give it careful thought for me.” Zuo added, “This is not for other ears.”
请你好好替我想一想。』左宗棠又说，『不足为外人道。』

“Of course!”
『当然！』

Hu’s expression was solemn.
胡雪岩神色凛然，

“Surely I understand that much.”
『我不能连这个道理都不懂。』

“Yes, yes,” Zuo said apologetically.
『是，是，』左宗棠歉疚地，

“I misspoke.”
『我失言了。』

“You are too kind.”
『大人言重。』

Hu inclined himself.
胡雪岩欠一欠身子，

“There must be many others waiting to see you.
『等着见大人的，只怕还很多，

I shall take my leave.”
我先告辞。』

“Very well.
『也好！』

In future, you need not restrict your visits to fixed hours, nor must you always wear official robes.
左宗棠说，『以后你来，不必拘定时刻；也不一定要穿公服。

And there is no hurry about the matter we have just discussed.
还有，刚才我跟你谈的那件事，不必急；

Let us watch how the situation develops.”
且看看局势再说。』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第九章（本章第1部分，共7部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER NINE
第九章


Events developed in unexpected ways.
局势的发展，实在出人意表。

First, on the sixth day of the fourth lunar month, Changzhou was recovered after a concerted assault by Li Hongzhang, his subordinate commanders Guo Songlin, Liu Mingchuan, Zhou Shengbo, and Zhang Shusheng, and Gordon’s Ever-Victorious Army.
第一、常州在李鸿章 部下郭松林、刘铭传、周盛波、张树声、李鸿章 及常胜军戈登合力猛攻之下，于四月初六十复；

Feng Zicai, who had long held Zhenjiang, then advanced and took Danyang.
接着久守镇江的冯子材进克丹阳。

Everyone assumed that once the two armies joined they would follow up their victories, turn west, and march straight on Jinling to assist Zeng Guoquan.
大家都以为这两支军队会师以后，一定乘胜西趋，直扑金陵，为曾国荃助攻。

Yet despite repeated orders from the court, Li Hongzhang remained where he was, pleading heavy casualties and an urgent need to replenish and reorganize his forces.
哪知李鸿章 尽管朝旨催促，却以伤亡过重，亟须整补为名，按兵不动。

Zuo Zongtang and Hu had foreseen this.
这是为左宗棠、胡雪岩所预料到的，

Li did not wish to share the great achievement that Zeng Guoquan was determined to claim alone; his posture was deliberate.
李鸿章 不愿分曾国荃一心想独到的大功，有意作态。

Second, the “Heavenly King,” Hong Xiuquan, suddenly issued a dreamlike decree: he would “ascend forthwith to Heaven, obtain heavenly troops from the Heavenly Father and Heavenly Elder Brother, and secure the Heavenly Capital.”
第二、是『天王』洪秀全忽然下了一道有如梦呓的『诏令』，说『即上天堂，向天父天兄，领到天兵，保固天京』。

Two days later he poisoned himself, fulfilling his promise to “ascend to Heaven.”
过了两天，『天王』服毒自尽，实现了他『上天堂』的诺言。

His successor was his sixteen-year-old son, Hong Tianguifu, styled the “Young Heavenly King.”
接位的是洪秀全的十六岁儿，名叫『洪天贵福』；称号唤做『幼天王』。


As the news spread, everyone knew that Zeng Guoquan’s great triumph was near.
消息外传，都知道曾国荃成大功在即，

Some recited Du Fu’s line, “With spring for company, how gladly I shall journey home,” and began planning to rebuild their homes after the war.
颇有人高吟杜少陵的『青春作伴好还乡』，作乱后重整家园之计。

Conscientious and industrious ministers in the capital and governors in the provinces were also quietly making calculations.
而京里重臣、京外督抚，有良心，肯做事的，亦都在默默打算，

Once Jinling fell, the accumulated wealth of more than a decade of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, concentrated in the Heavenly King’s Palace, should suffice to discharge soldiers and restore the devastated country.
曾国荃一下金陵，太平天国十余年的积聚，尽萃于『天王府』，足可用来裁遣将士，恢复地方；

Admittedly, the spoils of Jinling would be used for the southern Yangtze region and the Hunan Army; nevertheless, if other provinces no longer needed to send their military contributions, the savings would be equivalent to increased local revenue.
固然，金陵所得，必是用于江南及湘军，但应解的协饷，可以不解，就等于增加了本地的收入。

Zuo, for example, had an agreeable calculation of his own: once Zeng Guoquan took Jinling, Guangdong would again become a source of military funds for Zhejiang.
象左宗棠就是打着一把如意算盘，认为曾国荃一克金陵，广东便将复成浙江的饷源。

He had told Hu that when the time came he would submit a special memorial requesting Hu’s appointment to assist in administering the likin levy there.
他曾跟胡雪岩谈过，到那时候，要专折奏，派他到广东去会办厘捐。

Hu had agreed without demur, but privately attached little importance to the scheme.
胡雪岩口头一诺无辞，其实不当它一回事；

To him the prospect was extremely uncertain.
在他看来，此事渺茫得很，

Unwilling to spoil Zuo’s pleasure, he merely assented politely.
只是不便扫左宗棠的兴，所以只是唯唯敷衍而已。


With supporting fire from artillery lent by Li Hongzhang, Zeng Guoquan’s troops captured Longbozi at the end of the fifth month.
在李鸿章 所拨借的炮队协攻之下，曾国荃所部在五月底攻占了『龙膊子』，

It stood on the summit of Zhongshan, northeast of Jiangning, commanding a view over the whole city.
其地在江宁城外东北的钟山之巅，居高临下，俯瞰全城。

With this position lost, the Loyal King, Li Xiucheng, was at his wits’ end.
此地一失，『忠王』李秀成束手无策了。

Zeng Guoquan’s art of war rested upon a single quality: persistence.
曾国荃用兵，独得一『韧』字；

Having maintained the bitter siege until persistence was about to triumph, he was less willing than ever to relax.
苦苦围困到这般地步，要韧出头了，更不肯丝毫怠慢，

He ordered every battalion to tighten the ring on all sides, press up to the walls, and attack furiously day and night.
下令各营，由四面收束，直往里逼，逼近城下，昼夜猛攻。

The true purpose, however, was to use the incessant cannon fire to conceal the sound of tunneling.
而真正的作用是，借无时或已的炮声，遮掩他掘地道的声响。

During the two-year siege of Jinling, his men had dug more than thirty tunnels between Chaoyang Gate and Zhongfu Gate.
金陵围了两年，曾国荃从朝阳门到钟阜门，挖过三下多处地道，

Sometimes the roofs collapsed; the diggers died and were buried where they fell, together in the tunnels.
有时是『落磐』，挖地道的士兵随死随埋，丛葬其中；

Sometimes the rebels discovered them and sent in smoke or water, killing men by the hundred.
有时是为长毛所发觉，烟熏水浇，死者论百计。

Once, when a tunnel was nearly complete, the men inside suddenly saw a spear thrust down from above.
有一次快成功了，地道内的士兵，忽然发现一枝长矛刺了下来；

In fact, a rebel had merely planted it in the ground while resting on the march.
其实是长毛行军休息，随意将矛一插，

But the imperial soldiers, rash and thoughtless, seized it and pulled hard.
而官军轻躁没脑筋，使劲将那枝矛往下拉，

First alarmed, then delighted, the rebels dug down and attacked.
长毛始而大骇，继而大喜，掘地痛击，

The enterprise failed at the very brink of success, and more than four hundred men died, all from Zhu Hongzhang’s command.
功败垂成，死了四百人之多；都是朱洪章的部下。


Zhu Hongzhang came from Guizhou, the only senior commander under Zeng Guoquan who was not a Hunan man.
朱洪章 是贵州人，也是曾国荃部下高级将领中，唯一的非湖南人。

Isolated among them, he had to exert himself all the more to avoid being pushed aside.
因为孤立其间，不能不格外卖力，免得遭受排挤。
