Zeng valued him highly too, repeatedly recommending his promotion until he held the honorary rank of provincial military commander and was registered for appointment as a brigade commander.
曾国荃亦很看重他，一直保到提督衔记名总兵，

He had also put him in charge of the military administration office.
派他经理营务处。

The new tunneling operation was jointly entrusted to Zhu and Li Chendian, brigade commander of Guide in Henan and a registered candidate for provincial military command.
此时再挖地道，由他与记名提督河南归德镇总兵李臣典共同负责。

Beginning on the eighth day of the sixth month, the work continued night and day.
从六月初八开始，日夜不停，

After seven days the tunnel was finished and packed with explosives; all was ready for the final assault.
挖了七天才挖成，填塞炸药，可以作最后的攻击了。

Zeng asked which battalion would form the first attacking wave and which the second.
曾国荃问部下诸将∶哪一营『头敌』；哪一营『二敌』？

The generals said nothing.
诸将默无一言。

He then questioned them individually in order of rank.
便按官职大小，个别征询。

The most senior was Xiao Fusi, who had already been appointed commander of Fujian’s land forces.
官阶最高的是萧孚泗，已经补上福建陆路提督，

He too remained silent, leaving Zeng to ask Li Chendian.
他依旧沉默；便只好问李臣典了。

Li was willing to lead, provided Zhu gave him one or two thousand picked men.
李臣典倒愿打头阵，但要朱洪章 拨一两千精兵给他。

“In that case,” Zhu said, “I might as well take the lead myself.”
朱洪章 表示∶『既然如此，不如我来当头。』

The matter was settled accordingly.
事情便这样定局，

A written military pledge was drawn up: anyone who shrank back would be executed.
还立了军令状，畏缩不前者斩！


At noon on the sixteenth day of the sixth month, Zhu ordered the charge fired.
六月十六日正午，由朱洪章 下令施放炸药。

More than thirty thousand jin of explosives filled the tunnel, whose entrance had been sealed with enormous stones.
地道中的炸药有三万斤之多，进口之处用巨石封固；

Thick bamboo poles extended into it, packed with explosives wrapped in coarse cloth to serve as a fuse.
另外以极粗的毛竹伸入地道，内用粗布包炸药填塞，作为引线；

Once the fuse was lit, a low rumbling like distant thunder came from underground, but no explosion followed.
引线点燃以后，但闻地底隐隐如雷声，却不爆发，

The sun blazed overhead with a heat that seemed to melt metal; surely the charge could not fail to burn.
天空中的骄阳，流水烁金一般，炸药决无不燃之理；

Thousands upon thousands of officers and men waited, sweating and holding their breath, until their anxiety became unbearable.
万千将士挥汗屏息，等得焦灼不堪。

An hour passed.
这样过了一个钟头之久，

Even the faint underground rumbling ceased.
地底连那隐隐雷声都消失了。

Charges had often failed before, and this attempt too seemed to have come to nothing.
过去亦常有不能引发炸药的事情；这一次看起来又是陡劳无功。

Throughout the camps the men were bitterly disappointed.
各营将士，无不失望，

They were about to withdraw some of the troops for a rest in shifts when a tremendous crash suddenly burst forth, as though heaven and earth were breaking apart.
正准备先撤退一批部队，分班休息时；突然间，霹雳之声大作，仿佛天崩地裂似的。

A section of wall at Taiping Gate, more than twenty zhang long, rose high into the air with the smoke: an unheard-of spectacle.
太平门的一段城墙，约有二十多丈长，随烟直上，耸得老高，成为闻所未闻的奇观。


There was an explanation for it.
这有个说法。

The founder of the Ming dynasty had made Nanjing his capital and begun building its walls in the second year of Hongwu.
明太祖建都南京，洪武二年始建都城，

Vast numbers of laborers had been conscripted, and the work took four years.
征发大量民夫，花了四年功夫，方始完工，

The circuit measured sixty-one li, greater not only than Beiping’s forty-odd li and Xi’an’s twenty-four, but than that of any other city in the world.
周围六十一里，不但比北平城周四十余里、西安城周二十四里都大；而且亦是世界第一大城。

Nanjing’s walls were tall as well as extensive, averaging more than forty chi in height.
南京城不但大，而且高，平均都在四十尺以上。

Their most remarkable quality, however, was their strength.
大与高之外，最大的特色是坚，

Granite formed the foundations, and specially fired giant bricks made up the walls, bonded with mortar of lime steeped in glutinous-rice paste.
城以花岗石为基，特为烧制的巨砖为墙；砖与砖之间，用石灰泡糯米浆水砌合。

When the whole circuit was finished, the same mixture was spread over it.
全城告成，再以石灰泡糯米浆水涂敷，

Strike the outer wall at any point and a white mark would show.
所以在城外随便指一处敲击，都会显出白印。

For five hundred years it had resisted weapons, water, and fire; yet in the end even this wall could not withstand Western explosives.
五百年来刀枪不入，水火不侵的城墙，毕竟还敌不过西洋的炸药；

Its bricks were bonded so firmly, however, that the blast hurled an entire section more than twenty zhang long into the air.
只是被炸以后，砖砖相砌，过于坚牢，所以才会造成二十余丈长的整段城墙，飞入空中的奇观。

It was later learned that the section had traveled more than a li before breaking into several pieces and falling to earth, killing several hundred people.
后来知道，这段城墙飞出一里多外，裂成数段落地，打死了数百人之多。


At the moment of the breach, Zhu rushed forward with a flag in his left hand and a sword in his right, shouting for the men to mount the wall.
在当时，朱洪章 奋身向前，左手执旗，右手操刀，大呼上城。

All nine gates were taken, giving rise to the name “the Nine Generals Who First Mounted the Walls.”
于是九门皆破，有所谓『先登九将』，

Besides Zhu, Li Chendian, and Xiao Fusi, they were the registered brigade commanders Wu Mingliang, Xiong Deng, and Wu Weishou; Provincial Military Commander Zhang Shiri; Liu Lianjie, registered for appointment as a provincial judicial commissioner; and Peng Yuju, a registered circuit intendant.
除朱洪章 、李臣典、萧孚泗以外，还有记名总兵武明良、熊登、伍维寿、提督张诗日、记名按察使刘连捷、记名道员彭毓橘。

When the news reached Beijing, great rewards naturally followed.
捷报到京，自然要大赏功臣。

The late Xianfeng Emperor was said to have promised a princely title to whoever suppressed Hong Xiuquan and Yang Xiuqing.
据说文宗在日，曾有诺言∶平洪杨者封王。

Yet since the rebellion of the Three Feudatories, the Qing had made no one outside the imperial clan a prince, or even a duke.
但清朝自三藩之后，异姓不王；甚至封公爵的亦没有。

Many imperial nobles therefore opposed fulfilling the late emperor’s promise, creating a difficult problem.
因此，亲贵中颇有人反对实现文宗的诺言；形成难题。

At last Empress Dowager Ci’an proposed dividing one princely honor into four lesser titles.
最后是慈安太后出了个主意，将一个王爵，析而为四，

Zeng Guofan, whose merit was greatest, became a marquis; Zeng Guoquan came next and became an earl; the remaining titles, a viscountcy and a barony, went to Li Chendian and Xiao Fusi respectively.
曾国藩功劳最大，封侯；其是曾国荃，封伯；接下来是一个子爵、一个男爵，封了李臣典和萧孚泗。


When the decree appeared, Zhu was deeply dissatisfied.
朝旨一下，朱洪章 大为不服。

Judged by their achievements on the day of the breach, he should surely have ranked first.
论破城当日之功。他实在应该第一，

He had been the first over the wall, captured the rebel King Yong, Hong Renda, alive, and occupied the Heavenly King’s Palace.
首先登城，生擒伪勇王洪仁达，占领『天王府』。

Yet Zeng Guoquan’s report placed Li Chendian first.
而曾国荃奏报叙功时，却以李臣典居首；

It was said that Zhu had held the palace until dusk, when Li arrived with troops, announcing that he had come “on the Ninth Marshal’s orders to take over the defense.”
据说，当朱洪章 占领『天王府』，看守到黄昏时分，李臣典领兵驰到，自道『奏九帅之命接防』。

The palace thus passed into Li’s control.
于是『天王府』归李臣典的控制，

He guarded it until eight the following morning, when, in broad daylight and for no apparent reason, it caught fire and burned to the ground.
看守到第二天上午八点钟，光天化日之下，『天王府』无缘无故起火，烧得精光。

Zeng subsequently reported that a search had yielded nothing but a rebel imperial seal.
事后曾国荃奏报，搜索『天王府』，除了一颗伪玺以外，什么都没有了。

Here, then, lay the secret of Li’s place at the head of the list!
李臣典叙功居首的奥妙是如此！

Among the nine first over the walls, Zhu did not fare even as well as Xiao Fusi, who at least received a first-class barony, the lowest of the five grades of nobility.
朱洪章 在『先登九将』中甚至不如孚泗还落得一个五等爵末位的『一等男』；

Zhu’s rewards were an order that he be given priority for recommendation whenever a provincial military command or brigade command fell vacant, permission to wear the yellow riding jacket, and the hereditary dignity of cavalry commandant.
他所得的恩典，是『无论提督总兵缺出，尽先提奏；并赏穿黄马褂，赏给骑都尉世职』，

These were by no means insignificant honors, but to rank third was a bitter injustice.
虽亦不薄，但名列第三，太受委屈。


Unable to swallow it, Zhu went to argue with the Ninth Marshal.
一口气咽不下，朱洪章 去找『九帅』理论。

Zeng had evidently prepared his response, and it was masterly.
曾国荃大概早有防备，应付之道甚绝，

“I too believe you should have received first credit.
他说∶『我亦认为你应居首功。

But the memorial listing the achievements was submitted by my elder brother.
但叙功的奏折，是由我老兄拜发；

I hear that a secretary of his, a fellow named Li, has been manipulating things.”
听说是他的幕友李某捣鬼。』

As he spoke, he drew a gleaming knife from his boot and held it out hilt first.
说着，从靴页子里拔出一把雪亮的雪子，倒持着递向朱洪章 ，

“Go and kill the man.”
『你去宰了那个姓李的。』

Zhu did not know whether to laugh or cry.
朱洪章 为之啼笑皆非。

Li Chendian’s glory, meanwhile, proved as fleeting as a dream.
但李臣典亦如黄梁一梦，

He never lived to receive the decree granting his title, yellow jacket, and two-eyed peacock feather.
锡爵之恩；黄马褂、双眼花翎之荣，竟不克亲承宠命；

By the time it arrived, he was dead.
恩旨到时，已经一命呜呼。

According to Zeng’s memorial, Li had suffered an injury to an acupuncture point at the waist during the assault, obstructing the flow of his vital energy; he died on the second day of the seventh month.
据曾国荃奏报，说他攻城时，『伤及腰穴，气脉阻滞』，因而于七月初二日不治出缺。

Others, however, said that he had died “beneath the peony blossoms.”
却又有人说，李臣典死在『牡丹花下』——

When the city fell, treasure, women, and children had been there for the taking.
破城之日，玉帛子女，任所取携；

In a single night Li was said to have slept with more than ten women; careless in the oppressive summer heat, he contracted a fever associated with sexual indulgence and died.
李臣典一夜之间，御十数女子，溽暑不谨，得了『夹阴伤寒』，一命呜呼！

This, of course, was private rumor.
当然，这是私下的传说；

If the cause of death lay in the bedchamber, the truth would never be established.
反正死因如出于床第之间，真相是再也不能水落石出的。

There was a story behind Xiao Fusi’s barony too.
萧孚泗的封男爵，亦有一段故事。


When the city fell and all hope was gone, Li Xiucheng took a trusted page through the disordered troops and escaped southeast through Tongji Gate.
当城破无可为计时，李秀成在乱军中带着一个亲信书僮，出通济门往东南方向逃走；

He intended to cross Maoshan and travel by way of Liyang and Changxing to Huzhou, joining the rebels who had fled from Hangzhou.
目的是越过茅山，经溧阳、长兴到湖州，与由杭州遁走的长毛会合。

At a place called Fangshan he encountered eight woodcutters.
走到一处叫方山的地方，撞见八个樵夫，

One thought he recognized him but was not certain, so ventured to call, “Loyal King!”
其中有人认识他，却确不定，便冒叫一声∶『忠王！』

Seeing that his identity had been discovered, Li sank to his knees and begged, “If any of you will guide me to Huzhou, I shall give him thirty thousand taels.”
李秀成一看行藏被人识破，便长跪相求∶『哪位领路带我到湖州，我送三万银子酬谢。』

He and his page pulled back their sleeves.
说着，他与他的书僮都将袖子抹了上去；

All four arms were covered with gold bracelets.
但见四条手臂上，戴满了金镯子；

A horse also carried a chest that looked quite small but bent the animal’s back beneath its weight.
另外有一匹马，驮着一只箱子，看上去并不大，可是压得马的腰都弯了，

One could readily imagine it filled with gold, silver, and jewels.
可以想见其中装的是金银珠宝。

The eight woodcutters grew greedy.
这八个樵夫见此光景，大起贪心，

They wanted both to seize Li’s wealth and to earn a reward for reporting him.
一方面想侵吞李秀成的钱财，一方面还想报功领赏。

They therefore tricked master and servant into Jianxi Village at the foot of the hill and chose a man named Tao to inform the imperial troops.
于是这八个人将李秀成主仆骗入山下的『涧西村』，公推一个姓陶的去向官军报信；

He was to go to Li Chendian’s camp outside Taiping Gate, because a kinsman of his served there and could safely pass on the information.
目的地是驻扎太平门外的李臣典营中，因为姓陶的有个同族弟兄是李臣典的部下，托他转报，比较妥当。


Passing Zhongshan, Tao grew hungry and thirsty.
姓陶的经过钟山，又饥又渴；

Remembering that this was Xiao Fusi’s sector, he thought of a cook in the camp whom he knew through supplying firewood.
想起这里是萧孚泗的防区，营中有个伙夫，因为供应柴草的关系而熟识，

He might as well stop there to rest and get a meal.
不妨到他那里歇脚求食。

Carried away by his good fortune, Tao let slip during their conversation how they had captured Li Xiucheng.
姓陶的得意忘形，休息闲谈之间，透露了生擒李秀成的经过。

The cook told a bodyguard, who informed Xiao; from that moment Tao was doomed.
这个伙夫便转告亲兵；亲兵转报萧孚泗，姓陶的便注定要做枉死鬼了。

After giving secret instructions that Tao be entertained with good meat and wine, Xiao took more than twenty bodyguards and rode hard through the blazing heat to Jianxi Village.
一番密密嘱咐，将姓陶的好酒好肉款待；萧孚泗自携亲兵二十多人，烈日下疾驰到涧西村，

There he seized Li with ease and took possession of gold, silver, and jewels worth more than a hundred thousand taels.
将李秀成手到擒来；价值十余万银子的金银珠宝，亦归掌握。

Tao was killed with a single sword stroke to silence him.
姓陶的被一刀斩讫，借以灭口；

Xiao retained enough conscience to spare the cook: he gave him five fine pearls and a good horse, hinting that he should desert that very night and go as far away as possible.
不过萧孚泗总算还有良心，没有杀那个伙夫，给了他五颗上好的珠子，一匹好马，暗示他连夜『开小差』，走得越远越好。

It was for capturing Li Xiucheng that Xiao received his barony.
萧孚泗的得封男爵，就以生擒李秀成之功。

Only later did Zeng Guoquan learn the truth and order a reward of a hundred taels for each of the eight woodcutters’ families.
曾国荃到后来才知道真相，吩咐赏那八家樵夫，每家一百两银子。

His bodyguards pocketed most of it.
结果为亲兵吞没大半，

All that reached the eight households was one large ingot—fifty taels—to divide among them.
只拿出去一个『大元宝』——五十两银子，由八家均分。


Had Xiao truly captured Li Xiucheng by his own efforts, the achievement would indeed have deserved a barony.
如果李秀成真是为萧孚泗凭一己之力所生擒，这份功劳，就真值得一个男爵了。

For although the Heavenly Capital had fallen, the Young Heavenly King had not been captured.
因为『天京』虽破，『幼天王』未获，

Merely claiming that he had died in the fighting would scarcely satisfy the court.
只说已死在乱军之中，对朝廷似难交代。

Fortunately there was Li Xiucheng, whose practical importance exceeded that of the young ruler.
幸好有个李秀成，论实际，其人之重要又过于『幼天王』，

His capture could compensate for the failure to establish the principal rebel’s whereabouts.
足可弥补元凶下落不明之失。

Zeng Guofan had by then come from Anqing to Jiangning in a specially provided vessel.
其时曾国藩已由安庆专船到江宁，

Besides reassuring the troops and relieving the people, he had another important task: deciding Li Xiucheng’s fate.
抚循将士，赈济百姓以外，另一件大事，就是处置李秀成，

He appointed Circuit Intendant Pang Jiyun and Prefect Li Hongyi to interrogate him jointly.
委派道员庞际云、知府李鸿裔会审，

Li Hongyi was the very “fellow named Li” whom Zeng Guoquan had accused of manipulating the rewards when speaking to Zhu.
这李鸿裔，就是曾国荃向朱洪章 所说『捣鬼』的『李某』。


During the ten days from the twenty-seventh of the sixth month to the sixth of the seventh, comparatively little time was spent questioning Li.
从六月廿七到七月初六，十天的功夫，审问的时间少，

Most of it he spent in his prison cage writing a personal confession, producing some seven thousand characters a day and seventy or eighty thousand in all.
李秀成在囚笼写『亲供』的时候多；每天约写七千字，总计约七、八万言。

Zeng Guofan then cut and altered it extensively, retaining no more than a third before forwarding it to the throne.
却为曾国藩大删大改、所存不过三分之一；方始奏报。

In discussing what had become of Hong Xiuquan’s two sons after the city fell, the confession stated: “I took only the young lord with me.
其中谈到城破后，洪秀全两个儿子的下落，说是『独带幼主一人，

As he had no good horse, I gave him my own warhorse to ride.
幼主无好马，将我战马交与骑坐。』

After the third watch I led a desperate charge, bringing him out through the breach made in the wall by the Ninth Marshal.
『三更之后，舍死领头冲锋，带幼主冲由九帅攻倒城墙缺口而出。

Several hundred of us, sovereign and followers together, fought our way beyond the city.
君臣数百人，舍命冲出关外，

The camps we passed stood layer upon layer, with deep ditches and strong defenses.
所过营塞，叠叠层层、壕满垒固。

As the young lord came out, cannon fired from every camp of the Ninth Marshal, and shouts rose everywhere without cease.
幼主出到城外，九帅营中，营营炮发，处处喊声不绝；

He and I became separated, while the Ninth Marshal’s mounted and foot soldiers pursued us.
我与幼主两个分离，九帅之兵，马步追赶，

Though he had escaped the city, whether he lived or died was unknown.
此时虽出，生死未知。

A child of sixteen, he had never ridden a horse in all his life and had never endured such terror.
十六岁幼童，自幼至长，并未骑过马，又未受过惊慌，

With the Ninth Marshal’s troops advancing from every side, he must surely have been killed.
九帅四方兵进，定然被杀矣，

If the cavalry or infantry killed him on the road, they would not have known he was the young lord.
若九帅马步在路中杀死，亦未悉其是幼主，

Who would recognize a little boy?”
一个小童，何人知也？』


This passage chimed perfectly with Zeng Guofan’s report that “the young rebel has already died amid the fighting.”
这段供词，与曾国藩奏报『幼逆已死于乱军之中』，有桴鼓相应之妙；

But the attempt to be clever defeated itself and exposed the alterations: the Young Heavenly King was alive and had escaped to Huzhou.
不道弄巧成拙，反显删改之迹——『幼天王』未死，逃到湖州了。

At the same time that Zeng became a marquis, further decrees rewarded the principal commanders and provincial authorities of the southeast.
在曾国藩封侯的同时，又有恩旨赏赉东南各路统兵大帅及封疆大臣；

Prince Sengge Rinchen received an additional grant of a beile title.
亲王僧格林沁，加赏一贝勒；

Guanwen, Governor-General of Huguang, became a first-class earl, with his title perpetually hereditary without reduction; Li Hongzhang, Governor of Jiangsu, also became a first-class earl.
湖广总督官文，赐封一等伯爵，世袭罔替；江苏巡抚李鸿章 一等伯爵；

Yang Yuebin, Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu, and Peng Yulin, Right Vice-Minister of War, received the hereditary dignity of first-class light-chariot commandant and the honorary title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
陕甘总督杨岳斌、兵部右侍郎彭玉麟赏给一等轻车都尉世职，并赏加太子少保衔；

Luo Bingzhang, Governor-General of Sichuan, and Bao Chao, Zhejiang’s provincial military commander, likewise received first-class light-chariot commandancies.
四川总督骆秉章 、浙江提督鲍超，一等轻车都尉世职；

Duxing’a, the Xi’an general; Fuming’a, the Jiangning general; and Feng Zicai, Guangxi’s provincial military commander, received hereditary cavalry commandancies.
西安将军都兴阿、江宁将军富明阿、广西提督冯子材、均赏给骑都尉世职。

Among the senior officials of the southeast, only Zuo and Shen Baozhen, Governor of Jiangxi, were left out.
东南大员，向隅的只有左宗棠和江西巡抚沈葆桢，

The decree expressly stated that further favor would be granted once Zhejiang and Jiangxi had been cleared of rebels.
上谕中特为交代∶『俟浙赣肃清后再行加恩。』

Intended as encouragement though this was, the contrast was humiliating.
这虽是激励之意，但相形之下，未免难堪；

Li Hongzhang’s ennoblement especially angered Zuo.
尤其是李鸿章 封爵，使得左宗棠更不服气。

More fundamentally, Zeng Guofan directed military affairs in five provinces, including Zhejiang and Jiangxi.
往深一层去想，曾国藩节制五省军务，江西、浙江亦在其列；

If those two were not pacified, his own task was unfinished.
这两省既未肃清，就是曾国藩责任未了，

Why should he receive such outstanding rewards?
何以独蒙上赏？

There was another cause for anger.
再有一件事，使左宗棠气恼的是，

The defeated rebels from Jiangning had only one escape route, southeastward.
江宁溃败的长毛，只有往东南一路可逃；

Operations around Huzhou had been progressing well; suddenly they faced a crushing new pressure.
因而湖州一带，本来打得很顺利的，忽然增加了沉重的压力。

Had Zeng secretly consulted Zuo beforehand about the date of the assault and the plans to encircle and destroy the enemy, Zuo could have stationed troops to block the gaps and ambush the fugitives.
如果事先密商，曾国荃定于何时破城，进兵围剿的策略如何？都能让左宗宗知道，先期派兵填塞缺口，伏路拦截，

How else could the defeated rebels have come pouring in like a collapsing mountain or a bursting dike?
又何致于让溃败的长毛，如山倒堤崩般涌过来？

Zeng’s army, seeking glory only for itself, was simply diverting disaster onto its neighbor.
然则曾军只顾自己争功，竟是『以邻为壑』了！


Prince Gong, who directed affairs at court, and Grand Councilor Wenxiang—a worthy bannerman, trusted above and respected below, genuinely loyal in his service to the state—knew nothing of the depth of this antagonism among the southeastern commanders.
朝中当国的恭王，以及上获信任，下受尊重，确能公忠体国，为旗中贤者的军机大臣文祥，却不知东南将帅之间，存着如此深刻的矛盾；

Close upon the decrees rewarding merit came another edict, sternly pressing Zuo to act.
紧接着大赏功臣的恩诏之下，又有一道督责极严的上谕，

Reading it made him more uncomfortable still.
让左宗棠看了，更不舒服。

It began: “Jiangning has been recovered, the entire band of villains destroyed, and no rebel has escaped.”
上谕中说∶『江宁克复，群丑就歼，无逸出之贼』，

Those words made Zuo wonder how extravagantly the Zeng brothers had embellished their reports of victory.
这几句话，便使左宗棠疑心，曾氏弟兄奏报克复江宁的战功，不知如何铺张扬厉，夸大其词？

He therefore resented all the more the ensuing instructions: “Li Hongzhang shall transfer the forces of Wang Yongsheng and others to Changxing to assist in defending Huzhou. Zuo Zongtang shall direct his armies, in concert with the Jiangsu forces, speedily to annihilate all rebels in Huzhou and Anji, recover their fortified cities, and allow not a single rebel to escape farther inland.”
因此对于后面∶『着李鸿章 将王永胜等军，调长兴，协防湖郡；左宗棠当督率各军，会合苏师，迅将湖州、安吉之贼，全行殄灭，克复坚城，勿令一贼上窜』的要求，越起反感。


“Look,” he said to Hu. “The Zeng brothers have not merely claimed glory for themselves; they have blocked everyone else’s path to earning it.
『你看，』他对胡雪岩说∶『曾氏兄弟，不但自己邀功，还断了别人的建功之路。

Judging by the language here, the great work is finished and Zhejiang can be pacified within days.
照字里看，大功已经告成，浙江可以指日肃清；

Yet Huzhou is swarming with rebels and will be harder than ever to take.
湖州长毛如毛，攻起来格外吃力，

Even if we fight to the death and capture it, we shall get no credit.
即使拼命拿下来，也讨不了好。

The Zeng brothers have spoken first: at Jiangning ‘the entire band of villains was destroyed, and no rebel escaped.’
因为有曾氏兄弟先人之言，说江宁的「群丑就歼，无逸出之贼」；

The court will certainly think we are inventing victories.
朝廷一定以为我们虚报军功。

Is that not infuriating?”
你想，可恨不可恨？』

Hu could only try to soothe him, but vague consolations had no effect.
胡雪岩当然只有劝慰，但泛泛其词，不能发生作用；

Intelligence reports arrived one after another, all describing this or that rebel “king” moving from Guangde in southern Anhui into Zhejiang, crossing the Tianmu Mountains, and making straight for Huzhou.
而谍报一个接一个，尽是长毛的某『王』、某『王』，由皖南广德，窜入浙江境界，越过天目山，直奔湖州的消息。

At last came a report originating among the refugees.
最后来了一个消息，是难民之中传出来的；

It was rushed to Hangzhou.
飞报到杭州，

When Zuo read it, he became extraordinarily excited.
左宗棠一看，兴奋非凡。



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第九章（本章第2部分，共7部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


The report stated that after the fall of Jiangning, the Young Heavenly King, Hong Tianguifu, had been escorted by King Gan, Hong Rengan; King Yang, Ji Qingyuan; King Yu, Li Ruisheng; and King Yang, Li Mingcheng.
这个报告中说∶『幼天王』洪福真，在江宁城破以后，由『干王』洪仁干、『养王』吉庆元、『誉王』李瑞生、『扬王』李明成『保驾』，

They reached Guangde on the twenty-first day of the sixth month.
六月廿一那天，到达广德；

Five days later Huang Wenjin, King Du, who held Huzhou, personally welcomed him into the city.
然后由守湖州的『堵王』黄文金，在五天以后亲迎入湖州城内，

Learning that the Loyal King, Li Xiucheng, had been captured by the imperial forces, the young ruler had appointed Hong Rengan chief military counselor.
并且已得知『忠王』李秀成为官军所获的消息，所以改封洪仁干为『正军师』。

Zuo thought he could now put the Zeng brothers to shame.
这一下，左宗棠认为可以要曾氏弟兄的好看了；

He immediately ordered a secretary to draft a memorial, intending to send it by express rider and expose Zeng Guofan’s false claim that the young rebel had died in the fighting.
当即嘱咐幕友草拟奏稿，打算飞骑入奏，拆穿曾国藩所报『幼逆已死于乱军』中的谎言。

Just as he was exulting and laughing openly, Hu arrived at his temporary headquarters.
而正当意气洋洋，解颜大笑之际；胡雪岩正好到达行辕，

On hearing the news, Hu felt obliged to dampen his pleasure with a word of caution.
听得这个消息，不能不扫左宗棠的兴，劝他一劝。


“My lord, might this memorial wait a little?”
『大人，这个奏折，是不是可以缓一缓？』

“What is there to wait for?
『何缓之有？

Now that the principal rebel’s whereabouts are known, how should I dare conceal them?” Zuo answered with righteous confidence.
元凶行藏已露，何敢匿而不报？』左宗棠振振有词地说。

Hu knew that an appeal against quarrels among commanders as harmful to the state would go unheard.
胡雪岩知道用将帅互讦，非国家之福的话相劝，是他听不入耳的，

He therefore appealed to practical consequences.
因而动以利害，

“We have a saying in Hangzhou: lift a stone yourself, and crush your own foot.
『我们杭州人有句俗语，叫做「自扳石头自压脚」，

My lord, this is a stone you must not lift.
大人，你这块石头扳不得！』

Handle it badly, and it may break your head.”
他说，『扳得不好，会打破头。』

“What do you mean?”
『这是怎么说？』

“Consider what will happen when the memorial arrives.
『大人请想，这样一奏，

The court will naturally be delighted.
朝廷当然高兴，

‘Excellent!
说是「很好！

You must capture the young rebel.
你务必拿幼逆抓来；

On no account may he escape.
无论如何，不准漏网。

Take him, and we shall make you a marquis.’
抓到了，封你的侯。」

But suppose you fail?”
大人抓不到呢？』

“Ah!
『啊，

Ah!”
啊！』

Zuo suddenly understood.
左宗棠恍然大悟，

“Then I shall be the man who let the principal rebel escape!”
『抓不到，变成元凶从我手中漏网了！』


Hu deliberately said no more.
胡雪岩是有意不再往下说。

A man as intelligent as Zuo needed only a hint, certainly; but Hu’s chief reason was another consideration.
象左宗棠这样的聪明人，固然一点就透，无烦词费；最主要的，还是他另有一种看法使然。

On his recent visit to Shanghai he had heard a great deal about the Zeng brothers and Li Hongzhang from their secretaries and trusted associates.
他这一次上海之行，听到许多有关曾氏兄弟和李鸿章 的近况，皆由曾、李的幕友或亲信所透露。

Even remarks in private correspondence, which by rights no third person should ever have heard, had leaked out.
有许多札中的话，照常理而论，是不容第三人入耳的，而居然亦外泄了！

Evidently Zeng and Li had spoken freely to those about them.
这当然是曾李本人毫无顾忌，说与左右，

The discreet passed the information only to people who could appreciate it; the shallow boasted of their intimacy with great officials and their access to inside news, adding flourishes until every story came vividly to life.
深沉的只为知者道∶浅薄的自诩接近大僚，消息灵通，加枝添叶，说得活龙活现，

Thus they created endless needless disputes and damaged relationships for no reason.
无端生出多少是非，也没来由地伤害了好些人的关系，

This had made Hu wary of Zuo.
因为如此，胡雪岩对左宗棠便有了戒心。

His own lord was notorious for speaking without restraint.
他在想，这位『大人』的大没遮拦，也是出了名的。

If Hu devised a scheme to sow discord between Zeng and Li, Zuo might one day tell someone exactly how he had done it.
如果自己为他设计，离间曾李之间的感情；说不定有一天，左宗棠会亲口告诉别人如何如何。

That would be curing one ailment by causing another.
这岂非『治一经、损一经』；

To offend both Zeng and Li for no good reason was hardly worthwhile.
无缘无故得罪了曾、李，就太犯不着了！

Zuo, however, had heard enough.
而左宗棠有他这句话，已经足够。

Delighted, he kept saying, “I understand!
当时很高兴地，一叠连声地说∶『吾知之矣！

I understand!”
吾知之矣！』

Hu found this less than satisfactory.
这样的回答，在胡雪岩却又不甚满意；

He wanted a definite plan, so that he could grasp Zuo’s intention and help carry it out.
他希望左宗棠有个具体的打算说出来，才好秉承宗旨，襄助办事。

He therefore asked, “Then does Your Excellency find something useful in my humble opinion?”
因而追问一句∶『大人是不是觉得愚见还有可采之处？』

“Humble opinion?
『什么愚见？

Your judgment is excellent!”
你的见解太高明了！』

Zuo paused thoughtfully. “Still, I am not a man to change my face at a turn of the hand.
左宗棠沉吟着说道∶『不过，在我到底不是翻手为云覆手为雨的人；

Besides, Li Shaoquan has always been, to me—” He too left the sentence unfinished.
而况李少荃一向为我——。』他也没有再说下去，

Anyone familiar with his usual remarks could supply the rest: he had always despised Li Hongzhang.
只是知道他平日言论的人，都能猜想得到，李鸿章 一向为他所藐视。

To seek friendship now seemed like asking a favor, and he resented it.
如今与他修好，仿佛有求于人似的，未免心有不甘。

Hu decided that open advice toward a proper end was different from privately criticizing others.
胡雪岩认为从正面设词规劝，与在私底下说人短处不同，

Even if such words leaked out, they could stand in public without injuring his reputation.
即令密语外泄，亦是『台面上』摆得出去的话，并无碍于自己的名声，

He resolved to persuade Zuo to cooperate with Li.
因而决定下一番说词，促成左、李的合作。


“My lord,” he asked deliberately, “what is the one urgent task before us?”
『大人，』他有意问道∶『如今唯一的急务是什么？』

“Do you mean public business, or my own affairs?”
『你是指公事，还是指我自己的事？』

“It is the same in both.
『公事也是如此，大人的私事也是如此。

Two matters in one, and one in two: what is the great task that concerns both?”
一而二，二而一，无大不大的一件大事是什么？』

“Naturally, to clear all Zhejiang of rebels.”
『自在是肃清全浙。』

“Exactly.
『是，

And there is only one obstacle left: Huzhou.
肃清全浙只剩一处障碍；就是湖州。

Once it falls, you can report the province pacified.
拿湖州攻了下来，就可奏报肃清。

Then you too will be made a marquis and a grand minister.”
那时候，大人也要封侯拜相了。』

“A grand minister is far in the future, and a marquisate is nothing remarkable.
『拜相还早，封侯亦不足为奇。

If such a grant of nobility is offered, I shall insist upon declining it.”
果然膺此分茅之赏，我是要力辞的。』

Hu could not tell whether Zuo spoke from real feeling or affected indifference.
胡雪岩不知道他这话是有感而发，还是故作矫情，

There was no point in arguing.
反正不必与他争辩，

Only by following the direction of his words could Hu move him.
惟有顺着他的语气想话来说，才能打动他的心。


“A masterly move, my lord!”
『大人这一首高！』

Hu raised his thumb. “To think nothing of a marquisate shows that wealth and rank are no more to you than passing clouds.
他着大拇指说∶『封侯不希罕，见得富贵于我如浮云，

That places you above both Grand Secretary Zeng and Governor Li.
比曾相、李中丞都高一等了。

But unless the court first offers the honor, how can you display such superior character?”
不过，朝廷如无恩命，大人又怎能显得出高人一等的人品？』

“There is truth in that.”
『这话倒也是。』

Zuo nodded deeply.
左宗棠深深点头。

At last he had yielded a little, and Hu could breathe freely.
左宗棠终于松了口，胡雪岩也就松了口气。

How cooperation with Li was to be arranged no longer required Hu’s attention.
至于如何与李鸿章 合作？就不用他费心了；

Zuo understood the whole situation, and military strategy was not a subject on which Hu could presume to speak.
一切形势，左宗棠看得很清楚，而且谈用兵，亦不是他所能置喙的。

He merely reminded Zuo of one point: Li had disobeyed the court’s orders to assist at Jiangning and now urgently wished to make amends.
他只提醒左宗棠一点，会攻江宁，李鸿章 忤了朝旨；目前急图补救，

Even if Zuo refused cooperation, Li would send troops toward Huzhou on his own, demonstrating obedience to the repeatedly stated principle that provincial authorities suppressing rebels must not let territorial boundaries divide their efforts.
所以即使左宗棠不愿与他合作，他自己亦会派兵进窥湖州，表示遵从朝廷所一再揭示的，『疆臣办贼，决不可有轸域之分』的要求。

Zuo, moreover, truly needed his support.
左宗棠亦实在需要李鸿章的支援。


The first reason was manpower.
第一是兵力。

Huzhou had become the refuge of the rebels of the southeast.
湖州已成为东南长毛的逋光薮，

Their scattered armies and defeated commanders had gathered there in numbers several times greater than Zuo’s forces.
残兵败将交集结在一起，人数超过左军好几倍。

Pressed too hard, they would fight like trapped beasts and must not be underestimated.
而且逼得急，会作困兽之斗，决不可轻视。

The second reason was terrain.
第二是地形。

Around Huzhou, waterways branched in every direction, offering ambush positions everywhere.
湖州四周，港汊纵横，处处可以设仗邀击，

The place was naturally easy to defend and difficult to attack.
本是易守难攻之地；

When Zhao Jingxian had held the isolated city, he had adapted his defense to the ground and used it to the utmost.
当年赵景贤孤城坚持，因势制宜，将地形的利用，发挥到了极致。

Its present rebel commander, Huang Wenjin, was no weakling either.
如今长毛守湖州的主将黄文金，亦非弱者；

Acting in the Young Heavenly King’s name, he could issue orders readily.
且假『幼主』洪福真的名号以行，指挥容易。

Reports also said that Huzhou held enough grain for a year, placing him in a much better position than Zhao had enjoyed.
而且湖州所贮存的粮食，据报可以支持一年，这又比赵景贤当时的处境好得多了。

Zuo could overcome neither obstacle alone; only Li could help him surmount both.
这进取湖州的两大障碍，都不是左宗棠独力所能克服的；而亦惟有李鸿章可以帮助他克服这两大障碍。

In manpower, the assistance of the Jiangsu forces was needed to complete the investment of Huzhou—not, of course, a four-sided encirclement like Zeng Guoquan’s siege of Jinling.
论兵力，有苏军的协力，才可以完成对湖州的包围——当然不是象曾国荃攻金陵那样的四面包围。

Even if enough troops could be deployed for that, it would be unwise.
如果采取这样的方略，即使兵力部署上能够做得到，亦是不智之举；

Since ancient times, besiegers had often left one side open.
从古以来，围城往往网开一面，

Give the enemy no way to live, and he must fight to the death.
因为不放敌人一条生路，必然作生死的搏斗，

Even if annihilated, he would inflict terrible losses.
就算能够尽歼敌人，自己这方面的伤亡，亦一定是惨重无比。

Leave an outlet, by contrast, and the hope of survival would weaken his will to resist.
反过来看，留下一个纵敌的缺口，正可以激起敌军的恋生之念，瓦解他的斗志。

Moreover, ambushes could be laid along a carefully prepared escape route.
而况在预先安排好的敌人逃生路上，可以处处设伏，

That was the better calculation.
反为得计。


As for terrain, the first vital position outside Huzhou was Daqiankou, opening northward onto Lake Tai.
论地形，湖州外围的第一要隘是北面出太湖的大钱口；

Zhao Jingxian’s loss of Daqian on a snowy night had led to the fall of the city.
当年赵景贤雪夜失大钱，导致湖州的不守。

The circumstances were much the same now: Huzhou could not be taken until Daqian was seized.
以今视昔，情势不殊，要破湖州须先夺大钱；

It was far easier for the Jiangsu troops to cross Lake Tai from the north than for Zuo’s forces to march around to it.
而夺大钱，苏军渡太湖南下，比左军迂道而北要方便得多。

Most importantly, an attack on Daqian required a naval force—the Jiangsu army’s strength and Zuo’s weakness.
同时最大的关键是，攻大钱必须要用水师，而这又是左军之所短，苏军之所长。

Li would naturally use that strength to the full, both to atone for remaining idle at Changzhou and to justify his newly bestowed title.
李鸿章 当然要用他之所长，尽力有所作为，既以弥补常州顿兵之咎；亦以无负锡封爵位之恩。

After his long talk with Hu, Zuo considered matters quietly.
左宗棠自与胡雪岩深谈以后，默默打算；

In local advantages and connections, his position was inferior to Li’s.
自己这方面地利、人和都不及李鸿章 ，

Unless he could undertake the whole task himself and promise to capture Huzhou unaided within a fixed time, he could not prevent Li from advancing against it from the north.
如果不能大包大揽，放下诺言，限期独力攻克湖州，就不能禁止李鸿章 驰驱前路，自北面攻湖州。

Without cooperation, the two armies would compete for glory.
两军不能合作，便成争功的局面；

If Li lost the contest, little harm was done to him.
李鸿章 争不过无所谓，

If Zuo lost and allowed his guest to displace him as host, the reputation of a lifetime would be ruined.
自己争不过，让李鸿章 喧宾夺主，那就一世英名付之流水了。

After much thought, Zuo decided that the best course was to achieve his purpose with Li’s assistance.
他想来想去，因人成事，利用李鸿章 相助，是为上策。

If he fulfilled his duties as host, the visiting army would have to show him courtesy at every turn.
自己只要尽到了地主的道理，客军不能不处处情让，

Even if the Jiangsu troops entered Huzhou first, Li could scarcely send his own independent memorial.
即使苏军先攻入湖州，李鸿章 亦总不好意思，径自出奏。

Provided the report of victory went through Zuo’s hands, he could control the account of the achievements.
只要光复湖州的捷报由自己手中发出，铺叙战功，便可以操纵了。


His mind made up, Zuo would for the moment be a great man capable of bending as well as standing firm.
打定了主意，暂且做一个能屈能伸的大丈夫；

He personally wrote Li a most earnest letter, discussing how to sweep away the remaining rebels of the southeast and hinting at his need for assistance.
左宗棠亲自提笔，写了一封极恳切的信给李鸿章 ，在商略扫荡东南余孽的策略中，透露出求援之意。

Li responded handsomely, promising to commit all four of his “Guo, Liu, Pan, and Yang armies” to Huzhou.
李鸿章 亦很漂亮，答应将他部下的『郭刘潘杨四军』，全数投入湖州战场。

These commands—Guo Songlin’s, Liu Mingchuan’s, Pan Dingxin’s, and Yang Dingxun’s—formed the backbone of the Anhui Army.
郭刘潘杨——郭松林、刘铭传、潘鼎新、杨鼎勋四军，是淮军的中坚；

In fact, Li sent more than those four.
其实李鸿章投入湖州战场，还不止这四军，

Liu Bingzhang, who had joined the army from the Hanlin Academy, was also ordered to assist, as was the naval force of Huang Yisheng, Jiangnan’s provincial military commander and a close fellow townsman of Zeng Guofan.
另有以翰林从军的刘秉璋，与曾国藩小同乡、江南提督黄翼升的水师，亦奉委派，

They would advance by different routes.
分道助攻。

Li’s intentions broadly resembled Zuo’s.
朱鸿章 的心思与左宗棠大致相同，

He meant to make a great display and treat the Huzhou campaign as scarcely less important than the recovery of Jinling.
有意大张声势，将进攻湖州一役，看得不下如金陵之复，

Like a gambler placing a wager, he hoped to capture the young rebel and uncover a hoard of treasure; at the same time, he wished to dampen the Hunan Army’s elation.
一方面象押宝似的，希望能俘获『幼逆』，掘得『金穴』；一方面亦是有心扫扫曾军的兴头。


The rebels at Huzhou claimed two hundred thousand men and probably had at least sixty percent of that number.
在湖州的长毛，号称二十万，至少亦有六折之数；

Zuo’s and Li’s regular forces together numbered no fewer than eighty thousand; with civilian officials, laborers, and other followers, the total exceeded a hundred thousand.
左李两方，正规军合起来不下八万，加上随军的文员、夫役，总数亦在十万以上。

The sides were roughly matched, and fierce fighting was expected.
彼此旗鼓相当，发生恶战是意中之事；

Yet the outcome was virtually predetermined, and even the general course of the rebel retreat could be foreseen.
但胜负已如前定，而且长毛败退的情况，大致亦在估计之中。

The ground constrained the directions of advance.
因为由于地形的限制，进取的方向，只能顺势而行。

Zuo’s troops would press from the southeast and southwest, while the Jiangsu forces attacked from northeast and northwest and moved directly south to block Daqiankou, preventing escape onto Lake Tai.
左宗棠所部由湖州东南、西南两方面进逼；苏军则由东北、西北分攻，并从正北进扼大钱口，以防长毛窜入太湖。

East of Huzhou lay the richest country in the southeast, heavily defended; beyond it was the coast, offering no way out.
湖州的东面，是东南最富庶的地区，有重兵防守，而且东到海滨，并无出路；

The rebels’ only escape lay westward.
在湖州的长毛，唯一的出路，只是向西，

If they broke through Guangde, they might join Li Shixian and Wang Haiyang in Jiangxi, both famous fighting commanders, and perhaps prolong their existence a little.
如能冲过广德，则江西有李世贤、汪海洋，都是长毛中有名的悍将，能会合在一起，或者还有苟延残喘的可能。

A battlefield was like a chessboard.
战场如棋局，

Deception flourished not only between enemies, but among allies competing against one another.
不但敌我之间，尔虞我诈；就是联手的一方，亦在钩心斗角——

Li did, after all, make a move for his own advantage.
李鸿章 毕竟还是下了一着专为自己打算的棋，

He sent Liu Mingchuan’s twenty battalions, one after another, toward the Zhejiang–Anhui border, ostensibly to attack Guangde and cut the rebels’ retreat.
将刘铭传的二十营，陆续拔队，指向浙皖之交；名为进攻广德，断贼归路，

His real aim was to intercept Huang Wenjin, capture the young ruler, and seize the baggage train.
其实是想拦截黄文金，俘『幼逆』，夺辎重。


Huzhou was finally recovered on the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month.
湖州终于在七月二十六克复了。

As predicted, Huang opened the western gate and fled.
如事先所估计的，黄文金果然开湖州西门遁走。

The main rebel forces escaped west in three columns.
大队长毛分三路西窜，

At Guangde they divided again into two routes: one led into southern Anhui; the other, taken by Huang with the young ruler, went through Ningguo, over the western Tianmu Mountains, and by Kaihua and Yushan into Jiangxi.
到了广德，又分两路，一路向皖南；一路是由黄文金带着『幼逆』，由宁国过西天目山，经开化、玉山窜入江西境内。

Liu Mingchuan pursued relentlessly.
刘铭传穷追不舍；

The other armies, eager for credit, also pressed forward with all their strength.
其他各军为了争功，亦无不奋勇当先，

After five days and nights of pursuit, the rebels were scattered beyond cohesion, and Huang died amid the fighting.
连追五日五夜，长毛溃不成军，黄文金死在乱军之中了。

Hong Tianguifu, however, was still missing.
但是洪福真却还是下落不明；

The more credible reports said that he was moving south through Jiangxi to join Li Shixian and Wang Haiyang on the Guangdong–Fujian border.
比较可靠的传说是由江西南下，打算与窜至广东、福建边境的李世贤、汪海洋会合。

From there they intended to turn west toward Hubei, link up with King Fu, Chen Decai, and pass from the Jingzhou–Xiangyang region into Shaanxi, establishing themselves anew in Guanzhong.
然后西趋湖北；与『扶王』陈德才联结，自荆襄西入陕西，在关中另起一个局面。

This was certainly a hopeful calculation.
这当然是一把如意算盘。

Yet even if it failed, such ceaseless movement was dangerous: a junction with the Nian rebels of Anhui and Henan would give grave cause for concern.
但即令打不成功，这样窜来窜去，如与安徽、河南的捻匪合流亦是大可忧之事。

The court was therefore deeply angered that repeated, relentless pursuit had still failed to capture the young rebel and bring him to justice.
因此，朝廷对两次三番，穷追猛打，而竟未能促住『幼逆』，置之于法，深为恼火。

Zuo was angrier still.
更恼火的是左宗棠。

His memorial announcing “all Zhejiang cleared of rebels” had already gone forward, but with Hong Tianguifu uncaptured, the achievement remained incomplete.
『全浙肃清』的折子已经拜发，而洪福真未获，就不能算克竟全功，

For the time being, he could hardly expect his grant of nobility.
一时还难望分茅之赏。


Having disposed of the claim of “a hundred thousand,” Zuo turned to responsibility for impeaching negligent subordinates, and his language grew still sharper: “As for the statement that the entire enemy force escaped from Hangzhou and no impeachments were heard of, this is particularly incomprehensible.
辨明了『十万』之说；再论纠参部下的责任，言语晚为犀利∶『至云杭城全数出窜，未闻纠参，尤不可解。

Jinling had long been completely surrounded; Hangzhou had not been surrounded at all.
金陵早已合围，而杭州则并未能合围也；

From Jinling came the report, ‘All the rebels have been killed.’
金陵报』杀贼净尽『，

From Hangzhou came the report, ‘The principal rebels have indeed escaped.’”
杭州报「首逆实已窜出」也！』

Those two sentences alone had the force of an experienced magistrate’s judgment: Zeng Guoquan had been responsible for preventing escape, and Zeng Guofan had falsely reported the military situation.
仅是这两句话，便如老吏断狱，判定曾国荃有不容贼众逸出的责任，而曾国藩有谎报军情的罪过。

At the close, however, the pen turned again with calculated subtlety. “In military affairs, truth and substance are of the first importance; I have therefore had no choice but to explain.
但在结尾上，却又笔锋一转，故弄狡猾∶『臣因军事最尚质实，故不得不辩。

In all future public business I shall continue to consult and cooperate harmoniously.
至此后公事，均仍和衷商办，

I would not dare harbor the slightest prejudice and thereby increase my own fault.”
臣断不敢稍存意见，自重衍尤。』

These were needles wrapped in silk.
这段话是所谓『绵里针』，

Cautious and modest on the surface, the words were sharp beneath; every sentence contained a concealed accusation against Zeng Guofan.
看来戒慎谦和；其实棱角森然，句句暗隐着指责曾国藩的意思在内。


Within half a month of the memorial’s dispatch, a reply came.
这通奏折发出，不过半个月便有了回音。

Issued through Prince Gong, the confidential court dispatch was extraordinarily tactful.
由恭王出面的『廷寄』，措词异常婉转，

Instead of saying that Zuo could not yet be ennobled, it declared: “Since entering Zhejiang, Zuo Zongtang has recovered dozens of cities and fortified positions and cleared the whole province.
不说一时还不能封左宗棠的爵，却说『左宗棠自入浙以来，克复城隘数十处，肃清全境，

His achievement is very great.
厥功甚伟。

We had intended at once to bestow a substantial reward, but feared that, with the young rebel Hong still undestroyed, the governor-general would insist upon declining it.
本欲即加懋赏，恐该督以洪幼逆未灭，必将固辞；

As soon as the remaining rebels are eliminated, a decree of favor will be issued.”
一俟余孽净尽，即降恩旨。』

This clearly implied that Zuo’s ennoblement was only a matter of time.
是很明显地暗示，左宗棠封爵，不过迟早间事。

There was gentle reassurance concerning his dispute with Zeng as well. “The court does not wish to press meritorious servants over minor details.
关于他与曾国藩的争辩，亦有温愉∶『朝廷有功诸臣，不欲苛求细故。

When the young rebel Hong entered Zhejiang, the governor-general reported the facts; when he left the province, troops were sent in pursuit.
该督于洪幼逆之入浙，则据实入告；于其出境则派兵跟追，

Both were proper actions.
均属正办。

His declaration that he will continue to consult harmoniously with Zeng Guofan in public affairs, harboring no prejudice, particularly accords with the bearing of a great minister and deserves high praise.
所称此后公事仍与曾国潘和衷商办，不敢稍存意见，尤得大臣之体。深堪嘉尚。

The court’s expectations of him are great and far-reaching.
朝廷所望于该督者，至大且远；

Let him exert himself still further and become an eminent minister of his age, fulfilling our hopes.”
该督其益加勉励，为一代名臣，以副厚望。』

The edict did not reproach Zeng, but its judgment of right and wrong was clear.
上谕中虽未责备曾国藩，但是非好恶，已表现得很清楚。

The promise that Zuo might be “an eminent minister of his age” was especially rare language in an imperial decree.
而许左宗棠以『一代名臣』，更是上谕中难得一见的字样。

In this dispute of memorials, submitted to the sovereign’s judgment, Zuo had gained the advantage on every point.
总之这一场御裁的笔墨官司，左宗棠占尽上风；

Naturally, his enmity with Zeng deepened as well.
而与曾国藩的怨，自然也结得更深了。


On the surface, the quarrel between Zeng and Zuo was a war of words; beneath it lay a fierce struggle for territory.
曾左结怨，形诸表面的，是口舌之争；暗中拼命抵拒的，是地盘之争。

Caught between them, and at the same time bearing the first impact, was Zeng Guoquan.
而又象在夹缝中受挤，又象首当其冲的是曾国荃。

His substantive appointment was Governor of Zhejiang.
曾国荃的本职是浙江巡抚。

In wartime, to encourage commanders, appointments had not followed ordinary administrative boundaries.
用失之时，为了鼓励将帅，不按建制任职；

A senior official of one province leading troops in another was nothing unusual.
此省大员在他省领兵，事所常有。

Once a phase of the war ended, however, the situation changed.
但战事告一段落，情形就不一样了。

By ordinary reasoning, whatever faults Zeng Guoquan might have committed after taking Jiangning, his distinction in a hundred battles was undeniable.
照常理而论，曾国荃即令破江宁以后有过失，到底百战功高；

The proper course was to let him assume his governorship.
应该让他赴浙江巡抚本任，才是正办。

But Zuo, Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang and acting Governor of Zhejiang, had no intention of giving way.
无奈左宗棠以闽浙总督兼署浙巡，绝无退让之意。

Zeng Guofan requested sick leave for his brother partly out of anxiety over slander and criticism, seeking prudent retirement at the height of success.
而曾国藩为曾国荃告病，虽由于忧谗畏讥，以急流勇退作明哲保身之计；

More fundamentally, he had perceived the hidden uncertainty of his brother’s position.
其实亦是看透了老弟有『妾身不分明』的隐衷，

Judging that Guoquan could never take up the post, he thought it better to recognize the situation and withdraw voluntarily.
估量他决不能到任，不如自己知趣。


The court was in a dilemma.
在朝廷却又能左右为难之苦。

On one hand, military operations in the southeast had culminated in the recovery of Huzhou and the pacification of Zhejiang, so Zuo’s dignity had to be considered.
一方面东南军务地穴于湖州克复、全浙肃清，不能不敷衍左宗棠的面子；

On the other, to let a newly created earl lay down his arms and retire to the countryside seemed an improper way to treat a meritorious servant.
一方面却又觉得真个让簇新的一位伯爵，解甲归田，不是待功臣之道。

The request for Zeng Guoquan’s retirement on grounds of illness was therefore left unresolved.
因此，对于曾国荃告病，一直采拖延着不作明确的处置；

The court hoped that Zeng and Zuo might put aside their resentment and be reconciled, with Zuo himself requesting permission to relinquish the acting governorship and an order for Guoquan to take office.
希望曾左之间，能够消释嫌怨，言归于好，由左宗棠出面奏请交卸篆，饬令曾国荃到任。

That hope was impossible to fulfill.
这是个不能实现的奢望。

At last the court saw that indefinite delay would not do and agreed to Guofan’s wish, allowing Guoquan to resign.
朝廷看看拖着不是回事，决定成全曾国藩的心愿，许曾国荃辞职。

Who should fill the vacancy, however, required careful thought.
可是空出来的浙江巡抚这个缺，由谁替补？却颇费斟酌。

The court knew what Zuo wanted: Jiang Yili promoted from provincial treasurer to governor, with the treasury vacancy filled on Zuo’s recommendation.
朝廷也知道左宗棠的意思，最好是让蒋益澧由藩司升任，而浙江藩司一缺，则由左宗棠保荐。

But Jiang lacked sufficient seniority and standing; such an arrangement would also humiliate Zeng Guofan.
无奈蒋益澧的资望还浅；并且这样处置，在曾国藩的面子上太难看。

In balancing its commanders, the court would not lightly give the impression of favoring one man.
朝廷调和将帅，决不肯轻易予人以偏袒某人的印象，

Zuo’s wishes were therefore ruled out.
所以左宗棠的意愿是不考虑的了。


Three considerations remained. First, the new Governor of Zhejiang must be honest, experienced, and capable.
要考虑的是∶第一、新任浙江巡抚确需清廉练达的干才，

Of all the provinces ravaged by Hong Xiuquan and Yang Xiuqing, Zhejiang had suffered most, and its reconstruction would be the hardest.
因为洪杨所蹂躏的各省，浙江被祸最惨；善后事宜亦最难办，

Nothing less than integrity and practical ability would suffice.
非清廉干练，不足以胜任。

Second, he should have neither obligations nor grievances toward Zuo, while enjoying the support of Zeng Guofan and even Li Hongzhang, so that Zhejiang could obtain its neighbors’ help.
第二、此人要与左宗棠没有什么恩怨；而又能为曾国藩，甚至李鸿章 所支持，然后浙江的善后事宜，才能取得邻省的援助。

Third, with the great rebellion suppressed, arms were to give way to civil government.
第三、大乱已平，偃武修文；

This would be the first provincial governorship filled since the defeat of the Taipings, marking the restoration of civil rule.
浙江巡抚是洪杨平后委派的第一员封疆大吏，也是恢复文治的开始，

The appointee should preferably have risen through the examinations.
所以此人最好科甲出身。

Military achievements as well would make him ideal.
如果有过战功，更为理想。

An exceptionally suitable man was eventually chosen: Ma Xinyi, courtesy name Gushan.
结果选中了一个很理想的人。此人名叫马新贻，字谷山；

His ancestors were Hui Muslims who had helped the founding Ming emperor win the empire.
先世是回回，从明太祖打天下有功，

Appointed military officers in a Shandong garrison, they settled in Heze County, Caozhou Prefecture.
派在山东卫所当武官，定居曹州府荷泽县，

More than four hundred years had passed.
已历四百余年之久，

Apart from his adherence to Islam, Ma was thoroughly a native son of Shandong.
因此，马新贻除了信回教以外，彻头彻尾是个山东土著。



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第九章（本章第3部分，共7部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


As news of Ma Xinyi’s appointment reached Zhejiang, an important and intriguing report arrived from Jiangxi: the young rebel Hong Tianguifu had at last been captured.
在马新贻的新命传至浙江的同时；江西来了一个重要而有趣的消息，『幼逆』洪福真终于落网了。

The campaign against the Taipings was drawing to a close, but formidable work remained before disorder could be put down.
收束平洪杨的军务，却还有相当艰巨的戡乱大任，需要部署。

In the judgment of Prince Gong and Wenxiang, three rebellions still stood between the empire and lasting peace: the Taiping remnants who had fled south, the Nian bands disturbing the central provinces, and the Muslim rebellions devastating the western frontier.
恭王、文祥的计议，犹有三处叛乱要平服，才能臻于太平盛世。这三处叛乱是∶第一、南窜的洪杨余孽；第二是扰乱中原的捻匪；第三是荼毒生灵、为患西陲的回乱。

Fortunately, men of talent abounded in numbers surpassing earlier reigns.
幸好人才旺盛，冠绝前朝；

Prince Gong and Wenxiang decided to entrust the suppression of these three troubles to four men.
恭王与文祥决定托付四个人去平这三处的叛乱。

The first was still Zeng Guofan.
第一个仍然是曾国藩。

On the first day of the tenth month, as Zeng Guoquan retired in triumph and led the disbanded Hunan troops home, a confidential dispatch reached Jiangning: “Jiangning is now entirely pacified, and military operations there are concluded.
在十月初一曾国荃功成身退，率领裁撤的湘军回湖南的同时，朝中有一道廷寄递到江宁，说『江宁已臻底平，军务业经藏事，

Zeng Guofan shall select a portion of his forces and proceed to the Anhui–Hubei border to direct the suppression of the rebels.
即着曾国藩酌带所部，前赴皖鄂交界，督兵剿贼，

He must advance speedily and permit no delay.”
务期迅速前进，勿少延缓。』

These “rebels” were the Nian.
这所谓『贼』，便是捻匪。


The Nian had originally made northern Anhui their base.
捻匪原以皖北为老巢，

Under Prince Sengge Rinchen’s vigorous attacks, they had moved into Hubei and Henan.
自经僧王全力攻剿，流窜到湖北、河南一带。

Though Zhang Luoxing was dead, his nephew Zhang Zongyu was no weak successor.
张洛行虽死，他的侄子张总愚亦非弱者；

Lai Wenguang, formerly one of Chen Yucheng’s commanders, had also returned from Guanzhong.
加以陈玉成的旧部赖文光由关中回窜，

With the Heavenly Capital fallen, he was a man without a home; naturally he joined the Nian, greatly increasing their strength and boldness.
因为『天京』已破，成了丧家之犬，自然而然地与捻匪合流，大为猖獗。

The court knew that the prince’s cavalry tactics—pursuing and driving the Nian from place to place—were unsound.
朝廷深知僧王的马队，追奔逐北，将捻匪撵来撵去的打法，并非善策；

Once his troops exhausted themselves, a rebel counterattack must bring disaster.
一旦疲于奔命，为捻匪反扑，非大败不可。

Yet his exalted position made him extremely difficult to handle. Even the Western Empress Dowager had to show him special indulgence.
同时，又因为僧王的身分尊贵，连西宫太后都不能不格外优容，是位极难伺候的王爷，

Offer strategic instructions, and he could invoke the maxim that a commander in the field need not obey every order of his sovereign.
指授方略，则『将在外君命有所不受』；

Press him a little, and he might take offense and act entirely on his own.
稍加督责又怕惹恼了他，索性独断独行。

It would be better, for public and private reasons alike, to find a way for him to relinquish his command and return to enjoy life in Beijing.
因此，倒不如设法让他交卸军权，回京享福，才是公私两便之计。

Only Zeng Guofan could replace him in directing operations across several provinces.
能代僧王指挥数省的，只有一个曾国藩。

His prestige was sufficient, and his practice of “seeking security first and flexibility afterward”—meeting movement with stillness, advancing steadily from firm positions—would correct the prince’s mistakes.
不仅威望足够；而且他那『先求稳当，次求变化』，以静制静，稳扎稳打的作风，亦正可救僧王之失。

For the financing of the campaign, the court had thought of another indispensable man.
至于筹饷之责，朝廷也想到了一个必不可少的人。


That man was Li Hongzhang. An edict appointed him to act in Zeng’s place as Governor-General of Liangjiang, while Wu Tang, Director-General of Grain Transport and a benefactor of Empress Dowager Cixi, was transferred to act as Governor of Jiangsu.
这个人就是李鸿章.上谕派他接替曾国藩，暂署两江总督；江苏巡抚则调慈禧太后的恩人，漕运总督吴棠署理。

The decree did not expressly state that Li would bear full responsibility for the rear supply bureau supporting Zeng on the Anhui–Hubei frontier, but the intention was plain.
上谕中虽未明言，曾国藩带兵驻扎皖鄂交界，从路粮台由李鸿章 负其全责；可是这样部署的用意是很明白的，

First, Zeng and Li were teacher and pupil; it was only proper that “when there is work to be done, the disciple undertakes the labor.”
第一，曾、李师生，『有事弟子服其劳』，天经地义；

Second, Zeng had raised funds when Li commanded in the field; now their roles should be reversed.
第二，李鸿章 带兵，曾国藩替他筹过饷，如今曾国藩带兵，自然该李鸿章 筹饷；

Third, Liangjiang was the richest region and a principal source of military revenue, so whoever governed it was bound to provide funds.
第三，两江最富，是海内最主要的一处饷源，所以谁当两江总督，都有筹饷的责任。

Viewed in terms of the general situation, the arrangement was sound.
这样的安排，就大局而言，不能算错；

It merely disadvantaged Zeng and benefited Li and Wu—but not every consideration could be accommodated.
只是委屈了曾国藩，便宜了李鸿章与吴棠，可也就顾不得那么许多了。


Another man selected was Yang Yuebin, a naval commander whose fame equaled Peng Yulin’s.
再有一个是杨岳斌。他是与彭玉麟齐名的水师名将，

His original name was Yang Zaifu.
本名杨载福；

Since the first character of the Tongzhi Emperor’s generation in the imperial genealogy was Zai, however, the name risked offending the naming taboo, and he changed it to Yuebin.
因为同治皇帝这一辈，玉牒谱系上第一字为『载』，不免有犯讳的不便，所以改名岳斌。

Before Jiangning fell he had already been appointed Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu, with the intention of entrusting him with the suppression of the Muslim rebellion.
当江宁未克复以前，他已升任陕甘总督；打算赋以敉平回乱的重任。

Such rebellions had broken out not only there but in Yunnan and Xinjiang as well.
回乱不仅生于陕甘；也生于云南与新疆。

Yunnan was approaching pacification, while Xinjiang’s troubles were gathering force.
云南将次平服，而新疆方兴未艾；

For the latter, the court placed its hopes in the newly created viscount Bao Chao.
朝廷寄望于新封子爵的鲍超，

A warmly worded decree declared that without “a man of exceptional courage and strategy such as Bao Chao” it would be difficult to transform the military situation in Xinjiang.
特降温旨，认为新疆平乱，『非得勇略出群如鲍超者，前往剿办，恐难壁垒一新』，

Zeng was therefore ordered to transmit instructions that, upon the expiry of Bao’s two-month leave to bury his parent, he should “depart immediately from Sichuan, pass beyond the frontier, and suppress the Muslim rebellion.”
所以命曾国藩传旨鲍超，在他回籍葬亲的两月假期一满，『即行由川起程，出关剿办回乱。』

Knowing Bao’s love of renown, Prince Gong and Wenxiang flattered him by comparing him with Yang Yuchun, the celebrated general of the Qianlong and Jiaqing reigns.
恭王和文祥知道鲍超好名，特地拿乾嘉名将杨遇春，与他相提并论，很灌了一番米汤。

“In former campaigns in the Muslim territories, Yang Yuchun, himself a native of Sichuan, won frontier victories whose glory shone upon the military banners.
上谕中说∶『从前回疆用兵，杨遇春即系川省土著，立功边域，彪炳旅常。

Bao Chao must lead his forces to pacify the western marches, carrying his fame ten thousand li and matching the splendor of his predecessor.
鲍超务当督率诸国，肃清西陲，威扬万里，以与前贤后先辉映。

Loyal and brave by nature, he will surely obey upon receiving this decree and fulfill the court’s trust.”
该提督忠勇性成，接奉此旨，必即遵行，以逼朝廷委任。』

The language was most earnest.
话说得很诚挚，

By requiring Zeng to transmit it, the court also hinted that he should help urge Bao forward.
而命曾国藩传旨，亦有暗示他帮着催劝之意。

Zeng, however, had long resolved that the Hunan Army should withdraw prudently at the height of its success.
无奈曾国藩对湘军的急流勇退，明哲保身，早有定算；

Bao was a favorite commander whom he particularly wished to protect.
鲍超是他的爱将，当然要加意保全，

He simply conveyed the edict in the usual way and offered no encouragement to depart.
所以只是照例传旨，并不劝驾。


The other man in whom the court placed great hopes was Zuo.
再有一个朝廷寄以重望的，便是左宗棠。

As Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang, he was naturally responsible for suppressing the two large forces of Li Shixian and Wang Haiyang, defeated by Bao at Ruijin in Jiangxi and driven into Fujian.
他是现任的闽浙总督，由江西瑞金为鲍超所败，而窜入福建境内的李世贤、汪海洋两大股，顺理成章 地该由他负责清剿。

Zuo was not a man to shrink from trouble.
左宗棠不是怕事的人，

He regarded the duty as his by right and could not honorably refuse.
对此亦自觉当仁不让，义不容辞；

Yet a succession of court decisions made him angry, anxious, and deeply resentful.
可是朝廷一连串的处置，却使他即气又急，愤愤不平。

His first disappointment was Ma Xinyi’s appointment to Zhejiang.
首先大失所望的是，浙江巡抚派了马新贻；

Jiang Yili had been passed over, which meant that Zuo had lost control of the province.
蒋益澧落了空，也就等于是他失去了浙江这个地盘。

Next came Li’s transfer to act as Governor-General of Liangjiang, placing him above Zuo in standing and precedence—a most unpleasant thought.
其次是李鸿章 调署两江，名位已在己之上，使他很不舒服。

Then Yang Yuebin, still in Jiangxi, was ordered to proceed promptly to his post in Shaanxi and Gansu.
其次是在江西的陕甘总督杨岳斌，奉旨迅即到任；

Zhejiang was required to contribute a hundred thousand taels a month toward his military expenses and first to raise eighty thousand for his army’s departure.
朝廷责成浙江每月拨给陕甘协饷十万两，并先筹措八万银子，作为杨军的开拔费用。

Zuo’s temper flared.
为此，左宗棠的肝火很旺，

Every day, when receiving his staff, he roundly abused Zeng Guofan, Li Hongzhang, and Guo Songtao.
每日接见僚属，大骂曾国藩、李鸿章 和郭嵩焘。

After several days his anger abated a little.
这样骂了几天，怒火稍减；

Since he would not resign and return to farming, he must undertake something substantial and impressive.
想想既不肯辞官归田，就得有声有色地大干一番。

He was confident of his military ability; the difficulty was an ever-shrinking revenue base.
军务是有把握的，就是饷源越来越绌，

Before Ma arrived, he needed a resourceful man to help arrange matters properly.
得要找个足智多谋的人，趁马新贻末曾到任以前，好好筹划妥当。


That man could only be Hu.
这个人自然非胡雪岩莫属。

“Mr Xueyan,” Zuo said, “they have squeezed me until I have nowhere to turn.
『雪翁，』他说，『你看，挤得我无路可走了！

Where do you think I can raise funds?
你算算看，我该到哪里筹饷？

It is difficult everywhere.”
哪里都难！』

Together they went through the fifteen provinces one by one.
两个人将十五行省一个一个地算。

Leaving aside the poor provinces, every wealthy source of revenue had already been claimed.
除开穷瘠的省份，有饷可筹的富庶之地，都已为他人早着先鞭；

Jiangsu and Anhui lay within Liangjiang, where Zeng and his pupil Li were deeply entrenched.
江苏、安徽是两江辖区，曾李师弟的势力，根深蒂固；

Shen Baozhen’s treatment of the Hunan Army in Jiangxi was warning enough.
江西沈葆桢，对待曾军的前例，足以令人望而却步；

Shandong and Shanxi supplied the capital, and their governors, Yan Jingming and Shen Guifen, were upright, shrewd, and difficult men to deal with.
山东、山西供应京饷，而且两省巡抚阎敬铭、沈桂芬清刚精明，都不是好相与的人；

Hubei consumed Sichuan salt, collecting substantial likin revenue through an office at Shashi.
湖北食用川盐，在沙市设局征厘，收入相当可观，

But Guanwen was the only bannerman among the governors and governors-general; right or wrong, he enjoyed the court’s protection, and gaining access there would be hard.
可是官文是督抚中唯一的一个旗人，有理无理，皆受朝廷袒护，不容易打得进去；

As for prosperous Sichuan, Luo Bingzhang governed it.
至于天府之国的四川，有骆秉章 在那里，

Remembering their old relationship as patron and secretary, Zuo could hardly bring himself to play out a “seizure of Chengdu.”
顾念旧日宾主之谊，自然不好意思唱一出『取成都』。

“Fujian is desperately poor.
『福建穷得很；

The only places left to me are your province and Guangdong.
我能筹饷的地方，只有贵省和广东了。

Guangdong withholds the contributions due to me.
东该给我的饷不给；

That hateful Guo Yunxian recognizes no one but Zeng Disheng and Li Shaoquan!
可恨郭筠仙，心目中只认得曾涤生、李少荃。

I cannot forget it.”
此恨难消！』

Zuo paused.
左宗棠停了一下又说，

“As for Ma Gushan, I hear he is reasonable enough.
『至于马谷山，听说倒还讲理；

But Zeng recommended him, and he passed the examinations in the same year as Li.
不过既是曾涤生所保，又是李少荃的同年，

He may not be willing to help me.
不见得肯助我一臂。

Mr Xueyan, what am I to do?”
雪翁，你看我该怎么办？』


Hu remained silent.
胡雪岩默然。

His position was difficult.
因为他觉得自己的处境很难，

He must repay Zuo’s recognition and favor, yet Zhejiang was his home province.
左宗棠的知遇要报答；而浙江是自己的家乡，

He could not devise schemes for Zuo that would earn the curses of its people.
为左宗棠设谋画策，可不能挨地方父老的骂。

Hu usually spoke decisively and accepted even the greatest difficulties without hesitation; such a prolonged silence was almost unprecedented.
胡雪岩一向言词爽利，而且不管天大的难事，一诺无辞；象这样迟疑不答的情形，可说绝无仅有。

Mildly surprised, Zuo pressed him for an explanation.
左宗棠微感诧异，不免追问缘故。

“To be frank, my lord, I am in a difficult position.
『不瞒大人说，我很为难。

Zhejiang is now the only province you can draw upon, so naturally your supplies and pay must come from it.
大人现在只有浙江一个地盘，粮饷当然出在浙江，

Raise too little, and it will not suffice; raise too much, and the people suffer.
筹得少了不够用；筹得多了，苦了地方。

Everyone will say it was my idea.
说起来是我胡某人出的主意；

Among my own countrymen, that would be an uncomfortable position.
本乡本土，我不大好做人。』

If you continued to act as Governor of Zhejiang, I could still suggest ways to balance one source against another and adapt to circumstances, taking both interests into account.
雪岩又说，『如果大人兼署浙江巡抚，我还可以出出主意，截长补短，见机行事，总还兼顾得到。

But Governor Ma is coming.
现在换了马中丞，

I am only a probationary circuit intendant assigned to Jiangxi, whom you had transferred here for service.
我又是分发江西的试用道，是大人奏调我在浙江当差；

Once you leave Zhejiang, I shall have no right to concern myself with its affairs.
大人一离浙江，我当然不能再问浙江的公事，

I must even hand over my post at the Reconstruction Bureau, let alone anything else.”
善后局的差使亦要交卸，何况其他？』


Zuo nodded throughout.
他一路说，左宗棠一路点头，

When Hu finished, he gestured for patience. “I understand all the circumstances you have described.
等他说完，做个『稍安毋躁』的手势答道∶『你刚才所说的情形，我完全清楚，

We must discuss them carefully.
我们要好好谈谈。

Through every change, one principle remains: you must continue to help me.
万变不离的宗旨是∶雪翁，你仍旧要帮我的忙。

How you are to help we shall consider presently.
怎么个帮法，我们回头再商量，

First, let us deal with your difficulty.
现在先谈你的难处；

As you say, Zhejiang is my only base, and Zhejiang must provide my army’s funds.
诚如所言，我现在只有浙江一个地盘，粮饷只有着落在浙江，

Moreover, there must be a fixed sum, remitted each month on a fixed date, not one day late.
而且要定一个确数，按月一定汇到，连日子都错不得一天。

Mr Xueyan, in everything we first establish what is reasonable, then appeal to personal feeling.
雪翁，凡事先讲理，后讲情；

If both reason and feeling support us and we still cannot prevail, I naturally have methods of my own.”
情理都站得住，还争不过人家，我当然也有我的手段。』

Hu did not know what the last words implied.
胡雪岩不知他最后这几句话，意何所指？

Keeping to the immediate issue, he asked, “What sum do you intend to fix, my lord?”
只能就事论事，问一事∶『大人预备定一个啥数目？』

“What would you suggest?”
『你看呢？』

Zuo lowered his voice. “Between ourselves, I shall tell you the truth. I actually have eighteen thousand men, but funding must allow a margin.
左宗棠放低了声音说∶『我们自己人，我告诉你实话∶我的兵，实数一万八千，不过筹饷要宽，

We should calculate for twenty-three thousand.”
照两万三千人算。』

Hu reckoned rapidly.
胡雪岩的心算极快。

A soldier’s monthly pay, grain, weapons, ammunition, horse fodder, and miscellaneous needs—tents, cooking pots, bowls, and the rest—averaged five taels.
士兵每人每月饷银、军粮、器械、弹药、马草，加上营帐、锅碗等等杂支，平均要五两银子；

Twenty-three thousand men meant a hundred and fifteen thousand taels.
两万三千人就是十一万五千两。

Add the commander’s own expenses, the salaries and board of secretaries and commissioned officials, and the costs of hospitality, and no less than a hundred and fifty thousand taels a month would do.
另加统帅个人的用途；文案、委员的薪水伙食；送往迎来的应酬费用，每个月非十五万银子不可。


For Zhejiang to bear that enormous sum alone was too much.
这笔巨数，由浙江独力负担，未免太重；

Hu therefore spoke tactfully. “Fujian and Zhejiang are one family.
胡雪岩便很婉转地说道∶『闽浙一家。

Over the years, Fujian has contributed at least three million taels toward Zhejiang’s military expenses.
福建拨给浙江的协饷，前后总计，不下三百万两之多；

Now that Fujian has trouble, we should naturally help.
如今福建有事，当然要帮忙。

Besides, the troops you command are Zhejiang troops; Zhejiang ought to pay them.
而况大人带的又是浙江的兵，理当浙江支饷。

But you understand the province’s condition better than anyone.
不过，浙江的情形，大人是再明白不过的；

If we could determine our income by our expenditure, matters would be easier.”
如果能够量出为入，事情就好办了。』

The usual maxim was to determine expenditure by income; Hu had reversed it, which was something new.
成语是量入为出，胡雪岩却反过来说，倒也新鲜；

Stroking his drooping mustache, Zuo asked with a smile, “What do you mean by determining income by expenditure?
左宗棠便捻着八字胡子，含笑问道∶『何以谓之量出为入？

I should like to hear.”
倒要请教。』

“Suppose there is a bowl of soup.
『譬如一碗汤，

One man takes a ladleful, another takes a ladleful; very little reaches anyone’s mouth—” “Ah!” Zuo interrupted. “I understand.
你也舀，他也舀，到嘴都有限┅┅。』『啊！』左宗棠抢着说道∶『我懂了！

I had the same thought.
我亦本有此意，

First, we absolutely cannot agree to the contribution for Shaanxi and Gansu.
第一，陕甘的协饷，决不能答应；

Second, Guangdong’s contribution to Zhejiang exists only in name.
第二，广东解浙江的协饷，有名无实，

I shall petition to have it discontinued.”
我要奏请停拨。』

At this his eyes moved from side to side, and a slow, exceedingly secretive smile spread over his face.
说到这里，他眼珠打转，慢慢地笑了，笑得极其诡秘。


There was much behind that smile. Hu felt he must understand it and deliberately probed. “Guangdong’s contribution is a picture of a cake.
这一笑，大有文章.胡雪岩觉得非搞明白不可；便有意套问一句∶『广东的协饷是个画饼，

Though it cannot feed us, it is something to look at.”
虽不能充饥，看看也是好的。』

“No.
『不然！

By asking for its cancellation, I shall show the court that it is only a painted cake.
奏请停拨，就是要让朝廷知道，这是个画饼。

Mr Xueyan—” Zuo suddenly grew excited.
雪翁，』左宗棠突然兴奋了，

“Watch this old man’s methods!
『你看老夫的手段！

I shall turn the painted cake into a great thick barley cake, enough to fill our bellies.
画饼要把它变成个又大又厚，足供一饱的大麦饼。

Do you believe me?”
你信不信？』

“Of course.
『怎么不信？』

Will you need me as an assistant in this conjuring trick?”
胡雪岩紧接着问，『大人变这套戏法，可要我做下手？』

“Naturally!
『当然！

Without you I could never perform this trick of producing a cake from bare ground—and sawing a living man in two besides.”
少了你，我这套平地抠饼，外带大锯活人的戏法就变不成了。』

Though meant as a joke, the last words were jarring.
『大锯活人』四字，虽是戏言，却也刺耳，

Half in jest, Hu asked, “Whom do you mean to saw in two, my lord?”
胡雪岩便用半开玩笑的语气问道∶『大人，你要锯哪一个？』

“Whom?”
『哪一个？』

Zuo’s smile had grown fierce.
左宗棠有种狞笑的神色，

“My own in-law.”
『锯我那位亲家。』

Hu was appalled.
胡雪岩骇然。

He had long known that Zuo bore a grievance against Guo Songtao, one that time had deepened rather than eased.
他早知左宗棠跟郭嵩焘有心病，而此心病，不但未能由时光来冲淡，反有与日俱深之势；

But how had it reached the point of such language?
但何致于说出『大锯活人』的这样的话来？

For a moment he stood speechless.
因此一时楞在那里作声不得。

Zuo too ceased smiling.
左宗棠的脸上，也收起嬉笑之态，

His face grew serious, his eyes wide, his mouth firmly closed; yet his gaze flickered and his lips moved, as though powerful waves were passing through his mind.
变得相当认真，眼睁得好在，嘴闭得好紧；但眼神闪烁，嘴唇翕动，竟似心湖中起了极大的波澜似的。

Hu listened with even closer attention to hear how this “sawing a living man in two” was to be done.
这就使得胡雪岩越发贯注全神，要听他如何『大锯活人』了。


“Xueyan!”
『雪岩！』

For the first time Zuo dropped the formal address and used his courtesy name, treating him as an intimate friend.
左宗棠第一次改口，以别字相呼，表示对胡雪岩以密友看待，

“I know you have not read many books.
『你的书读得不多，我是知道的；

But understanding the world is itself learning, and in that respect I admire you.”
不过「世事洞明皆学问」，照这一层来说，我佩服你。』

“You are too kind.”
『不敢当。』

Hu was a little uneasy but remained frank.
胡雪岩有些局促，但也很率直，

“If you have something to say, please give me your instructions.
『大人有什么话要说，尽管吩咐；

Such a tall hat of praise is rather too much for me.”
拿顶「高帽子」套在我头上，就有点吃不消了。』

“Why should I need flattery between us?
『你我之间，何用要什么送高帽子的手段？

What I mean is that you understand half of my character and conduct.
我的意思是，我的为人，我的处世，只有你能明白五分；

The other half you not only fail to understand, but may strongly disapprove of.
还有五分，你不但不明白，或许还会大不以为然。

That is because you have read too little.
这就因为你少读书；

If you had studied more, you would understand that other half as well, and see that I have no choice: circumstances compel it.”
如果你也多读过一点书，就会明白我那另外五分，而且谅解我不得不然；势所必然！』

So that was what he meant.
原来如此，

Hu felt almost overwhelmed by the confidence shown him.
胡雪岩倒有些受宠若惊了，

“My lord, if you speak to me of ‘the Way of Great Learning lies in manifesting luminous virtue,’ I shall understand nothing.”
『大人』他说∶『你老跟我谈「大家之道，在明明德」，我是不懂的。』

“I shall speak of history, not the Classics.
『我不跟你谈经，我跟你谈史。

First, tell me what these two sayings mean: ‘For a greater righteousness, sacrifice even one’s kin,’ and ‘For public duty, forget private interests.’”
雪岩，我先请问你两句成语，「大义灭亲」、「公而忘私」怎么讲？』


Hu had no answer, nor felt one was needed.
胡雪岩无以为答；觉得也不必答，

He replied honestly, “Please do not examine me, my lord.
老实回复∶『大人不要考我了。

Begin with those sayings and tell me your plans.”
就从这两句成语上头，谈你老的打算。』

“I am not examining you.
『我不是考你，

My point is that ordinary people may condemn my actions bitterly.
我的意思是，我的行事，照世俗之见，或许会大大地骂我。

Yet though I fail my kin, I do not fail what is right; though I may be ashamed in private relationships, I have nothing to blush for in public duty.
不过，我的行事，于亲有亏，于义无悖；于私有惭，于公无愧。

Common opinion cannot understand this.
这都非世俗之见所能谅解，

Only a learned man will say in his heart: ‘Zuo is a hero born for his age.
而只有读过书的人，才会在心里说一声∶左某人命世之英，

He could do no otherwise.’”
不得不然。』

The speech was rather bookish, but Hu understood it well enough and grasped its implication: Zuo meant to deal Guo Songtao a severe blow.
这段话很掉了几句文，不过胡雪岩也大致还能听得懂；而且听出意思，他对郭嵩焘要下辣手了！

What he could not see was what blow lay within Zuo’s power.
所想不通的是，他有何辣手可对郭嵩焘？

His question was answered at once.
他的疑问，立刻得到了解答；

Zuo rose, sat at his desk, took a brush, and spread out paper.
左宗棠起身坐在书桌前面，伸毫铺纸，

He rapidly drew a map, adding place-names among the curved lines and dots.
很快地画成一幅地图，在那些曲线、圆点之中，写上地名；

Hu recognized the Fujian–Guangdong frontier.
胡雪岩看出是一幅闽粤交界的形势图。

“Li Shixian is at Zhangzhou, which fell on the fourteenth day of the ninth month.
『李世贤在漳州。漳州是九月十四沦陷的，

Brigade Commander Lukui was killed in action; Circuit Intendant Xu Xiaofeng of Tingzhou, Zhangzhou, and Longyan died at his post.
总兵禄魁阵亡；汀漳龙道徐晓峰殉难。

Li has probably more than eight thousand men and must not be underestimated.”
李世贤大概有八千多人，不可轻敌。』

Pointing to the triangle formed by Changting, Liancheng, and Shanghang, Zuo continued, “Wang Haiyang is here.
左宗棠又指着长汀、连城、上杭这三角地带说∶『汪海洋在这一带；

In my judgment he is fiercer than Li.
照我的看法，他比李世贤更凶悍。

Still, there is no cause for alarm about putting these rebels down.
然而，不足为虑，贼不足平！

Xueyan, you must have learned a little strategy in recent years.
雪岩，你这几年总也懂得一点兵法了！

Where do you think Li and Wang can escape?”
你看李、汪二贼的出路在哪里？』


For a moment Hu seemed stumped.
这一下好象考倒了胡雪岩。

He studied the map closely before answering. “They came from Jiangxi in the west.
他仔细看了半天，方始答说『他们是由西面江西逃过来的；

To the east lies the sea, a long way off—and without ships they could not put to sea anyway.
往东是出海，有好长一段路，再说没有船也出不了海。

In the north, your troops are pressing down.
北面呢，大人带兵压了下来，

Ah!”
啊，』

Understanding came suddenly, and he spoke with confidence. “Their only way out is south into Guangdong.
胡雪岩恍然大悟，很有把握地说∶『这两个长毛的出路，只有南面的广东，

Jiaying Prefecture will bear the first attack.”
嘉应州首当其冲！』

Zuo nodded deeply, stroking his mustache with a smile.
左宗棠深深点头，拈髭微笑，

“Exactly.
『对，』

Jiaying will bear the first attack.
他说，『嘉应州首当其冲！

Then we shall no longer be feeding ourselves on painted cakes.”
到了那时候充饥的就不是画饼了！』

There was a hidden meaning in his words.
语中有深意。

He did not continue, and Hu dared not ask, fearing that a mistaken guess might lead him into a grave indiscretion.
左宗棠没有说下去；胡雪岩不便回——怕自己猜错了，冒昧一关，是大大的失言。

Zuo, however, had no such reservations.
谁知左宗棠毫不忌讳，

He truly regarded Hu as a confidant fit to hear the deepest secrets.
真的拿胡雪岩当可共极端机密的心腹看待，

“Guo Yunxian has always feared that Zeng Disheng would drive the rebels into Guangdong.
『郭筠仙一直担心曾涤生「驱寇入粤」，

He never imagined it would be his own in-law who did so.
他没有想到「驱寇入粤」的是他的亲家。』

When that happens, Xueyan, the situation will be entirely different.”
他说∶『雪岩，到那时候，又另是一番局面了。』

Hu shuddered involuntarily.
胡雪岩不自觉地打了个寒噤，

Zuo’s methods seemed altogether too ruthless.
觉得左宗棠的手段真是太辣了些！

He had guessed this very thing, certainly; but a conjecture was one matter, and hearing it confirmed in the man’s own words was another.
虽然，这正是他所猜想到的，但测度是测度，听别人亲口证实，感觉又自不同。


“Xueyan, tell me what the situation will be then.”
『雪岩，』左宗棠问道∶『你倒说说看到那时候是怎么样的一番局面？』

“Yes.”
『是。』

Hu considered.
胡雪岩想了想说，

“The court will naturally turn to your prestige and ability, appoint you imperial commissioner, and place military affairs in Fujian, Zhejiang, and Guangdong under your authority.
『到那时候，朝廷当然借重大人的威望，拜钦差大臣，节制福建、浙江、广东三省的军务。

Governor Guo—” He stopped.
郭中丞——。』他没有再说下去；

His meaning was clear: under Zuo’s handling, Guo would suffer severely.
意思是郭嵩焘在左宗棠『大锯活人』的摆布之下，非吃足苦头不可。

“Precisely.
『不错，

Circumstances must lead to that.
此亦是势所必然之事。

Then, Xueyan, I shall no longer burden Zhejiang.
到那时候，雪岩，我不会再累浙江了，

Guo Yunxian will have to raise funds obediently for me.
不怕郭筠仙不乖乖替我筹饷。

Unless—” Zuo pondered for a long while.
不过，』左宗棠沉吟了好一会，

“There is no certainty.
『也说不定！

Guo is foolish and obstinate.
郭筠仙愚而好自用；

He may still refuse to see reason.”
怕他仍旧执迷不悟。』

“And if he does, my lord, what will you do?”
『果然如此，大人又怎么办？』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第九章（本章第4部分，共7部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“Then he cannot blame me.
『那就不能怪我了！

What a pity!”
可惜！』

The two remarks seemed disconnected.
前后两句话不接气，

Quick-witted as he was, Hu could not guess their meaning.
胡雪岩再机敏也猜不透他的意思；

Since the matter concerned a possible reduction of Zhejiang’s burden, he had to ask. “A pity in what respect, my lord?”
只以此事于减轻浙江的负担关系甚大，不能不追问∶『大人，可惜些什么？』

“A pity I have no suitable man in reserve to become a governor.”
『可惜，我夹袋里没有可以当巡抚的人物。』

In other words, if Guo Songtao failed to raise enough money for him, Zuo would not hesitate to bring him down and put someone else in his place.
这是说，如果将来郭嵩焘不能替左宗棠筹得足够的饷；他不惜攻倒他派人取而代之。

That would indeed be “forgetting private interests for public duty” and “sacrificing kin for a greater righteousness.”
这样做法，却真是『公而忘私』、『大义灭亲』了。

“We shall see when the time comes.
『到时候看吧！

It is too early to speak of it.”
言之过早。』

Zuo stared for some time at his map.
左宗棠对着他手绘的地图凝视了好一会，

Suddenly he struck the desk and sprang up.
突然拍案而起，

“Yes!
『对，

That is how it shall be done!”
就是这么办！』


He explained his sudden inspiration, pointing to the map.
接着，左宗棠谈了他的突如其来的灵感。他指着地图为胡雪岩解释，

His forces were still insufficient.
自己的兵力还不够；

Enveloping the rebels on three sides and squeezing them toward Guangdong would be difficult.
倘或想用三面包抄的办法，将长毛向广东方面挤，相当吃力。

If one gap remained unblocked and the rebels escaped to sea, whether off Fujian or Zhejiang, he would still bear responsibility.
万一有个漏洞填塞不住，长毛一出了海，不管在福建或浙江的海面，自己都脱不了干系，

Would that not defeat his own purpose?
岂不是弄巧成拙？

He therefore wished to enlist Li Hongzhang’s Anhui Army.
因此，左宗棠想请李鸿章 的淮军助以一臂。

Their cooperation at Huzhou had been satisfactory; surely Li would not refuse another request.
克复湖州之役，彼此合作得还满意；如今再申前请，想来李鸿章 不致于拒绝。

“But I cannot make the approach myself,” Zuo said.
『不过，这话我不便开口。』左宗棠说，

“If I invite them, I must fund the visiting troops.
『如果是我出面相邀，就得替客军筹饷；

Suppose he sends ten thousand men: that means at least fifty or sixty thousand taels a month.
譬如他派一万人，一个月起码就得五六五银子，

Add their departure expenses, and the first allocation must be a hundred thousand.
再加上开拔的盘缠，第一笔就非拨十万银子不可，

That is beyond me.
实在力有未逮。

If the court orders the Anhui Army to bring its own pay and provisions and assist in Fujian, we need provide no more than fifty thousand as a reward.
倘或朝廷有旨意，让淮军自备粮饷，来闽助剿；我们至多备五万银子作犒赏，

That would satisfy appearances.
面子上也就把好看了。

Xueyan, what do you think of my calculation?”
雪岩，你说，我这把如意算盘如何？』

“It is a good one.
『是好算盘。

But Governor Li may refuse to provide both pay and food.
不过淮军自备粮饷，恐怕李中丞不肯。

If he supplies the pay and we the grain, he will have nothing to object to.
他出饷，我们出粮；李中丞就没话好说了，

His men must be paid even if they remain idle.
因为他的军队闲摆在那里，一样也是要发饷的。

As for obtaining an imperial order, we must ask Fujian officials in Beijing to work for it.”
至于请朝廷降旨，只有请福建的京官在京里活动。』

“That may not succeed.”
『那怕不行。』

Zuo shook his head.
左宗棠摇摇头，

“No Fujian man there currently holds a sufficiently high position; their words carry little weight.
『福建京官，目前没有身居高位的，说话不大有力量。

Fujian and Zhejiang depend on one another like lips and teeth.
闽浙唇齿相依。

Think of the senior Zhejiang men in Beijing.
浙江在京的大老，雪岩你倒想想看，

Whom could we approach?”
有什么人可托？『


“Among the senior Zhejiang men, Lord Xu naturally comes first.
『浙江在京的大老，自然要数许大人；

But he has retired from the Ministry of Personnel.
不过，他的吏部尚书交卸了。

His eldest son, however, is much favored in the Southern Study.
倒是他的大少爷，在南书房很红；

He also has a nephew in the Grand Council secretariat, dealing particularly with military affairs—” “Exactly!
还有他一位侄少爷，是小军机，专管军务——。』『对！

Exactly!” Zuo interrupted.
对！』不等胡雪岩说完，左宗棠便抢着说，

“There could be no better approach.
『这条路子再好都没有，

Please arrange it for me.
请你替我进行。

The Xu family is one of Hangzhou’s great clans.
许家杭州望族，

Surely you know someone?”
你总有熟人吧？』

“There are many of them, and I know several.
『他家的人很多，我倒认得几痊；

But a matter of this importance cannot be entrusted to just anyone.”
不过象这样的大事，也不好随便托人。』

Hu thought a moment.
胡雪岩想了一会说，

“I should like to go to Shanghai and see Seventh Master Xu.
『大人，我想到上海去一趟；去看许七大人。

I can put your business before him and at the same time try to persuade him to return to Hangzhou and take charge of reconstruction.”
一面拿大人交办的事托他；一面想拿许七大人搬到杭州，出面来办善后。』

After considering, Zuo found this an excellent plan.
左宗棠想了一下。觉得胡雪岩这个办法极好——

“Seventh Master Xu” was Xu Naizhao, Governor of Jiangsu at the time of Liu Lichuan’s Small Swords uprising, now living as a refugee in Shanghai.
所谓『许七大人』就是小刀会刘丽川起事之时的江苏巡抚许乃钊；如今逃难在上海。

His elder brother, Hu’s “Sixth Master Xu,” was Xu Naipu, retired Minister of Personnel.
他的胞兄，也就是胡雪岩口中的『许六大人』许乃普，以吏部尚书致仕，

Unable to return south because of the rebels, he had become a kind of home away from home for Zhejiang men in Beijing.
因为闹长毛不能南归；在京里是浙江同乡的『家乡』。

A senior examination graduate who had long presided over literary selection, he was treated with particular respect by the capital’s elders.
而且科名前辈，久掌文衡，京中大老，颇加尊礼。

His eldest son, Xu Pengshou, had graduated in the same cohort as Li Hongzhang and headed the metropolitan examination list in the dingwei year, the twenty-seventh of Daoguang.
许乃普的长子许彭寿，是李鸿章 的同年，也是道光二十七年丁未这一榜的会元；

Xu Naipu also had a nephew, Xu Gengshen, who had rendered important service during the Xinyou coup.
许乃普还有个胞侄许庚皋，在『辛酉政变』中出过大力，

Now a highly favored senior secretary of the Grand Council, he understood military affairs and strategy and exercised considerable influence over deployments.
如今是极红的『小军机』——军机章京领班之一，熟谙兵事，精于方略，对军务部署有极大的发言权。

This route opened doors in every direction.
所以走这条路子，路路皆通；

If necessary, Xu Pengshou could use his fellowship with Li to write him a particularly earnest letter.
必要时还可以请许彭寿以同年的交情，写封切切实实的信给李鸿章 ，

There was every reason to expect success.
更无有不能如愿之理。


Bringing Xu Naizhao back to direct Hangzhou’s reconstruction was likewise an excellent and necessary move.
至于将许乃钊请回杭州来主持善后，这也是一着非下不可的好棋。

Once Ma arrived, Hu would have to leave, and Xu was the best possible replacement.
因为马新贻一到任，胡雪岩有不得不走之势；而要找替手，最适当的人选就是许乃钊。

First, he had governed a province and risen through the Hanlin Academy, a gentleman of established rank in every sense.
第一，他做过封疆大吏，科名是翰林出身，名副其实的『缙绅先生』；

Second, Ma was not only his junior but a fellow graduate of his nephew Xu Pengshou.
第二，马新贻不仅是许乃钊的后辈，而且与他的胞侄许彭寿同榜，

Visiting Ma in the position of an honored uncle of the older generation, Xu would be entitled to the formal courtesy of the central gate being opened for his arrival and departure.
以『老世叔』的身分去看马新贻，照例应受『硬进硬出』——开中门迎送的礼遇，

His voice on local affairs would carry correspondingly greater weight.
这样为地方讲话就有力量就得多了；

Third, he was just, incorruptible, and universally respected, eminently qualified to lead the local gentlemen.
第三，许乃钊公正廉洁，德高望重，足以冠冤群伦。

Zuo therefore gladly accepted Hu’s proposal and offered to write Xu a most earnest personal letter.
因此，左宗棠欣然接纳胡雪岩的建设；而且自己表示，要亲笔写封很恳切的信，向许乃钊致意。


With public business settled, they turned to “private” business, which was itself public: Hu’s future position.
谈完了公事谈『私事』；而私事也就是公事∶胡雪岩的出处。

Zuo intended to have him transferred to Fujian.
左宗棠打算将他调到福建；

He need not travel with the army, however; he would remain in Shanghai and manage all Zuo’s affairs there.
但不必随他一起行动，专驻上海，为他经理一切。

Hu agreed without hesitation.
胡雪岩毫不迟疑地答应了下来。

From the following day, Zuo energetically began carrying out their agreed steps.
从第二天起，左宗棠便照商定的步骤，积极开始部署；

Besides military reports, he sent several memorials in succession.
除了战报以外，一连拜发了好几道奏折。

The first pleaded that Zhejiang could scarcely meet its own army’s needs and asked the Ministry of Revenue to find another source for the contribution to Shaanxi and Gansu.
第一道是∶浙江的兵饷军需，十分困难，自顾不暇；应该拨给陕甘的协饷，请饬户部另筹改拨。

The second urged Ma Xinyi to take office quickly and requested that Provincial Treasurer Jiang Yili temporarily administer the governorship until his arrival.
第二道是，请饬新任浙江巡抚马新贻，从速到任，至于马新贻未到任前，浙江巡抚请由藩司蒋益澧『护理』。

The third stated that, of the eighty thousand taels ordered for Yang Yuebin’s departure expenses, only half had been raised, and that with the greatest difficulty.
第三道是，奉旨拨解杨岳斌的『行资』八万两，于无可设法之中，勉强设法筹拨半数。


The fourth concerned Fujian.
第四道奏折与浙江无关——

Every year, as summer passed into autumn, the Ministry of Revenue pressed the provinces to remit their contributions to the capital.
每天夏秋之交，户部照例催各省报解『京饷』；

These paid not merely the Eight Banner guards but the salaries and allowances of princes, ministers, and officials; the expenses of government offices; sacrifices at ancestral temples and imperial tombs; and the silver presented at three annual festivals for the personal use of the emperor and the two empress dowagers.
京饷不止于发放在京八旗禁军的粮饷，举凡王公大臣，文武百官的廉俸；大小衙门办公的经费；宗庙陵寝的祭祀费用；以及专供两宫太后及皇帝私人花用，每年分三节呈上的『交进银』，无不出在京饷之内，

Provincial military contributions might fall into arrears; the capital’s funds could not.
所以协饷可欠，京饷不可欠。

Fujian owed a hundred thousand taels in customs revenue and twenty thousand in tea tax.
福建欠海关税银十万两；茶税二万两，

An edict demanded payment in full during the twelfth month and threatened named impeachments under the prescribed rules if further excuses delayed essential expenditure.
上谕催解∶『务于十二月内，尽数解齐。倘仍饰辞宕延，致误要需，即由户部查照奏定章 程，指名严参。』

Despite this stern order, Zuo meant to default once more.
虽奉这样的严旨，左宗棠仍要欠上一次；

Only thus could he demonstrate Fujian’s poverty and its need for Zhejiang’s help.
因为非如此，不足以表示福建之穷，必须浙江接济。

Yet default required method; blunt defiance would not suffice.
当然，欠有欠的方法，不是硬顶可以了事的；

Besides pleading poverty, he remitted his own ten-thousand-tael governor-general’s integrity allowance through a draft bank to the Ministry of Revenue, to be credited toward the capital’s funds.
左宗棠的方法是，哭穷之外，将他闽浙总督应得的『养廉银』一万两，由票号汇到户部，作为京饷报解。


The fifth memorial requested an end to Guangdong’s military contributions to Zhejiang.
第五道是请停止广东解浙的协饷。

Its chief purpose was to show the court that these contributions had been no more than a painted cake.
主要的作用是借此机会让朝廷知道，广东的协饷，对浙江来说是个『画饼』。
