The stated reason for discontinuance was brief: “Military operations in Zhejiang having now ended, the above contributions should naturally cease.”
所以，停止的理由，不过『现在浙省军务肃清，所有前项协饷，自应停止』这样一句；

But the preceding accounts were set out precisely.
而『停止』以前的帐目，却算得很清楚，

From the first month of the first Tongzhi year to the eighth month of the current year, including the intercalary month, thirty-three months had elapsed.
从同治元年正月到这年八月，连闰共计三十三个月；

Guangdong should have remitted three million three hundred thousand taels.
广东应解浙江协饷三百三十万两，

Zhejiang had actually received only two hundred and eighty thousand, of which two hundred and twenty thousand came from likin.
可是实收仅二十八万。其中由厘金所拨者是二十二万两；

Zeng Guofan had reported that Guangdong’s likin receipts, from the levy’s introduction to the end of that eighth month, totaled one million two hundred thousand taels.
曾国藩奏道，广东厘金开办起至这年八月底止，共收一百二十万，

Thus Zhejiang’s army had received “not even two-tenths.”
是则浙军『所得不过十成之二』。


The sixth memorial concerned personnel after the move to Fujian.
第六道是部署到福建以后的人事。

Its heading requested rewards for officials who had managed military supplies and funding; it also sought their transfer.
奏折的案由是『办理饷需各员，请旨奖励』；附带请求调用。

Hu was naturally included.
其中当然有胡雪岩，

He was then a probationary circuit intendant assigned to Jiangxi, holding the honorary rank of salt commissioner.
他本来是『盐运使衔』的『江西试用道』；

Zuo asked that he be “reassigned to Fujian for substantive appointment as a circuit intendant, and granted the honorary rank of provincial judicial commissioner.”
左宗棠奏请『改发福建以道员补用，并请赏加按察使衔』，

Such wording looked less splendid than military requests for a peacock feather or the title of baturu.
这报奖的文字，看来并不如武官的『请赏戴花翎』、『请赏加巴图鲁称号』来得热闹起眼；

In reality, it did Hu a tremendous service.
其实帮了胡雪岩很大的一个忙，

Once approved, the change from probationary status to eligibility for substantive appointment meant that he could immediately fill any vacant circuit intendancy.
因为由『试用道』改为『以道员补用』，只要一准，立刻可以补任何实缺；

The judicial commissioner’s honorary rank would also qualify him to act in that higher office, rising above an ordinary circuit post into the senior provincial administration.
而『赏加按察使衔』，便可以署理阜司，成为实缺道员更上层楼的『监司大员』。

Zuo’s recommendation was worth at least three years of service.
在左宗棠来说，这一保，起码等于三年的劳绩。


Hu knew nothing of this memorial when Zuo sent it, for he had already reached Shanghai.
不过左宗棠拜发这道奏折时，胡雪岩并不知道；因为他人已到了上海。

Carrying Zuo’s personal letter, he called on Seventh Master Xu, and their conversation went most agreeably.
拿着左宗棠的亲笔函件去见『许七大人』；谈得十分融洽。

He completed all the business entrusted to him, stayed only two nights, spoke with his aged mother of West Lake after the devastation, spent half a day with Gu Yingchun, and returned to Hangzhou in the same boat.
将左宗棠所托之事，一一办妥；只不过耽搁了两夜，陪老母谈一谈劫后的西湖，与古应春盘桓了半天，便即原船回到杭州。

The first man seeking him there was not Zuo but Jiang Yili, the provincial treasurer temporarily administering the governorship.
回到杭州，第一个要想见他的不是左宗棠，而是藩司『护理抚篆』的蒋益澧；

Jiang had already left word at Fukang Bank that he was to be notified the moment Hu arrived, so that they could meet.
他早就派人在阜康钱庄留下话，等胡雪岩一到，立刻通知，以便会面。

“Mr Xueyan,” he said with a miserable expression, “you must help me.
『雪翁，』与胡雪岩见着了面，蒋益澧哭丧着脸说∶『你非帮我的忙不可！

The commander has ordered Zhejiang to send Fujian two hundred thousand taels every month, remitted on the twelfth without a single day’s delay.
大帅交代下来了，浙江每个月解福建协饷二十万两；按月十二号汇出，迟一天都不准。

Is that not asking the impossible?”
这不是强人所难吗？』

Hu too was startled.
听得这话，胡雪岩也吓一跳。

Zhejiang had suffered especially grievously in the Taiping war; devastation lay everywhere, and everything awaited rebuilding.
洪杨之乱，浙江遭劫特深，满目疮痛，百废待举，

Where could it find two hundred thousand taels a month to support an army entering Fujian?
何来每月二十万两银子，供养入闽之师？

Hu had reckoned that scraping together a hundred thousand would already strain the province to the utmost.
当时估计，每月能凑十万两银子，已经至矣尽矣；

Now Zuo demanded twice that amount and would not even permit a delay in payment.
不想左宗棠狮子大开口，加了一倍，而且日子都不准托，

It was excessive.
这就未免太过分了。


“On both public and private grounds, you must speak,” Jiang continued.
『雪翁，』蒋益澧又说，『于公于私，你都不能不说话，

“Privately, the commander listens to you and follows your advice.
私，老兄在大帅面前言听计从；

Publicly, as the saying goes, wool must come from the sheep.
公，俗语说的「羊毛出在羊身上」，

If this sum is forced from us, the people must suffer.
真是逼得非解这个数目不可，只有让地方受累。

You could not bear that either.
雪翁，你也于心不忍吧！

Besides, I am, after all, only the provincial treasurer.”
再说，我到底不过是藩司。』

That last sentence revealed his real distress.
最后这句话，才是蒋益澧真正的苦衷。

For the moment he held the governor’s seal and could issue effective orders.
目前巡抚的大印握在手里，令出即行，办事还容易；

Once Ma arrived, however, if the new governor considered the contribution excessive and ordered a reduction, Jiang would have to obey.
等马新贻一到任，认为协饷数目太大要减，他当藩司的，不能不听命。

Yet Zuo was the patron who had raised him, and Jiang had already undertaken to maintain the original sum.
而另一方面左宗棠又是一手提拔他的恩主，且有承诺在先，不能不维持原数。

Would he not be crushed between the two?
这一下岂非挤在夹缝里轧扁了头？

After thinking it over, Hu concluded that he must take this difficulty upon himself.
想了一会，胡雪岩觉得这个麻烦非揽下来不可，

He nodded. “Very well.
便点点头说∶『好的。

I shall find a way.”
我来想办法。』

“Then there is hope!”
『这一来有救了！』

Relieved, Jiang clasped his hands and asked, “I imagine you already have a plan.
蒋益澧如释重负，拱拱手问说∶『雪翁，谅来胸来成竹了。

Might I hear it?”
是何办法，可以不可以先闻为快？』

“Of course.
『当然，当然！

I wished to consult you.
原要请教。』

First, I shall ask Lord Zuo to reduce the amount.”
胡雪岩答说，『第一，我想请左大人酌减数目。』

“Reduce it by how much?”
『酌减？』蒋益澧问，『减多少？』

“At least by thirty percent.”
『总得打个七折。』


“That would still be a hundred and forty thousand a month,” Jiang said. “Now that the province is pacified, I need no longer command troops.
『打个七折，每月亦还得要十四万两。』蒋益澧说∶『如今军务肃清，我这个藩司不必带兵打仗，

I ought to accomplish something in my proper office.
要在本分上做点事。

Consider—” He listed his duties.
你看——。』蒋益澧细数他该做的事，

The most important for the economy and the people’s livelihood was the repair of waterworks.
最有关国计民生的要政，便是兴修水利。

Zhejiang was a land of cultivated fields: those near the hills were poor, those near water rich.
浙江全境皆是土田，近山者瘠，近水者腴。

Silk production made mulberry cultivation particularly important, and mulberries required much the same irrigation as paddy fields.
兼以蚕丝之利，首重栽桑；而桑树的栽培灌溉，与水田的要求，没有什么两样。

Since ancient times, officials whose kindness was long remembered in Zhejiang had invariably distinguished themselves in water management.
所以自古以来，在浙江做官，而遗爱在民，久留去思的，无不是因为在水利方面大有成就之故。


The chief concern was northern Zhejiang, and there the sea dikes were paramount.
浙江的水利重在浙北；浙北的水利父重在海塘。

The Qianlong Emperor had made inspection of these dikes the stated purpose of all six southern tours—proof enough of their importance.
乾隆六次南巡，都以巡视浙江海塘为名，可以想见其关系的重大。

To withstand the tides, they needed to be built of stone.
海塘欲求完固足以捍御海潮，须用石塘；

Since the rebellion, the stone dikes around Haining had received no repairs and were steadily crumbling.
洪杨作乱以来，海宁一带的石塘没有修过，日渐坍圮，

Restoration would cost more than a million taels.
现在要及时修复，估计费用须上百万银子；

With no alternative, temporary earthen works would have to suffice.
迫不得已，只有先办土塘，暂且将就。

“Even earth dikes will cost three hundred thousand,” Jiang said. “The materials are cheap; labor is dear. After the great disorder, there are fewer able-bodied men, which makes labor expensive.
『就是办土塘，亦要三十万银子。土塘料不贵，人工贵；大乱之后，壮丁少了，就是人工费。』蒋益澧说，

We must discuss how to raise money for repairs.
『雪翁，这件事我亦要跟你好好商量；怎么筹得一笔款子，拿海塘修一修？

If the sea dikes give way, the consequences will be terrible.
万一海塘溃决，可是件不得了的事，

The thought keeps me awake.”
一想起来，我真连觉都睡不着。』

Even if this display was affected, Hu found it worthy of respect.
听蒋益澧这样表示，即令是娇饰之词，胡雪岩亦是十分可敬。

“Since the Three Dynasties, the danger is only that men may not care for a good name.”
『三代以下惟恐不好名』，

Jiang’s deepest motives need not be examined.
他的本心不必问。

He sounded as though he wanted to be a good official.
听他的语气是想做好官；

Hu might as well encourage and support him, pressing him into that path for the province’s benefit.
正不妨与人为善，趁此机会捧他一捧、扶他一扶，拿他逼到好官的路上，亦正是地方之福。

“Do not worry,” he answered at once.
想到这里，他毫不迟疑地答道∶『请放心。

“I shall make a plan.
我来策划一下，

Let everyone contribute according to his means; it should not be difficult.”
大家量力捐办，不是难事。』

“That would be excellent.”
『那就再好没有。』

Jiang was pleased.
蒋益澧很欣慰地，

“The dredging of West Lake cannot wait either.
『还有西湖的疏浚，也不能再拖了。

Its waters irrigate fields in Hangzhou and Haining.
西湖水利，关乎杭州、海宁的水田灌溉；

Everything must be put in order before next spring, and that too will cost tens of thousands of taels.
明年春天以前，一定要整理好，这也得好几万银子。

Is a treasurer’s task easy?
雪翁，你倒想，我这个藩司难做不难做？

I must ask your advice on new revenue.”
有啥开源之道，真要好好向你请教。』

“For the present, salt is our only resource.
『如今只有在盐上动脑筋。』胡雪岩答说，

My method could tide us over.
『倘能照我的办法，可以救得一时之急，

In six months or a year, the Fujian campaign should reach a conclusion, and Zhejiang will no longer have to contribute.
一年半载，福建军务，告个段落；浙江不必再负担协饷，

Then things will be easier.”
那时候就轻松了。』

“I think so too.
『我也是这么想，

But I know little of salt administration.
不过，盐法我不大懂；

The commander is an expert.”
大帅倒是内行。』

“Lord Zuo is an expert?” Hu asked in surprise.
『左大人是内行？』胡雪岩很惊异地问。


“Nothing surprising about that.
『这也无足为怪的。

Do you not know?
雪翁，你莫非不知道？

The commander’s family is joined by marriage to that of Lord Tao, posthumously honored as Wenyi.”
大帅是陶文毅公的儿女亲家。』

“Ah!
『啊！

So that is it!”
啊！原来如此！』

Hu suddenly understood.
胡雪岩恍然大悟，

Zuo’s knowledge of salt administration had a history.
左宗棠对盐法内行，渊源有自。

When Zuo was twenty-six, Tao Shu, Governor-General of Liangjiang, had completed an inspection of troops in Jiangxi and obtained leave to visit the ancestral graves at his native Anhua in Hunan.
在他廿六岁时，两江总督陶澍在江西阅兵事毕，请假顺道回湖南安化原籍扫墓，

Passing through Liling, he was received with the customary official arrangements.
经过醴陵，县官照例『办差』，

While preparing his residence, the magistrate asked Zuo, then head of the Lujiang Academy at Liling, to compose a couplet.
布置公馆时，请主讲醴陵渌江书院的左宗棠，做了一副对联，

Tao admired it immensely.
陶澍一见，激赏不已；

Learning who had written it, he immediately sent for Zuo.
问知县官，出自左宗棠的手笔，当时便请来相见。

Sure enough, when Hu raised Zhejiang’s salt administration, Zuo declared at once that reforming it was one of the tasks he must complete before relinquishing the acting governorship.
果然，一谈到浙江的盐务，左宗棠立即表示，在他交卸浙江巡抚兼职以前，有几件必办的事，其中之一是就是整顿浙江盐务，

He intended to replace the quota-certificate system with salt permits, beginning in the first month of the fourth Tongzhi year, on a one-year trial.
改引行票，打算从同冶四年正月起，先试办一年。


“My plan has four parts,” Zuo said. “First, suppress smuggling; second, abolish irregular fees; third, reduce prices; fourth, conduct a proper registration of salt-producing households.
『我的办法，一共四款∶第一是缉私；第二是革浮费；第三是减价；第四是清查煎盐的灶户。

All salt-tax receipts will go to the army.
至于盐课收入，全数提为军饷；

After expenses, there should be at least a hundred thousand taels a month—enough for half my requirement.”
除去开销每个月至少有十万银子，够我一半的数目了。』

So Zhejiang was indeed expected to provide two hundred thousand a month for his Fujian campaign, exactly as Jiang had said.
这就是说，左宗棠援闽之师，每个月要浙江负担二十万两的饷银。与蒋益澧的话，完全相符。

Hu remained composed and set that aside for the moment, speaking first of salt.
胡雪岩很沉着，暂且放在心；先谈盐务。

“The last three parts can be carried out.
『大人这四款办法，后面三条是办得到的；

Suppressing smuggling will be more difficult.
就是缉私有些难处。

Zhejiang salt is sold in Songjiang, which is Jiangsu territory and beyond our reach.
浙盐行销松江；松江是江苏地面，鞭长莫及。

Have you considered that?”
这一层可曾想过？』

“Certainly.
『当然想过。』

I was going to discuss it with you.
左宗棠答道，『我正要跟你商量，

Did you not once mention a leader of the Grain-Boat Guild in Songjiang, an honest and capable man?
你不是跟我提过，有个松江漕帮的首脑，人很诚朴能干吗？

Would he help Zhejiang?”
他肯不肯帮帮浙江的忙？』

“His surname is You.
『此人姓尤，

If you give the word, he will gladly serve.
只要大人吩咐，他一定乐予效劳。』

But what form would his help take?”
胡雪岩问道∶『就不知道这个忙怎么帮法？』


“Naturally, he would lead troops against smugglers.”
『自然是带队伍缉私。』

Hu had asked a question whose answer he knew.
胡雪岩是明知故问；

Now he deliberately shook his head. “I fear that cannot be done.
等左宗棠有了答复，因话答话，故意摇摇头说∶『这怕办不到。

He is a grain-transport boatman, not an official.
他本人是个「运子」，不是官儿的身分；

By the rules of rank he must address even a bazong respectfully as ‘sir.’
说到规矩，见了把总都要尊称一声「总爷」。

How could he command troops?
大人请想，他怎么带队伍？

Even if he agreed, the officers and men assigned to him would not obey.”
就算他肯帮，分拨过示的官兵，也不服他的指挥。』

“True.”
『这话倒也是。』

Zuo hesitated.
左宗棠踌躇了，

“But unless he leads troops against smugglers, how can we make use of him?”
『不过，若非带队伍缉私，又有什么可以借重他之处？』

“You know the workings of the guild well.
『漕帮的底蕴，大人向来深知。

His followers all obey his word. Give him an official capacity, and there will certainly be results against smuggling around Songjiang.”
尤某的手下，都听他一句话∶如果有个名义，对松江一带的缉私，成效是一定有的。』

“Ah, I understand.”
『喔，我明白了。』

After a moment Zuo said, “There is no objection to that.
左宗棠想了一会说∶『这样办也没有什么不可以；

Let him recruit his own men—not too many, of course; two or three hundred will do.
让尤某自己去招人，当然也不能太多，招个两三百人，

We shall recommend him for an official rank and let him command them.
保尤某一个官职，让他管带。

I shall tell the salt commissioner to arrange it.
这件事，我交代盐运使去办；

Please make contact with You.
尤某那里，请你去接头。

Pay and operating expenses will follow the rules of my own army and come from the salt administration’s funds.”
至于饷银公费，一概照我营里的规矩，由盐务经费里面开支。』

Hu was delighted.
胡雪岩很高兴；

He had found a livelihood for Brother You and a means of serving public business at the same time.
这不但为尤五找到了一条生路，而且于公事亦有裨益，

He gladly agreed.
所以欣然应诺。



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第九章（本章第5部分，共7部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


They next turned to the business Jiang Yili had entrusted to Hu: Zhejiang’s monthly contribution to the army in Fujian.
然后谈到蒋益澧所托之事；亦就是浙江按月协解福建饷银的数目。

“Zhejiang formerly depended on Fujian for more than three million taels,” Hu began.
『从前浙江靠福建协饷，前后用过三百万之多；

“Now that Zhejiang troops are going to its aid, Zhejiang should naturally support them.
如今浙师援闽，饷银自然应该由浙江接济。

What arrangement do you propose, my lord?
大人是怎么个主意，请交代下来，

We should know early enough to prepare.”
好趁早筹划。』

“I have settled it with Xiangquan: Zhejiang will send me two hundred thousand a month.”
『我已经跟芗泉谈妥当了，浙江每个月接济我二十万。』

“Two hundred thousand is not much.
『二十万不多，

The trouble is that Zhejiang’s strength has been so badly drained.”
只限浙江的元气丧得太厉害！』

Hu deliberately paused, then asked without warning, “Once you reach Fujian, do you intend to request the transfer of Jiang and Yang to assist you?”
胡雪岩故意沉吟了一会；然后突如其来地问说∶『大人是不是打算到了福建，要奏调蒋杨两位去帮忙？』

Zuo was baffled.
这话问得左宗棠莫名其妙，

“I have no such intention.
立即答说∶『我并没有这样的打算。

Both have worked their way up to senior provincial office.
而且蒋杨两位，也巴结到监司大员了，

For one thing, Fujian has no suitable positions; for another, the court might not approve.
一则福建无可位置；二则，朝廷也未见得会准。

Besides, why should I clear the road for Ma Gushan, vacating two important posts so that he can bring in his own men?”
再说，我又何苦为马谷山铺路，腾出这么两个紧要缺分，好方便他援引私人？』

Hu had expected this answer, particularly the last point.
这番回答，原在胡雪岩意料之中；尤其是最后一点，

Keeping Jiang as provincial treasurer and recommending Yang Changjun as judicial commissioner was a calculated move to restrain Ma and protect Zuo’s revenue in Zhejiang.
更有关系——蒋益澧留任浙江藩司；并保杨昌为浙江阜司，原是左宗棠所下的一着『行手棋』，用来箝制马新贻，保护他在浙江的饷源，

Why would Zuo surrender that advantage?
岂肯自我退让？

Hu had asked precisely to lead the conversation toward his real purpose.
而胡雪岩所以明知故问，亦正是因话答话，好引入正题的一种手法。

“Exactly.
『这就是了！

If Jiang and Yang remain secure in their posts, it will be almost as though you still held the acting governorship.
但愿蒋杨二分，安于其位；就等于大人仍旧兼摄浙江抚篆一样。

But I fear I must offer some unwelcome advice.”
不过，大人，我有句话，只怕忠言逆耳。』

“Go ahead.
『不要紧，

There is nothing you and I cannot discuss.
你我无话不可谈。

Besides, I know it will be for my good.”
而况你必是为我打算的好话。』


“Yes, I am thinking of your interests: a small but steady stream, a firm and lasting arrangement,” Hu replied calmly. “Zhejiang’s income is not merely limited; it cannot yet be estimated with certainty.
『是，我是替大人打算；细水长流，稳扎稳打。』胡雪岩很从容地答说∶『浙江的收入不但有限，而且没有确数可以预估。

The land-tax payments have been remitted by imperial order.
地丁钱粮，已经奉旨豁免；

Salt revenue will not improve before late spring or early summer next year.
盐课收入，决要明年春末夏初，才有起色；

The rice levy depends upon neighboring provinces’ willingness to help.
米捐要看邻省肯不肯帮忙？

Only likin can be relied upon.
靠得住的，只有厘金；

As trade revives, receipts should increase, though even that depends upon the honesty of the collectors.
市面越来越兴旺，收数自然越来越多，但也要看经手人的操守。

On the expenditure side, reconstruction comes first, and the sea dikes second; both require great sums.
至于支出，第一是善后；第二是海塘，都要大把花银子。

Government offices and civil and military salaries must also be provided for, and the province must maintain some troops of its own.
大小衙门，文武官员的经费俸禄，更不能不筹；地方上总还要养些兵。

Suppose two hundred thousand taels is scraped together each month and sent first to your supply bureau, leaving the provincial treasury bare and all other work at a standstill.
大人倒想一想看，倘或每个月先凑二十万银子解粮台；藩库一清如洗，什么事都动不了，

How could Jiang Xiangquan remain treasurer?”
蒋芗泉这个藩司，怎么还当得下去？』

“Surely—” Zuo was silent for a while.
『这，』左宗棠呆了半晌，

“Surely things cannot be as difficult as you suggest?”
方始说下去∶『这也不致于如你所说的那样子艰窘吧？』

“Of course.
『当然。

I have overstated them a little.
我是说得过分了一点。

But consider Governor Ma too.
不过，大人，请你也要替马中丞想一想；

Having just risen to provincial authority, he naturally wishes to accomplish something.
人家刚刚巴结到方面大员，自然也想做番事业。

If he is hampered on every side, what can he do but press Jiang?
如果处处捉襟见肘，动弹不得；那时候怎么办？只有逼蒋芗泉；

And to press Jiang is to press you.”
逼蒋芗泉就是逼大人。』

Hu paused. “Governor Shen of Jiangxi owed his advancement entirely to Grand Secretary Zeng.
胡雪岩停了一下又说∶『从前江西沈中丞是曾中堂一手提拔的；

Yet he withheld his province’s likin revenues when he chose, and the court did not blame him for delaying the Zeng brothers’ eastern campaign.
本省的厘金说截留就截留，朝廷也不曾责备他耽误了曾家弟兄的「东征」。

Governor Ma may not be as fierce as Shen, but neither is he content merely to drift.”
马中丞为人虽不如沈中丞那样子刚烈，然而也不是肯得过且过的人。』

The example of Shen Baozhen’s rupture with Zeng put Zuo on his guard.
提到沈葆桢与曾国藩交恶的往事，左宗棠不能不起警惕之心。

No one paid closer attention to practical interests.
他是最讲究利害关系；

Considered calmly, Ma’s position was secure and offered no weakness to attack.
冷静思量，马新贻的脚步站得很稳；亦无弱点可攻，

If a dispute arose, Zuo might not prevail.
果然为此有所争执，自己不见得能占上风。

Jiang would bear the first blow; once removed from Zhejiang, how could he provide two hundred thousand a month?
而且一闹开来，蒋益澧首当其冲；他一调离了浙江，每月又何有二十万银子可得？

With this thought, Zuo asked in a more even temper, “Then what do you advise, Xueyan?”
转念以此，便心平气和地问道∶『那末，雪岩，你说呢？我该怎么办？』


“The amount must be reduced,” Hu answered directly.
胡雪岩率直答道∶『只有减个数目。』

“By how much?”
『减多少呢？』

“I dare not fix a figure.
左宗棠问。『这我就不敢说了。』

You must ask the officers and men to bear some hardship for the present.
左宗棠答道，『惟有请大人交代下去，官兵弟兄先委屈些，

Once matters improve, they can be compensated.”
只要局面一好转，必然补报。』

“Very well.”
『好！』

Zuo nodded.
左宗棠点点头，

“I too cannot bear to overburden Zhejiang.
『我也不忍太累浙江；

As you suggest, I shall have the supply bureau recalculate and reduce the sum as far as possible.
就照你的意思，让粮台重新核算，减到减无可减为止。

But you know my position.
不过，雪岩，我的处境你是知道的，

I have always been isolated and unsupported.
一直孤立无援；

I must open a way forward.”
总要打开一条出路才好。』

“Yes,” Hu answered without expression.
『是！』胡雪岩毫无表情地应声。

“You must help me greatly.
『你要大大地帮我的忙！』

How do you think I should find that way?”
左宗棠问道，『你看，我的出路该怎么打？』

“Have you not already decided, my lord?”
『大人不是已有成算了吗？』

He meant the plan to gain control of Guangdong.
那是指谋取广东而言。

Zuo frowned slightly. “Removing Guo is not difficult.
左宗棠微微皱着眉说∶『驱郭不难；

The question is who can replace him.
难在执可取代？

Xiangquan still lacks the standing for a governorship.
芗泉的资望，当方面之任，总嫌不足。

If my recommendation is rejected, I shall find it hard to speak again.
万一碰个钉子，我以后就难说话了。

The consequences are serious.
这一层关系很大，

I cannot act rashly before I am sure.
没有把握以前，我不便贸然动手。

Yet I cannot tell Xiangquan this.”
然而，这话又不能向芗泉透露。』

Hu listened closely, searching beneath the words.
胡雪岩很用心地听着；细细体会，辩出味外之味，

If Jiang wanted Guangdong, he would need another source of support.
蒋益澧如果想当广东巡抚，不得另外去找一份助力。

In other words, if influential patrons at court could ensure that the recommendation would succeed, Zuo would gladly submit it.
这也就是说，只要朝中有奥援，保证左宗棠将来举荐时不会驳回；他是乐于出奏的。


Hu then asked himself whether he should help Jiang and whether he could.
想到这里，便又自问∶是不是该帮帮蒋益澧的忙？这个忙帮得上帮不上？

The first question required little thought: Jiang’s promotion to Guangdong would bring great public and private advantages.
前者无须多作考虑；能让蒋益澧调升广东巡抚，于公于私都大有好处。

As for whether help was possible, it was too early to say.
至于帮得上忙、帮不上忙？此时言之过早；

Much depended upon effort; if he did his utmost, there was hope.
反正事在人为，只要尽力，就有希望。

“You are a pillar of the court, my lord, and have always enjoyed great imperial favor,” he said.
想停当随即说道∶『大人是朝廷柱石，圣眷一直优隆。

“In Shanghai I heard from people newly arrived from Beijing that Prince Gong values you highly, and Prince Chun admires you still more.
我在上海听京里的人说起，恭王很看重大人；醇王尤其佩服。

Grand Secretary Zeng was allowed to recommend governors for provinces within his military command.
想当初，曾中堂可以保他督办军务有关省份的巡抚；

Why should you not have the same right?
如今大人又为什么不可以？

As for Xiangquan’s standing, promotion from Treasurer of Zhejiang to Governor of Guangdong would be no extraordinary leap.
至于说到芗泉的资望，由浙藩升粤抚，亦不算躐等；

Governor Ma is an example ready to hand.
马中丞不就是个现成的例子？

Guangdong is different because its maritime customs revenues are closely connected with the Imperial Household Department.
当然，广东因为粤海关的收入与内务府很有关系，情形与他省不同；

Still, if someone in Beijing looks after the matter, there is hope.”
但是，只要京里有人照应，亦不是没有希望的事。』

“Exactly—someone in Beijing must look after it.
『就是这话罗，要京里有人照应！

Xiangquan is at a disadvantage there.”
芗泉在这一层上头，比较吃亏。』

“It is not too late to begin tending those neglected fires.”
『就眼前烧起冷灶来，也还不晚。』

Zuo looked at him intently, pondered for some time, then finally said, “You might discuss it with Xiangquan.”
左宗棠深看了他一眼；沉吟又沉吟，终于说了一句∶『你不妨与芗泉谈谈！』

“Yes.”
『是！』


“He must rely on you,” Zuo continued.
『他的事要靠你。』左宗棠又说，

“And I can do without you even less.
『我更少你不得。

You command no troops for me and run no supply bureau, yet your work is more important than either.
你在我这里，既不带兵，又不管粮台；可是比带兵管粮台更要紧。

Once I leave, you must set out promptly and remain in Shanghai.
雪岩，等我一走，你也要赶紧动身，长驻上海；

If the supply bureau falls short—whether of pay, grain, or military equipment—you alone will be my resource.”
粮台接济不上，要饷要粮要军装，我就只靠你一个人了！』

The responsibility weighed heavily upon Hu, but he could show no hesitation.
这份责任太重，胡雪岩顿感双肩吃力；可是说什么也不能有所犹豫，

He braced himself. “Yes, my lord.
便硬着头皮答一声∶『是！

You may be at ease.”
大人请放心！』

“With that assurance, I truly can.” Zuo breathed out, then asked, “What would you like me to do for you?
『有你这句话，我真的可以放心了。』左宗棠舒了口气；然后问道∶『你有什么事，要我替你办的？

I intend to leave at the end of the month; there is still half a month.
我预备月底动身；还有半个月的功夫。

If you want anything, tell me early.”
有话你趁早说。』

Hu had already considered this.
胡雪岩早就想过了，

After Zuo left, Jiang would hold the acting governor’s seal and could still be consulted; yet a request to Zuo would be more direct and effective.
左宗棠一走，虽是蒋益澧护理巡抚的大印，有事仍旧可以商量得通；然而究竟不如托左宗棠来得简捷有力。

During their half-year together, Hu had asked no favor.
这半年的相处，自己从无一事求他；

He must not miss the opportunity now, especially when Zuo himself had invited him to speak.
如今却不能再错过机会了。更何况是他先开口相问；

Further silence would seem affected and false, and would hardly be wise.
倘再不言，反显得矫饰虚伪，未免太不聪明。


He decided to speak freely, first retreating a little in order to advance.
有此了解，便决定『畅所欲言』；先使个以退为进的手法，

“There are many things I wish to ask, but I fear you may find them tiresome.”
『想求大人的事情很多，』他说，『又怕大人厌烦，不敢多说。』

“Not at all!”
『不要紧，不要紧！』

Zuo waved both hands.
左宗棠连连摆手，

“I am always asking you for help and owe you many favors.
『一向都是我托你，欠你的情很多；

Speak.”
你尽管说。』

“First, the former Governor Wang died so tragically.
『是！』胡雪岩说∶『第一件，从前的王中丞，死得太惨。

You upheld justice, investigated what had happened, and reported the facts to the throne.
当时蒙大人主持公道，查明经过，查明参奏。

But the case is not finished.
不过这一案还没有了，

I should like you to see it through.”
想请大人始终成全。』

“Oh?”
『喔，』

More than two years had passed, and Zuo’s recollection was vague.
左宗棠有些茫然；因为事隔两年有余，记忆不清，

“In what way is it unfinished?”
只好问说∶『这一案怎么没有了？』


“I mean your memorial in the fourth month of the first Tongzhi year, reporting the inquiry into Wang Lüqian’s obstruction and failures—” “Ah!”
『就是同治元年四月里，大人所奏的「讯明王履谦贻误情形」那一案——』『啊，』

Reminded, Zuo said, “Wait a moment.”
左宗棠被提醒了，『你等一下。』

He lifted his riding jacket and took a key from his belt.
他欣开马褂，从腰带上去取钥匙——

Keys signified authority.
钥匙表示权威，

In institutions as great as the Shenji Camp or the Imperial Household Department, to be designated keeper of the keys meant being entrusted with leadership.
大而至于『神机营』、『内务府』，被指定为『蒙明』，即表示赋予首脑之任；

In a wealthy household, a steward—or Wang Xifeng in Dream of the Red Chamber—likewise displayed practical power by holding the keys.
小而至于一家大户人家的管家——或者象红楼梦中的王熙凤，都以掌管钥匙为实权在握的鲜明表示。

A key was small, however, insufficiently imposing to proclaim such authority.
只是钥匙甚小，不瞳以显示其权威的地位，

Hence the additions: usually quantity made the impression.
所以多加上些附丽之物；通常都是『以多取胜』，

Useless keys were tied together, sometimes threaded on a large iron ring that clattered in the hand.
弄些根本无用的钥匙拴在一起；甚至弄个大铁环串连，拎在手里『蒋朗蒋朗』地响，

The intention resembled a jailer’s: shake the bunch, and every prisoner would submit.
仿佛『牢头禁子』的用心，只要拎着那串钥匙一抖动，就足以慑服群囚。

Yet the truly weighty key was often a single one.
可是，真正能见钥匙之重的，却往往只有一枚，

Zuo had only one, threaded on a silk cord at his belt.
左宗棠亦是如此，他只有一枚钥匙，用根丝绳子穿起，挂在腰带上；

Pulling it out, he leaned toward a book chest, unlocked it, and removed a thick stack of red booklets.
此时往外一拉，以身相就，凑近一个书箱，打开来取出一大叠红簿册；

From a distance Hu could read the large characters on their covers: “Copies of Memorials.”
胡雪岩遥遥望去，只见上面写着四个大字∶『奏稿留底』。

Zuo found the booklet for the fourth month of the first Tongzhi year, put on his smoky-crystal reading spectacles, and studied it before asking, “What remains unsettled, Xueyan?”
检到同治元年四月的那一本，左宗棠戴上墨晶老花眼镜细看了一遍，方始发问∶『雪岩，你说此案未了；未了的是什么？』


“If you look at the reply received then, my lord, you will see.”
『请大人再检当时的批回；就知道了。』

The reply could not readily be found.
批回一时无从检取，

“You must know what it said.
左宗棠答说∶『想来你总清楚，

Tell me.”
说给我听吧！』

“Yes.”
『是！』

Hu now felt awkward.
胡雪岩倒有些为难了。


When Wang Youling had held Hangzhou through the siege, his principal source of funds had been Shaoxing.
因为当王有龄苦守杭州时，主要的饷源是在绍兴；

Wang Lüqian, the militia commissioner residing there, had been uncooperative.
而在籍团练大臣王履谦，却不甚合作。

Unscrupulous local gentry, skilled with their pens, surrounded him and portrayed the governor’s demands for military funds as callous extortion for private gain.
同时绍兴有些擅于刀笔的劣绅，包围王履谦，视王有龄以一省大吏征饷为不恤民困，勒索自肥，

Officials and people had almost imperceptibly become enemies.
无形中官民之间竟成了敌对的局面。

This made the position of Prefect Liao Zongyuan extremely difficult.
因此，绍兴府知府廖宗元的处境极其困难；

When the rebels advanced from Xiaoshan toward Shaoxing, imperial gunboats actually clashed with the local militia.
当长毛由萧山往绍兴进攻时，官军的炮船与团练竟发生了冲突。

Badly outnumbered, Liao’s bodyguards lost twelve men, and he himself suffered a head wound.
兵力悬殊，寡不敌众，廖宗元的亲兵被杀了十二个；廖宗元本人亦被打破了头。

Wang Lüqian should have intervened and restored order, but stood aside.
这本来是应该由王履谦去弹压排解的，而居然袖手旁观。

Soon Shaoxing fell and Liao died at his post.
不久，绍兴沦陷；廖宗元殉难；

Wang Lüqian had already fled to Ningbo and escaped by sea to Fujian.
而王履谦则先期逃到宁波，出海避难在福建。

The needless loss of Shaoxing, together with Wang’s constant obstruction and disregard of the larger cause, filled Governor Wang with bitter hatred.
绍兴不该失而失，以及王履谦的处处掣肘，不顾大局，使王有龄深恶痛绝，

In his blood-written letter from the doomed city, he said that he could not “close his eyes in death.”
在危城中寄出来的血书，表示『死不瞑目』。

Hu too had never forgotten and wished to avenge him.
胡雪岩亦就因为如此，耿耿于怀，一直想为王有龄报仇雪恨。


Even without Hu’s intervention, of course, the court would have investigated responsibility for Hangzhou’s fall and would not let Wang Lüqian escape punishment.
当然，就是胡雪岩不作此想，朝廷亦会追究杭州沦陷的责任，不容王履谦逍遥法外。

In the spring of the following year, the first Tongzhi year, Qingrui, Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang, was ordered to arrest Wang and send him to Quzhou for interrogation by the new Zhejiang governor, Zuo.
第二年——同治元年春天，闽浙总督庆瑞奉旨逮捕王履谦，解送衢州的新任浙江巡抚左宗棠审问，

Zuo recommended penal military exile to Xinjiang; the throne approved, giving some satisfaction to Governor Wang’s memory.
复奏定拟了充军新疆的罪名。朝旨准如所请，算是为王有龄出了一口气。

But the chief offender in the affair was Zhang Cunhao, a wealthy Shaoxing gentleman.
可是这一案中，首恶是绍兴的富绅张存浩，

He had led the false accusations that Liao’s gunboats were in league with the rebels, the killing of the guards, and the assault on the prefect.
诬赖廖宗元所带的炮船通贼，以及杀亲兵、打知府，都是他带的头。

Zuo’s memorial stated that Zhang and the others, enraged by Liao’s urgent demands for contributions, had acted from private resentment and committed unforgivable offenses.
左宗棠在复奏中说，『张存浩等因廖宗元催捐严紧，挟忿怀私，胆敢做出那些不法之事，罪不容赦。

Once Shaoxing was recovered, they should be arrested and punished to the full extent of the law.
应俟收复绍兴府后，严拿到案，尽法惩处。』

Now not merely Shaoxing but all Zhejiang had been cleared.
如今不但绍兴早已光复，而且全浙亦已肃清。

Yet no arrest had followed.
可是严拿张存浩到案一节，却无下文。

That was what Hu meant by the unfinished case.
胡雪岩所说的『这一案未了』，即是指此而言。


His present difficulty arose from a sudden reluctance to be harsh.
而此刻他的为难，却是一念不忍。

Amid the disorders of the age, who had failed whom, and who owed what to whom?
论到乱世中人与人的关系，谁负了谁，谁怎么亏欠谁？

Such questions were never simple.
本就是难说的一件事。

Years had passed, and everyone had survived a great catastrophe.
事隔数年，而彼此又都是大劫余生；

Perhaps they ought now to be calmer and more forgiving.
似乎应该心平气和，看开一步了。

Zuo could not guess this change of heart.
他这临时改变的心意，左宗棠当然不会猜得到；

“We have many matters to discuss,” he urged.
便催问着说∶『既然你我的事很多，

“Take them one by one, quickly.
就一件一件快说吧！

We must not waste time.”
不要耽误功夫。』

Hu had to tell the truth.
这一下他不能不说实话了。

As he spoke, another thought occurred to him.
口中谈着，心中又涌现了新的主意；

After explaining his original intention, he added, “You might show mercy and spare Zhang Cunhao, but he should not get off too easily.
所以在谈完原来的想法以后，接着又说∶『张存浩虽可以请大人宽恩饶他，可也不能太便宜他。

Let him make amends through some useful service.
我在想，他也应该将功赎罪；

Could he be required to contribute to a public undertaking?”
罚他为地方上做些公益。大人看，是不是可行？』

“Certainly.
『当然可行。』

What are his means?”
左宗棠问道∶『此人家道如何？』

“He was wealthy before, and I hear he is still comfortably off.”
『从前是富绅；现在的情况，听说也不坏。』

“Then I shall tell Xiangquan to instruct the Shaoxing prefect to summon him and require a contribution proportionate to his means for some local work of merit.”
『那好！我来告诉芗泉，转知绍兴府，传他到案；责令他量力捐款，为地方上做件功德之事。』

“That will satisfy both public justice and private feeling.
『能这样，于公于私都过得去了。

As for those loyal men who died during the two disasters, the Reconstruction Bureau is collecting their histories and reporting them in turn.
至于两次殉难的忠臣义士，善后局采访事迹，陆续禀报；

I hope you will memorialize promptly, to comfort the dead.”
亦要请大人早日出奏，安慰死者。』

“Naturally.
『当然。

I shall attend to that before leaving.
这件事我在动身以前，亦是要做好的。』

Now tell me the second matter.”
左宗棠又说∶『你再讲第二件。』


The second was important in both public and private affairs.
第二件是公私牵连，彼此有关的大事，

Since Ma’s appointment had begun to change Zhejiang’s political arrangements, Hu had wished to stop acting as banker to the provincial treasury.
胡雪岩从马新贻的新命下达，浙江政局开始变动之初，就希望不再代理藩库；

Jiang would not release him.
无奈蒋益澧不肯放他，

At the slightest mention, he clasped his hands repeatedly and begged Hu to “continue helping.”
略一提到，便连连拱手，要求『继续帮忙』。

Hu valued personal feeling too much to refuse and had reluctantly carried on.
胡雪岩最重情面，不能不勉为其难。

“Things are different now,” he said, after explaining.
『如今不同了。』胡雪岩谈过前半段的衷曲，

“You have ordered me to remain in Shanghai.
接着又说∶『大人命我长驻上海，

If grain, money, or arms are urgently needed, I alone must answer.
要粮要饷要军械，缓急之际，惟我是问；

The responsibility is too great for me to continue serving Zhejiang’s treasury as well.”
这个责任太重，没有余力再为浙江藩库效劳了。』

By “serving,” he meant finding advances whenever receipts failed to cover immediate needs.
所谓『效劳』，就是青黄不接之际，得要设法垫款。

Zuo understood, but saw it differently.
左宗棠当然明白他的意思；但却有不同的看法，

“Zhejiang’s treasury is to remit a hundred and forty thousand taels to me each month through your bank.
『雪岩，浙江藩库每个月要拨我十四万协饷，由你的钱庄转汇粮台。

If you remain its banker, it will be merely a transfer from your left hand to your right.
照这样子，你代理浙江藩库，等于左手交付右手，

It costs no trouble.
并不费事；

Why refuse so firmly?
何必坚拒呢？』

In my view, your continuing in that role can only benefit me.
他停了一下又说，『依我看，你代理浙江藩库，对我有利无害；

Whenever funds arrive, they can be remitted.
有款子收入，随时可以拨解。

If the front urgently needs money, you can arrange it more easily.”
如果前方有急用，你调度也方便。』

“No,” Hu replied.
『不！』胡雪岩说，

“First, once I have been transferred at your request for service in Fujian, it is improper for me to continue acting for Zhejiang’s treasury.
『第一，我既蒙大人奏调，归福建任用，就不便再代理浙江的藩库；

Second, precisely because I am managing your supplies, I must keep my dealings with Zhejiang clearly separate.
其次，惟其管了大人这方面的供应，我要跟浙江划分得清清楚楚。

If someone raises objections later, your reputation will not be involved.”
万一将来有人说闲话，也不致于牵涉到大人的名誉。』

“I am deeply obliged.
『承情之至！

You think of my interests at every turn.
你真是处处为我打算。

Since you insist, I shall tell Xiangquan.”
既然你一定坚持，我关照芗泉就是。』


The promise lifted a weight from Hu.
得此一诺，胡雪岩如释重负。

He alone saw the entire situation clearly.
因为整个情况，只有他看得最清楚；

Although the contribution for Fujian had been reduced by sixty thousand taels, the remaining sum was still an immense burden.
援闽之师的协饷虽已减去六万，对浙江来说，仍然极重的负担。

The new governor would naturally have plans of his own.
新任巡抚莅任后，自必有一番新猷展布，

Even if he could not restore everything at once, the sea dikes alone required a large expenditure.
纵汉有百废俱举，光是整修海塘，便须一笔极大的经费。

Frost’s Descent had already passed, the season when river officials reported that the waters were safely under control.
眼前霜降已过，河工是『报安澜』的时候；

At the beginning of the new year, however, work must start immediately.
一开了年，可就要立刻动手了！

From the spring “peach-blossom flood” onward, rising waters at the turn of spring and summer might bring catastrophe.
不然从『桃花汛』开始，春夏之交，洪水大涨，可能招致巨祸。

Would it be easy to act as banker to the treasury then?
那时藩库，岂是容易代理的？

Hu could plead inability to advance the cost of the dikes.
当然，海塘经费他可以表示无力代垫；

But if Ma said, “Then let Intendant Hu’s bank advance the contribution to Fujian,” could he refuse, on either public or private grounds?
但如马新贻说一句∶『那末福建的协饷请胡道台的钱庄垫一垫』；不论于公于仅，他总是义不容辞的吧？

In truth, even after relinquishing the treasury business he would still have to advance funds for Zuo.
事实确是如此，而且即使不代理浙江藩库，他亦仍得为左宗棠垫款。

The difference lay in how the transaction was understood.
只是同为一垫，说法不同。

As the treasury’s banker, he would be expected by Zhejiang to find the money.
在浙江来说，既是代理藩库，理当设法代垫；

Zuo, meanwhile, would regard it as an advance for Zhejiang and owe him no gratitude.
在左宗棠来说，胡雪岩是为浙江垫款，他不必见情。

Hu would please neither side.
这一来落得两头不讨好。

If instead Zhejiang, unable to remit, privately asked him for an advance, his action would be a public-spirited favor: Ma would be grateful, and Zuo would acknowledge his friendship.
倘或浙江解不出协饷，跟他情商代垫，那是私人急公好义；马新贻会感激，左宗棠亦会说他够朋友。

Most importantly, a formal loan from his bank to the provincial treasury would carry security and interest, leaving him no risk to bear.
而最要紧的是，浙江藩库向他的钱庄借款，有担保、有利息，不会担什么风险。

“What else is there?” Zuo asked.
『还有什么事？

“You might as well tell me everything now.”
你索性此刻都说了吧？』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第九章（本章第6部分，共7部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“I shall trouble you no further,” Hu said with a smile.
『不敢再麻烦大人了。』胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地说，

“The rest are small matters I can manage myself.”
『其余都是些小事，我自己料理得下来。』

Yet he had an enormous amount of public business in hand.
话虽如此，胡雪岩经管的公事太多；

Besides the bank, his own interests included silk and tea, and there were innumerable favors undertaken for others.
自己的生意，除钱庄以外，还有丝茶；加上受人之托，有许多闲事不能不管。

With the political arrangements changing and Zuo’s new responsibilities requiring him to remain in Shanghai, he had to settle his public and private affairs in Zhejiang during the interval between Zuo’s departure and Ma’s arrival.
如今政局变动，又受左宗棠的重托，要长驻上海；在浙江的公私事务，必得趁左宗棠离浙，马新贻未到任这段期间内，作个妥善的安排。

He became so busy that meals and sleep lost all regularity.
因而忙得饮食不时，起居失常，

He wished for another mouth and another pair of hands.
恨不得多生一张口，多长一双手，才能应付得下来。

Even amid this pressure, Zuo frequently summoned him.
在这百忙里，左宗棠还是时常约见，

One day a personal letter arrived, inviting him to visit West Lake the following morning.
有一天甚至来封亲笔信，约他第二天上午逛西湖；

Hu scarcely knew whether to laugh or cry, but could not refuse.
这下，胡雪岩可真有些啼笑皆非了！但亦不能不践约；

He stayed awake all night to finish several long-delayed and urgent matters originally scheduled for the next morning.
只好通宵不睡，将积压已久，不能不办理，原来预定在第二天上午必须了结的几件紧要事务，提前处理。

Just before dawn he dozed in his clothes.
到曙色将透之时，和衣打个盹；

Soon he woke with a start to find bright sunlight filling the windows.
睡不多久，一惊而醒，但见是个红日满窗的好天气，

He hurriedly washed, dressed, and took his chair toward the lake.
急急漱洗更衣，坐上轿子飞快地直奔西湖，来赴左宗棠的约会。

Passing the ruined Banner garrison, he noticed unusually large numbers of people walking north along the shore.
轿子抬过残破的『旗营』，西湖在望；胡雪岩忽然发现沿湖滨往北的行人特别多。

He sent an attendant to inquire and learned that they were going to see a “Western steamer.”
当时唤跟班去打听；才知道都是去看『西洋火轮船』的。

Then he understood.
胡雪岩恍然大悟，

Zuo had not invited him for a leisurely excursion but to witness the trial of a small steam vessel.
并非有逛西湖的闲情逸致；只是约他一齐去看小火轮试航——

Hu knew about the undertaking: as early as summer, Zuo had told him that suitable mechanics had been found to attempt its construction.
这件事胡雪岩当然也知道。早在夏天，就听左宗棠告诉过他，已觅妥机匠，试造火轮。

Too busy to ask further, Hu had not imagined that in three or four months they would actually produce a vessel of their own.
他因为太忙，不暇过问；不想三、四个月的功夫，居然有了一艘自己制造的小火轮。

This was momentous.
这是一件大事！


If they could build a small steamer, they could build a large one.
能造小轮船、就能造大轮船；

Hu’s mind ranged quickly over the many advantages China would gain from possessing large steamships.
胡雪岩的思路很宽也很快，立刻便想到了中国有大轮船的许多好处。

He became so absorbed that only the chair’s stopping roused him.
越想越深，想得出了神；直到停轿才警觉。

He stepped out before Zhaoqing Temple, one of West Lake’s four great monasteries.
下轿一看，是在西湖四大名刹之一的昭庆寺前。

A pavilion of canvas stood by the water.
湖滨一座篷帐；

Outside it, rank buttons and feathers glittered, and swords flashed like snow.
帐外翎顶辉煌，刀光如雪；

Most striking were several foreigners among the crowd.
最触目的是夹杂着几名洋人，

One wore Western clothes; another wore the uniform of a third-rank Chinese military officer, with an artificial queue attached behind his hat.
其中一个穿西装；一个穿着三品武官服色，大帽子后面，还缀着一条假辫子。

Hu knew them well.
胡雪岩跟他们很熟，

Both were French: Giquel had left military for civil employment and been appointed commissioner of the Ningbo New Customs, hence his civilian dress; d’Aiguebelle had been recommended for the rank of canjiang for military service and willingly adopted Chinese dress to signify allegiance.
这两个洋将都是法国人，一个叫日意格，已改武就文，被委充为宁波新关的税务局，所以换穿便服；另一个叫德克碑，因军功保到参将，愿易服色，以示归顺，

Zuo valued him highly.
颇为左宗棠所器重。

On the lake, a small steamer lay secured by a very thick cable, its fire already lit.
看到湖中，极粗的缆绳系着一条小火轮，已经升火待发。

Hu joined the inspection.
胡雪岩亦随众参观，

While explanations and pointing fingers occupied the group, Zuo emerged from the tent, passed slowly between the civil and military officials standing at attention, halted at the shore, and called loudly, “Ask Lord Hu to come!”
正在指点讲解时，左宗棠已经出帐；在文武官员肃立站班的行列中，缓缓穿过，直到湖边站定，喊一大声∶『请胡大人！』


Hu came forward, saluted, and first apologized for not arriving earlier.
胡雪岩被唤了过去，行完礼，首先道歉∶『没有早来伺候。』

Then he smiled. “Grand Secretary Zeng and Governor Li both concern themselves with foreign methods and powerful arms.
又笑着说∶『曾中堂李中丞都讲究洋务，讲究坚甲利兵，

Now they will have to fall behind you.”
现在都要落在大人后头了。』

The compliment delighted Zuo.
这句话恭维得左宗棠心花大开，

Stroking his short, graying beard, he nodded. “That is just what I want them to see!
『我就是要他们看看！』他摸着花白短髭点头，

I particularly asked you here because only you understand my intention.”
『所以我特意要请你来看，只有你懂得我的用意。』

Hu dared not pursue the subject.
胡雪岩不敢再接口，

A passing compliment was harmless, but he did not know what deeper purpose Zuo had in mind, and understood little of the matter himself.
因为随口恭维，无甚关系。一往深处去谈，不知道左宗棠到底有什么主意；而且他自己对此道亦还不甚了解，

Better to conceal his ignorance for the moment.
不如暂且藏拙为妙。

Fortunately, this was a time for watching rather than discussion.
好在此刻亦不是深谈的时候；主要的是要看。

At a command, the crudely built little vessel began to chug, churning a great patch of water astern.
一声令下，那条形式简陋的小火轮，发出『卜卜卜』的响声，激起船尾好大一片水花；

Its engine faltered and resumed like the coughing of a feeble old man, struggling for breath.
但机器声时断时续，就象衰迈的老年人咳嗽那样，有些上气不接下气的模样。

At least ten thousand officials, soldiers, and ordinary people watched from the shore in anxious silence.
这时在湖边屏息注视的官员、士兵、百姓，不下上万之多；

The vessel made noise but did not move; everyone feared it would fail.
都为那条只响不动的小火轮捏把汗，惟恐它动不了，

The four mechanics responsible, drenched in sweat, kept climbing in and out of the engine compartment.
四名负责制造的机器匠，更是满头大汗，不断地在舱中钻进钻出；

At last the sound grew stronger and steadier.
忙了好半天，终于听得机器声音响亮了起来，而节奏匀净。

The vessel suddenly surged forward.
然后蓦地往前一冲；

“Thank Heaven, it is moving!” Hu exclaimed involuntarily.
胡雪岩情不自禁地说了句∶『谢天谢地，动了！』

Moving it was, but scarcely at any speed: it staggered along, barely making headway.
动是动了，却走不快；蹒蹒跚跚，勉强推动而已。

In about half an hour it completed a circuit of the lake and returned.
费了有两刻钟的功夫，在湖面上兜了个圈子，驶回原处。

The expectant prefect responsible for the work brought the mechanics, now wearing red-tasseled hats, to report.
承办的一名候补知府，领着戴了红缨帽的机器匠来交差；

Zuo’s face was grave, but he nevertheless ordered twenty taels for each man.
脸色很深沉的左宗棠，仍旧吩咐，赏机器匠每人二十两银子。


Seeing his dissatisfaction, the onlookers lost their enthusiasm.
大家看左宗棠不甚满意，都觉得意兴阑珊；

Hu felt the same.
胡雪岩也是如此。

After standing in the ranks to see Zuo depart, he hurried back to his business in the city.
站班送走了左宗棠，急急赶回城去忙自己的公私事务。

Yet at dusk another bodyguard arrived with Zuo’s card: “The commander will not dine until Lord Hu arrives.”
那知到得傍晚，左宗棠又派了戈什哈持着名片来请，说的是『大帅要等胡大人到了才开饭。』

At headquarters Hu was surprised to find both foreign advisers present, with an interpreter named Cai.
到了行辕，很意外地发现两位客卿都在，此外就是一个姓蔡的通事。

He greeted Zuo, exchanged bows with d’Aiguebelle and Giquel, and went in to dinner.
胡雪岩先见左宗棠；然后与德克碑、日意格行礼，彼此一揖，相将入席。

Though host, Zuo took the highest seat, the two Frenchmen on either side; Hu sat below them.
左宗棠虽是主人，仍居首座，左右两洋将，胡雪岩下首相陪；

Interpreter Cai, like a bodyguard, could only stand behind Zuo.
蔡通事就跟戈什哈一样，只有站立在左宗棠身后的分儿了。

“For foreign methods, we must consult foreigners,” Zuo told Hu. “I asked Commander d’Aiguebelle and Commissioner Giquel to inspect the vessel.
『办洋务要请教洋人。』左宗棠对胡雪岩说∶『我请德参将与日税务司下船看过，

They say the copied design is broadly sound, and that making the engine work at all is a considerable achievement.
说仿制的式样，大致不差，机器能够管用，就很难为他们。

But speed requires Western machinery.
不过，要走得快，得用西洋的轮机。

The commander happens to have a book of shipbuilding drawings.
德参将正好有本制船的图册，

You should look at it.”
你不妨看看。

“Yes.” Hu ventured a question. “Your intention, my lord, is—?”
『』是！『胡雪岩试探着问∶』大人的意思是——？

“First hear what they say.”
『』你先听听他们的说法。

Without answering directly, Zuo turned slightly and instructed Cai, “Ask whether they can hire foreign mechanics for me. I wish to manufacture marine engines.”
『左宗棠答非所问；然后略略回头，嘱咐蔡通事∶』你问他们，我想造轮船机器，他们能不能代雇洋匠？

Cai translated into French.
『于是蔡通事用法语传译。

Both men answered eagerly, one after the other, speaking rapidly with rolling tongues.
德克碑与日意格立即作答，一个讲过一另一个讲；舌头打卷，既快且急，显得十分起劲。

“They say they can do more than hire mechanics,” Cai reported.
『回大帅的话，』蔡通事说道∶『德参将与日税务司说，不但可以代雇洋匠，

“They would also procure materials, establish a yard, and supervise construction.
而且愿意代办材料，设厂监造。

Now that fighting in Zhejiang is finished, Commander d’Aiguebelle intends to leave military service and return to France. If you wish, he will devote himself to arranging this.”
如果大人有意，现在全浙军务告竣；德参将打算退伍回国，专门为大人奔走这件事。』

“Ah.”
『喔！』

Zuo nodded and gave Hu a penetrating look.
左宗棠点点头，向胡雪岩深深看了一眼。


Hu understood and put a succession of questions to the two guests, concentrating upon expense.
胡雪岩会意，随即向两位洋客提出一连串的问询；最着重的是经费。

They knew only approximate figures and could not answer everything.
德克碑与日意格亦只知大概，并不能有问必答。

Yet they followed the old Chinese maxim: acknowledge what you know, and acknowledge what you do not.
不过洋人倒是守着中国『知之为知之，不知为不知』的古训，

They offered no evasive guesses.
决不模棱两可地敷衍。

Hu could therefore use the reliable figures they supplied, drawing comparisons and deductions, to arrive at a general estimate.
因此以胡雪岩的头脑，根据已知的确实数字，引伸推比，亦能获知全盘的概算。

Dinner lasted until the first watch.
这一顿饭吃到起更方散。

After seeing the foreigners off, Zuo kept Hu behind and invited him into his private office.
左宗棠送走洋客，留下胡雪岩，邀到签押房里坐定，

Once seated, he said at once, “Xueyan, I want to build steam warships ourselves.”
第一句话就说∶『雪岩，我想自己造兵轮。』

Hu was startled.
胡雪岩吓一跳，

“That is no easy matter.
『这谈何容易？』

A shipyard would cost at least five hundred thousand taels.
他说，『造一个船厂，没有五十万银子下不来；

Each warship would cost two or three hundred thousand—and one cannot build a yard for a single ship.
造一条兵轮总也得二三十万银子——也不能为造一条兵轮设个船厂；

Say only ten: that is two or three million.
不说多，算造十条，就是两三百万。

Fujian and Zhejiang, even with Liangjiang added, may not have the means.”
闽浙两省，加上两江，也未见得有这个力量。』

“True.
『不错！

But do not be hasty.
不过，你不要急；

Hear me out, and you will see that my plan is not only practicable but necessary.”
等我说完，你就知道我的打算不但办得通，而且非如此打算不可。

Zuo looked about him with satisfaction.
雪岩，』左宗棠顾盼自喜地说，

“Li Shaoquan’s knowledge comes from experience gained in these last few years.
『李少荃的学问，是从阅历中来的，不过这几年的事；

He entered the Hanlin Academy merely because he knew the Book of Songs well.
他点翰林，不过靠一部诗经熟。

When I began serious study, he probably could not yet finish an essay.
我做学问的时候，只怕他文章 还没有完篇。

As for great warships upon the open ocean, I began studying them in the nineteenth year of Daoguang—” In that year Lin Zexu destroyed opium in Guangdong, British warships entered Chinese waters, and the Opium War broke out.
说到汪洋大海中的艨艟巨舶，我从道光十九年起，就下过功夫——。』这年林则徐在广东查毁鸦片，英国军舰犯境，爆发了鸦片战争；

Tao Shu also died that year while Governor-General of Liangjiang.
也就是这一年，陶澍病殁在两江总督任上，

Zuo moved into the Tao household to look after its affairs and gained access to the books left at Yinxin Stone House.
左宗棠迁居陶家，代为照料一切，得能遍读印心石屋的遗书，

Histories, biographies, miscellaneous records, and tales from the Tang and Song onward, together with Qing chronicles and public and private documents—anything touching upon maritime lands—he read them all.
凡唐宋以来，史传、别录、小说；以及入清以后的志乘、载记、官私文书凡是有关海国故事的，无不涉猎。

Great ships on the ocean were therefore no wholly unfamiliar subject to him.
所以谈到『汪洋大海中的艨艟巨舶』，他不算全然外行。


“Modern foreign steam warships have no precedent in antiquity,” Zuo continued.
『如今洋人的火轮兵船，于古无征；

“But principles can be extended from one case to another.
不过举一反三，道理是一样的。

Ocean-going ships cannot be used in rivers without running aground.
海船不可行于江河，不然必致搁浅。

The absurd thing is that our distinguished officials fail to understand even so simple a point and let foreigners play them in the palms of their hands.
可笑的是，衮衮诸公，连这点浅近的道理都不懂，以致为洋人玩弄于股掌之上！

Li Shaoquan’s knowledge of foreign affairs is really limited.”
说起来，李少荃的洋务，懂得实在也有限。』

Hu could make nothing of this sudden declaration.
这番话在胡雪岩听来，没头没脑，无从捉摸；

They were now familiar enough to dispense with ceremony, so he asked plainly, “Which affair do you mean?”
他跟左宗棠的关系，已到熟不拘礼的程度，当即老实问道∶『大人指的是哪件事？』

“The purchase of warships from Britain at the end of the Xianfeng reign, of course.”
『不就是咸丰末年跟英国买兵轮那件事吗？』

“Oh, I remember.
『喔，我想起来了，是有那么一回事。

Hangzhou was under siege then.
当时杭州被围；

After it fell, I was seriously ill in Ningbo and cut off from everything.
后来杭州失守，我在宁波生一场大病，一切都隔膜了；

I knew there was such a purchase, but nothing of its history.”
只知有这样一件事，对来龙去脉，完全不清楚。』

“I know it well.
『我很清楚。

I have read all the memorials and can give you the outline.
这重公案的始末经过，我细看过全部奏折，可以约略跟你说个大概。

The Englishmen Lay and Hart were manipulating matters.
是英国人李泰国与赫德捣鬼，

Britain was to procure three medium-sized steamers and four small ones, at an agreed price of six hundred thousand taels.
英国代办中号火轮三只，小号火轮四只，船价讲定六十万银子，

Lay took it upon himself to increase the amount again and again, until it reached one million seventy thousand.
李泰国擅作主张，一加再加，加到一百零七万银子。

Once the ships arrived, their officers’ and men’s pay, coal, and miscellaneous expenses would cost a hundred thousand taels every month.
至于火轮到后，轮上官兵薪饷、煤炭杂用，每个月要用十万银子。

Worse still, the crews were all to be commanded by British officers—” “May I interrupt?” Hu asked. “Why was that?”
这还不算，火轮上的官兵，都要由英国人管带——。』『我打句岔，』胡雪岩截断了话问∶『这为了什么？』

“Here.
『喏，

Read this and you will understand.”
你看看这个就知道了。』

Zuo had carefully collected copies of the relevant edicts and memorials in a booklet.
左宗棠真是有心人，已将前几年购买英国兵轮的有关上谕与奏折，抄辑成册；

He opened it at one entry and handed it to Hu.
这时随手翻开一篇，递给胡雪岩，让他自己去细看。


It was a joint memorial submitted in the fifth month of the second Tongzhi year by Prince Gong, minister directing foreign affairs, Wenxiang, and their colleagues.
这一篇抄的是同治二年五月间，总理各国事务大臣恭亲王，及文祥等入会衔的奏折，

It began: “Your servants, faced with the continuing rebellion, sought every means of securing victory and proposed the purchase of foreign gunboats to assist in its suppression.
一开头就说∶窃臣等前以贼氛不清，力求制胜之方，因拟购买外洋炮船，以为剿贼之资，

A special memorial was submitted in the fifth month of the eleventh Xianfeng year, and the following decree was received: ‘The rebels’ power is spreading through the southeast.
于咸丰十一年五月间专折奏明，奏上谕∶『东南贼势蔓延，

If foreign gunboats can indeed be purchased, they will provide effective aid in suppressing them and benefit the general situation.’
果能购买外洋炮船，剿赋必可得力，实于大局有益。』

Reverently obeying, we communicated with the governors and governors-general concerned.
等因，钦此；遵即咨行各该督抚。

Thereafter Zeng Guofan, Governor-General of Liangjiang, reported that ‘the purchase of foreign ships and guns is the foremost urgent measure for rescuing the present situation.’”
旋据两江督巨曾国藩复奏，『购买外洋船炮为今日救时第一要务。』

Hu needed to read no further.
读到这里，就不必再往下看了。

“If the purpose was suppressing rebels, small gunboats able to navigate the Yangtze would suffice.
胡雪岩说道∶『如用于剿贼，只须能航行长江的小炮艇；

Why spend a million taels?”
何致于要花到一百万银子？』

“Exactly!
『就是这话罗！

It shows how blind our eminent gentlemen are.
衮衮诸公目贵目贵不明，于此可见。

Read this other memorial.”
你看年这一篇！』

Zuo pointed to one submitted by Zeng Guoquan late in the eighth month of the second Tongzhi year: “By imperial order, seven steamships have been purchased at great expense.
左宗棠指给胡雪岩看的是，同治二年八月下旬曾国荃的一道奏折，说的是∶查前后廷旨购办轮船七号，不惜巨资，

The undertaking has fortunately succeeded, and all are said to be approaching the coast.
幸而有成，闻皆将到海口矣！

Yet recent correspondence between the Zongli Yamen and the foreigner Lay shows that, besides the actual purchase price of a million taels, the foreign crews’ monthly maintenance will exceed seventy thousand, amounting in a year to no less than a million, all deducted from customs revenue.
惟近见总理衙门与洋人李泰国商定往复；除轮船实价百万之外，所用西人兵士每月口粮七万余两，每年大率不下百万两，俱于海关支扣。

The national treasury is empty.
窃计国家帑藏空虚，

To add so vast an annual expense must strain it further.”
倏而岁增巨款，度支将益不给。


“When the purchase was first proposed, it was assumed that Chinese personnel would be employed and could be freely commanded.
当始议购买之时，原以用中国人力，可以指挥自如，

At that time the Yangtze was obstructed; these powerful vessels were intended to defeat a powerful enemy.
且其时长江梗塞，正欲借此巨器，以平巨寇。

Since the capture of Jiufuzhou this summer, under the Emperor’s august protection, the river route has been opened.
自今夏攻克九氵伏州，仰仗皇上威福，江路已通，

Of the cities along it, only the provincial capital, Jinling, remains unrecovered.
江边之城，仅金陵省会，尚未恢复；

Our river navy, its masts thick as a forest, is cooperating fully with the land forces.
然长江水师，帆樯如林，与陆军通力合作，

Once the encirclement is complete, the enemy can certainly be swept away within a fixed time.
一经合围，定可克期扫荡。

I have observed steamships navigating the Yangtze.
巨窍见轮船经过长江，

Wherever sandbanks twist and intersect, a vessel may fail to turn aside in time and risk grounding.
每遇沙渚回互，或趋避不汲，时有胶浅之虞。

The river is narrow, offering none of the sea’s freedom of movement.
盖江路狭窄，非若大海之得以施展如意。

It is like a strong warrior holding a long spear in a short alley: before, behind, and on either side he must encounter obstacles.
譬犹健儿持长矛于短巷之中，左右前后，必多窒碍，

The conditions make this inevitable.
其势之使然也。

If even ordinary movement in a straight line is difficult, how can such ships maneuver freely in battle and display their full powers?
平时一线直行，犹且如此；临阵之际，何能盘旋往复，尽其所长？

On the river their effectiveness is not merely reduced; circumstances may leave them helpless.
是大江之用轮船，非特势力少逊，究亦有术穷之时，

If brought upriver now, their fighting strength is not truly needed.
今会其入江，实有不借彼战攻之力；

If kept at the river mouth, they will lie idle with nothing to do.”
若顿诸海口，则又安闲无所事事。


Again, Hu could close the booklet.
看到这里，亦可以掩卷了。

Purchasing and building great steamships was not for the purpose of suppressing rebels.
购造大轮船，非是为了剿匪；

When Zeng Guoquan submitted his memorial, Jinling was about to be encircled and Li Hongzhang was vigorously attacking Suzhou.
当曾国荃上此奏折时，金陵将次合围；苏州亦正由李鸿章 猛攻之中，

Success was already assured; naturally Guoquan wanted no one to share his glory.
大功之成，已有把握，曾国荃自然不想有人来分他的功。

His comparison with a long spear in a short alley, moreover, aptly described ocean-going ships operating on a river.
而况他所作的譬喻，如『健儿持长矛于短之中，左右前后，必多窒碍』，衡诸海轮和示范的实况亦甚贴切。

The court already regarded Lay as deceitful and difficult to deal with.
朝廷正以李泰国狡诈，难以与谋；

Such a memorial would naturally encourage it to abandon the proposal decisively.
得此一奏，当然会毅然决然地，打消此议。

“But circumstances have changed,” Zuo said. “Along Fujian’s coast, only steam warships can secure our frontiers and resist foreign enemies.
『然而，今昔异势，』左宗棠说∶『福建沿海，非兵轮不足固疆圉、御外敌。

What do you think?”
雪岩，你以为如何？』

“Yes.
『是！

You take the long view, my lord.
大人见得远。』

Governors and governors-general are responsible for their regions’ defense.
胡雪岩答说，『督抚担当方面军务；

Internal disorder is nearly ended; foreign threats must not be neglected.
如今内乱将平，外患不可不防。

If outsiders attack from the seas off Fujian and Zhejiang, responsibility for holding the territory will rest entirely upon you.
倘或外人由闽浙海面进犯，守土之责，全在大人。

Without long-term preparation, even if you do not repeat Lord Ye’s absurd failure in Guangdong, your reputation will suffer.”
如果不作远图；虽不致于闹出叶大人在广东的那种笑话来，可也伤了大人的英名。』

Lord Ye was Ye Mingchen, Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi, who “neither fought, negotiated, nor defended; neither died, surrendered, nor fled,” and finally died in exile in India.
所谓『叶大人』是指『不战不和不守，不死不降不走』，客死在印度的两广总督叶名琛。

The comparison was somewhat awkward, yet his fate offered a warning.
拿他作比，稍觉不伦；但就事论事，却是前车可鉴。

Zuo grew animated. “Exactly!
左宗棠很起劲地说∶『你说得一点不错！

It makes my duty all the clearer.
益见得我责无旁贷，

I am determined to establish a shipyard.”
雪岩，我决计要办船厂。』

“Provided the funds can be found, it should certainly be done.”
『只要经费有着，当然应该办。』

“There is no need to worry about funds.
『经费不必愁。

The former purchase was apportioned among the customs stations.
当然购船，是由各海关分摊；

We shall follow the same precedent.
如今当然仍照旧章.不过，

Fujian and Zhejiang’s customs will naturally have to exert themselves especially.”
闽浙两海关，格外要出力。』

“Certainly.
『那是一定的。

But—” Hu fell thoughtfully silent.
不过——。』胡雪岩沉吟着不再说下去了。


Zuo knew that such hesitation meant Hu saw a serious difficulty and could not readily voice it.
左宗棠知道，遇到这种情形，便是胡雪岩深感为难，不便明说的表示；

He also believed that in the end Hu would solve it.
可是他也知道，到头来，难题在胡雪岩也一定会解消。

The essential thing was to let him speak without reserve.
最要紧的是，让他无所顾忌，畅所欲言。

Adopting a leisurely air, Zuo said, “No hurry.
因此，他了以闲豫的神态，『不必急，

We can discuss it slowly.
我们慢慢谈。

The undertaking is necessary; its timing need not be fixed.”
事情是势在必行，时间却可不限。』

He smiled mysteriously.
他神秘地一笑到，

“Once I set out on this campaign, the whole situation will be in my hands.
『等我这趟出兵以后，局面就完全掌握在我手里了；

I can make it move quickly or slowly, tighten or relax it as I please.”
要紧要慢，收发由心。』

The last words were obscure.
这最后两句话，颇为费解；

Even Hu, alert as he was, had to study Zuo’s expression and weigh their meaning.
就连胡雪岩这样机警的人，也不能不观色察言，细细去咀嚼其中的意味。

At the sight of that confident yet enigmatic face, he suddenly understood.
看到左宗棠那种成竹在胸，而又诡谲莫测的神态，胡雪岩陡然意会；

Zuo meant the campaign in Fujian.
所谓『要紧要慢、收发由心』，是指入闽剿匪的军务而言。

He was confident not merely that the remaining rebels could be eliminated, but that he could determine when: soon if he wished, late if he preferred.
换句话说，残余的长毛，他不但自信，必可肃清；并且肃清的日子，是远是近，亦有充分的把握，要远就远，要近就近。

The choice would depend entirely upon his purpose.
这远近之间，完全要看他是怎么样一个打算？

Eager to serve the throne and win distinction, he could pursue vigorously and end the campaign quickly.
勤劳王事，急于立功，自是穷追猛打，克日可以肃清；

If the rebels were useful—for instance, as a reason to demand troops and money—he would preserve the enemy to increase his own importance.
倘或残余的长毛有可以利用之处，譬如借口匪势猖獗，要饷要兵，那就必然『养寇自重』了。


Hu must first understand his plan. “How many years do you intend to remain in Fujian, my lord?”
想到这里，就得先了解左宗棠的打算∶『大人，』他问，『预备在福建做几年？』

“An excellent question!”
『问得好！』

Zuo was delighted by this meeting of minds.
左宗棠有莫逆于心之乐；

“How many years do you think I should remain?”
然后反问一句∶『你看我应该在福建做几年？』

“If you are determined to establish a shipyard, several years will be necessary.”
『如果大人决心办船厂，当然要多做几年。』

“I think so too.”
『我也是这么想。』

“And how will you manage it?
『做法呢？』

Surely you cannot keep fighting the rebels indefinitely?”
胡雪岩问，『总不能一直打长毛吧？』

“Naturally not.
『当然，当然！

They are doomed souls at the bottom of the cauldron, unable to withstand a blow.
釜底游魂，不堪一击；

To prolong the campaign would injure my reputation.
迁延日久，损我的威名。

But neither need I succeed the moment I arrive.”
不过，也不必马到成功。』

He stroked his beard in thought, the smile fading.
说到这里，左宗棠拈髭沉思；脸上的笑容尽敛，

After a long silence he nodded. “As you know, I must gain Guangdong as a base.
好久才点点头说∶『你知道的，广东这个地盘非拿过来不可；

How long the fighting lasts depends upon whether my in-law understands the situation.
兵事久斩，只看我那位亲家是不是见机？

If he withdraws in good time, I shall gladly defeat the enemy promptly.
他肯急流勇退，我乐得早日克敌致果；

Otherwise, more money must be spent.
不然就得多费些饷了。

Do you understand?”
你懂我的意思吗？』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第九章（本章第7部分，共7部分）
逐句英中对照

“I understand,” Hu replied.
『懂！』胡雪岩说，

“Only when I know your intentions can I make plans for you.”
『我就是要明白了大人的意思，才可以为大人打算。』

“Then you understand now?”
『那末，如今你是明白了？』

The question reminded him that it was time to do so.
这是提醒胡雪岩该作打算了。

He answered with renewed energy. “If Guangdong follows your lead, matters will be manageable.
他精神抖擞地答说∶『只要广东能听大人的话，事情就好办了。

When you petition to establish a shipyard, the court will surely ask the coastal governors and governors-general for their opinions on so important an undertaking.
我在想，将来大人出奏，请办船厂，象这样的大事，朝廷一定寄谕沿海各省督抚，各抒所见。

Fujian and Zhejiang are assured.
福建、浙江不用说；

如果广东奏复，力赞其成。大人的声势就可观了。』

“Exactly!
『正是！

我必得拿广东拉到手，就是这个道理。

南洋沿海有三省站在我这面；两江何敢跟我为难？』

『两江亦不敢公开为难；

It would make difficulties over sharing the expense. Funding a shipyard from maritime customs revenue is perfectly reasonable.
必是在分摊经费上头做文章.说到办船厂的经费，由海关洋税项下抽拨，是天经地义的事。

Set aside Tianjin’s northern customs for the moment.
北洋的津海关，暂且不提；

In the south, including Guangdong, there are five major customs establishments: Jianghaiguan in Shanghai, Guangdong Customs at Guangzhou, Fujian Customs and Xiamen Customs, and our own Ningbo Customs.
南洋的海关，包括广东在内，一共五大关∶上海的江海关；广州的粤海关；福建的闽海关跟厦门关；我们浙江的宁波关。

When the cost is apportioned, support from Guangdong would give you three of the five, counting Fujian and Xiamen.
将来分摊经费，闽、厦两关以外，粤海关肯支持，就是五关占其三；

浙江归大人管辖，马中丞亦不能不卖这个面子。

Could Liangjiang then insist that Jianghaiguan contribute nothing?”
这一来，两江方面莫非好说江海关一毛不拔？』


“Precisely.
『对了！

你的打算合情合理；其间举足重轻的关键，就在广东。

Take this collection of copies home, study the precedent of the former ship purchase, and prepare a detailed memorandum.
雪岩，我想这样，你把我这个抄本带回去，参照当年购船成例，好好斟酌，写个详细节略来；

When to submit it will depend upon the opportunity.
至于什么时候出奏，要等时机。

I think we must first settle Guangdong.”
照我想，总要广东有了着落，才能出奏。』

“I agree.
『是的。我也是这么想。』

Fortunately, we have ample time.
胡雪岩说，『好在时间从容得很，

I shall consult d’Aiguebelle and the others and make a rough calculation of the sources of revenue.
一主面我先跟德克碑他们商量；一方面大致算一算经费的来源。

Some money will be needed for preliminary work; I shall arrange to advance it.”
至于筹备这件大事，先要用些款子，归我想办法来垫。

“Excellent.
『』好极！

We shall proceed that way.
就这么办。

But Jianghaiguan holds the richest resources.
不过，雪岩，江海关是精华所在；

We cannot let Li Shaoquan keep them entirely in his grasp.
总不能让李少荃一直把持在那里！

Think of a way to draw more out of him.”
你好好想个法子，多挖他一点出来！

“There is a way,” Hu said, shaking his head, “but it would be better not to use it.”
『』法子有。不过，『胡雪岩摇摇头，』最好不用那个法子！

“Why?”
『』为什么？

“We should be roundly criticized.”
『『用那个法子要挨骂。』

“Leave that aside for the moment.
『这你先不必管。

What is the method?”
请说，是何法子？』


“We could borrow from foreigners.
『可以跟洋人借债。』

A loan requires security.
胡雪岩说，『借债要担保。

If Jianghaiguan says it cannot contribute now, there must be a time when it can.
江海关如说目前无款可拨，那末总有可拨的时候。

We could earmark a certain proportion of its receipts in specified future years to repay the foreign loan.
我们就指着江海关某年某年收入的多少成数，作为还洋债的款，

That would be the security.
这就是担保。

不过，天朝大国，向洋人借债；一定有人不以为然。

If the censors attacked together, it would be difficult to bear.”
那批都老爷群起而攻，可是件吃不消的事。

Zuo was struck silent.
『这番话说得左宗棠发楞；

He rose and paced solemnly for some time, then took back the booklet he had handed to Hu, turned to a page, and pointed. “Read this passage.”
接着站起身来踱了好一回方步；最后拿起已交在胡雪岩手里的』抄本『，翻到一页，指着说道∶』你看看这一段！

『指的是恭亲王所上奏折中的一段，

Lay had told the prince that, should China need money, he could arrange a loan of ten million taels from foreign merchants, repayable with interest over a term of years.
据李泰国向恭王面称∶『中国如欲用银，伊能代向外国商人借银一千万两，分年带利归还。』

可是恭王又下结论∶『其请借银一千万两之说，中国亦断无此办法。』

“There, my lord.”
『大人请看，』

Hu pointed to the sentence. “The court will never permit a foreign loan.”
胡雪岩指着那句话说∶『朝中决不准借洋债。』


“That was then; this is now!”
『彼一时也，此一时也！』

Zuo abruptly changed the direction of the discussion.
说到这里，左宗棠突然将话锋扯了开去，

“Xueyan, remember this: in great affairs, the most important thing is to make up one’s mind.
『雪岩，你要记住一件事；办大事最要紧的是拿主意！

Once the decision is made, reasons are not hard to find.
主意一拿定，要说出个道理来并不难；

Take this memorial.
拿恭王的这个奏折来说，

China was buying ships but had to submit to foreign wishes in everything; many at court objected.
当时因为中国买船，而事事要听洋人的主张，朝中颇有人不以为然；

Prince Gong was already inclined to retreat, which is why he said China could never borrow abroad.
恭王已有打退堂鼓的意思，所以才说中国断无借洋债的办法。

Suppose the military situation had been uncertain and foreign armor and guns indispensable.
倘或当时军务并无把握，非借重洋人的坚甲利炮不可；

There would have been a different argument.
那时就另有一套话说了；

First, foreigners lending to China would be showing admiration for the Celestial Dynasty and voluntarily supporting the rightful cause.
第一、洋人愿意借债给中国，是仰慕天朝，自愿助顺；

Second, their willingness to lend without fearing loss would demonstrate confidence that China could suppress the Taipings, recover the rich southeastern provinces, and repay the debt.
第二、洋人放债不怕放倒，正表示信赖中国，一定可以肃清洪杨，光复东南财赋之区，将来有力量还债。

你想想，那是多好听的话，

Why would the court not gladly agree?”
朝廷岂有不欣然许诺之理？』

To Hu, these words were an education.
这几句话，对胡雪岩来说，就是『学问』；

心诚悦服地表示受教。而左宗棠亦就越谈越起劲了。

『我再你讲讲办大事的秘诀。

There is a saying: ‘Better to use a favorable situation than wait for a favorable time.’
有句成语，叫做「与其待时，不如乘势」；

Many apparently difficult enterprises succeed smoothly because someone understands how to use the force of circumstances.
许多看起来难办的大事，居然顺顺利利地办成了，就因为懂得乘势的缘故。

What is that force?
何谓势？

Let me test you.
雪岩，我倒考考你；

Tell me what it means.”
你说与我听听，何谓势？』


“You have defeated me with that question,” Hu said with a smile. “Please instruct me.”
『这可是考倒我了。』胡雪岩笑道∶『还是请大人教导吧！』

“In some matters I must seek your advice; in others I may properly claim the right to teach you.
『有些事，我要跟你请教；有些事我倒是当仁不让，可以教教你。

The force of circumstances depends upon the person, the business, and the time.
谈到势，要看人、看事、还要看时。

In a person, it is influence—the power that attracts the self-seeker.
人这势者，势力；也就是小人势利之势。

I once nearly met disaster because Guanwen, Governor-General of Huguang, had more influence than Luo Bingzhang, Governor of Hunan.
当初我几乎遭不测之祸，就因为湖广总督的官文的势力，比湖南巡抚路秉章 来得大，

Naturally the court listened to him.
朝中自然听他的。

It was easy for him to impeach me.”
他要参我，容易得很。』

“Yes.
『是的。

The same matter carries different weight according to who speaks.”
同样一件事，原是要看什么人说。』

“And according to what he speaks about,” Zuo added.
『也要看说的是什么事？』左宗棠接口，

『以当今大事来说，军务重于一切；而军务所急，肃清长毛余孽，又是首要，

所以我为别的事说话，不一定有力量，

要谈入闽剿匪，就一定会听我的。

你信不信？』

『怎么不信？

Certainly I do.”
信，信！』

『我想你一定信得过。

My present position gives my words sufficient force.
以我现在的身分，说话是够力量了；

But I must still consider the business and the moment to speak.
论事则还要看是什么事？在什么时候开口？

Choose the moment exactly, and advice is heard and plans followed.
时机把握得恰到好处，言听计从。

Speak too late, and you harm yourself; too early, and it is useless.”
说迟了自误；说早了无用。』

Zuo smiled. “For example, the time has not yet come to drive out my in-law.”
左宗棠笑道∶『譬如撵我那位亲家，现在就还不到时候。』


“Exactly,” Hu answered at once.
『是的。』胡雪岩脱口答道，

“Not until the fighting reaches the Fujian–Guangdong border.” Zuo laughed heartily, then grew serious. “The shipyard must wait until military operations are concluded and coastal defense becomes the subject of discussion.
『要打到福建、广东交界的地方，才是时候。』左宗棠大笑，笑完了正色说道∶『办船厂一事，要等军务告竣，筹议海防，那才是一件事。

Even then, the moment must be right.
但也要看时机。

But we must prepare in advance or the opportunity will pass.
不过，我们必得自己有预备，才不会坐失时机。

Do you understand?”
你懂我的意思了吧？』

Hu understood not merely the words but their full implications, carrying the thought farther than Zuo himself.
胡雪岩不但懂他的意思，而且心领神会，比左宗棠想得更深更远。

Combining the general situation, Zuo’s future distinction, and his own business and interests, he saw one essential point: Zuo must win a brilliant military victory.
结合大局，左宗棠的勋名前程，和他自己的事业与利益，了解了一件事∶左宗棠非漂漂亮亮地打胜仗不可！

Nothing else could take its place.
这是一个没有东西可以代替的关键。


From this understanding Hu decided the order of his work for Zuo, though he must first obtain agreement.
由于这个了解，他决定了为左宗棠办事的优先顺序；不过，这当然先要征得同意，

“I understand your ambitions and can broadly judge when each matter should be undertaken.
因而这样说道∶『大人的雄心壮志，我都能体会得到；到什么时候该办什么事，我亦大致有数，

I shall prepare beforehand.
事先会得预备。

如今我要请问大人的是，这趟带兵剿匪，最着重的是什么？』

The question halted Zuo.
这句话将左宗棠问住了；

After a moment he answered, “Funds, naturally.”
想了一会答道∶『自然是饷！』

“I can arrange advances.
『饷我可以想法子垫。

But that is not a service only I can provide.
不过，并不是非我不可；

If the provincial contributions arrive regularly, why borrow from me and pay extra interest?”
各处协饷，能够源源报解，何必我来垫借，多吃利息？』

“Ah, I see what you mean.
『啊，我懂你的话了。』

A workman must sharpen his tools before he can work well.
左宗棠说，『工欲善其事，必先利其器；

Good soldiers with poor weapons can defend but cannot attack.
兵坚而器不利，则能守而不能攻。

I need fine Western arms, the more the better.
我要西洋精良兵器，多多益善；

That is something I must rely on you for.”
雪岩，这非你不可！』

“Exactly.”
『是！愚见正是如此。』

Hu was pleased. “Then procuring Western weapons will be my first concern.
胡雪岩欣慰地答说∶『我替大人办事，第一是采办西洋兵器，

You need not remind me; I shall watch for them myself.
不必大人嘱咐，我自会留意。

Shells and ammunition go without saying—I shall never let the front run short.
至于炮弹子药，更不在话下；决不让前方短缺。

第二是饷，

Whatever sum is due under the regular allocation, I shall have it ready, whether Zhejiang’s treasury remits early or late.
份内该拨的数目，不管浙江藩库迟拨早拨，我总替大人预备好。

至于额外用款，数目不大，当然随时都有；

如果数目太大，最好请大人预先嘱咐一声，免得措手不及。

此外办造厂之类，凡是大人交代过的，我都会一样一样办到；

我总不误时机就是。』

“Excellent!”
『好极了！』

Zuo was delighted.
左宗棠愉悦异常，

“The founding Han emperor owed his success to Xiao He.
『汉高成功，功在萧何。

Then we are agreed.
我们就这样说了；

Go ahead freely.
你尽管放手去做，

I shall stand behind everything.”
一切有我担待。』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第十章（本章第1部分，共3部分）

CHAPTER TEN
第十章


At the end of the tenth month of the third year of Tongzhi, Zuo Zongtang relinquished his concurrent duties as acting governor of Zhejiang.
左宗棠在同治三年十月底，交卸了兼署浙江巡抚的职司；

Amid cannon salutes and the respectful farewell of Hangzhou’s civil and military officials, he set out for Fujian to direct the campaign.
在杭州全城文武官员，呜炮恭送之下，启程入闽督师。

The relief armies had already departed in three columns.
在此以前，援闽之师分三路出发。

The western column’s main force comprised eight thousand newly raised troops under Liu Dian, Zhejiang’s judicial commissioner and assistant director of military affairs in Fujian.
西路以帮办福建军务浙江按察使刘典所部新军八千人为主力；

With twenty-five hundred men under Wang Debang, who held the designation of judicial commissioner pending appointment, they entered Tingzhou from Jianchang in Jiangxi.
会同记名按察使王德榜的两千五百人，由江西建昌入汀州；

In the centre, Huang Shaochun, designated for appointment as provincial military commander, and Deputy Brigade Commander Liu Mingdeng led forty-six hundred men from Quzhou through Pucheng and Jianning towards Yanping.
中路记名提督黄少春，副将刘明灯两部共四千六百人，由浙江衢州，经福建浦城、建宁入延平；

In the east, Acting Zhejiang Military Commander Gao Liansheng and Wei Guangbing, a prefect awaiting appointment, led forty-five hundred men across the Qiantang River to Ningbo, where they boarded steamships for Fuzhou.
东路由署理浙江提督高连升会同候补知府魏光邴，领兵四千五百人，过钱塘江由宁波乘轮船，循海道至福州登陆。

All three columns were directed towards southern Fujian.
这三路军队的目标都是闽南——

Li Shixian occupied Zhangzhou, west of Xiamen; Ding Taiyang was at Wuping, where Fujian, Guangdong, and Jiangxi met; Wang Haiyang ranged between the eastern and western districts of southern Fujian.
李世贤踞厦门之西的漳州；丁太洋在福建、广东、江西三省交界的武平；而汪海洋则在闽南的东西之间流窜。

Zuo was determined to prevent them from putting to sea.
左宗棠的打算是，决不能让他们出海；

He would tighten the pressure from north, west, and east, forcing them south.
由北、西、东三面收紧，压迫敌人南窜。

South of Fujian lay Guangdong.
福建之南就是广东。

Mao Hongbin, governor-general of Liangguang, and Guo Songtao, governor of Guangdong, saw the danger.
两广总督毛鸿宾与广东巡抚郭嵩焘，见此光景，心知不妙。

If Zuo drove the rebels into their province, the relieving army would follow, leaving Guangdong squeezed between rebels and “friendly troops.”
左宗棠如果驱贼入粤，则援闽之师，随贼而至，会形成长毛与『友军』交困的窘境，

They were deeply alarmed.
所以非常着急。

Yet the Guangdong forces under the two deputy brigade commanders Fang Yao and Zhuo Xing amounted to only eight thousand.
可是由两员副将方耀、卓兴所率领的粤军，不过八千之众；

Kang Guoqi, intendant of the Yanping-Jianning-Shaowu circuit in Fujian, was a Guangdong man and commanded a newly formed force largely recruited there, but it could not be counted as a Guangdong army: he served under Zuo and took no orders from Guangdong’s senior officials.
福建延建邵道康国器，虽是广东人，新统一军，亦多粤籍，却不能算粤军，因为是左宗棠的部下，并不听命于广东大吏。

Mao and Guo had little choice.
毛鸿宾与郭嵩焘迫不得已，

They sent Fang and Zhuo into Fujian to join the campaign, openly blocking the rebels and covertly checking Zuo.
一而派方耀、卓兴入闽会剿，明阻长毛，暗挡左宗棠；

Meanwhile, hoping to strengthen their own position, they planned to ask the court to appoint Feng Zicai, the celebrated defender of Zhenjiang, to direct military affairs along the East River.
一面打算奏请起用守镇江的名将冯子材督办东江军务，自求振作。


Before the relieving armies arrived, Lin Wencha, Fujian’s land-force military commander, had already fought Li Shixian.
当援闽之师未到以前，福建陆路提督林文察已与李世贤接过仗。

A native of Changhua in Taiwan, Lin had entered military office as a youji commander in the eighth year of Xianfeng, after contributing funds and helping suppress bandits in Tamsui.
林文察是台湾彰化人，咸丰八年以助饷剿淡水的土匪，授职游击，做了武官；

His Taiwanese volunteers were fierce, adept with firearms, and effective in battle.
他所统率的台勇擅用火器，剽悍善战，

Their success helped him rise to brigade commander and gain the title Baturu.
助林文察当到总兵，获得『巴图鲁』的名号。

While Wang Youling was besieged in Hangzhou, Lin had been ordered to assist Zhejiang but was held up at Hengzhou.
王有龄被困杭州时，曾奉命援浙，而阻于衡州；

Later placed under Zuo’s command, he earned further distinction and received substantive appointment as commander of the Funing Brigade in Fujian.
以后归左宗棠节制，很立了些战功，补实为福建福宁镇总兵，

Soon promoted to the province’s land-force military command, he returned to Taiwan with troops to suppress disorder in his native district.
不久擢升为福建陆路提督，随即提兵回台，在他家乡平乱。

The rebel leader was Dai Chaochun, whose ancestral home was Longxi in Zhangzhou.
乱党的首领，是原籍漳州龙溪的戴潮春；

He belonged to the surviving adherents of the White Lotus sect, that old source of rebellion which never seemed to disappear from Chinese history.
他是中国历史上阴魂不散的老牌乱党白莲教的余孽。

Nominally he organized militia in Changhua; in reality he was in contact with the Taipings.
在彰化名义上办团练，实际上与长毛是勾通的。

At the transition from the Xianfeng to the Tongzhi reign, Zhejiang fell and many government troops in Fujian were transferred to northern Fujian and southern Zhejiang.
咸同之交，浙江沦陷，在福建的官军，多调闽北浙南；

Dai judged the moment favourable.
戴潮春认为是起事的好机会，

In the third month his follower Lin Gangsheng rose at Dadun.
三月间由其党羽林戆晟在大墩起事，

Five days later Changhua was occupied and Kong Zhaoci, Taiwan’s military intendant, was killed.
五天以后，占领彰化，台湾兵备道孔昭慈被杀。

Dai called himself the Eastern King and Lin the Southern King; there were also Western and Northern Kings, with a Grand Preceptor, chief ministers of the left and right, and ministers of the six boards beneath them.
戴潮春自称『东王』∶『南王』是林戆晟；此外还有『西王』与『北王』。下面的官职有『大国师』、『左右丞相』、『六部尚书』等等。

This rough imitation of the Taiping administration, a collection of pretenders playing ministers and generals as though on a stage, survived for a time because the southeastern war had reached a critical point. In response to Grain Intendant Ding Rijian’s urgent requests, the court had sent only six hundred men against it.
这个略仿太平天国建制，沐猴而冠，仿佛戏台出将入相的场面，由于东南战局正在紧要关头，朝廷只应粮道丁日健的力请，派了六百人去攻剿；因而得以维持一时。

Not until the autumn of the second year of Tongzhi, when Zuo was confident of recovering Zhejiang, did he send Lin back to Taiwan to rally his former troops.
及至同治二年秋天，左宗棠收复浙江，已有把握，才派林文察回台，号召旧部；

Fujian’s governor, Xu Zonggan, also sent Ding, who had served in Taiwan for many years, with reinforcements.
福建巡抚徐宗干，亦派久官台湾的丁日健领兵赴援，

Ding was appointed Taiwan’s military intendant and given charge of military affairs throughout the island.
并授为台湾兵备道，督办全台军务。


Early in the eleventh month, Changhua was recovered, followed by Douliu.
于是到了十一月初，彰化收复，继攻下斗六；

By the end of the year Dai had been captured at Zhangcuozhuang and Lin Gangsheng defeated and killed at Sikuai Cuo.
到了年底，戴潮春被擒于张厝庄、林戆晟败死于四块厝，

The situation could be considered stable.
局面可以算是稳定下来了。

Clearing out the remaining rebels was nevertheless arduous.
不过肃清残余乱党，亦很费力；

In particular, after Li Shixian occupied Zhangzhou, Dai’s surviving followers prepared to join forces with him and rise again.
尤其是当李世贤占据漳州以后，戴潮春的余党准备接应会合，图谋再举。

This was precisely why Zuo feared that Li and Wang Haiyang might put to sea.
左宗棠深恐李世贤、汪海洋等人出海，正就是为此。

Lin Wencha faced a dilemma.
林文察见此光景，深感为难，

On one hand, he could not relax his efforts to prevent the embers of rebellion from flaring up.
一方面要防止死灰复燃，放不得手；

On the other, as Fujian’s highest military officer on land, he had an inescapable responsibility for recovering Zhangzhou, Tingzhou, and the other occupied districts.
另一方面以福建陆路提督为一省最高武官的地位，对于收复漳州、汀州等地，责无旁贷。

After careful thought, he decided that he must return to Fujian.
仔细考虑下来，还是应该回福建；

If Li could be destroyed, the rebels in Changhua would lose both support and hope and collapse without a fight.
因为能够消灭李世贤，彰化的乱党便失去凭借与指望，不战而自溃。

He crossed hurriedly, taking only two hundred personal guards in his ship.
打定主意，仓卒内渡，同船只带了两百亲兵。

Having fought Li more than once, he did not underestimate him.
他与李世贤交过手不止一次，不敢轻敌；

His original intention was to make arrangements after reaching Fujian and only then advance.
原意到了福建，先作部署，然后出击，

But Li was already prepared, with an ambush at Wansong Pass awaiting his arrival.
那知李世贤早有准备，在万松关设下埋伏，专等他入网。


Lin then changed his plan.
而林文察则又改变了主意。

Feeling his force too small, he gathered many stragglers along the road into an improvised army.
因为他自感兵力孤单，一路收容了许多散兵游勇，杂凑成军；

Given ample pay and provisions, sufficient time, and capable assistants, such men could gradually be trained into a strong force.
如果粮饷充裕，时间从容，而又有得力的帮手，当然可以将此辈渐渐练成劲旅，

Without those advantages, the only course was to exploit their urgent desire for a livelihood or their thirst for revenge, sharpen their fighting spirit, and stake everything on one desperate effort.
否则就只有利用他们急于追求出路，或者怀仇报仇的心理，淬厉士气，作背城借一之计。

An experienced commander, Lin studied the circumstances and concluded that he must seek a rapid decision.
林文察老于兵事，默察情势，认为不得不速战速决；

Delay would merely consume supplies while discipline became impossible, and the army would collapse without fighting.
拖下去徒耗粮饷，且难部勒，将不战自溃。

Zuo’s original order had been to hold Quanzhou and Xiamen firmly.
本来左宗棠的檄令，是责成他『力保泉厦』，

That was a difficult task.
这是很难的任务，

The country from Zhangzhou eastwards to the two coastal cities was flat, easy to attack and hard to defend, while the opposing forces were grossly unequal in strength.
因为漳州以东，直到厦门、泉州，地势平衍，易攻难守，而况彼此兵力众寡悬殊。

Strategically, attack should serve as defence.
就方略讲，应该以攻为守；

In weighing the consequences, although attacking a larger force was arduous, defeat while attacking was preferable to defeat while merely holding a position.
就利害关系来看，以少攻多，虽然吃力，但与其守而败，不如攻而败。

Early in the tenth month, therefore, Lin advanced from Quanzhou and Xiamen and camped at Wansong Pass.
因此，在十月初便由泉厦而进，在万松关上扎营。

Also called Wansong Ridge, it stood on Phoenix Mountain, twenty-five li east of Zhangzhou, commanding the route into the city after crossing the river from the coastal towns.
万松关又名万松岭，在漳州以东二十五里的凤凰山上，为由泉厦渡江入漳的孔道。

His camp was scarcely established when Li sent a force to test its strength.
扎营刚定，李世贤派一队人马来攻，用意在试探虚实；

Deputy Brigade Commander Huishou proved incapable, and the rebels actually overran the camp.
哪知副将惠寿不中用，竟让长毛踩了营盘。

Lin had to withdraw to a place called Yuzhou.
林文察迫不得已，退驻叫做玉洲的地方，

Two days later, he attacked and returned with a minor victory.
隔了两天出队攻击，小胜而回。


At this point another order arrived from Zuo: dig deep trenches and raise high ramparts; avoid rash fighting in pursuit of victory; wait for the Zhejiang troops, then cooperate in recovering Zhangzhou.
就在这时候又接到左宗棠的札子，指示他『深沟高垒，勿浪战求胜；俟浙军到后，协力规复漳州。』

Lin now had to obey.
林文察这时不能不听命，

He encamped on Wansong Ridge and waited.
驻营在万松岭上，静候援军；

Naval Brigade Commander Zeng Yuming established a river camp at Haikou near Haicheng County on the Jiulong River, so that the two positions could support one another.
另由水师总兵曾玉明，在九龙江近海澄县地方的海口镇，结扎水营，以为犄角之势。

They held on until the end of the tenth month.
这样守到十月底，

Zuo had not yet entered Fujian, but the Zhejiang forces sent ahead were nearing positions from which the three columns could close in.
左宗棠还未进入福建境内，而先行出发的浙军，三路合围之势，将次形成。

Li had originally laid his ambush west of Wansong Pass, expecting Lin to enter it.
李世贤原来是在万松关以西设下埋伏，专候林文察入网；

Seeing him remain inactive while the Zhejiang troops approached, Li urgently needed to open a way out.
见他按兵不动，而浙军又已入闽，不能不急着打开一条出路，

On the third day of the eleventh month, he launched a surprise attack by land and water.
因而在十一月初三，发动突袭。突袭是分水陆两路进行。

The rebels striking the river camp blackened their faces with soot, both to appear terrifying and to recognize one another.
袭击水营的长毛，皆以烟煤擦脸，有意扮成狰狞可怖的鬼相；同时亦用作为『自己人』的识别。

Zeng’s naval force was caught unprepared.
曾玉明的水师，猝不及防，

Apart from resistance with the small guns aboard the gunboats, the camps collapsed.
除了用炮艇上的小炮轰击以处，其余各营，都垮了下来。

To the west, Lin’s force at Wansong Pass consisted of stragglers whose condition had steadily deteriorated with delay.
在西面万松关上的林文察所部，本是越拖越坏的散兵游勇；

Hearing that their rear had been attacked, they fell into disorder before fighting began.
听说后路被袭，未战先乱。

Huishou and Youji Commander Xu Zhongbiao could not hold the ranks and escaped as best they could.
副将惠寿，游击许忠标，压不住阵，只有溜之大吉；

Lin refused to flee and was shot dead.
林文察都不肯逃，结果中枪阵亡。

The routed troops were barely collected on the east bank of the Jiulong River, forming what protection they could for the approach to Quanzhou.
溃散下来的乱兵，勉强集结在九龙江东岸，算是保障泉州门户。


Three months later, Zuo reached Pucheng and formally entered Fujian, intending to establish his travelling headquarters there.
三月以后，左宗棠到了浦城，正式进入福建境界；预定就以此为行辕。

The first battle report received at those headquarters announced Lin’s defeat and death in action.
行辕所收到的第一件战报，便是林文察兵败殉职。

This was no omen of immediate success, and Zuo was greatly displeased.
这不是马到成功的征兆，左宗棠大为不悦。

In his view, Lin had blunted the Zhejiang army’s spirit and damaged his own prestige.
在他看林文察是挫了浙军的锐气，也伤了他的威名；
