Although the man had not deserved death, his failure was unforgivable.
虽非死有余辜，却是决不可原谅的。

Zuo therefore would not devote a separate memorial to it.
因而出奏时，便不肯专叙此事，

Instead, under the heading “Arrival at Pucheng to Direct the Campaign, and Current Arrangements for Suppression,” he reproached Lin for disregarding orders and thereby suffering defeat.
只用一个『督师行抵浦城，现筹剿办情形』的案由，在折子中斥责林文察不听调度，致有此失；

Fortunately, Gao Liansheng’s troops had reached southern Fujian from Fuzhou, so Quanzhou and Xiamen could be secured.
幸亏高连升军一已由福州赶到闽南，泉厦可保无虞。

As for Lin’s posthumous honours, a separate request would be submitted; it was easy to infer that the provision would not be generous.
至于林文察的恤典，申明另案奏请；但可想而知的，恤典不会优厚。

The situation soon stabilized.
不过局势很快地稳住了。

Zuo’s greatest concern was that Li might break southeastwards to the sea.
左宗棠最担心的，就是李世贤向东南横窜入海，

If Gao’s force could move south from Fuzhou in time to block him and hold him briefly, the arrival by sea of the Jiangsu armies under Guo Songlin and Yang Dingxun would make the clearing of the interior virtually certain.
所以只要高连升一军，能自福州南下，及时拦堵，先挡得一阵；等苏军郭松林、杨鼎勋领兵航海而来，肃清腹地便有十足的把握了。


Zuo accordingly adopted a strategy of holding in the east, attacking from the north, and applying pressure from the west.
为此，左宗棠定下东守北攻西压的策略，

First he recovered Longyan, in the northern part of southern Fujian.
最先收复闽南偏北的龙岩；

Then, in cooperation with Fang Yao’s Guangdong troops, he recovered Yongding on the provincial border.
接着会同粤军方耀所部，收复闽粤交界的永定。

These two victories greatly raised morale and gave him more freedom of command.
这两场胜仗才下来，士气大振，指挥更加灵活；

He began to drive the rebels into Guangdong, first pushing Wang Haiyang’s men south from Tingzhou and Liancheng, near Jiangxi, towards Wuping and Shanghang on the Guangdong border.
左宗棠开始『驱贼入粤』，首先是由毗连江西的汀洲、连城一带、将汪海洋部下的长毛，往南撵向与广东交界的武平、上杭一带。

The Jiangsu reinforcements were arriving in succession.
其时援闽苏军已陆续到达，

They divided the defensive sectors with Gao’s and Huang Shaochun’s Zhejiang forces, taking Zhangzhou as their common objective.
与浙军高连升、黄少春所部，划分防区，而以进取漳州为目标，

The Jiangsu armies held the south of the city, the Zhejiang armies the north, completely cutting off Li’s route to the sea.
苏军守漳州之南浙军守漳州之北。这一来，李世贤出海之路是彻底被遮断了。

In the middle of the fourth month they attacked simultaneously from north and south.
到了四月中旬，浙苏各军由南北同时出击，会功漳州；

On the twenty-first, Zhangzhou was recovered.
到了四月廿一，漳州克复，

Li, however, opened the western gate and escaped to join Wang, leaving the two like cornered beasts.
可是李世贤却开西门而走，与汪海洋会合在一起，成为『困兽』了。

The strongest forces now lay along the southeastern coast around Quanzhou, Xiamen, and Zhangzhou.
当时的形势是东南方面泉、厦、漳沿海一带，兵力最厚；

More than seven thousand guarded Yongding to the northwest; a gap in the northeast had also been closed in time.
西北永定有七千余人防守；东北的漏洞，亦已及时防补，

Only the west remained weak, with almost no dispositions made by Zuo.
唯有西面最弱，左宗棠几乎毫无布置。

To the west lay Dabu and Raoping in Guangdong.
西面就是广东的大埔、饶平一带，

Fang Yao’s troops defended them, but anyone could see they were no match for Li and Wang.
虽有粤军方耀防守，可是决非李世贤、汪海洋的对手，是谁都看得出来的。

What, then, did Zuo intend?
然则，左宗棠之意何居？

A discerning observer could draw the conclusion.
明眼人自然看得出来。


That observer was Xu Gengshen, chief secretary of the Grand Council, far away in the capital.
这个明眼人是远在京城里的军机章 京领班许庚身，

On the twelfth day of the fifth month, a memorial passed down to him caused considerable surprise.
在五月十二那天，看到发下来的一个奏折，大为诧异；

Submitted by Li Hongzhang to record his troops’ achievements, it was headed, “Jiangsu Reinforcements in Fujian Join the Zhejiang Forces in Converging Attacks and Recover the Prefectural City of Zhangzhou on the Twenty-first Day of the Fourth Month.”
这个奏折是李鸿章 所上，作用是在表功，所以案由是『援闽苏军，会合浙军分路进逼，于四月二十一日克复漳州府城』；

In describing the attack, it stated that “the rebel Shi King, Li Shixian, secretly opened the western gate and fled.”
奏报进攻情形中，有一句话说∶『侍逆李世贤潜开西门而遁。』

This did not agree with Zuo’s report received at the same time.
这与同时收到的左宗棠的战报，情况不符。

Zuo’s heading was “Great Victory in the Advance West of Zhangzhou, and Current Arrangements.”
左宗棠的奏折，案由是『进逼漳西大捷，现筹办理情形』。

It mentioned neither the recovery of the city nor Li’s escape through its western gate.
并未提到漳州克复，再未变到李世贤由漳州西门而遁；

It said only that Li, repeatedly defeated and increasingly desperate, had tried to take a minor route north of Zhangzhou around to Anxi and strike the government troops’ rear.
只说『李逆世贤经官军叠次击败，势日穷蹙；图由漳北小路绕犯安溪，以抄官军后路。

Failing in that, he had attempted to stir up internal disorder in collusion with bandits in Tong’an.
其计未成，又图勾结同安土匪，内讧滋事；

Guo Songlin had then hurried to Tong’an with two battalions and, together with Intendant Zeng Xiande, cleared the bandit strongholds at Xitang, Shangzhai, and Hujing.
经离松林凰带所部两营驰赴同安，会同道员曾宪德将西塘、上宅、浒井各乡匪巢洗荡。』

The memorial was dated the twenty-sixth day of the fourth month and submitted from the provincial capital.
再看拜折的日期是四月廿六，拜折的地点是福建省城。

Fuzhou was only two or three days from Zhangzhou.
福州离漳州不过两三日路程；

If the city had been recovered on the twenty-first, Zuo could hardly have remained ignorant on the twenty-fifth.
廿一克复漳州，在福州的左宗棠不应该到廿五还不知道。

If he knew, why did he not announce the victory in his memorial on the twenty-sixth?
如果已经知道，廿六拜折何以不报捷？

This was a major puzzle, but a little consideration made it plain.
这是莫大的一个疑窦，但稍作参详，不难明白，

Zuo withheld the victory report because Li had escaped.
左宗棠只为李世贤『漏网』，不肯报捷；

By first describing an intended movement towards Anxi, then collusion with Tong’an’s bandits, and finally Guo’s actions, he meant quietly to shift responsibility for Li’s escape onto Guo Songlin.
先说他想『绕犯安溪』，又想『勾结同安土匪』，最后说由郭松林如何如何，是打算将李世贤『漏网』的责任，轻轻推到郭松林头上。


The reason for Zuo’s wish to deal with Guo could also be inferred.
至于左宗棠想『整』郭松林的缘故，亦可以推想得到。

After Lin Wencha’s death, Guo, commander of the Fushan Brigade, had been appointed acting land-force military commander of Fujian.
原来从林文察阵亡以后，福建陆路提督一缺便补了福山镇总兵的郭松林，

Acting or not, it was a promotion.
虽为署任，总是升官；

Had Zuo not requested the Jiangsu reinforcements, Guo might never have obtained this highest provincial military office.
而如没有左宗棠的奏请苏军援闽，这个武将中最高职衔的提督，请未见得轮得到郭松林。

Zuo reasoned that, since the promotion arose from service in Fujian and the post itself belonged to Fujian, both gratitude and the proper relationship between title and duty required Guo to enter his command.
照左宗棠的想法，郭松林的升官，既由援闽而来；而所升的官，又是福建的缺分，则不论感恩图报，还是循名责实，都该照建制归隶他的部下。

Yet despite repeated urgings from Governor Xu Zonggan, Guo refused to assume the appointment.
无如郭松林虽经福建巡抚徐宗干一再催促，始终不肯到任。

He fought in Fujian while holding a Fujian military office, but continued to regard himself as a visiting commander.
以福建的武官在福建打仗，却自居于客将的地位，

Zuo found that hard to tolerate.
在左宗棠是颇难容忍的；

Before Guo and Yang sailed south, however, Li had expressly stated that Guo would not take up the post and that he would not urge him to do so.
只是当郭杨两军航海南来之前，李鸿章 特为声明∶郭松林不履任，他亦『不劝驾』。

Zuo had agreed and could not now conveniently go back on his word.
左宗棠曾经同意，此时不便出尔反尔！

His resentment remained.
但又有所憾于郭松林，

He therefore planted a suggestion for future use: on one hand, his vague phrasing implied that pursuing Li Shixian was Guo’s responsibility; on the other, he could wait to see what happened.
因而此时先作一个伏笔，一方面隐约其词地表示，追击李世贤是郭松林的责任；另一方面可以看将来的情况，

If Tong’an’s bandits proved difficult to suppress, he could formally request that Guo remain in Fujian.
果真同安土匪一时不易收拾，便可正式奏请将郭松林留在福建——

A province’s own military commander suppressing its own bandits was an entirely proper arrangement.
以本省的提督剿本省的土匪，天经地义，名正言顺，

The court could scarcely refuse, Li would have to release him, and Guo would have to stay.
朝廷不能不准，李鸿章 不能不放，郭松林不能不留。


Once Zuo’s concealed manoeuvring was understood, Li’s memorial on the relief forces’ victory and the joint recovery of Zhangzhou became clear.
了然于左宗棠暗中的勾心斗角，再来看李鸿章 的『援闽获胜，会克漳州府』一折，才会恍然大悟，

Besides claiming distinction and rewards, it left the Jiangsu armies a means of disclaiming responsibility in advance.
除表功邀赏以外，还有预先为苏军留下卸责余地的作用。

Its account of the campaign was particularly precise about the sectors and dispositions of Guo’s and Yang’s forces.
因为折中铺叙战况，对于郭杨两军的防区及部署，说得特别详细，

First, it stated that Dongshan, ten li south of Zhangzhou on the main road to Zhangpu, was held by Guo with eight battalions.
一则谓∶『东山在漳州城南十里，系通漳浦大路，郭松林以八营扼之；

Another ten li farther lay Zhenmen, centrally placed between Dongshan, Haicheng, and Shima, where Yang held the ground with five battalions.
又十里为镇门，系东山、海澄、石码适中之地，杨鼎勋以五营扼之。

Haicheng County lay behind both armies, with mountain paths leading to Zhangpu; three more battalions had therefore been deployed inside and outside the county town to prevent a surprise attack on their rear.
海澄县为两军后路，有山径可通漳浦，复派三营分布县城内外，防贼抄袭。』

Second, it stated that Brigade Commander Liu Lianjie and Officer Wang Kaibang were in the northwest, while Military Commander Gao Liansheng, Huang Shaochun, and their forces were on the eastern route.
再则谓∶『总兵刘连捷、阜司王开榜在西北；提督高连升、黄少春等军在东路。

Once the Jiangsu troops occupied Dongshan, the southern route was cut.
自苏军扼扎东山，南路已断。』

Third, it recorded that the defeated rebels fled towards Nanjing County; the various battalions pursued for several li, then joined Gao, Huang, and the others in turning back southeast to clear all the rebel positions at Fangzi Bridge beyond the eastern gate, the Dongyue Temple, and the New Bridge near the southern gate.
三则谓∶『败逆向南靖一路纷逃，各营追剿数里，当会同高、黄等军，折回东南，将东关外放子桥、东岳庙及附近南门新桥各贼垒一律荡平。』

Every detail showed that, whether defending or attacking, Guo and Yang were chiefly responsible for Zhangzhou’s southern side, with its eastern side secondary.
处处可以看出，郭扬两军无论防守还是攻剿，都以担当漳州南面为主，东面其次；

Who, then, was responsible for Li’s escape through the western gate?
然则李世贤开西门而遁，责任谁属？

The answer was obvious.
不问可知。


After repeated examination, Xu concluded that Zuo was practising a dangerous form of political manipulation.
这样反复研判下来，许庚身认为左宗棠是在玩弄可怕的权术。

Since the war began, provincial commanders had habitually tried to drive rebels beyond their own borders.
从军兴以来，各省带兵大员，以驱贼出境为惯技；

Zuo, however, seemed deliberately to be making a neighbour bear the calamity, with some further malicious purpose concealed behind it.
而左宗棠则似乎有意以邻为壑，包藏着什么祸心。

The matter must be corrected early.
此非早作纠正不可。

Xu explained the consequences to Prince Gong, Wenxiang, and the others.
因此，他向恭王与文祥等人，指陈利害，

With the two empress dowagers informed, a court dispatch was drafted.
奏明两宫太后，拟发『廷寄』，

It first noted Li’s report that Zhangzhou had been recovered and the rebel Shi King had secretly escaped through its western gate.
首先指出李鸿章 已有奏报，漳州克复，『侍逆潜开西门而遁』；

It continued that, although the city was recovered, the chief rebel remained alive and would certainly join Wang Haiyang in further plans.
接下来便说，『漳州别经克复，而渠魁仍未授首，必将与汪逆合谋，计图复逞。

The southeastern routes were stable and Liu Mingdeng and others held the northeast in coordination, but Zhangpu, Yunxiao, Zhao’an, and Pinghe in the west remained in rebel hands.
现在东南两路局势既尚稳固；东北一路亦有刘明灯等联络扼守，而西面之漳浦、云霄、诏安、平和等城，均为贼踞，

There could be no doubt that the fugitives would try to escape that way.
该逆必思由此路窜走，已无疑义。

Fang Yao’s forces guarded Raoping and Dabu in Guangdong, but might be too few to cover the area.
粤省饶平、大埔一带，虽有方耀等军防守，尚恐兵力不敷分布，

Zuo and his colleagues were therefore to detach strong forces, make a circuit to the western route, join the Guangdong troops, and intercept the rebels, preventing them from crossing the border.
左宗棠等仍当分拨劲旅，绕赴西路，会同粤军，迎头拦截，杜其窜越之路。』

At this point, Zuo knew the moment had come to drive Guo Songtao from office.
到此地步，左宗棠知道撵走郭嵩焘的时机成熟了。

He had already laid groundwork for Jiang Yili, using Li Hongzhang as a favourable comparison.
在此以前，他曾为蒋益澧下过一次伏笔；并用李鸿章 作为陪衬，来提高蒋益澧的地位。

Early in the ninth month, when Ruilin and Guo fell out, Zuo had added a remark to his memorial requesting withdrawal of the order placing the armies of three provinces under his control: fighting in Liangguang might continue indefinitely, but if it had commanders such as Li Hongzhang and Jiang Yili, perhaps the disorder could be brought to an end.
这一伏笔，下在九月初，瑞麟与郭嵩焘交恶之时，而于『恳请收回节制三省各军成命』的奏折中，附带一提∶『恐两广兵事，尚无已时，若得治军之才如李鸿章 、蒋益澧其人，祸乱庶有豸乎！』

The implication was that Li should become governor-general there and Jiang governor of Guangdong.
意思是最好将李鸿章 调为粤督，而以蒋益澧升任粤抚；

This was a tentative hint, and the court had given no explicit response.
这是隐约其词的试探，朝廷即令没有明确的反应，

Yet the impression that Jiang could govern a province had been planted in the minds of the Western Empress Dowager and the grand councillors.
但蒋益澧可当方面之任的印象，却已在西宫太后与军机大臣的脑中留下了。


Zuo still could not openly recommend Jiang for promotion and transfer to Guangdong.
此时当然还不能明保蒋益澧升调广东；

Instead, he attacked Guo and supported Jiang in an attached memorandum on Guangdong’s military affairs and finances.
是用夹片的方式，在『陈明广东兵事饷事』中，攻郭保蒋。

It began by declaring that the province’s military condition would not bear examination, and its finances scarcely bore inquiry.
首先就说∶『广东一省兵事实足观，而饷事亦不可问。

The war had lasted a long time, it said; in some provinces military strength had grown from weakness, whereas Guangdong, once fierce, was now feeble.
军兴既久，各省兵事或由弱转强，粤则昔悍而今弩矣！

In some provinces funds had gradually recovered from scarcity, whereas Guangdong, once rich, was now exhausted.
各省饷事或由匮而渐裕，粤则昔饶而今竭矣！』

Those two sentences alone attacked the governors and governors-general of the preceding two years.
光是这两句话，便将近两年的督抚一起攻击在内；

Naturally, Guo bore more responsibility than Ruilin, since he had been in office longer.
当然，郭嵩焘的责任应更重于瑞麟，因为他在任之日比瑞麟久。



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第十章（本章第2部分，共3部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


The memorandum then concentrated upon military finance, which was precisely the governor’s responsibility.
接着便专责饷事，而此正是巡抚的职责；

Although Guo Songtao was never named, most of the attack fell upon him, with particular emphasis on the likin collected in prosperous Chaozhou.
其中并无一语提及郭嵩焘的名字，而大部分的攻击却集中在郭嵩焘身上，特别提到广东富饶之区的潮州厘税。

Zuo declared that, on reaching Dabu, he had met officials, gentry, and ordinary people from Chaozhou and inquired into its taxes.
左宗棠是这样指责∶『臣抵大埔，接晤潮郡官绅士民，询及潮郡厘税，

The levies on miscellaneous merchandise and imported opium, Shantou’s trade levy, and the shipping contribution together yielded only a little over thirty thousand taels annually—not enough to pay six thousand men for a single month.
合计杂货之厘、洋药之厘、汕头行厘、船捐，每年所得，共止三万余两，是一年所入，不足六千人一月之饷也。

If so rich a prefecture in eastern Guangdong produced so little, the condition elsewhere could be inferred.
潮州为粤东腴郡，而厘税之少如此，外此已可类推。』

This deliberately distorted the facts.
这是有意歪曲事实。

Ever since Qian Jiang had introduced likin, a tax collected on goods, Guangdong had been the most difficult place in which to impose it.
从钱江创设就货征税的厘金以来，最难办的就是广东；

On first taking office, Guo had submitted a joint memorial with Governor-General Mao Hongbin explaining the circumstances.
当郭嵩焘莅任之初，就曾会同总督毛鸿宾奏明。


Guangdong differed from other provinces chiefly because of foreign interference.
广东办厘的情形，有异于他省，主要的原因是洋人的牵掣。

Macau lay to its west and Hong Kong to its east.
广东的形势，『澳门据其西，香港绕其东，

The strategic outlets of the provincial waterways were in foreign hands, and Hong Kong in particular had become a gathering place for merchant firms.
所有省河扼要海口，其地全属之洋人，而香港尤为行户屯聚之地。

One or two great establishments had moved there to place themselves under foreign protection and further their private interests.
一二大行店皆移设香港，以图倚附夷人，便其私计，

The provincial authorities dared not approach them about contributions or likin.
一切劝捐抽厘，从不敢一过问。

Others wishing to evade payment likewise lodged their goods in Hong Kong.
其有意规避捐输者，亦多寄顿香港，希图幸免。

The major trades all used it as a point of transfer.
统计出入各货，凡大宗经纪，皆由香港转输。

Other provinces merely had to prevent evasion; Guangdong also had a refuge to which evaders could withdraw.
是他省但防偷漏之途，而粤东兼有逋逃之薮。』

Local customs posed another difference.
其次是广东的风气与他省不同。

Guangdong’s gentry often undertook the collection of taxes and contributions.
广东的士绅，往往包揽税捐；

When likin began, unscrupulous gentry contracted to collect it and enriched themselves by extortion, harming both the public revenue and private interests.
厘金开办之初，亦由劣绅承包，任令侵渔中饱。而公私交受其病。

When collection was subsequently returned to officials, the former contractors resented the loss of their privilege and incited disorder.
其后收为官办，则原来包厘的劣绅，因为失去特权，心有不甘，从中煽动捣乱，

Mobs destroying likin offices were nothing unusual.
聚众捣毁厘局之事，不足为奇；

Timid officials dared not punish the instigators.
官府胆怯怕事，不敢惩办祸首，

Instead they dismissed the collecting officers or transferred prefects and magistrates in hopes of compromise.
反而撤去委员，或调动府县地方官，以裘发协。

The more they yielded, the harder the problem became.
而结果是越迁就，越棘手。


After taking office, Guo reorganized likin on the principles of eliminating private skimming and making the system reasonable.
从郭嵩焘到任后，以易除中饮，讲求合情合理的宗旨整顿厘捐，

He achieved considerable results.
颇有成效，

Offices were established successively in places where none had existed, including Qiongzhou, Lianzhou, and Heyuan in Huizhou.
从未设局的琼州府、廉州以及惠州的河源等地，次第开办。

Chaozhou, however, lay in a remote eastern corner of the province and had long remained beyond effective control.
至于潮州，就广东而言，偏处东隅，久成化外，

Only when Wang Haiyang approached the Guangdong border did Zhang Xian, intendant of the Chaozhou-Jiaying-Huizhou circuit, find a way to begin collection.
直到汪海洋逼近广东边境时，方由潮嘉惠道张铣，设法开办；

The amount was small, but it was a beginning.
数目虽少，但总是一个开端。

Chaozhou’s people would discuss anything if approached tactfully and in accordance with local circumstances; coercion merely made them refuse.
潮州的民风，因势利导，好话说在前面，无事不可商量；强制硬压，则偏不服从。

Zhang believed that, once they accepted likin in principle, the amount could gradually increase.
张铣的意思是，只要潮州肯承认厘捐，以后可以陆续增加；

Moreover, with the rebels pressing near, a quarrel between the authorities and local society over taxation would be extremely dangerous.
而况贼势方急，官府与绅民之间，为此先起争执，是件极危险的事。

Guo fully agreed.
这个看法，郭嵩焘深以为然；

Zuo, deliberately disregarding these facts, stressed the mere thirty thousand taels collected each year without mentioning how hard won that sum was, or how collecting thirty thousand now offered hope of three hundred thousand later.
但左宗棠有意抹煞事实，只强调每年只收得三万银子，却不说这三万银子来之不易，而只要能收此三万，以后三十万亦有希望。

Most maliciously, he also exaggerated Guangdong Customs revenue. He said he had heard that its various ports collected no less than two million taels annually, while the amount remitted to the capital could not be ascertained.
最恶毒的是，左宗棠又夸大广东海关的收入∶『闻海关各口所收，每岁不下二百万两，其解京之数，无从稽考。

If the governor-general and governor could arrange to use it, the regular imperial remittances need not suffer and provincial military finance would benefit greatly.
此项若能由督抚设法筹办，于正供固期无误；而于该省筹饷大局，实裨益非浅。

But this involved an arrangement two hundred years old, he added, which a provincial official dared not lightly question.
特此为二百年旧制，非外臣所敢轻议。』

He then recommended Jiang.
接下来便是保蒋益澧了。

Having entered Guangdong with a visiting army, he could not refrain from reporting what he had observed.
他说∶『臣率客军入粤，偶有闻见，自不敢不据实直陈。

Coordinating troops and funds was a great responsibility requiring an administrator of exceptional ability.
至兵饷兼筹，任大责重，非明于开济之才，不能胜任。

Jiang Yili, Zhejiang’s provincial treasurer, possessed unrivalled talent and judgment several degrees above his own.
浙江市政使蒋益澧，才气无双，识略高臣数等，

If the emperor ordered Jiang to Guangdong to direct military affairs and raise funds, the current situation would surely improve.
若蒙天恩，调令赴粤督办军务，兼筹军饷，于粤东目前时局，必有所济。』

This was a forceful recommendation indeed.
这就是所谓力保。

Its force lay in the claim of unrivalled talent and judgment superior to Zuo’s.
力保之『力』，端在一句话上∶『才气无双，识略高臣数等。』

Praise of that kind from a governor-general commanding military operations in three provinces carried extraordinary weight.
以节制三省军务的总督，如此推崇，分量实在太重了。


Zuo regarded himself as another Zhuge Liang and habitually looked down upon everyone.
左宗棠以诸葛武侯自命，目空一切，

Such humble admiration was quite unlike him.
竟这样降心推崇，也实在不类他的为人。

A rumour therefore circulated: the secretary responsible for memorials in the Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general’s office had received ten thousand taels from Jiang and insisted upon adding the ten Chinese characters asserting Jiang’s unrivalled talent and superior judgment.
因此有人传了来一个内幕，说是闽浙总督衙门主章 奏的幕友，受了蒋益澧一万银子的红包，力主加这『才气无双，识略高臣数等』十个字；

If true, the payment amounted to a thousand taels per character.
如果流言属实，算起来是一字千金。

Whether there had been a bribe was unknown.
不过，行贿之说，虽不可知；

On the merits of the situation, however, those ten characters were indispensable.
而就事论事，却非有此十字不可。

The grand councillors knew Jiang’s abilities and generally considered him unfit to govern a province.
蒋益澧的才具如何，军机大臣大都了解；无不以为他难当方面之任。

Although Zuo had hinted that he should replace Guo and had used Li as a favourable comparison to raise his standing, the court had consistently pretended not to hear.
是故虽经左宗棠在奏折中暗示，他可代郭而为粤抚，并利用李鸿章 作陪衬，来抬高他的身价；而朝廷始终装聋作哑。

Now the ten characters thundered too loudly to ignore.
现在左宗棠的这十个字，分量之重，如雷灌耳，

It could no longer pretend deafness, but it could pretend stupidity.
那就装不得聋，作不得哑了。不过，装聋不许，却可装傻，

Deliberately overlooking the implied request, the court granted only what had been asked on the surface.
朝廷有意不理左宗棠的暗示；只如他表面所请，

On the eighth day of the first month of the fifth year of Tongzhi, it ordered Jiang, as provincial treasurer of Zhejiang, to proceed swiftly to Guangdong to handle military affairs and arrange provisions and pay.
在同治五年正月初八降旨∶『着浙江布政使蒋益澧，驰赴广东办理军务，兼筹粮饷。』


By the time Zuo submitted the recommendation, he was confident of recovering Jiaying, where Wang Haiyang had entrenched himself.
当保荐蒋益澧的奏折拜发之时，左宗棠对克复汪海洋所盘踞的嘉应州，已有把握。

A general assault on the twelfth day of the twelfth month brought a decisive victory, and Wang was killed in the gunfire.
在十二月十二发动总攻，一仗大捷，汪海洋为乱枪所杀；

Ten days later the operation was complete.
十天以后，克竟全功。

At the year’s end, Zuo memorialized that Jiaying had been recovered, the rebel leaders exterminated, and the remaining forces swept away.
左宗棠在年底拜折∶『收复嘉应州城，贼首歼灭净尽，余孽荡平。』

This amounted to the final suppression of the Taiping remnants.
这一下等于肃清了长毛余孽，

Zuo would return to his own post, and the armies would be sent back to their respective provinces.
左宗棠本人班师回任，各军遣归本省；

What military affairs, then, was Jiang to handle in Guangdong, and for what troops was he to raise supplies?
然则蒋益澧『驰赴广东』，办何『军务』，筹何『粮饷』？

If someone influential asked that question, his new appointment might be revoked.
如果有力者作此一回，蒋益澧的新命，就可能撤消。

Zuo had of course anticipated it.
左宗棠当然早就计议及此，

He used another matter to press Guo still harder: Gao Liansheng was to take his troops with him when assuming office.
于是借题发挥，对郭嵩焘逼得更紧了。所借的题目是『高连升带所部赴任』。

Gao’s substantive post was land-force military commander of Guangdong.
高连升的本职是『广东陆路提督』；

With Zuo’s command over the three-province campaign at an end, Gao should naturally report to Guangdong.
如今左宗棠节制三省军务的任务告一段落，自回本省，则高连升亦应有广东履任。

A military commander taking up office needed no force beyond his own headquarters guard.
提督到职，除本标亲兵以外，无须另带人马；

Zuo nevertheless instructed him to bring his entire command.
而左宗棠却嘱咐高连升尽携所部赴新任。

The stated reason was to maintain order after the upheaval, while public feeling remained unsettled.
表面上的理由是大乱初平，民心不定，『以资镇压』；

The real object was to burden Guangdong.
实际上是有意给广东出难题，

Gao had five thousand men, requiring at least thirty thousand taels a month, which Guangdong would have to provide.
因为高连升所部有五千人，每月至少亦要三万金银子的饷银，当然归广东负担。


Guangdong welcomed Gao but not his army.
可是，广东欢迎高连升，却不欢迎高连长的部队。

Zuo consequently complained to the throne in forceful terms.
于是左宗棠上奏指责广东，大发牢骚，

He had done everything possible for Guangdong, he said, yet the province made difficulties and wanted him to order Gao’s men back to Fujian.
说是『臣扪心自问，所以为广东谋者，不为不至，而广东顾难之。欲臣一概檄饬高连升所部为旋闽，

He could not understand it.
兹则臣所不解也。

If Guangdong maintained that Fujian should still pay them, then let it consider its arrears: more than three hundred thousand taels of promised assistance to Fujian remained unpaid.
如谓高连升军饷仍应由闽支领，则试为广东筹之，应解协闽之饷，约尚有三十余万两，

Another fifty thousand or more was owed for sending refugees back to their provinces, relief and reduced-price grain sales in Jiaying and Zhenping, and the rice he had allocated to Bao Chao’s army.
此次资遣各省难民及嘉应州、镇平县赈恤平粜米粮及臣均拨鲍超一军军米价银，应由广东解还归款者亦约五万余两。

If all these sums were applied to Gao’s pay, Fujian’s own money would sustain the Fujian force for roughly a year.
即以此款悉数移充高连升军饷，以闽饷济闽军，约足一年之需；

By then disorder would have subsided, and gradual disbandment would still be timely.
一年之后，诸患渐平，陆续裁撤此军，亦未为晚。』

Interprovincial military subsidies formed accounts that could never be finally settled. Who owed what to whom was perpetually disputed.
各省协饷，哪一省亏欠哪一省，是笔永远算不清的帐，

In the end, being able to fight supplied an argument; winning supplied a stronger one.
反正能打仗就有理∶打胜仗更有理。

Zuo understood this perfectly and spoke with assurance, his confidence making his case seem all the more just.
左宗棠对这一层了解得最透彻，所以能够侃侃而言，气壮更显得理直。

His memorials often ended with general reflections.
左宗棠的折报，常在最后发议论，

This one did too.
此折亦不例外，

In attacking Guo, he extended his censure to Guangdong itself.
因为打击郭嵩焘的缘故，殃及广东，

The coastal troubles had originated there, he declared, and so had the rebellion that afflicted the central plains.
亦被恶声∶『伏思海疆之患，起于广东；中原盗贼之患，亦起于广东，

Now that the campaign was over, those responsible for soldiers and funds should learn from the past and strengthen their position.
当此军务甫竣之时，有筹兵筹饷之者，应如何惩前毖后，以图自强？

If they continued to mistake dullness for generosity and evasion for ability, clever in petty calculations but blind to major strategy, they could scarcely relieve the court’s concern for the south.
若仍以庸暗为宽厚；以诿卸为能事，明于小计，暗于大谋，恐未足纾朝廷南顾之忧也。

He requested an order directing Guangdong’s senior officials to deliberate carefully, and an imperial decision permitting Gao to bring his troops.
合无请旨敕下广东督抚熟思审处，仍檄高连升带所部赴任之处，出自圣裁。』

As with the earlier recommendation of Jiang, someone in Zuo’s secretariat who had received a gratuity copied the memorial privately and sent it to Zhejiang.
这个奏折，象以前所保蒋益澧的奏折一样。左宗棠幕府中得了红包的人，密抄折底，寄达浙江，

Jiang was a rough man, but he had perceptive advisers.
蒋益澧虽是粗材，但毕竟也还有高人，

They told him promotion was near.
告诉他说∶高升之期已不在远。

Overjoyed, he had sealing strips printed for the governor of Guangdong and began preparing to take office.
蒋益澧喜不可言，随即刻印了广东巡抚的封条，准备打点上任了。


The most effective feature of the memorial was its use of Ruilin to attack Guo.
这个奏折最厉害之处，是在借瑞麟以攻郭嵩焘。

The matter had begun with an official communication from Ruilin, and Zuo’s aggressive language initially named him.
事由瑞麟一咨而起，左宗棠的咄咄逼人的笔锋，在前面亦都指出瑞麟；

The implication was that, if the attack on Guo failed, it would turn upon Ruilin.
这是暗示，如果攻郭无效，便要转而攻端了。

Everyone at court knew the quality of Ruilin’s administration.
瑞鹿在广东的政绩如何？朝中大臣，尽人皆知；

Prince Gong and Wenxiang, however much more capable than certain Manchu dignitaries who had wielded power in the Daoguang and Xianfeng reigns, still believed that he must be preserved.
而恭王与文祥，较之道光、咸丰两朝若干用事的满州权贵，虽不知高明多少？但亦认为瑞麟必须保全，

First, since the war began, nine-tenths of the governors and governors-general had become Han Chinese, an unprecedented situation for the dynasty.
因为第一，军兴以来，督抚十分之九为汉人，此是清朝开国以来所未有之事。

Only Huguang and Liangguang were presently held by bannermen.
眼前亦仅只湖广、两广是旗人；

If Zuo’s relentless impeachment forced Ruilin’s removal, there was no suitable senior bannerman readily available to replace him.
倘或左宗棠对瑞麟参劾不已，逼得朝廷非调不可，一时却没有适当的旗下大员，可以承乏。

Second, Ruilin had Empress Dowager Cixi’s powerful support and could not be touched.
其次，瑞麟有慈禧太后的奥援，动他不得。

Third, though mediocre, he was obedient.
第三，瑞麟虽是庸材，但很听话；

The Imperial Household Department’s finances were closely connected with Guangdong Customs; an obedient governor-general in Guangzhou made many things convenient.
尤其内务府的经费，跟粤海关有很大的关连，能有个听话的粤督在广州，诸事方便。

The court therefore had to placate Zuo, both to preserve Ruilin and because the warning about continued danger in the south had aroused concern.
因此，朝廷就必须安抚左宗棠，不但为了保全瑞麟，亦因为由『恐未足纾朝廷南顾之忧』这句话而起了警惕。

The resulting edict rebuked Ruilin severely. After Zuo’s victorious withdrawal, it said, Guangdong would still have much to do in settling surrendered soldiers, hunting bandits, and restoring order.
所以上谕中责备瑞麟，措词相当严厉∶『左宗棠凯旋后，粤省安插降卒，搜诛土匪，善后之事方多；

Strong troops should remain to enforce peace.
正当留扎劲兵，以资镇压。

Since Ruilin had urged Gao to assume his substantive command, why now ask Zuo to send the force back to Fujian?
瑞麟既咨催高连升赴广东提督本任，何以反令左宗棠将其部典檄饬回闽？

If renewed disorder after its withdrawal required another campaign, could the acting governor-general bear such grave responsibility?
倘闽军凯撤，而降卒土匪又复滋生事端，重烦兵力，该署督其能当此重咎耶？』


The edict then granted Zuo’s request in full. Gao’s five thousand and more men required only a little over thirty thousand taels a month.
接下来便是悉如左宗棠所请∶『高连升所部五千余人，计每月饷需不过三万余两。

Zuo was to order him to proceed with his troops, and Ruilin and Guo were to provide their pay monthly, without the slightest shortage or arrears that might impede operations.
即着左宗棠檄饬该提督带所部赴任，月饷由瑞麟、郭嵩焘按月筹给，不准丝毫短少蒂欠，致有掣肘之患！』

Ruilin lost face under this rebuke, but his career was preserved.
瑞麟的受这顿申斥，当然很失面子，但前程是保住了；

The man whose career was not preserved was Guo, who had not been rebuked.
保不住前程的是末受申斥的郭嵩焘。

The court meant to sacrifice Guo in exchange for Zuo’s “loyalty” while keeping Ruilin.
朝廷的意思是决意保全瑞麟，牺牲郭嵩焘来换取左宗棠的『忠诚』。

Yet its edicts constantly proclaimed complete impartiality in appointments and administration.
不过上谕于『用人行政』，动辄申明，『一秉大公』，

Both governor and governor-general bore responsibility for delays in Guangdong’s military affairs; removing one and leaving the other untouched would be difficult to justify.
而广东军务的贻误，督抚同罪，不该一个被黜、一个无事。

An unwritten form of “fairness” therefore came into play: rebuke without punishment for one, punishment without rebuke for the other.
所以运用『打而不罚』，『罚而不打』这个不成文的『公平』之理，

Ruilin had received his rebuke; the absence of one for Guo foreshadowed his dismissal.
对瑞麟严加申饬是已打不罚；而对郭嵩焘之不『打』，正是将『罚』的先声。

Only seven or eight days later, two edicts concerning Guangdong appeared on the same day.
不过七八天的功夫，有关广东的政局，一日连发两谕，

A public decree issued through the Grand Secretariat summoned Guo to the capital and appointed Jiang governor of Guangdong.
一道是由内阁『明发』，『着郭嵩焘来京，以蒋益澧为广东巡抚』；

A court dispatch, sent to Zhejiang, Guangdong, and Fujian with urgency just below the highest six-hundred-li express rate, addressed Ma Xinyi’s reports on inspecting the coast, rebuilding war vessels, and whether Jiang should still proceed to Guangdong now that fighting there had ended.
另一道是仅次于『六百里加紧』的紧急军报的『廷寄』，分饬浙江、广东及福建，写的是∶马新贻奏∶巡视海口情形，酌议改造战船；粤省军事已定，藩司蒋益澧应否前往各一折。

Effective vessels and weapons, it said, were essential against maritime raiders.
官军搜捕洋盗，全赖船械得力，方能奏效。

Ma’s proposal to rebuild thirty red-banner Guangdong boats, combine them with the ten already under Zhang Qiguang, and distribute the forty among Wenzhou and other strategic ports was sound.
马新贻见拟改造红单广艇三十号，合之张其光原带广艇十只，共计四十号，分派温州等处各要口；

So was the purchase of one or two foreign steamships for mobile pursuit.
并购买外国轮船一两只，以为游击搜剿之用，所筹尚属周妥，

Both were approved.
均着照所请行。

Ma was to direct coastal officers to patrol vigorously with the vessels already available and suppress the remaining bandits without negligence.
仍着马新贻督饬沿海各将弁，就见有师船，认真巡缉，搜捕余匪，以靖地方，毋得稍涉疏懈。

The dispatch then announced Jiang’s appointment as governor, ordered him to hand over his duties and leave promptly, and charged him with energetic reform of military affairs, administration, and finance.
本日已明降谕旨；授蒋益澧为广东巡抚。即着蒋益澧赶紧交卸起程，前赴新任。蒋益澧经朝廷擢膺疆寄，责任非轻，到任后将军务吏治及筹饷各事宜，力加整顿，以期日有起色；

He must not disappoint the court through habitual delay.
毋得稍蹈因循积习，致负委任。

The dispatch was to travel by the five-hundred-li express service.
将此由五百里各谕令知之。


Zuo had driven Guo from office in order to gain Guangdong as part of his own sphere.
左宗棠驱逐郭嵩焘是为了想占得广东这个地盘。

On the surface, he had succeeded.
这个目的在表面看，算是达到了；

In reality, he had not.
其实不然。

The court had yielded to pressure in accepting his emphatic recommendation, but the combined judgment of its leading men still had resources for dealing with an imperious commander.
朝廷接纳左宗棠对蒋益澧的力保，虽说是要挟之下，不得不然；但到底集众之力对付独断独行的左宗棠，毕竟有其深谋远虑的过人之处。

Before long, discerning observers could see that the men in power at the centre had made the better move.
没有多久，明眼人都可以看得出来，到头来是朝中用事的人，棋高一着。

First, the court already had preliminary plans to employ Zuo in another important undertaking.
第一，朝廷已有初步的打算，还要重用左宗棠，

It could therefore make a special show of favour over Jiang’s appointment to bind him more closely.
因而借他力保蒋益澧这件事上，特加词色，以为笼络；

Second, Guangdong’s wealth was famous, and the province had long supplied the Imperial Household Department’s public and private demands.
第二，广东的富庶，早就有名，而且一向是内务府公私需索之地，

During more than a decade of Taiping devastation in the southeast, Guangdong had suffered comparatively little.
十多年来，洪杨荼毒遍东南，但广东受灾极轻。

Earlier, the need for military funds had forced the court to defer to Zeng Guofan’s recommendations concerning its senior appointments.
不过早年为了筹饷，广东督抚不得不迁就膺专阃之寄的曾国藩的保荐。

Now that the fighting was over, the time had come to reclaim authority.
事平以后，情况不同，收权之时已到；

But Zeng’s influence was an obstacle, and Guo’s background and administrative record made it impossible to remove him casually without a serious fault.
但一则碍着曾国藩，再则以郭嵩焘的出身与居官的绩效，如无重大过失，不能随便调动，

With Ruilin beside him as a comparison, any honest reform of Guangdong’s administration ought to begin with Ruilin.
尤其是有瑞麟在，相形对比，如说要整饬广东吏治，首先该调的应该是瑞麟而不是郭嵩焘。

At the least, both men should go.
即令退一步来看，至少亦该瑞郭同调；

Otherwise the repeated declarations of impartiality would become mere deception.
否则谕旨中一再申明的『用人行政，一秉大公』等等冠冕堂皇的话，就变成欺人之谈了。

Zuo’s determined attack on Guo offered a rare opportunity to recover control.
难得左宗棠力攻郭嵩焘，却好可用来作为收权的途径。

Guo was hard to dismiss; Jiang would be easy.
黜郭不易；要黜蒋益澧容易得很。

His background, standing, and abilities were all unsuitable for provincial government.
因为论他的出身资望与才具，都不适方面之任；

A future edict could move him with little difficulty and no complaint.
将来一纸上谕，轻易调动，决不会有人说闲话。

There was another advantage: compared with Jiang, Ruilin would look quite qualified to govern Liangguang.
再有层好处，便是有蒋益澧的比照；瑞麟当两广总督，便显得很够格了。

In the eighth month, therefore, Ruilin’s acting appointment was made substantive.
所以八月间降旨，瑞麟的两广总督真除；由署理变为实授。


On that same day, the seventeenth of the eighth month in the fifth year of Tongzhi, two further edicts appeared. One reported that Yang Yuebin, governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu, pleaded inadequate ability and worsening illness and requested release from office.
同一天——同治五年八月十七，另有两道上谕∶一道是陕甘总督杨岳斌奏∶『才力不及，病势日增，恳请开缺』；

Zuo was transferred to replace him.
调左宗棠为陕甘总督。

The other explained that Yang had proved ill suited to the people and locality and had achieved no effective results.
另一道说∶『杨岳斌于人地不甚相宜，办理未能有效；

The court’s concern for the western frontier was profound.
眷顾西陲，实深廑系。

Zuo’s prestige, strategic knowledge, and ability to handle both military and civil affairs made him the proper choice to suppress the Hui rebellion swiftly and pacify the borderlands.
左宗棠威望素著，熟谙韧略，于军务地方，俱能措置裕如；因特授为陕甘总督，以期迅扫回氛，绥靖边陲。』

The edict thus expressly entrusted him with the great task of settling the northwest.
是特为表明，赋左宗棠以平服西北的重任。

Under customary procedure, an intended appointee to a major provincial post would first be summoned to the capital.
照历来的规制，封疆大臣的调动，首先将预定的人选召赴到京，

If his audience satisfied the emperor, a public edict followed, after which he received instructions and departed.
陛见称旨，方始明发上谕；然后『请训』出京。

If a direct appointment bypassed that procedure, the new official should himself request an audience and instructions.
如果不经这一番程序，直接降旨调补，那末新任就该自请陛见请训；

A transfer generally implied intended reform, and he needed to ascertain the court’s wishes.
意思是此一调动，必含有除旧布新的整顿之意在内。朝廷的希望如何，必先探询明白，所以应该请训。

There were exceptions: urgent military circumstances might make delay impossible, in which case the edict could explicitly direct him to proceed immediately without coming to the capital.
当然，亦有例外，例如军情紧急，不容耽误，便可在上谕中明示∶『即赴新任，毋庸来京请训。』

Zuo’s appointment contained just such a direction.
对左宗棠的新命，即是如此。


That was the outward explanation.
不过，这是表面的看法，

There was another reason beneath it. Travelling from the southeast to his new northwestern post by way of the capital, then through Shanxi into Shaanxi and Gansu, would not have been especially troublesome.
实际上另有文章.因为左宗棠由东南旧任赴西北新任，绕道京师，由山西入秦陇，并不算太费事；

Moreover, the Hui rebellion had persisted for some time and did not demand the immediate suppression required by a newly emerging danger.
而况回乱势缓，已经历相当时日，与防患将然，深恐一发不可收拾，愈早扑灭愈好的情况不同。

The real reason for preventing an audience was that the Grand Council, boards, and other offices had already experienced Zuo’s methods.
而所以阻止他赴京请训，只为左宗棠的手段，军机处及各部院都领教过了，

He demanded money and men without end.
要饷要人，需索不已；

Once in the capital, he might refuse to leave for his post until every demand was met.
一旦到京，非满足他的要求不到任，

Why invite that difficulty?
岂不麻烦？

Better simply to keep him away.
所以索性不要他上京。

The transfer edict reached Fuzhou more than twenty days later.
调任的上谕到达福州时，已在二十天之后。

Zuo was then preparing extensive lists of recommendations for rewards.
其时左宗棠正在大办『保案』，

Those who had helped suppress the remaining rebels in Fujian and Guangdong naturally expected a place; those who had not exerted themselves sought influence and intercession by every means to have their names added.
肃清福建广东残匪，出了力的人，固然个个有分；不曾出力的，亦千方百计，夤缘请托，希翼在保案上加个名字。

Fuzhou filled with official hats and carriages and became extraordinarily lively.
一时福州城内『冠盖云集』，热闹非凡；

When news of Zuo’s transfer spread, the men awaiting appointment in Fujian who had already secured the necessary connections for military promotions were deeply disappointed.
及至传出左宗棠调督陕甘的消息，在福建候补，已搭上了线，可以借军功升官补缺的人，无不大为失望，

Their patron had not fallen, but he had moved away, leaving them without support they could use.
因为靠山虽然未倒，却已移了地方，无可倚恃了。


Hu was also in Fuzhou.
胡雪岩这时也在福州。

To reward his service in supplying arms, provisions, and military funds from Shanghai, Zuo had prepared a separate memorandum and waited for his arrival before sending it with a memorial.
左宗棠为了酬谢他在上海接济军火粮饷的功劳，特地备好一个『附片』，等他到了，方始随折拜发。

It specially recommended Hu for advancement.
这个『附片』是专保胡雪岩加官；

A recommendation submitted individually, outside the general list, was called confidential and differed in effect from an open recommendation by list.
不列入名单而单独保荐，称为『密保』，效用与开单『明保』，不大相同，

Its language was naturally emphatic.
措词当然极有分量，

Hu Guangyong, it said, held the honorary rank of judicial commissioner and was eligible for appointment as a circuit intendant in Fujian.
说是∶『按察使衔福建补用道胡光墉，

Since Zuo’s entry into Zhejiang, he had handled every commission satisfactorily.
自臣入浙，委办诸务，悉臻妥协。

After Hangzhou’s recovery, his work in local reconstruction had been highly effective.
杭州克复后，在籍筹办善后，极为得力；

His devotion to public causes, loyalty, and sincere exertions far exceeded ordinary achievements in relief.
其急公好义，实心实力，迥非寻常办理赈抚劳绩可比。

As Zuo moved from Zhejiang to Fujian and Guangdong, Hu had repeatedly arranged arms and provisions, sending continuous shipments that invariably arrived when required and met the army’s needs.
迨臣自浙而闽而粤，叠次委办军火军糈，络绎转运，无不应期而至，克济军需。』

Zuo therefore requested an exceptional reward to encourage such service: might Hu be granted the honorary rank of provincial treasurer?
是故恳请『破格优奖，以昭激励，可否赏加布政使衔』。



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第十章（本章第3部分，共3部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Advancement was naturally what Hu desired.
加官自是胡雪岩所希望的；

Yet what particularly excited him was not the title of provincial treasurer itself, but the change of hat insignia it permitted.
不过，使他特别兴奋的，还不在布政使这个衔头，而加了布政使衔，便可改换顶戴。

His existing honorary rank, judicial commissioner, belonged to the upper third grade and carried a bright blue finial.
原衔按察使——臬司是正三品，戴的是亮蓝顶子；

Provincial treasurer belonged to the lower second grade: he could wear a red one.
布政使——藩司是从二品，便可以戴红顶子了。

For a man who had entered officialdom by purchase, attaining a red finial was extremely difficult.
捐班出身的官儿，戴到红顶子，极不容易；

For a merchant, it was almost unheard of, apart from one or two salt merchants specially favoured in the Qianlong reign.
买卖人戴红顶子，更是绝无仅有的事；除非象乾隆年间的盐商那样出自特恩，但亦只有一两个人。

Remembering the source of his good fortune, Hu reflected that, although Zuo had recommended the honour he was about to receive, without Wang Youling there could have been no present success.
是故饮水思源，想起将有得戴的红顶子，虽出自左宗棠的保荐；但没有王有龄，何有今日？

He therefore made a special visit to Wang’s ancestral home.
因而又特地到王有龄的老家去了一趟——

Providing for Wang’s surviving family was his first concern at every festival and New Year; this visit was solely to remember the old friendship, weep, and offer sacrifice.
赡恤王氏遗属，是胡雪岩逢年过节的第一件大事；这次登门，完全是感念旧情，哭奠一番。

He had hoped to visit the grave as well, but an important undertaking kept him desperately busy.
本来还想亲谒墓门，无奈有件大事在办，忙得不可开交；

That would have to wait until the official business was finished.
只好等公事完了再说。


The undertaking was the plan to build steamships themselves.
这件大事就是打算自己造轮船。

Zuo possessed an iron determination: once he had set his mind on something, he could not rest until it was put into practice.
左宗棠的意志强毅，蓄志之事，非见诸实行，不能甘心。

His orders to direct the Fujian campaign had prevented personal attention to the project, but he had not abandoned it.
当时奉命入闽督师，不能躬亲料理，却并未搁下，

He entrusted it to the man he most trusted, Hu.
委托了一个他最信任的人，就是胡雪岩。

In dealings with foreigners, Hu invariably sought Gu’s help.
有关跟洋人打交道的事，胡雪岩必求救于古应春；

Gu had wide connections and saw no need to employ Giquel and d’Aiguebelle.
他的路子很广，认为造轮船不必找日意格、德克碑。

In steamships, railways, and firearms, he thought, the United States was catching up with and surpassing the older Western powers.
方今泰西各国，讲到轮船、铁路、火器的粮良，美国有后来居上之势。

Americans also seemed easier to deal with: in his view, they lacked the cunning of the British, the arrogance of the French, the stubbornness of the Germans, and the deviousness of the Japanese.
同时美国人不似英国人的狡猾、法国人的蛮横、德国人的顽固、日本人的阴险，比较易于相处。

Hu thought differently.
可是胡雪岩另有看法，

Britain possessed the greatest foreign influence in China, France the next.
外国在华势力，英国最大，法国其次。

Only France could be used to check Britain.
要制抑英国的势力，只有利用法国；

Americans and British were of the same stock, he reasoned, so cooperation with Americans would in effect help British expansion.
美国与英国同种，所以与美国合作，等于帮助英国扩张势力。

Moreover, Giquel and d’Aiguebelle had originated the proposal.
同时，日意格与德克碑是原始创议之人，

To abandon them without cause would be dishonourable.
无故背弃，道义有亏。


There was another reason Hu did not mention, though Gu, after their years together, could infer it.
其实胡雪岩还有一层没有说出来的意思；古应春与他多年相处，亦能揣摩得到——

Zuo’s rivalry with Li over power and advantage had almost become irreconcilable.
左宗棠与李鸿章 争权夺利，几已成不两立之势，

Li’s dealings with foreigners relied heavily upon the British Inspector General of Customs, Hart.
李鸿章 办洋务，倚总税务局英国人赫德为重；

If Zuo consulted the British too, the matter would probably pass through Hart’s hands.
然则左宗棠如果再请教英国人，将会逃不了仍由赫德经手。

Hart and Li supported one another; Hart might well advise Prince Gong and Wenxiang, who directed foreign affairs, that steamship construction should be entrusted to Liangjiang.
而赫德与李鸿章 互为表里，说不定会向总洋务的恭王与文建建议，制造轮船事务以由两江经办为宜。

Would that not open the way for Li?
那一来岂不是给李鸿章 开了路？

Gu therefore offered no further proposal and devoted himself to assisting Hu in negotiations with Giquel and d’Aiguebelle.
因此，古应春不再有何主张，只实心实力地作胡雪岩跟日意格、德克碑打交道的助手——

In practice, they dealt only with Giquel, since d’Aiguebelle had left military service and returned to France.
实际上只跟日意格一个人接头；因为德克碑已经退伍回国了。

He arranged there for the shipyard plans, drawings, and associated material to be prepared and sent to Giquel, who discussed them with Hu and Gu.
一切建船厂的计划、图样及瞀，都由德克碑在法国托人办理，寄给日意格，再找胡雪岩、古应春洽谈；

After more than a year, the scheme had been worked out in considerable detail.
一年多下来，已经策划得很周祥了。

When Zuo returned from Guangdong, Hu immediately accompanied Giquel to Fuzhou.
到得左宗棠由广东班师，胡雪岩立即陪着日意格到了福州；

The clarity of the drawings and explanations delighted Zuo.
左宗棠一看图说详明，非常高兴，

He personally inspected the proposed site near Luoxing Pagoda at Mawei, by the approach to Fujian’s coastal waters.
亲自去视察日意格所建议的设厂之地；地在福建海口、马尾罗星塔一带，

Clear water and firm ground made it suitable for slipways and docks, while proximity to the provincial capital made supervision convenient.
水清土实，宜于开槽建坞。兼以密迩省城，稽察方便，

He approved it as soon as he saw it.
所以一看便即中意。


The remaining problem was finance.
剩下来的事，就是筹划经费。

Building the yard, purchasing machinery, and hiring foreign specialists would require more than three hundred thousand taels in initial expenditure.
造厂买机器、雇募师匠，瞀开办费要三十多万银子，

Once production began, materials and wages would cost fifty or sixty thousand a month, or six to seven hundred thousand a year.
厂成开工，材料薪水，每月须银五六万两，一年就是六、七十万，

The first ship was expected after two years, by which time one and a half million taels would have been spent.
预计两年以后造出第一艘船，要花下去一百五十万银子。

Thereafter costs would fall: the total for five years was estimated at a little over three million.
不过以后就可以省了，五年通计，不过三百多万。

Raising that sum would naturally be troublesome.
这三百多万银子，从何筹集？当然煞费周章 ；

Zuo’s idea was to begin first.
左宗棠的意思是先办起来再说，

A million taels would carry the project through its first year.
只要有一百万银子，能应付得了头一年，

Once it had gone too far to abandon, the court would have to find a means of continuing it.
此后欲罢不能，不愁朝廷拿不出办法，

And with Hu at hand, some way to sustain it could surely be devised.
好在有胡雪岩，一定可以想出一条维持得下的路子来。

Zuo made a rough calculation.
因而粗粗计算，

He controlled the allocation of Fujian Customs revenue and provincial likin.
福建海关及本省厘税，提用之权在自己手里；

Zhejiang lay within his jurisdiction and would not stand aside.
浙江分属自己管辖，不会袖手；

Jiang in Guangdong owed his advancement entirely to Zuo and should contribute all the more readily.
广东蒋益澧是自己一手提拔，更当效劳。

With those three sources, the undertaking could proceed boldly.
有此三处财源，尽可放手办事了。


In the middle of the fifth month, Zuo submitted an initial account of the proposed purchase of machinery, recruitment of foreign artisans, and experimental construction of steamships.
因此，左宗棠在五月中旬，便先奏陈『拟购机器，雇洋匠，试造轮船大概情形』。

At the same time, responding to a request for opinions, he recommended wagon warfare against the Nian rebels and military agricultural colonies for the campaign against the Hui, where provisions otherwise had to be transported over immense distances.
同时应诏陈言，以为剿捻宜用车战；平回则千里馈粮，转运艰难，应该采用屯田之策。

The court’s reply showed little enthusiasm for the wagons or the agricultural proposal.
复旨对车战、屯田之议，不见得欣赏；

Steamship construction, however, was declared an urgent necessity of the day.
试造轮船则以为『实系当今应办急务』，

Funds could be drawn in suitable amounts from Fujian Customs, with provincial likin available if those proved insufficient.
所需经费，准予在闽海关关税中酌量提用；如果不够，准再提用福建厘金。

The proposed measures were approved, and Zuo was instructed to submit detailed further memorials on matters not yet settled.
同时指示∶『所陈各条，均着照议办理；一切未尽事宜，仍着详悉议奏。』

With that authority, he set to work vigorously.
有此一旨，左宗棠便密锣紧鼓地干了起来，

He instructed Hu to negotiate the details with d’Aiguebelle, now in Annam, through Giquel, who had been transferred to the Jianghan Customs at Hankou.
一面关照胡雪岩通过已调汉口江汉关税务司的日意格，与在安南的德克碑，商酌一切细节。

Giquel travelled through the summer heat and reached Fuzhou early in the seventh month.
日意格是七月初，冒暑到达福州的。

His first task was to survey the site.
第一件事是勘察船厂地址，

He selected ground below Mount Mawei, where the water reached twelve zhang in depth when the tide stood level.
择定马尾山下，潮平之时水深亦达十二丈的地方设厂；

They then discussed construction, workmen, and finance.
然后议土木、议工匠、议经费，

With broad agreement reached, they drew up a preliminary contract.
大致妥协，订立草约，

At Hu’s suggestion, the French consul-general in Shanghai, Brenier, was to act as guarantor.
担保人照胡雪岩的建议，由法国驻上海的总领事白来尼担保。

Arranging that naturally fell to Hu as well.
当然，这个差使必然又落在胡雪岩肩上。


Late in the eighth month, d’Aiguebelle came directly from Annam to Fuzhou.
到了八月下旬德克碑直接由安南到达福州，

On meeting Zuo, he raised no objection to the preliminary contract, but disputed the site.
与左宗棠晤见之下，对于所订草约，并无异词，但对所选定的建厂地点，却有意见，

The ground below Mount Mawei, he said, had formed from deposited silt and was not firm enough for foundations.
认为马尾山下是淤沙积成的一块陆地，基址不够坚固。

Zuo decided to invite Brenier and Giquel to Fuzhou for a final, comprehensive discussion, after which the plan could be settled and formally submitted.
因而左宗棠决定邀请白来尼、日意格到福州作客，作一个最后的，也是全面的商议，作成定案，正式出奏。

He first wrote asking Hu to come.
主意既定，先写信找胡雪岩到福州来谈。

Just as his enthusiasm was at its height, the edict transferring him to Shaanxi and Gansu arrived.
正在起劲的时候，忽然奉到调督陕甘的上谕；

He found it abrupt, but a little reflection showed it to be a natural outcome of events, not wholly unexpected.
在左宗棠虽觉突兀，但稍一细想，便知事所必然，势所必至，并非全出意外。

Recalling the many historical campaigns that had pacified the Western Regions, he felt his ambition rise and was eager for the challenge.
同时想起历史上许多平定西域的史实，雄心陡起，跃跃欲试，相当兴奋。

Hu, however, was deeply disappointed and anxious, almost at a loss.
在胡雪岩却是件非常扫兴的事，而且忧心忡忡，颇有手足无措之感。

When he called at the governor-general’s office to offer congratulations, his outward composure seemed unchanged, but those who knew him well could see beneath it.
因此，到总督衙门向左宗棠道贺时，虽然表面从容，一切如常；但逃不过相知较深的人的眼光。

One was his fellow townsman Wu Guanli, courtesy name Ziru and literary name Gui’an.
其中有一个是他的小同乡吴观礼。此人字子儒号圭庵，

A provincial examination graduate, Wu was brilliantly gifted and wrote excellent poetry.
本来是一名举人；才气纵横，做得极好的诗。

Hu had recommended him for Zuo’s staff, where he had won profound trust and become head of the military affairs office.
由于胡雪岩的推荐，入左宗棠幕府，深得信任，担任总理营务处的职司，

He was the one secretary in the governor-general’s establishment who participated in military strategy, a counsellor directing events from behind the scenes.
是闽浙总督衙门唯一参赞军务，可说是运筹帷幄的一位幕友。


Wu understood aspects of Zuo that Hu could not, a difference arising from the extent of their reading.
吴观礼对左宗棠所了解的，是胡雪岩所不能了解的，这就因为是读书多少的缘故。

Seeing dejection in Hu’s face, he readily guessed his thoughts.
看到胡雪岩的眉宇之间有落寞之色，当然也就猜想得到他内心的想法。

“Xueyan, are you afraid that, once Lord Zuo goes northwest, you will lose your patron?”
『雪岩，』吴观礼问道，『你是不是怕左公一去西北，你失掉靠山？』

The question was direct, and Hu answered honestly. “Yes.
话问得很率直，胡雪岩也就老实答道∶『是的！

Both public and private business will be difficult for me.”
以后无论公私，我都难了！』

Wu shook his head vigorously. “Not at all!”
『不然！不然！』吴观礼大为摇头。

In his view, a western expedition beyond the passes would take three to five years to show results.
照吴观礼的看法，出关西征，总得三年五载，才能见功；

It was a major campaign, certainly, but differed from the struggle against the Nian, who roamed the central plains and threatened the approaches to the capital.
这当然是一次大征伐，但情势与剿捻不同。捻匪窜扰中原，威胁京畿，

Even if not a disease at the heart, they were a danger close at hand.
在朝廷看，纵非心腹之患，但患在肘腋，

The court could not rest until they were removed, and commanders had to achieve success within a fixed time.
不除不能安心；所以督兵大臣，必得克日收功。

No delay could be tolerated.
事势急迫，不容延误。

The western war, by contrast, would be fought on a distant frontier, beyond the court’s anxious attention morning and evening.
西征则在边陲用兵，天高皇帝远，不致于朝夕关怀，

With less immediate pressure, official business would be easier.
其势较缓，公事自然比较好办。

As for private matters, these meant Hu’s own enterprises.
至于私事，无非胡雪岩个人的事业，

A patron nearby in the southeast could protect him and smooth his path; one far beyond the passes might be difficult to reach in an emergency.
有近在东南的左宗棠，可资荫庇，处处圆通。一旦靠山领兵出关，远在西陲，鞭长莫及；缓急之际呼应为难。

But Wu thought that fear excessive too.
吴观礼认为亦是过虑。

“You must understand that campaigns in the northwest have always depended upon support from the southeast.
『你要晓得，从来经营西北，全靠东南支持；

Your duties in Shanghai will grow more important, and your standing with them.
此后你在上海的差使，会更加吃重，地位也就更非昔比。

What happens depends on what a man makes of it.”
事在人为。』

He patted Hu’s shoulder.
吴观礼拍拍胡雪岩的肩说，

“You have not read the Record of Imperial Military Achievements and do not know Qianlong’s Ten Great Campaigns.
『你没有读过「圣武记」，不知道乾隆年间的「十大武功」。

In the past, frontier enterprises were entrusted to imperial relatives or great Manchu officials.
经营边疆，从前都是派亲贵或者满洲重臣挂帅；

Giving one to our Lord Zuo is no ordinary matter.
如今派了我们左公，是件非同小可的事。

Among the great commanders distinguished since the Taiping uprising, Lord Zeng has stood above the rest, with Zuo and Li next.
洪杨以来的元戎勋臣，曾相高高在上；左李两位两次；

From now on, Zeng and Zuo may well be spoken of together.”
从此以后，只怕曾左要并称了。』

That last sentence awakened Hu.
最后一句话，点醒了胡雪岩；

His anxiety vanished.
满腔忧烦，顿时一扫而空。

His patron would be farther away, but greater and more firmly established.
靠山虽远，却更高大稳固；

Once he understood that, there was no reason to fret.
了解到这一层，就不必发什么愁了。


“Thank you for enlightening me,” Hu said happily.
『多承指点。』胡雪岩很高兴地说，

“Let me trouble you further.
『索性还要费你的心，

Please explain the situation in the northwest in detail.”
西北是怎么个情形，请你细细谈一谈。』

“First let us discuss the steamships,” Zuo said firmly. “However urgently the court presses me to go beyond the passes, I shall not leave Fujian until this undertaking has been settled under my own hand.”
『我们先谈谈造轮船。』左宗棠极坚决地说∶『不管朝廷催得怎么紧，要我赶出关；这件事非在我手里先定了局，我不会离开福建。』

“Yes, sir,” Hu replied. “Once it is settled, to whom will you entrust it?”
『是的。』胡雪岩问道∶『定局以后，交给哪位？』

“Exactly!
『着！

You have reached the crucial point.
你问在要害上了。

I have cherished this ambition for three years and worked hard for months to bring it this far.
我蓄志三年，辛苦数月，才能有此结果，

If I entrust it to the wrong man and it is abandoned halfway, I shall never be reconciled to it.
倘或付托非人，半途而废，我是不甘心的。

I am still considering that.
这一层，我还在考虑；

For the present, I must ask you to take more trouble.”
眼前还要请你多偏劳。』

“That goes without saying.
『那何消说得。

But I can only attend to it until you leave Fujian.”
不过，我亦只能管到大人离福建为止。』

“No.
『不然。

You must continue after I leave,” Zuo said.
我离开福建，你还是要管。』左宗棠说，

“The shipyard will remain your concern.
『管的是船厂。

I will never abandon this halfway and give Li Shaoquan occasion to laugh.
这件事我决不能半途而废，为李少荃所笑。

I have considered it countless times: if it succeeds, it will surpass his foreign undertakings many times over.”
而且我不知道盘算过多少次，这件事办成，比李少荃所办的洋务，不知道要好过多少倍。』

His competitive motive was plain.
这就很明白的了，左宗棠是出于争胜之心。

No advice could diminish his desire to excel.
他的好胜心是决不因任何的规劝而稍减的；

Hu knew that he could not escape the burden; he must perform his part, however crushing the weight upon his head.
胡雪岩知道自己难卸仔肩，非『顶石臼做戏』不可了。

Yet the crucial question remained unanswered, and he had to ask again.
不过，刚才那句『问在要害』上的话，并无答复，还得追问。

“Then I can only obey.
『大人这么说，我当然只有遵命。』

But whom shall I have to serve in Fujian?”
胡雪岩说，『就不知道将来在福建还要伺候哪位？』

“Do not speak of serving.
『不要说什么伺候的话。

Xueyan, you are exceptionally clever.
雪岩，你最聪明不过；

There is no one you cannot get on with.
没有什么你不能相处的。

It is precisely because I shall entrust the work to this man that I need you still more—” He broke off. Hu understood perfectly: the chosen man would be difficult to serve.
惟其我付托了这个人，更得借重你——。』左宗棠没有再说下去∶胡雪岩却完全懂了他的意思，他所付托的，是个很难「伺候」的人。

He was all the more eager to know. “Who is it?”
这就更急着要问∶『是哪位？』

“Shen Youdan.”
『沈幼丹。』


It was Shen Baozhen, the former governor of Jiangxi, now at home observing mourning.
原来是丁忧回籍守制的前任江西巡抚沈葆桢。

Hu was genuinely surprised.
这在胡雪岩却真有意外之感。

On reflection, the choice was sound, but the regulations forbade a man to serve as an official—particularly a high official—in his native province.
细想一想，付托倒也得人；不过以本省人做本省官，而且必是大官，为法例所不许。

Mourning created a further obstacle.
兼以丁忧，更成窒碍。

What was Zuo’s intention?
不知左宗棠是怎么想来的？

Hu remained silent.
他只有付之默然了。

“I know what you are thinking.
『我知道你的想法，

Let me show you a draft memorial.”
我给你看个奏稿。』

The lengthy document argued the advantages of shipbuilding before reaching its principal point. The undertaking was imperative, it said; Zuo’s approaching departure from Fujian could not justify setting it aside.
奏向洋洋千言，畅论造船之利；最后谈到主题∶臣维轮船一事，势在必行，岂可以去闽在迩，忽为搁置？

He and the foreign officers had negotiated the many complicated arrangements for establishing the works.
且设局制造，一切繁难事宜，均臣与洋员议定，

Unless these were settled while he remained, his successor would face tangled affairs without anyone to consult; unclear agreements might also cause later controversy for which Zuo could not evade responsibility.
若不趁臣在闽定局，不但头绪纷繁，接办之人无从咨防；且恐要约不明，后多民议，臣尤无可诿咎。

He therefore had to remain another thirty days to bring the arrangements to completion.
臣之不能不稍留三旬，以待此局之定者，此也！

A successor must be chosen, but above all he must be able to remain at the work for a long time.
惟此事固须择接办之人；尤必接办之人能久于其事，

Continuity would steady everyone’s purpose, make success attainable, and allow deeper study to bring greater mastery.
然后一气贯注，众志定而成功可期；亦研求深而事理愈熟。

After repeated consideration, Zuo could think only of Shen Baozhen.
再四思维，惟丁忧在籍前江西抚臣沈荷桢，

In office and at home, Shen had long enjoyed a reputation for integrity admired throughout the realm.
在官在籍，久负清望，为中外所仰。

His careful, exact judgment was already known to the emperor.
其虑事详审精密，早在圣有洞鉴之中。

At present he was at home attending to his family and might remain there for many years, unlike officials liable to frequent transfer.
现在里居侍养，爱日方长，非若宦辙靡常，时有量移更替之事；

His high local reputation would strengthen his commitment to the enterprise.
又乡评素重，更可坚乐事赴功之心。

If given charge, he would certainly see it established.
若令主持此事，必期就绪。

Yinggui and Xu Zonggan agreed.
商之英桂、徐宗余亦以为然。

Zuo had visited him three times to discuss the matter, but Shen had repeatedly declined.
臣曾三次造庐商情，沈荷桢始终逊谢不遑。

Might the emperor, considering the project’s importance and near completion, graciously urge him to accept the public duty and appoint him director-general of shipbuilding?
可否仰恳皇上天恩，俯念事关至要，局在垂成，温谕沈葆桢，勉轻大义，特命总理船政，

An official seal should be issued by the appropriate board, and he should have authority to memorialize directly on all shipbuilding matters, preventing obstruction by others.
由部颁发关防，凡事涉船政，由其专奏请旨，以防牵制。


The necessary funds would be obtained as required in consultation with the general, governor-general, and governor.
其经费一切，会商将军督抚随时调取；

Acting Provincial Treasurer Zhou Kaixi was to ensure that there was no delay.
责成署藩司周开锡，不得稍有延误。

Hu Guangyong was to manage all materials, the engagement of foreign artisans and Chinese workers, and the opening of the technical school.
一切工料及延洋匠、雇华工、开艺局，责成胡光墉一手经理。

Hu, the memorial explained, was capable, meticulous, experienced in foreign affairs, indispensable to the shipbuilding establishment, and already trusted by the foreigners.
缘胡光墉才长心细，熟谙洋务，为船局断不可少之人，且为洋人所素信也。

“Good!
『好！

I entrust it to you.”
我就交给你了！』

Zuo rose and moved towards his writing table.
左宗棠站起身，一面走向书案，

“Now we must discuss the first great task.”
一面说道∶『现在要跟你谈第一件大事了！』



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第十一章（本章第1部分，共2部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER ELEVEN
第十一章


The first great task was the western expedition.
他的第一件大事，便是西征。

Any major campaign began with two questions: troops and funds.
而凡有大征伐，首先要筹划的是兵、饷二事。

For several nights Zuo had remained awake, thinking beneath the lamp, and had written an outline of his plans.
左宗棠连日深宵不寐，灯下沉思，已写成了一个筹划的概略；

He now took it from a drawer and asked Hu to study it.
此时从书案抽斗中取了出来，要胡雪岩细看。

The outline dealt first with troops, then with finance.
这个节略先谈兵，次筹饷。

Military arrangements had to suit local conditions.
而谈兵又必因地制宜，

The terrain of the northwest differed completely from that of the southeast.
西北与东南的地势，完全不同；

Southern soldiers would find the food unfamiliar and the cold intolerable.
南方的军队，到了西北，第一不惯食科；第二不耐寒冷。

The effective commanders and units with whom Zuo had fought across the southeast, particularly those recruited in Fujian and Guangdong, could therefore not be taken northwest.
因此，左宗棠在东南转战得力的将领部队，特别是籍贯属于福建、广东两省的，都不能带到西北。

He intended to bring only three thousand and more men.
带到西北的，只有三千多人，

Liu Dian, formerly assistant director of military affairs in Fujian and now recommended for the corresponding duties in Shaanxi and Gansu, would return to Hunan to recruit another three thousand men and lead them west.
另外他预备派遣原来帮办福建军务，现已出奏保荐帮办陕甘军务的刘典回湖南，召募三千子弟兵，带到西北。

These six thousand and more would form Zuo’s personal force.
这六千多人，左宗棠用来当作亲兵；

The main fighting army he intended to raise locally, making common cause with the able men of Guanzhong.
至于用来作战的大批部队，他打算在本地招募，要与『关中豪杰』共事业。


At this point Hu exclaimed, “Your Excellency, if you proceed in this way, when can the Hui rebellion be suppressed?”
看到这里，胡雪岩不由得失声说道∶『大人，照你老人家的办法，要什么时候才能平得了回乱？』

“I do not quite understand you.”
『你这话，我不大懂。』

“Consider, sir.
『大人请想，

Recruiting an army is not the work of a day, and training it into an elite force is harder still.
招募成军，不是一朝一夕的事；练成精锐，更是谈何容易？

It will take a year or two.”
这一来，要花一两年的功夫。』

“A year or two?
『岂止一两年？』

Establishing the Western Regions will require no less than ten years.”
左宗棠说道∶『经营西域，非十年不足以收功。』

“Ten years!”
『十年？』

Hu was startled.
胡雪岩吓一跳，

“That would take—” He stopped, but Zuo knew he meant the cost.
『那得——。』他虽住口不语，左宗棠也知道，说的是要费多少饷？

Smiling, he said, “Do not be anxious.
笑笑说道∶『你不要争！

I intend to establish agricultural colonies in the northwest.
我要在西北办屯垦；

That is the way to lasting peace.
这是长治久安之计。

As with the shipyard, one must not seek an immediate return.
就象办船厂一样，不能急切图利；

Once the results appear, you will see that I have planned correctly.”
可是一旦见效，你就知道我的打算不错了。』

Hu set the outline down and bent his head in thought.
『是！』胡雪岩将那份节略搁下，低着头沉思。

“What are you considering?”
『你在想什么？』

“A long way ahead.
『我想得很远。』

I too am thinking eight or ten years into the future.”
胡雪岩答说∶『我也是想到十年八年以后。』

“Exactly!”
『着！』

Zuo clapped his hands in delight.
左宗棠拊掌欣然，

“Our thoughts coincide.
『你的意思与我不谋而合；

We must plan carefully and find provisions and pay for eight or ten years.”
我们要好好打算，筹出十年八年的饷米。』

Hu did not answer immediately.
胡雪岩暂且不答，

He picked up the outline and continued reading until he understood the broad scheme.
捡起节略再看，大致了解了左宗棠在西北用兵的计划。

Zuo intended to train cavalry, build two-wheeled gun carriages, and establish a central bureau for agricultural colonies.
他要练马队；又要造『两轮炮车』；开设『屯田总局』——

The colonies would need implements, seed, carts, horses, and advances for all food and incidental expenses until the first harvest.
办屯垦要农具、要种子、要车马、要垫发未收成以前的一切粮食杂用，

The amount was considerable.
算起来这笔款子，真正不在少数。

“Your Excellency, cavalry and gun carriages are necessary for victory, and the court will certainly approve them.
『大人，』胡雪岩问道∶『练马队、造炮车、是致胜所必需，朝廷一定会准。

But might it regard the agricultural colonies as a matter that can wait?”
办屯垦，朝廷恐怕会看作不急之务吧？』


“That is where you do not understand.
『这，你就不懂了。』

There are still many men of learning at court.
左宗棠说，『朝中到底不少读书人，

They will understand.”
他们会懂的。』

Hu reddened, but spoke sincerely. “Yes, sir.
胡雪岩脸一红，却很诚恳地说∶『是！

I do not fully understand.
我确是不大懂，

Please instruct me.”
请大人教导。』

Zuo outlined the restrictions upon campaigning in the Western Regions.
于是左宗棠为胡雪岩约略讲述用兵西域的限制，

Since the Qin and Han dynasties, armies had gone west in early spring and returned in autumn.
自秦汉以来，西征皆在春初，及秋而还。

When autumn came and the horses were fat, the enemy held the advantage; the severe cold that followed was also beyond the endurance of troops from within the passes.
因为第一，秋高马肥，敌人先占了优势；其次就是严寒的天气，非关内的士兵所能适应。

“Because of these difficulties, Emperor Wu of Han won victories almost every year against the Xiongnu in the early Yuanshuo period, yet had to send an army out again every year.
『就是为了这些不便，汉武帝元朔初年征匈奴，几乎年年打胜仗，而年年要出师，

The grass was cut, but the roots remained—a burden without end.”
斩草不能除根，成了个无穷之累。』

After citing precedents, Zuo returned to the present. “The Hui rebellion presents much the same problem. I could choose twenty or thirty thousand good troops, take them beyond the passes in spring, pursue the enemy through the summer, and return in autumn, as Wei Qing and Huo Qubing did.
左宗棠一番引经据典以后，转入正题∶『如今平回乱，亦仿佛是这个道理∶选拔两三万能打的队伍，春天出关，尽一夏天追奔逐北，交秋班师，如当年卫霍之所为，我亦办得到。

But would that settle the rebellion?”
可是，回乱就此算平了吗？』

“Naturally not.”
『自然没有平。』

Hu understood.
胡雪岩了然了，

“As the verse says, wildfire cannot burn it all away; the spring wind brings it back.
『有道是「野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。」

Only by thoroughly turning over the ground can the weeds be prevented from returning.”
只要花大功夫拿那块地彻底翻一翻，野草自然长不出来了。』

“Precisely!
『一点不错！

Your comparison is apt.”
你这个譬喻很恰当。』

Zuo was pleased.
左宗棠欣慰地说，

“If you understand my purpose, I can rest easy.
『只要你懂我的意思，我就放心了。

You will obtain what I need.”
你一定会把我所要的东西办妥当。』

Praise from Zuo was precious, but it was also a weighty burden.
这顶『高帽子』出于左宗棠之口，弥觉珍贵；然而也极沉重。

Hu knew that he was being asked to bear the principal responsibility for raising funds.
胡雪岩知道左宗棠的意思是要他负筹饷的主要责任。

After concentrated thought, he felt that so great and complicated a matter required some definite answers first.
凝神细想了一会，觉得兹事体大，而且情况复杂，非先问个明白不可。


“Your Excellency, how many battalions do you intend to train?”
『大人，将来要练多少营的队伍。』

“That is difficult to say.
『这很难说，

I must see the circumstances beyond the passes.”
要到了关外看情形再说。』

The very first question thus became a difficulty.
第一个疑问，便成了难题；

Without the number of men, monthly expenditure could not be calculated.
人数未定，月饷的数目就算不出来。

Hu could only estimate: at fifty thousand men, with pay, food, clothing, weapons, tents, cooking utensils, and other expenses kept within five taels per man, the total would be two hundred and fifty thousand a month.
胡雪岩只能约略估计，以五万人算，每人粮饷、被服、武器；以及营帐锅碗等等杂支，在五两银子以内开支，每月就要二十五万两。

He asked a second question. “You will take six thousand men beyond the passes?”
于是他再问第二问∶『是带六千人出关？』

“Yes.
『是的。

About sixty-five hundred.
大概六千五百人。』

Thirty-five hundred will set out from Fujian and Zhejiang.
左宗棠答说，『三千五百人由闽浙两省动手；

Another three thousand, once recruited in Hunan, will go directly west.”
另外三千人在湖南招募成军以后，直接出关。』

“What about travelling expenses?
『行资呢？

Would ten taels a man suffice?”
每人十两够不够？』

“I think it should.”
『我想，应该够了。』

“That is sixty-five thousand, needed immediately.” Hu asked his third question. “How much cavalry do you propose to train?”
『那就是六万五千两，而且眼前就要。』胡雪岩又问第三问∶『大人预备练多少马队？』


“I have never commanded cavalry and do not yet know its battalion organization very well.
『马队我还没有带过，营制也不甚了然。

My preliminary intention is three thousand men.”
只有自初步打算，要练三千马队。』

“Then at least three thousand horses will be needed,” Hu said.
『那就至少要有三千匹马。』胡雪岩说，

“They must be bought at Zhangjiakou.
『买马要到张家口，

That money is available; I can advance it.”
这笔钱倒是现成的，我可以垫出来。』

“You have money in Zhangjiakou?”
『怎么？你在张家口有钱？』

“Yes.
『是的。』

A hundred thousand taels, originally intended for furs and medicinal materials.
胡雪岩说，『我有十万银子在张家口，原来打算留着办皮货、办药材的，

I shall have to use it for horses first.”
现在只好先挪来买马。』

“Excellent.”
『这倒好。』

Zuo was delighted.
左宗棠很高兴地说，

“Then I can send a purchasing officer at once.”
『既然如此，我立刻就可以派委员去采办了。』

“Let me know whom you appoint, and I shall send someone with him.” Hu continued, “What about the two-wheeled gun carriages?
『是！大人派定了通知我；我再派人陪着一起去。』胡雪岩又问，『两轮炮车呢？

How many?”
要多少？』

“Like Han Xin with soldiers, the more the better.
『「韩信将兵，多多益善」。

Beyond the passes the country is vast.
塞外辽阔，

In addition to swift cavalry, guns on carriages can sweep the ground clear at a stroke.
险精骑驰骋以外，炮车轰击，一举而廓清之，

There is no better instrument for destroying the enemy’s strongholds.”
最是扫穴犁庭的利器！』

Hu’s heart grew heavy.
听这一说，胡雪岩觉得心头沉重。

He had often heard of government troops who cared nothing for civilian lives, turned their guns upon villages, and bombarded indiscriminately.
因为他也常听说，有那不恤民命的官军，常常使炮口对准村落，乱轰一气。

Bandits hiding there might be killed, wounded, or driven out, but many innocent inhabitants suffered with them.
窝藏在其中的盗匪，固然非死即伤或逃；而遭受池鱼之殃的百姓，亦复不少。


Most of the Western firearms and artillery in Zuo’s army had been purchased by Hu in Shanghai.
左宗棠所部的洋枪洋炮，多由胡雪岩在上海采办；

Follow the matter back to its origin, and he himself had unknowingly contributed to wrongdoing.
推原论始，便是自己在无形中造了孽，

His mother had remonstrated with him countless times over his procurement of weapons that killed people.
为了胡雪岩的购办杀人利器，胡老太太不知道劝过他多少次；

He was a devoted son and obeyed her in every detail of family affairs.
胡雪岩十分孝顺，家务巨细，母命是从，

Only in public business did he feel unable to follow her wishes.
惟独到公事上头，不能不违慈命。

Fortunately, she understood: it was not deliberate disobedience, but a situation from which he saw no escape.
好在胡老太太心地亦很明白；知道不是儿子不听话，实在是无可奈何。

She could only do her utmost to make amends for his “sins.”
因此，只有尽力为他弥补『罪过』，

Besides her customary worship, she provided medical treatment, medicines, and cooling tea in summer, padded clothing and rice vouchers in winter.
平时烧香拜佛，不在话下；夏天施医施药施凉茶，冬天舍棉衣、散米票，

Anyone seeking help to repair bridges or roads, care for the old, or relieve the poor received a generous promise.
其他修桥铺路，恤老怜贫的善举，只要求到她，无不慷慨应诺。

Yet however many good deeds she performed, buying birds to release could not compensate for human lives.
但是，尽管好事做了无其数；买鸟雀放生，总抵偿不了人命，

Every mention of arms purchases saddened her.
所以胡老太太一提起买军火，便会郁郁不乐。

Hearing Zuo speak so enthusiastically now, Hu saw his mother’s troubled face in his mind and remained silent.
胡雪岩此时听左宗棠说得那么起劲，不由得便想起了老母的愁颜；因而默不作声。


“What is it?”
『怎么？』

Zuo naturally did not understand.
左宗棠当然不解，

“Do you think building the gun carriages will be difficult?”
『你是不是觉得我要造两轮炮车，有困难？』

“No.
『不是。

I am wondering how many will be required and what each will cost.
我是在想，炮车要多少，每辆要多少银子？

I cannot draw up that budget.”
这笔预算打不出来。』

“That comes later.
『那是以后的事。

For now, we must allow a rough amount.
眼前只好算一个约数；

I should like to set aside two hundred thousand taels.”
我想最好能抽个二十万银子造炮车。』

“And the agricultural colonies?
『那末办屯田呢？

How much must be raised for those?”
请问大人，要筹多少银子？』

“Harder still to say.
『这更难言了。』

Fortunately, the colonies are not an undertaking of merely three or five years, and their burden will steadily diminish.
左宗棠说∶『好在办屯田不是三年五载的事；而且负担总是越来越轻。

I think five hundred thousand taels, used as a revolving fund, will certainly suffice.”
我想有个五十万银子，前后周转着用，一定够了。』

Hu calculated silently for a moment, then exclaimed, “This is tremendous!
『是的。』胡雪岩心里默算了一会，失声说道∶『这样就不得了！

Tremendous!”
不得了！』

“How so?”
『怎么？』

“Let me reckon it for you.”
『我算给大人听！』

He counted on his fingers. “Travelling expenses, sixty thousand.
胡雪岩屈指数着∶『行资六万。

Horses with saddles and bridles, say a hundred and twenty taels each: three thousand horses make thirty-six thousand.
买马连鞍辔之类，算他一百二十两银子一匹，三千匹就是三万六千。

Gun carriages, two hundred thousand.
造炮车二十万。

Half the agricultural fund to begin with, two hundred and fifty thousand.
办屯田先筹一半，二十五万。

Pay and provisions for fifty thousand men at five taels per month, two hundred and fifty thousand monthly, or three million a year.
粮饷以五万人计，每人每月五两，总共就是二十五万，一年三百万。

Altogether, three million five hundred and forty thousand.
合计三百五十四万，

That is what must be raised for the first year.”
这是头一年要筹的饷。』

Zuo too was stunned.
这一算，左宗棠也楞住了。

Raising three million five hundred and forty thousand taels was no easy matter.
要筹三百五十四万两的饷，谈何容易？

Even half—one million seven or eight hundred thousand—was a formidable sum.
就算先筹一半，也是一百七、八十万，实在不是一笔小数目了。


“And with transport so difficult in the northwest, we must make generous allowances everywhere.
『而且我想，西北运输不便，凡事都要往宽处去算。

The money has to be secured before you take it with you.
这笔饷非先筹好带去不可！

This is not like Fuzhou and Shanghai, only two days apart by sea, where I can somehow provide assistance in an emergency.
大人，这不比福州到上海，坐海轮两天功夫就可以到，遇有缓急之时，我无论如何接济得上。

Thousands of miles away, amid snow and ice, if you run short of provisions and cannot make yourself heard, what use will frantic anxiety be?”
西北万里之外，冰天雪地之中，那时大人乏粮缺食，呼应不灵，岂不是急死了也没用？』

“Exactly.
『说得是，说得是！

That is precisely my thought.
我正就是这个意思。

Xueyan, we must raise it beforehand.
雪岩，这笔饷，非先筹出来不可；

If not enough for a year, then at least enough to prevent shortage for six months.”
筹不足一年，至少也要半年之内不虞匮乏之好。』

“Provided there is a dependable source of military funds, I shall do everything I can to arrange advances and subsequent receipts.” Hu then explained why the western army could never be allowed even a temporary interruption.
『只要有了确实可靠的「军饷」，排前补后，我无论如何是要效劳的。』接着，胡雪岩又分析西征军饷，所以绝不能稍有不继的缘故。

Elsewhere, a gap could be filled from likin, land revenue, or customs receipts, or at worst by an accommodation with a neighbouring province.
在别的省份，一时青黄不接，有厘税可以指拨，有钱粮可以划提，或者有关税可以暂时周转，至不济还有邻省可以通融。

The northwest was barren and poor, leaving no room to move money around.
西北地瘠民贫，无可腾挪，

Only Shanxi offered a possible neighbouring resource, and that was limited.
邻省则只有山西可缓急之恃，但亦有限，

Communications were difficult; transporting silver might itself take a month.
而且交通不便，现银提解，往往亦须个把月的功夫。

If funds failed and hungry soldiers mutinied, the situation could become irretrievable.
所以万一青黄不接，饥卒哗变，必成不可收拾之势。

Zuo had foreseen this in his own careful deliberations.
这个看法，亦在左宗棠深思熟虑的预见之中。

He fully agreed that they must first secure funds guaranteed to arrive without a tael missing or a day’s delay: the contributions assigned to the various provinces for Gansu.
因而完全同意胡雪岩的主张，应该先筹好分文不短，一天不延的『的饷』；也就是各省应该协解的『甘饷』。

Here he felt pleased with his foresight.
谈到这一层上头，左宗棠便很得意于自己的先见了；

Without driving out his relative by marriage, Guo Songtao, he would have had only Fujian and Zhejiang as bases of support.
如果不是撵走了他的『亲家』郭嵩焘，便顶多只有福建、浙江两个地盘，

Now wealthy Guangdong was included.
而如今却有富庶的广东在内。

Those three provinces must be the starting point.
要筹的饷，自然先从这三省算起。


Fujian came first.
三省之中，又必先从福建开始。

It had been contributing forty thousand taels a month towards Zuo’s Zhejiang troops, with another ten thousand from Fujian Customs.
福建本来每月协济左宗棠带来的浙军军饷四万两；闽海关每月协济一万两。

After the Taiping remnants were cleared, the forty thousand had been reassigned to Gansu.
从长毛余孽肃清以来，协浙的四万两，改为协济甘肃；

It now naturally came under Zuo’s control.
现在自是顺理成章 归左宗棠了。

The customs contribution, however, had already been allocated to the shipyard.
至于海关的一万两，已籴接济船厂经费；

Since that was his own initiative, he could not reverse himself and had to relinquish those ten thousand.
此事是他所首创，不能出尔反尔，这一万两只得放弃。

Next came Zhejiang.
其次是浙江。

When Yang Yuebin became governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu with responsibility for the western campaign, Zeng Guofan had helped arrange funds and assigned Zhejiang twenty thousand a month.
当杨岳斌接任陕甘总督，负西征全责时，曾国藩曾经代为出面筹饷，派定浙江每月协解两万。

In the tenth month of the previous year, Zuo had brought his army into Guangdong and achieved his plan of feeding it there.
上年十月间左宗棠带兵到广东，『就食于粤』的计划既已实现，

Under Hu’s indirect pressure, he had then had to honour his promise to relieve Zhejiang’s burden.
在胡雪岩的侧面催促之下，不得不守减除浙江负担的诺言。

That left Zhejiang with an additional hundred and forty thousand a month.
在浙江等于每月多了十四万银子；

Ma Xinyi, mindful of the wider situation, voluntarily increased the Gansu subsidy by thirty thousand, making fifty thousand monthly.
马新贻是很顾大局的人，自请增拨甘饷三万两，每月共讲五万银子。

“Zhejiang has treated me well,” Zuo said.
『浙江总算对得起我；

“Ma Gushan is a fine man.
马谷山为人亦很漂亮，

Fifty thousand a month is no small contribution.
每月五万银子协饷，实在不能算少了，

But”—he paused—“there are two other sums already budgeted in Zhejiang.
不过，』左宗棠停了一下说∶『有两笔款子，在浙江本来是要支出的，

Taking those would add nothing to its burden.
我拿过来并不增加浙江的负担，

What do you think?”
你看如何？』

“That depends on their original destination.”
『这要看原来是给什么地方？』

“One is the promised shipbuilding contribution, ten thousand a month.
『一笔是答应支持船厂的造船经费，每月一万两。

The shipyard is now funded entirely from Fujian Customs and likin.
现在设厂造船，全由福建关税、厘金提拨；

Zhejiang’s ten thousand could be redirected to Gansu.”
这一万两不妨改为甘饷。』

This was an indirect way of increasing Fujian’s burden.
这是变相增加福建负担的办法。

Hu found it privately amusing: Zuo’s calculations could be sharper than a petty merchant’s.
胡雪岩心里好笑，左宗棠的算盘，有时比市侩还精；

But so long as Zhejiang did not suffer, he had no reason to object.
但只要不累浙江，他没有不赞成之理。

“I do not think Governor Ma will oppose that.”
因而点点头说∶『这一层，我想马中丞决不会反对。』


“The other ten thousand supports Lord Zeng’s cavalry.
『另一笔协济曾相的马队，也是一万两。

I think that should come to me too.
照我想，也该归我。

Consider the reason.”
雪岩，你想想其中的道理。』

“Lord Zeng originally assigned Jiangsu thirty thousand a month for Gansu, but I hear the full sum is never remitted.
『曾相从前自己定过，江苏协济甘饷，每月三万；听说每月解不足。

Do you propose to offset Zhejiang’s ten thousand against what Jiangsu owes?”
大人是不是想拿浙江的这一万两，划抵江苏应解的甘饷？』

“Precisely.
『是啊！

It costs Zeng nothing, so why should the accounts not be adjusted?”
算起来于曾无损，为什么不能划帐？』

On the merits, how could it be said to cost Zeng nothing?
就事论事，何得谓之『与曾无损』？

Hu wanted to advise against displeasing him for the sake of ten thousand taels.
胡雪岩本想劝他，犯不上为这一万两银子，惹得曾国藩心中不快。

Then he reflected that any such advice would make Zuo launch another tirade against Zeng, bringing their serious business to a halt.
转念又想，若是这样开口一劝，左宗棠又一定大骂曾国藩。正事便无法谈得下去。

He swallowed the words.
因而将到口的话又缩了回去。


Next came Guangdong.
这下来就要算广东的接济了。

Its existing contribution to Gansu was only ten thousand; another ten thousand was intended for shipbuilding.
广东的甘饷，本来只定一万；造船经费也是一万，

Following the Zhejiang precedent, both could go to Gansu, making twenty thousand.
仿照浙江的例子协甘，共是两万。

Zuo hoped to double that to forty thousand, matching Fujian.
左宗棠意思，希望增加一倍，与福建一样，每月四万。

“That can certainly be done,” Hu said.
『这一定办得到的。』胡雪岩说，

“Governor Jiang owes his advancement to you and should exert himself for public and personal reasons alike.
『蒋中丞是大人一手提拔，于公于私，都应该尽心。

There is no time to lose; you should write at once.”
事不宜迟，大人马上就要写信。』

“That hardly matters.
『这倒无所谓，

Jiang Xiangquan cannot refuse me.
反正蒋芗泉不能不买我的面子，

We may include it in the budget now.”
现在就可以打入预算之内。』

“Fujian forty thousand, Zhejiang seventy thousand, Guangdong forty thousand, and Jianghaiguan Customs another thirty thousand.
『福建四万、浙江七万、广东四万、另加江海关三万，，

That gives a dependable hundred and eighty thousand a month, only two million one hundred and sixty thousand a year.
目前可收的确数是十八万；一年才两百十六万。

The gap is still large.”
差得很多。』

“There are others, of course.
『当然还有。

The Ministry of Revenue has designated seven further provinces.
户部所议，应该协甘饷的省份，还有七省。

I shall speak in person to the authorities in Jiangxi, Hubei, and Henan while passing through on my way west.
江西、湖北、河南三省，等我这次出关路过的时候，当面跟他们接头；

Jiangsu, Henan, Sichuan, and Shandong must wait until I reach Shaanxi.
江苏、河南、四川、山东四省的甘饷，只有到了陕西再说。

Taking everything together, I think we can certainly count on two million four hundred thousand a year.”
我想，通扯计算，一年两百四十万银子，无论如何是有的。』

“Then I shall raise half of that in advance for you,” Hu said as though it were a casual matter.
『那，我就替大人先筹一半。』胡雪岩若无其事地说。

“Half?” Zuo wondered if he had heard correctly.
『一半？』左宗棠怕是自己没有听清楚，

“Half is one million two hundred thousand taels.”
特意钉一句∶『一半就是一百二十万银子。』

“Yes.
『是，一百二十万。』

I shall have it ready for you to take.”
胡雪岩说∶『我替大人筹好了带走。』

“But—” Zuo scarcely knew what to say.
『这，』左宗棠竟不知怎么说才好了，

“Where will you find such an enormous sum?”
『你哪里去筹这么一笔巨数？』

“I have a method.
『我有办法。

Naturally, it will require your approval.
当然，这个办法，要大人批准。

Once I have worked out the arrangements, I shall explain them.”
等我筹划好了，再跟大人面禀。』

Zuo could not press further.
左宗棠不便再追着问。

He was doubtful, but more confident than doubtful.
他虽有些将信将疑，地是信多于疑；

Remembering that Hu had fulfilled every promise he had made, he felt reassured and pleased.
再想到胡雪岩所作的承诺，无一不曾实现，也就释然、欣然了。


“When will you leave, sir, and when do you expect to pass beyond the frontier gates?”
『大人什么时候动身，什么时候出关？』

“I intend to leave early in the eleventh month.
『我想十一月初动身，

I shall travel slowly, discussing affairs with governors and governors-general along the way.
沿途跟各省督抚谈公事，走得慢些，

I shall probably not reach the capital until the year’s end.”
总要年底才能到京。』

“The capital?
『到京？』

Did the edict not direct you to proceed straight to the west?”
胡雪岩不解地问，『上谕不是关照，直接出关。』

“That was hardly the intention of Their Majesties.
这哪里是上头的意思？

It was certain men using the authority of the realm to command its governors.
无非有些人挟天下以令诸侯。

They fear I shall cause trouble in the capital.
他们怕我进京找麻烦，

I mean to be a nuisance to them.
我偏要去讨他们的厌；

Before leaving, I shall request an audience.
动身之前，奏请陛见。

I do not believe the two empress dowagers will refuse.”
想来两宫太后决不致于拦我。

Zuo paused. “As for passing beyond the gates, I cannot fix the date yet.
『左宗棠停了一下又说∶』至于出关的日期，现在还不能预定。

Next spring at the earliest.”
最早也得在明年春天。

“Then we have another three or four months.
『』那还有三四个月的功夫。

The million two hundred thousand will be ready before you go.
大人出关以前，这一百二十万一定可筹足；

For immediate needs, I can still arrange two or three hundred thousand.”
至于眼前要用，二、三十万银子，我还调度得动。

“Excellent!
『』那太好了！

Xueyan, settle it as soon as you can, so that I may rest easy.”
雪岩我希望你早早筹划停当，好让我放心。

Hu needed no such reminder.
『这又何消左宗棠说得？

He too wished to settle the matter quickly.
胡雪岩亦希望早早能够定局。

Although he gave his plan an eight-in-ten chance, the silver was not yet in his hands.
无奈自己心里所打的一个主意，虽有八成把握，到底银子不曾到手。

The proverb about a cooked duck flying away was an exaggeration, but where money was concerned, even an agreed arrangement could change at the last moment.
俗语说的『煮熟了鸭子飞掉了』，自是言过其实；但凡事一涉银钱，即有成议，到最后一刻变卦，亦是常有之事。
