“One to prepare your opium, one for general tasks, and one to accompany you when you go out.
“打烟的一个，打杂的一个，出门跟班的一个，

You need at least three.”
至少得三个人。”

“I shall take only the one who prepares my pipe,” Baosen said, still somewhat ashamed.
“我就带一个打烟的。”宝森略有些不好意思地，

“I have the habit.
“有一口嗜好，

It cannot be helped.”
没法子。”

“It is the paste of good fortune and long life.”
“这是福寿膏。”

Wang picked up a long cloth bag beside him and removed its cover, revealing a rectangular red-sandalwood box polished like a mirror.
汪惟贤将手边一个长形布袋拿了起来，脱去布套，是个打磨得光可鉴人的紫檀长方盒，

He handed it over.
顺手递过去说：

“See what you think of this.”
“森二老爷倒看看，这样东西怎么样？”

The lid bore an inlaid, coloured clerical-script inscription: “Playing the Flute to Bring the Phoenix.”
宝森接来一看，盒盖上刻着一行填彩的隶书：“吹萧引凤”。

Baosen knew at once that it held an opium pipe.
便知是一支烟枪，

He slid the lid open, and there it was.
抽开盒盖，果不其然。

In thirty years of smoking, he had seen many fine implements, but this pipe was exceptional.
虽抽了三十年的鸦片，见过许多好烟具，

Its green-jade mouthpiece, set into a thirteen-jointed stem of mottled bamboo, was valuable enough.
这一支十三节湘妃竹的烟枪，所镶的绿玉烟嘴固然名贵，

Its real excellence lay in the stem, lined from end to end with olive stones threaded together and bored through: cool outside and hot within, it made smoking especially satisfying.
但妙处却在竹管，是用橄榄核累贯到底，核中打通，外凉内热，抽起来格外过瘾。

“A fine thing.”
“好东西。”

He could hardly bear to put it down.
宝森爱不忍释，

“It must cost two hundred taels?”
“总得二百两银子吧？”

“If it pleases you, there is no need to ask the price.
“森二老爷中意，就不必问价钱了。

Please keep it.”
请留着用吧！”

Before Baosen could decline, Wang continued, “My employer says you need not bring your smoking tray.
汪惟贤不容他谦辞，紧接着又说：“敝东交代，森二老爷不必带烟盘。

It would be too cumbersome.
太累赘，

We shall provide everything.”
都由我们预备。”

Further polite resistance would now have seemed insincere.
说到这样的话，倘再客气，就变得虚伪了。

Baosen clasped his hands.
宝森拱拱手说：

“I cannot express my gratitude for Mr Hu’s kindness.
“胡大先生如此厚爱，实在心感不尽。

But I am quite determined to bring only one man.
不过，人，我准定只带一个，

More would be cumbersome too.”
带多了也是累赘。”

“Certainly.
“是，是。

We have people, so it does not matter if you bring fewer.
我们那里有人，森二老爷少带也不要紧。

And since we are in national mourning and dress plainly, you need not bring silk clothes.
还有，现在是国丧，穿着朴素，森二老爷不必带绸衣服，

When the mourning period is over, they can be made in Shanghai.”
等穿孝期满，在上海现做好了。”


Baosen agreed to everything.
他说什么，宝森应什么。

After Wang left, he reflected on his good fortune with pleasure, smoked his fill through the new pipe, and noticed that it was past three in the afternoon.
等汪惟贤一走，想一想不免得意，用新得的烟枪过足了瘾，看辰光未时已过，

His brother would have returned from court.
宝鋆已经下朝了，

In high spirits, he went to tell him the agreeable news.
乘兴省兄，打算去谈一谈这件得意之事。

The doorkeepers at Bao Yun’s house grew alarmed at the arrival of “Second Master” and hurried to report it.
宝鋆家的门上，一看“二老爷”驾到，立即就紧张了，飞速报到上房。

Bao Yun was about to tell them to say that he had a headache and had gone to bed when Baosen strode in.
宝萎刚想关照：说我头疼，已经睡了。只见宝森已大踏步闯了进来，

Seeing that nothing would stop him, he sighed and dismissed the servant with a wave.
料想挡也挡不住，只能叹口气，挥一挥手，命门上了退了下去。

“That matter of yours will have to wait,” he said before his brother could speak.
“你那件事，过一阵子再说。”宝鋆一见了他老弟的面就先开口，

“Everyone is overwhelmed by the Eastern Empress Dowager’s funeral.
“这会儿办东太后的丧事，大家都忙得不可开交，

I cannot bring it up just now.”
我也不好意思跟人家提。”

“Which matter?”
“哪一件？”

Baosen had asked his brother to intervene in so many affairs that he did not know which one he meant.
宝森要他老兄托人情的事太多了，不知他指的是哪一件，所以如此发问。

“The inheritance lawsuit you undertook to help someone with.”
“你不是兜揽了一件帮人争产的官司吗？”

“Oh, that one.
“喔，那一件。”宝森答说：

I have no time to manage other people’s affairs now.”
“如今我可没工夫管人家的事了。”

A son born of a concubine had sued his eldest brother, the son of their father’s principal wife, for a division of the family property.
原来宝森受人之托，有件庶出之子，向嫡出长兄要求分家的官司，

Acting for the other party, Baosen had asked Bao Yun to influence the prefect of Shuntian to dismiss the claimant’s petition.
要求宝鋆向顺天府尹说情，将庶出之子的状子驳回。

Since Liu Xitong’s conduct in the Yang Naiwu case had exposed him to public criticism, Bao Yun had wanted nothing more to do with such judicial matters.
他从杨乃武那一案，受刘锡彤之累，为清议抨击以后，凡是这类牵涉刑名的案件，不愿再管，

Baosen’s persistence had forced him to invent one excuse after another for delay, to his great distress.
无奈宝森一再纠缠，只能饰词敷衍，每一次要想不同的理由来拖延，深以为苦，

Hearing Baosen say he no longer had time for the affair felt like a weight lifted from his shoulders.
因而此刻听得宝森的话，顿觉肩头一轻，浑身自在了。

“I have come especially to tell you that I am going to Shanghai.
“我特为来跟大哥说，我要到上海去一趟，

I shall be away two or three months.”
总得两三个月才能回来。”

“What for?”
“喔，”宝鋆问道：“到上海去干什么？”

“Someone has invited me for a holiday.
“有人请我去玩两三个月。

Food and lodging, collection and delivery: all four provided.
管吃管住。外带管接管送，一共是四管，

I shall not spend a single cash.”
自己一个子儿都不用花。”

“Indeed!
“好家伙。

Two or three months in Shanghai without costing you anything?
管你到上海玩两三个月，不要分文，

Who is so rich?”
谁那么阔啊？”

“Hu Xueyan.”
“胡雪岩。”

“So you have made friends with the God of Wealth!”
“原来你交上‘财神，了！”

Bao Yun’s face darkened.
宝鋆立刻沉下脸来，

“Do not go promising him things and making trouble for me.”
“你可别胡乱许了人家什么，替我添麻烦。”

Baosen was astonished.
宝森愕然，

“Would he want anything from me?
“人家会是事托我？”他问：

What could it be?”
“会有什么事呢？”

“Who knows?
“谁知道，

The man has endless devices.
此人的花样，其大无比，

He has come this time to arrange a foreign loan for Zuo Jigao.
这一趟是来替左季高筹划借洋债，

Perhaps he will send you to pester me.”
说不定就会托你来跟我罗晾。”

Baosen gave a faint sneer.
“哼！”宝森微微冷笑，

“With Haiyue Shanfang there, what need would he have of me to pester you?”
“有海岳山虏在那里，哪轮得到我来跟你罗嗦。”


Bao Yun pretended not to hear.
宝鋆装作不曾听见，

After taking several bubbling draws on his water pipe, he asked, “When are you leaving?”
呼噜噜地抽了几口水烟，开口问道：“你哪一天走？”

“In the next few days.” Bao Yun nodded and called his servant Baofu.
“就在这几天”宝菱点点头，喊一声：“来啊！”将听差宝福唤来吩咐：

“Draw two hundred taels from the accounts office and send them to Second Master.”
“到帐房里支二百银子，给二老爷送了去。”

Baosen made his formal thanks, chatted a little longer, and left happily.
“谢谢大哥！”宝森请个安，又说了些闲话，高高兴兴地走了。

He had scarcely disappeared when Baofu quietly approached.
等他的背影刚刚消失，宝福俏然而至，走到宝鋆面前说道：

“Zhu Tiekou has brought a present from Lord Hu.”
“朱铁口来过了，替胡大入送了一份礼来。”

“Which Lord Hu?”
“哪个胡大人？”

“His official visiting card is here.”
“有手本在这里。”

Seeing the name Hu Guangyong, Bao Yun immediately became interested.
一看手本上的名字是“胡光墉”，不同得就关切了，

“What has he sent?”
“送的什么？”他问。

“A vase from the Chenghua kilns.”
“一个成化窑的花瓶。”

“Large or small?”
“大的还是小的？”

“Large.”
“大的。”

A large one meant twenty thousand taels.
大的便是两万银子。

Bao Yun reflected that, after giving him twenty thousand, Hu need not have troubled to do Baosen a kindness as well.
宝望心想，胡雪岩既然送了两万银子，就大可不必再在宝森身上作人情，

Yet he had, and no small kindness either.
而居然作了，并且这个人情还不轻，

He seemed a very considerate man.
看起来是个很厚道的人。

The prospect of peace once Baosen left made Bao Yun think still better of him.
同时又想到宝森一走，耳根清净，便对胡雪岩越有好感了。

“Has Zhu Tiekou gone?”
“朱铁口走了没有？”

“Not yet.”
“还没有。”

Bao Yun summoned him.
“宝望便将朱铁口传唤到上房问道：”

“What did Lord Hu say?”
那胡大人是怎么说的？

“He said he wished to send Your Excellency a present and asked what would be suitable.
““胡大人说想送中堂一份礼，问我有什么合适的东西？

I asked how substantial a gift he intended.
我问他打算送多重的礼？

Twenty thousand taels, he said.
他说两万银子。

So I suggested the vase.
我就让他买花瓶。

He also asked me to deliver it.
他还托我代送，

The vase is here, and the silver has been handed to the accounts office.”
花瓶送来了，银子也交到帐房里了。”

“Did he leave any message?”
“有什么话托你转达的没有？”

“No.
“没有。

I asked him that too.
我倒也问过他，

He said only that he admired Your Excellency’s devoted service to the country.
他说只不过佩服中堂为国贤劳，

He had intended to call and pay his respects, but feared that the great mourning had made you too busy for him to intrude.”
本想上门来求见请安，又怕中堂最近因为大丧太忙，不敢冒昧。”

Bao Yun’s doubts vanished.
宝鋆的顾虑消释了。

He could accept the twenty thousand with an easy mind.
这两万银子可以安心笑纳，

Had a request accompanied it, helping would have been more awkward; if he could not bear to return the money, his conscience would have reproached him.
倘或附带有一句什么请托的话，反倒不便帮忙，两万银子如果舍不得退回，良心上就不免要自责。

After dismissing Zhu, however, he went on thinking about the gift.
遣走朱铁口以后，宝鋆仍在考虑胡雪岩送的这笔重礼，

To do nothing for Hu would still trouble his conscience.
不帮他的忙，良心上仍不免要自责，

Yet he had always argued that the western military funds could wait and that foreign borrowing was not urgent.
要帮他的忙呢，又觉得自己一向主张“西饷可缓，洋款不急”，

Suddenly to support Zuo’s loan enthusiastically would contradict his earlier position and arouse suspicion.
忽然很热心地赞成左宗棠借这笔洋债，出尔反尔，启人疑窦。

Finding a way to satisfy both considerations occupied him throughout the day.
如何得以筹划出一个两全之道，成了他这天念兹在兹的一桩心事。


Early next morning, on his way to court, Bao Yun suddenly remembered a story Baosen had told him about Ding Baozhen.
第二天一早上朝，在轿子里忽然想起宝森告诉他的，丁宝祯当年的故事。

Ding was renowned for integrity, but as governor-general in the southwest he still had to maintain the dignity of his office.
丁宝祯以清廉知名，但身为总督，开府西南，朝延的体制不能不顾，

Friends and relatives from his native Guizhou crossed mountains and endured great hardships to seek his help.
家乡贵州的亲友，翻山越岭，千辛万苦来投靠，

There were not enough easy appointments to accommodate them all, but he could not neglect the obligations of offering food and lodging and providing their fares home.
没有那么多闲差使可应酬，招待食罕，致送回乡盘缠的情谊不能不尽，

These expenses came out of his monthly integrity allowance of about ten thousand taels.
这些都在他每个月一万两左右的“养廉银子”中支付，

However carefully he lived within his income, there were times when funds ran short.
尽管量人为出，总也有青黄不接的时候。

Most governors found this easy to remedy: a note to the provincial treasury brought whatever silver they required.
照一般督抚的惯例，方便得很，写张纸条，向藩库提银若干，困窘即时可解，

They need not worry about replacing it; the provincial treasurer, expectant intendants collecting taxes, and even the prefect and county magistrate of the provincial capital would find a way.
至于亏空如何弥补，不必费心，有藩司，有榷税的候补道，甚至首府、首县为他想办法。

But a man who did that could hardly reform official administration.
但那一来，就谈不到整饬吏治了。

Thus even a great governor-general had to turn to a pawnshop.
于是，堂堂“制台大人”也不免要向当铺求援了。

What could he possess that would raise thousands of taels?
可是，他又有什么东西能当到上千上万银子？

After much thought, he found only one solution: to pledge his rank and prestige.
想来想去只有一个当身分、当面子的办法，

He filled a leather trunk with old clothes, locked it, and pasted two dated strips bearing the great seal of the Governor-General of Sichuan firmly across it in a cross.
取一只皮箱，随便找些旧衣服塞满上锁，再取两张封条，盖上“四川总督部堂”的大印，标明日期，在皮箱上十字交叉，满浆实贴。

A goshha was then sent to carry it to a pawnshop.
然后派戈什哈抬到当铺里去当。

The appraiser was startled; he had never heard of a governor-general pawning things.
朝奉吓一跳，从来没有听说总督也会当当的，

Politely he asked how much was required.
便很客气地请问：“要当多少银子？”

“Five thousand taels.”
“五千银子。”

Startled again at the sum, he asked, “What valuable articles are inside?
朝奉又吓一跳，五千银子不是小数目，要问一问：“是什么贵重东西，

May I look?”
能不能看一看？”

“No.
“不能看。

His Excellency sealed it himself.
大人亲手贴的封条，

Who would dare break the seals?”
谁敢揭开来？”

“Then…”
“那么……”

“You need concern yourself with nothing else,” the guard interrupted.
“你不必多管。”戈什哈抢着说道：

“The seals are all you need.
“你只凭封条好了。

When it is redeemed, intact seals will show that nothing has been touched.
将来赎当的时候，只看封条完整，就是原封不动。

Do you understand?”
你明白了没有？”

The appraiser naturally did and advanced the full sum.
朝奉自然明白了，如数照当。

Ding proved a good customer.
丁宝祯倒是好主顾，

When the next month’s integrity allowance arrived from the treasury, he redeemed the trunk at once.
下个月藩库将养廉银子送到，立刻赎当。

Thereafter it became an established practice: the pawnshop lent on Ding’s seals alone, without further enquiry.
从此了宝祯当当，成了规矩，只凭封条不问其他。


Why should Zuo not borrow abroad on the same principle? Bao Yun thought.
室鋆心想，左宗棠借洋债，如果照丁宝祯的办法，

How much trouble that would save—and the present moment offered just the opportunity.
岂不省事？而且目前也正是一个机会。

He considered it silently, then, on reaching the Grand Council, sent a sula attendant to the southern office for Xu and drew him aside.
于是默默盘算了一阵，到得军机处，立刻派苏拉到“南屋”去请了徐用仪来，邀到僻处，悄悄相语。

“Have the arrangements for Marshal Zuo’s foreign loan been settled?”
“左帅借洋款的事，接头好了没有？”

“They have.
“接头好了。

The terms are indeed better than before.
这一回的条件，确是比以前来得好。

Hu Xueyan has been trying to make amends for his earlier faults.
这也是胡雪岩力盖前愆的缘故。”

A memorial was intended long ago, but the Eastern Empress Dowager’s death forced a delay.”
徐用仪又说：“本来早就想出奏了，为有东太后的大事，不能不暂缓一缓。”

“There is no need for further delay.
“也不必再缓。

Tell Grand Secretary Zuo that if he seeks formal permission to borrow, the matter must go to the Ministry of Revenue for deliberation, and the old accounts will have to be examined.” Bao Yun abruptly asked, “Have you heard the story of Ding Zhihuang’s pawning?”
请你转告左相，要朝廷批准他借，必得交户部议奏，也就要算老帐了。”宝鋆突然问道：“丁稚璜当当的故事，你听说过没有？”

Xu could not see why he asked but smiled deferentially.
徐用仪不知他忽有此问的用意，赔笑答道：

“It is a famous amusing story.
“那是个有名的笑话，

Many people know it.”
知道的人很多。”

“It is not an amusing story,” Bao Yun said gravely.
“不是笑话。”宝鋆正色说道：

“If I were the appraiser and lent five thousand taels against a few old clothes, how could I answer to my employer?
“如果我是朝奉，看几件破烂衣服，让他当五千银子，怎么对得起东家？

People would also talk about how much I had been paid to do it.
外头也一走有闲话，不知道我得了人家多少好处。

He has to force my hand and refuse to show me his cards; then I can do nothing.
他只有硬吃一注，不让我掀他的底牌，我拿他没办法。

Zuo’s loan is the same.
左相借债也是如此，

Once the raw rice is cooked, the court will overlook the matter out of respect for his long service.
生米煮成熟饭，朝廷看他的老面子，不跟他计较。

Do you understand?”
你属于我的意思不？”

Xu understood perfectly, but was too tactful to answer directly.
徐用仪怎能不懂？可是他也很圆滑，不作正面回答，只说：

“I am sure Lord Zuo will appreciate Your Excellency’s good intentions.”
“中堂的美意，我相信左大人一定能够领会。”

“Good.
“好。

But”—Bao Yun’s face grew stern—“Ding does this almost every month.
不过，”宝鋆沉着脸说：“丁稚磺当当，几乎月月如此，

Zuo’s foreign borrowing must be for this occasion only, never a precedent.
左相借洋债，可就是只此一回，下不为例。

Be sure to make that clear.”
请你千万说清楚。”

“Yes.”
“是。”


Promising was one thing; delivering the message was another.
答应归答应，说不说又另是一回事。

After leaving duty, Xu first visited Hu and repeated Bao Yun’s words, asking whether he should convey the final sentence.
徐用仪退值以后，先去访胡雪岩，将宝鋆的话，告诉了他，商量最后的那句话，要不要说。

“Of course not,” Hu replied.
“当然不必说。”胡雪岩答道：

“The situation is plain.
“事情明摆在那里，

The western campaign has succeeded, and there will be no more foreign loans for it.
西征军事成功了，以后也再不会借洋款了。

Loans for coastal defence are another matter, and no concern of Lord Zuo’s or mine.
至于海防要借，那也不是左大人跟我的事。

Why say something that will only displease him?”
既然如此，何必又说这话，惹左大人不高兴？”

Xu followed this advice.
徐用仪听从他的主张，

At Xianliang Temple he passed on Bao Yun’s suggestion.
到了贤良寺，转达了宝鋆的意见。

Zuo had already intended to act in that way, but had not expected such “generosity” from Bao Yun.
左宗棠本来就想这么办，但未想到宝鋆如此“大方”，

Delighted and reassured, he personally took up his brush to draft the memorial.
欣慰之余，乘兴亲自妨笔起草奏槁。

Its first paragraph naturally explained the importance of frontier affairs and the difficulties caused by provincial military contributions that arrived late, with arrears mounting year after year.
第一段当然是陈述边务之重要，以及各省协饷，不能及时而至，拖欠年复一年，越积越多的困难。

It then described the origins of the proposed loan: “The German merchant Focke heard of the matter at the Lanzhou woollen mill and declared that substantial funds could be borrowed in his country at a low cost in interest and charges, against notes issued by the governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.”
接下来便叙此次筹借洋款的由来：说有“德国商伙福克，在兰州织呢局闻之，自称该国有巨款可借，息耗亦轻，并可由陕甘总督出票”，

A memorial had therefore been submitted on the third day of the twelfth month of the preceding year.
因子上年腊月初三日具奏，

The Ministry of Revenue had replied that, although the amount had been stated as four million taels, the term, interest, and sources of repayment required further explanation.
接到户部咨复，以借数虽经奏明为四百万，惟期限、利息，以及还款来源，应该补叙说明。

By then Zuo had been ordered to the capital and, no longer holding the provincial post, should seemingly no longer concern himself with its affairs.
但其时左宗棠已奉旨晋京，不在其位，似乎不应再谋其政，

This too required explanation: “When I relinquished my seal and set out north, I spoke with Liu Jintang and Yang Changjun.
所以此处须作一番解释：“臣卸篆北上时，与刘锦棠、杨昌浚晤谈，

Both said that, having only just assumed office, they faced difficulty in raising military funds and asked me to arrange borrowing on their behalf.
均以甫经接任，筹饷艰难，属臣代为借筹。

Although about to leave my post, I did not wish to burden my successors.
臣虽去任在即，亦不俗贻累替人，

I therefore urgently directed Circuit Intendant Hu Guangyong, in charge of the Shanghai Purchasing and Transport Bureau, to negotiate a loan of four million taels from foreign merchants to meet the pressing need.
遂飞饬办理上海采运局道员胡光墉，速向洋商议借银四百万，以应急需。

Since reaching the capital, I have received successive letters from Yang Changjun and Liu Jintang reporting that their sources of funds are exhausted and that they cannot maintain payments at the turn of spring and summer.
抵都后，连接杨昌浚、刘锡棠来函，言及饷源已涸，春夏之交，断难接续，

Their requests that I lay the facts before the throne are exceptionally urgent.”
恳即据情入告，情词迫切异常。”

The terms that followed were based on the representations of “Hu Guangyong, together with Focke of the German Tailai Trading House and Cameron of the British HSBC.”
以下是根据“胡光塘偕同德国泰来行伙福克及英国汇丰行伙凯密伦”所称，开具办法。


The principal was four million treasury-standard taels of full-fineness silver sycee, repayable within six years, at an annual interest rate of 9.75 per cent.
借款数目：库平足色宝银四百万两。期限：六年还清。利率：年息九分七厘五毫。

Interest was to be paid every six months, in twelve instalments over the six years.
付息办法：每六个月一付，六年共十二期。

No principal would be repaid in the first two years.
还本办法：第一、第二两年不还本，

From the third year, one million taels would be repaid annually, with interest reduced accordingly.
第三年起，每年还本一百万两。利息照减。

As security, the Ministry of Revenue was asked to urge the provinces and customs offices to remit their current and overdue military contributions directly to the Shanghai Purchasing and Transport Bureau for payment of interest and principal.
保证办法：请户部催饬各省关，将应解新旧协饷，径交上海采运局，据付息还本。

If the contributions failed to arrive and the bureau had no funds to disburse, the foreign merchants were to be allowed to present the sealed notes issued by the governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu and collect payment from the Ministry of Revenue when due.
如协饷不至，上海采运局无款可拨，应准洋商凭陕甘总督所出印票，向户部如期兑取。

These terms offered three advantages over earlier loans.
这些条件与过去比较，好处有三：

First, no notes were required from the customs or the governors and governors-general of the provinces concerned, avoiding much complication.
一是不需海关及有关各省督抚出票，可免周折，

Second, annual interest had fallen from more than twelve per cent to less than ten, equivalent to just over eight-tenths of one per cent a month.
二是年息由一钱二分多减至不足一钱，合月息只八厘有零，

Third, postponing repayment of principal for two years would allow the provinces to clear their earlier arrears: “Their resources will thus have some respite, without the danger of being pressed beyond their means.”
三是头两年不还本，俾各省得以清理旧欠，“其力尚纾，并无窘迫之患。”

For these reasons, “Hu Guangyong, Focke, and Cameron have already been instructed to proceed under the agreed terms.
因为如此，“已饬胡光墉、福克、凯密伦即依照定议，

We humbly implore Imperial grace to direct the Zongli Yamen to issue instructions to Circuit Intendant Hu Guangyong and to notify the British minister, for transmission to HSBC, that all parties shall comply, so that Shaanxi and Gansu may issue the notes and draw the silver.”
应仰恳天恩敕下总理衙门，札饬道员胡光塘及照会英国使臣转行汇丰银行，一体遵照，以便陕甘出票提银”。


The memorial was submitted on the first day of the fourth month, and the reply came that same day: “Let the office concerned take cognizance.”
出奏那天是四月初一，当天就奉到批复：“该衙门知道。”

This meant that the arrangement was accepted for the record.
也就是准予备案的意思，

The office concerned was the Zongli Yamen, formally the Office for the General Management of Affairs with Foreign Countries.
“该衙门”指总理各国事务衙门。

It worked in close conjunction with the Grand Council.
这个衙门与军机处互为表里，

Its officials were likewise called secretaries and enjoyed the same generous conditions.
办事司官，亦称章京，待遇优厚，亦与军机章京相同，

The difference in organization was that the Grand Council secretaries served in two alternating shifts but all handled the same kinds of business, whereas those of the Zongli Yamen each had their own field.
规制不同的是，军机章京分为头班、二班、轮班入值，而所办之事并无两佯，总督章京则各有专司，

This case belonged to the British and German sections, and Xu naturally made the necessary contacts.
此案归“英国股”及“德国股”所管，自有徐用仪代为接头，

Cameron’s presence also made it easy to obtain the British legation’s authorization for HSBC to lend.
同时因为有汇丰银行的凯密伦同来，英国公使馆批准汇丰银行照借的手续，亦很顺利，

In only three days, every formality was complete.
不过三天工夫，一切都齐备了。



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第二章（下）
Towers of Light — Chapter Two, Part Two
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Their departure nevertheless had to wait.
但赋归却还有待。

There were several reasons.
原因很多，

First, they had decided to return south by steamer, and the sailings followed a fixed schedule.
第一是南归决定坐轮船，班期有定，

The first-class accommodation on the next ship had already been reserved.
而最近一班船的“大餐问”，已为人定下了，

Hu Xueyan insisted that everything provided for Baosen must be the best available; he would rather wait for the following sailing, ten days later.
胡雪岩认为招待宝森，什么都是要“最好的”，宁愿再等一班，那要在十天以后。


Second, Hu wanted to take home a specially ordered supply of medicinal plasters.
第二是胡雪岩要定制一批膏药带回去。

Ever since he had begun managing supplies for the western campaign and established a transshipment bureau in Shanghai, everything he touched had prospered.
从经管西征粮台，在上海设转运局开始，胡雪岩无事不顺手，

Enormous profits often came overnight; sometimes he scarcely understood himself how the money had been made.
常是一夕之间，获利巨万，财是怎么发的，连他自己都不甚清楚。

His strength, however, had gradually declined.
但精神却渐渐差了，

He ate less, slept poorly, and grew thinner by the day.
饮食渐减，夜卧不安，人一天比一天瘦了下来，

His mother and all the women of the household became frantic, burning incense, making vows, and performing charitable deeds wherever they could, in the hope of securing Heaven's protection.
急得胡老太太以下，全家女眷都是到处烧香许愿，大做好事，祈求上苍保佑，

Nothing helped.
然而没有什么用处。

Once, at a social gathering, he met Zhou Litang, a man who had purchased eligibility for a county magistracy and was awaiting an appointment in Hubei. Zhou had come to Shanghai on official business and was skilled at reading faces.
有一次在应酬场中，遇见一个在湖北候补，而到上海来出差的捐班知县，名叫周理堂，善于看相，

He examined the company in turn, offering light remarks that frequently struck home.
遍相座客，谈言微中，

Of Hu, he predicted that the next ten years would bring even greater fortune than he enjoyed already: one day people would call him the God of Wealth.
看到胡雪岩，说他往后十年大运，犹胜于今，将来会有“财神”之号。

“To tell you the truth, Mr Litang, my strength is failing.
“不瞒理翁说，我的精神很坏，

A man needs energy to accomplish anything.
事情要有精神来做的，

Without it, the only fortune awaiting me is a place in the grave.
没有精神只会交墓库运，

How could I possibly enjoy a great run of luck?”
哪里会有什么大运。”

“That is because you have not learned to free your mind, Mr Xueyan.
“这是因为雪翁想不开的缘故，

Once you do, I guarantee that your spirits will revive a hundredfold.”
一想开了，包你精神百倍。”

The words themselves gave Hu a lift.
听得这话，胡雪岩先就精神一振，

“Then I must ask your advice.
“理翁，倒要请教，

In what way is my mind not free?
我是怎么想不开。”他问：

How am I to free it?”
“要怎么样才想得开？”

“It is not a subject we can discuss properly in a few hurried words.
“此中之理，非仓促之间能谈得透彻的。

Where is your residence?
雪翁公馆在哪里，

Once I have finished my official business and have a little leisure, I shall call on you, and we can talk at length.”
等我勾当了公事，稍微闲一闲，登门拜访，从容呈教。”


Hu knew the sort of expectant local official who read a manual such as The Hemp-Clad Master's Art of Physiognomy, then talked at random to flatter his superiors, hoping to win an appointment or an assignment.
胡雪岩心想，官场上专有那种读了一本《麻衣相法》，信口开河，目的是为了奉承上司，讨得欢心，企求谋得一缺半差的候补州县班子。

Zhou's conversation suggested that he was a different kind of man.
而看周理堂的谈吐，不象是那一流人物，

“I could hardly trouble you to come all that way,” Hu replied, then added, “Forgive my asking, but what business has brought you here?”
当即答说：“不敢清理翁劳步。”接着又说：“恕我冒昧，理翁这趟是啥公事？”

“His Majesty is getting married this year.
“今年皇上大婚，

The governor sent me to Shanghai to purchase tribute gifts.
我奉抚宪之命，到上海来采办贡品，

Everything has been selected, but there was an error in the amount of money Hubei was supposed to remit.
东西都看好了，无奈湖北应该汇来的款子数目弄错了，

I have been running about over it for days.
连日为此事奔走，

It will take another four or five days to settle everything.”
总还要四、五天首尾才会清楚。”

“Ah!
“喔！

You mean the official funds are insufficient?”
理翁是说公款不够。”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

“How much are you short?”
“差多少？”

“A little over thirteen thousand taels.”
“一万三千多两。”

“I see, I see.
“喔，喔，”胡雪岩问说：

The money should arrive soon, I suppose?”
“总快到了吧？”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

“Good.”
“那好。”


The next morning Hu called on Zhou at the Xianghe Inn.
第二天上午，胡雪岩到周理堂所住的祥和客栈去拜访，

Someone inside Zhou's room was arguing vigorously with him.
只听得有人在他屋子里大办交涉，

The voice sounded familiar, though Hu could not at first place it.
声音很熟，想不起来是什么人？

Then the man happened to turn, and Hu recognized Old Xiao, the counter manager at the Fang Jiuxia Jewellery Shop.
及至偶然一照面，认出来了，是方九霞银楼的档手老萧。

“Mr Hu!”
“胡大先生，”

Abandoning Zhou, Xiao hurried out, smiling and bending a knee in greeting.
老萧丢开周理堂奔了出来，笑嘻嘻地打了个千问：

“What brings you here too, sir?”
“你老怎么也来了。”

“What a curious question!”
“ 你这话问得奇怪！”

Having noticed how discourteously Xiao had been treating Zhou, Hu deliberately kept a stern face.
胡雪岩因为看刚才那番光景，老萧对周理堂不甚礼貌，所以有意板着脸说：

“Are you allowed to come here while I am not?”
“就许你来，不许我来？”

“That is not what I meant!
“不是这话，

Not at all!” Xiao protested hastily.
不是这话！”老萧急忙辩解：

“I have some business to discuss with Magistrate Zhou.”
“我是有生意来跟周大老爷接头。”

“Business?
“接头生意？

Have you never heard that good temper brings prosperity?
莫非你不晓得和气生财？

What is all this racket about?”
哗喇哗喇啥事体。”

Having rebuked him, Hu turned to greet Zhou with warmth and courtesy, leaving Xiao standing neglected at one side.
训斥完了，转身与周理堂叙礼，客气而亲热，将个老萧干搁在一旁，置之不理。

Zhou himself felt rather uncomfortable about this.
倒是周理堂有点过意不去，

“Please take a seat, Mr Xueyan.
“雪翁，你请稍坐。”他说：

Let me settle matters with Manager Xiao first.”
“我跟这萧掌柜先打个交道。”

“Of course.”
“请便。”


With Hu present, Xiao was less overbearing than before, although his terms remained uncompromising.
有胡雪岩在座，那老萧不似刚才那样嚣张了，但话仍说得很硬。

Zhou had ordered a jade ruyi sceptre inlaid with gold from Fang Jiuxia.
原来周理堂在方九霞定了一柄玉镶金如意，

Materials and workmanship came to nine thousand taels, of which he had paid only two thousand as a deposit.
工料总计九千银子，只付了两干定金。

The sceptre was finished, and the shop had been pressing him to take delivery and settle the account; he had no money to do so.
如意制就，来催交货，周理堂无以为应。

Meanwhile, the governor of Guangxi had also sent an agent to buy tribute gifts.
就在这时候，广西巡抚亦派人来采办贡品，

Short of time, the agent was becoming anxious.
因为时间迫促，颇为焦急。

Hearing of this, Xiao had approached him with an offer: he could have the Hubei governor's sceptre at its original price.
老萧打听到这件事，上门兜揽生意，说湖北巡抚订的玉镶金如意，愿照原价转让。

The inscription invoking the nine blessings of the poem “Heaven Protects You,” together with the upper dedication, could remain; only the province and donor's name in the lower inscription needed changing.
如意上所錾的“天保九如”字样，以及上款都可不动，下款只改动省名、姓名便能合用，

It would involve almost no trouble.
毫不费事。

The Guangxi agent was both decisive and shrewd.
广西的差官办事很干脆，也很精明，

He judged nine thousand taels a reasonable price and was willing to buy, provided there was proof that Hubei's agent had actually abandoned his claim.
估价九千银子不贵，愿意照价收买，但必须能够证明，湖北的差官确是放弃了才能成交。

Xiao had therefore come to put pressure on Zhou: payment must be made by a stated deadline, or the deposit would be forfeited to compensate the shop for its loss.
为此，老萧便来逼周理堂，限期限件，否则没收定金，作为补偿损失。

With no money to strengthen his hand, Zhou could scarcely speak firmly.
周理堂手头不硬，口头上就不能不软，

The wrangling had been wearing him down when Hu arrived.
正在磨得心烦意乱之时，胡雪岩来了。

Once Hu understood the matter, he intervened.
弄清楚了是怎么回事，胡雪岩便开口了，

“Old Xiao, what exactly do you propose?”
“老萧”，他问：“你打算怎么样？

Xiao knew at once that his clever scheme had failed.
“胡雪岩一出头，老萧便知如意算盘落空了，

“You know yourself, Mr Hu, that gold has risen again these last two days.
“胡大先生晓得的，这两夭金价又涨了。”他说：

Frankly, we have already lost money on Magistrate Zhou's sceptre.
“打周大老爷的这柄如意，说实话已经亏本了，

It ties up a great deal of capital, too.
而且吃本很重，

Every further delay costs us interest.
再拖下去，利息上又是损失，

I cannot answer to my employer for that.”
我对我们东家不好交代。”

“Well, what do you propose?”
“那么怎么样呢？”

“I thought we could allow another three days.”
“我想，再等三天。”


“There is no need.”
“不必。”

Hu turned to Zhou.
胡雪岩转脸对周理堂说：

“This is a small amount, Mr Litang.
“理翁，这是笔小数，

Why did you not mention it sooner, instead of putting up with their insolence?”
你为啥早不跟我讲，宁愿来受他们的气！”

He took an envelope from the pocket of his riding jacket and handed it over.
说着，从马褂口袋里掏出一个信封，递了过去。

Zhou drew out a banknote for fourteen thousand taels.
抽出来一看，是一万四千两的一张银票，

Gratitude mingled with humiliation, and he nearly wept.
心里又甜又酸，几乎掉泪。

Hu feared he might say something excessively self-abasing in front of Xiao, which would embarrass Hu as well.
胡雪岩怕他说出什么过于谦卑的话，当着老萧面连自己也失面子，

He therefore spoke quickly.
所以很快他说道：

“Go back at once, Old Xiao, and bring the gold sceptre.
“老萧，你快回去，把金如意送来，

Once Magistrate Zhou has inspected it and found it satisfactory, you will receive every last penny.”
周大老爷验收不错，自然分文不少你的。”

“Yes, sir!
“是，

Certainly!
是！”老萧诺诺连声，

I shall bring it immediately.”
“马上送来，马上送来。”

“Wait!” Hu called him back and turned again to Zhou.
“慢慢！”胡雪岩将老萧唤住，转脸说道：

“On second thoughts, having it brought here would be unwise.
“理翁，我想送了来也不好，

It would expose you to risk and attract attention.
一则要担风险，再则也怕招摇。

Why do I not accompany you to Fang Jiuxia to inspect it?
不如我陪理翁到方九霞验货，

If everything is in order, you can pay the balance and have the shop issue a receipt acknowledging that it is holding the sceptre for you.
果然不错，就把余款付清了它，叫方九霞出张寄存金如意的条子，

Then, when you leave, it can be delivered straight to the ship.
动身的时候直接送上船，

Would that not save trouble?”
岂不省事。”

“Quite right.
“说得是。

But I could not trouble you to accompany me.
不过不敢劳雪翁相陪，

I shall send someone to arrange it.”
我派人去办这件事就是。”

Zhou summoned a clerk who had come with him, handed him Hu's banknote, and gave detailed instructions.
当下将他随带的一名司事找了来，拿胡雪岩的银票交了给他，一一交代清楚。

Only after the clerk had left with Xiao did he begin thanking Hu.
等司事跟老萧一走，方始开口道谢。

“A trifling matter!” Hu said.
“小事，小事！”胡雪岩问道：

“Is there anything else you still need to settle?”
“理翁还有什么未了？”

“Thank you, thank you.
“多谢，多谢。

Nothing else.” Zhou immediately asked how he should repay the money.
没有了。”周理堂紧接着问：“这笔款子，如何归还？”

“Entirely at your convenience,” Hu replied, then continued, “If you have no urgent business, I should like you to show me the way out of my confusion.
“悉听尊便。”胡雪岩紧接着说：“倘或理翁没有急事要办，我想请理翁指点指点迷津，

In what respect is my mind not free?
我是怎么想不开？

I am not aware of anything constantly weighing on it.”
我自己倒不觉得有什么事老挂在心里。”


“With your intelligence, Mr Xueyan, you would already have freed yourself if you were aware of it.
“以雪翁的智慧，自己觉得，就不至于想不开了。

It is precisely because the thought remains hidden that you are habitually oppressed.” Zhou continued, “There is nothing particularly mysterious about reading faces.
正因为那个念头隐而不显，所以居恒郁郁。”周理堂又说：“看相这件事，本无足奇，

Still, it takes experience to look through a face into the mind behind it.
不过在脸上看到心里，也要有些阅历。

There is a thief in your heart.
雪翁心中有贼，

Until you drive him out, you cannot regain your vitality.”
此贼不除，精神就好不起来。”

“Ah!”
“喔！”

Hu had heard the saying that it was easy to remove the bandits in the mountains, but difficult to remove the bandit in one's heart.
胡雪岩也听说过“去山中贼易，去心中贼难”这句话，当即问说：

“What is this thief in my heart?”
“我心中之贼是指哈？”

“Money.
“钱。

That single word.
一个钱字。”

Do you not think of it constantly?”
周理堂问：“雪翁是不是常常想到它？”

“I run a bank,” Hu answered with a laugh.
“我是开钱庄的。”胡雪岩笑道：

“People call our trade ‘turning somersaults inside the hole of a copper coin.’
“我们这一行，称之为‘铜钱眼里翻筋斗’，

If I do not think about money, what am I to think about?”
不想到钱，想什么？”

“Exactly!
“是不是？

That is why I say there is a thief in your heart.
我说雪翁心中有贼！

You are a man of heroic ability, Mr Xueyan.
雪翁是大英雄，

Why should you too be trapped by our square-holed friend, unable to break free?”
何以亦为孔方兄所困，跳不出来？”

Somewhat ashamed, Hu considered this for a while.
听得这话，胡雪岩不免惭愧，想了好一会说：

“I think I begin to understand your meaning.
“理翁的话，我听出点味道来了。

But I still do not know how to escape.
就不知道怎么才能跳得出来。

It would be hard for me to stop thinking about money.
要我不想到钱这一个字，只怕不容易，

I have been learning about it ever since I entered business as a boy.
从小学生意就是学的这个，

It is so deeply rooted that it has become part of my nature.
根深抵固，跟本性一样了，

How can I put it out of my mind?”
怎么能不去想它。”

“You need not stop thinking about it.
“想也可以。

Think about spending it instead of making it, and you will have escaped.”
只要不是想赚钱，而是想花钱，就跳出来了。”

“You must explain further.”
“这话，还要请理翁明示。”

“The principle is simple.
“道理很简单。”周理堂说：

Suppose you decide to build a garden.
“譬如雪翁想造一座花园，

That involves spending money, but what occupies your thoughts is how to design its towers and terraces, how to gather flowers and trees, how to bring spring water into it, and whom to invite to name and celebrate its features.
这是花钱，可是所想的是如何起造楼台、如何罗致花木、如何引泉入园、如何请人品题。

These are enjoyable things to think about.
这些东西想起来是很有趣的，

Before you know it, the word ‘money’ has slipped from your mind.
自然而然把个‘钱，字忘掉了。

Of course, not everyone can do this.
当然，这也不是人人办得到的，

A man without sufficient means would only create fresh worries and trouble for himself.
力量不够，要为钱犯愁，反而是自寻烦忙，

But you have no need to worry about money, and consequently no need to suffer those anxieties.”
雪翁根本不必愁钱，当然也就不会有烦忙。“


This reminded Hu of something another man had told him.
这使得胡雪岩想起了一个人的话。

The man, surnamed Lei, came from Jiangxi.
此入姓雷，江西人，

His family had served in the Imperial Household Department for generations, beginning in the Kangxi reign.
他家从廉熙年间开始，世世代代在内务府当差，

Whenever a palace was to be built, they were first asked to prepare the design, then to construct a scale model from stiff cardboard shaped with heat.
凡有宫殿营造之事，都先找他家设计，然后按照尺寸比例，用硬纸版烫出样子来，

So famous had the family become as “Model Lei” that the man's actual given name was scarcely known.
出了名的“样子雷”，真姓名反而不为人所知了。

On one visit to the capital, Hu had met him socially and heard him recount his ancestors' history.
有一年胡雪岩进京，在应酬场中认识了“样子雷”，听他谈先世的掌故，

The family's greatest period had begun after the sixteenth year of Qianlong, when its principal work was the expansion of the Yuanming Yuan.
说他家全盛时代是在乾隆十六年以后，主要的职司是扩建一座圆明园，

Once a structure was complete, the emperor would inspect it.
建成了请皇帝来看，

Anything he disliked was immediately demolished and rebuilt; if the alteration still displeased him, down it came again.
某处不妥，立即拆掉改建，改得不满意，复又拆去，

Building and demolition followed one another countless times.
这样建了拆，拆了建，不知多少遍，

Throughout the remainder of Qianlong's sixty-year reign, there was not a single day without major construction at the garden.
总之终乾隆六十年，圆明园无一日不在大兴土木之中。

The treasury had been full in those days.
乾隆年间。国库充盈，

Whatever gave the emperor pleasure, he could pursue freely, without worrying about its cost.
皇帝只要觉得什么事能够怡情悦性，尽可以放手去做，不必愁钱，

Perhaps this helped explain his remarkable longevity.
这也许就是他能够克享大年的道理。

Comparing Zhou's advice with Qianlong's example, Hu radically changed his habits.
听了周理堂的话，印证乾隆皇帝的作为，胡雪岩的行事大改常度，

He still thought about making money, but devoted more thought to spending it.
虽仍然不忘如何赚钱，但想得更多的是，如何花钱？

He built extensive gardens and indulged himself in music and women.
大起园林，纵情声色。

His former sleeplessness and melancholy disappeared, only to be replaced by another complaint: what physicians called kidney deficiency.
以前眠前不安，郁郁寡欢的毛病倒是消失了，却别添了一样病：肾亏。

Fortunately, he owned the foremost pharmacy in the country and knew innumerable eminent doctors, secret prescriptions, and rare medicines.
好得是开设着一家海内第一的大药铺，连带也认识了无数名医、秘方珍药，

Remedies intended to fortify his constitution and replenish his vitality did something to make up the loss.
固本培元，差能弥补。

The restorative he valued most was a medicinal plaster with the unappealing name of “dogskin plaster.”
补药中最为胡雪岩所重视的是一种膏药，名称很难听，叫做“狗皮膏”，

Its effects, however, were marvellous: with its help, even taking several more concubines would present him with no difficulty.
但效用神妙，有了它，胡雪岩多娶几房姬妾也不要紧了。


The plaster was available only from a hereditary pharmacy in Beijing.
这狗皮膏，只有在北京一家祖传的药铺才有。

Hu had offered a considerable sum to persuade its proprietor to move south and manufacture it exclusively at Hu Qingyu Hall, but without success.
胡雪岩曾不惜重金，想聘请这家药铺的主人南下，到胡庆余堂去专制狗皮膏，却未能如愿，

Buying the secret formula was an even more hopeless proposition.
想买他的秘方，便更是妄想了。

Every spring, therefore, he had to send someone specially to Beijing to purchase a supply.
因此，胡雪岩每逢春天，就得派专人到北京来采办狗皮膏。

This year, since he had come himself, there was no need for a separate messenger.
这年自己进京，就不必再派人了。

Immediately on arrival, he had told Wang Weixian to order three hundred plasters.
一到就关照汪惟贤订购三百帖狗皮膏，

One essential ingredient was unavailable, however, and the order remained unfinished.
只以一样重要药材缺货，尚未制就，

Since Hu insisted on taking the medicine south with him, he had no choice but to wait.
而胡雪岩可坚持要随身携药南归，这一来就不能不等了。

When it finally arrived, a piece of news brought by Xu Yongyi made him decide to stay in the capital a little longer.
及至等到了药，却因徐用仪带来的一个消息，胡雪岩决走再在京里住一阵，

He wanted to see just how far one particular man's extraordinary influence could carry him.
要看一个人的神通到底大到如何程度？

“Take the foreigners and accompany Second Master Sen south first,” he told Gu. “I want to see whether he can get through this ordeal.
“你带着洋人陪森二爷先走。我倒要看看他这一关过得了，过不了？”胡雪岩说：

Nobody understands his tricks better than I do.
“他的这套把戏，只有我顶清楚，

His Excellency Zuo may ask me about them; and another opportunity may present itself.”
说不定左大人会问我，也说不定另外还会有机会。”

What other opportunity?
另外会有什么机会呢？

Gu understood.
古应春明白，

If the man fell, Hu would not only be rid of a formidable commercial rival; he might also be able to take over the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company.
如果“他”倒了，不独胡雪岩去了一个商场上的劲敌，而且也可能接办招商局。


The man Hu meant was Sheng Xuanhuai of Changzhou, whose courtesy name was Xingsun.
胡雪岩口中的“他”，是个常州人，名叫盛宣怀，字杏荪。

His father, Sheng Kang, courtesy name Xuren, had earned the jinshi degree in the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang.
他的父亲单名康，字旭人。盛康是道光二十四年的进士，

Beginning in local administration, he had risen to become circuit intendant at Hankou before retiring.
由州县做起，做到汉口道告老还乡，

He now lived as a gentleman of standing in Suzhou, a position his son needed him to use in cultivating connections among Jiangsu officials.
在苏州当绅士，因为盛宣怀需要利用老父的这种身分，在江苏官场上为他打交道。

Sheng Xuanhuai was a licentiate.
盛宣怀是一名秀才，

As a young man he had studied medicine with the celebrated Fei family of Menghe.
年轻时跟有名的“孟河费家”学过医。

A physician ought to possess a spirit of self-sacrifice, even a willingness to cut flesh from his own thigh for another; Sheng, however, was always looking for opportunities to profit at someone else's expense.
医家要有割股之心，而盛宣怀只要有机会，就要打人家的主意，

Recognizing that medicine was not his calling, he had gone to Beijing and purchased a secretary's rank in preparation for an official career.
自觉不宜入这一行，所以进京捐了个主事，准备入仕。

This was near the end of the Tongzhi reign.
时当同治未年，

Li Hongzhang, Governor-General of Zhili and Northern Trade Commissioner, was vigorously developing Western-style enterprises.
直隶总督北洋大臣李鸿章大兴洋务，

Sheng had a particularly quick grasp of such matters, an excellent memory, and an even better tongue.
盛宣怀在这方面的脑筋特别快，而且记性好，口才更好，

By searching out every opening, he managed to obtain an audience with Li, who was greatly impressed.
钻头觅缝，得以见了李鸿章一面。相谈之下，大蒙赏识，

Sheng then paid for further distinctions and qualifications, and Li memorialized to have him transferred to the Northern administration as an expectant circuit intendant.
便加捐了“花样”，以候补道的身分，为李鸿章奏调到北洋当差，

Soon he became associate administrator of China Merchants.
不久被派为招商局的会办，

Thus, while holding expectant status in Zhili, he remained in Shanghai for long periods, half official and half merchant, devising one scheme after another.
以直隶的候补道，久驻上海，亦官亦商，花样百出。


China Merchants had been founded in the eleventh year of Tongzhi on Li's recommendation.
招商局创办于同治十一年，出于李鸿章的建议，

To counter foreign steamship companies, he proposed that the government build merchant vessels for Chinese merchants to hire and operate, with permission to carry tribute grain as well.
为了抵制外商轮船，“拟准官造商船，由华商雇领，并准其兼运漕粮，

This would provide them with a reserved source of business and prevent foreign merchants from driving them out.
惮有专门生意，而不为洋商所排挤”。

Imperial permission was granted for a trial.
奉旨准予试办，

The Northern administration advanced funds, additional merchant shares were solicited, and Zhu Qi'ang, an expectant prefect serving as Zhejiang's sea-transport commissioner, was appointed to organize the undertaking.
即由北洋拨惜经费，另招商股，派浙江海运委员候补知府朱其昂筹办，

Named the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company, it bought a steamer from Britain and began operations.
定名轮船招商局，向英国买了一条轮船，开始营业。

Poor management consumed its original capital in scarcely six months.
由于经营不容，不过半年工夫，老本亏得光光。

Hu, one of the shareholders, lost several tens of thousands of taels.
胡雪岩是股东之一，也送了几万银子在里头。

In the summer of the twelfth year of Tongzhi, Chen Qin, the Tianjin customs intendant, recommended that Li send Lin Cuo, an expectant assistant prefect, to Shanghai to reorganize it.
同治十二年夏天，天津海关道陈钦建议李鸿章，派候补同知林搓到上海整理。

Both Chen and Lin were Cantonese, and Lin naturally turned to fellow Cantonese in Shanghai: Tang Tingshu, comprador of Pahe Bank, and the wealthy merchant Xu Run.
陈、林都是广东人，林搓在上海自然亦是找广东同乡，一个是怕和银行的买办唐廷枢，另外一个是富商徐润，

They raised more than four hundred thousand taels in merchant subscriptions and took over.
由他们募集商股四十余万两银子接办。

But because the enterprise already contained official capital and received government payments for transport, it remained a merchant-operated concern under official supervision, controlled by the Northern administration.
但本有官本，且又领官款为运费，所以仍然是官督商办，由北洋控制。

It was on this basis that Li could send Sheng there as associate administrator.
此所以盛宣怀得以由李鸿章派去当会办。


After the reorganization, China Merchants steadily improved.
改组后的招商局，业务日有起色。

Xu Run separately established an insurance company to cover its vessels, using the public undertaking to advance his private interests and making handsome profits.
徐润又别组保险公司，承保本局船险，假公济私，大发利市。

Confronted with a powerful competitor, the foreign steamship companies saw their business decline.
洋商轮船公司，遇到劲敌，业务大不如前。

Shares in the American firm of Qichang, which had once risen to nearly twice their face value of one hundred taels, fell to fifty-odd taels and seemed likely to fall further.
美商旗昌洋行的股票，本来票面百两升值已近一倍，结果跌到五十几两，且有继续下跌的趋势。

Xu therefore conceived the idea of purchasing Qichang.
于是徐润起意收买旗昌，

Under Sheng's direction, however, the acquisition became a fraud.
但在盛宣怀的策划之下，变成了一个骗局。

Its victim was to be Shen Baozhen, Governor-General of Liangjiang and Southern Trade Commissioner, who had previously served as governor of Jiangxi and commissioner of the Fujian shipbuilding administration.
骗谁呢？骗曾当过江西巡抚、福建船政大臣的两江总督南洋大臣沈葆祯，

In reality, it was public money they intended to defraud.
而实际上是骗公家的钱。

Sheng's scheme was ingenious.
盛宣怀的设计很巧妙。

First, he secretly used China Merchants' government funds to buy Qichang shares.
第一步是利用招商局的官款，秘密收买旗昌的股票，

Once he had a reasonable prospect of gaining control, he went to Nanjing with Tang and Xu.
到得有相当把握，可以接收旗是时，盛宣怀偕同唐廷枢、徐润取袂到了南京，

Their first task was to win over the provincial treasurer, Mei Qixu.
首先是说动藩司梅启煦。

Jiangsu had two such treasurers: the Jiangsu treasurer resided at Suzhou with the provincial governor, while the Jiangning treasurer resided at Jiangning—Nanjing—with the Governor-General of Liangjiang.
江苏有两个藩司，一个称为江苏潘司随江苏巡抚驻苏州，一个称为江宁藩司，随两江总督驻江宁——南京。

After arranging matters with Mei, they submitted a petition to the Governor-General, declaring that Qichang was willing to be absorbed for a price of more than two and a half million taels.
梅启煦的关节打通了，方始向总督衙门上了一个呈文，说旗昌洋行甘心归并，开价二百五十余万，

If it could be acquired, the potential profits would be too great to estimate at once.
倘能收买，获利之丰，一时难以估计。


Shen was a man willing to take responsibility.
沈葆祯亦是勇于任事之人，

Although ill at the time, he would not delay an undertaking promising such substantial benefits.
当时虽在病中，以大利所在，不愿延搁，

He received Sheng, Xu, and their companions at his sickbed to hear their explanation.
在病榻召见盛宣怀、徐润等人，听取说明。

It was the thirteenth day of the eleventh month in the second year of Guangxu.
这天是光绪二年十一月十三日。

Sheng, adept at manipulating figures, presented a persuasive argument supported by evidence, and Shen was delighted.
盛宣怀善于玩弄数字，讲得头头是道，且有佐证，沈葆祯听得满心欢喜。

Yet although China Merchants fell partly within Southern jurisdiction, the Northern administration had always taken the lead.
但招商局南洋虽亦管得到，而一向以北洋为主，

Shen therefore proposed consulting the Northern Trade Commissioner and submitting a joint memorial.
所以沈葆祯表示，这件事应该会商北洋大臣，共同具奏。

“We must not miss this opportunity!” Sheng explained that the foreign year ended ten days after the winter solstice, which that year meant the sixteenth of the eleventh month, four days away.
“机不可失！”盛宣怀为沈葆祯解释，洋人以冬至后十日为岁终，在这年便是四天以后的十一月十六。

The company's managers changed every three years, and the present manager's term ended on that date.
公司主管三年更换一次，现任的主管，任期到那一天为止。

Once his successor arrived, negotiations would have to begin again, and such favourable terms would no longer be available.
过了十一月十六，新任主管一到，重新谈判，便捡不到这个便宜。

The new manager might even raise substantial capital and revive the company, threatening China Merchants.
或者新任主管，另集巨资，重整旗鼓，招商局便会遭受威胁，

Only by seizing the opportunity to absorb Qichang could China Merchants secure an unassailable position.
惟有乘机归并旗昌。招商局始能立于不败之地。

“There are ordinary rules and there are exceptional circumstances,” he concluded.
结论是：“事有经权，

“Besides, China Merchants operates within the Southern trading jurisdiction.
而况招商局在南洋通商的范围之内，

Your Excellency should both accept the responsibility and act decisively.”
大人不但当仁不让，且须当机立断。”


Shen still had reservations.
沈葆祯盘算之下，还有顾虑，

Even if the American firm were absorbed, what about the British firms, Swire and Jardine Matheson?
美商的旗昌固然归并了，英商的太古、怡和又将如何？

“Their fleets are small and need not concern us.
“太古、怡和船少，不足为虑。

Once Qichang is absorbed, China Merchants will have twenty-six vessels and greatly increased strength.
旗昌归并以后，招商局的船有二十六号之多，势力大增，

In foreign commerce the large always swallow the small.
洋人做生意一向以大吃小，

Swire and Jardine will have to follow our lead.
太古、抬和只有跟着招商局走。

Our former disadvantage was that we had no wharves or warehouses of our own and sometimes had to accommodate those firms.
招商局从前吃亏的是，自己没有码头栈房，有时不能不迁就太古、恰和，

With Qichang's wharves and warehouses, we shall no longer depend on others.
现在有了旗昌的码头、栈房，不必再迁就他人，

The balance of power will naturally change.
主客之势，自然就不同了。

Moreover, with a larger fleet we can provide our own insurance, retaining the profits instead of allowing them to flow elsewhere.
还有，船一多了，自己可以办保险，利权不外溢，

That amounts to opening another source of revenue.”
就等于另开了一条财源。

Completely persuaded, Shen ordered Sheng back to Shanghai that very day to negotiate with Qichang, reduce the acquisition price as far as possible, and settle the transaction first.
“沈葆祯完全被说服了，命盛宣怀当天就回上海，跟旗昌谈判，尽量压低“受盘”的价格，先把交易敲定下来。

The original petition had proposed joint official and merchant financing.
至于收买旗昌的资本，原呈中提出官商合办之议，

Sheng was to raise as much merchant capital as he could; government funds would make up the shortfall.
命盛宣怀尽力先招商股，不足之数以“官本”补足，

The precise arrangements could be considered separately.
如何筹划，另作计议。


With this authorization, the fraud was certain to succeed.
获得这样的授权，骗局已必可实现。

Back in Shanghai, Sheng again diverted government funds to buy Qichang shares.
盛宣怀一到上海，复又调动官款，收买旗昌股票，

After acquiring fifty-one per cent of the stock, he retained a foreign lawyer named Danwen to arrange the takeover and hurried to Nanjing to report that the matter was settled.
取得百分之五十一的股权以后，一面委托一名外国律师担文，办理接管的手续，一面赶到南京，向沈葆祯复命，事情已经定局了。

His written report stated that the agreed price was two million taels in cash for the wharves, steamships, warehouses, docks, ironworks, all materials on hand, equipment, and other items.
据盛宣怀的书面报告，说是“议定码头、轮船、栈房、船坞、铁厂，及一切浮存料物、器皿等项一概在内，现银二百万两。

The remaining wharves, foreign-style buildings, and warehouses at Hankou, Jiujiang, Zhenjiang, Ningbo, and Tianjin were valued at another two hundred and twenty thousand.
其余汉口、九江、镇江、宁波、天津各码头、洋楼、栈房，作价二十二万两”。

The total was therefore 2,220,000 taels, more than three hundred thousand below the original asking price.
总计二百二十二万两，较原来的开价，减了三十万两之多。

As for payment, he reported that a deposit of two hundred thousand had already been paid on the nineteenth of the eleventh month.
至于付款的办法，在十一月十九日已先付定银二十万两，

A further two hundred thousand would be paid on the eighteenth of the twelfth month, followed by three hundred thousand on the sixteenth of the first month of the coming year, when possession would be transferred.
约定十二月十八日续付二十万，明年正月十六再付三十万，即行交盘。

Instalment arrangements for the remainder had also been agreed.
余数如何分期交付，亦已商定。

Sheng claimed to have raised 1,220,000 taels in merchant subscriptions, leaving one million to be supplied by the government.
至于商股，盛宣怀说已招到一百二十二万两，短缺“官本”一百万两，

He had even taken the trouble to identify how much could be drawn from each official source—arrangements, of course, settled beforehand with Mei.
盛宣怀亦已借著代筹，某处可拨多少，一一指明，当然这也是预先跟梅启煦商量好的。


A memorial now had to be submitted.
谈停当了，便需出奏，

In cases of this kind, a memorial drafted by the Northern administration required the Southern commissioner's joint signature, and the converse applied if the South drafted it.
类此案例，倘为北洋主稿，便需南洋会衔，南洋主稿，自然亦需北洋会衔，

Sheng insisted that time was short: correspondence back and forth would delay the second payment and cause the two-hundred-thousand-tael deposit to be forfeited.
盛宣怀极力申说，时机迫促，往返磋商，误了二批交款之期，所付二十万定洋将遭没收，

He urged Shen to submit the memorial under his own name alone.
劝沈葆祯单衔出奏，

Li and Shen had passed the examination in the same year, he added; Li could only welcome so advantageous a transaction.
又说李鸿章与沈葆祯是同年，遇到这样的好事，只会赞成，不会反对。

Shen agreed and appended the explanation: “The waterways being obstructed by ice, there has been no time to consult the Northern Trade Commissioner by letter.”
沈葆祯思想也不错，同意单衔出奏：在折尾上声明：“时值冻阻，不及函商北洋大臣。”

Even if the waterways were frozen, the roads remained open.
运道冰封，陆路仍可通行，

The excuse was plainly strained.
显然的，这是一个很牵强的理由。

Shen never dreamed that it was part of a trap.
沈葆祯做梦也没有想到，这是盛宣怀特设的圈套，

First Sheng had invoked the deadline of the sixteenth to persuade him to assume sole responsibility; then he used the danger of missing the second payment to force a memorial bearing only Shen's name.
先则以“十六之朗”劝沈葆祯“当仁不让”，继而以恐误二批交银之朗，会遭损失，迫使沈葆祯单衔出奏，

Every step was designed to keep Li clear of the affair, so that, when the fraud emerged, he could defend Sheng more easily from the position of an uninvolved outsider.
这种种设计，都是为了要出脱李鸿章，以便将来骗局败露时，李鸿章得以未与闻共事的局外人身分，易于回护。


Four years later, the fraud did indeed come to light.
果然，四年以后骗局败露了。

The first attack came from Wang Xianqian, a celebrated Hunan scholar serving as director of the Imperial Academy.
发难的是一个湖南籍的名士，国子监祭酒王先谦，

He submitted a severe impeachment of Sheng and the other circuit intendants managing China Merchants, accusing them of deception, domination of the enterprise, and fraudulent pursuit of private profit.
上折严劾招商局管事道员盛宣怀等蒙蔽把侍，营私舞弊。

Critical officials then wielded considerable influence, and the court paid close attention to the views of the “pure stream” critics.
当时言路上很有力量，朝廷对一般“清流”的议论与主张，十分重视，

It immediately ordered the Governor-General of Liangjiang to undertake a thorough reform and investigate every item rigorously.
当即饬下两江总督“痛加整顿，逐一严查”。

The incumbent was Liu Kunyi of Xinning, Hunan, who had long resented Li.
其时的两江总督名叫刘坤一，湖南新宁人，对于李鸿章久怀不满。

Since using Shanghai as his base to pacify the Wu region, Li had continued to regard Liangjiang as his own territory.
原来李鸫章自从“用沪平吴”后，一直视两江是他的地盘，

Although appointed Governor-General of Zhili and Northern Trade Commissioner, he skilfully used foreign connections and the practical administration of Western affairs to install his own men in Liangjiang and direct them personally.
官拜直隶总督北洋大臣，却能巧妙地运用洋人，以及实际上办理洋务的关系，在两江安插私人，直接指挥。

What Liu found most intolerable was the conduct of Li's brother-in-law, Zhao Jiyuan.
最使刘坤一不能忍受的是，李鸿章的妻舅赵继元在两江的胡作非为。


Zhao came from Taihu in Anhui.
赵继元是安徽太湖人，

His grandfather, Zhao Wenkai, had been the top graduate in the bingchen examination of Jiaqing's first year.
他的祖父名叫赵文楷，是嘉庆元年丙辰科的状元，

Zhao himself had entered the Hanlin Academy, although his head was full of straw; how luck had secured him such scholarly distinction remained a mystery.
赵继元本人亦点了翰林，但肚子里一团茅草，如何侥幸而得列清班，一直是个谜。

He did at least recognize his limitations.
不过，他本人倒也有自知之明，

Knowing that his writing would never carry him far in the capital, he used his Hanlin status to purchase circuit-intendant rank, cultivated contacts in the Ministry of Personnel, and obtained assignment to await a vacancy in Jiangnan.
知道凭他的那支笔，做京官决无出头之日，因而以翰林捐班为道员，在吏部走了门路，分发江南候补。

The Governor-General of Liangjiang was then Zeng Guofan.
那时的两江总督是曾国藩，

In the early years of the Hong-Yang upheaval, fearing that excessive achievement might alarm the throne, Zeng decided to withdraw at the height of his success, disband his Hunan Army, and foster Li's Anhui Army as its replacement.
当洪杨初年时，怕功高震主，决定急流勇退，遣散湘军，扶植李鸿章的淮军来替代。

Accordingly, when Zhao reported at Jiangning, he received an exceptionally important and lucrative assignment: executive director of the Liangjiang General Military Supply Bureau.
所以赵继元一到江宁“禀到”，便派了他一个极重要极肥的差使：两江军需总局坐办。

Zhao thought himself clever in everything and relied on his younger sister's husband, Li, as his protector.
赵继元凡事自作聪明，自恃有妹夫李鸿章作靠山，

Zeng's successors—Ma Xinyi, Li Zongxi, and Shen Baozhen—could scarcely make him obey.
在曾国藩以后的历任两江总督马新贻、李宗羲、沈葆祯，都不大能指挥得动他。

When Shen died, the less senior Liu Kunyi counted for even less in Zhao's eyes.
沈葆祯病殁，继任的刘坤一，资格比较浅，就更不在他眼里了。


Besides Zhao, Liu resented Sheng and the others who served in the South but obeyed only the North.
除了赵继元对身在南洋而唯北洋之命是从的盛宣怀等人，刘坤一亦耿耿于怀，

He had long wanted to act.
久已想动手了。

On receiving the imperial order, he immediately appointed Liu Ruifen, the Shanghai circuit intendant, and Li Xingrui, director of the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau, to examine the company's books item by item.
因此，一奉朝旨，立刻派上海道刘瑞芬及上海制造局总办李兴锐，“调看该局帐目，逐款严查。”

Liu Ruifen, a licentiate from Guichi in Anhui, had accompanied Li to relieve Shanghai in Tongzhi's first year, taking charge of purchasing and forwarding military equipment.
刘瑞芬是安徽贵池人，出身是个秀才，同治元年从李鸿章援沪，主管军械的采购与转运，

Military merit had won him circuit-intendant rank.
以军功保到道员，

He had supervised the Songhu likin administration and acted as Lianghuai Salt Transport Commissioner, becoming an important civil official in the Anhui Army system.
曾经督办淞沪厘金，署理过两淮盐运使，是淮军系统中一名很重要的文官。

His ties to Li were close, but he investigated conscientiously.
刘瑞芬跟李鸿章的关系很密切，但奉命查办此案，却很认真，

He was comparatively upright and despised Sheng's deceitful opportunism.
因为他为人比较正派，看不起盛宣怀那种奸诈取巧的小人行径，

Moreover, the shrewd Liu Kunyi had summoned him beforehand and warned him plainly: if the inquiry was inaccurate, another investigator would be appointed.
加以刘坤一为人精明，在授命之前将他找了去，率直警告：如果查得不确实，他会另外派人再查，

“You would lose face then, my friend.
“那时老兄面子上不好看，

Do not blame me.”
可别怪我。”


In fact, so many people knew about Sheng's tricks that Liu Ruifen could hardly have concealed them even had he wished to.
其实盛宣怀搞的那套把戏，知道的人很多，刘瑞芬即令想为他掩饰也办不到，

Once the books were produced, questions appeared everywhere.
及至调出帐目来一看，疑问到处都是。

To proceed cautiously, he consulted several knowledgeable friends, including Gu Yingchun.
刘瑞芬为了慎重起见，特为找了几个内行朋友来研究，其中之一就是古应春。

“The accounts show only forty-odd thousand taels in merchant subscriptions.
“帐本说商股只有四万多银子，

Yet Sheng Xingsun's original report to Liangjiang states: ‘Agreement was reached after consultation on the eighteenth of the eleventh month, and a deposit of two hundred thousand taels was paid on the nineteenth.’
可是盛杏荪当时具禀两江，说‘已于十一月十八日公商定议，即于十九日付给定银二十万两’，

Where did those two hundred thousand come from?”
这二十万两银子是哪里来的？”

“The whole story is false,” Gu replied.
“根本没有这回事。”古应春说，

“You need only work out the dates.”
“只要算一算日子，就知道他是假话。”

The sixteenth day of the eleventh month in Guangxu's second year corresponded, by the Western calendar, to New Year's Day, 1877.
光绪二年十一月十六日，照西历算是公元一八七七年元旦，

Sheng's warning to Shen that no further agreement would be possible once the sixteenth passed and the replacement manager arrived referred to the beginning of the new year.
盛宣怀当初跟沈葆祯说：“若逾十六之期，则受代人来，即无从更议。”即指新的年度开始而言。

The eighteenth and nineteenth of the Chinese eleventh month, then, were the first and second of January in the Western calendar.
然则中历的十一月十八、十九，即是西历的正月初一、初二，

The foreigners were still on their New Year holiday.
洋人犹在新年假期之中，

Nobody was conducting business at Qichang, and all the foreign banks were closed.
旗昌公司固然无人办事，外商银行亦一律封关，

The supposed agreement and payment of a two-hundred-thousand-tael deposit were pure invention.
所谓“定议”，所谓“付给定银二十万两”，全属子虚乌有。

Next came the government funds allocated by the provinces: one million taels in all, recorded as transferred in full to Qichang Bank.
其次是各省所拨的官款，总计一百万两，照数转付旗昌银行，

Not a tael was missing from the stated payment.
银数固然分毫不短，

But Gu knew the inside story and pointed out that Sheng and his associates had pocketed 440,000 taels of it.
但古应春深知内幕，指出这一笔百万银子中，盛宜怀等人中饱了四十四万两。

His evidence?
证据呢？

“The provincial funds were real money, all remitted through Fukang.
“各省官款是实数，都由阜康汇来，

China Merchants sent someone to withdraw actual silver and deposit it in a foreign bank.
招商局派人来提走了白花花的现银，转存外国银行。

But what they handed Qichang was not cash.
可是，付给旗昌的，不是现款，

It was Qichang's own stock.”
是旗昌的股票。”

Gu could produce the Shen Bao newspaper, which recorded the contemporary market price: shares with a face value of one hundred taels were selling for fifty-six.
古应春有《申报》为凭，载明当时旗昌股票的行情是，票面一百两，实值五十六两。

Sheng thus needed to spend only 560,000 taels to purchase stock that would discharge a debt of one million.
这就是说，盛宣怀只需花五十六万两银子买进旗昌的股票，便可抵一百万银子的帐，

Had he not pocketed the remaining 440,000?
岂非中饱了四十四万两。

Those two points alone provided firm evidence of fraud.
光是这两点，舞弊的证据便很确实了。


The thorough inquiry exposed the entire operation.
彻查的结果，掀开了整个的内幕，

Sheng, Xu, and their associates had proceeded in seven stages.
盛宣怀与徐润等人所玩的花样是：

First, they paid twenty-five thousand taels as a deposit on a preliminary purchase agreement with Qichang.
第一，以定银二万五千两，与旗昌订定收买的草约。

Second, they diverted government money held by China Merchants to buy Qichang stock that had fallen from a face value of one hundred taels to a market price of fifty-six.
第二，挪用招商局的官款，收购每一百两已贬值至五十六两的旗昌股票。

Third, invoking competition with foreign steamship companies and the recovery of Chinese commercial interests, they falsely claimed to have raised 1,220,000 taels in merchant subscriptions and persuaded Shen to provide official capital.
第三，以对抗洋商轮船公司，挽回利权的理由，捏词已集商股一百二十二万，说动沈葆祯拨给官本。

Fourth, they falsely reported having paid a two-hundred-thousand-tael deposit, presenting the transaction as a fait accompli; then, using the frozen waterways as an excuse to dispense with Northern consultation, they forced Shen to bear sole responsibility.
第四，捏称已付定银二十万两，造成既成事实，并以运道冻阻，无需咨商北洋为借口，迫使沈葆祯单独负责。

Fifth, after obtaining more than fifty-one per cent of Qichang's shares, they engaged the British lawyer Danwen to take it over legally.
第五，取得旗昌百分之五十一以上的股权，委托英籍律师担文，依法接收旗昌。

Sixth, when the million taels in government capital reached China Merchants, they exchanged Qichang stock for cash at its full face value.
第六，官本一百万两汇到招商局后，盛宣怀等以旗昌股票，照面额十足抵换现银。

Seventh, towards the outstanding purchase price they first advanced more than four hundred thousand taels from China Merchants' official funds.
第七，应付旗昌余款，先由招商局官款中垫付四十余万两，

Another 690,000 remained unpaid, to be met gradually through deferred interest on government capital, retained interest on merchant shares, and insurance profits.
尚短六十九万，由“官本缓息”、“商股存息”，以及保险费盈余等陆续给付。

Here again, a substantial difference between cash and stock values went into private pockets.
事实上现银与股票之间，仍有很大的一个差额，饱人私囊。

“Deferred interest on government capital” meant temporarily suspending interest payments on the 1,980,000 taels that the Jiangnan provinces had advanced to China Merchants.
所谓“官本缓息”是江南各省拨交招商局的官款一百九十八万两，应付利息，暂时停止。

“Retained interest on merchant shares” meant paying shareholders only half their interest and converting the other half into share capital.
“商股存息”是商股利息暂付一半，所余一半改为股本。

With funds shifted from one pocket to another and obligations endlessly entangled, the whole affair became an unintelligible muddle of accounts.
这样陆陆续续，东挪西凑牵扯不清，根本是一盘糊涂帐。


Before Liu Kunyi could memorialize, however, Sheng and his associates struck first.
哪知刘坤一尚未出奏，盛宣怀等人先发制人，

They submitted eighteen points of defence to the Northern administration, and Li hurried a memorial to court, hoping to establish a favourable first impression that would prejudice the throne against Liu's conclusions.
列举了十八条申辩的理由，具禀北洋，由李鸿章抢先出奏，希望造成朝廷的先人之见，发生排拒刘坤一的意见的作用。

With Sheng also exerting himself energetically behind the scenes, Liu's report was indeed retained in the palace without further action.
加以盛宣怀的大肆活动，刘坤一的夏奏，果然“留中”了。

By established practice, a copy of Li's memorial went to the Southern administration.
李鸿章的复奏，照例要抄送南洋，

Reading it, Liu found it nothing less than eighteen specious arguments.
刘坤一一看，真正是“歪理十八条”。

A powerful writer himself, he personally drafted a rebuttal.
他的笔下很来得，当下亲自草拟奏稿，驳斥李鸿章。

He began by explaining that Li considered the investigators' findings erroneous, had vigorously defended Sheng, and had requested that no disciplinary action be taken.
首先说明：李鸿章认为刘瑞芬等，查案不无错误，为盛宣怀极力剖辩，奏请免议。

The court must naturally weigh that question; it was not for a subject to prejudge.
此则朝廷自有权衡，非臣下所能置议，

Nevertheless, the investigators' account of Sheng's greed and fraud was sufficiently clear that Liu dared not refrain from presenting it once more before the throne.
不过，刘瑞芬等所禀盛宣怀的贪诈情形，颇为明确，“有不敢不再陈于圣主之前者。”


His first target was Li's account of the financing.
首先要驳的是，李鸿章所陈，

According to Li, the original proposal had sought one million taels in official capital and an order directing the Lianghuai Salt Transport Commissioner to encourage salt merchants to subscribe for shares through allocations attached to their salt certificates.
当初收买旗昌，请拨官本银一百万，并饬两淮盐运使劝盐商就“盐引”派搭股份，

This was expected to yield eight hundred thousand taels.
预计可得银八十万两，

Provincial treasurers and customs intendants throughout the Southern jurisdiction were also to encourage wealthy merchants to subscribe as opportunities arose.
再通饬南洋各省藩司、各海关道，随时劝谕富商搭股，

There had been no claim that 1,220,000 taels had already been raised.
并无已集商股一百二十二万两之说。

Liu quoted Shen's original memorial: “From my sickbed I summoned Sheng Xuanhuai and the others.
刘坤一先引沈葆祯当年所奏“臣于病榻传见盛宣怀等，

They subsequently reported that, despite every effort to assemble the funds, the merchants could raise only 1,220,000 taels.
续据禀称，各商尽力攒凑，只能集成银一百二十二万两，

To meet the deficiency, they requested that the Southern provinces make every effort to allocate one million taels.”
所短之数，拨请南洋各省，尽力筹拨一百万两”的原文，

Liu then challenged Li: if Sheng had never claimed to have assembled 1,220,000 taels, on what basis had Shen written this?
向李鸿章提出质问：“如盛宣怀无此凑集一百二十二万两之说，则沈葆祯何所据而云然？

If the sum referred instead to subscriptions that provincial treasurers, the salt commissioner, and customs officials were being asked to solicit, why had Shen neither stated that official involvement clearly in his memorial nor instructed those officials to proceed?
如谓此一百二十二万两即系原禀请饬藩运海关劝商搭股之项，则事既经官，沈葆祯何以不于折内明晰声叙，又何以不札饬各司道查照办理？”


Li further maintained that the officials had not assisted with solicitation, the merchants had not promptly contributed, and only forty-odd thousand taels had been raised.
李鸿章又说，藩司、运使、关道并未“帮同劝谕，各商亦未即附本，仅集股银四万余两”。

Deferred interest on official capital and other arrangements could cover part of the 1,220,000, but a large deficiency remained.
虽有“官本缓息”等项，可以弥补此一百二十二万两的一部分，所短尚多，

Sheng had therefore been obliged to borrow from banks to pay Qichang; this explained China Merchants' heavy interest burden.
因而盛宣怀等不得不暂向钱庄借款来付旗昌，这也就是招商局利息负担甚重的由来。

Liu attacked this from two directions.
对这一点，刘坤一分两方面来驳，

From Shen's position, if Sheng had not represented the merchant capital as already available, but merely proposed that officials persuade merchants to contribute, would Shen have risked a million taels from the treasury on so uncertain a prospect?
一是由沈藻祯方面来看，倘如盛宣怀不是表明已集有商股一百二十二万两，而要动用官方力量劝谕商人附本，如此渺茫之事，沈葆祯能“轻掷百万库款”吗？

From Sheng's position, if funds were indeed to be raised in the manner described, what had happened to the shares allocated through salt certificates?
再是从盛宣怀方面来看，如果商股是照他所说的方法来凑集，那么“盐引”上派搭股份之事如何？

How much had the treasurers and customs intendants persuaded wealthy merchants to contribute?
各藩司关道劝谕富商附股，已有多少？

Surely he ought to have submitted inquiries or reminders.
理当具呈催问，

Was it reasonable that he had written not a word, while willingly borrowing elsewhere at high interest?
而竟无一字之禀，甘愿以重息在外称贷，这是合理的吗？

Liu concluded that Sheng had already claimed to possess the 1,220,000 and therefore dared not ask for further assistance, while Shen, believing him, had seen no need to seek other means.
由此分析，刘坤一作一论断：“是盛宣怀先有凑集百二十二万两之言，故不敢复有所请，而沈葆祯信以为实，无俟他谋也。”

Matters of such importance, Liu continued, were normally discussed repeatedly, and financial figures carefully settled before being reported to the throne.
又说：“此等重大事件，往往反复筹商，至于数目，必须斟酌尽善，而后上闻，

Sheng's evasions could not be used to erase Shen's memorial or to accuse the investigators of neglecting the original records.
似不得执盛宣怀等饰词而抹煞沈葆祯奏案，以刘瑞芬等为未查原卷也。

When Shen discussed military funding in a memorial during Guangxu's third year, he had regretted the rashness of his advances to China Merchants.
沈葆祯于光绪三年陈奏饷事，论及提拔招商局之款，自悔孟浪，

There had plainly been circumstances he found difficult to disclose.
固有难言之隐矣。”


Nor, Liu continued, did his impeachment rest on those two points alone.
接下来又说：“臣之所以奏参盛宣怀者，原不独此两端”，

Other abuses were still less tolerable.
而是因为另有更不堪容忍的弊端，

Qichang had been near collapse.
旗昌公司当时已濒临倒闭边缘，

Even if worth buying, its assets should have been valued with depreciation, according to Western practice.
即欲收买，应照西洋“折旧”之例，

Why accept them at their original value?
为何照原价承受。

His strongest charge was that, although Sheng and his associates had promised to remove a formidable rival and recover profits, expansion had brought still greater waste.
刘坤一最有力的指责是：“盛宜怀等收买旗昌轮船，原谓去一劲敌，可以收回利权，乃局面愈宽，而虚靡更巨，

In the fifth financial year the company had lost more than 246,000 taels, threatening to consume both government funds and merchant capital.
去年系第五届，竟亏银至二十四万六千有奇，国需高货，势将付之乌有。

Yet after Ye Tingchun, a candidate for a circuit intendancy, took over in the sixth year, it earned more than 290,000.
随经候选道员叶廷春人局经理，是为第六届，遂余银至二十九万有奇，

Counting the elimination of the loss together with the gain, Liu put the improvement at 532,000 taels.
短长并计，实多出银五十三万二千两，

Such a rapid and substantial result, achieved entirely through economy, exposed the appalling scale of the previous managers' annual waste.
其收效如是之巨而且速，悉由力求节省而来，则盛宣怀等之滥用滥支，一年之内数十万两，岂不骇人听闻，

Even confiscating Sheng's property would not exceed the law, he argued; merely requesting his dismissal was exceptionally lenient.
即将盛宣怀查抄，于法亦不为过，仅请予以某职，已属格外从宽。

What had happened was that the acquisition greatly enlarged the company's capital obligations and interest burden, while the old vessels, wharves, and warehouses required heavy expenditure.
“原来此骗局成功后，局本大增、利息日重，而旧船、码头、仓库的管理，亦需大皂费用，

The result was a hopeless mess.
成了个无法收拾的烂摊子。

Sheng and Tang decided to find someone to take over so that they could extricate themselves.
盛宣怀、唐廷枢计议，不如找个人来接办，以便脱身。

After searching widely, they persuaded Ye, an expectant circuit intendant in Jiangsu, to accept.
多方物色，找到一个江苏的候补道叶廷春，同意接手，

This was the summer of Guangxu's fourth year.
其时为光绪四年夏天。

Following the Western accounting practice of a financial year spanning two calendar years, the company called each such period a “term”; this was its sixth.
依照四洋会计年度跨年的算法，称之为“一届”，这年是第六届。

Ye dealt with practical realities and concentrated on reducing expenditure.
叶廷春接办后，实事求是，力求节流，

By the end of the calendar year he had produced a surplus of 290,000 taels; by the close of the financial year in the following year, the actual surplus exceeded 530,000—what Liu described as counting the shortfall and the gain together.
至年底盈余二十九万两，到第二年会计年度届满，实盈五十三万余两，即是刘坤一所说的“短长并计”。

Sheng's original intention had been to slip out of his predicament and leave Ye as the scapegoat.
盛宣怀等人的原意是，金蝉脱壳，将叶廷春当作“替死鬼”，

But when Ye unexpectedly made the business thrive, greed revived, and Sheng's group began scheming to drive him out.
不过叶廷春居然能将这个烂摊子经理得有声有色，贪念一动，便又设计排挤。

Ye saw the danger.
叶廷春一看不是路，

Knowing Sheng's ruthlessness and Northern backing, he feared trouble and withdrew while he could.
知道盛宣怀心狠手辣，又有北洋的奥援，说不定会惹祸上身，因而急流勇退，

China Merchants once again fell under Sheng's control.
招商局便又归盛宣怀等人把持了。


Liu's memorial rested on established facts and compelling arguments.
刘坤一此奏，事实俱在，理由充足，

Sheng ought to have had no escape.
盛宣怀本万无可免，

But it reached Beijing just as Empress Dowager Ci'an died suddenly, and the case was set aside.
哪知奏报到京，适逢慈安太后暴崩，这件案子便压了下来。

Hu expected a decision after the great funeral observances were over: Sheng and his associates would be dismissed, and perhaps Hu would be appointed to take charge of China Merchants.
胡雪岩原以为慈安的“大事”一过，会有结果，盛宣怀等人撤职，招商局或者会派他接办。

What he had not foreseen was that Sheng had opened another avenue of influence, while Li had an immediate need for his services.
可是他没有想到，盛宣怀另外走了一条路子，同时李鸿章亦正有用他之处，

Together, these circumstances enabled him to survive.
两下一凑，竟得化险为夷。

His new connection was Li Lianying, Empress Dowager Cixi's trusted chief eunuch at the Palace of Eternal Spring.
盛宣怀新走的一条路子，便是慈禧太后的亲信、长春宫的总管太监李莲英。

Li had originally learned the fur trade, whose practitioners in Beijing were called fur workers.
此人本学的皮毛行生意，京师称之为“毛毛匠”，

Because saltpetre was used in preparing hides, he acquired the nickname “Saltpetre Li.”
又以制皮需用硝，所以李莲英的外号叫做“皮硝李”，

In his twenties he lost heavily at gambling. Hounded by creditors and seeing no other escape, he had himself castrated and entered the palace.
他是二十几岁时赌输了为债主所遥，无可奈何，“净身入宫”，作为逃避。

Since he had joined the profession relatively late, he still kept in touch with many former colleagues and friends.
原是“半路出家”，早先的许多同行、朋友，仍有往来，

Through these connections Sheng found a way to cultivate him lavishly.
所以盛宣怀得以找到关系，大事结构。


Li Hongzhang, meanwhile, needed Sheng to develop telegraphy.
至于李鸿章有重用盛宣怀之处是，正在开办电报。

As early as Tongzhi's third year, Russia had requested permission to build an overland line from Kyakhta directly to Beijing.
早在同治三年，俄国要求自治克图铺设陆线，直达北京，

The court flatly refused.
朝廷继然拒绝，

Russia adopted an indirect approach instead, extending its Siberian line to Vladivostok, then cooperating with Denmark's Great Northern Telegraph Company to lay three single-core submarine cables: one from Vladivostok to Nagasaki, another from Nagasaki to Dashan Island off the mouth of the Wusong, and a third from Hong Kong to Dashan Island.
俄国改变计划，采取迂回的办法，先将西伯利亚陆线延伸至海参出，然后与丹麦大北公司合作，先在公海上敷设单心水线三条，一是条海参出至长崎，一条是长崎至吴淞口外的大山岛，又一条是香港至大山岛。

These were completed successively in Tongzhi's tenth year.
先后在同治十年完工，

Dashan Island lay within Chinese territorial waters, but the court considered the matter insignificant and ignored it.
大山鸟已在中国领海之内，但朝廷认为无足轻重，置之不问。

Great Northern then pushed further, running a cable from the island up the Yangtze to Shanghai, landing it on the Huangpu waterfront, and openly establishing a commercial office.
于是大北公司得寸进尺，由大山岛沿长江伸一条水线进来，直通上海，在黄浦滩登陆，而且公然设局营业，

Russia could now receive Chinese political and commercial intelligence in St Petersburg almost instantly through Shanghai, Nagasaki, and Vladivostok.
这一来，俄国经海参出、长崎而达上海，对于中国的政情、商务、瞬息之间便能传到圣彼得堡。

Other European countries enjoyed the same convenience through relay at St Petersburg.
当然欧洲各国，也能经由圣彼得堡的转运，获得同样的便利。

This was called the northern route.
这条名为北线，

Great Northern also operated a southern route from Dashan Island through Gulangyu, off Xiamen, to Hong Kong, its length stated in the text as “nine hundred five thousand nautical miles”; from Hong Kong it connected through Singapore and Penang to Europe.
大北公司另有一条南线，由大山岛经厦门鼓浪屿而达香港，长九百五千海里，再由香港通新加坡、槟榔屿以达欧洲。

At first, telegrams on both routes used only foreign languages.
南北两线的电报最初只用洋文，

Later, a Chinese code was devised, assigning four Arabic numerals to each of seven thousand characters.
后来发明四个阿拉伯数字编组的中文码，一共七千字，

Printed codebooks were widely sold, enabling Chinese people who knew no foreign language to use the service.
印刷成书，普遍发售，于是，不识洋文的中国人，也能分享电报的便利了。

Britain, too, was unwilling to leave the profits entirely to Great Northern.
其次英国亦不甘让大北公司独檀利查，

In Tongzhi's ninth year, the British minister, Thomas Wade, encouraged the Eastern Telegraph Company to establish a submarine route from Britain through the Atlantic, the Red Sea, and the Indian Ocean to India.
同治九年由英国公使威妥玛策动英商东方电报公司，自英国设海线经大西洋、红海及印度洋而达印度。

The Eastern Extension Telegraph Company was then formed to continue the line from southern India through Singapore and Saigon in Vietnam to Hong Kong.
再另组大东电报公司，由印度南境，延伸这条海线经新加坡、越南西贡等处至香港。

Its formal application for a route from Hong Kong through Shantou, Xiamen, Fuzhou, and Ningbo to Shanghai remained unsettled.
及至正式向中国申请自香港铺钱经汕头、厦门、福州、宁波至上海时，却一直未获成议。

But once Great Northern opened its Huangpu office in Tongzhi's twelfth year, Eastern Extension proceeded without ceremony: it laid a cable from Hong Kong through Fuzhou to Baoshan, connected it to the British concession in Shanghai, and opened for business.
到同治十二年大北公司既在黄埔设局营业，大东公司毫不客气地自香港经福州，设海线至上海宝山，再转接至英租界，开张营业。


Sheng had long recognized the future of an instrument that could carry a message across ten thousand miles in an instant, almost as though the correspondents were face to face.
盛宣怀是早已看出电报这项万里一瞬，恍同晤对的通信利器，必有前途，

Building landlines in the interior, however, was difficult.
但在内地架设陆线，颇为不易，

The greatest obstacle was the belief that they disturbed people's feng shui.
最大的障碍是，破坏了人家的风水，

Conflict was certain; even poles and wires successfully installed might later be pulled down or cut.
一定会发生冲突，即令勉强架设好了，亦会遭人拔杆剪线，

His ambition had therefore exceeded his means.
所以对此事的进行，一直心有余而力不足。

In Guangxu's fifth year, an opportunity finally arose.
这样到了光绪五年，机会终于来了。

Negotiations over Ili had severely strained relations between China and Russia.
当时因为伊犁交涉，中俄关系大为紧张，

Besides the northwest, the northeast and Korea were unsettled.
除西北以外，东北及朝鲜的情势亦颇为不稳。

Surveying the military situation, Li saw that an opponent equipped with telegraphs could obtain intelligence and seize the initiative, leaving China a move behind before fighting even began.
李鸿章统筹军务全局，看人家有电报之利，掌握军情，占尽先机，未战已先输一着，

He accepted Sheng's proposal to employ technicians from Great Northern and build a landline from the Dagu and Beitang coastal forts to the Northern administration's office in Tianjin.
因而接纳盛宣怀的建议，延聘大北公司的技术人员，架设自大沽口北塘海口炮台起，到天津北洋公所的陆线，

Its trial use for military communications proved successful.
试办军报，效果良好。

Sheng naturally proposed a further step: a landline between Tianjin and Shanghai.
这一来，盛宣怀自然要进一步建议，创设由天津至上海的陆线电报。

In the seventh month of Guangxu's sixth year, Li memorialized that speed was essential in war.
光绪六年七月，李鸿章上奏：“用兵之道，必以神速为贵，

Besides studying firearms and artillery, Western nations used fast steamers on water and locomotives on land to traverse enormous distances.
是以泰西各国于讲求枪炮之外，水路则有快轮，陆路则有火轮车，飞行绝迹数万里。

Telegraphy carried military intelligence across the oceans, bringing countries as close as neighbouring households, whether exchanging friendly courtesies in peace or confronting one another in war.
海洋欲通军信，则又有电报之法，于是和则玉帛相亲，战则兵戎相见，海围如户庭焉。

Russia and Japan had adopted the same methods.
近来俄罗斯、日本均效而行之，

Telegraph connections now linked foreign countries with Shanghai, allowing questions and answers to pass almost instantly.
故由各国以至上海，莫不设立电报，瞬息之间，可以互相问答，

China alone still depended on relay couriers.
独中国文书尚恃驿递，

Even urgent dispatches travelling six hundred li a day fell hopelessly behind.
虽日行六百里加紧，亦以迟速悬殊，望尘莫及。”


The clearest example was a telegram from Zeng Jize in Russia: it took only one day to reach Shanghai, but another six or seven days to reach Beijing by steamer.
最明显的实例是，曾纪泽从俄国打回来的电报，到上海只需一天，而上海至北京，由轮船传递，要六、七天，

If the sea route was unavailable, even the fastest overland relay required ten days.
如果海道不通，由陆路驿递，最快也得十天，

Thus the two-thousand-odd li from Shanghai to Beijing took ten times as long as the tens of thousands of li from Russia to Shanghai.
“是上海至京仅二千数百里，较之俄国至上海数万里反迟十倍。”

The telegraph's speed was almost beyond imagination.
电报的灵捷，真令人梦想不到。

For its military value, Li cited the line from the Dagu and Beitang forts to Tianjin: orders could summon the various camps and receive responses in moments.
至于军务上的用途，李鸿章举大沽北塘海口炮台至天津的军报为例，说是“号召各营，顷刻响应。”

Those words held immense appeal for Prince Chun.
这两句话对醇亲王来说，真有莫大的魅力，

He fully supported Li's request, thereby accepting Sheng's plan.
全力支持李鸿章的要求，亦即是接纳了盛宣怀的策划，

The Tianjin–Shanghai landline was approved, with Sheng naturally placed in charge of preparations.
决定建设天津至上海的陆路电线，当然是委任盛宣怀负责筹备。


The China Merchants fraud was then about to erupt.
其时他在招商局舞弊的案子，已将发作，

Sheng understood that successful construction of the inland telegraph could earn enough merit to offset his offences.
盛宣怀看得很清楚，筹办内陆电报一事办成功，可以将功折罪，

But he had to move quickly and begin many activities simultaneously, making the undertaking so complicated that only he could manage it and a replacement would be unable to take hold.
但必须从速进行，而且要诸端并举，头绪搞得非常复杂，非由他一手经理，换个人就无从措手不及，

Even if a penalty were imposed, it could not then be enforced immediately.
因为那一来即令有了处分，亦不能马上执行。

If enforcement of the penalty could be delayed until the enterprise succeeded, Li could request a reward that would cancel it.
只要一拖下来，等大功告成，李鸿章奏请奖叙，自然可以抵消原有的处分。

Sheng therefore established the General Telegraph Administration at Tianjin.
因此，盛宣怀首先在天津设立电报总局，

On receiving appointment as its director, he immediately went to Shanghai to engage Danish instructors, opened a telegraph school in Tianjin, and ordered machinery abroad.
奉到总办的差委外，立刻到上海聘请丹麦教席，在天津开办电报学堂，同时向外洋采买机器。

Reports every three days and proposals every five created a tremendous appearance of activity.
三天一个禀帖，五天一个条陈，把场面搞得非常热闹。

The most important task, surveying the route, could proceed more slowly.
至于最要紧的勘察线路，却不妨慢慢进行，

He knew it would be troublesome and did not wish to provoke a chorus of opposition at the outset.
他知道这件事很麻烦，不愿一上来便遭遇一片反对的声浪，

Better to wait until the equipment had arrived, the personnel were trained, and everything was ready except the wires.
且等机器买到了，人也训练好了，诸事就绪，就差架线，

An imperial decree could then require the governors and viceroys along the route to carry the project through in earnest, removing every obstruction.
那时用一道上谕，责成沿路各省督抚实力奉行，自然畅通无阻。


Hu's judgments were usually seven or eight parts certain.
胡雪岩料事，一向总有七八分把握，

He believed that even if Sheng survived the immediate crisis, he would certainly lose his directorship of the General Telegraph Administration.
在他以为盛宣怀这一关就算能过得去，“电报总局总办”这个差使，一定不保。

This time, however, his prediction failed completely.
哪知这一回的预料，完全落空。

The news again came through Xu Yongyi: Cixi had put Liu's memorial away in a drawer.
依然是徐用仪那里来的消息，刘坤一的奏折，让慈禧太后塞在抽斗里了。

Provincial memorials were delivered by the provinces' capital dispatch officers directly to the Inner Memorial Office, which presented them to the sovereign in yellow boxes.
凡是外省的奏折，由各省驻京的“提塘官”直接送交内奏事处，用黄匣呈送御前。

At present they went to the Palace of Eternal Spring for Cixi to read first.
目前是送到长春宫由慈禧太后先看，

She marked the thick, soft paper with her fingernail, and the office's eunuchs interpreted the marks and wrote the appropriate responses in vermilion: “Noted,” “Let the ministry take note,” “Refer for deliberation,” or, on a memorial inquiring after her health, simply “Peace.”
在软而厚的折子上，用指甲掐出记号，内奏事处的太临看掐痕用朱笔代批，不外乎“知道了”、“该部知道”、“交议”，以及请安折子上批一个“安”字之类。

Important matters were invariably referred to the Grand Council for deliberation and a report.
凡是重要事件，一定“交议”，亦就是交军机处议奏，
