Is that not frightening, Seventh Sister?”
七姐，你说可怕不可怕？

Not understanding his point, she murmured a noncommittal assent.
“七姑奶奶不明他的用意，含含糊糊答一声：“嗯。”

“Someone came to me for help recently,” Hu continued.
“前一晌有个人来跟我告帮。”胡雪岩又说：

“He might simply have asked, but he had another approach.
“告帮就告帮好了，这个人的说法，另有一套，

‘Mr Hu,’ he said, ‘if you fail to do what you ought to do, people will talk.
他说：”胡大先生，你该当做的不做，外头就会说你的闲话，

It is not worth it.’ I answered, ‘Loyalty and filial duty are the foundations of life.
你犯不着。‘我说：“人生在世，忠孝为本，

Beyond them, what must I do?
除此以外，有啥是该当做的事？

So long as I fulfil the five human relationships, nobody has grounds to criticize my conduct.’
我只要五伦上不亏，不管做啥，没有人好批评我。’

‘Not so,’ he replied.
他说，‘不然，

‘Beyond those five relationships, there is one thing that you, Mr Hu, ought to do.’ I asked what it was.
五伦之外，有一件事是你胡大先生该当做的事。’我问：”是啥？

What do you think he said?
‘你们道他怎么说？

‘Spend money.’”
他说：“花钱。’”

His argument was that Hu was famous for extravagant generosity, so any occasion requiring expenditure was properly his responsibility.
此人的说法是：胡雪岩以豪奢出名，所以遇到花钱的事，就是他该做的事。

Otherwise, he would cease to be Hu Xueyan.
否则就不成其为胡雪岩了。

The man then asked to borrow five hundred taels, but could not say what he wanted them for.
接下来便要借五百两银子，问他作何用途，却无以为答。


“I knew perfectly well that he wanted to pay gambling debts.
“我也晓得他要去还赌帐，

Had he told me honestly, such a small amount would not have mattered.
如果老实跟我说，小数目也无所谓。

Instead, he said, ‘You need not ask what I want it for, Mr Hu.
哪晓得他说：”胡大先生，你不要问我啥用途，

Nobody needs a reason to borrow from you.
跟你借钱，是用不着要理由的。

Everyone knows how generous you have always been and how much money you have thrown away.
大家都说你一生慷慨，冤枉钱也不知道花了多少。

If word gets out that you are questioning me over five hundred taels, people will think you insist on getting value for every coin and are unwilling to waste anything.’
你现在为五百两银子要问我的用途，传出去就显得你胡大先生一钿不落虚空地，不是肯花冤枉钱的人。

Tell me, should I have been angry?”
“你们想，我要不要光火。

“Of course,” Gu replied.
““当然要光火。”古应春答说：

“It was outright blackmail.
“明明是要挟，

He meant that unless you lent him the money, he would spread malicious stories.
意思不借给他，他就要到处去说坏话。

Detestable!”
可恶！”

“Utterly detestable!
“可恶之极！”胡雪岩接着往下谈：

I thought: if I refuse, naturally he will say nothing good of me.
“我心里在想，不借给他，用不着说，当然没有好话，

But if I lend it, a man with such a spiteful tongue will take the benefit and sneer at me too.
借给他呢，此人说话向来刻薄，一定得便宜卖乖，

He will say, ‘Look, I called him a fool to his face, and he still did not dare refuse.
说是：‘你们看，我当面骂他冤大头，他还是不敢不借给我。

He is like a candle that gives no light until someone strikes a match.’
他就是这样子不点不亮的蜡烛脾气。’

What do you think I should have done?”
你们倒替我想想，我应该怎么办？”

“If it were me,” the Seventh Lady said indignantly, “I would give the five hundred—but he would never spend it.
“叫我啊！”七姑奶奶气鼓鼓他说：“五百两银子照出，不过，他不要想用，

I would donate it to a charity in his name.” Hu sighed.
我用他的名字捐了给善堂。”胡雪岩叹口气，

“If only I had possessed your wit at the time, Seventh Sister.”
“七姐，”他说：“我当时要有你这点聪明就好了。”

“Why?” Gu asked.
“怎么？”古应春问：

“What did you do wrong, Little Uncle?”
“小爷叔，你是怎么做错了呢？”


“I gave a cold laugh and said, ‘True, I have thrown away I do not know how much money in my life.
“我当时冷笑一声说：”不错，我胡某人一生冤枉钱不晓得花了多少，

But you are the one exception.’
不过独独在你身上是例外。

I happened to have a thousand-tael note from Beijing's Four Great Heng banks in my pocket.
‘我身上正好有一张北京’四大恒‘的银票，数目是一千两，

‘It seems I am destined to lose money today,’ I said.
我说：“今天注定要破财，

‘There is no helping it.’
也说不得了。’

Then I struck a match and burned the note before his eyes.”
我点根洋火，当着他的面，把那张银票饶掉了。”

“What did he do?
“他怎么样呢？

Was he furious?”
气坏了？”

“He was not.
“他倒没有气坏，

He said something that made me furious.”
说出一句话来，把我气坏了。”

“What?”
“他怎么说？”

“‘Do not try tricks for fooling children on me, Mr Hu.
“他说：”胡大先生，你不要来这套骗小伢儿的把戏，

Fukang and the Four Great Heng are in the same business.
你们阜康跟四大恒是同行，

You can report the burned note as lost.’”
银票烧掉可以挂失的。

Gu and his wife fell silent.
‘“古应春夫妇默然。

At last the Seventh Lady said, “Little Uncle, you suffered an injury you could not answer.”
然后七姑奶奶说道：“小爷叔，你吃了哑巴亏了。”

So he had.
确是个哑巴亏。

It had never occurred to Hu to register the note as lost.
胡雪岩根本没有想到可以“挂失”，

Once the man suggested it, however, he could no longer do so without proving the accusation that he had merely staged a children's trick.
及至此人一说破，却又决不能去挂失，否则正好坐实了此人的说法，是“骗小伢儿的把戏”。

“Later, when people asked, I admitted the incident.
“后来有人问我，我说有这桩事情，

If they asked whether I had reported the loss, I could only smile and say, ‘What do you think?’”
问我有没有挂失？我只好笑笑，答他一句：”你说呢！

“It is better when people ask,” Gu observed. “At least they can see your manner for themselves. The danger is those who hear the story and immediately assume you must have reported it, without thinking a question necessary.
‘““能有人问，还是好的，至少还有个让人家看看你小爷叔态度的机会。就怕人家不问，一听说有这件事，马上就想到一定已经挂失了，问都不用问的。“古应春说：”

A'qi is right.
阿七说得不错，

You suffered badly from this.”
小爷叔，你这个哑巴亏吃得很大。“


“One must learn from a loss,” Hu replied.
“吃了亏要学乖。”胡雪岩接口说道：

“Afterwards I thought the fellow did have a point.
“我后来想想，这位仁兄的确是有道理，

Spending money is what I ought to do.
花钱的事，就是我该当做的事，

I should never have asked his purpose.
根本就不应去问他的用途。

If my spending is wasteful, what about the money I earn?
如果说我花得冤枉了，那么我挣来的钱呢？

From my side, I earn through judgment, skill, energy, and effort.
在我这面说，挣钱靠眼光、靠手腕、靠精神力气，

But I ought to consider the man who loses.
不过我也要想想亏本的人，

If he regards his loss as money thrown away, then what I gain is that same thrown-away money.”
他那面蚀本蚀得冤枉，我这面挣的就是冤枉钱。”

“Your reasoning grows more mysterious all the time,” Gu said with a laugh.
“小爷叔的论调，越来越玄妙了。”古应春笑道：

“Can earning money be a waste too?”
“挣钱也有冤枉的？”

“If you do not know how to use it, earning it is a waste.
“挣了钱不会用，挣的就是冤枉钱。”胡雪岩问道：

Have you heard of the ‘death-bell loans’ around Huai'an and Yangzhou?”
“淮扬一带有种‘磐响钱’，你们有没有听说过？”

Gu had never heard the expression, but the Seventh Lady knew it.
古应春初闻此“磐响钱”三字，七姑奶奶倒听说过，

Some rich merchants counted every penny, accumulated enormous fortunes, and yet ate and dressed miserably, clinging to each coin as though it were life itself.
有那一班铢锱必较，积资千万，而恶衣恶食，一钱如命的富商，

Unfortunately, they sometimes produced wastrel sons.
偏偏生个败家子，

With their fathers keeping such a tight grip on the purse, the sons borrowed wherever they could.
无奈做老子的钱管得紧，就只好到处借债了，

Interest was even more savage than on the instalment loans of the Shanxi moneylenders.
利息当然比向“老西儿”借印子钱还要凶，

But there was one advantage: if the prodigal could not pay, the creditors would never press him.
却有一样好处，在败家子还不起钱的时候，决不会来催讨。

“When, then, did repayment fall due?” the Seventh Lady explained to Gu.
“那么要到什么时候还呢？”七姑奶奶自问自答地为古应春解释：

“On the day his father died.
“要到他老子死的那天。

As soon as the old man stopped breathing, the first thing was to summon a monk to chant the prayers at the deathbed.
人一咽气，头一件事是请个和尚来念‘倒头经，，

The moment the monk struck his chime, the creditors came to the door.
和尚手里的磐一响，债主就上门了，

That is why they were called death-bell loans.”
所以叫做磐响钱。”

“Better spend it oneself than leave it for unfilial descendants,” Gu said.
“与其不孝子孙来花，不如自己花，

“What one has gained oneself, one may lose oneself; that need not matter.
自我得之，自我失之，本来也无所谓。

But the proposition that every expense is your duty, Little Uncle—perhaps that still deserves some consideration.”
不过，小爷叔，你说花钱的事，就是该当你做的事，这话，”古应春很含蓄他说：“只怕也还有斟酌的余地。”


“I have thought it over repeatedly.
“我想过好几遍了，

Since people call me the God of Wealth, I ought to distribute wealth.
既然人家叫我‘财神’，我就是应该散财的，

Otherwise I invite trouble.”
不然就有烦恼。”

Hu abruptly returned to his original subject.
胡雪岩急转直下地回入本题，

“Take Mother's sixty-ninth birthday next year.
“譬如说明年老太太六十九，

I must celebrate it.
我一定要做。

If I do not, those who envy me will have something to say.
不做，忌我的人就有话说了，

They will say I have always loved appearances, and that with His Excellency Zuo now Governor-General of Liangjiang, I ought to be eager to borrow his prestige for a grand display.
怎么说呢？说胡某人一向好面子，如今两江总督是左大人，正好借他的威风来耍一耍排场，

If I refrain, it cannot be because I do not want one; it must be because Zuo no longer treats me as before.
不做不是他不想做，是左大人对他不比从前了，

Of course he would send Mother a birthday present, but only an ordinary one.
胡老太太做生日，礼是当然要送的，不过普普通通一份寿礼，

He would do nothing special to enhance the occasion.
想要如何替做面子，是不会有的事。

Better for me, then, to recognize my position and keep quiet.
倒不如自己识相为妙。

Seventh Sister, would people not say that if I held no celebration?”
七姐，你说，如果我不做，是不是会有这种情形。”

She could not deny it, but answered differently.
七姑奶奶不能不承认，却换了一种说法：

“There is nothing wrong with celebrating the sixty-ninth.”
“做九原是好做的。”

“And after celebrating it next year, I must celebrate again the year after.
“明年做了九，后年还要做。”胡雪岩又说：

Otherwise people will say Mother's seventieth had long been planned, but I brought it forward a year to exploit Zuo's prestige.
“如果不做，又有人说闲话了，说胡老太太做七十岁是早已定规了的。只为想借左大人招摇，所以提前一年。

Having held it once, I let it suffice, because my circumstances have declined and I must economize where I can.
做过了也就算了，他这两年的境况不比从前，能省就省了。

You must understand, Seventh Sister, that this would be worse than not celebrating next year.”
七姐，你要晓得，这比明年不做还要坏！”

“Why?”
“为什么呢？”

“Do you not see?”
“这点你还不明白？”

Gu intervened.
古应春接口：

“Once that rumour spreads, Fukang's deposits will shrink.”
“这句话一传开来，阜康的存款就要打折扣了。”

“Shrink is hardly the word!”
“岂止打折扣？”

Hu quoted a literary saying: “Pull one hair and the whole body moves.
胡雪岩掉了句文：“牵一发而动全身，

A major storm would break immediately.”
马上就是一个大风浪。”


The Seventh Lady could not picture precisely what such a storm would mean.
七姑奶奶无法想象，会是怎佯的一种“大风浪”？

But seeing an unusually apprehensive expression on his face, she could not keep back something she had long wished to say.
只是看他脸上有难得一见的警惕之色，忍不住将她藏之心中已久的一句话说了出来。

“Little Uncle, I too must advise you to draw things in.
“小爷叔，我也要劝你，好收好了。

My meaning differs a little from your mother's.
不过，我这句话，跟老太太说的。意思稍为有点不同，

She says you should reduce the display where possible, instead of expanding it further.
老太太是说排场能收则收。不必再摆开来，

I mean that you should stop businesses you need not conduct, and manage properly those you ought to keep.”
我说的收一收是能不做的生意不做，该做的生意要好好儿做。

Gu was the first to find this painfully offensive.
“此言一出，首先古应春觉得十分刺耳，不免责备：

“What do you mean?
“你这话是怎么说的？

Does Little Uncle need you to criticize his business?”
小爷叔做生意，还要你来批评？

“Yingchun!”
““应春！”

Hu laid a hand over Gu's on the table to stop him.
胡雪岩伸手按着他摆在桌上的手，拦住他的话说：

“Seventh Sister is the only person still willing to tell me the truth.
“现在肯同我说真话的，只有七姐了。

I want to hear it.”
我要听！”

He nodded emphatically.
说着还重重地点一点头。

Gu had noticed that Hu's temperament was no longer quite what it had been.
古应春原是觉得胡雪岩的性情，跟以前不大一样了，

He feared his wife's bluntness would offend him; even if Hu said nothing, the evening would be spoiled.
伯七姑奶奶言语过于率直，惹他心中不快，即或不言，总是件扫兴的事。

Since Hu welcomed unwelcome truths, Gu had no reason to obstruct her, although he still gave her a glance urging tact.
即然他乐闻逆耳之言，他当然没有再阻挠的必要，不过仍旧向妻子抛了个眼色，示意她措词要婉转。

“I have kept some things inside for a long time, without an opportunity to say them,” she began.
“有些话我摆在肚皮里好久了，想说没有机会。

“Since you wish to listen, I shall speak plainly.
即然小爷叔要听，我就实话直说了，

I am not afraid of offending people.
得罪人我也不怕，

If even one or two of my remarks reach you, their resentment will be worth it.”
只要小爷叔有一句两句听进去，就算人家记我的恨，我也是犯得着的。”


From this introduction Hu knew she meant to criticize the people he employed.
由这一段开场白，胡雪岩便知她要批评他所用的人。

This was a matter in which he took great interest and pride.
对这一点，他很在意，也很自负，

He believed that his achievement—an establishment surpassing even the Yangzhou salt merchants at their height in the Qianlong and Jiaqing reigns—rested on his ability both to judge people and to use them.
他认为他之有今日立下这番乾嘉年间，扬州盐商全盛时期都及不上的局面，得力于他能识人，更能用人，

Naturally, discovering a person's strengths and faults required open observation and discreet inquiry.
这当然要明查暗访，才能知道一个人的长处何在，毛病在哪里。

Yet when listening to judgments of character, he followed principles of his own.
不过，他听人月旦人物，胸中却自有丘壑，

First he examined the critic: was that person open to criticism?
首先要看批评人的人，自己有没有可批评之处，

Only then did he weigh the remarks, distinguishing what he ought to hear from what the speaker merely wanted him to believe.
然后才来衡量那些批评，哪一句是可以听的，哪一句是对方希望他能听的。

The Seventh Lady was among the very few people he felt he should admire.
七姑奶奶是极少数他认为应该佩服的人之一，

He wanted not only to hear her judgments but to ensure that she left nothing unsaid.
她对人的批评，不但要听，而且唯恐她言之不尽，

He therefore encouraged her.
因而觉得有鼓励她的必要。

“Nobody will resent you, Seventh Sister, because nobody will know what you tell me.
“七姐，没有人会记你的恨，因为没有人会晓得你同我说的话。

Say whatever you have observed.
你有见到的地方，尽管说，

Even if I am at fault, do not spare me.
就是我有错处，你亦不必客气，

I shall be grateful for the truth, never angry with you.”
你说了实话，我只有感激，决不会怪你。”

His sincerity made her feel that criticizing particular employees would not adequately express her loyalty.
有这样诚恳的表示，反使得七姑奶奶觉得光是批评某些人，犹不足以尽其忠悃，

She must go deeper, to the source of the faults.
要批评就要从根本上去批评毛病的由来。


“To be honest, Little Uncle, I respect you less than I did ten or more years ago.
“小爷叔，说实话，跟前个十来年比起来，我对你的敬重打折扣了。

But my concern for you has increased, not diminished.
不过小爷叔，对你的关心，是有增无减。

Sometimes I think about your affairs until I cannot sleep all night.”
思前想后，有时候为你想得一夜困不着。”

Hu was visibly shaken.
这话说得胡雪岩耸然动容，

“We are friends who have endured hardship together, Seventh Sister.
“七姐，”他说：“我们是患难之交，

What I most admire is your courage and integrity.
我最佩服你是女中丈夫。

I know I am not as considerate of others in everything as I was ten or more years ago.
我自己也知道，做人处世，没有十几年前那样，处处为人着想，

Still, I have not treated people badly.
不过，总还不算对不起人。

My establishment is large, but the people I employ are capable, and everything is held firmly together, inside and out.
场面虽然扯得大，用的人是得力的，里里外外都绷得牢，

I do not understand what worries you so much that you cannot sleep.”
不晓得七姐是为啥为我愁得一夜困不着。”

“What worries me is that a great tree catches the wind.
“我愁的是树大招风。

You are a towering lampstand, Little Uncle.
小爷叔，你是丈八灯台，

So many people borrow your light to find their way and move ahead quickly and safely.
多少人沾你的光，照出一条路来，走得又快又稳，

Yet you cannot illuminate yourself.”
可惜你照不见自己。”

Hu found this use of the familiar saying particularly apt, and listened still more attentively.
“丈八灯台”这句俗语，是如此用法，胡雪岩觉得格外贴切，因而也就更重视她的下文了。

“Fortunately, you can see clearly.
“七姐，亏得还有你看得清楚。

There are no outsiders here today.
今天没有外人，

Tell me honestly: what faults must I change?”
请你老实说，我有哪些毛病要改？”

She hesitated.
七姑奶奶沉吟不语。

Her first thought was that his very belief in the competence of all his people and the security of his affairs needed changing.
她本想着：你认为你用的人都得力，里外部能绷得住，这一点就要改，

But that sounded like a wholesale condemnation and might provoke resistance.
不过这好象一概抹煞，会惹胡雪岩起反感，

There was a practical difficulty too.
而况事实上也有困难，

If he asked whether he must replace everyone, where so many replacements could be found at once, and whether they would all be trustworthy, she could not answer.
如果他这样说一句：照你说起来，我用的人通通要换过，请问，一时三刻哪里去找这么多人？找来的人是不是个个靠得住。这就无辞以答了。

Gu partly understood her hesitation.
古应春多少看出她的心思，

Fearing that excessive criticism would merely unsettle Hu without practical benefit, he suggested, “A'qi, describe one or two small incidents.
怕她说得过分徒乱人意，无稗实际，便暗示她说：“阿七，你谈一两件小事，

Little Uncle will draw his own conclusions.”
小爷叔心里自然有数。”

“Very well.”
“好！”

She thought briefly.
七姑奶奶接受了这个建议，略想一想说道：

“I shall tell you of two occasions when others offended people on your behalf, without your knowledge, and the blame was entered against your name.”
“小爷叔，我讲两件你自己不知道，人家替你得罪了人，都记在你帐上的事。”


The first concerned Hu's garden. After it was completed, he disliked the rockery and decided to rebuild it.
第一件花园落成以后，胡雪岩对其中的假山不满意，决心改造。

Several specialists inspected it and produced plans, but none impressed him.
请了几个专工此道的人来看，画了图样，亦不见得有何出色之处，

Eventually he heard of an eminent master in Beijing, Ying Chong, a native of Henan.
最后打听到京中有个大名家，姓应单名一个崇字，河南人，

Early in the Xianfeng reign, Ying had been a retainer of Prince Yi, Zaiyuan.
咸丰初年是怡亲王载垣门下的清客。

The Xinyou coup destroyed Zaiyuan's household and cost him his life.
辛酉政变，载垣家破人亡，

Having watched the great mansion rise and then collapse, Ying was deeply affected.
应崇眼看起高楼，眼看他楼坍了，感慨甚深，

He withdrew to the Western Hills, shut his door, taught his children, and ignored outside affairs.
因而遁人西山，闭门课子，不闻外事。

Generous gifts received during Zaiyuan's ascendancy meant that a few years of simple living would not leave him destitute.
好在当年载垣炙手可热时，应崇曾获厚赠，粗茶淡饭的生计，维持个几年，还不至于拮据。

He had no wish to return to worldly employment.
这应崇本来不想出山，

But Hu's humble entreaties and generous payment, reinforced by the persuasive Liu Bucai, who had been sent to invite him, eventually brought him to Hangzhou.
经不起胡雪岩卑词厚币，加以派去延请的刘不才，能言善道，终于将他请到了杭州。

Having inspected the existing rockery and several unused designs, Ying thought them reasonably good.
实地看了已造好的假山，又看了好些绘而未用的图样，应崇觉得也不算太坏，

Alteration would suffice; complete rebuilding was unnecessary.
只需修改，不必重造。

Hu disagreed and insisted on starting afresh.
但胡雪岩不以为然，坚持全盘更新。

Ying privately thought this the consequence of having too much money.
应崇心想，这是钱太多的缘故，

Yet he could not say so: such frankness before their acquaintance had deepened might lead Hu to think he lacked the imaginative resources to dare demolish and rebuild it.
不过，这话不便说破，交浅言深，会使得胡雪岩误会他胸中本无丘壑，所以才敢拆了重造。


Stung by the desire to prove himself, Ying shut himself away and did not come downstairs for a month, until he had completed a preliminary design.
也就是这好强争胜的一念，应崇关起门来，一个月不下楼，画成了一幅草图，

Even then he would not show it.
却还不肯出以示人，

Each day he walked with his staff among the Six Bridges and Three Tianzhu Temples, or explored the Northern and Southern Peaks in search of secluded and remarkable scenery.
每天在六桥三竺之间，策杖徜徉，或者深入南北高峰，探幽搜奇，

At night he spread out the plans by lamplight and revised them carefully.
回来挑灯展图，细细修改。

After three months the work was finally complete: seventeen drawings, one general plan and sixteen detailed sheets.
到得三个月后，终于杀青了。这一套图一共十七张，一幅总图、十六幅分图，

Strange rocks, unusual ravines, and countless winding turns made a small space suggest an immense landscape.
奇岩怪壑，百折干回，方丈之地，以小见大，

The result inspired delighted admiration.
令人拍案叫绝。

Overjoyed, Hu entertained him at a lavish banquet and asked him to supervise construction.
胡雪岩大喜过望，设盛筵款待，当面约请监工，

Ying agreed.
应崇也答应了。

A rockery required exceptional stones.
造假山当然要选奇石。

Hangzhou, the Southern Song capital, contained many famous gardens, including abandoned ones.
杭州是南宋的都城，名园甚多，也有废弃了的，

Ying inspected them all, without finding much to satisfy him.
应崇一一看过。却都不甚当意。

One day he came to a ruined garden by Gongyuan West Bridge, said to have been the ancestral shrine of Zhao Wenhua, Yan Song's adopted son.
这天到了贡院西桥，一处废园，据说原是严嵩的干儿子赵文华的祠堂，

A stone lying on its side there caught his attention.
其中有块卧倒在地的石头，却大有可观。

Three qualities defined a fine ornamental rock: slenderness, wrinkled texture, and openings through its body.
论百之美，有个三字诀，叫做“瘦、皱、透”，

Although half buried, the exposed portion possessed all three, and Ying judged that the hidden half must be equally fine.
应崇看这块石头虽一半埋在土中，但露出地面的部分，足以当此三字，判断另一半亦夏如是。


As he examined it from every angle, an old man whose beard and eyebrows were completely white strolled over. He wore a short jacket and straw sandals and carried a spotted-bamboo pipe.
正在反复观赏之时，只见有个须眉全白老者，短衣草鞋，手里捏一支湘妃竹的旱烟袋，意态消闲地踱了过来。

His clothes were not those of a gentleman, but his bearing suggested a great official retired into seclusion.
应崇看他打扮不似缙绅先生，那气度却似退归林下的大老，

Ying greeted him respectfully.
顿时肃然起敬地问讯。

“May I ask your surname, sir?”
“老先生尊姓？”

“You are too kind.
“不敢当。

Zhao.
我姓赵。

And yours?”
足下贵姓？”

“Ying.
“敝姓应。”应崇问道：

Is anyone responsible for this abandoned garden, Mr Zhao?”
“请问赵老先生，这废园可有人管？”

“Certainly.
“怎么没有？

I am.”
我就是。”

“Ah!
“喔！

Forgive my ignorance.”
失敬，失敬。”

Ying repeatedly clasped his hands in greeting.
应崇连连拱手。

Returning the salute with his pipe raised, Zhao asked why he wanted the keeper.
赵老者一面擎着旱烟袋还礼，一面问道：“足下要找管园的，有何见教。”

“I hoped to ask about this stone.”
“想请教请教这块石头。”

Zhao nodded, looked him over, and said, “You seem to share Mi the Eccentric's passion.
赵老者点点头，将应崇自上而下端详了一番问道：“足下想来亦有米颠之癖。

Since you ask, I must tell you.
既承下问，不敢不告。

The stone has a distinguished history: it came from Genyue in Daliang.”
提起这块石头，大有来历，原是从大梁艮岳运来的。”

So it had belonged to Emperor Huizong's Genyue garden, carried all the way from Kaifeng six or seven centuries earlier.
原来是宋徽宗艮岳的旧物，千里迢迢，从开封运来，亘历六七百年之久，

Its rarity was obvious.
名贵可知……

“Perhaps you have not yet discovered its finest feature.” Zhao turned and called, “Little Fourth, bring a drying pole!”
“足下恐怕还不知道这块石头真正的妙处”赵老者回头喊道：“小四儿，拿根浪竿来！”

In Hangzhou, a bamboo pole for hanging clothes was called a langgan.
晾衣服用的竹竿，杭州叫做“浪竿”。

Little Fourth knew what it was wanted for.
小四儿知道要“浪竿”作何用途，

Without a word he inserted it into one end of the stone.
取了来一言不发，从石头的一端伸进竹竿去。

Only then did Ying notice a bowl-sized hole running right through it.
这时应崇才发现石头中间有个碗大的孔，贯通两头，

The pole easily emerged at the other end.
竹竿很容易地从另一面冒出头来。

“A true thread of sky!”
“这才是真正的‘一线天’。”

Ying immediately imagined the stone incorporated into the rockery, with the midday sun shining through it into a cavern as a round shaft of light.
应崇很快地想到这块石头叠在假山上，到得正午，阳光直射入山洞，圆圆的一道光柱，

What an exquisite scene that would make.
岂非很别致的一景。


“Mr Zhao,” he asked directly, “could you bear to part with it?”
“赵老，”应崇率直问道：“这块石头能不能割爱？”

Zhao studied him again.
赵老者又细看了几眼，开口问道：

“Are you building a garden for yourself, or finding materials for someone else?”
“足下是自己起造园林，还是为人物色材料。”

“To be frank, the God of Wealth, Hu, invited me to remodel his garden.
“实不相瞒，我是应胡财神之邀，替他来改造花园。

If I obtain this remarkable stone, I shall have to revise my design again.”
得此奇石，我的图样又要修改了。”

“So it is for him!”
“原来是他！”

Zhao shook his head.
赵老者摇摇头说：

“I will not commit that sin.”
“我不造这个孽。”

Ying was astonished.
应崇愕然，

“What do you mean?”
“赵老，”他问：“这话怎么说？”

“Mr Hu is admirable in many ways and has done a great deal of good.
“说起来，这位胡大先生倒是值得佩服的，好事也做得不少。

Unfortunately, these past few years he has become proud, extravagant, indulgent, and idle, quite changing his nature.
可惜，这几年来骄奢淫逸，大改本性，

Those despicable flatterers under him have made him forget all limits.
都是他手下那班卑鄙小人奉承得他不知道天高地厚。

Diligence and thrift build a household; pride and extravagance ruin it.
从来勤俭兴家，骄奢必败。

Consider this very stone.
只看这块石头，

Had Emperor Huizong not built Genyue and imposed his flower-and-rock transport levies, how could the Jin armies have reached Bianliang?
当年道君皇帝，如果不是要起艮岳，弄出什么‘花石纲’，金兵哪里到得了汴梁？

Since garden building is your profession, you must have worked for many wealthy and powerful families.
足下既以此为业，想来平生也替达官贵人造过不少花园，

How many of their owners have worthy descendants?
不知道这几家的主人，有哪几家是有贤子孙的？

As for Mr Hu, his establishment has grown too large to control.
至于这位胡大先生，尾大不掉，

A true friend would urge him to withdraw while there is time.
真是他的好朋友要劝劝他，趁早收山，

Anyone who continues encouraging his reckless expenditure will sooner or later feel the reproach of conscience.”
倘或依旧撺掇他挥霍无度，迟早有受良心责备之一日。“


The speech left Ying sweating and deeply regretting his decision to emerge from retirement.
这番侃侃而谈，使得应崇汗流侠背，深悔出山之非计。

Yet matters had gone too far for him to return his fee and withdraw his plans.
但事已如此，总不能说退还聘金，收回图样，

He could only plead urgent business at home and firmly decline the supervision.
只好托词家乡有急事，坚辞监工的职务。

Unable to detain him despite repeated entreaties, Hu asked him to recommend a replacement.
胡雪岩再三挽留留不住，只好请他荐贤自代。

Ying found it hard to refuse.
应崇却不过情，

The design also embodied much effort, and he feared seeing it ruined by an incompetent hand.
而且毕竟是一番心血所寄，也怕为俗手埋没，

Among Hu's retainers was Zeng Xiaosu, who knew something of the art and occasionally offered original ideas in conversation.
看胡家的清客中，有个名叫曾笑苏的，对此道不算外行，有时谈起来颇有创见，

Ying therefore said that Zeng could undertake the task.
因而说了句，“曾笑苏堪当此任。”

Hu always wanted to establish a man's abilities before employing him.
胡雪岩用人，一定要先摸清此人的本事，

He summoned Zeng, had him examine the drawings in Ying's presence, and asked how long construction would take.
随即将曾笑苏请了来，当着应崇的面，要他细看图样，然后问道：“照应先生的图样，不晓得要多少日子，才能完工？”

“With a great master here,” Zeng said, smiling, “how could I venture an opinion?”
“这，”曾笑苏笑道：“当着大行家在这里，哪有我置喙的余地。”

“Not at all!” Ying interjected, giving him a meaningful glance.
“不敢，不敢！”应崇接口，同时抛了个眼色给他：

“Please make an estimate, Brother Xiaosu.”
“笑苏兄，请你估计。”

Zeng understood that this profitable assignment was probably within reach.
曾笑苏会意，监工这个有油水的好差使，多半可以捞得到手了，

He concentrated on calculations for a while, then asked, “When would you like it finished, sir?”
当下聚精会神地盘算了好一会，方始问道：“大先生想多少日子完工？”


“How about fifty days?”
“五十天如何？”

“Fifty days would require one hundred and twenty workers.”
“五十天就得要用一百二十个人。”

Zeng counted on his fingers.
曾笑苏屈着手指计算，

“There are four grottoes in the design: twenty craftsmen for each, leaving forty men to transport stone.
“照图施工，四处山洞，每洞工匠二十名，下余四十名，专运石料。

Five days to pound the mortar, twenty for construction, ten allowed for alterations, and ten to complete the tops.
舂浆五天，施工二十天，预备改作十天，结顶十天。

If everything goes smoothly, forty-five days will suffice.
如果一切顺利，四十五天可以完工。

You may arrange your grand banquet for fifty days from the start.”
大先生要大宴宾客，日子挑在五十天以后好了。”

Hu neither agreed nor disagreed, but turned to Ying.
胡雪岩不置可否，转脸问道：

“What do you think?”
“应先生看怎么样？”

“The calculation is intelligent, but rather tight.
“算得很精明。不过稍微紧了一点，

Any slackening during construction, and fifty days will be insufficient.”
施工的时候，稍一放松，五十天就不够用了。”

“I have allowed five days' margin,” Zeng replied.
“原有五天的余裕打在里面。”曾笑苏答说：

“You may not realize, sir, that elsewhere I might hesitate to promise a fixed date because materials or labour could be short.
“应先生，你老有所不知，淌或是在别处施工，也许石料不齐。人手不足，我不敢说哪天一定可以完工，

Here, whatever workers, money, or materials are needed can be supplied.
在我们胡大先生府上，要人有人、要钱有钱、要料有料，

I am confident of finishing in fifty days.”
五十天完工，是有把握的。”

“That is true.”
“说得是。”

Ying's approval was like the certification of examination officials.
有应崇这句话，

In the provincial examination years corresponding to Zi, Wu, Mao, and You, the court first appointed senior officials who had passed both higher examinations to test the eligible capital officials; only those who passed could be sent out as chief and deputy examiners.
就象朝廷逢到子午卯西大比之年，放各省乡试主考，先钦派两榜出身的大员，将够资梧派充考官的京官，集合起来，考上一考，合格了方能放出去当正副主考那样，

Ying had similarly certified Zeng's competence to supervise, and Hu consequently trusted him without reservation.
曾笑苏能充任监工之职，已由应崇认可，胡雪岩自是信任不疑。


An auspicious day was chosen, and work began.
于是择吉开工，

The old rockery had already been demolished. On the cleared ground, one hundred and twenty craftsmen formed twelve circles and began pounding mortar.
一百二十名工匠，在早经将原有假山拆掉的空地上，分做十二圈，开始舂浆。

The steward, Hu Yunfu, had instructed them beforehand: “No calling out while you pound.
事先有总管胡云福关照：“舂浆不能出声，

The old lady dislikes the noise.”
老太太讨厌那种声音。”

There was a special reason for this.
原来其中有个讲究。

The mortar, known in Hangzhou as niaojiang, used a particular kind of leaf which, soaked in water, produced a thick liquid resembling the wood-shaving infusion women used to dress their hair.
所谓舂浆的浆，杭州人称之为“袅浆”，专有一种树叶子，用水一泡，稠稠地象妇女梳头用的刨花水，

This was added to lime and yellow clay before pounding.
然后用石灰、黄泥掺合，加入这种稠汁，就可以开始舂了。

Several men stood in a circle around the mixture, each holding a waist-high T-shaped rammer.
舂浆的法子是，几个人绕着石灰、黄泥围成一圈，每人手里一把齐腰的丁字锤，

Its shaft was a piece of chestnut wood as thick as a rice bowl, with a rounded iron head at the bottom and a firmly fitted crosspiece two chi long at the top.
锤身是饭碗粗的一根栗木桩，桩底镶半圆形的铁锤，柱顶有条两尺长镶得很牢固的横木，以便把握。

At the leader's signal, the men stepped back, straightened, and swung their rammers upward.
到得围拢站齐，为头的一声讯号，往后退步，腰身挺起，顺势将丁字锤往上一翻，

As the tools descended, they stepped forward and bent, driving the heads heavily into the lime and clay.
翻到朝天往下落，同时进步弯腰，锤头重重舂在石灰、黄泥上。

Another worker continuously ladled on the thick leaf infusion.
另有人不断地用木勺舀着稠汁往上浇。

At first, white lime and yellow clay remained distinct; gradually they blended, and the longer the pounding continued, the tougher the mixture became.
起始是白灰、黄泥的然可见，后来浑然融合，舂得愈久，韧性愈佳。

In Hangzhou, tomb builders packed it around coffins.
杭州人修造坟墓，棺木四周，必实以袅浆，

Once dry, it became extraordinarily hard, virtually impervious to blades and weapons.
干燥以后，坚硬异常，真正是“刀枪不入”，

The rarity of grave robbery there was attributed to this mortar.
杭州盗墓之风不炽，即因得力于袅浆。

When a burial had to be moved, there was a separate method for breaking it: the tomb was opened, strong liquor poured over the mortar and ignited, and, after the liquor and flames were exhausted, the material became brittle enough to work with a hoe.
至于有那要迁葬的，另有一个破袅浆之法，法于是打开坟头，遍浇烈性烧酒，用火点燃，等酒尽火熄，泥质发脆，自能下锄。


When the Ming founder built Nanjing's walls, he had charged Shen Wansan, the immensely wealthy man of the late Yuan, with construction.
从前明太祖造南京城，责成元末巨富沈万三施工，

Massive stones were joined with boiled glutinous-rice paste, enabling the walls to endure for centuries.
城墙用巨石堆砌，接缝用糯米熬浆粘合，所以能历数百年不坏。

Niaojiang could perform a similar function.
袅浆居然亦有此功用，

What mattered most was prolonged, even pounding, making the leader's signals indispensable.
最要紧的是，舂得匀、舂得久，所以为头的讯号，关系不浅，

These were the familiar heave-ho cries of labour.
而讯号无非“邪许”之声，

Their rhythm, while expressing the workers' exertion, naturally directed the force and speed of each stroke, counted the blows, and regulated the length of their steps.
从宣泄劳苦的“力笨之歌”中，音节上自然有指挥下锤轻重徐疾，计算锤数，以及移动步伐“尺寸”的作用在内，

As they worked, the men slowly moved round to their right, both to ensure even mixing and to measure the labour performed.
舂袅浆的人，一面舂。一面慢慢向右转，为的是求均匀，同时亦为计算工夫的一种方法，

Usually twelve to sixteen circuits were needed to bring the mortar to its full strength.
大致总要转到十二至十六圈，那袅浆的功用，才能发挥到顶点。

Besides tomb building, it was used in rockeries, where only this material could firmly join the stones.
除了修造坟墓以外，袅浆另外的用途，就是起造假山，石料与石料的接台，非用袅浆，不能坚固。

But the distinctive pounding chant was often heard around burial grounds in spring and autumn, inevitably suggesting that another grave was being built nearby.
但这一有特殊音节的“邪许”之声，春秋每闻于定山，自然而然地使人意识到，附近又有一座新坟在造。

Hu's elderly mother disliked hearing it; hence Hu Yunfu's order for silence.
胡老太太年纪大了，恶闻此声，所以由胡云福交代下来，不准出声。

Without the chant, the workers were like soldiers deprived of commands.
这一来便如军队失去号令，

Their movements became disordered and slow.
自然混乱不齐，手脚慢了。

Eager to succeed, Zeng scolded and shouted at them.
曾笑苏求功心切，不免责骂叱喝，

They dared not voice their anger at work, but talked bitterly as they left.
工匠敢怒不敢言，到得散工出门，议论纷纷，

Their complaint was not that Zeng lacked consideration, but that the Hu household was cruel.
不说曾笑苏不体恤人，却说胡家刻薄。


Cruelty was indeed occurring, though Hu knew nothing of it.
刻薄之事，不是没有，只是胡雪岩根本不知。

Whenever a great household undertook construction, contractors or foremen were apt to skimp on labour or materials.
从来大户人家有所兴作，包工或者工头，总难免偷工减料。

In building a rockery there was little scope to economize on the stone, but labour could be cheated.
起造假山，料无可减，工却可偷，

Because Zeng was shrewd, the contractors dared not inflate the headcount; instead they passed apprentices and assistants off as skilled craftsmen.
只以曾笑苏颇为精明，不敢虚报人数，只以学徒下手混充熟练的工匠，

The first two days went well, but by the third something was wrong.
头两天还好，到第三天情形就不对了，

Racking his brains, Zeng devised a rule: no wages could be drawn in advance, and payment would be made at the end of each day.
曾笑苏挖空心思，走了个规矩，工钱不许先支，当日发给。

A specially built long bench more than eight chi high stood by the garden gate.
散工时，园门口置特制的八尺多高条凳一张，

For each group of twelve men, twelve wage packets were placed on it.
每班十二人，上置十二份工钱，

Everyone had to reach for his own; nobody could pass a packet to someone else.
各人自取，不得接手代递，

Anyone whose arm did not reach received nothing for his day's work.
手不够长拿不到的，就算白做。

Young apprentices left empty-handed and tearful, but short adults were equally helpless.
不但未成年的学徒，只好眼泪汪汪，空手出门，就是身矮的，也是徒呼奈何。

Zeng proudly claimed credit for the arrangement: tall men had ample strength, he said, while even a strong short man had limited power.
曾笑苏还得意洋洋地表功，道是“身长力不亏。矮子纵有气力也有限，

What use was a rockery builder without strength?
试问堆假山没有力气，有何用处？

This was the surest means of retaining the able and eliminating the unfit.
这是存优汰劣的不二法门”。

Public opinion, however, became appalling.
可是外头的舆论就不堪闻问了，

As the story spread, it was said that Hu abused his power by making men work without paying them.
传来传去，说是胡雪岩伏势欺人，叫人做了工，不发工钱。

Some protested that a man famous for charity could never be so harsh.
有人不信，说，：胡大先生做好事出名的，哪里会有这样刻薄“，

But witnesses were available, and even those wishing to defend him were silenced.
无奈人证俱在，想替他说好话的人，也开不得口了。


Another incident was still more outrageous.
还有件事，更为荒唐。

One year, early in winter, Hu held Buddhist rites for his late father's posthumous birthday and distributed food and clothing.
一年胡雪岩为亡父冥寿作佛事，时逢初冬，施衣施食，

Anyone willing to endure the embarrassment of accepting charity could queue for a blue cotton padded jacket and four white-flour steamed buns, each as large as a rice bowl.
只要自己舍得下脸的，都可以排队来领，每人蓝市棉袄一件，饭碗大的白面馒头四个。

Hu had personally inspected the jackets and tasted the buns, taking every care.
棉袄、馒头都经胡雪岩自己看过，尝过，毫不马虎。

The charitable event should have gone well.
这场好事，应该做得很好，

Instead, people cursed him through clenched teeth.
不迫有人咬牙切齿在痛骂。

Again, the fault lay in his choice of subordinates and their reckless conduct.
说来说去，还是胡雪岩用人不当，主事的胆大妄为。

Some recipients, wanting a little extra, joined the queue a second time for another portion.
原来有那贪小的，排了一次队，第二次再来，多领一份。

A generous view would recognize that they had spent further time and effort to obtain it, rather than gained something for nothing.
这往宽处说，他也是花了工夫气力，多换得一份施舍，不算白捡便宜，

Even a strict response need have gone no further than a reprimand.
就算从严，训斥几句，亦就至矣尽矣，

But the organizers devised a novel system.
谁知主事者别出心裁，

After receiving a jacket and buns, each person encountered a group of daizhao, as barbers were also called, waiting at the exit with a razor in each man’s hand.
等人头一次来领了棉袄、馒头，到出口处有一班，“待沼”在等着，剃头匠别称“待沼”。每人一把剃刀，

A patch of hair was shaved off as proof that charity had already been received.
头发剃去一块，作为已领施舍的记号，

Anyone unwilling to submit had to forgo the gifts.
倘或不愿，除非不领。

“Little Uncle,” the Seventh Lady said, still angry at the recollection, “imagine someone queuing before dawn and waiting until noon, without knowing of this rule.
“小爷叔，”七姑奶奶谈到这件事，犹有余愤，“你倒想想，有的天不亮去排队，轮到日中才轮到，料不到有这么一个规矩，

To refuse would mean all that hardship for nothing.
要不领呢，白吃一场辛苦，于心不甘，

To accept would leave a bald patch advertising that he wore charity clothes.
要领呢，头发缺一块，挂了块穿舍衣的招牌在那里，

What a choice!
真叫进退两难，

How could people help feeling bitter?”
有个不咬牙切齿的吗？”


Hu's face alternately flushed and paled.
这几句话说得胡雪岩脸上红一阵、青一阵，

Despite the late-autumn weather, sweat dampened his back.
深秋天气，背上却湿漉漉地冒汗，

“I knew nothing of this, Seventh Sister.
“七姐，”他说：“你说的情形，我一点都不知道。

When I return, I shall investigate and give the culprit a thorough dressing-down.”
我回去要查，查出来我要狗血喷头，骂他一顿。”

“There is no need.
“你也不必去查。

The man no longer works for you.
这个人已经不在小爷叔你那里了，

That is why I have spoken.”
我才说的。”

“Then there are still others like him there?”
“这样说，还有这样子的人在那里？”

She was silent, which amounted to assent.
七姑奶奶默然，也就是默认，

Since matters had reached this point, Gu decided to add his own counsel.
古应春觉得话既说到如此，就索性再劝一劝他。

He had followed Hu for years and knew much of the difficulty of establishing the business; his advice was therefore both extensive and penetrating.
古应春追随胡雪岩多年，当初创业维艰的经过大多熟悉，所以劝他的话不但很多，而且也很深刻，

“You regard your pawnshops as a service to the poor, Little Uncle, and say you do not want to make money from them.
“小爷叔，”他说：“你的事业当中，典当在你看，完全是为了方便穷人，不想赚钱。

But what pawnshop in the world makes no money?
话是这样说，天下哪有不赚钱的典当？

Because you have expressed that intention, even profits that ought properly to be earned are not appearing.
不过，因为你有这番意思在那里，明明应该赚的也不赚了、

Have you considered that?”
小爷叔，这一层，不知道你想过没有？

“I have.
““我想过。

I told them that a bank is a rich man's pawnshop, and a pawnshop is a poor man's bank.
我同他们说：钱庄是有钱人的当铺，当铺是穷人的钱庄，

I deal with the rich.
有钱的人，我来对付，

They pledge their credit or their connections; I can generally judge whether to accept the pledge and how much it is worth.
他‘当信用’、‘当交情’，能不能当，能当多少，多大致有数。

There are too many poor people for me to look after personally, so I entrust them to the staff, who must act according to conscience.
穷人太多，我照顾不到，都托你们了，大家要凭天良。

I have treated those Huizhou friends well.
我想，那班‘徽州朋友’我待他们不坏，

Surely they cannot be entirely without conscience.”
应该不至于没良心。”

Pawnshop appraisers came from Huizhou, hence his name for them.
当铺朝奉都出在徽州，所以胡雪岩称之为“徽州朋友”。

Gu realized from this speech that Hu knew nothing of the accumulated abuses in his own pawnshops.
古应春听他这一番话，便知他对自己的典当的积弊，一无所知，

He also saw that his own observations could be of real use.
同时也觉得自己的看法，对胡雪岩确实有用。


“Do you know how many pawnshops you own, Little Uncle?”
“小爷叔，你有多少爿典当，你自己知道不知道？”

Hu was taken aback.
胡雪岩一愣，

Scratching his head, he said, “There must be twenty?”
搔搔头说：“二十家总有吧？”

“Count them,” the Seventh Lady urged.
“小爷叔，”七姑奶奶怂恿着说：“你倒算算看！

“Start with Hangzhou.”
从杭州算起。”

First came Gongji, the earliest shop Hu had established; then Guangshun and Tai'an, at Gongzhen Bridge outside Wulin Gate, the starting point of the canal, set up especially for the convenience of the grain-transport brotherhood.
从杭州算起，首先便是公济，这是胡雪岩所设的第一家当铺，然后是广顺，武林门外拱震桥，运河起点，专为方便漕帮的泰安，

Across Hangzhou, Huzhou, Jiaxing, Haining, Jinhua, and Quzhou in Zhejiang, Suzhou and Zhenjiang in Jiangsu, and Hubei and Hunan, there were twenty-three in all.
浙江的杭州、胡州、嘉兴、海宁、金华、衢州、江苏的苏州，镇江，还有湖北。湖南，一共二十三家。

A pawnshop's operating capital was called its shelf capital.
当铺的资本，称为“架本”，

By convention it was stated in copper cash rather than silver, at one thousand cash to a tael: ten thousand taels thus became ten thousand strings of a thousand cash.
向例不用银数，而以钱数计算，一千文准银一两，一万银子便称为一万千文。

Shops varied in size, with shelf capital ranging from fifty thousand to two hundred thousand such strings.
典当有大有小，架本少则五万千文，大则二十万千文，

At an average of one hundred thousand each, the twenty-three shops represented 2,300,000 taels.
通扯以十万计，二十三家典当的架本。便是两百三十万银子，

If their pledged goods were valued instead, the figure would at least double.
如果以“架货”折价，至少要加一倍。

“Let us put the total at four and a half million taels,” Gu said.
“小爷叔，架本总共算它四百五十万银子好了，

“A return of one per cent is a low estimate for a business like this.
做生意打它一分息，算低了吧，

That would mean forty-five thousand taels a month—more than one could spend.
一个月就是四万五千银子，怎么样用也用不完，

You could have me give up all my other work and concentrate on managing these twenty-three pawnshops.”
小爷叔叫我别样生意都不必做，光是经营这二十三家典当好了。”

Hu calculated: forty-five thousand a month meant 540,000 a year.
胡雪岩心想一个月四万五，一年就是五十四万，

Yet he could not remember annual pawnshop profits ever exceeding two hundred thousand.
在他记忆中，每年年底结总帐，典当部分的盈余，从未超过二十万，

On that reasoning, the Huizhou friends were swallowing more than three hundred thousand taels a year.
照此说来，每年有三十多万银子，为“徽州朋友”吞掉了。


“My monthly expenditure, including all entertaining, is only forty or fifty thousand taels.
“我一个月的开销，连应酬通通算在内，也不过四五万银子。

If the pawnshops were properly managed, I could put myself beyond defeat.
典当弄好了，我可以立于不败之地。”胡雪岩问道：

Where do you think I should begin reforming them, Yingchun?”
“应春，你看我应该从哪里下手来整顿？”

“Naturally, with an audit and inspection.”
“自然是从盘查着手。”

“One shop after another, or all together at a single order?”
“查了一家再查一家呢？还是一声号令一起查？”

“All together, of course.”
“自然是一起查。”

“Are you talking without thinking?” the Seventh Lady interrupted.
“你是不是在信口开河？”七姑奶奶插嘴说道：

“Where will you find enough people to inspect twenty-three shops at once?
“二十三家典当一起查，人手呢？

It is not merely checking accounts.
不光是查帐，

The pledged goods on the shelves must be examined too, and outsiders cannot do that.”
还要查架子上的货，不是外行做得了的。”

“Seventh Sister,” Hu stopped her, “if Yingchun proposes it, he must have a method.”
“七姐，”胡雪岩拦住她的话说：“应春出这个主意，当然有他的诀窍。”

“Exactly!” Gu answered with satisfaction.
“小爷叔说得对！”古应春得意他说：

“My method is quick, thorough, and unlikely to offend anyone.
“我有个诀窍，不但快，而且切实，兼且还不会得罪人。

Consider: if we inspect one shop after another, we naturally start with those we distrust, taking them by surprise.
这话怎么说呢？譬如一家一家查，当然就要从靠不住的那几家先下手，为的是叫他措手不及。

If faults appear, well and good.
但这一来，查出毛病来不必说，

But if a shop proves entirely sound, its people will resent the suspicion, and it will be harder to obtain their best service afterwards.”
倘或倒是干干净净的，人家心里就会不舒服，以后就不容易得力了。”


“Enough preliminaries!” the Seventh Lady said impatiently.
“闲话少说。”七姑奶奶性急，

“If you have a method, tell us.”
“你既然有诀窍，赶快说啊！”

“It leaves no sign of suspicion.
“这个诀窍，不着痕迹，

Little Uncle, make a general reshuffle.
小爷叔，我劝你来个大扳位，

Transfer all the managers and custodians of pledged goods among the twenty-three shops.
二十三家的。管总，、‘管包’，通通调动，

Transfers require formal handovers, and each person taking over becomes responsible.
调动要办移交，接手的有责任，

Naturally, he will not dare be careless.
自然不敢马虎，

In this way, both the accounts and the actual goods on the shelves will be thoroughly checked.”
这一来帐目、架货的虚实，不就都盘查清楚了？”

“That is ingenious.
“这个法子倒真巧妙。

But moving a man from a small shop to a large one will cause no complaint; moving him from a large one to a small one certainly may.”
不过以小调大，没有话说，以大调小，难免会有闲话。”

“There is a remedy.
“这也有个法子。

Divide the shops into three classes according to size, and have those within each class draw lots for exchanges.
典当大小，拿它分成三等，同等的抽签互换，

The differences will be limited, and everyone will depend on his luck, leaving little ground for complaint.”
好坏相差有限，各凭运气，大家也就没话说了。”

“Besides,” the Seventh Lady added, “you can privately reassure and reward the few who are truly capable and have done well.”
“再说，”七姑奶奶有补充的意见：“真正几个得力、做得好的，小爷叔不妨私下安慰奖赏他们。”

“Quite right.
“说得是，

I shall arrange it when I return to Hangzhou.”
我回杭州就办。”



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第四章（上）
Towers of Light — Chapter Four, Part One
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER FOUR: THE BEAUTY STRATAGEM｜第四章 美人计


Hu Xueyan remained in Shanghai until definite news of Zuo Zongtang arrived.
胡雪岩在上海，一直等得到左宗棠的确实信息，

Zuo had left Beijing on the eighteenth day of the tenth lunar month, but instead of taking a seagoing steamer south from Tianjin and passing through Shanghai on his way to assume the Liangjiang governor-generalship at Jiangning, he was first returning to Hunan to visit his ancestral graves.
已于十月十八日出京，但不是由天津乘海轮南下，经上海转江宁去接两江总督的任，而是先回湖南扫墓，

He was not expected to take up his post until near the year's end, when official seals were put away for the New Year holiday.
预计要到年底快封印时，才会到任。

Hu had intended to welcome him in Shanghai and return to Hangzhou only after Zuo left for Jiangning.
胡雪岩本打算在上海迎接左宗棠，等他动身赴江宁后，再回杭州，

Now he decided to go home first and come back later.
见此光景，决定先回去了再来。

On his second day in Hangzhou, he summoned Tang Zishao, manager of Gongji Pawnshop, and explained his plan to transfer all twenty-three pawnshop managers.
回到杭州的第二天，他就将公济典的管总唐子韶约了来，将打算全盘调动二十三家典当的管总，

Their handovers would naturally provide an opportunity for a thorough inspection of every shop.
趁彼此移交的机会，自然而然作了一次大清查的计划，告诉了他。

“Zishao, you are the senior man among the managers of my twenty-three shops.
“子韶，”他说，“我这二十三家典当，你算是他们的头儿。

I want you to handle this.
这件事，我要请你来做，

Draw up a scheme, preferably to be completed before the year's end.
你去拟个章程来，顶好在年里办妥当，

Then every shop can begin next year with a fresh set of accounts, the dividing line clear and everything in order.
明年开头，家家都是一本新帐，界限分明，清清楚楚。

What do you say?”
你说呢？”

Tang was taken aback.
唐子韶一愣，

A multitude of anxious thoughts crowded his mind.
心里七上八下，念头很多，

Collecting himself, he replied, “At the end of the year, Mr Hu, those who are doing well come to redeem their pledges, while those who cannot make ends meet must pawn things.
定一定神说：“大先生，年底下，景况好的要来赎当头，年过不去的，要求当当，

Wouldn't a general reshuffle at our busiest time throw everything into confusion?”
生意正忙的时候，来个大调动，不弄得天下大乱？”

“There is something in that.
“这话倒也不错。

But you can prepare the scheme first and let everyone get ready.
不过章程可以先拟，叫大家预备起来，

Once the New Year is over, make the transfers in a quiet month.”
一过了年，逢到淡月，再来调动。”

“Yes.
“是的。

That is the proper way.”
这样子才是正办。”


On returning from these instructions, Tang immediately sought out Pan Maocheng, the custodian of pledged goods, and shut the door for a confidential discussion.
奉命回来，唐子韶立即找到管包潘茂承，关起门来密谈。

The two had been defrauding the business together for years.
原来唐潘勾结舞弊，已历多年，

Their worst irregularities involved clothing left unredeemed after the loan period expired.
毛病最多的是满当的衣服，

Gongji had so much of this that it had opened a second-hand clothing shop of its own, under the sign of Gongji Clothing House.
公济典为了满当的衣服太多，特为设了一家估衣铺，招牌叫做“公济衣庄”，

Forfeited garments from the various pawnshops were sent there for sale.
各典满当的衣服，都发衣庄去叫卖，

Some arrived unchanged; others had been switched.
有的原封不动，有的是掉了包的，

A nearly new sheepskin coat of the fine “radish-thread” variety, for instance, would turn into a plain-skin coat by the time it reached the clothing shop.
明明一件八成新“萝卜丝，，的羊裘，送到衣庄，变了一件”光板“，

Pawn tickets habitually described valuable objects as worthless.
当铺”写票“，向来将值钱的东西写得一文不值，

A gold repeater watch might be entered as “one broken brass watch.”
明明是个金打簧表，当票上却写的是”黄铜烂表一个“。

The wildly cursive handwriting could be read by nobody but the appraiser himself, so customers never protested.
那笔龙飞凤舞的狂草，除了朝奉自己，无人能识，所以从无顾客提过抗议，

With tickets and accounts written in this fashion, substitutions among forfeited pledges were impossible to trace.
而因为如此”写票“记帐，满当之物要掉包，亦就无从查考了。

At Gongji, the switching was particularly flagrant: dark sable became dark lambskin, and silk garments became bamboo ones.
公济典掉包掉的最凶，紫貂换成紫羔，纺绸换成竹衣，

A comparison with the clothing shop's stock-entry accounts would expose the irregularities, and then matters would look very ugly.
拿来跟公济衣庄的进货帐一对，清弊毕现，那时就会弄得难看了。

After much discussion, they could see only one way out: have the whole transfer scheme abandoned.
谈来谈去，唯一的挽救之道，便是根本打消这个计划。

The year-end rush provided a reason to postpone it, but beyond that they could find no argument against it.
但除了以年底生意忙碌，不宜大事更张的说法，将此事缓得一缓以外，别无可以驳倒此一计划的理由。

Pan was at his wits' end.
潘茂承一筹莫展，

Tang, however, thought of one desperate expedient.
唐子韶却想到了一个万不得已的主意，

It must be carried out secretly, without a word getting about, and whether it could be attempted at all depended on his concubine's willingness.
不过这个主意只能悄悄去做，决不能声张，而且能不能做，还要看他的姨太太肯不肯。


Tang came from Huizhou.
原来唐子韶是徽州人，

Appraisers from that region did not bring their families when they went elsewhere to earn a living.
徽州朝奉到外地谋生，都不带家眷，

Seeing how lonely he was away from home, Hu had given him a maid named Yueru as a concubine three years earlier.
胡雪岩看他客中寂寞，三年前送了他一个名叫月如的“丫头做姨太太。

Within six months of her marriage, she had seemed transformed into another woman.
月如自从嫁了唐子韶，不到半年功夫，竟似脱胎换骨变了另一个人，

Her yellowish hair had grown thick and black; her coarse skin had become fair and smooth.
头发本来发黄，变黑变多了，皮肤本来粗糙，变白变细了，

Her figure had always been good, but now her slender waist and full hips stood out more strikingly, inviting thoughts of pleasure.
她的身材本来不坏，此时越发显得蜂腰丰臀，逗人避思，

Most remarkable were her eyes.
尤其是那双眼睛，

Once dull and vacant, as though she never had enough sleep, they had become bright and liquid; a glance from them seemed to flash with a power that seized the heart.
本来呆滞失神，老象没有睡足似的，忽然变得水汪汪地，顾盼之间，仿佛一道闪光，慑人心魄。

Hu was greatly attracted.
为此，胡雪岩颇为动心，

His manner and conversation often betrayed an eagerness to try his chances.
言谈神气之间，每每流露出跃跃欲试之情。

Tang had noticed long ago and merely pretended not to know.
唐子韶早已发觉，只是装做不知而已。

Now, in desperate circumstances, he thought of using her beauty as his stratagem.
如今事急无奈，才想到了这条美人计，

If he could persuade Yueru, half the task would be done.
若能说服月如，事成一半了。


After considering his approach, Tang decided to frighten her with the consequences.
事先经过一番盘算，决定胁以利害，

“Disaster is upon us, Yueru.”
“月如，”他说：“祸事临头了。”

“Disaster?”
“祸事？”

Alarmed, she asked at once, “What trouble have you got yourself into?”
月如自不免吃惊，急急问说：“你闯了什么祸？”

“You could say I brought it on myself.”
“也可以说是我自己闯的祸。”

He pointed to the jade hairpin in her hair and the emerald ring on her hand.
他指着月如头上插的一只翠玉钗，手上戴的一个祖母绿的戒指问道：

“Do you know where those came from?”
“你知道不知道，这些东西哪里来的？”

“Weren't they forfeited pledges?”
“不是满当货吗？”

“They should have been.
不错，应该是满当货，

I entered them as having been redeemed by their original owners and took them away.
我当做原主来赎了回去了。“唐子韶说：”

That counts as tampering with the records and fraud.
这就算做手脚舞弊，

If it comes out, there will be terrible trouble.”
查出来不得了。

“There won't.
““不会的，

Mr Hu is a very generous man.
大先生为人顶厚道，

Tell him honestly and admit your fault.
你跟他老实说一声，认个错，

He won't make things difficult for you.”
他不会为难你的。”

“That is no use.
“没有用，

I am not the only person involved.
不是我一个人的事，

It is bound to come out.
一定会查出来。

Then he won't have to dismiss me: I shall have no face to remain in Hangzhou.
到那时候，不用大先生开口请我走路，我自己也没有这张脸再在杭州混了，

I shall have to go home and live on what we have put by.”
只好回家吃老米饭。”


Looking utterly miserable, Tang continued, “I have brought this on myself.
唐子韶紧接着又哭丧着脸说：“在我自己是自作孽，

What grieves me is that I have ruined you too.”
心里难过的是害了你。”

“Ruined me?”
“害了我？”

Yueru was shocked.
月如大惊，

“How have you ruined me?”
“怎么会害了我？”

“Think.
“你想，

First, once the fraud is discovered, restitution must be made.
第一，作弊抓到，自然要赔，

I fear not one piece of your jewellery will remain.
你的首饰只怕一样都不会剩，

Second, you will have to come back to Huizhou with me and suffer hardships.
第二，你跟我回徽州要吃苦，

How could you bear that kind of life?”
那种苦，你怎么吃得来？”

She had often heard him describe his home country.
月如平时听唐子韶谈过家乡的情形，

Huizhou lay among countless mountains, with little land, many people and scant produce.
徽州在万山丛中，地少人多，出产不丰，

The men therefore went away to trade, leaving the women to do men's work: carrying water, chopping firewood, everything.
所以男人都出外经商，女人就要做男人做的事，挑水劈柴，样样都来，

Their lives were harder than those of women anywhere in Jiangsu or Zhejiang.
比江浙那个地方的女人都来得辛苦。

Then she thought of her own position.
而况，她又想到自己的身分，

Before Tang's principal wife she would have to be humble and submissive, serving her morning and evening.
见了唐子韶的原配，要她做低服小，早晚伺候，

She would rather die than endure that.
更是件宁死也不愿的事。

The thought made her frantic.
转念到此，不由得大为着急，

“Really, what were you thinking?” she reproached him.
“你也真是！”她埋怨着说：

“Besides your salary, every month you get shares of storage fees, sales commissions, pooled extra interest, loan fees and redemption fees.
“正薪俸以外，每个月分”存箱“、”使用“、”公抽“、”当厘“、”赎厘“，

Those extras are substantial, and there is a dividend at the year's end.
外快已经不少了，年底还有分红，

Why couldn't you enjoy a comfortable life instead of devising further tricks?”
舒舒服服的日子不过，何苦又另外去搞花样？”


Though she had been married to Tang for only three years, Yueru already knew the customs of the pawnshop well.
月如嫁过来虽只三年，当铺的规矩，已经很熟悉了。

Every grade of staff shared in extras beyond the regular monthly wage: the inside posts of manager, pledge custodian, cashier and bookkeeper; the outside posts of appraisers at the counter; the intermediate ranks who wrote and checked tickets, wrapped bundles and attached labels; and even the apprentices.
典当从，“内缺”的管总、管包、管钱、管帐，到“外缺”站柜台的朝奉，以下“中缺”的写票、清票、卷包、挂牌，还有学徒，每月正薪以外，还有“外快”可分，

Valuable clothes required special care, for which a fee of one per cent of the loan principal was customarily charged, called cunxiang, the storage fee.
贵重衣服，须加意保管，例收当本百分之一的酬劳，称为“存箱”，

When forfeited goods were sold, six-tenths of one per cent was deducted for the employees, under the name shiyong, the sales commission.
满当货卖出，抽取六厘，归伙友所得，称为“使用”，

The customary grace period did not exceed five days: redemption within five extra days incurred no additional interest, but a delay of more than six days required payment of two months' interest.
典当宽限，例不过五，赎当时不超过五天，不另计息，但如超过六天，要付两个月利息。

The extra month's interest then went to the staff as gongchou, the pooled levy.
遇到这种情形，多出来的一个月利息亦归伙友，称为“公抽”。

The dangli, or loan fee, was one-tenth of one per cent of the principal advanced; the shuli, or redemption fee, was three-tenths of one per cent of the principal repaid.
至于“当厘”是照当本抽一厘，“赎厘”是照赎本抽三厘，

Thus, if a shop advanced a hundred thousand taels in a month and recovered fifty thousand, the loan fees would amount to a hundred taels and the redemption fees to a hundred and fifty.
譬如这个月当本支出十万两银子，赎本收回五万银子，就有一百两银子的“当厘”，一百五十两银子的“赎厘”。

These extras were pooled and divided each month in differing proportions.
这些外快，汇总了每月公分，所得多寡的比例不同，

As manager, Tang naturally received a large share: fifty or sixty taels in a lean month, over a hundred in a good one.
唐子韶是管总，当然得大份，每个月少则五六十两，多则上百，

His circumstances were decidedly comfortable.
日子过得着实宽裕。


Tang did feel regret, but he said, “What is done is done. Reproaches are no use.
唐子韶自然亦有悔意，不过，“事情做也已经做了，你埋怨也没胡。”他说，

We must find a remedy now.

“本来就难得见的。”唐子韶说：

“一缸火腿当中，只摆一条‘戌腿’，为的是取他的香味。“


“Dog meat certainly is fragrant.
“狗肉是真香。

Unfortunately, my mother will not allow it into the house.”
可惜老太太不准进门。”

Hu turned to Yueru.
胡雪岩转脸看着月如说：

“She often mentions your steamed eggs.
“老太太常常提起你炖的蛋，

Make her another bowl tomorrow.”
你明天再弄一碗去孝敬孝敬她。”

“How kind of the old lady!
“唷！老太太真是抬举我。

If she likes them, I will make them and send them every day.”
她老人家喜欢，我天天做了送去。”

“Steamed eggs should be eaten straight from the steamer,” Tang said, suggesting a better plan.
“蒸蛋要现蒸现吃。”唐子韶有个更好的办法，

“Why not teach Young Madam Liu the secret?
“倒不如你把诀窍传授了小刘妈，

Then the old lady can have them whenever she wants.”
老太太想吃就有，多么好？”

Like an imperial household, Hu's establishment had several small kitchens.
原来胡家也仿佛宫中那样，有好几个小厨房，

The one devoted to his mother was managed by Young Madam Liu.
胡老太太专用的小厨房，归小刘妈管，

Teaching her the method would make everything much easier.
诀窍传了给她，就省事得多了。

“An excellent suggestion, Zishao.”
“子韶这话，通极。”

Hu thoroughly approved.
胡雪岩深以为然，

“Tell me, Yueru, why is it that however many fine ingredients one puts into steamed eggs, they always come to table clear on top and thick below, with everything sunk to the bottom in a hard mass?
“月如，我倒要问你，凡是蒸蛋，不管你加多少好作料，端上桌来，总归上清下浑，作料沉在碗底，结成绷硬一块。

Only in your three-delicacy eggs is everything evenly distributed, tender rather than overdone.
只有你蒸的这碗三鲜蛋，作料都匀开在蛋里面，嫩而不老，

What is the secret?”
诀窍在哪里？”

“They must be steamed twice…”
“诀窍是分两次蒸……”

First she beat three eggs thoroughly with a teacup of ham stock from which the fat had been removed and a little salt, then steamed them until set, as tender as the softest tofu.
月如的方法是，第一次用鸡蛋三枚，加去油的火腿汤一茶杯、盐少许，打透蒸熟，就象极嫩的水豆腐，

Only then did she add the chopped ham, chopped dried mushrooms, shrimp and other ingredients.
这时才加作料、火腿屑、冬菇屑、虾仁之类，

She beat another raw egg into the steamed custard, mixed everything thoroughly, and added mushroom stock according to the consistency.
另外再打一个生鸡蛋，连同蒸好的嫩蛋，一起打匀，看浓淡酌量加冬菇汤。

Steamed again, it became the three-delicacy egg dish Hu was now eating.
这样上宠蒸出来的蛋，就是此刻胡雪岩所吃的三鲜蛋。


“One should never reveal a secret,” Tang said with a laugh.
“凡事说破不得。”唐子韶笑道：

“Once explained, it is worth nothing.”
“说破了就不值钱了。”

“Not so,” Hu replied.
“不然。”胡雪岩说：

“Merely knowing the method is no use without care and effort.
“光晓得诀窍，不用心、不下工夫，

The result will be neither one thing nor another, let alone better than anyone else's.
弄出来也是个‘三不象’，更不必说胜过人家。

Am I right, Yueru?”
月如，你说我这话是不是？”

His words naturally pleased her, and her smile was sweet.
月如听了他的话，必里当然很舒服，绽开的笑容很甜，

“If you say so, Master, have some more while it is hot.”
“老爷这么说，就趁热再吃点。”

She scooped up a spoonful and held it towards his lips.
说着，用汤匙舀了一匙，伸到胡雪岩口边。

“I can manage myself.”
“我自己来。”

Hu caught her hand and prevented her from putting the spoon into his mouth.
胡雪岩捏住她的手，不让她将汤匙送入他口中。

At this, Tang turned to the maid waiting at table.
见此光景，唐子韶便回头关照侍席的丫头：

“Bring me a bowl of rice.
“你替我盛碗饭来，

Once I have eaten, I must catch my boat.
吃完了，我要赶上船，

Time is getting very short.”
辰光已经很局促了。”

“When does it leave?” Hu asked.
“啥辰光开船？”胡雪岩问。

“At two.”
“两点钟。”

“Then you must hurry.
“呃，这倒是要快了。

It is past one already.
已经一点过头了。

These days a small steamer tows seven or eight passenger boats together.
现在小火轮拖航船，一拖七八条，

They won't wait once it is time to leave.”
到时候不等的。”


Tang hurriedly finished his rice and took his leave.
于是唐子韶匆匆吃完了饭，向胡雪岩告辞。

Yueru went to see him downstairs, but he stopped her at the stairhead.
月如要送他下楼，到得楼梯口，却让唐子韶拦住了。

“Stay and keep Mr Hu company.
“你陪陪大先生。

There is plenty of time; I shall catch the boat.
辰光够的，航船一定赶得上。

I expect to be away three days.
去了总有三天耽搁，

Be careful with the fires and candles.”
你火烛小心。”

“I know.
“我晓得，

Go without worrying.” She told the maid, “See the master downstairs, then help Mother Chen in the kitchen.
你放心去好了。”月如又叫那丫头：“你送老爷下楼，就到厨房里去帮陈妈的忙，

I will attend here.”
这里有我。”

Yet she remained where she was until the footsteps had died away.
月如说完了，却仍站在原处，直待脚步声消失，

Then she turned, shut the door to the staircase and slipped the movable bolt into place, cutting them off from the outside.
方始回身，顺手把楼梯间的门关上，活络门闩一拨，顿时内外隔绝。

Hu felt a stir of excitement.
胡雪岩心中一动，

This was rather like the opening of The Plum in the Golden Vase: Mr Hu had become Master Ximen.
这倒有点象《金瓶梅》开头那种情形了。“胡大先生”变了“西门大官人”，

Tang might look like the procuring Granny Wang, but if he missed his boat and came home to find them, he would suddenly turn into the cuckolded Wu Dalang.
不过唐子韶虽说看起来象王婆，倘或航船赶不上，回家来撞见了，一下变成了武大郎，

That would be no joke.
那不是开玩笑的事。

Could Tang have conceived a malicious plan and laid a honey trap for him?
“会不会唐子韶起黑心，做好仙人跳的圈套要我来钻？”

Hu asked himself the question while studying Yueru's face.
胡雪岩在心中自问，同时抬眼去看月如的脸色。

Her calm expression reassured him.
她的脸色很平静，使得胡雪岩心里也平静了，

Even if Tang had such wicked intentions, he would lack the courage to carry them through.
想想唐子韶即令“起黑心”，也还没有这样的胆子。

Yueru had still less reason to join him in a blackmail trap.
月如更没有理由陪唐子韶扮演仙人跳，

Apparently they wanted something and had resorted to this desperate means of obtaining it.
看起来是有所求，出此下策，

There was nothing very serious to fear.
没有什么大不了的。


Reassured, Hu let his thoughts roam.
这样想着，心思便野了，

“Yueru, how I regret having given you to Old Tang.”
“月如，”他说：“我好懊悔，不该把你许给老唐的。”

“Why?”
“为啥？”

“Must you ask?”
“还要问我？”

He took her hand.
胡雪岩捏着她的手说：

“Are you pretending not to understand?”
“你是不是装糊涂？”

“I am not pretending.
“我不是装糊涂，

I am only lamenting my hard fate.
我是怨我自己命苦。

If I must be a concubine anyway, why am I unworthy to live in the Twelve Chambers?”
一样是做小，为啥不配住‘十二楼’？”

Hu had built a gallery-lined residence divided into twelve sections for his twelve concubines, hence its name, the Twelve Chambers.
胡雪岩造了一座走马楼，共分十二区，安置十二个姨太太，所以这座走马楼又称十二楼。

Hearing her resentment, he replied, “Don't blame me.
听她话中有怨怼之意，胡雪岩便即说道：“你也不要怪我。

How could I know you would become what you are today?”
哪晓得你今天会是这样子的！”

“What have I become?
“我怎样？

Yueru is still Yueru.”
月如还不是月如。”

“Su Qin was no longer the Su Qin of old.
“苏秦不是旧苏秦。

A woman goes through eighteen transformations as she grows, but nobody has changed as much as you.
女大十八变，不过人家没有你变得厉害。

Except for…”
你除了……”

He swallowed the rest.
胡雪岩将话咽住了。

She pressed him.
月如却要追问：

“Except for what?
“除了什么？

Except that I can cook a few dishes, there is nothing about me that pleases you.”
除了会弄几样菜，没有一样中老爷的意的。”

“Everything pleases me.
“样样中意。

Except…”
除了……”

“There you go again, beginning and then stopping.
“喏，说说又不说了。

I hate half-finished remarks.”
我顶不欢喜话说半句。”

“I will tell you if you promise not to be angry.
“你不动气，我就说。

The one flaw in your beauty is that pair of large feet.”
你美中不足的是，一双大脚。”

“What is wrong with large feet?
“脚大有什么不好？

Grand Secretary Li's mother has them too.”
李中堂的老太太就是一双大脚。”


She meant Li Hongzhang.
李中堂是指李鸿章。

The story went that when his brother Li Hanzhang was Governor-General of Huguang and brought their mother to live with him, Li Hongzhang came ahead from Tianjin to Wuchang to welcome her.
据说李瀚章当湖广总督时，迎养老母，李鸿章亦先期由天津赶到武昌去迎候，

When her official boat reached the landing, the city's civil and military officers crowded the quay.
官船靠岸，码头上挤满了一城文武。

From there to the governor-general's residence, the procession included dozens of horses ridden by outriders and attendants, placards displaying offices and ranks, and the full ceremonial escort.
上岸到总督衙门，顶马、跟马几十匹，职事衔牌加上“导子”，

It stretched so far that the gong and cries clearing the way at the front could not be heard at the rear.
长到前面鸣锣喝道，后面听不见。

Beside the shafts of the old lady's great green-wool-covered sedan walked her two sons, both governors-general, one on either side.
李太夫人的绿呢大轿，左右扶轿杠的是两个当总督的儿子。

The people of Wuchang poured out to watch, all envying her good fortune.
倾巷来观的武昌百姓，无不羡慕，说“李老太太真好福气”。

The old lady herself was naturally delighted.
那李老太太自然也很得意，

In her exhilaration, she unconsciously extended the tips of her feet beyond the curtain.
得意忘形，不知不觉间将脚尖伸出轿帘以外，

Her feet were unbound, and the spectators began whispering.
原来李老太太是天足，看热闹的百姓，不免窃窃私议，

Li Hongzhang noticed and felt embarrassed.
李鸿章发觉了，自不免有些窘，当下向轿中说道：

“Mother, please draw your feet in.
“娘，请你把脚缩进去，

It does not look seemly to show them.”
露出来不雅观。”

This angered her, for she particularly hated remarks about her large feet.
谁知一句话恼了李老太太，实在也是因为她最恨人家说她大脚，

Mortification turned to fury.
不免恼羞成怒，当时大声说道：

“Your father never objected to my large feet.
“你老子不嫌我大脚，

Now you object!”
你倒来嫌我！”

It was a famous joke, and Yueru knew it.
这是很有名的一个笑话，所以月如也知道，

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩便即笑笑说道：

“Very well.
“好，好，

I do not object to yours.”
我不嫌你。”


“There is really nothing to object to.
“实在也没啥好嫌的。

You don't know the advantages of large feet.”
你不晓得大脚的好处。”

“Then tell me.”
“喔，你倒说说看。”

She blinked thoughtfully, suddenly blushed and gave him a sidelong look.
月如眨着眼思索着，突然脸一红，而且白了他一眼说：

“I shan't.”
“偏不告诉你。”

Hu felt a pleasurable stir of desire.
胡雪岩心里有点发痒，

Smiling, he said, “Put your feet out and let me look.”
笑嘻嘻他说道：“你倒把脚伸出来让我看看。”

“No!” she answered sharply, drawing them back behind her chair.
“不要！”月如答得很简截，同时将一双脚往椅子后面缩了去。

Again he thought of The Plum in the Golden Vase.
于是胡雪岩又想到了《金瓶梅》，

He longed to follow Ximen Qing's example: deliberately knock down his chopsticks and, while bending to retrieve them, take the opportunity to squeeze her foot.
很想照西门庆的办法，故意拂落筷子，俯身去捡时，便好捏一捏她的脚。

Before the thought had fully formed, however, she spoke.
不道念头还未转定，月如却开口说话了。

“You will see my feet in time.”
“我的一双脚，你总看得见的。”

“When?”
“喔，”胡雪岩问：“啥辰光？”

She did not answer.
月如不答话。

He reached over and held her hand.
“月如，”胡雪岩伸过手去，握着她的手说：

“Come and sit nearer.
“你坐过来，

I have something to tell you.”
我有话跟你说。”

“Can't you say it from where you are?”
“你坐在那里，不也好说？”

“No.
“不！

This is something that tastes better when one ‘bites an ear.’”
这话要‘咬耳朵”才有味道。

In Hangzhou speech, biting an ear meant whispering.
“杭州话“咬耳朵”是耳语之意，

“There is nobody here.
“又没有人，

Why must you bite my ear?”
要咬啥耳朵？”

Despite her words, she brought over a round rosewood stool and sat beside him.
月如话虽如此，还是将一张红木圆凳移了过来，坐在胡雪岩身边。


Hu put his left arm around her soft, slender waist, leaned close and first breathed in the scent of her hair.
胡雪岩将左手伸了过去，揽着她那又细又软的腰，凑过头去，先好好闻一闻她的头发，

Then he whispered, “Go and wash your feet now, will you?”
然后低声说道：“你现在就去洗脚，好不好？”

“No,” she answered promptly.
“不好！”月如很快地回答。

“But wasn't it you who said…”
“咦！不是你自己说的。”

“Yes, I said it.
“不错，我说过的。

But not today.”
不过不是今天。”

“Then when?”
“那么，哪一天呢？”

Yueru did not reply.
月如不答，

She let him hold her tighter and tighter without trying to pull away.
但任由胡雪岩越搂越紧，却并无挣拒之意，

After a long while she murmured, “It is so hot.”
好久，才说了声：“好热。”

Sitting a little straighter, she raised her left hand and undid the fastenings from her collar to the button beneath her arm.
接着略略坐直了身子，伸左手去摘衣钮，从领子到腋下那一颗，都解开了，

Her jacket fell half open, releasing a faint fragrance.
衣襟半锨，芗泽微闻。

Seated on her right, Hu needed only to lift his hand to touch her bosom.
胡雪岩坐在她的右面，要探摸她的胸前，只是一举手之劳，

But he preferred first to settle the question.
但他宁愿先把话问清楚。

“Why won't you speak?”
“你为什么不说话？”

“What can I say?
“叫我说哈？

If Madam Luosi found out, how could I ever show my face in Yuanbao Street again?”
螺蛳太太晓得了，我怎么还有脸到元宝街？”

“How would she find out?
“她从哪里去晓得？

Every man who comes out with me knows how to keep his mouth shut.”
跟我出来的人，个个都是嘴紧的人。”

Yueru fell silent again.
月如又不作声了，

To Hu, she now seemed willing, and he waited patiently.
看样子是肯了，胡雪岩便耐心地等着。

“I have some duck congee simmering.
“我炖了鸭粥在那里，

Would you like a bowl?”
要不要吃一碗？”

“Later.”
“等歇再吃。”

Hu rose and gave her a tug.
胡雪岩站起身来，顺手拉了她一把。



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第四章（下）
Towers of Light — Chapter Four, Part Two
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Yueru straightened the bedding and washed her hands, then opened the door to the stairs and called the maid to bring up the pot of duck congee.
月如收拾了床辅，又洗了手，然后开楼门叫丫头从厨房里将一锅鸭粥端了来。

She sent the maid away again, filled a bowl for Hu, and took half a bowl herself to keep him company.
随即遣走丫头，亲手盛了一碗捧给胡雪岩，她自己也盛了半碗，在一旁相陪。

“Master,” she asked casually, “is it true that you mean to move all twenty-three managers to different shops?”
“老爷，”月如闲闲问道：“是不是说二十三家的管总，要来个大扳位？”

“Yes.
“是啊！

That is what Old Tang has gone to Deqing to discuss.”
老唐到德清就是商量这件事去的。”

“Where do you mean to send him?”
“你预备把老唐调到哪里？”

“I do not know yet.”
“这还不晓得。”

“How can you not know?”
“怎么你会不晓得呢？”

“Heaven will decide.
“ ‘凭天断’，

How could I know?”
我怎么会晓得？”

“What do you mean, Heaven will decide?”
“啥叫‘凭天娄’？”

“We shall draw lots.
“抽签。”胡雪岩答说：

The twenty-three pawnshops will be divided into three classes—large, medium, and small—and the managers will draw within each class.
“二十三家典当分做大中小三等，分等抽签。

Suppose there are eight in the largest class: their eight managers draw together, and each goes wherever his lot sends him.”
譬如顶大的有八家，这八家的管总合在一起抽签，抽到哪里是哪里。

“Then if Old Tang draws Suzhou he goes to Suzhou, and if he draws Zhenjiang he goes to Zhenjiang?”
““这样说，老唐抽到苏州到苏州，抽到镇江到镇江？”

“Exactly.”
“不错。”


At this, Yueru put down her chopsticks, covered her face, and stumbled back into the bedroom.
听得这话，月如将筷子一放，掩着脸踉踉跄跄地奔回卧室。

Startled, Hu followed.
胡雪岩大吃一惊，随即也跟了进去，

She lay face down on the bed, her shoulders shaking with sobs.
只见她伏在床上，双肩耸动着在哭。

“Yueru!
“月如，

Yueru!”
月如！”

Though he kept nudging her, she paid no attention.
他尽管推着她的身子，她却不理，

The sound of her crying did seem to stop.
但哭声仿佛止住了。

“What is the matter?
“你到底为啥？

Why are you suddenly so heartbroken?”
无事端端地哭得好伤心。”

Facing the inner side of the bed, she complained, “How could I not be?
“我怎么不要伤心？”月如脸朝里床口发怨言：

You heartless creature!
“你死没良心！

You have tricked me into your arms, had your taste of something new, and immediately thought of this scheme.
把我骗到手，尝过新鲜了，马上想这么一个法子！

You will have Old Tang take me into exile in another county, so you need never set eyes on me again!”
叫老唐带着我充军充到外县，你好眼不见为净！”

Hu could not help laughing in astonishment. “Where did that come from?
“这是从哪里说起？”胡雪岩不由得失笑，

I never dreamed you would connect two things that have nothing to do with each other.”
“我做梦也没有想到，你会把毫不相干的两桩事情扯在一起！”

“Nothing to do with each other?
“哪里是毫不相干？

If Old Tang is sent away, I must go with him.
老唐调到外县，我自然要跟了去，

You do not seem to care in the least.
你好象一点都不在乎，

You have had your pleasure, and that is the end of it.”
玩过就算数了。

Her accusation was not wholly unreasonable.
“这番指摘，不能说她没有道理，

After considering it, Hu said, “You need not necessarily go with him.
胡雪岩细想了一会说道：“你也不一定要跟老唐去，

I could buy you another house.”
我替你另外买一幢房子。”

“To be your secret household?”
“做你的小公馆？”

“It would not exactly be that…”
“也不是啥小公馆……”

He was at a loss, but Yueru pressed on.
胡雪岩有些词穷了，月如却毫不放松。

“What else would it be?
“不是小公馆是啥呢？”她说：

Even if we said Old Tang had bought it, how should I explain living alone in Hangzhou? People would ask.
“就算作为是老唐买的房子，我一个人住在杭州，别人问起来，我怎么回复人家？

And someone would be sure to discover your visits.
而且你要来了，总归有人晓得的，

If your attendants said nothing, somebody else would tell Madam Luosi.
跟你的人不说，自然会有人到螺蛳太太面前去说，

One day she would come with a crowd to attack me.
总有一天带了人打上门来。

Then I should have no choice but to throw myself into a river or a well.”
那时候我除了投河跳井，没有第二条路好走。

Unable to refute her, Hu stood speechless for some time.
“话说得驳不倒，胡雪岩愣了好半晌说：

“You know the transfer plan came first.
“月如，你晓得的，二十三家管总调动的事在前，

Even yesterday I had no idea we would share a bed today.
我们今天会睡在一床，是我连昨天都没有想到的事。

The two things were entirely separate; now they seem tied together.
本来是两桩不搭界的事情，现在倒好象扯在一起了。

Tell me, then: what can we do?”
你倒说说看，有啥好办法？”


Yueru deliberately paused as though thinking it over.
月如故意沉吟了一会，方始说道：

“There is a way.
“办法是有。

But first I must ask: did you only want to take advantage of me today, or do you still want me?”
先要问你，你是只想今天捡捡便宜呢，还是仍旧要我？”

“I still want you.”
“仍旧要你。”

“Then there is only one thing to do.
“那就只有一个办法，

Leave everything as it is.”
原样不动。”

“What do you mean?”
“怎么叫原样不动？”

“Move the other managers wherever you please, but leave Old Tang at Gongji.
“别家的管总，你尽管去调动，老唐仍旧管公济，”月如又说：

He is the head of all your pawnshop managers, different from the others.
“老唐是帮你管典当的头脑，跟别家不同，

There is good reason to leave him where he is.”
他不动是说得过去的。”

“How could that be justified?
“那怎么说得过去？

Once I make an exception, everyone will object.”
一有了例外，大家不服。”

“Then move none of them.
“那就大家不动。”月如又说：

I know nothing about business, but surely it depends on knowing people.
“我是不懂做生意，不过照我想，做生意全靠人头熟，

Arrive suddenly in a strange place and you are completely in the dark.
忽然之间到了陌生地方，两只眼睛墨黑，

By the time you can see your way, other firms have taken the business.”
等到你看清楚，生意已经让别家抢走了。”

Hu turned the matter over anxiously, unable to find a solution that served both purposes.
胡雪岩心里七上八下，盘算来盘算去，苦无兼顾的善策，

At last he sighed.
最后叹口气说：

“We shall have to leave everyone where he is.”
“只好大家不动。”


The servants in Yuanbao Street soon knew of Tang Zishao’s beauty trap.
唐子韶的“美人计”，元宝街的下人很快地都知道了，

Hu’s mother, however, ruled the household strictly.
不过胡老太太治家极严，

She treated the saying “Those who bring you gossip are troublemakers themselves” as an inviolable law, so no one dared carry this secret into the Twelve Chambers.
将“来说是非者，便是是非人”这句俗语，奉为金科玉律，所以没有人敢到十二楼去说这个秘密。

It remained unspoken nearby but traveled far away.
但近处未传，远处却传到了。

Gu related it gloomily to the Seventh Lady, who refused to believe him.
古应春以抑郁的语气，将这件事告诉了七姑奶奶，而七姑奶奶不信。

“Little Uncle is not that sort of man.
“小爷叔不是这种人。

If a woman could make him overturn a settled business plan, how could he have built up what he has today?
如果为了女人会把生意上商量好的事推翻不算，小爷叔哪里会有今天这种场面，

He would have ruined himself long ago.”
老早败下来了。”

“I cannot be bothered to argue.
“我懒得跟你争。

He will soon be here to meet His Excellency Zuo.
好在他就要来接左大人，

Ask him yourself.”
你不妨当面问问他。”

“Of course I shall.” She continued defending Hu.
“我当然要当面问他。”七姑奶奶继续为胡雪岩辩护，

“He must have his reasons for leaving the twenty-three managers in place.
“二十三家典当管总仍然照旧，一走有他的道理。

His judgment will not be wrong.”
小爷叔的打算不会错的。”

Hu arrived the next day and stayed, as before, at Gu’s house.
第二天，胡雪岩就到了，仍旧住在古家，

He and Gu returned from their engagements after eleven that night to find the Seventh Lady waiting with the customary late supper.
应酬到半夜十一点多种才跟古应春一起回家。七姑奶奶照例预备了消夜在等他们。

Over wine and conversation, she asked casually, “Little Uncle, I hear you have abandoned your plan to transfer the twenty-three managers.
把杯闲谈之际，七姑奶奶闲闲问道：“小爷叔，你二十三家典当管总调动的计划，听说打消了，

Why?”
是为啥？”

“Ah, Seventh Sister, please do not ask.”
“嗐，七姐，请你不要问了。”

Her expression changed at once.
一听这话，七姑奶奶勃然变色，立即问说：

“Why should I not ask?”
“为啥不要问？”

“Pleasant things are worth talking about.
“七姐，有趣的事，大家谈谈，

Unpleasant things will only upset you as well.
没趣的事谈起来，连带你也不高兴，

Why bother?”
何苦？”

“Then it is true.
“这样说，是真的了。

Tang really did lay a trap for you to walk into.
真的姓唐的做了圈套，请你胡大先生去钻。

Little Uncle, how could you do anything so foolish?”
小爷叔，你怎么会做这种糊涂事？”


As she said “foolish,” her mouth twisted, her eyes turned askew, and her face became fiery red.
说到“糊涂”二字，嘴已经歪了，眼睛也斜了，脸红如火，

“Something is wrong!” Gu cried, rushing to support her.
古应春叫声：“不好！”赶紧上前去扶，

She could no longer sit upright and fell headlong from her stool.
七姑奶奶已在凳子上坐不住，一头栽在地上，

Fortunately, the thick Persian wool carpet kept her head from being cut open.
幸好地上铺了极厚的波斯羊毛地毯，头没有摔破。

“A stroke!”
“是中风！”

Hu jumped up and shouted for servants.
胡雪岩跳起身来喊道：“来人！”

While some lifted her, others were sent for doctors.
于是一面叫进人来，扶起七姑奶奶，一面打发人去延医，

Hu ordered them to fetch Doctor Cao, known as an imperial physician because he had been summoned to take pulses in the palace during the Xianfeng reign.
胡雪岩关照去请在咸丰年间曾入宫“请脉”，号称太医的曹郎中，

Gu trusted Western medicine and sent separately for a doctor he knew, Ailituo.
但古应春相信西医，且有一个熟识的医生，名叫艾礼脱，所以另外派人去请。

It was past midnight, and knocking up doctors from their beds naturally took time.
时已夜半，叩门将医生从床上叫起来，自然得费些工夫。

Gu remained comparatively composed; Hu was extraordinarily distressed.
古应春倒还沉得住气，反是胡雪岩异样地焦急不安，

He paced and wrung his hands, watching the Seventh Lady on the couch, her eyes closed, a rattling sound of phlegm in her throat.
望着躺在软榻上，闭着眼“呼噜、呼噜”只在喉间作痰响的七姑奶奶，搓着手蹀躞不停。

He knew that anger at his disgraceful conduct had brought this on.
他知道七姑奶奶是听到他做了没出息的事，气恼过度，致生此变。

If she died, it would be like the saying, “I did not kill Boren, but Boren died because of me.”
倘或不治，则“我虽不杀伯仁，伯仁由我而死”，

Lifelong remorse would be his.
会一辈子歉疚在心，

How could he go on living with it?
日子还过得下去？


At last Ailituo arrived.
好不容易将医生等到了，先来的是艾礼脱，

Seeing her lying flat, he told Gu in English that a stroke patient should not be left in that position.
一看七姑奶奶躺在那里，用英语跟古应春说中风的病人，不宜横卧。

Gu immediately had two serving women sit her up in an armchair, supporting her on either side.
古应春随即叫两名仆妇，把七姑奶奶扶了起来，靠在安乐椅上、左右扶持。

Western doctors observed none of the rules against physical contact between the sexes.
西医看病，没有“男女授受不亲”那一套，

Ailituo opened his bag, put the stethoscope to his ears, and had Gu unfasten her clothes so that he could listen to her heart.
艾礼脱打开皮包，取出听诊器挂在耳朵上，关照古应春解开七姑奶奶的衣钮，拿听筒按在她胸前听心跳。

After examining her, he pried open her clenched teeth and contrived to get her to swallow a pill with warm water.
诊断完了，撬开牙关，用温开水设法将他带来的药丸，让她吞了下去。

If she regained consciousness after six hours, he told Gu, her life could be saved.
然后告诉古应春，六小时以后，如能苏醒，性命可保，

He would return after daybreak.
他天亮后再来复诊。

As he was speaking, Doctor Cao arrived.
正在谈着，曹郎中到了，

Ailituo looked displeased and protested that someone receiving Western treatment could not also consult a Chinese physician.
艾礼脱脸色不大好看，抗议式地对古应春说，看西医就不能看中医。

Gu was embarrassed and asked Hu what to do.
这一下，让古应春为难了，跟胡雪岩商量，应该怎么办。

“You trust Western medicine, so naturally you must decide.
“你相信西医，自然是你作主。

Let Doctor Cao examine her and write his prescription as usual.
曹郎中，病情他照看，方子由他照开，

Simply do not give her his medicine.”
不吃他的药就是了。”

“Quite right.
“不错，不错！

That is the way.”
这法子好。”

Gu followed the suggestion.
古应春照他的话办。


Ailituo was a capable doctor.
艾礼脱的本领不错，

By daybreak the Seventh Lady had actually opened her eyes, though Hu was now too exhausted to keep his own open.
到了天亮，七姑奶奶居然张开眼睛了，但胡雪岩去倦得眼不开眼睛。

“Little Uncle, go and sleep.
“小爷叔，你赶紧去睡一觉，

You still have to meet His Excellency Zuo this afternoon.
下午还要去接左大人。”古应春说，

Rest without worrying; I shall wake you in time.”
“尽管放心去睡，到时候我会叫你。”

“If only I could put my mind at ease enough to sleep.”
“能放心睡得着倒好了。”

“Life and death are ordained.
“小爷叔，死生有命，

Besides, she seems better.
而且看样子也好转了，

You need not worry.”
你不必担心。”

But how could Hu be easy?
话虽如此，胡雪岩如何放心得下？

His eyes were sore and heavy, yet his sleep was broken by frequent starts.
双眼虽涩重得睁不开，睡却睡不好，时时惊醒，

He rose before noon.
不到中午就起身了。

“Ailituo has been again,” Gu told him. “He says the danger has largely passed, though paralysis is probably unavoidable. Many people live another ten years or more with such an illness.
“艾礼脱又来看病，说大致不要紧了，不过风瘫恐怕不免。带病延年，活上十几年的也多的是。”古应春说道：

Attend to your business, Little Uncle.
“小爷叔办正事去吧，

I am sorry I cannot accompany you.
可惜我不能陪你，

Please explain to His Excellency when you see him.”
见了左大人，代我说一声。”

“Of course.
“好，好！

I shall.”
我会说。”


Zuo had waited until after Cixi’s birthday before leaving Beijing, with permission to visit his ancestral graves.
左宗棠等过了慈禧太后的万寿，方始出京，奉准回籍扫墓，

He reached Changsha, the Hunan provincial capital, on the twenty-fifth day of the eleventh lunar month.
十一月二十五日到湖南省城长沙，

His first act was to call on Guo Songtao.
第一件事是去拜访郭嵩焘。

Their relations were tangled with old favors and grievances.
郭嵩焘与左宗棠有一段重重纠结的恩怨。

In the eighth year of Xianfeng, when Zuo served on Governor Luo Bingzhang’s staff in Hunan, he decided everything for himself.
当咸丰八年左宗棠在湖南巡抚骆秉章幕府中时，一切独断独行，

One day Luo was reading in his office when a gun sounded at the outer gate.
一天骆秉章在签押房里看书。忽然听见辕门放铳，

As it was not time for the regular noon gun, he asked what had happened.
看辰光不是每天正午的“午时炮”，便问是怎么回事？

“Adviser Zuo is ceremonially dispatching a memorial,” a servant replied.
听差告诉他：“左师爷拜折。”

Luo had not even known that a memorial was being sent.
连上奏折他都不知道，

Zuo was virtually the governor of Hunan himself and acquired the nickname “Left Censor-in-Chief.”
湖南巡抚等于左宗棠在做，因而得了个外号，叫做“左邵御史”。

Governors normally carried the concurrent title of Right Vice Censor-in-Chief: the nickname implied that Zuo exercised still greater power.
巡抚照例挂“右副都御史”衔，叫左宗棠为左都御史，意思是说他比“右副部御史”巡抚的权还要重。


At that time Fan Xie, brigade commander of Yongzhou in Hunan, was a man of poor reputation from Enshi in Hubei.
其时有个湖南永州镇总兵樊燮，湖北恩施人，声名不佳，

On one visit, Zuo questioned him about Yongzhou’s defenses.
有一次去见左宗棠，谈到永州的防务情形，

Fan could answer nothing and was less than respectful.
樊燮一问三不知，而且礼貌上不大周到，

Furious, Zuo slapped him hard across the face and immediately drafted a memorial denouncing him as “corrupt, unrestrained, lawless, and notorious.”
左宗棠大为光火，当时甩了他一个大嘴巴，而且立即办了个奏稿，痛劾樊燮“贪纵不法，声名恶劣”，

Among its judgments was “unable to recognize a single written character.”
其中有“目不识丁”的考语，

He sent it without informing Luo.
也不告诉骆秉章就发出去了。

Whether Fan was corrupt and lawless remained to be investigated, but how could a wholly illiterate man command a brigade?
樊燮是否“贪纵不法”，犹待查明，但“目不识丁”何能当总兵官？

He was dismissed first and investigated afterward.
当下光革职，后查办。

Those words burned more deeply into him than a branding iron.
这“目不识丁”四字，在樊燮心里，比烙铁烫出来的还要深刻，

Once retired, he used the considerable military funds he had withheld to engage distinguished teachers for his only son.
“解甲归田”以后，好在克扣下来的军饷很不少，当下延聘名师教他的独子读书，

Beside the study’s tablet honoring Heaven, Earth, the Sovereign, Parents, and Teachers, he pasted red paper bearing the charge of illiteracy.
书房里“天地君亲师”的木牌旁边，贴一张梅红笺，写的就是“目不识丁”四字。

“Zuo is only a provincial graduate, yet he puts on such airs.
他告诉他的儿子说：“左宗棠不过是个举子，就这么样的神气，

Unless you become a jinshi, you are no son of mine.”
你将来不中进士，不是我的儿子。”

The son justified his hopes: he not only became a jinshi but entered the Hanlin Academy, winning literary distinction early.
他这个儿子倒也很争气，后来不但中了迸士，而且点了翰林，早年就是名士，

He was Fan Zengxiang.
此人就是樊增祥。

While educating his son, Fan also sought revenge.
一方面教子，一方面还要报仇。

Through influence he appealed to Luo’s superior, Guanwen, described as Governor-General of Liangguang, and sent men to present his grievance at the Censorate in Beijing.
樊熨走门路，告到骆秉章的上司，两广总督官文那里，又派人进京，在都察院递呈鸣冤。

Guanwen’s memorial used the formidable phrase “one office, two seals,” meaning that two men were acting as governor of Hunan.
官文为此案出奏，有一句很厉害的话，叫做“一官两印”，意思是说有两个人在做湖南巡抚。

Official authority could not be lent to private hands, least of all the authority of a great provincial governor.
名器不可假人，而况是封疆大吏，

The matter was serious.
这件事便很严重了。


Guo Songtao was then a Hanlin scholar serving in the Southern Study.
其时郭嵩焘是南书房翰林，

His child had married a child of Zuo’s elder brother Zuo Zongzhi, so he knew Zuo well and understood his exceptional ability.
他跟左宗棠的胞兄左宗植是儿女亲家，与左宗棠当然很熟，深知他才气过人，

He approached Pan Zuyin, another Southern Study scholar.
便跟同为南书房的翰林潘祖荫说：

“Without Zuo Jigao, Hunan cannot possibly hold out.
“左季高如果不在湖南，一走保不住，

There would then be no hope for the situation in the southeast.
东南大局，不夏可问。

I am his fellow provincial and a relative by marriage; it would be improper for me to speak.
我跟他同乡，又是姻亲，不便进言，

Why not submit a memorial yourself?”
老兄何妨上个摺子。”

Pan did so.
潘祖荫听他的话，果然上了个摺子，

After recounting Zuo’s achievements, he concluded, “The state cannot do without Hunan for a single day, and Hunan cannot do without Zuo Zongtang for a single day.”
铺叙他的功绩以后，作了个结论：“国家不可一日无湖南，即湖南不可一日无左宗棠。”

Moved, the Xianfeng Emperor asked Zeng Guofan whether Zuo should remain in Hunan or be transferred to his headquarters, where his abilities could be fully used.
咸丰一看，为之动容，当即传旨问曾国藩，左宗棠是仍旧在湖南好呢？还是调到曾国藩大营中，以便尽其所长。

Zeng replied that Zuo was “firm, clear-sighted, able to endure hardship, and thoroughly versed in military affairs.”
曾国藩回奏，左宗棠“刚明耐苦，晓畅兵机”。

An edict assigned him to assist Zeng.
于是奉旨随同曾国藩襄办军务。
