Misfortune had become good fortune, thanks largely to Pan and Guo, but Zuo treated the two men very differently.
左宗棠因祸得福，多亏得藩祖荫、郭嵩焘，但他对潘、郭的态度，大不相同。

For Pan, he sent generous gifts of money on the customary three festivals and two birthdays.
对潘祖荫除了“三节两寿”必送一份极厚的礼金以外，

Knowing Pan’s interest in ancient inscriptions and stone monuments, he also sent the first rubbings of newly unearthed Guanzhong steles by special messenger while serving as Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu.
知道潘祖荫好收藏金石碑版，当陕甘总督时，凡是关中有新出土的碑，初拓本一走专差送潘祖荫，

Sometimes he sent the original stones themselves.
有时甚至连原碑都送到潘家。


After the Taiping defeat, Guo had been appointed Governor of Guangdong.
郭嵩焘是在洪杨失败后，奉旨出任广东巡抚。

Ruilin, Governor-General of Liangguang, also resided in Guangzhou.
两广总督名瑞麟，与巡抚同驻广州，

A governor and governor-general in the same city often failed to agree.
“督抚同城”，常不和睦，

Ruilin was greedy and incompetent, but his Imperial Household background gave him direct access to both empress dowagers and powerful protection.
瑞麟贪而无能，但为内务府出身，有事可直接诉诸两宫太后，靠山很硬，

Guo suffered badly from his obstruction and could do little about it.
所以郭嵩焘深受其掣肘之苦而无可如何。

Difficult though his position already was, he never expected Zuo, an old friend whom he had once helped, to turn against him as well.
那知处境本已很难的郭嵩焘，万想不到多年好友。且曾加以援手的左宗棠会跟他为难，

Over supplementary military contributions, Zuo sent reproachful letters and submitted four memorials criticizing Guo’s administration.
为了协饷，除致函指南以外，且四次上奉祈，指摘郭嵩焘，措施如何不然。

Various stories explained their estrangement.
郭、左失和的原因，有仲付传说，

The most widespread was that an auspicious lingzhi fungus had appeared in the Confucian temple at Xiangyin when Guo was appointed to Guangdong.
流传最盛的一个说法是，当郭嵩焘放广东巡抚时，湘阴文庙忽产灵芝，

His younger brother Guo Kuntao wrote that this foretold good fortune for his new governorship.
郭嵩焘的胞弟郭昆焘写信给老兄，以为是他开府的吉兆。

Zuo supposedly took offense: “If lingzhi in the temple is an omen, it must refer to my ennoblement.
左宗棠得知其事，大为不悦，说“文庙产灵芝。如果是吉兆，亦当应在我封爵一事上面，

What has it to do with the Guo family?”
与郭家何干？“由此生了意见。

In fact, lingzhi appeared there often, and Zuo was not petty enough to quarrel over such a thing.
其实，湘阴文庙产灵芝，是常有之事，左宗棠亦不至于小气到连这种事都要争，

The real reason lay in military finance. Since the Taiping wars, commanders had raised their own funds: possession of territory meant possession of revenue.
真正的原因是，洪杨军兴以后，带兵大员，就地筹饷，真所谓“有土斯有财”。

Li Hongzhang understood this best and never loosened his grip on Jiangsu, especially Shanghai.
李鸿章最懂得这个道理，所以始终霸住江苏，尤其是上海这个地盘不放，

Zuo had only Zhejiang, whose resources frequently fell short.
左宗棠却只得浙江一省，每苦不足，

Seeing Guangdong’s possibilities, he hardened his heart against friendship and repeatedly attacked Guo.
看出广东是大有生发之地。所以狠狠心不顾感情友谊，一再攻讦郭嵩焘。

At last his own general, Jiang Yili, replaced him.
最后终于如愿以偿，由他的大将蒋益澧接了郭嵩焘的手。

Jiang’s tenure as Governor of Guangdong, however, was brief; he too was soon transferred.
不过蒋益澧的广东巡抚，干不多久就被调走了。


Guo remained depressed by his frustrated career.
郭嵩焘因此郁郁不得志。

At the beginning of the Guangxu reign, senior officials living in retirement were recalled, and he and Zeng Guoquan were summoned to Beijing.
光绪建元，起用在籍大员，他跟曾国荃同被征召至京，

Zeng was appointed Governor of Shaanxi, but, unwilling to serve with Zuo, was transferred to the governor-generalship of the Hedong River Conservancy.
曾国荃放了陕西巡抚，因为不愿与陕甘总督左宗棠共事，改任河东河道总督，

Guo became Judicial Commissioner of Fujian.
郭嵩焘则奉派为福建按察史。

For a former governor, this was humiliating, but he accepted it.
这在当过巡抚的人来说，是很委屈的，不过他还是接了事。

Soon afterward he was released from the post, placed on the expectant list for a vice-ministership, and appointed imperial envoy to Britain.
不久，诏命开缺，以侍郎候补，充任出使英国钦差大臣。

At that time the British minister’s interpreter, Margary, had crossed the Yunnan–Burma frontier to meet a British armed surveying party and been killed by Chinese troops and civilians.
其时云南发生英国公使翻译马嘉理，越滇缅边境接应英国武装“探路队”，为中国军民所杀，

A serious diplomatic dispute followed.
因而引起的很严重的交涉。

The British minister, Wade, said Guo could leave at once if his credentials acknowledged China’s fault; otherwise he must wait until the Yunnan case was settled.
英国公使咸妥玛表示，郭嵩焘出使英国，如果在国书上表明中国认错字样，可即赴任，否则应候云南案结后再赴英国。

The Zongli Yamen ministers refused such an admission, so Guo could not sail.
总署诸大臣都认为中国不能认错，郭嵩焘亦就不能出国，

He was made acting Vice-Minister of War and assigned to the Yamen.
奉旨署理兵部侍郎，并在总署行走。


Guo believed foreign affairs required fairness and reason, without which foreigners could not be persuaded.
郭嵩焘对办洋务，一面主张公平合理，认为非此不足以析服洋人。

In his view, Governor Cen Yuying of Yunnan could not disclaim responsibility.
他认为马嘉理被杀一案，云南巡抚岑毓英不能说没有责任，

After the killing, Cen had sought to protect those involved, failing to establish the circumstances and report them truthfully, and simply blaming remote mountain tribes.
当案发以后，意存掩护，又不查明击杀情由，据实奏报，一味倭罪于深山中的野人。

Officials at court defended him because the man killed by the troops was a foreigner, making the British feel more wronged and increasingly intransigent.
而朝中士大夫又因为官兵所杀的是洋人，群起袒护岑毓英，以至于英国更觉不平，态度亦日趋强硬。

Guo attributed the deadlock entirely to this absence of fairness and reason.
郭嵩焘以为，这件纠纷固结不解，全由不讲公平、不讲事理之故，

On entering the Yamen, he submitted a memorial under his sole name, requesting a strict disciplinary review by the ministry of Cen’s part in provoking the affair, “as a warning to those who rely on empty arrogance instead of calmly examining principles and circumstances, and thereby burden the state.”
因而奉命入总署之日，便单衔上奏，请旨“将岑毓英先后酿成事端之处，交部严加议处，以为恃虚骄之气，而不务沉心观理、考察详情，以贻累国家者戒。”

Conservative defenders of orthodoxy already resented Guo’s views.
郭嵩焘平时讲洋务，本已为守旧的“卫道君子”所不满，

To impeach a man who had killed foreigners now seemed clear proof of collusion with foreign powers.
如今居然参劾杀洋人的岑毓英，在他们看，显然是私通外国，

His action provoked general indignation.
因而引起了公愤，

Even his close friends and former pupils could not understand him; many Hunan men would no longer acknowledge him as a fellow provincial.
连他平素往来密切的朋友、门生，对他亦很不谅解，湖南则有许多人不认他是同乡。

In Beijing, someone wrote a mocking couplet: “Outstanding among his kind, surpassing all his fellows—yet unwelcome in an age of Yao and Shun.
此外京师有人做了一副对联骂他：“出乎其类，拔乎其萃，不容于尧舜之世。

Unable even to serve men, how can he serve devils?
未能事人，焉能事鬼，

Why must he leave his parents’ land?”
何必去父母之邦？

At the end of the seventh lunar month of the following year, the Chefoo Convention settled the Yunnan dispute.
“到得第二年七月底，中英订立《烟台条约》，“滇案”解决。

Guo could finally sail for Britain, but another unhappy incident occurred before his departure.
郭嵩焘可以启程赴英国了，当时称为“放洋”，而“放洋”以前又发生了一件很不愉快的事。


Liu Xihong, a Cantonese formerly serving as an assistant departmental director in the Ministry of Punishments, was an old Guangdong acquaintance with whom Guo had enjoyed discussing foreign affairs.
有个广东人叫刘锡鸿，原任刑部员外郎，此人是郭嵩焘在广东的旧识，谈起洋务来，颇为投机。

He wanted to accompany him.
此时希望跟郭嵩焘一起放洋。

Talking was one thing, however, and conducting diplomacy another.
但谈洋务是一回事，办洋务又是一回事，

Guo thought Liu too rigid and impulsive for work requiring patient, delicate effort.
郭嵩焘认为刘锡鸿脾气太刚、好意气用事，而办洋务是“水磨工夫”，颇不相宜。

Liu persisted, enlisting Guo’s friend Zhu Sunzhi to intercede.
哪知刘锡鸿不死心，托出郭嵩焘的一个好友朱孙治来关说。

Zhu said he had repeated Guo’s criticisms to Liu, who recognized his faults and promised not to meddle: Guo should simply take him as a friend with whom to talk and relieve the loneliness of a foreign country.
朱孙治向郭嵩焘说：“你批评他不宜办洋务的话，我都跟他说了，他亦很有自知之明，表示一切不问，你只当带一个可以谈谈，以解异国寂寞的朋友好了。”

Moved by Liu’s poverty and lack of prospects, Guo recommended him as a counselor.
听得这样说，郭嵩焘可怜刘锡鸿穷困不得意，便上奏保他充任参赞。

A mere sixth-rank departmental official, Liu qualified for no higher diplomatic appointment.
刘锡鸿是个司员，而且只是六品的员外郎，论资格只能当参赞。

Yet the edict released him from the Ministry of Punishments, made him an expectant fifth-rank metropolitan court official, added an honorary third-rank title, and appointed him deputy envoy to Britain.
不过上谕下来，竟是“刑部员外郎刘锡鸿着即开缺，以五品京堂候补，并加三品衔，充出使英国副使”。

Such a precedent was rare.
这种例子，殊为少见，

Behind it lay Grand Councillor Li Hongzao’s mistrust of Guo.
其中有个内幕，军机大臣李鸿藻对郭嵩焘的态度，有此怀疑，

Fearing that Guo would always take Britain’s side, he had raised Liu to deputy rank to restrain the chief envoy.
怕他出使后，处处帮英国人讲话，因而提拔刘锡鸿，以副使的身分去钳制正使。

Liu misunderstood his mission as that of an enforcer.
这刘锡鸿是个不明事理的人，以为李鸿藻派他去当“打手”，

After thanking the throne, he visited Guo and demanded to know why Guo had proposed him only as counselor, rather than deputy envoy.
所以谢恩以后，便去看郭嵩焘，责问他为何不保他当副使而当参赞？

He accused him of failing a friend and added much abusive language.
说他不够朋友，另外还有很难听的话，等于是骂了郭嵩焘一顿。


Guo was furious, but could only blame fate for continually bringing him people who repaid kindness with hostility.
郭嵩焘气得半死，总是遇到这种恩将仇报的人，只好自怨命中注定。

Liu indeed obstructed him at every turn and made disgraceful scenes.
后来刘锡鸿果然处处跟他为难，而且大吵大闹，不顾体统，

In a letter to Li Hongzhang, Guo described their service together as “ghosts howling in the rooms, foxes screeching among the rafters.”
郭嵩焘写信给李鸿章，形容共事为“鬼嗥于室，狐啸于梁”，

The unrest throughout the legation was easy to imagine.
公使馆的上下不安，可想而知。

By then Liu had become minister to Germany and could submit memorials independently.
其时刘锡鸿已调充驻德公使，可以单衔上奏，

They impeached one another, and Liu’s backing from Li Hongzao gave him the advantage.
彼此互劾，而由于刘锡鸿有李鸿藻撑腰，占了上风。

Zhang Peilun, one of the celebrated Four Hanlin Remonstrants and a follower of Li Hongzao, called for the envoy to Britain to be recalled.
李鸿藻的门下，赫赫有名的“翰林四谏”之一张佩纶，上奏“请撤回驻英使臣”。

Discouraged, Guo repeatedly asked to leave.
郭嵩焘大为泄气，一再求去，

In the seventh lunar month of Guangxu’s fifth year, Zeng Guofan’s eldest son, Zeng Jize, was appointed to replace him.
终于在光绪五年七月改派曾国藩的长子曾纪泽接替郭嵩焘，

Liu fell at the same time, however, and Li Fengbao, whom Guo admired, succeeded him in Germany.
不过刘锡鸿亦同时垮台，改派郭嵩焘所欣赏的李凤苞使德。

This was the result of Li Hongzhang’s vigorous intervention.
这是李鸿章力争的结果。


Guo had won an excellent reputation in Britain, where his departure was widely regretted.
郭嵩焘在英国博得极好的声望，所以于郭之去，多表惋惜。

His first wife had long been dead, and his second had been put aside.
郭嵩焘原配早死，继室下堂，

He had taken only a concubine surnamed Liang to Britain.
只带了个姓梁的姨太太赵英，

Her status should have barred an audience with Queen Victoria, yet an exception had been made for her.
照她的身分是不能觐见维多利亚女王的，竟亦破例特许。

However well he had been treated there, Guo knew that Li Hongzao’s party would not leave him in peace at home.
但在英国如此，回国后郭嵩焘自知李鸿藻这班人不会放过他，

Already sixty-two, he resolved to retire.
而且已六十二岁，因而决意引退，

On reaching Shanghai he pleaded illness rather than returning to Beijing to report, and requested release from office.
一到上海即称病，不回京复命，而请开缺，

His wish was eventually granted, and he settled in Changsha.
终得如愿以偿，回湖南后住在长沙。

Retirement did not mean indifference to public affairs.
身虽在野，并不消极，

He corresponded frequently with Li Hongzhang and Zeng Guoquan, discussing current policy, especially foreign affairs, in detail.
关于时政，特别是洋务方面，常跟李鸿章、曾国荃书信往米，细作讨论。

His days were fairly tranquil.
日子过得也还闲适。

In the seventh year of Guangxu, two events, one early and one late, gave him particular satisfaction.
这一年，光绪七年，郭嵩焘年初年尾有两件比较快意之事，

In the second lunar month, Liu Xihong, recalled to serve as a councillor in the Office of Transmission, denounced Li Hongzhang as overbearing, disloyal, and practically assuming imperial powers. He resented Li for having broken his diplomatic rice bowl.
一件是二月间，调回国充任通政使司参议的刘锡鸿，因为李鸿章敲掉了他的“洋饭碗”记恨在心，奏劾李鸿章跋扈不臣，俨然帝制。

Li was then at the height of favor, and Liu’s ill-judged attack merely invited humiliation.
李鸿章正在红的时候，刘锡鸿自不量力，出以此举，自然是自讨没趣，

An edict condemned his “reckless slander” and referred him for disciplinary review.
上谕斥责其“信口诬蔑，交部议处”。

The result was dismissal.
结果竟落得个革职的处分。


The other satisfaction was Zuo’s visit.
再一件就是左宗棠来拜访。

His procession was magnificent: horses before and behind, lofty boards displaying his titles, and crowds of attendants around a great green-covered chair.
排场阔极，顶马、跟马高脚牌，前听后拥一顶绿呢大轿，

Within sat the Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and Marquis Kejing, wearing a jeweled hat button, a double-eyed peacock feather, a four-slit robe, and a yellow riding jacket, with large dark crystal spectacles on his nose.
内中坐的是头戴宝石顶、双眼花翎、身穿四开褉袍黄马褂，鼻架一副大墨晶镜的东阁大学士烙靖候。

The prefect and county magistrate of Changsha had already cleared the streets near Guo’s house and stood waiting.
首府长沙知府及首县长沙县，早就在郭嵩焘家附近，清道等候。

Hunan’s two provincial commissioners, expectant intendants, and other officials also attended.
湖南省的藩、两司、候补道等等，亦来站班。

Yet Guo’s double doors remained firmly shut.
可是郭家双扉紧闭，拒而不纳，

Zuo had to alight outside and send a red-buttoned military aide with his visiting card.
左宗棠只好在大门口下轿，由戴红顶子的“材官”上门投帖。

Guo’s doorkeeper came out, made a formal obeisance, and said, “We cannot presume to receive such an honor.
“不敢当，不敢当！”郭家门上到左宗棠面前，打千说道：

Please have Your Excellency’s chair turn back.”
“请大人回驾。”

Zuo had expected this and showed no anger.
左宗棠早已料到有此一着。一点都不生气，和颜悦色地答说：

“Tell your master that I have come to see a friend of fifty years.
“你跟你家老爷去回，说我是来看五十年的故人，

Informal clothes would not show sufficient respect, so I have worn my official robes.”
便衣不恭敬，所以穿了官服来的。”

The servant went in, and no answer came.
门上一进去，久无消息。

Seeing the marquis-grand secretary left in this embarrassing position, the county magistrate forced his way inside and pleaded with Guo: unless he admitted Zuo, all the civil and military officials in the city would remain stranded outside.
首县看“爵相”下不了台，硬闯进去跟郭嵩焘打躬作揖，说是“如果不见，全城文武亦都僵在那里了。”

He begged consideration for their predicament.
请他体恤下情。

At last Guo agreed to open the main gate, though he himself waited in the hall.
总算说动了郭嵩焘，开正门迎接，不过他自己只是站在大厅上等候。

“My old friend,” Zuo said on meeting him, “I behaved disgracefully.
“老哥！”左宗棠见面便说：“宗棠无状，

I have come expressly to ask your pardon.”
特来请罪。”

He brushed back his horseshoe cuffs, gathered the skirt of his robe, and knelt.
接着，拂一拂马蹄袖，捞起四开褉袍下摆，跪了下去。

“I dare not accept this!”
“不敢，不敢！”

Guo had no choice but to kneel in return.
郭嵩煮也只好下跪答礼。

The accompanying officials helped both men up.
随从官员，将主客二人都搀扶了起来，

Zuo reproached himself for his former conduct, making no attempt to explain it by military funding or the need for territory and revenue.
左宗棠便自责当年的不是，也不解释是为了军饷，“有土斯有财”的缘故，

He merely repeated, “I deserved to die.
只连声：“是我该死，

I behaved outrageously.”
是我荒唐。”


Zuo was always talkative.
左宗棠一向健谈，

He discussed the western campaign, frontier defenses, and news from Beijing, then turned from Zeng Guofan to old times.
谈西征、谈边防、谈京里的新闻，又从曾国藩谈起往事，

Noon arrived with no sign of his leaving.
一直到中午都没有告辞的意思，

Guo could hardly dismiss him by lifting a teacup, as governors did with visitors, and had to invite him to lunch.
郭嵩焘也不便象督抚会客那样“端茶碗送客”，便只好留饭。

The county magistrate provided for the attendants, ordering a banquet from Yuloudong, Changsha’s foremost restaurant, to be served at a nearby temple of Guan Di.
随从倒是有首县办差，从长沙第一家大馆子玉楼东去叫了酒席来，在附近的关帝庙接待。

Zuo, however, must be fed from Guo’s own kitchen if hospitality were to be properly observed.
左宗棠却必须是郭嵩煮的家庖，才是待客之道。

Fortunately, senior men from the Hunan Army, apart from Hu Linyi, were undemanding about food.
好在湘军出身的达官，除了胡林翼以外，都不甚讲究饮食。

Zuo liked dog meat, which he called “earth mutton.”
左宗棠喜欢吃狗肉，称之为“地羊”，

A dish of that, some cured meats, and a plate of boned Dong’an chicken made a feast for him.
有些一味，加上腊味，再炒一盘去骨的东安鸡，在他便是盛馔了。

The meal lasted until about three in the afternoon.
一顿饭吃到未末申初，

Only then did his enthusiasm ebb enough for him to leave.
左宗棠开始兴尽告辞。

At the door he gestured, and a military aide handed him a red envelope.
临行时做个手势，材官递上一个红封套，

Offering it in both hands, he said, “A modest token to help you through the year’s end.
左宗棠双手奉上，口中说道：“不腆之仪，聊肋卒岁，

I earnestly beg you to accept it.”
务请赏收。”

Guo refused; Zuo insisted.
郭嵩焘不肯收，左宗棠非送不可。

Before so many Hunan officials, Guo considered a dispute undignified and accepted, having already decided what to do.
当着好些湖南的文武官儿，郭嵩焘觉得起了争执，有失体统，便收了下来，不过，心里已经打算好了，

Inside was a Fukang banknote for ten thousand taels.
拆开封套一看，是阜康钱庄所出的一万两银票，

He immediately wrote “Canceled” across it, put it in another envelope, and sent it to Zuo’s temporary headquarters.
当即提起笔来批上“注销”二字，拿个信封装了，送到左宗棠的行辕。

Courtesy required a return visit, but Guo dispensed with that convention too.
照道理是要回拜的，郭嵩焘也免了这套俗礼。

In the end, Zuo had still met with a rebuff.
左宗棠到头来，还是讨了个没趣。


On the second day of the twelfth lunar month, Zuo reached Xiangyin.
十二月初二到湘阴，

That evening a special messenger from the governor’s office delivered a confidential dispatch from the Grand Council.
当天晚上，就收到一道由湖南巡抚衙门派专差送来的军机处的“廷寄”。

It reported an impeachment of Li Hanzhang, Governor-General of Huguang, for employing favorites, indulging corrupt officials, maintaining defense units below their authorized strength while wasting public funds, harming the people, and amassing wealth without restraint.
廷寄中说，有人参劾湖广总督李瀚章“任用私人，纵容劣员，该省防军缺额，虚糜帑金，贻害地方，李瀚章本人默货无套，

Popular resentment was deepening.
民怨日深。”

Four charges were particularly serious.
原奏肿列了李瀚章许多劣迹，其中情节重大者四款：

First, Hubei’s likin revenue amounted to three or four million taels annually, but only forty thousand was reported to the ministry.
一，湖北全省厘金，岁收三四百万，报部则仅四万。

Second, bamboo and timber duties yielded a million a year, while only thirty thousand was reported.
二，竹木税年收百万，报部仅三万。

The governor-general’s office spent seven hundred and fifty taels a day from this source, consuming over two hundred and seventy thousand annually.
湖广总督衙门每日用银七百五十两，即在此中开支，年耗帑银二十七万余两。

Third, public steamers carried private merchandise for open sale.
三，以公家轮船，载运私货，公然贩卖。

Fourth, Li owned pawnshops in both Yangzhou and Wuhu.
四，李瀚章在扬州、芜湖均设有当铺。

Qing procedure varied according to the gravity of an impeachment against a governor or governor-general.
清朝的规制，凡是督抚被参，视情节轻重作不同的处置。

A serious case usually brought a special investigator from Beijing, at least a minister and senior in standing to the accused.
情节较重者，常由京里特派大员，至少是尚书，且须资格较被参督抚为深的，前往查办。

To prevent the destruction of evidence, the public edict named another province as his destination.
为了防备被参督抚事先湮灭证据，所以明发上谕中只说派某人往某地出差，所谓“某地”决非被参督抚所管的省份，

An assignment to Sichuan, for example, required passage through Hubei.
譬如说派到四川出差，湖北是必经之地，

On reaching Wuchang, the investigator would proclaim the actual order, and his staff would immediately seal the treasury and inspect the books, taking the accused by surprise.
一到武昌，立即传旨，随带司员马上动手，封库的封库，查帐的查帐、来他一个措手不及。

In a minor case, or one the court intended to treat lightly, a nearby official of superior rank and seniority would be appointed to investigate formally or simply ascertain the facts and report.
情节轻微，或者有意把案情看得不重，便就近派官阶资格较高音查办或查夏。

Zuo’s order read, “Establish the truth of each allegation and report the facts.”
左宗棠奉到的上谕是：“将所奏各节，确切查明，据实具奏。”

This was an inquiry for a report, not a formal disciplinary investigation.
这是查夏，不是查办，

Zuo disregarded the distinction.
可是左宗棠不理这一套。


By the time he reached Wuchang on the thirteenth, Li Hanzhang had been warned by Li Hongzhang that Zuo was coming to investigate.
十二月十三到武昌时，李瀚章已经接到李鸿章的通知，知道左宗棠要来查案，

He had prompted Yang Zonglian, an expectant circuit intendant with the honorary title of provincial treasurer, to take leave and return home.
需先示意布政使衔候补道杨宗濂告假回籍。

In the closing years of Xianfeng, Yang had organized militia in his native Jintan, Jiangsu, while holding rank as an assistant departmental director in the Ministry of Revenue.
此人在成丰末年，以户部员外郎在原籍江苏金坛办团练。

In Tongzhi’s first year, when Jiangsu gentry raised a hundred and eighty thousand taels to hire British steamers to bring the Anhui Army from Anqing to fight the Taipings at Shanghai, Yang had gone back and forth making the arrangements.
同治元年，江苏土绅凑集了十八万银子，雇用英国轮船到安庆，接淮军到上海打太平军时，杨宗濂就是往来奔走接头的人，

This gave him a close connection with Li Hongzhang.
以此渊源，与李鸿章的关系很深，

During Li’s two years fighting the Nian, Yang had managed his army administration; afterward he remained a circuit intendant in Hubei.
李鸿章镇压捻军那两年，杨宗濂替他管过营务处，以后一直在湖北当道员。

As the Li brothers successively governed the province, he passed from the service of “Second Master Li” to that of “Eldest Master Li,” managing Hankou’s New Customs.
李氏兄弟相继督鄂，李宗濂由“李二先生”的部属变为“李大先生”的部属，管理汉口“新关”。

A customs assignment was always lucrative.
“关差”一向是好差使，

Hankou was the Yangtze’s foremost commercial port, and bamboo and timber duties formed its principal customs revenue.
汉口是长江的第一个大码头，收入以竹木税为大宗。

Timber from the southwestern mountains was assembled into rafts at Chenzhou in western Hunan, floated down the Ruan River into Dongting Lake, then through Yueyang to the Yangtze for sale at Hankou.
西南深山中的木材，以湘西辰州为集散地成“木排”，由阮江入洞庭湖，经岳阳入长江，在汉口交易。

Zuo had long heard western Hunan raft merchants describe abuses at the New Customs.
宗棠早就听湘西的“排客”谈过，汉口“新关”收竹木税的种种弊端，

On reaching Wuchang, he immediately sought Yang.
所以一到武昌，就要找杨宗濂。


Acting under an imperial commission, Zuo avoided private dealings with Li Hanzhang.
由于奉旨查案，所以左宗棠跟李瀚章不作私人的交往，

From his temporary headquarters he sent the governor-general’s office a formal request that Yang be ordered to attend for questioning.
在行辕以一角公文咨湖广总督衙门，“请饬杨宗濂到案备询”，

The reply stated that Yang had already taken leave and returned home, and could not be summoned.
而夏文是“该员业已告假回籍，无从传饬”。

Zuo was furious.
这一下左宗棠大为光火，

He issued directives to the Han–Huang–De circuit intendant and the prefect of Wuchang, requiring them to have Yang proceed promptly to Jiangning for questioning.
用“札子”下给汉黄德道及武昌府，“催令杨宗濂迅赴江宁问话“。

He also memorialized: “On my previous journey home through the New Customs, Yang Zonglian avoided meeting me.
一面出奏：”臣前次回湘，路过新关，杨宗濂避而未见，

On this occasion he again obtained leave in advance and returned home.
此次又先朗告假回籍，

Whether this was deliberate evasion cannot yet be known.
是否有意规避，虽未可知，

Inquiries into his ordinary reputation, however, agree that it is undistinguished and his disposition unstable.
而查询杨宗濂素日声名平常、性情浮动，则众论相同，

No one speaks in his defense.”
无代其剖白者。

Whether there had been fraud in the bamboo and timber duties must await examination of the receipt counterfoils and original ledgers, together with Yang’s personal interrogation.
“至于经收竹木税有无弊端，”应俟查取票根底薄，传杨宗濂到到案质询，方昭核实“。

Zuo explained that, as he had to assume office in Liangjiang, Yang was being summoned to Jiangning.
接着声明：因为须赴两江接任，所以传杨宗濂到江宁备询，

Describing him as “greedy, mean, and deceitful,” he requested Yang’s immediate dismissal pending investigation.
同时以”贪鄙狄诈“的考语，请旨将杨宗濂”先行革职，听候查办“。

He Weijian, the circuit intendant, and Li Qian, an expectant prefect, were also Li Hanzhang’s clients.
此外汉黄德道何维键、候补知府李谦，都是李瀚章的私人，

Zuo spared neither.
左宗棠亦毫不客气，

Calling He “weak and incompetent,” he requested removal from his post and presentation through the ministry for an imperial audience—in other words, examination by Cixi herself.
对何维键以“庸软无能”四字考语，奏请“开缺送部引见”，意思是请慈禧太后亲自考查，

Li Qian was “adept at accommodating himself to others, unlikely to show vigor.” Zuo asked that Governor Peng Zuxian of Hubei keep him under observation.
对李谦则谓之“性善圆通、难期振作”，请旨交湖北巡抚彭祖贤“察看”。


The memorial also lectured Li Hanzhang.
奏折中还将李瀚章训了一顿，

The Li family, Zuo wrote, had enjoyed an enlightened reign and risen to great distinction.
他说：李瀚章一门，遭逢圣时，功名大显，

Many relatives and associates could support themselves, but many others lived through dependence.
亲党交游，能自立的亦颇不乏人。不过依附者亦很多，

Those who had earned wealth and rank in the brothers’ service had their own friends and relations, creating successive chains of patronage.
当时随从立功，身致富贵者，又各有其亲友，辗转依附，

In time such people abused their influence.
久而久之，恃势妄为，

Officials found them difficult to punish and tolerated them; local people endured their bullying, angry but afraid to speak.
官府处置为难，不能不作姑息，乡里受其欺凌，亦惟有敢怒而不敢言。

“The worthy will not correct them, while the timid fear their resentment.
由于“贤者不肯规之以正，懦者畏其忌嫉，

Slanders multiply and troubles arise one after another.
谣诼纷兴、事端叠起，

This can scarcely benefit the family.
洵非家门之福。

They should lead by example, refrain from contending with their fellow provincials for power and profit, and exercise restraint, lest they become a focus of resentment.
宜以身作则，毋与乡邦人士争势竟利，遇事敛抑，免为怨府。

Where Li Hongzhang and Li Hanzhang cannot say everything necessary, we who have the honor to hold provincial office should earnestly instruct these people, so they may understand that righteousness is their true advantage.
其李鸿章、李瀚章所难尽言者，臣等忝仕疆圻，亦当尽心化诲，俾知以义为利，

Preserving the family across generations is the foundation of service to the state.
如思保世承家，为报国之本，

Such conduct would benefit both the Li brothers’ relatives and friends and the family itself.”
则李氏亲友之福，亦李鸿章、李瀚章一门之福也”。

The language was far from gentle, yet Zuo believed he had largely exonerated Li and done him a great service.
话说得很不客气，但左宗棠自以为对李瀚章多所开脱，帮了他很大的忙。

After ceremonially dispatching the memorial on the nineteenth day of the twelfth month, he took a Yangtze steamer east to Jiangning to receive the seal and assume office.
十二月十九拜发奏折以后，随即坐长江轮船，鼓悼东下，到江宁拜印接任。

Thus Hu’s journey to meet him came to nothing.
因为如此，使得胡雪岩扑了个空。

Zuo’s original plan had been to visit the ancestral graves, then travel south through Guangdong to Fujian, take a specially dispatched Nanyang warship from Xiamen to Shanghai, and proceed to Jiangning.
原来左宗棠原先的计划是：回湖南原籍祭祖扫墓以后，南下由广东至福建，自厦门坐特派的南洋兵舰到上海，再转江宁接任。

Besides revisiting the ground of his old campaigns, he intended a coastal inspection in his capacity as Nanyang Minister.
这是为了一履旧日百战立功之地，同时还有“南洋大臣”巡海之意。

The imperial inquiry received at Xiangyin delayed him eleven days, forcing him to take the direct route if he was to assume office before the new year.
不想一到湘阴，有奉旨查夏李瀚章纵容劣员一案，前后耽误了十一天，不能不走捷径，在年前赶到江宁接任。


“In that case, Little Uncle, go home to Hangzhou for the new year,” Gu said.
“既在如此，小爷叔你回杭州过年吧。”古应春说：

“Afterward I shall accompany you on a special visit to Nanjing.”
“过了年，我陪小爷叔专程到南京去一趟。”

“There seems no other choice.
“也只好这样子。

But I cannot stop worrying about Seventh Sister.”
不过，七姐的病，我实在不放心。”

“She will be all right.
“不要紧的。

She has regained consciousness; with patient nursing she will gradually improve.
人是醒过来了，只要慢慢调养，逐渐会好的。

The doctor says a stroke depends above all on aftercare.
医生说：中风这种病，全靠调理。

She will have to live on with the illness.”
将来总归带病延年了。”

Hu and the Seventh Lady were as close as brother and sister.
胡雪岩跟七姑奶奶情如兄妹，

Though awake, she still could not speak.
看她人虽醒了，却还不能说话，

She recognized him, and tears streamed down her face as her lips moved, full of things she could not say.
不过人是认得的，一见双泪交流，嘴唇翕动，不知多少有苦难言，

Hu could not hold back his own tears.
胡雪岩忍不住也掉眼泪。

“Little Uncle, please do not,” Gu urged.
“小爷叔，小爷叔，千万不要如此。”古应春劝道：

“That only makes her feel worse.”
“这样子反让病人心里难过。”

Hu nodded, wiped his eyes, and forced a cheerful expression.
胡雪岩点点头，抹掉眼泪，强作欢颜，

Sitting beside the bed, he said, “Seventh Sister, there is so much business at year’s end that I must leave.
坐在病榻前向七姑奶奶说道：“七姐，年底下事情太多，我不能不走。

Take time to recover.
你慢慢调养，

I remember your horoscope said you would meet a crisis at forty-four: fierce in its onset, but not truly dangerous.
我记得你的八字上，说你四十四岁有一关，来势虽凶，凶而不险，

Once past it, you would live to seventy-eight.
过了这一关，寿至七十八。

This year the Beginning of Spring falls before the lunar year ends, so the reckoning is already the renwu year, when you turn forty-four.
今年年内春，算壬午年，你正好四十四，

You have passed the crisis.
你这一关应过了，

Next autumn Mother will be waiting for you at her birthday feast.”
明年秋天，老太太等你来吃寿酒。”

Unable to speak but understanding him, she moved her head on the pillow to acknowledge his words.
七姑奶奶口不能言，却听得懂，只在枕上摆头，表示会意。

“One more thing, Seventh Sister.
“还有句，七姐，

That foolish conduct was a single lapse.
那种荒唐事情，偶尔一回，

It will never happen again.”
以后决不会再做了。”

Anger at his behavior had brought on her illness, and this was the best comfort he could offer.
七姑奶奶致疾之由，便是由于气恼胡雪岩的荒唐，所以这句对她是最好的安慰，

She even smiled through her tears.
居然含着泪笑了。


Leaving her bedside, Hu prepared to return home.
离了病榻，打点回乡。

Gu gave him a farewell dinner that evening.
当天晚上，古应春为胡雪岩饯行，

With the Seventh Lady ill, they stayed at home, where the cook prepared a few delicate dishes.
只为七姑奶奶在病中，所以在家由厨娘备了几味精致的肴馔，

No other guests were invited; the two men drank alone.
也不邀陪客，只是两人对酌。

During dinner a clerk from the Purchasing and Transport Bureau brought a letter from Zuo, written at Xiangyin.
在餐桌上，采运局的司事送来了一封信，是左宗棠自湘阴所发，

It explained that the imperial order to investigate at Wuchang had canceled his original itinerary.
告诉胡雪岩因为奉旨赴武昌办案，原来的行程取消，

When that business was finished, he would go straight to Jiangning, and wished to meet Hu there after the Lantern Festival.
武昌事毕，径赴江宁，约胡雪岩灯节以后，在江宁相会。

He also requested a discreet inquiry: “The treasury, customs, likin and other bureaus in Jiangsu, together with the salt-sales supervision bureaus in Hubei, Hunan, Anhui and the province abbreviated as Xi, all make earmarked monthly military remittances.
此外又托胡雪岩查一件事，说是“江苏司关厘局，及鄂湘皖西的督销局，每月均有专拨之饷。

What are the exact amounts?
其细数如何，

Pray inquire confidentially and let me know.”
乞为密访见示。”

Hu considered the letter for some time.
胡雪岩看完信，沉吟了好一会说：

“I believe His Excellency means to move against Li of Hefei.”
“我看，左大人对李合肥要动手了。”

“You see a sign of it, Little Uncle?
“喔，小爷叔看出苗头来了？”古应春问道：

How will he act?”
“怎么样动手法？”

“It is too early to say, and action will depend on opportunity.
“这还言之过早。而且动手也要看机会，

But he already has the intention.”
不过左大人现在已经有这个意思了。”


Several units of Li’s Anhui Army were stationed in Jiangsu.
原来李鸿章的准军有好些部队，驻扎在江苏，

Like the Hunan Army, it consisted of men recruited through personal and local ties.
湘淮军都是子弟兵，

A commander was appointed first and then raised his men; the resulting camps took his name.
行命将，后招募，募兵成营，即以统率将官之名命名。

Wu Changqing’s forces were the Qing camps, one of which was stationed in Jiangsu.
吴长庆所部名“庆字营”，有一营在江苏，

Although “Sixth Pockmarked Liu,” Liu Mingchuan, had already carried home his official fortune and built the Daqian Mountain Retreat at Hefei, where he drank, wrote poetry, and thoroughly enjoyed playing the scholarly general, the Ming camps retained their designation.
“刘六麻子”刘铭传虽已挟其宦囊，在合肥原籍构筑“大潜山房”，饮酒赋诗，大过儒将的瘾，但“铭字营”的番号依旧，

Li had divided them.
不过由李鸿章拿他们一分为二，

One part, under Liu Shengxiu, a registered candidate for provincial military command, guarded important canal points around Zhangqiu in Shandong.
一部分由记名提督刘盛休统带，驻山东张秋一带，防守运河要口，

Another, under Tang Dingkui, the provincial military commander of Fujian, was stationed in two counties named in the text as Jiangsu and Jingjiang.
一部分交福建提督唐定奎率领，驻防江苏、靖江两县，

A mounted vanguard camp of the Ming forces stood at Suqian in Jiangsu, chiefly to rush to the aid of places along the canal at the first alarm.
另有铭字先锋马队之营，驻扎江苏宿迁，主要的任务，亦是防运河沿岸一带有警，可以迅速赴援。

The Anhui Army also included a former Hunan Army commander, Guo Songlin.
李鸿章的淮军中。亦有原为湘军的将领，此人名叫郭松林，

His old forces were known as the Wuyi Army.
他的旧部名为“武毅军”，

Ten camps formed river-defense units in Jiangyin and Jingjiang, while five served coastal defense in Shanghai and Baoshan.
有十营为江防军，亦驻江阴、靖江境内，有五营为海防军，驻扎上海、宝山两县境内。

Jiangsu paid all these troops.
这些部队，都由江苏发饷。

The expression “treasury, customs, likin and bureaus” meant the provincial treasury, customs offices, likin administration, contribution and tax bureaus, and the Huai Salt Sales Supervision Bureau.
所谓“司关厘局”，司指藩局，关指海关，厘指厘金，局指捐局、税局以及淮盐督销局。

Salt from Lianghuai was an important source of revenue for Liangjiang.
两淮出盐，盐课收入为两江一大财源。

Anhui and Jiangsu could not consume the entire output, so designated sales areas, known as salt-certificate districts, extended into Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, and Anhui.
但上江安徽、下江江苏两省的人吃不完两淮的盐，所以淮盐有指定的销售地区，称为“引局”，分布在鄂、湘、西、皖四个省份，

Here Xi meant Jiangxi, not Shanxi.
西非山西而是江西。

Each of the four provinces had a Huai Salt Sales Supervision Bureau, whose revenue also belonged to Liangjiang.
这四省都有淮盐督销局，收入亦归两江。


“There is no need to investigate in Hangzhou or set the Purchasing and Transport Bureau to work,” Hu said.
“也不回杭州查，也不叫采运局去办，

“I have a much easier way. Let Old Mi write to the various places and ask.
我有个极方便的法子叫老宓写信到各处问一问，

That should tell us nearly everything.”
就差不多了。”

Old Mi was Mi Benchang of Ningbo, manager of the Shanghai establishment of Fufeng Xueji Bank.
胡雪岩口中的“老宓”，名叫宓本常，宁波人，他是阜丰雪记沪庄的档手。

Shanghai was Fufeng’s headquarters.
沪庄是阜丰总号，

If he wrote to its affiliated banks in the various places, asking how much the treasury, customs, and other offices had remitted in recent months to the Anhui Army’s Rear Commissariat, the approximate monthly burden could readily be calculated.
由他分函各地阜丰联号一查“司关厘局”近几个月汇款到淮军后路粮台的数目，每个月的负担，大致就可以算出来了，

It was indeed convenient.
确是个很方便的办法。

“But if His Excellency intends to attack Li, the inquiry must be secret,” Gu said.
“不过，”古应春说：“既然左大人是要攻李合肥，这件事就是隐秘，

“Might word of it get out?”
这样子做法，会不会有风声传出去？”

“What word?
“ 有啥风声传出去？”胡雪岩说：

Suppose you managed Fufeng at Nanchang.
“譬如，你是南昌阜丰的档手，

If I asked how much the Jiangxi Huai Salt Sales Supervision Bureau sent each month to the Rear Commissariat at Jiangning, why would you imagine that Zuo wanted the figures for a particular purpose?”
我问你江西淮盐督销局每个月汇到江宁淮军后路粮台的款子有多少？你怎么会想到这是左大人要查了有作用的？”

“Quite right.
“不错，不错。

I worry only because I know what lies behind it.
我是知道了有这么件事，才会顾虑，

Otherwise I should never dream of it.
不知道，我做梦也想不到的。

But if all the money goes to Jiangning, why take so much trouble?
不过，小爷叔，既然各处都是汇到江宁，那又何必费事，

Have the Fufeng bank there look it up.
只要江宁阜丰查一查，

Would that not give us the total account?”
总帐不就出来了？”

“Ah!”
“啊！啊！”

Hu slapped his forehead.
胡雪岩在自己额头上拍了一下，

“My brain is failing me.
“脑筋不灵了！

Taking off my trousers to fart—quite unnecessary!”
‘脱裤子放屁’，真是多余的。

Before boarding the boat next morning, he had set the matter in motion with just two letters.
“于是第二天在上船之前，胡雪岩就办好了这件事，只不过写两封信，

One informed Zuo that there seemed to be no simpler way of remitting the Jiangsu offices’ military contributions than through Fufeng.
一封是写给左宗棠，说江苏各处解交淮军后路粮台的款项，似乎除了委托阜丰以外，另无更简易的通汇之法，

Hu had therefore asked its Jiangning manager to prepare a statement and send it directly to Zuo’s headquarters; any omissions could be investigated and reported afterward.
所以已函江宁阜丰开单径呈辕门，如有缺漏，另再设法查报。

He also confirmed that he would come after the Lantern Festival.
此外叙明，准明年灯节以后，到江宁叩遏。

The second letter instructed the Jiangning manager to carry this out.
一封是写给江宁阜丰的档手，照办其事。


“When will you come back after the new year, Little Uncle?” Gu asked.
“小爷叔，”古应春问：“开年什么时候来？”

“Around the time the lanterns go up.”
“总在上灯前后。”

“Good.
“好！

I shall go to Nanjing with you then.”
到时候我陪小爷叔一起到南京。”

“Nothing would please me better, but it depends on Seventh Sister’s condition.”
“我当然巴不得你陪了我去，不过，也要看七姐的情形。”

“She is sure to be well enough by then.
“那时候一定不要紧了。”古应春又说：

And when you go home, do not mention A’qi’s illness.
“阿七得病，小爷叔回去了不必提。

With the new year coming, why make your mother worry?”
过年了，何必让老太太记挂。”

Hu was silent for some time.
胡雪岩不答，沉吟了好一会，

At last he sighed.
叹口气说：

“I truly never imagined Seventh Sister would care so deeply about what happened to me.”
“我实在没有想到，七姐为了我，会这样子在意。”

Gu hesitated, then decided to speak.
古应春欲言又止，考虑了一会，终于说了出来，

“Since you have seen it, Little Uncle, I may as well say so.
“小爷叔，既然你看出来了，我索性就说吧！

A’qi has been worrying about you for a long time.
阿七为小爷叔担心，也不是一天两天的事了。

She often says a tall tree catches the wind.
她常说：树大招风。

You must have made many enemies without intending to.
小爷叔无心结下的怨家，大概不少。

That is the lesser concern.
这倒还在其次，

In recent years, the people you employ have been much poorer than before: some lack ability, others character.
这几年小爷叔用的人，大不如前，有的本事有限，有的品性不好。

She cannot understand why your judgment has grown less sharp.
她说，她还真不知道小爷叔的眼光，为啥不大灵了？

Is your business too extensive and complicated?
是事情太多太杂，

Have you less energy to oversee it?
还是精神不济，照顾不到，

Or is there some other reason?”
或者是别有缘故？”

Hu flushed.
胡雪岩脸一红，

He knew “some other reason” was Gu’s discreet way of putting it.
心知道“别有缘故”四字，是古应春说得含蓄，

In the end, the trouble came back to the dogskin plasters.
这“缘故”，说来说去总由于狗皮膏药在作怪。

“I know Seventh Sister means well.
“七姐为我好，我晓得。

But she does worry rather more than she need.
不过，她实在也担心得稍微过头了。”胡雪岩又说：

When she is a little better, tell her I shall think very carefully about every fault she has pointed out and make a thorough effort to correct it.”
“等七姐稍微好一点，你同她说：她说我的毛病，我要仔仔细细想一想，结结实实拿它改掉。”

“That will put A’qi’s mind much more at ease,” Gu replied with pleasure.
“小爷叔这么说，阿七心里一定宽得多。”古应春欣然答说。



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第五章（一）
Towers of Light — Chapter Five, Part One
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER FIVE: MADAM LUOSI｜第五章 “螺蛳太太”


Hu Xueyan did not enter the New Year in quite the spirits of former years.
胡雪岩这年过年的心境，不如往年，

The Seventh Lady’s stroke had left him with a sense of guilt he could not shake off.
自然是由于七姑奶奶中风，使他有一种难以自解的歉疚之故。

Nothing of this showed on the surface, however.
不过，在表面上是看不出来的，

The Hu household celebrated with its customary splendor and bustle, and no one was busier than Madam Luosi.
胡家的年景，依旧花团锦簇，繁华热闹，其中最忙的要数“螺蛳太太”。

The name was of long standing.
这个称呼，由来已久，

Her surname was Luo, and she was the fourth in her family.
她本姓罗，行四，

Before her marriage she had been an exceptionally capable young woman of modest background.
未嫁以前，是个极能干的小家碧玉，

Everyone who knew her, old or young, called her Luo Sijie—Sister Four Luo—as a mark of respect.
认识她的人，不管老少，都叫她“罗四姐”，算是个尊称。

She had recognized Hu’s promise while he was still down on his luck and had helped him through his difficulties.
这罗四组慧眼识英雄，在胡雪岩潦倒的时候，接济过他。

Unfortunately, he already had a wife.
可惜胡雪岩已经娶了妻子，

Though they were fond of each other, they could not marry.
彼此虽都有爱慕之意，却无从结合。

Before long the Taiping uprising sent them fleeing in different directions.
不久，太平军起事，他们纷纷逃去，

They lost all news of each other and did not meet again for nine years.
音信不通，一别九年，方始重逢。

Hu remembered their reunion clearly.
胡雪岩记得很清楚，

It was the sixth year of Tongzhi.
那年是同治六年，

He had already been appointed to direct the Purchasing and Transport Bureau for the western campaign and spent most of his time in Shanghai.
他已经奉委主持西征采运局，长驻上海。

Shortly after Qingming, his old associate Fat Zhang died.
清明之后不久，胡雪岩的旧侣张胖子去世，

Buddhist services were held at Jing’an Temple, and Hu went with Gu Yingchun and the Seventh Lady to pay his respects.
在静安寺作佛事，他跟古应春夫妇去祭吊时，

There he saw a young married woman, lightly made up, offering incense.
看见有个在烧香的淡妆少妇，

Her face was extraordinarily familiar, yet he could not remember where he had seen her.
异常面善，却怎么样也想不起来是在哪里见过。

When she had finished, she left with a maid of thirteen or fourteen.
那少妇烧完香，带着个十三四岁的小大姐走了。

Unwilling to let the matter rest, Hu quietly followed, wondering all the way who she could be.
胡雪岩不死心，悄悄跟在后面，一路走，一路想，到底是什么人？


Jing’an was Shanghai’s foremost ancient Buddhist temple, founded in the tenth year of Chiwu under the Wu emperor.
静安寺是上海第一古刹，建于吴大帝赤乌十年，

Its grounds were extensive.
地方很大，

Once celebrated for its Eight Views, it now retained only one, the Gushing Spring, also called the Boiling Well.
原有“静安八景”之称，但那时已只剩下“涌泉”一景，涌泉又称沸井，

The water churned throughout the year as though boiling, and Shanghai people called it an opening into the sea.
井中之水终年翻翻滚滚，有如水沸，上海人说它是个海眼。

A first-time visitor could hardly fail to go and look.
初礼静安寺的人，少不得都要去望一望。

The woman was no exception.
那少妇亦不例外，

Hu followed closely, then stopped nearby, pretending to be a traveler examining the well while he watched what she did.
胡雪岩亦步亦趋地跟了过去，装作来看沸井的旅客，驻足不行，以观动静。

“A’hua, be careful!
“阿华，当心，当心，

If you fall in, you’ll lose your life!”
跌到井里，把你小命送掉！”

The maid had gone too close to the edge and was leaning forward to peer down.
原来那小大姐探头下望沸井，走得很近，身子又往前倾，

The danger made her mistress call out loudly.
这个动作很危险，所以那少妇大声警告，

Her Hangzhou accent unlocked Hu’s memory.
一口杭州话帮胡雪岩敲开了记忆之门，

Could this be Luo Sijie? He was astonished and delighted.
又惊又喜地在想：这不是罗四姐？

At first he thought of calling her name to make sure before approaching.
本想冒叫一声，证实了再上前招呼。

But there were many visitors about.
但游客甚多，

Shanghai might be comparatively liberal, yet it had not reached the Western custom of allowing men and women to greet each other openly in a crowd.
而上海的风气虽然比较开通，也还不到西洋人男女可以在稠人广众间公然招呼的程度，

After a moment’s thought, he turned to his page Guisheng and told him to fetch one of the Seventh Lady’s maids as quickly as possible.
因而考虑了一下，回头关照书僮桂生，赶快将七姑奶奶所带来的小大姐叫一个来，越快越好。

Guisheng ran off.
桂生飞奔而去，

Without first consulting the Seventh Lady, he found Caifeng, the more friendly toward him of the two maids she had brought.
他亦不必先告诉七姑奶奶，在七姑奶奶带来的两个小大姐中，找到跟他比较好的彩凤，说一声：

“Come with me.
“跟我来，

Something important.
有要紧事，

Quick!”
快，快！”

Thinking he had got himself into trouble, she hurried after him.
彩凤只当他闯了什么祸，急急忙忙跟在他身后，

Only when Hu came into sight did Guisheng stop.
桂生等看到胡雪岩的影子，方始停住脚。


“It’s our master who wants you.”
“是我们老爷要叫你。”

Hu pointed the woman out discreetly. “Caifeng, go and ask whether she is Sister Luo from Hangzhou.
“彩凤，”胡雪岩悄悄指点：“你上去问她，是不是杭州的罗四姐？

If she says yes, tell her that your mistress is a relative of Mr Hu’s and would like her to come over and meet her.”
如果她说是，你就说我们奶奶是胡老爷的亲戚，请她跟你们奶奶去见一见。”

Caifeng was quick-witted.
彩凤很伶俐，

She considered this and asked, “What if she refuses?”
想了一下问：“如果她不肯去呢？”

“Just turn and look at me.
“你就回过头来看我，

Then she will certainly agree.”
她就一定肯去了。”

Events followed his prediction.
果然，一如胡雪岩的估计，

When Caifeng approached the woman, there seemed at first to be some difficulty in making herself understood.
只见彩凤上前搭话时，仿佛有难以沟通的情状，

Then she looked back at Hu.
然后是彩凤先回头来看胡雪岩，

The woman followed her gaze, searching until she found him in the distance, and appeared deeply shaken.
接着是那少妇随着她的视线所示来搜索，遥遥望去，显得相当震动似地。

Hu knew that his plan had worked.
胡雪岩知道成功了，

He immediately turned and hurried to a monastic room set aside for the women guests.
赶紧转身直奔作为堂客休憩之地的一座禅房，

Finding the Seventh Lady’s other maid, he asked her to bring her mistress out for a word.
找到七姑奶奶的另一个小大姐，关照请她的主母出来叙话。

“Seventh Sister, do you remember the Sister Luo I told you about?”
“七姐，我同你谈过的罗四姐，你还记得记不得？”

After a moment she nodded.
七姑奶奶想了一下，点点头说：

“I do.”
“记得。”

“She is here today.
“她今天在这里，

I have had Caifeng issue a false imperial decree in your name: she has told her we are relatives and you want to meet her.
我叫彩凤‘假传圣旨’，说你同我是亲戚，请她来见面。

She’ll be here any moment.
马上就要来了。

Invite her home, Seventh Sister, and ask her carefully about her circumstances.
七姐，你请她到你那里去，仔仔细细问问她，

She seems to be living as a widow.”
她好象居孀在那里。”

“Of course, of course!
“好，好！”七姑奶奶连连答应，又问，

And what about you, Little Uncle?”
“小爷叔，你呢？”

“I must go to the bank.
“我到钱庄里、

As soon as I have dealt with something important, I’ll come straight over.”
有桩要紧事情料理好了，马上来。”


Hu had been gone some time before Caifeng appeared with an attractive young woman in plain mourning clothes.
等胡雪岩走了好一会，才看到彩凤领着莲步姗姗一个俏括括的素服少妇，

Resting a hand on her maid’s shoulder, she advanced slowly with delicate steps.
扶着小大姐的肩头，冉冉而来。

The impatient Seventh Lady strode forward on her unbound feet to meet her.
七姑奶奶性子急，撇开一双大脚，迎了上去。

“Are you Sister Luo?”
“是不是罗四姐？”

“You are too kind.
“不敢当。

My name is Luo.
我姓罗，

May I ask yours?”
尊姓？”

“My husband’s name is Gu, my maiden name You, and I am the seventh in my family.
“我夫家姓古，娘家姓尤，行七，

Our Little Uncle calls me Seventh Sister.
我们小爷叔叫我‘七姐’。

Please call me that too.”
罗四姐你也这样叫我好了。”

Frank as ever, she poured everything out at once.
七姑奶奶是直性子，一古脑儿都说了出来。

To Luo, it did not quite make sense.
在罗四姐听，却有些牛头不对马嘴，

Why should someone she called Little Uncle call her Seventh Sister?
既是“小爷叔”，何以又叫她“七姐”？

That puzzle could wait.
但这个疑团，还在其次，

One more pressing question had to be settled first.
眼前有句最要紧的话先要问清楚，才谈得到其他。

“May I ask, Mrs Gu, who is this Little Uncle of yours?”
“请问，古太太你的‘小爷叔’是哪个？”

“Who else but your old acquaintance Hu Xueyan, owner of the famous Fukang Bank?”
“还有哪个？不就是你老早认识的胡雪岩，鼎鼎大名阜康钱庄的老板。”

Luo was both surprised and delighted.
罗四姐又惊又喜。

She had heard that Fukang’s proprietor was the Hu Xueyan who had once worked for Fat Zhang.
她也曾听说过，阜康钱庄的老板，就是从前在张胖子那里做伙计的胡雪岩，

She had long wanted to inquire but had found no opportunity.
一直想打听，苦无机会。

So it really was true.
不想真的有这回事。

“You can tell from my calling him Little Uncle that we are close, Sister Luo.
“罗四姐，”七姑奶奶说，“你听我叫他小爷叔，就晓得我们是自己人。

You must come and sit with me at home.
你一定要请到我那里去坐一歇。

He has told me how kind you were to him in the old days.
你当年待我们小爷叔的好处，他也跟我说过。

He will be coming over shortly.”
等下他也要来的。

Hu had not forgotten her kindness after all!
“罗四姐心想：胡雪岩倒真是有良心的！

The thought set Luo’s heart in a turmoil.
就这一转念间，心里顿时七上八下在翻动了。

“Will you do me the honor, Sister Luo?” the Seventh Lady urged.
“罗四姐，”七姑奶奶催问着：“你肯不肯赏面子。”

“Oh, Mrs Gu, you are far too courteous.
“唷，古太太，你的话太客气了。

I really don’t deserve it.”
真正不敢当。”


After taking leave of the bereaved family, the Seventh Lady brought Luo and her maid home.
于是七姑奶奶向丧家致意告辞，将罗四姐主婢二人带回家。

The style of the household, together with her hostess’s warmth and generosity, convinced Luo that she wanted to cultivate this friendship.
一看她家的气派，七姑奶奶又热心伉爽，罗四姐决心要结交，

She adopted the more intimate form of address and began to speak freely of her life.
因而改了称呼，同时深谈身世。

She had fled the fighting with her parents, traveling a thousand li in their wanderings, and both had died on the road.
原来罗四姐当年随父母逃避战乱，转徒千里，流离途中，父母双亡，

Remaining entirely alone was no solution; she had to choose someone to marry.
不然一身，不是了局，只有择人而事，

They had been traveling in a party of three families.
结伴同行，一共有三家，

Two of the other families had unmarried sons in their twenties, both continually looking for opportunities to show her attentions.
其中两家都有个尚未婚娶的二十来岁的儿子，当然亦都时时在找机会向她献殷勤。

One family was rich and the other poor.
这两家一富一穷，

Luo chose the poor family’s son, an only child named Cheng.
而罗四姐挑了穷的那家，姓程，是独子。

“Seventh Sister, I chose him because, poor as he was, he wanted to make something of himself.
“七姐，我是因为他虽穷，肯上进，

So long as he had that ambition, I was confident I could help him rise.
只要他肯上进，我就有把握帮他出头。

Besides, he had only an old mother.
再说，上头只有一个老娘，

The other man had both parents, three brothers, and two sisters.
不比另外一家，父母双全，还有三个兄弟，两个妹妹，

Marrying into that household would have been like performing a play with a stone mortar on my head—all effort and no thanks.”
嫁过去做媳妇，一定象顶石臼做戏，吃力不讨好。”

“I would have chosen as you did, Sister Luo.”
“罗四姐，换了我，也会象你一样，宁愿挑这一位。”

The Seventh Lady had already noticed the chrysanthemum made from white hair cord at her temple, but deliberately asked, “And where is Brother-in-Law Cheng?
七姑奶奶早就发现她鬓边戴一朵白头绳结的菊花，却故意问说：“我们程姐夫呢？

When will you bring him to meet us?”
几时请过来见一见。”

“He is gone,” Luo answered sadly.
“不在了。”罗四姐凄然说道：

“He died at this time the year before last.”
“是前年这个时候去世的。”

“Poor thing.
“可怜，

Poor thing.”
可怜！”

The Seventh Lady clasped her hand, offering the comfort for which there were no words.
七姑奶奶紧握着她的手，但有无言的慰藉。


“In a way, it was my fault,” Luo said.
“说起来也怪我不好。”罗叫姐说：

“He had learned the woodblock cutter’s trade.
“他学的是刻字匠手艺。

Once he told me that, two years before the Longhairs reached Hangzhou, he and his master went into the examination compound to cut the blocks for the provincial examination papers.
有一回他跟我谈起，说是长毛打到杭州的前两年，乡试考举人，他跟他师父一起到考场里去刻题目纸，

He worked through the night until dawn, thinking: ‘I have studied too.
熬夜熬到天亮，心里在想：我也读过书，

If I must stay up all night, why shouldn’t I be sitting the examination for a juren degree, instead of working here as a lowly block cutter?
一样是熬夜，为啥不是去考举人，坐在这里当个低三下四的刻字匠，

If a candidate writes a wrong character, at worst there is a notice on blue paper.
人家举子写借了字，顶多贴出‘蓝榜’，

If I cut one wrong character, they beat my palms.
我刻错一个字要打手心，

I get a thrashing!’ So I told him, ‘If you really mean it, take down your shop sign and devote yourself to your books.
‘吃生活’？我就说：“你果然有心，把招牌收起来，好好儿读书。

Leave all seven daily household necessities to me.
开门七件事都是我管，

You needn’t worry about them.’
用不着你费心。

He took me at my word and studied with his head down, burning his lamp in the third watch and rising with the cock in the fifth…”
‘他真的就听我的话，三更打灯五更鸡，闷倒头读书……”

“Sister Luo,” the Seventh Lady interrupted, “how did you provide those household necessities?”
“罗四姐”，七姑奶奶打断她的话问：“你这开门七件事，怎么管法？”

“I embroidered.
“我绣花，

And not only that: I collected work for embroidery shops.
不光是绣花，还替绣庄去收件，

Later I became a small contractor, taking on a whole batch and distributing it among other women.
到后来做‘小包’，一批绣货包下来，再分给人家去做，

We lived very comfortably.
日子过得很舒服。

Shanghai is a prosperous place, Seventh Sister.
七姐，上海滩繁华地方，

There is silver lying everywhere, if only you are willing to take the trouble to pick it up.
遍地银子，只要你肯花工夫去捡。

To tell you the truth, I don’t believe anyone need starve.
不瞒你说，我就不相信，世界上有饿死的人。

People do starve, of course, but because there is no rice to be bought, even with money—not because they have no cash to buy it.
饿死的人是有，那是因为有钱买不到米，不是没有铜钱买米。

That is a different matter.
这不一样的。

Wouldn’t you say so?”
七姐，你说是不是？

“Certainly!”
““怎么不是？”

The Seventh Lady smiled.
七姑奶奶笑道：

“You sound very much like Little Uncle.
“你的说法，倒跟小爷叔很象。”她紧接着又问：

What happened then?”
“后来呢？”


“After Hangzhou was recovered, he told me he would have to go back there to take the examination for a xiucai degree, and later the provincial examination as well.
“后来杭州光复了。他同我说，考秀才要到杭州去考，将来举人也是杭州考，

If we moved, all I had built up here would be lost.
家一搬到杭州，你的这点基础，就要抛掉了。

It would be better to purchase Imperial Academy student status and go straight to Beijing next time to sit for the juren degree.
不如捐个监生，下回直接进京去考举人，

If he passed in the autumn, he could take the jinshi examination the following spring.
头一年秋天考中了，第二年春天再考进士。

Even if he won his juren in Zhejiang, he would still have to go to Beijing for the jinshi.
如果在浙江考中了举人，考进土还是要进京。

Doing in two stages what could be done in one would be less economical.
一番手续两番做，反而不划算。

I thought he was right and scraped together two hundred taels to purchase the qualification for him.
我想想不错，凑了二百两银子，替他捐了个监生，

Then he studied harder than ever.
他就更加用功了。

Ah…” She sighed and could not continue.
唉！”罗四姐叹口气，说不下去了。

“Did the studying damage his health?” asked the Seventh Lady, who understood the ways of the world.
“用功用出毛病来了？”练达人情的七姑奶奶问说。

“First he began coughing blood,” Luo said, quietly but calmly.
“先是吐血。”罗四奶用低幽但很平静的声音说。

“He hid it from me.
“他还瞒着我，

He coughed into his handkerchief and washed it himself.
吐血吐到手帕里，手帕自己去洗。

His face grew paler and paler, yet in the afternoons his cheekbones looked as though he had put rouge on them.
脸色越来越白，到了下半天，颧骨上倒象搽了胭脂，

I was foolish and thought nothing of it.
我懵懵懂懂，还不当它一回事。

One day he came home from an engagement.
有一天他有应酬回来，

I helped him take off his robe and happened to put my hand into a pocket.
我替他脱袍子，随手在口袋里一摸，

There was a bloodstained handkerchief.
摸出一条上有血迹的手帕，

Only then did I realize he had consumption.”
才晓得他是痨病。”

“Consumption?”
“痨病？”

The Seventh Lady looked alarmed.
七姑奶奶神色紧张，

“Did he still go to the examinations?”
“后来呢，照样还是赶考去了？”

“No.
“没有。

How could he, in that condition?”
他这样子怎么能赶考？”

“What happened afterward?”
“以后呢？”

Afterward, naturally, he tried to recover.
以后自然是养病。

People called consumption the craving sickness: the sufferer longed for one thing after another.
痨病俗称“馋痨病”，想吃这个，想吃那个，

Luo always procured whatever he wanted, but once it arrived, he took only a taste.
罗四姐总依着他的性子去办，办来了，却又浅尝即止，

What remained was not merely uneaten food, but his guilt.
剩下来的不仅是食物，还有他的歉疚。

“I had heard that with a good appetite, consumption was not too serious.
“我听人说，痨病只要胃口好，还不要紧，

But he had terrible cravings and no appetite at all.
象他那样子，馋是馋得要命，胃口一点都没有。

He grew thinner every day.
人一天比一天瘦，

In only three months…
不过三个月的工夫。

Ah!” She sighed again.
唉！”罗四姐又是一声长叹。


There was no need to ask more about her husband.
七姑奶奶不必再谈她的丈夫，

The Seventh Lady felt it was Luo herself who now needed concern.
觉得要关心的是罗四姐，

“Where are you living?”
“你现在住在哪里？”她问。

“In the southern city, behind the Catholic church.”
“南市。天主教堂后面。”

“Life must be very difficult?”
“日子过得很艰难吧？”

“I manage,” Luo answered without emphasis.
“也还好。”罗四姐淡淡地答说。

“Any children?”
“有没有伢儿？”

“No.”
“没有。”

Her answer was brisk, though inwardly she could not help feeling apologetic.
罗四姐口中干脆，内心不免抱歉。

“With no children, and still a long way from being old…”
“既无儿女，年纪也离‘老’字还早……”

The Seventh Lady stopped short.
七姑奶奶突然咽住。

This was their first meeting, after all; she could hardly go so far.
毕竟还是第一次见面，哪里能谈得那么深。

As the conversation faltered, Luo rose. “Seventh Sister, I must leave.
看看没有话了，罗四姐便即告辞：“七姐，我要走了。”一面说，一面站了起来，

I’ll come to see you again tomorrow.”
“明天我再来看你。”

“No, no!”
“不，不！”

Her hostess stopped her at once.
七姑奶奶急忙拦阻，

“Why wait until tomorrow?
“何必等到明天？

We have taken to each other like old friends.
我们一见如故，

Don’t stand on ceremony.
你不要见外，

Stay for dinner, and I’ll send you home in the carriage.”
在我这里吃了饭，我再拿马车送你回去。”

Luo had only been saying something to fill the silence; she had no real wish to leave.
罗四姐原是没话找话，并没有想走的意思，

With so warm an invitation, she was happy to comply.
见她留客之意甚殷，落得将顺。

“You are quite right, Seventh Sister.”
“七姐的话，一点不错。”

She sat down again.
她复又坐了下来，

“I feel we have known each other forever.
“我也觉得我们一见如故，

Perhaps we were connected in a former life.”
大概是前世的缘分。”

“If you speak of a bond from a former life, I’m still less willing to let you go.”
“罗四姐，你说到‘前世的缘分’，我就更不肯放你回去了。”

The Seventh Lady’s heart warmed further.
七姑奶奶的心又热了，

“You cannot go on like this.
“你这个样子不是个了局。

Remaining a widow looks easy, but it is very hard.
守寡这回事，看起来容易，其买很难，

My advice is…”
我劝你……”

She did not finish, but there was no need to explain what she meant.
她的话没有说完，但要劝的是什么，却无需明言，就会知道。

Luo answered frankly, “I have no ambition to have a chastity arch raised in my honor.
于是，罗四姐很坦率地答说：“我也不想造‘节孝坊’，

But this time I must choose very carefully.”
不过，这回是要好好挑一挑了。”


While they were talking, Hu arrived.
正在谈着，胡雪岩来了，

“It really is Sister Luo!”
“果然是罗四姐！”

He gazed at her, overwhelmed by conflicting feelings.
他怔怔地望着她，心中百感交集，

Countless things he wished to say crowded his throat, and he could not decide where to begin.
有无数的话要说，但都堵在喉头，竟不知说哪一句好。

Luo seemed the more composed of the two.
相形之下，罗四姐反显得比较沉着，

Rising, she said, “I used to call you by your name.
站起来说道：“从前我叫你的名字，

Now I don’t know what to call you.”
现在不晓得叫你啥好？”

“Go on calling me Xueyan.”
“你仍旧叫我雪岩好了。”

“That would hardly be proper.
“这不象样。

You are a great proprietor now.
你现在是大老板，

To keep calling you by your name would show no sense of what is fitting.”
哪里好直来直去叫名字，也忒嫌没分寸。”

The Seventh Lady intervened.
“这样好了，”七姑奶奶插嘴说道：

“Everyone calls him Mr Hu, or simply Sir.
“大家都叫他胡大先生，或者大先生，

You may do the same, Sister Luo.”
罗四姐，你也这样叫好了。”

“Very well.
“好的，好的。

That is a respectful form.
这是禀称。

Sir, it must be nine years since we last met?”
大先生，我们没有见面有九年了吧？”

Hu calculated silently.
胡雪岩默默算了一下，

“Nine years!
“九年！”

Yet it feels like another lifetime.
他说，“虽说九年，同隔世一样。

After Hangzhou was recovered, Governor-General Zuo put me in charge of relief and restoration.
杭州光复之后，左大人叫我办善后，

I had people inquire for you everywhere, without the slightest news.
我叫人到处访你，音信毫无，

Where were you then?”
那时候你在哪里？”

“Already in Shanghai.”
“我已经在上海了。”

“How did you come to Shanghai?”
“喔，怎么会到了上海了呢？”

“That is a long story.”
“这话说起来就长了。”

The Seventh Lady thought the account would take some time.
七姑奶奶心想，罗四姐这一谈身世遭遇，要费好些辰光，

Having heard it already, she need not sit there idly.
她是已听说过了，不必在此白耗工夫，

She stood up.
便即起身说道：

“Sister Luo, Little Uncle, you are both staying for dinner.
“罗四姐，小爷叔，你们都在这里便饭，

I’ll see to it.
我去料理一下，

Take your time talking.”
你们慢慢谈。”

All she needed to do was give a few instructions: order dishes from a restaurant and send word to Gu that there was a guest, Hu was there too, and he should cancel any dinner engagement if he could and come home to help entertain them.
所谓料理，只是交代几句话的事，一是到馆子里叫菜，二是通知古应春，家中有客，胡雪岩也在，晚上有饭局最好辞掉。回家来陪客。

Then she sat in a small room adjoining the sitting room, with the door open, resting her eyes and listening to the old friends reminisce.
然后坐在客厅间壁的小房间中，打开了房门，一面闭目养神，一面听他们叙旧。


“Sister Luo,” she heard Hu say, “you helped me so much in the old days.
“罗四姐，”她听见胡雪岩在说，“你从前帮过我许多忙。

Now I can at last stand on my own feet.
现在我总算立直了，

If there is anything I can do for you, please say so.”
不晓得不啥地方可以帮你的忙，请你尽管说。”

“Thank you.
“多谢你。

I can still get along.
你也还混得落，

When I can no longer manage, I shall ask for your help, Sir.”
到我混不落去的时候，再请你大先生帮忙。”

“But living alone like this is no lasting solution.”
“你一个人这样混也不是一个了局。”

The Seventh Lady’s interest stirred.
听得这话，七姑奶奶心中一动，

She rose quietly and looked in from a distance.
悄悄起身，遥遥相望，

Hu and Luo were gazing into each other’s eyes.
只见胡雪岩与罗四姐四目凝视，

Their old affection had been rekindled, she thought.
心里在想：他们那一段旧情，又挑起来了。

She was right.
她猜得不错。

Hu felt that Luo had changed during their nine years apart.
胡雪岩觉得九年不见，罗四姐变了，

In the old days she had been a young woman of modest means whose long braid swung to and fro, whose waist swayed briskly as she walked, and whose eyes were always glancing about. Strangers never made her blush.
从前是一根长辫子甩来甩去，走路腰扭得很厉害，左顾右盼，见了陌生人不会脸红的小家碧玉，

Now she was much quieter, and her complexion had grown fairer and clearer.
如今沉静得多了，皮肤也白净得多了，

The sharply contrasted black and white of her eyes, set in an unpainted oval face, no longer moved about as restlessly as before.
瓜子形的清水脸上，那一双黑白分明的眼睛，不似从前那么灵活，

Yet an occasional glance at him seemed charged with countless things she wished to tell.
但偶尔瞟他一眼，仿佛有无数心事要倾诉似地。

Most touching of all was the chrysanthemum of white cord beside her loose, drooping hair knot.
最动人的是堕马髻旁戴一朵白头绳结成的菊花。

Hu had a particular taste for young widows, and this white flower of mourning stirred his imagination more than anything.
胡雪岩选色，喜欢年轻孀妇，所以这朵带孝白菊花，最逗人遐思。

“What do you think of this?” he asked.
“这样好不好，”胡雪岩说：

“Let me help you open an embroidery shop in Hangzhou.”
“我帮你在杭州开一家绣庄。”

“No.
“不！

I don’t want to return to Hangzhou.”
我不想回杭州。”

“Why?”
“为啥呢？”

“I am used to living in Shanghai.”
“在上海住惯了。”

“Then open it in Shanghai?”
“那么，绣庄就开在上海？”

“Thank you,” she said.
“多谢你。”罗四姐说，

“Let me think it over.”
“等我想一想。”


The Seventh Lady would have liked to listen longer, but Gu had returned.
七姑奶奶很想再听下去，但古应春回来了，

She had to intercept him, explain briefly who their new guest was, and then bring him into the sitting room.
不能不抢先一步截住他，略略说了生客的来历，方始带他到客厅，与罗四姐见面。

“Ah, Brother-in-Law Gu.” Luo gathered her jacket neatly and made her greeting with easy grace.
“喔，”罗四姐很大方地捡袄为礼，口中叫一声：“七姐夫。”

The intimate form of address soon dispelled Gu’s feeling of unfamiliarity, and he talked to her as he would to an old acquaintance.
是这样亲近的称呼，使得古应春很快地消失了陌生感，象跟熟人那洋谈了起来。

Before long the restaurant dishes arrived and they went in to dine.
不久，馆子里送了菜来，相将入席，

Everyone urged Luo to take the place of honor, but she would not hear of it.
大家都尊罗四姐上坐，她说什么也不肯，

In the end Hu occupied it as usual. The four of them sat one on each side of a square table.
结果依旧是胡雪岩首座一张八仙桌，主客四人，各占一方。

“Sister Luo can drink,” Hu told the Seventh Lady.
“罗四姐会吃酒的。”胡雪岩对七姑奶奶说，

“And she has an excellent capacity.”
“而且酒量好得很。”

“Then grape wine will be too light.
“这样说，葡萄酒是太淡了。”七姑奶奶问说：

What do you prefer, Sister Luo?
“罗四姐，你喜欢哪种酒，

Shall we warm some Huadiao?”
烫花雕来好不好？”

“Thank you.
“谢谢。

I no longer drink.”
我现在酒不吃了。”

“Why give it up?
“为啥要戒酒？”七姑奶奶说：

Living by yourself, you need a little wine.
“你一个人，正要吃酒，

One good bout of drinking dissolves a thousand sorrows.”
一醉解千愁。”

“Listen to yourself!” Gu reproached her.
“你看你！”古应春埋怨地说：

“You sound drunk before you have touched a drop.
“你没有吃酒，倒在说醉话了。

Sister Luo is managing perfectly well.
人家罗四姐日子过得好好地，

Why should she drown her sorrows?”
何必借酒浇愁？”

“Very well, I spoke out of turn.”
“好！算我说错了。”

The Seventh Lady yielded, then urged her guest again.
七姑奶奶让步，复又劝客人：

“Break your rule for me.
“你为我开戒，

I’ll have a couple of cups with you.”
我陪你吃两杯。”

“You are too kind.
“不敢当，不敢当。

If you insist, I will.”
七姐一定要我吃，我就吃。”

“Then that is settled.
“守和好。

What shall we have?”
你说，吃啥酒？”

“Whatever you have.”
“你吃啥，我吃啥。”

“I only drink for amusement.
“我是吃了好玩儿的。

I’m afraid you may not like it.”
只怕你不喜欢。”


The Seventh Lady fetched a bottle of mint liqueur from a cabinet.
七姑奶奶到柜子里取来一瓶薄荷酒，

Its gourd-shaped bottle and emerald-green contents were so attractive that Luo’s appetite for a drink revived.
葫芦形的瓶子，碧绿的酒，非常可爱，倒将罗四姐的酒兴引发了。

“I’ll have some too,” Hu said, joining in the spirit of the occasion.
“我也吃杯薄荷酒。”胡雪岩凑趣，

With his glass in hand, he looked at the Seventh Lady.
举杯在手，看着七姑奶奶说：

“I have been urging Sister Luo to open an embroidery shop.
“我劝罗四姐开一家绣庄，

What do you think?”
你们看好不好？”

“Sir, I have considered it,” Luo interposed.
“大先生，我想过了”。罗四姐接口说道：

“Thank you for your kindness, but it is beyond my strength.
“多谢你的好意，我是力不从心。

Even if you supply the capital, there must be people to do the work.
本钱虽归你出，也要人手，

I could not oversee it all alone.”
我一个人照应不过来。”

“Why worry about that?
“那怕什么？

Ask Seventh Sister to help, and let Yingchun look after outside business.
请七姐帮你的忙，外场请应春照应。

I’ll send you two reliable, experienced assistants as well.
另外我再派两个老成靠得住的伙计给你。

You need only be the proprietor of a business ready-made for you.”
你做现成的老板好了。”

“There is not much satisfaction in having everything handed to me.”
“吃现成饭也没啥意思。”

The conversation was beginning to go awry.
言语有点谈不拢。

Gu thought it better to leave the matter for the time being and changed the subject.
古应春觉得这件事暂时以不谈为妙，便将话扯了开去，

As host, he naturally chose something familiar or interesting to the guest, and so they came to Gu embroidery.
作主人的当然要拣客人熟悉或感兴趣的话题，所以自然而然地谈到了“顾绣”。

Chinese embroidery fell into three schools: Hunan’s Xiang embroidery, Suzhou’s Su embroidery, and the Shanghai style uniquely called Gu embroidery.
中国的刺绣分三派，湖南湘绣、苏州苏绣以外，上海独称“顾绣”，

The last had a long history and a considerable tradition behind it.
其中源远流长，很有一段掌故，

Luo proved surprisingly well able to explain it.
罗四姐居然能谈得很清楚。

“Everyone knows that it was handed down by a concubine of the Gu family at Luxiang Garden.
“大家都晓得的，顾绣是从露香园顾家的一个姨太太传下来的。

They tell me the place where I now live stands on the garden’s old grounds…”
我现在住的地方，听他们说就是露香园的基址……”


Luxiang Garden stood in the northwestern corner of the walled city.
露香园在上海城内西北角，

Gu Mingru, a Ming prefect of Daozhou, had originally built it under the name Retreat of Ten Thousand Bamboos.
先是明朝道州知府顾名儒所建，本名“万竹山居“。

His younger brother Gu Mingshi became a jinshi in the thirty-eighth year of Jiajing and rose to Assistant Director of the Imperial Seals Office.
顾名儒的胞弟叫顾名世，嘉靖三十八年的进士，官拜尚宝丞，

Retiring home with a substantial fortune from his official career, he saw that much ground remained vacant east of the retreat and enlarged it, digging a pond.
告老还乡，宦囊甚丰，看万竹山居东面的空地尚多，于是拓宽来开辟一座池塘，

The site proved to have held a pond before: an unearthed stone inscription supplied the evidence.
哪知此地本来就是池，有掘出来的一块石碑为证。

It bore the words “Dew-Fragrance Pond,” in Zhao Zi’ang’s own calligraphy.
碑上刻的是”露香池“三字，而且是赵子昂的手笔。

Gu Mingshi therefore renamed the retreat Luxiang Garden, the Garden of Dew Fragrance, and naturally restored the pond’s old name.
因此，顾名世将万竹山居改名”露香园“，那座池塘当然一仍其旧，依然叫做”露香池“。

Among his many concubines was one surnamed Ying.
顾名世的姬妾很多，其中有一个姓缨，

While in Beijing she had learned embroidery, including techniques passed down from the palace.
她在京城的时候，学会了刺绣，而且是宫中传出来的诀窍，

Gifted in the craft, she improved on them until her work became still more exquisite.
缨姨娘在这方面有天才，更加改良，益见精妙。

With fine needles and close stitches, her silks of five colors blended seamlessly from light to dark; the beauty of her color combinations went without saying.
五色丝线孽，细针密缕，颜色由浅入深，浑然一体，配色之美，更不在话下。

Above all, Gu embroidery used the needle for a brush and silk thread for pigment, taking famous paintings as models.
最见特色的是，顾绣以针代笔，以丝钱作丹青，以名迹作蓝本，

Landscapes, figures, flowers, and birds all possessed a living spirit and unrivaled delicacy.
山水、人物、花鸟，无不气韵生动，工细无匹，

It was then known as “painted embroidery.”
当时称为“画绣”。

Mistress Ying once embroidered a version of Zhao Zi’ang’s Eight Steeds.
缨姨娘曾经仿绣赵子昂的《八骏图》，

Dong Qichang declared that even Zhao himself, working with a brush, might not surpass her.
董其昌认为即使是赵子昂本人用笔，亦未见得能胜过她。

She also made a Pausing the Needle, extraordinarily expressive and beautiful, in which painting and embroidery were indistinguishable.
又绣过一幅《停针图》，真是穷态极研，而且无法分辨是画，是绣。

A Yangzhou salt merchant later obtained it in exchange for a set of linked jade rings from the Han dynasty and a painting of a beauty by the celebrated Southern Tang artist Zhou Fang.
后来由扬州的一位监商，拿一个汉玉连环，及南唐名家周昉作画的一幅美人图交换了去。

Under Mistress Ying’s instruction, all the women of Luxiang Garden, down to the maids, became highly accomplished embroiderers.
由于缨姨娘的教导，露香园的女眷，下至丫头，都会刺绣，而且极精，

Their fame overshadowed Gu Mingshi’s own name, until one day, after drinking, he complained that his reputation hung between their ten fingers.
“画绣”之名大著，顾名世本人的名字，反而不为人所知，以至于顾名世有一次酒后大发牢骚，说他“寄名于汝辈十指之间”。


The name “Gu embroidery,” however, came into use only after the beginning of the Qing.
不过称为“顾绣”是入清以后的事。

Gu Mingshi had a granddaughter who married a man named Zhang.
顾名世有个孙女儿，嫁夫姓张，

Widowed at twenty-four with a year-old son, she supported the orphan and maintained her widowhood entirely through the work of her slender fingers.
二十四岁居孀，有个一岁的儿子。抚孤守节，全靠纤纤十指，

Her embroidery equaled Mistress Ying’s.
绣件不输于缨姨娘，

Besides pictures, she embroidered ordinary designs, and business flourished.
但除绣画以外还绣普通的花样，生意很好，

“Gu embroidery” replaced “painted embroidery” as the name of the craft and became known throughout the country.
“顾绣”便取“画绣”之名而代之，传遍南北。

It was now one of Shanghai’s celebrated products, practiced in household after household; even men learned to embroider.
同时“顾绣”也成了上海的一佯名产，家学户习，甚至男子也有学刺绣的。

Luo told the story with such command that Hu and the Seventh Lady listened with keen enjoyment.
罗四姐讲得头头是道，胡雪岩与七姑奶奶也听得津津有味。

Gu was somewhat distracted, however.
不过古应春却有些心不在焉，

Hu had six or seven engagements at changsan houses that evening.
他关心的是胡雪岩这天在长三堂子中有六七处应酬，

At half an hour in each, plus travel, they would take at least four hours.
每处坐半点钟，连路上的工夫，至少亦要四个钟头，

As soon as Luo reached a pause, he reminded Hu, “We ought to go.”
所以等罗四姐谈得告一段落，便提醒他说：“应该去了。”

Hu frowned.
一听这话，胡雪岩便皱起了眉，

“Which can we miss?”
“可以不去的，有哪些地方？”他问。

“Best to go to all of them.
“最好都去。

If you absolutely cannot, there are two you must attend.”
万不得已，那么，有两处非去不可。”

“Very well.
“好吧！

We’ll go to those two.
就去这两处。”

What about Sister Luo?
胡雪岩问道：“罗四姐呢？

Someone ought to see her home.”
应该有人送。”

“There is no need,” the Seventh Lady said.
“不要了。”七姑奶奶说：

“It is such a long way into the city, and at night too.”
“城里这么远，又是晚上。”

Clearly, she meant to keep her guest overnight and would accept no argument.
七姑奶奶是不由分说要留客过夜了。

Luo wanted to stay, but only an old manservant was at home to watch the house.
罗四姐也想留下来，不过家里只有一个老苍头看门，

If she did not return, he would worry, and she could not bear to cause him that anxiety.
她一夜不回去，害老苍头着急，亦觉于心不忍。


“That is easily settled,” Gu said.
“这倒容易。”古应春说：

“Give me your address, Sister Luo, and I’ll send someone to let him know.”
“请罗四姐把府上的地址告诉我，我派人去通知。”

The two men left the table first.
于是胡、古二人先行离席，

When the women had finished, the Seventh Lady took Luo to a room reserved for female guests, checked the bedding and other necessities, and invited her to remove her makeup and settle comfortably over tea and conversation.
七姑奶奶陪着罗四姐吃完饭，领她到专为留堂客的客房，检点了补褥用具，请罗四姐卸了妆，再舒舒服服喝茶闲谈。

They talked until midnight.
一谈谈到午夜，

A late supper was a daily custom in the Gu household, and while they were eating congee, Gu returned—with Hu beside him.
古家照例每天必有消夜，正在吃粥时，古应春回来了，同行的还有胡雪岩。

“You didn’t go home, Little Uncle?” the Seventh Lady remarked casually.
“小爷叔没有回去？”七姑奶奶信口说了一句。

“I felt like some congee,” Hu answered just as casually.
“我想来吃粥。”胡雪岩也信口回答。

Everyone understood that he had come expressly to see Luo.
其实，大家都明白，他是特为来看罗四姐。

With her makeup removed, she wore her hair in a loose, thick braid, and had put on wide-legged trousers and a little lined jacket.
卸了妆的她，梳一条松松的大辫子，穿的是散脚裤、小夹袄，

By convention this was bedroom dress, unsuitable for receiving male visitors.
照规矩是卧室中的打扮，见不得“官客”的。

But since they had come upon her in it, she could only behave naturally, as though nothing were amiss.
不过既然让官客撞见了，也就只好大大方方地，视如无事。

“Which two houses did you visit?” the Seventh Lady asked.
“你们走了哪两家？”七姑奶奶问。

“Yajun’s Fifth Miss in Huile Lane, and Qiuyuelou’s Fourth Miss in Zhoujin Lane.”
“会乐里雅君老五家。还有昼锦秋月楼老四家。”古应春答说。

“Hadn’t Fourth Miss left the profession to marry?
“秋月楼老四不是从良了吗？”七姑奶奶问说：

Has she merely ‘taken a bath’ and come back?”
“莫非‘淴了个浴’又出来了？”

“It wasn’t that she meant it to be just a bath,” Hu replied.
“倒不是她要‘淴浴’，”胡雪岩答说：

“The Qiu family’s senior wife drove her out.”
“是让邱家的大太太赶出来的。”

“Is she still so thin?”
“喔。”七姑奶奶问：“老四还是那么瘦？”

“She has filled out a little.”
“稍微发福了。”

“That’s good.
“那好，

She needs a little more flesh to look her best.”
她是要胖一点才好看。”


As they talked, Luo kept glancing from one to another in surprise.
他们在交谈时，罗四姐的眼光不断扫来扫去，露出诧异的神色，

The Seventh Lady noticed.
七姑奶奶觉察到了，

“Have you ever visited a courtesan house, Sister Luo?”
“罗四姐，”她问：“你逛过堂子没有？”

“Never.
“没有。”罗四姐答说：

I have never even heard of such a thing.”
“听都没有听说过。”

“Among women, only this wife of mine goes visiting them,” Gu said, a little embarrassed.
“女人逛堂子，只有我们这位太太。”古应春有点不好意思地说：

“Would you like her to take you and broaden your experience?”
“罗四姐，要不要让她带你去开开眼界？”

“Thank you, thank you!” Luo laughed and made a hesitant movement with her hand.
“ 谢谢， 谢谢！” 罗四姐一面笑， 一面瑟缩…… 手，

“I wouldn’t dare.”
“我不敢。”

“What is there to fear?” the Seventh Lady encouraged her.
“怕啥？”七姑奶奶鼓励她说：

“You learn something from every experience.
“不经一事，不长一智，

Once you have visited those houses, you will understand why men in their fifties and sixties enter a ruinous turn in their fortunes.
你要到堂子里去过，才晓得为啥五六十岁的老头子，会交墓库运？

And once you understand, your own husband won’t suffer that fate.”
你懂了其中的道理，你家老爷也就不会交墓库运了。”

“How does that follow?”
“这又是啥道理呢？”

“Because you will know how a woman can hold a man’s heart.
“因为你懂了，女人家要怎么个样子，才能收男人的心？

Don’t force him to do things he dislikes.
他不喜欢的事情，你不要逼了他去做，

Say less of what he doesn’t want to hear.
他不喜欢听的话，你少说。

Whatever he cares about, take it to heart as though it concerned you yourself.
他喜欢的事情，你也要当自己的事情那样子放在心上。

Once you can do that, let him visit courtesans and drink with them as much as he pleases.
到了这个地步，你尽管放他出去逛堂子，吃花酒，

His heart will still belong to you.”
他一颗心还是在你身上的。”

“No wonder Brother-in-Law Gu is so obedient!” Luo said with a smile.
“怪不得！”罗四姐笑道：“七姐夫这样子听你的话。”

“Obedient may not be the word,” Gu answered, trying to save face.
“听她的话倒不见得。”古应春解嘲似地说：

“But I probably won’t suffer that turn of fortune.”
“不过大概不至于交墓库运。”

“There you are!” the Seventh Lady urged.
“是不是？”七姑奶奶怂恿着说：

“We’ll go for tea and conversation, and if we feel like it, order a whole banquet.
“我们去打个茶围，有兴致再吃它一台酒，

You’ll learn something.
你也长长见识。

We won’t be going with the men, so what is there to fear?”
又不跟他们男人家在一起，怕啥？”

“I have no need to learn about that.
“我用不着长这个见识了。

I am alone in the world.
孤家寡人一个，

Such knowledge would be no use to me.”
这番见识也用不着。”

Raising her head as she spoke, she met Hu’s eyes squarely.
说着，抬起头来，视线恰好跟胡雪岩碰个正着。

She looked away at once, only to encounter the Seventh Lady’s half-smiling gaze.
赶紧避开，却又跟七姑奶奶对上了，看她似笑非笑的神情，

For no reason she could explain, she felt guilty and blushed, hardly knowing what to do with herself.
罗四姐无缘无故地心虚脸红，竟有些手足无措了。


“Seventh Sister!
于是胡雪岩便叫一声：“七姐，

Yingchun!” Hu began talking about something quite unrelated, drawing their attention away to rescue Luo from her embarrassment.
应春！”接着谈一件不相干的事，目的是将他们夫妇俩的视线吸引开去，为罗四姐解围。

Finding an opening in the conversation, she touched her faintly burning cheeks and said, “I mustn’t drink any more.
“我的酒不能再吃了。”罗四姐找个谈话的空隙，摸着微微发烧的脸说：

Another glass and I shall be drunk.”
“再吃要醉了。”

“Not at all.
“不会的。

One can tell at a glance whether someone can hold her drink.
酒量好坏一看就看出来了。”七姑奶奶说：

Perhaps the wine is not to your taste.”
“只怕是酒不对你的胃口。”

“Probably,” Gu agreed.
“大概是。

“Mint liqueur is sweet.
薄荷酒带甜味，

People who drink well generally dislike sweet flavors.
酒量好的人，都不喜欢甜味道。”

Would you care for a couple of glasses of brandy, Sister Luo?”
古应春问道：“罗四姐，你吃两杯白兰地好不好？”

“Mixing two kinds will make me drunk.”
“吃两种酒会醉。”

“No, no!” the Seventh Lady put in.
“不会，不会！”七姑奶奶接口，

“Foreigners drink several kinds at one meal, some before it and some afterward.
“外国人一顿饭要吃好几种酒，有的酒在饭前，有的酒在饭后，

They put all those different drinks into their stomachs, and I’ve never seen anything wrong with them.”
杂七杂八都吃在肚皮里，也没有看他们有啥不对。”

“Really?”
“真的？”

Since Luo did not seem firmly opposed, Gu fetched a bottle of three-star brandy.
看样子并不坚拒，古应春便起身去取了一瓶三星白兰地，

As he worked at the cork with a corkscrew, she spoke again.
拿着螺丝钻在开瓶塞时，罗四姐开口了。

“I have heard that if you rub the crescent-shaped label at the top with a damp cloth, three blue marks appear.
“我听人家说，这种酒上面那块月牙形招头纸，拿湿手巾擦一擦，会有三个蓝印子出来。

Without those marks, the brandy is counterfeit.”
没有蓝印子的就是假酒。”

“That is new to us.
“这我们还是第一回听说，

Let us try.”
试试看。”

A damp handkerchief was brought, and they rubbed and rubbed, without the least result.
叫人拿块湿手中来擦了又擦，毫无反应，

Luo said calmly, “That shows how little one can trust hearsay.
罗四姐从从容容地说：“可见得听来的话靠不住。

There could hardly be counterfeit wine in your house.”
府上的酒，哪里会有假的？”


“That is not certain either.
“这也不见得，

We must taste it to decide.”
要尝过才算数。”

The Seventh Lady fetched two crystal glasses and said to her husband, “You will have to keep Sister Luo company.”
七姑奶奶起身去拿了两个水晶酒杯来，向她丈夫说：“只有你陪罗四姐了。”

“What about you, Mr Hu?” Luo asked.
“胡大先生，你呢？”罗四姐问。

“I have little capacity.
“我酒量浅，

Please go ahead.”
你请。”

The Seventh Lady returned to the proposed visit. “Well, Sister Luo, what day shall it be?”
“罗四姐，”七姑奶奶又提逛堂子的事了，“怎么样，哪一天？”

Hu interposed with a joking air. “Seventh Sister, how about helping me arrange a tea visit with a little ‘border’ added?”
“七姐，”胡雪岩玩笑似地插嘴：“帮衬我打个‘镶边茶围’好不好？”

“Who wants you adding a border?
“哪个要你‘镶边’，

We want none of your ‘border’—and we mean to snip your border away as well!”
不但不要你镶边，我们还要‘剪’你的‘边’呢！”

Watching them joke so freely, without the slightest affectation or awkwardness, Luo understood how close they were.
罗四姐看他们这样随意开玩笑，彼此都没有丝毫做作或不自然的神色，知道他们的交情够深了。

The Seventh Lady was not merely warm and frank; Hu evidently listened to her.
而且看七姑奶奶不但爽朗热心，似乎胡雪岩很听她的话。

If Luo intended anything with Hu, she thought, she would first have to win the Seventh Lady over.
她心里在想，如果对胡雪岩有什么盘算，一定先要将七姑奶奶这一关打通。

Her tone changed accordingly.
于是，她的语气改变了，

She had regarded courtesan houses as disreputable places and refused even to discuss them.
先是提到“堂子”就觉得是个不正经的地方，谈都不愿谈，

Now she asked of her own accord, “Seventh Sister, what does ‘snip your border away’ mean?”
这时候却自动地问道：“七姐，什么叫‘剪你的边’？”

“Steal someone’s sweetheart.”
“ ‘剪边’就是把人家的相好夺过来。”

Leaning toward her with playful curiosity, the Seventh Lady lowered her voice a little.
七姑奶奶凑过去，以一种顽皮好奇的神态，略略放低了声音说：

“I’ll take you to see Little Uncle’s favorite.
“我带你去看看小爷叔的相好，

A true Suzhou woman!
真正苏州人，

Once you sit down and hear her speak, you won’t want to leave.”
光是听她说说话，你坐下来就不想走了。”

“A true Suzhou woman?”
“真正苏州人？”

Luo was puzzled.
罗四姐不懂了，

“Can there be false ones?”
“莫非还有假的苏州人？”

“Of course.
“怎么没有？

Ask them, and they all say they come from Mudu in Suzhou.
问起来都说是苏州木渎人，

In fact, they have merely learned a courtesan-house version of the Suzhou dialect.”
实在不过学了一口‘堂子腔’的苏白而已。”

“Suzhou speech is Suzhou speech.
“苏白就是苏白，

What do you mean by a courtesan-house version?”
什么叫堂子腔的苏白？”

“I can’t imitate it.
“我不会说，

Come and listen, and you’ll understand.”
你去听了就知道了。”

“Very well!”
“好啊！”

Having resisted so firmly, Luo used this opening to change her position.
一直坚拒的罗四姐，趁此转圜，

“I’ll go with you one day and broaden my experience.”
“几时跟七姐去开开眼界。”



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第五章（二）
Towers of Light — Chapter Five, Part Two
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“You may go,” Gu warned, half in jest, “but take care that your adventures do not appear in the Shen Bao.”
“你们去是去，”古应春半真半假地警告：“当心《申报》登你们的新闻。”

“Ah!” Hu suddenly raised his voice.
“喔，”胡雪岩突然提高了声音说：

“That mention of the Shen Bao reminds me of something.
“应春提到《申报》，我倒想起一件事来了。

Since the Tianjin–Shanghai telegraph opened last winter, I have noticed that some of its news arrives by wire.
从去年冬天天津到上海的电报通了以后，我看《申报》上有些新闻是打电报回来的。

With Sheng Xingsun directing the telegraph administration, he is exceptionally well informed.
盛杏荪当电报局总办，消息格外灵通，

In certain kinds of business, if our news comes later than his—even one step later—we can suffer a serious loss.
有些生意上头，我们消息比人家晚，哪怕只不过晚一步，亏就吃得很大了。

I have been wondering, Yingchun, whether we could obtain help from the newspaper's reporters.”
所以，我有个念头，应春，你看能不能托《申报》的访员帮忙？”

“To telegraph market quotations?”
“是报行情过来？”

“Yes.”
“是啊。”

“Then why not station someone of our own in Tianjin and have him send a daily report in cipher?”
“那，我们自己派人在天津，每天用密码发过来好了。”

“That would be of limited use.
“那没有多少用处。”胡雪岩说：

There are things only reporters can discover.
“有的行情，只有访员才打听得到。

Besides, I do not mean merely conditions in the market.
而且，也不光是市面上的行情，

I mean conditions at court too.
还有朝廷里的行情。

Take the impeachment of the elder Mr Li last winter…”
象去年冬天，李大先生的参案……“


The elder Mr Li was Li Hanzhang.
“李大先生，”是指李瀚章。

For all her outward bluntness, the Seventh Lady was inwardly perceptive.
七姑奶奶的性情，外粗内细，

Once the conversation turned to the political fortunes of senior statesmen, she knew that many consequential remarks ought not to be overheard by people unconnected with the matter.
一听谈到这些当朝大老的宦海风波，深知有许多有关系的话，不宜为不相干的人听见，

If repeated, they might cause trouble for both Hu and Gu.
传出去会惹是非，对胡雪岩及古应春都没有好处，

She quietly drew Luo Sijie aside, signalling with her eyes that they should leave the table.
所以悄悄拉了罗四姐，同时还做了个示意离席的眼色。

“Once they begin, they will talk for ever.
“他们这一谈就谈不完了，

Let us go over there and have our own conversation.”
我们到旁边来谈我们的。”

Luo immediately understood and cooperated.
罗四姐极其知趣，立刻迎合着七姑奶奶的意向说：

“I have things to say that I would rather not discuss before them.
“我也正有些话，不便当着他们谈。

Seventh Sister, I feel rather unsettled.”
七姐，我心里头有点发慌。”

“Why?”
“为啥？”

Instead of answering, Luo led her to a long red-velvet easy chair, where they sat side by side.
罗四姐不即回答，将七姑奶奶拉到一边，在红丝绒的长安乐椅上并排坐了下来，

With one hand she held the Seventh Lady's; with the other she kept touching her wine-flushed cheeks.
一只手执着七姑奶奶的手，一只手只是摸着因酒而现红晕的脸。

“Are you unwell?” the Seventh Lady asked anxiously.
“是不是身子不舒服？”七姑奶奶不安地问：

“Why should you suddenly feel unsettled?”
“怎么好端端地，心里会发慌？”

“It is not that.” Luo seemed to find the words difficult.
“不是身子不舒服。”罗四姐仿佛很吃力他说：

“I never dreamed that a day like this would come: meeting Xueyan again, and getting to know you.
“我做梦也没有想到，忽然会有象今天这样子一天，又遇见雪岩，又结识了七姐你，

I feel like a family that buys its firewood a handful at a time and suddenly wins a prize in the White Pigeon lottery.
好比买‘把儿柴’的人家，说道有一天中了‘白鸽票’，

I hardly know what to do.”
不晓得怎么好了。”

Though a native of Songjiang, the Seventh Lady understood Hangzhou expressions through her acquaintance with Hu.
七姑奶奶虽是松江人，但由于胡雪岩的关系，也憧杭州话，

Luo meant that an ordinary poor person had suddenly won a fortune.
罗四姐的意思是，升斗小民突然中了奖券，也就是拿穷儿暴富的譬喻，来形容她自己的心境。

The comparison pleased her.
七姑奶奶觉得她的话很中听，

She had liked Luo already and now felt still closer to her.
原来就觉得她很好，这下便更对劲了。

Finding a suitable reply was difficult, however, so she merely smiled and said, “Surely not!
不过要找一句适当的话来回答倒很难，所以她只是笑嘻嘻地说：“怎么会呢？

Surely not!”
怎么会呢？”


“Why not?
“怎么不会？

When has a widow like me ever had a day of talking, laughing, and drinking like this?
我一个寡妇，哪里有过这种又说又笑又吃酒的日子。

He offers to help me open an embroidery shop, and you offer to take me to a courtesan house.
他要帮我开绣庄，你要请我逛堂子，

I could never have imagined such things in this life—or even a previous one.”
不要说今生今生，前世都不曾想到过的。”

Her delight was unmistakable.
踌躇满志之意，溢于言表，七姑奶奶当然看得出来，

Taking one of Luo's hands between her own warm, plump palms, the Seventh Lady quietly asked, “Helping you open a shop would take no more than a word from him. What do you really think of it, Sister Luo?”
抓住她一只手，合拢在那那双只见肉、不见骨的温暖手掌中，悄悄问道：“罗四姐，他要帮你开绣庄，不过一句话的事，你的意思到底怎么样呢？”

Luo lowered her eyes without replying, as though troubled by something she could not express.
罗四姐不答，低垂着眼，仿佛有难言之隐，无法开口似地。

“Say something.
“你说一句嘛！

If you want it, you want it; if you do not, you do not.
愿意就愿意，不愿意就不愿意，

Nobody can force you.”
勉强不来的事。”

“How could I not want it?
“我怎么会。不愿意呢？

But, Seventh Sister…”
不过，七姐，”

She suddenly looked up.
罗四姐倏然抬眼，

“What would that make me?”
“我算啥呢？”

“The proprietor.”
“女老板。”

“The person who supplies the capital is the proprietor.
“出本钱是老板，

The capital would not be mine.”
本钱又不是我的。”

At first the Seventh Lady was puzzled.
七姑奶奶始而诧异，

Becoming the owner of a ready-made business was a wonderful opportunity; why hesitate?
做现成的老板，一大美事，还有什么好多想的？

Then understanding dawned.
继而憬然有悟，脱口说道：

“The proprietor's wife, then?”
“那么是老板娘？”

Luo lowered her head again.
罗四姐又把头低了下去。

“That is exactly what I fear people would think.”
幽幽地说：“我就怕人家是这样子想法。”

By speaking of other people rather than herself, she conveyed a subtle implication.
不说自己说人家，言外之意就很微妙了。
