At such moments the Seventh Lady was far from indiscreet.
遇到这种时候，七姑奶奶就不会口没遮拦了，

She would not venture a delicate remark until she had judged its precise effect.
有分寸的话，她拿把握住分寸，才肯出口。


“You are still young, Sister Luo,” she finally said, testing the ground.
“罗四姐，”她终于开口探问了，“你年纪还轻，

“And with no children, what is the point of remaining a widow?”
又没有儿女，守下去没有意思嘛。”

Before supper, Luo had spoken of her past, vaguely implying that she had no children.
在吃消夜以前，罗四姐原曾谈过身世。当时含含糊糊表示过，没有儿女，

Hearing this repeated, she felt she should correct it at once to demonstrate her honesty.
此时听七姑奶奶这样说，她觉得应该及时更正。才显得诚实。

“I have a daughter,” she said.
“有个女儿。”她说，

“She lives with her maternal grandmother.”
“在外婆家。”

“Where is her grandmother?”
“外婆在哪里？”

“Hangzhou.”
“杭州。”

“A daughter is different from a son.
“女儿不比儿子，

In the end, she belongs to another family.
总是人家的。

Depending on a son-in-law may be tolerable if the young couple get along well, but otherwise that ready-provided meal can be hard to swallow.
将来靠女婿，他们小夫妇感情好还好，不然，这碗现成饭也很难吃。

Especially if his mother is still living: the looks a daughter's mother receives from her fellow mother-in-law can be very unpleasant.”
尤其是上有婆婆，亲家太太的脸嘴，实在难看。”

声音很平淡，但字字清楚，显得很有把握。

“靠自己就更要有一样靠得住的东西了。”

The Seventh Lady meant that Luo should accept Hu's financial assistance.
意在言外，是劝她接受胡雪岩的资助，

否则宁可不受。

因而明知其意，却装作不解。

七姑奶奶当然不相信她不懂这话，沉默不答，必是别有盘算，

绣花这样本事，全靠年纪轻、眼睛亮、手底下准，

没有几年，你就靠不住了。”

靠得住的便是绣庄。

罗四姐不会再装不懂了，

莫非是嫌胡雪岩的忙帮得不够？还是性情耿介，不愿受人的好处？

七姑奶奶一时还看不出来，便也就保持沉默了。

“Very much alive and vigorous.
“健旺得很呢。”

Have you met her?”
七姑奶奶问：“你见过？”

“Yes.”
“见过。”

“那么，胡太太呢？

Have you met her too?”
也见过？”

“Yes.”
“也见过。”

罗四姐忽然幽幽地叹了口气。

Now the Seventh Lady understood completely.
这一下，七姑奶奶恍然大悟。

Neither Hu nor Luo had forgotten their former affection.
胡雪岩未忘旧情，罗四姐旧情未忘。

There would be no obstacle on his side; if Luo were willing to accept a less exalted position, the arrangement might prove a happy one.
胡雪岩那边不会有什么障碍，如果罗四姐这方面肯委屈，倒也未始不是一件美事。

感情上的事，要两厢情愿。

七姑奶奶当时便作了个决定，给他们机会，让他们自己去接近。

果然有缘，两情相洽，那时看情形，再来做现成媒人，也还不迟。

七姑奶奶转脸看时，小大姐已在伺候胡雪岩穿马褂了，

明天晚上我正正式式请罗四姐，

你有没有空？”

胡雪岩尚未答话，罗四姐抢在前面谦谢，

道理上应该。”七姑奶奶奶又说：

罗四姐不作声了，

随随便便一句话就能够把你的嘴封住，没话可说。”

“我话还是有的，”罗四姐说：“恭敬不如从命。”

“你这话。”七姑奶奶说道：“才真的太客气了。”

“那么，还有句不客气的话：只此一回，下不为例。”

“Very well.
“好，好。

No precedent.”
下不为例。”

Hu and Gu exchanged a glance of shared understanding.
古应春与胡雪岩互相看了一眼，有同感的默契，

Luo was a woman of mettle too, matching the Seventh Lady's wit point for point.
罗四姐也是个角色，针锋相对，口才上并不逊于七姑奶奶。

罗四姐今天住在我这里，

明天早晨，我送她回去，下午再去接她，

如果她对胡雪岸没有意思，一定会推辞，

一个男人，深夜送单身女子回家，那会在邻居之中引起极多的批评，

罗四姐果真以此为言，七姑奶奶是无法坚持一定要胡雪岩送的。

七姑奶奶看着罗四姐笑了，这一笑倒使得她有些发窘，将视线避了开去。

第二天，七姑奶奶送罗四姐回家，

She lived in Nanshi, in a two-storey stone-gated house on a lane inhabited by comfortably situated families.
她家住南市，一楼一底的古库房子，这条弄堂是小康之家集居之地。

The living quarters were upstairs and the reception room below.
楼上住家，楼下客厅。

客厅中已坐满了人，大多挟着一个平平扁扁的包裹，

有个中年妇女首先迎上来埋怨似地说：

My son needs a doctor.
我儿子要看病，

急着要交货等钱用。

“I stayed at my sister's last night.”

Nobody had heard that she had a sister, and everyone looked curiously at the Seventh Lady.
谁也没有听说过罗四姐有个姐姐，所以不免好奇地注视七姑奶奶，

看她一副富态福相，衣服华丽不说，腕上一双翠镯，指上黄豆大一枚闪光耀眼的金刚钻戒指，便使得大家另眼相看了。

Yet she was entirely unassuming and cheerful.
七姑奶奶却毫无架子，而且极其爽郎，

“你先不要招呼我，

Everyone is waiting.
大家都在等你。”她对罗四姐说：

Get on with your work, and I shall help.”
“你赶紧料理，我来帮你。”

“Nothing could be better!
“再好没有。”

Old Ma!
罗四姐高叫：“老马，

Old Ma!”
老马！”

Old Ma was her assistant, a man in his fifties who kept the accounts, answered the door, and occasionally did odd jobs.
老马是她请的帮手，五十多岁，帮她管帐兼应门，有时也打打杂，

人很老实，但语言木讷，行动迟缓。这么多交货领货的人，无以应付，索性在厢房里躲了起来，

此时听得招呼，方始现身。

Normally Luo and he handled all the receiving and issuing themselves.
平时收货发货，只有罗四姐跟他两个人，

With another pair of hands, things went more smoothly, but it was still noon before they finished.
这天添了一个帮手，便顺利得多，但也一直到中午，方能毕事。

“真对不起。”罗四姐说，“累你忙了半天。”

She told Old Ma to order food from a restaurant, intending to keep her guest for lunch.
接着便关照老马，到馆子里叫菜，要留七姑奶奶吃饭。

我来认一认地方，等下再来接你。

家里还有事要料理，

我索性楼上都不上去了，下半天来了再来看你的卧房。”

Luo welcomed this, for her bedroom was bound to contain some untidiness unsuitable for a visitor.
这在罗四姐倒是求之不得，因为卧房中难免有凌乱不宜待客之处。

Tomorrow evening I should like you and Brother-in-Law Gu to have a simple meal here.
明天晚上，我请七姐、七姐夫来吃便饭，

不晓得七姐夫有没有空。”

客人一走，罗四姐便从容了，

吃过饭，她有午睡的习惯。

一觉醒来，想起胡雪岩晚上要来，当即唤小大姐，连老马都叫了上来，帮着拖地板、抹桌子、擦窗户，

换了干净的被褥，又把一套平时难得一用的细瓷茶具亦找了出来，另外备了四个果盘。

等预备停当，开始妆扮，

好在她一向是一张清水脸，只加意梳好一个头，便可换衣服坐等了。

罗四姐没有想到是他来接，

好在都已经预备好了，不妨请他上楼来坐。

Jiangsu and Zhejiang observed many restrictions between men and women.
江浙两省，男女之间的忌讳很多，

在楼梯上，上楼时必是男先女后，下楼正好相反，

因为裙幅不能高过男人头顶，否则便有“晦气”。

罗四姐也是为此而急忙闪汗，

是个旺地。”

胡雪岩没想到她一开口就是很直也很深的话，一时倒不知该持何态度？

便只好笑笑不答。

罗四姐便照杭州待客之礼，将高脚果盘中的桂圆、荔枝、瓜子、松子糖之类，各样抓一些，放在胡雪岩面前，

打开来看，里面是三扣“经折”，一个小象牙匣子。

意思是罗四姐不管吃的、穿的、用的，凭折到这两家商号随便索取，三节由阜康付帐。

胡雪岩拿起小象牙匣子，”

上万银子，还说小意思。”

他想得很周到，另外还加了一顶小轿，是供她的女仆或小大姐乘坐的。

胡雪岩还带了三个跟班，簇新的蓝布夹袍，上套玄色软缎坎肩，脚下薄底快靴。

罗四姐也很好面子，

心里不由得在想：出门能带着这样子的“底下子”，主人家自然很显得威风了。

“你这份礼很重，不过我也不客气了。”她说：

First, we have many years ahead of us, and opportunities to return one another's kindness.
“第一，我们的日了还长，总有礼尚往来的时候。

Second, I truly like them.”
第二，我是真正喜欢。”

当时便先将绣花椅披，陈设起来，

Peonies embroidered on pink satin gave the room a rich splendour.
粉红软缎，上绣牡丹，显得十分富丽。

I embroidered them.”
是我自己绣的。”

One was red, covered with a hundred butterflies in dazzling colours.
一条是红裙，上绣百蝶，色采繁艳，令人眩目，

“A bride of about twenty, returning to visit her parents, would look splendid in it.
“这条裙子，要二十左右的新娘子，回门的时候穿，那才真叫出色。

我留起来，将来给我女儿。”

“应春，

你要请我吃红蛋了？”

原来古应春夫妇，只有一个儿子，七姑奶奶却一直在说，要想生个女儿。

Hu had noticed her thickened waist, and her words now made him suspect that she was expecting.
胡雪岩看她腰身很粗，此刻再听她说这话，猜想是有喜了。

Gu smiled without answering, tacitly confirming it.
古应春笑笑不答，自然是默认了。

“七姐，恭喜，恭喜！

几个月了。”

七姑奶奶轻声答了句：“四个月。”

“四个月了！

唷、唷，你赶快给我坐下来，

动了胎气，不得了。”

“It is all right.
“不要紧的。

The foreign doctor says I should walk about regularly to make the birth easier.”
洋大夫说，平时是要常常走动走动，生起来才顺利。”

“ 唷！七姐，你倒真开通，有喜的事，也要请教洋大夫。”

罗四姐因为七姑奶奶爽朗过人，而且也没有外人，便开玩笑地问：“莫非你的肚皮都让洋大夫摸过了。”

“Of course.
“是啊！

不摸怎么晓得胎位正不正？”

Luo had meant it as a joke; discovering it was true left her speechless.
原是说笑，不道真有其事，使得罗四姐挢舌不下，

The Seventh Lady was quite unconcerned.
而七姑奶奶却显得毫不在乎。

“There is nothing strange or shameful about it.”
“这没有啥好稀奇的，也没有啥好难为情的。”

Luo shook her head repeatedly. “I could never do that, even if I died.” Gu laughed. “Do not let her deceive you, Sister Luo.
“叫我，死都办不到。”罗四姐不断摇头。“罗四姐！”古应春笑道：“你不要上她的当，

She is teasing.
她是故意逗你。

洋大夫倒是洋大夫，不过是个女的。”

“Would you not be afraid of a foreign man's hand, covered in black hair like a bear's paw, touching your belly?”

七姑奶奶付之一笑，拿起另一条裙子料子看，

月白软缎，下绣一圈波浪，上面还有两只不知名的鸟。

The design was both novel and graceful.
花样很新，但也很大方。

“这条裙子我喜欢的，

明天就来做。”七姑奶奶兴致勃勃地说：

When the skirt moves, it will look just like a flowing tide.
“穿在身上，裙幅一动，真象潮水一样。

How did you think of it?”
罗四姐，你是怎么想起来的。”

“One of my customers, the Zhang family's second young mistress, is very learned.
“也是我的一个主顾，张家的二少奶奶，一肚子的墨水，

We get along so well that whenever I visit, we talk for half a day.
她跟我很投缘，去了总有半天好谈。

有一天不知道怎么提起来一句古话，叫做‘裙拖六幅湘江水’，

我心里一动，回来就配了这么一个花样。

月白缎子不耐脏，

七姐，我再给你绣一条，替换了穿。”

我穿裙子的回数也不多。”

这时古应春跟胡雪岩在看那幅“顾绣”，

Viewed from different angles, the spread-tailed peacock's colours changed.
开屏的孔雀，左右看去，色彩变幻，

配上茶花、竹石，令人观玩不尽，

胡雪岩便说：“何不配个框子，把它挂起来？”

“接着又看被面、看枕头，

七姑奶奶自己笑自己，说是”倒象看嫁妆“。惹得婢仆们都笑了。

“饿了！”胡雪岩问：

“Can we dine soon?”
“七姐，快开饭了吧？”

“Everything is ready.
“都预备好了，

马上就开。”

席面仍旧象前一天一样。菜是古应春特为找了个广东厨子来做的，

既好又别致，罗四姐不但大快朵颐，而且大开眼界，

One consisted of two fish, one red-braised and one steamed, on a double-fish-shaped porcelain platter, one side white and the other yellow.
有道菜是两条鱼，一条红烧、一条清蒸，摆在一个双鱼形的瓷盘中，盘子也很特别，一边白，一边黄，

这就不仅罗四姐，连胡雪岩都是见所未见。

“Gold and Silver Fish,” Gu explained.
“这叫‘金银鱼’，”古应春说，

“A dish presented as tribute.”
“进贡的。”

“By whom?” Hu asked in surprise.
胡雪岩大为诧异，“哪个进贡？”他问，

“By the time cooked fish reached the palace, even if it had not spoiled, it would no longer taste good.”
“鱼做好了，送到宫里，不坏也不好吃了。”

“Naturally, it is cooked there and eaten fresh.

“Ah!” Hu remembered.

“I have heard that his household serves its most distinguished guests what is called ‘household cuisine.’

莫非就是这种菜？”

“一点不错。

府菜一共有一百三十六样，

菜好不奇稀，奇的是每样菜都用特制的盘碗来盛。

餐具也分好几种，有金、有银、有锡、有瓷，

少一样，整桌台面都没用了，

所以衍圣公府上请贵客，专有个老成可靠的老家人管餐具。”

At great palace celebrations, such as the Tongzhi emperor's wedding or Cixi's fortieth birthday, the duke goes to Beijing to offer congratulations, taking his cooks, tableware, and rare ingredients.
“宫里有喜庆大典，象同治皇帝大婚，慈禧太后四十岁整生日，衍圣公都要进京去道喜、厨子、餐具、珍贵的材料都带了去。

Permission must first be sought for a day on which the court will enjoy his household cuisine.
须先请旨，预备哪一天享用府菜，

The food is prepared and delivered at the appointed time, though some dishes are cooked inside the palace itself.
到时候做好送进宫，有的菜是到宫里现做，

这要先跟总管太监去商量，当然也要送门包。

好在衍圣公府上产业多，不在乎。”

胡雪岩听了大为向往，

不过，他的爷爷倒是衍圣公府出身。

这里面有段曲折，谈起来蛮有趣的。”

说着，他徐徐举杯，没有下文。

不要卖关子！”

等我好好想一想。”

先说开头，乾隆未年……”

Bi Qiufan was then governor of Shandong.
乾隆来年，毕秋帆当山东巡抚。

Ruan Yuan had enjoyed early success and been in the Hanlin Academy only a few years when a major examination of Hanlin and Household of the Heir Apparent officials was held.
阮元少年得意，翰林当了没有几年，遇到“翰詹大考”，

Qianlong himself set the questions.
题目是乾隆亲自出的，

The prescribed subject for the examination poem was spectacles.
“试帖诗”的诗题是“眼镜”。

It was difficult: spectacles had entered China from the West only late in the Ming, so ancient poetry and prose offered no established allusion to them.
这个题目很难，因为眼镜是明朝未年方由西洋传入中土，所以古人诗文中，没有这个典故，

Moreover, the required rhyme was ta, an awkward choice that made the task harder still.
而且限韵“他”字，是个险韵，难上加难，

Every candidate looked distressed.
应考的无不愁眉苦脸。

Ruan was originally placed second in the first class, but Qianlong promoted him to first, saying that his rhapsody was excellent.
考试结果，阮元原为一等第二名，乾隆拔置为第一，说他的赋做得好，

In fact, it was the poem that pleased him, particularly a couplet to the effect that four eyes had no need of these things, and double pupils had no use for them.
其实是诗做得好，内中有一联：“四目何此，重瞳不用他”，为乾隆激赏，

The emperor had been unusually favoured by Heaven: even after eighty, his hearing and eyesight remained keen, and he wore no spectacles, a fact of which he often boasted to his ministers.
原来乾隆得天独厚，过了八十岁还是耳聪目明，不戴眼镜，平时常向臣下自诩。

Ruan had used the allusions to Shun's four eyes and double pupils to flatter him, implying that he perceived people and affairs so clearly that spectacles were unnecessary.
因此，阮元用舜的典故“四目”、“重瞳”来恭维他，意思是说他看人看事，非常清楚，根本用不着借助于眼镜。


First place in this examination traditionally brought promotion through three grades.
大考第一，向来是“连升三级”，

Ruan rose at once from Hanlin Compiler to junior supervisor in the Household of the Heir Apparent, and soon became educational commissioner of Shandong.
阮元一下子由编修升为詹事府少詹，不久就放了山东学政，

年纪不到三十，继弦未娶。

毕秋帆便向阮元迎养在山东的“阮老太爷”说：“小女可配衍圣公，请老伯做媒，

衍圣公的胞姐可配令郎，我做媒。”

阮元就此成了孔家的女婚。

The duke's household paid particular attention to food, following the tradition of Confucius, who did not consider food too finely prepared.
衍圣公府上的饮撰，是非常讲究的，因为孔子“食不厌精”，原有传统。

Four cooks therefore accompanied Miss Kong as part of her marriage establishment.
因此，随孔小姐陪嫁过来的，有四名厨子，

其中有一个姓何，他的孙子，就是古应春这天邀来的何厨。

“Ruan later became Governor-General of Liangguang, a famously lucrative post, and entertained frequently.
“阮元后来当两广总督，有名的肥缺，经常宴客，

Although the food did not equal the duke's household cuisine, it far surpassed anything available commercially.
菜虽不如府菜，但已经远非市面上所及。

不过不能用‘府菜’的名目，有人便叫它‘满汉全席’。

The Governor-General's cooks were often borrowed to prepare meals elsewhere.
总督衙门的厨子，常常为人借了去做菜，

That is how Cook He's grandfather settled in Guangdong, and the family became Cantonese.”
这何厨的爷爷，因此落籍，成为广东人。“

正谈到这里，鱼翅上桌，只见何厨头戴红缨帽，列席前来请安。

这是上头菜的规矩，主客照例要犒赏，

四个人享用，的确是太多了，

就一半也还是多了些，

胡雪岩吃了两小碗，摩腹说道：“我真饱了。”

接着又问：“这何厨我以前怎么没有听说过？”

“最近才从广州来。”古应春答说：

要谈条件。”

等我来问他。”

钟打九点，七姑奶奶便催胡雪岩送罗四姐回家。

在城开不夜的上海，这时还早得很，

选歌征色、纸醉金迷的几处地方，如昼锦里等等“市面”还只刚刚开始。

是先分出来的，不是吃剩的东西。”

“于是罗四姐开发了佣人的赏钱，与胡雪岩原轿归去。

到家要忙着做主人，胡雪岩将她拦住了。

罗四姐忽然觉得胸前有透不过气的感觉，

To my eyes, you are more beautiful than before.
照我看，你比从前更加漂亮了，

Like a persimmon: once green and hard, now red and soft.”
好比柿子，从前又青又硬，现在又红又软。”

Hu swallowed.
胡雪岩咽了口唾沫，

“One can imagine how sweet it would taste.”
“吃起来之甜，想都想得到的。”

She glanced at him and laughingly called him greedy.
罗四姐瞟了他一眼，笑着骂了句：“馋相！”

“Sister Luo,” he asked, “do you remember a summer when I brought you the savings-club payment, and you were alone at home…?”
“罗四姐，”胡雪岩问道：“你记不记得，有年夏天，我替你送会饯去，只有你一个人在家……”



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第五章（三）
Towers of Light — Chapter Five, Part Three
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Of course Luo remembered.
罗四姐当然记得，

She had recalled it on the evening of their reunion.
在与胡雪岩重逢那天晚上就回忆过。

It had been the thirtieth day of the seventh month, the birthday of the Bodhisattva Kshitigarbha.
那天，是七月三十日地藏王菩萨生日，

After setting out the incense, the family had gone to watch lotus lanterns being floated, leaving her alone to mind the house.
插了地藏香，全家都出去看放荷花灯，留她一个人看家，

Hu had suddenly appeared.
胡雪岩忽然闯了进来。

“What brings you here?”
“你怎么来了？”

“Your savings-club payment.
“我来送会饯。”

Today is the last day of the month.
胡雪岩说：“今天月底，

A day's delay would carry it into next month, and credit matters.
不送来迟一天就算出月了，信用要紧。

Where is everyone?”
你们家人呢？”

“Watching the lotus lanterns.
“都看荷花灯去了。”

Actually, it would have been better if you brought it tomorrow.
罗四姐又说：“其实，你倒还是明天送来的好。

I have to pass it straight on to someone else.
因为我这笔钱转手要还人家的，

In one hand and out of the other—that would be simple.
左手来，右手去，清清爽爽，

Money kept overnight will not produce little coins, and a thief might come.
你今天晚上送来，过一夜，大钱不会生小钱，说不定晚上来了贼，

Your kindness could turn into harm.”
那一来你的好意反倒害人。

“I had not thought of that.
““这一层我倒没有想到，

If I had, I would have found some way to gather it all and bring it after lunch.”
早知如此，我无论如何要凑齐了，吃过中饭就送来。”

He considered.
胡雪岩想了一下说：

“Let me take it back, then, so you need not worry.
“这样子好了，钱我带回去，省得害你担心。

Tell me who is to receive it, and I shall deliver it for you first thing tomorrow.”
这笔钱你要送给哪个，告诉我，明天一早，我替你去送。

“That would be wonderful!” she said happily.
““这样太好了。”罗四姐高兴地笑着，

“You are saving me the journey.
“你替我赔脚步，

I do not know how to thank you.”
我不晓得拿啥谢你？”

“First, give me a cup of cool tea.”
“先请我吃杯凉茶。”

“Certainly!”
“有，有！”

They had been talking in the courtyard by the light of candles set in the ground.
原来是借着插在地上的蜡烛光，在天井中说话，

For tea, she invited him into the main room.
要喝茶，便需延入堂屋。


She brought tea, and Hu drank it all.
她倒了茶来，胡雪岩一饮而尽。

He then behaved inappropriately towards Luo, and she objected.
随后他对罗四姐举止不当，她表示拒绝。

Just then someone outside called loudly, “Sister Luo!
恰好门外有人大喊：“罗四姐，

Sister Luo!”
罗四姐！”

She immediately moved away from him and answered, “Coming!”
她立刻与他拉开距离，答应一声：“来了！”

At the same time she signalled that Hu should step out of sight.
同时示意胡雪岩躲到一旁。

The visitor was a neighbour with a small inquiry, whom she answered in a few words at the door and sent away.
来的是邻居，来问一件小事，罗四姐三言两语，在门外把他打发走了。

Back inside, she kept well away from Hu.
回屋后，她站得远远的。

When he tried to approach again, she moved to the other side of the square table.
胡雪岩再想靠近时，她退到方桌对面。

“You ought to go.
“你好走了。

That thoughtless fellow’s sudden shout frightened me nearly out of my senses.
刚刚那个冒失鬼一叫，我吓得魂灵都要出窍了。

Quickly, quickly—please go.”
快，快，快点走。”


They returned to the memory of that incident.
两人又说起那次往事。

Luo’s expression showed sadness and loneliness.
罗四姐的神情有些怅惘与落寞。

“It must have been ten years ago?” Hu asked.
“这件事有十年了吧？”胡雪岩问。

“Eleven,” Luo replied.
“十一年。”罗四姐答说：

“I was sixteen that year.”
“那年我十六岁。”

He tried to pursue the old subject, but she said she did not wish to discuss it, at least not yet.
胡雪岩还想顺着旧事谈下去，罗四姐却说不愿再谈，至少现在不是时候。

“When, then?” he asked.
“要到什么时候呢？”胡雪岩问。


“I don’t know,” Luo replied.
“我不晓得。”

Then she suddenly asked, “Do you think my abilities fit me for nothing more than an embroidery shop?”
罗四姐忽然问道：“你看我的本事，就只配开一家绣庄？”

The question checked Hu's amorous thoughts.
问到这句话，胡雪岩的绮念一收，

“Let us discuss this seriously.
“我们好好来谈一谈。”

I knew how capable you were when you were still in your teens.
他说，“你的本事，十几岁我就晓得了，

Nobody was shrewder at arranging savings clubs or calculating interest.
那时候‘摇会’，盘利息，哪个都没有你精明。

Frankly, if you were a man, I would ask you to manage a bank.”
说一句实话，你如果是男的，我要请你管钱庄。

“Compliments cost nothing.”
““卖高帽子不要本钱的。”

She smiled.
罗四姐笑道：

“But I am not convinced by your claim that only a man can manage a bank.”
“不管你说一定要男的才好管钱庄，这话我倒不大服气。”

“Do not misunderstand.
“你不要误会。

I am not saying that you are less capable.
我不是说你本事不如男的，

It is inconvenient for a woman—especially one as beautiful as you.
是女人家不大方便，尤其是你这样子漂亮，

The clerks would quarrel over you, and my bank would be ruined.”
下面的伙计为了你争风吃醋，我的钱庄就要倒灶了。”

“How outrageous!”
“要死！”

Her feet were not tiny three-inch golden lilies, but the larger sort that had been bound and then released, described as having ginger for sale in front and duck eggs behind.
罗四姐的一双脚虽非三寸金莲，但也是所谓“前面卖生姜，后面卖鸭蛋”裹了又放的半大脚，

Laughing, she became a little unsteady and reached for the table, only to have Hu catch her hand.
笑得有些立足不稳，伸出一只手去想扶桌沿，却让胡雪岩一把抄住了。

“Never mind the clerks.
“不要说伙计，”

I might be unable to concentrate on business myself, worrying all day that some customer would marry you and take you away.”
胡雪岩笑道，“就是我，只怕也没心思在生意上头了，一天到晚担心，哪个客人会把你讨了去。”

In Hangzhou, the expression he used meant taking a wife.
杭州人叫“娶亲”为“讨亲”，

It touched Luo's old sorrow.
这最后一句话，又勾起罗四姐的心事，

“Enough!”
“不要说了！”

She drew back her hand, sat aside, and said softly, “I can only blame my unhappy fate.”
她夺回了手，坐到一旁，幽幽地说：“总怪我自己命苦。”

“I feel unhappy too,” Hu offered in sympathy.
“我也难过啊！”胡雪岩以同感表示安慰，

“If only I had married two years later.”
“我迟两年讨老婆就好了。”

She gave a faint, cold laugh.
“哼！”罗四姐微微冷笑，

“Fine words come easily to you.”
“你嘴里说得好听。”

“Whether they are merely fine words, time will show.
“好听不好听，你等着看将来。”

But to return to business: you say your abilities extend beyond an embroidery shop.
胡雪岩说道：“言归正传，你说你的本事不止于开一爿绣庄，

What larger enterprise have you in mind?
那么，还有啥大生意好做？

Tell me.”
你说来我听听看。”


She lowered her eyes to the tabletop, her lashes moving as though absorbed in calculation.
罗四姐不作声，低着头看桌面，睫毛不住眨动，盘算得好象出神了。

At last she looked up. “Let us talk tomorrow.
“明天再说。”罗四姐抬眼说道：

Will you come for a simple meal?”
“你明天来吃便饭好不好？”

“Gladly.
“怎么不好？

I shall come early in the afternoon so that we can talk at length.”
我明天下半天早一点来，好多谈谈。”

“No.
“不！

Come for lunch and leave early in the afternoon.
你明天来吃中饭，下半天早一点走。

Evenings are inconvenient.”
晚上总不方便。”

Hu considered his engagements.
胡雪岩想了一下说：

He had two invitations for lunch the next day, one involving official business that he could not miss.
“明天中午我有两个饭局，有一个是要谈公事，不能不到。

The day after, he also had an engagement, but it could be declined.
这倒麻烦了。”“那么后天呢？”后天中午已有应酬，不过可以推掉的。

Luo settled on that day, and he reluctantly agreed.
““那就后天。”胡雪岩无奈，只好答说：“后天就后天。”

“I shall make a couple of Hangzhou dishes for you.
“后天我弄两个杭州菜给你吃。”

Now let me act as hostess on the Seventh Lady's behalf and offer you supper.”
罗四姐又说：“现在我代七姑奶奶做主人，请你吃消夜。”

Hu had little appetite, but the thought of not seeing her the next day made him reluctant to leave.
胡雪岩胃口不太好，本不想吃，但想到第二夭不能会面，便有些不舍之意，

Supper would provide an excuse to linger.
惜吃消夜盘桓一会也好，

He nodded, asking her not to go to any trouble.
便点点头：“不必费事！”

“Everything is ready.
“现在的东西。”

Shall we eat downstairs?”
罗四姐说，“到楼下去吃好不好？”

Drinking a little together upstairs would have been more agreeable, but would involve extra work and contradict his request.
原要在楼上小酌才够味，但那一来比较费事，变成言行不符，

He rose and followed her down.
只好站起身来，跟着罗四姐下楼。

“What would you like to drink?”
“你吃什么酒？”

“Anything.
“随便。”

I am no drinker; I shall merely keep you company.”
胡雪岩说：“我又不会吃酒，完全陪你。”

“Then join me in some medicinal wine I have infused myself.”
“谢谢。既然你陪我，就陪我吃我自己泡的药酒。”

“Ah!
“喔，

That reminds me…”
我倒想起来了……”

“Wait until I have laid the table.”
“慢点！”罗四姐说：“等我把桌子摆好了再说。”


Four dishes appeared: ham, crisp eel, vegetarian mock chicken, and dried croaker preserved in wine lees, all sent by the Seventh Lady.
桌子上摆出来四个碟子，火腿、脆鳝、素鸡糟白鲞是七姑奶奶送的。

Luo also brought a white porcelain jar.
罗四姐另外捧来一个白瓷坛，

The medicinal wine she poured from it had an unappealing colour but an enticing fragrance.
倒出来的药酒，颜色不佳，但香味扑鼻，发人酒兴。

“This looks promising.
“你这酒看样子不坏，

Do you have the recipe?”
有没有方子？”

“Yes.
“有。

It is called Duke Zhou's Hundred-Year Wine.
名叫周公百岁酒。

I can copy it for you.”
你要，我抄一个给你。”

“The more recipes of this kind, the better.
“有这种方子，越多越好。”

I intend to open a pharmacy and sell medicinal wines.”
胡雪岩说，“我想开一家药店，将来要卖药酒。”

Surprised, she asked what had suddenly given him that idea.
罗四诅不由得诧异，“怎么忽然想起来要开药店？”她问。

“Several things.
“其中有好些缘故。

One is a request for a very large quantity of prepared medicines.
有个缘故是有人要我办各样成药，数量很大，

I thought that opening a pharmacy myself would be both convenient and a way to ensure proper quality.”
我心里在想，不如自己开一家药店，既方便，又道地。”

Who had made the request, and why so much medicine?
“这个人是哪个？要那许多成药，做啥用场？”

Zuo's soldiers on the western campaign had begun suffering from difficulty adjusting to unfamiliar climates and conditions.
原来左宗棠的西征将士，已发现有水土不服的现象，

Letters to the Shanghai transshipment bureau requested large quantities of pills, powders, plasters, and other remedies.
寄信到上海转运局，要采办大批丸散膏丹，

This had prompted Hu's plan for a substantial pharmacy.
因而触发了胡雪岩自己设一座大规模的药铺的构想。

He had already obtained an official communication from the Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu requesting tax exemption, and had sent buyers to Anguo County in Zhili, the largest centre for crude medicinal ingredients, to purchase authentic supplies.
目前已请了一道陕甘总督衙门所发、请予免税的公文，派人到生药最大的集散地，直隶安国县采办道地药材去了。

Nothing interested him more than this plan, which he regarded as a practical means of relieving suffering and encouraging the troops.
对于这个计划，胡雪岩最感兴趣，认为是救世济民、鼓励士气最切实的一件事，

Once started, he spoke without pause.
一谈起来，滔滔不绝。

Luo listened closely and asked concise questions whenever something was unclear.
罗四姐很用心地倾听着，遇有他说得欠明白之处，会要言不烦地提出疑问。

Seeing that she both understood the project and cared about his work, he grew still more enthusiastic.
这表示她不但能够领会他的计划，而且也关心他的事业，胡雪岩便越加兴奋了。

They talked into the third watch.
一谈谈到三更天，

At last he noticed neighbours looking curiously at the brilliant lights in her house and the chair bearers talking and laughing loudly outside.
胡雪岩发现左右邻居看她家半夜里灯火辉煌，门前轿班高声谈笑，都好奇地在张望，

Ashamed of the disturbance, he could no longer justify staying.
不免抱愧，也不好意思再作流连。

“The day after tomorrow at noon, then.
“好了，后天中午再来。”

If we talk any longer, the neighbours will curse us.”
胡雪岩站起身来说：“再谈下去，邻居要骂人了。”


On the third morning, Hu went as usual to Fukang Bank.
到得第三天上午，胡雪岩照例先到阜康钱庄办事，

He was told that Weiji had withdrawn nine thousand taels in seventeen bank drafts of differing amounts.
有人告诉他说，“维记”来提了九千两银子，开出数目大小不等的十七张庄票。

He remembered the information but asked no questions.
胡雪岩记在心里，并未多问。

Feeling that his previous visit to Luo had been too conspicuous, he took only one attendant this time and took a Hengsimei carriage instead of a sedan chair.
由于那天到罗四姐家，自觉太招摇了，这天只带了一个跟班，亦未乘轿，而且坐了一辆“亨斯美”马车，

Alighting at the entrance to her lane, he sent the carriage away and walked to the house.
在罗家弄口下车，将马车打发回去，步行赴约。

It was not yet noon, and seven or eight customers were still waiting in her reception room.
本未过午，罗家客厅里还坐着七、八个客户在等候发落。

Luo rose without embarrassment. “Please sit down, Mr Hu.
“胡大先生请坐。”罗四姐大大方方地站起来说：

I shall be finished very soon.”
“我马上就好了。”

“There is no hurry.
“不忙，不忙！

Attend to your business.”
你尽管请治公。”

Holding a cup of tea, he watched quietly as she gave clear, brisk explanations and directions.
胡雪岩捧着一杯茶，悄悄坐在一边，看罗四姐处事，口讲指画，十分明快。

Her customers seemed to accept her authority: what she said was done, without argument.
她的客户似乎也服她，说如何便如何，绝无争执，

In scarcely the time needed to drink the tea, everyone had departed.
所以不过一盏茶的工夫，都打发走了。

“Admirable!”
“佩服，佩服。”

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑道：

“You really are capable.”
“实在能干。”

“We do not know that yet.
“能干不能干还不晓得。

Wait until the land I bought for you rises in value before praising me.”
等我替你买的地皮涨了价，你再恭维我。”

He was bewildered.
胡雪岩摸不着头脑，

“What are you talking about?”
“罗四姐，”他问：“你在说啥？”

“I shall explain over lunch.
“等等吃饭的时候再同你讲。

Sit a little longer while I go to the kitchen.”
你请坐一坐，我要下厨房了。”


Most of the meal was ready.
厨房里菜都预备得差不多了，

Fish head and bean curd simmered on the stove; pieces of pork were in the steamer.
炉子上炖着鱼头豆腐，“件儿肉”在蒸宠里，

Brined shrimps, crucian carp braised with spring onions, and vegetarian mock chicken had been prepared earlier.
凉菜盐水虾、葱焖鲫鱼和素鸡，是早做好了的，

She needed only to fry crisp bean-curd-skin rolls and stir-fry shepherd's purse with spring bamboo shoots.
起油锅炸个“响铃儿”，再炒一个荠菜春笋，就可以开饭了。

“Nothing fine to offer you.
“没有啥好东西请你。”

But you eat shark's fin and sea cucumber every day and must be tired of them.
罗四姐说：“不过我想，你天天鱼翅海参，大概也吃腻了，

A few simple, refreshing home dishes might persuade you to eat another bowl of rice.”
倒不如清清爽爽几样家常菜，或许反例可以多吃一碗饭。”

“Exactly.”
“一点不错。”

Hu sat down happily.
胡雪岩欣然落座，

“I had little appetite before, but now I am hungry.”
“本来没有啥胃口，现在倒真有点饿了。”

She smiled, poured medicinal wine, and served him.
罗四姐笑笑不作声，只替他斟了一杯药酒，然后布菜。

He ate with relish, much to her pleasure.
胡雪岩吃得很起劲，罗四姐当然也很高兴。

“I did not understand what you said about land.
“你刚才说什么地皮不地皮，我没有听懂。

Please explain.”
请你再说一遍。”

“I withdrew nine thousand taels yesterday from the account you gave me.
罗四姐点点头，“你给我的折子，我昨天去提了九千两银子。”

Did you know?”
她问，“你晓得不晓得？”

“They told me.”
“他们告诉我了。”

“When the British concession renamed its roads two years ago, I noticed how methodically the foreigners proceeded.
“从前年英租界改路名的辰光，我就看出来了，外国人办事按部就班，有把握的，

Wherever they built a road, land prices rose.
马路修到哪里，地价涨到哪里，

Unfortunately, I had no spare money to buy any.
可惜我没有闲钱来买地皮。

A couple of months ago someone approached me about a plot on Shandong Road…”
前两个月还有人来兜我，说山东路……”

“Wait.
“慢点！”

Where is Shandong Road?”
胡雪岩问道：“山东路在啥地方？”

“Temple Street.”
“就是庙街。”


When the British concession's roads were first laid out, they received English names for the foreigners' convenience: Consulate Road where the consulates gathered, and Customs Road where the Jianghaiguan stood. During the Warring States period, Shanghai had belonged to the fief of Lord Chunshen, Huang Xie of Chu.
原来英租街新造的马路，最初方便他们自己，起的是英文名字，例如领事馆集中之处，名为Consulate Road，江海关所在地名为Customs Road.上海在战国时，原为楚国春申君黄歇的封邑，

To relieve flooding in the Songjiang region, he had opened a channel to carry water to the sea.
当时为了松江水患，要导流入海，春申君开了一条浦江，

It was called the Huangpu after his surname, or Huang Xie Pu.
用好的姓，称为黄浦江，或称黄歇浦，

Other names for Shanghai—Chunshen Pu, Chunshen Jiang, and Shenjiang—came from the same association.
此外春申浦、春申江、申江，种种上海的别称，都由此而来。

Later generations had built a shrine to honour his achievement, also known as Lord Chunshen's temple, but its site could no longer be identified.
后人为了崇功报德，曾建了一座春申侯词，又称春申君庙，但年深月久，遗址无处可寻。

Tradition held that Yanzhen Temple, established in the Ming near Sanmaoge Bridge to worship the Three Mao Immortals, had originally been that shrine.
相传建于明朝、地在三茅阁桥、供奉“三茅真君”的延真观，原来就是春申君庙，

The British therefore named a nearby road Temple Street.
英国人便将开在那里的一条马路，称为Temple Street，译成中文便是“庙街”。

Place names in the concession were confused, and the Municipal Council had long wanted a uniform system.
英租界的地名很乱，工部局早就想反它统一起来，

East–west roads were to bear the names of major Chinese cities, while north–south roads would take provincial names.
将界内的马路，分为两类，横的一类从东到西，用中国主要的城市命名，纵的自南至北，以中国的省名命名，

Consulate Road became Beijing Road.
因此领事馆路改名北京路，

Nanjing supplied the next great city's name, given to the road extending west from the Bund park.
而第二个大城市是南京。便将外滩公园向西延伸的马路，改名南京路。

Temple Street ran north–south and became Shandong Road.
庙街是南北向，改名山东路。

This had happened two years earlier, but Hu had paid no attention and did not recognize the new name.
那是前两年的事，胡雪岩未尝留意于此，所以罗四姐提起这个新地名，他茫然莫辨。

Temple Street he knew.
庙街他是知道的，

“Ah!
“呃，”

Someone offered you land there?”
他问：“有人兜你买庙街的地皮？”


“The road is now being extended southwards.
“庙街现在是往南在造马路，

Land there is certain to rise, so I withdrew nine thousand taels and bought more than twenty mu.
那里的地皮，一定会涨价，所以我提了九千两银子出来，买了二十多亩地皮，

The transaction is complete.”
已经成交了。”

Hu was astonished.
胡雪岩大为诧异，

Buying property could remain unsettled for months or years, yet she had finished in a single day.
求田问舍，往往经年累月，不能定局，她居然一天工夫就定局了，

Had someone deceived her?
莫非受入哄骗不成？

Reading his expression, she asked whether he disbelieved her.
罗四姐看他的脸色，猜到他的心里，“你不相信？”她问。

“Not that.
“不是我不相信，

It simply seems very quick.
只觉得太快了。”胡雪岩问，

Have you any documents for the land?”
“你买的地皮，有没有啥凭证？”

“Of course.
“怎么没有”，

I have official lease deeds and authority certificates.”
我有‘道契’，还有‘权柄单’。

He was still more surprised.
胡雪岩更为惊异，

“You have even completed the minor transfer?
“你连‘小过户’都弄好了？”他说：

You really are capable.”
“你的本事真大。”

“If you do not believe me, I shall show you.”
“你不相信，我拿东西给你看。”


She brought three official lease deeds.
于是罗四姐去取了三张“道契”来。

Following defeat in the Opium War and the Treaty of Nanjing in Daoguang's twenty-second year, five ports had opened to foreign trade and foreigners had begun arriving in numbers.
原来鸦片战争失败，道光二十二年签订《南京条约》，开五口通商，洋人纷纷东来，

Their settlement, however, posed a problem.
但定居却成了疑问。

All land beneath Heaven belonged to the sovereign; Chinese land could not be sold to foreigners.
“普天之下，莫非玉土”，中国的土地是不能卖给洋人的，

Some accommodation had to be devised.
这就不能不想个变通办法了。

In Daoguang's twenty-fifth year, the British consul and the Shanghai circuit intendant therefore agreed on land regulations establishing perpetual leases.
于是道光二十五年由英国领事跟上海道签订了一份“地皮，章程”，规定了一种“永租”的办法。

A foreigner negotiated with an owner, paid annual rent for a plot, and built upon it.
洋人跟土地业主接头，年纳租金若干，租得地皮，起造房屋，

In addition, the owner received a sum roughly equal to ten years' rent, called a deposit but effectively the purchase price.
另外付给业主约相当于年租十倍的金额，称为“押手”，实际上就是地价。

Once a lease was agreed, the neighbouring locality had to be notified.
租约成立后须通知邻近的地方，

The local headman accompanied representatives of the circuit intendant and consulate to measure the property, establish its boundaries, and record them with a plan on the deed.
由地保带领，会同上海道及领事馆所派人员，会同丈量，确定四至界限，在契纸上附图写明白，

The consul forwarded it to the circuit intendant for examination.
由领事转送上海道查核。

If all was correct, the official sealed the lease deed and returned it to the lessee.
如果查明无误，即由上海道在“出租地契”加盖印信，交承祖人收执，

Such a document was called a daoqi, an official lease deed.
这就是所谓“道契”。

It established rights and responsibilities clearly, making disputes easier to decide than under old Chinese deeds, whose vagueness could turn a dispute into years of litigation and bitter regret. As the saying went, “However wealthy you are, never buy property that brings you grief.”
这种“道契”，产权清楚，责任确实，倘有纠葛，打起官司，是非分明，比中国旧式的地契，含糊不清，一生纠葛，涉讼经年，真是“有钱不置懊恼产”，海不当初。

People accordingly devised a nominal arrangement: a foreigner would obtain a daoqi on a Chinese owner's behalf.
因此就有人想出一个办法，请洋人出面代领道契，这原是假买假卖的花样，

After agreeing terms and receiving his fee, the foreigner issued an authority certificate acknowledging that he held the property for its owner, who could dispose of it freely at any time.
所以在谈妥条件，付给酾劳以后，洋人要签发一张代管产业，业主随时可以自由处置凭证，名为“权柄单”。

This was called nominee registration, and Shanghai had foreign brokers specializing in it.
而这种做法，称之为“挂号”，上海专有这种“挂号洋商”。

Before buyers and sellers concluded their transaction, they paid the broker to issue a replacement authority certificate.
地皮买卖双方订约成交之前，到“挂号洋商”那里，付费改签一张“权柄单”，

The original daoqi need not be changed; it passed to the buyer with equal validity.
原道契不必更易，照样移转给买方，一样有效。

This was a minor transfer.
这就叫“小过户”。

Luo's three deeds naturally came with three authority certificates, written in English.
罗四姐这三张道契，当然附有三张“权柄单”，是用英文所写。

Hu had learned a little English through years of dealing with foreigners.
胡雪岩多年跟洋人打交道，略识英文，

When he saw that the named owner was himself, he understood why she had said she had bought the land for him.
一看洋人所签的“抬头”是自己的英文名字，方始恍然，怪不得罗四姐有“我替你买的地皮”的话。


“No, no!
“不要，不要！

The land is yours.”
地皮是你的。”

Taking the deeds and certificates, Hu said he would have another minor transfer made into her name.
胡雪岩将道契与权柄单拿到手中，“我叫人再办一次‘小过户’，过得你的名下。”

“There is no need.
“你也不必去过户，

Transferring it back and forth merely gives the foreigner more fees.
过来过去，白白挑洋人赚手续费。

But you ought to show the three authority certificates to Brother-in-Law Gu.
不过，你把三张权柄单去拿给七姐夫看看，倒是对的。

He knows English and understands the foreign settlement.
他懂洋文，洋场又熟悉，

If anything is wrong, we can raise it with the foreigner promptly.”
看看有什么不妥当的地方，趁早好同洋人去办交涉。”

“I shall.
“我晓得了。”

But I truly do not understand where you learned to buy land and complete every formality in a day.
胡雪岩问道：“罗四姐，我真有点想不通，你哪里学来的本事，会买地皮，而且一天工夫把手续都办好了。

Even a professional might not manage it so quickly.”
说真的，叫专门搞这一行的人去办，也未见得有你这么快。”

“Nonsense.
“没有的话。

Foreigners are straightforward about business.
洋人做事情最爽炔，

Once buyer and seller agree, they need only register it and sign to collect a fee.
你们双方谈好了，到他那里去挂个号，签个字就有多少银子进帐，

Why should they create delays?
他为啥要推三阻四？

The middlemen deliberately drag matters out for a couple of days to make their errand fees seem hard-earned.” She explained her own experience.
不过搞这一行的人，一定要拖两天，为啥呢？为的是显得他的脚步钱赚得辛苦。象我……”罗四姐拿她自己的经验为证。

After agreeing to buy the Shandong Road land, she had engaged a specialist to handle the minor transfer for ten taels.
谈妥了山东路的那块地皮，找个专门替人办“小过户”的人要去挂号，讲妥十两银子的“脚步钱”，

He claimed it would take five days.
却说需五天才能办得好。

Having heard of this trick, she said she would pay the same fee but employ him only as an interpreter while she dealt with the foreigner herself.
罗四姐听人讲过其中的花样，当即表示只请他去当翻译，妒自己跟洋人打交道，脚步钱照付，

The business was indeed completed in a single visit.
果然，一去就办妥当了。

“Here is something amusing: the foreigner even invited me to a Western meal.
“我还说句笑话给你听，那个洋人还要请我吃大菜。

他说他那里从来没有看见我们中国的女人家上门过。

他佩服我胆子大，要请请我。”

“Did you accept?” Hu asked, smiling.
“那么，你吃了他的大菜没有呢？”胡雪岩笑着问说。

“No.
“没有。”

I said I was brave enough to ask him to do business, but not brave enough to eat his food.
罗四姐说：“我说我有胆子来请他办事，没有胆子吃他的饭，

When the interpreter translated it, he laughed heartily.” Hu laughed too.
同去的人翻译给他听了，洋人哈哈大笑。”胡雪岩也笑了，

“Never mind the foreigner: I admire you myself.
“不要说洋人，我也要佩服。”

Now I understand.
他紧接着又说：“罗四姐，我现在才懂了，

You think an embroidery shop too small to display your abilities, do you not?”
你是嫌开绣庄的生意太小，显不出你的本事是不是？”


“I would not presume to say that.
“也不敢这样子说。”

But you have plenty of funds available at your bank.
罗四姐反问一句：“胡大先生，你钱庄里的头寸很多，

为啥不买一批地皮呢？”

“I have never considered it.” Hu explained that his view of money differed from other people's.
“我从来没有想过买地。”胡雪岩说他对钱的看法，与人不同，

Money ought to flow like spring water.
钱要象泉水一样，流动才好，

Buying land and waiting for its value to rise was like keeping water in a pond: only Heaven could supply the rain that raised the level.
买了地等涨价，就好比池塘里的水一样，要靠老天帮忙，多下几场雨，水才会涨，

A prolonged drought would dry it up.
如果久旱不雨，池塘就干涸了。

He disdained business that depended on such chance.
这种靠天吃饭的事，他不屑去做。

“That view is out of date,” Luo said, boldly criticizing him.
“你的说法过时了。”罗四姐居然开口批评胡雪岩，

“Elsewhere, land rises slowly and is difficult to sell.
“在别处地方，买田买地，涨价涨得慢，脱手也不容易，

The money does become stagnant water.
钱就变了一池死水，

But in Shanghai the foreigners are building roads day and night.
在上海，现在外国人日日夜夜造马路，

Once a road is complete, the fields along it can carry houses, and prices rise at once.
一造好，马路两边的田就好造房子，地价马上就涨了。

Buyers can also resell easily.
而且买地皮的人，脱手也容易，

With brisk demand and quick sales, land ceases to be immovable property and becomes movable capital.
行情俏，脱手快，地皮就不是不动产而是动产了。

How is that different from your stocking silk and cocoons?”
这跟你囤丝囤茧子有啥两样？

Hu was taken aback.
“一听这话，胡雪岩愣住了，

He had not expected such an acute insight and felt genuinely outmatched.
想不到她有这样高明的见解，真有自愧不如之感。

“I must be going.
“我要去了。”

Let us have rice.”
胡雪岩说：“吃饭吧！”

She brought a shallow bowl.
罗四姐盛了浅浅一碗饭来，

He poured soup over it and quickly finished, then sent his attendant to hail a street carriage at the entrance to the lane. He went to the transshipment bureau to conduct business and receive visitors.
胡雪岩拿汤泡了，啼哩呼噜一下子吃完，唤跟班上来，到弄口叫了一辆“野鸡马车”到转运局办公会客。

晚上应酬完了，半夜来看古应春夫妇。

Sister Luo knows how to deal in land and negotiate directly with foreigners.
罗四姐会做地皮生意，会直接跟洋人去打交道。

Look!”
你们看！

Examining the deeds and certificates, Gu asked in surprise whether Hu had commissioned the purchase.
“古应春看了道契跟权柄单，诧异地问道：“小爷叔，你托她买的。”

Hu said no and explained everything.
“不是！”胡雪岩将其中原委，细细说了一遍。

“Sister Luo is a formidable woman,” the Seventh Lady remarked.

“Little Uncle…”
小爷叔……”

她欲言又止，始终没有再说下去。

胡雪岩有点听出来了，并未追问，

只跟古应春谈如何再将这三块地皮再过户给罗四姐的事。

“I know this foreign registration broker,” Gu said.
“这个挂号的洋人我知道，

“He sometimes plays tricks.
有时候会耍花样，

索性花五十两银子办个‘大过户’好了。”

Without asking what a full transfer involved, Hu left the arrangements to him.
胡雪岩也不问他什么叫“大过户”，只说：“你随便。好在托了你了。”

“What is Sister Luo's name?” Gu asked.
“罗四姐的名字叫什么？”

“There you have me.”
“这，把我问倒了。”

“Sister Luo is Sister Luo,” his wife said.
“罗四姐就是罗四姐。”七姑奶奶说：

“Surname Luo, given name Sijie.
“姓罗名四姐，

What is wrong with that?” Hu laughed.
有啥不可以？”胡雪岩笑道：

“Seventh Sister settles a matter with a single stroke.
“真是，七姐说话，一刮两响，

She has judgment.” Gu laughed too, though rather ruefully, and rose with an air of casualness.
真正有裁缝。”古应春也笑了，不过是苦笑，搭讪着站起来说：

“I shall write her name in English.”
“我来把她的名字，用英文翻出来。”


When Gu had gone into his study, Hu moved closer to the Seventh Lady and lowered his voice.
等古应春走入书房，胡雪岩移一移座位靠近七姑奶奶，轻声说道：

“七姐，有件事，我想跟你商量。

Since the two younger women in my household died in an epidemic, and with my wife's health poor, Mother still has to trouble herself with domestic affairs at times.
自从两个小的，一场时疫去世以后，内人身子又不好，家务有时候还要靠老太太操心，

It is hardly right.
实在说不过去。

I am very fond of Sister Luo.
这罗四姐，我很喜欢她，

I wonder… can anything be arranged?”
不晓得……七姐，你看有没有法子好想？

“I have already considered it.
““我已经替你想过了，

If she would marry you, Little Uncle, you would be a tiger given wings.
罗四姐如果肯嫁你，小爷叔，你是如虎添翼，

You would prosper still further.
着实还要发达。

But whether she will accept the position of a concubine is difficult to say.”
不过，她肯不肯做小，真的很难说。”

“七姐，你能不能探探她的口气？”

“More than that: we must find a way.
“不光是探口气，还要想办法。”

七姑奶奶问道：“ ‘两头大’呢？”

胡雪岩又说：“只要她肯在名分上委屈，其余的，我都照原配看待她。”

I understand.

好在婶娘贤慧，也决不会亏待她的。”

七姑奶奶言而有信，第二天上午就去看罗四姐，帮她应付完了客户，在楼上吃饭，

那时候，有人有啥事情来寻我帮忙，譬如来一脚会，如果叫我阿荷，就不成功。

这样子才把我罗四姐这个名字叫开来的。““原来还有这么一段掌故。”七姑奶奶笑道：

为啥要丈夫怕？”罗四姐摇摇头，

现在更谈不到了。”

一定还会有人怕你。”

七姑奶奶很深沉，点点头说：

照你这份人材，普普通通的人不配娶你，

这种怕，有啥用处？”

“七姐，你这话真有道理。”

七姑奶奶把话拉回正题，

到头来还是空的。”

“七姐，命也靠不住。”

When I was little, everyone who read mine said it was excellent.
罗四姐说，“我小的时候，人家替我算命，都说命好，

Look at me now.
你看我现在，

Where is the excellence?”
命好在哪里？

“What did they say?”
““喔，当初算你的命，怎么说法？”

“I did not understand much of it.
“我也不大懂，

Only that a jiazi day and a jiazi hour made an unusually rich and honourable destiny.”
只说甲子日、甲子时，难得的富贵命。”

“Perhaps the wealth and honour lie ahead.”
“作兴富贵在后头。”

“What future is there?
“哪里有什么后头，

With a son, there might be hope.
有儿子还有希望，

Like the White Lady: after a lifetime of suffering, her son became the top examination graduate and she could hold her head high at last.
好比白娘娘，吃了一世的苦，到后来儿子中了状元，总算扬眉吐气了。

What have I?”
我呢？有啥？”

“Could you not marry again and have one?
“你不会再嫁人，生一个？”

There is a Wu Tiekou on Second Road whose predictions everyone calls extraordinarily accurate.
七姑奶奶紧接着又说：“二马路有个吴铁口，大家都说他算的命，灵极了，

I shall take you to see him sometime.”
几时我陪你去看看他。”

Had the Seventh Lady consulted him herself?
“七姐，请他算过？”

She said she had, and that his prediction had certainly proved true. He had foretold a bijie period in the first half of this year.
“算过。”“灵不灵呢？”“当然灵。”七姑奶奶说：“他说我今年上半年交的是‘比劫运’，果然应验了。”

Asked what that meant, she explained that it was a period of friendship and brotherhood.
“什么叫‘比劫运’？”‘比劫运就是交朋友兄弟的运，

Had they not become as close as sisters at their first meeting?
我跟你一见就象亲姐妹一样，不是交比劫运？

Luo was persuaded and asked when they could go.
“罗四姐让她说动心了，“好啊！”她问：“哪一天去？”

“His business is tremendously busy.
“吴铁口的生意闹猛得不得了！

You must book in advance, whether for a full reading or the year's fortunes.
算命看流年，都要预先挂号的。

I shall send someone to register and let you know the appointment.”
等我叫人去挂号，看排定在啥辰光，我来通知你。”


Back at home, the Seventh Lady immediately asked Gu whether he knew Wu Tiekou well.
七姑奶奶回到家，立刻就找她丈夫问道：“二马路的吴铁口，是不是跟你很熟？”

“We are companions at courtesan banquets.
“吃花酒的朋友。”古应春问道：

Why do you ask?”
“你问他是为啥？”

“I have a set of birth characters…”
“我有个八字……”

“Enough!
“算了，算了！”

It is all a charlatan's formula, saying whatever suits the listener.
古应春兜头浇了她一盆冷水，“完全是江湖诀，见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话，

Believe him and you invite trouble.”
你相信他就自讨苦吃了。”

“That is precisely what I want him to do.
“我就是要他‘见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话，。

Let him examine these birth characters first, and then say what I instruct.”
我有个八字在这里，请他先看一看，到时候要他照我的说法。”

“What you instruct?
“照你的说法？”

Whose birth characters?”
古应春问道：“是什么人的八字？”

“Sister Luo's.
“罗四姐的。

Snake year, the fifteenth of the sixth month, a jiazi day and a jiazi hour.” Gu began to understand.
她属蛇，六月望生日。甲子日、甲子时。”古应春有些会意了，

“Very well.
“好吧！”

What do you want him to say?”
他说，“你要他怎么说？”

“Before that, I have two questions.
“你先不要问我，我要问你两件事：

Will he follow my instructions?
第一，他肯不肯照我的话说，

And can he make it sound convincing?”
第二，说得圆不圆？”

“He will certainly follow them—if you pay a larger fee.”
“好，那么我告诉你：第一，一定肯照你的话说，不过润金要多付。”

“That is a small matter.
“这是小事，

I am afraid he may fail to make it convincing, or even reveal the trick.
就怕他说得不圆，甚至于露马脚，

That would ruin my plan.”
那就误我的大事了。”

“He is devilishly clever and will not give himself away.
此人鬼聪明，决不会露马脚，

Whether his account withstands scrutiny depends on whether the other person knows the subject.”
至于说得圆不圆，要看对方是不是行家。

“Why?”
““这是啥道理呢？”

“An expert can find faults and expose gaps.
“行家会挑他的毛病，捉他的漏洞。

His profession has a saying: submit your reading to challenge, and you put your life in another's hands.”
他们这一行有句话，叫做‘若要盘驳’性命交脱‘。

“Tell him not to worry.
“你叫他放心，

His life will certainly be safe.”
他的性命一定保得住。”



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第五章（四，至本章结束）
Towers of Light — Chapter Five, Part Four (conclusion)
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


On the afternoon of the third day, the Seventh Lady accompanied Luo Sijie to consult Wu Tiekou.
第三天下午，七姑奶奶陪了罗四姐去请教吴铁口。

He lived on Second Road, whose English name had been Rope Walk Road, translated into Chinese as Towpath Road.
他住的二马路，英文名字叫做Rope Walk Road，翻译出来是“纤道路”，

In the early days, boats could still use Yangjing Creek, but the shallow water made towing necessary.
当初洋泾浜还可以通船，不过水浅要拉纤，

When the towpath was turned into a road, it retained that name.
这条纤路改成马路，就叫纤道路。

The local people could not manage the English street names, so they called Garden Lane, the first road opened, First Road.
本地人叫不来英文路名，就拿首先开辟的Garden Lane叫做大马路，

The next to the south became Second Road, followed by Third, Fourth and Fifth Roads, all running east and west, down to Yangjing Creek.
往南第二条便叫二马路，以下三马路、四马路、五马路，一直到洋泾浜，都是东西向。

Two years earlier, First Road had been renamed Nanjing Road and Second Road Hangzhou Road.
前两年大马路改名南京路，二马路改名杭州路，

Someone pointed out to the foreigners that there were two waterways between Nanjing and Hangzhou, the Yangtze and the Grand Canal.
有人跟洋人说，南京到杭州的水路是两条，一条长江，一条运河，

Since Nanjing was on the lower Yangtze, the name of a major port farther upstream would make a more fitting companion to Nanjing Road.
南京是长江下游，要挑个长江上游的大码头当路名，跟南京路才连得起来，

Second Road was therefore renamed Jiujiang Road, and Third Road, formerly Customs Road, naturally became Hankou Road.
因而改为九江路，三马路也就是“海关路”，自然成为汉口路。

Shanghai people were accustomed to the old names, however, and continued to say First Road and Second Road.
不过上海人叫惯了，仍旧称做大马路、二马路。


Second Road had been opened early, and its shops and businesses had long flourished.
二马路开辟得早，市面早就繁华了。

Wu Tiekou's place for receiving clients was in Fuhou Lane: the first house on the right.
吴铁口“候教”之处在二马路富厚里，进弄堂右首第一家就是，

Two stone-gated houses had been joined together, making a large reception hall.
二座石库房子打通，客堂很大，

Its walls were covered with inscribed plaques presented by high officials, wealthy merchants and distinguished men.
上面挂满了达官巨商名流送的匾额，

Hu Xueyan had given one himself, bearing the words “Supreme Mastery of Ziping Astrology.”
胡雪岩也送了一块，题的是“子平绝诣”四字，

It hung on the north partition, beside a door leading to Wu's consulting room.
挂在北面板壁上，板壁旁边有一道门，里面就是吴铁口设砚之处。

Wu had a square face, large ears and a moustache that spread down on either side.
那吴铁口生得方面大耳，两撇八字胡子，

He was only a little over thirty, but his large dark-crystal spectacles made him look older.
年纪只有三十出头，不过戴了一副大墨晶眼镜，看上去比较老气，

He wore a lined robe of date-red satin beneath a black jacket patterned with round floral medallions.
身上穿的是枣红缎子夹袍，外套玄色团花马褂，

An enormous stone called pinxia was set in the band of his blue-satin cap.
头上青缎小帽，帽檐上镶一块极大的玭霞，

His fingernails were very long.
手上留着极长的指甲，

On his left thumb he wore an archer's ring of Han jade, on his right ring finger a platinum ring set with a square diamond; a bright gold watch chain crossed his chest.
左手大拇指上套一个汉玉扳指，右手无名指上还有一枚方钻白金戒指，马褂上又是黄澄澄横过胸前的一条金表链，

He was dressed like a fashionable rake.
打扮得象个花花公子。

“Mrs Gu!”
“古太太，”

He rose to greet them, four purses of different sizes dangling beneath his jacket.
吴铁口起身迎接，马褂下面垂着四个大小荷包，

Removing his spectacles, he smiled.
他摘下眼镜笑道：

“How well you look.”
“你的气色真好。”

“With a bijie period like this, how could I not?”
“交比劫运了，怎么不好。”

She indicated Luo.
七姑奶奶指着罗四姐说：

“This is a dear friend of mine, surnamed Luo.
“这位是我的要好姐妹，姓罗。

You may call her Sister Luo.”
吴先生，你叫她罗四姐好了。”

“Certainly.
“是，是！

Sister Luo.
罗四姐。

Please sit down, both of you.”
两位请坐。”

There were two stools beside the rosewood desk, one opposite Wu and one to his left.
红木书桌旁边，有两张凳子，一张在对面，一张在左首，

The Seventh Lady took the former, indicating that Luo should sit beside him for ease of conversation.
七姑奶奶自己坐了对面，示意罗四姐坐在吴铁口身旁，以便交谈。

Wu put on his spectacles, settled into his rosewood armchair, rolled back his sleeves and took up his brush.
吴铁口重新戴上墨晶眼镜，在那张红木太师椅上落坐，挽起衣袖，提笔在手，

Having asked Luo's birth year, month, day and hour, he wrote her Four Pillars on a writing tablet: ji-si, xin-wei, jia-zi, jia-zi.
问明罗四姐的年月日时，在水牌上将她的“四柱”排了出来：“已巳、辛未、甲子、甲子”，

He added marks and annotations, laid down the brush and studied them intently.
然后批批点点，搁笔凝神细看。


He studied them for a full quarter of an hour.
这一看，足足看了一刻钟，

From the side, Luo could see his eyes blinking rapidly behind the dark lenses, and she began to feel uneasy.
罗四姐从侧面望去，只见他墨晶镜片后面的眼珠，眨得很厉害，心里不由得有些发毛。

“Mr Wu,” she said at last, unable to contain herself, “is my destiny bad?”
“吴先生，”她终于忍不住了，“我的命不好？”

He removed his spectacles and looked at her.
吴铁口摘下眼镜，看着罗四姐说：

“What a pity!”
“可惜了！”

Then he turned to the Seventh Lady and repeated with emphasis, “A very great pity!”
接着望对面的七姑奶奶，加重语气说：“真可惜！”

“What is it?
“怎么？”七姑奶奶说：“吴先生，

Please tell us frankly.
请你实说。

A sensible person asks about misfortune, not good fortune.
君子问祸不问福，

Sister Luo is broad-minded.
罗四姐很开通的，

There is no need to spare her feelings.”
你用不着有啥忌讳。”

Wu nodded heavily, set his spectacles aside and pointed with his brush.
吴铁口重重点一点头，将眼镜放在一边，拿笔指点着说。

“Sister Luo, yours is a Wood destiny.
“罗四姐，你是木命，

Beneath your day stem lies a Direct Seal, and the hour is also jia-zi: Wood has a fellow to support it and a Seal to shelter it.
‘日元’应下一个‘正印’，时辰上又是甲子，木‘比’‘印’庇，

Judging by the day and hour pillars alone, this is a superior configuration, one that turns misfortune into blessing and danger into good luck.”
光看日时两柱，就是个逢凶化吉、遇难成祥的‘上造’。”

Luo did not understand “superior configuration,” but she could tell that her destiny was good.
罗四姐不懂什么叫“上造”，但听得出命是好命，

“Please go on.”
当即说道：“吴先生，请你再说下去。”

“Wood born in summer, in a si-Fire year as well: this tree would normally find it hard to survive.
“木命生在夏天，又是已火之年，这株树本来很难活，

Fortunately, zi-Water nourishes it.
好得有子水滋润，

Not only can it live; it is a great tree.
不但可活，而且是株大树。

Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth are all present, and so are Wealth, Officer, Seal and the Food God.
金木水火土，五行俱备，‘财’、‘官’、‘印’、‘食’四字全，

Moreover, these are a Direct Officer and a Direct Seal.
又是正官正印，

If this were a man's horoscope, he would be like Lord Pan Wenrong of Suzhou: first in the imperial examination, a chief minister, living to eighty with children and grandchildren all around him, enjoying endless honour and riches.
这个八字，如果是男命，就同苏州的潘文荣公一样，状元宰相，寿高八十，儿孙满堂，荣华富贵享不尽。

A pity it is a woman's destiny!”
可惜是女命！”


Before Luo could speak, the Seventh Lady protested loudly.
罗四姐尚未开口，七姑奶奶抗声说道：

“What is wrong with a woman's destiny?
“女命又怎么样？

Are examination champions and chief ministers not born of women?”
状元宰相还不是女人生的？”

“Do not be angry, Mrs Gu,” Wu replied calmly.
“古太太，你不要光火！”吴铁口从从容容地答道：

“When I say it is a pity, I do not mean that Sister Luo's destiny is bad.
“我说可惜，不是说罗四姐的命不好。

Heaven would not forgive me if I called a horoscope like this bad.”
这样的八字如果再说不好，天理难容了。”

Her anger gave way to pleasure.
听这一说，七姑奶奶才回嗔作喜，

“Then what is there to regret?
“那么，可惜在哪里呢，

Please, Mr Wu, tell us honestly.”
吴先生，”她说：“千万请你实说。”

“I had intended to judge the horoscope on its merits and speak plainly.
“我本来要就命论命，实话直说的，

Now I hardly dare.”
现在倒不敢说了。”

“Why not?”
“为啥呢？”

“With your temper, Mrs Gu, if I said something unwelcome, you might slap me.
“古太太火气这么大，万一我说了不中听的话，古太太一个耳光劈上来，

I could not afford such a loss of dignity.”
我这个台坍不起。”

“I beg your pardon!” She laughed apologetically.
“对不住，对不住！”七姑奶奶笑道道歉，

“Rest assured.
“吴先生，请你放心。

Explain yourself clearly, and of course I shan't lose my temper.” Wu called for his water pipe, then told his young attendant to bring a fruit platter for the ladies.
话说明白了，我自然不会光火。”说完，吴铁口叫小跟班拿水烟袋来吸水烟，又叫小跟班装果盘招待堂客。

Repeatedly protesting against all this trouble, the Seventh Lady nevertheless summoned her maid to bring her silver water pipe.
七姑奶奶一面连声：“不客气，不客气。”一面却又唤小大姐取来她的银水烟袋，

She lit a paper spill and began smoking with leisurely, bubbling draws.
点上纸媒，好整以暇地也“呼噜呼噜”地吸将起来。

She and Wu were playing their duet with a perfect understanding, and Luo was already taken in.
她跟吴铁口取得极深的默契而扮演的这出双簧，已将罗四姐迷惑住了，

Desperate to learn what was so regrettable, she grew impatient at this interruption, even resenting the Seventh Lady's failure to consider her anxiety.
渴望想听“可惜”些什么，见此光景，心里焦急，而且有些侄七姑奶奶不体谅她的心事，

Unable to say so openly, she pretended to cough, as though the pipe smoke were choking her, to hint that her friend might stop.
却又不便实说，只好假装咳嗽，表示为水烟的烟子呛着了，借以暗示七姑奶奶可以歇手了。


“Open the window,” Wu ordered.
“把窗户开开。”

He put down his pipe and took up his brush again, first looking at the Seventh Lady to secure her attention.
吴铁口将水烟袋放下，重新提笔，先看七姑奶奶，将她的注意力吸引过来，方始开口说道：

“A woman's horoscope must be read differently from a man's.
“女命跟男命的看法不同，

In a woman's destiny, the element that controls her represents the Husband Star.
女命以‘克我’为‘夫星’，

Thus what we call the Direct Officer and Indirect Officer in a man's horoscope both stand for husbands in a woman's.
所以男命的‘正官’、‘偏官’，在女命中都当丈夫来看。

That is a fundamental rule.
这是一句‘总经’，

You must understand it to see why Sister Luo's horoscope is regrettable.”
要懂这个道理，才晓得罗四姐的八字，为啥可惜？

The Seventh Lady knew something of astrology and followed him.
“七姑奶奶略通命理，听得懂他的话，

Luo understood less, but, eager for what came next, nodded faintly too.
罗四姐不十分了了，但为急于听下文，也微微颔首，表示会意。

“Metal controls Wood.
“金克木，

This xin-Metal in the month pillar is the Husband Star for jia-Wood.
月上的这个‘辛金’，就是‘甲木’的夫星。

The trouble is that there is another jia in the hour pillar.
坏就坏在时辰上也有个甲，

We have a name for that: Two Women Contending for One Husband.”
这有个名堂，叫做‘二女争夫’。”

The women exchanged a simultaneous glance.
七姑奶奶与罗四姐不约而同地互看了一眼，

Luo's look conveyed a request, and the Seventh Lady spoke for her.
罗四姐有所示意，七姑奶奶也领会，便代她发言。

“You mean another woman will compete with Sister Luo?”
“吴先生，你是说另外有个女人，跟罗四姐争？”

“Exactly.”
“不错。”

“Can she win?”
“那么争得过，争不过呢？”

“If she could, there would be nothing to regret.
“急得过就不可惜了。”

When two women contend for one husband, the stronger wins.
吴铁口说：“二女争夫，强者为胜。

On the surface, each is jia-zi, with zi-Water generating jia-Wood.
照表面看，你是甲子，我也是甲子，子水生甲木，

It is like children fighting: a parent comes out to help the child on one side, and another parent speaks up on the other.
好比小孩打架，这面大人出来帮儿子，那面也有大人出来说话，

They seem evenly matched.”
旗鼓相当扯个直。”

“Yes, yes, I understand!” Luo said repeatedly.
“嗯，嗯，”罗四姐这下心领神会，连连说道：“我懂了，我懂了。”

“By the usual rule, Sister Luo, the jia-zi in the hour pillar ought not to beat you.
“罗四姐，照规矩说，时上的甲子本来争不过你的，

Your Husband Star is right beside you: the pavilion nearest the water catches the moon first.
为啥呢，你的夫星紧靠在你，近水楼台先得月，

You should have the advantage.
应该你占上风。

Unfortunately, there is the configuration called geng-zi wang-wei.
可惜‘庚子望未’，

Chen, xu, chou and wei are the Earth of the four seasons, and Earth generates Metal.
辰戌丑未‘四季土’，土生金，

On the other side, Wealth benefits the Officer.
对方就是‘财星官’，

That is excellent for the Husband Star but disastrous for you, because Wealth Damages the Seal.
对夫星倒是大吉大利，对你大坏，坏在‘财损印’！

Imagine children fighting when one has parents and the other has lost theirs and is an orphan.
好比小孩子打架，一方面有父母，一方面父母不在了，是个孤儿。

Could the orphan defeat the other child?”
你想，打得过人家，打不过人家？”


The Seventh Lady, who could follow the explanation, thought it marvellous.
这番解说，听得懂的七姑奶奶觉得妙不可言：

“Let me look, Mr Wu.”
“吴先生，我看看。”

He turned the tablet round, angling it slightly towards Luo so that both could see.
吴铁口将水牌倒了过来，微侧着向罗四姐这面，让她们都能得见，

After studying it, the Seventh Lady pointed things out to her friend.
七姑奶奶细看了一会，指点着向罗四姐说：

“Look.
“你看，

This wei beneath geng is Earth.
庚下这个未，是土，

It is right beside your zi, which is Water, and Water controls Earth.
紧靠着你的那个子，是水，水克土。

Water is Wealth and Earth is the Seal, hence Wealth Damages the Seal.
水是财，土是印，所以叫做财损印。

There is nothing to be done.
没有办法，

You are destined to lose to the other woman.”
你命中注定，争不过人家。”

“And what happens if I lose?”
“争不过人家，怎么样呢？”罗四姐问。

That, of course, was for Wu to answer.
这话当然要吴铁口来回答：

“Become a concubine.”
“做小！”

The words were uncompromising.
两字斩钉截铁。

Repelled by his cold, unfeeling tone, Luo raised her voice.
罗四姐听他语声冷酷无情，大起反感，提高了声音说：

“And if I refuse to become a concubine?”
“不愿意做小呢！”

“You will bring death to your husband.”
“克夫。”

“I have already lost one.”
“克过了。”

“还是要做小！”

“偏要做大！”

“做大还是要克，

嫁一个克一个。”

Luo's face went white with anger.
罗四姐脸都气白了，

“I don't believe…”
“我倒不相信……”

Wu's iron certainty met an equally unyielding resistance.
一个铁口，一个硬碰，

看看要吵架了，七姑奶奶赶紧拉一拉罗四姐的衣服说：

你先听吴先生说，

说得没有道理再驳也不迟。”

“我如果说得没有道理，古太太，罗四姐请我吃耳光不还手。”

“罗四姐克过了，八字上也看得出来的，

The Seal represents shelter.
‘印’是荫覆，

在家从父，出嫁从夫，

这印是个靠山，

丈夫去世，不就是靠山倒了？”

罗四姐脸色比较缓和了，

逃不掉的。

真的不肯做小，也没有办法，

所谓‘人各有志，不能相强。’

不过，这一来，前面的‘财’、‘官’、‘食’就不必再看了。”

好，木克土，甲木有帮手，力量很强，

不过你们倒看看未土，

年上那个己土是帮手，

这还在其次，最厉害是已火，火生土，源源不绝，

请问哪方面强？

这块未土硬得象块石头一样，草木不生，

甲木要去斗它，就好比拿木头去开山，

木头敲断，山还是山。”

她问“不是不要紧，

是要做了小，就是说肯拿辛金当夫星，然后才能谈得到前面那四个字的好处。”

这个八字顶好的是已火那个‘食神’，

八字不管男女，有食神一定聪明漂亮。

换句话说，夫星显耀，全靠我生的这个食神。”

“高明，高明。”

七姑奶奶转脸说道：

“Sister Luo, is there anything else you would like to ask Mr Wu?”

罗四姐迟疑了一下，使个眼色，

七姑奶奶知道她要说悄悄话，随即起身走向一边，

“I understand.”
“我晓得。”

七姑奶奶回到座位上问道：“ 吴先生，如果要嫁，哪种命的人最好？”

“Metal, naturally.”
“自然是金命。”

“土命呢？”

She gave him the faintest signal with her eyes.
说着，七姑奶奶微示眼色。

Wu was extremely quick-witted.
吴铁口机变极快，

“Earth generates Metal. Better still,” he replied at once.
应声而答：“土生金更好。”

“Oh.”
“喔。”

七姑奶奶无所措意似地应声，然后转脸问道：“四姐，

还有啥要问？”

“一时也想不起。”

说这话就表示她已经相信吴铁口是“铁口”，而且要问的心事还多。

The Seventh Lady felt that her plan now had at least a seventy or eighty per cent chance of success.
七姑奶奶觉得到此为止，自己的设计，至少已有七，八分把握，

吴铁口面有难色，

他半开玩笑地说：“ ‘满路桃花’的命，不吃花酒，就要赴阎罗王的席，划不来。”

总归不会让我白送的。”

不过，我决不嫌。”

好在总还有来请教你的时候，

罗四姐托辞头疼，一定要回家。

七姑奶奶心里明白，吴铁口的那番斩钉截铁的论断，已勾起了她无穷的心事，要回去好好细想，

因而并不坚邀，

一起坐上她家的马车，到家以后，关照车夫送罗四姐回去。

到了晚上十点多钟，古应春与胡雪岩相偕从宝善街妓家应酬而回。

“This Wu Tiekou really has some ability.

说得连我都相信了。”

“It makes me laugh to think of it.

吴铁口说，自然是金命。

我说土命呢？”七姑奶奶说：

更加好。”

罗四姐的心思，比哪个都灵，

“对！”

You can make some preparations there.

“你不能再哭了！”七姑奶奶用责备的语气说：

“女人家就靠一双眼睛，

You must look after yourself.
身子要自己爱惜，

哭瞎了怎么得了！”

“哪里就会哭瞎了？”

罗四姐顾而言他地问：“七姐，你从哪里来？”

“Home.” The Seventh Lady called to the maid.
“从家里来。”七姑奶奶喊小大姐：

这是为了替罗四姐热敷消肿。

七姑奶奶一面动手，一面说话，说胡雪岩要回杭州去过节，

菜冷了，还好吃？”罗四姐接着便骂小大姐。

还有，我想请人替我写封家信。”

我来抓他的差。”

你请过来。”

Back in Hangzhou, he first sent someone to attend to Luo's commission, adding a generous festival gift.
回到杭州先派人去办罗四姐所托之事，同时送了一份丰厚的节礼。

Then, on a free day, he dressed simply, took few attendants and went in an easy manner to visit her mother.
然后挑了个空闲的日子，轻装简从，满荷洒洒地去看罗四姐的母亲。

He addressed her by the old name, Auntie Luo, but she could scarcely recognize him.
胡雪岩仍旧照从前的称呼，称她“罗大娘”，但罗大娘却不大认得出他了，

His unfamiliarity, added to her astonishment at the honour, made her extremely uneasy.
陌生加上受宠若惊，惶恐不安。

Understanding her feelings, he began with news of her daughter, then gradually recalled old times.
胡雪岩了解她的心情，跟她先谈罗四姐的近况，慢慢地追叙旧事，

Only then did Auntie Luo relax.
这才使得罗大娘的心定了下来。

Once at ease, she naturally became both pleased and moved, repeatedly saying that she would never have dared imagine a man in his present position lowering himself to visit her.
这心一定下来，自然就高兴了，也感动了，不断地表示，以胡雪岩现在的身分，居然降尊纤贵，会去看她，是她想都不敢想的事。



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第六章（上）
Towers of Light — Chapter Six, Part One
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER SIX: A WINDING ROAD TO MARRIAGE｜第六章 曲折情关


Ten days later, Luo Sijie received a letter from home.
十天以后，罗四姐接到了家信，

As she had requested, her mother had asked Mr Wu to write it.
罗大娘照她的话，是请乌先生代写的。

Mr Wu was the keeper of the Temple of Lord Guan, a warm-hearted man with a thorough understanding of the world.
这乌先生是关帝庙的庙祝，为人热心，洞明世事，

Reading Luo’s letter first, he had wondered why she had specifically requested him as the writer of the reply.
先看了罗四姐的来信，心头有个疑问，何以回信要指写他来写。

Then, listening to Auntie Luo’s delighted account of Hu’s visit, he understood.
再听罗大娘眉飞色舞地谈胡雪岩来看她的情形，恍然大悟，

Her daughter probably had not been certain whether Hu would call in person, which explained why she had omitted the name of the man carrying her letter and gifts.
罗四姐大约不能确定，胡雪岩会不会亲自来看罗大娘，所以信中不说信件等物托何人所带。

Yet his actions mattered greatly to her.
不过胡雪岩的动静，在她是很关心的，

Mr Wu must therefore tell her everything in detail: that was precisely why she had asked him to write.
既然如此，就要详详细细告诉她。她之指明要自己替罗大娘写回信，也正是这个道理。

He had guessed her intention perfectly, and the letter fully met her expectations.
这完全猜对了罗四姐的心思，因此，她的信也就深副她的期待了。

His language was plain and clear.
乌先生的代笔，浅显明白，

She first had Old Ma read it aloud, then worked carefully through it herself.
罗四姐先找者马来念给她听过，自己也好好下了一番工夫，

Once she could understand most of it, she put it inside her clothes and went to see the Seventh Lady.
等大致可以看得懂了，才揣着信去看七姑奶奶。

“Seventh Sister, I have a letter.
“七姐，”她说。“我有封信，

Would you look at it for me?”
请你给我看看。”

“From whom?”
“哪个的信？”

“My mother.
“我娘的信，

It is very long, and Mr Hu seems to be mentioned in the middle.
我一看信很长，当中好象提到胡大先生，

I am afraid there may be something important that I ought not to ask Old Ma to read.”
我怕有要紧话在里头，不方便叫老马给我看。”

“I am not much better than you.
“我比你也好不了多少，

If you cannot make it out, I may not be able to either.
你看不明白，我也未见得看得懂。

But never mind.
不过，不要紧，

One guest need not trouble two hosts.
一客不烦二主，

You asked Yingchun to write before; let him read this one too.”
当初你是托应春替你写的现在仍旧叫他来看好了。”

“Is Brother-in-Law Gu at home?”
“七姐夫在家？”

“Yes.
“在家。”

A foreigner is coming to see him, and he is waiting.”
七姑奶奶答说： “有个洋人要来看他，他在等。”


Gu was summoned and given the letter.
于是将古应春找了来，拿信交了给他。

He read and explained as he went.
他一面看，一面讲：

“Everything arrived.
“东西都收到了，

Mr Hu also sent a very substantial gift, eight things in all: ham, tea, Huadiao…”
胡大先生还送了一份很厚的礼，一共八样，火腿、茶叶、花雕……”

“You need not read those out,” the Seventh Lady interrupted.
“这不要念了。”七姑奶奶插嘴问道：

“Does the letter call Little Uncle Mr Hu?”
“他信里称小爷叔，是叫胡大先生？”

“Yes.
“是啊！

That is how Hangzhou people who respect him address him.”
杭州人之中，尊敬小爷叔的，都是这样叫他的。”

“Go on, then.”
“好！你再讲下去。”

“On the seventh day of the fifth month, Mr Hu called on your mother.
“五月初七胡大先生去看你母亲，

He was extremely courteous and stayed two full hours, talking about your recent life in Shanghai…”
非常客气，坐了足足有一个时辰，谈起在上海的近况……”

Gu smiled and stopped.
讲到这里，古应春笑笑硕住了。

“What is amusing?” his wife asked in surprise.
“咦！”七姑奶奶诧异地问：“啥好笑？”

“Your mother says she was pleased to learn that you had met the two of us.
“信上说。你母亲知道你认识了我们两个，

She calls it ‘the happy encounter with benefactors.’
说是‘欣遇贵人’。”

That is far more than we deserve.”
古应春谦虚着，“实在不敢当。”

“My mother is right.
“我娘的话不错。

You are certainly my benefactors.” Luo asked whether the letter also mentioned her daughter.
你们两位当然是我的贵人。”罗四姐问道：“七姐夫，信上好象还提到我女儿。”

“It does.
“是的。

Your mother says Mr Hu liked her very much, asked all sorts of questions, and talked with her at length.
你母亲说，胡大先生很喜欢你女儿，问长问短，说了好些话。

He also gave her a present at their first meeting: a pair of twisted-wire gold bracelets.”
还送了一份见面礼，是一双绞丝的金镯子。

“Just think, Seventh Sister!
““你看！”罗四姐对七姑奶奶说，

Such costly things for a child.
“大先生对伢儿们，给这样贵重的东西，

But I do not quite understand.
不过，七姐，我倒不大懂了，

Why did he have those bracelets with him?
大先生怎么会将这双镯子带在身边？

Did he know before going that I had a daughter?”
莫非他去之前，就晓得我有个女儿？”

“Not necessarily.
“不见得。”

Little Uncle has so many social obligations that he keeps gold watches and all sorts of other things.
七姑奶奶答说，“我们小爷叔应酬多，金表杂七杂八的东西很多，

When a present is needed, he can simply produce one.”
遇到要送见面礼，拿出来就是。”

“So that is the explanation.”
“原来这样子的。”

Her doubt resolved, Luo asked Gu to continue.
罗四姐的疑团一释，“七姐夫，请你再讲。”

“你娘说，你说要回去，她也很想念你，

If you cannot spare the time, perhaps she might come to Shanghai instead.”
如果你抽不出工夫。或者她到上海来看你。”

Before Luo could answer, the Seventh Lady exclaimed, “Let her come!
罗四姐还未开口，七姑奶奶先就喊了出来，“来嘛！”

Bring her here for the summer.
她说，“把你娘接了来歇夏，

She can stay two or three months before going back.”
住两三个月再回去。

Luo nodded. “Shanghai is cooler than Hangzhou.
““上海是比杭州要凉快些。”罗四姐点点头：

Let me think about it.”
“等我来想想。”

“There is another passage, a postscript from Mr Wu.
“后面还有段话，是乌先生‘附笔’，

Quite interesting.”
很有意思！”

Gu smiled.
古应春微笑着，

“He says that since Mr Hu’s personal visit, the tea drinkers at the temple have talked of little else for days.
“他说，自从胡大先生亲临府上以后，连日‘庙中茶客议论纷纷’，

Everyone calls him a generous and loyal man.
都说胡大先生厚道。

Mr Wu thinks he might even be the benefactor destined to enter your life.”
照他看，胡大先生是你命中的‘贵人’，亦未可知。”

The words touched the deepest part of Luo’s heart.
这话触及罗四姐心底深处，

Composed as she was, she could not help blushing.
再沉着也不同得脸一红，

With great tact, the Seventh Lady deliberately changed the subject.
七姑奶奶非常识趣，故意把话扯了开去，

“What tea drinkers?
“什么‘庙中茶客’？”她问：

What temple?”
“什么庙？”

“The Temple of Lord Guan, near our house.
“关帝庙，就在我家邻近。

Mr Wu, who wrote this letter for my mother, is its keeper.
替我娘写这封信的乌先生，是那里的庙祝，

He sets out tables and sells tea, with storytellers performing.
靠平常摆桌子卖茶、说大书，

That is how the temple’s worship and incense are supported.”
关帝庙的香火才有着落。”

At this point Gu’s foreign visitor arrived.
正谈到此处，洋人来拜访古应春了。

While he received him, the two women continued talking.
在他会客时，罗四姐与七姑奶奶的话题未断，

Luo would very much like her mother to stay, but had no suitable person to escort her.
她也很想接她母亲来往，苦无便人可以护送。

The Seventh Lady thought that no difficulty at all: she need only write to Hu.
七姑奶奶认为这根本算不了一回事，写信给胡雪岩就是。

“No, that would not do.”
“不好！”

Luo kept shaking her head, and only when pressed explained, “I owe him too much already.”
罗四姐只是摇头，却不说为何不好，及至七姑奶奶追问时，她才答说：“我欠他的情大多了。”

“已经多了，何妨再欠一回。”

“I am afraid I could never repay him.”
“我怕还不清。”

“There is a way of doing that too…”
“那也有办法……”

On reflection, the Seventh Lady decided not to speak too plainly.
七姑奶奶想一想，还是不必说褥大露骨。

罗四姐也没有再问，这件事就暂且搁下来了。


They chatted until the lamps were lit.
谈了些闲话，到了上灯时分，

The Seventh Lady proposed an early dinner followed by a visit to a Western circus.
七姑奶奶提议，早点吃晚饭，饭后去看西洋来的马戏。

Luo agreed to dine but declined the circus: it would finish late, and she would feel guilty at making her hostess escort her so far home.
罗四姐答应在她家吃饭，但不想去看马戏，因为散戏已晚，劳她远送回家，于心不安。

“That is easily settled.
“那还不好办？

Stay here.
你住在我这里好了。

We can talk some more as well.”
我们还可以谈谈。”

After considering it, Luo accepted.
罗四姐想了一下，终于接受邀约。

When they returned from the circus after dinner, Gu had just arrived home too.
饭后看马戏回来，古应春也刚刚到家。

“A’qi, please pack my things.
“阿七，请你替我收拾收拾行李。”

Today’s visitor is the new manager of a German trading house.
他说：“今天来的洋人。是德国洋行新来的总管。

He wants to make a special journey to Hangzhou to see Little Uncle and take the opportunity to visit West Lake.
他说要专程到杭州去拜访小爷叔，顺便逛逛西湖，

I have no choice but to accompany him.”
我只好陪他走一趟。”

“You are going to Hangzhou?
“怎么？”七姑奶奶高兴他说：“你要到杭州！

Wonderful!
好极，好极！

Bring Sister Luo’s mother back with you.”
你把罗四姐的老太太带了来。”

Gu paused, then remembered the letter and understood.
古应春愣了一下，想到罗大娘信中的话，方始会意，欣然答说：

“Gladly.
“好，好！

I shall certainly arrange it.”
我一走办到。”

With husband and wife having decided between them, Luo could do nothing but thank them.
他们夫妇已经这样作了决定，罗四姐除了道谢，别无话说。

They discussed the journey, which Gu reckoned would take about half a month there and back.
接着便谈行程，古应春计算，来去约需半个月。

His wife had another idea.
七姑奶奶便又出了主意。

“Why not move into the British settlement?
“你索性搬到‘大英地界’来往，

It would be easier for us to visit each other.
我们来去也方便。”

Half a month is quite enough to find a house and move.”
她说：“寻房带搬家，有半个月尽够了。”

“嗯，嗯。等我想一想。”

“You need not.
“你不必想。

Let me think for you.”
等我来替你想。”

七姑奶奶是在想，有什么熟人的房子，或租，或买，一切方便，思索了一会，想到了，

“老宓不是在造‘弄堂房子’？她问，

Are they finished?”
“完工了没有？”

“Long ago.”
“老早完工了。”

“他那条弄堂，一共二十四家，算是条很长的弄堂。

“I am sure some must be available.”
我想一定有的。”

“那好。”

七姑奶奶转脸对罗四姐说：“老宓是阜康的二伙，

He has made a fortune too.
现在也发财了。

If the houses are his, one word is all it will take for you to move in.”
是他的房子，只要一句话，就可以搬进去住。”

“看看，看看！”

Luo hastily rejected the suggestion.
罗四姐急忙否定，

“I think it would be better to find somewhere else.”
“我想另外寻，比较好。”

“Why?”
“为啥呢？”

She would only shake her head.
罗四姐不答，只是摇头，

At last the Seventh Lady understood.
七姑奶奶终于想到了，

At this delicate stage in Luo’s relations with Hu, she wished to avoid suspicion and leave no obvious sign.
在此她跟胡雪岩的关系，正当微妙的时刻，她是有意要避嫌疑，免得太着痕迹。

The Seventh Lady found her shrewd, capable, and loyal to her friends, yet also somewhat affected.
七姑奶奶觉得罗四姐人虽精明能干，而且也很重义气交情，但不免有些做作。

A frank woman herself, she had a way of cutting through complications that Luo could not manage.
她是个心直口快的人，遇到这种情形，有她一套快刀斩乱麻的手法，是罗四姐所做不到的。

总而言之，言而总之一句话，你搬家是搬定了。

房子呢，或租、或典、或买下来，我来替你作主，

你不必管。”

罗四姐反到服帖了，

“七姐，”她说：“我就听你的话，

一切不管，请你费心。”

这条弄堂名叫富厚里，

二十四户，望衡对宇，两面可通，

七姑奶奶挑定的一户，坐北朝南，

楼下东西厢房，大客厅，后面是“灶披间”、下房、储藏室。

扶梯设在中间，

楼上大小五个房间，

最大的一个，由南到北，直通到底，是个套房，足供藏娇。

另外四间，一间起坐、一间饭厅、两间客房，

家具摆饰，亦都是七姑奶奶亲自挑选，布饰得富丽堂皇，着实令人喜爱。

前后不过十天工夫，诸事妥帖，七姑奶奶自己也很得意。

第十一天早上，派马车将罗四姐接了来，告诉她说：

“房子我替你弄好了。

Come and see.”
现在陪你去看看。”

Luo was astonished and delighted.
一看之下，罗四姐又惊又喜，兴奋之情，溢于言表，不断他说：

“It is wonderful!
“太好了，太好了。

I only fear I lack the good fortune to live in such a house.”
只怕我没有福气，住这么好的房子。”

七姑奶奶不理她这话，光是问她还有什么不满意之处，马上可以改正。

罗四姐倒也老实说了，还应该加上窗帘。

“窗帘已经量了尺寸，叫人去做了，

They will be ready tomorrow.
明天就可以做好。”七姑奶奶接着又问：

When will you move?”
“你哪天搬？”

“Wait.”
“慢点！”

Luo drew her down to sit beside her and hesitated.
罗四姐拉着她并排坐下，踌躇了一下说道：

“To tell the truth, I love the house.
“七姐，说实话，房子我是真欢喜。

But I am afraid it is beyond my means.
不过，我怕力量办不到，

House and furniture together must cost four thousand taels?”
房子连家具，一起在内，总要四千银子吧？”

“Less than four thousand.
“四千不到。

I have a detailed account.
我有细帐在那里。”

You need not worry about affording it now.
七姑奶奶说：“你现在不必担心买不起。

For the moment, regard it as my property, lent to you to live in free of charge.
这幢房子现在算是我置的，白借给你住，

When you can afford it, I shall let you have it at the original price.”
到你买得起了，我照原价让给你。”

“Can such good things happen in this world?”
“世界上有这样的好事吗？”

“You don’t believe it?
“你不相信，

I hardly believe it myself!” The Seventh Lady laughed.
我自己郡不相信呢！”七姑奶奶笑道：

“It looks as though Wu Tiekou’s words are coming true.”
“看起来，吴铁口的话要应验了。”

Luo remembered them perfectly.
罗四姐记得很清楚，

He had insisted she must become a concubine.
吴铁口断定她要“做小”，

If she insisted on being a principal wife, she would bring death to one husband after another.
如果“偏要做大”，就会“嫁一个克一个”。

If she would neither accept the lesser position nor occupy the higher one, disaster would overtake her own life.
假使不愿“做小”，又不能“做大”，本身就会遭殃，性命不保。

In that case, the Wealth, Officer, and Seal represented in the first four of her birth characters would count for nothing.
倘或如此，八字中前面那四个字的“财”、“官”、“印”，自然都谈不到了。

Only by willingly becoming a concubine could she enjoy good fortune.
所以只有心甘情愿“做小”，才会有福气。

The Seventh Lady’s meaning was therefore plain.
这样一想，七姑奶奶话中的意思，也就很明显了。

Yet Luo would neither acknowledge nor reject it.
话虽如此，罗四姐却不愿表示承认，可也不愿表示否认。

Her only course was to pretend she had not quite heard, ignore the implication, and deliberately change the subject.
这一来，唯一的办法便是装作未听清楚而忽略了她的弦外余音，故意言他。

“七姐，搬家是件蛮麻烦的事，

I am afraid…”
恐怕……”

“There is no need to worry about every possibility.
“你用不着顾前想后。

The furniture and fittings are all here.
这里家具摆设都有了，

Give away what you can of your old furniture, and have a secondhand dealer take the rest in one lot.
你那里的木器，能送人的送人，没人可送，叫个收旧货的来，一脚踢。

Packing clothes, jewelry, and household utensils cannot take more than a day.
收拾收拾衣服、首饰、动用器具，不过一天的工夫，

有啥麻烦？

或者老马投了新东家，你就更加省事了。

“如今只剩下一件事：挑日子。”

“对。”

七姑奶奶说，“到我那里去，一面挑日子。一面再好好商量。”

很不巧，一连八、九天都不宜迁居，

最快也得十天以后。

“那时候老太太已经来了。”

七姑奶奶说：“我的想法是：顶好这三、四天以内就搬停当，老大太一来就住新房子，

让她老人家心里也高兴，而且也省事得多，

四姐，你说呢？”

“话自然不错。

不过，日子不好，没有办法。”

七姑奶奶想了一下说，

“Yes, there is.

As the saying goes, better to take the day you happen upon than labor over choosing one.
俗语道得好：拣日不如撞日。

Whatever day comes our way will be the day.
撞到哪天是哪天，

你说好不好？”

“怎么撞法？”

老太太到了，先在我这里歇一歇脚，马上进屋，

你也把要紧东西先搬运了来，

顺便就算替老太太接风，

不是一举两得。”

因此，七姑奶奶一会便对他有好感。

在古应春引见以后，自然有一番客套，七姑奶奶问到罗四姐的母亲何以不来，

到上海来作客，种种不方便，所以不来。

不过她娘倒有几句要紧话，要我私下限她说，

所以沾古先生的光，携带我到上海来开开眼界。”

“蛮好，蛮好。”

七姑奶奶说：“罗四姐，我跟她一见如故，感情象亲姐妹一样，

乌先生是她敬重的人，到了这里，一切不必客气。

现在，乌先生看，是把罗四姐接了来呢？还是你去看她。”

还是我去好了。”

为啥要我亲自送你去呢？这有两个缘故。”

我一手替她料理的。

原来胡雪岩一回杭州，略得清闲，便与老母妻子谈罗四姐的事。

本来娶小纳妾，胡雪岩原是自己可以做主的，但罗四姐的情形不同，

好些有关系的事，都要预先谈好，最要紧的，第一是虚名，第二是实权。

In Hangzhou official households, a concubine was first called the New Miss.
杭州官宦人家的妾侍，初进门称“新姑娘，

一年半载亲党熟悉了，才会称姓，假如姓罗，便叫”罗姑娘“，

三年玉载以后，才换称”姨奶奶“的称呼。

至于熬到”姨太太“总要进入中年，儿女成长以后。

到底是叫哪个？”

胡老太太用手遥指，这“地”是指胡太太。

先要娘准了，我再跟她去说。”

Old Madam Hu knew her daughter-in-law was kind and weak.
胡老太太知道，媳妇贤惠而软弱，

台面上说得过去的。“

你总晓得，当家人是很难做的。”

罗四姐极能干，

这个家一定当得下来。”

她有没有这份肚量，人家明明’当着和尚骂贼秃‘，她只当没有听见，脸上有一点懊恼的神气都没有？

一个忍不住闹了起来，弄得家宅不和，那时候你懊悔嫌迟了。”

这是各人的看法不同。

胡老太太以前也见过罗四姐，但事隔多年，是何面貌都记不清楚了，当然只就一般常情来推测。

说当然有个说法，

胡雪岩自然同意，便发了一份请帖，请乌先生吃饭。

这在乌先生自有受宠若惊之感，准时到胡家来赴宴。

做主人的介绍了古应春与其他的陪客，敬过一杯酒，托辞先离席了。

席间闲谈，不及正事，

乌先生等七姑奶奶一走，从房子看到摆饰，

在他心目中无一不新，无一不精，
