Yours are so consistent throughout.”
不比你的整齐。”

His praise gave Luo an indescribable pleasure.
听他这样夸赞，罗四姐心里有种说不出的舒服，

Few satisfactions could equal being seen by someone who had known one from childhood as a person of ambition and achievement, risen far enough to deserve new respect.
人生得意之事，无过于从小相亲的熟人，看到此人肯争气、有出息，青云直上，乱目相看。

She felt almost as though she had returned home in glory.
她此时的心情，亦大有衣锦还乡之感，

Yet an emptiness followed: the glory was incomplete.
不过紧接着而来的感觉，却是美中不足的空虚。

“Neither house nor furniture is mine.
“房子、家具都不是我的，

How could I have risen far enough to maintain such a display?”
我哪里就到得了能这样子摆场面的地步？”


Mr Wu was not entirely surprised.
这话在乌先生并不觉得全然意外，

“Even if Mr Hu bought them for you, once you use them, they are yours.”
略想一想说道：“就算是胡大先生替你置的，即使用了，就算是你的了。”

“It wasn’t he.
“也不是他，

They belong to the Seventh Lady.”
是七姑奶奶的。”

“The Seventh Lady?
“七姑奶奶？”

Where did such a married aunt suddenly appear in your Luo family?” Luo laughed. “How have you got so confused?
乌先生诧异，“你们罗家哪里跑出来这样一位姑奶奶？”“乌先生你缠到哪里去了？”罗四姐笑道：

I mean Mrs Gu.
“就是古太太，

Her maiden name is You, and she is seventh in her family.
娘家姓尤，行七，

Everyone calls her the Seventh Lady; I call her Seventh Sister.”
大家都叫她七姑奶奶，我叫她七姐。”

“Ah, so it is she.”
“啊，啊，原来是她。”

The more he thought, the more confused he became.
乌先生眨着眼想，越想越糊涂，

“Then why do the Gus call Mr Hu Little Uncle?
“那么，古家两夫妇，怎么叫胡大先生‘小爷叔’？

Shanghai people use that word for an uncle.
上海人叫叔叔叫‘爷叔’，

How can he be their young uncle?” Luo explained what she herself had learned only days before.
胡大先生怎么会是他们的小叔叔？”其中有个缘故，我也是前几天才听七姑奶奶谈起，

The Seventh Lady’s brother, You Laowu, led the Songjiang Grain Transport Brotherhood.
她的哥哥行五……“罗四姐告诉他说，尤五是松江漕帮的当家。

His master was Hu’s close friend.
尤五的师父跟胡雪岩是朋友，交情很厚，

The Green Gang placed great weight on its rules of seniority, so although You was older than Hu, he honored him as an elder.
清帮中人，极重家规，所以尤五年龄虽比胡雪岩大，却尊他为长辈，

His sister and Gu followed his usage.
七姑奶奶和古应春亦都跟着尤五叫胡雪岩为小爷叔。

“Seventh Sister says the Songjiang group is called an exhausted brotherhood.
“照七姑奶奶说，松江的潜帮称为‘疲帮’。

It is large and has many grain boats, but little substance behind the name.
他们这一帮的漕船很多，是大帮，不过是个空架子，

Leading it is difficult, and Mr Hu has helped them greatly.
所以当家的带帮很吃力，亏得胡大先生帮他们的忙。

That is why he has so much influence along the water route between Hangzhou and Shanghai.”
为此，胡大先生在杭州到上海的这条水路上很吃得开，就因为松江漕帮的缘故。”


Mr Wu listened closely while considering his own position.
乌先生听得很仔细，一面听，一面在心里想他自己的事。

He had agreed to act as matchmaker, but this was not a marriage to a principal wife through the full formal rites, and there was little distinction in arranging it.
他虽受托来做媒，但仔细想想；不是什么明媒正娶，他这个媒人也没有什么面子，

On the journey he had resolved that if Luo was not particularly willing, or Hu’s conduct outside Hangzhou had earned him an unfavorable reputation, he would have to withdraw.
所以一路上抱定一个主张，如果罗四姐本人不甚愿意，或者胡雪岩的为人，在杭州以外的地方，风评不佳，那就说不得打退堂鼓了。

What he now saw made those earlier reservations seem unrealistic.
此刻看来，自己一路上的想法，似乎都不切实际了。

He might as well turn to business.
既然如此，就不妨谈正事了，

“Sister Luo, do you know why I have come?”
“罗四姐，”他说：“你晓不晓得，我这趟为啥来的？”

The question embarrassed her.
这佯问法，罗四狙不免有些发窘，

But this concerned the rest of her life; she must not let reluctance to speak create a misunderstanding.
不过这是自己的终身大事，不能因为羞于出口，以致弄成误会，

She answered steadily, “Has my mother asked you to tell me something?”
所以很沉着他说：“是不是我娘有什么话，请乌先生来跟我说。”

“Yes.
“是的。

I thought that if she could not come herself, a letter would do just as well.
我原来的意思，你娘即使不能来，写信给你，也是一样，

But she disagreed, with reason.
你娘不赞成。她的话也有道理，

A letter to you and a reply would take a month or so between them.
写信问你，等你的回信，一来一去个把月，

Better for me to come and ask you directly.”
倒不如我来一趟，直接问个明白。”

“What does she wish to ask?”
“娘要问我的是什么话？”

“How you feel about Mr Hu.”
“问你对胡大先生怎么样？”

Luo blushed.
这一下，罗四姐的脸有些红了，

“Feel about him in what way?”
“什么怎么样呢？”

She covered her shyness with a complaint.
她用埋怨来遮掩羞涩，

“You are being so vague.
“乌先生你的话，说得不清不楚，

How can I answer?”
叫我怎么说？”

Serving tea at the temple brought Mr Wu into contact with every sort of person, and his experience was considerable.
乌先生在关帝庙设座卖茶，一天见过三教九流的人不知多少，阅历甚丰，

Matchmaking, however, was new to him.
不过做媒人却是第一次，

People always spoke of a matchmaker’s formidable tongue: one sentence could make or ruin a match.
因而有时不免困惑，心想，大家都说“媒人的嘴”是最厉害的，成败往往在一句活上，

He had never understood quite how a word could save a kingdom or destroy it, but now the meaning came naturally.
到底如何是一言丧邦、一言兴邦，却始终无法模拟，不想，此时自然而然就懂了，他在想：

If he simply said, “Mr Hu wants to take you as a concubine,” she would surely be angry and ashamed, refuse in indignation, and destroy the prospect.
只要答一句：“胡大先生要讨你做小。”罗四姐必然既羞且恼，一怒回绝，好事就难谐了。

Had he thought poorly of Hu, that was what he would have said.
“如果乌先生对胡雪岩的印象不佳，他就会那样说，

Since he had now decided to join the pair, he chose the most pleasing words.
但此刻已决心来牵这根红线，便要拣最动听的话来说：

“Mr Hu would like you to take charge of his household.”
“罗四姐，胡大先生要请你去当家。”


Her heart leapt, but she hardly dared believe him.
这话让她心里一跳，但却不大敢相信，

“Can that be true?
“哪里有这回事？”

Everyone calls him the God of Wealth.
她说：“大家都叫胡大先生是‘财神’，

With such a grand establishment, how could I manage his household?”
他家那佯子大的排场，我怎么当得了他的家。”

“There is no need for modesty.
“罗四姐，我劝你不要客气，

Your ability was evident from childhood.
你的能干，从小就看得出来的，

Mr Hu has always been an excellent judge of people.
胡大先生向来最识人，

If he asks you to manage his house, he is certain you can bear the responsibility.”
他说要请你去当家，当然看准了你挑得起这副担子。”

It did not sound like an idle joke.
看来不象是随口玩笑的话，

“Really?”
罗四姐不由得问一句：“真的？”

“Of course.
“当然是真的。

Without that undertaking, I would never have come.
没有这句话，我根本不会来。”

You would already be making a sacrifice in formal status.
乌先生说：“名分上你已经吃亏了，

Without anything to compensate for it, do you think I would agree to arrange the match?”
没有别的东西来弥补，你想我肯不肯来做这个媒？”

His wording was skillful.
乌先生的话说得很巧妙，

In place of the offensive word “concubine,” he spoke of a sacrifice in formal status, and Luo accepted the idea inwardly almost without noticing.
用“名分上已经吃亏了”的说法，代替听者刺耳的“做小”二字，罗四姐不知不觉便在心里接受了。

“What do you think, then?” he urged.
“你的意思到底怎么样？”乌先生催问着，

“If you have nothing further to say, I shall speak to Mrs Gu this evening.
“如果你没有话，晚上我就要跟古太太去谈了。

As your side’s matchmaker, I shall certainly press your interests.”
当然，我是女家的媒人，一定会替你争。”

“Why speak to the Seventh Lady?
“怎么？为啥要跟七姑奶奶去谈？”

Is she…”
罗四姐问“莫非她是……”

“The matchmaker for his side.”
“她是男家的媒人。”

“What does my mother think?”
“我娘的意思呢？”

“She favors the marriage.”
“你娘情愿结这门亲的。”

Luo’s feelings surged as she considered it from every angle.
罗四姐心潮起伏，思前想后，

Some things were difficult to say even to Mr Wu.
觉得有些话是连在乌先生面前都难出口的，

After a long pause, she replied, “You know that the Seventh Lady and I are like sisters.
考虑了好一会说，“乌先生，你晓得的，七姑奶奶跟我象同胞姐妹一样，

I think I had better ask her myself.”
我看，我自己来问问她。”


“If I need only arrange a match you have settled yourselves, nothing could be better.
“让我做个现成媒人，那再好都没有了。”

But your mother has entrusted me with this, Sister Luo.
乌先生说：“不过，罗四姐，你娘是托了我的，

When you speak to Mrs Gu, do not forget to leave your mother something to fall back on.”
你自己跟古太太谈的辰光，不要忘记了替你娘留一条退路。”

Luo did not understand.
何谓“退路”？罗四姐不明白，便即问说：

“What did my mother say to you?”
“乌先生，我娘是怎么跟你说的？”

Mr Wu regretted mentioning a safeguard.
乌先生有些懊悔，“退路”的话是不应该说的。

With the position Luo would occupy in the Hu household, her mother would not become a recognized fellow mother-in-law or visit on the footing of an ordinary relative.
所谓“退路”是以罗四姐将来在胡家的身分，她母亲不会成为“亲家太太”，也就不会象亲戚那样往来，

A fund should therefore be provided for her old age: that was the safeguard he meant.
这样，便需为她筹一笔养老的款子，才是个“退路”。

But in the present circumstances, surely not only Luo but Hu himself would think of it. The remark had been unnecessary.
但看目前的情形，且不说罗四姐，即便是胡雪岩也一定会想到他那句话便是多余的了。

Unwilling to state his full meaning, he merely answered, “Your mother said nothing.
因此，他就不肯再说实话，只是这样回答：“你娘没有说什么，

It was my own thought.
是我想到的，

One raises children against old age and stores grain against hunger.
养儿防老，积谷防饥，

You must make provision for her.”
你要替你娘打算打算。”

“So that is what you mean!” Luo answered readily.
“原来是这一层！”罗四姐很轻松地答说：

“Naturally, I have plans for that.”
“我当然有打算的。”

“Then I am reassured.
“那好，我也放心了。

When we reach the Gu house, speak to Mrs Gu yourself.”
等下到了古家，你自己跟古太太去谈好了。”


Gu gave some thought to the dinner welcoming Mr Wu.
为了替乌先生接风，古应春稍微用了些心思。

As a new guest meeting his wife for the first time, he should, by ordinary custom, dine separately from the women.
乌先生既是生客，跟七姑奶奶又是第一次见面，应该照通常的规矩，男女分席，

But there were only four of them.
但主客一共四个人，

Dividing the company would create distance and make conversation awkward.
分做两处，把交情都拉远了，而且说话也不方便，

Gu therefore decided on a Western dinner.
因此古应春决定请乌先生“吃大菜”。

Mr Wu had never eaten one in a private house.
在人家家里“吃大菜”，乌先生还是第一回。

Fortunately, his host had considered the difficulties.
幸好做主人的想得很周到，

There were many stories of mishaps at Western meals.
“吃大菜”的笑话见得多，

Cutting one’s tongue with a knife was an exaggeration, but drinking the finger-bowl water as though it were plain drinking water was no joke; clattering knives and forks were commonplace.
刀子割破舌头虽是故甚其词，拿洗手指的水当冷开水喝，却非笑话，至于刀叉乱响，更是司空见惯之事，

Gu provided chopsticks as well as Western cutlery.
所以古应春除了刀叉以外，另备一双筷子。

He avoided underdone beef, had every meat dish boned, and used few Western seasonings.
选的菜，第一，避免半生的牛排，第二，凡是肉类都先去骨头，第三，调味少用西洋的佐料。

The drinks, however, were foreign.
不过酒是洋酒，

Instead of distinguishing between those served before or after food, he set out several bottles—yellow, white, and red—for Mr Wu to choose.
也不分饭前酒、饭后酒，黄的、白的、红的，摆好了几瓶，请乌先生随意享用。

As they sat down, the Seventh Lady said frankly, “We are among friends.
“乌先生！”七姑奶奶入座时就说：“自己人，我说老实话，

If you are not used to knives and forks, use chopsticks.”
用不惯刀叉，用筷子好了。”

“Very well.
“是！是！

Obedience is better than ceremony.
恭敬不如从命，

I shall be frank too.”
我就老实了。”

He happily picked up his chopsticks.
乌先生欣然举著。

“Have you seen Sister Luo’s new house?”
“乌先生看见罗四姐的新房子了？”

The Seventh Lady softened the last part of the Chinese word, making it sound like “bridal chamber.”
七姑奶奶有意将“子”字念得极轻，听去象“新房”。

She was joking, but Mr Wu misunderstood.
在她是开玩笑，乌先生却误会了，

He thought Luo would remain in Shanghai and her present home would become the couple’s shared residence.
以为将来罗四姐会长住上海，她目前的新居，将来便是双栖之处。

How, then, could she manage Hu’s household?
心想，如果是这样子，又怎么让罗四姐去当家？

He had no time to examine the doubt, for he must answer.
心里有些疑问，却不暇细思，因为要回答七姑奶奶的话，

“It is excellent.
“好得很。”

Sister Luo tells me you arranged it all, Mrs Gu.”
他说：“我听罗四姐说，是古太太一手经理的。”

Before he could finish, Luo said, “Please call her Seventh Sister, or the Seventh Lady.”
“乌先生，”罗四姐不等他话完，便即说道：“你叫七姐，也叫七姑奶奶好了。”

“Very well.
“好！

Seventh Lady, you are a heroine among women!”
七姑奶奶，真是中帼英雄！”

“How did you think of that?” Luo laughed.
“怎么会想出这么一句话来？”罗四姐笑道：

“Even a compliment must fit.
“恭维嘛，也要恭维得象才是。

Seventh Sister isn’t some adventurer’s wife.
七姐又不是‘白相人嫂嫂’，

Why call her a heroine?”
怎么叫中帼英雄？”

Mr Wu himself felt the comparison was misplaced.
乌先生自己也觉得拟于不伦，

“Before I came, the storytellers were performing the tale of Yue Fei.
便即说道：“我来之前，‘大书’说岳传，

They had reached Liang Hongyu beating the war drums to defeat the Jin.
正说梁红玉擂鼓破金兵，

I heard ‘heroine among women’ so often that it slipped out.”
‘中帼英雄’这句话听得多了，才会脱口而出。”


“If you enjoy storytelling, I shall take you tomorrow.”
“乌先生喜欢听大书，明天我陪你。”

Gu, a devotee himself, spoke eagerly.
古应春爱好此道，兴致勃勃他说：

“Two performances at the City God Temple, one of Tales of Heroes and the other of Water Margin, are both celebrated.
“城隍庙的两档大书，一裆‘英烈’，一档‘水浒’，都是响档。

You must not miss the chance.”
乌先生不可错过机会。”

“They speak Suzhou dialect,” Luo pointed out.
“苏州话，”罗四姐说，

“Mr Wu may not understand.”
“乌先生恐怕听不懂。”

“I understand, I understand.”
“听得懂、听得懂。”

In stiff Suzhou speech, he added, “Yinli, baizuo.” Everyone laughed.
乌先生接着用生硬的苏白说道：“阴立，白坐。”大家都笑了。

“He not only understands,” Gu said.
“乌先生不但懂。”古应春说：

“He knows the business.”
“而且是内行。”

The expressions were puns on Yinglie, Tales of Heroes, and Baishe, White Snake.
原来“阴立、白坐”是“英烈、白蛇”的谐音，

Story-house patrons used them to mock freeloaders.
是书场里挖苦刮皮客的术语，

Some stood furtively in a corner and heard an entire episode without paying a copper: “shadow standing,” yinli.
有的阴阴地站在角落，不花一文听完一回书。名为“阴立”，

Others sat quite openly at the back, then slipped away as soon as the attendant came to collect payment: “free sitting,” baizuo.
有的大大方方坐在后面，看跑堂的要‘打钱“了，悄悄起身溜走，名为”白坐“。

Discovering their shared enthusiasm, Gu and Mr Wu felt the pleasure of meeting a kindred spirit and talked at length about storytelling and its different schools.
由于彼此同好，皆有喜遇知音之感，大谈“大书”，以及说书人的流派。

Luo watched them, then said quietly to the Seventh Lady, “Mr Wu will be drinking until midnight.
罗四姐见此光景，轻轻向七姑奶奶说道：“乌先生这顿酒会吃到半夜，

Let us leave the table.”
我们离桌吧！”



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第六章（中）
Towers of Light — Chapter Six, Part Two
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


The Seventh Lady had been thinking the same thing.
七姑奶奶亦正有此意。

Finding a pause, she interrupted the men's flow of talk with a few of the gracious remarks expected of a hostess, and the two women left the table.
找个空隙，打断他们的谈锋，说了两句做女主人应有的门面话，与罗四姐双双席席。

She took Luo Sijie upstairs to her bedroom, which Luo had always admired.
七姑奶奶将她带到楼上卧室。这间卧室一直为罗四姐所欣赏，

Gu Yingchun had redesigned it in the Western style, with a spacious balcony and large glass doors hung with two layers of curtains, one gauze and the other velvet.
因为经过古应春设计，改成西式，有个很宽敞的阳台，装置很大的玻璃门，门上加两层帷幕、一层薄纱、一层丝绒，

When the velvet curtains were drawn back by day, sunlight passed through the gauze and filled the room, making it bright, splendid, and wonderfully refreshing.
白天拉开丝绒那一层，阳光透过薄纱，铺满整个房间，明亮华丽，令人精神一爽。

At night, the sight of countless lights from the balcony had a charm of its own.
晚上坐在阳台上看万家灯火，亦别有一番情趣，

In summer, especially, nothing could be more comfortable than sitting there in the cool air and talking.
尤其是象这种夏天，在阳台上纳凉闲谈，是最舒服不过的一件事。

“Will you have Chinese tea or foreign tea?”
“你是喝中国茶，还是喝洋茶？”

Foreign tea meant English tea with milk.
所谓“喝洋茶”是英国式的奶茶。

The Seventh Lady had a complete silver tea service and followed the English custom of preparing the tea herself and pouring it for her guests, a rather elaborate business.
七姑奶奶有全套的银茶具，照英国规矩亲自调制，而且亲自为客人倒茶，颇为费事。

Luo, intent on discussing serious matters, had no mind to appreciate it.
罗四姐此刻要谈正事，无心欣赏“洋茶”，便即说道：

“I'd like a cup of chrysanthemum tea.”
“我想吃杯菊花茶。”

The yellow and white Hangzhou chrysanthemums could be brewed like tea to calm the mind and dispel internal heat.
黄白“杭菊花”可以当茶叶泡来喝，有清心降火之功，

“Is your mind rather unsettled?” the Seventh Lady asked with a smile.
七姑奶奶笑着问道：“你大概心里很乱？”

“I don't know why, but I've been feeling restless all this time.”
“也不晓得啥道理，心里一直烦躁。”

“Let's sit out on the balcony.”
“我们到阳台上来坐。”

She chose the balcony out of consideration for Luo.
七姑奶奶挑到阳台上去密谈，是替罗四姐设想，

Discussing her own marriage was bound to make her shy; in the dim light she could conceal her embarrassment and speak more freely.
因为谈到自己的终身大事，她难免腼腆，阳台上光线幽暗，可以隐藏妞促的表情，就比较能畅所欲言了。


When the maid had brought their chrysanthemum tea, Luo, sitting with her face turned away from the light, gave a soft sigh.
等小大姐泡了菊花茶来，背光坐着的罗四姐幽幽地叹口气说：

“Seventh Sister, perhaps it really is my destiny.”

《大清律例》是他的家学，对“户婚律”当然亦很熟悉，

所以能为古应春夫妇作一番很详细的解释。

他说，以“兼祧”为取“两头大”的借口，是刁俗如此，而律无明文，

不过既然习俗相沿，官府亦承认的，只是兼祧亦有一定的规矩，

胡大先生既然有兄弟，就可以承继给他无子的叔伯，

何用他来兼祧？”

‘胡大先生’这个称呼，就摆明了他是有兄弟的。”

御史老爷一本参上去，事实俱在，逃都逃不了的。”

他心里在想，李老板的生意做得很大，而且人虽精明，却很讲信用，

It seemed unlikely that he would simply pocket an extra two hundred taels.
似乎不至于硬吞二百两银子，

Perhaps there was another explanation.
其中或者另有缘故，

With Luo present, however, Gu could not pursue the matter and remained silent.
只是当着罗四姐，不便深谈，只好沉默。


Luo tried to soothe her friend.
于是罗四姐便劝七姑奶奶说：

“The furniture really is good, Seventh Sister.
“七姐，东西实在是好的，

Eight hundred taels is very reasonable.
八百两银子是真正不贵。

Calm down first.
你先消消气，

I want to discuss a use I have in mind for it.”
我要好好跟你商量，这堂木器有个用法。”

Before the Seventh Lady could reply, the maid came in to announce that Mr Li had arrived and wished to see her.
七姑奶奶正要答话，让小大姐进来打断了。她是来通报，李老板来了，要见七姑奶奶。

“I won't see him.”
“不见。”

“I will,” Gu said.
“我见。”古应春接口，

“Let me question him.”
“等我来问他。”

He returned shortly afterwards, smiling broadly and carrying a red envelope.
去了不多片刻，古应春笑嘻嘻地回进来，手里拿着个红封套，

The Seventh Lady took it.
七姑奶奶接过来一看，

On the label were the words “Wedding Gift,” with Mr Li's name below.
封套签条上写“贺仪”二字，下面是李老板具名，

Inside was a banknote for two hundred and forty taels.
贺仪是一张二百四十两的银票。

“What is this supposed to mean?”
“这算啥？”

“It is not for you,” Gu said.
“不是送你的。”古应春说：

“You told me Miss Luo was to be a bride, didn't you?
“你不是告诉我，罗四姐要做新娘子了，

This is his wedding present.”
人家是送喜事的贺礼。

Taken completely by surprise, the two women exchanged bewildered looks, then urged him with their eyes to go on.
“听这一说，七姑奶奶与罗四姐相顾愕然，事出突兀，都用眼色催古应春说下去，

But Gu seemed barely able to contain his laughter.
但古应春却是一副忍俊不禁的神气。

His wife gave him a sharp look. “What are you laughing at?
“你笑啥？”七姑奶奶白了丈夫一眼，

Tell us!”
“快说啊！”

“How could I not laugh?
“怎么不要好笑？

Only people who think as deeply as you two could manage something like this.”
这种事也只有你们心思用得深的人，才做得出来。”


Gu glanced at Luo, then told his wife, “Do you know what the furniture costs?
古应春看了罗四姐一眼，向妻子说道：“你晓得这堂木器多少钱？

Twelve hundred taels.”
一千二百两。”

“Oh!” Luo exclaimed.
“晴！”罗四姐叫了起来，

“Brother-in-Law Gu, he told you?”
“七姐夫，李老板告诉你了？”

“Of course.
“当然告诉我了，

How else could he explain taking a further two hundred as deposit and then flatly refusing to acknowledge it?”
不然，他另外收了二百两银子的定洋，硬不认帐，这话怎么交代呢？”

“You had already paid him two hundred, Seventh Sister?”
“啊？”罗四姐问说：“七姐，你已付过他二百两？”

The Seventh Lady stared for a moment, then understood.
七姑奶奶愣了一下，弄明白是怎么回事了，

“And you had paid four hundred first?”
反问一句：“你先付过他四百两？”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

“Why?”
“为啥？”

“I didn't want you to spend too much.”
“我不愿意你太破费。”

The Seventh Lady burst out laughing. “We both took the same road!
“两个人走到一条路上来了。”七姑奶奶哈哈大笑，

I knew you didn't want me to spend too much, so I paid him two hundred beforehand.
“我晓得你不愿意我太破费，所以预先付了他二百两。

I was wondering how such fine things could be so cheap.”
我道呢，哪里有这么便宜的东西！”

Luo found it amusing too.
罗四姐也觉得好笑，

“Brother-in-Law Gu is right.
“七姐夫说得不错，

Only people who think too hard would do this.
心思用得太深，才会做出这种事来。

I kept it from you; you kept it from me; we both reasoned ourselves into a corner.
你瞒我，我瞒你，大家都钻到牛角尖里去了。

Still, Mr Li was not quite right either.
不过，”她说：“李老板也不大对，

Why didn't he simply take two hundred less at the time, instead of making you angry for nothing?”
当时他就让二百两好了，何苦害七姐白白生一场气。”

“He has an explanation,” Gu replied.
“他也有他的说法。”古应春接口答道：

“Let me repeat his words.
“我拿李老板的话照佯说一遍。

He said, ‘That Miss Luo looks a very formidable woman.
他说：那位罗四小姐，看起来是很厉害的角色，

I had to be on my guard.
我不能不防她，

The receipt expressly says I must quote eight hundred taels, and if I change my words I must return double the deposit.
收条上写明白，报价只能报八百两，改口的话，加倍退还定洋，

Suppose I altered the price, and she produced the receipt and struck me with it like the Heaven-Overturning Seal?
万一我改了口，罗四小姐拿出收条，一记‘翻天印，打过来，

I would have no defence.
我没话说，

That is why I would not give way.
所以我当时不松口，

I preferred to offend Mrs Gu and come afterwards to apologize.’”
宁可得罪了古太太，事后来赔罪。“


The Seventh Lady's resentment vanished.
七姑奶奶前嫌尽释，

“He does know how to behave, after all,” she said happily.
高兴地笑道：“这个人还算上路，

“He has even added forty taels as a wedding gift.”
还多送了四十两贺礼。”

She handed the red envelope to Luo.
说着将红封套递给罗四姐。

“I don't want it.
“我不要。”

It isn't mine.” Luo refused to take it.
罗四姐不肯接，“不是我的。”

“Then is it mine?
“莫非是我的？”

I am not the one becoming a bride!” the Seventh Lady joked.
七姑奶奶开玩笑：“又不是我做新娘子。”

Luo smiled in embarrassment but still refused, leaving her friend's hand suspended between them.
罗四姐窘笑着，仍旧不肯接，七姑奶奶的手也缩不回去，

“Give it to me,” Gu said.
古应春说：“交给我。

“Two hundred is the returned deposit, and forty is the wedding gift.
二百两是退回来的定洋，四十两送的贺礼，

I shall have them entered in the accounts.”
我叫人记笔帐在那里。”

His wife handed him the envelope, then began praising the suanzhi furniture with its mother-of-pearl inlay.
于是七姑奶奶将红封套交了给古应春，接着便盛赞那堂酸枝嵌螺甸的家具，

Even twelve hundred taels, she thought, was not too much for it.
认为一千二百两银子，实在也不算贵。


They went on to discuss the furniture's history.
由此便谈到这堂木器的来历，

Its value could no longer be measured simply in silver.
它之贵重，已经不能拿银子多寡来论了。

Luo had therefore formed a plan.
罗四姐因此有个想法，

Even if it were part of her dowry, such a set seemed too grand for her own use and might attract criticism.
觉得自己用这堂木器，虽说出于“陪嫁”，亦嫌过分，难免遭人议论；

She privately proposed to the Seventh Lady that she present it to Old Madam Hu.
因而私下跟七姑奶奶商量，打算把这堂木器，孝敬胡老太太。

“It was something Mr Li said that gave me the idea.
“我这个念头，是听了李老板的一句话才转到的，

A Circuit Intendant Zhu from Jiangxi had wanted to buy it for a governor-general's mother.
他说：有个江西的未道台，想买这堂木器孝敬一位总督的老太太。

I thought: if I use it and Old Madam Hu's furniture is not as fine, I shall feel uncomfortable.
我心里就在想，将来我用这堂木器，胡老太太用的不及我，我用了心里也不安。

Better to offer borrowed flowers to the Buddha and turn it into a gift.
倒不如借花献佛，做个人情。

You won't blame me, will you, Seventh Sister?”
七姐，你不会怪我吧？”

“Of course not.”
“哪里，哪里：”

The Seventh Lady was deeply pleased.
七姑奶奶异常欣慰地，

“To tell the truth, seeing how well you understand people sets my mind at rest.
“说实话，你这样子会做人，我就放心了。

There are so many people and so much gossip in the Hu household.
胡家人多口杂，

I was afraid you might feel that, since you had done nothing wrong, you could be too outspoken and offend them.”
我真怕你自己觉得行得正、坐得正，性子太直了，会得罪人。”

“One cannot avoid offending people.
“得罪人是免不了的。

As long as certain people are not offended, that is enough.
只要有几个人不得罪就好了。

Old Madam Hu, for instance, must be very well attended to.”
譬如胡老太太，一定要伺候得好。”

The Seventh Lady nodded inwardly.
七姑奶奶暗暗点头，

Luo must understand the principle of holding the emperor in one's power to command the feudal lords, she thought.
心里在想，罗四姐一定懂。挟天子以令诸侯‘的道理，

Luo knew not only how to deal with people but how to practise the art of government.
不但会做人，还会做“官”，

Worrying about her had been quite unnecessary.
替她担心，实在是多余的。



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第七章（全章，至本卷结束）
Towers of Light — Chapter Seven (complete; end of volume)
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER SEVEN: A WIFE WHO BRINGS HER HUSBAND PROSPERITY｜第七章 帮夫运


Once Luo Sijie married into the Hu household, she truly entered upon a fortune that advanced her husband.
自从罗四姐嫁到到胡家，真是走了一步帮夫运，

Hu Xueyan's enterprises flourished like “fresh flowers upon brocade,” as Dream of the Red Chamber puts it.
胡雪岩的事业如《红楼梦》上所形容的“鲜花着锦”般兴旺。

Their prosperity, of course, rested on Zuo Zongtang's support, while Zuo regarded Hu as his indispensable right hand.
当然，兴旺的由来是他恃左宗棠为靠山，左宗棠视他为股肽，

As the western campaign advanced from victory to victory and the court granted every request Zuo made, Hu rose with the tide and found everything going smoothly.
只要左宗棠西征，节节胜利，所请在朝廷无有不准，胡雪岩水涨船高，亦就事事顺手了。

Since the Daoguang reign, benighted rulers and foolish ministers had provoked troubles at home and abroad.
原来从道光年问开始，君暗臣愚，激出内忧外患，

The Muslim uprisings in the northwest had likewise been stirred up by corrupt officials.
西北的回民起义，亦是贪官污吏激荡而成。

The forces then known as the Gansu Muslims fell into three main divisions, western, southern and northern, with three principal leaders.
其时所谓“甘回”共有西、南北三大支，三大首领，

In the west was Ma Duozhi, based at Xining in Qinghai.
西面的叫马朵之，驻扎在青海的西宁，

In the south was Ma Zhan'ao, whose base was Hezhou, also called Linxia, in the Gansu–Qinghai region.
南面的叫马占鳌，以甘肃与青海的河州，也就是临夏为根据地，

The northern leader, Ma Hualong, was the most formidable of the three.
北面叫马化龙，是三大首领中最厉害的一个，

His influence extended over Ningxia and Lingwu, and his stronghold was Jinjibao.
势力范围在宁夏、灵武一带，根据地名为金积堡，

It stood at the beginning of the Hetao region, the great bend of the Yellow River celebrated in the saying, “The Yellow River brings a hundred troubles; only its bend grows rich.”
这个地方就是“黄河百害，惟富一套”的河套的起点，

Besides controlling the profits from tea and horses, he had a major source of wealth in Huamachi, a salt lake to the east.
擅茶、马之利以外，东面有个盐池叫花马池，更是一大财源。

More than five hundred fortified villages encircled Jinjibao like stars surrounding the moon.
金积堡周围有五百多个寨子，众星拱月般环卫着马化龙的金积堡。

Ma was extremely respectful towards Mutushan, the general at Ningxia.
此人对宁夏将军穆图善很恭敬。

Zuo saw what lay beneath this behaviour, and the first objective of his western campaign was to capture Jinjibao.
左宗棠看到了此人的底蕴，所以西征的第一目标就是攻下金积堡。


Before attacking Jinjibao, however, he had to sever the link between the Nian armies and the Gansu Muslim forces.
在攻金积堡之前，先要隔断捻军与甘回的联系。

The Nian were divided into two main groups, the Eastern and Western Nian.
捻军分为两大股，称为“东捻”、“西捻”。

Explaining their name, Zeng Guofan wrote, “Paper is twisted to burn in oil; hence the name nian.”
曾国藩解释捻军之捻说：“捻纸燃脂，故谓之捻”，

Anything made by twisting thin paper into a strip, such as the spills used for lighting water pipes, was called a nianzi.
凡是用薄纸搓成条状，如吸水烟用的纸煤等等，都叫做捻子。

The Nian armies could gather and disperse with equal ease.
捻军的特性在于易聚易散，

Though they looked like an undisciplined rabble, their unpredictable movements over a thousand li left pursuers exhausted and made them formidable opponents.
但看起来象乌合之众，而流转不定，飘忽千里，令人疲于奔命，亦很厉害。

Sengge Rinchen's Heilongjiang cavalry chased them relentlessly.
僧格林沁的黑龙江马队，追奔逐北，

Whenever they saw it coming, they withdrew.
捻军见了就澈，

Yet as soon as the cavalry halted, innumerable Nian soldiers would somehow appear all around it.
但一停下来，周围不知如何，就会冒出无数捻军来，

That was how Prince Sengge Rinchen had met his death.
僧王就是这样阵亡的。

He had been fighting the Eastern Nian.
僧王打的是东捻，

Zhang Zongyu, leader of the Western Nian, moved between Henan and Shaanxi, crossing the Yellow River from Henan and pressing north towards Yan'an and Mizhi.
西捻的首领叫张宗禹，自河南至陕西，由河南横渡黄河，直上延安、米脂，

His north–south front stretched over a thousand li.
南北战线拉长到一千多里，

He hoped to join Ma Hualong's front, which extended a similar distance from west to east.
目的就是希望与马化友由西往东，也有千把里的这条战线交会。

Once the two linked up, the Western Nian would be beyond control, and there would be no telling when the Muslim uprising could be suppressed.
只要一接上头，西捻不复可制，回民起义亦不知何时才能镇压下去，

Zuo's initial strategy was therefore to keep them apart and prevent a junction.
所以左宗棠西征的初步战略，就在隔离西捻与甘回不让他们“会师”。

When Luo married into Hu's household, the Western Nian had just been defeated.
罗四姐嫁到胡家时，正当西捻初平，

The two empress dowagers received Zuo with gracious praise, and he declared that he could suppress the Muslim uprising within five years.
两宫太后召见左宗棠，天语褒嘉，左宗棠自陈五年可以镇压回民起义之时。


Zuo first stationed his army at Xi'an, then advanced gradually northwest.
左宗棠最初驻军西安，然后往西北逐步推进，

Headquarters moved first to Qianzhou, then to Jingchuan in Gansu.
大营先移乾州，再移甘肃境内的泾川，

Turning north, he captured Zhenyuan and Qingyang, took in 170,000 surrendered people and famine refugees, and established agricultural settlements for them.
然后往北打，攻克镇原、庆阳，收容降众及饥民十七万人，行屯垦之法，

The seeds and farming implements were all procured by Hu's Transport Bureau and shipped to Gansu.
种子、农具，都由胡雪岩的转运局采办好了，运到甘肃。

When Zuo's advance troops approached Lingwu, Ma Hualong saw that his base was in danger of destruction and submitted a letter asking for pacification.
及至左宗棠的前锋逼进灵武，马化龙看根据地有被剿之虞，于是“上书言抚”，

That meant he was willing to surrender: his followers might be absorbed into the Qing army, dispersed, or provided with some means of livelihood.
抚是安抚，表示愿意投降，部众或者收编为清军、或者遗散、或者为他们谋个生计。

Turning weapons into peaceful relations would have been the ideal outcome.
有此化干戈为玉帛的结果，本来是最理想的办法，

But countless rebels had accepted pacification only to rise again.
但造反起义的，就抚而又反复音，不知多少。

Zuo was deeply experienced, and Ma had a reputation for repeated reversals.
左宗棠阅历极丰，而马化友又有善于翻覆的名声，

He might play tricks on Mutushan, but Zuo would not be fooled.
他可以玩弄穆图善，而左宗棠决不会受他的愚，

Ignoring the appeal, he prepared three months' provisions and advanced on Jinjibao.
所以置之不理，备妥三月行粮，进攻金积堡。


The general commanding the attack was Liu Songshan, a man from Zeng Guofan's own immediate home district.
指挥此役的大将是刘松山。此人是曾国藩的小同乡，

He had risen from the ranks to become a brigade commander through distinguished service.
行伍出身，积功升至总兵。

In the tenth year of Xianfeng, when British and French forces invaded, Sengge Rinchen had taken his troops to defend the emperor.
咸丰十年，英法内犯，僧格林沁提兵勤王，

The removal of that fierce cavalry force from the southeast greatly affected the war there.
东南没有这一支膘悍的马队，战局大受影响。

Li Xiucheng, just beginning to enjoy Hong Xiuquan's confidence, convened a military conference at Wuhu and divided the Taiping forces for an advance on several routes.
那时太平军李秀成，刚开始为洪秀全所重用，在芜湖召集军事会议，分道进兵，

He himself marched south from Wuhu and captured Yi County in southern Anhui.
李秀成本人自率大军，由芜湖南下，攻占皖南黟县，

Other formidable Taiping commanders, Li Shixian, Huang Wenjin and Li Jiyuan, successively took Ningguo and Huizhou, followed by Fuliang, Duchang and Raozhou in Jiangxi.
另外太平军悍将李世贤、黄文金、李继远等，相继陷宁国、下徽州，又占江西浮梁、都昌、饶州。

Zeng, based at Qimen, was cut off from his Hubei supplies to the west because the route through Jiangxi had been broken.
驻节祁门的曾国藩，西面来自湖北的接济，因江西粮道中断而绝，

From the east, confident troops led personally by the two Lis pressed upon him.
东面则有二李亲领的骄兵相逼，

Encircled, he accepted his advisers' proposal to counterattack Huizhou and reopen a supply route to Zhejiang.
重重围困，听从幕宾建议，反攻徽州，以期打开通浙江的运道。

He therefore moved his army to Xiuning, east of Qimen and west of Huizhou.
于是曾国藩侈军祁门以东、徽州以西的休宁；

One night the Taipings attacked, and every camp broke except Liu's.
有一天太平军夜袭，诸营皆贵，

Liu formed his men in the moonlight to meet the enemy, who dared not approach.
只有刘松山在月下列队迎敌，太平军不敢相逼，

Troops fleeing from the other camps, unable to see clearly, mistook his ranks for a Taiping blocking force and turned to run.
其余溃散各营，月夜看不真切，以为太平军拦截，掉头要逃，

Only when Liu displayed the proper recognition signals did they realize that headquarters still held and the old commander was safe.
及至刘松山打出真号，大家才知道大营未夫，“老帅”无恙，

Their terror subsided.
惊魂始定。

Since his defeat at Jinggang, when he had thrown himself into the water and been rescued, this had been Zeng's next great crisis.
祁门一役，是曾国藩靖港兵败，投水遇救以后，另一次的大危机，

He had even written his last letters.
他连遗书都写好了，

His escape was entirely due to Liu, whom he thereafter treated as a man of exceptional national worth.
结果转危为安，都由刘松山之功，从此以国士相待。


When Zuo received command of the western expedition, its scale demanded cooperation from all the armies; this was no merely local operation.
及至左宗棠受命西征，这是一场大战役，非地方性的军务可比，各军理当协力，

Zeng placed his most valued force, Liu Songshan's, under Zuo's command.
曾国藩将他最重视的刘松山一军，交给左宗棠指挥。

Zuo had originally owed his advancement to Zeng, but they had later quarrelled over military funds.
左宗棠本由曾国藩所提携，以后由于争饷而存意见，

When Zeng Guoquan captured Jinling and allowed Hong Xiuquan's son to escape, Zuo openly denounced the matter in a memorial.
复以曾国荃破金陵，纵容洪秀全之子逃遁，直言讦奏，

Their relations broke down, and they had long ceased corresponding.
因而失和，不通音问已久，

Only now did Zuo acknowledge, “In loyalty to the country's interests and discernment of men, I am ashamed to fall short of the Grand Secretary.”
到这时，左宗棠才知道，谋国之忠，知人之明，自愧不如元辅“。

He compared Zeng's placing Liu under his orders to giving a daughter in marriage.
将刘松山一军交他节制，比作曾国藩”嫁女“，

Needless to say, he entrusted Liu with important duties.
对刘讼山的重用，自不待言。

Liu fully justified both Zeng's recognition and Zuo's expectations, winning almost every engagement against the Western Nian and the Gansu Muslim forces.
刘松山真亦不负曾国藩的知遇及左宗棠的期许，打西捻、甘回，几乎战无不胜、攻无不克。

Before enlisting, he had become engaged at home but had not married.
他从军以前，在家乡就已定下亲事，聘而未娶，

In more than ten years of service, he returned home only once, to recruit men.
在军中十几年，只因招兵，回过一次家乡，

Not until the Western Nian were defeated did he finally marry at Luoyang.
直到西捻既败，方在洛阳成婚，

Bride and groom were both over thirty.
新郎新娘都三十多岁了。

After a honeymoon of only ten days, he entered Shaanxi.
蜜月只得十天，刘松山便即入陕，

Clearing the four districts of Yu, Yan, Sui and Fu, he advanced on Lingwu and took it in a single battle.
肃清榆、延、绥、鄜四州以后，进军灵武，一战而克。

Unable to defeat him, Ma Hualong again sought pacification while appealing everywhere for help.
马化龙力战无功，一面再次言抚，一面四处求援，

But the Muslim armies at Xining, Hezhou, Lintao and Jingyuan, overawed by Liu's reputation, dared not move rashly.
但西宁、河州、临洮、靖远各地的回民军，震于刘松山的威名，都不敢妄运，

Liu launched a major assault.
于是刘松山大举进攻。

In the first lunar month of the ninth year of Tongzhi, he was struck by cannon fire while attacking a fortified village outside Jinjibao, fell from his horse and died.
同治九年正月，攻金积堡外围一个寨子，中炮坠马，因而阵亡，

His nephew Liu Jintang took command.
所部由他的侄子刘锦棠率领，

In the eleventh month of that same year, Jinjibao finally fell.
同年十一月，终于攻克了金积堡。


The western army won more often than it lost and advanced steadily because its weapons were superior, its morale high and its discipline good.
西征军能够胜多败少，着着进展，是因为器械利、士气旺、纪律好。

With Gu Yingchun's help, Hu bought any new Western firearms or ingenious military equipment that could be useful, without first asking Zuo for instructions.
胡雪岩得古应春之力，西洋凡有新式枪械，以及其他精巧的军事装备，只要能用得上的，不必向左宗棠请示，先就办了来，

Supplies arrived on time; the troops never feared an interruption in provisions or pay.
加以补给适时，从无粮饷不断之虞，

Naturally, morale was high.
士气自然就旺盛了。

Officers and men admired Hu for this and were grateful.
这是西征军将士都佩服，也感激胡雪岩的，

But only Zuo fully understood that their discipline too owed much to him.
但纪律好亦应归功于胡雪岩，就只有左宗棠最明白了。

Since the closing years of Xianfeng, when Saishang’a, grandfather of the Tongzhi emperor's empress of the Aludai clan, had lost his army and squandered two million taels of military funds from the ministry treasury, the provinces had been fighting their own wars.
从成丰未年，同治皇后阿鲁待氏的祖父赛尚武丧师失律，浪掷了一笔发自部库的二百万两银子的军饷以后，仗都是地方上自己在打，

Hence the various Chu, Hunan, Huai, Zhejiang and Guangdong armies, all called government troops.
因此有楚军、湘军、淮军、浙军、粤军等等名号，都称之为“官军”，

They came from many sources.
这些官军，来源不一，

Men recruited in their commanders' home districts formed the majority, but there were also bandits and men transferred from elsewhere.
“回乡招募”的子弟兵固占多数，但也不个是土匪或者别处投过来的，

Their backgrounds differed, as did their officers' methods, and discipline varied greatly.
出身不同，队官的作风各异，军纪就大有区别。

Within the Hunan Army, Peng Yulin's men were the best disciplined and Bao Chao's the worst, reflecting their commanders' differing views.
湘军中以彭玉鳞部下纪律最严，鲍超一军最糟糕，这就是带兵的看法不同之故，

But Bao was brave and skilful, a favourite of Zeng's, and was indulged in many things.
不过鲍超骁勇善战，是曾国藩的“爱将”，所以诸事宽容。

Zuo's forces were equally mixed, yet they all observed discipline.
左宗棠所部，亦是杂牌军队，但都能格守纪律，

Half the credit belonged to his strict command; the other half to their wholehearted devotion, which made them unwilling to disobey.
一半是左宗棠治军较严，一半亦由于心悦诚服，不忍违犯纪律，

For that devotion, Hu deserved acknowledgement.
论心悦诚服之所起，就不能不推服胡雪岩了，

Hunan men served all over the empire without anxiety for those at home because his extensive network of banks and convenient remittances supported their families regularly.
“湖湘子弟满天下”而无后顾之忧，都由于胡雪岩靠他广设钱庄、通汇便利，按时得能接济官兵家属。

When officers or soldiers died, he sent men to provide death benefits and support the survivors without waiting for Zuo's instructions.
至于阵亡将士，恤死养生，不用左宗棠关照，他就派人去做了，

Everyone thought: the marquis cares so much for us; how could we bear to violate his discipline?
大家都道“侯爷”如此爱护部下，何忍犯他的军纪？

They did not know that Hu was helping the marquis maintain it.
却不知是胡雪岩在助“候爷”维持纪律。


Hu managed to attend to public duties and private business alike.
胡雪岩能够公私兼顾，

Banks, pawnshops and silk firms opened one after another, his enterprises expanded, and his reputation as the God of Wealth grew ever louder.
钱庄。典当、丝号一家接一家开张，生意越做越大，“财神”的名气越来越响，

Everyone, beginning with Old Madam Hu, attributed it to Madam Luosi.
从胡老太太起始，都认为是“螺蛳太太”的功劳，

That title had arisen because they wished to avoid calling her Second Madam but could think of nothing more suitable.
原来为了避免用“二太太”之名，却又想不出更合适的称呼，

A learned man had offered a precedent: “In the Shunzhi reign, Gong Zhilu, one of the Three Great Masters of the Lower Yangtze, married Gu Meisheng, who came from the Qinhuai courtesan quarter.
有个通人说：“顺治年间‘江左三大家’之一的龚芝麓，娶了秦淮出身的顾眉生，

Gong's principal wife addressed her as Madam Gu.
龚芝麓的元配称她为‘顾太太’，

Why not follow that example and replace the ‘Sister’ in ‘Luo Sijie’ with ‘Madam’?”
仿照这个例子，拿‘罗四姐，的’姐，字改为‘太太’，有何不可？

Thus she became Madam Luo Si.
于是，‘罗四太太，就此叫开了。

Servants who did not understand the reasoning assumed the title came from her family home outside Luosi, or Snail, Gate, and it became Madam Luosi.
下人不明其理，只当她娘家住在螺蛳门外的缘故，叫成’螺蛳太太“。

但最为乡党称道，而且使得胡雪岩自觉对螺蛳太太有愧，既爱且敬的是，她有个“大贤大德”的名声，为胡雪岩娶了十一房姨太太。

约莫嫁后一年，螺蛳太太向到杭州三天竺来烧香的七姑奶奶诉苦。

Hu had exceptional sexual energy.
原来胡雪岩精力过人，

Being his sole nightly companion had become more than she could manage, and the pleasure no longer outweighed the strain.
只她一个人“当夕”，有些力不从心，因而也就觉得乐不敌苦了。

Hu consequently began lingering among the courtesans.
于是胡雪岩不免留连花丛，

Entertaining at their houses had long been an almost daily duty for him, but previously he had confined himself to dining and drinking there.
本来欢场中应酬，在胡雪岩几乎是每天的例课，以前仅止于“吃花酒”，

渐渐地以勾栏为行馆，经常整夜不归，其至在“堂子”里接见宾客，料理公事，

这件事就可忧了。

“Seventh Sister, he is riding high now.
“七姐，”螺蛳太太说：“他现在正在风头上，

He cannot afford this run of romantic adventures.
这步桃花运走不得，

First, it harms his health.
第一，伤身体，

Second, it delays important business.
第二，耽误正事，

Third, it damages his reputation.
第三，名声不好听，

And fourth, what if every employee follows his example, whoring and gambling without restraint?
还有第四，伙计们看东家的样，个个狂嫖滥赌，怎么得了？

Even if they don't imitate him, they will be discouraged.
就算不学他的样，也会灰心，

They work so hard to help him build his enterprises, only to discover that he is such a disappointment.”
辛辛苦苦帮他创业，哪知道他是这样子不成材！”

The Seventh Lady knew that these last words expressed her friend's own resentment.
七姑奶奶知道最后两句话，是她“夫子自道”的牢骚，

不过，她也有些怀疑，

“Everyone knows that Little Uncle has never overcome his weakness for women.
“小爷叔对这个‘色，字看不破，是大家都晓得的。

But why should it have reached such a degree?”
不过，”她问；“又何至于’好‘到这个程度呢？”

Madam Luosi could not suppress a complaint.
“喏，”螺蛳太太不免有怨言，

“It is all the fault of our Third Uncle Liu!”
“都是我们那位刘三叔！”


Hu had decided to open a medicine shop.
原来胡雪岩决定开办药店，

He had long wished to do so, and an affront had finally prompted him.
他本早有此心，恰好又受了气，

The previous summer, his mother had suffered an attack of sha after exposure to the heat.
去年夏天胡老大大受暑发痧，

The traditional remedy was to scrape the skin with a copper coin, producing a bright red streak, after which the symptoms promptly subsided.
土法子是拿铜钱刮瘀，刮出一条鲜红的血痕，病势顿去。

Old Madam Hu had been thoroughly scraped and was already out of danger, but her son remained anxious.
胡老太太的痧刮得很透，本来已经不要紧了，只是胡雪岩不放心，

请“郎中”来看了以后，开方打药，一再关照下人要快！

Even so, the man did not return for two double-hours.
仍旧去了两个时辰才回来，

Hu was exceptionally particular about anything concerning his mother, and he flew into one of his rare tempers.
胡雪岩对有关老母的事异常认真，当下大发了一场难得一见的脾气。

Only after the scolding ended did the servant explain.
下人等他骂完，方始声诉：

An epidemic was spreading that year, and customers had to queue for medicines.
原来这年时疫流行，打药的人排着队等，

After waiting for more than a double-hour, he had lost patience and squeezed to the front, hoping to have his prescription filled out of turn, as people sometimes did when seeking a consultation.
一等等了个把时辰，他忍不住挤上前去，象看病“拔号”似的，要求先配他的方子。

“Please hurry.
“请你快点。

Our old lady is waiting to take it.”
我们老太太等在那里要吃呢！”

“Who doesn't have an old lady at home?” the shop assistant replied.
“哪家没有老太太？”药店伙计答说：

“If you are in such a hurry, why don't you open your own medicine shop?”
“你要快，不会自家去开一爿药店？”

The scolded servant now vented his resentment on the assistant, embellishing the account until he rekindled Hu's anger.
挨了骂的那人，一股怨气发泄在药店伙计头上，加油添酱地形容了一番，将胡雪岩的火气挑拨了起来，

Stamping his foot, Hu declared, “Very well!
当时顿一顿足说：“好！

I shall open one and show him.”
我就开一爿给他看。”

Liu Bucai was ordered to make the preparations and set off that very day for Zhili to buy medicinal ingredients.
于是刘不才受命筹备，即日北上到直隶去采办药材，

Along with them, he brought back several hundred dogskin plasters for Hu to try.
顺便带回来几百帖“狗皮膏药”，供胡雪岩试用。


These dogskin plasters were a kind of sexual stimulant.
这“狗皮膏药”是“房中药”的一种。

While buying medicines, Liu's generosity and humour had won him many friends.
刘不才在采买药材时，由于他的豪爽风趣，结识了好些朋友，

Over wine, their conversation inevitably turned to women.
酒酣耳热之际，少不得谈谈风月。

One man from Suzhou mentioned Hong Jun, the top graduate of the previous imperial examination and now Education Commissioner of Hebei.
其中有个苏州人，谈起上一科的状元，现任河北学政的洪钧，

Hong had recently written home asking someone to find him a concubine.
说他最近写信回苏州，托人买妾，

His letter was frank: the purpose of taking a concubine was to enjoy life while one could.
信中说得很坦率，娶妾无非及时行乐，

There was no need for excuses such as “Of the three failures in filial duty, having no heir is the greatest,” when a man lacked a son, or “There is no one to look after me,” when he lived away from home.
用不着找什么理由，没有儿子，一定说是“不孝有三，无后为大”，单身在外，说是没有人照料起居，

Such claims merely deceived oneself and others.
这些话、无非自欺欺人而已。

Enjoying life while one could, he said, had two sides.
他说：及时行乐，这句话，要分做两面来谈，

First, one must be timely: take a concubine early, for by middle age strength begins to decline.
一面是及时，娶妾就要娶得早，人到中年，渐形衰颓，

To face beauty with insufficient vigour was to disappoint not only oneself but another person.
美色当前，力不从心，不但自误，而且误人，

Second came enjoyment, which naturally required a beautiful concubine.
一面是行乐，当然要娶美妾，才有乐趣而言。

His listeners responded to such frankness with equal sincerity and eventually found him a celebrated Shanghai courtesan of exceptional beauty, Sai Jinhua.
大家听他说得诚恳，亦以诚恳相待，终于替他觅到了一个上海的名妓，国色天香的赛金花作妾。

Another man lamented that in youth, while building a career, one had ample energy but no money.
于是另有一人感叹：说少年创业，精力过人，就是没有钱，

及至创业已成，钱是有了，精力却嫌不足，姬妾满眼，广田自荒，说不定还会戴上绿帽子，

人生憾事，莫过于此。

这些话提醒了刘不才，想起胡雪岩或许亦有此憾。

因而打听，有没有好春药，只壮阳，不伤身。

当时便有人指点，北京鼓楼有一家小药店，

It sold externally applied dogskin plasters, said to act gently, unlike internal stimulants that exhausted a man like draining a pond to catch its fish.
可以买到外用的“狗皮膏药”，药性王道，不似内服的春药，竭泽而渔那样霸道。

不过这家小药店的主人，颇以制售此药为耻，

须有跟他交情很深的人介绍，而且只特制，不零售。

刘不才的人缘不错，居然找到了适当的介绍人，

出重金订制了一批。

胡雪岩试用之下，床第之间，便就此放纵了。

“这是没法子的事。”七姑奶奶说：“除非你想得开，”

这意思是，螺蛳太太可能容许胡雪岩另外纳妾来分她的宠？

她心里想，自己是半正半侧的身分，

老太太固然宠信有加，大太太也能相安无事，但做当家人难免为下人憎厌，

倘或娶进一房夷太太来。为人厉害，又为下人撺掇，联络大太太，不顾先进门为大“这个规矩，明枪暗箭，处处作对，

不会吃醋的，吃得可笑、可怜、可怕，
