Keep an eye out for someone for me, Seventh Sister.”
螺蛳太太说：“七姐，你也帮我留意留意。”

The Seventh Lady realized that she had decided to act on the advice.
一听这话，七姑奶奶知道她决心照她的话去做了。

It had begun as casual conversation; even if meant as a plan, it would require long consideration.
本来是闲谈，即令有为她策划的意思，亦需从长计议，

She had never expected such immediate acceptance.
不道她从善如流，立刻就听信了！实在出人意外。


At that thought, the Seventh Lady suddenly felt a weight on her shoulders.
转念到此，她顿感肩头沉更，

As the saying went, “If you want discord at home, take a concubine.”
俗语说的“若要家不和，娶个小老婆”，

Women like Madam Luosi were exceedingly rare.
象螺蛳太太这样的情形，实在少而又少，

Besides, Hu had chosen Luo for himself.
再说罗四姐是胡雪岩自己看中的，

Even if things had gone badly after she entered the household, the Seventh Lady could not have been blamed.
即令进门以后不如意，也怪不到她头上。

This was different: it now seemed entirely her proposal.
现在不同了，竞完全象是她出的主意，

If trouble followed, everyone, beginning with Old Madam Hu, would resent her.
将来倘有风波，从胡老太太起，都会怨她。

She must therefore think carefully on her friend's behalf.
因而不能不好好替螺蛳太太想一想。

“Sister Luo, things sound fine in the planning but are not so easy to carry out.
“四姐，”她想到就说：“凡事想得蛮好，做起来不太容易。

If Little Uncle wants to marry someone from a courtesan house, you must refuse.
小爷叔如果要讨堂子里的人，你不可以许他，

Such women have habits that make them difficult to manage.”
堂子里的人有习气，难管。”

“Yes.
“是的。

She must be a girl from a respectable family.
要讨总要讨好人家的女儿。”

I shall make it clear to him first: he may look for someone himself, but I must see her.
螺蛳太太又说：“我要先同大先生说明白，他尽管自己去物色，人一定要让我看过。”

In fact, there is no need for him to look.
她紧接着又说，“其实用不着他自己去物色，

I shall ask people to choose someone for him.”
我先托人替他去挑。”

She did as she said.
螺蛳太太说到做到，

Over three or four years, the women she found, together with those Hu chose himself, made eleven additional concubines.
三、四年工夫，陆续物色，加上胡雪岩自己选中的，一共娶了十一房姨太太，

Including her, they numbered exactly twelve, like the Twelve Beauties of the novel.
连她自己在内，恰好凑成十二金钗之数。


With more family members and an expanding business continually bringing new personnel, the house proved inadequate despite repeated extensions.
眷属一多，又加上生意发达，不断添人，原有的房子虽然一再扩充，始终不敷所需，

Eventually the limits of the site meant either complete rebuilding or finding another home.
到后来基地所限，倘非彻底翻造，就得另辟新居。

Hu discussed it with Madam Luosi.
胡雪岩便与螺蛳太大商量，

He proposed buying land and building a new residence elsewhere, moving his two younger brothers there along with the various people who worked for him, and demolishing the vacated buildings to make a garden.
打算另外觅地建一所住宅，将他的两个胞弟，连同各式办事人等一起迁了出去，空出来的房子拆掉，改做花园，

He also wanted a gallery-lined residence where his Twelve Beauties could live together.
另外要造一座“走马楼”，将“十二金钡”集中一起。

Madam Luosi approved of the latter but objected to the separate house.
螺蛳太太对造一座走马楼，倒颇赞成，但对另建新宅却有异议。

“Asking Second Master and Third Master to move out will hurt your mother.
“请二老爷、三老爷搬出去，会伤老太太的心，

The relatives will gossip too.
亲戚也会说闲话。

You ought to reconsider.”
这件事，老爷还要斟酌。”

At the thought of hurting his mother, Hu abandoned the proposal at once.
听说会伤老母之心，胡雪岩立即打消了原议，

“But there isn't enough room.
不过，“房子不够住，

We must do something.
总要想法子。”

Have you a better idea?”
他问：“你有啥好主意？”

“I hear the Liu house next door is for sale.
“我听说间壁刘家的房子要卖，

The owner of the rice shop behind us has died, and his two sons keep quarrelling over the division of the estate and who should run the shop.
后门口米店老板死掉了，两个儿子分家争产，米店归哪个管，一直在吵，

They also want to sell the building and divide the cash.
也想卖了房子分现款。

Why not buy both properties and break through the walls to join them to ours?”
不如拿这两家的地皮买过来，打通围墙，不是可以联在一起？”

This revived Hu's appetite for grand display.
这下又激起了胡雪岩好摆排场的意兴。

Silk prices happened to rise sharply that year.
恰好这年丝价大涨。

Through his control of the silk trade with foreign houses, he made four hundred thousand taels in three months.
胡雪岩操纵“洋庄”，结算下来三个月的工夫，赚了四十万银子，

He decided on a grand garden.
‘决定大治园林。

“Let us pretend I never earned that money.
“譬如我没有挣到这笔款子，”他这样对螺蛳太太说：

I shall follow your suggestion, but on a larger scale.
“我照你的意思来做，不过范围要做得大，

Streets must bound it on all four sides, making one great, regular block, with the grandeur of a prince's mansion.”
前后左右都要临街，方方整整一大片，象王府的气派才好。”

Madam Luosi was naturally pleased by such distinction.
这是有面子的事，螺蛳太太当然高兴。

Hu sent men to persuade the surrounding households, offering substantial inducements.
于是胡雪岩派人到周围人家去游说，动以厚利，

All but two agreed to move and sell.
其中除了两家，都愿意迁让。


One holdout was a wine warehouse.
这两家一家是酒栈，

It said the stored wine was too difficult to move and refused to sell, firmly but politely.
说存酒搬运不便，无法出让，态度虽然坚决，说话却很客气。

The other was different.
另一家就不同了。

It was a tiny barbershop at the corner of Yuanbao Street and Wangxianqiao Straight Street, a place everyone had to pass when entering or leaving.
这一家是个极小的剃头店，位置恰好在元宝街与望仙桥直街转角之处，为出入所必经，

To have a gap in the estate at such an important junction—and a dilapidated barbershop at that—was as intolerable as a peerless beauty with one eye blind.
整片房子，在此交通要道上缺了一块，而且是家破破烂烂的剃头店，就象绝色美人，瞎了一只眼那样令人难以忍受。

“What does she want?” Hu demanded.
“好是啥意思？”胡雪岩说：

“If she wants a good price, let her name it.
“她如果想卖好价钱，尽管说。

Whatever she asks, she can have.”
要多少就多少好了。”

“She” was Old Mrs Cui, the proprietor's mother.
她，是指剃头店的“崔老太婆”。

Her son was stubborn too, but the Hu household's frequent visits and courteous persuasion, together with the prospect of money, had begun to move him.
老板是她的儿子，脾气虽然也很犟，但经不住胡家人三天两头去说好话，又看在钱的分上。意思倒有些活动了。


His mother, however, refused absolutely.
可是崔老大婆执意不允，

Widowed young and left without support, she had struggled to bring him up, only to see him become a barber.
原来她是年轻守寡，孤苦无依，好不容易将儿子抚养成人，也只是个剃头匠，

Rather than blame herself for choosing that trade for him, she accused Heaven of blindness.
她不怨自己当初不该叫儿子去学了这一行，只说老天无眼，

Over time she had grown contrary and bitter, hating the wealthy in proportion to their wealth.
慢慢养成了乖僻的脾气，最恨有钱人，越有钱越恨。

Hu's promise to pay whatever she asked touched precisely her sore point.
因此，胡雪岩说到“要多少就多少”这句话，恰恰犯了她的忌。

“Tell your employer that he may be the God of Wealth, but we are paupers.
“你同你们东家去说，他是财神，我们是穷鬼，

We have no dealings with him.
打不上交道。

Let him make his fortune.
他发财是他的，

He is neither the King of Hell nor a judge in the underworld.
他又不是阎王、判官，

I have no reason to fear him.”
我也用不着怕他。”

The negotiator was Zhang Zihong, a literary hanger-on in Hu's household, famous for his mild temper.
去打交道的是胡雪岩门下的一个清客，名叫张子洪，以脾气好出名，

Even he lost patience.
此时也忍不住生气，

“He may not be the King of Hell or an underworld judge, but he is a circuit intendant.”
说了一句：“他虽不是阎王判官，不过是个道台。”

“Does that put him above the law?
“道台莫非不讲王法？”

My son and I have only our two lives.
崔老太婆答说：“我们娘儿两个两条命，

Let him do as he pleases.”
随便他好了。”

When Hu heard this, he was so angry that he ate nothing all day.
这番话传到胡雪岩耳朵里，气得一天没有吃饭。

His household retainers, accountants, managers and servants proposed all kinds of measures: send the county bailiffs, burn down the house, or forge a deed and sue her.
门下清客，帐房、管事，还有听差打杂的，议论纷纷，而且出了好些主意，有的说请县里的差役来跟她说话，有的说放火烧掉她的房子再说，有的说造张假契约跟她打官司，

Hu could not bring himself to do it.
但胡雪岩终觉不忍，

Madam Luosi also feared that coercion might lead to a death and restrained the servants from any rash act.
螺蛳太太也怕逼出人命案子来，约束下人，不准胡来。

Even after the great mansion was completed and Yuanbao Street repaved, the barbershop remained.
以至于一直到巨宅落成，元室街也重新翻修过，那家剃头店始终存在。


The completion was celebrated with three days of banquets.
落成之日，大宴宾客，共分三日，

On the first day, the guests were the three principal provincial authorities, the prefect of Hangzhou, the magistrates of Renhe and Qiantang, and expectant circuit intendants, with local gentry invited to keep them company.
第一天是“三大宪”，杭州府、仁和、钱塘两县，以及候补道，邀约在籍的绅士作陪，

Before the meal, Hu personally led them through the garden.
入席之前，主人亲自引导游园，

Following its winding paths around a rockery, they saw an extraordinarily splendid tower rising among the trees to the southeast.
曲曲折折，转过假山，只见东南方树木掩映之中，矗起一座高楼，华丽非凡，

What puzzled them was the gold light flashing from the carved railings all around it.
令人不解的是，四周雕栏，金光闪耀，

At that distance, nobody could account for it.
远远望去，谁也猜不透是何缘故。

“Mr Hu,” Governor Yang Changjun asked, “what is that building?”
“雪翁，”巡抚杨昌浚问道：“那是个什么所在？”

“The residence of my wife.”
“是内人所住的一座楼。”

Hearing that it belonged to the women's quarters, Yang could not inquire further, but private questions brought the explanation.
听说是内眷住处，杨昌浚不便再间，私下打听，

It was called the Hundred Lions Tower.
才知道那座楼名为“百狮楼”。

One hundred lions carved and polished from zitan stood on the railing posts.
栏杆柱子上，用紫檀打磨出一百个狮子，

Their protruding eyes were cast in gold and glittered in the sunlight so brightly that one could scarcely look at them.
突出的狮目，是用黄金铸就，所以映日耀眼，令人不可逼视。

“Why call the ladies' residence Hundred Lions Tower?
“太太们住的地方，怎么叫百狮楼，

Does he not know the saying about the lioness of Hedong roaring?”
莫非‘河东狮吼’这句话，他都不懂。”

“No, that isn't it.
“不是。

The lady is called Madam Luosi, and he built the tower for her.” Yang asked how she had acquired the name and what her origins were.
因为那位太太称为螺蛳太太，所以胡大先生造了这座楼给她住。”杨昌浚再问“螺蛳太太”之名如何而起，是何出身。

Once informed, he felt that Hu had gone rather too far and quietly wrote to Zuo at Suzhou in Gansu, expressing some criticism.
打听清楚了觉得未免过分，便悄悄写了一封信给在肃州的左宗棠，颇有微词。


Zuo disagreed considerably with Yang but could not conveniently say so outright.
哪知左宗棠对他的看法，颇不以为然，只是不便明言，

As it happened, his eldest son also wrote to criticize Hu, giving him a suitable occasion to express his view.
恰巧他的长子来信，亦批评了胡雪岩，正好借题发挥，

A man's enjoyments, he said, should be proportionate to his deserts.
说一个人的享用，求其相称，

The world did not fully understand Hu's services, but he did.
胡雪岩的功劳，世人不尽了解，他很清楚，

The western campaign owed its present success entirely to Hu; a little excess in his pleasures need give him no shame.
西征军事之能有今日，全亏得有胡雪岩，享用稍过，自可无愧。

He cited Tao Shu, his closest lifelong friend and the father of his child's spouse.
他又提到他的儿女亲家，也是平生第一知己的陶澍，

When Tao was Governor-General of Liangjiang, his son-in-law Hu Linyi, a Hanlin academician living idly at Jiangning, spent his days seeking singers and beautiful women, all at the expense of his father-in-law's integrity allowance.
在两江总督任上时，他的女婿胡林翼，以翰林在江宁闲住，每天选歌征色，花的都是老丈人的“养廉银”，

Once Tao's household accountant asked whether Hu Linyi's extravagance ought to be restrained.
内帐房有一次向陶演表示，胡林翼挥霍无度，是否应该稍加节制？

“Let him spend,” Tao replied.
陶澎告诉他说：“尽管让他花！

“He will serve the country one day.
他将来要为国家出力，

Then, even if he has money, he will have no time to spend it.”
有钱亦没有工夫去花。”

Hu Xueyan's circumstances differed, but compared with the great benefits he secured for the country, even extravagant personal pleasures counted for little.
胡雪岩跟胡林翼的情形虽有不同，但个人的享用，比起为国家所谋的大利来，即令豪奢亦不足道。

These remarks eventually reached Zhejiang.
这些活辗转传到浙江，

Deeply grateful, Hu served Zuo with still greater loyalty and effort.
胡雪岩感激在心，对左宗棠自然越发尽忠竭力，

Madam Luosi, however, grew uneasy.
但螺狮太太却心生警惕，

In private talks with the Seventh Lady, both agreed that a tall tree catches the wind: it was time to become less conspicuous.
与七姑奶奶私下谈起来，都认为“树大招风”，应该要收敛了。

Yet Hu needed only to ask, “How are we to cut back?” and she had no answer.
可是胡雪岩只问一句：“怎么收法？”螺蛳太太却又无词以对。

For Hu depended on credit; credit rested on the confidence others placed in him; and that confidence was created by the grandeur of his establishment.
因为胡雪岩所凭借的是信用，信用是建立在大家对他的信心上面，而信心是由胡雪岩的场面造成的。

The display could only grow, never shrink.
场面只能大，不能小，

Otherwise, a single casual remark—“Mr Hu is no longer what he used to be”—would instantly set off endless speculation.
否则只要有人无意间说一句：“胡大先生如今也不比从前了。”立刻就会惹起无数猜测，

Those who bore him grudges, and those who had no grievance but were merely envious, would fan the rumours.
原来有仇恨的、无怨无仇只是由于妒嫉的，都将推波助澜，大放谣言，

His credit would be shaken, with consequences too terrible to contemplate.
那一来信用就要动摇，后果不堪设想。



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第一章（本章第1部分，共4部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER ONE
第一章


For this reason, although Madam Luosi, like Hu Xueyan, felt quite unlike her usual self at the turn of the year, she forced herself to be cheerful, put on a smiling face, and saw the household through a lively New Year.
因为如此，螺蛳太太的心境虽然跟胡雪岩一样，不同往年，还是强打精神，扮出笑脸，热热闹闹地过了一个年。

Then came another rush of preparations, this time for Old Madam Hu’s birthday.
接着便又要为胡老太太的生日，大忙特忙了。

The birthday fell on the eighth day of the third month, but invitations announcing that a birthday feast would be laid and respectfully requesting the guests’ presence had gone out before the New Year.
生日在三月初八，『浩治桃觞，恭请光临』的请帖，却在年前就发出去了。

By the middle of the second month, special messengers bringing gifts from the capital and the provinces were arriving in Hangzhou in a steady stream.
到得二月中旬，京中及各省送礼的专差，络绎来到杭州，

Members of the Hu household had been assigned specifically to receive them.
胡府上派有专人接待；

The gifts were modest in material value but rich in sentiment.
送的礼都是物轻意重，

Since Hu Xueyan already bore the title of God of Wealth, anything merely expensive would be so much wasted effort.
因为胡雪岩既有『财神』之号，送任何贵重之物，都等于『白搭』，

What could truly lend distinction to the birthday halls were congratulatory couplets, embroidered banners, and birthday tributes bearing their donors’ official titles.
惟有具官衔的联幛寿序，才是可使寿堂生色的。


Seven birthday halls had been prepared.
寿堂共设七处，

The most important was not in Yuanbao Street but at Yunlin Temple at Lingyin.
最主要的一处，不在元宝街，而是在灵隐的云林寺。

Hu Xueyan brought his resident literary companions there and personally supervised its decoration.
铺设这处寿堂时，胡雪岩带着请客，亲自主持，

High in the center hung a plaque with gold lettering on a red ground: “Her Virtuous Conduct Is Widely Known.”
正中上方高悬一方红地金书的匾额，『淑德彰闻』，

Above the inscription appeared the imperial seal, “Treasure of the Empress Dowager Cixi”; below it was the dedication, “Bestowed upon Lady Zhu, mother of Hu Guangyong, expectant circuit intendant [the province is corrupt in the source], bearing the honorary rank of provincial treasurer and the honors of the senior first rank.”
上铭一方御玺∶『慈禧皇太后之宝』，款书∶『赐正一品封典布政使衔东西候补道胡光墉之母朱氏』。

Whose couplets and banners should hang beneath it required some thought.
匾额之下，应该挂谁送的联幛，却费斟酌了。

In the capital, princes and members of the imperial family were ordinarily prohibited by established custom from exchanging such courtesies with officials or private citizens.
原来京中除了王公亲贵，定制向不与品官士庶应酬往来以外，

Apart from them, however, everyone from the grand secretaries and grand councilors down through the heads of the Six Ministries and the Nine Courts had sent birthday gifts.
自大学士、军机大臣以下，六部九卿，都送了寿礼，

Li Hongzhang, like Zuo Zongtang, had sent a pair of couplets and an embroidered banner.
李鸿章与左宗棠一样，也是一联一幛，

In terms of official standing, Li, Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall, had long been the senior grand secretary and the foremost of all civil officials; his gifts belonged in the center.
论官位，武英殿大学士李鸿章，久居首辅，百僚之长，应该居中。

Hu Xueyan, however, insisted on giving Zuo pride of place.
但胡雪岩却执意要推尊左宗棠，

One of his literary companions, Zhang Aihui, believing that true concern for a friend required guiding him toward proper conduct, ventured to remonstrate.
便有爱人以德的一个名叫张爱晖的清客，提出规劝。


“Mr Hu, the ranks and honors conferred by the throne are matters of the utmost importance.
『大先生，朝廷名器至重，

Lord Li of Hefei is the senior grand secretary.
李合服是首辅；

Lord Zuo of Xiangyin is Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and entered the Grand Secretariat only recently.
左湘阴是东阁大学士，入阁的资格很浅，

He must accept the lesser position.
不能不委屈。

If the order of precedence is wrong at an occasion as grand as this, people will criticize it.
这样的大场面，次序弄错了。要受批评；

And should some meddlesome censor choose to pick faults and accuse you of letting private attachments overturn the established order, whatever unpleasantness followed would be quite needless.”
如果再有好事的言官吹毛疵，说大先生以私情乱纲纪，搞出啥不痛快的事来，也太无谓了。』

“You are right.
『你的话不错。

But a splendid sedan chair needs people to lift it: we all depend on others to help us up.
不过「花花轿儿人抬人」，

Xiangyin thinks so highly of me.
湘阴这样看得起我，

If I fail to uphold him on an occasion like this and put him down in second place, my own conscience will reproach me.”
遇到这种场面，我不捧他一捧，拿他贬成第二，我自己都觉得良心上说不过去。』

“That is not the way to look at it, Mr Hu.
『话不是这么说。大先生，

If you follow the rules, Xiangyin will certainly understand.”
你按规矩办事，湘阴一定也原谅的。』


“Even if he understands, I cannot forgive myself.
『就算他原谅，我自己没法子原谅，

Mr Zhang, do try to think of a reason that would let us put Xiangyin in the center.”
张先生，你倒想个理由出来，怎么能拿湘阴居中。』

“There is no such reason,” Zhang Aihui replied. “Besides, Mr Hu, you have no need to offend Lord Li of Hefei for nothing.”
『没有理由。』张爱晖又说∶『大先生，你也犯不着无缘无故得罪李合肥。』

Hu Xueyan said nothing.
胡雪岩不作声，

The discussion was on the point of reaching an impasse when Mr Wu, a frequent visitor, suddenly spoke. “There is a way.
局面看着要僵了；那常来走动的乌先生忽然说道∶『有办法，

We need only alter the signature at the bottom.”
只要把下款改一改好了。』

“How?” Hu asked eagerly.
『怎么改法？』胡雪岩很高兴问。

“Add his hereditary title.”
『加上爵位就可以了。』


The banner Zuo Zongtang had sent was addressed, “To my honored Aunt Hu, in celebration of her sixty-ninth birthday.”
原来左宗棠送的寿幛，上款是『胡老伯母六秩晋九荣庆』，

At the bottom stood the bare signature, “Zuo Zongtang respectfully offers his congratulations.”
下款是『秃头』的『左宗棠拜祝』，

For Zuo to treat Hu as a friend of his own generation was in itself a considerable distinction.
平辈论交，本来是极有面子的事；

Mr Wu proposed adding Zuo’s hereditary title, making the signature read, “Zuo Zongtang, Marquis Kejing, respectfully offers his congratulations.”
乌先生主张加上左宗棠的爵位，变成『恪靖候左宗棠拜祝』；

This would place him above Li.
这一来就可居李之上了，

Even if Li’s signature were furnished with all his titles—Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall, Minister of Beiyang, Governor-General of Zhili, and Earl Suyi—an earl still ranked one grade below a marquis and would have to yield precedence.
因为李鸿章的下款上加全衔『武英殿大学士北洋大臣直隶总督部堂肃毅伯』，伯爵次侯爵一等，只好屈居左宗棠之次。

Mr Wu was only a temple keeper.
那乌先生是个庙祝，

Hu Xueyan had included him among his literary companions because he belonged to Madam Luosi’s own circle: affection for her extended to those connected with her.
只为他是螺蛳太太的『娘家人』；胡雪岩爱屋及乌，将他侧于清客之列。

He had never been held in much regard.
一直不大被看得起，

This masterly suggestion made everyone see him in a new light.
此时出此高明的一着，大家不由得刮目相看了。


“Still, Mr Hu, let me presume to offer one more suggestion.
『不过大先生，我倒还要放肆，胡出一个主意。

If Lord Zuo of Xiangyin hangs in the center, Lord Li of Hefei’s couplets and banner will have to go on the paneled wall to the east.
如果左湘阴居中，李合肥的联幛只好挂在东面板壁，

That seems rather too great a slight.
未免贬之过甚；

Would it not be better to hang a picture of the immortals offering birthday greetings at the Jade Pool in the center, with Zuo’s and Li’s gifts on the more and less honored sides?”
是不是中国挂一幅瑶池祝寿图，拿左、李的联幛分悬上下首，比较合适？』

Seeing how carefully Mr Wu considered the whole situation, Hu put him in sole charge of the principal birthday hall at Lingyin.
胡雪岩看乌先生善持大体，便请他专管灵隐这个最主要的寿堂，

He also instructed his nephew Zhang Anming to consult Mr Wu whenever anything arose.
而且关照他的一个外甥张安明，遇事常找乌先生来商量；

Zhang was the chief steward responsible for the entire birthday celebration.
张安明是胡府做寿揽全局的大总管。


Zhang Anming naturally obeyed to the letter.
张安明自然奉命唯谨，

That very day he invited Mr Wu to drink with him and sincerely sought his advice.
当天就请乌先生小酌，诚意请教，

“There is something I should like your opinion on,” he said.
『有件事，不晓得乌先生有啥好主意？他说，』

“We have seven birthday halls, but there will be so many guests, of such different standing, that if they all crowd in together it will be chaos.
寿堂虽有七处，贺客太多，身分不同，挤在一起，乱得一塌糊涂，

We must find a better arrangement.”
一定要改良。

“There are seven halls.
『』寿堂是七处，

Will the celebrations last seven days as well?”
做寿是不是也做七天？

“Yes.
『『不错。

Mr Hu says the palace custom is ‘three days before and four days after,’ making seven days.”
大先生说，宫里的规矩「前三后四」，要七天。』

Zhang lowered his voice. “But we cannot say that openly.
张安明轻声答说∶『不过，这话对外面不便明说；

We shall simply say that the old lady’s birthday calls for a seven-day Buddhist observance, so guests will be received for seven days.”
只说老太太生日要「打七」，所以开贺也是七天。』

This observance was a shortened form of the Water and Land rite, the most solemn of Buddhist services, formally called the Water and Land Fasting Ritual and popularly known as “performing the Water and Land service.”
『打七』便是设一坛水陆道场，是佛门中最隆重的法事，称为『水陆斋仪』，亦名『水陆道场』，俗称『打水陆』。

The full ritual, with scripture recitation and rites of repentance, lasted seven times seven days, or forty-nine days.
斋仪又有繁简之分，讽经礼忏七七四十九日称为『打水陆』；

For prayers to secure blessings and prolong life, seven days were generally sufficient; hence the name “the seven-day observance.”
为了祝厘延寿，通常只须七日，叫做『打七』。


“With seven halls and seven days for receiving congratulations, you can easily divide the guests into categories and keep them apart.
『有七处寿堂，又分七天受贺，大可分门别类，拿贺客错开来，

They will be easier to entertain, and the banquets will not go to waste.”
接待容易，而且酒席也不致于糟蹋。』

“An excellent idea.
『这个主意好。

Let us work out the divisions.”
我们来分它一分。』

After careful discussion, they decided to invite the official world on the first day.
于是细细商量，决定第一天请官场，

Civil and military dignitaries of the third rank and above, together with civil and military officials of the fifth rank and below, would occupy four halls.
三品以上文武大员；五品以下文武职官，占了四个寿堂，

Minor officials currently holding special assignments would take another, and expectant civil and military officials another.
此外是现奉差委的佐杂官，与文武候补人员各一；

The seventh would be kept for officials arriving unexpectedly from out of town.
留下一处专供临时由外地赶到的官员祝寿之用。

The second day would be for the business world, with associates from the silk, tea, salt, pawnbroking, banking, medicine, and silk-fabric trades divided among the seven halls.
第二天请商场，丝、茶、盐、典、钱、药、绸各行各业的伙友，分开七处。

The third would be for functionaries from the various government offices and the clerks of the six departments—Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Punishments, and Works.
第三天是各衙门的司事，以及吏户礼兵刑工六科的书办；

The fourth would be for members of religious orders.
第四天是出家人的日子；

Relatives and friends would be invited on the fifth and sixth days, the men on one day and the women on the other.
第五天、第六天请亲戚朋友，一天『官客』，一天『堂客』，一天『堂客』。

The seventh, the birthday itself, would naturally be a cheerful gathering of the family and their closest associates.
第七天是寿辰正日，自然是自己人热闹热闹。


They took the completed arrangements to Hu Xueyan, who was not entirely satisfied.
这样安排好了，去请示胡雪岩；他不甚满意，

“We do not need seven halls merely for a family gathering.
『自己人热闹热闹，用不着七处寿堂，

Besides, with no one but our own people it will hardly be lively enough.
而且光是自己人，也热闹不起来。』

We must think again.
他说，『我看还要斟酌。

And I have many foreign friends.
而且我的洋朋友很多，

Where are they to offer their congratulations when they come?”
他们来了，到哪里去拜寿？』

“Then let us set aside a day especially for foreigners,” Mr Wu suggested. “Many come to see West Lake in the third and fourth months.
『这样好了，专留一天给洋人。』乌先生说∶『一到三、四月里，来逛逛西湖的很多，

You might as well make it an open invitation: any foreigner who comes that day to offer birthday greetings, whether you know him or not, shall be invited to the feast.”
大先生索性请个客，这一天的洋人，不论识与不识，只要来拜寿的，一律请吃寿酒。』

“Foreigners cannot handle chopsticks,” Hu said. “If we invite them, we must serve Western food.”
『洋人捏不来筷子。』胡雪岩说∶『要请就要请吃大菜。』

“We shall have to consult Mr Gu about that.”
『这要请古先生来商量了。』

Gu Yingchun was summoned to plan it.
请了古应春来筹划。

The foreigners did not all speak the same language, and their eating habits differed too.
由于洋人语言不尽相同；饮食习惯，亦有差异，

Fortunately, there were seven halls.
好在有七处寿堂，

One each was assigned to the British, French, Germans, Americans, Japanese, Russians, and Belgians.
决定英、法、德、美、日、俄、比七国，各占一处。


“Yingchun,” Hu said, “you will oversee the reception arrangements at all seven places.
『应春，』胡雪岩说∶『这七处接待，归你总其成。

Go to Shanghai and engage the cooks for the Western meals yourself.”
大菜司务，归你到上海去请。』

“Very well,” Gu replied. “Once we have fixed the day, I shall ask my friends at the North-China Daily News to print a notice when I go to Shanghai.
『好。』古应春说∶『要把日子定下来，我到上海，请字林西报的朋友登条新闻，

The foreigners will then come of their own accord.”
到时候洋人自然会来。』

“Splendid!” Zhang Anming said, laughing. “Foreigners paying their respects on Grandmother’s birthday! I doubt any old lady in all history has enjoyed such good fortune.”
『妙极！』张安明笑道∶『外婆生日，洋人拜寿∶只怕从古以来的老太太，只有外婆有这份福气。』

Old Madam Hu was indeed delighted when she heard.
果然，胡老太太听了也很高兴。

The family’s close relatives and friends spread the story as a remarkable piece of news, all eagerly awaiting the sight of foreigners offering birthday congratulations.
胡家的至亲好友，更拿这件事当作新闻去传说，而且都兴致勃勃地要等看见洋人拜寿。


Spring in Hangzhou was unusually lively that year.
这年杭州的春天，格外热闹，

The warm weather naturally brought more boats carrying pilgrims, but that was a lesser cause.
天气暖和，香客船自然就到得多，这还在其次；

The chief attraction was Old Madam Hu’s birthday: accounts of the celebration’s magnificent extravagance had drawn crowds of curious onlookers.
主要的是胡老太太做生日，传说如何如何豪华阔气，招引了好些人来看热闹。

Those coming from other places specifically to offer their congratulations must alone have added several thousand people.
何况光算外地来拜寿的人，起码也增加了好几千人。

On the first day for receiving guests, four halls inside the city and three outside it were festooned with lanterns and colored decorations.
到得开贺的第一天，城里四处，城外三处，张灯结彩，

Around the halls, where ceremonial ensembles softly played their wind instruments and percussion, carriages and horses made a great clamor.
『清音堂名』细吹细打的寿堂周围，车马喧阗，

Add idle spectators and vendors of cooked food, and the crowds were so dense that one could scarcely move.
加上看热闹的闲人、卖熟食的小贩，挤得寸步难行。

Lingyin alone was an exception.
只有灵隐是例外，

Since the three highest provincial authorities were coming, soldiers from the governor’s own command, wearing brand-new uniform jackets, joined the runners of Renhe and Qiantang counties.
因为三大宪要来拜寿，仁钱两县的差役以外，『抚标』亦派出穿了簇新号褂子的兵丁，

From Jiulisong onward they posted guards along the road to maintain order, leaving a broad passage clear all the way to the temple gate.
自九里松开始，沿路布哨弹压，留下了极宽的一条路，直通灵隐山门。


From the gate to the birthday hall, congratulatory couplets and embroidered banners hung everywhere.
从山门到寿堂，寿联寿幛，沿路挂满；

In the hall, Hu Xueyan and the younger men of his family waited to return the visitors’ courtesies.
寿堂上除了胡雪岩领着子侄，等在那里，预备答谢以外，

Four gentlemen had also been invited to act as hosts.
另外请了四位绅士『知宾』。

One was Chen Yigong, a subchancellor of the Grand Secretariat home on leave to care for his parents, who would attend specifically to Liu Bingzhang, Governor of Zhejiang. Another was Tang Zhongsi, a former provincial judicial commissioner of Shanxi who had retired to his native place.
一位是告假回籍养亲的内阁学士陈怡恭，专陪浙江巡抚刘秉璋∶一位是做过山西臬司，告老回乡的汤仲思；

The other two were expectant circuit intendants, magnificently dressed in third-rank robes that Zhang Anming, acting on instructions, had sent a tailor to measure, make, and present to them.
另外两位都是候补道，三品服饰，华丽非凡，是张安明受命派了裁缝，量身现做奉赠的。

Near noon, Liu Bingzhang arrived at Lingyin to the beating of gongs and the cries of his advance attendants clearing the way.
近午时分，刘秉璋鸣锣喝道，到了灵隐，

The provincial treasurer and judicial commissioner, who had arrived earlier, waited before the birthday hall to receive him.
藩臬两司，早就到了，在寿堂前面迎接；

As soon as his sedan stopped, Chen Yigong stepped forward with his hands clasped. “Your Excellency’s presence fills our host with gratitude.
轿子一停，陈怡恭抢上前去，抱拳说道∶『承宪台光临，主人家心感万分。

Please come in.”
请，请！』

He ceremoniously conducted the governor into the hall.
肃客上堂，

After performing the proper greetings, Liu looked up first for the birthday tribute he himself had sent.
行完了礼，刘秉璋抬头先看他送的一堂寿序，

It hung at the foremost end of the western wall, facing a pair of couplets sent by Grand Secretary Bao Yun.
挂在西壁最前端，与大学士宝均金送的一副寿联，遥遥相对；

This was a marked sign of respect.
这是很尊重表示，

He gave a slight, satisfied nod.
他微微点头，表示满意。


Hu Xueyan, who had been leading the younger men of his family in returning the greetings from one side, rose from the strip of red felt on which he had knelt.
这时率领子侄在一旁答礼的胡雪岩，从红毡条上站起身来，

Smiling, he offered his thanks. “We are deeply honored that our venerable grandparent has troubled to come.”
含笑称谢∶『多谢老公祖步，真不敢当。』

The form of address, “venerable grandparent,” was another of Mr Wu’s inventions.
这『老公祖』的称呼，也是乌先生想出来的。

Hu was a circuit intendant with the honorary rank of provincial treasurer, and his mother had been granted the honors of the senior first rank.
因为胡雪岩是布政使衔的道员，老母又有正一品的封典，

He did not feel that his own standing was lower than the governor’s, and he was unwilling to address him as “Your Excellency.”
自觉地位并不下于巡抚，要叫一声『大人』，于心不甘；

Yet to address him as an equal, calling him “Mr Zhong” from his courtesy name Zhongliang, would be too presumptuous.
如用平辈的称谓，刘秉璋字仲良，叫他『仲翁』，又嫌太亢。

When Hu mentioned this small difficulty to Mr Wu, the latter suggested simply using the language of parental authority.
这个小小的难题跟乌先生谈起，他建议索性用『老父母』的称呼；

Local officials were called the people’s father and mother; members of the gentry addressed a magistrate as their “venerable parent,” and the provincial treasurer, judicial commissioner, or governor as their “venerable grandparent.”
地方官是所谓父母官，士绅对县官称『老父母』，藩臬两司及巡抚则称『老公祖』，

By speaking as one of the people under the governor’s jurisdiction, Hu could show due respect while preserving his own standing, neither arrogant nor servile.
这样以部民自居，一方面是尊重巡抚，一方面不亢不卑反而留了身分。


Liu Bingzhang naturally addressed him as “Mr Xue” and offered some complimentary remarks about Old Madam Hu’s good fortune.
刘秉璋自然称他『雪翁』，说了些恭维胡老太太好福气的话，

Chen Yigong then escorted him to the guest seats east of the hall for tea.
由陈怡恭请到寿堂东面的客座中待茶，

Sixteen gleaming new gold fruit stands, raised on high stems, cast such a glow that even Liu’s face seemed yellow.
十六个簇新的高脚金果盘，映得刘秉璋的脸都黄了。

After a short rest, the party was invited to the banquet.
稍坐一坐，请去入席。

It was held in Qingni Pavilion, west of the abbot’s quarters, an open hall six bays wide and thirty-six chi high.
寿筵设在方丈之西的青猊轩；这座敞轩高三太六尺，一共六间，

A finely constructed temporary stage stood to the south.
南面监时搭出极讲究的戏台，

About two zhang in front of it, three tables had been placed in a row, with the governor in the center and the treasurer and judicial commissioner to east and west.
台前约两丈许，并排设下三席，巡抚居中，东西藩臬；

The large square tables had embroidered coverings worked in flat gold thread hanging down their fronts.
大方桌前面系着平金绣花桌围，

The honored guests sat in the upper seats facing the stage, with Chen Yigong and Hu Xueyan attending on either side.
贵客面对戏台上坐，陈怡恭与胡雪岩左右相陪；

Four more tables behind were for expectant circuit intendants currently holding appointments.
后面另有四席，为有差使的候补道而设。

There were only seven tables in that enormous hall and fewer than thirty diners, even counting those present as companions.
偌大厅堂，只得七桌，连陪客都不超过三十个人，

Behind them, however, stood a whole crowd of attendants carrying their masters’ bundles of spare clothing.
但捧着衣包的随从跟班，在后面却都站满了。


Once everyone was seated, the performance of Hongluan Xi, then in progress, stopped briefly.
等安席既罢，戏台上正在唱着的『鸿鸾禧』暂时停了下来，

To the tap of a small gong, the Celestial Official of the Ministry of Personnel appeared in a red robe, black official hat, and jade belt, holding his mask in place between his teeth.
小锣打上一个红袍乌纱、玉带围腰，口衔面具的『吏部天官』，

With ceremonious swaying steps, he advanced to the front of the stage to perform the Dance of Promotion.
一步三摆地，步到台前『跳加官』。

This conveyed wishes that the honored guests might “rise in office any day now” and “hold first rank at court.”
这是颂祝贵客『指日高升』、『一品当朝』，

By custom, the highest-ranking official present had to reward the performers.
照例须由在座官位最高的人放赏；

Liu Bingzhang needed only to give the order: the host had already prepared a great quantity of newly minted copper cash in a bamboo hamper.
不过只要刘秉璋交代一声就行了，主人家早备着大量刚出炉的制钱，盛在竹筐中，

At the word “Reward!” four sturdy servants lifted the hamper, hurried forward, and together heaved it up and poured its contents onto the stage.
听得一个『赏』字，便有四名健仆，抬着竹筐，疾步上前，合力举起来向台上一泼，

Coins clattered across the boards in an astonishing display.
只听『哗喇喇』满台钱响，声势惊人。


Next the troupe’s manager, wearing a hat with a red tassel, came before the tables.
接下来便作戏班子的掌班，戴一顶红缨帽，走到筵前，

Dropping to one knee, he raised the repertoire list above his head. “May Your Excellency choose the plays.”
一膝屈地，高举着戏折子说道∶『请大人点戏。』

Choosing plays required considerable knowledge.
『点戏』颇有学问。

Many had auspicious titles but unhappy plots; an ignorant choice could make one a laughingstock.
因为戏名吉祥，戏实不祥，这种名实不副的戏文很多，不会点会闹笑话；

Worse, something in a play might touch a sensitive point in the history of the host or one of the distinguished guests.
或者戏中情节，恰恰犯了主人家或者哪一贵宾的忌讳，

Choosing such a work could amount to publicly exposing someone’s private affairs, and cases of lasting enmity arising from it were not unknown.
点到这样的戏，无异公然揭人隐私，因而成不解之仇者，亦时有所闻。

Liu Bingzhang knew little about the theater and decided not to reveal his ignorance.
刘秉璋对此道外行，决定藏拙；

Fortunately, an expert was at hand.
好在另有内行在，

“Ask Lord De to choose,” he said, indicating Dexin, the provincial treasurer, seated to the east.
当下吩咐∶『请德大人点。』他指的是坐在东面的藩司德馨，

A bannerman brought up in privileged circumstances, Dexin loved the theater above all else.
他是旗人，出身纨绔，最好戏曲；

After a few modest words, he readily selected four lively and excellent plays that offended no taboos.
当下略略客气了两句，便当仁不让地点了四出不犯忌讳而又热闹的好戏，

The first was The Battle of Wancheng.
第一出是『战宛城』，

Zhu Yunqiu, who played Lady Zou, was a lively female-role performer known as “the Goat-Hair Brush,” a particular favorite of Dexin’s.
饰邹氏的朱韵秋，外号『羊毛笔』，是德馨紧赏识的花旦，

In the scene of awakening romantic longing, the performance was likened to calligraphy traced with such a brush [the comparison is partly illegible in the source]. While Dexin was wholly absorbed in the stage, a personal guard in traveling clothes quietly approached and handed him a letter. “Secretary Chen sent a special messenger with this.”
演到『思春』那一段，真如用『羊毛笔』写赵孟钭郑崦耐鹱钊艘庀正当德馨全神贯注在台上时，有个身穿行装的『戈什哈』悄悄走到他身旁，递上一封信说∶『陈师爷派专人送来的。』

Secretary Chen was Dexin’s trusted aide.
陈师爷是德馨的亲信，

A letter delivered by special messenger at such a time must concern something urgent.
此时派专人送来函件，当然是极紧要的事；

Dexin opened it at the table.
因而当筵拆阅，

Surprise appeared on his face.
只见他面现诧异之色，

He waved the guard away, and his eyes no longer remained fixed on “the Goat-Hair Brush”: instead, he kept glancing toward Liu Bingzhang.
挥一挥手遣走『戈什哈』，双眼便不是专注在『羊毛笔』身上，而是不时朝刘秉璋那边望去。


He was watching for a movement from Hu Xueyan.
他是在注意胡雪岩的动静，

As soon as Hu left the table for a moment, Dexin went over and handed the governor the letter, saying quietly, “News just in from Shanghai.”
一看他暂时离席，随即走了过去，将那封信递了过去，轻声说道∶『刚从上海来的消息。』

Liu read it and sat blinking in thought.
刘秉璋看完信，只是眨眼在思索；

Only after some time did he pass the letter to Chen Yigong. “My friend, look at this.
好一会才将原信递给陈怡恭∶『年兄，你看，

The timing is unfortunate.
消息不巧；

On a day like this, it hardly seems proper to make it known.”
今天这个日子，似乎不宜张扬。』

“Quite,” Chen said after reading it. “This may bring about a small change in the political situation.”
『是！』陈怡恭看完信说∶『这一来，政局恐不免有一番小小的变动。』

“Yes.”
『是的。』

Liu turned to Dexin. “Please keep things going here.
刘秉璋转脸问德馨说∶『请老兄在这里绷住场面，

I must hurry back to the city.”
我得赶紧进城了。』


Dexin, too, wanted to return to his office, but after the governor’s request he could only answer, “Certainly.”
德馨也想回衙门，听刘秉璋如此交代，只能答应一声∶『是。』

Liu turned and beckoned to his attendant.
于是刘秉璋回身招一招手，

“Have the sedan brought up.”
唤来他的跟班吩咐∶『提轿。』

He then clasped his hands to Chen Yigong and was just about to ask him to make his excuses to the host when Hu Xueyan returned.
接着向陈怡恭拱一拱手，正待托他代向主人告辞时，胡雪岩回来了。

“What is it?” Hu asked. “Does our venerable grandparent wish to retire for a moment?”
『怎么？』他问∶『老公祖是要更衣？』

“No,” Liu replied apologetically. “Mr Xue, such fine plays and such an excellent banquet, and I am denied the pleasure of enjoying them!
『不是！』刘秉璋歉意地说∶『雪翁，这么好的戏、好的席，我竟无福消受；

An urgent matter requires me to return to the city at once.”
实在是有急事，马上得回城料理。』

“Ah, of course.”
『呃、呃。』

Hu could hardly press him.
胡雪岩不便多问；

He followed Liu out and saw him into his sedan. Only then did he ask Dexin, “Why is Governor Liu in such a hurry?
只跟在刘秉璋后面，送上轿后方始问德馨∶『刘中丞何以如此匆匆？

What can be so urgent?”
到底是什么急事？』

“We cannot discuss it here.”
『此处不便谈。』

Dexin and Hu were close enough to address each other as brothers. “Brother Hu, there is some news it would be improper to spread today.
德馨与胡雪岩的交情极厚，以兄弟相称∶『胡大哥，有个消息，不便在今天宣扬，

But it is not bad news.”
不过，消息不坏。』


Hu nodded without speaking and returned to the banquet.
胡雪岩点点头不作声，回到筵前，

He waited until the music had ended and the company dispersed before inviting Dexin to the monks’ cell where he was staying and asking for the details.
直待曲终人散∶才邀德馨他借住的一间禅房中，细问究竟。

“Why would it be improper to spread it today?” Dexin said. “Old Madam Li has died in Wuchang.”
『为什么今天不便宣扬呢？』德馨说道∶『李太夫人在武昌去世了。』

The dead woman was the mother of the brothers Li Hanzhang and Li Hongzhang.
去世的是李瀚章、李鸿章兄弟的老母。

Naturally, news of a death could not be announced during Old Madam Hu’s birthday celebration.
胡老太太做生日，自然不便宣布这样一个不吉利的消息。

But the Li brothers would now have to retire from office to observe the prescribed mourning.
但这一来，李氏兄弟丁忧守制，

Zuo Zongtang would temporarily be rid of a political opponent.
左宗棠暂时去了一个政敌，

For Hu Xueyan this was certainly favorable, even a cause for rejoicing, though he could rejoice only inwardly.
对胡雪岩来说，当然是有利的，亦可说是喜事，不过只能喜在心里而已。

“Two governorships-general vacant at once!
『一下子两个总督出缺，

The leading provincial officials will all have to shift their places.
封疆大吏要扳扳位了。

I wonder who will succeed in Zhili and who in Huguang?”
不晓得哪个接直隶，哪个接湖广？』


The question touched precisely on what occupied Dexin’s mind.
这一问，恰恰说中德馨的心事。

A vacant governorship-general would normally be filled by promoting a governor; a vacant governorship would in turn be open to competition among the provincial treasurers.
总督出缺，大致总是由巡抚调升；巡抚有缺，藩司便可竞争，

Liu Bingzhang and Dexin each had his own hopes.
刘秉璋与德馨，各有所图，

Both had therefore been eager to hurry back to the city and inquire into the news.
所以都急着要赶进城去打听消息。

But Dexin had the governor’s instructions to fulfill, as well as his friendship with the Hu family to consider, and could not simply take his leave.
不过德馨既有巡抚嘱咐，又有胡家交情在，不便就此告辞，

Why not discuss his thoughts with Hu?
心想何不就跟胡雪岩谈谈心事。

“For Huguang, I should say Tu Langxuan is almost certain to get it.
『湖广，我看十之八九是涂朗轩接，

Zhili I cannot guess.”
直隶就不知道了。』

Tu Langxuan was Tu Zongying, Governor of Hunan.
涂朗轩就是湖南巡抚涂宗瀛，

He had once managed grain supplies for Zeng Guofan and had formerly been Li Hanzhang’s colleague; he was now Li’s subordinate.
他替曾国藩办过粮，与李瀚章昔为同事，今为僚属，

His succession to the governorship-general of Huguang would therefore be perfectly natural.
由他来接湖广总督，倒是顺理成章的事。

“Then what about the governorship of Hunan?” Hu asked, smiling and adopting a literary turn of phrase. “Does Your Honor entertain an interest?”
『那末湖南巡抚呢？』胡雪岩笑着掉了句文∶『阁下甚有意乎？』

“I fear someone else may get there first.”
『只怕人家捷足先登了。』


“That is by no means certain.”
『那也说不定。』

Hu thought for a moment. “First you must make up your mind.
胡雪岩想了一下说∶『你先要把主意拿定了，

Then we can see what can be done.
才好想办法，

If you have no intention of seeking it, Brother, there is no point in wasting effort.”
倘或老大哥根本没有这个意思，也就不必去瞎费心思。』

“Water flows downward, and men climb upward.
『水往低处流，人往高处爬，

How could I not want it?
岂能无意。

But the lash will not reach that far.
不过鞭长莫及，

I can only lament my helplessness.”
徒唤奈何。』

“It is for men to make the attempt and Heaven to decide the outcome,” Hu said. “Let me send Wang Weixian a telegram asking him to find Second Master Sen and sound out the situation.”
『谋事在人，成事在天。』胡雪岩说∶『等我来打个电报给汪惟贤，要他去寻森二爷探探「盘口」。』

The matter could not safely be entrusted to an outsider, and Hu was hardly able to wield a writing brush himself.
此事不便假手于人，胡雪岩又拿不起笔，

He therefore dictated while Dexin wrote.
因而由他口述，让德馨执笔，

In the telegram, Wang was instructed to seek out Baosen immediately and ask him to sound out Bao Yun: how substantial a gift would be required for a provincial treasurer who wished to become governor?
电报中关照汪惟贤立即去觅宝森，托他向宝均金探探口气，藩司想升巡抚，该送多重的礼。



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第一章（本章第2部分，共4部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Dexin chose each word carefully and couched the message in guarded language.
德馨字斟句酌，用隐语写完，

After rereading it, he said, “Grand Secretary Bao and his brother are not on good terms.
看了一遍说∶『宝中堂他们兄弟不和，

Second Master Sen may have no influence with him.
森二爷或许说不上话。

Should we ask Manager Wang to sound out Saltpeter Li as well?”
是不是请汪掌柜再探探皮硝李的口气。』

“Yes.
『好！

I agree.”
我赞成。』

Dexin revised the draft.
于是德馨改好了电报稿子；

Hu called in A’xi, his young personal attendant, whose particular duty was to look after the Western leather bag that accompanied his master whenever he left home.
胡雪岩叫进贴身小跟班阿喜来，他专替主人保管一个一离家就要带着的西洋皮包，

Inside it was a telegraphic codebook.
内中有个蜜码电报本，

Hu and Dexin encoded the message themselves.
胡雪岩与德馨亲自动手，将蜜码译好，

By the time they had finished, the setting sun was touching the hills.
夕阳已经衔山了。

“I had not intended to go back to the city,” Hu said, “but now I must. The telegram has to be taken to Shanghai to be sent.
『我本来不打算进城，现在非回支一趟不可了。』胡雪岩说∶『电报要送到上海去发，

I shall dispatch someone reliable and have him wait there for the reply.
我派一个妥当的人去，叫他在上海等回电；

If it is a matter of twenty or thirty thousand taels, I shall advance it for you.
如果是两三万银子，我先替你垫。

More than that would hardly be worthwhile.”
多了就犯不上了。』

“Indeed, indeed.
『是，是。

I leave everything in your hands.
一切拜托，

I cannot thank you enough.”
承情不尽。』


Hu Xueyan and Dexin then set off for the city together.
于是胡雪岩与德馨一起进城，

Their official ranks were the same, but Hu had been granted the privilege of wearing the yellow riding jacket, so his ceremonial retinue was more imposing than that of Dexin, the serving provincial treasurer.
两人品秩相同，但胡雪岩曾赏穿黄马褂，所以仪从较现任藩司的德馨更为煊赫；

Hu’s tall official placards were used only for display, however.
只是他的『高脚牌』只作陈列之用，

When he traveled, there was simply one mounted outrider in front and four mounted attendants behind.
出行只是前面一匹顶马、后面四匹跟马、

His eight-man sedan had three teams of bearers, who took turns at the poles. Hu’s bearers were themselves addressed as “master” at home.
八抬大轿的轿班，一共三班，轮流换肩一胡雪岩的班，在家亦是『老爷』；

When one returned, a maid would call, “The master is back!
一回家就会听见丫头在喊∶『老爷回来了，

Hurry and bring water to wash his feet.”
赶快打水洗脚。』

Yet however desirable the position, carrying Hu’s sedan was no easy task.
不过替胡雪岩抬力求虽是好差使，却很难当，

He demanded both speed and steadiness: the men must keep pace with the leading horse, yet never spill the tea resting on the armboard inside.
因为既要快、又要稳，快到能跟着顶马亦步亦趋；稳到轿中靠手板上的茶水不致泼出来。

Thus, although Hu and Dexin started at the same time, Hu’s sedan took the lead from the first step and soon left Dexin far behind.
因此，两人虽是同时动身，胡雪岩的轿于起步就领先，很快地将德馨在身后抛得老远了。


Approaching Yuanbao Street, Hu could see the lanterns, decorations, and brilliant lights from a distance.
回到元宝街，老远就看到张灯结彩，灯烛辉煌；

The birthday hall itself was fairly quiet.
但寿堂中却颇安静，

Since particular days had been assigned to the guests, only a few of the closest relatives would venture to call unannounced.
因为既已排定贺寿的日期，除了极少数的至亲以外，不会有人贸然登堂。

Hu alighted, exchanged a few words in the hall, and immediately turned to the business of securing an office for Dexin.
胡雪岩下了轿，在寿堂中略作寒暄，随即着手处理德馨谋官之事。

He had just summoned a capable household servant and begun giving his instructions when Madam Luosi quietly appeared, leaning on a little maid’s shoulder.
正唤来得力的家人在交代时，只风见螺蛳太太扶着一个小丫头的肩，悄然而至；

Seeing that he was occupied, she seated herself some distance away in a velvet chair.
看到胡雪岩有来，她远远地在一张丝绒椅上坐了下来。

“Leave first thing tomorrow morning and wait in Shanghai for news.
『你明天一大早就动身，在上海等消息，

As soon as the reply from Beijing arrives, come straight back.
等北京的回电一到，马上赶回来，

The sooner the better.”
愈快愈好。』

The servant assented and withdrew.
等家人答应着走了，

Madam Luosi rose and approached.
螺蛳太太一面起身走近来，

“Why have you come back to the city instead of staying at Lingyin with the old lady?”
一面问道∶『你不在灵隐陪老太太、怎么回城来了？』

“Two governors-general’s posts have fallen vacant, which should mean two vacant governorships as well.
『出了两个总督的缺，连带就会出两个巡抚的缺，

De Xiaofeng wants one of them.
德晓峰想弄一个，

I had to come in to make arrangements for him.”
我只好进城来替他料理。』

As he spoke, Hu noticed something unusual in her expression.
说到这里，胡雪岩发觉螺蛳太太神色有异，

Looking at her closely, he asked, “What is this?
定睛看了一下问道∶『怎的，

Have you been crying?”
你哭过了？』

“Do not talk nonsense!
『不要乱说！

Why should I cry on the old lady’s happy day?”
老太太的好日子，我哭什么？』

She immediately changed the subject. “Were there many guests?”
螺蛳太太紧接着问∶『客人来得多不多？』


“Everyone who ought to have come was there,” Hu said. “There are not many officials of the third rank or above to begin with.
『该来的都来了。』胡雪岩说∶『三品以上的官，本来没有多少，

From tomorrow onward, each day will be busier than the last.
从明天起就要一天比一天忙了。

What worries me most is the day after tomorrow.
我最耽心后后天，

Everyone says they are going to watch the fun.
大家都说要去看热闹，

I wonder whether something ridiculous will happen.”
不晓得会不会有啥笑话闹出来？』

The schedule had been rearranged, and the third day was now reserved for the foreign guests.
原来贺寿的日期，已经重新安排，第三天轮到外宾。

The very phrase “foreigners offering birthday greetings” excited curiosity.
『洋人拜寿』这四个字听起来，就会逗人好奇，

People wondered what the foreigners would actually do: kowtow or bow with clasped hands?
都说不知道洋人拜寿是怎么个样子，是磕头还是作揖？

Would they use chopsticks to eat the birthday noodles?
吃寿面会不会用筷子；

If they could not, what would they use?
不会用用啥？

A fork would never hold them; perhaps they would have to scoop them up with their fingers.
叉子叉不住，只怕要用手抓。

All this talk of waiting to enjoy a joke made Hu uneasy.
诸如此类等着看笑话的议论，不免使胡雪不安，

He feared an embarrassing scene that would cost him face.
怕闹出笑话来失面子。

“Oh,” Madam Luosi said, reminded of something, “there is a present here you should look at.” She called through the window for a servant.
『喔，』螺蛳太太倒被提醒了，『有份礼在这里，你倒看看。』说着，例向窗外喊一声∶『来人！』

Ruixiang, her trusted senior maid, entered. Having already heard her mistress, she said at once, “The gifts from the foreign gentleman have been taken to the master’s study.”
进来的是螺蛳太太的亲信大丫头瑞香∶她已经听到了螺蛳太太的话，所以进门便说∶『洋人送的那份礼，送到老爷书房里去了。』

Hu reflected that he had received countless birthday presents over the past month or so.
胡雪岩心想，这个把月来，所收的寿礼，不知凡几？

If these alone had been sent to his study, there must be something special about them.
独独这份礼送到他书房，可知必有来历，

“Who sent them?” he asked.
便即问说∶『是哪个送的？』


“I am not sure either,” Madam Luosi replied. “They came through the customs office at Gongchen Bridge.
『我也清楚。』螺蛳太太说∶『是拱宸桥海关送来的，

I wanted you to have a look.
我想你来看，

There is a formal visiting card with them; that will tell you.”
有份全帖在那里，你一看就晓得了。』

“Very well.
『好！

I shall go to the study.”
我到书房里去看。』

“Yes, do.
『对！

They are about to begin dinner outside, and I must put in an appearance and see to the guests.
外面要开席了，我也要去照个面，敷衍敷衍。

What about you?
你呢？

Where will you eat?”
在哪里吃？』

“I am too tired to eat much.
『太累，吃不下什么，

Some congee will do.”
吃点粥吧。』

“You must at least have some of the old lady’s birthday noodles.”
『老太太的寿面不能不吃。』

Madam Luosi turned to give an order. “Ruixiang, tell the small kitchen to make a bowl of fine noodles in chicken broth.
螺蛳太太转脸吩咐∶『瑞香，你关照小厨房下碗鸡汤银丝面，

If the broth is too rich, have them skim off all the fat.”
鸡汤太浓，要把浮油撇干净。』

The three went their separate ways.
于是主仆三人各散，

Alone, Hu followed the long passage, which even on ordinary nights was lined with lamps and easy to walk along, to his study in Jingjian Pavilion.
胡雪岩一个人穿过平时就沿路置灯、明亮好走的长长的甬道，来到他的书房镜槛阁。


Jingjian Pavilion was one of the garden’s finest sights.
这镜槛阁是园中一胜，

A still pond lay before it and an artificial hill behind.
前临平池，后倚假山，

The stair rail had an iron core sheathed in porcelain cylinders shaped like bamboo joints, made to order at Jingdezhen in alternating crimson and green.
拾级而上时，那扶手是以铁杆为芯，外套在景德镇定烧的，朱翠相间，形如竹节的瓷筒；

Inside stood an immense mirrored panel that drew into its surface the pond outside, the mandarin ducks on the water, the red bridge across it, and the willows along the banks.
阁中有一面极大的镜砖，将阁外平池、池中鸳鸯、池上红桥、池畔重杨，一齐吸入镜中，

The design followed Jian Garden, Prince Gong’s retreat beside Shichahai outside Xuanwu Gate in Beijing, but surpassed it in delicacy.
这是仿北京玄武门外，什刹海畔恭亲王的别墅鉴园的规模所造，而精巧过之。

On entering, Hu stood before the mirror for a while.
胡雪岩进得阁来，在镜砖面前站了一回，

Distant towers and nearby galleries were hung with birthday lanterns and decorations.
看远处楼阁、近处回廊，都挂着寿庆的灯彩，

Their reflections fell into the pond and then appeared anew in the mirror: mirrors within mirrors, images within images, until reality and illusion could no longer be distinguished.
到影入池，复又重生于有镜、镜中有镜、影中有影，疑真疑幻，全不分明了。

As he gazed, absorbed, he heard a young voice. “Master, the room is open.”
正看得出神时，听得有个娇嫩的声音∶『老爷，房门开了。』


Hu looked up.
胡雪岩抬头看时，

He seemed to have seen the little maid before.
这个小丫头仿佛见过，

“What is your name?”
便问∶『你叫什么名字？』

“Xiaomei.”
『我叫小梅。』

“Oh.
『喔，

Have you just been assigned here?”
你是新派过来的吗？』

“No.
『不！

I have been here a long time.”
我老早就在这里了。』

“A long time?
『老早在这里？

Why do I hardly ever see you?”
为啥不常看到你？』

As he spoke, he stepped into the study and caught sight of a great heap of presents.
胡雪岩一面说，一面踏进书房，触目一大堆礼物；

Forgetting Xiaomei for the moment, he looked first for the visiting card.
便顾不得跟小梅说话，先找全帖来看。


The formal card was signed, “He Lubin, your humble friend, honored by your instruction.”
全帖的具名是『教遇弟赫鹭宾』。

The sender was the Englishman Robert Hart, Inspector-General of Customs.
原来是总税务司英国人赫德。

He had lived in China for more than twenty years, spoke excellent Beijing Chinese, and could read Chinese writing.
此人在华二十多年，说得一口极好的京腔，也识汉文；

An admirer of Chinese culture and a foreign servant of the throne entitled to wear an official hat button, he had given himself the Chinese name He Lubin, fashioned from the sound of his English name.
仰慕中华文化，兼且是朝迁的有顶戴的客卿，所以用他的英文名字的发音，自己起了一个中国名字叫做『赫鹭宾』。

A gift list accompanied the card.
全帖以外还有礼单。

There were four birthday presents: a complete set of fine porcelain tea things, a large silver bowl filled with sweets, a whole bolt of woolen cloth, and a purple sable muff suitable for an elderly lady.
寿礼一共四样，全喜精瓷茶具、一个装糖果的大银碗、整匹的呢料，另外一个老年人用的紫貂袖筒。


“Someone come here!”
『来啊！』

Hu had in mind the two senior maids who looked after Jingjian Pavilion, the sisters Qiaozhu and Qiaozhen.
他心目中使唤的是专管镜槛阁的两个大丫头一巧珠、巧珍两姊妹；

But it was Xiaomei who came.
但来的却是小梅。

“Neither of the two Qiaos happens to be handy,” she said with a play on their names.
『两巧一巧都不巧。』小梅答说，

“They have both gone to Lingyin with the old lady.”
∶都跟老太太到灵隐去了。

Her quick speech made Hu think she was quite capable of doing an errand.
『胡雪岩看她语言伶俐，料想也能办事，

“You will do just as well.
便即说道∶』你也一样。

Find two people to carry these four presents outside, and have them sent straight to Lingyin for the old lady to see.
你去寻两个人来，把这四样东西搬到外面，叫人马上送到灵隐给老太太看，

Say that they are from—” He stopped. To explain that He Lubin was Hart, and that this foreign dignitary also wore a red button on his official hat, would be too complicated; the messenger might not convey it clearly.
说是┅┅『这要说赫鹭宾就是赫德，这位』洋大人『戴的也是红顶子，那就太罗嗦了，怕传话的人说不清楚，所以停了下来。』

“What would you like, Master?”
老爷要啥！『


“I want to write something.”
『我要写字。』

Xiaomei immediately went to the desk, lifted the inkstone’s cover, poured in a small spoonful of clean water, and began carefully rubbing the inkstick.
小梅听说，立刻走到书桌前面，掀开砚盖，注了一小杓清水，细细研墨。

Hu sat down, dipped his brush, and with considerable effort wrote six characters on the visiting card: “That is, Hart, Inspector-General of Customs.”
胡雪岩便坐了下来，提笔蘸墨，很吃力地在全帖上批了六个字∶『即总税司赫德』。

As the ink was still wet, Xiaomei picked up the card and pursed her lips to blow on it.
小梅因为墨渖未干，便拿起全粘，嘟起小嘴朝字上吹气，

She was blowing busily when Ruixiang arrived.
正吹得起劲时，瑞香来了。


At the sight, Ruixiang first stared, then snapped at Xiaomei. “Get out!
见此光景，她先是一楞，接着便呵斥小梅∶『出去！

What right have you to be in here?”
这地方也是你来得的？』

The Hu household had adopted the conventions of great aristocratic families, with several ranks even among the servants.
原来胡家也学了一套豪门世家的规矩，下人亦分几等，

A young maid like Xiaomei, employed on rough household work, was not supposed to appear before the master.
象小梅这种『做粗生活』的小丫头，是走不到主子面前的，

To do so was to overstep her station.
否则便是僭越。

Ruixiang ordinarily presumed on her position as Madam Luosi’s confidante and treated the other maids as beneath her.
这瑞香平日自恃是螺蛳太太的心腹，目中无余丫，

She was unpopular, and Xiaomei was not inclined to submit to her.
人缘不好，小梅不大服她；

Blamed without cause, the girl felt deeply wronged.
此时无辜受责，大感委屈，

Young as she was, she had a sharp tongue and retorted at once.
她人小嘴利，当即反唇相讥，

“Qiaozhu is away, and the master came in.
『巧珠不在，老爷来了，

Was I not to attend to him?
莫非我就不伺候？

I did not go looking for a chance to curry favor.
这又不是我瞎巴结差使，

Why are you shouting at me?
何用你来吼我？』

We are all lowly servants.
她说∶『大家都是低三下四的人，

Who do you think you are impressing, putting on the airs of a wealthy young lady?”
摆你千金小姐的威风，摆给哪个看？』

“What!”
『啊！』

Ruixiang’s face went white with anger.
瑞香脸都气白了，

“How dare you answer back!”
『你在嚼什么嘴？』

She rushed forward to strike her.
说着，奔上去就要打。

Xiaomei stood her ground and spoke quickly. “This is the old lady’s happy day.
『小梅毫不示弱，又快又急地说∶』今天老太太的好日子，

Would you dare hit someone?”
你敢打人？『


Ruixiang was checked.
瑞香被吓阻住了，

Only with an effort did she lower her raised hand.
一只手好不容易放了下来，

Grinding her teeth, she cursed. “If it were not for the old lady’s celebration, I would tear you apart, you filthy little—!
咬牙切齿地骂道∶『不看老太太的好日子，看我不撕烂你的小Ｘ！

Just wait.
你等在那里，

I shall deal with you.”
看我不收拾你。』

Now Xiaomei was frightened.
这下小梅害怕了，

She knew only too well how much power Ruixiang wielded.
瑞香的威风，她自然识得，

In desperation she dropped to her knees before Hu Xueyan.
情急之下，向胡雪岩双膝跑倒，

“Master, you see how it is.
『老爷，你看。』

Please be fair to me.”
她说∶『请老爷做主。』

“There, there,” Hu said soothingly. “It was I who told her to grind the ink.
『好了，好了！』胡雪岩解劝着∶『原是我叫她磨墨的。

If you will not excuse her for her own sake, do it for mine.
不看僧面看佛面，

There is no need to tell your mistress.”
不必告诉你太太。

With the master himself pleading for her, Ruixiang had recovered some face and vented her anger.
『主人出面说情，瑞香总算扳回面子，出了口气，

“Still kneeling there in the hope of a reward?” she shouted.
当下喝道Ｌ∶∶你还跪在这里想讨赏是不是，

“I shall reward you with a good beating!
赏你一顿「毛笋炒腊肉」！

Get out!”
滚！

Seeing tears well in Xiaomei’s eyes, she added, “This is the old lady’s happy day.
看见小梅盈盈欲泪，瑞香便又警告∶』今天是老太太的好日子，

Do not dare start crying!”
你敢哭出来！

Xiaomei did not dare.
『小梅果然不敢哭，

She withdrew with tears brimming in both eyes.
噙着两泡眼泪，退了出去。

Hu felt deeply sorry for her but could hardly comfort her in Ruixiang’s presence.
胡雪岩好生不忍，却不便当着瑞香支抚慰小梅。

Fortunately, a ready means of drawing Ruixiang away lay before him: the birthday gifts had to be sent to Lingyin.
不过，眼前恰有一条现成的调虎离山之计，便是安排那份寿礼，送到灵隐。

When Ruixiang went downstairs to summon help, Hu stepped into the gallery and said softly, “Xiaomei, do not be afraid.
等瑞香下阁子去唤人时，胡雪岩便走到廊上，轻声说道∶』小梅，你不要怕，

Do not be upset.
不要难过，

Tomorrow I shall speak to your mistress and have you promoted.”
明天我跟太太说∶提拔你。

When Hu spoke of “your mistress” to the servants, he usually meant Madam Luosi.
『胡雪岩对下人说太太，多半是指螺蛳太太，』

“I do not want that,” Xiaomei replied. “How could I ever have a peaceful day under Ruixiang?”
我不要。『小梅答说∶』在瑞香手下，哪有好日子过？『


Hu was about to ask her more when Ruixiang unexpectedly returned.
胡雪岩正待再问时，不想瑞香来得好快，

On going downstairs, she had met Second Madam Yang, one of the household’s four chief women stewards, whose special charge was to supervise everyone entering or leaving the garden.
原来她一下阁子，就看到胡家四大管家婆之一，专管稽察花园出入的杨二太，

Carrying a palace lantern herself, she was escorting Gu Yingchun to see the master.
亲自打一盏宫灯，领着古应春来见主人。

Ruixiang exchanged tasks with her, and each turned back: one went to find people to deal with Hart’s presents, while the other brought Gu upstairs.
于是瑞香便跟她换了差使，各自回头，一个去找人来料理赫德的礼，一个便领着古应春入阁。

“Why have you come back?” Hu asked.
『你怎么回来了？』胡雪岩问。

Gu had intended to stay at Lingyin in preparation for receiving the British visitors who would offer birthday greetings the next day.
古应春原是预定留在灵隐，预备第二天接待来拜寿的英国人；

But news that Hart had unexpectedly arrived in Hangzhou had brought him back to find out more.
只为得到赫德忽然到了杭州的消息，特为赶了来探问究竟。


“I only discovered it was Hart when I read his card just now,” Hu said, pointing to the four presents. “Look, I was about to send these to Lingyin for the old lady to inspect.”
『我也是刚刚看了拜帖才晓得是赫德，喏，』胡雪岩指着那四样礼物说∶『正预备送到灵隐，请老太太去过目呢。』

Gu examined the gifts appreciatively and nodded. “By foreign standards, this is a very substantial present.”
于是古应春赏玩了礼物，点点头说∶『照洋人来说，这份礼送得很重了。』

It was plainly a sign of the sender’s high regard, and Hu could not help feeling pleased.
这自然是人家看重的缘故，胡雪岩不免得意，

After a moment’s thought, he said, “I wonder where he is staying.
想了一下说∶『他不晓得住在哪里？

It is too late today.
今天晚了，来不及了，

First thing tomorrow morning, you and I should go and call on him.
明天一大早，我同你先去拜访。

That is only proper, since we are the hosts.”
这也是我们做主人该尽的道理。』

“He is staying with Dr Meitenggeng.”
『他住在梅藤更那里。』

Meitenggeng was an English missionary and physician who had come to Hangzhou to preach and established a hospital at Dafangbo in the center of the city.
梅藤更是个英国教士，也是医生，到杭州传教，在中城大方伯开了一家医院；

There was a bridge there that had been called Guangji Bridge in the Song dynasty, and the hospital took the same name, Guangji, which also conveyed the idea of bringing help to all.
大方伯这个地方有一座桥，在宋朝叫广济桥，因此这家医院题名就用了双关的『广济』二字。

Hu had made a large donation when the hospital was founded and could count the doctor as an old friend.
梅藤更开设广济医院时，胡雪岩捐过一大笔钱，所以他跟梅藤更亦算是老朋友，

“Since he is staying there,” he said, “I shall send someone to ask the doctor to tell Hart that we will call tomorrow morning, and to find out what time would suit him.”
当即说道∶『既然是住在梅藤更那里，我派人去通知一声，请他转告赫德，说我们明天一早去看他，请他问一问赫德什么时候方便。』

“There is no need to send anyone.
『不必叫人去。

Calling on a doctor in the evening cannot be considered improper.
好在晚上去看医生，不算冒昧，

I shall go myself; it will be more satisfactory.”
我自己去一趟，比较稳当。』


“Very well.
『也好！

Thank you for the trouble.
辛苦，辛苦。』

Have you eaten?”
胡雪岩问道∶『你吃了饭没有？』

“I have been so busy I forgot to be hungry.
『忙得肚子饿都忘记了。

In fact, I am not hungry now.”
实在也不饿。』

“Neither am I.
『我也不饿，

I shall wait for you, and we can eat together when you return.”
我等你一来一起吃。』

“Good.”
『好！』

“Ruixiang, show Mr Gu down.” Then Hu suddenly asked, “When did these presents arrive?”
『瑞香，你送古才爷下去。』胡雪岩忽又问道∶『这礼是啥辰光送来的？』

“About three in the afternoon,” Ruixiang replied. “Dr Mei sent someone with them.”
『未末申初。』瑞香答说∶『梅院长派人送来的。』


“At that hour!”
『那个时候！』

Hu frowned. “We ought, properly, to have sent over a banquet.”
胡雪岩蹙着眉说∶『照道理要送席。』

“We did not send a banquet,” Ruixiang put in.
『席是没有送。』瑞香接口，

“But we sent a first-class hotpot, four kinds of pastries, and a basket of juicy flat peaches.
『送了个一品锅、四样点心，还有一篓水蜜蟠桃。

Madam had me prepare a gratuity envelope for the messenger [the amount is corrupt in the source].
太太叫我包了一个八封的赏封，打发来人，

She told him to explain to Dr Mei that our master was at Lingyin and therefore did not know who this foreign dignitary was, but that he must in any case be a good friend of our master’s.
请他告诉梅院长，我们老爷在灵隐，所以不晓得这位洋大人的身分，不过总归是我们老爷的好朋友。

Dr Mei was like one of the family, and we asked him to take the trouble to entertain the guest on our behalf.
梅院长是象自己人一样的，请他费心代为款侍，

When our master returned tomorrow, he would thank him in person.”
明天我们老爷回来了，再当面同他道谢。』

Ruixiang rattled it all off in one breath, setting out everything clearly.
瑞香咭咭呱呱一口气说下来，事情交代得清清楚楚；

Hu thought Madam Luosi had handled the matter most suitably.
胡雪岩觉得螺蛳太太处置得颇为得体，

“A good thing I did not have her come to Lingyin,” he said with satisfaction.
很满意地说∶『亏得我不叫她到灵隐去，

“Otherwise there would have been no one capable of attending to it.”
不然，没有人料理得来。』

“A good thing, too, that a strong commander has no weak soldiers.”
『也亏得强将手下无弱兵。』

Ruixiang recognized Gu’s compliment, smiled prettily at him, then turned her head away.
瑞香听出来是在夸赞她，古应春嫣然一笑，随即把头别了开去。

Gu smiled as well, two crow’s-feet showing at the corners of his eyes.
古应春也笑，笑得眼角露出两条鱼尾纹。

When Ruixiang returned from seeing him out, she said to Hu, “I suppose you will not want the noodles now.
等瑞香送了古应春回来，向胡雪岩说道∶『面想来不要了。

I have told the small kitchen to prepare a few delicate, refreshing dishes.
我已经关照小厨房，弄几样精致爽口的菜；

Where would you like dinner served?”
请老爷的示，在哪里开饭？』


“Here will do,” Hu replied. Then he added, “I had no idea you were so vicious!
『就在这里好了。』胡雪岩又说∶『我倒不晓得你这么凶！

A woman may be formidable; that is all very well.
女人厉害，可以；

But viciousness will only hurt her in the end.”
凶，不可以，自己吃亏。』

“Madam runs the household.
『太太当家，

Someone has to play the villain for her.
总要有个人来替她做恶人。

Would you have her be the villain herself while we stand by putting in kind words for everyone?”
莫非倒是太太自己来做恶人，我们在旁边替人家说好话？』

Hu could find no answer to that.
胡雪岩觉得她的话竟无可驳；

After a moment’s thought he said, “Even if you must play the villain, there is no need to behave like a fool.
想了一下说∶『就做恶人也犯不着撒蠢；

Those filthy insults you used—do you not hear how ugly they sound?”
什么小Ｘ不小ＸＸ，难听不难听？』

Ruixiang flushed.
瑞香涨红了脸，

She wanted to defend herself but could think of no excuse, and stood rooted to the spot, at a loss what to do.
欲待分辩，却又实在没有理由，以致于僵在那里有些手足无措的模样。


Hu offered a literary quotation. “‘A person must first demean herself before others will demean her.’
胡雪岩便又掉了一句文∶『「人必自悔而后人侮之。」』

Suppose she had turned your own obscenity back on you,” he went on.
他说∶『如果人家回你一句∶我「小」你「大」！

“How would a young woman like you have held up her head?”
你一个大青娘，脸上挂得住、挂不住？』

In Hangzhou, the expression he used referred to a girl in the bloom of youth, the age at which feelings were most tender and easily stirred.
杭州人叫妙龄女郎为『大青娘』，是最多悉善感的时候；

Ruixiang was ashamed and remorseful.
瑞香又羞又悔，

Her eyes reddened, and she was on the verge of tears.
眼圈红红的，要哭出来了。

“Why, why, why!” Hu exclaimed in astonishment.
『咦，咦，咦！』胡雪岩大为诧异，

“You forbade her to cry, and now you are about to cry yourself.
『你叫人家不准哭，自己倒要哭了，

What is the matter?
为啥？

Have I spoken too harshly?”
莫非我的话说得重了。』

At once Ruixiang checked her tears.
一听这话，瑞香顿时收泪，

She drew from beneath her arm a white silk handkerchief embroidered with a spray of daphne, the flower whose Chinese name was her own, and blew her nose. “Who is crying?”
抽出腋下的一方白纺绸绣一枝瑞香花的手绢，擤一擤鼻子答说∶『哪个哭了。』

“Best not to cry.
『不哭最好，

Bring me the dominoes, then go out front and see how far the dinner has got.”
你把牙牌拿来，再到前面看看，坐席坐到啥光景了？』


Ruixiang fetched a box of ivory dominoes, tipped them onto the square rosewood table, and went downstairs.
瑞香答应着，取出一盒牙牌，倒在红木方桌上，然后下了阁子。

Left alone, Hu played “Passing the Five Gates” to while away the time. After several unsuccessful rounds, he turned from the game to divination, seeking a sign of his future.
胡雪岩一个人拿牙牌『通五关』打发辰光连着几副不通，便换了起数问前程。

Following the rhyme for consulting the domino oracle—“Lay the full set out in line; count the openings that you find; three successive layouts mark, then judge the high, the low, the middle”—he counted sixteen openings in the first layout, twenty-one in the second, but in the third only one matched pair and one unmatched combination, six openings in all.
于是照牙牌神数的歌诀∶『全副牙牌一字开，中间看有几多开，连排三次分明记，上下中平内取裁。』头一次得了十六开，第二次更多，竟有廿一开，第三次却只得一副对子，一副分相，共计六开。


Hu knew the method well.
胡雪岩是弄熟了的，

He worked out the result as “highest auspice, highest auspice, lower middle.”
一算是『上上、上上、中下』。

He could more or less remember the verse, but he needed the book for its “Explanation” and “Judgment.”
诗句也还约略记得，但『解』与『断』，却须找书来看。

Finding the section on the domino oracle in Elegant Pastimes of the Ladies’ Chamber, he opened it and read: “With a fair wind, hoist your sail in time; / Cross safely the whale’s vast waters, ten thousand miles.
找到『兰闺清玩』的『牙牌神数』，翻开来一看，那着诗是『一帆风顺及时扬，稳度鲸川万里航，

/ Should you reach the turn where the sail follows the Xiang, / Rein in the gallant horse before it takes the downward slope.”
若到帆随湘转处，下坡骏马早收缰。』

As he recited it, he thought, “There is something in that.”
一面念，一面心想∶『有点意思。』

He read on: “Explanation: Do not torment yourself over your undertakings.
再往下看，『解曰∶谋为勿忧煎，

Their fulfillment lies before your eyes.
成全在眼前，

Whatever you attempt will prosper, but everywhere you must handle others tactfully.”
施为无不利，到处要周旋。』

At the last phrase, he suddenly slapped the table and exclaimed, “Today’s reading is uncannily accurate!”
看到最后一句，不由得蓦然一拍桌子，大声自语∶『今天这个数起得神了！』

He had scarcely finished when someone asked, “What are you doing?”
语声刚终，有人接口∶『你在作啥？』

Looking up, he saw Madam Luosi entering with a hand on a little maid’s shoulder; Ruixiang followed behind.
抬眼看时，前面螺蛳太太手扶小丫头的肩，正踏进门来，后面跟着瑞香。

“Have the guests gone?”
『客散了？』


“Not yet, but every table has someone to attend to it,” Madam Luosi replied. “I heard that Brother-in-law Gu had come back and gone out again.
『还没有，不过每桌都有人陪。』螺蛳太太说∶『我是听说七姐夫来了又出去了，

I wondered whether something important had happened, so I came specially to see.” “He has gone to Dr Meitenggeng’s.
不知道是不是有啥要紧的事，所以我特别来看看—』『他到梅藤更那里去了，

He will be back as soon as he has had a word with him.”
说一句话就回来的。』

Hu then went on to the “Judgment” that followed the “Explanation.”
胡雪岩接着又往下看『解』了以后的『断』。



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第一章（本章第3部分，共4部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“Judgment: The yellow bloom gives its fragrance late; unsullied integrity is precious.
『断曰∶黄节晚香，清节可贵，

Flowing water swirls back upon itself: have the courage to withdraw from the swift current.”
逝水回波，急流勇退。』

Hu understood that final injunction perfectly.
最后这四个字，胡雪岩是懂得；

It was precisely what his mother at home and his good friends outside had repeatedly urged him to do.
而且这也正是内则老母、外则良友在一再劝他的。

Without quite realizing it, he began to ponder it closely.
此刻不自觉地便仔细想了下去。

Madam Luosi had often watched him cast a divination, but never with such seriousness or with anything weighing on his mind as it seemed to do now.
螺蛳太太也常看他起数，但都不似此刻这么认真，而且是上了心事的模样，

Naturally, she was concerned.
当然深感关切。

“Ruixiang, mix me a glass of rose-and-mint cordial to clear my head after the wine.”
『瑞香，去调一杯玫瑰薄荷露来，我解解酒。』

Seating herself opposite Hu, she asked, “Tell me about the reading you have had.”
说着，在胡雪岩对面坐了下来问道∶『你起的数，倒讲给我听听。』

“The more I think about today’s reading, the more sense it makes,” Hu replied. “First it says I am sailing before a fair wind, but that when the time comes I must furl my sail.
『今天起的这个数，我愈想愈有道理。』胡雪岩说∶『先说我一帆风顺，不过到时候要收篷。

When?
啥时候呢？

‘Where the sail turns with the Xiang.’
「帆随湘转处」，

The uncanny thing is that word Xiang.
灵就灵在这个「湘」字上，

It means Lord Zuo.
是指左大人；

When Lord Zuo ceases to be Governor-General of Liangjiang, I must ‘rein in the gallant horse before it takes the downward slope.’”
到左大人不当两江总督了，我就要「下坡骏马早收缰」了。』

“And what else?”
『还有呢？』


“These two lines are remarkably accurate too: ‘Whatever you attempt will prosper, but everywhere you must handle others tactfully.’
『还有这两句，也说得极准∶』施为无不利，到处要周旋。

Pave the way with silver and naturally every road opens before you.”

汇丰的款子，应付的本息还早啊！』

也住在梅藤更那里。』

我们倒要好好儿想个应付的办法。』

『当然。』古应春又说∶『小爷叔，你哪天有空？』

Western food.
吃西餐；

席摆在哪里方便，要预备点啥，顶好趁早交代下去。』

『我看「阳春面加重，免免」了！』

『我看预备还是要预备在那里，』螺蛳太太插进来说∶『说不定赫德倒带了他来呢？』

Foreigners were not in the habit of arriving with uninvited companions.
洋人没有挟带不速之客的习惯。

Madam Luosi did not fully understand their rules of social intercourse.
螺蛳太太对这方面的应酬规矩不算内行；

不过多预备总不错，

或许临时想起还有什么人该请，即不致于捉襟见肘。

多预备几份好了。』

说着，相将落座，

Red wine was served.
喝的是红葡萄酒；

古应春看着斟在水晶杯中、紫光泛彩的酒说∶『这酒要冰了，味道才出得来。』

『那就拿冰来冰。』

Like the imperial palace, the Hu household had its own ice cellar.
原来胡家也跟大内一样，自己有冰窖。

In the depths of winter, hot water was poured into specially made square wooden molds.
数九寒天，将热水倒在物制的方形木盒中，

等表里晶莹，冻结实了，置于掘得极深、下铺草荐的地窖，

到来年六月，方始开窖取用。

Hu’s order meant opening it ahead of time.
此时胡雪岩交代，当然提前开窖。

这一来不免大费手脚，耽误工夫，古应春颇为不安，

But he knew Hu was growing more willful by the day.
但已知胡雪岩的脾气愈来愈任性，

Remonstrance would be useless, so he could only let matters take their course.
劝阴无用，只好听其自然。

趁这工夫，胡雪岩与古应春将次日与赫德会谈可能涉及的各方面，细细研究了一番。

其时螺蛳太太已回到前面，等席散送客；

镜槛阁中，凿冰冻酒，检点肴馔，都是瑞香主持，

胡雪岩看在眼里，

愈发觉得刚才胸中所动的一念，应该从速实现。

等入了座，他先看一看桌上的菜，

『还有锦乡长寿面、八仙上寿汤。』瑞香答说∶『古老爷跟老爷还想吃点啥？

我去交代。』

『够了，够了。』古应春说∶『两个人吃八样菜，已经多了；

再多，反而看饱了吃不下。』

『就是八珍汤。』瑞香笑道∶『今天是老太太的好日子，所以我拿它改个名字。』

“Good.
『好，

I see.
晓得了。』

I should like something sweet.
胡雪岩答说∶『我想吃点甜的，

你到小厨房去看看，

等弄好了带回来。』

Hu was deliberately sending Ruixiang away.
这是胡雪岩故意遣开瑞香，

因为他要跟古应春说的话，是一时不便让瑞香知道睥。

美中不足的，就是七姐没有来。』

『要美中不足才好。』古应春答说∶『曾文正分别号叫「求阙斋」，

特为去求美中不足，那才是持盈保仄之道。

After his son became emperor, Prince Chun acquired an antique vessel called a tilting bowl.
醇亲王从儿子做了皇帝以后，置了一样古董，叫做「欹器」，

盛水不能满，一满就翻倒了。』

胡雪岩并未听出他话中的深意，管自己问道∶『七姐现在身子怎么样？』

『无非带病延年。

西医说∶中风调养比吃药重要；

调养第一要心兀，她就是心静不下来，

自从她病倒以后，家里当然不比从前那样子有条理了，

糟糕不糟糕？』说到这里，古应春叹口气，将酒杯放了下来。

人，我已经有了，

一番话说得古应春心乱如麻，

“Never.”

复又想了一下，方始开口∶『没有。』

旋即转念，

此事决不能轻发！

倘若妻子根本不愿，一说这话，岂非伤了感情？

七姐人情、世故熟透，

世界上总是听话的老实无用；能干调皮捣蛋，

她一个端正人，躺在床上，

如果叫人到东，偏要到西，拿她有啥法子？

七姐顾虑来，顾虑去，就是顾虑这个。

应春，你说对不对！』

『是的。』古应春不能不承认∶『小爷叔把职七的为人，看得很透。』

四个条件，她占了三个；

感情深了，自然会体贴。』

『哪里就谈得到将来了？』古应春笑着喝了口酒说∶『这件事要慢慢商量。』

『你说谈不到将来，我说喜事就在眼前。』

胡雪岩略略放低了声音∶『贤慧，瑞香当然还谈不到；
