After moving his headquarters to the Temple of Lord Guan outside the east gate, he sent an official report to Beiyang requesting rewards according to merit.
他将大营移驻东门外关帝庙以后，随即行文北洋，奏请论功行赏。



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第四章（本章第1部分，共2部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER FOUR
第四章


This ought to have been good news, but Yuan Shikai had a guilty secret.
这本来是件好事，但袁世凯却怀着鬼胎，

There was nothing he could do except wait for the flaw to emerge and then find a remedy.
但亦无法，只好等纰漏出来以后再来想办法——

At last Zhou Jialu, a member of Wu Changqing’s secretariat who handled correspondence and had also taught Yuan, summoned him for a question.
终于有一天，为吴长庆办文案的幕僚。而且也教袁世凯读过书的周家禄，将他找了去有话问。

“Weiting, are you a secretary in the Secretariat Office?”
『慰亭，』他问∶『你是中书科中书？』

“What is the matter?”
『怎么样？』

Yuan neither confirmed nor denied it, first seeking to learn what had happened.
袁世凯不置可否，先打听出了什么事。

“Look at this.”
『你看！』

It was an official communication from Beiyang concerning the Qing Army’s recommendations for rewards.
是北洋来的公事，说庆军保奖一案，

Yuan Shikai, secretary in the Secretariat Office, had received imperial approval for promotion to deputy prefect.
中书科中书袁世凯，保升同知，业已奉旨允准。

But after searching its records, the ministry could find no secretary of that name.
惟本部遍查档册，中书科中书并无袁世凯其人；

He was to be instructed to submit an explanation.
请饬该员申复云云。

Yuan felt both delight and anxiety.
袁世凯一则以喜，一则以忧，

His delight was that he had built a tower from level ground and obtained a fifth-rank deputy prefecture.
喜的是平地起楼台，搞了个五品同知，

The post carried military duties—hence its other designation, “sima”—but its holder was a civil official with unlimited prospects, making it more valuable than a second- or third-rank military command.
这个职务是武职，故别称『司马』；但官却是文官，前程无量，比二、三品的副将、参将还值钱；

His anxiety was that the secretaryship in his record was fraudulent.
忧的是资历上的中书科中书原是假冒的，

If that underlying appointment did not exist, his dream of becoming deputy prefect would collapse.
这个底缺如果不存在，升同知的美梦也就落空了。

Inwardly he was in turmoil; outwardly he remained calm.
心里七上八下，表面却很沉着，

“Mr Zhou,” he said with a grin, “why not guess?”
『周先生，』他笑嘻嘻地说∶『你倒猜上一猜。』

“There is no need.
『用不着猜，

The ministry certificate for a purchased appointment that you brought originally had the right surname, Yuan, but the wrong personal name.
你当初拿来的那张捐官的「部照」，姓不错，是袁，名字不是，

You must have borrowed it.”
当然是借来的。』

“Yes, yes.
『是，是，

Nothing escapes you, Mr Zhou.”
周先生明见万里，

Yuan made a formal bow. “Please help me through this.”
这件事，』他打了个千说∶『请周先生成全。』

“That goes without saying.
『成全不用说，

If the truth were reported, even Commander Wu would be punished for failing to detect it.
据实呈复，连庆公都要担个失察的处分。』

There are two ways now, one easy and one troublesome.
周家禄紧接着说∶『现在有两个办法，一个容易，一个麻烦，

You must choose.”
要你自己挑。』

“Please explain them.”
『那请周先生指教，是怎么样的两个办法。』

“The easy one first: use the name on the certificate.
『先说容易的，你改用部照上的名字。』

It is not only easy but convenient.
周家禄说∶『这个办法，不但容易，而且方便。

A single official note stating that Yuan Shikai is a name adopted by Yuan So-and-so, and that you are reverting to the original name, will suffice.”
你方便，只要一角公文，袁世凯为袁某某的改名。恢复原名即可。』

Yuan did not want this easy solution.
袁世凯不愿用这个容易方便的法子，

He was already well known in Korea.
因为他在韩国已是知名人物；

More importantly, everyone at court, from Empress Dowager Cixi and Prince Gong to the secretaries of the Zongli Yamen, knew that a man called Yuan Shikai had distinguished himself there.
尤其有关系的是，朝中自慈禧太后、恭王到总理衙门章京，都知道有个在朝鲜立了功的袁世凯，

With a different name, who would recognise a mere deputy prefect?
一改名字，区区同知，有谁知道。


That, however, was not the reason he gave.
不过他拒绝的理由，却不是这么说，

“To be frank, Mr Zhou, the certificate belonged to a nephew of my clan who has died.
『周先生，实不相瞒，』他说，『原来的部照，是我一个堂侄子的，此人业已去世，

Restoring his name could cause all sorts of unforeseen complications.
恢复原名，有许多意外的纠葛。

Please tell me the difficult method.”
请说难的那个办法吧！』

“You must find someone to approach the Ministry of Personnel on your behalf.
『难的那个办法，就是你自己托人到吏部去活动。

Its clerks have more tricks than one can imagine.
吏部那些书办，花样之多，意想不到，

They will certainly find a way.
他们一定有办法，

But ‘Keep the fire going, and the pig’s head softens; provide the money, and official business gets done.’
不过「火到猪头烂，钱到公事办」，

Your affair may cost a thousand taels.”
你这件事，只怕非千金莫办。』

“Yes, yes.
『是、是。

I shall do as you advise.”
我照周先生的意思去办。』

“Good.
『好！

I shall hold the papers back for now.
我暂且把公事压下来，

Approach the ministry, and we shall decide what to do when we see the result.”
等你到吏部活动，看结果如何，再作道理。』

“Thank you, thank you.”
『是。多谢、多谢。』

Zhou smiled. “Weiting, I have a bit of doggerel for you.”
『慰亭！』周家禄笑道∶『我有一首打油送你。』

Taking up his brush, he wrote at one sweep on a sheet of official draft paper.
说完，拈起笔来，就桌上起公文的稿纸，一挥而就；

Yuan read it: “A crooked Henan scholar was his start; / The borrowed secretaryship is plain.
袁世凯接过来念道∶『本是中州歪秀才，中书借得不须猜。

/ Once he displayed his statesman’s art, / Seven severed heads became his gain.” Zhou roared with laughter.
一时大展经纶手，杀得人头七个来。』等他念完，周家禄哈哈大笑，

Yuan could only join in with a few dry chuckles to show how lightly he took it.
袁世凯也只好陪着干笑几声，以示洒脱。

Back in his tent, he naturally thought of Xu Shichang, a provincial graduate and a thoroughly reliable man.
回到自己营帐，袁世凯自然而然想起了一个人，此人名叫徐世昌，是个举人，办事很扎实，

Entrusting the matter to him would ensure success.
托他去活动，万无一失。

But if, as Zhou said, it would cost a thousand taels, where was the money to come from?
只是照周家禄说，花费须一千两银子，款从何出，却费思量。


After much thought, Yuan could only turn to Zhang Jian.
想来想去，只好去找张謇。

Zhang also managed the supply office and controlled the flow of provisions and pay.
他兼管着支应所，粮饷出入，大权在握，

One nod from him would secure the thousand taels.
只要他点头，一千两银子就有着落了。

Yuan greeted him with “Mr Zhang!”
见面招呼，一声『张先生！』

Zhang was taken aback.
张謇便是一楞，

Yuan called Zhou “Mr Zhou”, but had always addressed Zhang simply as “Teacher”.
原来他称周家禄是『周先生』，叫张謇一向只『老师』二字，

Now he had changed it to “Mr”, and added the surname.
如今不但改了『先生』，而且还加了姓，

Why?
此又何故？

It was awkward to challenge him immediately, so Zhang replied coldly, “What can I do for you?”
一时不便责问，只冷冷地答一声∶『有何见教？』

Yuan realised his mistake too, but would not correct himself.
袁世凯也发觉自己错了，但亦不愿再改口，

He explained his difficulty indirectly and asked Zhang to help him through it.
只婉转地说明了自己的困难，请张謇『成全』。

“I would not presume to call it that.
『成全不敢当，

But as friends, we ought to help one another.
不过既然是朋友，理当相助。

The supply office holds public money, which I cannot lend privately.
支应所的款子是公款，我不便私下借给你；

There is only one course: your official allowance is two hundred taels a month.
如今只有一个办法，你的公费每月二百两，

Give me five signed acknowledgements, and I shall advance you five months.”
你写五张「领结」来，我把你的五个月公费先发给你。』

“Good.
『好！

How should I write them?”
请问领结如何写法？』

In a “sealed acknowledgement”, the word “acknowledgement” signified that a matter was concluded.
本来『印结』之结，当作承认事情已经结束来解释，

The wording was not particularly pleasing, but ordinarily no one troubled about it.
辞句上不大好听，没有人去理会，

Yuan, however, was sensitive.
只是袁世凯心里有病，

When he took the form away and read it, he found it stated that he had received two hundred taels for a specified month, counted in his presence, with no deficiency in purity or weight, and that he would make no subsequent claim for compensation for any shortage.
将张謇所开的印结式样，拿回去一看，上面写的大意是，领到某月份公费二百两，当面点清，成色分两，均未短缺；嗣后倘有短缺，决不致提出任何补偿的要求。

It seemed designed to prevent him from repudiating the receipt, and he was already displeased.
倒象防他会耍赖似的，心里已经不大舒服；

Then he consulted the Expressions of the Six Ministries, a book he used as a guide to official life.
再翻一翻一部他当作作官秘诀来用的『六部成语』，

Under Personnel was an entry for a “voluntary undertaking”: once a case was decided, or property ordered returned, the person concerned signed a document declaring willing obedience.
其中『吏部』有一条常用的成语，叫做『甘结』，注解是∶『凡官府断案既定，或将财物令事主领回者，均命本人作一「情甘遵命」之据，上画花押，谓这甘结』。

Yuan flew into a rage.
顿时大为光火；

So a sealed acknowledgement was this sort of meek submission, merely replacing the signature with a seal!
原来所谓印结是这么一种做低服小的表示，不过画花押改为钤印而已，

He felt that the supply office was treating him intolerably.
他觉得支应所欺人太甚了。

Moreover, in the present recommendations Zhang had merely risen from assistant county magistrate to eligibility for a seventh-rank magistracy.
再一想到，这回的保案中，张謇不过是以县丞保用为七品的知县；

Yuan was a deputy prefect, a “fifth-rank occupant of the yellow hall”.
自己是同知，所谓『五品黄堂』，

Why should he give a sealed acknowledgement to the supply office?
凭什么要向支应所具印结？

He complained furiously, but without the documents he could not obtain the money and had to swallow his anger and comply.
当时大发了一顿牢骚，但不具印结，领不到银子，只好忍气吞声照办。

Zhang heard that he had been cursing behind his back—“What sort of thing is this supply office?”—and found his petty arrogance in success contemptible.
可是张謇虽然听说他背后大骂『何物支应所』，觉得小人得志的那副脸嘴，令人齿冷；

Nevertheless, he continued to help him.
但还是很帮他的忙。


“Weiting, is this money to be used in Beijing?”
『慰亭，』他问，『你这银子是要在京里用？』

“Yes.”
『是的。』

“To whom will you send it?”
『那么你要寄给谁呢？』

“A childhood friend named Xu.
『我的一个总角之交。』袁世凯答说∶『姓徐，

By now he is probably a newly successful provincial graduate.”
大概已经是新科举人了。』

Zhang understood.
张謇懂他的意思，

His friend had sat the northern provincial examination, whose results were now out.
他这姓徐的朋友应北闱乡试，如今已经发榜，

He might have passed, but Yuan, far away in another country, had not received the news; hence “probably”.
可能榜上有名，不过远在异国，未得京师消息，所以用了『大概』二字。

“Very well,” Zhang said. “I cannot give you silver to send, of course.
『好！』张謇说道∶『我当然不能发你现银，

A banknote might be lost in the post, which would cause trouble.
用银票呢，又怕寄递中途失落了，也很麻烦。

I have a method, if you agree.”
我有一个办法，不知道你愿意不愿意。』

“Please explain, Mr Zhang.”
『喔，请张先生说。』

“Mr Zhang” again!
又是『张先生』！

After hearing “Teacher” so often, this second use jarred.
听惯了他口口声声叫『老师』，现在第二回听见这个称呼，实在有些刺耳。

Still, Zhang patiently continued. “Our army’s pay is issued through the Beiyang Office in Tianjin.
不过张謇还是很耐心地说∶『本军的饷银，都是由天津「北洋公所」发的；

I shall give you an order to collect the money.
我现在给你一张领据，

Send it to your friend, and he can draw it there directly.
你寄给你的朋友，由他直接到北洋公所去领，

Would that not be convenient?”
岂不方便。』

“Excellent.
『好，好！

Thank you for your trouble, Mr Zhang.”
费心张先生了。』

“What is your friend’s personal name?
『你贵友的大名是哪两个字？』

It will be safer to name the person authorised to collect it.” Yuan agreed. “Xu Shichang.
张謇又说∶『领据上指明由某人去领，比较保险。』袁世凯觉得这话也不错，点点头说∶『叫徐世昌。

The characters for shichang come from ‘May his descendants prosper for five generations’.”
五世其昌的世昌。』

“Where is he from?”
『哪里人？』

“Must that go on the order too?”
『这也要写在领据上？』

“Not for its own sake.
『不是这意思。

I must specify his status.
我要写明他的身份，

To sit the northern provincial examination, he must be either an Imperial Academy student or a county licentiate.
赴北闱当然不是监生，就是生员，

If the latter, I must state the county.
生员就要写明哪一县的生员，

That is why I ask.”
所以我问他是哪里人。

“He is a licentiate.
『他是生员。』

His family originally came from Ningbo in Zhejiang and moved to Tianjin in the Qianlong reign.
袁世凯说∶『他原来浙江宁波人，乾隆年间迁居天津，

His great-great-grandfather served as magistrate of Nanyang in Henan, died in office and was buried in Ji county.
他高祖是河南南阳知县，殁在任上，葬在河南汲县，

The family has lived there since.
他家以后就一直寄居在那里，

So he can be considered a Zhejiang man, a Zhili man or a Henan man.”
所以他又算浙江人，也算直隶人，或者河南人。』

“Then his licentiate registration must still be in Tianjin.
『这样说，他还是天津的生员，

If he had qualified in Ji county, he would have had to sit the Henan examination.”
如果是汲县进的学，就得在河南乡试。』


Zhang issued the order, naming “Xu Shichang, formerly a licentiate of Tianjin” as the recipient.
张謇开了领据，指明由『原天津生员徐世昌』具领『。

By the time it reached Xu, he had indeed become a provincial graduate.
等这张邻据寄寄到徐世昌手里，他已经是新科举人了。

He and his younger brother Xu Shiguang had taken the examination together.
徐世昌是与他的胞弟徐世光一起下科场的。

After its three sessions, during the month’s wait for the results, his eagerness for a degree and anxiety over success or failure robbed his food of flavour and his sleep of ease.
三场考毕，在等候发榜的那一个月之中，功名心热，得失这念梗在胸中，有些食不甘味、寝不安枕；

A close friend advised him to seek a divination lot.
常常往来的一个好朋友，便劝他去求一支签。

The friend was Ke Shaoban, courtesy name Fengsheng, from Jiaozhou in Shandong.
他这个朋友叫柯绍半，字凤笙，山东胶州人。

“The lots at the shrine of Immortal Lü in Liulichang are extraordinarily accurate,” he said.
告诉徐世昌说∶『琉璃厂的吕祖祠，那里的签，最灵验不过，

“Every question receives an answer, and every answer proves true.
有求必应；有应必中。

Why not try?” Xu readily agreed.
你何妨去求一求看。』徐世昌欣然乐从，

At the shrine he found the worship even more fervent than at the Fire God Temple to its west, which strengthened his faith.
到了琉璃厂吕祖祠，看香火比它西面的火神庙还盛，信心便又添了几分。

He prayed sincerely and drew a lot bearing this verse: “The mystic work has laid its base; / Feed the fire well, make no mistake.
当下虏诚祷祝，抽了一支签出来，上面写的一首诗是∶『八九玄功已有基，频添火候莫差池，

/ When twelvefold towers yield their inner space, / The elixir forms, and cranes awake.”
待看十二重楼透，便是丹成鹤到时。』

“It seems my work is not yet complete,” Xu said. “Perhaps there is no hope in this examination.”
『这好象工夫还不到。』徐世昌说∶『今科恐怕无望。』

“Not so,” Ke replied. “I think it refers to the spring examination.
『不然。』柯绍半说∶『照我看，这是指春闱而言，

The second line, ‘Feed the fire well, make no mistake’, means that after success in the autumn, you must study harder and practise more full examination papers.
第二句「频添火候莫差池」，是说你秋闱得意以后，要加紧用功，多写写「大卷子」，

Next year you will pass the metropolitan examination and gain one of the top three places in the palace examination.
明年会试中式，殿试得鼎甲，

Would that not be breaking through the ‘twelvefold towers’?”
那岂非「十二重楼诱」出？』

Xu was delighted by this interpretation.
徐世昌听这一解，大为高兴。

Then he read the pronouncement beneath the poem: “Bring glory to those before and abundance to those after; make the family flourish greatly.”
再看诗后的『断曰』∶『光前裕后，昌大其门庭』，

His happiness increased still further.
益发满心欢悦了。


On the day the list appeared, he waited from midnight until dawn and from dawn until noon.
到得登榜那天，由半夜等到天亮，由天亮等到日中，

At last a messenger arrived with good news—but it left Xu Shichang acutely embarrassed.
捷报来了，不过徐世昌却格外难堪，

His younger brother, Xu Shiguang, had passed in ninety-fifth place.
原来他的胞弟徐世光中了第九十五名举人。

Rewards were paid and the provincial hostel bustled for a while.
当下开发了喜封，在会馆中乱过一阵，

Once it grew quiet, Shichang could not help shedding miserable tears.
等静下来不由得凄然下泪。

“Elder Brother, I thought your examination essays better than mine,” Shiguang consoled him. “You must be among the top five.
『大哥，我看你的闱墨比我强。』徐世光安慰他说∶『一定是五经魁，

It is too early for that news.”
报来还早呢！』

When the provincial results were posted, the sealed names were opened and written out one by one, a process lasting from the previous midnight until the following evening.
原来乡试发榜，弥封卷子拆一名，写一名，从前一天半夜，一直要写到第二天晚上。

By custom, the list began with sixth place.
向例写榜从第六名开始，

The top five, the “Leaders of the Five Classics”, were disclosed last, by which time it was evening.
前五名称为，『五经魁』，留到最后揭晓，那时已是第二天晚上，

When those scripts were opened, every servant and labourer in the examination compound held a red candle, making the place bright as day.
到拆五经魁的卷子时，闱中仆役杂工，人手一支红蜡烛，光耀如白昼，

This was called “making a stir over the list”.
称为『闹榜』。

Dusk had not yet come, which was why Shiguang said the news was still to arrive.
其时黄昏未到，所以徐世光说是『报来还早呢』。

“News!”
『报！』

There was another commotion outside.
外面又热闹了，

Shichang listened intently.
徐世昌侧耳静听，

“Your household’s eldest young master, Xu Shichang, has passed the Shuntian provincial examination of the Renwu year in one hundred and forty-fifth place!”
报的是∶『贵府徐大少爷郎世昌，高中壬午科顺天乡试第一百四十五名举人。』

Could it be true?
这是真的吗？

Of course it was.
当然是真的，

He might misread the gold-printed announcement, but the messenger, nicknamed “Three Firsts in Succession”, was demanding his reward.
泥金报条上所写的，还怕会眼花看错，报子『连三元』来讨赏，

Even twenty taels did not satisfy him.
赏了二十两还不肯，

“The eldest young master and the second young master—double happiness at your door!
说是∶『大少爷、二少爷，双喜临门，

At least a hundred taels is called for.”
起码得赏个一百两银子。』

Surely this could not be false.
这总不是假的吧！

After bargaining, they finally sent him away with forty.
争多论少，终于以四十两银子打发了『连三元』。

That was only the first announcement; second and third messengers followed, costing a few more taels.
不过这是『头报』，接下来还有『二报』、『三报』，少不得还要破费几两银子。

The hostel was lively that night.
这一夜会馆中很热闹，

With both Xu brothers bringing honour to the family, congratulations flowed especially thickly into their courtyard.
徐氏兄弟棠棣联辉，他们所住的那个院子，更是贺客接踵不断，

Not until after midnight was it quiet.
直到午夜过后，才得清静下来，

Though physically exhausted, Shichang was too excited to feel sleepy.
虽然人已经非常困倦了，但徐世昌的精神亢奋，一点睡意都没有。


“Younger Brother, how accurate it was!”
『二弟，好灵啊！』

Shichang suddenly sprang up and shouted, giving Shiguang a fright.
徐世昌突然跳起来，大声嚷着，倒把徐世光吓一大跳。

“What thing was accurate?”
『大哥，什么东西好灵？』

“You must not call it a ‘thing’.
『，二弟，你不能用「东西」这种字眼，

I mean Immortal Lü’s lot.
我是说吕祖的签好灵。

Look!”
你看。』

He pointed to the words. “‘Glory to those before’—Guang, glory, plainly says that you would rank before me!”
徐世昌指着签词∶『「光前裕后」，不明明道破，你的名次在前吗？』

“Ah!”
『呃！』

Shiguang thought there was something in it.
徐世光也觉得有点道理，

“True.
『真的，

The Immortal indicated that I would share in Elder Brother’s glory.”
吕祖已经明示，我要沾大哥的光。』

“But do not be too pleased with yourself.
『不过，二弟，你也别太得意。

Your future achievements will not equal mine.”
你将来的成就不及我。』

As the elder brother spoke in that tone, Shiguang could only remain silent.
他以兄长的身份，用这样的口吻说话，徐世光自然只有保持沉默。

“What?
『怎么，

Do you not believe me?”
徐世昌说∶』你不相信？

“It is not that.
『『不是我不相信。

One can readily imagine that my achievements will be less than yours.
我将来的成就不及大哥，也是可想而知的；

But we were discussing the lot.
不过刚刚是在谈吕祖的签，

You must have found some meaning in it.
大哥一定在签上有所领悟，

Until you explained, it was not for me to speak.”
而没有说出一个究竟来，我就不便置喙了。』

“Of course!
『当然！

It reveals the secret.
当然是签上透露的玄机，

Look: ‘Make the family flourish greatly.’
你看∶』昌大其门庭「，

Chang, flourish—that means I, Xu Shichang, will bring glory to our ancestors.”
不就是我徐世昌才能荣宗耀祖吗？

Shiguang had no answer beyond repeated agreement.
『『徐世光无话可答，只有连声应说是。

“Only Elder Brother can make our Xu family flourish.”
『只有大哥才能昌大咱们徐家的门庭。』

Shichang grew solemn. “Tomorrow we shall bow at the shrine: first to thank the Immortal for his guidance, and then to ask his advice on our next steps.”
『二弟，』徐世昌神情肃穆地说∶『明天到吕祖祠去磕个头，一则谢谢他老人家的指点；再则今后的行止，也要请他老人家指点。』

Shiguang obeyed.
徐世光听兄长的话，

The next day they returned and each drew a lot about what to do.
第二天又一起到吕祖祠祝告求签。这回是各求一支，叩问行止，

Shiguang’s advised him to return home to study and come again for the metropolitan examination in spring.
徐世光求得的签，意思不是如回家读书，明年春天会试再来；

Shichang’s read: “What gain in going from your door?
徐世昌的那一支是∶『出门何所图，

/ More than in sitting home once more.
胜如家里坐，

/ Though no stair reaches Heaven’s height, / Each step will raise you towards the light.”
虽无上天梯，一步高一步。』

“You go home, Younger Brother.
『二弟，你回去，

I cannot.
我不能回去。』

The lot is clear: going out is better than staying home.
徐世昌说∶『签上说得很明白，出门胜似在家。

I should study in Beijing.”
我在京用功为妙。』


Shiguang naturally accepted his decision and went home alone.
徐世光自是听他作主，一个人先回家乡；

Shichang found a tutoring place in the household of Zhang Zhiwan, Minister of War.
徐世昌却寻得一个馆地，是兵部尚书张之万家，

The two families were old friends.
他们是世交，

Zhang invited him to study alongside his son, Zhang Ruiyin, and help with correspondence, lodging him in the rear courtyard.
张之万将他请了去陪他的儿子张瑞荫一起读书，附带办办笔墨，住在张家后院。

It was spacious.
后院很宽敞，

After setting up a bedroom and study, Xu still had rooms to spare and considered installing a shrine to Immortal Lü.
徐世昌布置了卧室、书房以外，还有余屋，打算着设一个神龛，供奉吕祖；

Before he had quite decided, he dreamed that the Immortal said, “If you truly wish to offer me incense, you must keep it secret.
主意将定未定之际，夜得一梦，梦见吕祖，告诉他说∶『你果真有心供奉我的香火，事须秘密；

When my wanderings tire me and I need a brief rest, I shall come and use your place as a quiet retreat from the world.
我云游稍倦，需要小憩时，自会降临，把你这里作为一个避嚣的静室，

I must not be disturbed.”
不宜有人打搅。』

Usually he remembered a dream upon waking, then soon forgot it entirely.
平时做梦，刚醒来时还记得，稍停一停，便忘得精光；

This one remained perfectly clear even as he washed the next morning.
只有这个梦，在他第二天起身漱洗时，还清清楚楚地记得。

He regarded such a visitation as momentous and was determined to follow the divine instructions.
徐世昌认为吕祖托梦，非同小可，不过一定得遵照神灵指示办事，

Doing everything himself, he chose the most secluded room and quietly installed a shrine.
所以一切亲自动手，找一间最隐密的房间，悄悄置了一座神龛；

Its door stayed shut all day.
白天门户紧闭，

At night, only after the courtyard gate had been closed and bolted would he open the secret room, burn incense and worship.
晚上直到院门关紧闩住，方开密室，在神前烧香膜拜，

He also obtained a set of “Immortal Lü’s Divination Lots”, so that he could seek guidance whenever in doubt.
同时置了一副『吕祖神签』，以便疑难不决时，得以请吕祖指点。


When Yuan’s letter arrived, he naturally drew a lot to ask whether the matter could be managed.
这天接到袁世凯的来信，少不得也要求支签，问一问这件事能不能办？

The answer was not only yes, but that he must act quickly: delay would make him too late.
签上指示，不但可办，而且要速办；迟则不及。

He immediately asked Zhang Ruiyin whether he knew anyone at the Ministry of Personnel.
当下便向张瑞荫打听，吏部有没有熟人？

“What is the matter?”
『什么事？』

“A friend, Yuan Weiting, has a difficulty.” Xu explained it in detail.
『是一个朋友袁慰亭，有点麻烦。』徐世昌细说了缘由。

“That belongs to the ministry’s Civil Appointments Department,” Zhang said. “For such business, a clerk is more useful than an officer.”
『这是吏部文选句该管。』张瑞荫说∶『这种事找司官，不如找书办。』

“Exactly.
『正是，

Yuan stressed the same thing in his letter.
袁慰亭信中关照，也是要找书办；

When I asked whether you knew anyone, I meant whether you had a sufficiently friendly connection among the clerks.”
我问有没有熟人，就是说吏部书办之中有没有够交情的？』

“How could a family such as ours be on friendly terms with petty clerks?
『我们这种人家，怎么会跟胥吏有交情？』

Let me ask Old Niu at the gate.”
张瑞荫说∶『等我来问问门上老牛。』

Realising his blunder, Xu blushed. “Yes, yes.
徐世昌知道失言了，脸一红说∶『是，是，

I misspoke.
我说错了。

Please ask Old Niu for me.”
就拜托你找老牛问一问吧？』


They summoned the gatekeeper.
将老牛找了来一问，

“We know a man called He,” he said.
他说∶『我们熟识一个姓何的，

“He has considerable influence in Civil Appointments.
在吏部文选人司很吃得开。

But I do not know whether he is in Beijing.”
不过不知道在在京？』

“Why?
『怎么？

Where else would a ministry clerk be?”
吏部的书办不在京里会在什么地方呢？』

“Old He comes from Puzhou in Shanxi.
『老何原籍山西蒲州，

Some time ago I heard he intended to take leave and visit his ancestral graves.
前一阵子我听说他要请假回老家去上坟，

I do not know whether he has gone.”
不知道走了没有？』

“Go there at once,” Zhang Ruiyin said. “Find out whether he is still here.
『你赶快去一趟。』张瑞荫说∶『看看何书办在不在？

If he is, tell him about the matter.” Xu explained everything to Old Niu and asked him to negotiate.
在呢，就跟他说，有这么一件事。』这件事的始末，由徐世昌告诉了老牛，请老牛去谈。

There was a commission to be earned, so the gatekeeper eagerly went straight to Clerk He.
这是有回扣的事，老牛很巴结地，当时便去找何书办接头。

That evening he returned.
到晚来回话，

“A close thing!
『好险！』

One step later and we would have missed him.
老牛说道∶『只差一步，

His luggage was already on the cart, and he leaves first thing tomorrow.”
行李都上车了，明儿一大早就走。』

“Oh?
『喔，

Did you speak to him?”
你跟他谈了？』

“Yes.”
『是的。』

“Is there a solution?”
『有办法没有？』

“How could they lack solutions?” Old Niu laughed. “The only question is whether we can agree on the price.”
『他们怎么会没办法？』老牛笑道∶『就怕「盘子」谈不拢。』

“What price has he named?” Zhang asked.
『他开的「盘口」是多少？』张瑞荫问。



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第四章（本章第2部分，共2部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“Clerk He says the movements into and out of office make this a serious matter.
『何书办说，这件事一进一出，关系极大，

If Mr Yuan’s secretaryship cannot be traced to its proper origin, promotion to deputy prefect is out of the question.
如果袁老爷的中书还不出娘家，不但升同知不必谈，

There will also be an investigation into the discrepancy in his record.
还要追究他何以资历不符，

Then it will no longer concern the Ministry of Personnel.”
那就不是吏部的事了。』

“Which ministry would it concern?” Xu asked.
『不是吏部的事，』徐世昌问∶『是哪一部的事呢？』

“Punishments.”
『刑部。』

“Good heavens!”
『好家伙！』

Xu was alarmed.
徐世昌大吃一惊，

“He could be prosecuted?”
『还要治罪啊！』

“That is what they say.
『人家是这么说，

We need not believe every word, but Mr Yuan has this weakness and must ask their help.
咱们也不能全听他的。不过，袁老爷正好有这个短处非求他不可，

We can only listen to an extravagant demand.”
那就只好听他狮子大开口了。』

“How much?”
『要多少？』

“Two thousand.”
『两千。』

Exactly twice the available sum.
正好差了一半；

Looking troubled, Xu handed Yuan’s letter to Zhang Ruiyin.
徐世昌面有难色，将袁世凯的信，递给了张瑞荫看。

After reading it, Zhang asked, “Old Niu, did he tell you how he means to do it?”
看完信，张瑞荫问道∶『老牛，他跟你说了没有，是怎么个办法？』

“Would he tell me, Young Master?
『大少爷，你倒想，他肯跟我说吗？

I pressed him for ages.
我倒是盯着问了好半天，

跟他讲盘子吧，

Fifteen hundred at the most.
最多给他一个半数。』

Mr Xu’s friend is not an outsider.”
张瑞荫又说∶『徐老爷的朋友，不是外人。』

This hinted that Old Niu must not inflate the price for his own benefit. “Yes.

老牛又说∶『我得连夜跟何书办去谈，

He leaves at first light.”
不然人家天一亮就走人了。』

连夜折冲，以一千二百两银子成交；先交一半，等办妥了再交一半。

徐世昌第二天到天津，去北洋公所将一千两银子领了出来，存在阜康福钱庄，先打了一张六百两的票子，交给张瑞荫。

张瑞荫办事也很周到，

怕的万一出了什么差错，徐老爷对袁老爷也有个交代。』

“Yes.”
『是。』

老牛便去约好何书办，在一家饭馆见面。

Ministry clerks occupied a low social position.
部中胥吏的身份甚低，

尽管衣着比纨绔子弟还讲究，但见了张瑞荫称『大少爷』，对徐世昌叫『徐老爷』，站着说话，执礼甚恭。

一关过不去就不成。

银票我暂时收着，也不会去兑，等事情办妥了再说。』

“Very well.
『是的，

Thank you for your trouble,” Zhang said. “How should Mr Xu reply to Mr Yuan?”
你多费心。』张瑞荫问∶『徐老爷应该怎么回复袁老爷？』

只为将门之后，投效戎行，所以改名「世凯」。

只要北洋这么咨复吏部，

一准改名，袁老爷的同知就升定了。』

The device was simple once explained.
这个诀窍说穿了不稀奇，

Without connections smoothed at the ministry, however, a change of name could destroy an entire career.
但如果不是在吏部打通了关节，一改名字就可能会把整个前程断送掉，

If the clerks wished to obstruct it, any excuse could delay the matter for six months or a year.
因为要刁难的话，随便找个理由就可以折磨个一年半载，

After one barrier was passed, another would arise.
及至一关通过，又有另一关，

非把钱花够了数，不能领一张俗称为『部照「的任官』文凭『，

While the change remained unresolved, the man could neither be assigned a post nor take one up.
而在更名未确定以前，不能分发，不能赴任，

只有闲等，先就是一大损失。

Consequently, when a name was wrong in examination results or Personnel’s appointments, many willingly endured it and continued under the error.
所以考试发榜，吏部铨选，如果姓名弄错，往往情甘委屈，将错就错，

A fraudulent “name change” as smooth as Yuan’s was rare indeed.
象袁世凯这样顺利的假』更名『，实在很少。


Even so, the exchange of official documents took half a year.
即令如此，公文往返，也得半年工夫。

By then the situation had changed again: Li Hongzhang’s return to his former post was settled.
其时局势又已有变化，李鸿章的回任已经定局了——

After Zhang Shusheng and his son inadvertently offended Zhang Peilun, Li realised that Zhang Shusheng seemed inclined to borrow Beiyang indefinitely without returning it.
从张树声父子无意间得罪了张佩纶以后，李鸿章发觉张树声对北洋有『久假不归』之势，

He seized the opportunity, cultivated Zhang Peilun and worked through Li Hongzao to secure a decision that both men should return to their substantive posts.
便利用时机，极力拉拢张佩纶，走李鸿藻的路子，搞出来一个与张树声各回本任的结果，

But less than a year had passed since his mother’s death, and the Korean disturbance had been quelled.
但李鸿章母丧尚不满一年，而朝鲜的内乱已经平定，

With no further need for force, there was no justification for summoning him from mourning to military service.
不必再动用武力，就没有『墨从军』而且『夺情』的理由，

Fortunately, foreign affairs offered many difficult matters.
好在洋务上棘手之事甚多，

On the pretext that he was needed to negotiate with the foreign ministers, Li was retained, awaiting a suitable moment for the formal order restoring him.
以需要李鸿章与各国公使折冲的借口，将李鸿章留了下来，等待适当的时机再颁回任之谕。

Travelling from his Hefei home to Beijing, he spent many days in Shanghai and gained a strong impression of Zuo’s intention to expel his influence from Liangjiang.
当李鸿章自合肥老家入京时，在上海住了好些日子，对左宗棠打算驱逐李鸿章势力出两江的情形，印象深刻。

Their views on foreign and military affairs also differed sharply.
同时，对洋务、军务的见解，大相径庭，

Over the dispute with France in Vietnam, Li believed that “their demands cannot be satisfied, while our military funds cannot bear the strain”.
象中国与法国在越南的纠纷，李鸿章认为『彼欲难餍，我饷难支』，

A peaceful settlement was necessary; force must not be used.
应该和平了结，决不可用武，

Zuo, by contrast, advocated supporting Liu Yongfu’s Black Flag Army in helping Vietnam resist France.
而左宗棠主张支持助越拒法的『黑旗军「刘永福，

He supplied arms to Cen Yuying, governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, for onward delivery to Liu, and formally wrote the Zongli Yamen that “the choice between war and peace can be settled in a word”.
不但以军火接济云贵总督岑毓英转以援刘，而且正式致书总理衙门，认为』主战主和，不难一言而决『，

At present, he argued, “not only do many Western countries consider France in the wrong; they foresee that discord with China must leave the affair without a conclusion and bring irretrievable regret”.
目前的情势，』不但泰西诸邦多以法为不然；逆料其与中国不协，必致事无结束，悔不可追『，

France itself feared the great risks of war with China, but, having mounted the tiger, could only bluff.
就是法国亦何尝不顾虑，真要与中国开战，危险甚大，不过势成骑虎，不能不虚张声势，

If China wavered, it would fall into the trap.
如果中国动摇，适中其计。

His assessment was that war accorded with justice, suited the circumstances and conformed to opinion both in China and abroad.
他说他』默察时局，惟主战于正义有合，而于时势攸宜，

Because he kept arguing thus, the court specially ordered Li to Guangdong to supervise Vietnamese affairs.
即中外人情亦无不顺『就因为他一直有这种论调，所以朝廷特派李鸿章前赴广东督办越南事宜；

This was nominal: Li need not actually go there, since he could negotiate peace with the French minister Bourée in Shanghai or Tianjin.
这是一个名义，实际上李鸿章并不必赴广东，在上海、在天津，都可以跟法国公使宝海和谈。

But if Zuo continued urging armed intervention, Li might eventually have to command a war against France from Guangdong—a prospect that threatened to ruin him.
但如左宗棠不断鼓吹武力干预，到最后恐终不免要到广东去指挥对法战事，那一来只怕非身败名裂不可。

The Zongli Yamen was cautious and would not readily accept Zuo’s argument from “justice”.
当然，总署亦很持重，不会轻信左宗棠的『正义』说，

Nevertheless, his advocacy made Li’s negotiations with Bourée more difficult.
只是李鸿章跟宝海的交涉，因此而愈感困难。


Britain, too, gave Li headaches.
对法如此，对英亦常使李鸿章伤脑筋。

British merchants wanted to connect their submarine telegraph cable at Wusong to Shanghai by a land line; Zuo firmly refused.
英商的海洋电报线希望由吴淞接一条旱线到上海，左宗棠坚持不许；

They sought a reduction in the cocoon levy; he opposed that as well.
英商希望减轻茧捐，左宗棠亦表反对。

Most troublesome was his proposal to raise the likin on imported opium and native-grown opium.
而最使李鸿章为难的是，左宗棠倡议洋药土烟加厘一事。『洋药土烟』皆指鸦片，『加厘』便是加『通行税』。

He regarded opium’s harm as limitless and proposed using taxation as a means of suppression.
左宗棠认为鸦片流毒无穷，主张寓禁于征，

After imperial approval, he and Li negotiated with the British minister, Thomas Wade.
奉旨允准后，会同李鸿章与英国公使威妥玛交涉。

Wade proposed increasing the import duty while leaving inland transit levies unchanged.
威妥玛提出洋药进口增加税，行销内地在各关卡所征厘捐不增加；

Zuo agreed in principle, but China demanded a hundred and fifty taels per chest and Britain offered only eighty.
左宗棠也同意了，但每箱的进口税，中国要一百五十两；英国只愿缴八十两。

The gap was too wide for agreement.
相差太巨，一直没有成议。

After Zuo took a provincial appointment, Li continued the negotiations.
以后左宗棠外放，交涉由李鸿章接办，

Wade, recalled to Britain, hoped to conclude the matter on British terms and return home with enhanced standing.
而威妥玛奉调回国，希望此一交涉能如英国的条件谈成功，增添他回国以后的面子，

Li wished to help, but Zuo refused to compromise and opposed the terms as governor-general of Liangjiang, producing a deadlock.
李鸿章有心帮忙，却以左宗棠的不肯妥协，以江督的地位表示反对，搞得事成僵局。


Their greatest conflict of policy concerned the navy. Li had originally advocated maritime defence, and greatly admired Zhang Peilun’s proposal for a special Naval Yamen and a modern fleet.
但在事业上最大的冲突是，李鸿章原主『海防』，而张佩纶有个专设『水师衙门』创办新式海军之议，大为李鸿章所欣赏。

But after reaching Liangjiang and inspecting the coast and Yangtze, Zuo changed his earlier preference for land defence.
但左宗棠一到两江，巡阅过海口及长江以后，改变了他原来『陆防』的主张，

He invited Peng Yulin, whose career had begun in the naval forces, to discuss modern warship construction, and work was already under way.
特意将水师出身的彭玉麟请了来，商量造新式兵舰，而且已经开始在办了。

Having founded the Fujian shipbuilding establishment, Zuo could not be dismissed as an amateur.
左宗棠首创福建船政，对此道不能说他是外行；

It was therefore foreseeable that he would never permit Beiyang sole authority over the future modern navy.
因此可以预见的是，将来创办新式海军，左宗棠决不容北洋单独掌权。

In a dispute between land and sea defence, defeating his argument would have removed the difficulty.
『海防』、『陆防』之争，只要打倒了他的理论，便无他虑；

Now that he too favoured maritime defence, they would compete to carry out the same enterprise.
如今左宗棠亦主张海防，那就变成彼此竞争着办一件事，

Li could not tolerate sharing authority or being unable to act as he wished.
权不能独专、事不能由心，是李鸿章最不能容忍的一件事。

Whether he considered the present or the future, Zuo was a thorn in his eye that must be removed.
因此，无论看眼前，算将来，李鸿章认为左宗棠是非拔除不可的眼中钉。

The first step was to strip away his support.
这得从剪除左宗棠的羽翼着手。

Li’s advisers agreed, and thought Hu Xueyan should be the first target.
李鸿章手下的谋士，都有这样一种见解；且认为第一个目标，应该是胡雪岩。

Shanghai Circuit Intendant Shao Youlian accordingly made a secret plan with Sheng Xuanhuai and others: they would place Hu in difficulty over repayment of a foreign loan.
于是上海道邵友濂便与盛宣怀等人，密密商定了一个打击胡雪岩的办法，在洋债还款这件事上，造成胡雪岩的困窘。


Two loans handled by Hu remained outstanding.
其时胡雪岩经手、尚未清结的借款，还有两笔，

One was merchant funding contracted in the eighth month of the fourth year of Guangxu, with Chinese and foreign portions totalling six and a half million taels.
一笔是光绪四年八月所借的商款，华洋各计，总计六百五十万两；

Why had merchant funding been used rather than a foreign loan?
洋款不借借商款，

There was a story behind it.
其中别有衷曲，

In Guangxu’s third year, Hu had arranged a five-million-tael loan from HSBC, to be advanced and repaid in actual silver.
原来光绪三年，由胡雪岩经手，向汇丰银行借款五百万两，借还均用实银，

Interest was one and a quarter per cent a month, with principal and interest repaid in fourteen instalments over seven years.
条件是月息一分二厘五，期限七年，连本带利分十四期拔还。

Each instalment fell six months apart.
每期六个月，

As before, repayment was secured by bills issued by the Zhejiang, Guangdong, Shanghai and Jianghan customs.
仍由浙、粤、江海、江汉四关出票，按期偿还。

A supplementary condition stipulated that if the borrower abandoned the transaction after agreement, failing to supply the customs bills within three months, Hu would forfeit a hundred and fifty thousand taels.
此外有个附带条件，即商定此项条件后，如果借方作罢，三个月内关票不到，则胡雪岩罚银十五万两；

HSBC would incur the same penalty if it failed to deliver the silver within three months.
汇丰如果三个月内不交银，罚款相间。

Intervention by Shen Baozhen, governor-general of Liangjiang, caused repeated complications and long delay.
这笔借款由于两江总督沈葆桢的介入，一波三折，拖延甚久。

The western campaign was then going well.
其时西征军事颇为顺手，

Liu Jintang had advanced south from Urumqi and sent a force to join Shaanxi provincial commander Zhang Yao in an attack that recovered Turfan at one stroke.
刘锦棠率军自乌鲁木齐南进，并分兵与陕西提督张曜会功吐鲁番，一举克复，

Bai Yanhu, one of the Muslim rebel leaders, fled west in haste.
回乱首脑之一的白彦虎仓皇西遁；

Liu reached Toksun at the western end of the Turfan basin, and more than twenty thousand Muslim followers surrendered.
刘锦棠亦推进至吐鲁番盆地西端的托克逊，回众投降者两万余人。

But the leadership passed through Hoxud and Karashahr, emerged from Iron Gate Pass and established contact with the Russian military at Korla.
但回部首脑经和硕、焉耆，出铁门关在库尔勒地方，跟俄国军方搭上了线，

Meanwhile, shortages of provisions and pay prevented the expeditionary army from advancing west, to Zuo’s intense anxiety.
而西征军却因粮饷困难，无法西进，左宗棠着急得不得了。

At last the foreign loan was negotiated in the fifth month.
好不容易在五月里谈成功了这笔洋债，

Even the prospect was like imagining plums to quench thirst: army morale revived, and the supply offices in Shanghai, Hubei and Shaanxi found it easier to borrow from merchants for immediate needs.
至少望梅止渴，军心先是一振；同时在上海、湖北、陕西的三处粮台，借商款应急，亦比较容易措手了。


Complications arose during the formalities.
哪知在办手续时，起了波折，

A loan from the British-owned HSBC ordinarily required the Zongli Yamen to notify the British minister of its terms.
原来英商汇丰银行贷款，照例要由总理衙门出面，致英国公使一个照会，叙明借款条件等等，

The minister then instructed the inspector-general of customs and the Shanghai consul to inform HSBC accordingly.
由英国公使再转行总税务司及驻上海领事，转知汇丰银行照办。

If the loan could not be recovered, Britain could then raise the matter with China.
这一来，如果贷款放出去收不回，便可由英国向中国交涉；

In effect, the note was a Chinese government guarantee.
这通照会实际上是中国政府所出的保证书，

HSBC therefore drafted it and gave it to Hu, who passed it through Zuo with a request that the Zongli Yamen act.
所以由汇丰银行拟好稿子，交给胡雪岩，再经左宗棠咨请总理衙门办理，

Yet the bank’s draft said that interest must not exceed one per cent.
而汇丰的稿子中，说明『息银不得过一分』，

Why, then, had Zuo’s memorial specified one and a quarter per cent a month?
然则左宗棠的奏折中，何以说是月息一分二厘五？

Robert Hart, the inspector-general of customs whose role was crucial, declared the loan could not proceed.
为此，其中处于关键地位的总税务司赫德，表示这笔借款不能成立。

An investigation was inevitable.
这当然要查。

On the basis of Hu’s explanation, Zuo memorialised that HSBC’s interest was indeed only one per cent.
左宗棠根据胡雪岩的答复回奏，说汇丰的息银，只有一分，诚然不错，

But the loan was reckoned in shillings and paid in silver dollars.
但付款办法是以先令计算，折付银圆；

Those dollars, commonly called “worn foreign silver”, circulated in the southeastern provinces but not in the northwest.
这种银圆，一向在东南各省通用，称之为『烂番银』，西北向不通用，

The funds therefore still had to be obtained in actual silver measured in taels.
所以仍旧须借以两为单位的现银。

The shilling exchange rate varied with London quotations, even between morning and evening.
但先令的市价，根据伦敦挂牌，早晚不同；

If it rose at the time of conversion, Hu would suffer a loss.
到时候如果汇价上涨，胡雪岩便要吃赔帐，

He had therefore arranged with the German Tailai Trading House to guarantee the shilling conversion.
所以接洽德商泰来洋行，『包认先令』，

This involved substantial risk, for which its additional quarter of a percentage point in interest was not excessive.
这要承担相当风险，泰来洋行得息二厘五，并不为多。

Zuo insisted that the arrangement had been consistent throughout and merely had not previously been explained clearly.
左宗棠表示，此案『首尾本属一贯』，只是前次『未经声叙明析』，

He strongly asserted that Hu had no ulterior motive in borrowing abroad.
又力言胡雪岩『息借洋款，实无别故』。

Plainly, he was taking responsibility and standing firm; the court could hardly refuse to respect his seniority.
很显然的，这是左宗棠硬顶下来的，朝廷不能不买他的老面子；

Inwardly, however, he felt badly about it.
左宗棠心里却觉得很不是味道，

His trust in Hu diminished, though he could not do without him.
从此对胡雪岩的信用便打了一个折扣，可是却不能不用胡雪岩。


Hu naturally wished to make amends, and devised the merchant-loan method.
胡雪岩当然亦想力盖前愆，于是而有借商款的办法，

At the end of that year, Guangxu’s third, Zuo wrote in reply: “This year our finances have been exceptionally strained.
这年——光绪三年年底，左宗棠写给胡雪岩的复信说∶『今岁饷事，拮据殊常，

Had the prince at the Grand Council not pressed urgently for provincial assistance and arranged funds from the ministry, the whole undertaking would have been beyond saving.
非枢邸严催协饷，筹部款，大局已不可问。

Complications arose at every turn in the foreign loan.
洋款枝节横生，

Without your painstaking ingenuity and tireless support, nothing could have been done.
非阁下苦心孤诣，竭力维持，无从说起。』

Even now, the year-end payroll depends on the swift arrival of its first advance.
现在年关满饷，仍待洋款头批速到，始够支销，

After settling the Hubei debt, we must allocate money for famine relief in Shaanxi and the stricken people of Gansu.
除清还鄂欠外，尚须匀拨陕赈及甘属灾黎，

Of the remaining loan, after repaying the Shanghai office’s borrowings, enough will last only until the turn of summer and autumn next year.
所余洋款，除清还沪局借款外，核计敷至明年夏秋之交而止，

What is to be done after that, I do not know.
此后又不知何以为计？

You say that military affairs give comfort but finance gives grave concern, and preparations must begin a year ahead.
尊意以为兵事可慰，饷事则殊可忧，不得不先一年预为之地，

That is a thoroughly practical and sound judgement.
洵切实确凿之论，

What I wished to discuss, you have already considered for me.
弟心中所欲奉商者，阁下已代为计之，

Without putting yourself in my position and examining the whole situation, you could not have said a word of it.
非设身处地，通盘熟筹，不能道其只字，

Across ten thousand li, we are of one mind without needing explanation.”
万里同心，不言而喻。

Hu had indeed calculated it all: the year-end payroll, famine relief after drought in Shaanxi and Gansu, and repayment of the Hubei and Shanghai loans would leave another gap around the following summer and autumn.
『原来胡雪岩早替左宗棠算过了，年底本应发饷；陕甘两省旱灾要赈济，再还了湖北、上海两处借款，到得明年夏秋之间，便又是青黄不接的时期了。

Borrowing for military finance required a year’s preparation.
借款筹饷要早一年便须着手。

Yet another foreign loan was out of the question.
可是洋款已不能借。

Such loans were national obligations.
借洋款是国家的责任，

Though the provinces were to provide the funds, successive disasters had impoverished them, and arrears in their contributions to the western campaign meant that the government would still have to find repayment.
虽说由各省协饷，但灾荒连年，各省情形都不好，欠解西征协饷，无法归还欠款，仍须政府设法，

Further foreign borrowing could not even be proposed.
所以根本不能再提洋款。

Moreover, Zuo resented being subjected to Hart’s obstruction and was reluctant to borrow abroad, particularly from British firms.
而且左宗棠因为借洋款，要受赫德的气，自己亦不大愿意借洋款，尤其是英商的款子。

Hu recalled his words: “The interest and charges are too heavy.
胡雪岩想到左宗棠说过，『息耗太重，

With merchant money, what Chu loses Chu gains, and that might be tolerable.
如果是商款，楚弓楚得，倒还罢了。

But foreigners make great profits from us and still find fault at every turn.
洋人赚了我们重利，还要多方挑剔，

It is galling.”
实在不甘。』

He had also said repeatedly, “Why must the customs and provinces issue bills, as though they were repaying Shaanxi and Gansu’s debts?
同时又一再表示，『何必海关及各省出票？倒象是各省替陕甘来还债；

The repayments come from contributions those provinces are already owed.
其实还的还是陕甘应得的协饷。

I command the western campaign and have full authority to arrange its funds.
我主持西征，筹饷我有全权；

Borrowing when assistance is late is simply managing cash flow.
协饷不到，先借款子来接济，这就是所谓调度。

If merchants trust Shaanxi and Gansu and trust me, bills from those provinces should suffice.
商人如果相信陕甘相信我，由陕甘出票就可以了，

Why trouble the Zongli Yamen?”
何必劳动总署？』


Hu therefore devised a merchant-loan scheme.
因此他设计了一套借商款的办法，

After repeated discussion, he undertook to assemble one million seven hundred and fifty thousand taels in merchant subscriptions, with HSBC “subscribing” the same amount.
往返磋商定议，由胡雪岩邀集商股一百七十五万两；另由汇丰『认股』一百七十五万两，

The combined three and a half million would be lent through a company called Qiantai.
合并三百五十万，组识一个乾泰公司负责借出。

Zuo calculated that over seven years Shaanxi and Gansu would receive more than eighteen million one hundred thousand taels in provincial assistance.
照左宗棠的计算，在七年之中，陕甘可得协饷一千八百十万以上，

Even after repaying the foreign loan, at least ten million would remain, so a merchant loan of several million could certainly be discharged.
除还洋款以外，至少尚有千万之多，所以借几百万商款，一定能够清偿；

But remittances arrived at uncertain times and in varying amounts.
但协饷收到的日期不一，多寡不定，

He therefore requested flexible terms: first, no customs bills; second, no fixed maturity, so that repayment could be early or late; third, pay when money was available and owe it temporarily when it was not, with interest continuing but no fixed interval between instalments.
所以提出来一个『机圆法话』的要求，第一，不出关票；第二，不定年限，可以早还，亦可以迟还；第三，有钱还钱、无钱暂欠，利息照算，不必定为几个月一期。

This was wishful thinking.
这是他一厢情愿的想法，

Hu could secure only the absence of customs bills.
胡雪岩只能替他办到不出关票，

The term was fixed at six years, instalments remained half-yearly, and interest was one and a fifth per cent a month.
此外年限定为六年，期次仍是半年一期，利息是一分二。

Merchant borrowing also required imperial approval.
当然借商款亦须奏准；

Zuo memorialised on the sixteenth day of the eighth month of Guangxu’s fourth year.
左宗棠于光绪四年八月十六日出奏，

A month later he received the court’s reply: “Merchant loans carry heavy interest.
一个月以后奉到廷寄∶『借用商款，息银既重，

After annual allocations from the provincial and customs revenues for principal and interest, funds for the capital and other military requirements cannot be raised.
各省关每年除划还本息外，京协各饷，更属无从筹措，

Such borrowing is a last resort.
本系万不得已之计。

In consideration of Zuo Zongtang’s undertakings, now approaching completion, the present proposal is approved.
此次故念左宗棠筹办各务，事在垂成，准照所议办理。

Hereafter, whatever the urgency, merchant loans at interest must not be resorted to lightly, imposing burdens on the future.”
嗣后无论何项急需，不得动辄息借商款，致贻后累。

“Capital funds” covered the expenses of government in Beijing: civil and military salaries, pay for the Eight Banner soldiers, and the silver delivered to the palace three times a year for the private expenses of the two empress dowagers and emperor.
『所谓』京饷『，即是在京的各项开支，包括文武百官的俸给、八旗士兵的饷项，以及一年三次送入宫内供两宫太后及皇帝私人开支的』交进银『在内，

It was the most important budget item.
是最重要的一笔预算，

To say that even these funds could not be raised because of Zuo’s repeated borrowing was a severe rebuke.
由于左宗棠动辄借款之累，连京饷都』无从筹措『，这话说得很重了。


Not until the previous year, when Zuo was summoned to Beijing, had he borrowed again.
为此，一直到上年左宗棠奉召入京，

Obliged to arrange finance for Liu Jintang’s settlement of the western regions, he acted almost on his own authority and took a four-million-tael loan raised by HSBC through subscriptions.
为了替刘锦棠筹划西征善后，才迫不得已，在近乎独断独行的情况下，借了汇丰银行招股所贷的四百万两。

The risks on both loans rested entirely on Hu.
这两笔款子的风险，都在胡雪岩一个人身上。

Repayment of the three-and-a-half-million merchant loan had begun in Guangxu’s fifth year, and nearly half had been paid.
三百五十万的商款，自光绪五年起分期拔还，几乎已还了一半；

Each instalment of principal and interest came to only a hundred thousand taels or so.
而且每期本息约十来万银子，

Shao knew that would not trouble Hu; to obstruct him, he must use the loan contracted in the seventh year.
邵友濂亦知道，难不倒胡雪岩，要刁难他，只有在光绪七年所借的那一笔上。

Those funds were actually received in the fourth month of that year, at an annual rate stated as “nine li, nine hao and five”.
这笔款子实收于光绪七年四月，年息九厘九毫五，

For the first two years only interest was payable.
前两年只付息，不还本，

From the third year, a million taels of principal fell due annually, in two instalments: the first in the fourth month of Guangxu’s ninth year and the second in the tenth, five hundred thousand taels each.
第三年起每年拔本一百万两，分两期给付；光绪九年四月付第一期、十月付第二期，每期各五十万两。

Hu had handled earlier foreign loans without having to worry about repayment.
以前各次洋债，虽由胡雪岩经手，但如何偿还，不用他来操心，

The customs bills bore the provincial chiefs’ seals and, once collected at Shanghai Customs, were countersigned by the commissioner, who assumed joint liability.
因为各省督抚加了印的『关票』，汇集于江海关后，税务司还要签押负连带责任，

If provincial bills could not be honoured, he could withhold customs revenue to pay them.
如果各省的『关票』不能兑现，税务司可以截留税款，代为抵付。

But with the last four-million-tael loan, Zuo had acted almost independently to free Liu Jintang of financial anxiety.
可是这最后一次的四百万两，在借款时为了替刘锦棠解除后顾之忧，左宗棠近乎独断独行，

Assuming that future provincial remittances would easily cover it, he had broadly promised that principal would “be repaid on schedule through the Shanghai Transport Office; if Shanghai has no funds, the lender shall be permitted to obtain payment on schedule from the Ministry of Revenue”.
只以为未来数年协饷尚多，不愁无法偿还，所以大包大揽地说∶本银『如期由上海转运局经手交还；如上海无银，应准其向户部如期兑取。』

He feared that the Zongli Yamen and Li might prompt Hart to obstruct the loan, and accepted concessions to secure it.
这一惟恐总理衙门及李鸿章策动棘德阴挠，但求成功不惜迁就的承诺，

The promise quietly placed the entire risk on Hu’s shoulders.
无形之中便将全部风险都加了在胡雪岩的肩头上，

If the provinces failed to remit, HSBC would certainly approach him.
因为各省如果不解，汇丰银行一定找胡雪岩，

There was no need for the trouble of asking the British minister to negotiate with Revenue.
他们不必多费周折，请英国公使出面跟户部打交道；

With his resources, credit and willingness to shoulder responsibility, Hu would surely meet each five-hundred-thousand-tael principal instalment.
以胡雪岩的财力、信用与担当，每期五十万两银子的本银，亦一定挑得起来。


Even so, half a million taels was no small sum.
话虽如此，五十万两银子到底不是一个小数目。

Shao Youlian and Sheng Xuanhuai secretly agreed to “give him a squeeze” when the time came.
邵友濂与盛宣怀秘密商定，到时候，『挤他一挤』，

They might not bring him down, but could at least damage his credit.
虽未必能挤倒，至少可以打击打击他的信用。

That spring, Guangxu’s ninth year, relations with France deteriorated again.
其时——光绪九年春天，中法的关系复又恶化了。

In the eleventh month of the previous year, Li and the French minister had reached a three-point agreement in Shanghai for a peaceful settlement of the Vietnamese dispute.
本来前一年十一月间，李鸿章与法国公使在上海谈判，已经达成了和平解决在越南的纠纷的三点协议。

But the French naval and colonial authorities separately told their foreign ministry that they objected to Bourée’s agreement.
但法国海军部及殖民部，分别向他们的外交部表示，不满宝海与李鸿章的协议，

The navy had already sent reinforcements to Haiphong in northern Vietnam.
海军方面且已增兵越南北部的海防。

A political change in France then brought a new cabinet.
而又恰好法国发生政潮，

Its foreign minister, Challemel-Lacour, supported the military position, repudiated the agreement, recalled Bourée and sent Tricou as special envoy to negotiate in China.
新内阁的外交部长沙美拉库支持军部的主张，推翻前议，而且将宝海撤任，另派特使德理固专程来华谈判。

Curiously, Bourée himself travelled from Shanghai to Tianjin to see Li and urged him to uphold their earlier agreement, even accusing the French government of breaking its word.
妙的是法国公使宝海，特为自上海到天津去看李鸿章，他劝李鸿章坚持前议，不防指责法国政府违约；

With a French minister opposing his own government, Li felt confident of peace once more.
有了这种反对他们政府的法国公使，李鸿章觉得谈和又有把握了，

He therefore followed his original plan and requested leave to return home for his mother’s burial.
所以仍旧照原定计划，奏请准予给假回籍葬亲。

He was still unwilling to resume his former office, but had accepted the Beiyang commission in order to begin construction of the naval harbour at Lüshun.
李还不肯回任，但为了开始建设旅顺军港，北洋大臣的差使是接下来了，

During his leave, Zhang Shusheng would naturally act in that capacity.
既然请假，北洋大臣自然由张树声暂署。


But in the second month, while Li was at his ancestral home in Hefei, French forces resumed hostilities in Vietnam.
但就在二月里李鸿章在合肥原籍时，法军在越南复又动武，

They not only captured Nam Dinh but directly infringed Chinese interests.
不但攻占越南南定，而且直接侵犯中国在越南权益，

A China Merchants ship carrying rice was detained at Haiphong, and its warehouses at Haiphong and Thuan An were occupied; the grain and other property within them were confiscated.
招商局运米的船，在海防为法军扣押；设在海防及顺安的两处仓库，为法军占领，其中的存粮及其他物品，当然也被没收了。

Besides formally seeking aid through the Ministry of Rites, the Vietnamese government specially sent its “Minister of Punishments”, Fan Shen, to China, emulating Shen Baoxu’s weeping appeal at the court of Qin.
加以越南政府除行文礼部乞援外，并特派『刑部尚书』范慎来华，效『申包胥哭秦庭』，

The court was shaken.
因此，朝中震动，

Moral criticism rose, and all called for a firm response.
清议昂扬，都主张采取强硬的对策；

Even Zeng Jize, the first-rank Marquis Yiyong and minister to Britain and France, telegraphed to urge military aid to Vietnam and no concessions to France.
甚至驻英兼驻法公使一等毅勇侯曾纪泽，亦打电报回来，建议派军援越，不可对法国让步。

Many provincial chiefs also favoured war.
当时疆臣亦多主战，

Cen Yuying had long prepared for it, but Zeng Guoquan, acting governor-general of Liangguang, would not lightly begin hostilities, to the critics’ great displeasure.
云贵总督岑毓英，备战已有多时，但署理两广总督的曾国荃，却不愿轻启战端，清议深为不满，

Prince Gong, directing the Zongli Yamen, protested diplomatically to France while obtaining approval to order Li back at once to his substantive post as governor-general of Zhili.
因而主持总署的恭王，一面循外交途径向法国抗议；一面奏准命李鸿章迅回直隶总督本任，

Another decree then sent him, in that capacity, urgently to Guangdong to supervise Vietnamese affairs, placing the defence forces of Guangdong, Guangxi and Yunnan under his command.
接着降谕，派李鸿章以直隶总督的身分迅往广东督办越南事宜，所有广东、广西、云南防军，均归节制。

Zuo was simultaneously ordered to prepare troops in the lower Yangtze region for possible dispatch south.
同时命左宗棠筹划江南防军待命南调援越。

Hu happened to be in Jiangning and said to him, “There ought also to be a decree returning Governor-General Zhang to his substantive post in Liangguang.
这时胡雪岩恰好在江宁，便跟左宗棠说∶『好象应该还有张制军回两广本任的上谕；

Otherwise, when Li reaches Tianjin, will there not be two governors-general of Zhili?”
不然，李合肥一到天津，不就是有了两位直隶总署？』

“The interesting point is precisely that no decree sends Zhang Zhenxuan back,” Zuo replied.
『妙就妙在没有张振轩回本任的上谕。』左宗棠答说，

“The Zongli Yamen knows Li will never go to Guangdong, and probably will not return to Tianjin either.”
『总署也知道李少荃决不会到广东，恐怕也不会回天津。』

“Please enlighten us, Your Excellency.”
『这，大人倒多指点指点，让我们也开开茅塞。』

“Out of respect for the late Lord Wenzheng Zeng, Li has always treated Zeng the Ninth very considerately.
『李少荃看在曾文正分上，对曾老九一向是很客气的。

During the siege of Jiangning, Zeng’s weary army had made no progress.
当年江宁之围，师老无功，

Li had already recovered Changzhou and was ordered to help, but kept his troops where they were rather than share Zeng’s glory.
李少荃已经克复了常州，朝命赴援江宁，他按兵不动，为的是不愿分曾老九的功。

Think: if he goes to Guangdong now, what is to become of Zeng?”
你想，如今他如果一到广东，曾老九怎么办？』

“Yes, yes.”
『是，是。』

Hu considered it. “And you say he will not go to Tianjin because his arrival would send Zhang back to Guangdong, again displacing Marshal Zeng?”
胡雪岩想了一下说∶『大人说李合肥也不会到天津，是怕一到了，张制军就得回广东，那一来不是又要把曾九帅挤走的吗？』

“Exactly.”
『正是如此。』


“Then the capital’s order restoring Li, with no instructions about Zhang or Zeng, means he is to hold the title for the moment without actually resuming the post.”
『照此说来，京里只说叫李某某回任，对于张曾两位没不交代，意思也就是要李合能只领虚衔，暂时不必回任。』

“Correct.
『不错，

You can infer the rest from one point.
举一反三，

You understand.”
你明白了。』

“What will he do, then?”
『那末，李合肥怎么办呢？』

Zuo pondered for a long time. “What do you think?”
左宗棠沉吟了好了一会「问说∶『你看呢？』

“I think he will still come to Shanghai.”
『我看，他仍旧会到上海。』

Zuo nodded.
左宗棠点点头，

“I too think he can only stay in Shanghai first.
『我想他也只能先驻上海。』

Besides, he cannot quite relinquish it.” Hu answered at once, “I had intended to take leave of Your Excellency, return to Hangzhou and go to Shanghai afterwards.
他说∶『而且他也不能忘情上海。』胡雪岩当即说道∶『我本来想跟大人辞了行，回杭州，以后再到上海；

In these circumstances, it seems better to go straight to Shanghai.”
照现在看，似乎应该直接到上海的好。』

The provincial and customs contributions assigned to Shaanxi and Gansu for repayment of principal all passed through Shanghai Customs.
原来各省关应解陕甘，以便还本的协款，都交由江海关代转；

Only by going there could Hu discover what had actually been remitted.
所以各省解缴的情况如何，非要胡雪岩到上海去查了才知道。

“Good.
『好，

Make that your first business in Shanghai and write at once with the position.
你到上海首先办这件事，看情形如何赶紧写信来。

We must know which remittances are missing so that we can press for them early.”
看哪里还没有解到，好及早去催。』

Hu’s estimate proved correct.
胡雪岩的估计很正确，

Li petitioned to remain temporarily in Shanghai, coordinating affairs, assessing the military situation in north and south, and deciding his next move accordingly.
李鸿章果然奏请暂驻上海，统筹全局，察酌南北军情，再取进止。

His meaning was that if the lower Yangtze forces could not spare troops for the south, war need not follow; peace would be preferable.
意思是江南防军如果力量不足，无法南调，那就不一定用武，以求和为宜。

Prince Gong understood and obtained approval.
恭王懂他的用意，奏请准如所请；

At the end of the third month, Li arrived in Shanghai by a specially arranged steamer and established headquarters at Tianhou Temple.
于是李鸿章在三月底专轮到了上海，驻节天后宫行辕。



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第五章（本章第1部分，共3部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER FIVE
第五章


The sight of Gu Yingchun gave Hu Xueyan a shock.
一见古应春的面，胡雪岩一吓跳，

He had grown so thin that his whole appearance had changed.
他人都瘦得落形了。

“Yingchun, what—what has happened to you?” Gu sighed deeply.
『应春，你，你怎么弄成这个样子？』『唉！』古应春长长地叹口气，

“Little Uncle, my luck has been terrible.
『小爷叔，我的运气太坏！

I was careless too.”
也怪我自己大意。』

“What happened?
『你出了什么事？

Tell me at once.”
快告诉我。』

“I am going to lose everything.
『我要倾家荡产了。』

All because I listened to Xu Yuzhi.”
古应春说∶『都是听信了徐雨之的话。』

Xu was a wealthy Guangdong merchant whom Hu also knew well.
这徐雨之是广东籍的富商，胡雪岩跟他也很熟。

His personal name was Run.
此人单名一个润字，

Both capable and fortunate, he had learnt business in a Shanghai foreign firm, winning the foreigners’ high regard.
人很能干，运气也很好，在上海一家洋行学生意，深得洋人的器重，

From the age of twenty-two, he had joined partners to establish banks, silk firms and tea warehouses, profiting handsomely in every venture.
从廿二岁开始与人合伙开钱庄，开丝号，开茶栈，无不大发利市。

By the second year of Tongzhi, when he was twenty-six, he had accumulated a hundred thousand taels or more.
同治二年廿六岁，已经积赀十来万，

Through the Jiangnan military supply office he purchased the rank of an assistant departmental director, adding a peacock feather, and became a prominent gentleman of the Shanghai foreign settlement.
在江南粮台报捐员外郎，加捐花翎，俨然上海洋场上有名的绅士了。

In Tongzhi’s tenth year, he consequently received a commission.
因此，同治十年得了个差使。

Zeng Guofan, governor-general of Liangjiang and Nanyang minister, had decided to send young boys abroad to study.
那时两江总督南洋大臣曾国藩决定挑选幼童出洋留学；

Preliminary enquiries suggested selecting them in Guangdong.
事先研究，这批幼童以在广东挑选为宜，

Most Chinese residents in America came from that province, whose people were receptive to new ideas.
因为美国的华侨绝大部分是广东人，广东风气开通，

Fathers and elder brothers would not be unduly alarmed at sending young relatives across ten thousand li of ocean; meanwhile, the boys could be visited in America by older countrymen speaking familiar dialects, easing their homesickness.
作父兄的固不以幼年子弟在万里重洋之外而不放心；而此辈幼童在美国常有乡音亲切的长辈去看他们，亦可以稍慰思乡之苦。

As a leader of Shanghai’s Guangdong merchants, Xu received the task.
由于徐润是上海『广东帮』商人的领袖，所以曾国藩把这个差使交了给他。

He planned carefully, choosing a hundred and twenty promising boys to travel in four groups of thirty.
徐润策划得很周到，挑选了一百二十个资质很不错的幼童，分四批出洋，每批三十人；

The first sailed early in the seventh month of Tongzhi’s eleventh year under Yung Wing.
第一批在同治十一年七月初上船，由容闳带队，

Most were from Guangdong, especially Xiangshan, Xu’s own county.
大部分是广东籍，广东籍中又以香山为最多，因为徐润就是香山人。


There were only five boys from elsewhere: two from Jiangsu, one from Shandong, one from Fujian, and one whose family came from Huizhou, though he had been recruited in Guangdong.
当然，也有其他省份的人，但为数极少，只得五个，两个江苏、一个山东、一个福建、还有一个是徽州人，不过是广东招来的，

The last was twelve, born in the year of the Xinyou coup, and named Zhan Tianyou.
这个十二岁、生在辛酉政变那一年的幼童，叫做詹天佑，

His father, Zhan Zuoping, worked as a machinist at the Fujian shipbuilding establishment, while the family lived in Guangzhou.
他的父亲叫詹作屏，在福建船政局当机器匠，家眷寄居广州。

When Tianyou applied, someone advised his father to let him study law so that he could return and become an official.
詹天佑应募时，有人劝詹作屏让他的儿子学法律，学成回国，可以做官；

Zhan insisted that his son learn technical skills, and the newest ones at that.
但詹屏坚持他的儿子要学技艺，而且要学最新的技艺。

The second group sailed in the fifth month of Tongzhi’s twelfth year, led by Huang Pingfu, whose family was linked to Xu’s by marriage.
第二批是在同治十二年五月放洋的，由徐润的亲家黄平甫领队。

Besides the thirty government-supported boys, seven more from Guangdong went at their parents’ expense.
这回在挑选的官费生三十名以外，另有七名广东少年，由他们的家长自备资斧，

Their families asked Huang to take them to America: attitudes had indeed changed, and privately funded overseas study had begun.
请黄平甫带到美国——风气到底大开了，已经有自费留学的了。

The third group left in the eighth month of Tongzhi’s thirteenth year.
第三批是在同治十三年八月间派遣。

This time, apart from two boys studying technical crafts and one studying machinery, all attended ordinary schools: the older boys at middle schools, the younger at elementary schools.
这回与以前不同的是，除了两个学技艺、一个学机器以外，其余的都念普通学校，年长的念『中馆』；年幼的念『小馆』，

Even the older ones were only thirteen, including Tang Shaoyi of Xiangshan and Zhu Baokui of Changzhou, Jiangsu.
但所谓年长，亦不过十三岁，台广东香山的唐绍仪、江苏常州的朱宝奎；

The youngest were at least ten.
而最年幼的，至少也要十岁。

The fourth group departed in the ninth month of Guangxu’s first year.
第四批放洋在光绪元年九月，

Ten additional places brought the total to forty.
增加了十个名额，一共是四十名，

All would attend ordinary schools and choose a specialisation after completing middle school, according to their aptitudes.
这回一律念普通学校，到中学毕业，再视他们性之所近，决定学什么。

More boys came from other provinces, though these were still confined to Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Anhui.
同时外省籍的幼童也多了，但仍不脱江苏、浙江、安徽三省。

Zeng had initiated the scheme but did not live to see the first departure, dying in office in the second month of Tongzhi’s eleventh year.
幼童放洋是曾国藩所创议，但他不及见第一批幼童放洋，同治十一年二月殁于任上；

Li Hongzhang subsequently supported it.
以后便由李鸿章支持这件事，

Xu thereby gained Li’s appreciation and received a Beiyang appointment as associate director of China Merchants, working alongside Sheng Xuanhuai.
徐润亦由此获得李鸿章的赏识，由北洋札委为招商局的会办，与盛宣怀同事。


During those seven or eight years, Xu’s enterprises had flourished.
在这七八年中，徐润的事业蒸蒸日上，

He remained far below Hu in wealth, but was a substantial Shanghai merchant.
当然还远不及胡雪岩，但亦算是上海『夷场』上的殷商。

Apart from charitable undertakings, Hu had no business dealings with him.
胡雪岩跟他除了作善举以外，别无生意上的往来，

Gu, however, came originally from Guangdong, often encountered him when dealing with foreign firms, and had become close to him.
而古应春因为原籍广东，又以跟洋商打交道时，常会聚在一起，所以跟徐润走得很近，

They shared several ventures, including property speculation.
也有好些合伙的事业，其中之一是做房地产生意。

Xu held more than two thousand nine hundred mu of land, fifty-one foreign-style houses and at least two thousand commercial premises.
徐润的房地产很多，地皮有两千九百多亩，建成的洋房有五十一所，市房更多，不下两千间，

Their book value exceeded two million two hundred thousand taels, but too much capital was tied up.
照帐面上算，值到两百二十几万，但积压的资本太重，

Vacant land produced nothing and still incurred taxes, while rents from the premises were limited.
空地毫无收入，还要付税；市房则只是收租金，为数有限。

A British friend named Gulin, a knight keen on sport, widely connected and knowledgeable about business, proposed a partnership.
于是，他有一个英国朋友，名叫顾林，此人在英国是个爵士，本人热心运动，交游很广，亦很懂生意经，他向徐润建议，彼此合作。

Gulin also knew Gu, so Xu invited him to their discussions.
顾林亦是古应春的朋友，因此，徐润邀他跟顾林一起谈合作，

“Let us form a large company and invest capital to build on all the empty land,” Gulin said. “Build one group of houses and sell it, then use the proceeds for the next.
『我们组织一个大公司，投入资金，在空地上都盖起房子来。』顾林说道∶『造一批，卖一批；卖来的款子造第二批。

Once the vacant land is used, rebuild the old houses and keep renewing them.
空地用完了，把旧房子再来翻造，不断更新，

That is how great foreign cities, especially American ones, have grown.”
外国的大都市，尤其是美国，都是这样建造起来的。』

Xu understood the cycle of building and selling.
这个周而复始盖房子的决窍，徐润也懂，

“But it needs a great deal of ready cash.
『可是，「他问∶』这要大批现金，

Can you invest?”
你能不能投资？

“Of course.
『『当然，

Otherwise I would not propose a partnership.
我没有这个意思，不会跟你谈合作。

But I too must return home to raise subscriptions.
不过，我也是要回国去招股。

Once we agree on the terms and circulate the prospectus in London, I believe we can raise the capital in less than three months.”
我们把合作的办法商量好了，拿章程在伦敦市场上传了出去，相信不到三个月，就能把股本募足。』

“How much capital?”
『股本算多少呢？』

“That depends on you.
『这要看你的意思。

Value your property—at its real value, of course—and I shall raise an equal sum.”
你拿你的房地产作价——当然是实价；看值多少，我就募多少股本。』

Xu nodded and asked Gu’s view.
『徐润点点头问古应春∶』你看呢？

“It is workable and fair.
『『他这个法子可行，也很公平。

But I think our side should hold a larger share.”
不过，我认为我们这方面股份要多占些。』

After consideration, Xu proposed definite terms: capital of four million taels, fifty-five per cent Chinese and forty-five per cent British.
徐润想了一下，提出很明确的办法，这中英合资的公司股本定为四百万两，华方占五成半，英方占四成半；

The Chinese side would contribute property at an agreed real valuation, and the British side remit one million eight hundred thousand taels in cash.
华方以房地产核实作价，英方四成半计一百八十万两，由英国汇来现金。


A lawyer drew up a preliminary agreement, which they signed.
于是，请律师撰文签订了草约，

Xu also gave Gulin ten thousand taels to go home and raise subscriptions.
徐润还送了一万两银子给顾林，让他回国去招股。

But his property’s true value was only one and a half million.
但是徐润的房地产，照实价只值一百五十万两；

Another seven hundred thousand taels’ worth of land had to be bought to make up the Chinese share of two million two hundred thousand.
还要再买价值七十万两的地皮，才能凑足二百二十万两，合足五成半之数。

“Brother Yingchun, good friends should share the profits.
『应春兄，好朋友利益均沾，

Will you subscribe that seven hundred thousand?”
这七十万两，你来入股如何？』

After examining his resources, Gu agreed to contribute five hundred thousand.
古应春筹划了一下，愿意出五十万两银子。

This was at the end of the previous year.
这是去年年底的话；

By the second month of the present one, enough land had been purchased—but disaster overtook Gulin.
到这年二月里，地皮买足数了，可是顾林却出了事。

Soon after returning to London, he attended a royal hunting party.
原来顾林回到伦敦不久，在一次皇室邀请的狩猎会中，

His horse stumbled and threw him headfirst, inflicting a grave brain injury.
马失前蹄、人从马上倒栽出去，头先着地，脑子受了重伤，

Two eminent physicians saved his life, but he developed epilepsy.
请了两位名医诊治，性命虽已保住，但得了个癫痫症，

The great company project quietly died.
合作设大分司的事，就此无疾而终。

Xu and Gu were hit hard.
这一来徐润跟古应春大受打击，

In the Vietnamese dispute, France had repudiated the settlement and prepared for war, sending Admiral Courbet east with a fleet.
因为中法在越南的纠纷，法国政府不惜推翻已经达成和解的协议，准备动武，且已派水师提督孤拔，率舰东来，

Its legislature also voted five million francs for military expenditure.
同时国会通过，拨款五百万法郎，作为战费，

Rumours swept Shanghai.
因此上海谣言纷纷，

The most widespread said that French warships were continually cruising outside Wusong and had decided to attack the arsenal.
流传最盛的一个说法是，法国军舰不断巡弋在吴淞口外，决定要攻制造局。

Timid people were already fleeing.
胆小的人已经开始逃难；

In this atmosphere of panic, no one would even enquire about property.
在这种风声鹤唳的情况之下房地产根本无人问津。


“Of my five hundred thousand taels, three hundred and fifty thousand were borrowed.
『我那五十万银子，其中卅五万是借来的；

Money is now desperately tight.
现在银根紧到极点，

All thirty-odd Shanghai banks are trembling, afraid of another panic.
上海三十几家钱庄，家家心惊肉跳，只怕再来一个风潮，

If everyone withdraws their deposits, any number may collapse together.
大家提存挤兑，一倒就是多少家。

My lenders are pressing hard—very hard.
我借的款子，催得很急；实在是急！

Their clerks come and sit at my door every day, demanding payment.
每天都有钱庄里的伙计上门坐讨，

I can only keep pleading with them.” Gu added, “And I am afraid A’qi will hear and worry, so I must constantly hide it from her.
只好不断同人家说好话。』古应春又说∶『还有一层，我怕阿七晓得了着急，还要时时刻刻留心瞒住她。

Little Uncle, imagine the life I am leading.”
小爷叔，你想，我过的是啥日子？』

Hearing this and seeing his haggard face, Hu felt a sharp pang of pity.
胡雪岩听了他这番话，再看到他憔悴的形容，恻然心伤，

“Do not worry, Yingchun!”
『应春，你放心！』

He struck his chest. “I shall settle it for you.
他拍一拍胸脯说∶『我来替你了；

Leave everything to me.”
都在我身上。』

Gu hesitated without answering.
古应春迟疑未答。

Hu was surprised.
胡雪岩倒奇怪了，

Surely he should be delighted to have someone shoulder the whole burden?
照情理说，现有人替他一肩担承，他应该高兴才是，

Why look so troubled?
何以有此显得困惑的神情？

“What other difficulty is there?
『应春，』他问∶『还有啥难处？

With our friendship, what can you not tell me?”
我们这样的交情，你还有啥在我面前说不出口的话？』

“Little Uncle,” Gu paused, “do you really know nothing of the Shanghai market?”
『小爷叔，』古应春顿了一下问道∶『莫非上海的市面，你真的一点都不晓得？』

“What do you mean?
『怎么？

Markets rise and fall.
市面有好有坏，

That is ordinary enough.”
这也是常有的事。』

Gu stared, then at last spoke. “It seems you truly do not know.
古应春楞住了，好一会方始开口∶『看起来你老人家真的不晓得。

Let me tell you plainly: the man pressing hardest for repayment is Old Mi.”
我现在说实话吧，来催讨欠款，来催得最厉害的，就是老宓。』

Hu’s face burned as though he had been slapped.
此言一出，胡雪岩脸上火辣辣地发烧，真象上海人所说的『吃耳光』一样，

His thoughts tumbled, and he could not speak.
一时心里七上八下，竟开不得口了。

Old Mi was Mi Benchang, the managing clerk of his own Fukang Bank.
原来古应春口中的『老宓』，就是他阜康钱庄的档手宓本常。

“Pressing our own people so hard!
『自己人催欠款催得这么厉害！

Outrageous!”
岂有此理！』

Hu was angry.
胡雪岩非常生气；

Then another thought came: if even a friend was being pursued so urgently, Fukang itself must be in serious difficulty.
但转念一想，连自己人的欠款都催得这么厉害，可见得阜康的境况也很窘。

He broke into a sweat, steadied himself and said, “You know that for years I have left Fukang to Mi and seldom asked about it.
这一转念间，惊出一身汗，定一定神说道∶『应春，你晓得的，这几年，阜康的事，我都交老宓，难得问一问；

From what you say, its funds seem tighter than anyone’s.
照现在看，阜康的银根好象比哪一家都紧，

Tell me exactly what is happening.”
你倒同我说一说，到底是怎么个情形？』


“You have come from Jiangning, Little Uncle.
『小爷叔，你从江宁来，

Did His Excellency Zuo not discuss the Shanghai market with you?”
莫非没有听左大人跟你谈上海的市面？』

“What?
『怎么？

Is the market—” “It has never been worse.
上海的市面，莫非┅┅』『从来没有这么坏过。

Do you know how much ready silver there is in Shanghai now?”
小爷叔，你晓得现在上海的现银有多少？』

“How much?”
『有多少？』

Gu raised one finger.
『这个。』古应春伸一指相示。

“Ten million?”
『一千万？』

“One million.”
『一百万。』

Hu was shocked.
胡雪岩大吃一惊，

“Really?”
『真的？』他问。

“Ask Mi and you will see.”
『你差别老宓就晓得了。』

Hu still found it hard to believe.
胡雪岩仍旧有点不大相信，

“If the market is so bad, someone should tell His Excellency Zuo.
『市面这么坏，应该有人告诉左大人啊！』他说，

When we discussed Shanghai in Jiangning, he said that French military threats had affected trade somewhat, but it was nothing serious.”
『我在江宁，跟左大人谈起上海他说因为法国称兵，上海市面多少受点影响，不过不要紧。』

Gu gave a cold snort. “Which official nowadays does not deceive those above and bully those below?
『哼！』古应春冷笑一声∶『现在做官的，哪个不是瞒上欺下，

They all want to be magpies bringing good news; none will be a crow.”
只会做喜鹊，不肯当乌鸦。』

“Come.
『走！

Let us go to Jixian Lane together.”
「胡雪岩说∶』我们一起到集贤里去。

Fukang stood in Jixian Lane in the British settlement, just across a road from Hu’s residence.
『阜康钱庄设在英租界集贤里，与胡雪岩的公馆只隔一条马路，

He usually walked there at leisure.
他经常是安步当车走了去的。

As they were leaving, the housekeeper, Mrs Chen, hurried out. “When will you be back, sir?”
正要出门时，女管家陈嫂赶出来问道∶』老爷，啥辰光回来？『


“I do not know yet.”
『现在还不晓得。』

“Mr Mi has just sent an apprentice to say he knows you have arrived and will come at dinnertime.” She added, “We have found a very fresh shad today, which is rare.
『刚刚宓先生派徒弟来通知，他说晓得老爷已经来了，吃夜饭辰光他会来。』陈嫂又说∶『今夜难得买到一条很新鲜的鲥鱼，

Do come back for dinner.”
老爷回来吃夜饭吧！』

Hearing that Mi was coming, Hu hesitated.
一听宓本常要来，胡雪岩倒有些踌躇了；

Gu said, “Then perhaps we should wait for him.
古应春便即说道∶『即然如此，不如等老宓来，

Some things are more easily discussed at home.”
有些话也是在家里谈，比较方便。』

Hu took his striking watch from his gauze waistcoat pocket.
胡雪岩听这一说，便从纱背心口袋中掏出打簧表来看，

It was already half past four.
已经四点半了，

“Then send word asking him to come early.”
便点点头说∶『那就叫人去说一声∶请宓先生早一点来。』

They returned to the drawing room for a private discussion.
于是重回客厅去密谈。

Hu’s chief concern was the first five-hundred-thousand-tael principal payment to HSBC.
胡雪岩此时最关心的是要还汇丰银行第一期的本银五十万两。

The sealed notes issued by the governor-general’s office in Shaanxi and Gansu were little more than a formality.
陕甘总督衙门出的『印票』，不过是摆个样子，

Repayment came from provincial contributions collected through the Shanghai circuit intendant.
还款来源是各省交上海道衙门代收的协饷；

Hu could cover a shortfall, but with money so tight he might be unable to do so.
数目如果不够，他可以代垫，但银根如此之紧，代垫恐有不能，

He must plan early.
须要及早筹划。

“Yingchun, the HSBC payment is due at the end of the month.
『应春，』他问，『汇丰的款子，月底要交，

Do you know how much Shao Xiaocun has received?”
你晓不晓得，邵小村那里已经收到多少了？』

“Ten days or so ago I heard that half had arrived.
『前十来天我听说，已经收到半数了。

More should have come in since.
这几天，总还有款子进来。

The shortage should be no more than a million or so.
差也不过差个百把万，

But there is only a million in ready silver in all Shanghai.”
不过，现在全上海的现银只有一百万，』

Gu drew a breath. “This may be troublesome too.”
古应春吸着气说∶『这件事恐怕也是个麻烦。』

Hu’s heart sank.
胡雪岩的心一沉，

“My credit cannot suffer the slightest blemish.
『我的信用，伤不得一点点。

There is only half a month left.
应春，』他说∶『只有半个月的工夫了。

Have you any good idea?”
你有没有啥好主意？』

“Not at the moment.
『一时倒还没有。』

Let us wait for Mi.”
古应春答说∶『且等老宓来了再说。』

Mi did not arrive until dark.
宓本常一直到天黑才来。

He said he had meant to come immediately upon receiving the message, but several large customers were withdrawing deposits.
据他说，一接到通知，本来马上就要赶来，只为有几个大客户提存，

Arranging the funds had delayed him.
调度费时，所以耽误了工夫。


Hu knew what those arrangements involved.
胡雪岩知道，所谓调度，

First a banknote was issued and the customer asked where he wished to collect the silver; then the paying branch was notified.
无非先开出银票，问客户到何处提款；然后通兑付的联号。

Suppose he wanted fifty thousand taels in Jiangning.
譬如客户要提五万银子的存款，说要到江宁去提；

The fastest means would be used to alert Fukang there.
便用最快的方法通知江宁的阜康。

If that branch lacked funds, they would look for another with a surplus.
如果江宁『头寸』不足，再查何处有多余的『头寸』——

Shanghai Fukang was the head office and kept records of deposits and withdrawals at every branch.
上海阜康是总号，各联号存款进出的情形，都有帐可查；

Once the position was clear, remittances through other banks could use one branch’s surplus to cover another’s shortage.
查清楚了，透过同行的汇划，以有余补不足。

But that was the recent practice.
不过这是近来的情形，

Earlier, customers asking for ready silver had been paid it.
早些日子说要提现银，还要照付；

Hu asked where all that silver had gone.
胡雪岩便查问那些现银都到哪里去了？

“It has dispersed inland,” Mi said. “Deposits are up at branches away from major navigable-waterway ports.
『都分散到内地去了。』宓本常说∶『不靠水路码头的联号，存款都增加了。

By my reckoning, sixty or seventy per cent of the money has moved elsewhere; the other thirty or forty per cent is being kept at home.
不过照我计算，转到别处的只占十之六七；还有十之三四，是摆在家里了。

That will return to circulation only when the market calms.”
这些现银，要到市面平空了，才会派到市面上。』

Hu thought for a long time. “We must find a way to bring that thirty or forty per cent back sooner.
『喔，』胡雪岩沉吟了好一会儿说道∶『这十之三四的现银，也要想个法子，早点让它回到市面上。

Give me a list of the places where deposits have increased.”
你开个单了给我，看哪几处地方，存款增加了。』

“As I said, everywhere except the major ports on navigable waterways.”
『我说过了，只要不是水路上的大码头，存款都比以前多。』


“People fear that French warships will reach those ports if war begins.
『那是怕中法一开仗，法国兵轮会到水路大码头。』

What about Beijing?”
胡雪岩问∶『京里怎么样？』

“Deposits have risen greatly, and in large amounts.
『加了很多，而且都是大数目。』

Grand Secretary Wen withdrew all his three hundred thousand here, but deposited four hundred and sixty thousand in Beijing.”
宓本常说∶『文中堂的三十万都提走了。不过，北京存了四十六万。』

Wen was Wenyu, Minister of Punishments, promoted to assistant grand secretary two years earlier.
文中堂便是前年升了协办大学士的刑部尚书文煜；

Withdrawing three hundred thousand but depositing four hundred and sixty thousand showed complete confidence in Fukang, and Hu was deeply reassured.
提三十万存四十六万，表示他对阜康的信心十足，胡雪岩自然深感安慰。

“No wonder everyone wants to be an official.
『难怪大家都想做官。』

He has been in Beijing only three or four years and has accumulated another hundred and sixty thousand.”
胡雪晨说∶『他调到京里，也不过三、四年的工夫，倒又积了十六万银子了。』

“No,” Mi corrected him. “A hundred thousand of it belongs to a member of his clan.”
『不！』宓本常说∶『其中十万两是他的本家的。』

“Never mind.
『不管他了，

It all comes through him.” Hu asked, “With dozens of banks and only a million taels of ready silver, how is everyone managing?”
总是他的来头。』胡雪岩又问∶『上海几十家钱庄，现银只有一百万，大家是怎么应付的呢？』

“Entirely by working together and juggling the clearing accounts.”
『全靠同心协力，在汇划上耍把戏。』

“Oh?”
『喔，』

Since gaining Zuo’s patronage, Hu had managed the western expedition’s supply office and founded many enterprises.
胡雪岩从受知于左宗棠开始，一面要办西征粮台；一面又创办了好些事业，

His commercial interest had centred on silk, while banking was left almost wholly to Mi.
而且做生意的兴趣，集中在丝上，对于钱庄的经营，差不多完全交给宓本常主持，

He had little knowledge of changes in its practices and did not quite understand what “juggling” the clearing accounts meant.
钱庄的制度，有所改变，亦很隔膜，『汇划』上能够，『耍把戏』，却不甚明白。

Once he might have been content with a vague idea.
在过去，他可以不求甚解，

Now that a crisis had arisen, he must understand it fully.
现在出现了危机，他就非问问清楚不可了。


“Put simply, it is like friends who play cards together regularly.
『说穿了，一句话∶等于常在一起打牌的朋友一样，

However large the stakes, they use counters.
赌得再大，不过赌筹码，

I lose and he wins today; you win and he loses tomorrow.
今天我输他赢，明天你赢他输，

It sounds lively, but all we do is count the counters and make entries, settling the balance at the proper time.
听起来很热闹，无非数数筹吗，记一笔帐，到时候结一结就轧平了。

It works only among regular friends.
不过，这只好常常在一起的朋友这么办，

Let an outsider join, win a large sum and demand cash, and the trick cannot continue.
夹一个外头人进来，赢了一票，要拿现款走；这个把戏就耍不下去了。

So—” Thus Fukang had taken the lead in joining with a dozen or so of Shanghai’s major banks to establish a clearing association.
所以┅┅『所以上海的钱庄，由阜康领头，联络了十来家』大同行『，成立了一个』汇划总会『，

Following the model of the bill-exchange institution founded in Japan in the twelfth year of Meiji, they exchanged notes instead of transferring silver.
仿照日本在明治十二年所设立的』手形交换所『的办法，用交换票据来代替现银收解。

The exchange could not be conducted privately; everything had to go through the association.
票据交换，不能私下办理，一定要送总会；

Participating banks first sent all maturing notes there.
凡是汇划钱庄，到期的银票，一律先送总会，

These were sorted, and senior clerks took them to the issuing banks for verification.
分门别类理齐，派老司务送到各钱庄『照票』。

If correct, a bank accepted its notes and issued a receipt called a “public clearing certificate”.
如果不误，这家钱庄便将银票收了下来，另外打出一张收据，名为『公单』，

These used five hundred taels as the basic unit.
规定以五百两为基数，

Smaller amounts were either made up in cash or entered separately for later settlement.
不足五百两，或用现金找补，或者记帐另外再算。

By three or four in the afternoon, the certificates had generally all reached the association.
这些『公单』大概在下午三、四点钟，都已集中到总会，

A few calculations on the abacus showed what each bank should receive or pay.
算盘一打，立刻可以算出哪家该收多少、该付多少；

Suppose Fukang held a million taels in notes due from other banks, while only eight hundred and forty thousand of its own notes were presented: it had a surplus balance of a hundred and sixty thousand.
譬如，阜康应收各庄银票共计一百万，本号开出的银票只有八十四万，有十六万头寸多。



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第五章（本章第2部分，共3部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


Where one bank had a surplus, another had a deficit.
有多就有少，

The association issued a transfer order authorising Fukang to collect silver from a bank short of funds, with payment due before two the following afternoon.
由总会开出『划条』交阜康向欠头寸的钱庄先收现银。时间规定是在第二天下午两点钟以前。

What could the bank in deficit do?
那么，缺头寸的钱庄怎么办呢？

No matter: the next morning it could borrow through the association from another bank with a surplus.
不要紧，第二天上午可以到公会向有头寸多的同行去拆进，

Interest was calculated by the day, the transaction being called a “silver loan”. Such interbank advances for a day or two required no receipt, only an entry in the association’s books.
利息以日计，称为『银拆』这种一两天的同业借款，不必打收据，由公会记一笔帐就可以了。

There were two methods of charging interest.
至于利息的计算，又分两种，

Loans without receipts were “floating advances”, their rates rising and falling with the money market.
不打收据的拆借，称为『活拆』，利息高低视银根松紧而定。

Longer interbank loans were “fixed advances”, supported by written instruments at an agreed rate, unaffected by the daily quotation.
另外一种同业长期的拆借，称为『呆拆』，要立票据，议定利息；在此期间，不受每天挂牌的『银拆』的影响。

“Issuing public clearing certificates is like handing out gambling counters,” Mi explained.
『这种打「公单」的法子，就好象赌钱发筹码，

“There are two differences.
所不同的是，

First, only the house controls a casino’s counters, while every participating bank can issue these certificates.
第一，赌场的筹码，只有头家可以管；公单只要是汇划钱庄，家家可开。

Second, casino counters cannot be spent outside.
第二，赌场的筹码，不能拿到外面去用，

A clearing certificate can be converted into the bank’s own notes and used anywhere.
公单可以化成本号的银票，到处可用。

In plain terms, it creates something from nothing—tens of millions of taels out of thin air.
说实了，无非无中生有，凭空生出几千万银子来；

That is why great transactions continue even though there is only a million in actual silver.
所以现银不过一百万，市面上的大生意照样在做。

That is the clearing trick.”
这就是要汇划的把戏。』

They then turned to silk and cocoons.
接下来便谈到丝茧的情形。

Buyers going into the countryside depended largely on bank loans.
丝茧业下乡收值，多仰赖钱庄放款，

Hu’s control of a bank had helped make him a leader of the silk trade.
胡雪岩也就因为有钱庄在手里，所以成为丝业领袖，

During the past two years, his campaign against modern reeling mills had led him to buy still more cocoons and silk.
这两年因为抵制新式缫丝厂，收的茧子与丝更多。

Mi did not manage the silk business, but could judge the size of its stocks from the consolidated records of deposits and loans at the branches.
宓本常虽非胡雪岩经营丝业方面的档手，但可以从各联号存放款进出的总帐中，看出存货有多少。


“Sir,” Mi said gravely, “there must now be six or seven thousand bales of silk in stock, and still more cocoons.
『大先生，』宓本常神情严肃地说∶『现在存丝总有六七千包，茧子更多，

I do not think we need so much.”
我看用不着这么多存货。』

“You mean too much capital is tied up?”
『你是说吃本太重？』

“Yes.
『是啊。』

At a rough estimate, nearly three million taels are immobilised there.
宓本常说∶『粗估一估差不多有三百万银子的本钱压在那里。

Otherwise I would be ashamed to press Mr Gu for his hundred thousand.”
不是因为这样子，古先生的十万银子，我也不好意思来讨。』

“Ah!” Hu answered at once. “Transfer those hundred thousand to my account.”
『呃！』胡雪岩立即接口∶『这十万银子转到我名下。』

He turned to Gu. “We shall find a way with the rest.
他紧接着又转脸对古应春说∶『另外的，再想办法。

You have the land, after all.
好在你有地皮在那里，

It is only a temporary shortage of cash.”
不过现金一时周转不开而已。』

Gu’s own anxiety vanished, but concern for Hu took its place.
古应春满怀忧虑一扫而空；但自己虽不愁了，又为胡雪岩发愁，

“Little Uncle, all three reeling mills are short of material.
『小爷叔，』他说∶『现在三家缫丝厂都缺货，

Why not release a few thousand bales of cocoons?
你何妨放几千包茧子出去；

The new machines work very quickly.
新式机器，做丝快得很，

Once the silk is made, there will be no shortage of foreign buyers.
一做出来，不愁外洋没有买主，

Would that not get things moving?”
那一来不就活络了？』

“Mr Gu is quite right,” Mi said.
『古先生这话一点不错。』宓本常也说，

“The export buyers have been inactive this year because the foreigners are waiting for machine-reeled silk.
『今年「洋庄」不大动，是外国人都在等，等机器的丝，

In fairness, it is far superior to what our old foot-driven and hand-turned methods produce.”
凭良心说，机器做的丝，比脚踏手摇土法子做的丝，不知道要高明多少。』

“I know,” Hu said quietly. “But a man must have principles, and above all he must keep his word.
『我也晓得。』胡雪岩用低沉的声音说∶『不过，做人总要讲宗旨，更要讲信用，说一句算一句，

I promised not to let modern mills steal the livelihood of country families who raise silkworms and reel silk.
我答应过的，不准新式缫丝厂来抢乡下养蚕做丝人家的饭碗，

I cannot sell them cocoons.
我就不能卖茧子给他们。

If I tighten my grip a little longer and those three mills collapse, the foreigners will have nothing to wait for.
现在我手里再紧一紧，这三家机器缫丝厂一倒，外国人没有想头了，

They will buy my silk, and then I shall name the price.”
自然会买我的丝，那时候价钱就由我开了。

Both Gu and Mi thought this wishful calculation.
『古应春与宓本常，都认为他打的如意算盘。

But Gu was a close friend, Mi an employee; only Gu could continue trying to persuade him.
不过，古应春是好朋友的身分，而宓本常是伙计，所以只有古应春还可以劝他。


“Little Uncle, if the three mills close, foreigners will naturally have to buy our traditionally reeled silk.
『小爷叔，如果那三家新式缫丝厂倒闭了洋商当然只好仍旧买我们土法子做的丝；

But what if they do not close?”
可是那三家厂不倒呢？』

“If they have no material, what difference does staying open make?”
『不倒而没有货色，跟倒了有啥两样？』

“There is something else to remember.
『还有一层，小爷叔要想到，

Dried cocoons still cannot be stored indefinitely.
