一面将胡雪岩引入只有他来了才打开的一间布置得非常奢华的密室，亲自伺候，非常殷勤。

“Attend to your work, Xiaotang.
『小棠，』胡雪岩吩咐，『你去忙你的，

Mr Gu and I must speak.”
我同古先生有话谈。』

Once Zhou had withdrawn with repeated acknowledgments, Hu showed Gu the letter.
等周小棠诺诺连声地退出，胡雪岩才将左宗棠的信拿给古应春看。

Shandong had suffered floods that year.
原来这年山东闹小灾，

Great breaches had opened in embankments at Qihe, Licheng, Qidong, and other places along tributaries of the Yellow River.
黄河支流所经的齐河、历城、齐东等地都决了好大的口子，

Muddy water poured through, causing severe devastation.
黄流滚滚，灾情甚重。

Governor Chen Shijie had obtained approval to provide relief through work: the victims would repair the embankments and receive wages instead of charity.
山东巡抚陈士杰，奏准『以工代赈』——用灾民来抢修堤工，发给工资，以代赈济。

Labour and materials would be costly.
工料所费甚巨，

Besides a substantial grant from the central treasury, several prosperous provinces had been assessed contributions.
除部库拨出一大笔款子外，许多富庶省份都要分摊助赈；

Liangjiang’s share was four hundred thousand taels, but the Jiangning provincial treasury could raise only half.
两江分摊四十万两，但江宁藩库只能凑出半数，

With no alternative, Zuo appealed to Hu.
左宗棠迫不得已，只好向胡雪岩乞援，

“Shandong’s river calamity is grave.
信上说∶『山东河患甚殷，

The court has ordered relief, and the authorities intend to provide it through public works.
廷命助赈，而当事图兴工以代，

Could you lend me two hundred thousand?”
可否以二十万借我？』


“Indeed!” Gu exclaimed with feeling.
『真是！』古应春大为感慨，

“Liangjiang’s wealth is known throughout the country, yet it cannot raise even four hundred thousand taels.
『两江之富，举国皆知，哪知连四十万银子都凑不齐。

Imagine the state’s poverty.”
国家之穷，可想而知了。』

“Who knows when this two hundred thousand can be repaid?” Hu said. “I may as well make it a contribution.”
『这二十万银子，不知道什么时候才能还，』胡雪岩说∶『索性算我报效好了。』

“No!
『不！』

This is no time for conspicuous generosity.”
古应春立即表示反对，『现在不是小爷叔踊跃输将的时候。』

“Why not?”
『喔，有啥不妥当？』

“First, there has been no imperial appeal for donations.
『当然不妥当。第一，没有上谕劝大家捐款助赈，

Why volunteer, as though you had more money than you could use?
小爷叔何必自告奋勇？好象钱多得用不完了。

Second, the market is poor.
其次，市面很不好，

A gift of two hundred thousand would make everyone jealous.
小爷叔一捐就是二十万，大家看了眼红。

Third, defence needs are urgent and military expenditure immense.
第三，现在防务吃紧，军费支出浩繁，

If someone proposed asking wealthy merchants for contributions, you would be the first approached.
如果有人上奏，劝富商报效，头一个就会找到小爷叔，

Then two hundred thousand might be far from enough.
那时候报效的数目，只怕不是二十万能够过关的。

You must not draw that attention to yourself!”
小爷叔，这个风头千万出不得！』

The last warning was blunt, and Hu could not disregard it.
最后一句话，措词直率，胡雪岩不能不听，

“Very well.
『也好。』

Draft a telegram asking where payment is required.”
他说∶『请你马上拟个电报稿子，问在哪里付款。』

Gu wrote: “Governor-General’s Office, Jiangning.
于是古应春提笔写道∶『江宁制台衙门，

Confidential.
密。

Your letter received.
赐函奉悉，

Your instructions will be carried out.
遵命办理。

Please advise whether payment is to be made in Jiangning or Jinan.
款在江宁抑济南付，乞示。

Respectfully, your subordinate Circuit Intendant Hu Guangyong.”
职道胡光墉叩。

Hu read it and inserted “immediately” into the request for instructions, then gave it to Zhou to send to the Transport Bureau for transmission.
『胡雪岩看完，在』乞『字下加了个』即『字，随即交给周小棠，派人送到转运局去发。


Mi had meanwhile been found.
其时宓本常已经找回来了，

“Has HSBC transferred the five hundred thousand?” Hu asked.
胡雪岩问道∶『那五十万银子，由汇丰拨过来了？』

“Yes.”
『是的。』

“Untouched?”
『没有动？』

“Entirely.
『原封未动。』

But a quarter-year’s interest was deducted first, so it is no longer the full amount.”
宓本常说，『不过先扣一季的息，不是整数了。』

“I know.
『晓得。』

I have allocated the funds.
胡雪岩说∶『这笔款子的用途，我已经派好了。

His Excellency Zuo is borrowing two hundred thousand; the remainder is to be lent to a cocoon firm.”
左大人同我借二十万，余数我要放给一个茧行。

Neither use had occurred to Mi.
『这两笔用途，都是宓本常再也想不到的；

He had meant to earn short-term interest through a small bank owned by his younger cousin, underreporting the return and pocketing the difference.
他原来的打算，是想用这笔款子来赚』银拆『，经过他表弟所开的一家小钱庄，以多报少，弄点』外快『。

Disappointed at the collapse of this pleasant calculation, he nevertheless hoped to salvage something.
这一来如意算盘落空，不免失望，但心里存着一个挽回的念头。


“What does His Excellency need the money for?
因为如此，便要问了∶『左大人为啥跟大先生借银子？』他说，

What requires two hundred thousand?”
『左大人有啥大用场，要二十万？』

“The borrower is not he personally, but the Jiangning provincial treasury.”
『不是他借，是江宁藩库借。』

A personal loan to Zuo might not all be required at once, leaving room to use the money briefly.
如果是左宗棠私人借，也许一时用不了这么多，短期之内，犹可周转；

A public loan offered no such hope.
公家借就毫无想头了。

“And the cocoon firm?
『茧行呢？』

Which is it?
他又问∶『是哪家茧行？

What is its name?”
字号叫啥？』

“I do not know its name yet.”
『还不晓得啥字号。』

Mi grew still more astonished.
『大先生，』宓本常愈发诧异，

“You are lending so much without even knowing the firm’s name?”
『连人家字号都不晓得，怎么会借这样一笔大数目？』

“It is not really a loan to someone else.
『实在也不是借人家，

We shall use it ourselves.
是我们自己用；

You must draft a contract.”
你还要起个合同稿子。』

Hu turned to Gu. “Explain the arrangements to Mi.
胡雪岩转脸又说∶『应春，经过情形请你同老宓说一说，

Once the draft is ready and the contracts signed, I can prepare to return to Hangzhou.”
稿子弄妥当，打好了合同，我就好预备回杭州了。』

Mi listened in silence as Gu described the proposed mill purchase.
宓本常不作声，听古应春细说了收买新式缫丝厂的计划，

He was deeply displeased.
心里很不舒服；

He considered himself Hu’s foremost chief manager, senior even to Tang Zishao.
因为他自己觉得是胡雪岩的第一个『大伙』，地位在唐子韶之上。

Silk was closely connected with the banking business.
而且丝跟钱庄有密切关系，

To have been excluded beforehand from so important a decision filled him with jealousy and resentment.
这样一件大事，他在事先竟未能与闻，自然妒恨交加。

“Just wait,” he thought. “Tip over the dog’s feeding bowl, and no one gets to eat.”
『你看着好了！』他在心里说∶『「倒翻狗食盆，大家吃不成。」』



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第1部分，共6部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER SEVEN
第七章


The contracts were drafted.
合同稿子是拟好了，

But a cocoon firm could not open without approval from the Ministry of Revenue, and Mi used this as a pretext to suggest waiting for the ministry licence before signing.
但由于设立茧行需要呈请户部核准，方能开张，宓本常便以此为借口，主张等『部照』发下来，再签合同。

Hu and Gu had no suspicion of his malicious intentions.
胡雪岩与古应春哪里知道他心存叵测？

To them the contracts were merely a formality: once the mill purchase was agreed, the money would be available whenever required.
只认为订合同只是一个形式，只要把收买新式缫丝厂这件事说好了，款子随时可以动用，

They therefore consented.
所以都同意了。

With his Shanghai business concluded, Hu hurried back to Hangzhou through the oppressive summer heat.
在上海该办的事都办了，胡雪岩冒着溽暑赶回杭州；

A marriage had been proposed for his third daughter, and his mother had accepted on her behalf: she was to marry the only son of “Wang the Philanthropist.”
原来胡三小姐的红鸾星动，有人做媒，由胡老太太作主，许配了『王善人』的独养儿子。

Wang, whose personal name was Caisheng, had been Hu’s friend for many years.
王善人本名王财生，与胡雪岩是多年的朋友，

In their youth both had been shop assistants, the men Hangzhou people jokingly called “counter monkeys,” though in different trades.
年纪轻的时候，都是杭州人戏称为『柜台猢狲』的商店伙计，所不同的是行业，

Wang had begun as an apprentice in a large sauce-making establishment.
王财生是一家大酱园的『学徒』出身。

When Hu renewed his acquaintance with Wang Youling and rose rapidly in the world, Wang Caisheng remained an assistant.
当胡雪岩重遇王有龄，青云直上时，王财生仍旧在酱园里当伙计，

After the Taiping rebellion was suppressed, however, he reappeared in the guise of a gentleman.
但到洪杨平定以后，王财生摇身一变，以绅士姿态出现，

Some said he had enriched himself by looting during the disorder; others that he had unearthed gold, silver, and jewels buried by the rebels.
有人说他之发财是由于『趁火打劫』；有人说他『掘藏』掘到了『长毛』所埋藏的一批金银珠宝。

Whatever the source of his fortune, one fact was certain: at Hu’s invitation he helped with reconstruction, tending the wounded, saving the dying, and aiding displaced people.
但不管他发财的原因是什么，他受胡雪岩的邀约，同办善后，扶伤救死，抚缉流亡，做了许多好事，

These good works earned him the title “Philanthropist.”
博得个『善人』的美名，却是事实。

In the second year after Hangzhou’s recovery, a son was born to him, and people called it a reward for his charity.
杭州克复的第二年，王财生得了个儿子，都说他是行善的报应。


That was the yichou year, the fourth of Tongzhi.
那年是同治四年乙丑，

The boy, nicknamed A’niu, was now nineteen.
所以王财生的这个独子，小名阿牛，这年十九岁。

Wang had long wanted a marriage connection with Hu, but Hu thought A’niu dull—indeed, as stupid as the ox suggested by his name—and had consistently refused.
王财生早就想跟胡雪岩结亲家，而胡雪岩因为阿牛资质遇鲁，真有其笨如牛之概，一直不肯答应，

Unexpectedly, the young man had now passed into the county school as a licentiate, and the proposal was renewed.
不道这年居然进学成了秀才；因而旧事重提，

The matchmaker argued that his honest, kindly nature would ensure that Hu’s daughter was never mistreated.
做媒的人说∶阿牛天性淳厚，胡三小姐嫁了他一定不会吃亏，

As an only son’s wife, she would also be cherished by her parents-in-law.
而况又是独子；定受翁姑的宠爱。

Wang’s wealth fell far short of Hu’s, but his reputation for benevolence made up the difference; the families could be considered suitable equals.
至于家世，富虽远不敌胡雪岩，但有『善人』的名声弥补，亦可说是门当户对，

The sole deficiency had been A’niu’s lack of a degree.
所欠缺的只不过阿牛是个白丁；

Now a licentiate, he had a promising future: as the saying went, “A licentiate is the seedling of a chief minister.”
如今中了秀才，俗语说『秀才乃宰相之根苗』，前程远大，

It was an excellent match.
实在是头良缘匹配的好亲事。

The argument was reasonable.
这番说词，言之成理，

Hu’s mother particularly valued the fact that, with no brothers-in-law’s wives in the household, her granddaughter would suffer no friction from sisters-in-law.
加以胡老太太认为阿牛是独子，胡三小姐嫁了过去，即无妯娌，就不会受气，

She therefore accepted, merely writing to inform Hu and urge him home: the formal betrothal ceremony was set for the seventh day of the seventh month.
因而作主许婚，只写信告诉胡雪岩有这回事，催他快回杭州，因为择定七月初七『传红』。

On returning, he learned that the wedding too had been fixed, for the fifth day of the eleventh month.
回到杭州，才知道王家迎娶的吉期也定下了，是十一月初五；

Wang’s aged mother was frail and might die at any time; she longed to see her grandson’s bride enter the household.
为的是王善人的老娘，风烛残年，朝不保夕，急于想见孙媳妇进门；

If she died first, the wedding would have to wait three years, an excessive delay.
倘或去世，要三年之后才能办喜事，耽误得太久了。

The reasoning was entirely proper, and Hu’s mother agreed.
这番理由，光明正大，胡老太太深以为是，

Fortunately the dowry had long been prepared.
好在嫁妆是早就备好了的，

Only some fashionable foreign goods remained to be added.
只要再办一批时新的洋货来添妆就是了。


The scale of the celebration, however, awaited Hu’s return.
但办喜事的规模，却要等胡雪岩来商量；

Four people had to decide: Hu, his mother, his wife, and his concubine, Madam Luosi.
这件事要四个人来决定，便是胡雪岩与他的母、妻、妾——螺蛳太太。

All four had conflicting inclinations.
而这四个人都有一正一反的两种想法，

The three women favoured restraint, yet Hu’s mother loved this youngest granddaughter best and feared slighting her.
除了胡雪岩以外，其余三人都觉得场面应该收束，但胡老太太最喜欢这个小孙女儿，怕委屈了她；

His wife wanted equal treatment: the girl should enjoy the same splendour as her two elder sisters.
胡太太则认为应该一视同仁，她的两个姐姐是啥场面，她也应该一样地风光；

Madam Luosi thought of her own daughter.
螺蛳太太则是为自己的女儿设想，

A restrained wedding now would set a precedent limiting the display when her daughter married.
因为开了一个例子在那里，将来自己的女儿出阁，排场也就阔不起来了。

Hu naturally preferred the grandest possible occasion, but feared criticism in a depressed market.
至于胡雪岩当然愈阔愈好，但市面不景气，怕惹了批评。

Two days of discussion produced no decision.
因此谈了两天没有结果；

At last he concluded, “The occasion must be respectable.
最后是胡雪岩自己下了个结论∶『场面总也要过得去，

The difference between a large and small celebration is limited anyway.
是大是小，相差也有限；

There are still four months; we shall see how matters stand.”
好在还有四个月的工夫，到时候再看吧。』

“The celebration is for other people to look at,” Madam Luosi observed. “The dowry brings real benefit.
『场面是摆给人家看的。』螺蛳太太接口说道∶『嫁妆是自己实惠。

Give Third Miss a splendid dowry, and a smaller celebration will do.
三小姐的陪嫁，一定要风光；这样子，到时候场面就小一点，

Publicly, we can explain that business is poor; privately, she will not feel slighted.
对外说起来是市面不好；对内，三小姐也不会觉得委屈，

Even the bridegroom’s family can have no objection.”
就是男家也不会有话说。』

This considered every side.
这番见解，真是面面俱到，

Both Hu’s mother and his wife were pleased, while Hu felt that a magnificent dowry would preserve his dignity even without a lavish ceremony.
胡老太太与胡太太听了都很舒服；胡雪岩则认为惟有如此，就算排场不大，但嫁妆风光，也就不失面子了。


“Sister Luo is right.
『罗四姐的话不错。

We must not stint the dowry.
嫁妆上不能委屈她。

But the additions will have to be bought ready-made.”
不过添妆也只有就现成的备办了。』

“Then someone must go to Shanghai,” Hu’s wife said after her mother-in-law, looking at Madam Luosi.
『那只有到上海去。』胡太太接着她婆婆的话说，同时看着罗四姐。

Madam Luosi wanted to volunteer, but reconsidered and remained silent.
罗四姐很想自告奋勇，但一转念间，决定保持沉默；

There were too many tongues in the household.
因为胡家人多嘴杂，

However hard she tried, someone would talk behind her back, perhaps alleging that she begrudged the expense because Third Miss was not her own daughter.
即使尽力，必定也还有人在背后说闲话，甚至造谣言∶三小姐不是她生的，她哪里舍得花钱替三小姐添妆。

Hu had expected her to respond.
胡雪岩原以为她会接口，

When she did not, he decided for her.
看她不作声，便只好作决定了，

“You know Shanghai.
『上海是你熟，

Go there, and visit the Seventh Lady while you are about it.”
你去一趟。』他说∶『顺便也看看七姑奶奶。』

“Of course I should go for Third Miss’s wedding.
『为三小姐的喜事，我到上海去一趟，是千应万该的。

But expensive jewellery is not necessarily pleasing.
不过，首饰这样东西，贵不一定好；

Naturally I would choose costly pieces, yet their designs might not suit her taste.”
我去当然挑贵的买，只怕买了来，花样款式不中三小姐的意。

She smiled. “Why not let me take her and have her choose for herself at the foreign firms and jewellers?”
我看，』螺蛳太太笑一笑说∶『我陪小姐到上海，请她自己到洋行、银楼里去挑。』

“Quite improper!” the Old Madam exclaimed in broad Hangzhou speech. “An unmarried girl choosing her own dowry!
『不作兴的！』胡老太太用一口道地的杭州话说∶『没有出门的姑娘儿，自己去挑嫁妆，

People would laugh themselves sick if they heard of it.”
传出去把人家笑都笑煞了。』

“You go yourself,” Hu repeated.
『就是你去吧！』胡雪岩重复一句。


Madam Luosi still would not commit herself.
螺蛳太太仍旧不作承诺，

“I wonder whether Third Miss might enjoy a visit,” she murmured, as if to herself.
『不晓得三小姐有没有兴致去走一趟？』她自语似地说。

“There is no need,” Hu’s wife said. “Surely you know what jewellery she likes.”
『不必了。』胡太太∶『三丫头喜欢怎么样的首饰，莫非你还不清楚？』

Finally the Old Madam settled the matter: Madam Luosi would go alone.
最后还是由胡老太太一言而决，由螺师太太一个人到上海去采办。

She would, of course, first consult the girl’s preferences and Hu’s wife’s wishes.
当然，她要先问一问胡三小姐的爱好，还有胡太太的意见，

Most important was a spending limit, which only Hu could set.
同时最要紧的是，一个花费的总数，这是只有胡雪岩才能决定的。

“The dowry has already cost over a hundred thousand taels.
『她这副嫁妆，已经用了十几万银子了。

Spend no more than another fifty thousand on additions.
现在添妆，最多再用五万银子。』

Money is tight in Shanghai, so goods must be cheap.
胡雪岩说∶『上海银根很紧，银根紧，东西一定便宜，

Fifty thousand should buy at least seventy thousand’s worth.”
五万银子起码好当七万用。』


In Shanghai, Gu accompanied her to the German firm Biefa.
到了上海，由古应春陪着，到德商别发洋行里一问，

Their first inquiries showed that the opposite was true.
才知道胡雪岩的话适得其反。

Domestic products were indeed being discounted for ready cash, but imported goods had risen in price.
国内的出产，为了脱货求现，削价出售，固然不错，但舶来品却反而涨价了。

“The situation grows more tense every day, Mr Gu,” the manager explained.
『古先生，』洋行的管事解释∶『局势一天比一天紧，

“France has a new premier, Jules Ferry, a very determined man.
法国的宰相换过了，现在的这个叫茹斐理，手段很强硬，

If China refuses to yield over Vietnam, he means to go to war.
如果中国在越南那方面，不肯让步，他决心跟中国开仗。

Ever since the foreign newspapers reported Admiral Courbet’s arrival in Vietnam, goods at every foreign firm have risen by ten to fifteen per cent.
自从外国报纸登了法国水师提督孤拔到越南的消息以后，各洋行的货色，马上都上涨了一成到一成五；

Some things cannot now be bought at any price.”
现在是有的东西连出价都买不到了。』

“Why?” Madam Luosi asked.
『这是为啥？』螺蛳太太发问。

“If war begins, French warships will close China’s ports and foreign merchant ships will be unable to enter.
『胡太太，战事一起，法国兵舰封住中国的海口，外国商船不能来；

Once supplies stop, sellers can ask whatever they please.
货色断档，那时候的价钱，老实说一句，要多少就是多少，

The question will be whether an article is available, not whether it is dear.
只问有没有，不问贵不贵，

Every item sold now is one less for later, so everyone is putting the best goods aside.”
所以现在卖一样少一样，大家拿好东西都收起来了。』

“No wonder!”
『怪不得！』

She pointed at the jewellery in the glass cabinets. “There is nothing here I like.”
螺蛳太太指着玻璃柜子中的首饰说∶『这里的东西，没有一样是看得上眼的。』

“Your taste is naturally exceptional, Madam Hu.
『胡太太的眼光当然不同。』

We would not risk offending an old customer.
那管事说道，『我们对老主顾，不敢得罪的。

Tell me what you require, and I shall open the safe for you.”
胡太太想置办哪些东西，我开保险箱，请胡太太挑。』

Madam Luosi knew that foreigners in China, whatever their nationality, acted together.
螺蛳太太知道，在中国的洋人，不分国籍，都是很团结的；

They too had agreements among traders.
他们亦有『同行公议』的规矩，

One firm would be much like another, so the maxim about comparing three shops would be little use.
这家如此，另一家亦复如此，『货比三家不吃亏』这句话用不上，

Better to negotiate as a major customer.
倒不如自己用『大主顾』的身分来跟他谈谈条件。


“To be frank, I am buying a dowry for our third daughter.
『我老实跟你说，我是替我们家三小姐来办嫁妆，

If we agree, I shall give you the entire order—several tens of thousands of taels.
谈得拢，几万银子的生意，我都作成了你。

Otherwise, Biefa is hardly Shanghai’s only large foreign firm.”
不然，说老实话，上海滩上的大洋行，不是你别发一家。』

The prospect demanded attention.
听说是几万银子的大生意，那管事不敢怠慢，

“Third Miss’s dowry must be treated seriously.
『办三小姐的嫁妆，马虎不得。

Please come inside.
胡太太，你请里面坐！』

If you have a list, let me take it and assemble the goods for you to examine.”
他说∶『如果胡太太开了单子，先交给我，我照单配齐了，送进来请你看。』

She had prepared a list but would not reveal her hand.
螺蛳太太是开好了一张单子的，但不肯泄漏底细，

“No list.
只说∶『我没有单子。

If the goods are good and the prices reasonable, I shall buy more.
只要东西好，价钱克己，我就多买点。

First show me two pairs of diamond bracelets.”
你先拿两副钻镯我看看。』

Chinese and Western fashions differed.
中外服饰时尚不同，

To Chinese customers, diamond bracelets were the most precious jewellery.
对中国主顾来说，最珍贵的首饰，就是钻镯；

The request confirmed that she really was buying a dowry and that the order might indeed run to tens of thousands.
那管事一听此话，心知嫁妆的话不假，这笔生意做下来，确有好几万银子，

The manager became still more attentive.
是难得一笔大生意，便愈发巴结了。

He escorted her and Gu to the foreign director’s private sitting room and specially brought in a foreign saleswoman who spoke Chinese.
将螺蛳太太与古应春请到他们大班专用的小客厅，还特为找了个会说中国话的外籍女店员招待；

Her name was Aidun; Madam Luosi called her “Miss Ai.”
名叫艾敦，螺蛳太太便叫她『艾小姐。』


“Where are you from, Miss Ai?”
『艾小姐，你是哪里人？』

“I was born in Edinburgh,” she replied while preparing tea with milk.
『我出生在爱丁堡。』艾敦一面调着奶茶，一面答说。

Madam Luosi did not know the place, so Gu explained that she was British.
螺蛳太太不知道这个地名，古应春便即解释∶『她是英国人。』

“Then your country is like ours,” Madam Luosi said.
『喔！』螺蛳太太说道∶『你们英国同我们中国一样的，

“Both are ruled by an old empress dowager.”
都是老太后当权。』

Aidun’s Chinese covered everyday conversation only.
艾敦虽会说中国话，也不过是日常用语，

Talk of an “empress dowager ruling” left her as bewildered as the name Edinburgh had left Madam Luosi.
什么『老太后当权』，就跟螺蛳太太听到『爱丁堡』这个地名一样，瞠目不知所对。

Gu had to explain again. “She means your Queen Victoria and our Empress Dowager Cixi.”
这就少不得又要靠古应春来疏通了∶『她是指你们英国的维多利亚女皇，跟我们中国的慈禧太后。』

Aidun was surprised.
『喔，』艾敦颇为惊异，

She had served many Chinese women—courtesans, and occasionally ladies of rank or respectable young women—but none had mentioned the British queen.
因为她也接待过许多中国的女顾客，除了北里娇娃以外，间或也有贵妇与淑女，但从没有一个人在谈话时会提到英国女皇。

She warmed to Madam Luosi and served her afternoon tea with particular care.
因为如此，便大起好感，招待螺蛳太太用午茶，非常殷勤。

The manager then brought three oblong boxes, all of black leather with gold lettering.
接着，管事的捧来了三个长方盒子，一律黑色真皮，上烫金字，

Inside the first, a pair of brilliantly sparkling platinum bracelets set with diamonds rested on blue velvet.
打开第一个盒子，蓝色鹅绒上，嵌着一双光芒四射的白金钻镯，

The workmanship was exquisite.
镶嵌得非常精致。


On closer inspection, however, the box looked new while the metal’s colour seemed otherwise.
仔细看去，盒子虽新，白金的颜色却似有异，

“These are used?” she asked.
『这是旧的？』她问。

“Yes.
『是的。

They were favourite jewels of Napoleon’s empress.”
这是拿破仑皇后心爱的首饰。』

“I care nothing for empresses.
『我不管什么皇后。』

New things are better for a dowry.”
螺蛳太太说∶『嫁妆总是新的好。』

“Both these other pairs are new.”
『这两副都是新的。』

One was set entirely with diamonds; the other combined diamonds with rubies and sapphires.
另外西副，一副全钻，一副镶了红蓝宝石，

The all-diamond pair was the more valuable.
论贵重是全钻的那副，

Each bracelet held four diamonds the size of soybeans, linked by smaller stones, and glittered even when held still.
每一只有四粒黄豆大的钻石，用碎钻连接，拿在手里不动都会闪耀；

For splendour, however, the coloured stones excelled.
但谈到华丽，却要算镶宝石的那副。

“What are the prices?”
『什么价钱？』

“Thirty-five thousand for these; thirty-two thousand for the pair with coloured stones.
『这副三万五，镶宝石的这副三万二。』

I advise the all-diamond pair, Madam Hu.
管事的说∶『胡太太，我劝你买全钻的这副，

It costs three thousand more but is better value.”
虽然贵三千银子，其实比镶宝的划算。』

Unable to decide, she asked Aidun to put them on.
螺蛳太太委决不下，便即说道∶『艾小姐，请你戴起来我看看。』


Aidun wore one kind on each wrist and held out her arms for inspection.
艾敦便一只手腕戴一样，平伸出来让她仔细鉴赏，

After a long look, Madam Luosi turned to Gu. “What do you think, Brother-in-law?”
螺蛳太太看了半天转眼问道∶『七姐夫，你看呢？』

“The all-diamond pair is better, certainly, but rather too plain in colour.”
『好，当然是全钻的这副好，可惜太素净了。』

This exactly matched her own view, and she decided at once.
这看法跟螺蛳太太的完全一样，顿时作了决定，

“For a bride, with the Old Madam present, the effect should not be too subdued.”
『又是新娘子，又是老太太在，不宜太素净。』

She turned to the manager. “I have chosen.
她向管事说道∶『我东西是挑定了，

Now we must discuss the price, or choosing is pointless.
现在要谈价钱，价钱谈不拢，挑也是白挑。

When did these bracelets arrive?”
我倒请问你，这副镯子是啥时候来的？』

“More than a year ago.”
『一年多了。』

“What price did you mark them at then?”
『那末一年以前，你的标价是多少？』

“Thirty thousand.”
『三万。』

“I do not believe it.
『这不相信，

You have added only two thousand—less than ten per cent.”
你现在只涨了两千银子，一成都不到。』

“It is true.”
『我说的是实话。』

He drew a label from beneath the velvet lining. “Mr Gu, please look.”
管事的从天鹅绒衬底的夹层中，抽出来一张标鉴说∶『古先生，请你看。』

The Arabic numerals did indeed read thirty thousand.
标签上确是阿拉伯字的『三万』；

Madam Luosi could read them too and responded quickly.
螺蛳太太也识洋数码，她的心思很快，

“You yourself said the all-diamond pair was better value, so this one must be poor value.

胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement

父母能尽其爱心的，也只有这一次，所以踵事增华，多少阔都可以摆。

七姑奶奶小时候曾看过一家巨室发嫁妆，殿后的是八名身穿深蓝新布袍的中年汉子，

由于别发洋行陈列了胡三小姐的嫁妆，足以证明螺蛳太太所采办的都是精品，同时也证明了螺蛳太太的贤慧，对胡三小姐爱如己出。

Conversely, if such an opportunity for distinction were refused, no one would understand that the reason was to avoid ostentation harmful to Hu’s official reputation.
从另一方面看，有这样一个出风头的机会，而竟放弃了，大家都不会了解，原因是怕太招摇，于胡雪岩的官声不利；

They would say the goods were worthless and too embarrassing to show.
只说都因为是些拿不出手的不值钱的东西，怕人笑话，所以不愿陈列，

The difference between these impressions was crucial.
这一出一入之间关系的变化是太重要了。

After pondering for some time, the Seventh Lady said, “Biefa’s displays are for foreigners.
七姑奶奶沉吟了好一会说∶『别发的陈列，是陈列给洋人看的；

Few Chinese enter foreign shops, so it makes little difference to them whether the goods are displayed.
中国人进洋行的很少，陈列不陈列，不和多大的关系。

These things would chiefly be shown to foreigners.
所以别发陈列的这些东西，我看纯然是拿给洋人看的。

In that case, I have an idea.
既然如此，我倒有个想法，

See what you think.”
你看行不行？』


“Tell me.”
『你说。』

“Let them exhibit the goods, but require every description to be in English.
『陈列让他陈列，说明都用英文，

No Chinese characters.
不准用中国字，

That way it will look less ostentatious.”
这样子就不显得招摇了。』

After a moment Madam Luosi answered with an emphatic “Good,” seeming entirely willing to follow her lead.
螺蛳太太稍想一想，重重地答一声∶『好。』显得对七姑奶奶百依百顺似的。

The Seventh Lady then called, “Little Sister!”
于是七姑奶奶喊一声∶『妹妹！』

For several months she had addressed Ruixiang that way, and Ruixiang had accepted it naturally, answering readily.
喊瑞香为『妹妹』，已经好几个月了；瑞香亦居之不疑，答应得很响亮，

With Madam Luosi present, however, she grew shy and did not even dare reply aloud.
但此时有螺蛳太太在座，却显得有些忸怩，连应声都不敢，

She merely hurried to the bedside to await instructions.
只疾趋到床前，听候吩咐。


“Find out where the master is and ask him to come.”
『你看老爷在哪里？请他来。』

Ruixiang went.
瑞香答应着走了，

Madam Luosi lowered her voice.
螺蛳太太便即轻声说道∶『七姐，

“I came for three things: the Third Miss’s dowry, a visit to you in your illness, and Ruixiang.
我这趟来三件事，一是我们三小姐添妆，二是探望你的病，还有件事就是瑞香的事。

Why have they still not begun married life together?”
怎么不给他们圆房？』

“I have urged him several times.”
『我催了他好几遍了。』

“Him” meant Gu, who had now appeared at the door.
这个他是指古应春；此时已经出现在门外，

The Seventh Lady fell silent but gestured and gave Madam Luosi a look indicating that they would discuss it later.
七姑奶奶便住了口，却对螺蛳太太做个手势，递个眼色，意思是回头细谈。

“Yingchun, I have thought of a way, and Sister Luo agrees.” She explained the plan.
『应春，我想到一个法子，罗四姐也赞成的。』七姑奶奶接着便说了她的办法。

Gu thought it scarcely better than stopping one’s ears while stealing a bell.
古应春心想，这也不过是掩耳盗铃的办法；

Still, it was preferable to Chinese labels.
不过比用中文作说明，总要好些，

He nodded. “I shall tell Biefa’s clerk when he comes.
当下点点头说∶『等别发的管事来了，我告诉他。

But—”
不过┅┅』


He left the sentence unfinished, but the Seventh Lady understood.
他没有再说下去。七姑奶却明白，

“Provided it stays out of the newspapers, it cannot attract too much attention.
『只要不上报，就招摇不到哪里去了。』

Are you not a friend of the ‘Rebel First Scholar’—the man you go drinking with in the pleasure quarters?”
她说∶『你同「长毛状元」不是吃花酒的好朋友？』

“Yes!
『对！

You have reminded me.
你倒提醒我了；

I shall speak to him.
我来打他一个招呼。』

Is there anything else?”
古应春问道。『还有什么话？』

“Only that.”
『就是这件事。』

Gu turned to Madam Luosi. “I am sorry I cannot dine with you tonight, Sister Luo.
『那，』古应春转脸说道∶『四姐，对不起，今天晚上我不能陪你吃饭。

I have an important appointment with Mi Benchang and must leave now.
我同密本常有个约，很要紧的，我现在就要走了。

Oh, he knows you are here and wants to invite you to dinner.
喔，还有件事，他也晓得你来了，要你吃饭，

When would you be free?”
看你哪天有空？』

“No, thank him for me.
『不必，谢谢他罗。』

He lives in Shanghai without his family; it would be awkward for me to visit.
螺蛳太太说∶『他一个人在上海，没有家小，请我去了也不便。

Please decline firmly on my behalf.”
姐夫，你替我切切实实辞一辞。

Once Gu had gone, Madam Luosi hastened to ask about the “Rebel First Scholar.”
『等他一走螺蛳太太有个疑团急于要打开，不知道』长毛状元『是怎么回事？』

“His surname is Wang, and his name Tao—the same character as in Hangzhou’s Taoguang,” the Seventh Lady explained.
这个人姓王，叫王韬，你们杭州韧光的韬。

“When the rebels were powerful, they held examinations, and Wang Tao came first.
长毛得势的时候开过科，状元就是这个王韬。

Everyone in Shanghai calls him the ‘Rebel First Scholar.’”
上海人都叫他「长毛状元」。

“What does that have to do with the newspapers?”
『』那末，上报不上报，关长毛状元啥事情？

“He works at Shenbao and has considerable influence there.
『『长毛状元在《申报》馆做事，蛮有势力的；

If Yingchun asks him to keep the dowry display out of the paper, the family will not hear about it, and there will be no trouble.”
叫应春打他一个招呼，别发陈列三小姐的嫁妆那件事，不要上报，家里不晓得就不要紧了。』

“I see.”
原来如此！

Madam Luosi glanced toward Ruixiang.
『螺蛳太太瞄了瑞香一眼。


The Seventh Lady understood at once and sent Ruixiang to supervise the kitchen, freeing them to discuss her.
七姑奶奶立即会意，便叫瑞香去监厨；调开了她好谈她的事。

“I have urged Yingchun several times.
『我催了应春好几次，

He always says we can talk later.
他只说∶慢慢再谈。

Business is poor, he says, and he has no heart for such matters.
因为市面不好，他说他没心思来做这件事。

Your visit is timely.
你来了正好，

Persuade him for me.
请你劝劝他；

If he still refuses, take it up with him.”
如果他再不听，你同他办交涉。

“Take it up with him?”
『』办交涉？

Madam Luosi was astonished.
『螺蛳太太诧异，』

“How could I approach my brother-in-law on a matter like that?”
我怎么好同姐夫办这种交涉？

“Why not?
『『咦！

Ruixiang came from you.
瑞香是你的人，

You ought to speak for her.”
你要替瑞香说话啊！』

“Ah!” Madam Luosi laughed.
『喔！』螺蛳太太笑了，

“Once a thing passes through your mouth, even the unreasonable becomes reasonable.”
『七姐，什么事到了你嘴里，没理也变有理了。？』

“It is reasonable.”
本来就有理嘛！

The Seventh Lady lowered her voice. “They are all right: one is in no hurry, and the other is probably impatient inwardly but says nothing.
『七姑奶奶低声说道∶』他们倒也好，一个不急；一个只怕是急在心里，嘴里不说。

I am the one who suffers, feeling as though I owe Ruixiang something.”
苦的是我，倒象亏欠了瑞香似的。

“With that reason, I certainly can take it up with him.
『』好！『螺蛳太太立即接口，』有这个理由，我倒好同姐夫办交涉，

He will have to choose a day.”
不怕他不挑日子。

“If we wait for him, he will find more excuses.
『』等他来挑，又要推三阻四了。

Let us choose it ourselves.
不如我们来挑。

There must at least be a wedding cup of wine, and you must stay to drink it.”
『七姑奶奶又说∶』总算也是一杯喜酒，你一定要吃了再走。

“Of course.”
『』当然。

Madam Luosi considered. “Today is the twenty-eighth of the eighth month.
『螺蛳太太沉吟着说∶』今天八月廿八，

This is a short month; the ninth begins the day after tomorrow.
这个月小建，后天就交九月了。

The Third Miss’s wedding is only two months away.
三小姐的喜事只得两个月的工夫，

I really am longing to get home.”
我亦真正是所谓归心如箭。

“I know, I know.
『』我晓得，我晓得。

The almanac hangs behind the dressing-table mirror.
『七姑奶奶说∶』四姐，皇历挂在梳妆台镜子后面，

Please bring it.”
请你拿给我。

They consulted it and found the third day of the ninth month auspicious for everything.
『取皇历来一翻，九月初三是』大满棚『的日子。

Madam Luosi’s eagerness to return to Hangzhou left no time to choose another date.
由于螺蛳太太急于要回杭州，不容别作选择，

They settled at once on that day for Gu and Ruixiang to begin their married life together.
一下就决定了九月初三为古应春与瑞香圆房。


“She must have some new clothes and a couple of pieces of jewelry,” Madam Luosi said.
『总要替她做几件衣服，打两样首饰，七姐，

“Those will be my dowry gift.
这算是我的陪嫁，

You need not trouble about them.”
你就不必管了。』

“Your gift is yours,” the Seventh Lady replied. “I have prepared something too, though perhaps not enough.
『你陪嫁是你的。』七姑奶奶说∶『我也预备了一点，好象还不大够；

Do not stand on ceremony.”
四姐，你不要同我客气。』

Reaching beneath her pillow, she took out a Fukang passbook.
说着，探手到枕下，取出一个阜康的存折，

“Take her shopping tomorrow.
『请你明天带她去看看，

Whatever she likes, please buy it for her on my behalf.”
她喜欢啥，我托你替她买。』

Their friendship allowed neither polite hesitation nor refusal.
彼此有交情在，不容她客气，更不容她推辞；

Madam Luosi took the passbook and put it into her pocket without looking inside.
螺蛳太太将折子接了过来，看都不看，便放入口袋了。

“Our old lady worries about you so much.
『七姐，我们老太太牵挂你得好厉害。

Will you be able to come to the wedding in the eleventh month?”
十一月里，不晓得你能不能去吃喜酒？』

“I should like to.
『我想去！

But I may have difficulty getting about and cause you trouble.”
就怕行动不便，替你们添麻烦。』

“What trouble?
『麻烦点啥？

We need only assign another couple of maids or older serving women to look after you.
不过多派两个丫头老妈子照应你。

And Ruixiang will be there.”
而况还有瑞香。』

Long confined to bed, the Seventh Lady had often wished to go somewhere, and the invitation made her still more eager.
七姑奶奶久病在床，本就一直想到哪里去走走，此时螺蛳太太一邀，心思便更加活动了，

Her chief concern was that a household already overwhelmed with wedding preparations might lack time to care for her properly.
但最大的顾虑，还在人家办喜事已忙得不可开交，只怕没有足够的工夫来照料她。

They would feel uneasy, and she herself might not be comfortable either.
果然有此情形，人家心里自是不安；自己忖度，内心也未见得便能泰然。

Despite Madam Luosi’s encouragement, she still felt the matter required thought.
因此任凭螺蛳太太极力怂恿，她仍旧觉得有考虑的必要。


“Madam,” Ruixiang said, coming in, “both dishes you mentioned yesterday have arrived.
『太太，』瑞香走来说道∶『你昨天讲的两样吃食，都办来了。

Are you hungry?
饿不饿？

If so, I shall serve dinner.”
饿了我就开饭。』

“Which dishes?”
『哪两样？』

The previous evening Madam Luosi had fondly recalled several foods she used to enjoy and could not tell which two Ruixiang meant.
螺蛳太太前一天晚上闲话旧事时谈到当年尝过的几种饮食，怀念不置，不知瑞香的是哪两样，所以有此一问。

“Did you not say you missed zaobotou, the wine-lees casserole, and dumplings stuffed with greens most of all?”
『太太不是说，顶想念的就是糟钵头，还有菜圆子？』

“Exactly!
『对！』

But they must come from Sanpailou and Tao A’da’s.”
螺蛳太太立即答说∶『顶想这两样，不过一定要三牌楼同陶阿大家的。』

“They do.
『不错，

I gave particular instructions to buy from those places.
我特为交代过，就是这两家买来的。』

The casserole may be too rich for my mistress, but she can eat the vegetable dumplings.
瑞香又说∶『糟钵头怕嫌油腻，奶奶不相宜，菜圆子可以吃。

Shall I bring dinner in here?”
要不，我就把饭开到这里来。』

“Yes, yes!”
『好！好！』

The Seventh Lady loved company.
七姑奶奶好热闹，

“I grew up in Shanghai and have always heard of Sanpailou’s vegetable dumplings, but never seen them.
连连说道∶『我从小生长在上海，三牌楼的菜圆子，只闻其名，没有见过，

I must try them tonight.”
今天倒真要尝尝。』

“Several shops there make them.
『三牌楼菜圆子有好几家，

Widow Xu’s are the best.”
一定要徐寡妇家的才好。』

“What is so good about them?”
『喔，好在什么地方？』

In Shanghai, the glutinous-rice dumplings eaten at the Lantern Festival were called yuanzi.
原来上海称元宵的汤圆为圆子。

Widow Xu’s, at Sanpailou, gave full value.
三牌楼徐寡妇家的圆子，货真价实。

Frugal customers would buy a bowl containing four meat dumplings, eat only the wrappers, and take the four balls of filling home to stew with cabbage and bean-thread noodles for another meal.
有那省俭的顾客，一碗肉圆子四枚，仅食皮子，剩下馅子便是四个肉圆，带回家用白菜粉条同烩，便可佐膳。

Her greatest specialty, however, was the vegetable variety.
但徐寡妇家最出名的却是菜圆子，

“She says she has a secret, but once explained it is nothing remarkable,” Madam Luosi said. “I ate there several times and watched quietly until I understood.
『她说有秘诀，说穿了也不稀奇。』螺蛳太太说∶『我去吃过几回，冷眼看看，也就懂了。

The secret is painstaking work.
秘诀就是工要细，

Only the finest leaves are chosen; yellow and old ones are discarded.
拣顶好的菜叶子，黄的、老的都不要；

Even the tender leaves have every vein stripped out.
嫩叶子还要抽筋，抽得极干净，

They are briefly blanched, chopped very fine, put into a ramie-cloth bag, and squeezed dry.
滚水中捞一捞，斩得极细倒在夏布袋里把水分挤掉，

Mixed thoroughly with fine salt and stone-ground sesame oil, they make the filling.
加细盐、小磨麻油拌匀，就是馅子，

Naturally, the wrappers use the best wet-milled rice flour.”
皮子用上好水磨粉，当然不必说。』

“Then—” The Seventh Lady was just hungry enough to swallow involuntarily, making Madam Luosi laugh.
『那末，』七姑奶奶恰好有些饿了，不由得咽了口唾沫，惹得螺蛳太太笑了。



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第3部分，共6部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“To tell you the truth, Seventh Sister, apart from the Old Lady, everyone finds those plain vegetable dumplings pleasant enough once in a while, but too many of them spoil the appetite,” Madam Luosi said. “Even to me, ours taste quite different from the Xu family’s at Sanpailou.”
『七姐，我老实告诉你，那种净素的菜圆子，除了老太太以外，大家都是偶尔吃一回还可以，一多，胃口就倒了。』螺蛳太太又说∶『我自己也觉得完全不是三牌楼徐家的那种味道。』

The wine-lees casserole was an authentic Shanghai dish, one of the so-called local specialities, usually available only at this time.
糟钵头是上海道地的所谓『本帮菜』，通常只有今天才有，

Pork tripe, liver, and other offal were simmered with a plump chicken; when everything was properly cooked, it was poured into an earthenware pot and wine lees were added—hence its name.
用猪肚、猪肝等等内脏，加肥鸡同煮，到够火候了，倾陶钵加糟，所以称之为糟钵头『。

Wine-lees-cured black carp, cut into pieces and cooked with pale-hearted Chinese cabbage as a soupy dish, was called chuanzao.
糟青鱼切块，与黄芽菜同煮作汤菜，即是』川糟『。

“And do you think yours is better or worse than Tao A’da’s?”
『那末，你觉得比陶阿大的是好，还是坏？』

“Worse, of course.
『当然不及陶阿大的。』

Otherwise I should not keep thinking of his.”
螺蛳太太说∶『不然我也不会这么想了。』

“I suspect his would not seem quite as good now as you remember.”
『只怕现在不会象你所想的那样子好。』

“Oh?
『喔，』

Has the shop changed hands?”
螺蛳太太问道∶『莫非换过老板？』

“I have never tried those dumplings, but before I fell ill I used to eat Tao A’da’s casserole, outside the county yamen.
『菜圆子我没有吃过，县衙前陶阿大的糟钵头，我没有得病以前是吃过的。

Last year, when Brother Five came from Songjiang in the twelfth month, he made a special trip there.
去年腊月里五哥从松江来了，还特为去吃过。

Their business is flourishing.
人家做得兴兴旺旺的生意，

Why should it change hands?”
为啥要换老板？』

Madam Luosi was quick to detect a further meaning.
『那末，』螺蛳太太也极机警，知道七姑奶奶刚才的话，别有言外之意，

“Then there must be a reason for what you said.”
便即追问∶『既然这样子，你的话总有啥道理在里头吧？

The Seventh Lady considered. “I speak my mind, and we are as close as sisters.
七姑奶奶想了一下说∶』我是直性子；我们又同姊妹一样。

If I say something mistaken, do not take offence.”
我或者说错了，你不要怪我。

“How could I?
『』哪里会！

Seventh Sister, there is no need to say that.”
七姐，你这话多余。『


“There may indeed be some special knack to making those dumplings.
『我在想，做菜圆子，或者真的有啥诀窍；

But as for the casserole, surely your highly paid master cook is no less skilful than Tao A’da?
至于糟钵头，我在想，你家吃大俸禄的大司务，本事莫非就不及陶阿大？

And as for ingredients, leaving everything else aside, the wine lees you have brought from Shaoxing are better than anything he uses.
说到材料，别的不谈，光是从绍兴办来的酒糟，这一点就比陶阿大那里要高明了。

Your casserole cannot possibly be inferior to his.
所以府上的糟钵头，决不会比陶阿大来得差。

Yet you say it is. Why?”
然而，你说不及陶阿大的糟钵头这是啥道理。』

“Seventh Sister!” Madam Luosi laughed. “That was what I asked you.
『七姐！』螺蛳太太笑道∶『我就是问你，

Why turn the question back on me?”
你怎么反倒问我？』

“The casserole, I think, is still the casserole of those days.
『依我看，糟钵头还是当年的糟钵头，

But Sister Luo is no longer the Sister Luo of those days.”
罗四姐不是当年的罗四姐了。』

She hastened to add, “I do not mean that you have forgotten your beginnings.
七姑奶奶紧接着说∶『四姐，我这话不是说你忘本，

I mean that times and circumstances change.
是说此一时，彼一时，

Nor did I discover this truth for myself.
这番道理，也不是我悟出来的，

It came from a story I heard a storyteller tell.
是说书先生讲的一段故事，

In the Tang dynasty there was a monk called Lancan—” She told the story of the monk roasting taro.
唐朝有个和尚叫懒残——』讲了懒残和尚煨芋的故事，

Madam Luosi certainly felt no suggestion of mockery in it, but she remained silent for a long time, deep in thought.
螺蛳太太当然决不会觉得七姑奶奶有何讽刺之意，但却久久无语，心里想得很深。


Ruixiang now brought a maid to lay the table.
这时瑞香已带了小大姐来铺排餐桌，

They helped the Seventh Lady up and lifted her into a specially made round-backed chair.
然后将七姑奶奶扶了起来，抬坐在一张特制的圈椅上，

It was large, with brocade cushions packed around her to keep her upright without effort.
椅子很大，周围用锦垫塞紧，使得七姑奶奶不必费力便能坐直，

Across the front lay a broad, removable wooden tray for plates and bowls, edged with a little “wall” five fen high to prevent spilled soup from running everywhere.
前面是一块很大的活动木板，以便置放盘碗，木板四周镶嵌五分高的一道『围墙』以防汤汁倾出，以不致流得到处都是。

The chair served much the same purpose as a child’s chair.
那张圈椅跟『小儿车』的作用相同；

When Ruixiang had tied on her bib, the Seventh Lady laughed at herself. “People in Wuxi are always saying that the old become children again.
七姑奶奶等瑞香替她系上『围嘴』以后，自嘲地笑道∶『无锡人常说「老小、老小」，

The older I grow, the more of a child I am.”
我真是愈老愈小了。』

“You scarcely look old,” Madam Luosi said with a smile. “Your skin is so fair and soft that I want to feel it myself.”
『老倒不见得。』螺蛳太太笑道∶『皮肤又白又嫩，我都想摸一把。』

She took her arm and gave it a couple of gentle squeezes.
说着便握住她的手臂，轻轻捏了两下，

The flesh had lost its firmness, after all.
肌肉到底松弛了。

“Dumplings first, or wine?” Ruixiang asked.
『是先吃圆子，还是先吃酒？』瑞香问道。

The dumplings were already cooked, so naturally they came first.
菜圆子，已经煮好了，自然先吃圆子；

They were so large that only two would fit in a rice bowl decorated with yellow flowers.
圆子很大，黄花累瓷饭碗中只放得下两枚，

Ruixiang had taken particular pains, adding a few strips of ham and two or three coriander leaves.
瑞香格外道地加一几条火腿后，两三片芫荽，

The contrast of red and green was appetizing.
红绿相映，动人食欲。


“Let me try one.”
『我来尝一个。』

The Seventh Lady lifted a dumpling in her spoon, blew on it, and took a bite, followed immediately by another: her enjoyment was plain.
七姑奶奶拿汤匙舀了一枚，嘘口气，咬了一口，紧接着便咬第二口，，欣赏之意显然。

Madam Luosi also put one to her lips, then set it down and tasted the soup.
螺蛳太太也舀了一枚送入口中，接着放回圆子舀口汤喝，

“Ruixiang,” she asked doubtfully, “did these come from Widow Xu’s at Sanpailou?”
『瑞香，』她疑惑地问∶『是三牌楼徐寡妇家买的？』

“Yes.”
『是啊！』

Ruixiang’s smile suggested a secret.
瑞香微笑着回答。看她的笑容，便知内有蹊跷，

“What soup did you cook them in?”
『你拿什么汤下的圆子？』她问。

“You noticed, madam!
『太太尝出来了。』

A Cantonese restaurant called Xinghua Lou has just opened.
瑞香笑道∶『新开一家广东杏花楼，

I used their stock.”
用它家的高汤下的。』

“Stock?”
『高汤？』

In a modest eating house, stock was free: bone broth with a spoonful of soy sauce and a sprinkling of chopped scallions.
在小馆子，『高汤』是白送的；肉骨头熬的汤，加一匙酱油，数粒葱花便是。

Madam Luosi naturally wondered how such a broth could make vegetable dumplings taste so delicious.
这样的汤下菜圆子能有这样的鲜味，螺蛳太太自然要诧异了。

“Xinghua Lou’s stock is nothing like that pot-rinsing water.
『杏花楼的高汤，不是同洗锅水差不多的高汤；

They simmer chicken, ham, lean pork, and crucian carp over a low flame.
它是鸡、火腿、精肉、鲫鱼，用文火熬出来的汤，

It is sold by the liang.”
论两卖的。』

“No wonder!” the Seventh Lady laughed. “If Widow Xu’s dumplings tasted like this by themselves, she would have to be an immortal.”
『怪不得！』七姑奶奶笑道∶『如说徐寡妇的菜圆子有这样的味道，除非她是仙人。』

“Ruixiang has gone out of her way to please me,” Madam Luosi said, “but now I cannot recover the taste I remember at all.”
『瑞香倒是特别巴结我，不过我反而吃不出当年的味道来了。』


“Then try the casserole, madam.
『那末太太尝尝糟钵头，

We bought it at Tao A’da’s and have done nothing to it.”
这是陶阿大那里买回来以后，原封没有动过。』

Madam Luosi nodded, picked up a piece of tripe, and chewed it carefully, doing her utmost to recall the flavour of the old days.
螺蛳太太点点头，挟了一块猪肚，细细嚼；同时极力回忆当年吃糟钵头的滋味，

It was no use.
可是没有用，

This tasted less good than her own cook’s.
味道还不如她家厨子做的来得好。

“Seventh Sister, you were right.
『七姐，你的话不错。

I am no longer the Sister Luo I used to be.”
我罗四姐，不是当年的罗四姐了。』

The Seventh Lady said nothing.
七姑奶奶默不作声，

She rather regretted speaking so bluntly and making her friend sad.
心里还颇有悔意，刚才的话不应该说得那么率直，惹起她的伤感。


Ruixiang, who could make nothing of their riddling conversation, stared wide-eyed in bewilderment.
瑞香却不知她们打的什么哑谜，瞪圆了一双大眼睛发楞。

“Ruixiang,” Madam Luosi said, “remember this: only those who endure the bitterest hardships can rise above others.”
罗四姐便又说道∶『瑞香，你总要记牢，吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。』

Still unable to understand what she meant, Ruixiang could only answer, “Yes.”
瑞香仍旧不明她这话的用意，只好答应一声∶『是。』

“Then again, people are not born simply to suffer,” the Seventh Lady said. “If you have the good fortune to enjoy life, you should enjoy it.
『话要说回来，人也不是生来就该吃苦的。』七姑奶奶说道∶『有福能享，还是要享。

Only—” With Ruixiang present, she thought it better not to go too deeply into the subject, and changed her words. “The danger is to live in good fortune without knowing it.”
不过——』她觉得有瑞香在旁，话说得太深了也不好，便改口说道∶『就怕身在福中不知福。』

“Seventh Sister, that goes straight to the heart of it.
『七姐这句话，真正是一针见血。』

Ruixiang, warm a pot of huadiao wine.
螺蛳太太说∶『瑞香，你去烫一壶花雕来，

I feel like a drink today.”
我今天想吃酒。』

Madam Luosi could hold her wine well.
螺蛳太太的酒量很不错，

When it came, she poured for herself and drank rapidly.
烫了来自斟自饮，喝得很猛；

“Sister Luo, wine is for pleasure,” the Seventh Lady reminded her.
七姑奶奶便提了一句∶『四姐，酒要吃得高兴，

“Take it slowly.”
慢慢吃。』

“Do not worry.
『不要紧，

One pot will not make me drunk.”
这一壶酒醉不倒我。』

“Perhaps not, but you may talk as though you were.
『醉虽醉不倒，会说醉话；

And once you do, people will take you even less seriously.”
你一说醉话，人家就更加不当真的了。』

That was a riddle only the two of them understood.
这才真正是哑谜，只有她们两人会意。

Remembering that she had to speak to Gu about Ruixiang, Madam Luosi accepted the warning.
螺蛳太太想到要跟古应春谈瑞香的事，便听七姑奶奶的劝，

She took small, leisurely sips as they talked, finished the pot, and asked for no more.
浅斟低酌，闲谈着将一壶酒喝完，也不想再添，

After she had eaten a bowl of fragrant rice porridge, Gu returned.
要了一碗香粳米粥吃完，古应春也回来了。


At first they chatted in the Seventh Lady’s bedroom.
先是在七姑奶奶卧室中闲话；

When the clock struck nine, Madam Luosi said, “Seventh Sister must be sleepy.
听到钟打九下，螺蛳太太便即说道∶『七姐只怕要困了；

Brother-in-law, I should like you to write a letter for me.”
我请姐夫替我写封信。』

“Certainly.
『好！

Come to my study.”
到我书房里去。』

As soon as they entered, Ruixiang brought tea.
等他们一进书房，瑞香随即将茶端了进来，

She remembered the Hu household rule that servants must withdraw when a member of the family asked someone to write a letter, and closed the door behind her.
胡家的规矩，凡是主人家找人写信，下人是不准在旁边的，她还记着这个规矩，所以带上房门，管自己走了。

“Brother-in-law, the letter is a pretence.
『姐夫，写信是假，

I have really come to settle a matter with you.”
跟你来办交涉是真。』

“What is it?
『什么事？』

Whatever you wish, Sister Luo, just tell me.”
古应春说∶『有什么话，四姐交代就是。』

“Then I shall speak plainly.
『那末，我就直说。

What do you mean by leaving my Ruixiang to one side?”
姐夫。你把我的瑞香搁在一边，是啥意思。』

Faced with this aggressive challenge, Gu was embarrassed.
看她咄咄逼人，看有点办交涉的意味，古应春倒有些窘了。

The matter was hard enough to explain at the best of times; under these circumstances he could scarcely find a word.
本来就是件不容易表达清楚的事，在这样的情况之下，自然更是讷讷然无法出口。

Her manner was deliberate, intended to save argument.
罗四姐原是故意作此姿态，说话比较省力，

Having gained the advantage, she immediately softened her tone. “Brother-in-law, what is really in your mind?
既占上风，急忙收敛，『姐夫，』她的声音放得柔和而恳切，『你心里到底是啥想法？

Tell me freely.
尽管跟我说；

Have you found, after knowing her longer, that Ruixiang’s character is not what it should be?”
是不是日子一长，看出来瑞香的人品不好。』

“No, no!”
『不、不！』

Gu broke in hastily.
古应春急急打断，

“If I thought anything of the kind, I should have no conscience at all.”
『我如果心里有这样的想法，那就算没良心到家了。』


“Then you do like her?”
『照你说，瑞香你是中意的。』

“More than like her…” Gu smiled and left the sentence unfinished.
『不但中意┅┅』古应春笑笑没有再说下法。

“You mean you do not merely like her—you like her very much?”
『意思是不但中意，而且交关中意？』

“That is true too.”
『这也是实话。』

“Then, with Seventh Sister longing for you to begin your married life together, why do you show no enthusiasm?
『即然如此，七姐又巴不得你们早早圆房，你为啥一点都不起劲。

Brother-in-law, give me a reason.”
姐夫，请你说个道理给我听。』

Her voice rose again.
螺蛳太太的调子又拉高了。

Gu frowned slightly and did not answer at once.
古应春微微皱眉，不即作答；

He had recently taken to smoking—not opium, but Manila cigars.
他最近才有了吸烟的嗜好——不是鸦片是吕宋烟；

Opening his silver case, he took out an Old Beauty, clipped its end with a special cutter, struck a red-headed match against his shoe sole, and slowly lit it.
打开银烟盒，取出一支『老美女』用特制的剪刀剪去烟头，用根『红头火柴』在鞋底上划燃了慢慢点烟。

A moment later Madam Luosi could smell the rich tobacco but could no longer see his face through the smoke.
霎时间螺蛳太太只闻到浓郁的烟香，却看不见古应春的脸，因为让烟雾隔断了。


“Sister Luo,” his voice emerged from the cloud, “taking a concubine is, to speak frankly, one of the pleasures of a man’s life.
『四姐，』古应春在烟雾中发声∶『讨小纳妾，说实话，是我们男人家人生一乐。

That being so, it depends on circumstances and on one’s state of mind.
既然这样子，就要看境况、看心情，

If circumstances are bad, one may still find a little pleasure amid one’s troubles.
境况不好做这种事，还可以说是苦中作乐；

But if one’s heart is troubled, there can be no pleasure at all.”
心情不好，就根本谈不到乐趣了。』

The answer was rather unexpected.
这个答复，多少是出人意外的；

Madam Luosi considered it. “The Master told me that you were dragged into trouble over property by that man Xu.
螺蛳太太想了一会说∶『大先生也跟我谈过，说你做房地产受了姓徐的累，

But it is over now.
不过现在事情已经过去了，

Surely your spirits ought to be different?”
心情也应该不同了。』

“Quite the contrary.
『恰恰相反，

Things are different now, too.”
事情也应该不同了。』

“Why?”
『为啥呢？』

“Little Uncle could not have treated me better.
『四姐，小爷叔待我，自然没有话说；

He would never begrudge me a hundred thousand taels.
十万银子，在他也不会计较。

But it weighs on my mind, especially with money so tight in the market.
不过，在我总是一桩心事，尤其现在市面上的银根极紧；

Little Uncle does not mind; other people do not think as he does.”
小爷叔不在乎，旁人跟他的想法不一样。』

The implication in his last words made Madam Luosi both astonished and indignant.
最后这句话，弦外有音，螺蛳太太不但诧异，而且有些气愤，

“Who are these other people?
『这旁人是哪一个？』

What have their opinions to do with the Master?
她问∶『旁人的想法，同大先生啥相干？

Why should you listen to them?”
你为啥要去听？』

Gu did not reply.
古应春不作声，

He drew deeply on his cigar and continued with his own thought. “Little Uncle has helped me so much that I can feel easier only if I do something for him with all the ability and devotion I possess.
深深地吸了口烟，管他自己又说∶『小爷叔帮了我这么大一个忙，我想替小爷叔尽心尽力做点事，心里才比较好过。

Last time, after a great deal of effort, I persuaded him to buy modern silk-reeling mills, produce his own silk, and sell directly to the foreign firms.
上次好不容易说动小爷叔，收买新式缫丝厂，自己做丝直接销洋庄；

Who could have expected obstacles at every turn?
哪晓得处处碰钉子，

To this day I have achieved nothing.
到今朝一事无成。

Brother You has lost heart and gone back to Songjiang.
尤五哥心灰意冷，回松江去了。

Sister Luo, how can I be in the mood to think about Ruixiang?”
四姐，你说我哪里会有心思来想瑞香的事？』

His sincerity deeply moved her, and their conversation naturally shifted from Ruixiang to the mills.
这番话说得非常诚恳，螺蛳太太深为同情；话题亦就自然而然地由瑞香转到新式缫丝厂了。


“Was not everything carefully planned at the start?
『当初不是筹划得好好的？』

Why these obstacles at every turn?
她问∶『处处碰钉子是啥缘故；

What sort of obstacles?”
碰的是啥个钉子？』

“It is a long story.”
『一言难尽。』

Gu shook his head, unwilling to go further.
古应春摇摇头，不愿深谈。

She tried approaching him from several directions but could not draw out what troubled him.
螺蛳太太旁敲侧击，始终不能让古应春将他的难言之隐吐露出来。

She was beginning to feel annoyed and was about to reproach him when an idea occurred to her: she would provoke him into speaking.
以致于螺蛳太太都有些动气了。但正当要说两句埋怨的话时，灵机一动想到了一个激将法。

“Brother-in-law, tell me freely.
『姐夫，你尽管跟我说，

When I go home I shall certainly not make mischief.
我回去决不会搬弄是非；

I shall only put in a good word for you with the Master.”
只会在大先生面前替你说话。』

This made Gu extremely uneasy.
一听这话，古应春大为不安。

To refuse further would be virtually to admit that he feared she would “make mischief.”
如果仍旧不肯说，无异表示真的怕她回去『搬弄是非』。

Her tone also suggested that she suspected him of mismanagement, or even of pursuing some private interest that had left him with nothing accomplished.
同时听她的语气，似乎疑心他处置不善，甚至怀有私心，以致『一事无成』。

He was unwilling to accept such an unfounded misunderstanding in silence.
这份无端而起的误会，亦不甘默然承受。

Suppressing his agitation, he considered for a moment and said, “Sister Luo, I meant to swallow my broken teeth with the blood—to bear my grievance myself.
于是，古应春抑制激动的心情，考虑了一会答说∶『四姐，我本来是「打落牙齿和血吞」，有委屈自己受。

Now it seems I must speak.
现在看样子是非说不可了！

But first let me make one thing clear: I have never suspected you of making mischief between Little Uncle and me.”
不过，四姐，有句话，我先要声明，我决没有疑心四姐会在小爷叔面前搬弄是非的意思。』

“I know, I know.”
『我晓得，我晓得。』

She smiled triumphantly. “If I had not pressed you like that, how could I ever have got it out of you?”
螺蛳太太得意地笑道∶『我不是这样子逼一逼，哪里会把你的话逼出来？』


Only then did Gu realize that he had been caught. “I shall tell you.
听得这话，古应春才知道上当了∶『我说是说。

But now it feels as though I am the one making mischief.”
不过，』他说∶『现在好象是我在搬弄是非了。』

“Brother-in-law,” she said gravely, “I do understand what matters.
『姐夫，』螺蛳太太正色说道∶『我不是不识轻重的人。

Of course I shall consider what may be repeated and what must be kept to myself.
你告诉我的话，哪些能说，哪些不能说，我当然也会想一想。

If you refuse to tell me the truth merely to avoid suspicion, you are not treating me as one of your own.”
为了避嫌疑不肯说实话，就不是自己人了。』

There was an undertone of reproach in her final words, and Gu felt all the more obliged to speak frankly. “Strictly speaking, we cannot blame Old Mi altogether.
最后这句话，隐然有着责备的意思，使得古应春更觉得该据实倾诉∶『说起来也不能怪老宓，

He has his own difficulties—” “So it is he!” she interrupted.
他有他的难处——』『是他！』螺蛳太太插进去说，

“I began to suspect that the other person making remarks might be him.
『我刚就有点疑心，说闲话的旁人，只怕是他，

And sure enough!
果不其然。

How is he doing at Fukang?”
他在阜康怎么样。』

“I know nothing about his affairs at Fukang.
『他在阜康有情形我不清楚，

I can speak only of my own.
我只谈我自己。

I cannot understand where I have offended Old Mi, but he seems bent on making things difficult for me at every turn.”
我也弄不懂是什么地方得罪了老宓，有点处处跟我为难的味道。』

The reason the purchase of the modern mills had failed to go through was that Mi Benchang was obstructing it openly and sabotaging it in secret.
原来，收买新式缫丝厂一事，所以未成，即由于宓本常明处掣肘、暗处破坏之故。

He had spread the word that Hu Xueyan had no intention of running such mills.
他放了风声出去，说胡雪岩并无意办新式缫丝厂，

Gu, he said, had made a tremendous loss in property and was now speculating in purchases and sales he could not finance, hoping to conjure up money to fill the hole.
是古应春在做房地产的生意上扯了一个大窟窿，所以买空卖空，希图无中生有，来弥补他的亏空。

Any mill owner wishing to sell would do better to find another buyer; otherwise he would end up with nothing and miss his opportunity through his own mistake.
如果有缫丝厂想出让，最好另找主顾；否则到头来一场空，自误时机。


These reports left people divided between belief and doubt.
这话使人将信将疑，

In Gu’s favour was the fact that he was no obscure figure in Shanghai business, and his credit was good.
信的是古应春在上海商场上不是无名小卒，信用也很好。

That he had emerged unscathed from his failed partnership with Xu Yuzhai showed that he was a man of more than ordinary resources.
只看他跟徐愚斋合作失败，而居然能安然无事，便见得他不是等闲之辈了。

Against him stood the fact that his circumstances were indeed poor.
疑的是，古应春的境况确实不佳；

Still harder to understand was why Hu Xueyan, who had always opposed modern silk-reeling, should abruptly change course.
而更使人觉得不可思议的是，胡雪岩一向反对新式缫丝，何以忽然改弦易辙？

Everyone knew how highly Hu valued keeping his word.
大家都知道，胡雪岩看重的一件事是∶说话算话。

No one could recall an occasion on which he had gone back on it.
大家都想不起来，他做过什么出尔反尔的事。

Gu’s negotiations consequently became laborious: the other side was merely humouring him.
因为如此，古应春跟人家谈判，便很吃力了，因为对方是抱着虚与委蛇的态度。

Nevertheless, so long as there was no clear reason for an outright rupture, he had to continue, however difficult the talks, and sooner or later they were bound to yield some preliminary result.
当然只要没有明显的决裂的理由，尽管谈判吃力，总还要谈下去，而且迟早会谈出一个初步的结果。


At this time Gu was negotiating with Huang Zuoqing, the owner of Gongheyong.
其时古应春谈判的目标是公和永的东主黄佐卿。

Huang had built his mill at the same time as Jardine Matheson and Gongping Trading House had built theirs.
他跟怡和、公平两洋行，同时建厂，

All three were of much the same size, with over a hundred reeling machines apiece, bought from Italy and France.
规模大小相仿，都有上百部的丝车，买的是意大利跟法国的丝车；

Liu Hefu, Gongping’s comprador, proposed that the three jointly engage an engineer.
公平洋行的买办叫刘和甫，提议三厂共同延请一名工程师，

Huang agreed, and Liu hired an Italian named Maidengsi to supervise operations and train the workers.
黄佐卿同意了，由刘和甫经手，聘请了一个意大利人麦登斯来指导厂务、训练工人，

He was technically capable but a man of very bad character; his chief failing was his appetite for women.
此人技术不错，可是人品甚坏，最大的毛病是好色。

Most mill hands then were women, known as the Silk Sisters.
原来那时的工人，以女工居多，称之为『湖丝阿姐』。

Women from modest families who needed to help support their households had generally gone into domestic service.
小家碧玉为了帮助家计，大多以帮佣为主；

Those who did paid piecework took the materials home: embroidery and the pasting of tinfoil were older trades, while making matchboxes and sewing uniforms were newer ones.
做工是领了材料到家来做，旧式的如绣花、糊锡箔；新式的如糊火柴匣子、缝军服。

But the Silk Sisters, gathering in groups at the sound of the factory whistle and making their conspicuous way through the streets, were something wholly new.
但做『湖丝阿姐』，汽笛一响，成群结队，招摇而过，却是前所未有，

Watching them go to and from work became a public spectacle.
因而看湖丝阿姐上工、放工，成了一景。

These young women grew accustomed to appearing in public and naturally became much freer in speech and manner.
这些年轻妇女，抛头露面惯了，行动言语之间，自然开通得多；

The distinction between an open manner and loose morals, however, was little more than a matter of getting into bed; in time, breaches of convention became common.
而放荡与开通不过上下床之别，久而久之便常有荡检逾闲的情事出现；

The male workers, being nearest at hand, enjoyed the first opportunities, and many formed liaisons, particularly with young widows.
至于男工，『近水楼台先得月』，尤其是『小寡妇』，搭上手的很多。

There were benefits on both sides, of course.
当然这是『互惠』的，

A woman with a male worker to support her would not be bullied; if her protector was a foreman, the advantages were greater still.
女工有个男工作靠山，就不会受人欺侮；倘或靠山是个工头，好处更多，

At the least, she might be transferred to an easier department.
起码可以调到工作轻松的部门。

Conversely, a foreman whose wishes were denied could use his official authority to avenge a private grievance, assigning a woman to the worst work of all in the reeling room.
相对的，工头倘或所欲不遂，便可假公济私来作报复，调到最苦的缫丝间，

There boiling water and steam created a perpetual midsummer.
沸水热汽，终年如盛暑；

Even midsummer had an occasional breeze; the reeling room was both hot and airless.
盛暑偶尔还有风，缫丝间又热又闷，

Before one had been inside for the time it took to eat a meal, one was drenched from head to foot.
一进去要不了一顿饭的工夫，浑身就会湿透，

Men could strip to the waist and wear shorts; women had to remain in their soaking clothes.
男工可以打赤膊，着短裤，女工就只好着一件『湿布衫』，

Once the machinery started, it ran for twelve hours, and they had to wear those scorching, wet garments all day.
机器一开就是十二个钟头，这件火热的『湿布衫』就得穿一整天。

Summer was bearable enough.
夏天还好，

In winter, when the shift ended and the cold wind struck, the wet clothing became an iron shell.
冬天散工，冷风一吹，『湿布衫』变成『铁衣』，

That this should cause illness was hardly surprising.
因而致病，不足为奇，

After visiting a reeling room, one foreign journalist called it “a veritable hell on earth.”
所以有个洋记者参观过缫丝间以后，称之为『名副其实的活地狱』。


If a foreman could wield such power, an engineer could lord it over the workers even more easily.
工头如此，工程师自然更可作威作福，

Maidengsi treated the sexual exploitation of the Silk Sisters as his rightful privilege, using unscrupulous foremen to satisfy his demands.
麦登斯便视蹂躏湖丝阿姐为他应享的权利，利用不肖工头，予取予求，

Huang Zuoqing frequently received complaints and asked Liu Hefu to warn him.
黄佐卿时常接到申诉，要求刘和甫警告麦登斯，

He would improve for a few days, then soon revert to his old behaviour.
稍为好几天，很快地复萌故态，

After several repetitions, Huang could bear it no longer and decided to dismiss him.
如是几次以后，黄佐卿忍无可忍，打算解雇麦登斯，

He then discovered that Liu had signed a deeply disadvantageous contract: dismissal would require a huge payment in compensation.
哪知刘和甫跟人家订了一张非常吃亏的合约，倘或解雇须付出巨额的赔偿。

Huang was thoroughly discouraged.
为此黄佐卿大为沮丧，

With business poor as well, he finally decided to sell Gongheyong to Gu Yingchun.
加以生意又不好做，才决定将公和永盘让给古应春。



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第4部分，共6部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


All the terms had been settled: the buildings, equipment, and stock were to go for a lump sum of eighty thousand taels.
条件都谈好了，厂房、生财、存货八万银子『一脚踢』。

Gu Yingchun therefore notified Mi Benchang to issue a bank draft for the full amount.
古应春便通知宓本常，照数开出银票；

The answer, to his astonishment, was that the funds could not be released.
哪知所得的回答是∶『不便照拨。』

“What?” he asked. “Was there not a sum specifically set aside for this?”
『怎么？』古应春诧异，『不是有「的款」存在那里的吗？』

Of the original five hundred thousand taels borrowed from HSBC, two hundred thousand had been lent to Zuo Zongtang.
当初汇丰借出来的五十万银子，除了左宗棠所借的二十万以外，

Hu Xueyan had expressly designated the remainder as a loan to the cocoon firm headed by Brother You, to finance the purchase of modern silk-reeling mills.
余数由胡雪岩指明，借给尤五出面所办的茧行，作为收买新式缫丝厂之用，

Mi did not deny this, but he had his own explanation.
这一点宓本常并不否认，但他有他的说法。


“Brother Yingchun, a shop may be dead, but the man who runs it must be alive.
『应春兄，「死店活人开」，

The Master did say that, certainly.
大先生是有那样子一句话，

But if, as his manager, I can do nothing except obey him—if I am like a bead on an abacus, moving only when he pushes me—then I am hardly a living man.
不过我做档手的，如果只会听他的话，象算盘珠一样，他拨一拨、我动一动，我就不是活人，

I have only one breath more than a corpse.
只不过比死人多口气。

Would you not agree?”
你说是不是呢？』

Gu drew in a sharp breath.
古应春倒抽一口冷气，

“You—you are right,” he stammered, “but the Master’s word must count for something too.”
结结巴巴说∶『你的话不错，大先生的话也要算数。』

“I am not saying it counts for nothing.
『我不是说不算数，

I am saying there is no money at present.
是现在没有钱，

If there were, why should I withhold it? It is not mine.”
有，钱又不是我的，我为啥不给你。』

“How can the money be gone?
『这钱怎么会没有？

It was expressly assigned to this purpose.”
指明了做这个用途的。』

“Quite true.
『不错，指明了作这个用途的。

But you must consider my position, Brother Yingchun—and the Master’s even more.
不过，应春兄，你要替我想一想，更要替大先生想一想。

Every time we discussed the silk mills, you said, ‘Difficult, difficult!
几次谈到缫丝厂的事，你总说「难，难，

Who knows when anything will come of it?’
不晓得啥辰光才会成功？」

If you had told me, ‘The agreement is almost settled; payment will be due in ten days or a fortnight,’ naturally I should have kept the money for you.
如果你说∶快谈成功了，十天半个月就要付款，我自然会把你这笔款子留下来。

When you yourself had no certainty, how can you blame me?”
你自己都没有握，怎么能怪我？』

“My certainty is no concern of yours.
『你不必管我有没有把握，

Money expressly assigned to me ought to have been kept for me.”
指明了给我的，你就要留下来。』


This was distinctly brusque.
这话很不客气；

Mi gave a cold laugh. “Had you asked the Master then and there to order the sum transferred, with a separate passbook opened so that it became your deposit, I should have had no right to use it.
宓本常冷笑一声说道∶『如果那时候你请大先生马上交代，照数拨给你，另外立个折子，算是你的存款，我就没有资格用你这笑钱。

Until it was entered in your name, however, the money belonged to Fukang.
没有归到你名下以前，钱是阜康的。

Fukang’s money belongs to the Master, but its management belongs to me.
阜康的钱是大先生所有；不过阜康的钱归我宓某所管。

A man who takes another’s pay must serve his interests faithfully.
受人之禄，忠人之事，

With credit as tight as it is, am I to leave that money idle merely because of a word from the Master, far away in Hangzhou, and guard it until some unknown day when you may want it?
银根这么紧，我不把这笔钱拿来活用；只为远在杭州的大先生的一句话，把这笔钱死死守住，等你不知道哪天来用，

Would that make sense?”
你说有没有这个道理？』

These arguments left Gu without a leg to stand on.
这几句话真是将古应春驳得体无完肤，

He could not argue further and no longer wished to.
他不能跟他辩，也不想跟他辩了。


Mi, however, had more to say. “You know how the Master’s business keeps expanding: he makes one coin do the business of eight or ten.
可是宓本常却还有话∶『你晓得的，大先生的生意愈做愈大，就是因为一个钱要做八个钱、十个钱的生意。

He is always saying, ‘Eight jars and seven lids—keep moving the lids without letting anyone see an uncovered jar, and you know how to do business.’
大先生常常说∶』八个坛子七个盖，盖来盖去不穿帮，就是会做生意。

With the cash available in the market today, we have nothing like seven lids for eight jars.
「以现在市面上的现款来说，岂止八个坛子七个盖？

At most we have half as many lids as jars.
顶多只有一半，

Do you think it is easy to keep everything covered?
我要把他搞得不穿帮，哪里是件容易的事。

Let me ask you this, my dear fellow.
老兄，我请问你，

If a depositor came to withdraw his money today, and the only cash in the vault was that two hundred thousand taels and more, should I refuse to use it?
今天有人来提款，库房里只有那二十几万银子，我不拿来应付，

Should I tell him, ‘That money cannot be touched; it is being kept for Mr Gu to buy silk mills’?
莫非跟客户说∶那笔银子不能动，是为古先生留在那里收买缫丝厂用的？

My dear Mr Gu, at such a moment I tell you I would use not merely Fukang’s own money, but even official funds belonging to the Governor-General of Liangjiang, due to be withdrawn tomorrow to pay the troops.
古先生啊古先生，我老宓跟你，到那时候，不要说本来就是阜康的钱，哪怕是两江总督衙门的官款，明天要提了去给兄弟们关饷，我都要动用。

Fail to satisfy our customers and we shall have a run on the bank at once.
客户这一关过不去，马上就有挤兑的风潮，

That would finish the Master.”
大先生就完完大吉了。

“Sister Luo,” Gu went on with his account, “if what Old Mi said was true, then even if he would not help me, I had nothing to complain of.
『』四姐，老宓的说法，只要是真的，就算不肯帮我忙，我亦没话说。

We both work for Little Uncle, but each of us has his own authority and his own difficulties.
因为虽然都是为小爷叔办事，各有各的权限，各有各的难处，

I could not blame him.”
我不能怪他。

“Then,” she immediately pressed him, “you do blame him now?”
『』那末，『螺蛳太太立即钉一句∶』你现在是怪他罗？

“Yes,” Gu admitted frankly.
『古应春老实答道∶』是的。

“A little.”
有一点。

“In that case Old Mi cannot have been telling the truth, or you would not blame him.
『』这样说起来，是老宓没有说真话！不然你就不会怪他。

Which part of what he said was untrue?”
『螺蛳太太问道∶』他那几句话不真？『


“The part about the shortage of funds, of course.”
『还不是头寸。』

Gu had now drawn the bow and could no longer hold back the arrow.
话到此处，古应春如箭在弦，不发不可，

“He could have arranged the funds.
『他头寸是调得过来的，

Moreover, the money earmarked for purchasing the mills has never been touched.
而且指定了收买缫丝厂的那笔款子，根本没有动，

It is still at HSBC.”
仍旧在汇丰银行。』

Madam Luosi’s expression changed.
一听这话，螺蛳太太动容了，

“Brother-in-law, how do you know he has not touched it?”
『姐夫，』她问，『你怎么知道他没有动过？』

“Someone told me.”
『我听人说的。』

“Who?”
『是哪个？』

“Well—Sister Luo, please do not ask.
『这——』古应春答说∶『四姐，你不必问了。

My information is thoroughly reliable.”
我的消息很靠得住。』

She thought she understood.
螺蛳太太有些明白了，

Zhou Xiaotang, who kept Fukang’s general accounts, was not on particularly good terms with Mi Benchang.
阜康管总帐的周小棠，跟宓本常不甚和睦，

Perhaps he had let the information out.
也许是他透露的消息。


“If you would rather I did not ask, I shall not.
『姐夫要我不问，我就不问。

But there is something else I must ask: what are you going to do now?”
不过我倒要问姐夫，这件事现在怎么办？』

“There is no longer any point in discussing the purchase.
『收买缫丝厂的事，已经不必再谈了。

Even with eighty thousand taels in hand, I could not buy the mill now.
现在就有八万银子，也买不成功；

When Huang Zuoqing saw that I could not produce the cash, he found another buyer and sold it for ninety-five thousand.”
人家黄佐卿看我拿不出现银，另外寻了个户头，卖了九万五千银子。』

Gu shook his head, his face dark with distress.
古应春说到这里，摇一摇头，脸色非常难看，

“What hurts me most, Sister Luo, is that after all my decades in Shanghai, I had to hear something that could make a man spit blood.”
『四姐，我顶难过的是，在上海滩上混了几十年，听了一句教人要吐血的话。』

“Oh!”
『噢！』

Her sympathy was immediate.
螺蛳太太大为同情，

“Tell me what he said.
『你说了出来，

I shall get satisfaction for you.”
我来替你出气。』

“Satisfaction?”
『出气？』

Gu shook his head repeatedly.
古应春连连摇头，

“That would mean fighting among ourselves.
『那一来变成「窝里反」了，

No, no, that would never do.”
不好「不好。』

“Even if I say nothing about it, you must tell me.
『就算我不响，你也要说出来；

Speaking about an injustice makes it easier to bear.”
心里有委屈，说出来就舒服。』

Gu hesitated. “Very well.
古应春沉吟了说∶『好，

I shall tell you.
我说。

That day—”
那天——』


That day—two days before Madam Luosi arrived in Shanghai—Huang Zuoqing had sent Gu an invitation to a banquet with courtesans.
那天——螺蛳太太到上海的前两天，黄佐卿发了个帖子请古应春吃花酒。

Though their business had fallen through, they were still friends, and Gu arrived punctually.
买卖不成，朋友还是朋友，古应春准时赴约；

It was a lively gathering, with nearly twenty guests.
场面很热闹，黄佐卿请了有近二十位的客，

Two tables of mahjong and one of pai gow yielded over a thousand silver dollars in table fees.
两桌麻将，一桌牌九，打了上千大洋的头。

The banquet that followed was arranged with courtesans seated alongside the guests.
接下来吃花酒，摆的是『双双台』；

Counting the women summoned to join them, there were at least fifty people.
客人连叫来的局，不下五十人之多，

The partitions between three large upstairs rooms had to be opened before there was room for four dining tables.
须将整楼三个大房间打通，才摆得下四桌酒。


The guest of honour was the purchaser of Gongheyong, Chen Hesen, the Chaozhou merchants’ “Opium King.”
主客便是收买公和永的潮州帮『鸦片大王』陈和森；

Gu was seated at the same table.
古应春也被邀在这一桌坐。

Amid the clamour of music and singing, Huang raised his cup to him. “Brother Yingchun, I particularly want to drink to you.
笙歌嗷嘈之余，黄佐卿举杯向古应春说道∶『应春兄，我特为要敬你一杯酒；

Had you not been short of funds ten days ago, I should never have discussed Gongheyong with King Chen, and I should have received fifteen thousand taels less.
如果十天之前不是你头寸不便，我就不会跟「陈大王」谈公和永，也就少卖一万五千银子了。

In a manner of speaking, it was you who helped me make that extra fifteen thousand.
说起来这一万五千两，是你老哥挑我赚的，

Ought I not to drink to you?” He laughed heartily and drained his cup.
我是不是应该敬杯酒。』说完哈哈大笑，管自己干了酒。

Having related this, Gu added, “Sister Luo, was he not deliberately trying to humiliate me?
讲完了这一段，古应春又说∶『四姐，你想，这不是他存心给我难堪？

I truly had to swallow my tears.”
当时，我真正是眼泪往肚子里流。』

She grieved for him and felt the injustice even more keenly.
螺蛳太太亦为他难过，更为他不平，

“Does the Master know about this?” she asked.
『这件事，大先生晓不晓得？』她问。


“How could I bring myself to tell him such a thing?
『这件事，我怎么好告诉大先生？

But I have written to him about the failure to buy Gongheyong.”
不过收买公和永不成这一节，我已经写信给大先生了。』

“I heard nothing of it in Hangzhou.”
『我在杭州没有听说。』

Gu considered a moment. “My letter probably had not arrived when you left.”
古应春想了一下说∶『算起来你从杭州动身的时候，我的信还没有到。』


“Very well, we shall say no more about that.
『好！这一节就不去谈它了。

But as for Old Mi holding back the money and deliberately obstructing you, I must certainly question him.”
至于老宓勒住银不放，有意跟你作对，这件事我一定要问问他。』

“No!” Gu exclaimed. “Please think of the larger situation, Sister Luo.
『不！』古应春说∶『请四姐一定要顾大局，

Things are difficult at present; everything depends on our working together.
现在局势不大好，全靠大家同心协力，

If you question him, it is bound to stir up trouble.
你一问他，必生是非，

Whatever you do, please keep this to yourself.”
无论如何请你摆在心里。』

“You know I am like Seventh Sister.
『你晓得的，我也同七姐一样，

If I keep an injustice bottled up, I cannot even eat.
有不平的事，摆在心里，饭都吃不下的。』

So long as I do not give away the complainant, how can he know where my information came from?”
螺蛳太太说∶『我只要不「卖原告」，他哪里知道我的消息是哪里来的。


Seeing her determination, Gu knew he could not dissuade her.
看她态度非常坚决，古应春知道无法打消她的意向；

After some thought he said, “Sister Luo, if you think that merely leaving out my name will keep him from suspecting me, you are deceiving yourself.
考虑了一会说∶『四姐，你以为不提我的名字，他就不会疑心到我，那是自己骗自己。

You need a plausible explanation if you are to put him off the scent.”
你总要有个合情理的说法，才可以瞒得过他。』

“Tell me, then.
『你讲，

What explanation should I give?”
应该怎么个说法？』

“Do you know anyone at HSBC?”
『在汇丰银行，你有没有认识的人？』

She thought for a moment. “There is a Zhang Jitong.
螺蛳太太想了一下说道∶『有个张纪通，

I believe he works there.”
好象是汇丰银行的。』

“Yes, he is HSBC’s second clerk.
『不错，张纪通是汇丰银行「二写」。』

Do you know him well?”
古应春问∶『四姐跟他熟？』

“His wife and I were friends as girls.
『他太太，我们从前是小姊妹。

She made a special trip to Hangzhou to see me last year.”
去年还特为到杭州来看过我。』

“Good.
『好！

Then you have your explanation.
那就有说法了。

If you insist on questioning Old Mi, say this when you see him: ‘Gu Yingchun tells me that Fukang is desperately short of funds.
四姐，你如果一定问这件事，见了老宓就这样子说∶你说，古应春告诉我，阜康的头寸紧得不得了；

Yet I hear from Mrs Zhang Jitong that Fukang has more than two hundred thousand taels sitting untouched at HSBC.’
可是，我听张政通的太太说∶阜康有廿几万银子，一直存在汇丰没有动过。

See what he says to that.”
看他怎么说？』


“I understand.
『我懂了，

I shall give nothing away.
我会说得一点不露马脚；

Tomorrow morning I shall first call on Mrs Zhang, to make the story look genuine.
明天早晨我先去看张太太，做得象真的一样。

I am sure he will have no answer.
我看他一定没话可说；

Then I can reproach him a little and get satisfaction for you.”
那时候我再埋怨他几句，替你出气。』

“Please leave satisfaction out of it.”
『出气这两个字，不必谈它。』

“Very well.
『好，

Let us leave that and discuss your wedding night.”
不谈出气，谈你圆房。』

She changed the subject with startling abruptness. “Even if you will do nothing for your own sake or Ruixiang’s, you must do this for Seventh Sister: hold the wedding while I am here, so that I may drink a cup at your celebration.” Gu finally agreed.
螺蛳太太急转直下地说∶『这件事就算不为你，也不为瑞香，为了七姐，你也要趁我在这里，请我吃这杯喜酒。』古应春终于答应了。

Madam Luosi then explained, point by point, the arrangements she had settled with the Seventh Lady.
于是螺蛳太太便将与七姑奶奶商量好的计划，一一说知；

Matters had gone so far that Gu could only murmur his assent.
事到如今，古应春除了唯唯称是以外，别无话说。


The next morning, as soon as breakfast was over, Madam Luosi urged Ruixiang to get ready to go out.
第二天早饭既毕，螺蛳太太便催瑞香瑞得出门。

This had been agreed the previous evening.
这是前一天晚上就说好了；

But since they would be away all day, Ruixiang had a number of small household matters to arrange, and these delayed her.
但瑞香因为一出门便是一整天，有好些琐屑家务要安排好，因而耽误了工夫，

The Seventh Lady joined in urging her to hurry.
七姑奶奶帮着一催再催，

They were almost out of patience before the two women finally entered the carriage together; a glance at the watch showed that it was already eleven.
快到不耐烦时，方始相偕登车，看表上已经十一点了。

“I could not explain in front of the Seventh Lady just now, but I had a reason for hurrying you.
『刚刚当着七姑奶奶，我不好说，我催你是有道理的，

We were to call briefly on Mrs Zhang, then go to Fukang to get the bank drafts.
先要到张太太家去一趟，稍为坐一坐到阜康去开银票。

The timing is all wrong now.
现在，辰光不对了，

If we arrive at lunchtime, she is sure to keep us for the meal.
吃中饭的时候去了，一定留住；

By the time we have been to Fukang in the afternoon, we shall get nothing done.
下半天等去了阜康，就办不成事了。

One must take one’s time choosing jewellery, or nine times out of ten one regrets it.
看首饰不能心急；不然十之八九要后悔。

We shall have to miss the Zhangs.”
现在，没法子，张家只好不去了。』

“It is all my fault,” Ruixiang said with an apologetic smile. “Why did you not tell me earlier, Madam?”
『都是我不好。』瑞香陪笑说道∶『太太何不早跟我说一句。』


“I did not know you could dawdle so!
『我也不晓得你这么会磨！

Fiddling with this and that until you forget the time.
摸东摸西，忘记掉辰光。

Oh—and remember: when I tell Mr Mi that we have come from the Zhangs, do not say anything that will give the game away.” Ruixiang agreed and accompanied her by sedan chair to Fukang.
喔！』螺蛳太太特为关照∶『回头我同宓先生说，我们是从张家来，你不要多说什么，免得拆穿西洋镜。』瑞香答应着，随同螺蛳太太坐轿子到了阜康；

Mi Benchang naturally treated Madam Luosi as an honoured guest.
宓本常自然奉如上宾，

His courtesies were meticulous: beginning with Old Madam Hu, he asked after every member of the family in turn.
他的礼貌很周到，从胡老太太起，胡家全家，——问到。

He then turned his attentions to Ruixiang and asked with a broad smile, “Miss Rui, when are you going to invite us to your wedding feast?”
接下来又敷衍瑞香，笑嘻嘻地问道∶『瑞姑娘，哪天请我们吃喜酒？』


Ruixiang blushed and said nothing.
瑞香红着脸不答；

“Soon, soon!” Madam Luosi answered for her.
螺蛳太太接口∶『快了，快了！』

“That is why we have come to the bank today.
她说∶『今天就是为此到钱庄来的，

I should like to withdraw two thousand taels.
我想支两千银子，

I also have the Seventh Lady’s passbook here.”
七姑奶奶也有个折子在这。』

She took it out and found a balance of more than four thousand five hundred taels.
取出七姑奶奶的折子来一看，存银四千五百余两，

On her own authority, she withdrew another two thousand from that account, making four thousand in all, and asked Mi to issue a dozen or so bank drafts in assorted amounts.
螺蛳太太作主，也提二千，一共是四千银子，关照宓本常开出数目大小不等的十来张银票，

Once she had counted and received them, she was ready to raise Gu’s affairs.
点收清楚，要谈古应春的事了。

“Mr Mi,” she asked casually, “how has business been in Shanghai lately?”
『宓先生，』她闲闲问说∶『这一晌，上海市面怎么样？』

“Bad, bad!
『不好，不好！

Money grows tighter every day.”
银根愈来愈紧了。』

“And at our Fukang?”
『我们阜康呢？』

“Tight here too, of course.”
『当然也紧。』


“If money is tight,” she said with a look of bewilderment, “why do we leave more than two hundred thousand taels at HSBC without touching it?”
『既然紧，』螺蛳太太摆出一脸困惑的神情，『为啥我们有廿几万银子摆在汇丰银行，动都不动？』

Mi’s heart gave a jolt.
一听这话，宓本常心里一跳；

He was struggling for an answer when she unexpectedly added a question that allowed him to breathe again.
正在难于作答时，不道螺蛳太太又添了一句话，让松了口气。

“Is this the money borrowed from HSBC?”
『这笔款子是不是汇丰借出来的？』

“Yes.”
『是的。』


“Naturally, interest must be paid on money borrowed from HSBC.
『汇丰借出来的款子，当然要出利息；

A deposit there earns interest too, but surely the rate they charge on a loan is higher than the rate they pay on a deposit?”
存在汇丰虽也有利息，不过一定放款利息高，存款利息低，是不是？』

“Yes.”
『是的。』

“Then we borrow their money and leave it with them, paying the difference in interest for nothing.
『借他的钱又存在他那里，白贴利息的差额；

Mr Mi, I cannot quite follow the reckoning.”
宓先生，这把算盘是怎么打的，我倒不太懂了。』

By now Mi had thought of an ingenious excuse with which to fend her off.
这时宓本常已经想好了一个很巧的理由，可以搪塞；

At his leisure, he replied, “Madam Luo, there is a great deal to be learned here.
因而好整以暇地答说∶『罗四太太，这里头学问很大，

I am not boasting: I discovered the secret only after working for the Master for more than ten years.
不是我吹，其中的诀窍是我跟了大先生十几年才摸出来的。

Let us eat first, and I shall explain it to you slowly.”
我们先吃饭，等我慢慢讲给罗四太太你听。』

It was lunchtime, and Mi had already made preparations, so she accepted readily.
已是午饭辰光，而且宓本常已有预备，螺蛳太太也就不客气了。

Seating them posed some difficulty, however. There was no lady of the household to accompany her, while Ruixiang, conscious of their difference in status, would not sit at the same table.
不过既无堂客相陪，而瑞香的身分不同，不肯与螺蛳太太同桌，却颇费安排；

In the end two dishes were set aside for Ruixiang to eat elsewhere, and Mi kept Madam Luosi company over lunch and conversation.
最后是分了两样菜让瑞香在另一处吃，密本常陪螺蛳太太一面吃、一面谈。


“Madam Luo, I imagine it was Yingchun who told you that Fukang had money deposited at HSBC?”
『罗四太太，阜康有款子存在汇丰，想来是应春告诉你的？』

“No,” she answered composedly. “I called on a Mrs Zhang today.
『不是。』螺蛳太太从从容容地答说∶『今天去看一个张太太，

Her husband works at HSBC too.
他们老爷也在汇丰，

She told me.”
是她告诉我的。』

“Ah, is that Zhang written with ‘bow’ and ‘long,’ or Zhang written with ‘stand’ and ‘early’?”
『呃，是弓长张，还是立早章？』

“The one with ‘bow’ and ‘long.’”
『弓长张。』

“Then it must be Zhang Jitong?”
『那末是张纪通？』

“Yes.
『对的，

Her husband’s name is Zhang Jitong.”
他们老爷叫张纪通。』


Mi knew perfectly well that she was lying.
宓本常心想，螺蛳太太明明是撒谎。

Zhang Jitong was a friend of his; they had played cards together only the previous evening.
张纪通跟他也是朋友，前一天还在一起打牌；

At one in the morning, Zhang, the heaviest loser, had insisted on another four rounds to try to recover his money.
打到深夜一点钟，张纪通大输家，『扳轿杠』一定要再打四圈。

Someone had teased him: “Old Zhang, you always go home on the stroke of twelve.
当时就有人说∶『老张，你向来一到十二点，一定要回去的。

If you stay out all night today, are you not afraid your wife will make you kneel on abacus beads and balance a chamber-pot lid on your head?”
今天夜不归营，不怕张大嫂罚你跪算珠珠、顶马桶盖。』

Zhang was afraid of his wife, hence the joke.
原来张纪通惧内，所以这样打趣他；

But he had slapped his chest and declared, “No fear, no fear!
哪知他拍一拍胸脯说∶『放心，放心，

The tigress went back to her family in Changshu the day before yesterday, for her nephew’s wedding.”
雌老虎前天回常熟娘家，去吃她侄儿的喜酒去了。』

Here was an attempt at concealment that only made the truth more conspicuous.
这是所谓『欲盖弥彰』，

It gave Mi further confirmation that Gu had disclosed the HSBC deposit.
愈发可以证实，汇丰存款的消息是古应春所泄露。

He said nothing to expose the lie, however.
不过他绝不说破，

Instead, he assumed an expression of regret towards Gu.
相反地，在脸上表现了对古应春抱歉的神态。


“Madam Luosi, all Fukang’s deposits and loans are recorded in the books, including this deposit at HSBC.
『螺蛳太太，阜康的存款、放款都有帐可查的，存在汇丰的这笔款子当然也有帐；

But the extra interest we pay each month does not appear as a loss.
不过每个月倒贴的利息，在帐上看不出是亏损。

Why?
啥道理呢？

The difference in the rates is 0.15 percent a month, which costs us about four hundred taels monthly.
这笔利息的差额是一厘半，算起来每个月大概要贴四百两银子，

I enter it among our expenses, as a legitimate operating cost.”
我是打开销里面，算正当支出。』

He paused to observe her expression.
说到这里他停了下来，看螺蛳太太的表情。

Naturally, she looked astonished.
她当然是面现惊异之色，

“A legitimate operating cost?” she asked, as if she must have misheard.
『是正当开支？』她问，仿佛自己听错了似的。

Had her expression remained unchanged, Mi could not have been sure she had taken in his words.
『如果她声色不动，宓本常便不能确定，她是不是把他的话听了进去；

Surprise was the natural response and increased his confidence that he could dispel her doubts.
而惊讶却是正常的，他就更有把握能将她的疑团消除了。


“Exactly.
『不错，

A legitimate expense—as necessary as the money spent maintaining relations with officials at New Year and the other festivals.
是正当开支，好比逢年过节要应酬官场一样，是必不可少的正当开支。』

You know, Madam Luosi, that Fukang depends entirely on deposits from public offices and wealthy households.
他说∶『螺蛳太太，你晓得的，阜康全靠公家同大户的存款，

We pay less interest than other banks.
阜康的利息比人家低，

Why do people still put their money with us?
为啥愿意存阜康，

Because we are dependable. If someone begins to doubt that and comes to withdraw his deposit, one or two withdrawals do no harm.
就因为可靠如果有人存点疑惑怕靠不住，来提存款，一个两个不要紧，

But if the numbers grow, word spreads, and a run begins, there will be only one road left for me.”
人一多，消息一传，那个风潮一闹开来，螺蛳太太我就只有一条路好走。』

“Oh?
『喔！

What road is that?”
哪一条路？』


“The road to death.
『死路。

A rope, or three mace of opium.
不是一条绳子，就是三钱鸦片烟。』

I could repay the Master only in my next life.”
宓本常说∶『我只有来生报答大先生了。』

Shrewd as she was, Madam Luosi could not help being moved by this carefully contrived display of loyalty and responsibility.
螺蛳太太再精明，也不能不为宓本常蓄意表示尽忠负责的神态所感动，

“Mr Mi, you must not talk like that!
『宓先生，你不要这么说！

So long as you do your utmost in good faith, things cannot fail to turn out well.
只要你实心实力，一定不会没有好结果。』

The Master knows how loyal you are.”
她说∶『你的忠心，大先生晓得的。』

“For his sake, even offending people is worthwhile.”
『就为了大先生得罪了人也值得。』

Mi immediately brought the conversation back to his point.
宓本常马上又将话拉回来，

“With Fukang’s golden signboard, I need not go out soliciting deposits.
『螺蛳太太，有阜康这块金字招牌，存款不必我去兜揽，

They come to our door of their own accord.
自会送上门来。

My method is to polish that signboard until it positively shines, without the smallest blemish.
我的做法，就是要把我们的这块金字招牌擦得晶光丈亮，不好有一点点不干净的地方。

Keeping money at HSBC and paying the difference in interest is how I protect our reputation.”
款子存在汇丰，倒贴利息，就是我保护金字招牌的办法。』

“I see, I see.”
『嗯！嗯！』

She thought for a moment. “You mean that leaving those two hundred thousand taels and more untouched at HSBC makes Fukang appear amply supplied with ready money.
螺蛳太太想了一会说∶『你的意思是阜康有廿几万银子在汇丰，不去动它，显得阜康的头寸很宽裕，

People feel reassured and do not come to withdraw their deposits.”
人家就放心不来提存了。』

“Exactly!
『一点不错。

Madam Luosi, you are a true expert.”
螺蛳太太，你真是内行。』

Mi raised his cup and took a long drink, unable to conceal his satisfaction.
宓本常举一举杯，自己喝了一大口，得意之情，溢于言表。


“So that is the trick.
『原来有这样一招在里面。

Necessity drove you to it, then.”
说起来也是迫不得已。』

“At first it was necessity.
『先是迫不得已，

Later I understood the principle and saw that it was really the right thing to do.
后来我才悟出诀窍，实在是正当的做法，

We ought to do it even when money is not tight.
就银根不紧，也应该这么办。

Once the fifth concubine of Intendant Zhou, who lives on French Main Road, came to withdraw some money.
有一回法大马路周道台的五姨太来提款，

I asked her, ‘Are you transferring it to HSBC?
我说∶你是不是要转存汇丰？

If so, I can give you a draft on HSBC.
如果要存汇丰，我打汇丰的票子给你，

The transfer will be convenient, and you will lose nothing in exchange deductions when the money goes out and comes in.
转帐不但方便，而且进出不必「贴水」，

It will be more economical.’
比较划算。

Madam Luosi, what do you think she said?”
螺蛳太太，你道她听了我的话怎么说？』

“I cannot guess.
『我猜不着。

What did she say?”
她怎么说？』



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第5部分，共6部分）
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“She said, ‘Never mind, then.
『她说∶算了，算了。

My husband says money is tight and Fukang might not have ready silver when we urgently need it, so a foreign bank would be safer.
我们老爷说，现在市面上银根紧，阜康只怕要紧要慢的时候，没有现银，不如存到外国银行。

But after what you have said, I feel rather ashamed.
现在听人你这样子说，我倒不好意思了。

I shall leave it with you.’
还是存在你们这里好了。

Madam Luosi, that taught me a trick.
螺蛳太太，我当时悟出一个诀窍，

We must polish our golden signboard with foreign metal polish.
我们这块金字招牌，要用外国货的擦铜油来擦。

What is that polish?
啥叫外国货的擦铜油，

Dealings with foreign banks.
就是跟外国银行往来，

I mean to open an account with every one of them.
我要到所有外国银行去开户头，

If a customer like Intendant Zhou’s fifth concubine comes to withdraw money, I shall ask which foreign bank’s draft she wants.
象遇到周家五姨太那种来提存的户头，我问她要哪家外国银行的票子，

Whichever she names, she shall have it.
说哪家就是哪家；

Would that not make Fukang’s name more impressive still?”
这一下阜康的招牌不是更响了。』

Madam Luosi found his argument persuasive and followed it closely.
螺蛳太太因为他的话中听，所以能够深入，

Now a question occurred to her. “A fine method, but would it not leave large sums lying idle in those banks?”
这时听出来一个疑问∶『法子是蛮好，不过这一来不是有大笔头寸搁在那里了？』

Mi waved both hands. “No, no!
『哪里，哪里！』宓本常乱摇着双手，

That would be foolish.”
『那样做法不是太笨了？』

“What is the clever way, then?”
『不笨怎么办？』

“There is another trick.
『这里头又有诀窍了。

Open an account at each bank and deposit two or three thousand taels.
每家银行开个户头，存个三两千银子；
