Li, though unwilling openly to defy respectable public opinion, secretly used every means to remove the war party's support and weaken its power and prestige.
李鸿章则表面虽不敢违犯清议，但暗中却用尽了釜底抽薪的手段，削弱主战派的力量及声势。

His first target was Zhang Peilun, the Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief, chief strategist for Grand Secretary Li Hongzao, leader of the war party.
第一个目标是左副都御史张佩纶，因为他是主战派领袖大学士李鸿藻的谋主，

Bringing Zhang under control would be like capturing the leader to subdue the band.
制服他亦就是擒贼擒王之意。

In terms of suppressing the advocates of war, winning Zhang over dealt with the root; attacking Hu dealt with the branches.
就压制主战派这个目的来说，收服张佩纶是治本，打击胡雪岩是治标。


Hu, who would bear the first blow, knew nothing of this.
可是首当其冲的胡雪岩，却还睡在鼓里，

On reaching Jiangning, he went first to rest at his own residence.
到了江宁，先到他自己所置的公馆休息。

He kept houses in the great cities but rarely visited them even once a year.
胡雪岩在通都大邑，都置有公馆，但一年难得一到，

Because of Zuo, this was his second stay at Jiangning that year.
江宁因为左宗棠的关系，这年是第二次来往。

The “mistress” of this house was surnamed Wang.
这个公馆的“女主人”姓王，

She had formerly run a brothel in Diaoyu Lane in Qinhuai's Old Quarter, but misfortune had struck her two adopted daughters in succession: one died for love, and the other eloped.
原是秦淮“旧院”钓鱼巷的者鸨，运气不佳，两个养女，连着出事，一个殉情，一个私奔，

The elopement could be left alone, but the death involved Madam Wang in a homicide case.
私奔的可以不追究，殉情的却连累老鸨吃了人命官司，

She was finally acquitted and released, yet so disheartened that she no longer wished to earn her living by that precarious trade.
好不容易才得无罪被释，心灰意懒再不愿意吃这碗“把势饭”了。

The only alternative was to leave it and marry.
既然如此，只有从良之一途。

Like Li Xiangjun's adoptive mother in Miscellaneous Records of Banqiao, she was a madam without being old, only a little over thirty and still attractive.
这个王鸨，就象《板桥杂记》中所写的李香君的假母那样，虽鸨不老，三十出头年纪，丰韵犹存，

There were men willing to offer riches for her.
要从良亦着实有人愿量珠来聘。

But Qinhuai courtesans inherited the Old Quarter's traditions from the late Ming and early Qing.
但秦淮的勾栏中人，承袭了明末清初“旧院”的遗风，

They cared about refinement in food and daily life and admired poets and cultivated men.
讲究饮食起居，看得骚人墨客，

Those who wanted her had fortunes but no trace of elegance; those she wanted were gentle and refined but poor.
而看中她的，腰有万金之缠，身无一骨之雅；她看中的，温文尔雅，不免寒酸。

She wished to leave the profession, yet could find no one to entrust her future to.
因而空有从良之志，难得终身之托。


That was three years earlier.
这是三年前的事，

Jiangning Fukang had just acquired a new manager, Jiang Deyuan, transferred from another Fukang establishment.
江宁阜康新换一个档手，名叫江德源，此人是由阜康调过来的，

Well versed in the world of pleasure, he heard of her and hired her to manage Hu's residence.
深通风月，得知有王鸨这么一个人，延聘她来当“胡公馆”的管家，

Normally it entertained especially important clients; when the proprietor visited, she became its hostess, presiding over the household.
平时作为应酬特等客户的处所，等“东家”到江宁，她便是“主持中馈”的“主妇”。

Those duties naturally extended to the bedroom.
当然，这“主妇”的责任，也包括房帏之事在内。

Comfortable living and freedom from restraint made her readily accept.
王鸨为胡公馆的饮食起居舒服，且又不受拘束，欣然同意。

When Hu came that autumn, the first thing to attract him was the pair of tiny curved feet beneath her skirt, slender as crescent moons.
那年秋天，胡雪岩到江宁，首先就看中了她的裙下双钩，纤如新月，

After a night together, he found Yuan Zicai's saying true: “A mature woman's charms surpass those of youth.”
一夕缱绻，真如袁子才所说的“徐娘风味胜雏年”，

Besides generous gifts, he gave her the name Mother Wang Jiu, after the brothel keeper in the famous Southern Song tale set on West Lake, The Oil Vendor Wins the Flower Queen.
厚赠以外，送了她一个外号叫做“王九妈”，南宋发生在西湖上的，有名的“卖油郎独占花魁女”的故事，其中的老鸨就叫王九妈。

Now, warned by Jiang, she had prepared Hu's favourite food and gathered plenty of news to entertain him.
这王九妈已得到江德源的通知，早就迎合胡雪岩的喜好，除饮食方面有预备以外，另外还打听了许多新闻，作为陪伴闲谈的资料。


Naturally, Hu cared most about news of Zuo.
这些新闻中，胡雪岩最关切的，自然是有关左宗棠的情形。

He was said to be increasingly old and infirm, but more overbearing than ever.
据说他衰病侵寻，意气更甚，

Visitors and subordinates must never mention the western campaign: it opened a floodgate of talk about his achievements, his combination of kindness and authority in handling generals, and the miraculous unpredictability of his strategy.
接见僚属宾客，不能谈西征，一谈便开了他的“话匣子”，铺陈西征的勋业，御将如何恩威并用，用兵如何神奇莫测。

Then came the abuse, first of Zeng Guofan, next of Li Hongzhang, and sometimes of Shen Baozhen too.
再接下来便要骂人，第一个被骂的是曾国藩，其次是李鸿章，有时兼骂沈葆祯。

All three had preceded him in office, and many of their former subordinates remained in Jiangning, especially Zeng's.
这三个人都是左宗棠的前任，有好些旧部在江宁，尤其是曾国藩故旧更多，

Whatever might be said of Li, people resented attacks on Zeng's character.
而且就人品来说，左宗棠骂李鸿章犹可，骂曾国藩则不免令人不服，

Zeng's old followers often complained openly: “The present commander has grievances against the old commander.
因此，曾国藩的旧部，每每大庭广众之间批评他说：“大帅对老帅有意见，

The rights and wrongs between them are hard to judge.
他们之间的恩怨，亦难说得很。

Even if the old commander was at fault, he is dead and cannot hear the abuse.
就算老帅不对，人都过去了，也听不见他的骂，

Why must we endure it?
何必在我们面前罗嗦。

Besides, the arguments are neither just nor convincing.
而且道理不直，话亦不圆，

It all comes down to the same thing: he monopolized military funds and protected Ninth Marshal.
说来说去，无非老帅把持饷源，处处回护九帅，

We have heard it until our ears have grown calluses.” Hu wondered how Zuo could have declined so much in the mere six months since they last met.
耳朵里都听得生茧了。”胡雪岩心想，也不过半年未见左宗棠，何以老境颓唐至此？

He was doubtful until Jiang confirmed it.
便有些不大相信，及至一问江德源，果然如此，他说：

“Many things cannot be done in Jiangning now.
“江宁现在许多事办不通。

His Excellency begins with a lecture, then starts abusing people, talking without pause.
为什么呢？左大人先开讲，后开骂，一个人滔滔不绝，

When the allotted time is nearly over, a guard puts a teacup into his hand and someone outside immediately calls, ‘See the guest out!’
说到时候差不多了，戈什哈把茶碗交到他手里，外面伺候的人马上喊一声‘送客’。

There is no chance to discuss business.”
根本就没法子谈公事。”


“Surely that happens only occasionally?”
“这是难得一次吧？”

“Almost every day.
“哪里？可说天天如此。”

He becomes more excited with a larger audience.
江德源说，“左大人有点‘人来疯’，人越多他越起劲。

You needn't stand on ceremony, sir.
大先生亦不必讲究礼节。

Instead of attending a formal audience, go now and see him in the garden reception room or his office.
‘上院，去见，不如就此刻在花厅或者签押房里见，

Then you might discuss something useful.”
倒可以谈点正经。”

Governors-general and governors generally received the provincial treasurer and judicial commissioner, together with circuit intendants and lesser subordinates, about once every five days, often on dates ending in three or eight.
原来督抚接见“两司”——藩司、桌司以及道员以下的僚属，大致五天一次，“衙参”之期定在逢三、逢八的日子居多，

These formal visits, called “going up to the court,” took place in the official reception hall.
接见之处，称为“官厅”，而衙参称之为“上院”。

Hu had arrived on the seventeenth of the tenth lunar month and intended to attend on the eighteenth.
胡雪岩到的这天是十月十七，原想第二天“上院”，

Accepting Jiang's advice, he instead put on his official robes at once and went straight by sedan chair to the Liangjiang governor-general's gates.
如今听江德源这一说，决定接受他的建议，当即换了官服，坐轿直闯两江总督的辕门。


Seeing the God of Wealth, the gatekeepers were exceptionally attentive.
辕门上一看“胡财神”到了，格外巴结，

On their own authority they opened the main gate and let his sedan be carried to the eaves of the reception hall.
擅作主张开正门，让轿子抬到官厅檐前下轿，

Word was sent inside, and instructions came back: “Ask His Excellency Hu to change into informal clothes.
随即通报到上房，传出话来：“请胡大人换了便服，

We shall meet in the office.”
在签押房见面。”

His attendant opened the clothes bundle, and Hu changed in the hall before being shown into the office, where Zuo was already waiting.
于是跟班打开衣包，就在官厅上换了便服，引人签押房，左宗棠已经在等了，

Hu naturally made his full ceremonial greeting.
胡雪岩自然是行大礼请安，

Zuo helped him up himself and led him to the guest seats, where they exchanged the usual courtesies.
左宗棠亲手相扶，延入客座，少不得有一番寒暄。

As they spoke, Hu studied his eyes.
胡雪岩一面说话，一面细看左宗棠的眼睛，

A white film covered the left, while the right watered badly in a draught, forcing him to wipe it repeatedly with a silk handkerchief.
左眼已长了一层白翳，右眼见风流泪，非常厉害，不时拿一块绸绢擦拭，

Finding an opening, Hu said, “I heard your eyes were troubling you and had a special medicine prepared.
于是找一个空隙说道：“听说大人的眼睛不好，我特为配了一副眼药来，

It is cooling and clears the sight, with very good results.”
清凉明目，很有效验，”

Undoing a small brocade bundle he had brought, he added, “I also had a medicinal paste made for you.
说着，将随手携带的一个小锦袱解开来又说：“还替大人配了一服膏滋药，

If it agrees with you, have your correspondence secretary write, and I shall send more.”
如果服得好，请大人交代书启师爷写信来，我再送来。”

“Thank you!
“多谢，多谢！”

Nowadays I depend on a few friends for help, not just with private matters; even official business must trouble you.
左宗棠说：“我现在多靠几个朋友帮忙，不但私务，连公事都要累你。

When Shandong suffered floods, Liangjiang was assigned four hundred thousand taels for relief, and the provincial treasury could provide only half.
上次山东闹水灾，两江派助赈四十万，藩库只拿得出一半，

Your generous help saved us.
多亏你慷慨援手。

But Liangjiang still cannot repay you.”
不过，这笔款子，两江还无法奉还。”

“Please don't mention it.” Hu nearly added that, with public funds deposited with him, he ought to be of service, but checked the words before speaking.
“大人不必挂齿。”胡雪岩原想再说一句：“有官款在我那里，我是应该效劳的。”但话到口边，又缩了回去。


“With the situation in Vietnam urgent, the court has ordered Peng Xueqin to supervise military affairs in Guangdong.
“这一回越南吃紧，朝命彭雪琴督办广东军务，

We have been friends for thirty years, and I must help him.
我跟他三十年的交情，不能不助他一臂之力，

Moreover, I have been commanded to prepare southern maritime defences.
而况我奉旨筹办南洋防务，

The waters off Guangdong and Fujian fall within my jurisdiction; I cannot neglect them.
粤闽洋面，亦在我管辖之下，其势更不能兼筹并顾。

What infuriates me is that, since Zeng of Xiangxiang's time, officialdom in Liangjiang has grown steadily worse.
可恨的是，两江官场，从曾湘乡以来，越搞越坏，

Evasion and delay, with no thought for the wider situation—so once again I must rely on old friends.”
推拖敷衍，不顾大局，以致于我又要靠老朋友帮忙了。”

Hu assented gravely.
“是。”胡雪岩很沉重地答应着。

“Wang Langqing has left Beijing for Hunan to recruit six thousand men.
“王阆青已经出京回湖南去招兵了，打算招六千人，

He will need at least four thousand rifles.
总要有四千支枪才够用。

Li Shaoquan's elder brother-in-law has made a complete mess of the Jiangning Arsenal.
江宁的军械局，为李少荃的大舅子搞得一塌糊涂，

If we order the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau to produce them, first the money is not yet available, and second they cannot arrive in time for the emergency.
交上海制造局赶办，第一是经费尚无着落，其次是时间上缓不济急，

So I thought the Transport Bureau might find a way.
所以我想由转运局来想法了。

What do you say, Xueyan?”
雪岩，你说呢？

“I don't yet know the exact number of Western rifles in stock.
““转运局库存洋枪，细数我还不知道。

But if you require four thousand, I shall find some means of supplying the full number.”
不过大人既然交代要四千支，我无论如何要想法子办齐。”

“Good!
“好！”

I knew that a word to you would settle it.
左宗棠说：“我就知道，跟你商量不过是一句话的事，

Nothing could be more satisfying.”
最痛快不过。”

Referring to himself respectfully by his personal name, Hu replied, “Guangyong owes everything to your patronage.
“光塘……”胡雪岩称名谦谢：“承大人栽培，

I dare not fail to serve you with all my heart and strength.”
不敢不尽心尽力伺候。”


“You are too modest.
“好说，好说。

There is something else.
还有件事，

The Ministry of Revenue will of course arrange pay and provisions for Wang's recruits, but the cost of mobilizing them is considerable.
王阆青招来的兵，粮饷自然由户部去筹划，一笔开拔费，数目可观，

Liangjiang must contribute what it can.
两江不能不量力相助。

Could you help us once more?”
雪岩，你能不能再帮两江一个忙？”

In the past, Hu would simply have asked how much.
如果是过去，胡雪岩一定会问：“要多少？”

Circumstances were different now.
但目前情形不同，

After a little thought, he replied, “Your Excellency, money is desperately tight in the market.
他想了一下说：“回大人的话，现在市面上银根紧得不得了，

Even if it were not, you must consider your old subordinate.
就是不紧，大人要顾到老部下。

If I raise whatever you ask now and later cannot supply Shaanxi and Gansu, I shall be like a man who jumps into a well to rescue someone.”
如今我遵大人的吩咐，要多少筹多少，到了陕甘接济不上时，就变成从井救人了。”

The old subordinate was Liu Jintang.
所谓“老部下”是指刘锦棠，

Hu held a commission with the western expedition's Transport Bureau, and his responsibilities had an order of priority.
而胡雪岩又是西征转运局的委员，在他的职司有主有从，

Raising funds for Liangjiang was additional work, which he could undertake if he had capacity to spare.
如两江筹饷是额外的差使，行有余力，不妨效劳，

Otherwise, the western army must come first.
否则他当然要顾全西征军为主。

Zuo understood and could not disregard the concern.
左宗棠了解到这一点，便不能不有所顾虑，

“Very well.
想了一下说道：“这样吧，

Tomorrow I shall speak to the provincial treasurer again.
明天我再找藩司来想法子。

If there really is difficulty, we shall have to rely on you to come to our rescue.”
如果真有难处，那就不能不仰赖老兄拔刀相助了。”

“You are too kind.
“大人言重。”

When should I return for instructions?”
胡雪岩问道：“不知道什么时候再来请示。”

By instructions, Hu meant the answer.
“请示”便是听回音。

“Soon.
左宗棠答说：“很快、很快，

There will be news within two or three days.”
三两天之内，就有信息。”

Hu rose.
于是胡雪岩起身说道：

“I shall act as you direct.
“我听大人的指挥办理，

For today, I take my leave.”
今天就告辞了。”

“Are you free this evening?”
“嗯，嗯。”左宗棠问：“今天晚上没事吧？”

Realizing that Zuo meant to invite him to dinner, Hu quickly said that he had an engagement he could not miss.
胡雪岩知道要留他吃饭，急说道：“今天晚上有个不能不去的饭局。”

“Then I won't keep you.
“既然如此，我不留你了。

I know you are busy.
我知道你事情多，

There is no need to call again.
不必来看我，

When there is news, I shall send for you.”
等有了信息，我自然会派人来请你。”


After his farewell salute, Hu went to a banquet in a riverside house on the Qinhuai.
于是胡雪岩请安辞出。接着便转往秦淮河河房去赴宴会，

The guests were prominent men in Jiangning officialdom, unusually well informed, and he learned much inside news.
在座的都是江宁官场上提得起来的人物，消息特别灵通，胡雪岩倒是听了许多内幕，

Li Hongzhang was said to have formally told the Zongli Yamen that China's strength was insufficient and the Vietnamese affair must be settled promptly: there was no other satisfactory course.
据说李鸿章已向总理衙门正式表明他的看法，中国实力不足，对越南之事应早结束，舍此别无良法。

The Yamen, however, favoured notifying the countries of the world of France's coercion and unreasonable demands, making clear that the fault lay with France.
但总理衙门主张将法国对中国种种挟制及无理的要求，照会世界各国，以明其曲在彼。

If French troops attacked, China should fight.
如果法军来犯，即与开战。

Li disagreed, but even if he wanted negotiations, he had no one to negotiate with: the French special envoy Tricou had left for Japan.
李鸿章虽不以为然，无奈他想谈和，连对手都没有，法国的特使德理固已转往日本去了。

“China's difficulty is that we want peace but dare not make it, and want war but cannot fight it,” said Zhang Fengchi, an expectant circuit intendant serving as foreign-affairs commissioner at the governor-general's headquarters.
“中国的若恼是，欲和不敢和，欲战不能战。”督署的洋务委员候补道张凤池说：

“Now each side is trying to outlast the other.
“现在是彼此‘耗’的局面，

The question is which can do it.”
就不知道谁耗得过谁了？”

“Who do you think will last longer, Mr Feng?”
“那么，照凤翁看，是哪个耗得过哪个？”

“Hard to say.
“这一层很难说。

In France, only the foreign minister was initially so intransigent, but opinion has now become united.
不过，在法国，原来只有他们的外务部长最强硬，现在意见已经融洽了，

Their premier told parliament that they were determined to fight to the end in Vietnam.
他们的内阁总理在国会演说：决心在越南打到底。

Meanwhile, our court's two great pillars may not be fire and water, but they are certainly pulling in opposite directions and cannot agree.
而我们呢，朝廷两大柱石，纵不说势如水火，可是南辕北辙，说不到一起，

That is deeply worrying.”
大为可虑。”

The two pillars were plainly Li and Zuo.
所谓“朝廷两大住石”，自是指李鸿章与左宗棠。

Most guests were Liangjiang officials, but many had close ties to Li.
在座的虽以两江的官员居多，但其中跟李鸿章渊源甚深的也不少，

Their quarrel was a dangerous topic: an incautious word could bring trouble.
谈到李、左不和，是个犯忌讳的话题，如果出言不慎，会惹麻烦上身，

Everyone remained silent.
所以都保持着沉默。


Everyone, that is, except one man.
只有一个人是例外，

Yugui, an expectant circuit intendant in Shandong, was a Mongol Bannerman.
此人是山东的一个候补道，名叫玉桂，蒙古旗人，

He had formerly awaited appointment in Liangjiang, acted in an established circuit post and held many assignments.
原来在两江候补，署道实缺，也当过好些差使，

Senior in service and the oldest man present, he was called Brother Yu by everyone.
资格甚老，年纪最长，大家都叫他“王大哥”。

Clear-minded and ready to shoulder responsibility, he should have risen as an able official, but his blunt speech had harmed his prospects.
此人理路很明白，勇于任事，本来是应该红起来的一个能员，只以心直口快，妨了他的官运。

The Shandong governor had sent him to consult Zuo about dredging the Grand Canal.
这回是奉山东巡抚所派，到江宁来谒见左宗棠，商议疏浚运河，

He had spent half a month in Jiangning without getting anywhere, leaving him full of grievances.
哪知来了半个月，始终不得要领，以致牢骚满腹，

At mention of the quarrel, he could not remain silent.
一提到李左不和，忍不住要开口了。

“Lords Zuo and Li have illustrious achievements and the admiration of the empire.
“左、李两公，勋业彪炳，天下仰望，

The court has rewarded them with titles and high office.
朝廷酬庸有功，封侯拜相，

Their past military services are past; there is no need to keep discussing them.
过去的战功是过去了，可以不谈了，

A true hero doesn't boast of former valour.
好汉不提当年勇，

Why do it?”
何必呢？”

He plainly meant Zuo.
这明明是在说左宗棠。

With the great official so near at hand, the subject became more perilous still, and nobody dared say a word.
八座咫尺，忌讳益甚，更没有人敢置一词。

Slightly tipsy, Yugui took their silence as approval and grew more animated.
有了三分酒意的玉桂，只当大家默许他的议论，因而就更起劲了，

“In war, speed is everything.
“如说打仗，兵贵神速，

If we talk emptily all day and neglect real work, what happens when the enemy reaches the city walls while we are still boasting that the spring wind has already passed the Jade Gate?
倘或一天到晚说空话，正事不只，到得兵临城下，还在大谈春风已度玉门关，

Think what a state we shall be in!”
各位倒想，那会弄成怎么一个局面？”

The guests exchanged frightened looks.
听得这番话，座客相顾失色。

His closer friends were particularly worried.
有跟玉桂交情比较深的，便很替他担心，

If this reached Zuo, Yugui would certainly be summoned.
因为这话一传到左宗棠耳朵里，就一定会找上他去，

A severe scolding would be the least of it.
如果只是痛斥一顿倒还罢了，

What if Zuo asked, “What troops do you mean at the city walls?
就怕找了他去质问：你说“兵临城下”是什么兵？

The French?”
是法国军队吗？

In anger, he could impeach Yugui by name for alarming the public and undermining civilian and military morale.
一怒之下，指名严劾，安上他一个危言惑众、动摇民心士气的罪名，

Dismissal would be the minimum punishment.
起码也是一个革职的处分。

Someone hurriedly changed the subject.
于是有人便乱以他语：

“Brother Yu, tonight let us discuss only pleasant things.
“玉大哥、玉大哥，今宵只可谈风月，

Drink, drink!”
喝酒，喝酒。”


Yugui wanted to continue, but their host, Zhang Fengchi, seized his opportunity.
王桂还想再说，作主人的张凤池见机，大声说道：

“Brother Yu's black-faced roles ring like great bells and will sober us up.
“玉大哥的黑头、黄钟仲吕，可以醒酒，

Come, give us a passage to delight our ears.” Others agreed enthusiastically.
来，来，来一段让我们饱饱耳福。”“对！”有人附和：

“His singing is wonderfully stirring.
“听玉大哥唱黑头，真是痛快淋漓。

Quickly, where are the musicians?”
快，快，‘场面’呢？”

String and wind players and percussionists were all available and soon took their places.
文场、武场都现成，很快地摆设好了，

When they asked what to play, Zhang said, “His specialities are Exploring Mount Yin and Ascending the Heavenly Terrace.
“乌师”请示唱什么，张凤池便说，“玉大哥最拿手的是《探阴山》跟《上天台》。

Let us ascend the terrace first, then explore the mountain.”
我看先上天台，后探阴山吧！”

“No,” Yugui replied.
“不！”玉桂答说：

“I shall change roles today and sing a bearded character.
“今天我反串，唱‘胡子’，

做钱庄最怕遇到这样局势，谣言满天，人心惶惶。

胡雪岩连连摇手。

He had his own concerns.
原来他有他的顾虑，

Requesting an extension would amount to admitting that he could not even advance five hundred thousand taels.
因为请求展期，无异表示他连五十万银子都无法垫付。

If that became known, it would damage his golden reputation.
这话传出去，砸他的金字招牌，

Zuo would doubt his resources and ability, and on the fifth of the next month the crowds of wedding guests would be bound to discuss it.
不但左宗棠对他的实力与手腕，会生怀疑，十一月初五那一天，盈门的贺客少不得会谈论这件事，

The glory of the celebration would be greatly diminished.
喜事风光，亦将大为减色。


“Let us take the first and second steps for now,” Hu said.
“我们先走第一步同第二步。”胡雪岩说：

“I shall handle the first and entrust the second to you.”
“第一步我来，第二步托你。”

The first meant pressing the circuit intendant's office; the second, finding ways to arrange funds themselves.
第一步就是到上海道衙门去催问，第二步“自己想法子来调度”。

In practice, that meant urging Mi to act.
这一步无非督促宓本常去办。

Because of their earlier friction, Gu was unwilling to undertake an arduous, thankless task that might achieve nothing.
古应春因为有过去的芥蒂，不肯作此吃力不讨好，而且可能徒劳无功的事，

His face showed his reluctance.
因而面有难色。

“What is it?”
“怎么样？”

“I should like us to exchange roles.
“我想跟小爷叔调一调，

Leave the first step to me, and take the second yourself.
头一步归我，第二步小爷叔自己来。”

You have every right to press Old Mi.
古应春说：“小爷叔催老宓，名正言顺，

If I do it, he will resent it and pay no attention.”
我来催老宓，他心里不舒服，不会买帐的。”

“Very well.
“也好。”

But we must act quickly.”
胡雪岩说：“事情要快了。”

“I shall go first thing tomorrow.
“我明天一早就去，

I have acquaintances at the office.
上海道衙门我有熟人。”

Come for lunch and hear the news.”
古应春说：“小爷叔明天中午来吃饭，听消息。”

“Good.
“好。”

These next few days we must see each other morning and evening.”
胡雪岩说：“这几天我们早晚都要碰头。”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第一章（三，至本章结束）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter One, Part Three (conclusion)
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


At noon the next day, Gu Yingchun brought excellent news: almost all the provincial contributions to the western military funds had been collected.
第二天中午，古应春带来一个极好的消息，各省协助的“西饷”，已快收齐了，

The earliest payment had arrived at the beginning of the tenth month.
最早的一笔，在十月初便已汇到。

“Can that be true?”
“有这样的事！”

Hu Xueyan was thoroughly puzzled.
胡雪岩大为困惑，

“Why did Shao Xiaocun tell me he had not received a single cash?
“为啥邵筱村同我说一文钱都没有收到？

Where did you hear this?”
你的消息哪里来的？”

“From a younger fellow townsman whom I helped years ago.
“我有个同乡晚辈，早年我照应过他，

He is now the head clerk in the telegraph room at the Shanghai circuit office.”
他现在是上海道衙门电报房的领班。

“Then there can be no mistake!”
“那就不错了！”

Hu was delighted and angry at once.
胡雪岩既喜且怒，

“What game is Shao Xiaocun playing?
“邵筱村不晓得在打什么鬼主意？

I shall have a word with him!”
我要好好问他一问。

“There is no need for that, Little Uncle.
““小爷叔不必如此。

I think the best course is to ask Lord Zuo to send him a telegram.”
我想最好的办法是请左大人打个电报给邵筱村。”

Gu had also obtained highly confidential information from his fellow townsman: Li Hongzhang was looking for ways to strike at Zuo Zongtang.
原来古应春从他同乡晚辈中，另获有很机密的消息，说是李鸿章正在设法打击左宗棠，

This suggested that Shao Youlian had an ulterior motive for deliberately obstructing Hu.
因而想到，邵友濂对胡雪岩有意留难，是别有用心。

But the report had not been confirmed, and telling Hu might only cause trouble.
但这个消息，未经证实，告诉了胡雪岩，反而会生出是非，

The best course was to have Zuo intervene with a sternly worded warning, making Shao think twice and release the money he had collected before the deadline, thereby discharging Hu’s responsibility.
只有用左宗棠出面，措词严厉些，带着警告的意味，让邵友濂心生顾忌，在期限之前拨出这笔代收的款子，了却胡雪岩的责任，最为上策。


Hu, however, had no way of knowing what lay behind Gu’s advice.
但胡雪岩又何从去了解他的用心，

His concern was still to save face before Zuo.
他仍旧是抱着在左宗棠面前要保持面子的用心。

In Jiangning, Zuo had asked whether there was anything in which he should intervene, meaning the western military contributions collected through the Shanghai circuit office.
在江宁时，左宗棠原曾问过他，有什么事要他出面，意思就是指上海道代收“西饷”这件事，

Had Hu then asked him to write and hurry Shao along, it would have been a perfectly natural answer; Zuo would have thought nothing of it.
当时如说请他写封信催一催邵友濂，是很正常的回答，左宗棠不会想到别的地方去。

But Hu had already said that there was nothing he needed to trouble him about.
已经回答没有什么事要他费心，

To ask for his intervention now would amount to admitting that he could not advance five hundred thousand taels.
而结果仍旧要他出面，这等于作了垫不出五十万银子的表示是一样的。

He therefore replied, “There is no need to trouble His Excellency.
因此，他这样答说：“不必劳动他老人家了，

Since almost all the provincial payments have arrived, I shall go and press Shao myself.”
既然各省都快到齐了，我去催他。”


Hu had always been able to keep his temper, but this time the strain of too many affairs made him lose patience.
胡雪岩一向沉得住气，这一次因为事多心烦，竟失去了耐性，

He went angrily to see Shao, only to be told at the door, “His Excellency has gone to inspect the Manufacturing Bureau.”
气冲冲地去看邵友濂，门上回答：“邵大人视察制造局去了。”

This fruitless visit made him still more displeased.
吃了个闭门羹，心中越发不快，

Returning to the Manufacturing Bureau, he ordered his correspondence secretary to write to Shao.
回到制造局命文案师爷写信给邵友濂，

The letter was decidedly discourteous, with something of an official’s peremptory tone; it also hinted that, if Shao could not pay on time, Hu would have to ask Zuo himself to deal with the matter.
措词很不客气，有点打官腔的味道，而且暗示，邵友濂如果不能如期付款，只好请左宗棠自己来料理了。

Delivered to Jianghaiguan Customs, it was immediately forwarded to Shao’s residence.
这封信送到江海关，立即转送邵友濂公馆，

Naturally, it made him uneasy.
他看了自然有些紧张，

As the saying went, “It is not an official you need fear, but the man who has authority over you.”
因为“不怕官，只怕管”，

Since the suppression of the Taiping armies, provincial governors and governors-general had acquired powers unequalled since the founding of the Qing dynasty.
自太平军被平息后，督抚权柄之重，为清朝开国以来所未有，

Zuo was the incumbent Governor-General of Liangjiang.
左宗棠是现任的两江总督，

If he submitted a severe impeachment naming Shao, no argument, however sound, could win Shao a hearing.
如果指名严参，再有理也无法申诉，

Besides, contributions from several provinces had indeed arrived; withholding them was indefensible.
而况实际上确也收到了好几省的“西饷”，靳而不予，也是件说不过去的事。

Very reluctantly, he decided to draw up a statement and send the money already received to the Transport Bureau.
因此，他很不情愿地作了个决定，将已收到的“西饷”开单送交转运局，

It came to about four hundred thousand taels.
为数约四十万两，

Hu would then need to advance only one hundred thousand to preserve his credit with the foreigners.
胡雪岩只需垫十万银子，便可保住他对洋人的信用。

But just as Shao finished his reply and was about to send it, a visitor arrived who overturned his decision completely.
但就在写好复信，正待发出之际，来了一个人，使得他的决定整个儿被推翻。


The visitor was Sheng Xuanhuai.
这个人便是盛宣怀，

Having successfully established the telegraph bureau, he had become one of Li Hongzhang’s leading favourites and had also formed a connection with Prince Chun.
由于筹办电报局大功告成，不但成了李鸿章面前有数的红人，而且亦马结上了醇亲王的关系。

Li had sent him to Shanghai to discuss with Shao how to “put out the fire.”
此番是衔李鸿章之命，到上海跟邵友濂来商量，如何“救人”？

This was Sheng’s metaphor for rescuing the present situation, and Li used it too.
“救火”是盛宣怀形容挽救眼前局势的一个譬喻，这也是李鸿章的说法，

Li believed he had a way to turn the danger of the Sino-French conflict over Vietnam into a peaceful settlement.
他认为由越南危局引起的中法冲突，他有转危为安的办法，

The actions of the war party, however, were like setting fires, while the lofty rhetoric of the Pure Stream group poured oil on the flames.
但主战派的行动，却如“纵火”，清流的高调，则是火上浇油。

Once the fire was extinguished, even oil would have nothing to feed.
但如火势已灭，虽有助燃的油料，终无所用。

In other words, if the moves towards war could be stopped, the Pure Stream group would cease to be a threat.
意思就是打消了主战的行动，清流便不足畏。

Who, then, were the arsonists?
那么，谁是“纵火”者呢？

In Li’s eyes, Zuo came first and Peng Yulin second.
在李鸿章看，第一个就是左宗棠，第二个是彭玉麟。

As for men in the southwest, such as Cen Yuying, Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou, there were ways to keep them under control.
至于西南方面如云贵总督岑毓英等，自有办法可以控制，

Even Peng, deprived of Zuo’s support, could be made to recognise the difficulties and withdraw.
即使是彭玉麟，倘无左宗棠的支持，亦可设法让他知难而退。

Capture the ringleader first: once Zuo had been restrained, Li could control the whole situation and negotiate peace with France.
换句话说，擒贼擒玉，只要将左宗棠压制住，李鸿章就能掌握到整个局势，与法国交涉化干戈为玉帛。


“Brother Xiaocun, do not be misled by all the cries of ‘War and self-strengthening,’ ‘Let the empire display its might,’ and ‘Unite against the common enemy.’
“筱村兄，你不要看什么‘主战自强’、‘大奋天威’、‘同仇敌忾’，这些慷慨激昂的论调，

Those impassioned declarations ring to the skies, but they are merely the voices you can hear.
高唱人云，这不过是听得见的声音，

The voices you cannot hear are the ones with real power.
其实，听不见的声音，才是真正有力量的声音，

Without those silent voices behind him, His Excellency would have no reason to oppose Zuo of Xiangyin. Zuo is declining in his old age; at most, he has another three or five years of wealth and honours ahead of him.
中堂如果不是有这些听不见的声音撑腰，他也犯不着跟湘阴作对一一湘阴老境颓唐，至多还有三、五年的富贵而已，

Why should His Excellency be unable to tolerate him?
何必容不得他？

Conversely, if he cannot tolerate him, there must be a reason why Zuo has to go.
反过来说，如果容不得他，就一定有非去他不可的缘故在内。

Brother Xiaocun, you must first understand what is in His Excellency’s mind.”
筱村兄，中堂的心事，你先要明白。

By His Excellency, he meant Li Hongzhang.
“中堂是指李鸿章。

Sheng was a consummate speaker.
盛宣怀的词令最妙，

He portrayed Li’s attitude towards Zuo as generous and temperate, all forbearance and charity.
他将李鸿章对左宗棠的态度，说得忠厚平和，一片恕词。

What Shao heard, however, was perfectly clear: Li and Zuo had become irreconcilable enemies, and their struggle could end only with one or the other destroyed.
但在邵友濂听来，是非常明白的，李、左之间已成势不两立，非拼个你死我活不可了。


“Yes,” Shao said, suddenly alert.
“是的。”邵友濂矍然警觉，

“I understand.
“我明白。

But may I ask whose voices these are that cannot be heard?”
不过，我倒要请问，是哪些听不见的声音？”

“First, Empress Dowager Cixi, who holds all power in her hands.
“第一是当今大权独揽的慈禧皇太后，

She has laboured for more than half her life, and two years ago she suffered an illness that nearly killed her.
她辛苦了大半辈子，前两年又生了一场死去活来的大病，

Think of it: how many fifty-year-old ladies do not long for a few peaceful years?
你想，五十岁的老太太，有几个不盼望过几年清闲日子的，

Why should she want a war?”
她哪里要打什么仗？”

“If all power is hers, she need only say ‘Peace.’
“既然大权独揽，她说个‘和’字，

Who would dare disobey her command?”
哪个敢不奉懿旨？”

“That is precisely her difficulty. She can say anything but that one word.
“苦就苦在她什么话都好说，就是这个字说不出口。

Why?
为啥呢？

She put down the great rebellion of Hong and Yang.
洪杨勘定大乱，

No empress dowager who ruled from behind the curtain has ever had military achievements to equal hers.
从古以来，垂帘的太后，没有她这样的武功，

How can she show weakness before her ministers?
哪里好向廷臣示弱。

Besides, the Pure Stream group is so clamorous that she has to echo its lofty sentiments in public.
再说，清流的论调，又是如此嚣张，只好表面上也唱唱高调，

In reality, her wishes are quite different.”
实际上全不是这么回事。”

“I understand.
“我懂了，

It is a difficulty she cannot voice.” Shao asked, “And the second?”
这是说不出的苦。”邵友濂又问：“第二个呢？”


“The second is Prince Gong, who is in charge of affairs.
“第二个是当政的恭王，

He has always believed that, in dealings with foreigners, peace comes first.
他一向主张跟洋人打交道，以和为贵，

Now that he is older, he has even less appetite for grand ambitions.”
如今上了年纪，更谈不上什么雄心壮志了。”

“When the Anglo-French forces invaded, Prince Gong advocated peace and the imperial princes and grandees called him a traitor.
“英法联军内犯，恭王主和，让亲贵骂他是‘汉奸’、

No wonder he is afraid to speak.
难怪他不敢开口。

But Prince Chun has always favoured war.
可是，醇王一向主战，

Why is he silent too?”
怎么也不作声呢？

“That is the crucial point.
““这就是关键所在。

The Prince Chun of today is not the man he was.
如今的醇王，不是当年的醇王了，

In recent years, the foreigners’ strong armour and powerful weapons…”
这几年洋人的坚甲利兵，”

Sheng paused and smiled.
盛宣怀停下来笑一笑说：

“Indeed, it was Zuo who taught him that lesson.
“说起来倒是受了湘阴的教，

The western campaign went so smoothly entirely because of the superiority of its firearms.
西征军事顺手，全靠枪炮厉害，

When Zuo was in the capital, he explained this to Prince Chun in detail.
这一点湘阴在京的时候，跟醇王谈得很详细。

The prince now fully endorses His Excellency’s policy of learning the foreigners’ strengths in order to counter them.
醇王现在完全赞成中堂的主张，‘师夷之长以制夷’，

A plan is being prepared to make Lushun a naval port and develop a substantial navy.
正在筹划一个辟旅顺为军港，大办海军的办法。

Prince Chun is intensely enthusiastic about it.
醇王对这件事，热中得不得了，

Naturally, he does not want a moment’s impatience to ruin a great undertaking.”
自然不愿‘小不忍而乱大谋’。”

“Quite so!
“嗯！嗯！

With those three behind him, His Excellency has every reason to hold firmly to the course he believes right.”
有这三位，中堂足足可以择善固执。”


“Speaking of holding to the right course, there is another man we must not overlook.
“提到择善固执，还有个人不能忽略。

Xiaocun, you have been abroad.
筱村，你是出过洋的，

Tell me: among all the men dealing with foreign affairs today, who is the foremost?”
你倒说说看，当今之世，论洋务人才，哪个是此中翘楚？”

“The Old Man of Yuchi, of course.
“那当然是玉池老人。

Even Marquis Zeng has to seek his advice on foreign affairs.”
连曾侯办洋务都得向他请教。”

The Old Man of Yuchi was a name Guo Songtao had chosen for himself; Marquis Zeng was Zeng Jize, the imperial envoy to France.
“玉池老人”是郭嵩焘自署的别号，“曾侯”指驻法钦差大臣曾纪泽。

In fact, not only Zeng but Li Hongzhang himself had to consult Guo.
事实上不仅曾纪泽，连李鸿章办洋务亦得向他请教，

Li had seen a great deal, but his insight was less penetrating than Guo’s.
因为李鸿章虽看得多，却不如郭嵩焘来得透彻，

Moreover, although Li too had belonged to the Hanlin Academy, his scholarship could not match Guo’s.
同时亦因为李鸿章虽然亦是翰林，而学问毕竟不如郭嵩焘，

Guo could advance an opinion or develop an argument that embraced ancient and modern times, China and foreign lands, without contradiction.
发一议，立一论，能够贯通古今中外而无扞格，

Expounded with Li’s eloquence, Guo’s ideas sounded more persuasive still.
以李鸿章的口才，来解说郭嵩焘的理论，便越觉得动听了。


“Now Peng Xueqin is asking for money to recruit troops, and Wang Langqing has already enlisted his full four thousand men in Hunan.
“现在彭雪琴要请款招兵，王阆青已经在湖南招足了四千人，

These are the men Zuo is sending out to set fires.
这就是湘阴派出去‘纵火’的人，

Once trouble starts, it will spread like a blaze across the plains.
一旦祸发，立刻就成燎原之势。

His Excellency is deeply anxious.
中堂为此，着急得很，

To take just one example, French warships are lying outside the mouth of the Wusong.
不说别的，只说法国军舰就在吴淞口外好了，

The French have told him to his face that they can attack the Manufacturing Bureau at any time.
人家已经亲口告诉中堂了，随时可以攻制造局，

That is one of the lifelines of the Beiyang establishment.
这是北洋的命脉之一，

How can he help being anxious?”
你想，中堂着急不着急。”

Shao was appalled.
听得这话，邵友濂大吃一惊，

He had always assumed that any clash with France would occur in Guangxi or Yunnan.
他总以为中法如有冲突，不在广西，便在云南，

An attack on the Manufacturing Bureau at Gaochangmiao would mean fighting in Shanghai.
如果进攻高昌庙的制造局，便是在上海作战，

As circuit intendant, he was responsible for defending his territory.
他是上海道，守土有责，

Would he have to go into battle himself against the French?
岂不是要亲自上阵跟法国军队对垒。

The thought terrified him.
转念到此心胆俱裂，

“People have been saying that in Shanghai too,” he stammered.
结结巴巴地说：“上海也有这样的话，

“I always took it for a rumour.
我总以为是谣言，

But if they told His Excellency themselves, then it is true!”
哪知道人家亲口告诉了中堂，是真有这回事！”

“There is no need to be alarmed,” Sheng reassured him.
“你也不要着急。”盛宣怀安慰他说：

“They do not act indiscriminately.
“人家也不是乱来的，

If you do not strike, they will not provoke a quarrel.
只要你不动手，就不会乱挑衅，

But if you are going to strike, they will forestall you.”
你要动手了，人家就会先发制人。”


The meaning could not have been clearer.
这话说得再明白不过，

Shao immediately replied, “Whatever happens, we cannot let Zuo start this fire.
邵友濂立即答说：“无论如何不可让湘阴把这把火烧起来。

To set a fire, you need materials.
放火要有放火的材料，

Without Mobil kerosene or matches that light at a stroke, there can be no blaze.
没有美孚牌煤油、没有一划就来的火柴，火就放不起来。

Am I right, Brother Xingsun?”
杏荪兄，你说是不是？”

“Exactly.
“一点不错，

That is what they call removing the firewood from under the pot.”
这就叫釜底抽薪。”

“And there is only one way to do it,” Shao said.
“要釜底抽薪，只有一个办法。”邵友濂说：

“Hu Xueyan has all the kerosene and matches.
“煤油、火柴都在胡雪岩手里，

Without him, Zuo could not start a fire even if he wanted to.
没有胡雪岩，湘阴想放火也放下成。

The officials in Jiangning pay little heed to Zuo; whatever he tells them to do, they comply only in part.
江宁官场都不大买湘阴的帐，他说出话去，多多少少要打折扣，

There is just one man who does exactly what he says, and that is Hu.
只有一个人，他说一是一，说二是二，就是胡雪岩，

For instance…”
譬如……”

He offered a number of examples. When relief was needed for the fire in Shandong and the Jiangning provincial treasurer could not provide the money, Zuo had asked Hu for a loan of two hundred thousand taels and received an immediate response. Now Wang Debang was recruiting men to assist Vietnam; Hu was arranging not only the supply of four thousand foreign rifles but also a contribution towards the troops’ travelling expenses.
譬如山东火灾助赈，江宁藩座无法支应，左宗棠向胡雪岩借银二十万，如响斯应，这一回王德榜募兵援越不但四千杆洋枪由胡雪岩筹划供给，补助路费亦雪岩负责等等，邵友濂举了好些实例。

The conclusion was that, to prevent Zuo from setting his fire, Hu Xueyan had to be put out of action.
结论是要使得左宗棠“纵火”不成，非除去胡雪岩不可。


“Benchang,” Hu said, pointing to Shao’s reply, “read this and you will understand.
“本常，”胡雪岩指着邵友濂复他的信说：“你看了这封信就晓得了，

He makes it perfectly clear: as soon as all the provincial payments have been collected, he will send them over.
人家说得很明白，各省的款子收齐了，马上送过来，

Everything will be settled before the deadline, and if it is missed, he will take full responsibility.
限期以前，一定办妥当，误了期限，一切责任由他来负。

He is the Shanghai circuit intendant, after all.
他到底是上海道，

His word means something.
说话算话，

There is nothing to worry about.”
不要紧的。”

宓本常看完了信问：“洋人的限期是哪一天？”

“放宽十天，

只要十一月初十以前付款，就不算违限。”

“Ah.
“呃，”

When do you intend to return to Hangzhou, sir?”
宓本常说，“大先生预备啥辰光回杭州？”

The question greatly displeased Hu.
这句话问得胡雪岩大为不悦，

“十一月初五的好日子。”他说：

你说我应该啥辰光动身回杭州？”

Even with a small steamer towing his boat, the journey to Hangzhou would take at least three days.
由水路回杭州，用小火轮拖带，至少也要三天，

Before the wedding there were many elaborate formalities; even if he did not have to arrange or preside over them, he had to put in an appearance.
喜期以前，有许多繁文缛节，即便不必由他来料理主持，但必须由他出面来摆个样子，

Whatever happened, he must therefore set out the next day, the last day of the tenth month.
所以无论如何，第二天——十月底一定要动身。

Rebuked, Mi dared not say another word, though inwardly he was in turmoil.
宓本常碰了个钉子，不敢再多说一句，心里却七上八下，意乱如麻。

Hu knew nothing of his anxiety; his thoughts were fixed on the foreign loan’s deadline.
但胡雪岩不知道他的心事，只看重在洋债的限期上。

“这件事我当然要预备好。”他说：

“Since payment is due on the tenth, there is no need to press Shao now.

Go to see him on the fifth or sixth and collect whatever is available.
到了初五、六，你去一趟，看有多少银子先领了回来，

By my estimate, it will be at least eighty per cent, if not ninety.
照我估计，没有九成，也有八成，

We shall have to advance at most a hundred thousand taels, and that will settle the matter.”
自己最多垫个十万两银子，事情就可以摆平了。”

“Yes, sir.”
“是的。”


“How much cash have we now?”
“现在现款还有多少？”

Mi’s heart gave another jump.
问到这话，宓本常心里又是一跳。

Hu had examined the accounts and ought to know the answer.
胡雪岩已经查过帐了，现款还有多少，他心里应该有数，

Why ask a question whose answer he already knew?
如今提出来，不是明知故问？

So absorbed was Mi in this thought that he forgot to reply.
这样想着，便忘了回答，

Hu prompted him again.
胡雪岩便再催问一句：

“多少？”

“Ah!
“呃！”

You have seen the accounts, sir.

总在四十万上下。”

全上海的存银不过一百万两，

阜康独家就有四十万，岂能算少？

不过胡雪岩也知道他挪用了一部分，

心想，四十万虽不足，三十万应该是有的，

垫上十万两银子还不足为忧。

话虽如此，也不妨再问一句：“如果调度不过来，你有什么打算？”

An odd question!
这话就问得怪了！

Mi thought.
宓本常心想，

If ready silver was short, naturally he would draw on the other branches.
现银不足，自然是向“联号”调动，

无所谓“打算”。

Was Hu implying something?
他问这话，是否有言外之意？

一时不暇细想，

只有先大包大揽敷衍了眼前再说，

“There will be no difficulty arranging the funds.
“不会调度不过来的。

上海、汉口、杭州三十三处的收支情形，我都很清楚，

Advancing a hundred thousand is nothing.” He added, “The two Ningbo branches regularly have over a hundred thousand taels on hand.”
垫十万银子，不算回事。“他又加了一句，”宁波两个号子，经常有十几万银子在那里。

“这是为了掩饰他利用客户的名义，挪用存款。

“A shrewd fellow needs only a hint”: Hu took this as an indirect admission that Mi had diverted a hundred thousand taels or more and would find a way to replace it when necessary.
“光棍一点就透”，胡雪岩认为他是在暗示，承认他挪用了十几万银子，必要时他会想法子补足。

This reassured him further.
这样就更放心了。


What Hu did not know was how widely the rumours had already spread.
但他不知道，市面上的谣言已很盛了；

People said that he was on the verge of collapse.
说胡雪岩摇摇欲坠，

According to one account, he had lost his contest with the foreigners over silk and cocoons.
一说他跟洋人在丝茧上斗法，已经落了下风，

Although nothing had happened in Shanghai, the silk in his Tianjin warehouses could find no buyer even at a low price.
上海虽无动静，但存在天津堆栈里的丝，贱价出售，尚无买主。

Another concerned the foreign loan: he could not repay it when due.
又一说便是应付洋债，到期无法清偿。

This report had two versions.
这个传说，又分两种，

One was that, proud though Hu was, he could not raise the money in time and had asked the foreigners for an extension, which was still being negotiated.
一种是说，胡雪岩虽好面子，但周转不灵，无法如期交付，已请求洋人展限，尚在交涉之中；

又一种说法是，上海道衙门已陆陆续续将各省协饷交付阜康，却为阜康的档手宓本常私下弥补了自己的亏空。

Rumours needed supporting evidence if people were to believe them, and here the evidence took the form of a question: Hu’s daughter was to be married on the fifth of the eleventh month, so why was he still lingering in Shanghai?
谣言必须有佐证才能取信于人，这佐证是个疑问：胡雪岩十一月初五嫁女儿，而他本人却一直逗留在上海，为什么？

Because he could not balance his funds.
为的是他的“头寸”摆不平。

Otherwise, a man of his habits would long since have returned to Hangzhou to prepare for the wedding.
否则以胡雪岩的作风，老早就该回杭州去办喜事了。

It was a powerful argument.
这个说法，非常有力，

因为人人都能看出这是件大出情理之外的事。

所以大家疑忧虽深，总还有一种想法，既名“财神”，自有他莫测的高深，

They would wait and see.
且等着看一看再说。

看到什么时候呢？

Until the end of the tenth month, to see whether he could get through the crisis.

These reports, half true and half false, neither wholly rumour nor wholly fact, had mostly been circulated by Sheng and Shao through HSBC.

因此众所瞩目的十月三十那天，有许多人到汇丰银行去打听消息，但更多的人是到阜康钱庄去察看动静。

胡府上十一月初办喜事，

胡大先生当然要赶回去。”

“Oh?
“幄，

In that case, he ought to have left long ago.

Why…”
为啥……”

Why?
为啥？

这一问谁也无法回答。

The well-dressed visitor was an agent sent by Sheng to spread rumours.

第一个来的“凭票付银”五百两，

说是要行聘礼，不但要现银，而且最好是刚出炉的“官宝”。

Fukang’s employees had always been eager to oblige their customers.
阜康的伙计，一向对顾客很巴结，

特为到库房里去要了十个簇新的大元宝，

其中有几个还贴着红纸剪成的双喜，正就是喜事人家的存款。

The second customer redeemed eight hundred taels without giving a reason.
第二个来兑现八百两，没有说理由，

The employees had no right to ask for one.
伙计也不能问理由，

这也是常有的事，无足为奇，

但第三个就不对了。

象这样大笔兑现银，除非军营发恼，但都是事先有关照的。

费你的心。”

这时宓本常已接到报告，

请教！”

银子的式样很多，而两万多不是个小数目，

所以人家才要提现？

上了排门吃夜饭。

宓本常神情诅丧，食不下咽，

勉强吃了半碗饭，站起身来，向几个重要的伙计招招手，到后面楼上他卧室中去密谈。

阜康四个重要的伙计，奔走半夜情况大致都清楚了，能够集中的现银，不过十二万两。

A’zhang!”
阿章！”

阿章是学徒中的头脑，快要出师了，一向经管阜康的杂务，

现在就供。”

The Great Immortal was the fox spirit.
所谓“大仙”就是狐仙，

初二、十六上供，一碗烧酒，十个白的蛋，

酒是现成，蛋要上街去买。

时已午夜，

A’zhang went out and knocked on shop shutters until he could buy some, then boiled them and set out the offering.
敲排门去买了蛋来，煮好上供，

阿章上床已经两点钟了。

A’zhang!” he cried in a panic.

除了市声以外，别无他异，

Fortunately, the police had arrived.
幸而巡捕已经赶到，

Shanghai people were accustomed to the red-turbaned Indian policemen they called “A-san,” but raised batons still had a considerable restraining effect.
头裹红布的“印度阿三”，上海人虽说司空见惯，但警棍一场，还是有相当的弹压作用，

The several hundred customers were finally put back into a long queue.
数百顾客，总算仍旧排好长龙。

A junior police officer, known in Shanghai as “Three Stripes,” entered Fukang and asked in Chinese with a Shandong accent, “Who is the manager?”
巡捕中的小头目，上海人称之为“三道头”，进入阜康，操着山东腔的中国话问道：“谁是掌柜？”

“I am!”
“是我！”

Mi stepped forward.
宓本常挺身而出。

“You own this bank?”
“你开钱庄？”

“I do not own it.
“钱庄不是阿拉开的，

I manage it.”
不过归阿拉管。”

“As long as you manage it, that will do.
“只要是你管就好。

Get the silver out and send these people on their way.
快把银子搬出来，打发人家走路，

We cannot have the whole street disrupted.”
免得把市面弄坏。”

“There is plenty of silver.
“银子有的是。

Officer, please keep order and let them come one at a time.”
三道头，拜托你维持维持秩序，一个一个来。”

Three Stripes nodded, then shouted towards the customers beyond the counter, “There is plenty of silver!
三道头点点头，朝柜台外面大声说道：“银子有的是，

Enough for everyone!
统通有，

One at a time!”
一个一个来！”

This quietened them further.
这一声喊，顾客又安静了些。

All the employees had been instructed beforehand to work as slowly as possible.
伙计们都是预先受过叮嘱的，动作尽量放慢，

Some customers brought passbooks and required interest to be calculated on their withdrawals, which slowed matters still more.
有的拿存折来提存，需要结算利息，那一来就更慢了，

In an hour, the six men at the counter served only forty or fifty customers, who took away less than ten thousand taels.
站柜台的六个人，一个钟头只料理了四五十个客户，被提走的银子，不到一万，

It looked as though the situation could be kept under control.
看样子局面可以稳住了。


Towards noon, a thin, small elderly man arrived.
到了近午时分，来了一个瘦小老者，

Opening a bundle wrapped in a handkerchief, he passed a bankbook over the counter and said, “A withdrawal of one hundred thousand.”
打开手巾包，将一扣存折递进柜台，口中说道：“提十万。”

His voice was quiet, but to Mi it was a thunderclap overhead.
声音虽不高，但宓本常听来，恰如焦雷轰顶，

He hurried forward to deal with the customer himself and first examined the account name in the passbook: Fuji.
急心亲自赶上来应付，先看折子户名，上写“馥记”二字，

Trouble, he thought.
暗暗叫一声“不妙！”

“May I ask your name?”
“请问贵姓？”

“Mao.”
“敝姓毛。”

“How are you connected with Mr Zhaofu?”
“毛先生跟兆馥先生怎么称呼？”

“We are friends.”
“朋友。”

“I see.
“幄。

Please come inside and sit down, Mr Mao.”
毛先生请里面坐。”

“Very well.”
“也好。”

Mao strolled into the seating area, where an apprentice brought tea and tobacco.
姓毛的徐步踏入客座，小徒弟茶烟伺候，

Once he was settled, Mi asked, “You have come to withdraw one hundred thousand taels on Mr Zhaofu’s behalf?”
等坐定了，宓本常问道：“毛先生是代兆馥先生来提十万银子？”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

“Where is the money to be used?
“不晓得在什么地方用，

If you will let me know, I can have notes drawn up.”
请毛先生吩咐下来，好打票子。”

“Locally.”
“在本地用。”

“How many notes would you like?”
“票子打几张？

Mao raised his eyes and asked slowly, “Which bank’s notes are you going to give me?”
姓毛的抬眼看了一下，慢吞吞地问道：“你是打哪里的票子？”

Mi was taken aback.
宓本常一慢，

Fukang notes, naturally.
心想自然是打阜康的银票，

There had to be a reason for asking something so obvious.
他这样明知故问，必有缘故在内，

He therefore sounded the man out.
因而便探问他说：

“Which bank’s would you prefer?”
“毛先生要打哪里的票子？”

“HSBC.”
“汇丰。”


Mi’s heart jumped again.
宓本常心里又是一跳，

Fukang had only a little over sixty thousand taels on deposit at HSBC.
汇丰的存款只有六万多，

To write a cheque for one hundred thousand, he would have to make up the difference with notes from other banks, and under the rules these could not be drawn against on the day they were deposited.
开十万的支票，要用别家的庄票去补足，按规定当天不能抵用，

He might persuade HSBC to make an exception, but he could not get away.
虽可情商通融，但苦于无法抽空，

Besides, if word spread that he had gone begging HSBC for a favour at such a critical moment, Fukang’s credit would suffer.
而且当此要紧关头，去向汇丰讨情面，风声一传，有损信用。

Rather than appeal to HSBC, why not appeal to the man sitting before him?
转念到此，心想与其向汇丰情商，何不舍远就近向姓毛的情商，

“Mr Mao,” he said, “could we divide the payment?”
“毛先生，”他说：“可不可以分开来开？”

“How?”
“怎样分法？”

“Half in an HSBC cheque, and half in our own notes?”
“一半汇丰、一半开本号的票子？”

Mao smiled faintly.
姓毛的微微一笑，

“There is no need,” he said.
“不必了。”他说：

“Please give me back the passbook.”
“请你把存折还给我。”

So he had been right, Mi thought: Zhang Zhaofu was playing a trick.
宓本常心想，果不其然，是张兆馥耍花样，

The Fuji account belonged to Zhang, a cotton and yarn merchant and a friend of Hu’s whom Mi also knew.
原来“馥记”便是张兆馥，此人做纱花生意，跟胡雪岩是朋友，宓本常也认识，

Once, while drinking at a courtesan banquet, they had quarrelled over a courtesan’s transfer from one party to another. Both had had too much wine.
有一回吃花酒，彼此都有了酒意，为一个姑娘转局，席面上闹得不大愉快。

Sober the next morning, Mi felt deeply uneasy and made a special visit to apologise.
第二天宓本常酒醒以后，想起来大为不安，特意登门去赔不是，

Zhang had merely said coolly, “I am a friend of your employer’s.
哪知张兆馥淡淡地答了一句：“我是你们东家的朋友，

There is no need for this.”
不必如此。”

His meaning was that he did not regard Mi as a friend.
意思是不认他作朋友。

Now he had sent someone to withdraw his deposit, clearly with unfriendly intentions.
如今派人上门来提存，自是不怀好意，

Yet why demand the money and then decide not to take it?
不过何以要提又不提了，其中是何蹊跷，

That was a puzzle.
费人猜疑。


When Mao had his passbook back, he said, “You have cost me a dinner!”
等将存折接到手，姓毛的说道：“你害我输了东道！”

“A dinner?” Mi asked.
“输了东道？”宓本常问道：

“Who have you made a wager with, Mr Mao?
“毛先生你同哪位赌东道？

And what was the bet?”
赌点啥？”

“Zhang Zhaofu, of course…” Mao explained that he and Zhang had been taking tea that morning in the West Garden of the City God Temple when they heard of the run on Fukang.
“自然是同张兆馥……”姓毛的说，这天上午他与张兆馥在城隍庙西园吃茶，听说阜康挤兑，

Zhang said its position was dangerous.
张兆馥说情势可危，

Mao maintained that a bank with Fukang’s golden reputation was safe beyond question.
姓毛的认为阜康是金字招牌，可保无虞。

Zhang then said that Fukang probably had less than one hundred thousand taels at HSBC.
张兆馥便说阜康在汇丰银行的存款，只怕不足十万，

If Mao doubted it, he could put it to the test.
不信的话，可以去试一试，

If Fukang could write an HSBC cheque for one hundred thousand taels, Zhang would pay for a banquet at a changsan courtesan house; otherwise, Mao would be the host.
如果阜康能开出汇丰银行十万两的支票，他在长三堂子输一桌花酒，否则便是姓毛的作东。

This was disastrous!
糟糕到极点了！

After that evening’s banquet, Mi thought, who could say how many people throughout the foreign settlements would be repeating the next day that Fukang had only fifty thousand taels at HSBC?
宓本常心想，晚上这一桌花酒吃下来，明天十里夷场上就不知道有多少人会传说：阜康在汇丰银行的存款，只得五万银子。

The consequences were unthinkable.
果然出现这样的情况，后果不堪设想，

He had to turn the tide.
非力挽狂澜不可。

After considering and reconsidering every possibility, he finally saw a way: collect the military contributions due from the Shanghai circuit office and deposit them at HSBC as Fukang’s available funds.
宓本常左思右想，反复盘算，终于想到了一条路子，将上海道衙门应缴的协饷先去提了来，存在汇丰，作为阜康的头寸，

Then, the next day, anyone demanding redemption or withdrawing a deposit could be paid with an HSBC cheque.
明天有人来兑现提存，一律开汇丰的支票。


Whenever Mi visited the Shanghai circuit office to press for payment or ask for news, he called on a fellow townsman named Zhu.
宓本常每回到上海道衙门去催款或打听消息，都找他的一个姓朱的同乡。

This time, as soon as they met, Zhu asked, “How have you found time to come here?”
这次一见面，姓朱的便问：“你怎么有工夫到这里来？”

Mi was astonished.
宓本常愕然：

“Why should I not have time?” he countered.
“为什么我没有工夫？”他反问一句。

“I hear there is a run on Fukang.
“听说阜康挤兑。”

Should you not be at the bank looking after things?”
姓朱的说：“你不应该在店里照料吗？”

Mi was alarmed.
宓本常一惊，

News of the run had reached the circuit office, which would make it harder to ask for money.
挤兑的消息已传到上海道衙门，催款的话就难说，

But he was quick-witted enough to see that he could use the situation as his excuse.
但他的机变很快，心想正好用这件事来作借口，

“A run is an exaggeration.
“挤兑是说得过分了，

It is true that more people than usual are withdrawing their deposits, but that is because of the edict of the twenty-first of the tenth month, declaring martial law along the river.
不过提存的人比平常多，是真的，这都是十月二十一的一道上谕，沿江戒严，

People are preparing to flee.
大家要逃难的缘故。

Fukang has ample funds; they can withdraw as much as they please.”
阜康的头寸充足，尽管来提，不要紧。”

He hurried on.
他紧接着又说：

“But before he left, Mr Hu told me to set aside money to advance towards the foreign loan repayment.
“不过，胡大先生临走交代，要预备一笔款子，垫还洋款，

Now I cannot have the full amount ready.
如今这笔款子没有办法如数预备了，

Please ask His Excellency to send over whatever he has already collected, so I can see how much is still lacking and arrange for it.”
要请你老兄同邵大人说一说，收到多少先拨过来，看差多少，我好筹划。”

“Certainly!” Zhu replied without hesitation.
“好！”姓朱的毫不迟疑地说：

“You have come at just the right moment.
“你来得巧，

His Excellency has only just arrived.
我们东家刚到，

I shall speak to him for you.”
我先替你去说。”

Mi was delighted and could not help congratulating himself on his clever move.
宓本常满心欢喜，而且不免得意，自觉想出来的这一招很高明，

But Zhu returned very quickly, with suspicion on his face.
哪知姓朱的很快地就回来了，脸上却有狐疑的神气。


“You can go back with your mind at rest.
“你请放心回去好了，

The foreign payment is due on the tenth, and this office will pay it directly.
这笔洋款初十到期，由这里直接拨付，

Fukang will not have to advance a single cash.”
阜康一文钱都不必垫。”

Mi changed colour.
宓本常一听变色，

It lasted only an instant, but Zhu noticed, and his suspicions deepened.
虽只是一瞬间的事，姓朱的已看在眼里，越加重了他的疑心，

“Mi, let me ask you something.
“老宓，我倒问你句话，

His Excellency blamed me for failing to think it through.
我们东家怪我，怎么不想一想，

There is a run on Fukang.
阜康现在挤兑，

If official funds are sent over to fill the hole in your finances, how are the public accounts to be settled afterwards?
官款拨了过去，替你们填馅子，将来怎么交公帐。”

Was that what you had in mind?”
他问，“你是不是有这样的打算？”

How could Mi admit it?
宓本常哪里肯承认！

He waved his hands in repeated denial.
连连摇手：

“Nothing of the kind!
“没有这话，

Nothing of the kind!”
没有这话！”

“Really?”
“真的？”

“Of course.
“当然真的，

How could I deceive you?”
‘我怎么会骗你。”

“I did not think you would deceive me.
“我想想你也不会骗我，

Otherwise, you would be making me shoulder the consequences.
不然，你等于叫我来‘掮木梢’，

That would hardly be the act of a friend.”
就不象朋友了。

The words cut Mi to the heart.
“这话在宓本常是刺心的，

He could only offer a strained smile, thank Zhu and take his leave.
惟有赔着笑道谢，告辞出来，

His legs felt weak beneath him, as though Fukang were a cauldron of boiling oil or a blazing volcano waiting for him to leap into it.
脚步都软了，仿佛阜康是油锅火山等着他去跳似的。


Back at Fukang, Mi entered by the rear of the kitchen.
回到阜康，他是从“灶披间”的后面进去的，

The clamour outside the front door filled him with dread.
大门外人声鼎沸，闻之心惊，

He had scarcely come in when an employee named Du stopped him.
进门未几，有个姓杜的伙计拦住他说：

“Mr Mi, do not go out to the front!”
“宓先生，你不要到前面去！”

“Why?”
“为啥？”

“Two big depositors were here just now.
“刚才来了两个大户，

One wanted two hundred and fifty thousand, the other one hundred and eighty thousand.
一个要提二十五万、一个要提十八万，

I told them funds had been tight in Shanghai for the past year or so, and our manager had gone out to arrange the money.
我说上海的头寸，这年把没有松过，我们档手调头寸去了，

They said they would come back tomorrow.
他说明天再来，

If you show yourself, that explanation will no longer hold.”
你一露面，我这话就不灵了。”

At the end of his resources, Mi suddenly felt that a way had opened before him.
山穷水尽的窗本常真有柳暗花明之乐，

The truth could serve as an excuse too.
心想说老实话也是个搪塞法子，

Du was a capable man, the senior clerk at the counter.
这姓社的人很能干，站柜台的伙计，以他为首，

He could shoulder a heavy burden; why not let him try?
千斤重担他挑得动，不如就让他来挑一挑。

After a moment’s thought, Mi said, “Quite right!
于是他想了一下说：“不错！

That is how you should answer them.
你就用这话来应付，

Tell them there is nothing to worry about.
你说请他们放心，

Our silk alone is worth several million taels.
我们光是丝就值几百万银子，

There is no need for everyone to rush in and demand their money.”
大家犯不着来挤兑。”

“I understand,” Du replied.
“我懂。”杜伙计说：

“But even if we get through today, we must have an answer tomorrow.”
“不过今天过去了，明天要有交代。”

“When those two big depositors come back, tell them I have gone to Ningbo myself to collect cash.
“那两个大户明天再来，你说我亲自到宁波去提现款，

It will take five days.” Mi added, “I really am going to Ningbo.
要五天工夫。”宓本常又说：“我真的要到宁波去一趟，

I am leaving now.”
现在就动身。”

“It is nearly lunchtime.
“要吃中饭了，

Eat before you go.”
吃了饭再走。”

“How could I swallow anything?”
“哪里还吃得下饭。”

Mi patted his shoulder.
宓本常拍拍他的肩，

“I am placing a great trust in you here.
“这里重重托你。

Once this storm has passed, I shall put in a strong recommendation for you with Mr Hu.”
等这个风潮过去了，我要在大先生面前好好保荐你。”


But that afternoon still more customers arrived, and the large depositors were less accommodating than the two who had come that morning.
哪知道午后上门的客户更多了，大户也不比上午的两个好说话，

The crowd surged angrily, and trouble looked imminent.
人潮汹涌，群情愤慨，眼看要出事故，

The officer called Three Stripes demanded to know where Mi was.
巡捕房派来的那个“三道头”追问宓本常何在？

Du had no choice but to tell the truth.
姓杜的只好说实话：

“He has gone to Ningbo.”
“到宁波去了。”

“What is to be done here?”
“这里怎么办？”

Nobody knew.
谁也不知道怎么办？

Only A’zhang said, “We can only put up the shutters.”
只有阿章说了句：“只好上排门。”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第二章（上）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Two, Part One
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER TWO: AN UNFORESEEN CRISIS｜第二章 变起不测


Madam Luosi had already gone to bed when the maid Hong'er came to report a message from the inner gate: Xie Yunqing, the manager of Fukang Bank, wished to see her.
螺蛳太太已经上床了，丫头红儿来报，中门上传话进来，说旱康的档手谢云青求见。

“At this hour?”
“这时候？”

Her heart suddenly sank.
螺蛳太大的心蓦地里往下一落，

Could Hu Xueyan have fallen gravely ill?
莫非胡雪岩得了急病？

She dared not pursue the thought.
她不敢再想下去了。

“Madam,” Hong'er prompted, “shall I ask him to come back tomorrow morning?”
“太太！”红儿催问：“是不是叫他明天早上来？”

“No.
“不，”

Ask him what it is.”
螺蛳太太说：“问问他，有什么事？”

“He only said there was a telegram from Shanghai.”
“只说上海有电报来。”

“But what is it about?
“到底什么事呢？

Go and ask.”
去问他。”

Then she reconsidered.
螺蛳太太转念，

If it were not urgent, he would not be seeking an audience now; if it was, she must not waste time.
不是急事，不会此刻求见，既是急事，就不能耽误工夫，

“Open the inner gate and invite Mr Xie in,” she said instead, adding, “Don't disturb the old lady.”
当即改口：“开中门，请谢先生进来。”她又加了一句：“不要惊动了老太太。”

As Hong'er left, the other maids helped her rise and dress properly, then accompanied her downstairs.
红儿一走，别的丫头服侍螺蛳太太起床，穿着整齐，由丫头簇拥着下了楼。

She too had learned to master appearances and steady others by her bearing.
她也学会了矫情镇物的功夫，

Though anxious within, she walked with measured steps, her skirt scarcely stirring.
心里着急，脚步却依旧稳重，走路时裙幅几乎不动——

Those who read character and fortune from a person's gait had always said that hers promised distinction.
会看相的都说她的“走相”主贵，

Proud of her composure, she would not allow her steps to become disordered.
她本人亦颇矜持，所以怎么样也不肯乱了脚步。


Xie Yunqing was always punctilious.
那谢云青礼数一向周到，

At the first glimpse of her approaching figure, he stood respectfully with his hands at his sides, his gaze lowered in an attitude of complete restraint.
望见螺蛳太太的影子，老远就垂手肃立，眼观鼻、鼻观心地等候着，

Only when a breath of the foreign perfume she used reached him did he raise his head and bow with clasped hands.
直到一阵香风飘来，闻出是螺蛳太太所用的外国香水，方始抬头作揖，口中说道：

“I am very sorry to disturb you so late.”
“这样子夜深来打扰，实在过意不去。”

“Please sit.”
“请坐。”

She glanced around, then addressed the maids by the door.
螺蛳太太左右看了一下，向站在门口的丫头发话：

“Your manners are getting worse.
“你们越来越没有规矩了，

A guest arrives, and you don't even bring tea.”
客人来了，也不倒茶。”

“Please don't trouble.
“不必客气，不必客气。

I've received important news and dared not keep it from you, Fourth Madam.”
我接得一个消息，很有关系，不敢来告诉四太太。”

“Then sit down and tell me.”
“喔，请坐了谈。”

She waved him to a seat and took the place of honour herself.
说着，她摆一摆手，自己先在上首坐了下来。

Xie perched deferentially on his chair, his voice beginning to tremble.
“是这样的。”谢云青斜欠着身子落座，声音却有些发抖了，

“A telegram has just arrived.
“刚刚接到电报，

There has been a run on the Shanghai bank.
上海挤兑，

They put up the shutters at three this afternoon.”
下半天三点钟上排门了。”

Madam Luosi's heart jolted.
螺蛳太太心头一震，

“There can be no mistake?”
“没有弄错吧！”她问。

“None.
“不会弄错的。”

The telegram also says that Mi Benchang cannot be found.
谢云青又说：“电报上又说：宓本常人面不见，

He is said to have gone to Ningbo.”
据说是到宁波去了。”

“Who sent it?”
“那么，电报是哪个打来的呢？”

“Mr Gu.”
“古先生。”

A telegram from Gu Yingchun could not be mistaken.
古应春打来的电报，决不会错。

She maintained an outward calm, but her thoughts were in such turmoil that she could scarcely gather them.
螺蛳太太表面镇静，心里乱得头绪都握不住，

After a long pause, she asked, “Where is Mr Hu?”
好一会儿才问：“大先生呢？”

“Presumably on his way home.”
“大先生想来是在路上。”

“How could such a thing happen?” she murmured, almost to herself.
“怎么会有这种事？”螺蛳太太自语似地说：

“With all Mi Benchang's ability, how could he fail to hold things together and let it come to this?”
“宓本常这样子能干的人，怎么会撑不住，弄成这种局面？”

Xie had no answer.
谢云青无以为答，

Rubbing his hands, he could only say, “It's a very serious matter.
只搓着手说：“事情很麻烦，

Quite unimaginable.”
想都想不到的。”


She suddenly shivered.
螺蛳太太蓦地打了个寒噤，

Struggling to remain calm, she asked, “What about Beijing?”
力持平静地问：“北京不晓得怎么样？”

“Tianjin must have heard already.
“天津当然也有消息了，

Beijing will learn of it a day later,” Xie said.
北京要晚一天才晓得。”谢云青说：

“Pull one hair and the whole body moves.
“牵一发而动全身，

Tomorrow will be very hard to get through.”
明天这个关，只怕很难过。”

She felt an immense pressure descend on her shoulders, far heavier than any physical burden.
螺蛳太太陡觉双肩有股无可比拟的巨大压力，何止千斤之重！

She longed to escape it but dared not.
她想摆脱这股压力，但却不敢，

If she could not bear this invisible weight, the entire family would suffer.
因为这副无形中的千斤重担，如果她挑不起来，会伤及全家，

Yet even the thought of lifting it drained her courage, before any question of whether her strength was sufficient.
而要想挑起来，且不说力有未胜，只一动念，便已气馁，

Then came the warning thought of harm to the family, and above all to Hu.
可是紧接着便是伤及全家，特别是伤及胡雪岩的警惕，

因而只有咬紧牙关，全力撑持着。

“大先生在路上。”

她说：“老太太不敢惊动，另外一位太太是拿不出主意的，

谢先生，你有什么好主意？”

He had come to ask her for a decision.
谢云青原是来讨主意的，

He could only smile bitterly.
听得这话，只有苦笑，

There was an idea in his mind, but he dared not voice it.
他倒是有个主意，却不敢说出来。

After a silence, she spoke again.
沉默了一会，依旧是螺蛳太太开口。


“In your judgement, there is bound to be a run tomorrow?”
“谢先生，照你看，明天一定会挤兑？”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

“How much silver would we need to meet it?”
“大概要多少银子才能应付？”

“That is hard to say.
“这很难说。”

Here alone, Fukang has notes outstanding for more than one million four hundred thousand taels.
谢云青说：“阜康开出去的票子，光是我这里就有一百四十多万，

The deposits are greater still.”
存款就更加多了。”

“How much cash is in the bank?”
“那么钱庄里现银有多少呢？”

“About four hundred thousand.”
“四十万上下。”

She considered the matter repeatedly.
螺蛳太太考虑又考虑之后说：

“With four hundred thousand in ready silver, I should think we can hold out for a day or two.
“有四十万现银，我想撑一两夭总撑得住，

那时候大先生已经回来了。”

Xie thought that, judging by what had happened, even Hu might have no solution.
谢云青心想，照此光景，就胡雪岩回来了，也不见得有办法，

Otherwise, why would the Shanghai branch have had to close its doors?
否则上海的阜康何至于“上排门”，

But he could not say that plainly.
不过这话不便直说，

He asked only, “And if we cannot hold out?”
他只问道：“万一撑不住呢？”


Had she possessed a satisfactory answer to that question, he would never have needed to seek out his employer's wife in the middle of the night.
这话如能答得圆满，根本就不必谢云青黄夜求见女东家。

“谢先生，”螺蛳太太反问道：“你说，

What happens if we cannot?”
万一撑不住会怎么样？”

“There will be trouble, and people will get hurt.
“会出事，会伤人。”谢云青说：

Suppose those who arrive early, or can reach farther, take away the cash first, while the latecomers get nothing.
“譬如说，早来的、手长的，先把现银提走了，后来的一落空，

Put yourself in their place, Fourth Madam.
四太太你倒设身处地想一想，

Wouldn't you be furious?”
心里火不火？”

The question needed no answer.
这是个不必回答的疑问，螺蛳太太只说：

“Go on.”
“请你说下去。”

“The worst thing is to provoke a crowd's anger.
“做事情最怕犯众怒，

一犯众怒，官府都弹压不住，

Besides smashing the bank to pieces, they may come here to make trouble.
钱庄打得粉碎不说，只怕还会到府上来吵，

Where that would end is impossible to say.”
吵成什么样子，就难说了。”

She was horrified.
螺蛳太太悚然而惊，

Forcing herself to settle her thoughts, she went over the problem again.
勉强定一定心，从头细想了一遍说：

“They become angry because some receive their money and some don't.
“犯众怒是因为有的人有，有的人没有，

It is unfair.
不公平了！

If no one receives anything, that is a kind of fairness too.
索性大家都没有，倒也是一种公平，

What do you think?”
谢先生，你想呢？”

“Fourth Madam,” Xie said calmly, “you have understood.”
“四太太，”谢云青平静地说：“你想通了。”

“Very well!”
“好！”

For the moment, she felt she could shoulder the burden.
螺蛳太太觉得这副千斤重担，眼前算是挑得起来了，

“We won't open tomorrow.
“明天不开门，

But we must give the customers an explanation.”
不过要对客户有个交代。”

“Naturally.
“当然，

We shall say the closure is temporary and ask them not to be alarmed.”
只说暂时歇业，请客户不必惊慌。”

“That is the meaning, but the words must be tactful.” “I understand.” “I hear you are often in touch with Provincial Treasurer De's household?” Xie continued.
“意思是这个意思，话总要说得婉转。” “我明白。”谢云青又说：“听说四太太同德藩台的内眷常有往来的？”


Treasurer De was Dexin, courtesy name Xiaofeng, a Bannerman serving as provincial treasurer of Zhejiang.
德藩台是指浙江藩司德馨，字晓峰，此人在旗，

His friendship with Hu was close, and the women of the two households often visited one another.
与胡雪岩的交情很深，所以两家内眷，常有往还。

Madam Luosi and one of his favourite concubines were sworn sisters.
螺蛳太太跟德馨的一个宠妾且是“拜把子”的姐妹。

“Yes.
“不错。”

What about it?”
螺蛳太太问：“怎么样？”

“Go to his residence first thing tomorrow, if you would.
“明天一早，请四太太到藩台衙门去一趟，

It would be best to see him himself and ask for help in person.
最好能见着德藩台，当面托一托他，

With the authorities intervening to maintain order, we shall have a better chance of getting through this.”
有官府出面来维持，就比较容易过关了。”

“Very well.
“好的，

I'll go.
我去。”

Is there anything else we should consider and do immediately?”
螺蛳太太问：“还有什么应该想到，马上要做的？”


One question kept troubling her: should she tell the First Madam of this wholly unforeseen upheaval?
一直萦绕在螺蛳太太心头的一个难题是，这样一个从来没有想到过的大变化，要不要跟大太太说？

Within the Hu family's inner gate, there were, as the saying went, three rulers in one state.
胡家中门以内是“一国三公”的局面，

Nominally, the old lady presided over everything, like Empress Dowager Cixi ruling from behind the curtain.
凡事名义上是老太太主持，好比慈禧太后的“垂帘听政”，

The First Madam resembled Prince Gong, while Madam Luosi was like Shen Guifen, who had died two years earlier.
大太太仿佛恭亲王，螺蛳太太就象前两年去世的沈桂芬。

A Hanlin scholar named Wu had once written a poem called “The Younger Sister-in-Law's Lament,” comparing Shen, who had been summoned from the governorship of Shanxi into the Grand Council, to a daughter returning to her parents' home.
曾经有个姓吴的翰林，写过一首诗，题目叫做《小姑叹》，将由山西巡抚内调入军机的沈桂芬，比做归宁的小姑，

So beloved by her mother was this daughter that the daughter-in-law in charge of the household lost her authority: all domestic business was conducted by the daughter under her mother's instructions.
深得母欢，以致当家的媳妇，大权旁落，一切家务都由小姑秉承母命而行。

If the empire was the Manchus' family property, then the Manchu Shen did resemble a daughter coming home for a visit, or returning as a widow, and taking over the management of her natal household.
如果说天下是满洲人的天下，作为满人的沈桂芬，确似归宁或者居娟的姑奶奶，越粗代庖在娘家主持家务。


The closest parallel in the Hu family was the old lady's affection for Madam Luosi, which resembled Cixi's trust in Shen.
胡家的情形最相象的一点是，老太太喜欢螺蛳太太，就象慈禧太后宠信沈桂芬那样，

At the daily morning “audience,” when the day's important business was discussed, Madam Luosi usually raised a matter and the old lady approved it.
每天“上朝”——一早在胡老太太那里商量这夭有什么要紧的事要办，通常都是螺蛳太太先提出来，胡老太太认可，

Alternatively, the old lady would ask and Madam Luosi would propose a solution.
或者胡老太太问到，螺蛳太太提出意见来商量，

往往言听计从，

决定之后才由胡老太太看着大太太问一句：“你看呢？”

Sometimes even that was omitted.
有时甚至连这句话都不问。

Truly difficult matters, however, were not put to the old lady at all, and bad news was particularly to be concealed.
但是，真正为难的事，是不问胡老太太的，尤其是坏消息，更要瞒住。

Madam Luosi decided what she could herself and asked Hu about what she could not.
螺蛳太太的做法是，能作主就作主了，不能作主问胡雪岩。

If he was absent and a decision carrying some responsibility or risk of blame had to be made, she would consult the First Madam, hoping not for a useful idea but for someone to share the responsibility.
倘或胡雪岩不在而必要作主，这件事又多少有责任，或许会受埋怨时，螺蛳太太就会跟大太太去商量，这样做并不是希望大太太会有什么好办法拿出来，而是要她分担责任。

Tonight's news was too serious.
不过这晚上谢云青来谈的这件事是太大了，情形也太坏了，

It would terrify the old lady; even the First Madam might fall ill with anxiety.
胡老太太如果知道了，会受惊吓，即令是大太太，只怕也会急出病来。

Yet to decide alone would be more responsibility than she could bear.
但如不告诉她，自己单独作了决走，这个责任实在担不起，

Telling her, on the other hand, meant considering the consequences.
告诉她呢，不能不考虑后果——

Xie was right: to steady the situation, they must first keep their own composure.
谢云青说得不错，如今要把局势稳住，自己先不能乱，

Rumours outside were one thing.
外面谣言满天飞都还不要紧，

A single admission from within the family that they could not hold on would bring complete and irretrievable ruin.
倘由胡家的人说一句撑不下去的话，那就一败涂地，无药可救了。


“Madam!”
“太太！”

She started slightly and looked up.
螺蛳太太微微一惊，抬眼看去，

A'yun, her senior maid, stood in the doorway.
是大丫头阿云站在门口，

She had replaced Ruixiang as Madam Luosi's most trusted confidante.
她如今代替了瑞香的地位，成为螺蛳太太最信任的心腹，

Wearing a soft rose-purple satin lined jacket, she rubbed her sleepy eyes and suddenly looked astonished.
此时穿一件玫瑰紫软缎小套夹，揉一揉惺松的倦眼，顿时面露惊讶之色。

“Haven't you slept?”
“太太没有睡过？”

“No.
“嗯！”

Pour me some tea.”
螺蛳太太说：“倒杯茶我喝。”

A'yun brought it and said as she handed it over, “Hong'er told me Mr Xie came in the middle of the night—” “Don't ask questions.”
阿云去倒了茶，一面递，一面说：“红鬼告诉我，谢先生半夜里来见太太……”“不要多问。”

Madam Luosi waved her away with some impatience.
螺蛳太太略有些不耐烦地挥着手。

Just then, the watch gong sounded again and the morning bell began to ring.
就这时更锣又响，晨钟亦动，

A'yun glanced back in alarm.
阿云回头望了一眼，失惊地说：

“It's five o'clock.
“五点钟了，

If you don't sleep now, it will soon be daylight.
太太再不睡，天就要亮了。

Madam Matchmaker is coming for her thirteenth chicken today.
今天‘大冰太太’来吃第十三只鸡，

The old lady particularly asked you to be there.
老太太特为关照，要太太也陪，

How will you manage unless you get a little sleep?”
再不睡一息，精神怎么够？”

In Hangzhou's official households, a male matchmaker was respectfully called Master Matchmaker and a woman Madam Matchmaker.
杭州的官宦人家称媒人为“大冰老爷”，女媒便是“大冰太太”，

Arranging a marriage was known as “eating thirteen and a half chickens.”
作媒叫做“吃十三只半鸡”，

Under the procedures of the Six Rites, a matchmaker made as many as thirteen journeys between the prospective bride's and groom's homes.
因为按照六礼的程序，自议婚到嫁娶，媒人往还于乾坤两宅，须十三趟之多，

Each visit required a fine meal, with at least a chicken killed in the visitor's honour.
每来应以盛馔相飨，至少也要杀鸡款待，

The joke was that a greedy matchmaker would come for another meal just before the bridal chair departed, but in the rush could eat only half a chicken.
而笑媒人贪嘴，花轿出发以前，还要来扰一顿，不过匆匆忙忙只来得及吃半只鸡，

Hence thirteen and a half.
因而谓之为“吃十三只半鸡”。

Today, the matchmaker for Hu's Third Miss was coming to discuss the final details.
这天是胡三小姐的媒人来谈最后的细节，

Her next visit would be for the half-chicken meal before the bridal chair arrived on the fifth day of the eleventh lunar month.
下一趟来，便是十一月初五花轿到门之前，吃半只鸡的时候了。


Madam Luosi did not answer her point.
螺蛳太太没有接她的话，

She only sighed.
只叹口气说：

“Third Miss has a hard fate too.” Then she added, “Go to Mengxiang Tower and see whether the madam there is awake.
“三小姐也命苦。”紧接着又说：“你到梦香楼去看看，那边太太醒了没有？

如果醒了，说我要去看她。”

“Now?”
“此刻？”

“Of course now!”
“当然是此刻。”

She was growing angry.
螺蛳太太有些发怒，

“What's the matter with you this morning?
“你今天早上怎么了？

话都听不清楚！”

A'yun dared say no more and slipped away.
阿云不敢作声，悄悄地走了，

Mengxiang Tower, where the First Madam lived, was some distance off.
大太太住的梦香楼很有一段路，

所以直到螺蛳太太喝完一杯热茶，阿云方始回来，后面跟着大太太的心腹丫头阿兰。

她就叫阿兰跟了我来问太太。”

Madam Luosi knew that the First Madam was habitually slow to act, but how could she still fail to distinguish what mattered?
螺蛳太太虽知大太太的性情，一向迟缓，但又何至于到此还分不出轻重，

When they reached Mengxiang Tower, the First Madam was up and smoking the first of her five daily water pipes.
一起到了梦香楼，大太太已经起床，正在吸一天五次的第一次水烟。

“And dressed already.”
“而且打扮好了。”

螺蛳太太不即回答，

回头看了看说：

不叫不要上来。”

阿兰愣了一下，将在屋子里收拾床铺里衣服的三个丫头都带了出动，顺手关上房门。

螺蛳太太却直到楼梯上没有声响了，方始开口：

阜康‘上排门了’。”

大太太一时没有听懂，

心想上排门打烊，不见得要打电报来，

念头尚未转完，蓦地省悟，

“It happened yesterday afternoon.

现在宓本常人面不见。”

有他在，不会倒。”大太太说了这一句，重又吹燃纸媒，“呼噜噜、呼噜噜”地，水烟吸个不停。

螺蛳太太心里奇怪，

想不到她真沉得住气，

看起来倒是应该跟她讨主意了，

说到这里，她停下来等候大太太的反应。

有“上排门”这句话在先，“卸排门”当然就是开门做生意的意思，

“I think that, rather than let other people force us to fail, we had better fail ourselves.

不是，不是！”螺蛳太太急忙更正：

老爷不晓得啥辰光到？”

Today.”
应该是今天。”

“今天！”

Just this one day too late,” the First Madam said regretfully.
大太太惋惜地说：“就差今天这一天。”

她的意思是，胡雪岩如能早到一天，必可安度难关，

而螺蛳太太却没有这样的信心。

Only a wife married to him from the beginning could trust him so completely.
到底是结发夫妻，对丈夫这样信任得过，

But what use was that?
可是没有用！

In a crisis, she thought, you still have much to learn.
她心里在说：要应付难关，只怕你还差得远。

Her competitive spirit revived, along with her usual decisiveness.
这样转着念头，不由得又起了争强好胜之心，也恢复了她平时处享有决断的样子，

“Madam, this burden now falls on both of us.
“太太，”她首先声明：“这副担子现在是我们两个人来挑，

We must discuss what to do together.
有啥事情，我们商量好了办，

Whatever the outcome, the responsibility will be shared.”
做好做坏，是两个人的责任。”

“I understand.
“我明白。

Put forward whatever ideas you have, just as usual.”
你有啥主意，尽管拿出来，照平常一样。”

“Just as usual” meant she could decide and act for herself.
照平常一样，就是螺蛳太太不妨独断独行。

At such a moment, however, respect for the First Madam's position was necessary, so she continued in a tone of consultation.
当然此刻应该尊重她的地位，所以仍是商量的语气。


“First, I think we must keep this completely from the old lady.
“我想，这个消息第一个要瞒紧老太太。

We'll call the male and female stewards together shortly and give them instructions.
等一下找内外男女总管来交代，

Will you speak, or shall I?”
是你说，还是我说？”

“You speak.”
“你说好了。”

“I'll do the speaking, but you must be present.”
“说是我说，太太也要在场。”

“I will.”
“我会到，”

“Madam Matchmaker is coming at noon, and the old lady wants me to attend too.
“今天中午请大冰太太。”螺蛳太太又说，“老太太的意思，要我也要陪。

I'm afraid you must entertain her on your own.
我看只好太太一个人做主人了，

I have to go to the provincial treasurer's residence.”
我要到藩台衙门去一趟。”

“To see his second concubine?”
“是去看他们二姨太？”

“Not just her.
“不光是她，

I want to speak to Treasurer De himself.
我想还要当面同德藩台说一说，

I shall have to wait there, and probably won't be back by noon.
要在那里等，中午只怕赶不回来。”

The old lady may ask.”
螺蛳太太提醒她说：“老太太或者会问。”

“What shall I say?”
“问起来怎么说？”

“Isn't Treasurer De's eldest daughter going to Beijing for the selection of palace women?
“德藩台的大小姐，不是‘选秀女’要进京了吗，

Say Mrs De has invited me to discuss it.”
就说德太太为这件事邀我去商量。

“Oh, I understand.”
“噢！我晓得了。”

Madam Luosi rose.
螺蛳太太站起身来说：

“Please get dressed.
“太太请换衣服吧！

I'll call them together.”
我去把他们叫拢来。”


Those summoned were the Hu family's seven stewards: four men and three women.
“叫扰来”的是胡家的七个管家四男三女，

The women mattered most, since the men seldom passed the inner gate except under special circumstances and were less likely to let the news slip.
要紧的是三个女管家，因为男管家除非特别情形，不入中门，不怕他们会泄漏消息。

见面的地方是在靠近中门的一座厅上，胡家下人称之为“公所”，

The male and female stewards used it for joint discussions, and Madam Luosi often addressed them there at festivals or when important instructions were needed.
男女总管有事商量都在此处，逢年过节，或者有什么重要话要交代，螺蛳太太也常用到这个地方。

But this was the first meeting that required candles to be lit.
但象这天要点了蜡烛来说话，却还是头一遭。

Everyone felt an indefinable dread.
因此，每一个人都有一种没有来由的恐惧，

The first cold spell of the eleventh lunar month had arrived, and even their fox-fur coats could not keep the dawn chill from their bones.
而且十一月的天气，冷汛初临，那些男女总管的狐裘，竟挡不住彻骨的晓寒，

Their teeth chattered.
一个个牙齿都在抖战。

Guided by two rows of palace lanterns, the two mistresses, principal and subordinate, approached slowly and took their seats behind a large round table.
两行宫灯，引导着正副两大方冉冉而至，进了厅堂，两人在一张大圆桌后面坐了下来，

They removed their black-fox muffs.
卸下玄狐袖筒，

A'lan and A'yun put gold hand warmers into their hands, then took gold water pipes from the younger maids and began to fill them.
阿兰与阿云将两具金手炉送到她们手里，随即又由小丫头手里接过金水烟袋开始装烟。

“No.”
“不要！”

Madam Luosi waved A'yun away and glanced at the First Madam.
螺蛳太太向阿云摇一摇手，又转脸看一看大太太。

“Go ahead,” the latter said.
“你说吧！”


Madam Luosi cleared her throat and spoke in a voice rather lower than usual.
于是螺蛳太太咳嗽一声，用比平时略为低沉的声音说：

“Today is the second.
“今天初二，

Third Miss's wedding is on the fifth, three days from now.
大后天就是三小姐的好日子，

You must all work a little harder.
大家多辛苦，

Everything will proceed as usual.”
一切照常。”

Working harder was to be expected, but why the reassurance that everything would be as usual?
“多辛苦”是应该的，“一切照常”的话由何而来？

The thought made Old Mother He's throat itch, and her chronic cough broke out violently.
一想到此，素来有咳嗽毛病的老何妈，顿觉喉头发痒，大咳特咳。

Everyone looked at her in annoyance, making her more nervous and the coughing worse.
大家都憎厌地望着她，以致老何妈越发紧张，咳得越凶。

Madam Luosi, however, showed no irritation.
但螺蛳太太却是涵养功深，毫无温色，

“A'yun, pour Old Mother He some hot tea.”
“阿云，”她说：“你倒杯热茶给老何妈。”

Another maid had already brought it and asked quietly, “Would you like me to help you somewhere else to rest?”
不用她吩咐，早有别的小丫头倒了茶来，并轻声问道：“要不要搀你老人家到别处去息一息？”

“It will pass in a moment,” Madam Luosi intervened.
“马上就会好的。”螺蛳太太听见了，这样阻止，

Then, as the cough subsided, she asked, “Have you taken your tonic paste?”
又问咳已止住的老何妈：“你的膏滋药吃了没有？”

“Not yet.”
“还没有。”

Old Mother He smiled apologetically.
老何妈赔笑说道：

“With Third Miss's wedding, everyone has been busy.
“三小姐的喜事，大家都忙，

I haven't had this year's prepared.”
今年的膏滋药，我还没有去配呢！”

“You aren't busy; you're lazy.
“你不是忙，是懒。”

A'gao!”
螺蛳太太喊一声：“阿高！”

“Here.”
“在。”

“Send someone to have four batches of tonic paste made up for Old Mother He.
“你叫人替老何妈去配四服膏滋药，

Charge them to me.”
出我的帐好了。”

A'gao, the steward responsible for outside errands and purchasing, answered, “Yes.”
阿高是专管“外场”形同采办的一个主管，当下答一声：“是。”

After Old Mother He had thanked her, Madam Luosi continued, “You are all old members of this household, and none of you is young.
等老何妈道过谢，螺蛳太太又说：“你们都是胡家的老人，都上了年纪了，

You should take something to build up your strength.
应该进进补，

When you have time, see Mr Cai at Qingyu Hall and ask for a prescription.
有空就在庆余堂去看看蔡先生，请他开个方子，

Whatever quantity you need can be charged to the household.”
该配几服，都算公帐。”

Such kindness was common.
这种“恩典”是常有的，

Fusheng, the oldest and longest-serving, led the thanks as usual.
照例由年纪最大，在胡家最人的福生领头称谢，

Yet they remained puzzled.
但却不免困惑，

Had they been summoned at this cold hour simply to hear these few remarks?
这样冷的黎明时分把大家“叫拢来”，只是为了说这几句话？

Of course not.
当然不是！

Still, her unhurried composure had done much to ease their sense of impending disaster.
不过看螺蛳太太好整以暇的神情，大家原有的那种大祸临头的感觉，倒是减轻了好些。


When she resumed, she first answered the question in their minds.
再度宣示的螺蛳太太，首先就是解答存在大家心头的疑惑，

“Why do I say everything will proceed as usual?
“为啥说一切照常，

Is there some reason it might not?
莫非本来不应该照常的？

In a way, yes.
话也可以这样子说，

A telegram came from Shanghai yesterday.
因为昨天上海打来一个电报，

Conditions are poor, and Fukang must close for a couple of days.”
市面不好，阜康要停两天……”

She paused deliberately to study their reactions.
说到这里，她特为停下来，留意大家的反应——

They varied.
反应不一，

Some were unmoved, whether because they had not understood or because they had no idea how grave it was.
有的无动于中，不知道是没有听懂，还是根本不了解这件事是如何不得了，

有的却是脸色如死，显然认为败落已经开始了，

有的比较沉着，脸色肃穆地等待着下文，

Only A'gao, the purchasing steward who dealt with the outside world, looked evasive, his eyes darting restlessly.
只有一个人，就是跑“外场”管采办的阿高，形神闪烁，眼珠滴溜溜地转个不定，

She made a mental note of it.
螺蛳太太记在心里了。

“Mr Xie came last night and asked what to do.
“昨天晚上谢先生来告诉我，问我讨办法，

I discussed it with Madam.
我同太太商量过了，

The trouble has arisen at an awkward moment between outgoing and incoming funds, while our master happens to be travelling.
毛病出在青黄不接的当口，正好老爷在路上。

老爷一回来就不要紧了。

你们大家都是跟老爷多年的人，

总晓得老爷有老爷的法子。是不是？”

“是。”福生代表大家回答：

“He has weathered countless storms in his life.
“老爷一生不晓得经过多少大风大浪，

这一回也难不倒他的。”

“It's simply bad timing.
“就是当口赶得不好！”

Think of us as a great ship whose captain happens to be on the opposite bank.
螺蛳太太接口道：“如今好比一只大船，船老大正好在对岸，

我们要把这只船撑过去，把他接到船上，

由他来掌舵，这只船一定可以稳下来，照样往前走。

现在算是我同太太在掌舵，

We are confident of reaching the other side, but you must help her.”
撑到对岸这一点把握还有，不过大家要帮太大的忙。”

“请两位太太吩咐。”仍然是由福生接话。

“An old saying tells us to cross the river together in the same boat.

一条船上不管多少人，性命只有一条，

要死大家死，要活大家活，

这一层大家要明白。”

“是。”有几个人同声答应。

“In a storm, the worst danger is confusion among our own people.
“遇到风浪，最怕自己人先乱，

一个要往东、一个要往西，一个要回头、一个要照样向前，

意见一多会乱，一乱就要翻船。

所以大家一定要稳下来。”

螺蛳太太略停一停问说：

当然不会有人，

沉默了一会，福生说道：“请螺蛳太太说下去。”


“Since everyone is willing to share the boat's fate, remember that harming others means harming yourselves.
“既然大家愿意同船合命，就一定要想到，害人就是害己。

Listen carefully.
我有几句话，大家听好，

First, this matter must not be discussed in any of the towers or halls, above all in the old lady's rooms.”
第一，不准在各楼各厅，尤其是老太太那里去谈这件事。”

“Yes!”
“是！”

“Second, as the saying goes, whoever brings tales is a troublemaker.
“第二，俗语说的‘来说是非者，便是是非人’，

Do not go about talking.
你们自己先不要到处去乱说，

If anyone asks, consider who it is.
如果有人来打听这件事，要看对方的情形，

If it is someone with no business knowing, say you don't know.
不相干的人，回答他一句：”不晓得。

If it is a close friend with a real concern for the Hu family, you may reassure them sincerely: it's a temporary disturbance in the market, nothing serious.”
‘倘或情分深，也是关心我们胡家的，不妨诚诚恳恳安慰他们几句，市面上一时风潮，不要紧的。

Seeing nods and expressions of understanding, she felt easier and announced her third point, again beginning with a proverb.
“看大家纷纷点头或者颇能领悟的表情，螺蛳太太比较放心了，接着宣布第三件事。第三件事仍旧是用一句俗语开头：

“A tall tree catches the wind.

大家平时难免有得罪了人的地方，

Some will be delighted that Fukang is keeping its shutters up; others may take the chance to play tricks.
所以阜康不下排门，一定会有人高兴，或者乘此机会出点什么花样。

‘见怪不怪，其怪自败’，

If people are gossiping, pay no attention.
听见有人在说闲话，不必理他们，

If you discover someone plotting something, tell me quietly.
倘或发现有人出花样，悄悄儿来告诉我，

只要查实了确有其事，来通风报信的人，我私下有重赏。

A'yun!”
“说到这里，螺蛳太太回头叫一声：”阿云！

The maid stepped forward from behind her. “Here.”
““在这里。”阿云从她身后转到她身旁。

“Whoever comes to the inner gate asking to see me, you are to meet them.

有啥话你直接来告诉我，

If anything leaks out, you will answer for it.
如果泄漏了，唯你是问，

Do you understand?”
你听明白了没有。”

Not only A'yun but everyone present understood.
不但阿云听明白了，所有的人亦都心里有数，

Information would be well rewarded, provided it was passed through Madam Luosi's trusted maid.
只要告密就有重赏，不过一定要跟螺蛳太太的心腹阿云接头，

The secret would be safe, and the message would reach her faithfully.
不但不会泄漏机密，而且话亦一定能够不折不扣地转达。

“太太有没有什么话交代？”螺蛳太太转脸问说。

福生，你倒说说看，老爷是怎样子起来的？

有两回大家看他输定了，哪晓得老爷象下棋，早就有人马埋伏在那里，

‘死棋肚子里出仙着’。

这一回，老爷一定也有棋在那里，不过我们不晓得，

等老爷一回来就好了。”

“You have heard him,” the First Madam said.
“你们都听见了。”大太太说：

你们只当没有这桩事情好了。”


Before noon, it seemed that all Hangzhou knew Fukang Bank was in trouble.
未到中午，好象杭州城里都已知道阜康钱庄“出毛病了”！

Many people were “hawking the Court Gazette,” as Hangzhou people called running about spreading news.
“卖朝报”的人也很不少——奔走相告，杭州人谓之“卖朝报”。

Some did so because nothing so extraordinary had happened since the fall of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.
固然有的是因为这是从太平天国失败以来，从未有过的大新闻，

More were personally affected.
但更多的人是由于利害相关，

Hu had so many enterprises that countless people depended on him directly or indirectly.
胡雪岩的事业太多了，跟他直接间接发生关系的人，不知道多少，

最着急的是公济典总管唐子韶的姨太太月如，

For some time, people around the Hu household had been making businesses out of supplying it.
原来先是有胡家周围的人，以胡家为目标在做生意，

Madam Luosi disapproved, but Hu thought that benefits should stay among one's own people and that everyone was free to do business.
螺蛳太太很不赞成，但胡雪岩认为“肥水不落外人田”，而且做生意是个人自由，

There was nothing to condemn.
无可厚非。

这样久而久之，成了一种风气，月如见猎心喜，也做过一回生意，

At Old Madam Hu's birthday, the banquets had drawn in almost every celebrated cook in Hangzhou.
那是胡老太太做生日，大排筵席，杭州厨子这一行中有名的几乎一网打尽，

Yueru partnered with a cook named Sun, catered for one day, and made more than four hundred taels, to her great satisfaction.
月如跟一个孙厨合作，包了一天，赚了四百多两银子，非常得意。

For Third Miss's wedding, the banquets were to be held at five locations.
这回胡三小姐出阁，喜筵分五处来开，

The Hu household's own cooks would serve the guests of highest standing; the other four were contracted out.
除了头等客人，由胡家的厨子，自行备办以外，其余四处都找人承办。

A'gao was close to Tang, so Yueru knew him well.
阿高跟唐子韶走得很近，月如当然相熟，

托他设法包了一处，午晚两场，一共要开一百二十桌，
