威风更足，事情也就更容易办了。”

“Yes, that is easy.
“是，是，这倒容易，

I know Magistrate Wang of Renhe well.”
仁和县的王大老爷，我很熟。”

The more Ma heard, the keener he became.
马逢时越听越有兴趣，很起劲地问：

“And after we have the answers?
“问出来以后呢？”

Do we summon Tang for questioning?”
是不是再传唐子韶来问。“


“You will not need to summon him.
“用不着你去传他，

He will come to your house and ask to see you.”
他自己会到府上来求见。”

“What makes you so sure?”
“何以见得？”

“Well...” Zhou hesitated.
“这……”周少棠迟疑一下，

“Let me have a word with Old Yang first.”
说声：“我先同老杨说句话。”

Drawing the clerk aside, he quietly asked about his relationship with Ma.
“他将杨书办拉到一边，悄悄问他跟马逢时的关系。

Yang told him truthfully, and Zhou asked another question.
杨书办据实以告，周少棠便另有话问了。

“The New Year is approaching.
“快过年了，

His Honour will naturally want to find a little money to see him through it?”
马木老爷当然要弄几个过年盘缠是不是？”

“Of course.
“当然。”

You mean he should squeeze something out of Tang?”
杨书办问：“你的意思是要他敲唐子韶一笔？”

“Exactly.
“不错，

But both public and private interests must be considered.
不过，公私要兼顾，

He can give Tang two conditions.
他可以同唐子韶提条件：

First, Tang must redeem the pledged articles himself: that protects the public interest.
条一，要他拿原当赎回去，这是公，

Second, he must provide a few taels for the New Year.
第二，要弄几两银子过年，

His Honour can negotiate the amount with Tang—or you can.
数目他自己同唐子韶去谈……或者，同你谈。

If Tang refuses, report him and let him face prosecution.”
如果唐子韶不就范，报上去请他吃官司。

Yang considered it, decided the scheme was workable, and smiled.
“杨书办盘算了一下，觉得其事可行，笑笑说道：

“You really are a good friend to Mr Hu.”
“你对胡大先生倒是蛮够朋友。”

“One must not forget the friends of one’s poverty,” Zhou replied, dropping into a literary phrase.
“贫贱之交不可忘。”周少棠掉了句文，

The quotation was not altogether appropriate, but neither could one say it made no sense.
虽然有些不伦，却不能说他这句话不通。


As they discussed the matter further, a change came about naturally: the task of assisting Ma passed from Zhou to Yang.
两人再深入地谈了一下，自然而然地出现了一种演变，即是襄助马逢时的工作，由周少棠移转到杨书办身上。

Zhou would still support them from behind the scenes.
不过周少棠仍在幕后支援，

They agreed that he would sit drinking tea at Anli Tea House, opposite Fukang Bank.
商定他在阜康钱庄对面的一家安利茶店喝茶，

Gongji was only a step away, so they could contact him whenever necessary.
公济典近在咫尺，有事随时可以接头。

Returning to the table together, Zhou explained, “Your Honour, you and Clerk Yang know each other well.
等相偕回到原座，周少棠作了交代，“马大者爷，”他说：“你同杨书办很熟，

Ask him to accompany you tomorrow; it will be easier to discuss anything that arises.
明天请他陪了你去，有啥话说起来也方便。

I have told him the essential points, and this assignment will certainly go well.”
其中的窍门，我同杨书办说过了，这桩差使，一定可以办得漂亮。”

He then rose, said goodbye, and left.
说着起身告辞而去。

By now lights shone from every house, and drinkers were streaming into the tavern.
其时已是万家灯火，酒客络绎而至，

It was extremely noisy.
热闹非凡，

If they spoke softly they could not be heard; if loudly, they risked revealing their secrets.
说话轻了听不见，重了又怕泄漏机密，

Yang suggested going elsewhere for another drink.
杨书办提议另外找个地方去喝酒。

“Where?”
“到哪里？”

“Come with me.
“你跟我去，

But I must say this first: when we get there, I cannot address you by your title.
不过，”杨书办声明在行先，“马大老爷，到了那个地方，我不便用尊称，

Calling you ‘Your Honour’ would give you away.”
一叫马大者爷，露了相不好。”

“Never mind.
“不要紧，

Call me Old Ma.”
你叫我老马好了。”

“Better not use your real surname either.
“最好连姓都不要用真的。

What is your honoured mother’s surname?”
你们老太太尊姓？”

“Li.”
“姓李。”

“Then I shall call you Old Li.
“我就叫你老李了。

It is not far.
离这里不远，

Let us walk.”
我们走了去。”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第七章（一）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Seven, Part One
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER SEVEN: THE MASS SEQUESTRATION OF THE PAWNSHOPS｜第七章 大封典铺


Clerk Yang paid the bill and led Ma Fengshi across two streets into a winding lane.
杨书办惠了帐，带着马逢时穿过两条街，进入一条曲曲折折的小巷，

At its end stood a house with both doors shut.
在巷底有一家人家，双扉紧闭，

An oil lamp beside the entrance cast a feeble light on a faded rose-red slip of paper bearing the words “Sun Residence.”
但门旁有一盏油灯，微弱的光焰，照出一张退了色的梅红笺，上写“孙寓”二字。

“What is this place?” Ma asked uneasily.
“这是什么地方？”马逢时有些不安地问。

“Ma…” Yang checked himself.
“马……”杨书办赶紧顿住，

“Old Li, you must not tell Mrs Li about this place.”
“老李，这个地方你不能告诉李大嫂。”

Ma said no more.
一听这话，马逢时不再作声，

Yang knocked three times quickly and three times slowly.
只见杨书办举手敲门，三急三缓，

As he finished, the door creaked open.
刚刚敲完，大门呀地一声开了，

A middle-aged woman, still attractive, held up a hand lantern.
一个半老徐娘，高举着“手照”说：

“I wondered who it was.
“我道哪个，

You!
是你。

I thought it was about time you came.”
算算你也应该来了。”

Her face filled with smiles.
接着，脸上浮满了笑容又问：

“And this gentleman is…?”
“这位是……”

“Mr Li,” Yang answered, then asked at once, “Any guests upstairs?”
“李老板。”杨书办紧接着问：“楼上有没有客人？”

“No.”
“没有。”

“Downstairs?”
“楼下呢？”

“Old Zhu from Qingyu Hall is drinking with some friends.
“庆余堂的老朱同朋友在那里吃酒，

They will be leaving soon.”
就要走的。”

“His employer is in trouble, yet he still has a mind for courtesan parties!
“他们东家遭难，他倒还有心思吃花酒。”杨书办又说：

Do not tell him I am here.”
“你不要说我在这里。”

“As if I needed reminding!”
“多关照的。”

The woman turned to “Mr Li.”
那半老徐娘招呼“李老板”说：

“Come with me, please.
“请你跟我来。

Mind your step.”
走好！”

The three of them went up the stairs beside the main room.
于是一行三人，由堂屋侧面的楼梯上楼，

Upstairs were three rooms, one large and two small.
楼上一大两小三个房间，

In the central room, once their hostess had brightened the lamp, Yang introduced her.
到了当中大房间，等主人剔亮了灯，杨书办方为马逢时引见。

“Her surname is Sun.
“她姓孙。

You can call her Auntie Sun.”
你叫她孙干娘好了。”

Ma now understood: this was what Hangzhou people called a private brothel, and Auntie Sun was its madam.
马逢时已经了然，这里是杭州人所说的“私门头”，而孙干娘便是鸨儿，

Smiling broadly, he said, “You must have a great many daughters, Auntie Sun?”
当即笑嘻嘻地说道：“孙子娘的子女儿一定很多？”

“Indeed I do.”
“有，有。”

She turned to Yang.
孙子娘转脸问杨书办：

“Tea first, or wine?”
“先吃茶还是先吃酒？”

“Both—and we shall want a meal as well.”
“茶也要，酒也要，还要吃饭。”

He drew her into the outer room and returned some time later.
说着，杨书办拉着孙干娘到外房，过了好一会才进来。


“Auntie Sun may be past her first youth, but she still has plenty of charm,” Ma remarked.
“这个孙干娘，倒是徐娘半老，丰韵犹存。”马逢时说道。

“What?
“怎么？

Have you taken a fancy to her?
你倒看中她了！

I shall be your matchmaker.”
我来做媒。”

“Enough of that!
“算了，算了！

Let us discuss our business first.”
我们先谈正事。”

This suited Yang’s arrangements perfectly.
这话正好符合杨书办的安排，

He had instructed Auntie Sun to prepare good wine and a good meal, but to take her time, so he could settle tomorrow’s business with Ma before they drank freely.
他已关照好孙干娘备酒备饭，要讲究，但不妨慢慢来，公便跟马逢时先谈妥了明日之事，再开怀畅饮。

“Leave the rest of your business to me.
“你的事归我来接下半段。

First, how much do you owe at the year’s end?”
我先问你，你年底有多少帐？”

Ma was taken aback.
马逢时一愣，

After a rough calculation, he said, “I shall need fifty or sixty taels to get through it.”
约莫估计了一下说：“总要五六十两银子才能过关。”

“I understand.
“我晓得了。”杨书办说：

I shall go with you tomorrow.
“明天我陪了你去，

Once we reach Gongji Pawnshop, take your cue from my eyes.”
到了公济典，你看我的眼色行事。”

What exactly did that mean?
何谓看眼色行事？

Ma pondered it for a while.
马逢时在心里好好想了一会问道：

“Brother Yang…”
“杨大哥……”

“Wait!” Yang cut him short.
“慢点，慢点。”杨书办硬截断了他的话，

“You must not address me like that at Gongji tomorrow.”
“明天在公济典，你可不能这样叫我。”

“I understand.
“我明白。

When holding an office, observe its forms.
做此官，行此札，

I shall call you ‘Clerk Yang’ in my grandest official manner.
到那时候，我自然会官派十足地叫你杨书办，

Do not take offence.”
你可不要生气。”

“Of course not.
“不会，不会。

We are only putting on a performance.”
这不过是唱出戏而已。”

“You are the leading player.
“这出戏你是主角。”马逢时问：

Do you know Tang Zishao?”
“你认识不认识唐子韶。”

“Naturally, though we are not close.”
“怎么不认识，不过没有什么交情。”

“Good.
“你认识最好，

Tomorrow I shall play the stern red face and you the kindly white.
我想明天我做红脸，你做白脸，

If anything is wrong, I shall speak with official severity and you can smooth matters over.
遇见有不对的地方，我打官腔，你来转圜，

Tang will naturally turn to you.
唐子韶当然就要找上你了，

Whether something can be overlooked or must not be, I shall follow the tone you take.”
什么事可以马虎，什么事不能马虎，我都听你的语气来办。

“Exactly!” Yang said with satisfaction.
““一点不错。”杨书办很欣慰他说，

“We shall give a fine performance of Returning to Court in Triumph.”
“我们好好儿来唱他一出‘得胜回朝’。”


Footsteps sounded on the stairs.
谈到这里，楼梯上有响声，

The curtain lifted, and Auntie Sun entered, followed by a maid carrying a large tray with four dishes and two sets of cups and chopsticks.
只见帘启处，孙干娘在前，后面跟着女佣，手中端一个大托盘，四样酒菜，两副杯筷。

“Why only two?” Yang asked.
“怎么只有两副？”杨书办问。

“I thought you had business to discuss and would not want to be disturbed.”
“我怕你们要谈事情，不要旁人来打搅。

“We have finished.
“谈好了，

Bring two more sets.
再去添两副来。”杨书办问：

Is Qiaozhen here?”
“巧珍在不在？”

“She has not come today.
“今天没有来。”孙干娘说：

A’lan is here, though.
“阿兰在这里，

I do not know whether Mr Li would care for her.”
不晓得李老板看得中，看不中？”

Noticing that Ma could not take his eyes off Auntie Sun, Yang decided to bring about a brief liaison between them.
杨书办心中一动，因为看到马逢时目不转睛地看着孙干娘，决心成全他们这一段露水姻缘，

“We shall see later,” he said.
当即说道：“等一等再说。

“Have a couple of cups with us first.”
你先陪我们吃两杯。”

More cups and chopsticks were brought.
于是又去添了杯筷来，

Auntie Sun served the guests attentively, and Ma kept praising the wine and food.
孙干娘为客人布菜斟酒，颇为周到，马逢时不住地夸赞酒好菜好，

Yang merely smiled.
杨书办只是微笑不语。

When he thought the time was right, he asked, “Old Zhu from Qingyu Hall has not left yet?”
看看是时候了，他问：“庆余堂的老朱还没有走吧？”

“Not yet.”
“还没有？”

“I shall go down and see him.”
“我下楼去看一看他。”

Rising, Yang told Auntie Sun, “Keep Mr Li company over a few more cups.
杨书办站起身来，对孙干娘说：“你陪李老板多吃几杯，

He is a good friend of mine.
我的好朋友，

You must treat him especially well.”
你要另眼相看。”

He went downstairs and had an attendant announce him.
于是杨书办扬长下楼，叫相帮进去通知，

Old Zhu came out, his face flushed scarlet.
床余堂的老朱，满脸通红地迎了出来，

“Yang!
“老杨，老杨！”

Come in for a drink!” he said, taking his hand.
他拉着他的手说：“请进来吃酒。”

“Would it be convenient?”
“方便不方便。”

“Certainly.
“方便，方便。

Everyone is either a friend of yours or a friend of mine.”
不是你的熟人，就是我的熟人。”

Inside, Yang knew three of the four men.
进去一看，四个人中只有一个不认识，

On asking the fourth man’s name, he learned that he was Zhu’s colleague.
请教姓名，才知道是老朱的同事。

Yang had joined the party partly to leave Ma an opportunity to make advances to Auntie Sun and partly to find out how Qingyu Hall was faring.
杨书办之来闯席，一则是故意避开，好让马逢时有跟孙千娘勾搭的机会，再则便是打听庆余堂的情形，

What especially puzzled him was how Zhu could be enjoying himself so heartily when all Hu Xueyan’s businesses were in peril.
尤其使他困惑而又好奇的是，胡雪岩的全盘事业，都在风雨飘摇之中，何以老朱竟还兴高采烈地在这里寻欢作乐。


After the greetings and a round of drinks, someone mentioned the crisis at Fukang.
席间一一应酬过了，一巡酒下来有人提起阜康的风波，

It was the great news of the day throughout the country, discussed at almost every social gathering.
这是最近轰动南北的大新闻，凡是应酬场中，几乎无一处不资以为谈助。

Yang listened quietly until there was a pause.
杨书办只是静静地听着，等到谈得告一段落时，他开口了。

“Zhu, what exactly is your job at Qingyu Hall?”
“老朱，你在庆余堂是啥职司？”

“I handle inspections.”
“我管查验。”

“Inspections of what?
“查验？”杨书办问：“查验点啥？

The quality of the goods?
查验货色？

You did not start in the medicinal-herb trade.
你又不是药材行出身，

You cannot tell whether the ingredients come from the proper sources.”
药材‘路脚’正不正，你又不懂。”

“I may not know their quality, but I can read a weight!
“货色好坏不懂，斤两多少还不会看？

Once the experienced men pronounce the herbs genuine, they call me to supervise the weighing.
等看货的老先生说药材地道，过秤时就要请我了。”

My most important duty, though, is preventing goods from being stolen or spirited away.”
老朱又说：“不过，我顶重要的一项职司，是防备货色偷漏。”

“Have you ever caught anyone?”
“有没有抓到过。”

“Of course, but not many.”
“当然抓到过，不过不多。”

“You say not many.
“你说不多；

Perhaps goods have disappeared without your knowing.”
只怕已经偷漏了的，你不晓得。

“No.” Zhu paused.
“不会。”老朱停了一下说：

“To be frank, even if you urged the men to steal, they would refuse.
“老实说，你就叫人偷漏，你们也不肯。

Think of it: their rice bowls may not be gold or silver, but they are at least iron, unbreakable for a lifetime.
你倒想，饭碗虽不是金的、银的，至少也是铁的，一生一世敲不破；

Besides wages, there are bonuses.
工钱之外有花红，

When summer epidemics bring customers queuing for medicines, there is an extra allowance.
遇到夏天有时疫流行，上门的主顾排长龙等药，另外有津贴。

If an adult or child at home falls ill, medicines—pills, powders, pastes or pellets—are free, however costly.
再说家里大人、小伢儿有病痛，用药不管丸散膏丹，再贵重的都是白拿，

They do pay for tonic pastes and medicinal wines, but at less than cost.
至于膏滋药、药酒，收是收钱，不过比成本还要低。

Steal a root or two of ginseng out of greed, and all those benefits vanish.
如果贪便宜，偷了一两支人参，这些好处都没有了，

Would that be worth it?”
你想划得来，划不来？“


“You have a point.
“你的话是不错，

But this time the whole thing may be uprooted!”
不过这回恐怕要连根铲了！”

“You mean Mr Hu’s businesses may not survive?
“你是说胡大先生的生意怕会不保？

I cannot speak for the others, but Qingyu Hall is certain to remain.”
别的难说，庆余堂一定保得住。”

“Why?”
“为啥？”

“It has protection,” Zhu replied calmly.
“有保障。”老朱从从容容地说：

“When the trouble at Fukang began, our manager told us that Qingyu Hall was the best of all Mr Hu’s enterprises.
“这回阜康的事情出来，我们的档手同大家说：胡大先生办得顶好的事业，就是我们庆余堂。

It earns money and has earned him a reputation too.
不但挣钱，还替胡大先生挣了名声。

Suppose they say there is a shortage of public funds and seal Qingyu Hall to cover the debt.
如果说亏空公款，要拿庆余堂封了抵债，

They can confiscate the stock and equipment, but they cannot take away its signboard.
货色生财，都可以入官，庆余堂这块招脾拿不出去的。

Qingyu Hall is only the short name.
庆余堂是简称，

The full name is Hu Qingyu Hall.
正式的招牌是胡庆余堂，

If the owner is no longer a Hu, how can they keep using that sign?
如果老板不姓胡了，怎么还好用庆余堂的招牌。

So the authorities are certain not to seal it.
所以官府一定不会封庆余堂，

They will let Mr Hu remain the owner.
仍旧让胡大先生来当老板。

We must all work especially hard, dispense genuine medicines and treat customers courteously.
大家要格外巴结，抓药要道地，对待客人要和气，

Then our rice bowls will be secure.
这只饭碗一定捧得实，

There is no need to worry.”
不必担心。”


Yang was deeply moved by what he heard.
听到这里，杨书办心中浮起浓重的感慨，

With enterprises on so vast a scale, Hu must have trained more capable men than anyone could count.
胡雪岩有如此大的事业，培植了不知道多少人材，是可想而知的事，

But if, at the beginning, he sought only assistants who would make money for him by whatever means, the result would be a Mi Benchang or a Tang Zishao.
但培植人材之始。如果只是为他自己找个不问手段，只要能替他嫌钱的帮手，结果不是宓本常，就是唐子韶，

As the water rose, so did the boat: an apprentice became an employee, an employee became a manager.
因为水涨船高，“徒弟”升伙计，伙计升档手，

Then the manager would think, “How did you become the proprietor?
这时候的档手心里就会想：“你做老板，

When I was an apprentice, I emptied your chamber pot and rinsed your water pipe with hot water.
还不是靠我做徒弟的时候，洗尿壶、烫水烟袋，

I raised you up step by step.
一步一步抬你起来的？

How long must I remain an employee?
伙计做到啥时候？

I want to be a proprietor myself.”
我要做老板了。”

Once that thought took hold, he ceased to be a true manager.
一动到这个念头，档手就不是档手了，

First came private trading on the side.
第一步是“做小货”，

If a profitable transaction presented itself, he took it for himself.
有好生意，自己来做，

Someone might offer a consignment he knew would make money; he would find fault with it in every way, then openly or indirectly suggest another place where a deal might be struck.
譬如有人上门求售一批货色，明知必赚，却多方挑剔，最后明点暗示，到某处去接头，有成交之望，

That place would be his own secret business.
其实指点之处就是他私下所设的号子。

Next, he would watch for talent, privately cultivating promising employees and apprentices so that, when he could establish himself, he would have his staff ready.
其次是留意人材，伙计、徒弟中看中了的，私下刻意笼络，一旦能成局面，不愁没有班底，

Finally came drawing away customers.
最后是拉拢客户，

There were many methods, but one thing was certain: to win them over, he would never speak well of his present employer.
其道孔多，但要拉拢客户，一定不会说原来的东家的好话，是一定的道理，

Otherwise, why would they change firms?
否则客户不会“跳槽”。

A selfish manager who decided to set up on his own would inevitably profit at his employer’s expense.
因此，只要有了私心重的档手，一到动了自立门户的念头，就必然损人以利己，侵蚀到东家的利益，

Even if the employer had trained him from the start, he would feel no ingratitude.
即令是东家所一手培植出来的，亦不会觉得自己忘恩负义，

He had made money for the man and believed that debt was already paid.
因为他替东家赚过钱，自以为已经报答过了。


The reason Qingyu Hall’s manager could be so sincere and understanding, doing everything to preserve its reputation and one part of Hu’s business, was not difficult to imagine.
庆余堂的档手能够如此通达诚恳，尽力维持庆余堂这块金字招牌，为胡雪岩保住一片事业，这原因是可想而知的，

Hu had founded the medicine shop because the troops on the western campaign required enormous quantities of prepared medicines and herbs.
胡雪岩当初创办庆余堂，虽起于西征将士所需要成药及药材，数量极大，

Buying them elsewhere was expensive and did not always ensure timely delivery.
向外采购不但费用甚巨，而且亦不见得能够及时供应，

Responsible for the supply administration behind the army, he had to calculate carefully.
他既负责后路粮台，当然要精打细算，

A large shop of his own would save money, save trouble and make supply easier.
自己办一家大药店，有省费、省事、方便三项好处，

He had not intended to earn a profit.
并没有打算赚钱，

Later, genuine ingredients and effective preparations brought flourishing trade and substantial earnings.
后来因为药材地道、成药灵验、营业鼎盛，大力赚钱。

But apart from profits reinvested to expand the business, the surplus paid for free medicines and treatment for the poor, and for large donations of prepared remedies during floods, droughts, famines and epidemics.
但盈余除了转为资本，扩大规模以外，平时对贫民施药施医，历次水旱灾荒、时疫流行，捐出大批成药，亦全由盈余上开支，

Hu had never taken a single cash from Qingyu Hall for his own use.
胡雪岩从来没有用过庆余堂的一文钱。


Because his original purpose was entirely public-spirited, he had sought a different sort of manager.
由于当初存心大公无私，物色档手的眼光，当然就不同了，

Honesty came first.
第一要诚实，

Just inside the shop, above the place where customers waited and rested, hung a black-lacquered couplet in gold: “Though none may see your medicines prepared, Heaven knows the intentions in your heart.”
庆余堂一进门，供顾客等药休息之处，高悬一幅黑漆金字的对联：“修合虽无人见，存心自有天知。”

A dishonest medicine seller, especially one selling ready-made preparations, could harm people by using poor ingredients or insufficient quantities.
因为不诚实的人卖药，尤其是卖成药，材料欠佳，分量不足，服用了会害人。

Compassion came next.
其次要心慈。

A physician must have the heart to sacrifice his own flesh for another; a medicine seller should be the same.
医家有割股之心，卖药亦是如此，

Only by constantly thinking of the sick could he constantly attend to quality.
时时为病家着想，才能刻刻顾到药的品质。

Finally, the man must be capable, or honesty and compassion might merely make him easy to deceive.
最后当然还要能干，否则诚实、心慈，反而成了易于受欺的弱点。

Such a manager, free from concern for the proprietor’s personal profit, would devote himself wholeheartedly to the business.
这样选中的一个档手，不必在意东家的利润，会全心全力去经营事业，

An unselfish employer would not awaken selfishness in him; generous treatment removed any need for it.
东家没有私心，也就引不起他的私心，加以待遇优厚，亦不必起什么私心。

Examined closely, Qingyu Hall’s escape from Fukang’s troubles exemplified the enduring truth that good causes bear good fruit.
庆余堂能不受阜康的影响，细细考查来龙去脉，自有种善因、得善果的颠扑不破之理在内。

Yang felt a spontaneous admiration for its manager, whose name he did not even know.
念头转到这里，不由得对那连姓名都还不知道的余庆堂的档手，油然而起敬慕之心。

Over their drinks he asked Zhu about the man’s history.
于是在把杯闲谈之际，杨书办向老朱问起此人的生平，

He learned that his surname was Ye and that a relative of Hu’s named Liu had originally found him.
据说庆余堂的档手姓叶；当初是由胡雪岩的一个姓刘的亲戚去物色来的，

What he heard of Ye’s character and ability broadly confirmed his deductions, making Yang still more pleased with himself.
性情、才干大致证明了杨书办的推断，这就更使他感到得意了。


“Your manager has done right by Mr Hu and by himself,” Yang said.
“你们的档手对得起胡大先生，也对得起自己，

“Not like that black-hearted Tang Zishao at Gongji.
不比公济典的那个黑良心的唐子韶，

I think he will soon find himself facing charges.”
我看他快要吃官司了。”

“What?” Zhu asked.
“怎么？”老朱问道：

“Where did you hear that?”
“你这话是哪里来的？”

Only then did Yang realise that wine had loosened his tongue.
这一问才使杨书办意识到酒后失言了。

Naturally, he would say no more.
他当然不肯再说，

After some evasive replies, he returned upstairs.
支支吾吾地敷衍了一会，重回楼上。

Ma and Auntie Sun were still drinking and talking.
楼上的马逢时与孙干娘，还在喝酒闲谈，

Their manner remained decorous, but they were plainly getting on very well.
彼此的神态倒都还庄重，但谈得很投机，却是看得出来的，

Yang joked, “Old Li, do not go home tonight.”
因而杨书办便开玩笑他说：“老李，今天不要回去了。”

“Whom are you speaking to?” Auntie Sun asked, glancing across.
“你在同哪个说话？”孙子娘瞟眼过来问说。

Before Yang could answer, Ma laughed.
杨书办尚未开口，马逢时却先笑了，

There was something behind that laugh, so Yang held his tongue.
这一笑自有蹊跷在内，他就不作声了。

“He is Magistrate Ma.
“明明是马大老爷，

Why did you call him Mr Li?” Auntie Sun demanded.
你怎么说是李老板？”孙干娘质问：

“Why tell a lie?”
“为啥要说假话？”

“I am sorry,” Ma apologised to Yang.
“对不起！”马逢时向杨书办致歉：

“She said I did not look like a businessman and asked where I had acquired my official manner, so I told her the truth.”
“她说我不象生意人，又问我哪里学来的官派，所以我跟她说了实话。”

“The truth?
“说了实话？”杨书办问：

What truth?
“是啥实话？

Anything besides who you are?”
除了身分还有啥？”

“Nothing else.”
“没有别的。”

Somewhat reassured, Yang turned to Auntie Sun.
杨书办比较放心了，转脸对孙干娘说：

“You must understand the importance of this.
“你要识得轻重，

Do not tell people Magistrate Ma has been here for pleasure.”
不要说马大老爷到你这里来玩过。”


“What is there to hide?
“这有啥好瞒的？

Even a circuit intendant has come here to drink.”
道台大人都到我这里来吃过酒。”

“Do not argue.
“你不要同我争，

If you want me to keep bringing friends, listen to me.” Yang continued, “We must go now.
你要我常常带朋友来，你就听我的话。”杨书办又说：“今天要走了，

Magistrate Ma has official business tomorrow.
马大老爷明天有公事，

We shall come another day.”
改天再来。”

“When?” Auntie Sun asked.
“哪天？”孙干娘问：

“Tomorrow?”
“明天？”

“Tomorrow may still be impossible,” Ma answered for himself.
“明天怕还不行。”马逢时自己回答：

“I shall come as soon as my business is finished.”
“我等公事一完了，就来看你。”

“The rectangular stamp has not been made,” Yang said. “We shall find nobody to do it tonight. I shall go to an engraver first thing tomorrow.
“条戳没有到，今天晚上也找不着人了，明天一早去请教刻字店。”杨书办说：

It will be noon before everything is ready.
“总要到中午，一切才会预备好，

We had better settle on taking the shop into official custody at lunchtime.”
我看准定明天吃中饭去查封。”

“Very well.
“好！

I leave everything to you and shall wait for word at home.”
一切拜托，我在舍间听你的信。”

They rose and left together.
于是相偕离座出门，

On the way, Yang could not help reproaching Ma, but Ma apologised so persistently that he could hardly say more.
走在路上，杨书办少不得有所埋怨，而马逢时不断道歉，他也就不便多说什么了。


The next day was one on which attendance had to be marked.
第二夭是“卯期”，

As usual, Yang went to sit in the rites section, so that if the county magistrate had questions about dealings with the education official, he would be on hand to answer the roll.
杨书办照例要到“礼房”去坐一坐，以防“县大老爷”有什么要跟“学者爷”打交道的事要问，好及时“应卯”。

An engraver was readily available there.
礼房有现成的刻字匠，

Yang summoned one and handed him a slip bearing Ma’s temporary title.
找了一个来，将一张马逢时的临时衔名条交了给他，

In less than the time it took to eat a meal, the stamp was cut and brought back.
不到一顿饭的工夫，已经刻好送来，

Finding nothing else to do, Yang went home to prepare to accompany Ma to Gongji.
看看无事，起身回家，预备伴随马逢时到公济典去查封。

The moment he entered the main room, he saw a ham and four boxes of different sizes piled on the central table.
一进门跨进堂屋，便看到正中方桌上堆了一条火腿，大小四个盒子，

By the door stood a fifty-jin jar of Huadiao wine.
门口又是五十斤重的一坛花雕，

Someone had sent a gift.
知道是有人送礼，

“A’mao’s mother!” he called.
便喊：“阿毛娘，阿毛娘！”

A’mao was his son’s childhood name; he was calling his wife.
阿毛是他儿子的乳名，“阿毛娘”便是叫他的妻子。

She came at once and spoke before he could.
杨太太应声而至，不等他开口便说：

“Here is a card.
“有张片子在这里，

The man is Tang from Gongji Pawnshop.
是公济典的姓唐的。

We have no dealings with him, so I dared not touch the gifts.”
我们跟他没有来往，送的礼我也不敢动。

She handed him the card.
“说着，杨太太递过来一张名片，

It was indeed Tang Zishao’s.
一看果然是唐子韶，

After a moment’s thought, Yang asked, “What did he say?”
略一沉吟，杨书办问道：“他有什么话？”

“That he would come back shortly.
“说等等再来。”杨太太答说：

He seemed hesitant, as though he had something to say but would not say it.”
“看他吞吞吐吐，好象有什么话，要说不肯说似的。”

“I understand.
“我晓得了。

We cannot accept these gifts.”
这份礼不能收的。”

Yang sat drinking tea and thinking.
杨书办坐了下来，一面喝茶一面想，

Tang’s purpose was obvious.
唐子韶的来意，不问可知？

What puzzled him was how the man had learned so quickly that Yang would accompany Ma to take Gongji into official custody.
他只奇怪，此人的消息，何以如此灵通，知道他会赔马逢时去查封公济？

Had he already visited Ma and been told to come here?
是不是已经先去看过马逢时，马逢时关照来找他的呢？

If so, Yang ought to see Ma first and find out what they had discussed before deciding how to act.
倘是如此，似乎先要跟马逢时见个面，问一问他交谈的情形，才好定主意。


While he was considering this, someone knocked.
正这样转着念头，听得有人敲门，

Yang went to answer the door himself.
便亲自起身去应接。

He and Tang were nodding acquaintances from social gatherings.
他跟唐子韶在应酬场中见过，是点头之交，

Sure enough, Tang stood outside, and Yang had to make a show of surprise.
开门看时，果然是他，少不得要作一番讶异之状。

“You did not expect me, did you, Mr Yang?” Tang asked with a broad smile.
“杨先生，”唐子韶满脸堆笑地说：“想不到是我吧？”

“Indeed I did not.
“想不到，想不到。

Please come in.”
请里面坐。”

Leading him into the main room, Yang pointed at the table.
杨书办在前头领路，进了堂屋，指着桌子说：

“Master Tang, I cannot accept a reward I have not earned.
“唐朝奉，无归不肥禄，

I certainly shall not accept these gifts.”
你这份礼，我决不收。”

Tang seemed to have expected this response and took it lightly.
唐子韶似乎已经预知他会有这种态度，毫不在乎他说：

“A small matter.
“小事，小事，

We can discuss it in due course.”
慢慢谈。”

His composure made Yang wary.
杨书办见他如此沉着，不免心生警惕，

“Please sit.”
说声：“请坐。”

He did not call for tea, but sat stiffly upright in the lower seat, signalling that he did not intend a long conversation.
也不叫人倒茶，自己在下首正襟危坐，是不想久谈的神情。

“Mr Yang, I hear you are to accompany Magistrate Ma to take Gongji into official custody?”
“杨先生，听说你要陪马大老爷来查封公济典？”

Faced with this direct question, Yang was unwilling to admit it outright.
见他开门见山地发问，杨书办却不愿但然承认，

“Who told you, Master Tang?”
反问一句：“唐朝奉，你听哪个说的？”

“The news reached me indirectly.”
“是辗转得来的消息。”

If it was indirect news, he had not met Ma.
辗转传闻，便表示他不曾跟马逢时见过面，

There were only two possible sources: Zhou Shaotang or Old Zhu from Qingyu Hall.
而消息来源，只有两处，一是周少棠，一是庆余堂的老朱。

On reflection, the latter seemed more likely.
细想一想，多半以后者为是。

“Did you hear it through Qingyu Hall?”
“请问，你是不是从庆余堂那边得来的消息？”

That was itself an admission of the matter.
这也就等于杨书办承认了这件事，

Tang nodded. “Yes.”
唐子韶点点头说：“是的。”


“So you came only to find out about that?”
“那么，老兄就是打听这一点。”

“There are other things I should like to ask you, of course.
“当然还有话要请教杨先生。”唐子韶问：

When do you intend to come?
“请问，预备什么时候来？

I should like to be ready to receive you.”
我好等候大驾。

“You are too courteous.
““言重！言重！

You must ask Magistrate Ma about that.”
这要问马大老爷。”

Finding the conversation unpromising, Tang could not disclose his real purpose.
由于活不投机，唐子韶不能吐露真意，

Yet he would not take back the gifts, which were by no means trifling.
不过他送的那份不能算菲薄的札，始终不肯收回，

Yang could do nothing about it.
杨书办亦无可奈何，

He now felt uncomfortably indebted, and feared it would be harder to take a firm line when assisting Ma at Gongji.
心头不免有欠了人家一份人情，协助马逢时去查封公济时，较难说话的困惑。

As Tang rose to leave, he suddenly asked, “Mr Yang, may I ask whether you know Zhou Shaotang well?”
“杨先生，”唐子韶起身预备告辞时，忽然问出一句话来：“我想请问你，同周少棠熟不熟？”

Yang considered, then answered simply, “Well.”
杨书办沉吟了一下，只答了一个字：“熟。”

“And how well does he know Magistrate Ma?”
“他同马大老爷呢？”

This question suggested extensive connections and many sources of information.
问到这句话，显得此人的交游很广、路子很多，

Perhaps somebody had already told Tang that Yang, Ma and Zhou had met in the wine shop the previous day.
也许前一天他与马逢时、周少棠曾在酒店中一起聚晤这件事，已有人告诉了他，

To answer “I am not sure” would then be a deliberate lie.
然则用一句“不大清楚”来回答，便是故意说假话，

If, after receiving his gifts, Yang would not answer even that small question honestly, Tang would surely sneer inwardly.
受了人家一份礼，连这么一句话都不肯实说，唐子韶自然会在心里冷笑。

Whatever happened later, it was hardly worth earning the contempt of a man like Tang now.
以后如何是以后的事，眼前先让唐子韶这样的人对他鄙视，未免太划不来了。

Without quite intending to, Yang told the truth.
这样转着念头，不由得说了实话：

“Not particularly well.”
“不算太熟。”

Tang appeared satisfied.
唐子韶似乎对他的回答很满意，

Smiling, he said, “I have taken up your time.
微笑着说：“打扰，打扰。

Once the official business is finished, I should like to invite you and Magistrate Ma for a proper gathering.”
改天公事完了，我要请杨先生、马大老爷好好叙一叙。”


Yang was at Ma’s house, preparing to set out for Gongji, when his maid hurried over to ask him to come home.
正当杨书办在马逢时家，准备出发去查封公济典时，他家里的女仆匆匆奔了来，请他回家，

“Madam has something urgent to discuss,” she said.
道是“太太有要紧事要商量”。

While Yang hesitated, Ma spoke.
杨书办还在踌躇，马逢时开口了，

“Go back first.
“你就先请回去吧！”他说：

Come straight over when you have finished.
“商量好了马上请过来，

I shall wait here.”
我在这里等。”

Fortunately, the houses were close.
好在离得近，

Yang decided to return briefly, only to find, to his great surprise, that Zhou was waiting for him.
杨书办决定先回去一趟，到家一看，非常意外地是周少棠在等候，

Clearly Zhou was the one who wanted to talk; the excuse about his wife meant he did not wish Ma to know of the visit.
明明是他要请他来说话，却作了托辞，显然的，周少棠来看他，是不愿让马逢时知道的。

“Things have changed,” Zhou said. He paused.
“事情有了变化。”周少棠停了一下说：

“I shall tell you frankly: Tang Zishao has been to see me.”
“我说实话吧，唐子韶来看过我了。”

“Oh?
“喔，”杨书办问：

When?”
“啥辰光？”

“Just now.
“就是刚刚的事，

He found me at Fukang.
他寻到阜康来的。”周少棠说：

There is something in what he says.
“他的话也有点道理，

If Gongji’s affairs cause a commotion, there will be another scandal, which will harm Mr Hu.
公济的事一闹出来，又成了新闻，对胡大先生不利。

And if complications arise during the proceedings to take the shop into official custody, the authorities may deal with him more severely.
而且查封的事，一生枝节，官府恐怕对胡大先生有更厉害的处置。

Both points are sound, I think.
我想这两点也不错，

We must not smash the vessel while trying to strike the rat.
投鼠忌器，

That is why I came to consult you.”
特为来同你商量。”

After a moment’s thought, Yang replied, “He came to see me first and brought gifts.
杨书办想了一下答说：“他先到我这里来过了，还送了一份礼。

The position is clear: something is wrong at Gongji, and probably something quite serious.
事情很明白了，他在公济确有毛病，而且毛病怕还不小。

Now you speak of sparing the vessel.
现在你说投鼠忌器，

Do you mean we should let him off and drop the affair?”
是不是放他一马，就此拉倒？”

“Would that not be letting him off too cheaply?
“那不太便宜他了？

He understands his position and has agreed to disgorge the money.”
他亦很识相，答应‘吐’出来。”

“How?”
“怎么吐法？”

“That depends on you.”
“这就要看你了。”

Zhou wanted Yang to accompany Ma to Gongji and examine the storeroom and accounts carefully, uncovering every irregularity.
周少棠的意思是，杨书办陪了马逢时到公济典，细细查库、查帐，将唐子韶的毛病都找了出来，

A written record would be best, but they need take no action.
最好作成笔录，但不必采取任何行动，

Yang should bring the facts back, and Zhou would negotiate with Tang himself.
回来将实情告诉周少棠，由他跟唐子韶去办交涉。

Yang thought this made Zhou master of the entire affair, with himself and Ma merely Zhou’s employees.
杨书办心想，这等于是一切由周少棠做主，他跟马逢对不过是周少棠的“伙计”而已。

Still, provided there was something in it for them, being employees did not matter.
不过，只要有“好处”，做“伙计”亦无所谓。


There was no need for him to raise the point.
当然，这不必等他开口，

Zhou supplied the assurance himself.
周少棠亦会有交代：

“This arrangement only saves Tang from a lawsuit.
“这样做法，不过是免了唐子韶吃官司，

If he thinks he can profit from it as well, he is dreaming.
他再要想讨便宜，就是妄想。

We shall follow our original plan: help Mr Hu on the one hand, and find a few taels for the three of us—you, me and Ma—to see us through the New Year on the other.”
我们还是照原来的计划，一方面是帮胡大先生的忙，一方面我们三个，你、我、老马，弄几两银子过年。”

“It does not matter so much about me,” Yang said.
“我倒无所谓。”杨书办说：

“Ma seldom gets an assignment, and this one carries responsibility.
“老马难得派个差使，而且这件事也要担责任，

We ought not to stint his share.”
似乎不好少了他的。”

“Exactly.
“一点不错。

Tell him he need not worry.”
你叫他放心好了。”

“He trusts you to handle it.
“你做事，他也很放心的，

Still, it would be best to give him a ‘measurement.’”
不过，最好开个‘尺寸’给他。”

In business slang, a measurement meant a sum of money.
尺寸是商场的切口，意指银数，

“We do not yet know how many ‘feet of water’ there are,” Zhou replied.
周少棠答说：“现在有‘几尺水，还不晓得，

“How can I give him a measurement?”
这个尺寸怎么开法？”

The depth of the water meant the total amount.
“几尺水”者是指总数。

How much had Tang embezzled, and how much could be recovered?
唐子韶侵吞中饱几何，能“吐”出来多少？

They could not yet estimate it.
目前无从估计，

Zhou was right not to promise a definite sum, but they could at least agree on the shares.
周少棠不能承诺一个确数，固属实情，但亦不妨先“派派份头”。

When Yang suggested this, Zhou immediately said, “The largest share must naturally go to Mr Hu.
等杨书办提出这个意见以后，周少棠立即说道：“大份头当然是归胡大先生。

Divide it into ten parts: six for him, two for Ma, and one each for you and me.
如果照十份派，胡大先生六份，老马两发，你、我各一份。

How does that sound?”
怎么样？”

If ten thousand taels could be recovered from Tang, Yang thought, Ma would receive two thousand and he himself one thousand.
杨书办心想，如果能从唐子韶身上追出一万银子，马逢时可得两千，自己亦有一千两进帐，

That would make a very comfortable New Year.
这个年可以过得很肥了。

He nodded happily.
于是欣然点头：

“Good.
“好的，

Let us divide it that way.”
就照这样子派好了。”


Since contact had already been made, Ma needed no display of official importance when he arrived at Gongji with Yang.
由于事先已有联络，马逢时由杨书办陪着到了公济典，不必摆什么官派，

They simply posted the prepared notice suspending business for three days, waited for the customers to leave and shut the main doors.
只将预先写好的、暂停营业三夭的告示贴了出去，等顾客散尽，关上大门。

Then they began sealing the storeroom and examining the accounts.
开始封库查帐。

Tang was composed at first.
唐子韶先很从容，

Seeing Ma’s mild manner and hearing Yang’s courteous words, he thought his approach through Zhou had succeeded.
看马逢时态度平和，杨书办语言客气，以为周少棠的路子已经走通了，

When he saw that the storeroom was to be sealed, his expression became less natural.
及至看到要封库，脸色已有些不大自然，

On hearing that the accounts would be examined, he could no longer keep calm.
再听说要查帐，便无法保持常态了。

“Mr Yang, a word.”
“杨先生，你请过来。”

Drawing Yang aside, he asked quietly, “Did you meet Zhou Shaotang at noon today?”
他将杨书办拉到一边，低声问道：“今天中午，周少棠同你碰过头了？”

“Yes.”
“是的。”

“What did he say?”
“他怎么说？”

Yang was surprised, but his mind worked quickly.
杨书办不免诧异；不过他的念头转得很快，

He realised that Zhou had played a ruthless move.
知道周少棠下了一着狠棋，

Without betraying his feelings, he asked, “What did you tell him?”
因而声色不动地问说，“你同他怎么说的？”

Tang had met Zhou through Xie Yunqing.
原来唐子韶托谢云青居间，见到周少棠以后，

He had hinted that Zhou should ask Yang and Ma not to be too exacting in their inspection of Gongji, and had promised Zhou three thousand taels to settle everything.
隐约透露出，请他转托杨书办及马逢时，在查封公济典时，不必认真，同时许了周少棠三千银子的好处，“摆平”一切。

He had also asked Xie to guarantee that, once the affair was over, every cash of the three thousand would be paid.
复又央请谢云青作保，事过以后，三千银子分文不少。

Xie had agreed.
谢云青也答应了。

What Tang did not know was that Zhou intended to help Hu, not to pursue his own gain.
但他不知道周少棠有意要助胡雪岩，并非为了他自己的好处，

He felt indignant on Hu’s behalf, so this was not a matter of money.
有为胡雪岩不平的意味在内，这就不关钱的事了。

His ready agreement had been an empty dumpling—a promise with nothing inside.
当时周少棠满口应承，实是一个“空心汤圆”，

Tang had still not grasped this.
而犹一直不曾醒悟，

He merely assumed that Zhou had kept too much for himself and Yang, dissatisfied with his share, was making difficulties.
只以为周少棠自己吞得太多，杨书办嫌少，故而有意刁难，

There was nothing for it but to open his purse wider.
说不得只好大破悭囊了。


“Mr Yang, we are all men who know the ways of society.
“杨先生，大家都是场面上的人，

Everything can be discussed.
有话好说，

Do not make matters too embarrassing.”
不要做得太难堪。”

In his anxiety, Tang no longer chose his words carefully.
情急之下，他口不择言了，

“The New Year is coming.
“快过年了，

We all have debts to pay; I understand that.
大家都有帐要付，这一层我知道的。

Besides the original amount, I shall give another two thousand taels.
除了原来的以外，我另外再送两千银子，

If you can settle matters with Magistrate Ma, I shall have nothing to say.”
马大老爷那里，只要你老大哥摆平，我不说话。”

What original amount?
什么是原来的？

Yang could guess, but still needed to find out.
杨书办略想一想也就明白，不过还是要打听一下：

“How much was it originally?”
“原来多少？”

Once he had learned the details of Tang’s dealings with Zhou, he felt deeply uncomfortable.
等将唐子韶与周少棠打交道的情形问清楚以后，杨书办觉得很为难。

Yang was comparatively kind-hearted.
他为人比较忠厚，

Tang looked so pitiful that he could not bear to string him along with an empty promise as Zhou had done.
觉得唐子韶可怜兮兮的，不忍心象周少棠那样，虚与委蛇，让他吃个“空心汤圆”，

Yet accepting his terms was equally out of the question.
当然，要接受他的条件，也是决不可能的事。

“Mr Yang,” Tang said almost pleadingly, “do it for the sake of making a friend.
“杨先生，”唐子韶近乎哀求他说：“你就算交我一个朋友。

I know your word carries enormous weight with Magistrate Ma.
我知道你在马大老爷面前一言九鼎，

One word from you and he will show mercy and let me through.”
只要你说一声，他就高抬贵手，放我过去了。”

Friendship gave Yang something to say.
谈到“交朋友”。杨书办倒有话说了，

“Friendship is one thing, official business another.
“朋友是朋友，公事是公事。”他说，

So long as Magistrate Ma can answer for his conduct of the assignment, I shall certainly consider our friendship.
“只要马大老爷公事上，能过得去，我当然要顾朋友的交情。

Master Tang, I promise you one thing: you will not be humiliated today.
唐朝奉，我答应你一件事，今天决不会让你面子难看，

But I hope you will not obstruct official business.
不过，我只希望你不要妨碍公事。

We can all discuss what to do after the inspection and sealing.”
至于查封以后，如何办法，我们大家再商量。”

Tang recognised the needle hidden in the cotton.
这番话是“绵里针”，唐子韶当然听得出来，

If he failed to take the hint and refused to let Ma examine the accounts, he would be obstructing official business.
如果自己不知趣，不让马逢时查帐，变成“妨碍公事”，

Ma could have him detained in the county office’s holding room.
他是有权送他到县衙门的“班房”去收押的。

Fortunately, there was still the promise of later discussion.
好在还有以后再商量的话，

A sensible man did not invite immediate suffering.
好汉不吃眼前亏，

He would satisfy Yang first and consider the rest afterwards.
先敷衍好了杨书办，再作道理。

“Since you put it that way, Mr Yang, I must listen.
“杨先生，你这样子说，我不能不听，

I shall follow every instruction.”
一切遵吩咐就是。”


Tang now committed himself.
唐子韶也豁出去了，

He supplied every ledger they requested and answered every question, cooperating so fully that the examination proceeded smoothly.
不但要什么帐簿有什么帐簿，而且问什么答什么，非常合作，因此查帐非常顺利。

There were simply too many account books.
只是帐簿太多，

That afternoon they checked only a third; finishing would take at least the whole of the following day.
这天下午只查了三分之一，至少第二天还要费一整天才能完事。

When Yang returned home, his wife told him, “Zhou Shaotang came.
等回到家，杨太太告诉丈夫：“周少棠来过了，

He said he would wait for you where you were drinking yesterday.”
他说他在你们昨天吃酒的地方等你。”

“Oh?
“喔！”杨书办问：

Did he mean only me?”
“光是指我一个人？”

“Who else?”
“还有哪个？”

“Did he ask Ma to go too?”
“有没有叫老马也去？”

“He did not say.”
“他没有说。”

“Very well.
“好。

I shall go at once.”
我马上就去。”

Yang took a written record of the findings with him to the meeting.
杨书办带着一份记录去赴约。


“How could Mr Hu escape misfortune?” Zhou said, pointing at the record.
“胡大先生怎么能不倒霉！”周少棠指着那份记录说：

“Add up what is on this sheet alone, and the money swallowed already exceeds thirty or forty thousand taels.”
“光是这张纸上记下来的，算一算已经吞了三、四万银子都不止了。”

“What do you intend to do?”
“你预备怎么个办法？”

“Make him disgorge it, of course.
“还不是要他吐出来。”周少棠说：

The amount is so large that I think I must speak to Mr Hu first.”
“数目太大，我想先要同胡大先生谈一谈。”

Speaking for Ma, Yang said, “Would that be quite proper in official business?”
“这，”杨书办为马逢时讲话，“在公事上不大妥当吧？”

“Why not?” Zhou countered. Yang could not explain exactly why it was improper.
“怎么不妥当？”周少棠反问“杨书办亦说不出如何不妥，

He merely felt resentful that Ma, officially commissioned to take charge of Gongji, should have to wait for Zhou and Hu to decide how he was to discharge his assignment. Zhou was exercising too much control.
他只是觉得马逢时奉派查封公济典，如何交差，要由周少棠跟胡雪岩商量以后来决定，似乎操纵得大过分，心生反感而已。

“Official business is what it is.
“公事就是那么一回事，

You are an old hand at it—what is there that you do not understand?”
你老兄是‘老公事’，还有啥不明白的？”

Zhou spoke soothingly.
周少棠用抚慰地语气说，

“In any case, I shall make sure Ma can account satisfactorily for his assignment, and that the private benefit pleases him too.
“总而言之，老马的公事，一定让他交代得过，私下的好处，也一定会让他心里舒服。

As for your share, it certainly will not be less than his.
至于你的一份，当然不会比者马少，

That goes without saying.”
这是说都用不着说的，”

Naturally, Zhou’s own benefit would be no smaller than either man’s.
当然，周少棠的“好处”亦不会逊于他跟马逢时，更不待言。

Tang appeared to be in serious trouble.
照此看来，唐子韶的麻烦不小，

Recalling his helpless expression and desperate pleas, Yang grew troubled.
想起他那万般无奈、苦苦哀求的神情，不由得上了心事。

“What is it?” Zhou asked.
“怎么？”周少棠问：

“Is something troubling you?”
“你有啥为难？”

“How could it not?
“我怎么不为难？”杨书办说：

You gave him an empty dumpling, but he does not know it.
“你给他吃了个空心汤圆，他不晓得，

He thinks everything has been settled.
只以为都谈好了，

Now it looks as though we are deliberately making trouble for him.
现在倒好象是我们跟他为难，

He has been to my house once and will certainly come again.
他到我家里来过一次，当然会来第二次，

How am I to deal with him?”
我怎么打发他？”

“That is easy.
“那容易，

Put it all on me.”
你都推在我头上好了。”

In fact, this was the only possible answer, and Yang had already intended to use it in the end.
事实上这是唯一的应付办法，杨书办最后的打算亦是如此。

Now that Zhou had offered the assurance himself, he accepted it wholeheartedly and ceased to worry further.
此刻既然周少棠自己作了亏诺，他也就死心塌地，不再去多想了。



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第七章（二）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Seven, Part Two
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


The next day the inspection continued as before: polite words, unsparing eyes.
第二天仍如前一天那样嘴上很客气，眼中不容情，

Tang Zishao’s irregularities were pursued one by one to the end.
将唐子韶的弊端，一样一样，追究到底。

His own manner, however, had changed.
唐子韶的态度，却跟前一天有异，

He seemed scarcely concerned with what Ma Fengshi and Clerk Yang were doing, merely sitting to one side and smoking his water pipe.
仿佛对马逢时及杨书办的作为，不甚在意。只是坐在一边，不断地抽水烟，

Sometimes he rolled a paper spill between his fingers again and again until it broke; only then did he look momentarily lost, revealing how deeply his mind was at work.
有时将一根纸煤搓了又搓，直到搓断，方始有爽然若失的神情，显得他在肚子里的功夫，做得根深。

Shortly after noon began, Gongji served refreshments and invited Ma to rest.
约莫刚交午时，公济开出点心来，请马逢时暂时休息。

Tang took the opportunity to draw Yang aside.
唐子韶便趁此时机，将杨书办邀到一边有话说。

“Mr Yang, can you finish the inspection today?”
“杨先生，”他问：“今天查得完查不完？”

“We mean to try.”
一想把它查完。

“And afterward?
““以后呢？”唐子韶问道：

Didn’t you say we could discuss things?”
“不是说好商量？”

“Certainly.
“不错，好商量。

You had better find Zhou Shaotang.
你最好去寻周少棠，

Once you have settled matters with him, I’ll answer for His Honour Ma.”
只要他那里谈好了，马大老爷这里归我负责。”

Tang hesitated for some time.
唐子韶迟疑了好一会说：

“I thought we had settled things already.
“本来是谈好了，

Who could have known His Honour would come and insist on examining everything from the beginning?”
哪晓得马大老爷一来，要从头查起。

His tone suggested that Yang and Zhou were working together, deliberately passing him back and forth without helping.
语气中仿佛在埋怨杨书办跟周少棠彼此串通，有意推来推去，不愿帮忙。

Yang thought the misunderstanding natural enough; he might as well give him a hint.
杨书办心想，也难怪他误会，其中的关键，不妨点他一句。

“My dear fellow, don’t indulge in wishful thinking.
“老兄，你不要一厢情愿！

Before we’ve even examined the place, there’s nothing to discuss, let alone settle.
你这里查都还没有查过，无从谈起，更不必说啥谈好了。

Go and see him tonight.
你今天晚上去寻他，

I guarantee you’ll get a result.”
包你有结果。

Tang suddenly understood.
“唐子韶恍然大悟，

They wanted to see how much he had taken from Gongji before naming their price.
原来是要看他在公济典里弄了多少“好处”，然后再来谈“价钱”。

Expecting to settle everything for a few thousand taels was an absurd dream.
看样子打算用几千银子“摆平”，是一种不切实际的妄想。

When the tree fell, the monkeys scattered.
“树倒猢狲散”，

Better to take Yueru and flee far away.
不如带着月如远走高飞，

At worst, he would never work as a pawnbroker again; he should still have enough to live comfortably for the rest of his life.
大不了从此不吃朝奉这一行的饭，后半世应可衣食无忧。

The decision formed in an instant, leaving him even less concerned with Yang and Ma, though outwardly he remained respectful.
就在这刹那间打定了主意，就更不在乎杨书办与马逢时了，不过表面上仍旧很尊敬，

When the day’s examination ended, he invited them to dinner.
当天查帐完毕，要请他们吃饭。

Ma firmly declined, while Yang again hinted that he should find Zhou early and “discuss matters.”
马逢时当然坚辞，杨书办且又暗示，应该早早去觅周少棠“商量”。


Tang repeatedly agreed, without the least intention of doing so.
唐子韶口头上边声称“是”，其实根本无此打算，

His urgent business was to get home and consult Yueru.
他要紧的是赶回家去跟月如商量。

After briefly describing what had happened, he revealed his decision.
约略说了经过，随即向月如透露了他的决心。

“Of the Thirty-Six Stratagems, running away is the best.
“三十六计，走为上让。

Start preparing now.
你从现在起始，就要预备，

We should have everything ready in three to five days, then slip away.”
最好三、五天之内料理清楚，我们开溜，”

Yueru stared.
月如一愣，

“Where to?
“溜到哪里？”她说：

I won’t go to Huizhou.”
“徽州我是不去。”

Tang’s first wife remained in his native Huizhou.
唐子韶的结发妻子在徽州原籍，

Yueru would rather die than go there to take a subordinate place and do the household drudgery herself.
要月如去服低做小，亲操井臼，宁死不愿，

She had made that clear more than once, and he knew it perfectly.
这一层意思表明过不止一次，唐子韶当然明白。

“How could I send you to suffer in Huizhou?
“我怎么会让你到徽州去吃苦？

Even if you wanted to go, I couldn’t bear it.
就算你自己要去，我也舍不得。

I have three places in mind: Shanghai, Beijing, or Yangzhou, where I have two sets of relatives.”
我想有三个地方，一个是上海，一个是北京，再有一个是扬州，我在那里有两家亲戚。”

Provided Huizhou was excluded, the choice could be discussed at leisure.
只要不让她到徽州，他处都不妨从长计议，

Better still, though, would be not to leave at all.
但最好是能不走，

Yueru had lived here all her thirty years and had never traveled far.
上生上长三十年，从没有出过远门，

She feared that elsewhere the climate and water would disagree with her and she would not settle.
怕到了他乡水土不服住不惯。


“We can’t stay, unless we’re prepared to lose everything.”
“不走办不到，除非倾家荡产。”

“Is it as bad as that?”
“有这么厉害？”

“Of course.
“自然。”唐子韶答说：

This Zhou has a black heart and a ruthless hand.
“这姓周的，良心黑，手段辣，

They have copied all the accounts.
如今一盘帐都抄了去，

Once he adds them up item by item, it will take fifty thousand taels to get past him.”
一笔一笔照算，没有五万银子不能过门。”

“Can’t you deny it?”
“你不会赖掉？”

“With the evidence in their hands?”
“把柄在人家千里，怎么赖得掉？”

“What if you ignore him?”
“不理他呢？”

“Try it!
“不理他？你去试试看。”唐子韶说：

Ma is an expectant magistrate acting under his superior’s orders.
“姓马的是候补县，奉了宪谕来查封，

He has enormous powers.
权力大得很呢！

One word from him, and I’m in the lockup at Renhe.
只要他说一句，马上可以送我到仁和县班房，

You can bring me my meals there.” Yueru sighed.
你来送牢饭吧！”月如叹口气说：

“Then it will have to be Shanghai.
“那就只好到上海去了。

But even there, we may not be safe.”
只怕到了上海还是保不得平安。”

“We certainly will!” Tang declared confidently.
“一定可以保！”唐子韶信心十足地说，

“The foreign settlement is practically foreign territory.
“上海市场等于外国地方，

Even the circuit intendant can’t send runners in to arrest people, let alone the Shanghai magistrate.
哪怕是道台也不能派差役去抓人，上海县更加不必谈了。

People come there from everywhere, every sort imaginable.
而且上海市场上五方杂处，各式各样的人都有，

So long as you have money, you can swagger about every day, ride in carriages, visit Zhang Garden, eat Western meals, and watch Beijing opera.
只要有钱，每天大摇大摆，坐马车、逛张园、吃大菜、看京戏，

Nobody will meddle in your affairs.”
没有哪个来管你的闲事。”

This picture of Shanghai’s pleasures thoroughly tempted Yueru.
听他形容上海的繁华，月如大为动心，

All her sorrow at leaving vanished.
满腔离愁，都丢在九霄云外，

After careful thought, she said, “Fortunately, the cash is in HSBC.
细细盘算了一会说道：“好在现款存在汇丰银行，

We can take our valuables with us and should be packed within three days.
细软随身带了走，有三天工夫总可以收拾好，

The property we can’t move will have to stay for now.
不动产只好摆在那里再说。

But might something happen during those three days?”
不过，这三天当中，会不会出事呢？”


“We must play for time.
“当然要用缓兵之计。

Yang told me to see Zhou tonight.
杨书办要我今天晚上就去看周少棠。

He’s bound to name a price.
他一定会开个价钱出来，

He’ll ask the earth, and I’ll bargain him down.
漫天讨价，就地还钱，

Naturally, we won’t agree.
一定谈不拢，

I’ll invite him to dinner tomorrow evening, and you must make a special effort…”
我请他明天晚上来吃饭，你好好下点功夫……”

“That trick again!” Yueru shouted.
“又要来这一套了！”月如吼了起来，

“What do you take me for?”
“你当我什么人看。”

“The compassionate Guanyin herself, saving those in distress.
“我当你大慈大悲、救苦救难的观世音菩萨看。”唐子韶说：

This Zhou fed me an empty dumpling.
“这姓周的请我吃空心汤圆，

You must avenge me.”
你要替我报仇。

“Avenge you?” She gave a cold laugh.
““报仇？哼，”月如冷笑，

“I’ll have nothing to do with it.
“我不来管你的事！

You may end up losing the lady as well as the troops, and I’ll have let another man take advantage of me for nothing.
你弄得不好‘赔了夫人又折兵’，我白白里又让人家占一回便宜，

Why should I?”
啥犯着？”

“Don’t be foolish.
“你真傻，

Can’t you give him an empty dumpling too?
你不会请他吃个空心汤圆？

Drag it out for two or three days, and we’ll be in Shanghai.
两三天一拖拖过去，我们人都到上海了，

How will he take advantage of you then?”
他到哪里去占你的便宜？”

“Suppose he forces himself on me?”
“万一，”月如问说：“万一他来个霸王硬上弓呢？”

“Can’t you shout?
“你不会叫？

I’ll come and rescue you.”
一叫，我会来救你。”

“Then it becomes a blackmail set-up.
“那不是变成仙人跳了？

And what you do to him one day, he’ll repay the next.
而且，你做初一，他做初二。

It looks as though I’ll be bringing you prison meals after all.”
看起来我一定要去送牢饭了。”

Tang fell silent.
唐子韶不作声。

Yueru was not his first wife, and she had already once slept with another man.
月如不是他的结发妻子，而且当初已经失过一回身，

Since lifelong fidelity was no longer in question, he thought, it would hardly matter if Zhou enjoyed her favors too.
反正不是从一而终了，再让周少棠尝一回甜头，亦无所谓。

But he could not say so crudely and could only hint.
不过这话不便说得太露骨，只好点她一句。

“If you don’t want to bring meals to prison—if, in truth, you can’t bear to see me imprisoned—then everything depends on your showing a little compassion.”
“如果你不愿意送牢饭，实在说，你是不忍心我去吃牢饭，那么全在你发个善心了。”

Yueru said nothing either.
月如亦不作声，

She merely called the serving woman who did the cooking and told her to kill a chicken and buy extra food for the following day.
不过把烧饭的老妈子唤了来，关照她明天要杀鸡，要多买菜。


Zhou went eagerly to Yuanbao Street to see Hu Xueyan, only to meet a rebuff as soon as he explained his purpose.
周少棠兴冲冲地到了元宝街，要看胡雪岩，不道一说来意，就碰了一个钉子。

“To be frank, Mr Zhou,” the doorkeeper said, “illness is an excuse; the master is refusing visitors.
“说实话，周先生，”胡家的门上说：“生病是假，挡驾是真。

Just think—what mood can he be in to receive anyone?
你老倒想想，我们老爷还有啥心思见客。

I’ll announce you, certainly, but if he won’t see you, please don’t take offense.”
我通报，一定去通报，不过，真的不见，你老也不要见怪。”

“I have serious business to discuss with him.”
“我是有正事同他谈。”

“Business?” The man shook his head vigorously.
“正事？”门上大摇其头，

“Then you definitely won’t see him.
“那就一定见不着，

Mention the bank, pawnshops, or silk business, and his head begins to ache.”
我们老爷一提起钱庄、当店、丝行，头就大了。”

“Then say I’ve come to visit him.”
“那么，你说我来看看他。”

“That’s all I can say.
“也只好这样说。

Still…”
不过，”

As he started off, the doorkeeper muttered, “I doubt it will do any good.”
门上一面起步，一面咕哝着，“我看是白说。”

Zhou’s enthusiasm cooled.
见此光景，周少棠的心冷了。

He reflected silently that he had done his part in wishing to help; if Hu would not see him, nothing could be done.
默默盘算，自己想帮忙的意思到了，胡雪岩不见，是没法子的事。

Tang must not be let off, of course.
唐子韶当然不能便宜他，

He could think of some means of gripping the man by the throat and making him disgorge what he had swallowed.
不妨想想看，用什么手段卡住他的喉咙，让他把吞下去的东西吐出来：

The New Year was coming.
过年了，

Distributing padded clothes and rice would do good and earn merit in the unseen world.
施棉衣、施米、做做好事，也是阴功积德。

Absorbed in these thoughts, he lost track of time, until a sudden “Mr Zhou!” made him look up.
这一落入沉恩，就不觉得时光慢了，忽然听得一声：“周先生！”抬头看时，

The doorkeeper stood before him.
是门上在他面前，

“The master asks you in.”
“我们老爷有请，”

“Oh!” Zhou collected himself.
“喔，”周少棠定定神说：

“So he will see me after all?”
“居然见我了？”

“I didn’t know you were his friend of forty years!” the man said with an apologetic smile.
“原来周先生是我们老爷四十年的老朋友。”门上赔笑说道：“我不晓得！

“Please don’t be offended.”
周先生你不要见气。”

“Not at all.
“哪里，哪里！

Lead the way.”
你请领路。”


At the garden entrance the doorkeeper handed him over to a senior maid accompanied by an older serving woman, who led him straight to the Hundred Lions Tower.
门上领到花园人口处，有个大丫头由一个老妈子陪着，转引客人直上百狮楼。

“Mind your step, Mr Zhou!” A beautiful middle-aged woman greeted him upstairs.
“周先生走好！”一上楼便有个中年丽人在迎接，

He had met her once before and hastily clasped his hands.
周少棠见过一次，急忙拱手说：

“Madam Luosi!
“螺蛳太太，

You are too kind!”
不敢当，不敢当！”

“Mr Hu is waiting inside.”
“大先生在里头等你。”

She lifted the curtain herself.
说着螺蛳太太亲自揭开门帘，

This was Zhou’s first visit to these rooms.
周少棠是头一回到这里，

Looking in, he was dazzled: lamps to the east, lamps to the west; Hu Xueyan to the east, Hu Xueyan to the west.
探头一望，目迷五色，东也是灯，西也是灯，东也是胡雪岩，西也是胡雪岩。

There might be any number of lamps, but Hu could not multiply himself.
灯可以有多少盏，胡雪岩不可能分身，

He warned himself that there were many mirrors here: he must not make a fool of himself like Granny Liu entering Yihong Court.
周少棠警告自己，这里在镜子很多，不要象刘姥姥进了怕红院那样闹笑话。

He stopped just inside the doorway to get his bearings.
因此，进门先站住脚，看清楚了再说。

“Shaotang!
“少棠！”胡雪岩在喊：

Sit over here.”
“这面坐。”

Following the voice, he found Hu in a red-velvet armchair, wearing a short padded jacket buttoned down the front, with a checked woolen blanket around his lower body.
循声觅人，只见胡雪岩坐在一张红丝绒的安乐椅上，上身穿的小对襟棉袄，下身围着一条花格子的毛毡，

A satin band about a cun wide was tied around his forehead, presumably for a headache.
额头上扎一条寸许宽的缎带，大概是头痛的缘故。

“Sit here.” Hu patted the embroidered stool beside him and pointed to his head with a smile.
“坐这里！”胡雪岩拍一拍他身旁的绣墩，指着头上笑道：

“Don’t I look like a woman resting after childbirth?”
“你看我这副样子，象不象产妇做月子？”

If he could still joke, Zhou thought with relief, perhaps things were not as bad as he had imagined.
这时候还有心思说笑话，周少棠心怀一宽，看样子他的境况，不如想象中那么坏。


He began casually describing the inspection of Gongji, recounting the whole affair without omitting the smallest detail.
于是闲闲谈起查封公济典的事，原原本本、巨细靡遗，

Finally he explained how the money was to be divided once recovered from Tang.
最后谈到从唐子韶那里追出中饱的款子以后，如何分派的办法。

“Let it go,” Hu said.
“算了，算了。”胡雪岩说：

“There’s no need to pursue it so seriously.”
“不必认真。”

Zhou stared.
此言一出，周少棠愣住了，

Only after a long silence could he say, “It seems I’ve been meddling unnecessarily.”
好半天才说了句：“看起来，倒是我多事了，”

“Shaotang, that makes me sound a halfwit.
“少棠，你这样子一说，我变成半吊子了。

Let me tell you the truth.
事到如今，我同你说老实话，

I’m not willingly playing the gullible fool, unable to distinguish good from bad or right from wrong.
我不是心甘情愿做洋盘瘟生，不分好歹，不识是非，

I’m thinking of someone else.”
我是为了另外一个人。”

“Who?” Zhou naturally asked.
“为了哪一个？”周少棠当然要追问。

“Tang’s concubine.”
“唐子韶的姨太太。”

“Ah!” Zhou understood at once.
“喔，喔！”周少棠恍然大悟，

He had long known of Hu’s amorous adventure and now had a chance to confirm it.
他亦久知胡雪岩有此一段艳闻，此刻正好求证：

“I heard Tang laid a beauty trap and you fell into it?”
“我听说，唐子韶设美人局，你上了他的当？”

“It wasn’t exactly that.
“也不算上当，

I lost my head for a moment.
是我一时糊涂。

There’s no need to discuss it now.”
这话也不必去说它了。”

Hu went on, “Yesterday I told my concubines: ‘I’m giving you a way out.
胡雪岩紧接着说：“昨天我同我的几个妾说：我放你们一条生路，

Any of you who wish to leave may take everything in your rooms, and I’ll give you five thousand taels besides.’
愿意走的自己房间里东西都带走，我另外送五千银子。

Yueru, after all, once shared my affection.
想想月如总同我好过。

Now that I have this opportunity, I’d like to let Tang off.
现在有了这样一个机会，我想放他一马。

But it is Ma Fengshi’s official business, and you have gone to such trouble.
不过，这是马逢时的公事，又是你出了大力，

All I can do is thank you.
我只好说一声：多谢你！

I wouldn’t presume to interfere too much with how it is handled.”
到底应该怎么办？我也不敢多干预。”

“So that is what you have in mind.
“原来你是这么一种心思，

I misjudged you.
倒是我错怪你了。”同少棠又说：

I only wanted to do something for you.
“原来是我想替你尽点心，

If you remember an old lover and want it handled this way, naturally I’ll follow your wishes.
你不忘记者相好，想这样子办，我当然照你的意思。

As for how much or how little, I must judge by circumstances.
至于论多论少，我要看情形办，

And I shall tell them.”
而且我要告诉人家。”


“No, no!
“不必，不必！

Don’t explain it.”
不必说破。”

Hu suddenly smiled mysteriously.
胡雪岩忽然神秘地一笑，

“Shaotang, do you remember A’xiang, the ‘Tofu Beauty’ at Shita’ertou?”
“少棠，你记不记得石塔儿头的‘豆腐西施’阿香？”

Zhou paused, retrieving her image from the dust of memory.
周少棠愣了一下，从尘封的记忆中，找出阿香的影子来——

Shita’ertou was a place name.
石塔儿头是地名，

A’xiang, the daughter of a tofu-shop owner there, had been famous for her beauty.
有家豆腐店的女儿，就是阿香，艳声四播。

Zhou had first become her lover; later Hu had become his so-called “brother sharing the same boots,” and Zhou had stopped visiting altogether.
先是周少棠做了入幕之宾，后来胡雪岩做了他的所谓“同靴弟兄”，周少棠就绝迹不去了。

Looking back on that youthful dream of love, he felt nothing now.
少年春梦，如今回想起来，什么感觉都没有了，

He only wondered why Hu had suddenly brought it up.
只是奇怪胡雪岩何以忽然提了起来？

“I’ve always felt bad about that.
“当初那件事，我心里一直难过，

A rabbit shouldn’t eat the grass beside its own burrow.
‘兔子不吃窝边草’，

I shouldn’t have poached on you.
我不该割你的靴腰子。

Now it would be best to repay you in kind.”
现在顶好一报还一报。”

Lowering his voice, Hu said, “Yueru is what Yangzhou people call a ‘slender horse.’
胡雪岩放低了声音说：“月如是匹扬州人所说的‘瘦马，，

Why don’t you try riding her?”
你倒骑她一骑看。”

Zhou felt a flicker of interest, though he repeatedly protested, “You must be joking!”
听此一说，周少棠有点动心，不过口头上却是一叠连声地道：“笑话，笑话！”

Hu said nothing.
胡雪岩不作声，

His smile slowly faded, while his eyes kept blinking: plainly another thought was forming.
笑容慢慢地收敛，双眼却不断眨动，显然有个念头在转。

“Then, Shaotang, would you like to hear something that is certainly no joke?”
“那么，少棠，我说一句决不是笑话的话，你要不要听？”

“Yes.”
“要的。”


“You know the stories about General Nian, surely?”
“年大将军的故事，你总晓得罗？”

General Nian was Nian Gengyao.
“年大将军”是指年羹尧。

Hangzhou people told fantastic tales of his being “demoted eighteen ranks in a single night.”
这位被杭州人神乎其词他说他“一夜工夫连降十八级“的年大将军，

He had spent roughly six months in the city, first reduced from duke of the first class to Hangzhou Garrison General, then to an unattached officer—baitalabulehafan in Manchu, cavalry commandant in Chinese, of the regular fourth rank—and assigned as commander of the guard at Yongjin Gate beside West Lake.
在杭州大概有半年的辰光，他是先由一等公降为杭州将军，然后又降为”闲散章京“，满洲话叫做”拜他喇布勒哈番“，汉名叫做”骑都尉“，正四品，被派为西湖边上涌金门的城守尉，

There were so many stories about him in Hangzhou that Zhou asked, “Which one?”
杭州关于他的故事极多，所以周少棠问说：”你是问哪一个？

“The story of General Nian giving away his concubine.”
““是年大将军赠妾的故事。”

This was one of the most remarkable of the many Nian Gengyao legends.
这是众多年羹尧的故事中，最富传奇性的一个。

It was said that he sat every day at Yongjin Gate.
据说，年羹尧每天坐在涌金门口，

Country people passing through, awed by his formidable reputation, either avoided him or hurried past with lowered heads.
进出乡人，震于他的威名，或者避道而行，或者俯首疾趋，

Only a poor scholar, who came and went morning and evening, always greeted him with a respectful bow.
惟有一个穷书生，早晚进出，必定恭恭敬敬地作一个揖。

Several months passed.
这样过了几个月，

Then an imperial order arrived for Nian’s arrest and removal to the capital.
逮捕年羹尧入京的上谕到了杭州，

Early the next morning, he stopped the scholar.
于是第二夭一早，年羹尧等那穷书生经过时，喊住他说：

“I can see that you’re an honest, kindhearted man.
“我看你人很忠厚，

I doubt I shall survive this journey to the capital.
我这番入京，大概性命不保，

I have a concubine I should like to give you.
有个小妾想送给你，

Please look after her, and do not refuse.”
请你照料，千万不要推辞。”

The poor scholar dared not entertain such an extravagant thought.
那个穷书生哪敢作此非分之想，

He repeatedly declined, while Nian repeatedly urged him.
一再推辞，年羹尧则一再相劝。

Finally he admitted the truth: his house was bare, and he could not afford another mouth to feed.
最后，穷书生说了老实话，家徒四壁，添一口人实在养不起。

“So that is the difficulty!
“原来是为这一层，

You needn’t worry.
你无庸担心，

I’ll send her tomorrow.
明天我派人送她去。

Where do you live?”
你住哪里？”

Only after much questioning did the scholar reveal his address.
问了半天，穷书生才说了他家的住址。

At dusk the next day, a small sedan arrived, accompanied by a modest “dowry.”
下一天黄昏，一乘小轿到门，随携少数“嫁妆”。

A beautiful woman in the bloom of her twenties stepped out: Nian’s favorite concubine.
那轿中走出来一个风信年华的丽人，便是年羹尧的爱妾。

The scholar was overwhelmed with joy at this unexpected romantic good fortune, yet did not know how they would live.
穷书生无端得此一段艳福，自然喜心翻倒，但却不知往后何以度日。

Without a word, the woman unlocked the two drawers of a table she had brought.
那丽人一言不发，只将带来的一张双抽屉的桌子，开锁打开抽屉，

They were full of jewels—enough for a lifetime.
里面装满了珠宝，足供一生。


“I am much like General Nian now,” Hu said.
“我现在跟年大将军差不多。”胡雪岩说：

“Half my concubines left yesterday.
“我的几个妾，昨天走了一半，

Some insist on staying with me.
有几个说一定要跟我，

One has not decided whether to go; I think she fears having nobody to depend on for the rest of her life.
有一个想走不走，主意还没有定，看她的意思是怕终身无靠。

She is a very honest woman, and I want to find someone trustworthy for her.
我这个妾人很老实，我要替她好好找个靠得住的人。

Shaotang, take her home with you.”
少棠，你把她领了回去。”

“You’re joking!” Zhou replied without thinking.
“你说笑话了！”周少棠毫不思索地说，

“There can be no question of it.”
“没有这个道理！”

“Why not?
“怎么会没有这个道理。

Haven’t you heard the storytellers?
你没有听‘说大书’的讲过，

People in the old days often gave away concubines or horses.
这种赠妾、赠马的事，古人常常有的。

I’m offering her to you; you aren’t stealing my beloved.
现在是我送给你，可不是你来夺爱，

What is there to fear?”
怕啥？”

Zhou fell silent.
周少棠不作声，

He wanted to refuse but could find no reason.
他倒是想推辞，但找不出理由，

At last he could only say, “I must discuss it with my wife.”
最后只好这样说：“我要同我老婆去商量看。”


Early the next morning, while Zhou was still in bed, Clerk Yang knocked at his door.
第二天一大早，周少棠还在床上，杨书办便来敲门了。

Zhou rose to receive him, apologized for having been out the previous evening, and asked why he had come.
起床迎接，周少棠先为前一日晚上失迎致歉，接着动问来意。

“Tang Zishao!
“唐子韶！”杨书办说：

He came to see me last night and asked me to accompany him to your place.
“昨天早晚就来看我，要我陪了他来看你。

He seems quite obedient.
看起来此人倒蛮听话，

I told him yesterday to see you in the evening, and he really came.”
我昨天叫他晚上来看你，他真的来了。”

“Where is he now?”
“此刻呢？人在哪里？”

“I said I’d arrange a meeting with you and let him know, then sent him home.
“我说我约好了你，再招呼他来见面，叫他先回去。

Where shall you meet?”
你看，在哪里碰头？”

“Somewhere reasonably secluded.”
“要稍为隐蔽一点的地方。”

“My house, then.
“那么，在我家里好了。”杨书办说：

I’ll fetch him.
“我去约他，

Come over when you’ve washed and had something to eat.”
你洗了脸、吃了点心就来。”

Zhou nodded.
周少棠点点头，

After seeing Yang out, he washed and considered his plans.
送杨书办出门以后，一面漱洗，一面盘算，

Remembering Hu’s words the previous day, he could not help feeling tempted.
想到胡雪岩昨天的话，不免怦然心动，

He wanted to see what sort of “slender horse” Yueru might be.
想看看月如倒是怎么样的一匹“瘦马”？

Tang was already at Yang’s house when Zhou arrived.
到得杨家，唐子韶早就到了，

He hastily stood and, behaving like the host rather than a guest, attended to the newcomer with great solicitude.
一见周少棠，忙不迭地站了起来，反客为主，代替杨书办招待后到之客，十分殷勤。

“Brother Shaotang,” Yang said as he rose, “you two talk.
“少棠兄，”杨书办站起来说：“ 你们谈谈，

I have a small matter to attend to and will be back shortly.
我料理了一桩小事，马上过来。

Stay for a simple lunch.”
中午在我这里便饭。”

He was leaving them to speak privately; mentioning lunch further suggested that they need not hurry and could discuss everything at length.
这是让他们得以密谈，声明备饭，更是暗示不妨详谈、长谈。


In fact, little time was needed, for Tang had his plan ready and had no intention of denying anything.
但实际上无须花多少辰光，因为唐子韶成竹在胸，不必抵赖，

When Zhou produced Yang’s copied list and calculated that the total embezzled exceeded eighty-three thousand taels, Tang dropped to his knees.
当周少棠出示由杨书办抄来的清单，算出他一共侵吞了八万三千多银子时，他双膝一跪，口中说道：

“Mr Zhou, please save me!”
“周先生，请你救救我。”

“Please, please!” Zhou hastily pulled him up.
“言重，言重！”周少棠赶紧将他拉了起来，

“Mr Tang, whether or not I can save you, you must first propose some course for me to consider.”
“唐朝奉，你说要我救你，不管我办得到、办不到，你总要拿出一个办法来，我才好斟酌。”

“Let me tell the truth.
“周先生，我先说实话，

I took money from Mr Hu’s capital little by little because I had no choice.
陆陆续续挪用了胡大先生的架本，也是叫没奈何！

My luck has been bad these past few years.
这几年运气不好，

I lost money in business, and my concubine loves gambling and has lost a great deal too.
做生意亏本，我那个小妾又好赌，输掉不少。

Now that Mr Hu is in trouble, if I had any means of doing so, I ought to have replaced the money long ago.”
胡大先生现在落难，我如果有办法，早就应该把这笔款子补上了。”

“So you’re an iron rooster, unwilling to part with a single feather?”
“照此说来，你是‘铁公鸡，一毛不拔，？”

“No, no!
“不是，不是。”唐子韶说，

I still have a few antiques and jades.
一我手里还有点古董、玉器。

I know you are an expert.
我知道周先生你是大行家，

Perhaps you could come and see what they’re worth?”
什么时候到我那里看看，能值多少？

Tang paused, then added, “There isn’t much cash, but I’ll gather whatever I can.”
“唐子韶略停一下又说：”现款是没有多少，我再尽量凑。

“How much?”
““你能凑多少？”

“I can’t say at once.
“一时还算不出。

First we must value the objects and see what is lacking; then I’ll try to find a way.”
总要先看了那些东西，估个价，看缺多少，再想办法。”

This was a story Tang had invented to appeal to Zhou’s tastes.
原来这是唐子韶投其所好，编出来的一套话。

Zhou’s interest in jade was well known in the collectors’ tea gatherings.
周少棠玩玉器，在“茶会”上颇有名声，

Taking Tang at his word, he readily agreed.
听了唐子韶的话信以为真，欣然答说：

“Very well.
“好！

When shall I come?”
你看什么时候，我去看看。”

“Would this evening suit you?
“就是今天晚上好不好，”唐子韶说：

My concubine cooks very well.
“小妾做的菜，很不坏。

I’ll ask her to show what she can do, and you can judge her skill.”
我叫她显显手段，请周先生来赏鉴赏鉴。”

The invitation stirred both Zhou’s lust and his appetite.
一听这话，周少棠色心与食指皆动，

Still, he could not ignore Yang and Ma.
不过不能不顾到杨书办与马逢时，因而说道：

“You shouldn’t invite only me.”
“你不该请我一个。”

“I understand.
“我知道，我知道。

It would be awkward for me to invite His Honour Ma, but I’ll ask Clerk Yang as well.”
马大老爷我不便请他，我再请杨书办。”


Yang had deliberately withdrawn and had nothing to attend to.
杨书办是故意躲开的，根本没有什么事要料理，

Realizing that their conversation had ended, he immediately came out to urge them to stay.
所以发觉唐子韶与周少棠的谈话已告一段落，随即赶了出来留客。

“Lunch is almost ready.
“便饭已经快预备好了，

Have it before you go.”
吃了再走。”

“Thank you, thank you!” Tang clasped his hands repeatedly.
“谢谢！谢谢！”唐子韶连连拱手，

“I have something to do.
“我还有事，

I’ll trouble you another day.
改日再来打搅。

By the way, I’ve invited Zhou to a simple dinner at my house tonight.
顺便提一声：今天晚上我请周少棠到舍下便饭，

Please join us.”
请你老兄作陪。”

The phrase “by the way” showed how little sincerity there was in the invitation.
说成“顺便提一声”，可知根本没有邀客的诚意，

Yang also knew they had unfinished business to discuss and had no wish to come between them.
而且杨书办也知道他们晚上还有未完的话要谈，亦根本不想夹在中间。

Claiming an engagement that evening, he declined.
当即亦以晚上有事作推托，回绝了邀约。

After seeing Tang off, he kept Zhou for a confidential conversation over wine.
送走唐子韶，留下周少棠，把杯密谈，

Zhou described his visit to Hu the day before, omitting the suggestion that he ride Yueru, the “slender horse.”
周少棠将前一天去看胡雪岩的情形，说了给杨书办听。不过，他没有提到胡雪岩劝他去骑月如那匹瘦马的话。

This was not deliberate concealment; he had simply made no decision.
这倒并非是他故障隐瞒，而是他根本还没有作任何决定，

Even if the sight of her tempted him, he would first have to judge the circumstances.
即使见了动心，跃跃欲试，也要看看情形再说。

“Mr Hu has real generosity of spirit,” Yang said.
“胡大先生倒真是够气概！”杨书办说：

“Even now he remembers old affections.
“今日之下，他还顾念着老交情！

A man as kindhearted as that may yet rise again.”
照他这样厚道来看，将来只怕还有翻身的日子。”

“Hardly.
“ 难！

His powerful patron is no longer any use, and his own spirit is broken.
他的靠山已经不中用，他本人呢，锐气也倒了，

How can he rise again?”
哪里还有翻身的日子？”

Zhou paused.
周少棠略停一下说：

“Enough of that.
“闲话少说，

To business: how much should we make Tang disgorge?”
言归正传，你看要唐子韶吐多少出来？”

“You decide.”
“请你作主。”

Having designs on Yueru, Zhou left himself room to maneuver.
周少棠由于对月如存着企图，便留了个可以伸缩的余地，

“Half at most; twenty or thirty thousand at least.
“多则一半，少则两三万。”他说，

We three will divide it equally.”
“我们三一三十一。”


Tang’s house was easy to find.
唐子韶家很容易找，

One had only to go into the lane behind Gongji Pawnshop and ask where Pawnbroker Tang lived; someone would point it out.
只要到公济典后面一条巷子问一声“唐朝奉住哪里？”自会有人指点给他看。

Tang answered the door himself.
是唐子韶亲自应的门，一见面便说：

“It’s very cold today.
“今天很冷，

Come upstairs.”
请楼上坐。”

A brazier was burning there, and fresh strips of white paper covered the cracks in the wooden partitions.
楼上升了火盆，板壁缝隙上新糊了白纸条，

Though the wind outside was strong, the room was as warm as spring.
外面虽然风大，里头却是温暖如春，

Zhou could not bear to keep his fox-fur robe on.
周少棠的狐皮袍子穿不住了，

At his host’s suggestion, he removed it and was perfectly comfortable in his lined jacket of woolen satin.
依主人的建议脱了下来，只穿一件直贡呢夹袄就很舒服了。

“Would you care for a fragrant pipeful?” Tang asked, indicating the smoking tray.
“周先生，要不要‘香一筒，？”唐子韶指着烟盘说。

“You go ahead.
“你自己来。”周少棠说：

I have no craving, though I like reclining beside a smoking tray.”
“我没有瘾，不过喜欢躺烟盘。”

“Then make yourself comfortable.” Tang told a maid to light the opium lamp, brought out a large brocade-covered box, and placed it below the tray.
“那就来靠一靠。”唐子韶令丫头点了烟灯，然后去捧出一只大锦盒来，放在烟盘下方说道：

“Have a look at a few jades first.”
“周先生，你先看几样玉器。”

They lay facing each other.
两人相对躺了下来，

Tang smoked while Zhou opened the box to examine its contents.
唐子韶抽大烟，周少棠便打开锦盒，鉴赏玉器，

It was divided by removable trays.
那锦盒是做了隔板的，

On the top lay three Han jades, each roughly the same size: a little over one cun long and six or seven fen wide.
每一层上面三块汉玉，每一块的尺寸大致相仿，一寸多长，六七分宽，

Zhou could recognize only the last four seal-script characters carved on them.
上面刻的篆字，周少棠只认得最后四个字。

“These are gangmao amulets,” he said, pointing.
“这是‘刚卯’。”周少棠指着最后四个字说：

“They must have these four characters: ‘None dare confront me.’”
“一定有这四个字：”莫我敢当‘。

“Oh?” Tang asked deliberately.
““喔，”唐子韶故意问说：

“What are gangmao used for?”
“刚卯作啥用场？”

“Warding off evil.”
“辟邪的。”

“Gang means strong—that I understand.
“刚卯的刚好懂，

Naturally, something that wards off evil must be strong.
既然辟邪，当然要刚强。”唐子韶说：

But I don’t understand mao.”
“卯就不懂了。”

“Mao, together with ‘gold’ and ‘knife,’ gives the surname Liu.
“卯是‘卯金刀’，

The Han was the Liu dynasty.
汉朝是姓刘的天下。

Another explanation says the choice must be made in the first month of the year; hence the name gangmao.”
还有一个说法，要在正月里选一个，所以叫刚卯。”

“You really are an expert.”
“周先生真正内行。”

“Anyone who collects Han jade must know such things.”
“玩儿汉玉，这些门道总要懂的。”

Zhou took up the second piece and examined it by the opium lamp.
说着周少棠又取第二方，就着烟灯细看。


“What do you think of these three gangmao?”
“你看这三块刚卯，怎么样？”

“They’re all quite good.
“都还不错。

But…”
不过……”

When Zhou stopped, Tang looked up.
唐于韶见他缩口不语，便抬眼问道：

“But they aren’t worth much?”
“不过不值钱？”

“I wouldn’t say that.”
“也不好说不值钱。”

Zhou went no further.
周少棠没有再说下去。

Tang understood: against a debt of tens of thousands, objects like these would fall far short.
唐子韶当然明白，他的意思是，几万银子的亏欠，拿这些东西来作抵，还差得远，

There was no need to ask more.
因而也就不必再问了，

Lifting the partition, he said, “I doubt you have seen anything like this before.”
只伸手揭开隔板说道：“这样东西，恐怕周先生以前没有见过。”

Zhou picked it up.
周少棠拿起来一看，

It was indeed new to him: a large piece of Han jade with a rich, mottled patina, about eight cun square, carved with a circular ring.
确是初见，是很大的一块古色斑斓的汉玉，大约八寸见方，刻成一个圆环，

Lines radiated outward from the center, each ending in a number, from one to ninety.
再由圆环中心向外刻线，每条线的未端有个数目字，从一到九十，

There were ninety lines in all, exceptionally fine, deep, and evenly cut.
一共是九十条线，刻得极细极深极均匀。

“What is it?
“这是啥？

It looks like a compass.”
象个罗盘。”

“Yes, rather like one.
“不错，同罗盘差不多，

It’s a sundial.”
是日规。”

“A sundial?” Zhou examined it repeatedly.
“日规？”周少棠反复细看，

“The jade is certainly Han.
“玉倒确是汉玉，

It looks as though it was excavated recently.”
好象出土不久。”

“A discerning eye!” Tang held up his thumb.
“法眼、法眼！”唐子韶竖起大拇指说：

“Only three or four years ago, in Guihua City.”
“出土不过三四年，是归化城出土的。”

Intrigued, Zhou asked, “What is it worth?”
“喔，”周少棠对此物颇感兴趣，“这块玉啥价钱？”

“It’s only recently come to light, and nothing like it had been seen before, so there’s no established price.
“刚刚出土，以前也没有过同样的东西，所以行情不明。”唐子韶又说：

The owner originally wanted a loan of a thousand taels.
“原只要当一千银子，

I offered five hundred, and we finally settled on seven hundred.
我还了他五百，最后当了七百银子。

In the hands of someone who appreciates it, it could fetch a good price.” Zhou murmured without committing himself and lifted the second partition.
这样东西，要遇见识货的，可以卖好价钱。”“嗯。”周少棠不置可否，去揭第二块隔板，

Beneath it lay seven or eight jade seals of various sizes.
下面是大大小小七八方玉印。

He had just picked one up when footsteps sounded on the stairs.
正取起一块把玩时，只听得楼梯上有响声，

Turning onto his side, he listened.
便即侧身静听。


“Ask the master where dinner is to be served.”
“你去问问老爷，饭开在哪里？”

The voice came from the outer room, clear and composed.
语声发自外面那间屋子，清脆而沉着，

Its tone suggested that Yueru was past the first bloom of womanhood and approaching the age of mature charm.
从语声的韵味中，想象得到月如过了风信年华，正将步入徐娘阶段的年龄。

Giving orders to a maid from only a few steps away—did that mean she would not appear herself?
这样在咫尺之外，发号施令，指挥丫头，是不是意味着她不会露面？

A slight disappointment rose in Zhou.
转念到此，周少棠心头，不免浮起一丝怅惘之感。

When the maid came to inquire, Tang ordered dinner served upstairs, again because it was warmer.
此时丫头进来请示，唐子韶已经交代，饭就开在楼上，理由仍旧是楼上比较暖和。

Then the curtain lifted, and Zhou’s eyes brightened.
接着，门帘启处，周少棠眼前一亮，

The woman who entered was about thirty, tall and graceful, with an oval face and exceptionally bright almond-shaped eyes.
进来的少妇，约可三十上下年纪，长身玉立，鹅蛋形的脸上，长了一双极明亮的杏眼，

As her glance swept towards him, some force seemed to spring him from the smoking couch.
眼风闪处，象有股什么力量，将周少棠从烟榻上弹了起来，

Looking at her gentle smile, he found his own face wreathed in smiles.
望着盈盈含笑的月如，不由得也在脸上堆满了笑容。

“This is my concubine, Yueru,” Tang said, indicating her with his opium needle as he prepared another pipe.
“这是小妾月如。”在烧烟的唐子韶，拿烟签子指点着说：

“Yueru, this is Mr Zhou.
“月如，这是周老爷，

Make your greeting.”
你见一见。”

“Ah, Madam!” Zhou clasped his hands and bowed first.
“喔，是姨大大！”周少棠先就抱拳作揖。

“You are too kind!” She curtsied.
“不敢当，不敢当！”月如裣作礼，

“Mr Zhou, I feel I’ve seen you somewhere.”
“周老爷我好象哪里见过。”

“Naturally you have,” Tang said.
“你自然见过。”唐子韶说：

“Remember the platform outside Fukang, and the few words that silenced everyone demanding their money?
“那天阜康门口搭了高台，几句话说得挤兑的人鸦雀无声，

That was Mr Zhou.”
就是周老爷。”


“Ah, now I remember!”
“啊！我想起来了。”

Her eyes sparkled with delighted surprise.
月如那双眼睛，闪闪发亮，惊喜交集，

“I went with our neighbors to watch.
“那天我同邻居去看热闹回来，

We talked about you for two or three days afterward.
谈周老爷谈了两三夭。

Your eloquence is beyond praise.
周老爷的口才，真正没话说。

But that is the lesser thing.
这倒还在其次，

Everyone says your loyalty is truly rare.
大家都说周老爷的义气，真正少见。

Mr Hu was the God of Wealth; who knows how many people flattered him then?
胡大先生是胡财神，平常捧财神的不晓得多少，

Once misfortune struck, he became a God of Pestilence, and everyone fled at the sight of him.
到了财神落难，好比变了瘟神，哪个不是见了他就躲，

Only you could not bear it and came forward to speak fairly.
只有周老爷看不过，出来说公道话。

Now that I see you, I can tell you’re a blessed, kindhearted gentleman who does good, earns merit, and shows mercy wherever he can.”
如今一看周老爷的相貌，就晓得是行善积德，得饶人处且饶人，有大福气的厚道君子。

Her words soothed Zhou as though his heart had been gently ironed.
“这番话说得周少棠心上象熨过一样服帖，

Naturally, he recognized the hint conveyed by “shows mercy wherever he can.”
当然，他也有数，“得饶人处且饶人”，话中已经递过点子来了。

“You are too kind.
“好说，好说！”周少棠说：

I too have long heard how capable and virtuous Mistress Tang is—a worthy helpmate to our Old Tang.”
“我亦久闻唐姨太太贤惠能干，是我们老唐的贤内助。

Hearing this change of address, Tang knew Zhou was certain to fall into the trap.
唐子韶一听称呼都改过了，知道周少棠必中圈套，

“Cunning as a devil, yet you’ll drink the water a woman has washed her feet in,” he thought smugly.
“随你奸似鬼，要吃老娘洗脚水”，心中暗暗得意，

Tossing aside his pipe, he sprang up.
一丢烟枪，翻身而起，口中说道：

“Time for wine!”
“好吃酒了。”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第七章（三，至本章结束）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Seven, Part Three (conclusion)
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


The square table had been set.
其时方桌已经搭开，

Naturally Zhou Shaotang was given the seat of honour, but only Tang Zishao sat beside him.
自然是请周少棠上座，但只唐子韶侧面相陪。

The dishes were not particularly elaborate, yet they were delicious.
菜并非如何讲究，但颇为人味，

Zhou liked foods preserved in wine or wine lees, and especially enjoyed the whitefish steamed with lees, the country-style cured pork, and the drunken crabs.
周少棠喜爱糟臃之物，所以对糟蒸白鱼、家乡肉、醉蟹这三样肴馔，格外欣赏，

On learning that the pork and crabs had been prepared by Yueru herself rather than bought, he praised them still more warmly.
听说家乡肉、醉蟹并非市售，而是月如手制，便更赞不绝口了。

Zhou was an animated talker and in excellent spirits; Tang was deliberately flattering him.
周少棠的谈锋很键，兴致又好，加以唐子韶是刻意奉承，

They drank freely, talked eagerly, and got on very well.
所以快饮剧谈，相当投机。

Their subjects were naturally light and entertaining.
当然，话题都是轻松有趣的。

“Old Tang,” Zhou asked, turning to his host’s trade, “all the pawnbrokers in the country seem to be Huizhou men, just as all the remittance banks belong to Shanxi men.
“老唐，”周少棠间到唐子韶的本行，“天下的朝奉，都是你们徽州人，好比票号都是山西人，

I have heard that even those come from only two or three prefectures, such as Taigu and Pingyao.
而且听说只有太谷、平遥这两三府的人。

Why is that?”
这是啥道理？”

“Mr Zhou, if anyone else asked, I should pretend not to know and put him off with a few words.
“这话，周先生，别人问我，我就装糊涂，随便敷衍几句，

But since it is you, I must tell you the history.
你老哥问到，我不能不跟你谈来历，

It is not a very creditable story, though.”
不过，说起来不是啥体面的事？”

“Oh?
“喔，

How so?”
怎么呢？”


“During the Jiajing reign of the Ming, there was a man from our Huizhou called Wang Zhi.
“明朝嘉靖年间，我们徽州有个人，叫汪直，

Have you heard of him?”
你晓得不晓得。”

“I know only that there was a Zou Yinglong in the Jiajing reign—the man who attacked Yan Song.
“我只晓得嘉靖年间有个‘打严嵩’的邹应龙，

I know nothing about Wang Zhi.”
不晓得啥汪直。”

“Then I shall tell you.
“你不晓得我告诉你，

Wang Zhi was a traitor.”
汪直是个汉奸。”

“A traitor?
“汉奸？

You mean he conspired with foreigners, like Qin Hui?”
莫非象秦桧一样私通外国。”

“Exactly.
“一点不错。”唐子韶答说，

But Wang Zhi’s allies were not the Jin troops.
“不过汪直私通的不是金兵，

They were Japanese, what people then called the wokou pirates.
是日本人，那时候叫做倭寇。

When they landed on the Jiangsu and Zhejiang coast, they knew nothing of the country.
倭寇到我们中国，在江浙沿海地方一登了陆，两眼漆黑，

Wang Zhi and his followers guided them as they raped and plundered their way inland.
都是汪直同他的部下做向导，带他们一路奸淫掳掠。

The pirates were a base lot: when looting, they took everything.
倭寇很下作，放枪的时候，什么东西都要，

Some things they could not carry away; others would be of little use in Japan even if they could.
不过有的带不走，带走了，到他们日本也未见得有用，

So Wang Zhi had an idea.
所以汪直动了个脑筋，

He opened a pawnshop that would accept anything.
开爿典当，什么东西都好当，

Ordinary people bringing in their pledges were merely a cover.
老百姓来当东面，不过是个幌子，

In plain language, he was disposing of stolen goods for the Japanese.”
说穿了，不过替日本人销赃而已。

“No wonder your writing looks like a sorcerer’s charms, and you speak in special jargon.
““怪不得了，你们那笔字象鬼画符，说话用‘切口’，

There was a reason for it all,” Zhou said.
原来都有讲究的。”周少棠说：

“Since it was illegal, you naturally had to use men from your own district.”
“这是犯法的事情，当然要用同乡人。”

“Still, one must remember how poor Huizhou is.
“不过，话要说回来，徽州地方苦得很，

What the district produces cannot support its own people.
本地出产养不活本地人，

They have to go elsewhere for a living, calling in friends and helping fellow townsmen.
只好出外谋生，呼朋招友，同乡照顾同乡，

They have little choice.”
也是迫不得已。”

“你们微州人做生意，实在厉害，

象扬州的大盐商，问起来祖籍一大半是徽州。”周少棠说：

“象汪直这样子，做了汉奸，还替日本人销赃，倒不怕公家抓他法办？”

当时的巡按御史，后来做了巡抚的胡宗宪，也是徽州人，

虽不说包庇，念在同乡份上，略为高一高手，事情就过去了。

官司不怕大，只要有交情，总好商量。”

唐子韶举杯相邀：

最后那两句话，加上敬酒的动作，意在言外，的然可见，

千了酒，将话题扯了开去，

恐怕并没有庇护汪直的权柄。”

“王金龙是小生扮的，好象刚刚出道，

哪有这样子的威风？

戏总是戏。”

谈到这方面，唐子韶比周少棠内行得多了，

“Ming jinshi were different from those today.
“明朝的进士，同现在不一样。

现在的进士，如果不是点翰林或者到六部去当司官，放出来不过是个‘老虎班’的知县，

明朝的进士，一点‘巡按御史’赏上方宝剑，

等于皇上亲自来巡查，

威风得不得了。

我讲个故事，周先生你就晓得巡按御史的权柄了。”


There was said to have been a rich man in the Ming with two daughters.
据说明朝有个富人，生两个女儿，

The elder married a military officer, the younger a poor scholar.
长女嫁武官，次女嫁了个寒士，

The father was somewhat snobbish, and the younger son-in-law suffered many slights.
富人不免有势利之见，所以次婿受了许多委屈。

及至次婿两榜及第，点了河南的巡按御史，

而长婿恰好在河南南阳当总兵。

御史七品，总兵二品，

但巡按御史“代天巡狩”，地位不同，

所以次婿巡按到南阳，第二天五更时分，尚未起身，长婿已来禀请开操阅兵，

于今应识诗文贵，卧听元戎报五更。”

既“有诗为证”，周少棠不能不信，

这就是说，胡雪岩如果遇见一个能象胡宗宪照顾同乡汪直那样的巡抚，他的典当就不至于会查封。

唐子韶明白他的意思，但不愿意接口。

你要不要来看着？”

周少棠不想贪这个小便宜，但亦不愿一口谢绝，便即问说：

““有，有，多得很。”

唐子韶想了一会说：

“快要过年了，

有一堂灯，我劝周先生买了回去。

到正月十五挂起来，包管出色。”

Zhou was puzzled.
一听这话，周少棠不免诧异，

Lantern Festival lanterns were made of bamboo strips and coloured paper; novelty was their chief attraction.
上元的花灯、竹篾彩纸所扎，以新奇为贵，

How could they be accepted as pledges?
他想不明白，凭什么可以上当铺？

因此，他愣了一下问道：“这种灯大概不是纸扎货？”

“当然。

How could they be pawned otherwise?
不然怎么好来当？”唐子韶说：

They are silk lanterns, in a limited number of designs, mostly hexagonal, like palace lanterns.
“灯是绢灯，样子不多，大致照宫灯的式样，以六角形为主。

The silk is painted with figures, beautiful women, and all sorts of stories.
绢上画人物仕女，各种故事，

The frames fold.
架子是活动的，

用过了收拾干净，折起包好，明年再用。

海宁一带，通行这种灯。

周先生没有看过？”

“No.”
“没有。”

“You will understand when you do.
“周先生看过了就晓得了。

这种灯不是哄小讶儿的纸扎走马灯，

A respectable family gives a New Year dinner for distinguished guests and hangs them in the hall and corridors.
要有身分的人家，请有身分的客人吃春酒，厅上、廊上挂起来，

手里端杯酒，慢慢赏鉴绢上的各家画画。

当然，也可以做它多少条灯谜，挂在灯上，请客人来打。

这是文文静静的玩法：

象周先生现在也够身分了，应该置办这么一堂灯。”

Zhou’s income had been good in recent years, and he was eager to improve his social position.
周少棠近年收入不坏，常想在身分上力争上流，

尤其是最近为阜康的事，跟官府打过交道，已俨然在绪绅先生之列，

“多少都花得下去！”唐子韶说：

“这种灯，高下相差很大，

好坏就在画上，要看是不是名家？

就算是名家，未见得肯来画花灯，值钱就在这些地方。

Take Fei Xiaolou, the foremost painter of beauties today.
譬如说，当今画仕女的，第一把手的费晓楼，

你请他画花灯，他就不肯。”

“An exceedingly famous man.
“提起此人大大的有名，

康熙年间的大人先生，请他画过‘行乐图’的，不晓得多少。

他是扬州人，

姓大禹的禹，名叫禹之鼎，

他也做过官，官名叫鸿胪寺序班。

这个官、照规矩是要旗人来做的，不晓得他怎么会做这个官……”

“老唐，”周少棠打断他的话说：“我们不要去管他的官，谈他的画好了。”

于是唐子韶言归正传，

Yu’s set comprised twenty-four silk lanterns in six designs, illustrating six stories: Xi Shi and the fall of Wu, Wenjun tending the wine shop, Zhaojun going beyond the frontier, Wenji returning to the Han, Fufei leaving her pillow, and Mei and Yang competing for favour.
说禹之鼎所画的那堂绢制花灯，一共二十四盏，六种样式，画的六个故事，西施沼吴、文君当垆、昭君出塞、文姬归汉、宓妃留枕、梅杨争宠，

梅是梅妃，杨是杨玉环，

所以六个故事，却有七大美人。

“There are many counterfeit Yu Zhiding paintings, but these lanterns are certainly genuine.
“禹之鼎的画，假的很多，不过这堂灯绝不假，

Their history is different.
因为来历不同。”唐子韶又说：

‘康熙年间，有个皇帝面前的大红人，名叫高江村，他原来是杭州人，

后来住在嘉兴的平湖县，

到了嘉庆年间，子孙败落下来，

这堂灯就是高江村请禹之鼎画的，所以不假，

Mr Zhou, I shall have it sent to your house tomorrow.”
周先生，这堂灯，明天我叫人送到府上。

“No, no!” Zhou waved his hands.
““不，不！”周少棠摇着手说：

“Let me see it first; we can decide afterwards.”
“看看东西，再作道理。”
