唐子韶还要往下说时，只见一个丫头进来说道：

“Someone has come from Gongji.
“公济派人来通知，

The chief counter appraiser has been taken suddenly ill.
说‘首柜，得了急病，

They ask you to go at once.”
请老爷马上去。”

Pawnshop clerks held either internal or counter posts.
典当司事，分为“内缺”、“外缺”两种，

The head of the latter was called the chief counter appraiser and ordinarily sat at the extreme left of the counter facing the entrance.
外缺的头脑，称为“首柜”，照例坐在迎门柜台的最左方，

Any valuable article brought in had to pass through his hands for examination and valuation.
珍贵之物送上柜台，必经首柜镜定估价，

It was therefore an important position, and worry immediately appeared on Tang’s face.
是个极重要的职司，所以唐子韶得此消息，顿时忧形于色，

Zhou could no longer remain comfortably seated.
周少棠也就坐不住了。

“Old Tang, if you have urgent business, please go.
“老唐，你有急事尽管请。

I was about to take my leave.”
我也要告辞了。”

“No, no!
“不！不！

I shall go and look, then return.
我去看一看就回来。

Our business is important too.” He called for Yueru.
我们的事也要紧的。”接着便喊：“月如，月如！”

等丫头将月如去唤了来，唐子韶吩咐她代为陪客，随即向周少棠拱拱手，道声失陪，下楼而去。

In this situation Zhou naturally remembered the story of Hu falling into a beauty trap, and became a little wary.
面临这样的局面，周少棠自然而然地想起了胡雪岩中美人汁的传说，起了几分戒心。

但月如却落落大方地一面布菜斟酒，一面问起周少棠的家庭情形，由周太太问到子女，因话搭话，

谈锋很健，却很自然，完全是熟不拘札的闲话家常。

在周少棠的感觉中，月如是个能干贤惠的主妇，因而对于她与胡雪岩之间的传说，竟起了不可思议之感。

当然也少得谈到胡雪岩的失败，月如更是表现了故主情殷，休戚相关的忠捆。

周少棠倒很想趁机谈一谈公济的事，但终于还是不曾开口。

“姨太，”丫头又来报了，“老爷叫人回来说，首柜的病很重，

他还要等在那里看一看，

Mr Zhou is asked not to leave; there is still important business to discuss.”
请周老爷不要走，还有要紧事谈。”

“Very well.
“晓得了。

Warm another pot of wine.”
你再去烫一壶酒来。”

“酒够了，酒够了。”周少棠说，

“There is no need for more.
不必再烫，

有粥我想吃一碗。

“We have fragrant rice congee ready.
““预备了香粳米粥在那里，

酒还可以来一点。”

“那就以一壶为度。”

喝完了酒喝粥，接着又喝茶，

而唐子韶却无回来的消息，周少棠有些踌躇了。

“Mr Zhou.”
“周老爷，”

月如从里间走了出来，是重施过脂粉了，

她大大方方地说：“我来打口烟你吃。”

“我没有瘾。”

“香一简玩玩。”

说着，她亲自动手点起了烟灯，自己便躺了下去，拿烟签子挑起烟来烧。

丫头端来一小壶滚烫的茶，一盘松子糖，放在烟盘上，然后一言不发地退了出去。

“烟打好了。”月如招呼：

周少棠不由自主地躺在月如对面，

两人共用一个长枕头，一躺下去便闻到桂花油的香味。

魔障一起，对周少棠来说，便成了苦难，

由她头上的桂花油开始，鼻端眼底，触处无不是极大的挑逗。

“Zhou Shaotang, Zhou Shaotang!” he told himself.
“周少棠啊周少棠！”他在心中自语：

“You have been about the world for decades.
“你混了几十年，

又不是二三十岁的小伙子了，

莫非还是这样子的‘嫩’？”

The warning steadied him a little, but soon he was bewildered again and had to repeat it.
这样自我警告着，心里好象定了些，但很快地又意乱神迷了，需要第二次再提警告，

Before that single pipe reached his lips, he had struggled with himself three or four times.
就这样一筒烟，还没有到口，倒已经在内心中挣扎了三四回了。

月如终于打好了一个“黄、长、松”的烟泡，安在烟枪“斗门”上，拿烟签子轻轻地捻通，

然后将烟枪倒过来，烟嘴伸到周少棠唇边，说一声：

“尝一口看。”

这对周少棠来说，无异为抵御“心中贼”的一种助力，

Though he was not addicted, he could appreciate opium’s attractions.
他虽没有瘾，却颇能领略鸦片烟的妙处，

将注意力集中在烟味的香醇上，暂时抛开了月如的一切。

分儿口抽完了那筒烟，口中又干又苦，

但如“嘴对嘴”喝一口热茶，把烟压了下去，便很容易上瘾，所以他不敢喝茶，只取了块松子糖送人口中。

“周老爷，”月如开口了，“你同我们老爷，原来就熟悉的吧？”

“Not well, originally.
“原来并不熟，

不过，他是场面上的人，我当然久闻其名。”

“He tells me there is something for which he needs your help.
“我们老爷同我说，现在有悠扬事，要请周老爷照应，

不晓得是什么事？”

Zhou was surprised.
一听这话，周少棠不由得诧异，

不知道她是明知故问呢，还是真个不知？

想一想，反问一句：“老唐没有跟你谈过？”

“No.

他只说买的一百多亩西湖田，要赶紧脱手，不然周老爷面上不好交代。”

“他说，要托周老爷帮忙，空口说白话不中用。”月如忽然叹口气说：

“ 唉，我们老爷也是，

我等候两位大驾。”

再谈下去要天亮了。”

明朝会。

今天这顿饭，比吃鱼翅席还要落胃。”

一定要来叨扰。“

Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Eight, Part One

杨书办正要出门。

Mr Hu wants to repay Yueru’s kindness.
胡大先生要报月如的情，

We had meant to give him a share, but he does not want it.
我们原来预备分给他一份，他不要，

He is making it a present to Yueru.
算是送月如。

So we cannot report the full amount Tang has embezzled.”
所以唐子韶作弊的数目不能实报。”


Somehow the words “Mr Hu” reached Chen’s ears.
这段话中的“胡大先生”四字，不知怎么让陈老板听到了，

He strolled over to ask for news, and naturally there were sighs and expressions of regret.
便踱过来打听他的消息，少不得嗟叹惋惜一番。

Zhou and Yang sat beside a window of intricate latticework covered in white paper, with a square of glass set into the middle.
周少棠他们的座位临窗，窗子是碎锦格子糊上白纸，中间嵌一方玻璃，

Through it they could see an evergreen pine, its lofty crown spreading like a canopy.
望出去一株华盖亭亭的不凋松，

On fine days in spring and autumn, the space beneath it made an excellent place for tea.
春秋佳日，树下便是极好的茶座，

Chen pointed.
陈老板指着说道：

“Under that pine is where Mr Hu and Governor Wang sat the first time they came for tea and wine.
“那株松树下面，就是胡大先生同王抚台第一次来吃茶、吃酒的地方。

Governor Wang mentioned it particularly on a later visit.
王抚台有一回来过，还特为提起，

That was seventeen or eighteen years ago.”
这句话十七八年了。”

“If Governor Wang knew how Mr Hu would end, I doubt he could rest in his grave,” Yang said with deep feeling.
“王抚台如果晓得胡大先生会有今天这种下场，只怕他死不瞑目。”杨书办感慨不止，

“Such a magnificent enterprise, gone just like that!
“这样子轰轰烈烈的事业，说败就败，

Exactly like General Nian.”
真同年大将军一样。”

“Still, he is much better off than General Nian,” Zhou said.
“比年大将军总要好得多。”周少棠说：

“At least his life is not in danger.”
“至少，性命之忧是不会有的。”

“Even if his life is safe,” Chen added, “what pleasure can there be left in living?”
陈老板接口说道：“就算没有性命之忧，活得也没意思了。”

“True.”
“是啊！”

Yang nodded gravely.
杨书办深深点头：

“The higher you climb, the harder you fall.
“爬得高，跌得重，

Better to take things less to heart.”
还是看开点好。”


They went on talking about Hu until they had eaten and drunk their fill.
就这样一直在谈胡雪岩，直到酒醉饭饱，

Only as they walked down the hill together did Zhou return to Tang.
相偕下山，周少棠方又提到唐子韶，

“I promised him we would count only twenty-four thousand taels.
“我答应过他，只算两万四千银子。”

Tell Magistrate Ma that if he submits a report, that is the figure he should use.”
他说：“你同马大老爷去说，要报就报这个数目好了。”

“Very well,” Yang said.
“好的。”杨书办说：

“But you ought to explain it all to Mr Hu.
“不过，你应该同胡大先生去说说清楚，

We are reducing the amount out of consideration for Tang’s concubine, just as he wished.
现在是照他的意思，看在唐子韶小老婆分上，特为少报。

The three of us are simply following official procedure.
我们三个人是随公事。

Otherwise he may think we have made a fortune out of it.
不然，他只以为我们从中弄了多少好处，

That would be unfair to us.” He added, “Please be sure to tell him that.”
岂不冤枉。”他又加了一句：“这句话请你一定要说到。”

Yang spoke so earnestly that Zhou decided to visit Yuanbao Street.
由于杨书办的态度很认真，周少棠决走到元宝街去一趟。

Hu was no longer receiving visitors, but his affection for Zhou was different.
胡雪岩已经不会客了，但对周少棠的情分不同，

He had him shown in and asked what had brought him.
仍旧将他请了进去，动问来意。

“I have seen that ‘slender horse’ you spoke of.
“你说的那匹‘瘦马’我见过了，

Only seen her—nothing more,” Zhou said.
亦就是见一见，没有别的花样。”周少棠说：

“Tang’s deficit comes to at least eighty thousand taels.
“他亏空至少有八万银子，

In accordance with your wishes, we have cut it to thirty per cent.
照你的意思，打了他一个三折，

Once the report goes in, they will of course have to recover it.
公事一报上去，当然要追。

Whatever they collect can go towards repaying the government money you owe.
追出来抵还你的官款，

It will be of some help.”
也不无小补。”


Hu’s eyes reddened.
一听这话，胡雪岩的眼圈发红，

“Shaotang, those words alone are enough.
“少棠，”他说：“有你这句话就够了。

Since my troubles began, even my closest friends have come to settle accounts with me.
从出事到现在，再好的朋友，都是同我来算帐的，

At most they offer to knock something off and let me repay a little less.
顶多说是打个折扣，少还一点，

Not one has said, ‘Never mind that deposit I brought you.
没有人说一句，我介绍来的那笔存款，不要紧，

Leave it there for now.’
摆在那里再说，

As for helping me raise money, you could say there has been nobody.
帮我去弄钱来的，可以说没有。

Only two exceptions: Gu Yingchun, who helped scrape together two or three hundred thousand taels to meet the panic in Shanghai, and you.
其中只有两个人，一个是古应春，帮我凑了二三十万银子，应付上海的风潮；再一个是你。

Gu has benefited from me; we have always helped one another.
古应春受过我的好处，大家原是有往来的，

But you are giving up money you could rightfully earn by your own abilities and diverting it to make good my deficit.
象你，该当凭你本事弄来的外款不要，移过来替我补亏空，

A cup of water on a cartload of burning wood, perhaps—too little to save anything.
虽说杯水车薪，无济于事，

Yet to me these twenty-four thousand taels are more precious than anything else.”
不过，我看来这两万四千银子，比什么都贵重。

“Mr Hu, you must not put it that way.
““大先生，你不要这样说。

I too benefited from you in the old days.”
从前我也受过你的好处。”

Zhou went on, “At noon today we were having yousuobing on City God Hill and spoke of your friendship with Governor Wang.
周少棠又说：“今天中午，我们在城隍山吃油蓑饼，还提起你同王抚台的交情，

If he heard of this disaster, I doubt he could be at peace even in the other world.”
只怕他听得你有这一场风波，在阴司里都不安心。”

The mention of Wang Youling brought back the past and his lost friend.
提到玉有龄，枨触前尘，怀念故友，

Hu felt still more painfully close to tears.
胡雪岩越发心里酸酸地想哭，

“It has all been one great dream,” he said.
“真正是一场大梦！”他说：

“A dream is a dream.
“梦终归是梦，

In the end one has to wake.”
到底是要醒的。”

“From ancient times to the present, there can have been only a handful of men who ever dreamed a dream like yours.”
“一个人能够象你做这样一场梦，古往今来，只怕也不过数得出来的几个人。”


These words encouraged Hu.
这话使得胡雪岩颇受鼓舞，

Suddenly he thought of something that had never occurred to him before: his reputation after death.
忽然想到他从未想过的身后之名，

“I wonder whether storytellers will tell of me one day.
“不晓得将来说书的人，会不会说我？”

And if they do, what will they say?
他问：“说我又是怎样子地说，

That I brought ruin upon myself, or that my luck failed?”
是骂我自作孽，还是运气不好？”

“They certainly will tell your story.
“说是一定会说的，

Just like General Nian—who has not heard of him?”
好比年大将军一样，哪个不晓得？”

This reminded Hu of the story of General Nian giving away a concubine.
这使得胡雪岩想起年大将军赠妾的故事，

An idea stirred in him.
心中一动，

He smiled.
便笑一笑说：

“How could I compare with General Nian?
“我哪里比得上年大将军？

Let us leave that aside and talk of family matters, as old friends should.
不讲这些了。老弟兄聊聊家常。

Shaotang, how old are you this year?”
少棠，你今年贵庚？”

“I was born in the Year of the Tiger.
“我属老虎，

Fifty-four.”
今年五十四。”

“And your wife?”
“嫂夫人呢？”

“The Year of the Sheep, five years younger.
“她属羊，”比我小五岁。

In theory, with a sheep in a tiger’s jaws, my influence ought to harm her.
“周少棠说：”照道理，羊落虎口，我应该克她，

Yet her health is even better than mine.”
哪晓得她的身子比我还健旺。

“You do not look in your fifties at all.
““你也一点都不象五十几岁的人。”

I last saw your wife when we were young.
胡雪岩说：“嫂夫人我还是年纪轻的时候见过。

I thought you were a little afraid of her then.
那时候，我看你就有点怕她。

What about now?”
现在呢？”

“At our age, what does it matter who fears whom?
“都一把年纪了，谈啥哪个怕哪个？

Besides…”
而况……”

“Why stop there?” Hu asked.
“怎么不说下去？”胡雪岩问。

Zhou had reached a painful subject and did not wish to speak of it.
这是因为说到周少棠伤心之处了，不愿多谈，

He shook his head.
摇摇头说：

“It is nothing.”
“没有啥。”


“There must be a reason.
“一定有缘故。

Shaotang, if something is troubling you, why not tell me?”
少棠，你有啥苦衷，何妨同我讲一讲。”

“It is not that.
“不是有啥苦衷。”

Our only son…”
周少棠说：“我们的独养儿子……”

Zhou’s only son had been thirty that year.
周少棠的独子，这年正好三十，

He worked for a foreign firm in Shanghai and was highly valued by its chief.
在上海一家洋行中做事，颇得“大板”‘的器重，

With maritime restrictions lifted and foreign business flourishing, his prospects had seemed splendid.
当此海禁大开，洋务发达之时，可说前程如锦。

Then, in the second month, a spring epidemic had carried him off.
哪知这年二月间，一场春瘟，竟尔不治。

Mrs Zhou had been beside herself with grief.
周太太哭得死去活来。

What Zhou had begun to say was, “Besides, a young husband and wife become companions in old age.
周少棠本来要说的一句话是：“而况少年夫妻老来伴，

With our only son dead, she and I truly have no one but each other.”
独养儿子死掉了，我同她真正叫相依为命。”

It was this painful memory that had stopped him.
原来是提到了这段伤心之事，所以说不下去。

“Had your son married?” Hu asked.
胡雪岩便问：“你儿子娶亲了没有呢？”

“No.”
“没有。”

“Why was he still unmarried at thirty?”
“怎么三十岁还不成家？”

“He had taken to foreign ways.
“那是因为他学洋派，

He said foreigners did not marry until thirty.
说洋人都是这样的，三十岁才成家。

He also wanted to go abroad with his employer and learn something useful.
他又想跟他们老板到外国去学点本事，

Marriage would have made that inconvenient, so he kept putting it off.
成了家不方便，所以耽误下来的。

Now that delay has cost us even a grandson.”
如今是连孙子都耽误了。“


“Yes.
“是啊！

Of the three offences against filial duty, leaving no heir is the worst,” Hu said.
不孝有三，无后为大。”胡雪岩说：

“Has your wife not urged you to take a concubine?”
“嫂夫人倒没有劝你讨个小？”

“She has.
“提过。

I told her…”
我同她说……”

Zhou stopped abruptly.
周少棠突然顿住，

What he had actually said was, “Forget it.
因为他原来的话是：“算了，算了，

If you want discord at home, take a concubine.”
‘若要家不和，讨个小老婆’。”

As the words reached his lips, he remembered how offensive they might be.
话到嘴边，想起忌讳：

First, Madam Luosi was herself a concubine.
第一，螺蛳太太就是“小老婆”；

Second, Hu’s household had its “Twelve Beauties.”
第二，胡雪岩家“十二金钗”，

Perhaps having so many concubines was part of what had brought him to his present plight.
“小老婆”太多，或许就是落到今天这个下场的原因。

In any event, words that would wound him must not be spoken.
总之，令人刺心的话，决不可说。

Zhou changed his answer.
于是他改口说道：

“My wife meant it kindly, but I could not find a suitable woman just then.
“内人虽有这番好意，无奈一时没有合便宜的人，

I could only decline with thanks.”
只好敬谢不敏了。”

“That is true enough.
“这倒是实话，

Finding the right woman is the most important thing.
要有合适的人，是顶要紧的一桩。

‘If you want discord at home, take a concubine.’
‘若要家不合，讨个小老婆’，

People always assume this means the principal wife grows jealous.
大家总以为指大太太吃醋，

It need not be so at all!
其实不然！

Choose badly, and the concubine sees a quiet principal wife whom she can bully.
讨小讨得不好，看大太太老实好欺侮，

Spoiled by her husband’s favour, she tries to climb over the wife’s head.
自己恃宠而骄，要爬到大太太头上。

Then there will be quarrels, however virtuous the wife may be.”
那一来大太太再贤惠，还是要吵架。”

Zhou had not expected Hu himself to quote the very saying he had thought too delicate to mention.
周少棠没有想到自己认为触犯忌讳的那句俗语，倒是胡雪岩自己说了出来。

Yet there was much truth in his words.
不过他的话也很有道理，

Madam Luosi was a ready example; Zhou also knew what had happened when Gu Yingchun took a concubine.
螺蛳太太固然是个现成的例子；古应春纳妾的经过，他也知道。

Both experiences could serve as footnotes to Hu’s argument.
都可以为他的话作注脚。



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第八章（下，至本章结束）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Eight, Part Two (conclusion)
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


“Shaotang, we have been friends for so long.
“少棠，你我相交一场，

When I had the means to help you, I did very little…”
我有力量帮你的时候，没有帮你什么……”

“No, no!” Zhou interrupted.
“不，不！”周少棠插嘴拦住，

“Do not say that.
“你不要说这话，

You have helped me more than enough.”
你帮我的忙，够多了。”

“Very well.
“好！

Now I want to do you another service and find a suitable woman for you.” Zhou laughed. “Mr Hu!
我现在还要帮你一个忙，替你好好儿物色一个人。”“大先生！”周少棠笑道：

At a time like this, you still have leisure to concern yourself with such trifles?”
“你现在倒还有闲工夫来管这种闲事？”

“My serious affairs are no longer mine to manage.
“正事轮不到我管，

Governor Liu and Treasurer De worry about them for me.
有刘抚台、德藩台替我操心，

I can only occupy myself with trifles.”
我就只好管闲事了。”

His self-mocking tone, beneath which lay so much resentment, revealed his utter helplessness.
满腹牢骚，出以自我调侃的语气，正见得他的万般无奈。

Zhou felt the desolation of a hero brought to the end of his road.
周少棠不免兴起一种英雄末路的苍凉之感。

If they talked much longer, he might weep.
再谈下去，说不定会掉眼泪，

He therefore rose to take his leave.
因而起身告辞。

Hu grasped his arm as though he had something to say.
胡雪岩握着他的手臂，仿佛有话要说，

Twice he almost spoke, then stopped.
却两次欲言又止，

At last he released his hold.
终于松开了手说：

“We shall talk again.”
“再谈吧！”


At midnight there was a knock at the inner gate, and a letter was brought in, delivered by a special messenger from the provincial treasurer's yamen.
半夜里叩中门，送进来一封信，说是藩台衙门的专差送来的。

Madam Luosi woke Hu and held a Western lamp with a crystal-glass shade for him to read it.
螺蛳太太将胡雪岩唤醒了，拿一盏水晶玻璃罩的“洋灯”，让他看信。

Before he had gone through more than a few lines, he put it down.
看不到几行，胡雪岩将信搁下，开口说道：

“I must get up.”
“我要起来。”

She roused the maids, had the lights lit and the brazier stirred, and helped him dress.
于是螺蛳太太叫起丫头，点起灯火，拨旺炭盆，服侍胡雪岩起身，

He laid Dexin's letter on the table for closer examination.
他将德馨的信，置在桌上细看。

Besides the sheet of eight-column stationery, there was a copy of another document, written so small that he needed his reading spectacles.
一张八行笺以外，另有一个抄件，字迹较小，需要戴老花眼镜，才看得清楚。


It was an imperial edict: “To the Grand Secretariat.
抄件是一道上谕：“谕内阁：

Supervising Censor Deng Chengxiu has memorialized, requesting that corrupt officials be ordered to make substantial compulsory contributions to meet urgent needs.
给事中郎承修奏请，责令贪吏罚捐巨款，以济要需一折，

He lists as particularly notorious for illicit gains the late Governor-General Ruilin; Education Commissioner He Tingqian; former superintendents of the Guangdong Maritime Customs, Chongli and Junqi; Education Commissioner Wu Baoshu; Naval Commander Zhai Guoyan; Salt Transport Commissioner He Zhaoying; Circuit Intendant Fang Junshi of Zhaonan; Prefect Feng Duanben of Guangzhou; Prefect Liu Xiangnian of Chaozhou; Prefect Zhang Bingyan of Lianzhou; Magistrate Du Fengzhi of Nanhai; Magistrate Lin Zhuozhi of Shunde; and the present Magistrate Lu Lexu of Nanhai.
据称该给事中所开赃私最著者，如已故总督瑞麟、学政何廷谦、前任粤海关监督崇礼及俊启、学政吴宝恕、水师提督翟国彦、盐运使何兆瀛、肇难道方浚师、广州府知府冯端本、潮州府知府刘湘年、廉州府知府张丙炎、南海县知县杜凤治、顺德县知县林灼之、现任南海县知县卢乐戌，

All, he states, acquired great wealth after serving in Guangdong.
皆自宫广东后，得有巨资，

Such wealth must have come either from the people's substance or from the public treasury.
若非民膏，即是国帑等语，

Peng Yulin is hereby directed to ascertain precisely the reputations of these officials during their service in Guangdong and report the facts.”
着派彭玉麟将各该员在广东居官声名苦何，确切查明，据实具奏。”

This did not concern Hu.
这跟胡雪岩无关。


The supplementary memorial, however, concerned him very closely: “The supplementary memorial states: ‘I hear that Fukang Bank has closed, and that Wenyu, Assistant Grand Secretary and Minister of Punishments, has more than seven hundred thousand taels deposited there.
另有一个附片，就大有关系了：“另片奏：闻阜康银号关闭，协办大学士刑部尚书文煜，所存该号银数至七十余万之多，

I request an immediate investigation to ascertain the exact sum and its source, followed by a report seeking appropriate disciplinary action.’
请即查明确数，究所从来，据实参处等语，

The Shuntian prefectural authorities are hereby ordered to investigate and report.”
着顺天府确查具奏。”

Dexin's own letter contained only two short lines: “The affair has reached the throne.
接下来再看德馨的亲笔信，只有短短的两行：“事已通天，

Further severe orders may follow.
恐尚有严旨，

Please make preparations without delay.
请速为之计。

We must discuss this in person.”
容面谈。”


“Look!”
“你看！”

Hu handed the letter to Madam Luosi.
胡雪岩将信递了给螺蛳太太，

“He has not made himself clear.
“话没有说清楚，

Does ‘discuss this in person’ mean he is coming here, or that I am to go to him?”
‘容面谈’是他来，还是要我去？”

“Let me find out.” She called Qiaozhu, the maid who had brought in the letter and who had been transferred from Jingjian Pavilion.
“等我来问问看。”螺蛳太太将递信进来的丫头、由镜槛阁调过来的巧珠唤了来，

Qiaozhu was to send word through the inner gate to the gatehouse and ask whether the treasurer's messenger was still there.
关照她到中门上传话，赶到门房去问，藩司衙门来的专差，是否还在？

If he had gone, had he left any message?
如果已经走了，留下什么话没有？

It would take some time for an answer to return.
这得好一陈工夫才会有回话，

Hu could no longer sit still.
胡雪岩有点沉不住气了，

He paced about, muttering, “Severe orders, severe orders!
起身蹀躞，喃喃自语：“严旨，严旨！

Dismissal from office, or confiscation of the household?”
是革职还是抄家？”

Madam Luosi was terrified, but dared not show it.
螺蛳太太一听吓坏了，但不敢现诸形色，

She merely laid a heavy fur robe and a tribute-satin riding jacket on a chair.
只将一件大毛皮袍，一件贡缎马褂堆在椅子上，

Whether Dexin came to Hu or Hu went to Dexin, he would need to change, and she wanted the clothes ready.
因为不管是德馨来，还是胡雪岩去，都要换衣服，所以早早预备在那里。

“‘Make preparations without delay’—what preparations?”
“ ‘速为之计’，怎么‘计’法？”

Hu suddenly stopped.
胡雪岩突然住足，

“I think I must go to Shanghai.”
“我看我应该到上海去一趟。

“Why?”
“为啥？”

“At the very least I must put the Transport Bureau's official business in order and give a proper account.
“至少我要把转运局的公事，弄清楚了，作个交代，

I cannot let Lord Zuo become involved.
不要牵涉到左大人，

还有宓本常，

商议未定之际，只见巧珠急急来报，德馨已经微服来访。

胡雪岩急忙换了衣服，

未及下楼，已有四名丫头，持着宫灯，前引后拥地将德馨迎上楼来。

“We are brothers.
“自己弟兄，

Lord Wen was Wenyu, the current Assistant Grand Secretary and Minister of Punishments, and was therefore addressed as a grand secretary.
“文中堂”便是文煜，现任协办大学士刑部尚书，所以称之为“中堂”。

He was a famously wealthy man among the Eight Banners.

位尊而权不重，亦谈不到什么入息，

只有福州将军例外，因为兼管闽海关，

五口通商以后，福州亦是洋商贸易的要地，税收激增，所以成了肥缺，

文煜因为是恭王的亲戚，靠山甚硬，在这个肥缺上盘踞了九年之久，

及至内调进京，又几次派充崇文门监督，这也是一个日进斗金的阔差，

数十年宦囊所积，不下千万之多。

在阜康，他是第一个大存户，

His interests were bound up with Hu's, and their personal friendship was close.
一方面是利害相共，休戚相关；一方面他跟胡雪岩的交情很厚，

所以从阜康出事以后，他一直在暗中支持，

现在为邓承修一纸“片奏”所参，

纸包不住火，

“没有那么多。”

“照定制来说，朝廷就不会听片面之词，

一定是要文中堂明白回奏。”

“That I cannot say.
“那就不知道了。”

He will hardly admit that his money comes from a dubious source.”
德馨答说：“总不会承认自己的钱，来路不明吧！”

似乎也不算多。”

光是钱庄存款就有四五十万，还不算多吗？”

Hu had no answer.
胡雪岩无词以对，

只是在想：文煜究竟会得到怎么一种处分？

“I fear Lord Wen is in for trouble,” Dexin continued.
“文中堂这回怕要倒楣。”德馨说道：

“The Pure Stream group is very much in the ascendant.

朝廷为了尊重言路，只怕要拿文中堂来开刀。”

Hu started.
胡雪岩一惊，

“What?
“怎么？”

Will he be convicted of an offence?”

“Not that.
“治罪是不会的。

只怕要罚他。”

A fine?”
罚款？”

现在正在用兵，军需孔急，

作兴会罚他报效饷银。

数目多寡就不知道了。”

想拖一拖不都不成。”

后天走。”

“讲倒帐”，便是打折扣来清偿。任何生意失败，都是如此料理。

胡雪岩一直在等待情势比较缓和，存货就比较能卖得比较好的价钱，“讲倒帐”的折扣亦可提高。

Once those were paid, the twenty-odd pawnshops would still be ours?”
等还清了，二十几家典当还是我们的？

“胡雪岩失笑了，

天下世界哪里有这么好的事？”

By earning the money gradually, I mean keeping the profitable businesses running for the time being, then valuing them and handing them over against the public debts.”
他说，“所谓‘慢慢儿赚了来还’，意思是赚钱的事业，先照常维持，然后再来估价抵还公款。”

“这有啥区别呢？

迟早一场空。”

譬如说：这家典当的架本是二十万两，

典当照常营业，当头有人来赎，可以照二十万两算；

倘或关门不做生意了，当头只好照流当价来估价，

三文不值两文，

决不能算二十万两，不足之数，仍旧要我们来赔，

这样子一说，你明白了吧？”

“I understand.

不过，”螺蛳太太问道：“能不能留下一点来？”

胡雪岩是早就打算好了的，到了上海，

哪里都不住，到城里找了一家小客栈住了下来，为的是隐藏行迹，

He knew too many people in the foreign settlement.
租界上熟人太多，

The head attendants at the inns catering to officials were particularly well informed; how could they fail to have seen the celebrated God of Wealth?
“仕宦行台”的茶房头脑，更是见多识广，岂能没有见过鼎鼎大名的“胡财神”？

His only way of hiding his circumstances was to disappear into a small inn far from the settlement.
所以要遮掩真相，只有隐身在远离租界的小客栈中。

Once settled, he sent an attendant to fetch Gu.
安顿既定，派跟班去通知古应春来相会。

Gu was astonished, but could readily understand Hu's state of mind.
古应春大出意外，但亦不难体会到胡雪岩的心境，

Though inwardly moved by the desolation of a great man at the end of his road, he met him calmly and did not even ask why he was staying there.
所以尽管内心为他兴起一种英雄末路的凄凉，但见了面神色平静，连“小爷叔为啥住在这里”这么一句话都不问。

“How is Seventh Sister?
“七姐怎么样？

Is her health any better?”
身子好一点没有？”

“Fairly well.”
“还好。”

“And what does she say about my affairs?”
“我的事情呢？”胡雪岩问：“她怎么说？”

“She does not know.”
“她不晓得。”

“Does not know?”
“不晓得？”

Hu was surprised.
胡雪岩诧异：

“How have you kept it from her?”
“怎么瞒得住？”

“Thanks to Ruixiang.
“多亏瑞香，

She has tried every possible means of keeping her from hearing.
想尽办法不让她晓得。

The greatest difficulty is the newspaper.
顶麻烦的是报纸。

Every day I read Shen Bao first, and if a page carries news of you, I put that sheet away so that she cannot see it.”
每天送来的《申报》，我总先要看过，哪一张上面有小爷叔的消息，就把这张报纸收起来，不给她看。”

“Oh!” Hu breathed out and felt immediately easier.
“喔！”胡雪岩透了一口气，心头顿感轻松，

He had been worrying about what he could say to comfort the Seventh Lady when they met.
他本来一直在担心的是，见了七姑奶奶的面，不知道说什么话来安慰她，

Now that concern was lifted.
现在不必担心了。


They turned to business.
接下来便谈正事。

Hu first told Gu of his decision to sacrifice an arm to save himself, and naturally asked his opinion.
胡雪岩首先将他所作的“壮士断腕”的决定，告诉了古应春，当然也要问问他的看法。

“Since you have made up your mind, Little Uncle, it is not for me to say whether you are right.
“小爷叔己下了决心，我没有资格来说对不对，

What I think about day and night is how to preserve some capital for you to begin again…”
我日日夜夜在想的是，怎么样替小爷叔留起一笔东山再起的本钱……”

“Yingchun,” Hu interrupted, “do not indulge in impossible hopes.
“应春，”胡雪岩打断他的话说：“你不要痴心妄想了。

What I achieved depended on favourable times, favourable circumstances, and the support of the right people, together with two opportunities that cannot be sought at will and never come twice.
我胡某人之有今天，是天时、地利、人和，再加上两个可遇不可求、可一不可再的机会凑成功的。

Which of those advantages do I still possess?
试问，天时、地利、人各，我还占得到哪一样？

Even if I had them all, those two opportunities would never return.”
就算占全了，也不会再有那样两个机会了。”

“Which two opportunities do you mean?
“小爷叔说的是两个机会是啥？

The western campaign must be one.
一个大概是西征，

What was the other?”
还有一个呢？”

“还有一个海禁大开。

In those days very few people knew how to deal with foreigners.
当时懂得跟外国人打交道的，没有几个，

Now countless men understand foreign affairs.
现在呢？懂洋务的不晓得有多少，

In trading with foreigners, they know not only their prices but also all their tricks for exploiting Chinese people.
同洋人打交道，做生意，不但晓得他们的行情，而且连洋人那套吃中国人的决窍都学得很精了，

What place is left for me?
哪里还轮得到我来做市面？

Besides, a Chinese businessman needs a powerful patron.”
再说，中国人做生意要靠山。

Shaking his head, Hu changed the subject.
“胡雪岩摇摇头换了个话题，”

“You say you want to save some money for me.
你说要替我留一笔钱，

I can only be grateful for the thought; it cannot be done.
我只好说，盛情可感，其实是做不到的。

All my accounts have been handed over.
因为我的全部帐目都交出去了，

The silk and cocoons are recorded in detail.
象丝茧两样，都有细数，

How could I secretly hold back a portion?”
哪里好私下留一部分？“


“There are still ways,” Gu replied.
“办法还是有。”古应春说：

“The essential thing is that you must insist on handling the silk and cocoons yourself.”
“顶要紧的一点是，丝茧两项，小爷叔一定要坚持，自己来处理。”

“I understand what you mean.
“我懂你的意思。

But I cannot afford one wrong step now.
不过现在一步都错不得，

The goods may still be in my hands, but the right to dispose of them is no longer mine.
东西虽然在我手里，主权已经不是我的了。

Even with a buyer of our own, the sale depends on Governor Liu's consent.
我们有户头，卖不卖要看刘抚台愿意不愿意，

If he says the price is too low and refuses, we have nothing to say.”
他说价钱不好，不卖，我们没有话说。”

“And if the price is good?”
“价钱好呢？”

“How good?” Hu asked at once.
“好到怎样的程度？”胡雪岩脱口相问，

Seeing that Gu remained silent, he continued, “Only if the price were high enough to cover my deficit with something to spare could I immediately recover control and handle matters myself.
看古应春不作声，方又说道：“除非价钱好到足抵我的亏空有余，我马上可以收回，自己处理。

Unfortunately that cannot be done.
无奈办不到，

I can only ask Governor Liu to negotiate reduced settlements, so the decision must be his.”
只有请刘抚台出面来讲折扣，那就只好由他作主了。”

“But Governor Liu may not be able to find a buyer immediately.”
“不过，刘抚台一时也未见得找得到主顾。”

“True.
“不错，

I know he cannot.
我也晓得他找不到。

My original idea was to let the matter wait if he found none.
我原来的打算是，他找不到，就拖在那里，

After a few months, conditions might improve, or the foreign merchants might become too impatient for supplies.
拖它几个月，或者局面好转了，或者洋商要货等不及了，

Prices could recover, and perhaps we could regain our footing.
行情翻醒，或放我们可以翻身。

But in the present circumstances, further delay may end very badly.” He then explained in detail how the censors' impeachment of Wenyu might implicate him and lead to his own dismissal from office, before describing the purpose of his journey.
不过照目前的情形看，再拖下去，会搞得很难看。”于是胡雪岩将言官参劾，可能由文煜的案子，牵连到他受革职处分的情形细说了一遍，接着又细谈此行的目的。


“My first business here is to find a buyer for the silk and cocoons.
“我这趟来，第一件事，就是找丝茧的买主，

Have you anyone?”
你有没有？”

“Yes.
“有。

Only the price still needs some patient bargaining.”
就是价码上下，还要慢慢儿磨。”

“No more bargaining.
“不要磨了。

We shall introduce the transaction as brokers.
我们以掮客的身分，介绍这生意。

If Governor Liu agrees, we shall also explain the commission openly.”
刘抚台答应了，佣钱照样也要同他说明。”

“And Governor Liu?
“那么刘抚台呢？”

Is he to have a share of the commission?”
古应春问：“佣金是不是也要分他一份？”

“Naturally, and the largest share.
“当然，而且应该是大份。

But we cannot put that to him directly.
不过，这话不便同他说明，

We must take a roundabout approach.”
一定要转个弯。”

“How?
“怎么转法？

Speak to Treasurer De first?”
是不先跟德藩台去谈？”

“Exactly.
“不错，

You know my relationship with De Xiaofeng.
要先同德晓峰谈。我同他的关系，你是晓得的，

Since you have a buyer, let us telegraph him at once.”
既然你有了户头，我们马上打外电报给他。”

“It must be a confidential cable.”
“这要用密电。”

“Yes.
“是的。”

Before leaving, I obtained a codebook from him.
胡雪岩说：“临走以前，我同他要了一个密码本，

We also agreed to use assumed names.”
而且约好，大家用化名。”

“Then everything is in order.”
“那就很妥当了。”


Gu went through the buyers he had approached in detail.
接下来，古应春便细细地谈了他所接洽的户头，

A wealthy French merchant named Meiya offered comparatively favourable terms.
有个法国的巨商梅雅，开的条件比较好。

Having heard them, Hu asked about the method of payment and the bank providing the guarantee.
胡雪岩听完以后，又问了付款的办法、担保的银行，

He considered the transaction acceptable, but pressed one further question.
认为可以交易，但仍旧追问一句：

“Is there any buyer better than Meiya?”
“比梅雅好的户头还有没有？”

“No.”
“没有。”

“Good.
“好！

Then he is the man.
就是他。”

As for the commission, deduct your share.
胡雪岩又说：“至于佣金，你的一份要扣下来，

Mine is to go into the general settlement account.”
我的一份，归入公帐。”

“Mine can go into it too.”
“我的也归公帐。”

“No, no!
“不必，不必！

I am doing it to show my sincerity.
我是为了显我的诚心诚意，

Why should you put your money in for nothing?
你又何必白填在里头？

If, after a reduced settlement, I still had to make up the balance, you could reasonably say that your sacrifice lightened my burden.
如果说，折扣打下来，不足之数仍旧要在我身上追，你这样做，让我少一分负担，犹有可说，

But the whole matter is to be settled at a discount.
如今总归是打折了事，

Your contribution would do me no good.
你这样做，于我没啥好处，

Even I might scarcely appreciate the favour.
连我都未必见你的情。

Others would not know that you had forgone your commission, so there is no question of their gratitude.”
至于旁人，根本不晓得你不要佣金，就更不用谈了。”

“I feel that I ought to share your hardship…”
“我是觉得我应该同小爷叔共患难……”

“Enough, enough!”
“好了，好了！你不必再说了。”

Hu cut him short.
胡雪岩拿他的话打断，

“Even a copper coin thrown into the water makes a sound.
“铜钱掼到水里还听个响声，

If you sacrifice this money and no one knows it, what is the point?”
你这样牺牲了都没有人晓得，算啥？”

“Very well.”
“好吧！”

Gu formed a different intention but kept it to himself.
古应春另外打了主意，不必说破，只问：

“When shall we send the telegram?”
“电报什么时候打？”


“Now.
“现在就打，

Draft it first and let us look at it.”
你先起个稿子看。”

Gu nodded and thought carefully for a while.
古应春点点头，凝神细想了一会说：

“How shall I put the matter of the commission?”
“佣金的话，怎么说法？”

“Do not mention it yet.
“这先不必提，

Give only the price and explain the terms of payment.
你只报个价，叙明付款办法，

Stress that no better price can be obtained.
格外要强调的是，没有比这个价钱更好的了。

If Governor Liu is interested, you can go to Hangzhou and discuss it with him in person.
如果刘抚台有意思，由你到杭州同他当面接头，

That will be the time to speak of the commission.”
那时候再谈佣金。”

“Would it not be more suitable for you to go back and negotiate yourself, Little Uncle?”
“小爷叔，你自己回去谈，不是更妥当吗？”

“No.
“不！

First, I must go to Jiangning.
第一，我要到江宁去一趟；

Second, it would be better for me to keep out of this.
第二，这件事我最好不要插手，

If I appear uninvolved, De Xiaofeng will find it easier to speak.”
看起来置身事外，德晓峰才比较好说话。”

“I understand.” They called for the inn attendant to bring writing materials.
“好！我懂了。”于是唤茶房取来笔砚，

Gu prepared a draft, which they considered and revised together.
古应春拟好一个电报稿，与胡雪岩斟酌妥当，

They then took out the codebook, encoded the message, copied it afresh, and checked it.
然后取出密码本来，两人一起动手，翻好了重新誊正校对，

By the time they finished, evening had come.
直到傍晚，方始完事。

“I shall send it at once, or the telegraph office will close,” Gu said.
“我马上去发，否则，电报局要关门了。”古应春问：

“Will you dine at my house, Little Uncle, or shall we find pleasure in adversity and have a courtesan dinner?”
“小爷叔是不是到我那里去吃饭，还是苦中作乐，去吃一台花酒？”

“How could I be in the mood for that?
“哪里有心思去吃花酒？”

Let us go out for a walk and find somewhere to eat.
胡雪岩说：“我们一起出去逛逛，随便找个馆子吃饭，

I shall see Seventh Sister tomorrow.”
明天再去看七姐。”

“Very well.”
“也好。”

Leaving even Hu's attendant behind, they went out together, first sent the confidential telegram at the telegraph office, and then walked leisurely through the night market.
于是胡雪岩连跟班都不带，与古应春一起出了客栈，先到电报局发了密电，安步当车，闲逛夜市。



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第九章（全章）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Nine (complete)
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER NINE: YOUTHFUL DREAMS OF LOVE｜第九章 少年绮梦


Passing a small restaurant, Hu Xueyan stopped, and Gu Yingchun stopped with him.
走过一家小饭馆，胡雪岩止住了脚，古应春亦跟着停了下来。

Smoke and dust had so obscured the gold lettering on its sign that the name was no longer legible.
那有饭馆的金字招牌，烟熏尘封，已看不清是何字号，

The cooking range stood just inside the entrance; beyond it was a large room containing twenty or thirty square tables.
进门炉灶，里面是一间大厅，摆着二三十张八仙桌，

The restaurant was about to close.
此时已将歇市，

Only two tables were occupied, and the dim lights made the deserted room seem still more forlorn.
冷冷清清的，只有两桌客人，灯火黯淡，益显萧瑟。

“Little Uncle, let us try somewhere else,” Gu said.
古应春忍不住说：“小爷叔，换一家吧，

“Or go to the settlement and find a proper restaurant.
或者到租界上去，好好找家馆子。

This one is closing.”
这家要打烊了。”

“Let us ask.”
“问问看。”

Hu stepped inside.
说着，举步踏了进去。

The waiter was so eager to oblige that Gu could hardly deprive him of their custom.
跑堂的倒很巴结，古应春亦就不好意思打断人家的生意了。

“Please sit down, gentlemen.
“两位客人请坐，

Will you be eating or drinking?”
吃饭还是吃酒。”

“Both.
“饭也要，酒也要。”

Is this place called Laotonghe?” Hu asked.
胡雪岩问道：“你们这家招牌，是不是叫老同和？”

“Yes, sir.
“是的。

Laotonghe.”
老同和。”

“Where is the proprietor?
“老板呢？”胡雪岩问：

I remember he had six fingers on his left hand.”
“我记得他左手有六个指头。”

“That was our old proprietor.
“那是我们老老板，

He died years ago.”
去世多年了。”

“And now?
“现在呢？

Has the young master taken over?”
小开变老板了？”

“He had no son, only a daughter.
“老老板没有儿子，只有一个女儿，

She is our mistress now.”
现在是我们的老板娘。”

“Ah!”
“啊！”

Hu's eyes suddenly brightened.
胡雪岩突然双眼发亮，

“Was her childhood name A’cai?”
“你们老板娘的小名是不是叫阿彩？”

“You really are an old customer!
“原来你这位客人，真正是老客人了。”

Very few people still know our mistress's name.”
跑堂的说道：“现在叫得出我们老板娘名字的，没有几个人。”

The waiter turned and shouted for her.
接着，便回过去，高声喊道：“老板娘，老板娘！”

When there was no answer, Gu stopped him.
看看没有回音，古应春便拦住他说：

“Never mind calling.
“不必喊了。

Bring us a few of whatever dishes are good, and warm a jin of wine.”
有啥好东西，随意配几样来，烫一斤酒。”


When the waiter had gone, Hu said with deep feeling, “More than twenty years!
等跑堂离去，胡雪岩不胜感慨地说：“二十多年了！

The first meal I ever ate in Shanghai was here.”
我头一回到上海，头一顿饭就是在这里吃的。”

“You seem to know the place well, Little Uncle.
“小爷叔好象很熟嘛！

You even remember the proprietor's daughter's childhood name.”
连老板女儿的小名都叫得出来。”

“More than remember it...”
“不但叫得出来……”

Hu shook his head and said no more.
胡雪岩摇摇头，没有再说下去。

His hesitation, involving a young heiress to a business, readily suggested a story.
这种欲言双止的神态，又关涉到一个“女小开”，很容易今人想到，其中必有一段故事。

On such a cold night, in such a chilly, empty restaurant, hearing it might help them forget their cares.
如此寒夜，如此冷店，听这段故事，或者可以忘忧消愁。

The thought lifted Gu's spirits.
就这样一转念间，古应春便觉得兴致好得多了。

The waiter brought boiled pork and dark sea cucumber, both local specialties, and a hotpot flavored with wine lees.
等跑堂端来“本帮菜”的白肉、乌参，一个“糟钵头”的火锅，

Its vigorous blue flame warmed Gu's heart as well.
看到熊熊的青焰，心头更觉温暖，

He poured Hu a cup of the heated wine.
将烫好的酒为胡雪岩斟上一杯，开口说道：

“You have always been able to take things in your stride, Little Uncle.
“小爷叔，你是什么都看得开的，

Have a drink and tell me what happened here in those days.”
吃杯酒，谈谈当年在这里的情形。”

Lost in thought, Hu sipped his wine, put a slice of pork into his mouth, and chewed it for a while.
正落入沉恩中的胡雪岩，啜了一口酒，夹了一块白肉送入口中，咀嚼了一会说：

“I cannot tell whether the old proprietor was a better cook or my appetite has changed.
“不晓得是当年老板的手艺好，还是我的胃口变过了，

This pork tastes nothing like as good.”
白肉的味道，大不如前。”

“Perhaps both,” Gu said, smiling.
“说不定两个原因都有。”古应春笑道：

“There may even be a third reason.”
“还说不定有第三个原因。”

“A third?”
“第三个？”

“A’cai was here to wait on you then.”
“是啊！当年还有阿彩招呼客人。”

“She did not wait on customers.
“她不管招呼，

She sat at the accounts desk.
坐帐台。

I had lost my job at a bank in Hangzhou and came to Shanghai to look for work.
那时我在杭州钱庄里的饭碗敲破了，到上海来寻生意，

A capable assistant at Yuanli Bank, here in the city, had served his apprenticeship with me.
城里有家钱庄，字号叫做源利，有个得力的伙计是我一起学生意的师兄弟，

I came to ask his help, only to find that he had gone home to Shaoxing for his brother's marriage.
我到上海来投奔他，哪晓得为他兄弟的亲事，他回绍兴去了，

The people at Yuanli said he would soon be back, so I took a room in a small inn and waited.
源利的人说就要回上海的，我就住在一家小客栈里等。

Ten days passed without a sign of him.
一等等了十天，人没有等到。

My traveling money ran out, and I could do nothing but ‘sprout beans’ in the inn.”
盘缠用光了，只好在小客栈里‘孵豆芽’。”


To have an empty purse and no way out, and therefore stay shut indoors, was what Shanghai people called “sprouting beans.”
囊底无钱，一筹莫展，只好杜门不出，上海的俗语叫做“孵豆芽”。

His lodging bill could wait, but he had to eat.
但客栈钱好欠，饭不能不吃，

He had been coming to Laotonghe every day, ordering a plate of boiled pork, a bowl of blood soup, and a vegetable dish.
他每天到老同和来吃饭，先是一盘白肉、一碗大血汤，再要一样素菜，

First he gave up the pork, keeping only the soup and vegetables.
后来减掉白肉，一汤一素菜，

Then soybean soup replaced the blood soup.
再后来大血汤变为黄豆汤，

Finally, unable to afford even soybean soup, he made a meal of two baked flatbreads and a bowl of hot water.
最后连黄豆汤都吃不起了，买两个烧饼，弄碗白开水便算一顿。

“After seven or eight days of that, I could stand it no longer.
“这种日子过了有七、八天，过不下去了。

The dizziness and blurred eyesight were the least of it.
头昏眼花，还在其次，

What was worse was the panic, as though some terrible disaster were about to fall on me.
心里发慌，好象马上要大祸临头，

It was more than a man could bear.
那种味道不是人受的。

One day I steeled myself and pawned a lined spring robe.
这天发个狠，拿一件线春夹袍子当掉后，

一摸袋袋，才晓得当票弄掉了……”

掉了就掉了，有钱做新的。”

两条路，随你自己挑。”

那个小徒弟叫阿利，

原来胡雪岩掏钱惠帐时，将当票掉落在地上，

至晚打烊，阿利扫地发现，送交帐台。

阿彩本就在注意胡雪岩，

便知长袍已送入当铺。

特为交代，要守秘密，亦望胡雪岩不必说破，倒不是怕她父亲知道，是怕有人当笑话去讲。

见了她又不能还她钱，尴尬不尴尬？

她替我垫的钱，我以后会加利奉还。”

不道此一承诺竟成虚愿。

大约一年以后，胡雪岩与杨昌浚重逢，开始创业，

偶然想到其事，写信托上海的同业，送了一百两银子到老同和，不道竟碰了一个钉子。

人家不知道是啥花佯，自然不肯收了。”

小爷叔一直在上海，

莫非自己就不可以来一趟？”

有一回我想起来了，用个红封袋包好一张五百两银子的银票，正要出门，接到一个消息，

马上把什么要紧的事，都掼在脑后了。”

“什么消息？”

“Hangzhou had been recaptured.”

以后没有再想到过？”

再譬如在船上想到了，

也不能马上回去办，这是地方不对。

凡是这种时候，这种地方想到了，总觉得日子还长，一定可以了心愿。

到后来日子一长，这件事就想了起来，也是所谓无动于衰了。

明明一定办得到的事，阴错阳差，叫你不能如愿。”

His thoughts turned to Hu's present misfortunes, themselves the accumulation of a series of unhappy accidents.

这样一直想下去，竟忘了身在何地了。


“Yingchun!”

“I think both the time and the place are right today.

这个机会决不可以错过。”

他初见阿利是在二十七年前，照此算来，那里的阿利只有十三岁，而阿彩至少有十六七岁，

阿彩自己做了几样菜，

你倒尝尝看。

就在这里多谈一息好了。”

这话矛盾，既然有事，何以又能多谈？

A’li missed the flaw, but Hu understood.

In their long partnership negotiating and doing business with foreigners, they had often conveyed messages to one another in such apparently innocent phrases.
因为他们以前同洋人谈生意、办交涉是合作惯了的，经常使用这种暗带着机关的话，当面传递信息。

胡雪岩虽不知道他的本意何在，但暗示必须谢绝，却是很明白的，

明天再说吧！”

阿利又说：“我回去告诉了阿彩，她一定也想见一见胡老爷。”

这一下倒提醒了古应春。

When buying arms from foreigners for Hu, or paying foreign firms in his own business, he used foreign bank cheques.
原来他替胡雪岩与洋人打交道，购买军火，以及他自己与洋商有生意往来，支付货款，都开外国银行的支票，

He was well known among the Chinese banks.
在钱庄里的名气很大，

His English name was William, shortened to Billy; the mischievous young Chinese clerks in foreign firms had joined this to his surname, Gu, and given him the teasing nickname pigu, “buttocks.” If Shenfu asked about this cheque and A’li answered truthfully, word would spread that Hu's bank had defaulted on people's deposits while he himself continued to squander money, spending three thousand taels to repay a personal kindness.
他的英文名字叫William ，昵称Billy ，那些喜欢“寻开心”的“洋行小鬼”，连他的姓在内，替他起了个谐音的外号叫“屁股”。申福钱庄如果问到这张支票的来历，阿利据实回答，传出去说胡雪岩的钱庄倒了人家的存款，自己依旧大肆挥霍，三千两银子还一个人情债，

People would call him utterly heartless.
简直毫无心肝。

This would be extremely damaging to Hu and required careful consideration.
这对胡雪岩非常不利，不能不慎重考虑。


The situation was awkward.
情势有点尴尬，

Gu reflected that a man must not fall on bad times: once he did, he could not spend even the money he still had.
古应春心里在想：人不能倒霉，倒起霉来，有钱都会没法子用。

For the moment, Gu could only put A’li off and think of another solution.
为今之计，只有先把阿利敷衍走了，再作道理。

“Take the cheque first,” he said.
于是他说：“阿利，你先把这张支票拿了。

“I shall see whether Master Hu can come.
回头我看胡老爷能不能来？

If he can, we shall both come; if not, I shall certainly come myself.
能来，一起来，不能来，我一个人一定来。

We can decide then whether to deposit it at Shenfu or collect cash at HSBC.”
支票是轧到申福，还是到汇丰去提现，等我来了再说。

“I really dare not accept it, Master Gu.
““古老爷，”阿利答说：“支票我决不敢收，

You must bring Master Hu, or I shall get a scolding when I go home.”
胡老爷一定请了来，不然我回去要‘吃排头’。”

They already knew he was afraid of his wife, so he saw no need to conceal the likelihood of being berated by A’cai.
因为人家已经知道他怕老婆，所以他对可能会挨阿彩的骂，亦无需隐讳了。

“Very well.
“好！好！

I shall do my best.
我尽量办到。

Do not let me keep you from your business.”
你有事先请吧！”

A’li took an earnest leave, and Hu returned soon afterward.
等阿利殷殷作别而去，胡雪岩接着也回来了，

Gu briefly explained what had happened.
古应春半刚才的那番情形，约为提了一下，

He would first take Hu home, exchange the cheque for Chinese bank drafts, and then visit A’li alone.
表示先将胡雪岩送回家，他另外换用庄票，再单独去赴阿利之约。

“There is no need for the extra journey.
“不必多跑一趟了。

I have a dozen or more drafts at the inn.
我带了十几张票子在那里，

We can make up the sum from those.
先凑了给他。

Let us go back there first.”
我们先回客栈。”

At the inn, Hu opened his leather bag and took out a sheaf of drafts: two for a thousand taels and two for five hundred, making three thousand in all.
到得客栈，胡雪岩打开皮包，取出一叠银票，两张一千、两张五百，凑成三千，

As he handed them to Gu, grief struck him so sharply that he almost wept.
交到古应春手里时，心头一酸，几乎掉泪——

He owned a bank himself; once the name Fukang had carried enormous weight, and now it was not worth a penny.
自己开钱庄，“阜康”这块响当当的金字招牌，如今分文不值，

To give someone money, he had to use drafts issued by Shanxi remittance houses.
要用山西票号的银票给人家，

He had truly reached the end of his road.
真正是穷途末路了。


Gu did not notice Hu's expression.
古应春不曾注意到他的脸色，

He took the four drafts and hurried out.
拿起四张庄票，匆匆而去，

At the inn door he climbed into one of the “Japanese carriages” newly introduced from Japan and told the puller, “Laotonghe.”
在客栈门口，跨上一辆刚从日本传来的“东洋车”，说一声“老同和”，

The rickshaw's hard rubber wheels rumbled over the stone paving.
人力车硬橡皮轮子，隆隆然地滚过石板呼，

Halfway there, he heard someone calling, “Master Gu!”
拉到半路，听见有人在叫：“古老爷，古老爷！”

Recognizing the voice, Gu thought how fortunate it was that he was repaying another man's kindness rather than a debt of his own.
一听声音，古应春心想，幸而是来替人还人情，倘或是欠了人家的债，冤家路窄，

To meet the same man twice in one morning: what a coincidence!
一上午遇见两次，真是巧了。

“Stop!”
“停停，停停！”

When the rickshaw drew up at the roadside, A’li came over.
等东洋车在路边停了下来，阿利也就迎上来了。

“Collect your fare at Laotonghe.”
“车钱到老同和来拿。”

He knew the puller.
车夫是阿利认识的，

Turning to Gu, he said, “My house is just ahead, in the lane.
关照了这一句，他转脸对古应春说：“古老爷，我家就在前面弄堂里，

Please come and sit a while.
请过去坐一坐。

Where is Master Hu?”
胡老爷呢？”

“He has business and cannot come.
“他有事情不来了。”

Where is your wife?”
古应春问：“你太太呢？”

“Still at home.
“现在还在家，

She will go to the shop presently.”
等一下就要到店里去了。”

Discussing the matter at the restaurant might attract attention, Gu thought.
古应春心想，在他店里谈件事，难免惹人注目，

Their house would be better.
倒不如去他家的好，

He nodded readily.
于是连连点头：

“Very well.
“好！好！

Let us talk at your house.”
我到你家里去谈。”

A’li led him a short distance to a lane house, neither new nor particularly old.
于是阿利领路走不多远，便已到达。他家是半新不旧的弄堂房子，

Inside its stone-framed gateway was a small courtyard.
进石库门是个天井，

A’li looked up and called, “We have a guest!”
阿利仰脸喊道：“客人来了！”

A middle-aged woman leaned out of an upstairs window.
语声甫毕，楼窗中一个中年妇人，探头来望，

She must be A’cai.
想必就是阿彩了。

Gu had no time to look closely before following A’li into the main room, where they could already hear footsteps on the stairs.
古应春不暇细看，随着阿利踏进堂屋，楼梯上已有响声了。

“A’cai, make some tea!”
“阿彩，赶紧泡茶！”

“That is your wife?”
“是你太太？”

“Just call her A’cai.”
“叫她阿彩好了。”

She came through a doorway at the back of the room, her pregnant belly prominent.
阿彩下楼，从堂屋后面的一扇门，挺着个大肚子闪了出来，

Neatly dressed and lightly powdered, she smiled.
她穿得整整齐齐，脸上薄施脂粉，含笑问道：

“You must be Master Gu.”
“这位想来是古老爷？”


“You are too kind.”
“不敢当。”

“Where is Master Hu?”
“胡老爷呢？”

“He has business and cannot come,” A’li answered for him.
“有事情不来了。”是阿利代为回答。

The disappointment on A’cai's face was like that of a child promised an outing to the City God Temple to watch tricks and eat Nanxiang steamed buns and sweet fermented-rice dumplings, already dressed in new clothes, only to be told that something had come up and the outing was canceled.
阿彩脸上浮现出的失望神色，便如许了孩子去逛城隍庙，看变把戏，吃南翔馒头、酒酿圆子，新衣服都换好了，却突然宣布，有事不能去了那样，

It was so painful to witness that Gu had to look away.
直可谓之惨不忍睹，以至于古应春不能不将视线避了开去。

Yet she continued to perform her duties as hostess as though nothing had happened.
不过阿彩仍旧能若无其事地尽她做主妇的道理，

She personally brought tea in fine porcelain covered cups and opened a tin of English “Jialike” cigarettes, already available in Shanghai but seldom seen in an ordinary household.
亲自捧来细瓷的盖碗茶，还开了一罐虽已传到上海，但平常人家很少见的英国“茄力克”纸烟。

Clearly she had prepared with great care to receive Hu.
显然，她是细心安排了来接待胡雪岩的。

If all she wanted, however, was to welcome the God of Wealth, Gu need feel no regret.
但如说她是“接财神”，古应春便觉得毫无歉意，

Reaching inside his coat, he took the drafts in his hand.
探手入杯，将一把银票捏在手里，开口问道：

“May I ask your surname, Mr A’li?”
“阿利老板，你贵姓？”

“Zhu.”
“小姓是朱。”

“Ah.
“喔，”

Mrs Zhu, I hear you intend to rebuild and enlarge your premises.
古应春叫一声：“朱太太，听说你们房子要翻造，扩充门面，

Master Hu was delighted.
胡老爷很高兴，

He has asked me to bring you three thousand taels as a gift.”
他有三千两银子托我带来送你们。”


It was not that A’cai scorned the washerwoman who had once fed the impoverished Han Xin and later accepted his reward.
其实阿彩亦非薄漂母而不为，

But between the thousand pieces of gold and Han Xin himself, she valued the man more.
而是“千金”与“韩信”之间，更看重的是后者。

Ever since hearing of the unexpected encounter the night before, she had felt an indescribable excitement.
从前一天晚上，得知有此意外机缘之后，她就有种无可言喻的亢奋，

Over and over she told A’li how she had recognized Hu's promise all those years ago.
絮絮不断地跟阿利说，当时她是如何看得胡雪岩必有出息，

Even so, she admitted that she had never dreamed he would build so great an enterprise.
但也承认，做梦也没有想到他会创这么一番大事业，

And to see that enterprise collapse overnight awakened her pity for a hero brought to the end of his fortunes.
而这番大事业又会垮于旦夕之间，因而又生了一种眼看英雄末路的怜惜。

These mingled feelings of joy and sorrow had disturbed her dreams all night.
这些悲喜交集的复杂情绪夹杂在一起，害得她魂梦不安了一夜。

That morning, when A’li described his chance meeting with the two men and his bewilderment over the HSBC cheque, she reproached him for handling it badly.
及至这天上午，听阿利谈了他在茶馆中与胡雪岩、古应春不期而遇的经过，以及他对那张汇丰银行支票的困惑，阿彩便嗔怪他处理不当，

They need not accept the enormous gift.
照她的意思是，这笔巨款尽可不受，

But he could have followed Gu to HSBC and had the cheque verified, without collecting the money, and then invited Gu to Laotonghe or home.
但不妨照古应春的意思，先到汇丰银行照一照票，等证实无误，却不必提取，将古应春请到老同和或家里来，

Once they held on to Gu, Hu would naturally be drawn in as well.
只要缠住了古应春，自然而然地也就拉住了胡雪岩。

She was right that Gu would certainly come.
她的判断不错，古应春一定会来，

Whether she could see Hu was another matter.
但胡雪岩是否见得到，却很难说，

Torn between hope and fear, she could not sit still.
因而患得患失地坐立不安，

Even now she refused to give up.
到此刻她还不肯死心，

There was something she could not say aloud: “Unless Master Hu puts the three thousand taels into my own hands, I shall not accept them.”
心里有句话不便说出来：“你三千两银子除非胡老爷亲手送给我我不会收。”

For that reason, her refusal was not absolute.
就因为有这样一种想法，所以她并未表示坚辞不受，

As they exchanged offers and demurrals, Gu gradually understood her real purpose.
彼此推来让去，古应春渐渐发觉她的本意，

In A’li's presence, however, he could only hint.
但当着阿利，他亦不便说得太露骨，只好作个暗示。

“Mrs Zhu, Master Hu is a close friend, and I know his state of mind.
“朱太太，”他说：“胡老爷是我的好朋友，他的心境我很清楚，

A little earlier, he would gladly have come to talk about those poor days.
如果早些日子，他会很高兴来同你谈谈当年落魄的情形，

Now he has neither the heart nor the time.
现在实在没有这种心情，也没有工夫。

Accept this money and let him settle something that weighs on him.
你收了这笔银子，让他了掉一桩心事，

That would show consideration and help him.
就是体谅他，帮他的忙；

Once his troubles are over and Laotonghe reopens, I shall certainly bring him to congratulate you, and we shall have a good meal together.”
等他的麻烦过去，你们老同和老店新开的时候，我一定拉了他来道喜，好好儿吃一顿酒。”


“Yes, yes,” A’cai murmured, blinking repeatedly.
“是的，是的。”阿彩口中答应着，双眼却不断眨动，

She was plainly agreeing only out of politeness, with other thoughts in her mind.
显然只是随口附和，心中别有念头，

When Gu finished, she turned to her husband.
等古应春说完，她看着她丈夫说：

“Go to the shop and tell the head cook to send the dishes here.
“你到店里去一趟，叫大司务把菜送了来，

Master Gu will eat with us at home.”
请古老爷在家里吃饭。”

“No, please!”
“不必，不必！”

Gu waved his hands.
古应春连连摇手，

“I have business.
“我有事。

Thank you all the same.”
多谢！多谢！”

A’cai ignored him. “Go!” she urged A’li.
“去啊！”阿彩没有理他的话，管自己催促阿利。

Obedient as ever, he said, “You must not stand on ceremony, Master Gu,” and went out.
阿利自然奉命唯谨，说一声：“古老爷不必客气。”掉头就走。

She had deliberately sent her husband away so that she could speak her heart.
这是阿彩特意遣开丈夫，有些心里的话要吐露，

“Master Gu,” she said gravely, “I never imagined I would meet that old customer again in this life, after more than twenty years.
“古老爷，”她面色深沉地说：“我实在没有想到，今生今世，还会遇见二十几年前的老客人；

Still less could I have imagined that the man who pawned his robe for a meal was the famous God of Wealth.
更没有想到，当年当了夹袍来吃饭的客人，就是名气这样子大的胡财神。

To tell you the truth, I did not sleep all night.
古老爷，不瞒你说，我昨天晚上一夜没有睡着，

There seemed no end to the thoughts it brought me.”
因为这桩事情，想起来想不完。”

She lowered her eyes.
说着，将一双眼睛低了下去，

Moisture glimmered at their corners, as though tears were about to fall.
眼角微显晶莹，似乎泪水要流出来。

Gu understood her feelings, but deliberately said nothing.
古应春当然能体会她的心情，故意不答，

He must neither question nor console her: a single word might release her tears.
他觉得既不能问，更不能劝慰，只要有这样一句话，她的眼泪就会忍不住，

Only silence would allow her to regain control in peace.
惟有保持沉默，才能让她静静地自我克制。

After a while, she raised her eyes and spoke calmly.
果然，停了一会，阿彩复又抬眼，平静地说道：

“Please tell Master Hu I cannot accept his money.
“古老爷，请你告诉胡老爷，我决不能收他这笔钱，

First, he is in difficulties himself.
第一，他现在正是为难的时候，

My conscience would trouble me if I took it.
我收了他的这笔钱，于心不安；

Second, if I accepted it, I should become the one indebted to him.
第二，我收了他的这笔钱，变成我亏欠他了，

There would be nothing left to cherish in my thoughts.”
也没有啥好想的了。”


Gu felt that matters had become serious, more serious than he had imagined.
古应春觉得事态严重了，比他所想象的还要严重，

The three thousand taels might open a breach between husband and wife.
这三千两银子，可能会引起他们夫妇之间的裂痕。

This troubled him, and he deeply regretted involving himself.
转念到此，颇为不安，也深悔自己多事。

On reflection, the sharp blade of money remained the best means of severing this thread of affection that had drifted down from distant clouds.
细细想去，要割断她这一缕从云外飘来的情丝，还是得用“泉刀”这样的利器，于是他说：

“Mrs Zhu, I hope you will not take offense.
“朱太太，我说一句不怕你见气的话，

If you think Master Hu can no longer afford three thousand taels, you underestimate him.”
如果说，胡老爷现在三千两银子部花不起，你未免太小看他了。

Lowering his voice and looking straight into her eyes, he continued, “There are a couple of things I should like to say from the heart.
朱太太，”古应春将声音压得低低地，同时两眼逼视着她，“我有两句肺腑之言，

Are you willing to hear them?”
不晓得你要不要听？”

“Of course.”
“当然要听。”

“I am afraid I may speak too plainly.”
“只怕我说得太直。”

“It does not matter.
“不要紧，

There is nobody else here.”
没有旁人在这里。”

That meant he might say even what A’li must not hear.
这表示连阿利不能听的话都能说，

Gu put aside his remaining scruples.
古应春便不作任何顾忌了，

“Three thousand taels is no small sum, Mrs Zhu, especially when it is a gift from the man known as the God of Wealth, given to repay an old kindness.
“朱太太，”他说：“三千两银子，不是一个小数日，而况是号称财神的胡老爷送你的，更何况人家是为了完当年的一笔人情债，

The giver has nothing to conceal, and neither has the recipient.
送的人光明正大，受的人正大光明。

If your husband asks why you will not accept it, what are you going to tell him?”
朱老板如果问一句：你为啥不收？请问你怎么同他说？

A’cai had not considered A’li at all.
“阿彩根本没有想到阿利，

Only now did she realize that she would have difficulty explaining herself.
如今古应春提出来一问，才发现自己确有难以交代之处。

Seeing her at a loss for words, Gu knew he had struck home and pressed the point.
见她语塞，古应春知道“攻心”已经生效，便穷追猛打地又钉一句：

“Will you say, ‘All the gold in the world could not buy the feeling I cherish.
“莫非你说，我心里的那段情，万金不换，

What are three thousand taels to me?’”
三千两算得了什么？”

“Naturally I shall have my own explanation.”
“我当然有我的说法。”

It was an evasion.
这是遁词，

Gu felt there was no need to press further; he could now appeal to her directly.
古应春觉得不必再追，可以从正面来劝她了。


“Whatever you say, your husband may not dare argue, but in his heart he will not believe you.
“不管你怎么说，朱老板嘴里不敢同你争，心里不会相信的。

That will open a breach between you.
这样子，夫妇之间，就有一道裂痕了。

You have been married more than twenty years; you are carrying another child in your later years.
二十几年的夫妇，你肚皮里还有个老来子，

With these three thousand taels, you can rebuild Laotonghe, expand the business, and make a prosperous home.
有这三千两银子，将老同和老店新开，扩充门面，兴兴旺旺做人家，

Even your late father would be pleased in the world below.
连你们死掉的老老板，在阴世里都会高兴。

Why throw away such good days, seek out trouble, and risk breaking up your family?
这种好日子不过，要自寻烦恼，害得一家人家可能会拆散，何苦？

Besides, in Master Hu's present circumstances, a few thousand taels do not matter so much, but emotionally he cannot bear another blow.
再说，胡老爷现在的环境，几千银子还不在乎，精神上经不起打击，

He was delighted that he could settle this old debt of kindness first.
他因为能先还笔人情债，心里很高兴，

Last night he slept better than at any time in the past month or more.
昨天晚上睡了个把月以来从没有睡过的好觉。

If he knew what was in your mind, it would trouble him, and he cannot stand any further worries now.
倘或晓得你有这种想法，他心里一定不安，他现在经不起再加什么烦恼了。

In a word, accepting the money and relieving him of this concern will help him.
总而言之，你收了这笔银子，让他了掉一桩心事，就是帮他的忙。

Otherwise, to speak bluntly, it is as though you were deliberately trying to hurt him.
不然，说得不客气一点，等于存心害他！

You are no longer a girl of seventeen or eighteen, Mrs Zhu.
朱太太，你不是十七八岁的姑娘了，

You have a son and a daughter.
而且有儿有女，

It would not sound well if people began talking.”
闹出笑话来，不好听。”

This long speech exhausted every argument he could think of.
这长篇大套一番话，将想得到的道理都说尽了，

A’cai listened, deeply shaken.
阿彩听得惊心动魄，

At last, as though waking from a dream, she said, “I shall take it.
终于如梦方醒似地说了一句：“我收！

Please thank Master Hu for me.”
请古老爷替我谢谢胡老爷。”

“That is right!”
“对啊！”

Greatly relieved, Gu could not resist adding some compliments.
古应春大为欣慰，少不得乘机恭维她几句：

“I knew you were a woman of judgment and reason, who could see the larger picture.
“我就晓得你是有见识、讲道理、顾大局的人。

Your face, with its broad, well-rounded lower contours, is the very image of good fortune.
朱太太，照你的面相，真所谓‘地角方圆’，是难得的福相，

When you enter a period that brings prosperity to your husband, there will be a great deal of happiness waiting for you in later life.”
走到一步帮夫运，着实有一番后福好享。”


He spread out the drafts in his hand: three issued by Weifenghou and one by Baichuantong.
说着，他将捏在手里的一把银票摊开来，三张“蔚丰厚”，一张“百川通”，

Both were leading Shanxi remittance houses, with branches throughout the north and south, known to everyone in commerce.
这两家票号在山西帮中居领袖地位，联号遍布南北，商场中无人不知的。

“Keep these safely, Mrs Zhu.”
“朱太太，你收好。”

“You could really have given me Fukang drafts instead.”
“古老爷，其实你给我阜康的票了好了。”

A’cai knew that Fukang was already settling its affairs and that no one yet knew what proportion of a draft's value would be paid.
阿彩也知道阜康已经在清理，票款能收到几成，尚不可知，

Her remark still sprang from a reluctance to accept the gift.
所以如此说法，亦依旧是由于一种不愿接受赠款的心理。

Gu understood, and took the opportunity to explain Hu's feelings.
古应春明白这一点，却正好借此道出胡雪岩的心境。

“These four drafts came out of Master Hu's own pocket.
“朱太太，这四张银票，是胡老爷身上摸出来的。

Only a little more than a month ago, Fukang's name stood higher than either Weifenghou's or Baichuantong's.
不过一个多月以前，阜康的名气比蔚丰厚、百川通响亮得多，

Now he has to use other people's paper.
而现在，只好用人家的票子了。

Imagine yourself in his place.
你倒想，换了你是他，

Would you have any heart to recall the days when you pawned your lined robe for a plate of boiled pork?”
还人啥心思回想当初当了夹袍子来吃白肉的情形？”

A’cai felt a blank sense of loss.
阿彩爽然若失，

Slowly arranging the drafts, she said, “Of course he does not mind the three thousand taels.
慢条斯理地一面理银票，一面说道：“胡老爷自然不在乎这三千银子，

But for me, it is still a reward I have done nothing to deserve.”
不过在我来说，总是无功受禄。”

“Not at all!
“不是，不是！

Surely you have heard storytellers at the City God Temple tell the story of Han Xin.
我想你们在城隍庙听说书，总听过韩信的故事，

He repaid a single meal with a thousand pieces of gold.
一饭之恩，千金以报，

No one ever said the washerwoman should have refused.”
没有哪个说漂母不应该收。”


“Then I shall be the washerwoman.
“那，我就算漂母好了，

If people ask...”
人家问起来……”

“Ah!”
“喔，喔，”

Reminded of something, Gu hastily interrupted.
古应春被提醒了，急急打断她的话说：

“There is one thing you and your husband must be very careful about.
“朱太太，有件事，请你同朱老板一定要当心，

Never say that the God of Wealth gave you three thousand taels.
千万不好说：胡财神送了你们三千两银子。

People would gossip.
那一来，人家会说闲话。

This is extremely important: you must not tell anyone.
这一点关系重大，切切不可说出去。

Please, whatever you do, remember that.”
千万，千万。”

His insistence made A’cai nod repeatedly, showing that she understood completely.
见他如此郑重叮嘱，阿彩自然连连点头，表示充分领会。

“I know you are busy, Master Gu, so I shall not keep you to lunch.
“古老爷，”阿彩说道：“我晓得你事情忙，不留你吃饭了。

But you must give me your address.
不过，古老爷，你要把府上的地址告诉我，

Another day I should like to call and pay my respects to your wife.”
改天我要给古太太去请安。”

“There is no need for ceremony.
“请安不敢当。

My wife is ill in bed.
内人病在床上，

Whenever you can come and talk with her, you will be very welcome.”
几时你来陪她谈谈，我们很欢迎。”

Gu left his address and took his leave.
古应春留下了地址，告辞出门，

Looking back over what had happened, he felt he had handled the matter with some elegance, and his heart grew lighter.
回想经过，自觉做了一件很潇洒的事，胸怀为之一宽。



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第十章（全章）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Ten (complete)
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER TEN: THE PAST TOO PAINFUL TO RECALL｜第十章 不堪回首


When Hu Xueyan met the Seventh Lady, both felt as though a lifetime had passed.
见了七姑奶奶，彼此都有隔世之感，

Looking at one another, they could not keep back their tears.
两人对望着，忍不住心酸落泪——

In a month apart, each had acquired many more white hairs.
一个月不见，头上都添了许多白发，

Neither had thought much of their own; only on seeing the other did they understand how worry could ravage a person.
但自己并不在意，要看了对方，才知道忧能伤人，

Hu, above all, felt like weeping aloud at the thought that the Seventh Lady, already ill herself, had been so distressed on his account.
尤其是胡雪岩，想到病中的七姑奶奶，为他的事焦忧如此，真忍不往想放声一恸。

Whenever they met, her first inquiry was usually after Old Madam Hu.
每一回见了面，七姑奶奶第一个要问的是胡老太太，

This time alone she made an exception, afraid that the question would touch his deepest sorrow.
只有这一次例外，因为她怕一问，必定触及胡雪岩伤心之处，所以不敢问。

But she could not avoid asking about Madam Luosi.
但螺蛳太太却是怎么样也不能不问的。

“And Sister Luo?
“罗四姐呢？

She must have aged a great deal too.”
只怕也老了好多。”

“Indeed she has!
“怎么不是！

I depend on her now.”
如今多亏她。”

Hu went on to describe many instances of the warmth and coldness of human relations.
胡雪岩接下来谈了许多人情冷暖的境况。

The Seventh Lady’s eyes were red, and tears kept gathering.
七姑奶奶的眼圈红红的，不时有泪珠渗出来。

“Rest a little,” Ruixiang interrupted from time to time, hoping to stop these distressing conversations.
“息一息吧！”瑞香不时来打岔，希望阻断他们谈那些令人伤感的事，

At last she could bear it no longer.
最后终于忍不住了，

“It is time for your medicine and sleep,” she ordered.
用命令的语气说：“要吃药睡觉了。”

“Yes, yes!”
“喔，喔！”

Hu felt guilty.
胡雪岩不免歉疚，

“Rest properly, Seventh Sister, and do not worry.
“七姐，你好好儿息一息，心放宽来，

With Yingchun helping me, I shall certainly get through.”
有应春帮我，难关一定过得去。”

Gu accompanied him downstairs.
于是古应春陪着胡雪岩下楼，

They had just settled in the study when a servant brought a visitor’s card: Shen Lansheng, a shift supervisor in the telegraph bureau’s decoding room.
刚在书房中坐定，听差来报，有客相访，递上名片一看，是电报局译电房的一个领班沈兰生。

“Probably a reply from Hangzhou,” Gu said, handing Hu the card.
“大概是杭州有复电来了。”古应春将名片递给胡雪岩，

“He is a good friend.
“此人是好朋友，

Would you like to meet him?”
小爷叔要不要见一见？”

“No.
“不罗！”

I had better stay out of sight.”
胡雪岩说，“我还是不露面的好。”

“Very well.”
“也好！”

Gu went to receive him in the drawing room.
古应春点点头，出书房到客厅去会沈兰生。


Only a wall separated the drawing room from the study, and the door stood open, so Hu could hear their conversation clearly.
书房与客厅只是一墙之隔，房门未关，所以古、沈二人交谈的声音，清晰可闻。

“There are two telegrams concerning Circuit Intendant Hu.
“有两个电报，跟胡观察有关，

I made copies specially and brought them over.”
我特为抄了一份送来。”

The unfamiliar voice must be Shen’s.
是陌生的声音，当然是沈兰生。

Silence followed.
接下来便没有声音了。

Unable to restrain himself, Hu peered through the gap in the door.
胡雪岩忍不住从门缝中张望，

Gu was reading the messages.
原来没有声音是因为古应春正在看电报。

老兄这样子帮忙，我转告胡观察，

一定会有酬谢。”

能效绵薄，聊尽我心而已。”

胡观察这两天也许会到上海来，

到时候我约老兄见兄面。”

“Very good.
“好，好！

I shall take my leave.”
我告辞了。”

等古应春送客出门，回到书房时，只见他脸色凝重异常，

显然的，那两个电报不是什么好消息。

“应春，”胡雪岩泰然地问。“电报呢？怎么说？”

“Something entirely unexpected.”
“竞想不到的事。”

古应春将两份电报递给了他。

这两份电报是《申报》驻北京的访员发来的两道上谕，

第一道先引述顺天府府尹周家楣，以及管理顺天府的大臣，左都御史毕道远的复奏，

说奉旨彻查协办大学士刑部尚书文煜在阜康福存款的经过，指出有一笔存银四十六万两，

其中十万两为前江西藩司文辉所有，而据文辉声称，系托文煜经手代存；

另外三十六万两，帐簿上只注“文宅”字样，是否文煜所有，不得而知。

象这样的案子，照例“着由文煜明白回奏”。

His answer had been frank enough.
文煜倒说得很坦白，

During the past twenty years he had received numerous revenue appointments; since his transfer from Fujian to the capital, he had repeatedly served as superintendent of the Chongwen Gate customs.
他在这二十年中，曾获得多次税差，自福建内调后，又数蒙派充“崇文门监督”，

His accumulated official pay and allowances, together with habitual economy, accounted for the 360,000 taels deposited at Fukangfu.
廉傣所积，加上平日省俭，故在阜康福存银三十六万两。

The decree accepted his explanation as “substantially truthful,” but considered the amount “somewhat large” and ordered him to contribute 100,000 taels for public use.
上谕认为他“所称尚属实情”，不过“为数稍多”，责成他捐出十万一两，以充公用。

Shuntian prefecture was to withdraw the money from Fukangfu and remit it to the Ministry of Revenue.
这十万两银子，由顺天府自阜康福提出，解交户部。

“Yingchun,” Hu said after reading this message, “contact our Beijing branch.
“应春，”胡雪岩看完这一个电报以后说：“托你跟京号联络一下，

这十万两银子，一定要马上凑出来，

最好不等顺天府来催，自己送到户部。”

“小爷叔，”古应春另有意见，“我看要归入整个清理案去办，

我们似乎可以观望观望。”

“No.
“不！

Not a single coin can be withheld.
这是一文都不能少的，

迟交不如早交。”

“Very well.
“好！

I shall do as you wish.
既然小爷叔这么说，我就照你的意思办好了。”

But read the second telegram first.”
古应春又说：“请先看了第二个电报再说。”

总要后天才会见报。”

“Yes.”

古应春还能说出准确的日期，

“Good!”

有四天想下来，事情看得很透彻了。

我们去同她商量。”

话虽如此，由于与淮军的关系根深，不免间接会受李鸿章的影响。

胡雪岩既为李鸿章认作左宗棠的羽翼，必须加以翦除，

To expect Liu to offer special assistance was therefore like climbing a tree to catch fish.
那么期望刘秉璋能加以额外的援手，便等于缘木求鱼了。

Now the court had entrusted settlement of Fukang’s public and private debts to Zuo, who could direct Dexin himself.
如今朝廷将阜康所欠公私各款交左宗棠逐一清理，左宗棠便可直接指挥德馨办理，

This was naturally much more favourable to Hu.
这一来对胡雪岩自然非常有利。

“Seventh Sister, one word from you has awakened a dreamer.
“七姐，你是一语点醒梦中人。

Tell us what to do.
如今该怎办，

You are our female Zhuge Liang; give your orders.”
请你这位女诸葛发号施令。”

“Do not say that, Little Uncle.
“小爷叔不要这么说。

I shall suggest a few things for us to discuss.
我出几个主意，大家商量，

First, telegraph Treasurer De so that he understands the position.
第一，应该打个电报给德藩台，让他心里有数；

Governor Liu no longer has so much control.”
刘抚台管不到那么多了。”

“Exactly.
“不错，

That telegram must go at once.”
这个电报马上要打。”

“左大人那里当然要赶紧联络。”七姑奶奶问：

“小爷叔，你是自己去一趟呢？还是让应春去面真一切？”

“我看我去好了。”古应春自告奋勇，

“It would be inconvenient for Little Uncle now that he has lost his official cap.”
“小爷叔没有顶戴不方便。”

这话在胡雪岩是正中下怀。

A man dismissed by imperial decree could wear only ordinary clothes.
奉旨革职的人，当然只能穿便衣，

这对左宗棠来说，倒是无所谓的事，但江宁是全国候补道最多的地方，

People joked that “thieves were thick as hairs,” playing on the shared sound of dao, their rank and the word for thief.
为人戏称“群盗如毛”，

一到华灯初上，城南贡院与秦淮河房一带，碰来碰去的称号都是“某观察”，

They would naturally continue to address Hu in the same way.
人家当然还是照旧相呼，

He would not know whether to accept it silently or explain that he was now a commoner.
但胡雪岩不知是默受，还是要声明，已是一介平民。

这里尴尬的情势，能避免自然求不得。

“Yes, Yingchun, please undertake the journey.
因此，他即时说道：“对！应春请你辛苦一趟。

见了左大人，你是第三者的地位，比较好说话。”

“Very well.
“是！

I shall leave first thing tomorrow.
我明天一早就走。

What else should I tell him?”
还有啥话要交代？”

“Convey De Xiaofeng’s particular respects.
“你特别要为德晓峰致意，

He is very eager to establish a connection with Lord Zuo.
他很想走左大人的路子。

Another supporter among the provincial leaders would be useful to His Excellency too.”
左大人能在封疆大吏中，多一个帮手，也是好的。”

Gu knew how keen Dexin was to become a governor.
古应春也知道，德馨对升巡抚一事，非常热中，

If he could speak for him and obtain Zuo’s promise of a recommendation for advancement, Dexin would naturally work still harder on Hu’s behalf.
如果能找机会为他进言，并取得左宗棠的承诺，保他更上层楼，那一来德馨自然就会更加出力来帮胡雪岩的忙。

“不过，德藩台的复电，今天不到，明天一定会到，

“It may be unwise to lose contact with the foreign buyers.
洋人那面，接不上头，似乎不大好。”

Selling the silk is, after all, our most important business.”
古应春说：“丝能脱手，到底是顶要紧的一件大事。”

“The position is different now,” Hu replied.
“现在情形不同了，

“Lord Zuo is responsible for the settlement.
归左大人清理，

Whether the silk may be sold is for him to decide.
这批丝能不能卖，就要听他的了。”

That is why it is best for you to go to Jiangning: you can discuss it with him in person.”
胡雪岩紧接着说：“此所以你到江宁去最好，可以当面跟左大人谈。”

“如果备藩台复电来了，说可以卖呢？”

“那也要听左大人的。”

“事情不是这样办的。”七姑奶奶忍不住开口，

The foreigners are what matters now.
“如今是洋人这面重要，

价钱谈不拢不必谈，

谈拢了又不能卖，要请示左大人，时间上耽误了，洋人或许会变卦。”

“You are right.”
“七姐的话不错。”

Hu immediately decided.
胡雪岩马上作了决定，

“The silk must be sold.
“丝是一定要脱手的，

It is only a question of the price and allowing a few more days.
现在不过价钱上有上落，日子也要宽几天。

Yingchun, secure the buyer tomorrow morning.
应春，你明天先把买主去稳住，

Tell him the transaction will certainly go through, and ask him to wait a few days.
你同他说，交易一定做得成，请他等几天。

Foreigners understand by now that patience is necessary whenever officials are involved.
现在洋人也晓得了，一牵涉到官场，做事情一定要有耐心，

If he refuses to wait even a few days, he cannot be sincere, and there is nothing to regret in abandoning such a customer.”
几天的工夫不肯等，根本就没有诚意，这种户头，放弃了也没有什么可惜。”

“Very well.
“好！

I shall call on him first thing and set out as soon as I return.”
我明天一早去，去了回来就动身。”

Gu suddenly noticed something.
古应春忽然发觉：

“Why has Old Mi still not come?”
“咦，老宓怎么还不来？”


On his way to Shen Lansheng, Gu had followed Hu’s instructions and first called at Jixian Lane.
原来古应春去看沈兰生时，照胡雪岩的嘱咐，顺道先转到集贤里，

Although Fukang was closed, Mi Benchang and a few clerks remained there.
阜康虽已闭歇，宓本常与少数伙计，还留守在那里。

On hearing that Hu had arrived, Mi had immediately said he would come to Gu’s house to “meet Mr Hu.”
宓本常听说胡雪岩来了，即时表示，马上就会到古家来“同大先生碰头”。

Nearly three hours had passed since then.
这句话到此刻，将近三个钟头了，

Why was there still no sign of him?
何以踪影不见？

“An ugly daughter-in-law must meet her parents-in-law eventually.
“丑媳妇总要见公婆面，

He will come,” the Seventh Lady said.
他会来的，

“Little Uncle, have supper while we wait.
小爷叔吃消夜等他。”七姑奶奶说：

I wonder whether it is ready.”
“消夜不晓得预备好了没有？”

“It has been ready for some time,” Ruixiang called from the outer sitting room.
“早就预备好了。”瑞香在外面起坐间中，高声回答，

She entered the bedroom and wheeled the Seventh Lady out.
接着进了卧室，将坐在轮椅上的七姑奶奶推了出去。

Supper was still elaborate, with many of Hu’s favourite dishes.
消夜仍旧很讲究，而且多是胡雪岩爱吃的食物，

In the bitter weather there was naturally a hotpot, made with the wine-lees broth of zaobotou, fish balls, sea cucumber, winter bamboo shoots, and the Shandong cabbage known as jiaocai.
时值严寒，自然有火锅，是用“糟钵头”的卤汁，加上鱼圆、海参、冬笋，以及名为“胶菜”的山东大白菜同煮。

It reminded Hu of Laotonghe.
这使得胡雪岩想起了老同和。

“Yingchun, did you see A’cai?”
““应春，”他问，“你看见阿彩了？”

“Yes.”
“看见了。”

“Who is A’cai?” the Seventh Lady asked.
“哪个阿彩？”七姑奶奶问：

“That sounds like a woman’s name.”
“好象是女人的名字。”

Hu and Gu exchanged a smile.
胡雪岩与古应春相视而笑。

The news from Beijing had, paradoxically, steadied Hu’s spirits, and Gu felt there was no harm in recounting this unexpected romantic episode.
由于胡雪岩现在的心境，倒反而因为京里来的消息而踏实了，所以古应春觉得谈谈这段意外的韵事，亦自不妨，当即开玩笑地说：

“If Little Uncle had met A’cai just once more in those days, he might now be the proprietor of Laotonghe.”
“小爷叔如果当时再跟阿彩再一面，说不定现在是老同和的老板。”

Beginning with that joke, he told the story from the previous night’s meal to his conversation with A’cai that morning.
以这句笑谈作为引子，古应春由昨夜在老同和进餐，谈到这天上午与阿彩的对话，

Hu added details from time to time.
其问胡雪岩又不时作了补充，

Stretching over more than twenty years, it was almost a legend.
这段亘时二十余年的故事，近乎传奇。

The Seventh Lady and Ruixiang listened with fascination.
七姑奶奶与瑞香都听得津津有味。

Hu too learned much that he had never known or even imagined.
胡雪岩借此也了解了许多他以前不知道、甚至想象不到的情节，

A’cai’s enduring affection particularly surprised him.
尤其是阿彩如此一往情深，大出他的意料，

He tried hard to recall her appearance then, but could summon only a faint, almost formless image.
因而极力追忆阿彩当年的模样，但只有一个淡淡的、几乎不成形的影子，

All he remembered clearly was a slender figure and a pair of large eyes.
唯一记得清楚的是，纤瘦与一双大眼睛。

Supper did not end until midnight.
这顿消夜，吃到午夜方罢。

Mi never appeared.
宓本常始终未来。

“Never mind,” Hu said.
“算了！”胡雪岩说：

“We shall deal with it tomorrow.
“明天早上再说，

Sleep comes first.”
睡觉要紧。”


Hu slept badly.
这一夜睡得不很舒适，

The chief reason was a newly installed boiler in Gu’s house, which carried steam through lead pipes to the rooms.
主因是古家新装了一个锅炉，热汽由铅管通至各处，

This Western novelty was known in Shanghai as hot-water heating.
这是西洋传来的新花样，上海人称之为“热水汀”，

Elaborate though Hu’s Yuanbao Street residence was, it had nothing of the kind.
胡雪岩元宝街的住宅虽讲究，却尚无此物。

The room might be “as warm as spring,” but he was unused to it.
但虽说“一室如春”，胡雪岩却不不甚习惯，

Under a silk-floss quilt he woke sweating several times, until he had to get up and find two woollen blankets in a cupboard.
盖的又是丝绵被，半夜里出汗醒了好几次，迫不得已起床，自己动手，在柜子里找到两条毛毯来盖，

Only then did he sleep soundly.
才能熟睡。

When he woke, sunlight filled the windows.
醒来时，红日满窗。

Hearing him stir, Ruixiang came to attend to his washing.
瑞香听得响动，亲自来伺候漱洗，

Naturally she asked after the Hu household, but he answered only, “Everyone is well,” and showed no wish to discuss it.
少不得要问到胡家上下，胡雪岩只答得一句：“都还好。”便不愿多谈，

She tactfully let the subject drop.
瑞香也就知趣不再下去了。

Upstairs, breakfast was waiting with the Seventh Lady, including the customary bowl of bird’s-nest porridge.
上楼去看七姑奶奶时，已经摆好早餐在等他了，照例有一碗燕窝粥。

“Thank you, Seventh Sister. You have it.”
胡雪岩说道：“谢谢！七姐你吃吧。”

“Why will you not eat it?
“为啥不吃？”

Do not treat yourself badly, Little Uncle.”
七姑奶奶说：“小爷叔，你不要作贱自己。”

“It is not that.
“不是作贱自己。

I have enjoyed more good fortune than I deserved.
我享福享过头了，

Now I feel I should treasure what I have.”
现在想想，应该惜福。”

Before she could answer, hurried footsteps sounded on the stairs, as though someone were running up.
七姑奶奶未及答言，只听楼梯上的脚步声，异常匆遽，仿佛是奔了上来的。

Everyone looked.
大家都定睛去看，

It was Gu.
是古应春回来了。

“Little Uncle—Old Mi is dead!”
“小爷叔，”他说：“老宓死掉了！”

“Dead?
“死掉了！”

Was it a stroke?”
胡雪岩问：“是中风？”

“No.
“不是，

He took his own life with opium,” Gu said dejectedly.
自己寻的死路，吞鸦片死的。”古应春沮丧地说：

“He probably swallowed a few pellets after I left.
“大概我走了以后就吞了几个烟泡，

This morning he did not open his door.
今天早上，一直不开房门，

A’zhang knocked without getting an answer, climbed through the window, and found his body already stiff.”
阿张敲门不应，从窗子里爬进去一看，身子都僵了。”

A’zhang was a Fukang clerk.
阿张是阜康的伙计。

“Why?”
“是为啥呢？”

Hu shook his head.
胡雪岩摇摇头，

“There was no need for that.”
“犯不着！”


“You are truly kindhearted,” the Seventh Lady said.
“小爷叔，你真正厚道。”七姑奶奶说：

“He always felt the disaster was entirely his doing and could not face you.
“他总觉得祸都是他闯出来的，没有脸见你。

He came here twice.
他来过两回，

Whenever he spoke of it, he sighed and blamed himself for going to Ningbo.
一谈起来唉声叹气，怨他自己不该到宁波去的。

At that time...”
那时候……

She abruptly stopped.
“七姑奶奶突然住声不语，

胡雪岩便问：“七奶，你说下去啊。”

七姑奶奶没有答他的话，只问她丈夫：“你怎么晓得你一走了，他就吞了几个烟泡。”

“他们告诉我，昨天我一走，他就关房门睡觉了，

那时候只有八点钟，大家都还没有睡。”

“Did nobody wonder why he was going to bed so early?”
“那么，”七姑奶奶紧接着问：“大家倒没有奇怪，他为啥这样子早就上床？”

“奇怪是奇怪，没有人去问他。”

A’zhang told me he wondered why Mi was sleeping after saying he would go to see Mr Hu.
古应春答说：“阿张告诉我，他当时心里就在想，不是说要去看大先生，怎么困了呢？

他本来想进去看一看，只为约了朋友看夜戏，

A featured item was Yang Yuelou’s Eight Great Hammers with the Storytelling Scene, and he was afraid of being late, so he hurried off.
中轴子是杨月楼的‘八大锤带说书’，怕来不及，匆匆忙忙就走了。

看完夜戏吃消夜，回来就上床，

一直到今天早上起来去敲门，才晓碍出了事。”

七姑奶奶不作声了，但脸上的神色，却很明显表示出，她另有看法。

“阜康的人也还有好几个，

当时就没有一个人会发现？”

Opium is different from hanging.
胡雪岩又说：“吞鸦片不比上吊，

要死以前，总会出声，

莫非就没有一个人听见？”

“我也这么问他们，

有的说一上床就睡着了，没有听见，

有的说逛马路去了，根本不知道。”

在人面前亮过不止一回。”

古人舍命救主的事有，不过赔了性命，要有用处。

没有用处，白白送了一条命，对胡大先生一点好处都没有。

““他又怎么说呢？”

七姑奶奶又说：“他如果真的是这样想老早就该寻死了。

迟不死，早不死，偏偏等到要同你见面了，去寻死路。

照我想，他是实在没有话好同小爷叔你说，只好来一条苦肉计。

大凡一个人直的不想活了，就一定会想到千万不要死不成，

所以要挑挑地方，还要想想死的法子，要叫人不容易发现，一发现了也死不成，

他身上的烟泡，照我想，阜康的伙计总也见过的，

莫非他们就没有想到？

说了要来看大先生，忽然之间关了大门睡觉，

人家自然会起疑心，自然会来救他。

这样子一来，天大的错处，人家也原谅他了，他也不必费心费力说多少好话来赔罪了。

哪晓得偏偏人家留心不到此，

看戏的看戏，逛马路的逛马路，睡觉的睡觉，这都是他想不到的。

小爷叔你也不必难过，

他这样子一死，不必再还来生债，

对他也是有好处的。”

“死了，死了，死了一切都了掉了。”胡雪岩说：

应春，我晓得他对你不大厚道，

我已经叫阜康的伙计替他去买棺材了。

尽今天一天工夫，我把他的后事料理好，明天动身。”
