“喔，”胡雪岩很注意地问：“请你说，要怎么做？”

“First let me tell you that General Nian gave away more than one concubine, and not only in Hangzhou.
“我先说当初年大将军，拿姨太太送人，也不止在杭州的一个，

Every woman he gave away was pregnant…”
而且他送人的姨太太，都是有孕在身的……”

In Zheng’s account, Nian Gengyao’s ancestors had originally borne the surname Yan and came from Huaiyuan in Anhui.
原来年羹尧的祖先本姓严，安徽怀远人，

The founder of the line was Yan Fu, who passed the examinations and became a jinshi.
始祖名叫严富，两榜及第中了进士，

When the list of successful candidates was written, his surname Yan was mistakenly written as Nian.
写榜时，误严为年。

Under the regulations he could have requested a correction from the Ministry of Rites, but all the formalities would have had to be completed before he could receive an appointment.
照定例是可以请求礼部更正的，但那一来便须办妥一切手续后，方能分发任官，

Rather than delay his career, he accepted the error and used the name Nian Fu.
未免耽误前程，因而将错就错，改用榜名年富。

On entering office he was sent to Liaodong as inspecting censor, and his descendants settled there.
年富入仕后，被派到辽东当巡按御史，子孙便落籍在那里。

When the Qing founder Taizu took up arms, the Han Chinese of Liaodong were captured and made bondservants, called booi.
及至清太祖起兵，辽东的汉人，被俘为奴，称为“包衣”。

They were divided between the Upper Three and the Lower Five Banners.
包衣有“上三旗”、“下五旗”之分，

Those of the Upper Three came under the Imperial Household Department; those of the Lower Five served the princes.
上三旗的包衣隶属内务府，下五旗的包衣则分隶诸王门下。

During the Kangxi reign, Nian Gengyao’s father Nian Xialing, his elder brother Nian Xiyao and Nian Gengyao himself all belonged to the household of Prince Yong, the future Yongzheng Emperor.
年羹尧的父亲年遐龄、长兄年希尧及他本人，在康熙朝皆为雍亲王门下，雍亲王便是后来的雍正皇帝，

Nian Gengyao’s younger sister had been the prince’s secondary consort and later became a Noble Consort.
年羹尧的妹妹，原是雍亲王的侧福晋，以后封为贵妃。

After following their rulers through the passes into China, bondservants could also sit the examinations.
包衣从龙入关后，一样也能参加考试，

With powerful imperial relatives to support them, advancement could come in the twinkling of an eye.
而且因为有亲贵奥援，飞黄腾达，往往是指顾间事。


Nian Xialing rose to be governor of Huguang; Nian Xiyao too became a senior official of the second rank.
年遐龄官至湖广巡抚，年希尧亦是二品大员，

Nian Gengyao entered the Hanlin Academy in the thirty-ninth year of Kangxi.
年羹尧本人是康熙三十九年的翰林，

Recommended by Prince Yong, he became governor-general of Sichuan.
由于雍亲王的推荐，出任四川总督。

This was actually a move in the prince’s struggle for the succession.
其实，这是雍亲王为了夺嫡布下的一着棋。

In his later years, Kangxi had already chosen an heir: Prince Yong’s full brother, the fourteenth imperial son Yinzhen, Prince Xun.
原一为康熙晚年已经选定了皇位继承人，即是雍亲王的同母弟、皇十四子恂郡王胤祯，

When ordered to campaign in Qinghai as commander-in-chief, he was specially permitted to use the Plain Yellow Banner, implying that he represented the emperor on campaign and that Heaven’s mandate would pass to him.
当他奉命以大将军出征青海时，特许使用正黄旗县，暗示代替天子亲征，亦即暗示天命有归。

His future accession was an open secret.
恂郡玉将成为未来的皇帝，是一个心照不宣的公开秘密。

Nian Gengyao was his chief support in the Qinghai campaign.
询郡王征青海的主动助手便是年羹尧。

In the winter of Kangxi’s sixty-first year, the emperor fell gravely ill and urgently summoned Prince Xun to the capital, but Nian, commanding powerful forces, held him back.
及至康熙六十一年冬天，皇帝得病，势将不起，急召恂郡王来京时，却为手握重兵的年羹尧所钳制，

Prince Yong was thus able to collude with Kangxi’s confidant Longkodo, whom he later honoured as “Uncle,” and skilfully seize the throne.
因此，雍亲王得以勾结康熙皇帝的亲信、后来为雍正尊称为“舅舅”的隆科多，巧妙地夺得了皇位。

Yongzheng concealed his intentions deeply.
雍正的城府极深，

Soon after taking power, he decided to kill both Longkodo and Nian to silence them.
在夺位不久，便决定要杀隆科多与年羹尧灭口。

At first he flattered Nian and showed him every favour, encouraging his arrogance.
因此，起初对年羹尧甘言蜜语，笼络备至，养成他的骄恣之气。

Already overbearing, Nian believed he held the emperor’s secret and was therefore untouchable.
年羹尧本来就很跋扈，自以为皇帝有把柄在他手里，无奈其何，

His disloyal ambitions grew until his conduct resembled that of a second Wu Sangui.
越发起了不臣之心，种种作为都显出他是吴三桂第二。

But circumstances had changed.
但时势不同，

Even Wu Sangui had failed; what hope had Nian?
吴三桂尚且失败，年羹尧岂有幸理。

Yongzheng simultaneously stripped away his supporters and emptied his military authority of substance.
雍正用翦除他的羽翼以及架空他的兵权的手法，双管齐下，

Only when his pleas for mercy were refused did Nian realize that his whole family faced destruction.
到他乞饶不允，年羹尧始知有灭门之祸，

He therefore gave away pregnant concubines in the hope of preserving his own bloodline.
因而以有孕之妾赠人，希望留下自己的骨血。


None of those present had heard this account before.
郑俊生的这番话，在座的人都是闻所未闻，

“Then did Nian leave any descendants?” Wu asked.
“那么，”乌先生问：“年羹尧有没有留下亲骨血呢？”

“Yes.
“有。”

There is an unusual surname, Sheng—the last character of my own name, Zheng Junsheng.
郑俊生答说：“有个怪姓，就是我郑俊生的生字。

Everyone surnamed Sheng is descended from Nian Gengyao.”
凡姓生的，就是年羹尧的后代。”

“Why choose such an odd surname?”
“为什么要取这么一个怪姓。”

“There is a story behind that too.
“这也是有来历的，

Turn the character Nian upside down and move its first slanting stroke to the top.
年字倒过来，把头一笔的一撇移到上面，

Does it not look like Sheng?” Zheng continued, “But enough of the digression.
看起来不就象生字？”郑俊生说：“闲话表过，

Back to our business.
言归正传。

Suppose Mistress Zhu is already pregnant.
我是想到，万一朱姨太太有孕在身，

If the bloodlines of the two families become confused, that will be unfortunate.”
将来两家乱了血胤，不大好。”

“Ah!”
“啊，啊！”

Wu looked at Hu.
乌先生看着胡雪岩说：

“We must ask Mr Hu about that.”
“这要问大先生自己了。”

“It is hard to be certain.”
“这也难说得很。”

Hu thought for a while.
胡雪岩沉吟了一会说：

“Old Zheng has a point.
“老郑的话很不错，

What begins as a good thing should not lead to misunderstanding.
本来是一桩好事，将来弄出误会来倒不好了，

To be safe, I have a plan.
为了保险起见，我倒有个办法，

Let us settle the match now.
事情我们就说定了。

Shaotang can first find a place where she can live alone for two months.
请少棠先找一处地方，让她一个人住两个月，

Once it is clear that everything is normal, they can consummate the marriage.
看她一切如常再圆房。

What do you think?”
你们看好不好？”

“Yes, yes!”
“对，对！”

Zheng and Wu agreed together.
郑俊主与乌先生不约而同地表示赞成。

“Then you two shall be the matchmakers.
“那么，两位就算媒人。

I must trouble you to see to the arrangements.”
怎么样安排，还要请两位费心。


So that was why Hu had insisted that Wu and Zheng take the places of honour.
原来请乌先生跟郑俊生上坐的缘故在此。

Matters had gone this far; Zhou now put aside embarrassment and empty protestations.
事到如今，周少棠亦就老老脸皮，不再说假惺惺的话，

逐一敬酒，头一个敬胡雪岩。

“胡大先生，我什么话都用不着说，

Distance tests a horse’s strength; time reveals a person’s heart.
总而言之，路遥知马力，日久见人心。

If my family line can be preserved, all our Zhou ancestors in the other world will kowtow to you.”
倘若我能不绝后，我们周家的祖宗，在阴世都会给胡大先生你磕头。”

“A slip of the tongue!” Hu said.
“失言，失言！”胡雪岩说：

“How can you say such a thing?
“你怎么好说这样的话，

Drink a penalty.”
罚酒。”

“Yes, a penalty.”
“是，是，罚酒。”

周少棠干了第二杯酒以后，又举杯敬乌先生。

“Without his foresight, there might have been a misunderstanding that turned a fine affair into a dreadful mess.

那就叫人哭不出来了。”

“Quite right,” Hu said.
“不错！”胡雪岩接口，

三个人都干了酒，

Finally it was Wu’s turn.
最后轮到乌先生。

“Nothing could be better.
“那就再好都没有。

I leave it in your hands.”
拜托拜托！”

The host was the first to become drunk.
这一顿酒，第一个醉的是主人，

Hu, who had little capacity for wine, drank cautiously and remained as clearheaded as ever.
胡雪岩酒量不佳，不敢多喝，清醒如常，

When the meal ended, he invited Wu home for a long night’s conversation.
散席后邀乌先生到家里作长夜之谈。

Wu gladly agreed.
乌先生欣然同意。

They thanked their host, said goodbye to Zheng, and set off on foot for Yuanbao Street with the servant.
两人辞谢主人，又与郑俊生作别，带着小厮安步回元宝街。


Halfway home they saw a sedan chair approaching, preceded and followed by two large, bright lanterns.
走到半路，发现迎面来了一乘轿子，前后两盏灯笼，既大且亮。

Hu recognized it at once.
胡雪岩一看就知道了，

拉一拉乌先生，站在石板路正中不动。

走近了一看，果然不错，大灯笼上，扁宋字一面是“庆余堂”，一面是个“胡”字。

问起来才知道螺蛳太太不放心，特意打发轿子来接。

但主客二人，轿只一乘，

Since they were close to home, he ordered it carried back empty and continued walking with Wu.
好在家也近了，胡雪岩吩咐空轿抬回，他仍旧与乌先生步行而归。

Yuanbao Street felt strangely unfamiliar.
一进了元宝街，颇有陌生的感觉，

Ordinarily, when he returned at night, lanterns lit the whole way from the street entrance to his gate.
平时如果夜归，自街口至大门，都有灯笼照明，

Tonight it was black.
这天漆黑一片，

In the distance only a single lantern burned at the side gate.
遥遥望去，一星灯火，只是角门上点着一盏灯笼。

Most desolate of all was the garden.
但最凄凉的却是花园里，

Its twelve towers and pavilions stood in dark shadow.
楼台十二，暗影沉沉，

Hundred Lions Tower alone was brightly lit, yet its light made the scene seem lonelier, sharpening the sense of a world changed, its people gone and buildings empty.
只有百狮楼中，灯火通明，却反而显得凄清。因为相形之下，格外容易使人兴起人去楼空的沧桑之感。

A’yun came to meet them.
这时阿云已经迎了上来，

一见前有客人，定睛细看了一下，

惊讶地说：“原来是乌先生。”

“Mr Wu will stay here tonight.
“乌先生今天住在这里。”胡雪岩说，

Tell Madam Luosi.”
“你去告诉螺蛳太太。

阿云答应着，返身而去。

By the time they reached Hundred Lions Tower, Madam Luosi herself was holding the door curtain aside.
等他们上了百狮楼，螺蛳太太已亲自打开门帘在等，

一见乌先生，不知如何，悲从中来，

Tears sprang from her eyes.
眼泪忍不住夺眶而出，

赶紧背过身去，拭一拭眼泪，再回过身来招呼。

螺蛳太太亲自来招待乌先生。

“You are too kind.

谢谢！”

乌先生看她神情憔悴，不免关心，

千万要自己保重。”

“唉！”螺蛳太太微喟着，

“嘘！”乌先生双指撮唇，示意她别说这些颓丧的话。

这么大的西北风，脸都冻红了。”螺蛳太太喊道：“阿云，赶快打洗脸水来！”

“脸上倒还不太冷，脚冻僵了。”

螺蛳太太回头看了一眼，见胡雪岩与阿云在说话，便即轻声问道：

“Yes.”

应该这么做。”

胡雪岩在另一方面接口。

等一下，好好儿商量商量。“她又问道：”乌先生饿不饿？

螺蛳太太回身跟胡雪岩商量：“乌先生就住楼下书房好了？”

胡雪岩说：“索性请乌先生到书房里去吃酒谈天。”

这表示胡雪岩与乌先生要作长夜之谈。

“His powers are limited now too.
“他现在的力量也有限了。”

Yingchun has gone to Nanjing.
胡雪岩说：“应春到南京去了。

We shall see what he has to say when he returns.”
等他来了，看是怎么个说法？”

Wu pondered for a long time before he could bring himself to ask, “What further action will the court take?
乌先生沉吟了好一会，终于很吃力地说了出来：“朝廷还会有什么处置？

Will your property be confiscated?”
会不会查抄？

“Not if the public debts are repaid.
““只要公款还清，就不会查抄。”

The pawnshops taken into official custody can be set against them and repay them gradually.
胡雪岩又说：“公款有查封的典当作抵，慢慢儿还，

I need not concern myself with those.
我可以不管，

It is the private deposits: I do not know what proportion I shall eventually be able to repay.
就是私人的存款，将来不知道能打几折来还。

Whenever I think of that, it is like a thousand-jin burden on my shoulders, bending me double.”
一想到这一层，我的肩膀上就象有副千斤重担，压得我直不起腰来。

“Then it is your heart that is burdened, rather than your person.
““其实，这是你心里不轻，不是身上不轻。

Can you not take things more lightly?”
你能不能看开一点呢？”

“How?”
“怎么个看开法？”

“Stop thinking about them.”
“不去想它，”

Hu smiled without answering and changed the subject.
胡雪岩笑笑不作声，然后顾左右而言他地说，

“Mr Wu, do not forget Shaotang’s business.
“乌先生，你不要忘记少棠的事，

Discuss it properly with Luo Sijie later.”
回头同罗四姐好好谈一谈。”

Wu shook his head.
“唉！”乌先生摇摇头，

“Even now, you think only of other people’s private affairs.”
“你到这时候，还只想到人家的闲事。”

“Only that lets me stop thinking about my own.
“只有这样子，我才会不想我自己的事。

I cannot manage my affairs, so I occupy myself with other people’s.
我自己的事管不了，只好管人家的闲事，

If I manage theirs well, it gives me some comfort.
管好人家的闲事，心里有点安慰，

In that sense I am attending to my own affairs too.”
其实也就是管我自己的事。”

“That is the meaning of finding happiness in doing good.
“这就是为善最乐的道理。

A pity that this year…”
可惜，今年……”


“I understand.
“我懂，我懂！”

That is exactly what I wanted to discuss.” Hu continued, “I walked to Shaotang’s today, and the northwesterly wind stung my face.
胡雪岩接口说道：“我亦正要同你商量这件事。今天去看少棠，去也是走路去的，西北风吹在脸上发痛，

I thought: here I am in a fox-fur robe and a sable cap.
我心里就在想，身上狐皮袍子，头上戴的是貂帽，

My padded shoes may be old, but their soles show more white than black and are as good as new.
脚下棉鞋虽是旧的，不过鞋底上黑少白多，也同薪的一样。

If I am cold dressed like this, how will people without even a padded coat survive the winter?
这样子的穿戴还觉得冷，连件棉袄都没有的人，怎么样过冬？

Before I went to Shanghai, my mother sent word down from the hills that this year’s distribution of padded clothing and congee should continue as usual.
我去上海之前，老太太还从山上带口信下来，说今年施棉衣、施粥，应该照常。

But in my present circumstances, how can I still do charitable work?”
不过，乌先生，你说，我现在的情形，怎么样还好做好事？

“That is what I meant by a pity.
““我说可惜，也就是为此。

You still have the means, but if you do it, people are certain to say very ugly things.” Wu sighed.
你做这种好事的力量，还是有的，不过那一来，一定会有人说闲话说得很难听。”乌先生叹口气：

“Only now do I understand that even doing good requires the right opportunity.”
“现在我才明白，做好事都要看机会的。”

“Exactly.
“一点不错。？

Walking back with you, the cold made me think of it again.
胡雪岩说：”刚才同你走回来，身上一冷，我又想到了这件事。

This good work must still be done.
这桩好事，还是不能不做。

Can you see a way?”
你看有什么办法？

“You cannot appear in it yourself.
““你不能出面，

If you do, people will abuse you, and it will even affect the settlement of your debts.” “Precisely.
你出面一定会挨骂，而且对清理都有影响”对！“胡雪岩说：”

I was thinking of asking you to appear for me.”
我想请你来出面。

Wu shook his head repeatedly. “Nobody would believe it.
“”人家不相信的。“乌先生不断摇头：”

Who am I?
我算老几，

What standing have I to distribute padded clothing and congee?”
哪里有施棉衣、施粥的资格。

While they were unable to find an answer, A’yun came upstairs at Madam Luosi’s direction.
“正在筹无善策时。螺蛳太太派阿云上来通知，

Everything was ready in the study; host and guest were invited down for supper.
书房里部署好了，请主客二人下楼用消夜。


Supper was plentiful, the lamps shone brilliantly, and the fire blazed.
消夜亦很丰盛，明灯璀璨，炉火熊熊。

Wu knew that few evenings as a guest in such surroundings remained to him.
乌先生知道象这样作客的日子也不多了，

He treasured this one all the more, putting aside his worries to enjoy the moment, sipping slowly and savouring the fine wine and food.
格外珍惜，所以暂抛愁怀，且享受眼前，浅斟低酌，细细最尝满桌子的名酒美食。

Only when the second pot of Huadiao was warmed did he speak.
直到第二壶花雕烫上来时，他才开口：

“Mr Hu, I have thought of a way.
“大先生，我倒想到一个法子，

Why not make an anonymous donation and specify its purpose?
不如你用无名氏的名义。捐一笔款子，指定用途，

It would achieve the same result.”
也一样的。”

As he spoke, Madam Luosi asked, “What are you discussing?”
话一出口，螺蛳太太插嘴问说。“你们在谈啥？”

“That matter my mother spoke of.” Hu briefly explained.
“谈老太太交代的那件事。”胡雪岩略略说了经过。

“Then how much do you intend to give?”
“那么，你预备捐多少呢？”

“What do you think?”
“你看呢？”胡雪岩反问。

“In former winters, the padded clothing and congee cost thirty thousand taels.
“往年冬天施棉衣，施粥，总要用到三万银子。

We cannot manage that now.
现在力量不够了。

I think ten thousand at the most.”
我看顶多捐一万人。”

“Good.
“好！”

A fitting middle course.
胡雪岩点点头说：“这个数目酌乎其中，

Ten thousand it is.”
就是一万。”

“Mr Wu can take the money and make the donation.
“这一万银子，请乌先生拿去捐。

But even an anonymous donor’s real name becomes known to someone.
不过，虽说无名氏，总还是有人晓得真正的名字。

I think we should say it is the old lady’s private savings, given without your knowledge.
我看，要说是老太太捐的私房钱。你根本不晓得；

That is the only position you can defend.”
要这样说法，你的脚步才站得住。”

Both men agreed wholeheartedly.
胡雪岩与乌先生都深以为然。

The depths of winter had arrived; there could be no delay.
时入隆冬，这件好事要做得不能有片刻延误，

Madam Luosi left the table and went upstairs to see to it.
为此，螺蛳太太特为离席上楼去筹划——

In her dressing table lay an account of the private possessions discovered in the concubines’ rooms that day—jewels, gold and silver.
她梳妆台中有一本帐，是这天从各房姨太太处检查出来的私房，有珠宝、也有金银，

She would see whether ten thousand taels could be assembled from them.
看看能不能凑出一万银子？


“Mr Hu, you cannot think only of charity,” Wu said.
“大先生，”乌先生说：“你也不能光做好事，

“You must consider yourself too and keep something in reserve.”
也要为自己打算打算，留起一点儿来。”

Hu remained silent.
胡雪岩不作声，

After a while he suddenly asked, “You enjoy calligraphy and painting, Mr Wu.
过了一会，突然问道：“乌先生，你喜欢字画，

Before I hand mine over, would you like to choose a few pieces?”
趁我没有交出去以前，你挑几件好不好？”

He expected polite refusals and thought he would have to press hard before Wu accepted.
原以为乌先生总还要客气一番，要固劝以后才会接受，

Instead, Wu answered immediately with one word: “Yes.”
不道他爽爽快快地答了一个字：“好！”

Hu pulled a red silk cord.
于是胡雪岩拉动一根红色丝绳，

A clear bell rang: a Western-style servant bell, connected to the corridor and the upper floor.
便有清越的铃声响起，这是依照西洋法子所设置的叫人铃，通到廊上，也通到搂上，

Two maids soon appeared.
顷之间。来了两个丫头，

Madam Luosi also sent A’yun down to ask what was needed.
阿云亦奉了螺蛳太太之命，下楼来探问何事呼唤。

“Bring the picture chests over.
“把画箱扛开来！

There is not enough light.”
不够亮。”

Candles could not be used for examining paintings.
看画不能点烛，

A’yun called for two more servants and additional oil lamps, then fetched the keys and opened the chests.
阿云交代再来两个人，多点羌手油灯，然后取来钥匙，打开画箱，

When buying paintings and antiques, Hu had made little distinction between genuine and false, fine and crude.
胡雪岩买这画古董，真假、精粗不分，

A high price was what mattered to him.
价高为贵，

Antique dealers all knew a story about this.
有个“古董鬼”人人皆知的故事，

A man once offered him a Song painting.
有人拿了一幅宋画去求售，

It was genuine, and the price reasonable.
画是真迹，价钱也还克己，

The sale was all but settled when the man said, “Mr Hu, I am making no profit on this.
本已可以成交，不道此人说了一句：“胡大先生，这张画我没有赚你的钱，

The price is a bargain.”
这个价钱是便宜的。”

“If you cannot make a profit from me, where can you?
“我这里不赚钱，你到哪里去赚？

Take it away.
拿走拿走。

I do not want to take advantage of you.”
我不要占你的便宜。”

The sale fell through.
交易就此告吹。

Hence every dealer who came to Hu asked a high price and, after concluding the sale, thanked him profusely.
因此，“古董鬼”上门，无不索取高价，成交以后亦必千恩万谢。

Wu knew this field well and had bought several fine works for him.
乌先生对此道是内行，亦替胡雪岩经手买进过好些精品，

He was broadly familiar with the Qingyu Hall collection.
庆余堂的收藏，大致有所了解。

Before the Meifu kerosene lamps arrived, he said, “Let me look at the calligraphy rubbings first.”
在美孚油灯没有点来以前，他说：“我先看看帖。”


Rubbings from inscribed stelae were commonly called “black tigers.” Hu said excitedly, “I have a black tiger that really is tiger meat.
碑帖俗名“黑老虎”。胡雪岩很兴奋地说：“我有一只‘黑老虎’，真正是‘老虎肉’，

It cost me three thousand taels.
三千两银子买的。

To tell the truth, what caught my eye was the gold lettering in the Qianlong Emperor’s own hand.”
说实话，我是看中乾隆亲笔写的金字。”

“I have heard that you own a Tang rubbing of the Huadu Temple Stele.
“喔，我听说你有部化度寺碑，是唐拓。”乌先生说：

A Song rubbing would already be immensely valuable.
“宋拓已经名贵不得了，

I should like to see a Tang one.”
唐拓我倒要见识见识。”

“A’yun, where is that album?”
“阿云，”胡雪岩问道：“我那部帖在哪里？”

“I think it is with Mistress Zhu.”
“恐怕是在朱姨太那里。”

“Oh.
“喔，”

Is Mistress Zhu still in her own rooms?”
胡雪岩又问：“朱姨太还是在她自己的地方？”

“She has moved into a guest room.
“搬到客房里住。”阿云答说：

Her old rooms are locked.”
“她原来的地方锁起来了。”

“Then we cannot get the album just now?”
“这样说，那部帖一时拿不出来？”

“Let me ask her first.”
“我先去问问朱姨太看。

As soon as A’yun left, four maids filed in, each carrying a Meifu kerosene lamp with a white-copper base and a glass shade.
等阿云一定，只见四名丫头，各持一盏白铜底座、玻璃灯罩的美孚油灯，鱼贯而至。

The study became as bright as day.
书房中顿时明如白昼。

Hu handed Wu the bunch of keys to the picture chests.
胡雪岩便将一串画箱钥匙，交到乌先生手里，说一句：

“Please help yourself.”
“请你自己动手。”


Wu went about it as though handling his own collection.
乌先生亦就象处理自己的珍藏一样，

First he surveyed the chests: about seven chi long, four wide and three high, made of camphorwood.
先打量画箱，约莫七尺长，四尺宽，三尺高，樟木所制，

There were eight, arranged side by side against the north wall and labelled with the first eight characters of the Thousand Character Classic: Heaven, Earth, Dark, Yellow, Universe, Cosmos, Vast, Primeval.
一共八具，并排摆在北墙下，依照千字文“天地玄黄，宇宙洪荒”编号。

There were also eight keys, engraved with numbers.
钥匙亦是八枚，上镌数字，

Naturally the key numbered one opened the Heaven chest.
“一”字当然用来开天宇号画箱，

Inside, on top, lay a booklet entitled Catalogue of Calligraphy, Paintings and Rubbings in the Hu Family Collection of Qingyu Hall.
打开一看，上面有一本册子，标明“庆余堂胡氏书画碑帖目录”字样。

“That makes things easy,” Wu said happily.
“这就省事了。”乌先生很高兴地说：

“I shall read the catalogue first.”
“我先看目录。”

It had three main divisions—fine calligraphy, famous paintings and ink rubbings—each subdivided by dynasty.
目录分法书、名画、墨拓三大类，每类又按朝代来分。

The first calligraphy entry was “Western Jin: Lu Ji, The Pingfu Letter, handscroll on paper.”
法书类下第一件是“西晋际机平复帖卷纸本”。

Wu was so startled that for a moment he could not speak.
乌先生入眼吓一跳，愣在那里说不出话来。

“What is it?” Hu asked.
“怎么样？”胡雪岩诧异地向。

“At least fifteen hundred years have passed since the Western Jin, and a work on paper has survived!
“西晋到现在，少说也有一千五百年了，居然还有纸本留下来！

This is more precious than Wang Xizhi’s Preface to the Orchid Pavilion.
这比王羲之的《兰亭序》还要贵重。

The original of that went into the coffin with Emperor Taizong of Tang.
王羲之的《兰亭序》原本，唐太宗带到棺村里去了，

To find genuine writing earlier still—what extraordinary good fortune for the eyes!”
想不到还有比他再早的真迹，真正眼福不浅。”

Hu smiled.
胡雪岩笑一笑说：

“Look at it before you say more.”
“你看了再说。”


With great care Wu took out the scroll.
于是乌先生小心谨慎地从画箱中净“陆机平复帖卷”取了出来。

Its mounting was exquisite: a blue kesi silk wrapper patterned with birds and flowers, a mutton-fat white jade roller, and a coral fastening pin.
这个手卷，装演得非常讲究，外面是蓝地花鸟绰丝包衬，羊脂白玉卷轴，珊瑚插签，

He withdrew the pin and unrolled it.
拔去插签摊了开来，

At the beginning, over a yellow silk mounting strip, lay a pale-blue silk label inscribed by Emperor Huizong of Song with six Chinese characters: “Jin: Lu Ji’s Pingfu Letter.”
卷前黄绢隔水，一条月白绢签，是宋徽宗御题：“晋陆机平复帖”六字，

Beneath it was a double-dragon seal.
下铃双龙玺，

Another very old silk label read, “Written by Lu Shiheng of Wu Commandery, Administrator of Pingyuan under the Jin.”
另外又有一条极旧的绢签题明：“晋平原内史吴郡陆士衡书”。

The paper was ivory-coloured, the characters about half a cun high.
纸呈象牙色，字大五分许，

There were nine lines of zhangcao, an early cursive script.
写的是章草，一共九行，

Studying them closely, Wu could recognize only a tenth.
细细观玩，却只识得十分之一，

But every word of Dong Qichang’s later inscription was clear: “Before the General of the Right, after Yuanchang, only these few lines remain: a treasure rare through the ages.”
不过后面董其昌的一行跋，却是字字皆识：“右军以前，元常以后，唯存此数行，为希代宝。”


Wu had seen several examples of Dong Qichang’s hand.
董其昌的字，乌先生见过好几幅，

Careful comparison convinced him that this inscription was not genuine.
细细观察，判定不真，

Reluctant to say so outright, he merely rolled the scroll up.
但不便直言论断，只将那个手卷卷了起来。

“Well?” Hu asked.
胡雪岩便问：“怎么样？”

“There seem to be some grounds for doubt.”
“似乎有点疑问。”

“Your eye is good.
“你的眼光不错，

It is a fake.”
是西贝货。”

Hu pointed at the catalogue.
胡雪岩指着目录说：

“Look at a few genuine things.”
“你看几件真东西。”

Experts had already examined the collection for him and marked the catalogue.
原来这些字画，胡雪岩曾请行家鉴别过，在目录上做了记号。

There were three kinds of mark.
记号分三种，

A single circle meant a forgery; a double circle indicated uncertain authenticity, or a copy valuable in its own right, such as a Song copy of a Tang painting.
单圈是假货，双圈则在真假疑似之间，或者虽假也很值钱，譬如宋人临仿的唐画之类，

Works accepted without question as genuine bore a little plum-blossom stamp.
至于没有疑问的真迹，则印上一朵小小的梅花为记，

These made up about a fifth of the catalogue.
在目录上，大概只有五分之一。

Wu next selected Twelve Letters of the Su Family, containing letters by Su Laoquan, Dongpo, Ziyou and Dongpo’s youngest son Shudang.
于是，乌先生挑了一部“苏氏一门十二帖”来看，内中收了苏老泉、东坡、子由及东坡幼子叔党的十二封信，

One glance showed they were genuine.
入眼即知不假。

“I need not inspect every original.
“不必看原件，

I can choose from the catalogue.
我在目录上挑好了。

How many pieces do you intend to give me?”
大先生，你打算送我几件？”

“You decide.”
“你自己说。”

“Then I should like everything bearing a plum-blossom stamp.” He immediately added, “To keep safe for you.
“你要我说，有梅花印记的我都要。”乌先生紧接着又说：“我是替你保管。

Mr Hu, do you trust me?”
大先生，你相信不相信我？”

Hu had not anticipated his real purpose.
乌先生的本意如此，是胡雪岩所意料不到的，

But this would mean secretly concealing assets and would not be honourable.
但这便是私下藏匿资财，有欠光明磊落。

After considering, he answered firmly, “There is no need, Mr Wu.
他考虑了一会，断然决然地说：“乌先生，这不必。

I shall still give you a few pieces.
我仍旧送你几件，

Choose carefully.”
你再细细挑。”

Wu had meant well, but could say no more when Hu refused.
乌先生是一番好意，胡雪岩既然不受，他亦不便再多说什么，

Still hoping to preserve as much as possible for him, he selected, besides the Su letters, Emperor Huizong’s Thousand Character Classic in Slender Gold Script, Dong Yuan’s Dragon Emerging from Hibernation in Wind and Rain, and a handscroll of The Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove by Zhao Mengfu.
但仍旧存着能为他保全一份算一份的想法，因而除了“苏氏一门十二帖”以外，另外选了一部“宋徽宗瘦金体书千字文”，一幅董源的“风雨出蛰龙图”，一个赵孟頫的“竹林七贤图”手卷。

Together, these four works were estimated to be worth more than ten thousand taels.
估计这四件书画，就值上万银子。


Under Hu’s direction, the maids opened three chests, found all the works intended for Wu and tied them into a bundle.
于是丫头们在胡雪岩指挥之下，开启三只画箱，将送乌先生的字画找齐捆扎妥当。

Madam Luosi and A’yun returned one after the other.
螺蛳太太与阿云亦相继而回，

The Tang rubbing of the Huadu Temple Stele could not be located for the moment, so they let it pass.
那部“唐拓化度寺碑”一时无从找起，也就罢了。

The ten thousand taels for the charitable hall had been assembled, all in banknotes.
捐给善堂的一万银子，已经凑齐，都是银票，

They were counted out and handed to Wu at once.
即时点交乌先生收讫，

Then the table was laid for wine and supper.
然后摆开桌子，酒食消夜。

“Three cups and sets of chopsticks,” Hu told A’yun.
“摆三双杯筷！”胡雪岩关照阿云：

“Sit with us.”
“一起坐。”

He meant Madam Luosi.
这是指螺蛳太太而言。

She regarded Wu as an elder of her own family, so there was no need for the formal separation of men and women.
她视乌先生如亲属长辈，不必有礼仪上的男女之别。

Seated with them, she sipped green Western mint liqueur from a little glass while Wu drank aged Huadiao.
入座以后，用一小杯绿色的西洋薄荷酒，陪乌先生喝陈年花雕，

Hu took his usual medicinal wine before bed.
胡雪岩仍旧照例喝睡前的药酒。

“Has Old Seven moved to a guest room?” he asked.
“老七搬到客房里去了？”胡雪岩问。

He sometimes called Mistress Zhu Old Seven.
胡雪岩有时管朱姨太叫老七。

“At her own request.
“她自己提出来的，”

She said that after all the bustle and company, she would not be able to sleep in such sudden emptiness.”
螺蛳太太说：“她说，平时大家热热闹闹的，突然之间，冷冷清清，她会睡不着。”


Hu nodded and looked at Wu, signalling him to speak.
胡雪岩点点头，眼看乌先生，示意他开口。

Wu described the day’s events at Zhou’s house and ended with Zheng’s concern.
于是乌先生为螺蛳太太细谈这天在周少棠家的情形，最后提出郑俊生的见解。

“That will not be the case,” Madam Luosi said.
“不会的。”螺蛳太太说：

“Every night the master spends in each room is marked in the almanac.
“大先生哪天住在哪里，都在皇历上记下来的。

I checked.
我查过，

His last night with Mistress Zhu was more than two months ago.
住在朱姨太那里，最后一次是两个多月以前。

As for…”
至于……”

She had been about to joke that she could not know whether Hu and Mistress Zhu had been intimate in private since.
她本来想开个小小的玩笑，说胡雪岩与朱姨太是否私下燕好过，可就不知道了。

But nobody was in a joking mood, so she swallowed the words.
但这时候都没有说笑话的心情，所以把话咽住了。

“Better to be careful.
“还是小心点的好。

There is no harm in waiting another month and sending her to Zhou’s only when she shows no sign of pregnancy.”
再等一个月看，没有害喜的样子再送到周家也还不迟。”

“Very well.
“也好。”

Where will she stay for this month or more?”
螺蛳太太问：“这一个多月住在哪里呢？”

“At my house,” Wu said.
“住在我那里好了。”

“Then we can be still easier in our minds.”
“这就更加可以放心了。”

Hu made a decisive gesture.
胡雪岩作个切断的手势，

“That settles it.”
“这件事就算这样子定规了。”

“I understand,” Madam Luosi said.
“我知道了。”螺蛳太太说：

“I shall arrange everything.”
“我会安排。”


Now they were to speak frankly of their deepest concerns and fundamental plans.
于是要谈肺腑之言，根本之计了。

Wu began.
首先是乌先生发问：

“Mr Hu, do you believe this fall is final?”
“大先生，你自己觉得这个跟斗是栽定了？”

“What can I do but accept it?”
“不认栽又怎么样？”

“I do not accept it!”
“我不认栽！”

Madam Luosi put in.
螺蛳太太接口说道：

“A road is made by those who walk it.” Hu replied calmly, “Age does not spare a man.
“路是人走出来的。”“年纪不饶人啊！”胡雪岩很冷静地接着说道：

After a fall like this, getting back on my feet would be difficult enough.
“栽了这个跟斗，能够站起来，就不容易了，

How could I talk of making a new road?”
哪里还谈得到重新去走一条路出来。”

“Not so.
“不然，

If you can stand upright, you can walk,” Wu said.
能立直，就能走路。”乌先生说：

“Do not lose heart.
“大先生，你不要气馁，

A comeback depends on human effort.”
东山再起，事在人为。”

“I appreciate your encouragement.
“乌先生，你给我打气，我很感激。

But honestly, everything is easier said than done.
不过，说实话，凡事说来容易做来难。

You speak of rising again from the Eastern Mountain, but I do not even know where that mountain is.”
你说东山再起，我就不晓得东山在哪里？”

“All this dispirited talk!”
“你尽说泄气的话！”

Madam Luosi resented his lack of resolve.
螺蛳太太是恨胡雪岩不争气的神情，

“You were never like this before.”
“你从前不是这样子的！”

“Before was before.
“从前是从前，

Now is now.”
现在是现在。”

Hu too grew agitated.
胡雪岩也有些激动了，

“I am a commoner of the first rank, dismissed from office.
“我现在是革了职的一品老百姓，

I do not even know whether confiscation will follow.
再下去会不会抄家都还不晓得，

There is no point discussing anything else.”
别的就不必说了。”

Mention of confiscation brought another earnest appeal from Wu.
提到抄家，乌先生又有一句心里的话要说，

“You must keep some capital in reserve.”
“大先生，你总要留点本钱的。”

Hu said nothing.
胡雪岩不作声，

Madam Luosi, however, was prompted to think.
螺蛳太太却触动了心事，

She considered for some time and was about to speak when Hu spoke first.
盘算了好一会，正要发言，不道胡雪岩先开了口。


“If you refuse to accept defeat, I have an idea for you.
“你不服气，我倒替你想到一个主意。”胡雪岩对螺蛳太太说：

There is a business you could try.”
“有样生意你不妨试一试。

“You want me to return to my old trade?”
““莫非要我回老本行？”

She thought he meant embroidery.
螺蛳太太以为胡雪岩是劝她仍旧做绣货生意。

“No.
“不是。”

If you are interested, you could join Yingchun in Shanghai to speculate in land and build houses in lanes.
胡雪岩答说：“你如果有兴致，不妨同应春合作，在上海去炒地皮、造弄堂房子，

Or you could form a partnership with foreigners and open a firm specializing in foreign jewellery, dress materials and furniture.”
或者同洋人合伙，开一家专卖外国首饰、衣料、家具的洋行。”

“Exactly.
“不错，

Either business would make use of Luo Sijie’s strengths,” Wu said approvingly.
这两样行当，都可以发挥罗四姐的长处。”乌先生深表赞成，

“If Mr Hu has fallen, she can make a career of her own.
“大先生栽了跟斗，罗四姐来闯一番事业，

What is lost at sunrise may be regained at sunset.”
也算失之东隅，收之桑榆。”

“I shall have to depend on you from now on.”
“以后我要靠你了。”

Hu joked at his own expense.
胡雪岩开玩笑自嘲：

“Who would have thought that in my old age I should live on ‘slipper rice’—supported by a woman?”
“想不到我老来会‘吃拖鞋饭’。”

“What a dreadful thing to say!”
“难听不难听？”

She gave him a look.
螺蛳太太白了他一眼。

Both men laughed.
乌先生与胡雪岩都笑了。

Wu continued, “But neither business can be started with a small sum.
乌先生道：“不过，这两种行当，都不是小本生意。

While you still have some control, you should make arrangements early.”
大先生，趁现在自己还能作主的时候，要早早筹划。”

Again he was urging Hu to disperse his assets and lodge them elsewhere.
这依旧是劝胡雪岩疏散财物、寄顿他处之意。

Hu would not do that, but thought Madam Luosi should be reminded of something.
胡雪岩不愿意这么做，不过他觉得有提醒螺蛳太太的必要。

“See to your own private savings.
“你自己的私房，自己料理。”

Surely you have long had enough capital for either venture?”
胡雪岩说：“我想，你要干那两样行当，本钱应该早就有了吧？”

“No ready money.
“没有现款。

My cash is at Fukang.
现款存在阜康，

Who knows how much I shall recover?
将来能拿回多少，不晓得。

I have some jewellery, but that is difficult to sell too.”
首饰倒有一点，不过脱手也难。”

“Take it out soon and ask Mr Wu to carry it to Shanghai.
“你趁早拿出来，托乌先生带到上海，

Yingchun can find a way of disposing of it.”
交给应春去想办法。”


“I do not have it with me.”
“东西不在手里。”

“Where is it?
“在哪里？”

Have you left it in someone’s keeping?”
胡雪岩说：“你是寄在什么人手里？”

“With the Zhu family at Jindong Bridge.”
“金洞桥朱家。”

Hu fell silent, his expression darkening.
一听这话，胡雪岩不作声，脸色显得根深沉。

At the sight, Madam Luosi’s heart sank.
见此光景，螺蛳太太心便往下一沉，

Something must be wrong.
知道不大妥当。

“What is it?
“怎么了？”

Are the Zhus not old family connections?
她说：“朱家不是老亲吗？

Their eldest son’s wife is an excellent woman.”
朱大少奶奶是极好的人。”

“She is.
“朱大少奶奶人好，

But the old lady in that household would devour a person without leaving a bone.”
可是她家的老太太是吃人不吐骨头的角色。”

“Oh!”
“啊！”

Madam Luosi was alarmed.
螺蛳太太大吃一惊，

“Old Madam Zhu is a devout vegetarian, always chanting sutras.
“朱老太太吃素念经，

And the family is famously well off.
而且她们家也是有名殷实的人家，

Surely…”
莫非……”

“Surely she would not swallow up your property?” Hu asked, with a trace of mockery.
“莫非会吞没你的东西？”胡雪岩问得多少有些调侃。

“Yes.
“是啊！

I cannot believe she would be so wicked.”
我不相信她会起黑心。”

“Wickedness was how her family made its fortune in the first place…” Wu interrupted.
“她家本来就是起黑心发的财……”“这话，”乌先生插嘴说道：

“There must be a story behind that.
“大概有段故事在内。

Is there not, Mr Hu?”
大先生，是不是？”

“Indeed.
“不错，

Let me tell it to you.”
我来讲给你们听。”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第十二章（全章）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Twelve (complete)
逐句英中对照
原著：高阳


CHAPTER TWELVE: FOXES IN THE CITY WALL, RATS IN THE SHRINE｜第十二章 城狐社鼠


The story Hu Xueyan told concerned the digging up of buried treasure.
胡雪岩讲的是一个掘藏的故事。

After a great upheaval, when refugees were being brought home and order was gradually restored, people would often become rich overnight.
凡是大乱以后，抚缉流亡，秩序渐定，往往有人突然之间，发了大财，

Nine times out of ten, they had found a hidden hoard.
十九是掘到了藏宝的缘故。

There were two sorts of people who buried gold, silver, and valuables.
埋藏金银财定的不外两种人。

The first were wealthy families fleeing the ravages of war.
一种是原为富室，遇到刀兵之灾，举家逃难，

They could take only readily saleable things such as gold and pearls; silver and antiques were packed into durable containers and buried deep in some inconspicuous place, to be recovered when they returned after the war.
只能带些易于变卖的金珠之类，现银古玩，装入坚固不易坏的容器中，找一个难为人所注目的地方，深掘埋藏，等待乱后重回家园，掘取应用。

If the whole family was killed, or the head of the household or old servant who knew the secret died without an opportunity to pass it on, the fortune remained underground until, years later, someone destined for a windfall came upon it.
如果这家人家，尽室遇害，或者知道这个秘密的家长、老仆，不在人世而又没有机会留下遗言，这笔财富，便长埋地下，知不多少年以后，为哪个命中该发横财的人所得。

The other sort had already acquired a fortune but could not enjoy it because the situation had suddenly changed.
再一种藏宝的，就是已经横财就手之人，只以局势大变，无法安享，

They buried it for the time being and waited for a better opportunity.
暂且埋藏，徐图后计。

In the early Tongzhi years, the Taiping troops buried untold quantities of treasure.
同治初年的太平军，便不知埋藏了多少财宝。

Whenever they occupied an important city, they took over the houses of wealthy families as their quarters, a practice known as “setting up a mansion.”
太平军一据通都大邑，各自找大家巨室以安，名为“打公馆”。

When the owners returned, visitors would often arrive claiming that the “Longhairs” had buried valuables somewhere on the premises.
凡是被打过“公馆”的人家，重归家园后，每每有人登门求见，说“府上”某处有“长毛”埋藏的财物，

If the owner believed them, the next question was how to divide the proceeds: half each, perhaps, or sixty percent for the owner and forty for the informant, whose share would be at least thirty percent.
如果主人家信了他的话，接下来便是谈分帐，或者对半，或者四六——主人家拿六成，指点的人拿四成，最少也得三七分帐。

Some searches did turn up treasure, but most such visitors were opportunists.
掘藏有获的固然也有，但投机的居多，

They lost nothing if nothing was found and might as well try their luck with rumors and deception.
反正掘不到无所损，落得根据流言去瞎撞瞎骗了。


Hangzhou was no different after the Taiping troops were driven out: everyone seemed to be digging for treasure.
太平军败走后的杭州城，亦与其他各地一样，人们纷纷掘藏。

Hu Xueyan had a cousin of one of his parents, whom he called Uncle, named Zhu Baoru, who was particularly keen on it.
胡雪岩有个表叔名叫朱宝如，颇热中于此，

His wife was the “Old Madam Zhu” of whom Madam Luosi had spoken.
他的妻子便是螺蛳太太口中的“朱老太太”，

Honest-looking but deeply calculating, she told her husband, “You need a way in if you want to find treasure.
相貌忠厚而心计极深，她跟她丈夫说：“掘藏要有路子。

There is one now.
现在有条路子，

Keep your eyes open, and your luck may turn.”
你去好好留心，说不定时来运转，会发横财。”

“What way?”
“你说，路子在哪里？”

“The Reconstruction Bureau.
“善后局。”

Xueyan is your cousin’s son.
她说：“雪岩是你表侄、

Ask him for a post there, and he is bound to agree.
你跟他要个善后局的差使，他一定答应。

But you must be willing to take trouble.
不过，你不要怕烦，

Mix with the refugees and listen quietly while they talk about anything and everything.
要同难民混在一起，听他们谈天说地，静悄悄在旁边听；

You are certain to hear something useful.”
一定会听出东西来。”

Zhu Baoru had great respect for his wife’s judgment.
朱宝如很服他妻子，

He went to Hu Xueyan as instructed and volunteered to look after the refugees.
当下如教去看胡雪岩，自愿担任照料难民的职司。

Some jobs at the bureau were better than others.
善后局的职位有好有坏，

The most lucrative was handling claims for women who had lost their fathers and brothers in the fighting and flight. If a young, attractive woman was alone in the world, someone might come to claim her under the pretense of being a relative.
最好的是管认领妇女，有那年轻貌美，而父兄死于干戈流离之中，孤苦伶仃的，有人冒充亲属来领，

Once an understanding had been reached with her, the gratuity could run to a hundred taels or more.
只要跟被领的说通了，一笔谢礼，银子上百。

Next came food supplies and purchasing, both rich sources of illicit profit.
其次是管伙食，官采实，亦有极肥的油水。

Even copying documents and compiling registers were easy work.
此外，抄抄写写、造造名册，差使亦很轻松。

Only caring for the refugees was a tangle of troublesome details with nothing to be gained.
只有照料难民，琐碎烦杂而一无好处，

No one wanted it.
没有人肯干。

Hu Xueyan was delighted that Zhu Baoru had volunteered and appointed him at once.
而朱宝如居然自告奋勇，胡雪岩非常高兴。立即照派。


Following his wife’s advice, Zhu Baoru patiently dealt with the ragged, foul-smelling refugees, resolved their various difficulties, and listened carefully to the secrets that slipped out in casual conversation.
朱宝如受妻之教，耐着心跟衣衫褴褛、气味恶浊的难民打交道，应付种种难题，细心听他们在闲谈之中所透露的种种秘闻，

He established excellent relations with them.
感情处得很好。

One day a refugee in his thirties, who spoke with a Jiangxi accent, quietly said to him, “Mr Zhu, I have been here for more than half a month, and I can see that you are an honest, kindly elder.
有一天有个三十多岁江西口音的难民，悄悄向朱宝如说：“朱先生，我这半个多月住下来，看你老人家是很忠厚的人，

I should like to come to your home for a talk.”
我想到你府上去谈谈。”

“Oh?”
“喔，”

Zhu Baoru remembered him as a man of few words who had never caused any trouble.
朱宝如印象中，此人沉默寡言、亦从来没有来麻烦过他，

He did not even know his surname.
所以连他的姓都不知道，

“What is your name?”
当即问说：“贵姓？”

“Cheng.”
“我姓程。”

“Brother Cheng, there is nobody here. Whatever you have to say, go ahead.”
“程老弟，你有啥话，现在这里没有人，你尽管说。”

“No.
“不！

There is a great deal to say.
话很多，

It would be more convenient at your home.”
要到府上去谈才方便。”

Remembering his wife’s words, Zhu Baoru felt a stir of anticipation and took him home.
朱宝如想到了妻子的话。心中一动，便将此人带回家。

Cheng put down his bundle, untied his belt, and produced more than a dozen gold rings hidden inside it.
姓程的进门放下包裹，解下一条腰带，带子里有十几个金戒指。


“Mr and Mrs Zhu,” he said, “to tell you the truth, I was a Longhair.
“朱先生、朱太太，”此人说道：“实不相瞒，我做过‘长毛’，

I have now left the darkness for the light, and I should like to take you as my adoptive parents.
现在弃暗投明，想拜你们两老做干爹、干妈！

Would you be willing to accept me?”
不知道你们两老，肯不肯收我？

The request was rather sudden.
“这件事来得有些突兀，

Zhu Baoru was still hesitating, but his wife suspected that the bundle held more surprises and readily replied, “We have a son about your age, but he is away.
朱宝如还在踌躇，他妻子看出包裹里还有花样，当即慨然答应：“我们有个儿子，年纪同你差不多，如今不在眼前。

Fate has brought us together.
遇见你也是缘分，

We need not discuss becoming your adoptive parents just yet.
拜干爹、干妈的话，暂且不提，

Stay with us first.”
你先住下来再说。”

“No.
“不！

Only if you accept me as a son will I dare tell you certain things.
两老要收了我，认我当儿子，我有些话才敢说，

And once I become your son, I can take the surname Zhu.
而且拜了两老，我改姓为朱，

That will make everything easier.”
以后一切都方便。”

The couple conferred in private and agreed to adopt him.
于是，朱宝如夫妻悄悄商量了一会，决定收这个干儿子，

His surname was changed to Zhu, and since he had been born in the year of the Horse, they gave him the name Jiaju, “the family’s colt.”
改姓为朱，由于生于午年，起了个名字叫家驹。

The gold rings became his introductory gift to his new parents.
那十几个金戒指，便成了他孝敬义父母的见面礼。

With money, everything was easy.
有了钱，什么事都好办了。

Zhu Baoru sold two of the rings and fitted Zhu Jiaju out in new clothes.
朱宝如去卖掉两个金戒指，为朱家驹打扮得焕然一新。

He also bought wine and meat, and they enjoyed a convivial celebration of their new family ties.
同时沽酒买肉，畅叙“天伦”。


Zhu Jiaju seemed never to have known such comfortable days.
朱家驹仿佛从来没有过过这样的好日子，

Delighted, he ate great chunks of meat, drank bowlfuls of wine, and described his life among the Longhairs.
显得非常高兴，一面大块吃肉、大碗喝酒，一面谈他做“长毛”的经过。

An orphan, he had carried baggage for the Taiping troops in his native Jiangxi.
他是个孤儿，在他江西家乡，为太平军挑辎重，

When they reached Quzhou in Zhejiang, they released him to go home.
到了浙江衙州。太平军放他回家，

He said that he had no home and wished to become a “little Longhair.”
他说无家可归，愿意做“小长毛”。

Thus he went with them from Quzhou to Hangzhou, though they soon moved on again.
这就样由衢州到杭州，但不久便又开拔了。

This was in the spring of the tenth year of Xianfeng.
那是咸丰十年春天的事，

To relieve the siege of the Heavenly Capital, the Taiping Loyal King, Li Xiucheng, used the strategy of besieging Zhao to rescue Yan.
太平军的忠王李秀成，为解“天京”之围，使了一条围赵救燕之计。

Early in the second month he marched from southern Anhui into Zhejiang, intending to draw back the Zhejiang troops under Brigade Commander Zhang Yuliang, then besieging Jinling, and so ease the pressure.
二月初由皖南进攻浙江，目的是要将围金陵的浙军总兵张玉良所部引回来，减轻压力。

Li entered Hangzhou on the twenty-seventh day of that month.
二月二十七李秀成攻入杭州，

When Zhang’s reinforcements arrived on the third day of the third month, Li withdrew westward: his purpose had been achieved, and he feared that Zhang would cut off his retreat.
到了三月初三，张玉良的援军赶到，李秀成因为计已得施，又怕张玉良断他的归路，便弃杭州西走，

The occupation had lasted only five days.
前后只得五天的工夫。


Zhu Jiaju served under Li and fought in various places until a defeat separated him from his unit and another Taiping force took him in.
朱家驹那时便在李秀成部下，转战各地，兵败失散，为另一支太平军所收容。

His new commander, Wu Tiande, came from the same village and valued such ties.
他的长官叫吴天德，是他同一个村庄的人，极重乡谊。

Zhu Jiaju and another fellow villager, Wang Peili, became his trusted personal guards.
所以朱家驹跟他的另一个同乡王培利，成了吴天德的贴身“亲兵”，深获信任。

Later, mortally wounded in battle, Wu told them, “When the Loyal King took Hangzhou the second time, I was stationed there for half a year.
以后吴天德在一次战役中受了重伤，临死以前跟朱家驹与王培利说：“忠王第二次攻进杭州，我在那里驻扎了半年，

My quarters were at Jindong Bridge in the eastern city.
‘公馆’打在东城金洞桥。

When I was transferred, his orders were so strict that I could not take my things.
后来调走了，忠王的军令很严，我的东面带不走，

I buried them there and have never had a chance to return.
埋在那里，以后始终没有机会再到杭州。

Now that I am dying, I have something to give you.”
现在我要死了，有这样东西交给你们。”

From a pocket next to his skin he took an oilpaper packet containing a treasure map.
说着，他从贴肉的口袋中，掏出一个油纸包，里面是一张藏宝的图。

He told them to find an opportunity to dig up the hoard and divide it into three shares, sending one to his old home in Jiangxi.
他关照朱家驹与王培利，设法找机会到杭州去掘藏，如果掘到了，作三股分，一股要送回他江西的老家。

He also made them swear brotherhood and vow before Heaven never to betray their trust, on pain of divine punishment.
又叫朱家驹、王培利结为兄弟，对天盟誓，相约不得负义，否则必遭天谴。


“Afterward, my sworn elder brother and I agreed to cut the map in two and keep half each.
“后来，我同我那位拜兄商量，把地图一分为二，各拿半张，

We stayed together all along.
我们也一直在一起。

Now that Lord Zuo has recovered Hangzhou, our opportunity has come.
这回左大人克复杭州，机会来了，

Since I had been here before, I came ahead disguised as a refugee to find the place.
因为我到杭州来过，所以由我冒充难民，行来探路，

Once I had located it, I meant to send for Wang Peili and discuss how to proceed.”
等找到了地方，再通知王培利，商量怎么下手。”

“Where is this sworn brother of yours?” Zhu Baoru asked.
“那么，”朱宝如问：“你那姓王的拜把兄弟在哪里？”

“In Shanghai.
“在上海。

One letter from me will bring him at once.”
只要我一封信去，马上就来。”

“Your sworn brother is one of our own too,” Mrs Zhu said.
“你的把兄弟，也是自己人。”朱宝如的老婆说：

“Send for him!
“来嘛！

Tell him to come!”
叫他来嘛！”

“Wait, wait!”
“慢，慢！”

Zhu Baoru waved his hand.
朱宝如摇摇手，

“Let us discuss this first.
“我们先来商量。

Where is your map?”
你那张图呢？”

“I have only half.”
“图只有半张。”

Zhu Jiaju, too, took an oilpaper packet from a pocket next to his skin.
朱家驹也是从贴肉的口袋中，取出一个油纸包，

The half-map was well preserved.
打开一看，半张地图保存得很好，

Spread flat on the table, it proved to be the upper half, with its bottom edge cut in a zigzag.
摊开在桌上抹平一看，是一张图的上半张，下端剪成锯齿形。

Presumably this was intended to work like matching halves of a tally: the top edge of the other half was similarly cut, and only when the two fitted perfectly together could they be identified as Wu Tiande’s original map.
想来就是“合符”的意思；另外那半张，上端也是锯齿形，两个半张凑成一起，吻合无间，才是吴天德交来的原因。


“This half gives the location,” Zhu Jiaju said.
“这半张是地址。”朱家驹说：

“The lower half shows exactly where the treasure is buried.”
“下半张才是埋宝的细图。”

That made sense.
这也可以理解，

Having spent five days in Hangzhou, he had brought the half with the address to find Wu Tiande’s former quarters.
朱家驹在杭州住过五天，所以由他带着这有地址的半张，先来寻觅吴天德当初“打公馆”的原址。

Zhu Baoru examined it closely.
朱宝如细看图上，

Two places were named, Jindong Bridge and Wan’an Bridge.
注明两个地点，一个是金洞桥，一个是万安桥；

There were also two small squares, one labeled “Temple of Lord Guan,” with an arrow and the note: “About thirty paces south; faces west.”
另外有两个小方块，其中一个下注“关帝庙”，又画一个箭头，注明：“往南约三十步，坐东朝西。”

The unlabeled square was plainly the house containing the treasure.
没有任何字样的那一个小方块，不言可知便是藏宝之处。

“That should not be hard to find.
“这不难找。”朱宝如问：

And once we find it?”
“找到了以后呢？”

“We rent it or buy it.”
“或者租，或者买。”

“Buy it?”
“买？”

Zhu Baoru hesitated.
朱宝如踌躇着，

“A house used by your Longhairs as a mansion can hardly be small.
“是你们长毛打过公馆的房子，当然不会小，

It may cost a great deal.”
买起来恐怕不便宜。”

“That does not matter.
“不要紧。”朱家驹说：

Wang Peili will bring money.”
“王培利会带钱来。”

“Good!” Zhu Baoru said happily.
“那好！”朱宝如很高兴地说，

“Leave this to me.”
“这件事交给我来办。”

His wife asked, “Jiaju, what exactly is buried there?”
“家驹！”他老婆问说：“不晓得里面埋了点啥东西？”

“A great many things…”
“东西很多……”

There were said to be four or five hundred taels’ weight of gold leaf, together with quantities of jewels and ornaments.
据说，埋藏之物有四五百两金叶子、大批的珠宝首饰。

The method of burial had been elaborate.
埋藏的方法非常讲究，

The jewelry was wrapped in soft paper and placed in porcelain jars sealed with putty.
珠宝首饰先用绵纸包好，置于瓷坛之中，用油灰封口，

These went into an iron chest, surrounded by lime to keep out damp.
然后装入铁箱，外填石灰，以防潮气，

Finally the iron chest was placed inside a large wooden chest and buried.
最后再将铁箱置放于大木箱中，埋入地下。


The couple listened with delight.
朱宝如夫妇听得这些话，满心欢喜。

That night they conferred secretly.
当夜秘密商议，

A sudden adoption of a son whose background was unknown might arouse the neighbors’ suspicions, so they decided to move the next day, to the eastern city, where they could more conveniently search around Jindong Bridge.
怕突然之间收了一个来历不明的干儿子，邻居或许会猜疑，决定第二天搬家，搬到东城去住，为的是便于到金洞桥去觅藏宝之地。

Once settled, Zhu Baoru told his adopted son to write to Shanghai for Wang Peili.
等迁居己定，朱宝如便命义子写信到上海，通知王培利到杭州，

Then he prepared to inspect the neighborhood.
然后到金洞桥去踏勘。

“Jiaju, with your out-of-town accent, you would attract suspicion if you went asking questions.
“家驹，”他说：“你是外乡口音，到那里去查访，变成形迹可疑，诸多不便。

Stay here.
你留在家里，

I shall go alone.” Zhu Jiaju readily agreed.
我一个人去。”朱家驹欣然从命，由朱宝如一个人去悄俏查访。

Wan’an Bridge was the foremost bridge within Hangzhou, with a high arch under which grain boats passed.
万安桥是杭州城内第一座大桥，为漕船所经之地，桥洞极高，

There was a temple to Lord Guan on either side.
桥东桥西各有一座关帝庙，

From their positions relative to Jindong Bridge, the one on the map must be the eastern temple.
依照与金洞桥的方位来看，图上所指的关帝庙，应该是桥东的那一座，

Beside it was a teahouse.
庙旁就是一家茶馆，

Zhu Baoru ordered a pot and sat from morning until noon, quietly listening to the patrons’ expansive talk.
朱宝如泡了一壶茶，从早晨坐到中午，静静地听茶客高谈阔论。

After three days he finally heard what he wanted: accounts of the Taiping troops’ activities during their two occupations.
如是一连三天，终于听到了他想要听的话。当然他想听的便是有关太平军两次攻陷杭州，在这一带活动的情形。

Between Wan’an and Jindong bridges, they had occupied five houses.
自万安桥到金洞桥这个范围之内，太平军住过的军宅，一共有五处，

The one whose position matched the map belonged to a jinshi named Yan.
其中方位与藏宝图上相合的一处。主人姓严，是个进士。


Now it was easy.
这就容易找了。

Leaving the teahouse, Zhu Baoru found two lanes running south from in front of the temple, one broad and one narrow.
朱宝如出了茶店，看关帝庙前面，自北而南两条巷子，一条宽，一条窄，

He took the broad lane, walked thirty ordinary paces, and came to a stone inscribed with a Mount Tai protective formula.
进入宽的那条，以平常的脚步走了三十步，看到一块刻有“泰山石敢当”字样的石碑，

Using it as his reference point, he examined the west-facing houses and soon saw a plaque with bold black characters on a pale ground: “Residence of a Jinshi.”
以此为坐标，细细搜索坐东朝西的房屋，很快地发现有一家人家的门楣上，悬着一块粉底黑字的匾额，赫然大书：“进士第”三字，

This must be Yan’s home.
自然就是严进士家了。

He did not act rashly but walked past twice, studying the surroundings.
朱宝如不敢造次，先来回走了两趟，一面走，一面观察环境，

The house was not exceptionally fine, but it seemed large.
这一处“进士第”的房子不是顶讲究，但似乎不小。

On the second pass someone came out, giving him a view through the sedan-chair hall to the inner gate and a very imposing hall beyond.
第二越经过那里，恰好有人出来，朱宝如转头一望。由轿厅望到二门，里面是一个很气派的大厅，

Afraid of attracting attention, he did not linger.
因为怕惹人注目，他不敢多事逗留。

At home he kept his discovery to himself until bedtime, when he and his wife secretly discussed how to make inquiries.
回家先不说破，直到晚上上床，才跟他老婆密议，如何下手去打听。


“I cannot simply knock and ask whether they want to sell.
“我也不能冒冒失失上门，去问他们房子卖不卖，

At most I can ask whether they have spare rooms to let.
顶多问他们，有没有余屋出租。

If they say no, I must leave, and it will be awkward to go back.
如果回你一句：没有！那就只好走路，以后不便再上门，

That would close the way.”
路也就此断了。”

His resourceful wife thought for a moment.
他的老婆计谋很多，想了一下说：

“Is not Mr Hu planning another gruel kitchen in the eastern city?
“不是说胡大先生在东城还要立一座施粥厂？

Why not use that as your opening?”
你何不用这个题目去搭讪？

“Gruel kitchens are not my responsibility.”
““施粥厂不归我管。”

“What does that matter?
“怕啥？”朱家老婆说：

Public charities need everyone’s support.
“公益事情，本来要大家热心才办得好，

Besides, you work for the Reconstruction Bureau.”
何况你也是善后局的。”

“Quite right.
“言之有理。”

If Jiaju asks tomorrow, tell him we have not found the place.”
朱室如说：“明天家驹提起来，你就说还没有找到。”

“I know.
“我晓得，

I shall keep him satisfied.”
我会敷衍他的。”

Mrs Zhu was remarkably capable.
朱家老婆真是个好角色，

She attended to every detail of Zhu Jiaju’s food and comfort, so the delay in finding the treasure site did not make him unduly impatient.
将朱家驹的饮食起居，照料得无微不至，因此，对于寻觅藏宝之地迟迟没有消息，朱家驹并不觉得焦急难耐。

In fact, Zhu Baoru was already making considerable progress.
而事实上，朱宝如在这件事上，已颇有进展了。


Zhu Baoru also proceeded methodically.
朱宝如做事也很扎实，

His wife was right that everyone should support a public charity, and he could approach the household on that basis.
虽然他老婆的话不错，公益事情要大家热心，他尽不妨上门去接头，

Still, a word from Hu Xueyan would give him a stronger pretext.
但总觉得有胡雪岩的一句话，更显得师出有名。

Hu approved of another gruel kitchen but imposed a condition: Zhu Baoru must organize it and then take charge of its management.
在胡雪岩，多办一家施粥厂，也很赞成，但提出一个相对条件，要朱宝如负责筹备，开办后，亦归朱玉如管理。

This was an unexpected opportunity.
这是个意外的机缘，

Even if the treasure came to nothing, running such a kitchen offered the chance of a modest illicit fortune.
即使掘宝不成，有这样一个粥厂在手里，亦是发小财的机会，

He readily agreed and went eagerly to call on the jinshi.
所以欣然许诺。于是兴冲冲地到严进士家去拜访，

An old servant named Yan Sheng received him.
接待的是严家的一个老仆叫严升。

On hearing his purpose, Yan Sheng explained that the entire family had taken refuge in Shanghai and that he had no authority to decide.
等朱宝如道明来意，严升表示他家主人全家避难在上海，他无法作主，

He copied out his master’s address and told Zhu to approach him directly.
同时抄了他家主人在上海的地址给他，要他自己去接头。

“Very well.
“好的，”

But first there are some things I should like to understand.
朱宝如问道：“不过，有许多情形，先要请你讲讲明白，

If your master agrees, would he rent the house or sell it?”
如果你家主人答应了，这房子是租还是卖？”

“I do not know.
“我不晓得。”

Since it is for a good cause, he might lend it without charging a single coin.”
严升答说：“我想既然是做好事，我家老爷说不定一文不要，白白出借。”

“That would hardly do.
“不然。”朱宝如说：

With so many people coming and going every day, a gruel kitchen would leave the house in a dreadful state.
“一做了施粥厂，每天多少人进进出出，房子会糟塌得不成样子。

I should like to know whether your master would consider selling, and at what price.”
所以我想跟你打听打听，你家主人的这所房子，有没有意思出让？如果有意，要多少银子才肯卖？”

“You would have to ask him.
“这也要问我家老爷。”

Someone did inquire before, but he would only pledge it, not sell.
严升又说：“以前倒有人来问过，我家老爷只肯典，不肯卖。

It is the old family home, after all.
因为到底是老根基，

He might pledge it for a few years and, once things are peaceful, rebuild it and live here again.”
典个几年，等时世平定了，重新翻造，仍旧好住。”


Zhu Baoru asked to look around, and Yan Sheng readily agreed.
于是朱宝如要求看一看房子，严升很爽快地答应了。

The west-facing residence had three successive ranges of buildings, with an additional courtyard south of the second hall.
这一所坐东朝西的住宅，前后一共三进，外带一个院落，在二厅之南，

Three elegant rooms stood on each of its eastern and western sides.
院子里东西两面，各有三楹精舍，

The adjoining galleries were linked by a raised pavilion three zhang square.
相连的两廊，中建一座平地升高、三丈见方的亭子。

In the center of the courtyard was a stone flower bed five chi high, its blue-stone retaining walls exquisitely carved.
院子正中，石砌一座花坛，高有五尺，“拦土”的青石，雕搂极精。

Yan Sheng said that the elderly master had excelled at growing peonies, including such famous varieties as Wei Purple and Yao Yellow.
据严升说，严家老大爷善种牡丹，魏紫姚黄，皆为名种，

Every spring, when they bloomed, he would hold a banquet in the square pavilion, drinking wine, admiring the flowers, and composing poems to assigned rhymes.
每年春天，牡丹盛放时，严老太爷都会在方亭中设宴，饮酒赏花，分韵赋诗，

Several stones engraved with these poems were set into the gallery walls.
两廊墙壁上便嵌着好几块“诗碑”。

The choice peonies, of course, had long since been destroyed.
当然，名种牡丹，早被摧残，

The flower bed was now overgrown with weeds.
如今的花坛上只长满了野草。

As he looked, Zhu Baoru calculated.
朱宝如一面看，一面盘算，

With such a passion for peonies, and a specially designed bed that must have been costly and required particular attention to soil and drainage, the Yan family would never willingly sell unless its fortunes had declined.
严家老大爷既有此种花的癖好，这座花坛亦是专为种牡丹所设计，不但所费不货，而且水土保持，亦有特别讲究，所以除非家道中替，决舍不得卖屋。

A pledge for a limited term, however, might be negotiable.
出典则如年限不长，便可商量。

Hu Xueyan knew almost every Hangzhou gentleman who had taken refuge in Shanghai and was friendly with many.
逃难在上海的杭州士绅，几乎没有一个为胡雪岩所未曾见过，有交情的亦很不少，

A letter from him ought to settle the matter.
只要请胡雪岩出面写封信，应无不成之理。

His wife rejected the idea at once.
哪知道话跟他老婆一说，立即被驳，

“Do not involve Mr Hu.
“你不要去惊动胡大先生。”她说：

He must know Mr Yan.
“严进士同胡大先生一定有交情的，

One letter saying that everyone should help a good cause, and Yan will let you use the house as it stands.
一封信去，说做好事，人人有份，房子定在那里，你尽管用。

Then you will have no control over it.
到那时候，轮不着你作主，

Even if you do, you cannot shut the gates and attend to our own business.
就能作主，也不能关起大门来做我们自己的事！

Think!”
你倒想呢？”

Zhu Baoru woke as if from a dream.
朱宝如如梦方醒，

“True, true!
“不错，不错！”他问：

How do you think we should begin?”
“那么，照你看，应该怎么样下手？

“There is no hurry.
““这件事不要急！

Think three moves ahead before taking one.
走一步，想三步，

If we proceed steadily and safely, the gold and jewels underground cannot fly away.”
只要稳当踏实，金银珠宝埋在那里，飞不掉的……”


Counting on her fingers, Mrs Zhu laid out the steps.
朱家老婆扳着手指，第一、第二的，讲得头头是道：

First, they must keep Hu Xueyan satisfied and prevent the eastern-city gruel kitchen from passing into anyone else’s hands.
第一，胡雪岩那里要稳住，东城设粥厂的事，不能落到旁人手里。

Second, when Wang Peili arrived, they must find out how much money he had brought, and whether it was silver or valuables.
第二，等王培利来了，看他手上有多少钱，是现银，还是金珠细软？

If valuables, how could they be sold?
如果是金珠细软，如何变卖？

They must raise enough to take the house in pledge before proceeding to the third step.
总要筹足了典屋的款子，才谈到第三步。

That was for Zhu Baoru to go to Shanghai himself, secure an introduction to the jinshi, and negotiate.
第三步便是由朱宝如亲自到上海去一趟，托人介绍严进士谈判典屋。

What he said would depend on the circumstances.
至于如何说词，看情形而定。

“In a word, everything must be kept secret.
“总而言之一句话，这件事要做得隐秘。

Do not use Mr Hu lightly.
胡大先生这着棋，不要轻易动用，

He is too powerful a piece on the board: once brought into play, he cannot be recalled, and the whole business will be ruined.” Zhu Baoru agreed repeatedly.
因为这着棋力量太大、能放不能收，事情就坏了。”朱宝如诺诺连声。

Whenever Hu asked about the kitchen, he replied that he was still looking for suitable premises.
遇到胡雪岩问起粥厂的事，他总是以正在寻觅适当房屋作回。

Since the proposal had come from Zhu himself, Hu did not press him when he seemed unenthusiastic.
这件事本就是朱宝如的提议，他不甚起劲，胡雪岩也就不去催问了。


A few days later Wang Peili wrote to say when he would take the passenger boat.
不多几天王培利有了回信，说明搭乘航船的日期。

On the appointed day, Zhu Baoru and his adopted son met him and brought him home, where Jiaju introduced his adoptive mother.
扣准日子，朱宝如带着义子去接到了，带回家中，朱家驹为他引见了义母。

The couple deliberately withdrew to let the two men talk privately.
朱宝如夫妇便故意避开，好让他们密谈。

Jiaju described how he had met Zhu Baoru and warmly praised his adoptive mother’s attentiveness.
朱家驹细谈了结识朱宝如的经过，又盛赞义母如何体帖。

Wang Peili was more discerning.
王培利的眼光比朱家驹厉害，

“Your adoptive father seems a decent man,” he said.
“你这位干爹，人倒不坏。”他说：

“But that mother of yours looks a formidable character.”
“不过你这位义母我看是很厉害的角色。”

“She is certainly shrewd, but I have seen nothing formidable about her.”
“精明是精明的，你说厉害，我倒看不出来。”

“Tell people only three-tenths of what is in your heart; never lay it all bare.
“逢人只说三分话，未可全抛一片心。”王培利问：

Have you found the place?”
“地方找到了没有？”

“Father says he has seen one that looks very like it.
“听我干爹说，有一处地方很象，

He is making inquiries.
正在打听，

We should have an answer in a few days.”
大概这几天会有结果。”

“怎么是听说？

莫非你自己没有去找过？”

“你带来多少款子？”

等寻到地方再说。”

We are depending on them.

自己不诚，怎么能期望人家以诚待我？”

Wang considered.
王培利想了一下说：

“I have an idea.”
“我有办法。”

是何办法呢？他一直不开口。

朱家驹忍不住催问：“是什么办法，

你倒说出来商量。”

我们人地生疏，

他要欺侮我们很容易，所以一定要想个保护自己的办法。”王培利说：

“我想住到客栈里去，

比较好动手。”

“We must guard against others.
“防人之心不可无。

We are strangers here, with no local connections.
我们人地主疏，

他要欺侮我们很容易，所以一定要想个保护自己的办法。”王培利说：

I think I had better stay at an inn.
“我想住到客栈里去，

It will be easier to do what is necessary.”
比较好动手。”

“动什么手？”

“你不要管。

你只要编造个什么理由，让我能住到客栈里就行了。”

“这容易。”朱家驹将他的义父母请了出来，说是王培利有两个朋友从上海来找他。

在家不甚方便，想到客栈里去住几天，等会过朋友以后，再搬回来住。

朱宝如夫妇哪里会想到，刚到的生客，已对他们发生猜疑，

所以一口答应，在东街上替王培利找了一家字号名为“茂兴”的小客栈，

安顿好了，当夜在朱家吃接风酒，

谈谈身世经历，不及其他。

到得二更天饭罢，朱家老婆拿出来一床半新半旧、洗得极干净的铺盖，

你拿了这床铺盖，送你的朋友去。”

“你看，”忠厚老实的朱家驹，脸上象飞了金似地对王培利说：“我干妈想得这样周到。”

其实，这句话恰好加重了王培利的戒心。

到得茂兴客栈，他向朱家驹说：“你坐一坐，就回去吧。

你干妈心计很深，

不要让她疑心。”

“我干妈还要给我做媒，是她娘家的侄女儿。”

Wang smiled faintly.
王培利淡淡一笑，

“Let us get rich first.”
“等发了财再说。”

He left unspoken another thought: Do not fall for a beauty trap.
他还有句没有说出来的话：你不要中了美人计。

“现在谈谈正事。”朱家驹问：

王培利沉吟了一会。

He was not entirely confident of Jiaju either and wondered whether to conceal his secret plan from him as well.
他对朱家驹亦有些不大放心，所以要考虑自己的密计，是不是索性连他亦一并瞒过？

Why do you say nothing?”

We come from the same village and have shared hardship.

真可以说是生死祸福分不开的弟兄。

可是现在照我看，你对你干爹、干妈，看得比我来得亲。”

My parents are yours too.
朱家驹答说：“我的干爹、干妈，也就是你的，

要发财，大家一起发。

你不要多疑心。”

Wang could not immediately refute him, but one thing was clear.
王培利一时无法驳倒他的话，但有一点是很清楚的，

Further persuasion might make Jiaju think he was trying to drive a wedge between him and his parents.
如果继续再劝下去，朱家驹可能会觉得他在挑拨他们义父母与义子之间的关系。

If their friendship cracked before the undertaking began, and Jiaju sided with the couple, Wang would be isolated in unfamiliar surroundings and certain to lose.
大事尚未着手，感情上先有了裂痕，如果朱家驹索性靠向他的义父母，自己人单势孤，又在陌生地方，必然吃亏。


So he put on a look of understanding.
于是他摆出领悟的脸色说道：

“You are right.

Your parents are mine too.
你的干爹、干妈，就是我的，

I shall talk to your father tomorrow.
明天我同你干爹谈。

Have you brought your half of the map?”
你的半张图带来了没有？”

“No.
“没有。

It is too important.
那样重要的东西，

Now that I have a home, naturally I keep it there.
既有了家了，自然放在家里。”朱家驹又问：

Did you want to see it now?”

“No, no.
“不是，不是。”

My original plan was to make a false map.
王培利说：“我本来的打算是，另外造一张假图，

下面锯齿形的地方，一定要把你那半张图覆在上面，细心剪下来，才会严丝合缝，不露半点破绽。

But there is no need now.”
现在就不必了。”

“What an ingenious idea!”
“你的法子真绝。”

Believing that Wang had accepted his advice and regained confidence in the couple, Jiaju was delighted.
朱家驹以为王培利听他的开导，对朱宝如夫妇恢复了信心，很高兴地说：

“你住下去就知道了，

My parents really are good people.”
我的干爹、干妈真的很好。”

“我知道。”

“我要走了。”

朱家驹起身说道：“明天上午来接你去吃中饭。”

明天见。”

Wang caught his arm.
王培利拉住他又说，

“I did misunderstand the old couple, but no longer.

我们刚刚两个人说的话，你千万不要跟他们说，不然我就不好意思住下去了。”

“我明白，我明白。”

Jiaju nodded repeatedly.
朱家驹连连点头，

“I am not a three-year-old with no sense of what matters.”
“我又不是三岁小孩子，不识得轻重。”


After Jiaju left, Wang Peili went to the office, borrowed a writing brush and inkstone from the clerk, and shut himself in to “do what was necessary.”
等朱家驹一走，王培利到柜房里，跟帐户借了一副笔砚，关起门来“动手“。

先从箱子里取出来一本《缙绅录》，将夹在书页中的一张纸取出来，

摊开在桌上，这张纸便是地图的一半。

王培利剔亮油灯，伏案细看，

图上画着“川”字形的三个长方块，上面又有一个横置而略近于正方形的方块，

这个方块的正中，画出骰子大小的一个小方块，中间圆圆的一点便是藏宝之处。

After studying it for some time, he began to grind ink.
看了好一会，开始磨墨，

He tested the shade on scrap paper until it matched the original, then added four more die-sized squares at arbitrary points, placing a dot in each.
以笔懦染。在废纸上试了墨色浓淡，试到与原来的墨迹相符，方始落笔，在地图上随意又添画了四个骰子大的方块，一样也在中间加上圆点。

Looking again, he could still distinguish the new ink from the old.
画好了再看，墨色微显新旧，

A close inspection would give him away.
仔细分辨，会露马脚。

王培利沉吟了一会，将地国覆置地上，再取一张骨牌凳，倒过来压在地上，

然后闩上了房门睡觉。

First thing next morning he examined the half-map.
第二天一早起来。头一件事便是看那半张地图，

It was covered in dust.
上面已沾满了灰尘，

很小心地吹拂了一番，浮尘虽去，墨色新旧的痕迹，都被遮掩得无从分辨了。

Pleased with himself, he felt that these decoys would fool even Jiaju.
王培利心里很得意，这样故布疑阵，连朱家驹都可瞒过，

He could now show the map openly.
就不妨公开了。

于是收好了图，等朱家驹来了，一起上附近茶馆洗脸吃点心。

或典或买，如果价钱谈得拢，马上可以成交。”

你看，这个数目差不多吧？”

My notes are all for a thousand taels.

要到阜康去换成小票子。”

找到茶博士，问明阜康钱庄在清和坊大街，两人惠了茶资，安步当车寻了去。

It was a considerable distance from East Street, and finding it took some effort.
东街到清河坊大街着实有一段路，很辛苦地找到了，

大票换成小票，顺便买了四色水礼，雇小轿回客栈。

“直接到我干爹家，岂不省事？”

“你不是说，你干爹会问到地图？”

I had better bring it and see how things develop.”
王培利说：“不如我带了去，到时候看情形说话。”

“Yes, that is better.”
“对！这样好。”

Back at the inn, Wang took the Directory of Officials, and they went together to the Zhus’.
于是，先回客栈，王培利即将那本《缙绅录》带在身边，一起到了朱家。


It was just time for the noon gun.
恰是“放午炮”的时候，

Mrs Zhu had stewed a plump chicken and was waiting for them.
朱家老婆已炖好了一只肥鸡，在等他们吃饭了。

“Uncle Zhu, Auntie Zhu,” Wang said, setting the gifts on the table and offering a red envelope from Fukang with both hands, “I came in such a hurry that I brought nothing for you.
“朱大叔、朱大婶，”王培利将四色水礼，放在桌上，探手入怀，取出一个由阜康要来的红封袋，双手奉上，“这回来得匆匆忙，没有带东西来孝敬两位，

I can only offer money instead.”
只好折干了。”

“That will never do!”
“没有这个道理。”

Zhu Baoru pushed it away.
朱宝如双手外推，

“You have bought these foods, and we will say no more about them.
“这四样吃食东西，你买也就买来了，不去说它，

折干就不必了。

无功不受禄。”

“不，不！以后打扰的时候还多，请两老不要客气。”王培利又说：

Jiaju’s parents are my elders too.

朱宝如终于收了下来，抽个冷子打开来一看，是一张二百两银子的银票，

He was delighted.
心里很高兴，

Wang evidently had plenty of money.
看样子王培利带的钱不少，

Even if they found no treasure, there would be ways to squeeze more out of him.
便掘宝不成，总还可以想法子多挖他几文出来。

一面吃饭，一面谈正事，

“找到一处地方，很象。

朱宝如问：“你那半张地图带来了没有？”

“带来了。”

王培利问：“朱大叔要不要看看？”

“不忙，不忙！”

朱宝如说：“吃完饭再看。”

到得酒醉饭饱，朱家老婆泡来一壶极酽的龙井，为他们解酒消食。

As they returned to the matter, Wang asked Jiaju to fetch his half of the map and took his own from the Directory of Officials.
一面喝茶，一面又谈到正事，王培利关照朱家驹把他所保存的半张地图取出来，然后从《缙绅录》中取出他的半张，

They laid the pieces on the square table and slowly fitted the jagged edges together.
都平铺在方桌，犬牙相错的两端，慢慢凑拢，

但见严丝合缝，吻合无间，再看墨色浓淡，亦是丝毫不差，

确确实实是一分为二的两个半张。

Wang had deliberately staged this display, using the genuine to conceal the false.
这是王培利有意如此做作，这样以真掩假，

It was not merely to deceive Zhu Baoru.
倒还不光是为了瞒过朱宝如，

Above all, he wanted to test Jiaju’s memory.
主要的还在试探朱家驹的记忆，

They had divided the map hurriedly, without giving Jiaju a close look.
因为当初分割此图时，是在很匆遽的情况之下，朱家驹并未细看，

Yet even a glance might have left him with the memory of a single die-sized square.
但即令只看了一眼，图上骰子大的小方块，只有一个，他可能还记得，

If he noticed the additions, he would realize that Wang had tampered with the map to protect them against Zhu Baoru.
看真图上多了几个小方块，必然想到他已动过手脚，而目的是在对付朱宝如，

Surely he would keep that to himself, leaving them to discuss it afterward.
当然摆在心里，不会说破，事后谈论，再作道理。

If he remembered nothing, matters would be easier still.
倘或竟不记得，那就更容易处置了。

Wang watched him closely.
因而在一起看图时，他很注意朱家驹的表情，

To his slight surprise, Jiaju looked as bewildered as his adoptive father: neither understood what he saw.
使得他微觉意外的是，朱家驹虽感困惑，而神情与他的义父相同：莫名其妙。


“The little squares must mark buried treasure,” Zhu Baoru said.
“画了小方块的地方，当然是指藏宝之处！”朱宝如问：

“Why are there so many?
“怎么会有这么多地方？

Was there too much to bury in one place?”
莫非东西太多，要分开来埋？”

“That is possible,” Wang replied.
“这也说不定。”王培利回答。

“No,” Jiaju interrupted.
“不会。”朱家驹接口说道：

“I know there was only one large wooden chest.”
“我知道只有一口大木箱。”

Wang’s heart gave a jump.
此言一出，王培利心中一跳，

His deception was close to exposure, but he was quick-witted and adapted without changing expression.
因为快要露马脚了，不过他也是很厉害的角色，声色不动地随机应变。

“Then only one of the sites can be genuine.
“照这样说，那就只有一处地方是真的。”他说：

The others must be decoys.”
“其余的是故意画上去的障眼法。”

“Exactly!” Zhu Baoru agreed completely.
“不错，不错！”朱宝如完全同意他的解释：

“I once heard a storyteller recount the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
“前回‘听大书’说《三国演义》，

Cao Cao had seventy-three false tombs.
曹操有疑家七十三。

Perhaps they copied that idea in case the map was lost.”
大概当初怕地图万一失落，特为仿照疑家的办法，布个障眼法。”

Wang nodded and glanced at Jiaju, who still looked puzzled and seemed to be thinking.
王培利点点头，顺势瞄了朱家驹一眼，只见他的困惑依旧，而且似乎在思索什么，

Wang began to fear that his cleverness might backfire.
心里不免有些嘀咕，只怕弄巧成拙，

He was also deeply annoyed with Jiaju, who was as stupid as a block of wood and had no notion of cooperation.
而且也对朱家驹深为不满，认为他笨得跟木头一样，根本不懂如何叫联手合作。

“Sometimes in Shanghai I would take the map out and wonder about it too.
“我在上海，有时候拿图出来看看，也很奇怪，

I regretted not asking at the time.
懊悔当时没有问个明白。

Still, as long as the location is right, it does not matter whether only one spot is genuine or the treasure was divided.
不过，只要地点不错，不管它是只有一处真的也好，是分开来藏宝也好，

At worst it means a little extra work.
大不了多费点事，

The things cannot get away.”
东西总逃不走的。

Jiaju seemed reassured.
“听得这一说，朱家驹似乎释然了，

“Father, let us see the house.”
“干爹，”他说：“我们去看房子。”

“Very well.
“好！

Come along.”
走吧！”

回头关帝庙，向朱家驹使个眼色，以平常脚步，慢慢走了过去，当然是在测量距离。

听这一说，王培利与朱家驹连头都不敢抬，跟着朱宝如回家。

Since the capture of Jinling, the court had announced that those forced to join the Taiping ranks would not be prosecuted.
原来朝廷自攻克金陵之后，虽对太平军有所谓“胁从不问”的处置，

Nevertheless, local militia organizations responsible for investigating suspicious persons often harassed them.
但同时“盘查奸宄”，责有攸归的地方团练，亦每每找他们的麻烦，

A single disagreement could lead to their being taken to the militia office for punishment.
一言不合，便可带到“公所”去法办，

It was therefore natural that talk of attracting attention alarmed Jiaju and Wang.
所以朱家驹与王培利听说有人注目，便会紧张。

到家吃了晚饭，朱家驹送王培利回客栈，

朱家驹的印象中那下半幅图，似乎干干净净，没有那么多骰子大小的小方块。

王培利由这一次共事的经验，发觉朱家驹人太老实，

他也相信“老实乃无用之别名”这个说法，所以决定有所保留，

因为我用脚步测量过，那里坐东朝西，

到晚来，夫妇俩在枕上细语，秘密商议了大半夜，定下一条连环计，第一套无中生有，第二套借刀杀人，第三套过河拆桥，

“不干净？
